Four operations over OpenAPI 3.0, bearer authenticated, with a free tier and an x402 machine-payment surface on Base.

providers.name: A5X
providers.description: A5X S.A. is a next-generation derivatives and futures exchange and clearing house being built for the Brazilian market, founded in 2023 in Sao Paulo by former XP executives Carlos Ferreira Filho and Karel Luketic together with Nilson Monteiro (Ideal) and Julian Chediak. It is an asset-light, technology-first venue running on London Stock Exchange Group trading, clearing and market surveillance technology, and it has raised R$385 million (about USD 72.6 million) from investors including IMC Trading, Jump Trading Group, Optiver, XTX Markets and ABN AMRO Clearing. Its listed, financially settled contract set covers stock index futures and options (local and offshore), single stock futures and options, currency futures and options, local interest rate futures and options, and cryptocurrency futures, with European-style options exercised automatically at expiry. For integrators, A5X publishes a technical developer portal covering connectivity (site-to-site VPN, LAN-to-LAN, cross connect at Equinix SP3, AWS Direct Connect), order entry, market data, drop copy and post-trade settlement, allocation, positioning and risk interfaces over FIX and binary protocols. The portal requires a login, so those specifications are not publicly readable.

providers.name: Aatmunn
providers.description: Aatmunn (formerly Guardhat, founded 2014 in Detroit and headquartered in Livonia, Michigan) is an industrial safety and asset intelligence platform for frontline and deskless workers. Its SPANR / Industrial Internet of People (IIoP) platform unifies workers, workplaces, and assets into one real-time system, connecting devices from any manufacturer and layering AI-driven insights for predictive hazard detection, emergency response, inspections, and compliance. Products include Inspections, Lone Worker Safety, Human Condition Monitoring, Gas Detection, Control Access Zoning, and Asset Tracking, serving 250+ companies across high-risk industries such as oil & gas, chemicals, mining & infrastructure, manufacturing, utilities, and warehousing & logistics. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and is maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; Aatmunn publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Affect Therapeutics
providers.description: Affect Therapeutics (operating as "Affect") is a US digital health company founded in 2020 that delivers app-based outpatient and intensive outpatient treatment for substance use and mental health disorders. Care is delivered entirely through a mobile application on iOS and Android and combines contingency management, cognitive behavioral therapy, medication-assisted treatment, psychiatry, peer support and care coordination. The program treats alcohol, opioid, methamphetamine, cocaine, cannabis and prescription stimulant use disorders alongside anxiety, depression, OCD, PTSD, bipolar disorder and postpartum depression, and is offered to Medicaid and commercial insurance members across multiple US states. Affect is CARF-accredited and operates as a HIPAA-covered telehealth provider. It publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification; its software is delivered exclusively as an end-user patient application.

providers.name: Agent Experiences
providers.description: Agent Experiences provides educational resources and consulting on Agent Experience Optimization (AXO) and Agentic Experience Design (AXD). Published by PrimeCo, the site offers guides, scoring tools, and analysis to help websites and applications become readable and actionable by AI agents, improving AI citation and discovery. It covers principles, architecture, and practical steps for optimizing content, structuring data, and designing interfaces that enable intelligent agents to interact with digital services on behalf of users.

providers.name: AggREIgator
providers.description: AggREIgator is a software platform for real estate wholesalers, offering tools to calculate ARV, MAO, exit strategies, and manage deals from offer to assignment. The portal provides free calculators, pricing plans, and a marketplace for investors, supporting operations across many US states while ensuring compliance and providing extensive documentation and support resources.

providers.name: Amazfit
providers.description: Zepp Health, operating under the Amazfit brand, develops wearable devices and health-focused applications that empower individuals to monitor and improve their well‑being. Their product lineup includes smartwatches, fitness trackers, and a companion mobile app offering features such as heart‑rate monitoring, sleep analysis, activity tracking, and personalized health insights. Zepp Health emphasizes seamless integration of hardware and software to deliver an engaging user experience that inspires joy and promotes a healthier lifestyle.

providers.name: AramisAuto
providers.description: Aramisauto is the French retail brand of Aramis Group (Euronext Paris: ARAMI, majority-owned by Stellantis), founded in 2001 by Nicolas Chartier and Guillaume Paoli. It sells used, 0km and new cars online as a mandataire, reconditions vehicles in its own refurbishing centres, runs a trade-in service ("reprise") that pays within 24 hours, and arranges financing (crédit, LOA, LLD) through Cetelem, Socram, PSA Banque, Lizauto and Opteven. Aramisauto operates no public developer programme: there is no portal, no OpenAPI and no SDK. What it does publish is machine-readable and first-party — ten JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts at schemas.aramis.group covering the vehicle catalog (search request/response, the multi-language ingest model, the single-language read model served from "the preheated cache for the APIs", and the search-index projection) plus the four-stage collect/map/filter/enrich configuration contracts third-party marketplace sellers are onboarded with — and an llms.txt at the site root. Its API vhost, api.aramisauto.com, answers every anonymous request with an HTTP 403 demanding a WSSE (WS-Security UsernameToken) credential.

providers.name: Atly
providers.description: Atly provides context‑aware place recommendations, turning fragmented local signals into structured, explainable place intelligence. Users can specify intents such as "quiet café for work" or "dog‑friendly spot" and receive ranked matches with scores and reasons. The platform powers personal discovery today and enables partners—travel, hospitality, and marketplace services—to embed intelligent location insights into their products. Atly’s API offers place scoring, intent parsing, and rich attribute data, supporting AI assistants, travel planners, and location‑based applications.

providers.name: Auctria
providers.description: Auctria provides a cloud‑based fundraising platform that helps nonprofits run auctions, ticketed events, and donation campaigns. Its solution includes event websites, payment processing, mobile apps, and analytics to streamline donor engagement and maximize fundraising outcomes. The platform is designed for ease of use, offering tools for event creation, ticket sales, auction management, and comprehensive reporting, all accessible via a web interface.

providers.name: Autumn (autumn-js, billing)
providers.description: Autumn provides an open-source billing infrastructure built on top of Stripe, offering usage‑based billing, credits, entitlements, and subscription state through a simple API. It serves AI startups and other SaaS companies needing a unified system of record for subscriptions, metering, and feature access, while delegating payment processing to Stripe. The platform includes endpoints such as attach, check, and track, and is documented with quickstart guides and API references.

providers.name: Avatar Factory
providers.description: Avatar Factory provides an AI-powered platform that lets users create and monetize AI influencer avatars. Users can generate short video reels in minutes using scripts that analyze over 50 million videos. The service offers a $1 three‑day trial, monthly plans starting at $39, and a help center with guides, pricing details, and support resources.

providers.name: Bitácora
providers.description: Bitácora is a web-based design platform that enables teams to create, review, and hand off interface designs directly in code. Users can dictate changes on screens, collaborate with clients through a portal, and generate production-ready assets. The service offers a free tier and multiple paid plans, catering to freelancers, agencies, and enterprises seeking streamlined design handoff workflows.

providers.name: BuildZoom
providers.description: BuildZoom connects homeowners and property owners with vetted local general contractors, using data-driven matching across profiles for 4M+ licensed contractors and construction-permit history spanning hundreds of millions of projects. Alongside the contractor marketplace, BuildZoom operates the Building Permit Database (buildzoomdata.com) — a normalized dataset of 350M+ building permits covering 25+ years, 2,400 jurisdictions, and 90% of the US population, plus 6M+ licensed contractors. That data is delivered through bulk data exports (weekly/monthly, full and incremental), a RESTful Data API with batch requests and sub-second latency for property permit history and contractor license/permit lookups, a Data Explorer web app, and a Permit Map. BuildZoom is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Cape
providers.description: Cape is a privacy-first U.S. mobile carrier (mobile virtual network operator) that leases physical tower capacity from major operators but builds and runs its own mobile core and SIMs, enabling privacy-enhancing controls that traditional carriers cannot offer. Features include daily identifier rotation (changing SIM ID numbers to disrupt persistent tracking), minimal data collection, disappearing call logs, secondary phone numbers, SIM-swap protection, network lock, and secure global roaming. Founded in 2022 by John Doyle and Nicholas Espinoza and headquartered in Arlington, Cape serves privacy-conscious consumers, enterprises, and U.S. government agencies, and has raised roughly $190M from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Bain Capital Ventures, IVP, and Costanoa Ventures. Cape publishes no public developer API; this profile is an API Evangelist network company record enriched from Cape's public web surface.

providers.name: Capital Workbench
providers.description: Capital Workbench provides a public-company analysis workspace that delivers reasoning and analytics built on publicly available filings and market disclosures. The platform offers corporate finance intelligence, enabling users to explore financial data, performance metrics, and analytical tools for public companies.

providers.name: contentsweep-ai
providers.description: Adult creator content protection and leaked-content help. Sweep will find leaked content and remove it on your behalf. Content protection for adult creators starts with a private possible-match count and careful review before any DMCA takedown request. The service offers a free scan, ongoing monitoring, unlimited takedown requests, delisting notices, and 24/7 availability. Pricing is a clear $40 per month. The platform includes resources, FAQ, and support for independent creators.

providers.name: DigitalBPM
providers.description: DigitalBPM provides a no‑code automation platform that enables businesses to integrate SaaS applications without writing code. It offers a visual workflow builder, pre‑built connectors for popular services, and the ability to create custom integrations. Targeted at small to medium‑size teams, DigitalBPM aims to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and accelerate digital transformation across enterprises.

providers.name: Double Robotics
providers.description: Double Robotics builds telepresence robots for hybrid work and education, best known for the self-driving Double 3 videoconferencing robot and the earlier iPad-based Double 2. Its developer program spans three surfaces: the Double 3 SDK (a local command-and-event API exposed over a Unix domain socket on the robot, covering base movement, navigation, PTZ cameras, depth sensors, WebRTC calling, and standby/sidebar apps), iOS SDKs for the Double 2 (Basic Control and Camera Kit), and a Fleet REST API for programmatic access to fleet-management data such as robots, users, call logs, and visitor passes. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched against the company's public developer surface.

providers.name: DXchange.io
providers.description: DXchange.io is a digital data integration platform that enables enterprises to unlock their data for new digital experiences, offerings, and markets. It provides API management, managed file transfer, and B2B integration solutions as part of the Axway portfolio, helping organizations connect applications, partners, and services securely and efficiently.

providers.name: Ecamm
providers.description: Ecamm provides powerful live streaming and video production software for macOS, enabling creators to stream, record, and present with professional features such as multi-camera support, scene composition, green screen effects, and integration with platforms like Stream Deck. Their flagship product, Ecamm Live, offers a user-friendly interface for live broadcasting, podcasting, and video creation, targeting both individual creators and businesses seeking high-quality video content.

providers.name: EDGE
providers.description: EDGE provides tokenized intelligence and automated trading strategies for users. The platform offers a trading edge through diversified investment models, allowing users to select risk levels and connect crypto wallets. It includes a free trial, portfolio rebalancing, and detailed performance tracking via a web dashboard.

providers.name: Energy Robotics
providers.description: Energy Robotics GmbH, now trading as Korial, is a Darmstadt, Germany enterprise AI platform (spun out of TU Darmstadt robotics research) for fully autonomous industrial operations. It is hardware-agnostic, unifying mixed-vendor robots, legged and tracked ground robots, drones, fixed cameras, and field sensors into a single governed AI operating layer that turns live telemetry into verified insight and orchestrated action across oil & gas, chemicals, power & utilities, and critical infrastructure. The platform spans four modules: Kore (the AI core with LLM, agentic workflows, embedded AI skills, and fleet/device supervision), Connect (an integration backbone exposing bidirectional governed APIs into ERP, EAM, SCADA, historians and ICS/OT systems), Recreate (digital twins and mission simulation), and Sustain (support, onboarding, and managed mission execution). Korial reports 1,000,000+ autonomous inspections, 100+ global deployments, and named customers including Shell, bp, Repsol, Petrobras, Pluspetrol, Chevron, E.ON, Evonik, BASF, and Merck. Rebranded from Energy Robotics GmbH on 4 May 2026.

providers.name: Enveda
providers.description: Enveda (Enveda Biosciences) is a Boulder, Colorado based clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2019 that discovers medicines by decoding the chemistry of the natural world. It combines high-throughput mass spectrometry, metabolomics, robotics and machine learning — including PRISM, a foundation model trained on more than a billion small- molecule mass spectra — to build a searchable library of plant-derived molecules and translate them into drug candidates. Enveda has raised over $360M across Series B, C and D rounds from Premji Invest, Kinnevik, Lux Capital, Dimension and Sanofi, reached unicorn status in 2026, and runs FDA-cleared clinical programs including ENV-294 (atopic dermatitis and asthma), ENV-308 (obesity) and ENV-6946 (inflammatory bowel disease). Enveda publishes no product or developer API; the machine-readable surface on enveda.com is a published llms.txt plus the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) that serves the company newsroom, In-Veda blog, leadership profiles, clinical-trial site directory and media library as JSON, alongside a WordPress MCP Adapter endpoint that is present but authentication-gated. Its open science is published as research code and data in the github.com/enveda organization.

providers.name: Expressable
providers.description: Expressable is an online speech therapy platform based in Austin, Texas that connects children and adults with licensed speech-language pathologists for one-on-one virtual teletherapy sessions across the United States. Founded by speech-language pathologist Leanne Sherred, the company treats speech delays, stuttering, apraxia, aphasia, dysarthria, autism-related communication challenges, voice and swallowing disorders, accent modification and gender-affirming voice training through a client portal at app.expressable.com, and works with both insurance plans and private pay. Expressable is a direct-to-consumer and payer-facing healthcare services company: it publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: filehub GmbH
providers.description: filehub GmbH provides a no‑code automation platform that connects apps, portals and software to automate document flows such as invoice download, data extraction, archiving and workflow management. It serves finance, procurement, sales and operations teams with templates, integrations and compliance‑ready processes, offering a free plan and paid tiers for enterprises.

providers.name: Fort Robotics
providers.description: Fort Robotics provides a trust layer for physical AI, delivering safety and remote control solutions for robotics and autonomous systems. Their modular platform includes hardware like Safe Remote Control Pro, software such as FORT Manager, and services ranging from safety architecture to fleet analytics. Backed by Lemnos Labs, the company focuses on integrating safety into AI-driven physical devices, enabling secure deployment and operation across industries.

providers.name: Infinitum
providers.description: Infinitum (formerly Infinitum Electric) is an Austin, Texas motor manufacturer, founded in 2016 by Ben Schuler, that builds the Aircore EC+ family of air-core printed-circuit-board (PCB) stator electric motors along with integrated fan and pump systems, Active Front End (AFE) drives, power generation packages and off-road traction motors for data centers, commercial and industrial buildings, water and wastewater treatment, agriculture and mobility. Its software surface is operator tooling rather than a developer platform: the I-con motor control application for commissioning, monitoring and diagnostics, a browser-based Motor Selection Tool (MST) and Fan Selection Tool (FST), an IoT kit for telemetry, and BACnet, Modbus and analog/digital field integration on the motor itself. Infinitum does document an HTTP API for the selection tools - fan selection, motor selection and fan chart endpoints - but the reference is served behind an account sign-in and the company states that detailed API documentation and advanced integration require a signed NDA and a commercial agreement, so no public contract is reachable.

providers.name: InfinitySwap
providers.description: InfinitySwap is now Bitfinity Network, a next-generation Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) that serves as a Layer 2 for Bitcoin and Bitcoin on-chain assets, built on the Internet Computer (ICP). Bitfinity delivers high-throughput (1000+ TPS) EVM execution with full Ethereum tooling compatibility (MetaMask, Remix, Hardhat) exposed through a standard Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoint, letting developers deploy Solidity smart contracts and bridge BTC, ckBTC, and other assets. The project also maintains the Bitfinity Wallet, the Bitfusion bridging SDK, canister SDKs for the Internet Computer, and the InfinitySwap decentralized exchange heritage. Backed by Polychain, it targets DeFi builders who want Bitcoin-secured, EVM-compatible infrastructure.

providers.name: Interplay Learning
providers.description: Interplay Learning is an Austin, Texas edtech company delivering always-on, immersive skilled trades training through online video courses, 3D simulations, and VR for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, facilities maintenance, and solar. Its SkillMill platform has trained more than 500,000 workers to be job-ready, pairing hands-on simulations with custom learning paths, certification prep, and skill assessments. For employers, Interplay exposes an enterprise data-integration API plus SSO and LMS integrations so training data can flow into an organization's own systems; it publishes no public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI. Backed by Sierra Ventures. This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface.

providers.name: Jagex
providers.description: Jagex is a British video game developer and publisher headquartered in Cambridge, England, best known as the studio behind RuneScape and Old School RuneScape - persistent, community-shaped online worlds that have run for over two decades. Beyond the games, Jagex operates a set of public, read-only RuneScape web-data APIs: the Grand Exchange item price and catalogue endpoints (for both RuneScape and Old School RuneScape), the RuneScape and Old School RuneScape Hiscores, and the RuneMetrics player-profile service. These unauthenticated JSON and CSV endpoints power a large third-party ecosystem of price trackers, fan sites, clan tools, and community applications. Jagex was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners.

providers.name: Legacy
providers.description: Legacy is a United States direct-to-consumer male fertility company offering at-home sperm testing and sperm cryopreservation without a clinic visit. Customers order a collection kit online, provide a sample at home, and return it by free overnight shipping to Legacy's CLIA-certified, CLEP-approved laboratory, where results appear in a private client dashboard within 48 hours of receipt. Services span basic, standard, and advanced semen analysis (count, concentration, motility, morphology, and Halosperm sperm DNA fragmentation), STI testing, multi-year sperm storage bundles, and male fertility supplements. Legacy serves people trying to conceive and those preserving fertility ahead of a vasectomy, testosterone therapy, gender-affirming care, cancer treatment, or military deployment, and is in-network with selected insurers and employer fertility benefit programs. Legacy publishes no public developer API; its notable machine-readable surface is a first-party llms.txt written for AI answer engines.

providers.name: Lonti
providers.description: Lonti is a low-code integration and API platform offering Martini (iPaaS for building, consuming, publishing, and automating APIs), Bellini (data modeling and management), and Negroni (intelligent applications), enabling organizations to integrate data sources, create intelligent applications, and unlock the full potential of their data assets.

providers.name: Neomorph
providers.description: Neomorph, Inc. is a venture-backed, clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 5590 Morehouse Drive in San Diego, California, founded in 2020 to design molecular glue degraders — small molecules that bind an E3 ubiquitin ligase, reshape it into a new "neomorphic" surface, and recruit disease-causing proteins to the proteasome for destruction. The approach targets the roughly 85% of the human proteome considered undruggable by conventional small molecules because it needs no traditional binding pocket. Neomorph's platform reaches beyond cereblon to hundreds of E3 ligases and multiple proprietary degrons, which the company describes as the largest proprietary molecular glue target space in the field. Its lead programme, NEO-811, targets ARNT/HIF-1β in clear cell renal cell carcinoma and entered a Phase 1/2 trial in February 2026; the rest of the pipeline spans undisclosed solid tumors plus partnered oncology/immunology, neurology and cardiometabolic/rare disease targets. The company closed a $109 million Series A in December 2020 and a $100 million Series B in April 2026, and runs multi-target discovery collaborations with Novo Nordisk (February 2024), Biogen (October 2024) and AbbVie (January 2025). Philip Chamberlain, DPhil is CEO and Robert J. Hugin was appointed Chairman of the Board in May 2026. Neomorph runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, API reference, SDK or pricing. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind neomorph.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: Pathai
providers.description: PathAI is a healthcare artificial-intelligence company transforming pathology through machine learning. Its AISight Image Management System (IMS) and the AISight Link open API deliver AI-assisted disease detection, biomarker quantification, fields-of-interest and AI Impressions, and laboratory workflow integration for pathologists, hospital and reference labs, and biopharma research partners. AISight Link is an enterprise interoperability surface that connects AISight with third-party AI algorithms and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS/LIMS) over REST and HL7; PathAI does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs. The company is ISO 27001 certified and operates a vulnerability disclosure program. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 8vc.

providers.name: Pay.UK
providers.description: Pay.UK Limited is the recognised operator and standards body for the United Kingdom's interbank retail payment systems. It runs the domestic rails that move most of the money in the UK economy: Bacs (batch Direct Debit and Direct Credit), the Faster Payment System (24/7 real-time account-to-account payments), and the Image Clearing System for cheques, alongside the Current Account Switch Service. On top of the rails it owns industry overlay services including Confirmation of Payee (the API-based account name-checking service that fights Authorised Push Payment fraud) and Request to Pay, and through its Standards Authority it defines UK payments standards and the ISO 20022 migration underpinning the New Payments Architecture. Pay.UK is a scheme and standards operator, not a self-serve API platform: it publishes rulebooks, participation requirements, and ISO 20022 message specifications rather than an open public API, and its technical standards are distributed through the gated Standards Source and Faster Payment System Standards Library portals (single-login, registration required). Confirmation of Payee is a documented, API-based peer-to-peer scheme that participants and approved vendors implement against Pay.UK's technical standards. Home market is the United Kingdom.

providers.name: Pontera
providers.description: Pontera (formerly FeeX; legal entity Pontera Solutions Inc.) is a wealthtech platform that lets financial advisors securely manage, rebalance, and report on clients' held-away workplace-sponsored retirement accounts — 401(k), 401(a), 403(b), 457, TSP, and certain 529 plans — without a rollover. Accounts connect through a client-permissioned, credential-free workflow designed to avoid triggering custody under SEC Rule 206(4)-2, with an un-editable audit log for supervision. Pontera integrates with portfolio-management, reporting, billing, and supervision systems (Orion, Addepar, Black Diamond, Morningstar and others) but publishes no public developer API. Backed by ICONIQ Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Probely
providers.description: Probely is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: pulselake-co
providers.description: PulseLake provides an AI‑native operating system for market research and insights. The platform enables users to design studies, conduct AI‑led interviews, deploy research agents, capture institutional knowledge, and deliver results. Built to streamline the entire research workflow, PulseLake leverages large language models to automate questionnaire creation, data collection, analysis, and reporting, helping businesses accelerate insight generation while reducing manual effort. The service is delivered as a cloud‑based SaaS solution with integrations for data pipelines and collaboration tools.

providers.name: Redotpay
providers.description: RedotPay is a global stablecoin-based payment fintech that integrates blockchain solutions with traditional banking and finance infrastructures. The platform lets millions of people spend and send digital assets through a crypto-backed Visa card, a multi-currency wallet, P2P trading, international transfers, and stablecoin earning. Its developer-facing surface is agentic: a first-party Rust CLI (redotpay) and a local MCP server / Agent Skill (redotpay-payment) that let AI agents settle HTTP 402 "Payment Required" challenges over the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP), using OAuth2 device-flow login and per-payment idempotency against the production RedotPay API.

providers.name: SpeedyBrand
providers.description: SpeedyBrand (Speedy) is an AI-powered content marketing and SEO platform that helps businesses generate SEO-optimized blog posts, social media content, AI images, and Google Ads, along with keyword research, competitor analysis, technical SEO audits, and backlink recommendations. It generates content in 49+ languages across 100+ regions and offers one-click publishing plus integrations with WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Zapier, Google Search Console, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Speedy targets small businesses and enterprises seeking to scale organic traffic. The product is a no-code SaaS web application; no public developer API or API documentation is published as of this profile.

providers.name: StoryCut
providers.description: StoryCut provides an AI-powered platform that automatically creates short, viral‑ready videos for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and other social channels. Users upload long‑form video content and the service extracts key moments, adds dynamic captions, auto‑reframes, and applies transitions, all within seconds. The platform offers multiple caption styles, AI‑generated B‑Roll, and tools for branding, targeting creators, businesses and marketers looking to boost engagement across short‑form video platforms.

providers.name: Teem
providers.description: Teem is a workplace and meeting-room management platform for booking conference rooms and desks, coordinating spaces, and analyzing workplace utilization. Its product surface includes EventBoard room-display scheduling, LobbyConnect visitor management, desk and space booking, calendar integrations (Office 365, Google, Exchange), mobile and desktop apps, email plugins, and workplace analytics. Originally an independent, GV-backed company (formerly EventBoard), Teem was acquired by iOFFICE and is now delivered as part of Eptura's workplace portfolio. Teem historically exposed a developer API and webhooks for custom booking and provisioning workflows; developer and API access is now managed through the Eptura customer portal and Knowledge Center.

providers.name: Thinglink
providers.description: Thinglink is an educational technology company offering a no-code, AI-powered platform for creating and deploying immersive, interactive learning experiences. Users enrich images, videos, and 360deg / virtual-tour media with clickable "tags" that surface text, audio, links, and embedded content, producing multimodal content for XR, AR, and 360deg training that runs on any device. Thinglink serves K-12 and higher education as well as corporate learning and safety-training teams, and integrates with learning-management systems. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Thinglink publishes a public trust center (ISO 27001, GDPR) but exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Touchmark
providers.description: Touchmark is solving AI pricing - instead of AI being priced per token regardless of quality, Touchmark prices it by the quality, efficiency, and value of the output, so spend is fair, predictable, and tied to what you actually get. Applications emit the events they already produce (model outputs, tool calls, code diffs) with a base price, and Touchmark's out-of-band judge returns a quality-adjusted fair price for each event on a separate valuation stream. A Y Combinator Summer 2026 company founded by Ilia Bolgov and Roman Yanushevskyi in San Francisco; the TypeScript SDK (@touchmark/sdk) is in private beta.

providers.name: Tradeshift
providers.description: Babelway, now part of Tradeshift, provides a cloud‑based B2B integration platform that enables companies to exchange electronic documents such as invoices, purchase orders, and shipping notices across a wide range of standards (X12, EDIFACT, UBL, XML) and protocols (Peppol, AS2, FTP, SFTP, REST). The service offers a visual workflow builder, automated mapping, and a managed network for secure data transmission, helping businesses accelerate digital transformation and reduce manual processing costs.

providers.name: TrueCoach
providers.description: TrueCoach is a personal-training and remote-coaching platform for strength coaches, personal trainers, and physical therapists to deliver workouts online and train clients remotely. Started as Fitbot out of Techstars Boulder and now an Xplor Technologies brand, it offers a web app plus iOS and Android client apps with program and workout builders, a video exercise library, nutrition tracking, wearables data, Stripe-powered payments, a MyFitnessPal integration, and a Zapier connector — but publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Vergent Bioscience
providers.description: Vergent Bioscience is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, developing tumor-targeted fluorescent imaging agents for real-time intraoperative tumor visualization. Its lead compound, abenacianine for injection (VGT-309), is designed to let surgeons see previously undetected or difficult-to-find tumors during minimally invasive and robotic-assisted cancer surgery so that all tumor tissue can be removed in a single procedure. The company is first evaluating VGT-309 in lung cancer with the stated intent to expand into a wide range of solid tumors. Vergent publishes no developer program, no REST or GraphQL API, and no SDKs — it is a therapeutics and imaging-agent developer, not a software vendor. The only machine-readable surfaces on its own domain are a Wix-platform-generated llms.txt and a live, anonymous Model Context Protocol endpoint at /_api/mcp that exposes nine site-content and Wix-platform tools.

providers.name: wiastandards-com
providers.description: WIA Standards (World Certification Industry Association) is a global organization dedicated to developing, maintaining, and promoting certification standards across various industries. With 18 years of experience, it offers over 730 standards covering data exchange, API protocols, digital twins, and interoperability, supporting 24 categories and hundreds of simulators to foster universal compliance and innovation.

providers.name: Zoho Payments
providers.description: Zoho Payments provides a suite of online payment solutions, enabling businesses to accept payments via payment links, embedded checkout, subscriptions, and online stores. It offers APIs for creating payment links, processing transactions, managing subscriptions, and handling webhooks, with detailed developer documentation and SDKs across multiple languages.

providers.name: AddCal
providers.description: AddCal provides a suite of tools that let users create calendar event links, manage RSVPs, and embed calendars on websites. Their platform supports smart links, subscription calendars, and automated email invites, aiming to increase event attendance. The service offers a free tier with unlimited events and paid plans for advanced features, targeting event organizers, marketers, and developers needing seamless calendar integration.

providers.name: AlphaCreek
providers.description: AlphaCreek provides a hosted MCP that gives financial AI agents structured, citation‑ready SEC filing data. Covering over 6,000 US tickers, it offers fast retrieval, citation URLs, and seamless integration for Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT and other models, enabling compliance‑aware AI products without building their own filing pipelines.

providers.name: Ares Management
providers.description: Ares Management Corporation (NYSE: ARES) is a global alternative investment manager founded in 1997 and headquartered in Los Angeles, investing across credit, real estate, infrastructure, private equity and secondaries for institutional and private-wealth clients, with roughly $671 billion of assets under management, 60+ offices and about 4,400 employees as stated on its site in September 2026. Its corporate web presence moved from aresmgmt.com to ares.com. Ares publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract; its only investor-facing software surfaces are gated client portals.

providers.name: Barn & Willow
providers.description: Barn & Willow is a direct-to-consumer home furnishings brand specializing in made-to-measure window treatments — custom drapery, curtains, roman shades and blinds in natural fabrics such as linen, cotton and velvet. The company sells online at barnandwillow.com, a Shopify-hosted storefront, offering free fabric swatches, measuring guides and design consultations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, the storefront exposes a real agentic-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile and hosted MCP endpoint for agent-driven shopping, Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authentication, and an llms.txt agent-instructions document.

providers.name: Bauta
providers.description: Bauta enables users to instantly share AI‑generated content—presentations, reports, dashboards, or mini‑apps—from tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Cowork, or Codex as real, permanent web links. No account, no setup, and no login required. The service creates a shareable page in seconds, turning AI output into a link that can be embedded anywhere.

providers.name: BetBank
providers.description: BetBank provides Australian sports betting analytics, offering positive expected value (EV) bets, arbitrage opportunities, and real‑time odds from over 75 bookmakers. Users can track betting performance with a suite of professional tools, access detailed odds comparison, and leverage advanced analytics to improve wagering strategies across multiple sports.

providers.name: Billfold
providers.description: Billfold provides a cashless and contactless point‑of‑sale operating system for live events. Built by operators for operators, it unifies payments, devices, POS terminals, and workflow data into a single platform, offering real‑time revenue control, streamlined reporting, and enhanced guest experiences across festivals, conferences, venues, and venues of all sizes. The solution supports RFID, NFC, and traditional card payments, delivering a flexible, scalable, and secure event‑payment ecosystem.

providers.name: bitFlyer
providers.description: bitFlyer is a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange. Its bitFlyer Lightning trading platform exposes a public and private HTTP API at api.bitflyer.com for market data, account assets, deposits and withdrawals, and order placement.

providers.name: BlueSnap
providers.description: BlueSnap provides a Global Payment Orchestration Platform that enables businesses to accept payments worldwide through a single integration. It supports multiple payment methods, currencies, and regions, offering tools for fraud prevention, chargeback management, and compliance. BlueSnap also offers embedded payment solutions, subscription billing, invoicing, and robust reporting APIs for developers to integrate and automate payment workflows.

providers.name: Breathe Battery Technologies
providers.description: Breathe Battery Technologies is a UK battery software company, spun out of Imperial College London in 2019, that builds physics-based battery simulation, cell design, and adaptive charging software for OEM and cell engineering teams. Its API-delivered products — Breathe Design (cell design), Breathe Simulate (validated performance and degradation modelling), and Breathe Charge (embedded adaptive charging, shipped in Volvo EVs) — are consumed through first-party Python client libraries (breathe-simulate, breathe-design) and MATLAB/Simulink integration, backed by a token-authenticated cloud service. The company is venture-backed (Speedinvest among its investors) and profiled in the API Evangelist network for its developer-facing, programmatically accessible battery engineering platform.

providers.name: Broadcom
providers.description: Broadcom Inc. is a global technology company that designs, develops, and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. It serves customers in data center, networking, software, broadband, wireless, and storage markets, offering products such as ASICs, processors, and enterprise software. Broadcom’s portfolio includes networking chips, storage adapters, and a suite of software for security, management, and cloud services, positioning it as a key player in the digital transformation of enterprises worldwide.

providers.name: Budget Direct
providers.description: Budget Direct is one of Australia's largest direct-to-consumer general insurance brands, operated from Toowong, Queensland by Auto & General Services Pty Ltd (ABN 61 003 617 909) with general insurance products issued by Auto & General Insurance Company Limited (ABN 42 111 586 353), an APRA-authorised insurer. The brand sells car, home and contents, motorcycle, travel, pet and life insurance plus roadside assistance direct to Australian consumers online and by phone, with life cover underwritten by NobleOak Life Limited and travel cover by Zurich Australian Insurance Limited. Its parent, Auto & General, also white-labels personal lines through distribution partners including Qantas, Coles Insurance, ING and Oceania Insurance. Budget Direct publishes NO public self-serve developer portal and NO public API. Every candidate developer host was probed on 2026-07-25 — developer., developers., docs., api., partners., portal., broker., sandbox. and apis.budgetdirect.com.au all fail DNS resolution, and /developers, /developer, /api, /partners and /integrations all return HTTP 404 — while the full 738-URL sitemap contains no developer, API or integration page. Quote, bind, issue and claim (FNOL) exist only as consumer web journeys and a logged-in existing-customer self-service area; there is no documented machine surface for any of them. The parent domain does carry an Apigee gateway hostname (api.autogeneral.com.au, CNAME to autogeneral-prod.apigee.net, preconnect-hinted by the consumer site) but it is first-party and undocumented, with no developer portal, no OpenAPI, no ACORD/AL3 reference anywhere on either site, and partner integration handled as private commercial arrangements through Auto & General. This record is an honest stub: an APRA-regulated Australian carrier with no public API surface. The only machine-readable documents it serves are an RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt pointing at Auto & General's published external vulnerability disclosure policy, and the Apple and Android app-association files for its Fuel Discounts mobile app.

providers.name: CargoAi
providers.description: CargoAi is a Singapore-headquartered air cargo technology company that operates CargoMART, a digital marketplace where freight forwarders search routes, schedules, capacity and rates across 680+ airlines, book them, transmit the electronic air waybill, and track the shipment end to end. It sits in the middle of the air cargo chain as an aggregator between forwarders and their TMS vendors on one side and airline reservation and messaging systems on the other. Its API posture is genuinely public in documentation and sales-gated in access - the CargoCONNECT developer portal at cargoai.readme.io is open to anyone with no login and publishes a real OpenAPI 3.1 definition per operation, but an x-api-key is issued only after a commercial conversation with the CargoAi enterprise team. The published contract is a proprietary REST shape rather than an IATA ONE Record interface, though the payloads it carries are IATA-native - AWB numbers with airline prefixes, IATA airport and airline codes, Special Handling Codes, IATA cargo status event codes, FWB and FHL message content, and CO2 figures computed per IATA Recommended Practice 1678.

providers.name: Cinemark Holdings
providers.description: Cinemark Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CNK) is one of the largest motion picture exhibitors in the world, operating theatres across the United States and fifteen Latin American countries under the Cinemark, Century, Tinseltown, Rave and CineArts brands. Cinemark publishes no general-purpose public API and no machine-readable contract of any kind: as of September 2026 there is no OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, agent card, MCP server or .well-known document on any Cinemark-controlled host. Its Brazilian subsidiary does operate a branded Sensedia developer portal at developers.cinemark.com.br, but the API list and interactive API Browser are gated behind developer registration and most of the portal's public pages remain unmodified vendor template content. Showtime, ticketing and loyalty integrations are delivered through partner agreements and third-party aggregators such as Fandango, Atom Tickets and Movio.

providers.name: CLAP
providers.description: CLAP (주식회사 디웨일 / Dwhale Inc.) is a South Korean SaaS company offering an AI-powered, customizable performance management platform for enterprises. It covers the full performance lifecycle — multi-rater evaluations and calibration, OKR-style goal setting and alignment, continuous feedback and 1-on-1 meetings, and CLAP AI for diagnostics, feedback drafting, and automation — with tailored reporting and tool integrations. CLAP serves 1,000+ companies and claims to cut the HR time spent on performance management by up to 80%. The company is headquartered in Gangnam, Seoul, and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. CLAP publishes no public API or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and web properties.

providers.name: Connatix
providers.description: Connatix, now operating under the JWX brand, provides a video technology and monetization platform for streamers, publishers, and advertisers. Their solutions include streaming, video on demand, server‑side ad insertion, DRM, and data‑intelligence tools to help content creators maximize revenue and audience engagement across multiple channels.

providers.name: Dex
providers.description: A federated OpenID Connect provider that connects to other identity providers through connectors, enabling authentication for applications without handling passwords directly. Dex acts as a portal to other identity providers through connectors, making it easy to implement SSO across multiple providers. Dex is a single Go binary with pluggable storage and ships with a gRPC management API (api/v2/api.proto) for managing OAuth2 clients, passwords, connectors, and refresh tokens, alongside the standard set of OIDC endpoints.

providers.name: Draconic AI
providers.description: Draconic AI is an AI‑native trading terminal that synthesizes over 176 market measurements into a single analytical view across live Indian, cryptocurrency and commodity markets. Founded in October 2023 in Bangalore, it offers traders clarity through conversational AI, real‑time data, and integrated charting tools.

providers.name: Eridu
providers.description: Eridu is an AI networking infrastructure company founded in 2024 and headquartered at 12900 Saratoga Ave in Saratoga, California. It is building a clean-sheet network switch architecture — silicon, systems and software together — aimed at the interconnect bottleneck that limits how efficiently GPUs exchange data inside large AI training clusters and data centers. The company was co-founded by CEO Drew Perkins, who previously co-founded Lightera Networks (acquired by Ciena) and Infinera, alongside Chief Product Officer Omar Hassen, and emerged from stealth in March 2026 with an oversubscribed Series A of more than $200M led by Socratic Partners, bringing total funding to approximately $230M with participation from John Doerr, Kleiner Perkins, Hudson River Trading, Capricorn Investment Group, Matter Venture Partners and Fusion Fund. Eridu is a semiconductor and systems company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no developer portal, no product API, no SDKs and no pricing. The only machine-readable interface it serves is the WordPress core REST API behind its corporate site at eridu.ai, captured here for discovery purposes and anonymously readable but effectively read-only.

providers.name: Ginkgo Bioworks
providers.description: Ginkgo Bioworks is a synthetic biology company operating autonomous labs and a horizontal platform for engineering biology. Its public developer surface is the Ginkgo AI Model API (api.ginkgobioworks.ai), which runs inference on public and Ginkgo-proprietary biological foundation models — protein and DNA masked language models and embedding models such as ESM2 (650M/3B), ginkgo-aa0-650M, and ginkgo-maskedlm-3utr-v1. The API is an async, job-polling REST service: callers POST a transform request, receive a job result URL, and poll until the job completes. Authentication is via an x-api-key header, credits and keys are issued from the models portal, and an official Python client (ginkgo-ai-client) is published to PyPI. Ginkgo was surfaced as a Felicis portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gomultiply
providers.description: Multiply (gomultiply.com) is an AI-native paid media agency for B2B companies that combines proprietary self-learning advertising AI with human growth strategists. The platform plugs into a customer's sales calls and CRM data to learn why buyers actually convert, then uses 25+ specialized AI agents (customer insights, keyword, creative design, A/B testing, bidding, and attribution) to generate, launch, and continuously optimize hundreds of personalized ad experiments across Google and LinkedIn. Founded by Matt Jayson (formerly Google and Brex) and Ashish Warty (formerly SVP Engineering at HackerOne, Dropbox, and Airship), Multiply emerged from stealth with $9.5M led by Mayfield and reports 300-500% increases in sales meetings booked and pipeline generated for its B2B customers.

providers.name: GreenCycle Compound Atlas
providers.description: GreenCycle Compound Atlas offers an open, community‑curated atlas of cannabis compounds, their receptors, associated medical conditions, and related data. The platform aggregates verified scientific sources and provides JSON endpoints for compounds, targets, structures, conditions, and more, all licensed under CC BY 4.0. It supports researchers, developers, and the public by delivering reliable, machine‑readable cannabis information, complete with source citations and licensing details, enabling integration into applications and AI agents.

providers.name: Griffith University
providers.description: Griffith University is a public research university in South East Queensland, Australia, a member of the Innovative Research Universities (IRU) network and ranked #255 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Griffith operates no public developer portal and publishes no institution-authored API contract; a 2026-09-01 operator audit found that every machine-readable surface running under a griffith.edu.au hostname is a vendor platform under a Griffith tenancy, confirmed by DNS. Griffith Research Online (research-repository.griffith.edu.au) is a DSpace 7.6 repository hosted by Atmire, serving a live REST API and a fully conformant OAI-PMH 2.0 endpoint over Griffith's own research outputs. lms.griffith.edu.au is an Instructure Canvas tenancy exposing an LTI 1.3 keyset and an OpenID Connect discovery document, with the REST API itself behind authentication. Griffith Experts (experts.griffith.edu.au) is a Symplectic Discovery deployment. The one surface that is unambiguously Griffith's own engineering identity is its SAML 2.0 Shibboleth Identity Provider, registered in the Australian Access Federation and exported to eduGAIN with REFEDS Research & Scholarship, Code of Conduct v2 and SIRTFI assertions. Griffith is additionally a registrant in DataCite, Crossref and ROR. The main website sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge and is unreadable to non-browser clients.

providers.name: Groundswell
providers.description: Groundswell is a corporate social responsibility (CSR) platform that lets companies run employee giving, volunteering, grants, employee assistance funds, and corporate donor-advised funds from a single integrated system. The platform provides instant donation matching and payroll giving, volunteer event management and volunteer grants, AI-assisted grant application scoring and workflow configuration, confidential employee assistance fund applications with rapid funding, tax-efficient corporate DAFs, enterprise impact reporting and analytics, and web plus mobile employee experiences. Groundswell is backed by Felicis and GV and runs on AWS infrastructure with a published trust center and SOC 2 Type I and Type II attestations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; no public developer portal, API, or specification is currently published by the company.

providers.name: HCLSoftware
providers.description: HCLSoftware, part of HCLTech, delivers a broad portfolio of enterprise software solutions spanning AI-driven operations, cybersecurity, data analytics, and low-code development platforms. The company focuses on orchestrating experiences, data, and operations at scale for large organizations, offering products such as HCL BigFix, HCL Cloud, and HCL Volt MX. Through its extensive suite, HCLSoftware enables digital transformation, secure endpoint management, and intelligent automation across industries.

providers.name: Hyvor Talk
providers.description: Hyvor Talk provides a privacy‑focused, fully‑featured commenting platform that enables websites, blogs, newsrooms, and enterprises to add interactive discussions, reactions, and ratings. The service supports easy integration with WordPress, Ghost, Wix, Squarespace, and other platforms, offering built‑in spam detection, no ads, and customizable moderation tools. Over 10,000 businesses and individual creators use Hyvor Talk to build community, increase engagement, and gather audience feedback across multiple languages.

providers.name: Kapital
providers.description: Kapital (KPTL MEXICO BANK, S.A., Institucion de Banca Multiple, Kapital Mexico Grupo Financiero) is a licensed Mexican bank and AI-native financial platform for SMEs and corporates, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Mexico City. Its ecosystem combines business and personal deposit accounts, corporate cards, SPEI and SPID transfers, FX cash/transfers/cheques and derivatives (forwards, interest rates), working-capital and revolving credit (Credito Empresarial, Credito PyME, Credito FLEX), factoring, and fixed-income investments (Pagare, CEDES) with Kapital IA, a native artificial-intelligence layer that reconciles cash flow, projects sales, validates supplier pricing and flags anomalous costs. It is supervised by the CNBV and Banco de Mexico, with deposits protected by IPAB, and it also operates in Colombia as Kapital Colombia. Kapital publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK or webhook surface; the banking surface is delivered through its own web and mobile applications.

providers.name: Kubermatic
providers.description: Kubermatic provides a multi‑cloud Kubernetes management platform that enables enterprises to deploy, operate, and scale Kubernetes clusters across any infrastructure—public clouds, on‑premises data centers, and edge environments. The solution includes automated provisioning, lifecycle management, security controls, and integrated AI‑driven optimization for workloads. Kubermatic is recognized in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Container Management and offers products such as Kubermatic Kubernetes Platform, Kubermatic AI, KubeLB, and SecureGuard.

providers.name: Levity
providers.description: Levity (Levity AI GmbH, Berlin, Germany) is a Communication Intelligence platform for the global supply chain, delivering AI automation for freight operations on top of the systems logistics teams already run rather than replacing them. It turns the email and phone traffic that drives day-to-day freight work - quoting, order entry, track-and-trace, document processing and carrier communication, in any language - into structured, automated workflows with humans kept in the loop. The platform pairs inbox analytics (a control tower over millions of emails), an AI automation flow builder, human-in-the-loop review and a feedback loop that turns operator corrections into continuous model improvement. Levity integrates with named TMS platforms including CargoWise, MercuryGate, Descartes, SAP and Oracle, plus custom, in-house and legacy systems. Levity reports 100M+ emails processed and 5M+ working hours saved, serving customers such as ECU Worldwide, Gebrueder Weiss, DPD, LKW Walter and FitzMark across North America and DACH. Levity is backed by Balderton Capital. Levity publishes no public self-serve API, developer portal or SDKs - the product is sold and onboarded through sales - but it does publish an llms.txt, a status page, a trust center and a security program.

providers.name: Life Biosciences
providers.description: Life Biosciences is a Boston-based, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapeutics that target the biology of aging. Its platform — which the company calls epigenetic restoration, a partial epigenetic reprogramming (PER) approach using the OCT4, SOX2 and KLF4 transcription factors — is designed to return older and damaged cells to a younger, healthier functional state. Its lead program, ER-100, is in a Phase 1 first-in-human study in optic neuropathies (open-angle glaucoma and non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy) following FDA clearance of the IND in January 2026, with a preclinical program in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) behind it. The company is privately held, has raised an $80M Series D, and trades on secondary markets. Life Biosciences publishes no developer program, API documentation or SDKs; the only machine-readable surface reachable on its corporate site is the read-only WordPress REST content API, which serves its press releases, pages, media and taxonomies as JSON.

providers.name: Material Security
providers.description: Material Security is a cloud workspace security platform for Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. It connects via API (not an inline gateway) to give security teams unified detection and response across email, accounts and identity, and sensitive data — protecting against advanced email threats and phishing, preventing risky file sharing while automatically classifying sensitive data, and detecting account takeover and identity threats. Material is a private company backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Amplify Partners.

providers.name: Nobl9
providers.description: Nobl9 is a service-level objective (SLO) management platform that helps engineering and SRE teams define, measure, and act on reliability targets across cloud and observability tools. The platform aggregates data from Datadog, Prometheus, New Relic, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, and other sources to compute error budgets and surface reliability insights. Nobl9 exposes a suite of REST APIs for managing SLOs, annotations, budget adjustments, audit logs, and reports using access token authentication.

providers.name: OneAPM
providers.description: OneAPM (Beijing Blueware Technology / 北京蓝海讯通科技) is a Chinese application performance management and intelligent IT operations vendor founded in 2008. Its product suite instruments applications and infrastructure end to end: Application Insight (server-side, code-level tracing for Java, .NET, PHP, Python, Node.js, Ruby and Go), Browser Insight and Mobile Insight (real user monitoring), Infrastructure Insight and Network Insight, LogInsight for log analytics, Cloud Alert (OneAlert) for intelligent alerting, Cloud Test for performance testing, OneITSM for IT service management, and the Intelligence Insight (I²) AIOps platform. It serves over 60,000 enterprise users across telecommunications, finance, government, transportation, energy and e-commerce, delivered as SaaS or on-premise, and instruments applications via language-specific agents (SDKs) published to npm, RubyGems and a private index.

providers.name: openHAB
providers.description: openHAB is an open-source, vendor‑agnostic home automation platform that enables users to integrate a wide range of smart devices and technologies into a unified system. It offers a flexible architecture, extensive documentation, and a vibrant community supporting installation, configuration, and automation across Linux, Windows, macOS, and embedded hardware.

providers.name: OWASP
providers.description: The Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) is a nonprofit foundation that works to improve the security of software through community-led open source projects, hundreds of chapters worldwide, and educational resources. OWASP does not provide a centralized public API, but maintains many open source projects, standards (such as the OWASP Top 10 and ASVS), and tools (such as ZAP) that include APIs.

providers.name: Pactum
providers.description: Pactum is an AI procurement negotiation platform that deploys autonomous agents to conduct commercial supplier negotiations at scale while enforcing buyer-defined policies and guardrails. Its agent suite spans requisition alignment and negotiation, tactical and post-sourcing sourcing, price-list, discount, payment-terms, and rebate negotiations, letting enterprise procurement teams reach agreements on long-tail spend that would otherwise go unnegotiated. Pactum is a venture-backed enterprise SaaS company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, so this record captures the company's identity plus its published security, trust, and disclosure surface.

providers.name: Prescience
providers.description: Prescience, Inc. is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) health benefits platform for employers, building "healthcare for the age of abundant intelligence." It uses machine-learning underwriting to design custom, largely self-insured health plans that aim to cut employer healthcare spend 20-50% versus traditional PEO and insurer plans, pairing $0-deductible coverage, included GLP-1 medications, wearables, and a 24/7 AI Care Companion for members. The company sells to employers, private-equity portfolios, and providers, and publicly attests to SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance. As of this profile it exposes a marketing and member/employer web application only - no public API, developer portal, SDKs, MCP server, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Rates and Limits
providers.description: A free, keyless open-data publisher exposing US federal and state tax, payroll, benefits, and wage figures as JSON. Every figure ships bundled with provenance: the exact quoted sentence from the governing government document, byte offsets, sha256-stamped source snapshots, and last-verified dates.

providers.name: Reckon
providers.description: Reckon provides accounting, business, and bookkeeping software solutions for small businesses in Australia and New Zealand. Their cloud‑based platforms include Reckon One, Reckon Cloud POS, and Reckon Accounts Hosted, offering features such as payroll, invoicing, bank reconciliation, inventory management, and data migration tools. The company emphasizes easy migration from existing systems, comprehensive support resources, and a focus on helping small enterprises streamline financial operations.

providers.name: ReCode Therapeutics
providers.description: ReCode Therapeutics is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company headquartered in Menlo Park, California with operations in Dallas, Texas, founded in 2015 out of research at UT Southwestern. Its Selective Organ Targeting (SORT) lipid nanoparticle platform is a delivery technology that directs mRNA and gene-correction payloads to organs, tissues and cells beyond the liver — the constraint that has limited genetic medicines to date — with redosing capability. Its lead programmes are RCT1100, an inhaled DNAI1 mRNA therapy for primary ciliary dyskinesia which has reported first-ever proof of activity in PCD patients, and RCT2100, an inhaled CFTR mRNA therapy for cystic fibrosis now in a Phase 2 combination trial with ivacaftor; both hold U.S. FDA Orphan Drug designation. The company collaborates with Intellia Therapeutics on CRISPR-based gene correction for cystic fibrosis, is funded in part by the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation, and has raised over $260 million in Series B financing. ReCode Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal or API documentation; the only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind recodetx.com, catalogued here alongside the llms.txt the site publishes.

providers.name: Sonrai Security
providers.description: Sonrai Security is a cloud identity and access security company whose Cloud Permissions Firewall (CPF) enforces least-privilege access across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud by quarantining unused IAM identities, protecting sensitive permissions, and disabling unused services and regions without disrupting developers. The platform also ships WALLy, an AI-driven Cloud PAM agent that grants just-in-time privileged access through Slack and Teams, and offers agentic AI security consulting. Sonrai exposes a GraphQL API for the platform (endpoint https://app.sonraisecurity.com/graphql), documented in its CPF developer docs; platform and API access authenticate through an Auth0-backed OpenID Connect identity provider at login.sonraisecurity.com. Sonrai Security is backed by Menlo Ventures.

providers.name: Supercell
providers.description: Supercell is the Finnish mobile game developer behind Clash of Clans, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Hay Day, Boom Beach and Squad Busters. Supercell operates three official public game APIs — the Clash of Clans API, the Clash Royale API and the Brawl Stars API — that expose read-only game data including clan search, global and local leaderboards, player and clan profiles, leagues, cards, brawlers, rankings and live events. Access is authenticated with a JWT bearer API token created in each game's developer portal and locked to a set of whitelisted IP addresses. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with verified developer-surface artifacts.

providers.name: Thesis
providers.description: Thesis Care is a healthcare AI company that deploys clinical support agents backed by expert clinicians — nurses and care managers — to help physician groups, health systems, and health plans scale care management, care delivery, and clinical operations. Its platform pairs automation with human clinical oversight so work gets done end-to-end to deliver outcomes rather than create more work, handling the complex cases and edge scenarios that pure technology cannot. The company is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant and has announced a Series A round. Thesis Care publishes no public API or developer surface at this time; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's identity, security posture, and published compliance program.

providers.name: Tiptop
providers.description: Tiptop (Tiptop Labs) is the payments company founded by Postmates co-founder Bastian Lehmann that lets shoppers trade in items they already own for instant credit at checkout, alongside pay-over-time options. Merchants integrate through a Shopify payments app, a Salesforce Commerce Cloud cartridge, a Magento 2 module, or the Direct API — the tiptop.js browser library plus server-side order-management endpoints (capture, void, refund) authenticated with an api-key header. Backed by a16z ($23M Series A, 2022). Note: as of July 2026 tiptop.com redirects to mother.ai (Mother Computer Inc.) and its TLS certificate has expired, while docs.tiptop.com, api.tiptop.com, cdn.tiptop.com, and the first-party packages remain live.

providers.name: toptik-app
providers.description: Public TikTok data in one call — videos, creators, comments, search, hashtags, sounds, live streams, places, no-watermark downloads and real transcripts. Subscribe on RapidAPI, run on Apify, or pay per call over MCP. The service offers 38 REST endpoints, 25 MCP tools, and 14 Apify Actors with >99% success.

providers.name: TradeLanes
providers.description: TradeLanes is a trade execution and operational-intelligence platform for U.S. exporters, freight forwarders, and drayage teams. Its Vessel Schedule Report (VSR) delivers a daily delta-only view of ERD and CY cutoff changes across 40+ U.S. container terminals, Ava adds decision intelligence that evaluates whether a schedule change affects a specific booking (safe-to-commit / safe-to-dispatch), and the eLane Trade Execution Suite manages shipments, documents, and tasks. A Techstars portfolio company headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA; no public developer API is documented.

providers.name: U.S. Agency for Global Media
providers.description: The U.S. Agency for Global Media (USAGM) is an independent federal agency that oversees a network of international media organizations aimed at providing news and information to audiences around the world in support of freedom and democracy. These media outlets include Voice of America (VOA), Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty (RFE/RL), Radio Free Asia (RFA), Office of Cuba Broadcasting (OCB), Middle East Broadcasting Networks (MBN), and the Open Technology Fund (OTF). Together these entities operate in over 64 languages and reach approximately 427 million people weekly, producing more than 3,000 hours of original programming per week in regions where access to a free press is limited.

providers.name: Universe
providers.description: Universe provides a visual, no‑code website builder that lets users create custom sites, online stores, portfolios, event pages, blogs, and fan sites from any device. Users drag and drop blocks on a grid without writing HTML or CSS, and can add commerce features such as selling physical goods or digital downloads, with optional shipping label discounts. The platform includes built‑in analytics, mailing‑list tools, SEO tools, and integrations with social media advertising.

providers.name: Upstart
providers.description: Upstart is an AI lending marketplace (NASDAQ: UPST) that connects consumers with banks and credit unions, using AI-driven underwriting models to price credit beyond traditional FICO-based scoring. The marketplace offers personal loans, car loan refinancing, debt consolidation, home equity lines of credit, and short-term relief loans - loans are originated by regulated bank and credit-union partners, including lender-branded powered-by-Upstart sites. Upstart's API surface is partner-facing rather than public: a Reporting API for lending partners is operated at api.upstart.com and publicly tracked on status.upstart.com, but no public developer portal or API documentation is published.

providers.name: Wuhan University
providers.description: Wuhan University (武汉大学, WHU), founded in 1893 in Wuhan, Hubei, is a comprehensive public research university under China's Ministry of Education, a Double First-Class and former Project 985 institution, and is strongest in surveying, remote sensing, geoinformatics and GNSS. It operates no public developer portal, no open data portal and no documented public API: api., data., open. and developer. under whu.edu.cn do not resolve, /.well-known/apis.json, llms.txt, security.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml all return 404 on both the Chinese and English sites, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract exists anywhere in this profile. What it does operate, on its own CERNET address space, is an identity estate and a bulk research-data archive. Wuhan University runs a Shibboleth SAML 2.0 identity provider registered in CARSI, China's national research-and-education federation and a production eduGAIN member, and a campus CAS single-sign-on server that publishes a live OpenID Connect discovery document — the only conforming, self-describing, machine-readable contract WHU serves to the anonymous public, and it is the SSO product's shape rather than WHU engineering. It also operates one of the IGS Global Data Centers: the International GNSS Service's own data-access page names Wuhan University and links ftp://igs.gnsswhu.cn/, an anonymously listable archive of GPS, BDS, MGEX, high-rate and IERS products. Library discovery is an Ex Libris Aleph tenancy on a WHU host, and the registrar system is behind campus SSO. The institution's only evidenced education-regime conformance is SAML and Shibboleth; it is not a DataCite or Crossref depositing member, and no institution-operated OAI-PMH endpoint was found.

providers.name: Yandex Mail
providers.description: Yandex Mail is a free email service provided by Yandex, a Russian internet company. It offers personal and business email accounts with robust spam protection, security features, and integration with Yandex 360 suite. Users can access mail via web, mobile apps for iOS and Android, and desktop clients. The service includes customizable filters, forwarding, and a clean interface without ads. Yandex Mail supports corporate mailboxes, premium plans, and integrates with other Yandex services like Disk, Calendar, and Docs.

providers.name: Yaskawa / Motoman
providers.description: Yaskawa Electric Corporation is a Kitakyushu, Japan industrial automation company and the world's largest manufacturer of AC servo motors and motion controllers, with major business segments in motion control (AC servo motors, SERVOPACK amplifiers, machine controllers), AC drives / inverters, industrial robotics (under the Motoman brand), and systems engineering. Yaskawa's Motoman robotics division supplies articulated, SCARA, delta, collaborative, and mini robots used across automotive, EV, semiconductor, electronics, food, biomedical, and logistics manufacturing, alongside its Sigma-X servo family and GA / U1000 industrial AC drives. The company exposes a developer surface through the Yaskawa Motoman Developer Portal at developer.motoman.com and the Yaskawa-Global GitHub organization, including YMConnect (a modern PC-side communication library for C++ 17 and C#), MotoPlus SDK (on-controller C code for deterministic motion, I/O, jobs, and alarms), MotoROS2 (a native ROS 2 / micro-ROS node running on DX200, YRC1000, and YRC1000micro controllers), MotoCom SDK (legacy Windows communication SDK), the Smart Pendant SDK (Java extensions for the Smart Pendant teach interface), and YIP (Yaskawa Innovation Plus) packages and Smart Packager tooling. The catalog is SDK- and protocol-driven rather than HTTP/REST — there are no public OpenAPI specifications, so this profile captures the SDK, ROS, GitHub, and developer-portal surface without generated OpenAPI artifacts.

providers.name: Zocomputer
providers.description: Zocomputer is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: 402rates-com
providers.description: 402rates.com provides evidence‑backed tokenized treasury yields and measured cross‑chain USDC settlement costs. The platform aggregates and presents real‑time yield data, cost analyses, and methodological documentation, allowing developers and analysts to access transparent financial metrics. By publishing observations, sources, and methods, it aims to improve transparency in treasury finance and crypto settlement ecosystems.

providers.name: ActiKidz
providers.description: ActiKidz is a North American platform that lets parents search for children’s courses and activities across multiple cities. It also provides private teachers and educational institutions with scheduling, payment, and notification management tools. The service covers swimming, piano, coding, art, fitness and more, offering clear details on time, location, and price without requiring registration.

providers.name: Adidas
providers.description: A German multinational corporation designing and manufacturing athletic shoes, apparel, and accessories. One of the world's largest sportswear brands competing across performance and lifestyle markets.

providers.name: AdmitBase
providers.description: AdmitBase is a professional-school admissions data platform. It compares an applicant's GPA and standardised test score against the admitted‑student figures each school itself published, and returns a 0‑100 match score classified as Safety, Target, Reach or Far Reach. See your real chances at every law, medical, and dental school — your GPA and test score against admitted‑student data from official disclosures.

providers.name: Airwave
providers.description: Airwave (Indianapolis, founded 2022) is a field intelligence platform for industrial and field-service technicians: ANSI Z87+ smart safety glasses with a built-in camera, microphone and speakers record the job, and the Airwave software turns the footage into inspection reports, job hazard analyses, customer summaries and searchable job notes, with an AI assistant ("Blue") answering questions from uploaded manuals, parts lists and team knowledge. The pricing page lists API integrations (ERP, CRM, CMMS) and an Airwave Glasses SDK only in the custom-priced Video Intelligence tier behind a sales conversation; no public developer documentation, API reference or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: All SVG Icons
providers.description: All SVG Icons provides a free and open‑source collection of SVG icon libraries, offering a searchable catalog of over 400 k icons across dozens of packs. The site includes tools such as an SVG optimizer, sprite maker, favicon generator, and AI‑ready MCP for agents. It serves developers, designers, and AI applications looking for royalty‑free vector icons and related utilities.

providers.name: Askline
providers.description: Askline is an MCP-native SEO platform that provides AI‑visibility, keyword ranking, competitor analysis and backlink data in a unified dashboard. It offers a 3‑day free trial with 25 lookups, then pricing starts at $35 per 1,000 lookups. The product is built by HALO GLOBAL NETWORK LLC, based in Sheridan, Wyoming, United States.

providers.name: automatoncolony-xyz
