Wabtec provides B2B API integrations for railroad operators, mines, ports, and transit agencies to connect their operations with the WabtecONE platform.

providers.name: Xiao-Y Technology (小y科技)
providers.description: Xiao-Y Technology (小y科技), operated by Beijing Shiyou Interactive Technology Co., Ltd. (北京视游互动科技有限公司), is a Chinese smart-TV and big-screen gaming platform behind the 小y游戏厅 TV game store and YFans app, publishing licensed TV editions of titles like 葫芦娃, 胡莱三国2, 我叫MT2, and 中超荣耀. Its 小y手游开放平台 developer platform onboards game studios through first-party YTS SDKs (Android Fusion and iOS) rather than a public REST API, covering registration, qualification review, game submission, and revenue sharing. A Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: Zend
providers.description: Zend is the enterprise PHP platform business of Perforce Software, providing production-grade PHP runtimes, tooling, and long-term support for mission-critical applications. Its portfolio spans ZendPHP (a hardened, enterprise-supported PHP runtime with LTS builds for end-of-life PHP versions), ZendHQ (PHP application observability and monitoring), Zend Server, Zend Studio, and Zend Guard, along with migration, modernization, performance auditing, and Black Belt support services for Laravel, Symfony, CodeIgniter, and CakePHP teams. Zend ships product tooling and a documentation surface rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: ACTO
providers.description: ACTO is a Toronto-headquartered Life Sciences software company whose Intelligent Field Excellence (IFE) platform prepares biopharmaceutical, biotech and medtech commercial and medical field teams for healthcare-provider conversations. The platform is organized into three product pillars — Educate (learning, certification and MLR-approved content delivery), Engage (coaching, AI roleplay and practice through capabilities such as TalkTRx, CXZone, Journeys and the OmniSight dashboard) and Augment (real-time in-field support, including the LAICA assistant and role-based "SuperAgent" AI) — and is sold to enterprise Life Sciences organizations rather than to developers. ACTO states it supports more than 50,000 field professionals across 100+ countries and is a Veeva Gold Product Partner with validated integrations into Veeva Vault CRM, PromoMats and MedComms, plus an ACTOverse partner marketplace of pre-vetted content, data and services vendors. It is a validated platform compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and publishes SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR posture through a SafeBase trust center. ACTO publishes no public developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract of any kind — its integration surface is delivered as certified, partner-side work against Veeva's APIs rather than as a first-party public API.

providers.name: Adplane
providers.description: Adplane enables users to run all their Google, Meta, Microsoft, and TikTok advertising campaigns through a conversational interface powered by Claude or ChatGPT. By connecting multiple ad accounts to a single chat, users can ask questions, retrieve reports, adjust budgets, and make campaign changes in real time, all after a one‑click sign‑in. The platform offers a free trial and a $9.95 per month plan.

providers.name: AgentRank
providers.description: AgentRank provides a leaderboard and ranking of MCP (Machine-Callable-Protocol) servers, tools, and agents. It aggregates popularity signals, usage metrics, and community contributions to help developers discover and integrate top AI agents and tools. The platform offers daily updates, detailed tool profiles, pricing information, and a blog covering ecosystem trends and news.

providers.name: Apache PySpark
providers.description: Python API for Apache Spark - A unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing supporting batch processing, streaming, machine learning, and graph computing.

providers.name: apished-com
providers.description: APIShed is a modular HTTP API server that provides deterministic computation endpoints for tasks such as checksums, date arithmetic, character counts, and token counts. It offers a RESTful interface and MCP tools without requiring API keys or sign‑up, making it suitable for edge devices and IoT boards. The service is rate‑limited to 1 request per second per IP per endpoint and returns standard HTTP status codes. Documentation and an OpenAPI specification are publicly available.

providers.name: Australian Access Federation
providers.description: The Australian Access Federation (AAF) is the national trust and identity capability for Australia’s research and higher education sector. It enables seamless, secure access to digital resources across institutions with a single identity, supports federated services like EduGAIN, ORCID, and Rapid IdP, and connects thousands of users and services both domestically and internationally. AAF drives collaboration, reduces costs, and fosters innovation across the research ecosystem.

providers.name: Avero
providers.description: Avero provides a cloud‑based hospitality operations platform that helps restaurant operators, hotel groups, casinos and other food‑service businesses manage staff, inventory, sales and customer engagement. The solution offers real‑time dashboards, mobile logbooks, and analytics to improve efficiency and service quality across multiple locations.

providers.name: Bit Apps
providers.description: Bit Apps provides a WordPress automation plugin suite that connects WordPress sites to over 335 platforms, enabling easy automation of forms, CRM, social media, and AI workflows. Their products include Bit Form, Bit Assist, Bit Flows, and Bit Integrations, offering features like drag‑and‑drop form building, multi‑channel customer engagement, and advanced AI workflow design. The platform targets agencies and businesses seeking to streamline integrations and automate marketing, sales, and support processes.

providers.name: Bizcraw
providers.description: Bizcraw provides a web scraping and AI‑powered sales workspace that helps teams collect fresh market data, transform it into structured leads, and push those leads directly into CRM systems. The platform offers repeatable scraping workflows, AI‑assisted data enrichment, role‑based access controls, and audit trails, enabling accountable sales operations from discovery through quoting and closing.

providers.name: Bloomberg Financial Solutions
providers.description: Bloomberg Financial Solutions encompasses the full suite of Bloomberg financial data, analytics, and technology products designed to support front, middle, and back office workflows across asset management, banking, insurance, and corporate treasury. Solutions include market data, risk analytics, portfolio management, trading, compliance, and regulatory reporting capabilities.

providers.name: Bloomberg Product Suite
providers.description: Bloomberg's Product Suite encompasses the complete portfolio of Bloomberg professional products including the Bloomberg Terminal, data products, analytics solutions, trading platforms, media, and technology infrastructure. The suite serves financial professionals across asset management, banking, insurance, government, and corporate sectors with integrated data, analytics, and workflow tools.

providers.name: BotGigs
providers.description: BotGigs is a decentralized platform that connects AI agents with human workers to perform real‑world tasks such as photo verification, meter reading, and storefront checks. Payments are locked in on‑chain escrow on BNB Chain, ensuring workers keep 100% of the pay while bots cover a 2.5% fee capped at 5%. The service aims to create a fair gig economy for tasks that require human presence, leveraging blockchain transparency and smart contracts.

providers.name: brelsfordsoftware-com
providers.description: Brelsford Software LLC builds agent infrastructure, computational immunogenetics tooling, and quiet games. It provides a directory of projects, each published as structured data for automated enumeration, and offers APIs for agents to interact with its services.

providers.name: Chick-fil-A
providers.description: Chick-fil-A is an American fast-food restaurant chain specializing in chicken sandwiches and operating over 3,000 locations across the United States. Known for customer service and a closed-on-Sunday policy, Chick-fil-A operates the Chick-fil-A One tiered loyalty program, the Chick-fil-A mobile app for ordering and rewards, the catering platform, and eGift Cards.

providers.name: Civic Roundtable
providers.description: Civic Roundtable is a government operations platform that gives public sector organizations one place for the people, partners, and knowledge behind every mission. It combines Workspaces for cross-agency collaboration, a Knowledge Base for centralized search across systems, Communications for multi-channel stakeholder outreach, a CRM for contact and engagement tracking, Insights for data-driven decision analytics, and government-focused AI & Automation. The platform integrates with tools such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, and HubSpot, runs on AWS GovCloud, and serves more than 4,000 organizations across all 50 U.S. states. It maintains SOC 2 Type II, FedRAMP High ATO, FIPS 140-2, and NIST 800-171 security posture. Civic Roundtable is backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Co:Create
providers.description: Co:Create (operated by Gesso Labs, Inc.) was an a16z crypto-backed web3 platform that gave brands and developers a REST API to build and run token-driven loyalty, rewards, and community programs on the Polygon blockchain. Its API-first toolkit let teams create and manage users and hosted wallets, deploy and manage ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, and Soulbound token contracts, mint and transfer tokens (with synchronous and asynchronous variants plus status polling), run reward Campaigns with built-in business logic, issue Referrals, and offer Redemptions, Auctions, and Prize Draws. It also provided NFT media/metadata hosting, fiat and crypto checkout (via a Crossmint integration), a Co:Create SDK, and Shopify/Salesforce integrations. The public developer surface (docs.usecocreate.io, api.cocrt.xyz) is now offline; this profile is reconstructed from the provider's own published documentation (archived) and preserved for the network.

providers.name: Compa
providers.description: Compa Technologies provides AI‑driven compensation intelligence for enterprises. Its platform aggregates live market data, compensation benchmarks, and analytics to help compensation teams make data‑backed pay decisions. Features include analyst and partner AI agents, real‑time market briefs, and integrations with Slack and Claude, serving over 2.8 million employees across 42 countries.

providers.name: Customersai
providers.description: CustomersAI provides an AI‑powered customer data platform that helps ecommerce brands unify first‑party data, generate visitor IDs, and boost marketing ROI. It integrates with Shopify, Klaviyo and other tools to enable accurate audience segmentation, automated email flows, and advanced analytics, turning raw visitor behavior into actionable insights for higher conversion rates.

providers.name: Dealpad
providers.description: Dealpad is an AI-powered buyer-enablement and digital-sales-room platform for B2B sales teams. It centralizes the buyer and seller relationship into shared digital sales rooms, mutual action plans, and curated content, then layers "Sales Mind AI" predictive insight over each opportunity to help sellers progress complex, multi-stakeholder deals faster. Dealpad integrates with major CRMs including Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho, and targets sales leaders, account executives, and enterprise revenue teams. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Dealpad publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, SDK, or webhook catalog: "API integrations" is sold as a feature of the Large enterprise tier (from $2,999/month) behind a talk-to-sales gate, so the contract is not readable without a commercial conversation.

providers.name: Delightree
providers.description: Delightree is an AI-powered franchise operations platform that consolidates franchise management into a single operating system for headquarters and location teams. It combines a centralized knowledge base, interactive training, task management, forms and checklists, audits, a location launcher for opening new stores, team communication, and reporting so franchisors can standardize and enforce standard operating procedures across every location. The platform is built around frontline franchisee adoption and serves 150+ franchise brands across food and beverage, fitness, wellness, home services, and other multi-unit, regulated sectors. Backed by Accel; profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or documentation program was found during enrichment (2026-07-18).

providers.name: docs-md-com
providers.description: Docs MD provides a free markdown sharing service tailored for AI‑powered workflows. Users can paste a Markdown file and receive a rendered link that supports Mermaid diagrams, syntax‑highlighted code, and configurable expiry periods (day, week, month, or permanent). The platform also offers an MCP server enabling AI agents like Cursor and Claude Code to programmatically create shares via a REST API, plus a suite of free markdown tools. No signup is required.

providers.name: Dubai Wealth Index
providers.description: Dubai Wealth Index provides independent property intelligence for Dubai, aggregating recorded sale prices, registered rents, and comparable returns from Dubai Land Department and Ejari records. It offers forward Airbnb asking rates, building data, and market analytics to help investors, developers, and renters understand property performance across the emirate.

providers.name: Elixir Medical
providers.description: Elixir Medical Corporation is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Milpitas, California, developing implant and interventional platforms for coronary and peripheral artery disease. Its DynamX sirolimus-eluting coronary bioadaptor is designed to restore vessel pulsatility and compliance rather than permanently cage the artery, and holds a European CE mark, Japanese PMDA approval and a U.S. FDA Breakthrough Device designation; the LithiX Hertz Contact intravascular lithotripsy system and the DESyne family of drug-eluting stents round out the portfolio. Elixir Medical operates no developer program and publishes no product, device or clinical API. The only machine-readable surface it serves is the default WordPress REST API of its corporate marketing site, alongside an SEO-plugin-generated llms.txt.

providers.name: energynorth-uk
providers.description: Energy North UK connects homeowners with verified local tradespeople such as electricians, plumbers, gas engineers, and builders across the United Kingdom. The platform offers free job posting, instant quotes, and a commission‑free marketplace, leveraging AI to match jobs with qualified professionals quickly and transparently.

providers.name: eOne Solutions
providers.description: DataBlend, operating under eOne Solutions, provides an Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) enabling seamless data integration, virtualization, and migration across various enterprise systems. Their platform supports connectors for popular applications, offers data flow automation, and emphasizes security and compliance, catering to businesses seeking efficient data management solutions.

providers.name: EVgo
providers.description: EVgo is one of the largest public DC fast charging networks in the United States, operating over 1,100 fast charging locations across 47 states. EVgo provides REST APIs through its EVgo Inside partner integration platform, enabling automakers, fleet operators, and app developers to embed charging station discovery, real-time availability, session initiation, account creation, and payment processing directly into their own branded experiences. Charging station data is also served via the PlugShare API, which EVgo owns and operates.

providers.name: Foxtons
providers.description: Foxtons Group plc is a London-focused UK estate agency, founded in 1981 and listed on the London Stock Exchange, running residential sales, lettings and property management from roughly 40 branches across London and Surrey, plus independent mortgage broking through its Alexander Hall subsidiary. It sits on the brokerage rung of the value chain — it originates and holds the client and the listing rather than operating a portal or a data exchange — and distributes its stock to Rightmove and Zoopla through the UK's portal feed arrangements rather than through any shared cooperative, because the UK has no MLS. Its technology is deliberately proprietary: an internally built CRM/ERP called BOS underpins the whole business, and the My Foxtons customer portal is the consumer face of that same system. API posture, stated honestly, is none-published — no developer or partner portal, no api./developer./docs. host resolves, no OpenAPI or OData contract is served, and the only machine-readable public surface is schema.org JSON-LD embedded in its web pages. RESO is absent, as expected outside North America. The genuinely open UK property data layer belongs to government (HM Land Registry, Ordnance Survey), not to Foxtons.

providers.name: Furniture API
providers.description: Furniture API is a service that provides developers with access to a wide range of furniture data and resources through a simple and easy-to-use interface. This API allows users to retrieve information on various types of furniture, including furniture models, prices, availability, and more. Developers can use this data to enhance their applications, websites, and online platforms by incorporating detailed furniture listings, product images, and other relevant information.

providers.name: Headway
providers.description: Headway operates a national mental-health care platform that connects patients, therapists and psychiatrists, and insurance companies. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, Headway builds the first asset-free national network of behavioral-health providers who accept insurance, handling insurance credentialing, claims management, payments, and scheduling for clinicians while letting patients search for in-network providers, book appointments online, and see costs up front. The company partners with 45+ major insurers (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, Oxford, UnitedHealthcare, Oscar) and, as of 2026, powers 600,000+ appointments per month across all 50 states. Headway is backed by a16z, Thrive, Accel, GV, Spark Capital, and Forerunner. It maintains SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance. Headway does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Hook
providers.description: Hook is a London-based software company building AI agents for customer success (CS) teams. Its platform integrates product usage, revenue, support, and sales data to build a 360-degree view of each account, then uses predictive models to forecast churn, renewals, net revenue retention (NRR), and expansion up to six months ahead. Named agents such as Echo and Activator surface account insights and automate the administrative work CS teams would otherwise do by hand, helping subscription businesses reduce churn and grow expansion revenue without adding headcount. Hook is a SaaS product used by customer success and revenue teams; it is not a public developer API, so this profile enriches company identity and security posture rather than API artifacts. Surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LivePerson
providers.description: LivePerson is a leading provider of conversational AI and digital customer engagement technology. Their platform enables enterprises to design, deploy, and manage AI-powered messaging, voice, and agent-assisted conversations across web, mobile, and social channels, with a comprehensive suite of REST APIs covering conversation orchestration, contact center management, reporting, messaging, and security.

providers.name: Nauto
providers.description: Nauto is a predictive AI platform for commercial fleet safety. Using in-vehicle AI dash cams and computer vision, it monitors driver behavior in real time, delivers predictive collision alerts before incidents occur, scores driver risk with its VERA system, and powers driver coaching, exoneration, and incident intelligence. Nauto also supports DVIR, IFTA, and ELD fleet-compliance workflows across trucking, delivery, construction, passenger transit, and field-service fleets. Backed by Greylock, Playground Global, and SoftBank Vision Fund, Nauto is SOC 2 Type 1/2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.

providers.name: Opensesame
providers.description: OpenSesame is an online learning course marketplace founded in 2002 and headquartered in Portland, Oregon. It offers 60,000+ pre-vetted training courses in 70+ languages spanning compliance, business skills, safety, technology, leadership, and industry-specific topics, and delivers them into an organization's existing learning management system through a patented one-click curation integration with automatic daily metadata sync and xAPI progress reporting. OpenSesame is a portfolio company of Partech and maintains a public trust center with SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and GDPR posture.

providers.name: oscar-lopez-com
providers.description: Oscar E. López, Ph.D. is an academic researcher and lecturer at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, specializing in information systems, business intelligence, data analytics, artificial intelligence in business, and online privacy. This site serves as his professional profile, showcasing his research interests, publications, and academic contributions. While listed as a company stub in the API Evangelist network, the entity primarily represents an individual scholar rather than a commercial organization, providing insight into his expertise and academic activities.

providers.name: PagerTree
providers.description: PagerTree provides an incident management platform that aggregates alerts from various monitoring tools and routes them to on‑call responders via multiple channels such as email, SMS, phone, and mobile push. The service offers customizable escalation policies, integrations with popular services like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Slack, and supports webhook endpoints for automated incident creation. It aims to improve reliability and response times for engineering teams handling production incidents.

providers.name: Payform
providers.description: PayForm is a no-code payment form builder that lets creators and small businesses accept one-time and recurring credit-card payments without writing code. Users design customizable checkout forms with flexible fields, run recurring billing with trial periods and setup fees, and deliver digital content such as e-books, videos, and music through a members-only area. It supports 50+ currencies and 30+ languages, connects to the Stripe and PayPal payment gateways, and provides a subscriber self-service portal, Zapier automation to 2,000+ apps, and webhooks for custom integrations. Payform is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Probe Information
providers.description: Probe Information Services (Probe42) is an Indian company-intelligence and business-data platform that collects, cleans, and curates information on roughly one million Indian companies from 743 public-domain sources through a five-step verification process. Its products — Probe42 Business, Probe42 Banking, and the Probe42 API — deliver company profiles, financials, director and charge data, and risk signals used by banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and sales teams for onboarding, KYC/due-diligence, credit assessment, and lead intelligence. The Probe42 API lets developers embed this company data directly inside their own applications. Surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the public API surface is gated behind developer-portal authentication.

providers.name: Proximie
providers.description: Proximie is a health-tech company building a cloud platform it describes as the operating system for intelligent operating rooms, connecting surgical teams, medical devices, and data for remote telementoring, telesurgery, session recording, and AI-powered surgical insights across 500+ facilities in 50 countries. For developers, Proximie ships a pre-release C++ SDK (media streaming and session management, with an internal REST layer) and runs a Development Partners program that lets OEMs and medtech companies embed real-time connectivity, secure data routing, and white-label collaboration into their own devices. Proximie also open-sources WebRTC/Janus tooling (jarust, janus-mobile-sdk). Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Purolator
providers.description: Purolator is a leading North American courier and logistics company offering a comprehensive suite of shipping, freight, and supply chain solutions for businesses and consumers. Their services include domestic and international parcel delivery, freight transportation, customs brokerage, and e‑commerce integrations, supported by a robust online platform and developer resources. Purolator emphasizes reliability, tracking visibility, and flexible delivery options across Canada, the United States, and worldwide.

providers.name: Relyance Ai
providers.description: Relyance AI is an AI-native data security, AI security, and privacy platform that maps data flows from source code through cloud and SaaS systems to AI models. Its core product, Lyo, acts as a "data defense engineer" providing real-time visibility into where sensitive data lives and moves, who accesses it, and how to remediate risk. The platform unifies data security (sensitive-data discovery, classification, and exfiltration detection), AI security (AI agent inventory, MCP server discovery, agentic AI risk), and privacy automation (DSRs, ROPAs, DPIAs, and consent management). Relyance AI is backed by Menlo Ventures.

providers.name: Sempre Health
providers.description: Sempre Health is a San Francisco based digital health company, founded in 2015, that operates a behavior-based dynamic pricing platform for prescription medications. Working with health plans, pharmacy benefit managers and pharmaceutical manufacturers, it enrolls covered members and adjusts their copay at the point of fill through SMS outreach: the more consistently a member refills on time, the deeper the discount. The company reports more than 19 payer and PBM partners covering roughly 60% of commercially insured lives in the United States, availability at retail pharmacies in all 50 states, and HITRUST certification alongside a signed BAA with each plan. As of this profile Sempre Health publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; its own health-plans page describes payer integration as sharing a list of eligible members rather than as an API.

providers.name: Sierra
providers.description: Sierra is an enterprise conversational AI platform co-founded by Bret Taylor that builds and operates customer-facing AI agents across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and ChatGPT. Its Agent OS includes Agent Studio for building agents, Ghostwriter for agent generation from SOPs and transcripts, Insights for analytics, an Agent Data Platform for personalization, Voice Agents, and Live Assist for human handoff. Sierra is enterprise sales-led with no self-serve public developer API; integrations and Agent SDK access are provisioned through customer engagements.

providers.name: Skylight
providers.description: Skylight provides a smart profiling platform for Ruby and Rails applications, turning performance data into actionable insights. It helps developers identify bottlenecks, understand slowdowns, and improve application speed through detailed tracing and analytics. The service offers a free tier with 100,000 traces per month and paid plans starting at $20, catering to teams of all sizes.

providers.name: SMS.ru
providers.description: SMS.ru provides a mass SMS sending service across Russia, offering a personal account and an HTTP/SMTP API for sending SMS messages. Users can launch campaigns within 15 minutes, view transparent operator‑based pricing, and register an alphanumeric sender name. The platform supports bulk messaging, authentication via calls, balance checks, and cost estimation, catering to businesses needing reliable communication.

providers.name: Splunk On-Call (VictorOps)
providers.description: Splunk On-Call, formerly known as VictorOps, is an incident management and on-call alerting platform that helps DevOps and SRE teams reduce mean time to resolution by routing alerts, managing on-call schedules, and orchestrating incident response. The platform integrates with monitoring and observability tools to deliver context-rich alerts and supports collaborative chat-based remediation workflows. The VictorOps REST API enables programmatic management of users, teams, schedules, escalation policies, incidents, and integrations using API ID and API Key authentication headers.

providers.name: Sworkit
providers.description: Sworkit Health is a digital wellbeing platform combining on-demand fitness, mindfulness, mobility and recovery, nutrition, and wellness challenges to help organizations improve employee engagement and workforce health. Rather than a public REST API, Sworkit exposes its workout content to developers through the Sworkit Workout Player Platform — an embeddable web player and a React Native mobile SDK component, both published on npm under the @sworkit org. Its security and compliance posture covers SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR.

providers.name: Sydney Airport
providers.description: Sydney Airport Corporation Limited (ACN 082 578 809) operates Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport (IATA SYD, ICAO YSSY), Australia's principal international gateway, under private ownership by the Sydney Aviation Alliance consortium since its 2022 ASX delisting. In the travel distribution chain it is infrastructure rather than an intermediary - it sells no seats, holds no inventory, issues no PNRs, and sits outside the GDS and IATA NDC value chain entirely, monetising aeronautical charges, car parking, retail concessions and property instead. Its API posture is effectively nil - Sydney Airport publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI, and no terms of use for machine access. Its public website is backed by undocumented JSON endpoints under /_a/ that return live flight and security wait-time data with no published contract, while its only credentialed partner surface, InfoSYD, is gated behind a ForgeRock OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider at id.syd.com.au and is restricted to airlines, ground handlers and on-airport tenants. The published terms of use expressly prohibit automated retrieval, scraping and indexing of the site, so there is public data but no public interface - and no documented exit path beyond an Australian Privacy Principle 12 personal-information access request.

providers.name: Taiga
providers.description: Taiga is an open-source agile project management platform with a comprehensive REST API for managing projects, sprints, user stories, issues, tasks, epics, wiki pages, webhooks, and team member assignments. The API supports both standard bearer token and application token authentication, with optional server-side throttling. Available as a cloud-hosted service or self-hosted deployment.

providers.name: Technical University of Denmark
providers.description: The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) is a technical university in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark. DTU operates no central developer portal and publishes no OpenAPI-described public REST API of its own. Its two clearly institution-operated machine-readable surfaces are its identity federation — a DTU-run SAML 2.0 / WS-Federation / OpenID Connect token service at sts.ait.dtu.dk, registered in the Danish national federation WAYF and in eduGAIN — and the Global Wind Atlas OGC Web Processing Service, whose GetCapabilities document names DTU Wind Energy as the service provider with a dtu.dk contact. Everything that previously read as a DTU API was not: DTU Data (data.dtu.dk) is a Figshare tenant and DTU Orbit (orbit.dtu.dk) is an Elsevier Pure deployment, and both are recorded here as tenant relationships rather than DTU contracts. DTU Learn is a D2L Brightspace tenant. The course catalogue at kurser.dtu.dk is DTU-operated but sign-in gated. DTU maintains public GitHub organizations (dtudk, DTUWindEnergy) hosting affiliated open-source software.

providers.name: Tempur Sealy International
providers.description: Tempur Sealy International is one of the world's largest bedding providers, developing, manufacturing, marketing, and distributing bedding products under the Tempur-Pedic, Sealy, and Stearns & Foster brands. As a Fortune 500 manufacturer and retailer, the company operates e-commerce platforms and provides retailer integration APIs for product catalogs, inventory, and order management.

providers.name: ThirdWatch
providers.description: ThirdWatch provides next‑gen API monitoring that handles authentication complexities such as OAuth2 and JWT token rotation. It offers multi‑step API scenario testing, real‑time performance dashboards, smart alerting via email, Slack, Discord, and webhooks, and supports role‑based access for teams. With transparent pricing and a 14‑day free trial, ThirdWatch aims to simplify monitoring of authenticated APIs for small teams to large enterprises.

providers.name: Tide
providers.description: Tide is a UK business finance and administration platform ("built by business owners for business owners") serving over two million small businesses, sole traders, freelancers, and limited companies. It combines a business current account (an e-money account powered by ClearBank), expense cards, invoicing and payment tools (Tap to Pay, card readers, QR codes, payment links), MTD-ready accounting and admin, business credit and finance (loans, asset finance, invoice finance), company formation, and business insurance. Tide is authorised and regulated in relation to its regulated activities by the UK Financial Conduct Authority. Tide was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis, Creandum, and Speedinvest. It does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; "Open Banking" is offered as a consumer product feature.

providers.name: Timken
providers.description: The Timken Company is a global manufacturer of engineered bearings and industrial motion products including ball bearings, tapered roller bearings, seals, lubrication systems, gear drives, belts, clutches, couplings, and related motion control products serving aerospace, automotive, industrial, and energy markets.

providers.name: TLA Plus Foundation
providers.description: The TLA+ Foundation is an independent nonprofit hosted by the Linux Foundation, dedicated to fostering the adoption of the TLA+ specification language in industry, academia, and education. Created by Leslie Lamport, TLA+ is a high-level formal specification language based on set theory and temporal logic for modeling concurrent and distributed systems. Inaugural members include Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Oracle. The Foundation funds research and development, maintains the TLC model checker, TLAPS proof system, and TLA+ Toolbox IDE, and coordinates community resources including the VS Code extension, CommunityModules, and formal verification examples. The current stable release is v1.7.4 (The Xenophanes release).

providers.name: Tredence
providers.description: Tredence is a global data science and AI solutions company headquartered in San Jose, California, founded in 2013 by Shub Bhowmick, Sumit Mehra and Shashank Dubey. The firm positions itself around the "last-mile problem in AI" — the gap between insight creation and value realization — and delivers agentic AI, generative AI, data engineering, data science, MLOps, LLMOps, data modernization, supply-chain and customer-experience analytics as consulting engagements backed by named accelerators and platforms including RAPID (agentic process automation), Sancus (AI-led data quality and master data management), MLWorks (industrial MLOps), Customer Cosmos, Supply Chain Control Tower, Revenue Growth Management, On-Shelf Availability, Test and Learn Platform and UnityGO. It serves retail, CPG, healthcare, life sciences, banking/financial services/insurance, telco/media/tech, travel and hospitality, and industrials, with delivery centers across North America, Europe and Asia. Tredence publishes an authored llms.txt for AI agents and an ISO 27001:2022 / ISO 27701:2019 / SOC 2 Type 2 certifications page, but does not operate a public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification or first-party SDK is published on any Tredence host.

providers.name: Vega Security
providers.description: Vega (vega.io) is an AI-native security operations platform that bills itself as the operating system for agentic SecOps in the post-SIEM era. Its Security Analytics Mesh (SAM) federates queries across security data sources in place -- with no ingestion, migration, or egress -- and powers agentic detection engineering, autonomous alert triage, and security analytics, continuously assessing detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK. Backed by Accel. The product app and documentation are login-gated and no public API surface has been published yet.

providers.name: Verbal
providers.description: Verbal (tryverbal.com), from Salusive Health, is an AI-powered clinical compliance and quality-assurance platform for healthcare organizations. It automatically audits patient interactions — phone and video calls, telehealth visits, AI-agent conversations, and clinical chart notes — against customizable regulatory and quality checklists, scoring compliance in real time and surfacing gaps for supervisors and QA teams. Verbal connects to communications and EHR platforms including RingCentral, NICE, Zoom, Five9, Healthie, Epic, and Athena, and ships a Chrome extension for clinicians. It publishes a healthcare compliance posture — HIPAA compliant, HITRUST certified, CPRA, BAAs with all customers, PII redaction and US data residency. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API — the API language on its site describes Verbal consuming partner platform APIs, not an API it publishes, and there is no developer portal, reference, machine-readable spec, or SDK on any Verbal host. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Worksmith
providers.description: Worksmith is a retail operations platform founded in 2015 that unites workplace and workforce management for multi-location retailers. Worksmith Workplace covers facilities management, vendor sourcing, maintenance, and work-order tracking through a curated nationwide network of vetted service providers, while Worksmith Workforce (Progress Retail) covers scheduling, task management, training, and store audits. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant, publishes a public status page that lists a Worksmith API component, and runs a private GraphQL API at api.worksmith.com with no public developer program. Backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Zenline AI
providers.description: Zenline AI (Zenline GmbH / Zenline AG) is a Swiss assortment-intelligence platform for retail category teams. It blends public market data with a retailer's own product data to recommend pricing, product consolidation, and new-product launches, surfacing market white spots, sell-out trends, substitutes and variants so category managers can improve margin and portfolio performance across omni-channel retail. Backed by Seedcamp and used by European retailers including Otto Group, Conrad Electronic, Lapeyre and Fressnapf/Das Futterhaus. ISO 27001 certified. As of this enrichment pass Zenline publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: AccrueDev
providers.description: AccrueDev provides a hands‑on course and an agent store for building AI assistants that run on Claude Code, Anthropic’s command‑line coding assistant. The platform offers ready‑made agents, skills, and commands, along with a memory system, delegation architecture, quality‑gate checks, and production‑ready deployment tools. Users can purchase the course, subscribe to the agent store, and integrate the tools via the accruedev CLI to create, test, and maintain AI‑driven workflows.

providers.name: Achronix Semiconductor
providers.description: Achronix Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in high-performance FPGA (field-programmable gate array) products and embedded FPGA (eFPGA) intellectual property. Its portfolio includes the Speedster7t family of standalone FPGAs, Speedcore eFPGA IP for system-on-chip integration, VectorPath PCIe accelerator cards, and the ACE design tools suite for synthesis, verification, and optimization. Achronix technology targets AI/ML inference, 5G/6G networking, data-center compute acceleration, automotive, SmartNICs, and test-and-measurement workloads. The company is privately held and backed by investors including Battery Ventures. It exposes no public web/REST API or developer API portal; its developer surface is a hardware support portal, product documentation, datasheets, and design tools.

providers.name: AdRamp
providers.description: AdRamp is an AI‑powered performance marketing platform that connects to Google Ads, Meta, Shopify and Klaviyo data. Users can ask natural‑language questions, get instant insights, and execute changes directly in their ad accounts via a chat interface. The tool surfaces wasteful search terms, underperforming keywords and budget drains, allowing one‑click actions such as pausing ads, adding negative keywords, and reallocating budgets. Real‑time dashboards track spend, revenue, conversions, ROAS and CPA across campaigns. AdRamp operates as a read‑only, human‑in‑the‑loop system that respects user approvals and privacy. Early‑access is free with plans to be announced.

providers.name: Amber
providers.description: Amber provides a subscription Model Context Protocol (MCP) service that securely stores a person’s long‑term memories, moments, decisions and lessons. Users get an isolated, permanent, portable database that can be accessed by any MCP‑compatible AI, ensuring continuity across conversations and platforms. The service offers OAuth 2.1 authentication via PayPal and a free 90‑day trial before a $2.99 /month plan.

providers.name: Arka
providers.description: Arka is a custom packaging company that lets ecommerce brands design, order, and ship eco-friendly custom boxes, mailers, and sustainable packaging online. Arka offers low minimums, fast turnaround, and plug-in integrations with commerce platforms including Shopify, BigCommerce, and Square so merchants can reorder packaging alongside their fulfillment workflow. Arka's storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface — a published /llms.txt, an agentic-discovery sitemap, OIDC/OAuth 2.0 discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and complete buyer-approved checkouts. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled here as part of the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Asato
providers.description: Asato is an AI‑powered IT asset optimization platform founded in 2023. It helps enterprises discover, reconcile, and optimize their entire IT asset landscape using autonomous AI agents that continuously aggregate data from SaaS, cloud, hardware, and contracts, turning fragmented records into decision‑grade insights for CIOs. The platform aims to reduce waste, improve spend visibility, and enable strategic resource allocation across software, cloud, and AI services.

providers.name: Ask the Grid
providers.description: Ask the Grid provides a live power grid map for the US, Canada, and Mexico, offering real‑time data on prices, transmission, outages, and weather across markets. Users can query the platform in plain English to receive sourced answers, set up radar alerts for assets or collections, and access detailed reports and briefings. The service aggregates data from utilities, ISOs, RTOs, data centers, and other grid operators, delivering comprehensive insights for traders, utilities, and large energy consumers.

providers.name: Assay
providers.description: Assay finds what''s gone out of date across your site, blog, and decks, and has the fix ready for your approval. Nothing publishes, sends, or spends on its own. The platform offers AI SEO & GEO, AI Product Marketer, pricing, resources, changelog, security, integrations, and a free truth graph.

providers.name: Bellwether Coffee
providers.description: Bellwether Coffee is a Berkeley, California coffee-technology company founded in 2013 by Ricardo Lopez that designs and manufactures an all-electric, ventless, automatic commercial coffee roaster. The Bellwether Shop Roaster (SCA Best New Product 2024) roasts 1.5 kg per batch on a standard 240V/30A circuit with no gas line, exhaust, or construction, and is paired with a complete coffee business program: a traceable Green Coffee Marketplace with ready-made roast profiles, cloud-connected roast automation and inventory software, custom retail packaging and labels, and ongoing service. Bellwether has raised roughly $92.7M across eight rounds and serves 500+ customers across 26 countries. It publishes no public developer API, but does maintain a genuine machine-readable web surface: an RFC 9727 /.well-known/api-catalog linkset, a structured facts.json, an llms.txt, and Content Signals AI-usage declarations in robots.txt.

providers.name: Binocs
providers.description: Binocs is an agentic AI-powered due diligence and strategic advisory platform for financial professionals — private equity, consulting, corporates and portfolio companies spanning private credit, venture capital and venture debt. The SaaS product (app.binocs.co) automates deal sourcing and screening, investment memos and market assessment, financial statement analysis, growth strategy and pricing diagnostics, CRM integration, and sell-side documentation (CIM, teasers), promising decision-ready diligence in minutes at up to 90% lower cost than traditional consulting. Binocs is an Accel portfolio company with offices in Jersey City, NJ and Bengaluru, India. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Brava Home
providers.description: Brava Home, Inc. is a Redwood City, California consumer-hardware company that makes the Brava smart countertop oven — a connected cooking appliance that uses its patented Pure Light infrared-lamp technology to sear, bake, air-fry, dehydrate, toast, reheat, and slow-cook, controlled through the Brava Home mobile app and a guided recipe platform. Brava sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at shop.brava.com. Brava does not publish a public developer/device API; its machine-facing surface is agentic commerce — the storefront exposes a Shopify-native Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile at /.well-known/ucp and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint so shopping agents can search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a cowboy-ventures portfolio lead, this profile has been enriched from Brava's real public surface.

providers.name: Canditech
providers.description: Canditech is a skills-assessment and job-simulation platform that helps hiring teams evaluate candidates' technical and soft skills before interviewing. The product generates role-specific skill assessments with AI, offers a library of 500+ expert-made tests, and runs job simulations, video interviews, cognitive and personality tests, and pre-screening chatbots, backed by anti-cheating controls (ChatGPT detection, copy-paste and tab tracking, device and location monitoring). Canditech is API-first and integrates with 40+ applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and more), plus WhatsApp, SMS, and Google Sheets. A private Enterprise API is available to partners and enterprise customers on request. Backed by Insight Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: canhelpto
providers.description: Support where your users are: inside the AI agent. canhelpto provides customer support for MCP servers, offering three tools within the server: failure context attachment, a human inbox, and answer back in the conversation. It integrates with Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, and is free to start, aiming to streamline help desk operations directly in AI-powered workflows.

providers.name: clearmakes-com
providers.description: clearmakes-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: CoinDCX
providers.description: Cryptocurrency Trading Platform

providers.name: Compound Finance
providers.description: Compound is a decentralized, blockchain-based protocol that allows users to lend and borrow cryptocurrencies (DeFi lending protocol) built on Ethereum.

providers.name: Condé Nast
providers.description: Condé Nast is a global media company owned by Advance Publications that produces editorial content across more than two dozen iconic brands — Vogue, GQ, The New Yorker, Wired, Vanity Fair, Bon Appétit, Architectural Digest, Pitchfork, Allure, Glamour, Self, Teen Vogue, Condé Nast Traveler, Epicurious, Tatler, House & Garden, The World of Interiors, Ars Technica, Vogue Business, La Cucina Italiana and Johansens. Public content surfaces are not a developer API but a federated set of brand-level RSS feeds, schema.org NewsArticle JSON-LD on every article, monthly XML sitemaps, syndicated video on YouTube and OTT, and a private editorial CMS (internally known as Copilot) that powers all sites.

providers.name: Critical Path Partners
providers.description: Critical Path Partners (CPP) provides forensic schedule analysis and delay claim consulting services for Ontario construction projects. They offer expert forensic methodology, free claim checks, and detailed analysis of Primavera P6 schedules to defend or support delay claims. Their services include windows analysis, as-built collapse, concurrency assessment, and expert testimony preparation, ensuring admissibility in court and compliance with Daubert standards. CPP serves sectors such as nuclear, energy, municipal infrastructure, mining, and commercial projects, delivering thorough, AI‑assisted reports within days.

providers.name: DistributionOS
providers.description: DistributionOS provides marketing context and distribution memory for AI‑assisted coding tools like Codex and Claude. It helps indie app builders capture product details, audience insights, research briefs, and tracking checklists, turning shipped work into reusable marketing assets. The platform offers a visual workflow linking Brain Doc context, agent activity, and results, enabling better promotion of apps built with AI.

providers.name: downtester-com
providers.description: downtester-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: doxa-app
providers.description: Doxa is a prophetic encouragement app that provides Bible resources, courses, and community features for churches, youth leaders, and individuals seeking spiritual growth. The platform offers a range of tools including daily devotionals, AI‑driven Christian insights, and a marketplace of grace‑focused content. It aims to help users hear, prophesy, record, test, remember, and trust in their faith journey through an engaging mobile and web experience.

providers.name: Draftly
providers.description: Draftly provides an AI-powered blog writing service that generates SEO‑ready posts in a user’s brand voice. It reads a website, selects timely industry topics, writes a draft with meta data, and can publish directly to platforms such as WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Ghost, Squarespace, or HubSpot. The tool is aimed at small businesses and marketing teams that need regular, on‑brand blog content without manual research or editing.

providers.name: Dredd
providers.description: Dredd is a language-agnostic, MIT-licensed open source command-line tool that validates a running HTTP API against its own API description document. It compiles every request/response pair documented in an API Blueprint, OpenAPI 2.0 or (experimentally) OpenAPI 3.0 file into an HTTP transaction, calls the API under test, and reports where the implementation and the documentation disagree. Hooks written in Node.js, Ruby, Python, PHP, Perl, Go or Rust handle per-transaction test setup and teardown, and pluggable reporters (xunit, dot, markdown, html) wire it into CI. Dredd publishes no API of its own — it is a client you install and run. The project has been archived and unmaintained since November 2024; the last release, 14.1.0, shipped in November 2021.

providers.name: Eleven Friends of Grumpy Brush Cleaning
providers.description: Eleven Friends of Grumpy Brush Cleaning provides professional house cleaning services across Austin and Central Texas. Customers can book recurring, deep, apartment, office, Airbnb, and move‑in or move‑out cleaning. The company emphasizes reliable, quiet service with flexible scheduling and a focus on thoroughness, serving numerous Texas cities including Austin, Round Rock, and Georgetown. With a team of experienced cleaners, Grumpy Brush ensures each job meets high standards, offering transparent pricing and easy online quotes.

providers.name: Ellipsis Health
providers.description: Ellipsis Health is a healthcare AI company that has established the human voice as a vital sign for mental health, using clinically validated vocal-biomarker technology, natural language processing, and acoustic models to identify, measure, and monitor the severity of depression and anxiety from short samples of natural speech. Its flagship product, Sage, is an emotionally intelligent, agentic AI care manager that conducts 24/7 patient-engagement calls for health plans, health systems, specialty care, and pharma, handling program enrollment, benefits verification, clinical assessments and surveys, and care coordination. Sage is powered by Ellipsis' patented Empathy Engine, trained on millions of live clinical patient calls, and runs on HIPAA and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant infrastructure. Ellipsis Health integrates with health plans and systems such as Cigna, and exposes a private partner API (used by partners like Augmedix) rather than a public developer platform. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, and CVS Health Ventures.

providers.name: English Disc Golf Association
providers.description: The English Disc Golf Association (EDGA) is the governing body for disc golf in England, supporting the sport’s growth through organizing tournaments, maintaining a network of courses, and providing resources for players of all levels. It offers membership, promotes community events, and works to increase participation across the country, fostering a vibrant disc golf community.

providers.name: Fauna
providers.description: Fauna is a serverless cloud database platform that provides a globally distributed, transactional NoSQL database with built‑in security, authentication, and a powerful query language called FQL. It enables developers to build modern applications without managing infrastructure, offering features such as multi‑region replication, ACID transactions, and flexible data models. Fauna’s platform is designed for high scalability, low latency, and seamless integration with serverless functions and APIs, making it ideal for building real‑time, data‑intensive applications.

providers.name: First Solar
providers.description: First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSLR) is the largest American manufacturer of solar modules and the leading producer of thin-film cadmium telluride (CdTe) photovoltaic technology, an alternative to conventional crystalline silicon. It designs and manufactures Series 6 and Series 7 modules at vertically integrated factories in Ohio, Alabama, Louisiana, India, Malaysia and Vietnam, and supports utility-scale PV projects with energy prediction, plant design and post-sales technical services. First Solar publishes no public API, developer program or machine-readable contract. Its "Developer Portal" is a Salesforce Experience Cloud site for solar project developers and EPC partners, not software developers, and requires a login. PlantPredict, the energy-modelling API and Python SDK First Solar built, was acquired by Terabase Energy in October 2021 and is catalogued against Terabase.

providers.name: Five9
providers.description: Five9 is a leading cloud contact center (CCaaS) platform providing inbound, outbound, blended, and omnichannel customer engagement with intelligent virtual agents, workforce optimization, agent assist, and analytics. Five9 exposes multiple developer APIs including REST APIs for configuration and reporting, SOAP-based Configuration and Statistics Web Services, the Agent and Supervisor REST APIs (app.five9.com/appsvcs), and Voicestream/event APIs, with authentication via session login and API user credentials.

providers.name: Flight Centre Travel Group
providers.description: Flight Centre Travel Group (ASX FLT) is a Brisbane-headquartered travel retailer and corporate travel manager, one of the largest agency groups in the world and by far the largest in its home market of Australia. It operates more than thirty brands across leisure retail (Flight Centre, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout, Aunt Betty, BYOjet, Envoyage, Scott Dunn, StudentUniverse), corporate travel management (FCM, Corporate Traveller, Stage and Screen, FCM Consulting) and wholesale supply (Discova, Infinity Holidays, Topdeck, Backroads Touring, TPConnects), with company-owned operations in twenty-four countries and licensed operations in roughly ninety more. Structurally it sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain - it is an aggregator-reseller that buys airline, hotel, cruise and land content through the GDSs (Sabre and Amadeus), through NDC aggregators, and through direct supplier agreements, and resells it to consumers and corporate travel programmes. Its API posture is honestly assessed as none published - Flight Centre Travel Group operates no developer portal, publishes no API reference, no OpenAPI, and no partner API documentation on any of its brand domains, and probing developer, developers, docs and api subdomains of fctgl.com, fcmtravel.com and flightcentre.com.au returns no DNS record at all. The group's genuine machine-readable distribution asset is TPConnects, the Dubai NDC aggregator it holds a majority stake in, whose Iris and Astra APIs are described on public product pages but whose reference documentation sits behind a ReadMe login. Flight Centre and FCM were the first global travel management company to receive IATA NDC Level 4 certification for full offer and order management, yet no public NDC endpoint is exposed. There is no self-serve access gate and no bulk export - the only documented exit path is a personal-data subject access request through a OneTrust web form.

providers.name: FortisBC
providers.description: FortisBC is a British Columbia energy utility and a subsidiary of Fortis Inc., delivering natural gas to more than 1,054,000 customers and electricity directly to close to 185,000 customers across the province's Southern Interior, plus liquefied natural gas from the Tilbury and Mt. Hayes facilities, renewable natural gas, and EV charging. It sits at the regulated distribution tier of the value chain — the wires-and-pipes monopoly that meters the customer — under British Columbia Utilities Commission oversight, in a province with no wholesale electricity market and no consumer energy data right. Its API posture is honestly none: no developer portal, no published API, no OpenAPI, and no Green Button. British Columbia sits outside Ontario's Green Button regulation (O. Reg. 633/21) and outside Australia's Consumer Data Right, and the Green Button Alliance reports only "minor discussions of Green Button in British Columbia to-date". Consumer usage data is reachable only by the account holder through a SiteMinder-protected customer login at accounts.fortisbc.com, or — for commercial gas customers only — pushed into the US EPA's ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager via that platform's data exchange, an arrangement FortisBC participates in rather than an API it publishes. No open market, grid, or system data is published. Consumer data closed, market data closed.

providers.name: Heex Technologies
providers.description: Heex Technologies builds the Smart-Data Platform, an event-based data management solution for autonomous systems, robotics, and ADAS/AD vehicles. Instead of moving raw big data off fleets, Heex lets engineering teams define Smart Events with pre-set triggers so software agents capture only the most relevant, context-rich data ("Smart-Data") directly at the edge or in the cloud. The platform spans a Heex Agent/SDK deployed on robots and vehicles (Ubuntu x86_64/ARM, ROS/ROS2), a Heex CLI for operating the SDK and Heex Cloud, and a web platform for triggers, events, recordings, and fleet monitoring. It is used across AMRs, industrial robots, smart mobility, and off-road autonomy, with customers and partners including NVIDIA, Siemens, RATP, Vinci, Stanley Robotics, Apex.AI and Helm.AI. Backed by Techstars, Google for Startups, and AWS Activate.

providers.name: HomeBox
providers.description: HomeBox provides a simple, open‑source home inventory management system. It lets users catalog items, locations, and collections with a lightweight Go backend, supporting SQLite or PostgreSQL, Docker deployment, and self‑hosting. The software emphasizes privacy, low resource usage (under 50 MB RAM), and extensibility through templates and labels, making it suitable for personal households and small teams.

providers.name: HumanFirst
providers.description: HumanFirst is a digital health measurement company whose Atlas platform helps clinical research and life-sciences teams evaluate, select, and operationalize sensor-based digital health technologies — wearables, connected devices, and digital biomarkers — for clinical trials and real-world evidence. Atlas curates a knowledge network of digital measures, connected devices, and the published evidence behind them so sponsors and CROs can choose fit-for-purpose measures. HumanFirst is now part of ICON plc and integrated into ICON's Digital Health Technologies (DHT) capabilities. The Atlas platform is delivered as an authenticated web application at app.gohumanfirst.com; the company does not currently publish a public developer API. This profile captures the company's public identity, security, and compliance posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: IMDb
providers.description: IMDb provides a premier source of global entertainment metadata, including over 12 million titles, 16 million cast and crew entries, and extensive box office data. The new GraphQL‑backed API, available via AWS Data Exchange, offers on‑demand access to ratings, analytics, and detailed metadata for developers building entertainment‑focused applications.

providers.name: Ivo
providers.description: Ivo (Ivo AI, Inc., formerly Latch) is an AI-powered contract intelligence platform built for in-house legal teams at enterprises. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, Ivo delivers three integrated products that share one AI engine: Ivo Review (a Microsoft Word add-in that applies a company's playbooks clause-by-clause to produce surgical redlines), Ivo Assistant (an agentic AI for drafting, cross-contract Q&A, and legal research) and Ivo Intelligence (an AI-native repository, powered by its AiRE engine, that turns existing contract libraries into queryable business intelligence). Customers include Uber, Shopify, IBM, Atlassian, Canva, Reddit and Pinterest. Ivo is enterprise-only with custom pricing and no public developer API; it publishes a canonical llms.txt, a Trust Center (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR, CCPA), and a responsible-disclosure security.txt.

providers.name: LeanTaaS
providers.description: LeanTaaS is a healthcare capacity-management software company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Its iQueue product line applies lean principles and predictive and prescriptive machine learning to hospital operations, helping health systems raise utilization of assets they already own — operating rooms, infusion chairs and inpatient beds — instead of building new capacity. Products include iQueue for Operating Rooms, iQueue for Infusion Centers, iQueue for Inpatient Flow, the iQueue Autopilot generative-AI layer, and accompanying transformation services. LeanTaaS reports serving more than 1,000 hospitals and centers across the United States and has been majority-owned by Bain Capital since 2022. LeanTaaS operates no public API program: there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI description, SDK or sandbox, and EHR integration is contracted per health system rather than published.

providers.name: Lena Health
providers.description: Lena Health is a Houston, Texas healthcare technology company founded in the Texas Medical Center that combines AI agents with human care navigators to deliver care coordination at scale. Its LenaConnect platform handles routine patient outreach calls, appointment scheduling and coordination, payer and provider hold times, automatic call documentation, EHR integration, and resource and referral management, so human navigators can focus on building trust with patients. Lena offers fully managed care navigation services covering Chronic Care Management (CCM), Transitional Care Management (TCM), rising-risk care management, and annual wellness visits, and works with health plans, accountable care organizations (ACOs), health systems, provider groups, care management providers, and community organizations. The company reports retrospective matched-cohort results of 29% fewer unplanned readmissions, 42% fewer ED visits, and $3,116 saved per patient within 180 days. Lena Health is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified, and publishes a trust center. Lena Health is a Techstars portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment; the platform is delivered as a managed service with EHR integration handled through engagements.

providers.name: Mango Markets
providers.description: Mango Markets is a decentralized derivatives exchange and money market built on Solana, operated by the Blockworks Foundation. Mango v4 introduces unified margin accounts that combine spot trading, perpetual futures, and borrow/lend in a single risk engine, settled by the on-chain Mango v4 program. Beyond the on-chain program and the TypeScript client, the project exposes low-latency public market-data feeds through the mango-feeds geyser services - the Fills Feed (service-mango-fills, fills.mngo.cloud) and the Orderbook Feed (service-mango-orderbook, orderbook.mngo.cloud) - which stream fill events and L2/L3 orderbook state for Mango V4 Perp markets and Openbook spot markets over WebSocket.

providers.name: Medigate
providers.description: Medigate was a healthcare IoT / connected-medical-device cybersecurity company (headquartered in Brooklyn, NY, backed by Partech and others) that built the first security platform dedicated to healthcare IoT — device discovery, risk assessment, and clinically-aware network segmentation for hospitals. Claroty completed its acquisition of Medigate on 2022-01-10 and folded the product into "Claroty xDome for Healthcare"; the standalone brand is retired and medigate.io now redirects to claroty.com. A residual customer-facing REST API remains live at api.medigate.io (with a password-gated interactive reference at api.medigate.io/docs) that integrations use to pull device inventory, device groups, and device risk scores.

providers.name: Memo Therapeutics
providers.description: Memo Therapeutics AG ("MTx"), an Ipsen company, is a late-stage biotechnology company headquartered at Wagistrasse 27 in Schlieren / Zurich, Switzerland, with a US office as Memo Therapeutics US, Inc. in Wilson, North Carolina. It develops best-in-class therapeutic antibodies to transform the lives of patients with viral infections and cancer, built on DROPZYLLA, a microfluidic single-cell platform that makes a recombinant in vitro copy of an individual donor's B-cell antibody repertoire, banks it as a library, and screens it functionally at high throughput. Its lead program, potravitug, is a first-in-class monoclonal antibody against BK polyomavirus (BKPyV) reactivation in kidney transplant recipients; the Phase II SAFE KIDNEY II trial reported biopsy-proven resolution of BKPyV-associated nephropathy with sustained viral-load reduction to week 38, and the asset holds EU orphan designation. In February 2026 the company entered a collaboration and option agreement with CSL for its recombinant polyclonal IgG technology carrying milestones of up to CHF 265 million, and it has run an oncology antibody-discovery collaboration with Ono Pharmaceutical since 2022 alongside nephrology collaborations with the University Hospital of Zurich and the University Hospital of Bern. Ipsen completed its acquisition of Memo Therapeutics AG on 22 July 2026, adding potravitug to Ipsen's rare-disease pipeline. Memo Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, SDK or API documentation. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind memo-therapeutics.com, catalogued here, together with an llms.txt the site's SEO plugin publishes.

providers.name: Microsoft Surface
providers.description: Microsoft Surface is a line of touchscreen-based personal computers and accessories designed and developed by Microsoft. Surface provides enterprise management APIs through UEFI configuration and Intune integration for managing Surface devices at scale.

providers.name: ModernLoop
providers.description: ModernLoop is an automated interview scheduling and recruiting-operations platform for talent-acquisition teams, now paired with "Taylor AI," a configurable AI recruiting agent. It coordinates interviewer calendars, balances load, and schedules complex interview loops across time zones to cut time-to-hire and improve candidate experience. ModernLoop integrates deeply with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Avature), calendar and video tools (Google, Microsoft Outlook/Teams, Zoom, Google Meet), communication (Slack, Gmail), coding assessment (CoderPad, CodeSignal, Codility, HackerRank), and SSO providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID). The platform is delivered as SaaS: it consumes partner APIs but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server. Backed by Accel. This profile was enriched from ModernLoop's public site, trust center, and status page.

providers.name: Money View
providers.description: Moneyview is an Indian consumer fintech platform offering a suite of financial services including personal loans (up to Rs 10L), home loans, business loans, loans against property, credit cards, fixed deposits, digital gold, motor insurance, credit tracking, and UPI payments. The platform reports serving over 12 crore users across 18,400+ pincodes. Moneyview publishes ISO 27001:2022 and PCI DSS certifications and a responsible vulnerability disclosure program, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Moonfare
providers.description: Moonfare is a digital investment platform that gives individual professional and high-net-worth investors access to private equity and venture capital funds that were historically reserved for institutions. The platform pools investor commitments into Luxembourg-based feeder funds, applies rigorous due diligence (approving only a small fraction of screened funds), and offers products spanning direct fund investments, portfolio-of-funds, co-investments, secondaries, and open-ended funds, with a digital secondary market for institutional-style liquidity. Moonfare handles capital calls, distributions, reporting, and administration through a technology-enabled onboarding and portfolio experience. Moonfare does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Mozilla accounts
providers.description: Mozilla Accounts (formerly Firefox Accounts) is Mozilla’s unified authentication and user profile service that powers Firefox Sync, Pocket, and other Mozilla products. It provides secure sign‑in, account recovery, and profile management via a set of public APIs. The service is open‑source, with its code hosted on GitHub, and its documentation is available in the repository and on Mozilla’s developer site.

providers.name: NexMind
providers.description: NexMind (operating as NexLaw) is a legal AI platform for U.S. litigators and law firms, offering secure, hallucination-free AI that drafts, summarizes, and researches legal work up to 10x faster. Its products include NeXa (AI legal research and drafting assistant), ChronoVault (evidence centralization and automated case timelines), TrialPrep (trial preparation workspace for arguments and witness outlines), and a real-time Courtroom Assistant, with capabilities spanning citation-backed legal deep research, deposition and document analysis, case chronology building, legal memo drafting, and contract and breach analysis. NexLaw is a direct-to-user SaaS product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Next Big Idea Club
providers.description: Next Big Idea Club is a nonfiction book subscription club and podcast that curates the most important new nonfiction, chosen by a selection committee of Malcolm Gladwell, Adam Grant, Susan Cain, and Daniel Pink. Members receive curated new nonfiction, an in-app library, courses, and author interviews across the web and native iOS/Android apps. The consumer experience is powered by a first-party WordPress REST API (the members/v1 namespace) secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect via the WP OAuth Server, with Stripe integration for subscription billing. This profile was seeded as a Bloomberg Beta portfolio lead and enriched from the provider's public /wp-json/ discovery and /.well-known/ OAuth surface.

providers.name: NimaSensor
providers.description: NIMA (originally 6SensorLabs, founded by MIT alumni Shireen Yates and Scott Sundvor) makes a portable, consumer-use gluten detection sensor for people living with celiac disease and gluten sensitivity. A pea-sized food sample is loaded into a single-use capsule, inserted into the handheld NIMA Sensor, and returns a clear result in about three minutes, detecting gluten down to 10 ppm. The product relaunched in 2025-2026 with investment from RA Capital Management, pairing a next-generation sensor with newly engineered test capsules and the NIMA Now app. NIMA is a consumer hardware and e-commerce company (storefront hosted on Shopify), not a developer-API provider - it exposes no first-party public developer API. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: OKEx
providers.description: Cryptocurrency exchange based in Seychelles

providers.name: Pitch
providers.description: Pitch is a collaborative presentation software company (pitch.com) that builds a fast, web-based tool for teams to create, share, and present decks together in real time, with templates, brand controls, live collaboration, analytics, and in-product integrations. Backed by Index Ventures and tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this profile Pitch publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server; enrichment here captured its published security and identity surface.

providers.name: PostcardMania
providers.description: PostcardMania provides direct mail advertising services, offering businesses the ability to design, print, and mail postcards, flyers, and other marketing materials at scale. Through its Direct Mail API, developers can automate postcard creation and mailing, integrating with CRM and marketing platforms. The company serves small to large enterprises across various industries, emphasizing cost‑effective, targeted outreach.

providers.name: Prysm
providers.description: Prysm — legally Motherson Prysm, Inc. — builds large-format interactive display hardware and the Prysm Application Suite, a cloud-hosted visual collaboration and digital-workplace platform. Founded in 2005 in Silicon Valley as Spudnik by Amit Jain and Roger Hajjar, the company invented and patented Laser Phosphor Display (LPD) technology, shipped today as the bezel-free LPD 6K Series single-panel display (up to 225 inches) alongside an 85-inch LCD room solution. In 2014 Prysm merged with Anacore to add a multi-source interactive canvas, producing a platform that combines digital whiteboarding, on-screen annotation, co-browsing, device sharing and Teams/Zoom/Webex launching across web, desktop and iPhone clients for customer experience centers, executive boardrooms and huddle rooms. Prysm became part of the Motherson Group in 2025. Prysm announced an early preview of a "Prysm API" for custom applications on its digital workplace platform in June 2017, but publishes no developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification today.

providers.name: Structura
providers.description: Structura is a web-based visual domain modeling and code generation tool built by Metadev (metadev.pro). Architecture teams and software factories design class/domain models graphically or textually, refine them with the Zeus voice/text AI assistant, validate them for compliance and architectural consistency, and export deterministic, production-ready code for stacks such as Angular, .NET and Java, including custom generators that codify a team's conventions and policies. Its documentation also describes an MCP server for connecting AI tools to models.

providers.name: Swimm
providers.description: Swimm is a codebase-understanding and modernization platform that combines deterministic static analysis, AI agents, and senior engineers to help teams understand, document, and safely transform large or legacy codebases. Its core product is an AI coding assistant that helps developers understand complex code and capture that knowledge as code-coupled documentation that stays in sync with the source, with IDE integrations, CI verification, and an agentic context layer that feeds validated knowledge to tools like Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code.
