providers.description: HyperWrite (by OthersideAI) is an AI writing assistant plus Personal Assistant and Agent product line that combines AutoWrite, TypeAhead, HyperChat, an AI Document Editor, Scholar AI research, and a Chrome extension that lets an agent take real actions in the browser (Gmail, LinkedIn, shopping, travel). HyperWrite has historically described a partner/API program for its agent, but there is no fully public self-serve API reference - profiled here through the consumer product surface.

providers.name: Instadapp
providers.description: Instadapp is a decentralized finance (DeFi) middleware company that scales DeFi for users and developers through non-custodial Smart Accounts. Its core DSA (DeFi Smart Accounts / DeFi Smart Layer) protocol aggregates lending, DEX, and yield protocols behind a single upgradable smart-contract layer, driven by a composable cast() function, with connectors and resolvers for protocols such as Aave, Compound, MakerDAO, and Uniswap. Instadapp also builds Fluid (a capital-efficient lending and DEX protocol), Avocado (a smart-contract wallet with account, gas, and smart-contract execution), and Instadapp Lite (simplified DeFi vaults). It supports Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Fantom, Gnosis, Scroll, and Polygon zkEVM. The developer surface is on-chain smart contracts plus first-party JavaScript and TypeScript SDKs published to npm; there is no first-party REST API. Instadapp is backed by Pantera Capital.

providers.name: Invicti
providers.description: Invicti is an enterprise web application security solution providing automated vulnerability scanning, DAST, and API security testing. The Invicti platform includes API Discovery capabilities that help build a complete inventory of an organization's internal and external API assets.

providers.name: Jeeves
providers.description: Jeeves is a global financial platform for cross-border businesses, combining corporate cards (physical and virtual with spend controls and cashback), automated expense management with approval flows and policy enforcement, cross-border payments and transfers to 150+ countries in 40+ currencies, instant and stablecoin-based settlement, non-dilutive corporate credit, and AI-driven spend insights. Jeeves operates across Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Canada, the USA, the UK, and the European Union, serving globally operating companies. Backed by a16z and CRV, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Jellyfin
providers.description: Jellyfin is a free, open-source media system that lets you collect, manage, and stream your media files. It is community‑built, runs on your own server, and offers no‑strings‑attached streaming to any device, with full control over your library and privacy.

providers.name: JOLYN
providers.description: JOLYN is an athletic swimwear and apparel brand for competitive and team swimming, water polo, and aquatics, known for durable, functional practice and racing suits, team uniforms, and active lifestyle apparel. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, JOLYN publishes no first-party developer API — its direct-to-consumer storefront at jolyn.com (jolynclothing.com redirects here) is Shopify-hosted. That platform exposes a genuine agent-native commerce surface: a published /llms.txt with agent instructions, OpenID Connect discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for buyer-approved, agent-driven shopping and checkout.

providers.name: Linearity
providers.description: Linearity GmbH is a Berlin-based design-technology company building AI-assisted design and animation software for individuals, marketing teams, and enterprises. Its two flagship products are Linearity Curve, a professional vector design and graphic art tool formerly released as Vectornator, and Linearity Move, an animation tool that turns static designs into motion graphics with Auto-Animate and keyframe control. The platform adds an AI Design Generator that produces entire marketing campaigns, social posts, ads, and templates from a text prompt as fully editable vector files rather than flat images, along with an AI Vector Generator, Auto-Resize for adapting assets across channels, brand-kit management, and collaborative team workspaces with role-based permissions. Products ship on macOS and iOS with a web workspace. Linearity publishes no public HTTP API, developer portal, or SDKs as of July 2026; it does publish an llms.txt, dated release notes, a help center, and a public status page.

providers.name: Lively
providers.description: Lively is a fintech-healthtech company that provides modern, cloud-based Health Savings Accounts (HSA) alongside Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Reimbursement Arrangements (HRA), COBRA, and commuter benefits for individuals, families, employers, benefits administrators, and third-party administrators. Lively pairs interest-bearing and investment-enabled HSAs (via a Schwab Health Savings Brokerage Account and a guided HSA portfolio) with an employer dashboard for contributions and administration, positioning itself around transparent, zero-hidden-fee pricing. Backed by Costanoa Ventures and GGV Capital, Lively integrates with benefit administration platforms and third-party administrators but does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is handled through its sales and partnerships channels. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Lively's public web surface.

providers.name: MarqVision
providers.description: MarqVision is a brand-integrity and intellectual-property protection platform (Y Combinator S21) that uses AI-powered image recognition and semantic analysis to detect and remove counterfeits, unauthorized sellers, brand impersonation and pirated content across more than 1,500 online marketplaces, e-commerce sites, social platforms and app stores. The product line spans MarqCommerce (marketplace enforcement), MarqContents (content and piracy protection), MarqFolio (trademark portfolio management), MarqLaw (legal services) and a Brand Intelligence Agent for natural-language brand-threat analytics. MarqVision operates a customer-facing "MarqAI API" — named as a component on its own public status page and described in its engineering blog as the "Action-Enabled API" behind the Marq AI Slack app — but publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract; programmatic access is arranged through a customer success manager or the demo waitlist.

providers.name: Monnai
providers.description: Monnai is a global consumer-insights infrastructure company that delivers real-time, AI-ready data for decisioning across the entire customer lifecycle. Its Insights API unifies fragmented identity, device, phone, email, and behavioral signals from a proprietary data consortium into clean, contextual 360-degree profiles, enabling financial institutions, fintechs, ecommerce, and marketplaces to power acquisition, onboarding (KYC/AML), risk assessment and fraud detection, credit decisioning, and collections. Monnai provides localized coverage across 190+ countries with a privacy-first, encryption-backed approach. The API is secured with OAuth 2.0. Monnai is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: MyCrypto
providers.description: MyCrypto is a free, open-source, client-side interface for managing Ethereum accounts and interacting with the Ethereum blockchain. Founded in 2015, it is a non-custodial wallet — private keys never leave the user's device — supporting hardware wallets, Web3 and browser wallets, and offline transaction signing. In February 2022 MyCrypto was acquired by ConsenSys to consolidate with MetaMask and unify the Web3 wallet experience. MyCrypto ships no public REST API; its developer surface is the open-source application codebase and the JavaScript/TypeScript libraries (eth-scan, ethereum-blockies-base64, asset mappings) published under the MyCryptoHQ GitHub organization.

providers.name: Neobanks
providers.description: A collection of APIs from leading neobanks and digital banking platforms including Revolut, Monzo, Starling Bank, N26, Nubank, Bunq, and others that offer modern banking services through developer-friendly APIs.

providers.name: Nori
providers.description: Nori (Nori Robotics) is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) hard-tech company in San Francisco building affordable bimanual humanoid home robots — the NORI L2, a sub-$1,300 wheeled robot with dual Z-axis lift arms that autonomously handles household chores like loading dishes, making beds, food prep, and cleaning, with multiple units able to collaborate on coordinated tasks. Beyond the hardware, Nori publishes a developer surface: the @nori/sdk robot-local teleoperation SDK connects to a robot over WebRTC to stream video and telemetry and drive it from the browser in ~20 lines, with all safety mechanisms (clamping, watchdog, E-STOP, motor torque lifecycle) enforced on the robot's control daemon. The SDK targets the nori-protocol v1 wire format (NDJSON over a WebRTC data channel to the daemon on port 7777), is Apache-2.0 licensed, and is distributed to a small set of collaborating developers as a tarball rather than on public npm.

providers.name: Nova Labs
providers.description: Nova Labs, Inc. is the company behind the Helium Network, a decentralized wireless network that replaces traditional carrier infrastructure with community-hosted Hotspots and is coordinated on the Solana blockchain and incentivized with the HNT token. Helium operates two networks: a global LoRaWAN network for low-power IoT devices and a cellular/Wi-Fi offload network for mobile connectivity (Helium Mobile). Nova Labs open-sources the network's protocol surface as gRPC/Protobuf service definitions (the helium/proto config, router, and proof-of-coverage services) and publishes a set of first-party client libraries, a command-line tool, and Rust crates for cryptography and protobuf types. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from Nova Labs' public developer surface; much of the legacy Helium IoT REST API tooling is archived following the network's migration to Solana.

providers.name: Omnee
providers.description: Omnee (Omnee AI) is a Techstars-backed startup providing an AI-powered customer care platform built for residential homebuilders. It pairs a per-home digital "home twin" data record with a personalized, multilingual AI assistant that handles buyer support and warranty management 24/7, claiming to increase warranty-department capacity by over 60%. Products are sold per-home (Warranty Triage, AI Customer Care, and an Enterprise Partner tier with custom integrations). The company operates a marketing and product website but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was enriched from its public site.

providers.name: OpenDTU
providers.description: OpenDTU provides open-source firmware for solar inverters, enabling local monitoring and control without reliance on cloud services. The project supports ESP32-based hardware, offers a web UI, MQTT integration, and a documented Web API for retrieving inverter data, configuring settings, and managing devices. It targets DIY solar enthusiasts and small installations seeking transparent, self-hosted energy monitoring solutions.

providers.name: Openroll
providers.description: Openroll is an AI-native operating system for compensation, built for People and Finance teams. It connects to existing HRIS, ATS, ERP, and finance systems, runs fully auditable analyses, and turns repeated workflows into agentic operations - covering compensation reviews, salary bands, headcount planning, pay-strategy monitoring, and actuals-versus-budget variance. Founded in 2024 and backed by Y Combinator, Openroll operates from San Francisco and Stockholm, is SOC 2 Type I and Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and never uses customer data to train its AI models.

providers.name: RapidClaims
providers.description: RapidClaims is a healthcare revenue-cycle-management (RCM) company building autonomous AI agents for medical coding and claims. Its platform automates medical coding (RapidCode), value-based-care coding and risk adjustment (RapidVBC), denial management and revenue recovery (RapidRecovery), and a unified revenue cycle platform (RapidRCM) for FQHCs, community health centers, ACOs, physician groups, ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals, and management services organizations. The company emphasizes a healthcare-grade security and compliance posture (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 Type II, 256-bit encryption). RapidClaims is backed by Accel and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Real Estate Institute of Australia
providers.description: The Real Estate Institute of Australia (REIA), founded in 1924 and based in Canberra, is the national federation of the eight state and territory Real Estate Institutes (REINSW, REIV, REIQ, REIWA, REISA, REIT, REIACT, REINT), which between them represent roughly 85% of Australian real estate businesses and agents. REIA is a policy, research and accreditation body, not an operator of market infrastructure: it administers the REIA National Principles of Conduct that underpin state institute codes and training, awards Associate (AREI) and Fellow accreditations, runs the Australasian Auctioneering Championships (AUSTROS) jointly with REINZ and the National Awards for Excellence (NAFE), makes submissions to the Commonwealth Government, and publishes the quarterly Housing Affordability Report (HAR) and Real Estate Market Facts (REMF) series that Federal Treasury, the Reserve Bank, state treasuries and investment banks subscribe to. It sits well above the transaction rail in the Australian value chain - listings run through REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain, settlement through PEXA, valuation through PropTrack and CoreLogic, and title through the state land registries - and REIA touches none of those pipes. Its API posture is therefore an honest absence: no developer portal, no API subdomain, no OpenAPI or OData contract, and no RESO reference anywhere on its estate, because RESO is a NAR-mandated United States construct with no Australian counterpart. What REIA sells is data, not access to it - the HAR and REMF reports are AUD 450 subscriptions and each of the 7 HAR and 15 REMF underlying datasets is a separate AUD 280 subscription, delivered as documents through a platformOS/Insites ecommerce storefront with Stripe checkout behind an email-and-password account. Policy submissions, standalone research reports and the strategic plan are freely downloadable PDFs; the quarterly numbers are not, and there is no open data.

providers.name: SmartSuite
providers.description: SmartSuite is a collaborative work management platform that helps teams plan, track, and manage workflows, projects, and everyday tasks using customizable solutions, tables, records, and automations. The platform combines spreadsheet, database, project management, and workflow automation capabilities into a unified workspace. SmartSuite's REST API provides programmatic access to Solutions, Tables, Records, and Fields using token-based authentication.

providers.name: Tava Health
providers.description: Tava Health, Inc. is a Utah-founded (2019) digital behavioral-health company that sells mental health care as an employer and health-plan benefit. Employers, health plans and provider groups contract with Tava; covered members are matched to a licensed therapist — typically within about twelve hours — and receive care over secure video or in person through a nationwide clinical network. Care is delivered by Tava Professionals, a set of state-level professional entities that act as the HIPAA covered entity, while Tava Health, Inc. operates the technology platform as their business associate. The platform runs as two portals: a client portal at care.tavahealth.com for members and a provider/administrative portal at app.tavahealth.com for therapists and plan administrators. Tava also runs DirectCare, a partner-facing product with its own developer hub at docs.tavahealth.com; that hub is a ReadMe.io site and is password-protected, so no public API reference, OpenAPI definition or other machine-readable contract is available at this time.

providers.name: The Shippers Group
providers.description: The Shippers Group is a leading national third-party logistics (3PL) company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1901, the company provides warehousing, co-packaging, fulfillment, and transportation management services across 12 locations totaling over 5 million square feet of space. The Shippers Group serves brand leaders and market innovators in industries including food, consumer packaged goods, and retail. The company was acquired by Kenco Group in December 2023. Client integrations are handled via EDI connections and logistics technology partnerships with warehouse management systems and transportation management systems.

providers.name: Universal Robots
providers.description: Universal Robots is a Danish collaborative-robot (cobot) manufacturer headquartered in Odense, Denmark, founded in 2005 by Esben Østergaard, Kasper Støy, and Kristian Kassow, and acquired by Teradyne in 2015 for USD 285 million. Universal Robots is the market leader in cobots, with more than 100,000 units sold worldwide and a 40–50% share of the global collaborative-robot market. The company ships two product generations — the e-Series (UR3e, UR7e, UR12e, UR16e) and the newer high-payload UR series (UR8 Long, UR15, UR18, UR20, UR30) — running the PolyScope 5 teach-pendant software stack and the next-generation PolyScope X platform. Universal Robots is unusual among industrial-robot vendors in publishing an extensive open developer surface: the C++ Universal_Robots_Client_Library, the Universal_Robots_ROS_Driver and Universal_Robots_ROS2_Driver, the RTDE Python Client Library, the Universal_Robots_Isaac_Driver for NVIDIA Isaac, the URCap SDK (PolyScope 5 Java) and PolyScopeX URCap SDK (TypeScript/HTML), and the URScript language. The wire-level protocols — Real-Time Data Exchange (RTDE), Dashboard Server, Primary/Secondary Client Interface, Reverse/Trajectory interfaces, XML-RPC, and the Tool Communication forwarder — are all documented and externally addressable over TCP, making UR cobots first-class citizens in third-party automation stacks, ROS/ROS 2, MoveIt, Isaac Sim, and the UR+ ecosystem (500+ certified end-effectors, vision systems, and URCap software extensions on universal-robots.com/plus). Universal Robots does not publish a public HTTP/REST API or OpenAPI specification — all programmatic access is via the documented socket protocols and SDKs.

providers.name: 3Bar Biologics
providers.description: 3Bar Biologics (3BarBio) is an agricultural biotechnology company in Columbus, Ohio, spun out of research at The Ohio State University and operating as the first contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) dedicated to agricultural biologicals. Its business is getting living microbes to the field alive: the patented LiveMicrobe platform, including the Iso-Pak and Re-Pak delivery systems, keeps beneficial bacteria viable through storage and distribution, the problem that has historically limited adoption of microbial crop inputs. The company sells design, development, biomanufacturing and fulfillment services to discovery companies, distributors and bulk suppliers, and previously marketed its own Bio-YIELD inoculant to corn, soybean and wheat growers in the eastern Corn Belt. 3Bar Biologics is a manufacturer and services business, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs and no pricing for any programmatic product. The only machine-readable interface it exposes is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website at www.3barbiologics.com, which is captured here for discovery purposes. That surface is anonymously readable, read-only, entirely undocumented by the company, and carries two reproducible defects on its media collection that are recorded in this profile.

providers.name: Abercrombie and Fitch
providers.description: Abercrombie & Fitch is a global specialty retailer of casual apparel, accessories, and personal care products operating multiple lifestyle brands including Abercrombie, Hollister, and Gilly Hicks. The company operates through a direct-to-consumer model with both e-commerce and physical retail stores across global markets.

providers.name: AI Plan Creator
providers.description: AI Plan Creator is a New Zealand‑based browser application that uses AI to generate floor plans, 3D models, interior designs, landscaping and walkthroughs for homes and buildings. Users describe their idea in natural language and the platform creates detailed plans, renders 3D visualisations, and offers design tools. The service launched as PlotPilot in 2023 and rebranded in October 2026, providing free starter access with optional premium plans for advanced features.

providers.name: AI Website Security
providers.description: AI Website Security provides AI‑driven analysis and protection for websites, automatically verifying the provenance of every file on a site. It monitors changes, detects unauthorized modifications, offers real‑time alerts, and can restore sites to a verified state without installing software. Services include file‑justification, continuous monitoring, breach detection, and automated remediation, available in French, English and German.

providers.name: Altana AI
providers.description: Altana is an AI-powered network for trusted trade, operating the world's largest knowledge graph of the global supply chain — a map covering roughly half of global trade and 600M+ companies, built from shipment and product information contributed by logistics providers and businesses. Altana connects enterprises, logistics providers, suppliers, and government agencies (including US Customs and Border Protection) around a shared source of product truth, delivered as Product Passports and the Atlas knowledge graph. Its solutions span trade and tariffs, sourcing and procurement, supplier management and screening, supply chain risk, regulatory compliance (UFLPA, EUDR, Section 889), and trade compliance. The Atlas Graph API (customer-provisioned, HMAC-signed API keys) exposes advanced searches across the Atlas knowledge graph, including notebook-based analysis in Databricks.

providers.name: AskWatch
providers.description: AskWatch provides an AI visibility tracking platform that helps marketers and agencies understand why AI systems recommend certain brands or competitors. Users can check their brand presence, see AI‑generated recommendations, and receive actionable insights to improve visibility. The service offers free tools like AI‑visibility checkers, overview checkers, and integrations with popular AI models. It includes pricing plans for deeper monitoring, a blog with industry insights, and support resources. AskWatch aims to make AI‑driven brand discovery transparent and actionable for businesses.

providers.name: AstroPay
providers.description: AstroPay is a Uruguay-founded fintech and electronic money institution offering a multicurrency wallet, virtual and physical AstroCards, FX, and cross-border money transfers for consumers across Latin America, plus a business platform that lets merchants accept payments, issue cards, manage payroll, and pay out to wallets and bank accounts. AstroPay is regulated as an EMI in the UK, Denmark, Isle of Man, and Brazil, and operates the AstroPay wallet across Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Uruguay, and additional global corridors with support for ARS, BRL, CLP, COP, EUR, GBP, MXN, PEN, USD, USDT, and UYU. For developers, AstroPay exposes a comprehensive REST platform spanning payments, payouts, PIX instant payments in Brazil, issued cards, savings accounts, scheme transfers, user account management, tokenization (PCI-compliant card collection), settlements, transaction reporting, hosted and embedded Checkout, QR-code POS, Wallet-on-File account linking, Cashouts, and Webhooks — accessed through `developers.astropay.com` with HMAC-signed callbacks and an OAuth/API-key authentication model.

providers.name: Atlier
providers.description: Project Desk by Atlier is an AI‑first work‑management desk that provides a shared memory across AI sessions, keeping projects, queues, and handoffs truthful as agents do the work. Built and operated by Wilds, Inc., an independent company in Massachusetts, USA, it offers a beta‑stage product with transparent Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Trust & data‑handling pages. Users bring their own AI (Claude, Codex, etc.) and are never charged for agents; the service is free for solo builders and charges only for human seats in team plans.

providers.name: ATSPrep
providers.description: ATSPrep is a free, evidence‑first resume builder and job tracker that lets users tailor resumes with verifiable achievements, save multiple versions, track applications, and check PDF text recovery before submission. The web‑based tool runs locally in the browser, requires no account for core features, and offers optional paid Pro plans for AI‑enhanced editing and additional templates. It supports importing resumes from PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown, provides a job‑fit matcher, and ensures privacy by never uploading personal data.

providers.name: avots.ai
providers.description: avots.ai is an AI aggregator platform offering a single subscription that provides access to over 40 AI models, including GPT‑5, Claude, Gemini, Veo, FLUX, DeepSeek and many others. Users can generate text, images, video, music, and code through a unified web app, with plans ranging from a free tier to €149 per month. The service positions itself as a ChatGPT alternative, delivering a broad range of generative AI capabilities under one roof.

providers.name: Boundless Bio
providers.description: Boundless Bio (Nasdaq: BOLD) is a San Diego, California based clinical-stage, next-generation precision oncology company founded in 2018 to target extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) — circular, centromere-free DNA that carries high copy-number oncogene amplifications and is observed in roughly 17% of cancer patients, driving tumor heterogeneity and resistance to targeted therapy. Its proprietary Spyglass discovery platform, built on a suite of ecDNA+/- tumor models plus molecular analytics and imaging, identifies targets essential to ecDNA function, which the company drugs with small-molecule ecDNA-directed therapies (ecDTx). The clinical pipeline is led by BBI-940, a kinesin inhibitor targeting ecDNA segregation, in the Phase 1 KOMODO-1 trial in ER+/HER2- and TNBC-LAR breast cancer opened in February 2026, with earlier CHK1 (replication stress) and RNR (DNA assembly and repair) programs behind it; ECHO, its ecDNA diagnostic algorithm, reads ecDNA off routine clinical next-generation sequencing and is described by the company as the first ecDNA diagnostic used in clinical trials. Boundless Bio raised a $100M Series C co-led by Leaps by Bayer and RA Capital and listed on Nasdaq in 2024. It publishes no developer program, no product API, no SDKs and no API documentation of any kind; the only machine-readable surface on boundlessbio.com is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2), anonymously readable, which serves the corporate pages, the Leadership directory and the media library as JSON.

providers.name: BrightSpring Health Services
providers.description: BrightSpring Health Services is a leading Fortune 500 provider of comprehensive home and community-based health services for complex populations. The company operates across three primary service lines: Provider Services (home health, rehabilitation, neurorehabilitation, personal care), Pharmacy Services (specialty infusion, home and community-based pharmacy dispensing over 40 million prescriptions annually), and Managed Care (home-based primary care with demonstrated 44% reduction in hospitalizations). BrightSpring operates multiple clinical brands including Adoration Home Health, Amerita specialty infusion, and All Ways Caring.

providers.name: CheapChat
providers.description: CheapChat helps sellers turn Instagram and Facebook comments into automated direct messages, building comment and keyword automations, managing conversations, and offering a free starter plan. The platform streamlines social media engagement for businesses, enabling private replies and workflow automation without requiring a credit card to begin.

providers.name: Claude News
providers.description: Claude News aggregates real‑time news about Claude and Anthropic, pulling from official Anthropic releases, status updates, press, Hacker News, Reddit and GitHub. It curates and summarizes content, providing a signal without the noise. The service is operated by Héra SASU and launched in June 2026, offering timely AI model updates, security alerts, and community insights.

providers.name: CleanBoss
providers.description: CleanBoss is a consumer products brand offering non‑toxic, botanically‑derived cleaning solutions. Founded by Joy Mangano and Armando Christian Pérez, the company sells multi‑surface cleaners, laundry sheets, fruit‑and‑veggie washes, and other eco‑friendly products through its Shopify storefront. The brand emphasizes safety, effectiveness, and a “cleaning revolution” with a 100 % money‑back guarantee and free shipping on orders over $45.

providers.name: CounterTack
providers.description: CounterTack, Inc. was a Waltham, Massachusetts endpoint detection and response (EDR) vendor whose Sentinel and Endpoint Threat Platform products applied behavioral analysis, memory forensics and machine learning to detect zero-days, rootkits and advanced persistent threats. In June 2018 CounterTack acquired its channel partner GoSecure, a managed detection and response (MDR) provider, and in March 2019 rebranded the combined company as "GoSecure powered by CounterTack"; the CounterTack name has since been retired in favour of GoSecure, which today markets a managed extended detection and response (MXDR) service and the GoSecure Titan platform covering EDR, IDR, NGAV, SIEM and professional services. The CounterTack surface is therefore historical: countertack.com still resolves to GoSecure infrastructure but serves no valid certificate, and the living platform is customer-only behind a Keycloak single sign-on at titan.gosecure.net.

providers.name: CourtDrive
providers.description: CourtDrive provides an AI‑powered docketing assistant for law firms, automating federal and state court e‑notice handling, calendaring, and document management integration. The platform offers free docket access, AI‑driven deadline calculation, and seamless syncing with systems like iManage, NetDocuments, Clio, Google Drive, and more, helping legal teams save time and reduce errors.

providers.name: Crovia
providers.description: Crovia runs TACET: every hour, a public randomness beacon opens an epoch, Crovia fetches AI model cards, runs a published predicate, commits the results to a sparse Merkle map, signs the sheet and anchors it in Bitcoin. When a lab stays silent about training data, the silence becomes a proof anyone can verify offline. LACUNA certificates. EU AI Act Article 53 observatory. The platform provides transparent AI training-data disclosure through cryptographic verification.

providers.name: Cuyana
providers.description: Cuyana is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer women's fashion brand founded in 2011 by Karla Gallardo and Shilpa Shah, built on a "Fewer, Better Things" philosophy of timeless, high-quality essentials — leather totes and handbags, small leather goods, and apparel — crafted from sustainable, Leather Working Group (LWG) certified materials through ethical manufacturing partnerships. The brand runs an omnichannel direct-to-consumer business across its e-commerce store and a growing fleet of retail locations. Cuyana's storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes agent-facing surfaces on the cuyana.com domain: a live hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp for AI shopping agents (search_catalog, get_cart, update_cart, get_product_details, search_shop_policies_and_faqs), and Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC discovery documents under /.well-known/. Cuyana is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: DataSnipper
providers.description: DataSnipper is an AI-powered, agentic productivity platform built specifically for audit, tax, and finance teams. It automates repetitive testing and analysis work - extracting, matching, and analyzing data across documents and systems - while keeping human professionals in control of final decisions. Capabilities include AI Agents for end-to-end workflows (revenue testing, tests of detail, royalty calculations), Excel Agents that run analysis directly inside spreadsheets, and document intelligence that collects and cross-references evidence. The platform serves external audit, internal audit, tax, financial control, government audit, and advisory teams, with a security-first posture (no training on customer data, encryption, and 24-hour document deletion). Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Demandstar
providers.description: DemandStar (now Euna OpenBids) is a shared supplier network for government eProcurement that has connected local, county, and state government agencies with business suppliers since 1998. Government agencies publish bids, RFPs, and solicitations to the network for free, while suppliers subscribe to receive automated notifications about relevant opportunities matched through more than 9,000 commodity codes, download bid packages, and submit electronic bid responses online. The platform spans roughly 700 participating agencies and a network of over 150,000 registered suppliers, offering free and paid supplier tiers ($99-$299/month depending on geographic coverage) plus per-document service fees. DemandStar is now part of Euna Solutions and rebranding as Euna OpenBids as part of a broader public-procurement ecosystem.

providers.name: downforjustmeoreveryone-com
providers.description: downforjustmeoreveryone-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: DraftCall
providers.description: DraftCall is an AI‑powered fantasy football platform that provides player comparison tools, rankings, matchup analysis, and daily statistical updates for NFL fans. The service offers a free web experience and a premium mobile app (iOS & Android) with ad‑free access, expanded comparison caps, and advanced season outlook features. It aggregates live NFL data, applies AI verdicts on player performance, and presents interactive dashboards for matchups, rosters, and draft boards, refreshed daily throughout the season.

providers.name: EchoLeads
providers.description: EchoLeads is an autonomous AI voice sales platform out of T-Hub, Hyderabad, India, that replaces manual SDR work with AI agents running a full omnichannel workflow: outbound cold calling and inbound response, real-time BANT qualification, WhatsApp Business follow-up, Instagram DM lead capture, live intent-based lead scoring, human handoff, CRM sync, and calendar booking during the call. It sells into real estate, insurance, SaaS, healthcare, financial services and e-commerce, supports English, Hindi and regional Indian languages, and claims TRAI-compliant outbound calling. It is backed by Google for Startups, T-Hub and Math Nuage (DST, Government of India). Agent-native surface is real and verified — a live llms.txt, a full llms-full.txt content index, an RFC 9116 security.txt, and an AI-crawler-permissive robots.txt. The API surface is not: a REST API is self-declared in llms-full.txt (trigger calls, retrieve transcripts, push lead scores) but the documentation page returns 502, api.echoleads.ai has no listener, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, Postman collection or MCP server is published on any host.

providers.name: Eleos Health
providers.description: Eleos Health is the most widely adopted AI platform in behavioral and community-based healthcare. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, Eleos delivers purpose-built AI workflow agents that span clinical documentation, compliance, and revenue cycle management. The platform embeds directly inside providers' existing web-based electronic health records (EHRs) via a lightweight browser extension for both in-person and telehealth sessions, turning ambient session capture or quick text summaries into structured, payer-ready progress notes and cutting documentation time by roughly 70%. Eleos Compliance reviews every note against common risk areas (note cloning, empty notes, interventions, progress mentions, action plans, and the golden thread), and its revenue cycle tooling automates eligibility checks and claim protection. Deployed across 120+ care organizations in 30+ states, Eleos integrates without custom API builds; it is backed by Menlo Ventures and Greenfield Partners.

providers.name: Evergreen Content Poster
providers.description: Evergreen Content Poster provides a peer‑to‑peer employee recognition platform that helps teams celebrate achievements while planting trees to support the environment. The SaaS solution integrates with workplace tools like Slack and Microsoft Teams, offering features such as recognition badges, analytics, and a purpose‑driven mission to improve workplace culture and sustainability. It targets organizations seeking to boost engagement, reduce turnover, and contribute to ESG goals through a simple, scalable service.

providers.name: General Intuition
providers.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab building large action foundation models that can perceive, predict, and act across space and time in both virtual and physical environments. Spun out of the gaming clip platform Medal, the company trains its spatial-temporal reasoning models on billions of action-labeled gameplay clips - recordings of exactly which buttons a player pressed and when - to teach AI agents how to move through and reason about the world. Its Mira world model powers applications across games, simulation, and robotics. Founded in 2025 and based in New York City, General Intuition has raised $454M total, including a $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation, and is onboarding first partners to a commercial API ahead of a broader developer release.

providers.name: Gimlet Labs
providers.description: Gimlet Labs is an applied research lab building high-performance AI infrastructure — inference systems, schedulers, and compilers optimized for agentic and multimodal AI workloads across heterogeneous hardware. Its products include Gimlet Cloud, an agent-native serverless managed inference cloud for deploying single- and multi-agent systems that combine LLMs, multimodal and diffusion models, code sandboxes, web search, and custom data sources with automatic scaling; and kforge, a tool that autonomously generates optimized low-level PyTorch kernels across CUDA, ROCm, and Metal backends (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Apple) without manual kernel writing. The lab's research spans autonomous kernel generation, SLA-aware scheduling of multi-stage agent workloads across datacenters, edge/cloud workload partitioning, an MLIR-based universal AI compiler, headless DPU/accelerator hardware architectures, and cost-aware optimization for multitenant environments. Gimlet Labs is backed by Menlo Ventures. As of mid-2026 the developer surface is largely pre-launch, with a waitlist and access-gated documentation; no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Great American Insurance Group
providers.description: Great American Insurance Group (GAIG) is a specialty property and casualty insurance carrier operating in the United States. It provides a range of insurance solutions for niche industries, including commercial property, casualty, and specialty lines. GAIG is a member of American Financial Group, Inc., a publicly traded holding company. The website offers information about its services, corporate structure, legal disclosures, privacy policy, and contact options for customers and agents.

providers.name: Greybeam
providers.description: Greybeam provides Snowflake cost optimization powered by DuckDB, routing eligible queries to DuckDB while keeping others on Snowflake. It claims to reduce compute costs by up to 86% on average without requiring data migration, offering a seamless integration for BI tools and data teams. Founded in 2024 in San Francisco, the company focuses on query routing, Apache Iceberg support, and improving overall data warehouse efficiency.

providers.name: Hill House
providers.description: Hill House Home is a digital-first lifestyle brand that brings beauty and joy to everyday rituals. Since launching with bedding in 2016 it has extended its collections to bath, baby, accessories and apparel, including the widely beloved Nap Dress. The direct-to-consumer storefront at hillhousehome.com runs on Shopify and exposes a live, public Storefront MCP server (catalog search, cart, and store-policy tools) at /api/mcp, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect discovery for customer-scoped access. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and enriched from its public commerce surface.

providers.name: Infleqtion
providers.description: Infleqtion is a Louisville/Boulder, Colorado quantum-technology company — formerly ColdQuanta — that builds neutral-atom quantum computers, precision atomic clocks, and quantum sensors for governments, corporations, and research institutions. Its computing portfolio spans Sqale (a full-stack, fault-tolerant neutral-atom quantum computer), Quantum Cores (ready-to-use neutral-atom systems for laboratories), and Superstaq, an open-source quantum software platform with proprietary cross-layer optimization that compiles Qiskit, Cirq, and OpenQASM circuits down to hardware-native operations and routes them across heterogeneous quantum backends. Infleqtion's sensing portfolio includes the Tiqker optical atomic clock, Quantum Spectrum (Rydberg atomic spectrum sensing), and inertial sensors for GPS-denied positioning. The company was founded in 2007 as ColdQuanta, rebranded to Infleqtion in November 2022 after absorbing the Super.tech quantum-software acquisition, and became Infleqtion, Inc. (NASDAQ: INFQ) in January 2026. Superstaq (qiskit-superstaq, cirq-superstaq, general-superstaq) is the only developer-facing public surface; the hardware and sensing businesses are sold via direct engagement and government contracts rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Johrh
providers.description: Johrh (جوهره للعبايات, "Johrh for Abayas") is a Saudi Arabian direct-to-consumer women's fashion retailer specializing in abayas, jalabiyas, niqabs, scarves (طرح), bags, and complementary modest-wear. The brand operates an Arabic-language online storefront hosted on the Zid e-commerce platform, selling across price tiers (99 SAR, 199 SAR, and premium occasion pieces) with checkout through Saudi payment and buy-now-pay-later gateways (Tabby, Tamara, Madfu, Emkan, ZidPay, Tap, MisPay). It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network; its public web surface is served by the Zid "Vitrin" storefront application, whose OpenAPI is published at johrh.com/openapi.json.

providers.name: LeapYear
providers.description: LeapYear Technologies built an enterprise platform for differentially private analytics and machine learning, letting organizations run statistics, SQL-style queries, feature engineering, and supervised and unsupervised model training against their most sensitive data while a mathematically provable privacy guarantee bounds what any single record can leak. The product shipped as a self-hosted server, LeapYear Core, driven by a first-party Python client library that exposes databases, tables, views, users, groups, permissions, privacy profiles, and per-database privacy budgets as programmable resources. Snowflake announced its intent to acquire LeapYear in February 2023 and closed the acquisition for $62.0 million in cash, folding the differential privacy technology and team into the Snowflake Data Cloud clean-room capabilities. The standalone company surface is now retired: leapyear.io no longer answers on HTTPS. The surviving public developer surface is the hosted LeapYear Python client reference for version 4.1.1.

providers.name: Lovable
providers.description: Lovable is an AI app builder that generates full-stack web applications from natural- language prompts, with live preview, GitHub sync, and Supabase / Firebase integration. Lovable's developer-facing surface is in early release: the "Build with URL" API generates apps from a shareable URL, and the Lovable MCP Server lets AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor) manage Lovable projects via Model Context Protocol.

providers.name: Mirantis
providers.description: Mirantis provides enterprise Kubernetes and container platform solutions for multi-cloud, hybrid-cloud, and edge deployments. Its product line includes Mirantis Kubernetes Engine (MKE), k0rdent Enterprise, Mirantis OpenStack for Kubernetes (MOSK), Mirantis Container Runtime, Mirantis Secure Registry, Lens Desktop, and the open source k0s Kubernetes distribution and k0smotron orchestrator.

providers.name: nflverse data via nflreadr
providers.description: nflverse provides a suite of open-source data packages and APIs for comprehensive NFL analytics. Through R, Python, and other language bindings, it offers access to play-by-play data, player statistics, and advanced metrics, all licensed under permissive CC-BY terms. The platform supports researchers, developers, and fans in building models, visualizations, and applications around NFL data.

providers.name: Nuvolo
providers.description: Nuvolo is a modern Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) and Enterprise Asset Management provider that delivers its Connected Workplace suite natively on the ServiceNow platform. It unifies facilities and space management, real estate and lease administration, capital planning and projects, maintenance and work management, healthcare technology management (HTM), GxP and life-sciences asset management, refrigeration management, sustainability and energy, and OT security into a single cloud platform. Nuvolo serves healthcare, life sciences, public sector, retail, and education organizations, helping them manage the full lifecycle of their assets, spaces, and facilities with mobile access and real-time reporting. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Overpass API
providers.description: Overpass API is a read-only OpenStreetMap data API that enables querying geographic features including nodes, ways, relations, and tags using the Overpass Query Language (QL). It supports complex spatial queries with filters for bounding boxes, tags, proximity, area containment, and element relationships, making it the primary tool for extracting custom subsets of OSM data programmatically.

providers.name: PeopleSoft Financials
providers.description: API collection for Oracle PeopleSoft Financials suite covering General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Management, and other financial modules.

providers.name: Pindrop Security
providers.description: Pindrop is an Atlanta-based voice security and identity company founded in 2011 by Georgia Tech researchers. Its "Real Human + Right Human" platform detects deepfakes, prevents fraud, and authenticates callers across voice, video, and digital channels for contact centers and virtual meetings. Core products are Pindrop Pulse (deepfake and synthetic-voice detection), Pindrop Protect (near real-time fraud risk assessment), and Pindrop Passport (multifactor voice, device, and behavioral authentication, including VeriCall technology). Pindrop holds 300+ patents and integrates with contact-center and meeting platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Cisco Webex, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams. The company is an enterprise, sales-led vendor and does not publish a self-serve public developer portal or open API.

providers.name: PrimeRevenue
providers.description: PrimeRevenue is a global financial technology company providing working capital and B2B payment solutions through a bank-agnostic, ERP-integrated platform. Its offerings include Supply Chain Finance (buyers extend payment terms while suppliers are paid early), Receivables Finance (suppliers sell invoices for early payment without buyer disclosure), Dynamic Discounting (early payment at variable discount rates), and Payments as a Service (a modern B2B payment layer). The platform manages more than $25B in daily assets, has accelerated over 12.5M invoices, and supports 30+ languages. PrimeRevenue does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate, security, and compliance surface. Backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Prompt Privacy
providers.description: Prompt Privacy is a privacy‑focused platform that helps developers and enterprises manage the handling of AI prompt data. By offering tools to classify, redact, and audit prompts sent to large language models, the company ensures that sensitive information is not inadvertently exposed or stored. Their services include real‑time prompt filtering, compliance reporting, and integrations with major AI providers, enabling organizations to maintain data governance while leveraging generative AI capabilities. Prompt Privacy aims to build trust in AI applications by providing transparent, secure, and customizable privacy controls for prompt engineering workflows.

providers.name: QUIBIM
providers.description: QUIBIM is a healthcare AI company that unlocks medical imaging data to improve patient outcomes through quantitative imaging biomarkers and radiomics. Its cloud-based, tissue-agnostic platform ingests, harmonizes, and analyzes imaging data (MRI, CT, PET) to extract automated radiomics and deep-learning imaging biomarkers that support clinical decision-making and biopharma drug development. Regulated clinical products include QP-Prostate, QP-Brain, QP-Liver, QP-Breast, QP-Lung, and the QP-Insights multi-omics platform, several of which are CE and UKCA marked and integrate with hospital PACS systems. QUIBIM is ISO 27001:2022 certified and HIPAA and GDPR compliant. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; QUIBIM publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Rise.ai
providers.description: Rise.ai is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: rohnelt-dev
providers.description: Rohnelt-dev is the professional brand of Felipe Rohnelt, a software engineer specializing in end‑to‑end systems for industry, logistics and digital products. Based in Goiás, Brazil, the portfolio showcases over twenty‑three production systems, including public services and private client deployments, integrating ERP, databases, IoT hardware and cloud services. The site presents methodology, results, and a contact channel for consulting projects, reflecting a focus on operational excellence and measurable outcomes.

providers.name: rootz-global
providers.description: Rootz builds Measured AI: a quality system for the AI factory that consumes the output of TCG standards and confidential compute. Every AI output gets a stated quality level, a measured origin, and a signed owner — so a buyer can know which model, on which machine, under whose signed instruction, produced a given answer.

providers.name: Securian Financial Group
providers.description: Securian Financial Group is a Minnesota-based mutual holding company providing life insurance, annuities, retirement plan solutions, investment management, group and workplace benefits, and credit-union and bank insurance programs to individuals, employers and financial institutions. Securian runs production API infrastructure — a Kong gateway at api.securian.com and AWS API Gateway hosts at api.connect.securian.com and api.lifebenefits.com — and markets API integrations through Securian Platform Connect (group benefits, aligned to LIMRA LDEx EOIS and BEM) and FlexTech (embedded payment protection for digital lenders), but publishes no developer portal, no API contract and no SDK. Its only anonymously readable machine-readable document is the OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 discovery metadata served by its PingFederate authorization server at sso.securian.com.

providers.name: SellerX
providers.description: SellerX is a Berlin-based consumer-brand builder, founded in 2020, that acquires, operates and scales everyday consumer products into omnichannel global brands. Originally one of Europe's largest Amazon FBA aggregators, it merged with KW Commerce in 2021 and with the US aggregator Elevate Brands in 2023, and has since repositioned itself from an aggregator into a brand builder. The group operates 20+ brands and 25k+ products across 10+ countries from hubs in Berlin, London, Manila and Dongguan, and has raised more than $750M in equity and debt from Sofina, L Catterton, Cherry Ventures, Felix Capital, 83North, an ADIA subsidiary, BlackRock and Victory Park Capital. SellerX sells consumer goods to consumers through marketplaces and its own channels; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of its own.

providers.name: ServiceMax
providers.description: ServiceMax is asset-centric field service management (FSM) software that helps equipment manufacturers and service organizations maximize equipment uptime, optimize technician productivity, and streamline service delivery. Its cloud platform, built natively on the Salesforce platform (ServiceMax Core and Asset 360), spans work order and workflow management, scheduling and dispatch (Service Board), preventive and predictive maintenance, contract and entitlement management, parts and inventory, offline-capable mobile tools (ServiceMax Go), real-time technician collaboration (Zinc), and customer self-service (Engage). Founded in 2007 and acquired by PTC in 2023, ServiceMax integrates with PTC's IoT and PLM portfolio (ThingWorx, Windchill) and exposes its data and workflows through the underlying Salesforce API surface rather than a standalone public developer API.

providers.name: SignUp.com
providers.description: SignUp.com provides online sign‑up sheets and coordination solutions for schools, churches, teams, nonprofits, and businesses. Their platform enables users to create, share, and manage sign‑up forms, streamline event planning, and collaborate efficiently across various organizations.

providers.name: Simpro
providers.description: Simpro (simPRO) is field service management and project/business management software for the trades - electrical, plumbing, HVAC, security, fire, and other contractors. It covers the full workflow of estimating, quoting, job management, scheduling and dispatch, asset maintenance, inventory and catalog, purchasing, timesheets, and invoicing. The Simpro REST API v1.0 exposes these resources over HTTPS, but it is not a shared public API - each API runs on the customer's own Simpro Premium build (host https://your-build.simprosuite.com) and is authenticated with OAuth2 credentials provisioned by that build's administrator. Resources are nested under a company at /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/... where companyID is 0 on single-company builds.

providers.name: Spectrum Medical
providers.description: Spectrum Medical is a privately held medical technology company, co-founded by Steve Turner and Mark Drain, with corporate headquarters in Cheltenham, England, a U.S. headquarters in Fort Mill, South Carolina, and a European headquarters in Mirandola, Italy. It entered the global medical device market in 2005 with its non-invasive System M diagnostic technology and today builds two connected product families: Quantum Perfusion Technologies (workstations, centrifugal and roller pumps, oxygenators, heater-coolers, sensor modules and single-use sterile technologies for cardiopulmonary bypass, ECMO and other extracorporeal therapies) and Quantum Informatics (the VIPER clinical interfacing EMR, the VISION server and Perfusion Information Management System). Its software surface is a customer-deployed, on-premise stack: the VISION server passes case data to the hospital EHR over HL7 v2 interfaces through a bundled Mirth Connect interface engine, and third-party device connectivity is delivered through optional device-driver software rather than a public web API. Spectrum Medical is ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified and its VIPER Clinical Information Solution 3.0 earned ONC-HIT 2014 Edition Modular Certification via the Drummond Group. Systems are in use in over 60 countries.

providers.name: Tano
providers.description: Tano is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: The Clorox Company
providers.description: The Clorox Company is a multinational consumer-goods manufacturer best known for its bleach, cleaning and disinfecting brands, alongside a portfolio that includes Pine-Sol, Liquid-Plumr, Glad, Kingsford, Brita, Burt's Bees and Hidden Valley. Clorox runs no developer program and publishes no API documentation, OpenAPI, SDK or portal, and its commercial integration with retailers and suppliers runs over EDI and partner agreements rather than a public API. It does nonetheless serve a small, undocumented, anonymous first-party REST surface from its corporate site at /wp-json — Clorox-authored tcc/v1 and clorox-security/v1 namespaces exposing a Safety Data Sheet index, cleaning-product ingredient disclosure records, a CPSC general conformity certificate lookup, a live job feed and consent signalling. A MuleSoft Anypoint gateway at api.clorox.com serves partner traffic behind a 403, and Clorox's Anypoint Exchange public portal is enabled but publishes zero assets.

providers.name: Uncle Nearest
providers.description: Uncle Nearest, Inc. is an American whiskey company headquartered in Shelbyville, Tennessee, founded in 2017 by Fawn Weaver and Keith Weaver and named for Nathan "Nearest" Green, the formerly enslaved master distiller who taught Jack Daniel the craft. The company produces the Uncle Nearest 1856 Premium Aged, 1884 Small Batch, Master Blend, Single Barrel, Straight Rye and Uncut/Unfiltered Rye expressions, and operates the Nearest Green Distillery visitor destination in Shelbyville with tours, tastings, private events and a retail shop. Uncle Nearest is a privately held, consumer-facing brand with no developer program and no product API; its only public machine-readable surfaces are the WordPress REST API and the two OpenAPI-documented Events Calendar REST APIs served from its own web host at unclenearest.com, which expose the brand's published events, venues and organizers as read-only JSON.

providers.name: University of Indonesia
providers.description: University of Indonesia (Universitas Indonesia, UI) is a public research university in Depok and Salemba, Jakarta, the highest-ranked university in Indonesia. Its programmable footprint is real but almost entirely closed. UI operates its own Kong Enterprise API gateway at api.ui.ac.id on its own network allocation (152.118.0.0/16, APNIC "INDONESIAUNI-ID"), a campus-wide CAS Single Sign-On at sso.ui.ac.id, an institution-hosted Moodle learning platform at emas2.ui.ac.id exposing Moodle Web Services and an LTI 1.3 platform endpoint, and the LONTAR library OPAC at lib.ui.ac.id. Every one of those is credential-gated: the gateway answers 401 {"message":"Unauthorized"} on every probed path, the LMS web service rejects anonymous calls with invalidtoken, and no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI description, key issuance or client registration exists anywhere on the public surface. The two research-discovery surfaces that DO answer anonymously are vendor tenancies on UI hostnames, not UI engineering — scholarhub.ui.ac.id CNAMEs to bepress (Digital Commons) and scholar.ui.ac.id CNAMEs to ui.elsevierpure.com (Elsevier Pure Portal) — and are recorded here as tenant relationships with the vendor contracts deliberately left in the vendors' own repositories. UI is a Crossref member (4386, prefix 10.7454) and carries a ROR identifier. The main web estate at www.ui.ac.id sits behind an F5 bot-defense interstitial that returns HTTP 200 for every path including ones that do not exist, so no claim in this profile rests on a status code from that host.

providers.name: Xcel Energy
providers.description: Xcel Energy is a major U.S. electricity and natural gas utility holding company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, providing service to approximately 3.7 million electricity customers and 2.1 million natural gas customers across eight Midwestern and Western states: Colorado, Minnesota, Texas, New Mexico, North Dakota, South Dakota, Michigan, and Wisconsin. Xcel Energy operates a developer portal at developer-apim.aws.xcelenergy.com that organizes APIs across customer account management, billing, payments, product and service offerings, and request service. The company provides Green Button Connect My Data APIs based on the ESPI (Energy Services Provider Interface) standard developed by NAESB, enabling authorized third-party applications to access customer energy usage data via OAuth 2.0. Xcel Energy also supports IEEE 2030.5 protocol on newer Itron Gen 5 Riva smart meters for direct local-network access to real-time energy data including solar production. Beyond data APIs, Xcel Energy is a Fortune 500 company investing in clean energy, grid modernization, electric vehicle programs, demand response, and renewable energy interconnection.

providers.name: 包租公
providers.description: 包租公（Baozugong / YieldLord）是美股投资者的免费 AI 期权收租管家：把你长期看好的股票「租」出去——卖 Covered Call / Cash Secured Put / Wheel，每周收租金，好公司拿得住、拿得久。开仓前用 RENT 14 因子帮你挑合约，开仓后每个交易日帮你盯仓提醒。券商只读、不碰钱、不代下单。 包租公两档：免费档一直免费，完整覆盖挑合约、盯持仓与复盘，每月 30 次计算和生成额度；Gold 创始会员价 ¥100/月（海外 $14.99），券商自动同步、持仓主动提醒、不限次、可接 AI agent。免费领取 14 天 Gold 试用，不绑卡、不自动续费。

providers.name: 2nd Brick
providers.description: 2nd Brick designs custom LEGO brick sets for businesses, from logos and mascots to client gifts. Send a brief for a design by email in 12–24 hours, or design your own with AI. The service offers quick turnaround, AI‑assisted design tools, and a studio for ordering finished kits, targeting corporate branding, promotional gifts, and personal projects.

providers.name: Adaptive Biotechnologies
providers.description: Adaptive Biotechnologies Corporation (Nasdaq: ADPT) is a Seattle, Washington immune-medicine company that reads and translates the adaptive immune system at scale. Founded in 2009 by brothers Chad Robins and Harlan Robins as Adaptive TCR Corporation, it built an immunosequencing platform that amplifies and sequences rearranged T-cell and B-cell receptor genes, then applies computational models to turn that receptor repertoire into clinical and research data. Its lead commercial product is clonoSEQ, an FDA-cleared next-generation sequencing assay for measurable residual disease (MRD) in multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, mantle cell lymphoma and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, run out of its CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited Seattle laboratory. It also sells immunoSEQ research assays with the cloud-based immunoSEQ Analyzer and the immuneACCESS public data repository, and MRD biopharma services to drug developers. Adaptive is a diagnostics and services company, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification. Its integration surface is clinician-facing and delivered bilaterally — clonoSEQ orders and results flow through Epic (including Epic Aura), Flatiron Health's OncoEMR via Molecular Profiling Integration, and Carequality/health information exchanges, arranged through its EMR integration specialists rather than through self-serve documentation.

providers.name: ANOTS
providers.description: Your customers' AI doesn't read your website — it asks. ANOTS gives your business an agent that answers on Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity over Google A2A Protocol and MCP. 90-second setup, no SDK.

providers.name: Ascend Advanced Therapies
providers.description: Ascend Advanced Therapies is a gene-to-GMP contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for advanced therapies, specializing in adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector development and manufacture for gene therapies, immunotherapies, oncolytics, and vaccines. Formed in 2023 when expert teams merged behind more than $130M of funding, and aligned with ABL, Inc. since late 2024, Ascend operates GMP manufacturing, aseptic fill-finish, and analytical facilities in Rockville, Maryland and Alachua, Florida alongside European capacity. Services span process development, gene therapy formulation, scalable manufacturing, in-house fill-finish, GMP QC testing, long-read NGS for viral vectors, and potency assay development, built on its EpyQ production system and proprietary AAV yield enhancers. Ascend is a life-science manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no commercial product API; the only machine-readable interface it exposes is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website, captured here for discovery.

providers.name: AskMyEV
providers.description: AskMyEV provides an AI-powered assistant for Tesla owners, integrating ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Cursor to analyze vehicle data. Users can query battery health, range, charging costs, tire pressure, and alerts through a read‑only interface. The service offers a free trial and aims to simplify Tesla data insights with conversational AI.

providers.name: askTender
providers.description: askTender is a global procurement platform that connects businesses with public tender opportunities across more than 120 countries. It aggregates tender data, provides intelligence, and offers services to help companies find, qualify, and submit bids for government contracts. The platform includes pricing plans for various business sizes and offers an API for integration with enterprise workflows.

providers.name: Aspire (Powered by MindCloud)
providers.description: Aspire (Powered by MindCloud) provides field service management software that helps landscaping, commercial cleaning, and snow removal businesses streamline, automate, and optimize processes. Features include precise bidding, real‑time job costing, live performance insights, scheduling, estimating, CRM, invoicing, and reporting, enabling owners to improve margins and grow profitably.

providers.name: Audiobookshelf
providers.description: Audiobookshelf provides a self‑hosted audiobook and podcast server that lets users organize, stream, and share their personal media collections. It offers a web UI, mobile apps, and integrations for popular platforms, supporting features like library management, playback controls, and metadata fetching from online sources.

providers.name: AutoGen Studio
providers.description: AutoGen Studio is a low-code / no-code developer GUI from Microsoft Research for rapidly prototyping, composing, and debugging multi-agent AI workflows built on the AutoGen framework. Shipped as the `autogenstudio` Python package and launched with `autogenstudio ui`, it serves a FastAPI + React (Gatsby) web app on localhost that exposes four primary interfaces — Team Builder, Playground, Gallery, and Deployment — backed by a SQLModel persistence layer (SQLite by default; any SQLAlchemy-compatible backend such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL via `--database-uri`). The Team Builder offers drag-and-drop and JSON authoring of teams, agents, models, tools, and termination conditions fully aligned with AutoGen AgentChat's declarative component spec; the Playground streams live inter-agent messages and renders the control transition graph; the Gallery imports community components; and the Deployment view exports a team to Python, exposes it as an endpoint, and packages it for Docker. AutoGen Studio is built on AutoGen AgentChat / Core / Extensions and supports any OpenAI-compatible model endpoint (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, local vLLM/Ollama, etc.) via declarative `model_client` configuration, plus MCP tool integration. Authentication is experimental (GitHub OAuth + JWT only). Microsoft explicitly positions AutoGen Studio as a research prototype — not production-ready — and encourages teams that need authn/z, multi-tenancy, sandboxing rigor, or hardened deployment to build directly on the AutoGen framework instead. Companion to the broader AutoGen multi-agent framework, distributed under the Microsoft microsoft/autogen monorepo (CC-BY-4.0 docs, MIT code).

providers.name: Avid
providers.description: Avid provides media creation and management solutions empowering audio, video, and broadcast professionals. Their platform includes MediaCentral, Content Core, and AI‑powered workflow tools used by millions of creators worldwide. Avid’s products support news, film, TV, music, and live events, earning multiple Emmy Awards and serving customers in over 60 countries.

providers.name: Backerkit
providers.description: BackerKit is a crowdfunding and pledge-management platform for professional creators. It began as backer-survey and data-management software that helps creators who funded projects on Kickstarter and Indiegogo collect shipping addresses, sell add-ons and pre-orders, charge cards, and manage backer data for reward fulfillment. It has since grown into a full crowdfunding platform of its own, powering campaigns end to end and, in 2024, roughly one in every four dollars raised on Kickstarter. BackerKit is a Y Combinator company. It exposes integration API keys (API key, secret, and Store GUID) so creators can connect fulfillment services such as ShipStation, but it does not publish a public, self-serve developer API, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs; developer access is account-scoped and configured inside the BackerKit dashboard.

providers.name: BlueScope
providers.description: BlueScope (BlueScope Steel Limited, ASX-listed, headquartered in Australia) is a steel supplier and manufacturer for the building and construction industries, producing flat and painted steel products sold under brands including COLORBOND, ZINCALUME, LYSAGHT, TRUECORE and Butler, with operations across Australia, New Zealand, North America, ASEAN and China. BlueScope runs a Developer Centre (developer.apiaut.bluescope.com, an Azure API Management portal) for B2B EDI trading with its business units: REST APIs accepting XML or JSON for purchase orders, order responses, shipment notifications, invoices, test certificates and GS1 transport messages, with the API list visible only after sign-up and approved product subscription. dev.bluescope.com is a staging copy of the corporate site, not the developer portal.

providers.name: Boku
providers.description: Boku is a global mobile payments network that connects digital merchants to more than 200 local payment methods — mobile wallets, real-time account-to-account bank transfers, and direct carrier billing — across 70+ countries, reaching over 7 billion payment accounts. Through its Boku Direct payment gateway API, merchants such as Epic Games, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Netflix, Sony, Spotify, and Tencent accept local payments, run subscriptions, and settle globally. Boku processes over $9 billion in payments annually and is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange (LON:BOKU).

providers.name: brainattic
providers.description: Brainattic provides a governed knowledge base that teams and AI agents can read and write. It operates over an MCP with hybrid search and customizable rules, supporting Claude, ChatGPT, and Mistral. The platform emphasizes data governance, security, and seamless integration for enterprise knowledge management.

providers.name: Class Q Checker
providers.description: Class Q Checker provides a free online tool to determine whether a barn conversion in England qualifies under Class Q permitted development. It offers detailed guidance, statutory tests, cost indexes, and links to legislation, helping users assess eligibility, required approvals, and planning considerations for converting agricultural buildings into dwellings.

providers.name: Cocoon
providers.description: Cocoon is next-generation employee leave management software that automates the complexities of compliance, claims, and payroll for every type of employee leave (parental, medical, caregiver, accommodation, bereavement, and personal) across all 50 U.S. states. It factors in state, federal, company, and insurance benefits to calculate eligibility, generate designation notices, and streamline the leave experience for both employees and HR teams. Cocoon connects to 20+ HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, ADP, Paylocity, UKG, and more) via API integrations that sync employee data in real time. Founded in 2020 by former Stripe and Square leaders and backed by Index Ventures and First Round Capital, Cocoon was acquired by TriNet in April 2026. Cocoon is a consumer of HRIS/payroll APIs rather than a publisher of a public developer API; no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal are published.

providers.name: CoLab Software
providers.description: CoLab is an AI-powered design review platform for engineering and product-development teams. It pairs collaborative CAD viewing with AI peer checking and automated lessons-learned capture so distributed teams can run faster virtual design reviews, surface issues earlier, and turn expert engineering knowledge into faster, better-documented decisions. CoLab also publishes a REST-based Enterprise API (50+ endpoints) for two-way integration with PLM/PDM and other engineering systems — provisioning workspaces, users, and roles, importing files and feedback, and extracting review activity — with audit logging on every action. Enterprise API access is currently gated behind a waitlist. CoLab operates under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018, TISAX, and FedRAMP High.

providers.name: Convex Finance
providers.description: Convex Finance is a DeFi protocol that boosts Curve Finance liquidity provider and CRV staker yields through its CVX token and pooled staking mechanism. It allows users to earn boosted CRV rewards and CVX without locking CRV directly.

providers.name: convrgent-ai
providers.description: Convrgent is a personality intelligence platform for AI agents, offering 45 API endpoints across 11 personality frameworks such as Socionics, Enneagram, Human Design, BaZi, Vedic astrology, Numerology, and OCEAN. It operates on a pay‑per‑call model using the x402 protocol in USDC, requiring no API keys or signup. The service enables agents to profile humans, emulate human communication, and gain buyer intelligence, all without traditional authentication barriers.

providers.name: Flowdesk
providers.description: Flowdesk is a full-service digital-asset trading and technology firm that delivers liquidity, execution, and market infrastructure to token issuers, exchanges, and institutions. It is a regulated Crypto-Asset Service Provider registered with France's AMF and licensed by Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA). Products span liquidity solutions (token, stablecoin, exchange, and DeFi), OTC trading (spot, derivatives, and credit) across 150+ venues and 1,000+ asset pairs, tokenized-market infrastructure, and ventures. Flowdesk exposes a developer-facing "Platform Connect" API for programmatic OTC spot trading over REST with a companion WebSocket streaming channel, authenticated with OAuth 2.0 JWT bearer tokens issued through its Auth0 tenant.

providers.name: GeeTest
providers.description: GeeTest provides an all‑in‑one bot management and CAPTCHA solution for websites and mobile apps. Their platform combines behavior verification, device fingerprinting, and a business rules engine to detect and block fraudulent activities such as account takeover, credential stuffing, payment fraud, web scraping, and scalping. GeeTest serves enterprises across e‑commerce, finance, travel, social media, blockchain, and gaming, offering adaptive CAPTCHAs and risk management tools to ensure seamless user experiences while maintaining security.

providers.name: GitHub ReadMe Stats
providers.description: GitHub ReadMe Stats is an open-source (MIT) project by Anurag Hazra that dynamically generates SVG statistics cards for GitHub profile READMEs. It exposes GET endpoints for stats, top languages, repository pins, gists and WakaTime cards, served from a best-effort public Vercel instance and designed to be self-hosted on Vercel or run through a GitHub Actions workflow.

providers.name: GovTrack
providers.description: GovTrack is a free, open-access platform for tracking the United States Congress, providing legislative data since 2004. It offers a REST API for accessing bill status, voting records, Congressional member information, committee data, and cosponsorship records — all without authentication or API keys. Operated by Civic Impulse, LLC, GovTrack serves millions of users annually including journalists, legislative professionals, educators, and the general public.

providers.name: gpodder.net
providers.description: gpodder.net is a free, open-source podcast syncing service that lets users discover, subscribe to, and track podcasts across devices. It provides a web interface and API for managing podcast subscriptions, fetching episode metadata, and sharing lists. The platform is community‑driven, offers public directories, and supports integration with third‑party podcast apps.

providers.name: Greymatter
providers.description: Greymatter is a Kubernetes-native, zero trust networking platform that delivers secure, agentic, and scalable service connectivity across multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments. It provides a unified platform with five integrated layers covering service connectivity, zero trust security, orchestration, observability analytics, and enterprise integration for distributed microservices architectures.

providers.name: Harvey
providers.description: Harvey is a domain-specific AI platform built for elite law firms and in-house legal departments. Its product suite includes Assistant (question answering, document analysis, and drafting), Vault (secure document storage and bulk analysis), Knowledge (legal, regulatory, and tax research), Workflow Agents (pre-built and customizable legal agents), Harvey Mobile, and an Ecosystem of integrations with existing legal tools. Harvey is sold via enterprise contracts to large law firms and corporate legal teams, and does not currently publish a self-serve public developer API; integrations are arranged through direct sales and partnership engagements.

providers.name: Hayden AI
