providers.description: Hayden AI is a San Francisco based artificial intelligence and spatial analytics company that builds a mobile perception platform for public transit agencies and city governments. The company mounts a purpose-built AI camera and edge compute box on transit buses and other municipal fleet vehicles, then uses computer vision to detect bus lane, bus stop, bike lane, double parking and tram blocking violations in real time. Detections are reviewed by authorized agency staff in the Hayden AI Data Portal, which also carries traffic rule management, city asset monitoring and aggregated traffic analytics, and which hands verified evidence off to an agency's existing violations processing system for citation issuance. Hayden AI publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract; the platform is sold and integrated directly with transit agencies and municipalities.

providers.name: JobTread
providers.description: JobTread provides a cloud‑based construction estimating and project management platform. It helps contractors and remodelers plan jobs, track finances, manage resources, and integrate with tools like QuickBooks and Stripe. The SaaS solution streamlines bids, schedules, budgets, and client communication across the construction lifecycle.

providers.name: KNL
providers.description: KNL (KNL Networks Oy) is a Finnish defence-technology company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Oulu, Finland, that builds long-range, GNSS-independent HF radio communication systems for military, naval, and critical-communications operators. Its Cognitive Networked HF (CNHF) platform is a family of software-defined radios — CNHF Manpack, CNHF1 Radio, CNHF Vehicular, and CNHF Evolve — that perform continuous spectrum estimation and automatically switch to the next best channel to sustain IP data links over thousands of kilometres in jammed, contested, or infrastructure-denied environments. Radios are operated through a web-based CNHF User Interface providing role-based access, webmail, XMPP-interoperable instant messaging, mapping, and spectrum analysis. KNL was acquired by Telenor Maritime at the end of 2020 and now operates as Telenor's dedicated defence and security connectivity business. The company holds ISO 9001, AQAP 2110 (NATO), and ISO/IEC 27001 certifications and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Laserhub
providers.description: Laserhub is a Stuttgart-based digital procurement platform for custom-manufactured metal and plastic parts, founded to replace the traditional RFQ cycle for sheet metal, tube and machined components with instant online quoting. Buyers register at app.laserhub.com, upload CAD files, and receive an automated feasibility check plus an instant quote covering laser cutting, plasma and flame cutting, tube laser cutting, bending, CNC turning and milling, weldments, and secondary processes such as threading, deburring, galvanising, powder coating and engraving. Laserhub is itself the contracting party and allocates each order algorithmically across a network of roughly 100 ISO 9001:2015 certified producers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, serving both SMEs and DAX40 manufacturers with framework agreements, a parts library, sample parts, inspection certificates and design guidelines. Laserhub publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this profile: api.laserhub.com is a private AWS API Gateway that rejects unauthenticated requests, and the only machine-adjacent ordering channel the company documents is an email-based ordering flow (anfrage@laserhub.com) that its own release notes describe as still in a test phase for a subset of customers.

providers.name: Lecturio
providers.description: Lecturio is a medical and nursing education technology company headquartered in Leipzig, Germany (Lecturio GmbH), serving more than 500,000 learners and educators across 175+ countries. The platform combines video lectures, concept pages, spaced-repetition quizzes, and AI-tutored question banks covering 20+ preclinical and clinical subjects, with exam preparation for USMLE, NBME, COMLEX, MCAT, PANCE, NCLEX-RN, and international licensure exams such as the Saudi SNLE. Alongside the direct-to-student Lecturio Medical and Lecturio Nursing products, the company sells institutional platforms to medical schools, nursing schools, hospitals, and residency programs under the Healer (clinical reasoning), SimTutor (simulation authoring), and SIMTICS (procedural simulation) brands. Lecturio publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its public machine-readable surface consists of an RFC 9116 security.txt, a self-managed vulnerability disclosure policy, and a Rank Math generated llms.txt.

providers.name: Liferaft
providers.description: Liferaft provides flexible and affordable health benefits for individuals and employers, supplementing existing coverage with affordable options. Their platform offers easy enrollment, comprehensive plan options, and tools to manage health benefits, aiming to protect users when they need it most. Liferaft aims to simplify health benefit administration and improve access to care.

providers.name: LLM Abacus
providers.description: LLM Abacus provides a comprehensive comparison and pricing guide for large language model APIs, aggregating data on models such as GPT‑5.5, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and many others. The site offers detailed tables of token costs, latency, and feature sets, along with tools for estimating usage, exploring model capabilities, and accessing multilingual pricing information. It serves developers and businesses seeking to evaluate and select LLM providers based on cost, performance, and regional availability.

providers.name: Loox
providers.description: Loox provides a visual reviews platform for e‑commerce merchants, primarily on Shopify. It enables customers to submit photo‑rich reviews, share product experiences, and refer friends, helping over 130,000 brands grow through social proof marketing.

providers.name: Makersite
providers.description: Makersite is an AI-powered Product Lifecycle Intelligence platform that helps manufacturers manage product sustainability, cost, and compliance by connecting products to deep-tier supply chain, material, and chemical data. The platform automates lifecycle assessments (LCA) and product carbon footprint (PCF) calculations, supports eco-design and cost optimization, and produces regulatory reporting such as EU Taxonomy and CBAM. It integrates with enterprise CAD, ERP, and PLM systems (PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Autodesk, ANSYS). Makersite is a portfolio company of Partech. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Matternet
providers.description: Matternet designs, builds, and operates autonomous urban drone-logistics networks for healthcare and on-demand delivery. The integrated system pairs the FAA type-certified M2 aircraft with the Matternet Station and a proprietary cloud Software Platform that routes, commands, and monitors flights. Telemetry streams from drones and stations to the cloud over an MQTT broker (HiveMQ) as protobuf messages, and a consistent internal Hasura-powered GraphQL data layer serves Matternet's operator and client applications. As of this profile, Matternet does not publish a public or self-serve developer API; integrations are delivered through partner and operator engagements.

providers.name: Optimity
providers.description: Optimity is a health and rewards platform (myoptimity.com) that helps millions of members live healthier, wealthier, and longer through gamified micro-learning, wellness challenges, and behavioral-science-backed coaching across physical activity, nutrition, mental health, social connectedness, and financial wellness. Its consumer apps sync steps from Google Fit, Fitbit, and Samsung Health, while its enterprise Engagement Operating System (EOS) offers white-labeled apps, a management portal, rewards and nudge programs, and enterprise "API solutions & Tools" with developer-friendly modules for insurers, employers, and communities. Optimity is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or SDK is currently published; API access is offered privately to enterprise customers.

providers.name: Parrot
providers.description: Parrot is an AI-powered legal technology platform purpose-built for the litigation, court reporting, and insurance community. Its proprietary large language models are trained on legal and insurance terminology to deliver audio/video-synced deposition transcripts, AI-generated deposition summaries (narrative, page:line, or topic-based), remote deposition scheduling and livestreaming, and AI-enabled medical record summaries with chronologies and source linking. Trusted by law firms, insurance carriers such as USAA and Travelers, and Fortune 500 corporations, Parrot operates under SOC 2, HIPAA, and HITECH controls. Backed by Amplify Partners and XYZ Venture Capital ($11M Series A, 2023); Parrot is now part of Filevine. Parrot is a product and services company; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Quip
providers.description: Quip is a Salesforce-owned collaborative productivity platform that combines documents, spreadsheets, chat, and tasks into a single workspace tightly integrated with the Salesforce CRM. It enables teams to embed live data, collaborate in real time, and automate workflows across deal collaboration, account planning, and sales operations. The Quip Automation API is a REST interface for creating and managing threads, documents, messages, folders, and users with OAuth 2.0 Bearer token authentication.

providers.name: Retrofit
providers.description: Retrofit is a type-safe HTTP client for Android and the JVM (Java and Kotlin) built by Square, turning HTTP API interfaces into callable Java objects with annotation-based configuration and pluggable serialization. Retrofit is built on top of OkHttp and supports synchronous/asynchronous execution, JSON/XML/Protobuf converters, RxJava adapters, and Kotlin coroutines. Current stable version is 3.0.0.

providers.name: sennder
providers.description: sennder is Europe's leading digital road freight forwarder, connecting enterprise shippers with a vetted carrier network of 40,000+ small and medium-sized European carriers operating 250,000+ vehicles across 20+ European markets. Headquartered in Berlin with 20 offices across Germany, Italy, Spain, France, Poland, the Netherlands, Latvia, and Romania, sennder runs its proprietary sennOS platform covering end-to-end digital shipment lifecycle management, real-time visibility and tracking, self- service booking at fixed and market prices, and integrated carrier and shipper portals (including a driver app and shipper TMS connectors). sennder operates partner-gated integration APIs for carriers, shippers, and TMS vendors (joined via business onboarding rather than public self- service), and publishes open-source tooling on GitHub including a generator for Python httpx + Pydantic clients from OpenAPI definitions. Sustainability offerings include biofuel and electric vehicle options.

providers.name: Skydance Media
providers.description: Skydance Media is a Santa Monica, California diversified entertainment company founded in 2010 by David Ellison, producing event-scale film, television, animation, sports and interactive entertainment — Top Gun: Maverick, the Mission: Impossible films, Reacher, Grace and Frankie, Spellbound, and the VR titles The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners and Behemoth through Skydance Interactive and Skydance New Media. Skydance completed its merger with Paramount Global on 7 August 2025 to form Paramount Skydance Corporation, and skydance.com continues to operate as the label site for the Animation, Film, Television, Sports, Interactive and New Media divisions. Skydance publishes no developer program, no API documentation, no SDK and no OpenAPI of its own. The only machine-readable, anonymously readable surface on its own host is the WordPress REST API at skydance.com/wp-json — the CMS content API behind the label site, which serves pages, the media library, categories and site search as JSON.

providers.name: Slang Ai
providers.description: Slang AI is a voice-AI phone-answering and reservation platform for restaurants. Its customizable virtual phone agent answers every inbound call 24/7 in a natural, human-like voice, instantly responds to guest inquiries, and automatically manages reservations, with official integrations to OpenTable, SevenRooms, Tripleseat, Yelp, and Fishbowl. Founded by former Spotify data scientists, Slang AI reports 96%+ guest satisfaction (CSAT), 50% more phone reservations, and up to 200 staff hours saved per month. It is offered as a hosted SaaS product across Core, Premium, and Enterprise plans; at the time of profiling it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Term Finance
providers.description: Term Finance is a noncustodial, fixed-rate lending and borrowing protocol for crypto assets, modeled on the tri-party repo arrangements common in traditional finance (TradFi). Liquidity suppliers and takers are matched through a weekly blind double-auction that aggregates bids and offers into a single market-clearing rate, while collateral backing each loan sits in isolated, non-rehypothecatable smart contracts known as repoLockers. The protocol is deployed across Ethereum, Avalanche, Base, BNB Smart Chain and Plasma, and its Solidity contracts have been audited by Sigma Prime, Runtime Verification, Dedaub and Certora. Term Finance is developer-facing primarily through on-chain smart contracts and a Solidity API reference rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: The Black Tux
providers.description: The Black Tux is an online formalwear company offering premium suit and tuxedo rentals and purchases for weddings and formal events. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, it pairs a direct-to-consumer online store with roughly 50 physical showrooms nationwide, home try-on, group wedding coordination with party pricing, free shipping over $200, and a perfect-fit guarantee. The storefront runs on Shopify; The Black Tux does not publish a first-party developer API. The only machine-readable surface on the domain is Shopify's managed Customer Account identity service (OIDC / OAuth authorization server discovery). This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and enriched with the verifiable public identity and web properties the company genuinely publishes.

providers.name: Trusted Health
providers.description: Trusted Health is a career marketplace and workforce platform for travel nurses and allied health professionals across the United States. Clinicians build a single Trusted profile and get matched to travel and per-diem assignments, with transparent pay, licensure and compact-state guidance, and support through onboarding, credentialing, and placement. Its Works.AI product gives healthcare employers an AI-assisted staffing and workforce-management tool. Backed by Craft Ventures, Trusted Health operates a consumer web and mobile application (app.trustedhealth.com) rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or SDK surface is published. This profile captures the company's real security, trust, and compliance posture.

providers.name: University of Barcelona
providers.description: The University of Barcelona (Universitat de Barcelona, UB) is a public research university founded in 1450 in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, ranked #165 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. UB operates no central developer portal, no public API program and no confirmed organization-wide GitHub account, and its main web estate at www.ub.edu sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge that returns HTTP 403 to any automated client. What it does operate is a genuine, machine-readable institutional footprint that is easy to miss because none of it is marketed as an API: a SAML 2.0 identity provider published through RedIRIS SIR into eduGAIN with the ub.edu attribute scope; an LTI 1.3 Advantage tool platform on its self-hosted Moodle at campusvirtual.ub.edu, with a live JWKS and token endpoint; an OAI-PMH 2.0 data provider over 100 journal sets at revistes.ub.edu; a DSpace 7.6.6 repository at diposit.ub.edu that was live in June 2026 and returned 503 across every probe on 2026-09-01; and a Crossref membership for the university press. Its research-data repository and library discovery layer are tenancies on consortium and vendor platforms operated by CSUC and Ex Libris, not UB engineering, and are recorded here as relationships rather than as UB contracts.

providers.name: University of Bath
providers.description: The University of Bath is a public research university in Bath, United Kingdom, and a member of the Russell Group. It operates no public developer program: a full crawl of its 21,530-URL sitemap on 2026-08-30 returned no developer portal, no API reference, and no published OpenAPI under any bath.ac.uk path. Its one genuinely institution-operated machine-readable surface is the Research Data Archive at researchdata.bath.ac.uk — EPrints 3.4.7 running on the University's own infrastructure (138.38.44.144) — which serves a live OAI-PMH 2.0 interface, an EPrints REST/XML interface, and DataCite kernel-4 records carrying ORCID identifiers and DOIs under the University's own 10.15125 prefix. Everything else that appears to be a Bath API is a vendor contract running under a Bath hostname: purehost.bath.ac.uk and researchportal.bath.ac.uk both CNAME to bath-prod.elsevierpure.com and are an Elsevier Pure tenancy; the library catalogue is an Ex Libris Alma/Primo tenancy; library.bath.ac.uk is Springshare LibGuides; status.bath.ac.uk is Better Stack. The programme and unit catalogue is entirely behind CAS authentication at auth.bath.ac.uk, and the student records system behind Microsoft Entra ID. An Azure API Management portal exists only as a non-production "test" instance and is not recorded as a surface. This profile is deliberately thin because the footprint is thin.

providers.name: Vast
providers.description: Vast is a commercial space company building next-generation crewed space stations, beginning with Haven-1 (the first commercial space station, targeting a 2026 launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9) and the larger Haven-2. Vast is an aerospace hardware and human-spaceflight company; as of this writing it does not publish a public developer API. The surfaces catalogued here are informational product, research, and partnership pages rather than programmable HTTP APIs.

providers.name: vibeseo-dev
providers.description: VibeSEO provides an AI‑powered SEO platform that creates, publishes, and optimizes website content to rank highly on Google and emerging AI search assistants. The service offers automated article generation, keyword research, backlink analysis, and continuous monitoring of brand mentions across AI models like ChatGPT and Gemini. Pricing is usage‑based with credit packs, and the platform integrates with popular site builders and browsers to streamline SEO workflows for businesses of all sizes.

providers.name: Yourcounterpart
providers.description: Counterpart (yourcounterpart.com) is an insurtech managing general agent offering management and professional liability insurance for small businesses, positioning itself as the first Agentic Insurance system. It underwrites Directors & Officers, Not-For-Profit D&O, Employment Practices, Fiduciary, Commercial Crime, and Miscellaneous Professional Liability coverage, pairing AI-driven underwriting and data infrastructure with 350+ risk-mitigation policy templates and claims management. Counterpart distributes through 2,800+ brokers and exposes a Quote & Bind API partner program that lets brokers and insurtech platforms embed instant bindable quotes and coverage into their own branded workflows.

providers.name: Zenjob
providers.description: Zenjob is a Berlin-based staffing platform that connects businesses with vetted temporary workers (students and side-jobbers) through a mobile app and a self-service booking platform (Buchungsplattform). Companies create shifts, staff them in real time, track working hours, and handle invoicing in one place. Zenjob offers an integration layer (marketed as "Schnittstellen (API)") for personnel management, shift creation and staffing, time tracking, and billing, plus partner integrations with workforce and vendor-management systems including Quinyx, ATOSS, Ubeya, and compleet. The API is partner/consultation-led (arranged via a scheduled onboarding call) rather than a self-serve public developer program; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDK. Backed by 500 Global, Zenjob was surfaced as a portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Agent Rynku
providers.description: Agent Rynku provides AI-driven analysis of ESPI and EBI communications for companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (GPW). It monitors quarterly results, price movements, and alerts via email or Telegram, offering free and paid plans. Users can add companies to a portfolio, receive contextual insights, and interact with an AI chat for personalized evaluations.

providers.name: AgentGauge
providers.description: AgentGauge provides an AI-readiness scanner that grades websites on how discoverable, trustworthy, and usable they are for AI agents and answer engines. It offers llms.txt listings, schema extraction, agent tools signals, and a watch service that re‑scans sites weekly, delivering actionable fixes. Users can paste any URL to see if AI can find and act on the site.

providers.name: AI Separations
providers.description: AI Separations provides AI‑powered color separation and quoting software for screen printing and DTF workflows. Their web app offers instant quotes, pre‑flight checks, profit mode calculations, and ink matching without Photoshop. The platform includes a free separation tool, bulk mockup generator, gang‑sheet builder, and a metered API for developers to integrate automated color separations into their services.

providers.name: Aiguang
providers.description: Aiguang (爱逛) is a Hangzhou, China live-streaming and short-video commerce platform built on the WeChat ecosystem. Consumers enter live rooms through the Aiguang WeChat mini-program and the Aiguang mobile app to take part in limited-time discounts, group buys and live-stream giveaways, while merchants and MCN hosts run their broadcasts from the Aiguang seller app and a PC live-broadcast console carrying interaction, marketing, promotion and analytics tooling. The platform is wired into the Youzan (有赞) CPS product pool so viewers can resell what they watch. Per its own user agreement and privacy statement (effective 2025-01-17) the platform is operated by 杭州杨杨得翼文化有限公司 (Hangzhou Yangyang Deyi Culture Co., Ltd.). Aiguang publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; its merchant, supplier and MCN surfaces are reached through account logins and a merchant community forum.

providers.name: Alkami
providers.description: Alkami Technology (NASDAQ: ALKT) is a Plano, Texas based cloud digital banking platform for U.S. banks and credit unions. Through its "Alkami Foundry" developer program it exposes RESTful APIs and an extensible SDK — spanning authentication, money movement, data access, and real-time and batch workflows — that financial institutions and fintech partners use to embed and extend digital-banking experiences. The APIs are grouped into D2C (embed fintech experiences), B2B (automate backend workflows), and Open Banking (third-party connections such as Plaid) surfaces, are built on OpenID Connect, and are delivered through a gated DevPortal rather than an open public API. Alkami was surfaced as a portfolio company of D1 Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from its public developer, security, and legal surfaces.

providers.name: Anvyl
providers.description: Anvyl is a supply chain and production management platform (a "Production Hub") for consumer-brand and e-commerce companies, connecting brands with their suppliers to manage the purchase-order and manufacturing lifecycle in one place: issuing and tracking purchase orders, coordinating production milestones and tasks, managing suppliers and SKUs/products, and monitoring inbound shipments and logistics. Anvyl was acquired by Sage and now operates under the Sage umbrella. It exposes a token-authenticated REST API (api.anvyl.com/api/v1) documented via Stoplight, with resources such as purchase orders. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Anvyl's live public developer surface.

providers.name: Apache Sqoop
providers.description: Apache Sqoop is a command-line tool designed for efficiently transferring bulk data between Apache Hadoop and structured data stores such as relational databases. It supports parallel import and export of data, incremental loads, and direct database connectors for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and DB2. Note: Apache Sqoop has been retired to the Apache Attic as of 2021. Users are encouraged to migrate to Apache Spark or Apache NiFi.

providers.name: ApplyKoala
providers.description: ApplyKoala provides a free AI‑enhanced job application tracker that lets users paste job postings, organize them, and use a Chrome extension to auto‑fill applications. The platform offers features like AI‑driven resume keyword checking, mock interviews, and job market insights, all without requiring sign‑up. It targets job seekers looking to streamline their application process with AI assistance.

providers.name: Bankjoy
providers.description: Bankjoy is an end-to-end digital banking platform purpose-built for community banks and credit unions. Founded in 2014 and based in the Detroit metro area (Royal Oak, Michigan), the Y Combinator- and Bessemer-backed fintech delivers consumer and business online and mobile banking, online account opening, online loan origination, digital statements, and fraud tooling (FraudSense) to 85+ financial institutions serving more than one million members. Bankjoy's API-based technology integrates with banking cores including Corelation KeyStone (as its first Certified Partner) and Fiserv, plus 150+ partner integrations. It is a business-to-business SaaS provider and does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: BidSurvivor
providers.description: BidSurvivor is an advertising auction platform that offers two daily ad slots, each lasting twelve hours. Bidders compete for these slots, paying only when outbid, with real‑time metrics displayed publicly. The service operates independently, without a formal company structure, and emphasizes transparency and scarcity to create value for advertisers.

providers.name: Buy My Agent
providers.description: Buy My Agent is a curated marketplace to list and subscribe to business-ready AI workflows. Creators keep the subscriber relationship; the platform charges a 10% commission on sales. The platform offers free agents for businesses to integrate, with a focus on AI-driven automation and workflow solutions.

providers.name: C. R. Bard
providers.description: C. R. Bard, Inc. was an American multinational developer, manufacturer, and marketer of medical technologies in the fields of vascular, urology, oncology, and surgical specialties. Bard was founded in 1907 by Charles Russell Bard and was acquired by Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) in December 2017 for approximately $24 billion. Bard's product lines now operate as part of BD's Interventional segment under the BD Bard brand. No public API or developer portal is published; integrations with hospital and provider systems are arranged through BD enterprise channels.

providers.name: CallDesk
providers.description: Calldesk (calldesk.ai) is a French-founded, EU-focused provider of AI voice agents that automate inbound and outbound customer-service phone calls for enterprise contact centers. Its cloud platform designs, deploys, and monitors custom LLM-driven callbots that qualify, identify, and route callers, answer FAQs, create tickets, and transfer to human agents with summaries, speaking 80+ languages and integrating with existing SIP/telephony stacks and CRM/help-desk tools such as Salesforce and Zendesk. Calldesk processes tens of millions of calls per year for enterprises across insurance, energy, banking, retail, logistics, travel, and auto-leasing, marketing outcomes such as up to 80% call automation and up to 50% cost reduction. Integrations are delivered via a REST API and data export (sFTP data lake); there is no public developer portal or OpenAPI. Added to the API Evangelist network as a point-nine portfolio company.

providers.name: Canuck Eats
providers.description: Canuck Eats is a Canadian food‑delivery comparison service that started in Merritt, BC in 2017. It shows customers the crossed‑out competitor price on every menu item, letting them see how much they save versus DoorDash and UberEats. Today the service operates in 80+ Canadian cities, covering British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, the Atlantic provinces and the territories, providing transparent pricing and local restaurant options.

providers.name: Criteria Corp
providers.description: Criteria Corp provides pre‑employment testing and employee assessment solutions, offering a suite of scientifically validated assessments such as cognitive aptitude, personality, emotional intelligence, risk, skills, and game‑based tests. Their platform includes AI‑proctored video interviewing, real‑time interview scoring, and ongoing employee development tools like weekly manager check‑ins and coaching. Serving enterprises, mid‑market, and small businesses, Criteria Corp helps organizations make data‑driven hiring and development decisions through a cloud‑based SaaS platform.

providers.name: DecRec
providers.description: DecRec provides a decision‑recording platform that captures, preserves, and surfaces the reasoning behind choices made in AI‑assisted workflows. Users can commit decisions, recall prior reasoning, and share context across tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and VS Code. The service aims to prevent reopening settled decisions, improve institutional memory, and streamline collaborative AI interactions.

providers.name: demo.st
providers.description: demo.st is a "demo stage for vibe-coded prototypes": a hosting service that lets people who build prototypes with AI coding agents (Cursor, Bolt, Claude Desktop and similar) reserve a subdomain such as project-name.demo.st and publish a static site (a zip of HTML, CSS and JS, up to 10MB) without DevOps. It is MCP-native - agents connect to its MCP endpoint with a bearer token to reserve subdomains and upload sites - and it offers an optional document API at api.demo.st/v1 that a published static site can call with a per-site API key (dk_...).

providers.name: DomainROC
providers.description: domainroc-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Dutch
providers.description: Dutch (dutch.com) is a United States pet telemedicine service that gives dog and cat owners 24/7 access to licensed online veterinarians through a low-cost membership (from about $11/month), pairing virtual vet visits with free prescription delivery to most states. Founded to bring the direct-to-consumer telehealth model to pet care, Dutch is backed by Forerunner Ventures. The public presence is a consumer telehealth storefront hosted on Shopify; at the time of profiling no first-party public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface was found. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's real, published web surface (identity, policies, account, support) and the live platform-level discovery documents exposed on the domain.

providers.name: Educative
providers.description: Educative is an online learning platform that provides high-quality, interactive courses for developers of all skill levels. With a focus on practical, hands-on learning, Educative offers courses on a wide range of topics, from programming languages like Python and JavaScript to data structures and algorithms. Each course is created by expert instructors and includes quizzes, coding challenges, and real-world projects to help learners apply their knowledge.

providers.name: eMagiz
providers.description: eMagiz provides an integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) enabling lifecycle management, integration landscape management, messaging, API gateway, event streaming, and state generation. The Dutch‑based company offers a unified platform for connecting applications, handling asynchronous message exchange, and supporting community resources, partners, and demos. It targets enterprises seeking seamless integration and API management across cloud and on‑premise environments.

providers.name: Entropy
providers.description: Entropy is a threshold-signature network for trustless, programmable key management and distributed key generation (DKG). Positioned as "the Autonomous Agent Network," Entropy lets users and agents produce cryptographic signatures without any single party ever holding the private key, using on-chain WASM "programs" that define the exact conditions under which a signature may be generated. Built as a Substrate-based blockchain with a network of Threshold Signature Scheme (TSS) servers running inside Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), Entropy delivers secure crypto custody, programmable signing, and distributed key management for Web3 and autonomous-agent use cases. Backed by a16z and surfaced into the API Evangelist network via the venture-portfolio pipeline.

providers.name: EZKL
providers.description: EZKL (by Zkonduit Inc.) is a developer-friendly engine for verifiable AI and analytics that generates zero-knowledge proofs (ZK-SNARKs, Halo2) for machine learning model inference. Given a model in ONNX format and sample input, EZKL automatically compiles a proving circuit and produces a cryptographic proof that a computation ran correctly without revealing the underlying private data or model weights. Proofs are verifiable on-chain (EVM-compatible), in the browser, or on edge devices. EZKL ships as a command-line tool, Python and JavaScript (WebAssembly) bindings, and a Rust library, and supports tree-based models, transformers, CNNs, and RNNs. Lilith is its high-performance compute cluster for cloud-scale proof generation. The codebase was audited by Trail of Bits and is developed in the open at github.com/zkonduit/ezkl.

providers.name: Flare Therapeutics
providers.description: Flare Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 400 Technology Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing small-molecule precision medicines against transcription factors — a target class long considered undruggable. Its platform combines a "switch site" hypothesis with cell-based ligand discovery and chemoproteomics to find binding pockets on transcription factors that control cancer cell states. The company launched publicly in May 2021 with an $82 million Series A led by Third Rock Ventures, and closed an $85 million insider-led Series C on 30 June 2026 led by Third Rock Ventures and Nextech Invest with Pfizer Ventures, Boxer Capital, GordonMD Global Investments, Invus, Casdin Capital, Eli Lilly, Novartis, Agent Capital and Eventide Asset Management participating, appointing Anna Protopapas as Chief Executive Officer at the same time. Its clinical-stage lead FX-909 is a PPARG inverse agonist in advanced urothelial cancer; FX-111 is an androgen-receptor-directed program in prostate cancer that received FDA IND clearance ahead of a clinical start in the third quarter of 2026. Flare also runs a discovery collaboration with Roche on undrugged transcription factor targets in oncology. Flare Therapeutics operates no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal or API documentation. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind www.flaretx.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: flett-app
providers.description: Flett is an AI‑powered whiteboard platform that lets teams collaboratively create slides, documents, diagrams and other visual content. Users can clip web pages, screenshots or AI‑generated artifacts onto a shared board, edit and comment in real time, and export the results to PowerPoint, PDF or other formats. The service includes an MCP server for integration with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other models, and offers a Chrome extension for easy clipping. Flett provides a range of templates, brand kits and collaborative tools to streamline brainstorming and presentation creation.

providers.name: Gordon Food Service
providers.description: Gordon Food Service (GFS) is North America’s largest family‑operated foodservice distributor, supplying a broad range of food, beverage and related products to restaurants, healthcare facilities, schools and other institutions. With over 125 years of experience, GFS operates a network of distribution centers and offers services such as menu planning, culinary expertise, and technology solutions to help customers manage their operations efficiently.

providers.name: Graphcore
providers.description: Graphcore is a semiconductor and AI-computing company that designs the Intelligence Processing Unit (IPU), a processor purpose-built for machine intelligence workloads, along with the IPU-Machine, IPU-POD and Bow systems that scale it. Its developer surface is the Poplar SDK software stack -- Poplar, PopART (Poplar Advanced Runtime), PopTorch (a PyTorch interface for the IPU) and PopLibs -- distributed as open-source components on GitHub and as prebuilt wheels in the Poplar SDK download. Graphcore targets training and inference for deep-learning models and integrates with standard frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and ONNX. Founded in Bristol, UK, Graphcore became part of SoftBank Group in 2024. It exposes no public REST API; this profile catalogs its software developer surface. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of Atomico, Balderton Capital and DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: House Rx
providers.description: House Rx is a healthcare technology company that equips independent specialty and community clinics to run in-house, medically integrated dispensing pharmacies. Founded in 2021, its cloud platform — built by specialty pharmacists and physicians — supports the full specialty-medication workflow: prior authorization, financial counseling and copay assistance, fulfillment tools, scalable patient outreach and messaging, real-time operational analytics, and EHR integration so physicians and pharmacists collaborate on patient care. House Rx is SOC 2 compliant and backed by First Round, Bessemer Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Maverick Ventures, 1984 Ventures, and Character Ventures. House Rx does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Insurance Australia Group
providers.description: Insurance Australia Group (IAG, ASX: IAG) is the largest general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand, headquartered in Sydney and operating a portfolio of underwriting brands rather than a single consumer-facing label. In Australia it trades as NRMA Insurance, CGU, WFI, Swann Insurance and the digital-native ROLLiN'; in New Zealand as State, AMI, NZI and Lumley. Its lines of business are property and casualty — home and contents, motor, commercial, rural and farm, compulsory third party and specialty — split across a Direct Insurance Australia arm and an Intermediated Insurance Australia arm that sells through brokers and authorised representatives. IAG has no public, self-serve API surface. Probing every conventional developer hostname on iag.com.au, cgu.com.au and nrma.com.au found no developer portal and no published reference documentation; docs.iag.com.au exists but immediately redirects to a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and is an internal wall, not a portal. What the probes did confirm is a real Apigee API gateway fronting three brand virtual hosts — api.iag.com.au, api.cgu.com.au and api.nrma.com.au — each returning an Apigee ApplicationNotFound fault at the root, meaning proxies exist but none is discoverable or documented to the public. A second round of probing added a fourth brand virtual host, api.wfi.com.au, and a publicly resolvable non-production Apigee organisation at test-api.iag.com.au. IAG has also deployed MuleSoft's Anypoint API Experience Hub and is migrating roughly 600 APIs onto it, with a stated intent to make them agent aware — a substantial API estate that is entirely internal. Broker and partner integration in this market runs through human-facing trading portals — CGU's PolicyPlace quote-and-bind platform, the Ebix Sunrise Exchange and the Steadfast Client Trading Platform — not through an open API programme. IAG does run a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure programme, and published an RFC 9116 security.txt across seven brand domains until it was withdrawn in mid-2025. Australia has the legal machinery for open insurance and no live obligation: the Consumer Data Right that opened banking and energy was flagged for general insurance and then paused, so nothing compels IAG to publish. This record is therefore an honest stub: a partner-gated carrier with a private gateway and zero public specifications.

providers.name: ISO 20022
providers.description: ISO 20022 is the international financial messaging standard published by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) that provides a common language and model for financial data. It defines business processes, data elements, and message definitions used by banks, payment systems, securities settlement systems, and other financial institutions worldwide for payment messages, securities messages, trade finance, and foreign exchange. SWIFT serves as the ISO 20022 Registration Authority, maintaining the message repository and e-Repository. As of 2025 ISO 20022 became the exclusive format for cross-border payments on the SWIFT network, with more than 60 central banks worldwide either completed or underway with migration.

providers.name: JobAdder
providers.description: JobAdder is a cloud-based recruitment and applicant tracking platform used by staffing agencies and in-house talent acquisition teams to manage jobs, candidates, placements, and client relationships. The platform offers a comprehensive REST API that exposes recruitment workflows including job posting, candidate search, application tracking, and analytics. The JobAdder API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with region-specific base URLs returned in the token response.

providers.name: Judi Health
providers.description: Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx) is a healthcare technology company delivering unified pharmacy and medical benefit administration. Its platform, Judi, is a modern claims and benefits processing system (a Core Administrative Processing System / CAPS) that self-funded employers, unions, health plans, third-party administrators (TPAs), brokers, and health systems use to run transparent, pass-through pharmacy benefit management (Judi Rx), integrated health benefit administration (Judi Care), care navigation, level-funded pharmacy benefits, a Medicare prescription payment plan, and white-label discount cards. Judi Cloud licenses the underlying platform to other administrators. In 2026 the company rebranded from Capital Rx to Judi Health following a $400M funding round to accelerate its AI-powered health benefits platform, and its PBM business surpassed five million contracted lives. Judi Health does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference; this profile captures the company identity, web properties, and security/trust posture.

providers.name: Keld
providers.description: Keld is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: vc-portfolio; backed by founder-collective) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Kurtosys
providers.description: Kurtosys provides an integrated SaaS platform for automated investment reporting, fund data management, and client portal experiences, enabling financial firms to create compliant fact sheets, dynamic websites, and secure investor portals while leveraging AI-driven insights and regulatory documentation tools. The solution supports fund centres, fund websites, and investor presentations, delivering fast, flawless, and audit‑ready disclosures across multiple asset classes.

providers.name: Linker Finance
providers.description: Linker Finance Inc is a US financial technology company providing a digital banking and CRM platform for community and regional retail and commercial banks. Its platform covers digital account opening with embedded KYC and fraud checks, business and commercial onboarding with KYB, AML and beneficial-owner KYC, retail digital banking, and commercial banking features including positive pay, treasury management, remote deposit capture, team management and payment approvals. The platform runs on AWS, ships as responsive web plus native iOS and Android apps published under the bank's own app store accounts, and integrates with bank core systems directly or through integration partners. Linker Finance is a certified PREMIUM partner on the Fiserv AppMarket. Backed by Techstars and Alloy Labs, the company raised a $5M seed round. It publishes no public developer portal or API; its "API Connectivity" is a partner- and customer-scoped integration capability rather than an open API program.

providers.name: Locoia
providers.description: Locoia is a low-code integration platform as a service (iPaaS) that enables businesses to integrate their entire tech stack and automate processes and reporting via a drag-and-drop workflow editor with 200+ pre-built connectors. Hosted in Frankfurt, Germany, with GDPR/DSGVO compliance and 99.99% uptime.

providers.name: Marketing Evolution
providers.description: Marketing Evolution is an enterprise marketing measurement and analytics company whose stated mission is to "make marketing knowable." It ships two products. Substrate is positioned as a system of record for marketing performance, unifying fragmented media, audience, commerce and third-party data, enriching it, and publishing standardized output to data warehouses, BI tools, CDPs and agents. Darwin is the decisioning layer on top, running unified marketing measurement (MMM plus multi-touch attribution), budget scenario modeling and ROI forecasting, media performance intelligence, and always-on agents with automated anomaly detection. Roughly thirty published connectors cover the major ad platforms, warehouses, CRM and BI systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners and sells exclusively through an enterprise demo-request motion. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; its API host, api.marketingevolution.com, returns HTTP 403 to every anonymous request, and its published integration mechanism is data-plane (SFTP, Amazon S3, Snowflake data shares) rather than a public request/response API.

providers.name: Mirror
providers.description: Mirror Protocol is a decentralized finance (DeFi) synthetic-assets protocol built on the Terra blockchain (with an Ethereum bridge) that mints mirrored assets (mAssets) tracking the prices of real-world equities, commodities, and other assets. Its public developer surface is the Mirror API — a read-only GraphQL data service exposing protocol state (assets, prices, positions, staking) — together with the mirror.js JavaScript/TypeScript SDK and the mirrorcli command-line interface for querying and executing against the on-chain CosmWasm contracts. The protocol is governed by the MIR token. It is now in a legacy/dormant state following the May 2022 Terra/LUNA collapse, though its documentation, GitHub org, SDKs, and GraphQL endpoint remain reachable.

providers.name: MonetaIQ
providers.description: MonetaIQ provides global financial data covering over 400 million private and public companies, offering balance sheets, income statements, cash flow, and P&L information sourced directly from official registries and stock exchanges. Their platform includes a Managed Coverage Platform (MCP), extensive data dictionaries, and API access for seamless integration into financial analysis workflows.

providers.name: Mozilla Glean
providers.description: Mozilla Glean is an open-source telemetry library developed by Mozilla that provides cross-platform SDKs for collecting, aggregating, and exporting product usage data. It powers data collection in Firefox and other Mozilla applications, offering a privacy-preserving design, configurable metrics, and a data-control plane for developers to manage data pipelines. The project is hosted on GitHub and documented with comprehensive guides, API references, and examples for Android, iOS, JavaScript, Rust, and other platforms.

providers.name: Muuktest
providers.description: MuukTest (MuukLabs) is an AI-powered test automation and managed QA services company founded in 2019 that helps software teams reach high end-to-end test coverage in weeks rather than months. It blends an AI-driven automation platform with expert QA engineers to deliver end-to-end, functional, regression, API, and performance testing across web, mobile, and API surfaces, using self-healing scripts (Playwright, Selenium, Appium), CI/CD integration, and detailed bug reporting with repro steps, logs, recordings, and Slack alerts. MuukTest is a managed testing service delivered through a Chrome recorder and a dedicated team rather than a self-service public developer API; it is backed by Techstars, the NSF SBIR program, MassChallenge, and Google for Startups.

providers.name: OnTheMarket
providers.description: OnTheMarket is the third-largest residential property portal in the United Kingdom, operating onthemarket.com. It was founded in 2013 by Agents' Mutual Limited as an agent-owned challenger to Rightmove and Zoopla, listed on AIM as OnTheMarket plc, and was acquired outright by CoStar Group in December 2023 for approximately GBP 99 million. In a market with no MLS and no cooperative listing standard, OnTheMarket sits at the demand end of the value chain: consumers search the portal, and listings arrive from member estate agents' CRM systems rather than from a shared data pool. Its API posture is honest and narrow. There is no public developer portal — developer., developers., api. and docs.onthemarket.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /api-docs all return 404 on the main site. What does exist is a member-only integration surface: the OnTheMarket Real Time Datafeed (RTDF), a Rightmove-RTDF-compatible feed API served from the live, OnTheMarket-operated host realtime-api.onthemarket.com, used by agency CRM vendors to push listings and pull branch enquiries on behalf of member agents. No machine-readable contract for it is published anywhere; OnTheMarket's developer guide is distributed under agreement, and every path on the host returns 404 to an anonymous caller. There is no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData $metadata document and no Universal Property Identifier anywhere in the stack — RESO is a North American construct and the UK has never adopted it, so "certified but unreachable" does not apply here; there is no certification layer in this market at all. OnTheMarket publishes no open data. The genuinely open UK property layer belongs to the public sector — HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and Ordnance Survey — and none of it comes from the portals. OnTheMarket's own Terms of Use go further than most and expressly forbid automated access to any page other than the home page.

providers.name: Parachute Health
providers.description: Parachute Health is the leading digital platform for durable medical equipment (DME), home medical equipment, and medical supply ePrescribing. Clinicians eSign and submit DME orders in seconds, and the platform coordinates in real time across a network of 3,000+ supplier locations, 270,000+ eSigning clinicians, and 70,000+ facilities in all 50 states. Parachute integrates with EHR/EMR systems (athenahealth, PointClickCare, Epic, and others) using HL7 2.x and FHIR interfaces, and offers prior-authorization automation, health-plan workflows, and value-based-care coordination. Integration is delivered as private, partner-provisioned EMR/HL7/FHIR interfaces rather than a public self-service developer API.

providers.name: Podium Education
providers.description: Podium Education is an Austin, Texas experiential-learning and career platform founded in 2018 that partners with colleges, universities and employers to close the college-to-career gap. Its flagship program, The Global Career Accelerator, is a credit-bearing, financial-aid and Pell-eligible online field experience in which undergraduates work on real brand projects in data analytics, web development, digital marketing and tech operations alongside peers in other countries, earning certificates and minors through their own institution. Podium delivers the program on its own platform stack — a hosted Canvas LMS estate and a student application at globalcareeraccelerator.org — sold to universities as a partnership rather than as software, and it publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Pop
providers.description: Pop is a remote collaboration platform that provides multiplayer screen sharing, voice and video, whiteboarding, and integrated Slack calls, enabling teams to work together as if in the same room. It supports macOS, Windows, Linux, and major browsers, offering low‑latency screen sharing and the ability for each participant to control the shared screen with their own mouse and keyboard. Pop also offers a public API endpoint for ICE server configuration and provides pricing plans for individuals and teams. The company, Pop Technologies, Inc., markets its product for pair programming, remote meetings, and collaborative brainstorming.

providers.name: Proof Random API (Kepler Ops)
providers.description: Proof Random API (Kepler Ops) provides a free public randomness service by relaying the drand quicknet beacon. It offers a simple endpoint to derive reproducible integers from the latest beacon using a user‑supplied nonce. The API returns the sampled value, beacon round, signature digest verification, and indicates that no BLS verification or x402 billing is performed. This service is intended for non‑adversarial use cases such as testing, demos, or low‑stakes applications.

providers.name: Sea Machines Robotics
providers.description: Sea Machines Robotics builds autonomous command-and-control systems (SM300-SP, SM300-NG) and computer-vision perception (AI-ris) for commercial and defense marine vessels. In September 2025 it announced the SMLink Streaming-API and SMLink Control-API, partner-gated interfaces that stream real-time vessel telemetry to external systems and let approved third parties command SM300 autonomy functions from their own mission software. These interfaces are embedded, vessel-side product features, not a self-service public developer platform; access is arranged through Sea Machines sales.

providers.name: SimpliSafe
providers.description: SimpliSafe provides wireless home security systems that include professionally monitored alarm devices, cameras, and smart home integration. The company offers easy‑to‑install equipment, a mobile app for real‑time alerts, and 24/7 professional monitoring services for residential customers across the United States, focusing on user‑friendly design and reliable protection.

providers.name: Spoolman
providers.description: Spoolman is an open-source tool for tracking 3D-printer filament spools. It provides a public REST API that lets users query, add, update, and delete spool records, enabling integration with OctoPrint, Klipper, and other printer management platforms. The project is maintained on GitHub and aims to simplify inventory management for hobbyists and small-scale makers.

providers.name: Sword
providers.description: Sword Health is a digital health company delivering AI-powered virtual care for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain, pelvic health, and injury prevention. Founded in 2015 in Portugal by Virgilio Bento, Sword pairs licensed physical therapists with motion-sensor and computer-vision technology so members can complete clinically supervised physical therapy from home. Its platform spans an enrollment platform, a treatment platform, a mobile application backed by a mobile API, a file-exchange platform for enterprise clients, and an AI care system. Sword serves 1,000+ enterprise and health-plan clients across three continents, is backed by investors including General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, and Transformation Capital, and maintains SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, ISO 13485, HIPAA, GDPR, and Cyber Essentials compliance. Sword does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its identity, status, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Sycamore
providers.description: Sycamore (Sycamore Labs, Inc.) is a Palo Alto, California company building a "trusted agent operating system for the enterprise" — a platform for large organizations to build, deploy, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents across their existing systems with enterprise-grade security, human oversight, and organizational intelligence that compounds over time. Its stated pillars are a progressive trust system where agents earn autonomy through demonstrated reliability, adaptive system generation from natural language, continuous learning from outcomes, and collective multi-agent coordination. The company emerged from stealth in March 2026 with a $65M seed round led by Coatue and Lightspeed. As of this profile Sycamore is pre-product with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this repo captures its public company identity, security posture, and machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: Taranis
providers.description: Taranis is an AI-powered crop intelligence company that delivers full-service, leaf-level aerial scouting for agricultural advisors, retailers, and growers. Its AcreForward platform captures submillimeter drone and satellite imagery and applies computer vision and generative AI (Ag Assistant) to detect weeds, pests, disease, nutrient deficiencies, and stand counts, turning insights into measurable yield outcomes. Taranis is delivered as a closed SaaS platform (web dashboard and mobile apps); no public or partner developer API is documented as of this writing.

providers.name: The Lafz
providers.description: Lafz is a halal-certified cosmetics and personal-care brand, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore as part of the Believe PTE FMCG group. It sells hair care, skin care, makeup, a caffeine range, deodorants and fragrance made without alcohol, parabens or animal by-products. The direct-to-consumer storefront at lafz.com runs on Shopify and exposes real agent-facing surfaces: a Shopify customer-account OpenID Connect provider, an /llms.txt agent guide, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) shopping MCP server for buyer-approved agent-driven checkout. thelafz.com is the corporate "halal compliant factories" site. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio-graph lead and enriched from its live public surfaces.

providers.name: Upsolver
providers.description: Upsolver is a cloud data ingestion and lakehouse pipeline company whose SQLake platform lets teams build and deploy high-scale streaming data pipelines using familiar SQL, with automatic schema evolution and Apache Iceberg optimization. Upsolver was acquired by Qlik and the product now continues as Qlik Open Lakehouse; the standalone Upsolver (SQLake) product is legacy, with documentation maintained under Qlik's help site and first-party Python SDK, CLI, and dbt tooling still published on PyPI.

providers.name: Urban Sports Club
providers.description: Urban Sports Club is a Berlin-based sports and wellness membership platform. One flexible subscription gives members access to more than 50 sports and wellness activities across thousands of partner venues in Europe, plus online classes, and employers can offer it as a corporate fitness benefit. The company publishes no public developer API; partner studios and gyms connect through third-party booking-software integrations such as Eversports, Magicline, bsport, Virtuagym, and Mindbody. A Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: UrbanSitter
providers.description: UrbanSitter is an online marketplace that connects families with trusted local caregivers, including babysitters, nannies, child care providers, daycares and preschools, tutors, pet sitters, senior caregivers, and household help. Operated by UrbanSitter, Inc., the platform lets parents browse caregiver profiles, read reviews from other families, compare pay rates, and book and pay sitters, while caregivers find and manage child care and home care jobs. UrbanSitter runs its platform on a private Spring Boot API (Swagger UI is IP-safelisted) and does not publish a public developer program.

providers.name: Valyuu
providers.description: Valyuu is an Amsterdam-founded embedded recommerce service provider offering a plug-and-play trade-in platform that businesses integrate to buy back, resell, and recycle used consumer electronics such as smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches across Dutch, German, and English-language markets. Its partner-facing Trade-In API powers embedded trade-in flows covering device catalogs, condition questions, offers, payments, and shipping. Valyuu is a Techstars portfolio company; as of mid-2026 valyuu.com redirects to prioont.com, whose storefront is currently unreachable.

providers.name: Veritas Software
providers.description: Veritas Technologies (originally Veritas Software) is an enterprise data management and protection vendor whose products — NetBackup, Alta, Backup Exec, and InfoScale — expose RESTful APIs for automating backup, recovery, storage provisioning, and data governance. NetBackup ships Swagger/OpenAPI-documented REST APIs served from the master server, with first-party code samples published under the VeritasOS GitHub organization. The company runs a public trust and compliance program covering SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, FIPS 140, GDPR, and CCPA. Accel is among its historical investors.

providers.name: ViralGains
providers.description: ViralGains is an advertising technology platform that collects consumer feedback directly within digital ad units as zero-party data, then combines that real-time, consented consumer input with its VoiceAlike AI to build higher-quality audiences and deliver more relevant, privacy-respecting advertising for brands and agencies. The platform spans zero-party data collection, brand lift measurement, and a dedicated health and pharma offering (VG Health). ViralGains was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and product website but no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Abnormal Security
providers.description: Abnormal Security (operating under the abnormal.ai brand) is an AI-native email and SaaS security platform that uses behavioral AI to model normal communication and identity behavior, then detect socially engineered email attacks, business email compromise, vendor email compromise, and account takeovers across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams. The Behavior Platform is paired with AI Security Agents (AI Security Mailbox, AI Phishing Coach, AI Data Analyst) and exposes a gated REST API at api.abnormalplatform.com for SOC, SIEM, SOAR, and ticketing integrations. 4,500+ customers including 25% of the Fortune 500; named a 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for Email Security Platforms.

providers.name: AegisAI
providers.description: AegisAI is an AI-native email security platform that deploys a network of autonomous AI agents to detect and stop advanced inbound email threats — spear phishing, business email compromise (BEC), zero-day phishing, malicious attachments, and QR-code attacks — before they reach the inbox. It integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace via API in about five minutes with no MX record changes, can run in monitoring mode, provides explainable incident response with Indicators of Compromise for CISOs, and reduces false positives by up to 90%. Founded by former Google Safe Browsing, reCAPTCHA, and Web Risk leaders Cy Khormaee (CEO) and Ryan Luo (CTO), AegisAI raised a $13M seed round co-led by Accel and Foundation Capital in 2025 and is SOC 2 Type II certified.

providers.name: Applied Intuition
providers.description: Applied Intuition builds physical AI software and systems for intelligent machines, helping customers develop, test, validate, deploy, and operate autonomy and vehicle intelligence across automotive, defense, trucking, mining, construction, and agriculture. Its product lines include a Self-Driving System (a unified autonomy stack for land, air, and sea), Vehicle OS (an operating system for intelligent machines), and Tools for Vehicle Intelligence covering simulation, validation, data, training, and evaluation workflows. The company operates as a private enterprise vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API or self-service portal; this profile captures its public identity, security posture, and machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: Backtrace
providers.description: Backtrace provides crash and error reporting solutions for video games, embedded technologies, desktop and mobile software, and SaaS markets. It offers application monitoring, crash analytics, and debugging tools to help developers identify, prioritize, and fix issues quickly, improving software stability and user experience across platforms.

providers.name: Beaconcure
providers.description: Beaconcure is a clinical data technology company whose AI-enabled platform, Verify, automates the statistical analysis and reporting workflow for biometrics teams running clinical trials. Verify converts static Tables, Listings and Figures (TLFs) into machine-readable form and runs format, reference, within-table and cross-table validation checks, tracks quality-control progress in a shared review workspace, and captures every fix in an inspection-ready audit trail across its Essentials, Validate and Generate modules. Beaconcure also documents a customer-scoped Verify REST API that exposes near real-time QC data — deliverables, projects, protocols, users, files, suspected and verified outputs, and discrepancies — as JSON or CSV, though each customer receives a unique API version and endpoint behind an IP allowlist. Founded in Israel with US headquarters in Boston, the company works with top-10 pharmaceutical companies and contract research organizations.

providers.name: BitTorrent
providers.description: BitTorrent is the company behind the BitTorrent peer-to-peer file-sharing protocol and the uTorrent and BitTorrent desktop and web torrent clients, one of the most widely deployed distributed content-delivery technologies on the internet. Now part of the TRON ecosystem, BitTorrent also operates BitTorrent Chain (BTTC) — a layer-2 proof-of-stake cross-chain scaling and interoperability network bridging TRON, Ethereum, and BSC — along with the BTT token, the BTFS decentralized storage layer, and BitTorrent Speed. Its developer surface spans the local uTorrent Web UI API for controlling torrent clients and the BitTorrent Chain developer documentation for building on the BTTC network. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BlackBoiler
providers.description: BlackBoiler provides AI-powered contract review software that automatically applies a company’s playbook, prior redlines, and approved language as first‑pass tracked changes in Microsoft Word. The platform leverages patented NLP technology to improve contract review speed and consistency, offering features such as playbook‑driven markup, SOC 2 compliance reporting, and integration with legal workflows. Founded in 2016, BlackBoiler serves legal teams, law firms, and enterprises seeking automated, standards‑based contract editing.

providers.name: Blend AI
providers.description: Blend AI is an AI‑powered advertising platform that helps brands automate budget allocation, audience optimization, and creative testing across Google, Meta, TikTok and Bing. The service promises to boost ROI by using machine learning to manage campaigns, offering a demo booking for interested marketers.

providers.name: Bolt.new
providers.description: Bolt.new is StackBlitz's in-browser AI full-stack app builder. From a natural language prompt it generates, edits, runs, and deploys complete web applications inside the user's browser tab using StackBlitz's WebContainer runtime — a WebAssembly-based Node.js operating system that boots a real filesystem, npm/pnpm/yarn package manager, terminal, and live preview without a remote VM. The product targets product managers, entrepreneurs, marketers, agencies, and non-engineer builders with conversational app creation, design-system import from Figma and component libraries (Material UI, Chakra UI, Shadcn/ui), built-in database and authentication, one-click deploy to Netlify or bolt.host, custom domains, GitHub version control, and integrations with Supabase, Stripe, Expo, and MCP servers. Bolt.new itself is a hosted, UI-driven product metered in monthly AI tokens with Free, Pro, Teams, and Enterprise tiers — there is no public REST/HTTP developer API or CLI. StackBlitz separately ships the WebContainer API as a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (npm @webcontainer/api) for embedding the same in-browser dev environment in third-party sites, plus a StackBlitz SDK (@stackblitz/sdk) for programmatically opening projects. The Bolt.new reference codebase is open source under MIT at github.com/stackblitz/bolt.new as a foundation for building custom AI dev agents; the hosted commercial product is closed source.

providers.name: BorgWarner
providers.description: BorgWarner is a global automotive supplier designing and manufacturing propulsion systems, thermal management, battery systems, charging solutions, and power electronics for combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicles. The company accelerates the world's transition to clean, efficient mobility across passenger and commercial vehicle markets.

providers.name: Brainfile
providers.description: Brainfile is a maintained operating system for Claude Code, providing an autopilot that remembers how you work. It offers a cloud‑pull delivery model with no downloads, delivering rule sets, a weekly freshness feed, and a memory of your workflow directly to your local Claude Code environment. Users get a 30‑day free trial without requiring a credit card, and can cancel anytime via email or the billing portal. The service emphasizes privacy—your code never leaves your machine, and only a licence‑gated endpoint is contacted for updates.

providers.name: Brivo
providers.description: Brivo provides cloud‑based physical security solutions, including access control, video surveillance, visitor management, and intrusion detection. Their platform integrates with various hardware and software, offering unified management for commercial and multifamily properties. Brivo’s services focus on secure, scalable, and remote‑managed security infrastructure for enterprises.

providers.name: BTCDecoded
providers.description: BTCDecoded provides an open, searchable intelligence platform for Bitcoin public coordination records. It aggregates data from IRC, mailing lists, GitHub, project repositories, core announcements, podcasts, and academic papers. Users can query the index, access documentation, and explore plans, with optional Lightning payment for premium access. The service emphasizes decentralization, no KYC, and offers tools via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) for developers.

providers.name: BuiltOnRails
providers.description: builtonrails-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: CarShake
providers.description: CarShake provides a free valet damage protection app that lets drivers capture timestamped, GPS‑verified photos of their vehicle condition before hand‑off. Founded after the creator lost $4,200 to a hotel valet, the service aims to ensure drivers never pay for damage they didn’t cause. The app is available on iOS and Android and integrates with insurance partners to streamline claims.

providers.name: CELPass
providers.description: Independent online CELPIP practice platform with AI‑scored practice tests, mock exams and a free CLB diagnostic. It offers full‑length CELPIP‑General mock tests, AI scoring for speaking and writing, a free 25‑minute CLB diagnostic, daily drills, and resources for Canadian citizenship English preparation. Not affiliated with Paragon Testing Enterprises.

providers.name: CLARA Analytics
providers.description: CLARA Analytics is an AI-as-a-service provider for casualty insurance claims, serving carriers, MGAs/MGUs, reinsurers, third-party administrators and self-insured organizations. Its CLARAty.ai platform applies document intelligence, natural language processing, image recognition and predictive models to medical notes, legal demand packages, bills and other claim documents across workers' compensation, auto and general liability, with products for triage, fraud detection, litigation risk, treatment and provider selection, Medicare Secondary Payer compliance, and industry benchmarking. CLARA markets pre-built APIs for integration with RMIS and core claims systems and ships a Built-by-Guidewire integration for ClaimCenter through the Guidewire Marketplace, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Codewisp
providers.description: Codewisp is an AI-powered game creation platform that lets anyone build and publish real web games from natural-language prompts, with no coding or game-development tools required. Users describe the game they want and the platform generates the code, structure, and assets automatically, supporting 2D, 3D, and multiplayer browser games with instant, prompt-driven refinement. Founded by game developer Elvin Fu and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch, Codewisp reports 2,000+ weekly active creators and 17,000+ games created, offering a browser-based block editor, a community explore and marketplace surface, and shareable instant-play links. Codewisp is a consumer creation product and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: ConverseNow
providers.description: ConverseNow is an Austin, Texas voice AI company, founded in 2018, that builds conversational AI virtual assistants which automate restaurant order taking across high-volume voice channels — inbound phone, drive-thru, SMS, and kiosk. The platform uses large language models to understand natural-language orders, suggest upsells, and confirm items in real time, and it markets an "Order Injection API" that pushes completed orders into restaurant point-of-sale and order-management systems. ConverseNow lists integrations with Brink POS, Fiserv, Focus, ItsaCheckmate, NCR Aloha, Olo, PAR, Qu, Xpient, Adora POS, and Deliverect, and reports processing more than two million conversations per month across national QSR brands. It publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; API access is reached through a sales consultation.

providers.name: Copper Cow Coffee
providers.description: Copper Cow Coffee is a specialty Vietnamese coffee brand founded by Debbie, a Vietnamese‑Californian entrepreneur. The company sources climate‑resilient beans from Vietnam’s first organic‑certified farms, pays farmers double market rates, and blends coffee with real herbs and spices for unique flavors. Their e‑commerce store offers coffee, creamers, seasonal flavors, and subscription plans, emphasizing sustainability, zero‑fake ingredients, and AAPI woman‑owned leadership.

providers.name: CrowdSmart
providers.description: CrowdSmart Labs provides a trust layer for human and AI collective intelligence, offering products such as Collective Reasoning Foresight, Knowledge Agent, and Collective IQ. The platform enables organizations to build auditable, transparent AI reasoning with confidence scores, provenance, and a full audit trail, addressing governance challenges of AI deployment.

providers.name: Cuemarc
providers.description: Cuemarc provides AI-driven listening and reputation management tools for corporate communications, PR, and marketing teams. Their platform monitors large language model outputs to track narrative visibility, manage brand reputation, and identify content gaps. Offering features like real-time alerts, detailed reports, and actionable insights, Cuemarc helps organizations stay ahead of AI-driven reputational risks across pharma, medtech, and other industries.

providers.name: Dabble Me
providers.description: Dabble Me is a private, email‑first personal journaling service that helps users reflect daily. Users receive prompts by email and can reply to create entries, which are stored privately. The platform offers a free core product and a PRO tier ($4 / month or $40 / year) unlocking daily prompts, photo uploads, search, web writing, and remote MCP server access. It integrates with AI via MCP tools for searching, listing, analyzing entries, and more, while emphasizing privacy and no data training for AI.

providers.name: Detail
providers.description: Detail is a video creation and editing app for iOS and macOS built by Detail Technologies B.V., a Point Nine portfolio company. It combines multi-camera recording, AI-powered auto-editing (silence removal, zoom cuts, captions, titles, and music), live multi-platform streaming to YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, and LinkedIn, a built-in teleprompter, green-screen background removal, and automatic captions, aimed at creators, podcasters, and streamers producing polished video quickly. Detail won the 2025 App Store Award for iPad App of the Year and was a 2026 Apple Design Award finalist. It is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Distillsync
providers.description: Distillsync provides a semantic integration platform that connects ERP systems with e‑commerce platforms, enabling real‑time synchronization of orders, customers, products, pricing, and inventory.
