It lets teams design multilingual care workflows across voice, SMS, and email in minutes — automating screening and needs assessments, service recommendations, outreach, appointment reminders, wellness check-ins, emergency broadcasts, closed-loop referral tracking, and Medicaid/SNAP recertification. The platform integrates with existing EHR/CRM systems and databases via FHIR, HL7, API, and SFTP, and is HIPAA compliant with encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access controls, audit trails, BAAs, and SOC 2 documentation available on request. Blooming Health is a healthcare portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes an enterprise integration surface but publishes no public developer portal or API reference.

providers.name: Blueground
providers.description: Blueground is a global proptech company that leases, furnishes and operates move-in-ready apartments for stays of a month or longer, running thousands of units across cities in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Latin America. It operates an end-to-end technology stack: a consumer booking site and iOS/Android guest apps, an internal property, pricing and operations platform, and the Blueground Partner Network — an invite-only marketplace where third-party furnished-rental operators list supply and connect inventory through PMS and channel-manager integrations (Avantio, NextPax, Rentals United, Hostify, Hostfully, SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, Airbnb). Blueground publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable contract: partner connectivity is brokered through channel-manager partners rather than a self-serve API. Its engineering organization does maintain a real open-source footprint on GitHub (bluegroundltd), with libraries released to Maven Central and npm, and the main website publishes an llms.txt.

providers.name: Book a Sponsor
providers.description: Book a Sponsor helps newsletter, podcast, and YouTube creators find brands willing to sponsor their content. Users paste a link to their media, and the service scans recent sponsorships to match relevant brands, then emails those brands on the user’s behalf. The platform offers a free tier with 200 emails and paid plans starting at $19 per month, with no commission on deals. It aims to simplify sponsorship acquisition for creators and provides tools like media kits, pricing calculators, and proposal templates.

providers.name: Centrexion Therapeutics
providers.description: Centrexion Therapeutics is a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at One Boston Place, Suite 3520, Boston, Massachusetts, developing novel non-opioid, non-addictive therapies for chronic pain alongside an emerging portfolio in immunology and inflammation. The company was founded by Sol Barer, Ph.D. — a founder of Celgene, who chairs the board — and by James N. Campbell, M.D., president and chief scientific officer and Professor Emeritus of neurosurgery at Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine. Jeffrey B. Kindler, formerly chief executive of Pfizer, joined as chief executive officer in 2013. Its lead asset, CNTX-4975, is a highly purified synthetic trans-capsaicin injected directly into the painful joint that produces analgesia by reversibly deactivating the end terminals of TRPV1-expressing primary afferent pain fibers, delivering pain relief that can last months while clearing the body within 24 hours; the FDA granted it Fast Track designation for moderate-to-severe osteoarthritis knee pain. Centrexion runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, API documentation, SDK or status page. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind centrexion.com, catalogued here, together with an llms.txt the site generates for AI crawlers.

providers.name: CodePen
providers.description: CodePen is a social development environment for front-end designers and developers, offering a browser-based playground for writing and sharing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The platform allows users to create "Pens" (interactive code snippets) and share them publicly or privately. CodePen provides developer-facing APIs including an Embed API for displaying Pens on external sites, a POST to Prefill API for programmatically opening the Pen editor with pre-populated code, Prefill Embeds for transforming existing code blocks into interactive sandboxes, and an oEmbed endpoint for standard embed discovery. The platform is widely used by educators, tutorial authors, and documentation teams who need live, interactive code examples embedded in external pages.

providers.name: CommitChange
providers.description: CommitChange is an all-in-one nonprofit fundraising platform providing online donation processing, recurring giving, embeddable donation widgets, crowdfunding and peer-to-peer fundraising campaigns, professional event pages with ticketing, donor management, and a real-time analytics dashboard. Founded in 2012 and acquired by Software for Good (Minneapolis, MN) in 2022, the platform charges no monthly fees or long-term contracts, taking 5% + $0.30 per transaction with payments processed securely via Stripe. CommitChange is built on the open-source Houdini Project (AGPL) and has helped 1,000+ nonprofits raise $82M+ across 4,700+ campaigns and 2,900+ events.

providers.name: CourseStorm
providers.description: CourseStorm provides cloud‑based class registration and management software for arts, community, and continuing education programs. It streamlines enrollment, payments, scheduling, reporting, and communications, helping organizations save time and grow their education offerings. The platform offers features such as class management, integrated payments, growth analytics, and customizable registration forms, targeting schools, nonprofits, and community groups across the United States.

providers.name: DB Planner
providers.description: dbplanner-io is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Dtexsystems
providers.description: DTEX Systems (DTEX) is a cybersecurity company delivering a risk-adaptive insider risk management platform. Its DTEX InTERCEPT product and Platform v7 unify insider threat detection, data loss prevention (DLP), user activity monitoring (UAM), and AI/agentic risk governance through behavioral intelligence rather than intrusive content inspection. The platform correlates human behavior across endpoints to surface early-warning indicators along the insider threat kill chain, uses OCSF-aligned connectors and standardized schemas to export enriched telemetry to SIEM, SOAR, and ITSM tooling, and ships agentic defenders (Triage Guardian and Threat Hunter) to automate investigations. DTEX is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and serves enterprise and government customers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network; no public developer program, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation is currently published — integration is via the enterprise platform and OCSF connectors.

providers.name: dYdX
providers.description: Decentralized cryptocurrency exchange

providers.name: EidoStack
providers.description: EidoStack provides an AI model evaluation workspace that lets developers compare, test, and analyze large language models across providers. The platform offers side‑by‑side quality, cost, token, and context comparisons, enabling informed decisions before production deployment. Features include free tier testing, secure API key handling, detailed analytics, and tools for prompt regression, model benchmarking, and workflow integration across multiple AI providers.

providers.name: Electric
providers.description: Electric (Electric AI) is an IT and security management platform for small and medium-sized businesses, consolidating device management, application and SaaS management, security posture monitoring with automatic remediation, and employee onboarding/offboarding into a single platform that requires no in-house IT skills and syncs with HR systems. Founded in New York and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Electric bundles partner tooling (JumpCloud MDM/SSO, Keeper, ThreatDown, Harmony Email, Perimeter81 VPN, Drata) behind an AI-powered IT Hub, help desk, and hardware procurement service. It is not a developer-API company: there is no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company and enriched from Electric's public web surface.

providers.name: Enervee
providers.description: Enervee operates an AI-powered white-label marketplace platform that helps utilities and government energy programs scale energy efficiency across 39 million-plus households in North America. Its stack spans a utility-branded online store for efficient appliances and equipment across 40-plus product categories (HVAC, water heaters, heat pumps, smart thermostats, EV chargers), the Enervee Score - a proprietary 0-100 energy-efficiency rating updated daily - Eco Financing embedded lending at checkout through national bank partners, and Instant Rebates that automatically stack utility, government, and manufacturer incentives at checkout. Enervee is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published; this profile captures the company's public security, trust, and identity posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Entrata
providers.description: Entrata is a property management platform for multifamily housing that provides an all-in-one operating system for autonomous property management. Its REST API enables integration partners to access and manage properties, residents, leases, maintenance, payments, and reporting data in near real-time. API access requires a signed Developer Interface Agreement and is available only to approved partners with shared clients.

providers.name: Equip Health
providers.description: Equip Health is a virtual, evidence-based eating disorder treatment provider founded in 2019 by Kristina Saffran and Erin Parks. Equip delivers 100% remote, insurance-covered care for all eating disorder diagnoses — anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder (BED), ARFID, atypical anorexia, and OSFED — using Family-Based Treatment (FBT) and other evidence-based approaches. Every patient is matched with a five-person care team: a therapist, medical provider, dietitian, family mentor, and peer mentor. Equip serves patients across the United States with no waitlist, publishes an extensive library of clinical and recovery articles, partners with providers and health plans, and operates a patient portal at my.equip.health. This profile catalogs Equip's public web, legal, security, and content surfaces; Equip publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation program at this time.

providers.name: Family First
providers.description: Family First is an employee caregiving benefits provider that pairs certified Care Experts with a Care Hub mobile app to support working caregivers. The platform helps employers, health plans, and small businesses deliver caregiving advocacy, backup and subsidized care, and expert guidance across aging-parent care, mental health, chronic illness, caregiver burnout, fertility, childcare, veterans support, end-of-life planning, and financial and legal planning. The company operates under SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST i1, HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR frameworks and is Techstars-backed. Family First does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security posture.

providers.name: Fifteenth
providers.description: Fifteenth is a San Francisco-based fintech company operating an AI-powered personal tax platform for ambitious earners — founders, investors, executives, and technology professionals with complex financial situations such as equity compensation (ISOs, RSOs, RSUs, NSOs), liquidity events (IPOs and acquisitions), partnership income (K-1s), and active stock and crypto trading. The service pairs dedicated human CPAs with AI-driven automation: users link their banking, payroll, and investment accounts via one-click integrations (Workday, Rippling, Robinhood, Wealthfront, Carta, Charles Schwab, AngelList, Coinbase and more), and the platform automatically detects tax-relevant transactions, organizes documents, models scenarios, and delivers proactive quarterly planning plus unlimited year-round advice at flat-fee pricing starting around $1,000 per year. Fifteenth raised $8.25M in seed funding (February 2025) led by A* and General Catalyst. It is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: File Browser
providers.description: File Browser is an open‑source web file manager that provides a self‑hosted interface for browsing, uploading, downloading, editing and sharing files within a specified directory. It supports authentication, permissions, and a range of configuration options, and can be deployed as a single binary or Docker container. The project is archived as of September 2026, with no further releases or security updates planned, so users should consider alternatives for production use.

providers.name: Filmcraft
providers.description: FilmCraft is a free, open-source video editor from ArtCraft. It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and also offers a browser‑based online editor. Users can download the desktop application or edit videos directly in the web UI, with features comparable to Adobe Premiere Pro. The project is community‑driven, MIT‑licensed, and provides a CLI, JSON channel, and an MCP server for automation.

providers.name: FirstVet
providers.description: FirstVet is a digital veterinary care company offering 24/7 online video consultations with licensed veterinarians for dogs, cats, and other pets. Founded in Sweden, FirstVet operates a consumer telehealth platform across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States, providing virtual vet appointments, healthy pet checkups, follow-up care, and triage guidance on whether a case needs an in-clinic referral. The company partners with pet insurers and employers to offer covered or subsidized access to its subscription-based virtual care. FirstVet is a portfolio company of Creandum. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; FirstVet publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Gatling
providers.description: Gatling is an open source load and performance testing framework for web applications and APIs with a Scala-based DSL and detailed HTML reports. The Gatling Enterprise Edition exposes a public REST API for triggering runs and fetching run results and metrics.

providers.name: Habiteo
providers.description: Habiteo is a French PropTech company founded in 2014 in Paris that builds full-web 3D sales and marketing technology for new-build real estate. Its products let developers, house builders, commercial-property operators and their agencies model a programme in 3D before it is built: 3D floor plans and perspectives, virtual tours, drone-based site insertions and neighbourhood views (Modelisation and myHabiteo Studio), an interior configurator that lets a buyer choose materials and options in place of a physical showroom (Configurateur), a mobile on-site sales unit (Habiteo Truck), and the MegaWidget, a hosted mini-site that gathers every 3D asset for a programme behind a single link. myHabiteo is the operator platform that binds the 3D layer to commercialisation with a CRM, a reservation module, programme management and sales and marketing dashboards. More than 350 developers, including Nexity, Kaufman & Broad and Immobiliere 3F, have used the technology. Habiteo was acquired by the French listings portal Bien'ici in May 2022 and continues to operate under its own brand. Habiteo publishes no public developer programme, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract for any of these products; the only anonymously readable machine surface on its domain is the WordPress REST API behind its marketing site.

providers.name: Heartland Payment Systems
providers.description: Heartland Payment Systems is a payment processing company offering payroll, customer engagement, point-of-sale, and other business solutions to merchants across the United States. Heartland is now a brand of Global Payments, and developer resources for Heartland integrations are published through the Global Payments developer portal. The platform supports online and in-person payments, bill pay, IoT/connected device payments, gift and loyalty, payroll, and PCI-validated point-to-point encryption.

providers.name: Hello Patient
providers.description: Hello Patient builds AI agents (branded "Mia") for patient conversations across voice, text, and web chat, helping healthcare practices automate their front office, back office, and patient-growth workflows. Mia handles 24/7 appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and patient intake on the front office; revenue-cycle (RCM) follow-up and no-show recovery on the back office; and lead conversion, patient recall, and targeted outreach for growth. The platform serves dentistry, dermatology, ENT, mental health, optometry, primary care, urgent care, veterinary, and consumer-health practices, and integrates with EHR and practice systems including ModMed, AdvancedMD, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Athena Health, Veradigm, Zenoti, and others. Hello Patient is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type 2 certified. It is backed by 8VC and Scale Venture Partners. No public developer API is documented at this time; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HighByte
providers.description: HighByte provides Industrial DataOps software that enables organizations to ingest, transform, and operationalize data from diverse sources such as PLCs, IoT devices, and enterprise systems. Their platform offers a unified namespace, real‑time data pipelines, and AI‑ready datasets, helping manufacturers accelerate digital transformation and build AI‑driven applications. HighByte’s solutions include the Intelligence Hub, REST Data Server, and MCP services, delivering secure, scalable data management for modern industrial environments.

providers.name: Ithaca
providers.description: Ithaca is a crypto-infrastructure company (backed by Paradigm) building open-source developer tooling to accelerate the crypto frontier. Its flagship product, Porto, is a TypeScript SDK for passwordless authentication and payments on the web — letting applications and wallets create, manage, and interact with next-generation Ethereum accounts (keychains with passkeys, permissions, subscriptions, and native cross-chain interoperability) without passwords, extensions, seed phrases, or API keys. The stack also includes the Account smart contracts (Solidity), the Relay cross-chain transaction router and RPC server (Rust) for EIP-7702 accounts, and Odyssey, an experimental open-source Layer 2 testnet. The Ithaca team has since joined Tempo (tempo.xyz), and the Porto product is sunsetting on 2026-07-24 with users moving to porto.sh.

providers.name: Jnana Therapeutics
providers.description: Jnana Therapeutics Inc. is a biotechnology company headquartered at One Design Center Place, Suite 19-400, Boston, Massachusetts, that built RAPID — Reactive Affinity Probe Interaction Discovery — a next-generation chemoproteomics platform for discovering small-molecule medicines against target classes that conventional screening has struggled to drug, including SLC transporters, transcription factors, signaling scaffold proteins, phosphatases, GPCRs and helicases. RAPID runs in living cells: a proprietary Reactive Affinity Probe library covalently labels druggable pockets on a validated target, and a proprietary detection technology then screens large drug-like compound libraries for binders that displace the probe, yielding allosteric inhibitors, localization modulators and molecular glues without iterative structural biology. Its internal pipeline focuses on phenylketonuria (PKU) — where JNT-517, an oral inhibitor acting at a cryptic allosteric site on the SLC6A19 transporter, reached Phase 1b/2 — and on immune-mediated diseases including targets such as interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3), alongside biopharma collaborations that include Roche. Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. completed its acquisition of Jnana on 23 September 2024 for $800 million plus up to $325 million in development and regulatory milestones, making Jnana a direct subsidiary of Otsuka America, Inc.; Otsuka initiated a global Phase 3 trial of repinatrabit in PKU in December 2025. Jnana Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, API reference or SDK. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind www.jnanatx.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: L2Calendar
providers.description: Multilingual Lineage 2 private server listing platform tracking upcoming and past server openings across every game chronicle, with filters by chronicle, rates, labels, and opening date. Server owners publish announcements with optional VIP placement.

providers.name: Legendary Entertainment
providers.description: Legendary Entertainment is a Burbank, California media company that owns, produces and distributes content to worldwide audiences across three divisions: Legendary Pictures (film), Legendary Television and Digital Media, and Legendary Comics. Its productions have grossed more than $20 billion worldwide at the box office, spanning franchises such as Dune, Godzilla and Kong, A Minecraft Movie, Street Fighter, Enola Holmes and Monarch: Legacy of Monsters, with an explicit focus on the fandom demographic. Legendary runs no public developer program and publishes no documented API. It does, however, expose a live, publicly readable WordPress REST API on legendary.com that serves its news posts and its film, television, comics, trailer and digital catalogs as JSON — captured here as a platform-exposed content API rather than a supported product.

providers.name: Limbic
providers.description: Limbic is a clinical AI company for mental healthcare, founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York with a London engineering base. Its two products — Limbic Access, a Class IIa (UKCA) medical device for conversational patient intake, assessment and clinical decision support, and Limbic Care, an AI companion delivering guided CBT and on-demand support between therapy sessions — are embedded by health plans, health systems, behavioral health providers and NHS Talking Therapies services. Both are built on the proprietary "Limbic Layer", a clinical reasoning layer that sits between the user and a large language model to enforce validated clinical guidance. Limbic Access embeds into a provider website with a small script snippet rather than a public developer API; the company publishes no developer portal, OpenAPI definitions or SDKs, and integrates with EHR and patient management systems through customer engagements. Research code accompanying its peer-reviewed studies (including work published in Nature Medicine) is open on GitHub.

providers.name: Mercurius
providers.description: High-performance GraphQL server for Fastify with Just-In-Time compilation via graphql-jit, automatic query caching, N+1 prevention via dataloader integration, federation support, subscription via WebSocket, batched query support, and GraphQL Playground integration.

providers.name: MMOB
providers.description: MMOB provides an API integration toolkit for embedded finance, enabling businesses to embed financial services quickly and securely across channels. Their platform aggregates, transforms, and orchestrates APIs from multiple partners, offering products such as onboarding, payments, and compliance tools. MMOB focuses on rapid deployment, scalability, and improving adoption rates for embedded services, targeting fintechs, banks, and enterprises seeking to enhance their product offerings with integrated financial capabilities.

providers.name: newzai-ai
providers.description: NewzAI provides an AI‑powered news aggregation platform that curates personalized news feeds, summarises articles, and offers real‑time alerts across topics like finance, sports, and technology. Users can access the service via web, Android, and iOS apps, and developers can integrate news streams into agents via the MCP. The platform emphasizes multilingual support, customizable topics, and rapid updates to keep users informed with minimal effort.

providers.name: ParkourSC
providers.description: ParkourSC, formerly Cloudleaf, provides an AI-native Decision Intelligence platform for real‑time supply chain operations. The platform offers digital twins, dynamic decision intelligence, and low‑code workbenches to monitor inventory, cold‑chain logistics, and manufacturing processes. It serves industries such as logistics, pharma, consumer goods, and food & beverage, helping companies anticipate disruptions, optimize demand fulfillment, and ensure quality compliance across global supply chains.

providers.name: Pigeonly
providers.description: Pigeonly is an inmate-communication service that helps families and friends stay connected with incarcerated loved ones across more than 4,000 correctional facilities in the United States. Through its website and mobile apps, users can send photos, letters, postcards, greeting cards, and printed articles, and set up more affordable prison phone calls, all in a few clicks. Backed by 500 Global, Pigeonly is a consumer-facing platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, developer documentation, OAuth surface, or machine-readable specifications, so this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Plan A
providers.description: Plan A is a Berlin-based sustainability technology company providing certified carbon accounting and ESG management software that helps businesses measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. The platform is built on GHG Protocol standards, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and offers AI-enhanced emissions intelligence, supplier engagement, decarbonisation planning, and regulatory reporting (CSRD/ESRS). Plan A operates enterprise data integrations via custom APIs but does not publish a public developer platform, OpenAPI specification, or API reference. Backed by HV Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners; surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with verified public identity and web properties.

providers.name: ProfitWell
providers.description: ProfitWell (now ProfitWell Metrics by Paddle, following Paddle's 2022 acquisition of ProfitWell) is a free subscription analytics product that delivers accurate, real-time SaaS metrics such as MRR, churn, ARPU, LTV, retention, and cohort analysis by connecting directly to billing systems like Stripe, Braintree, Chargebee, Recurly, and Paddle. The ProfitWell API at https://api.profitwell.com/v2 provides programmatic access to subscription lifecycle events, customer data, financial metrics, and engagement data, authenticated via a bare API key passed in the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

providers.name: Radial Analytics
providers.description: Radial Analytics (Radial) is a Concord, Massachusetts healthcare technology company providing an AI/ML-powered clinical decision-support platform for the value-based care market. Its HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified software helps ACOs, hospitals, health systems, payers, and Medicare Advantage plans account for millions of clinical, claims, and quality datapoints to improve patient outcomes while reducing cost of care. Products include Radial Care, ACO Compare, Opportunity Navigator, decision-support modules, care pathways, and TEAM bundles. The company was founded by MIT PhDs Thaddeus Fulford-Jones and Eric Weiss and is backed by Initialized Capital. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: RamAIn
providers.description: RamAIn builds AI agents that automate any UI task with natural language. A Y Combinator (W26) company backed by General Catalyst and Nexus Venture Partners, RamAIn operates web portals, desktop apps, and legacy systems the way a human does — reading screens and interacting with UI elements — then compiles those workflows into reusable, self-healing automations that can be published and managed as APIs. It targets high-friction, document-heavy back-office work across mortgage, finance, healthcare, and insurance.

providers.name: Rembr
providers.description: Rembr provides AI-powered agent memory and debugging tools, enabling developers to capture, store, and query contextual snapshots of AI agents. Their platform offers portable memory, bounded context snapshots, relationship search, and temporal queries to streamline agent handoffs and improve debugging efficiency. With a focus on agent intelligence, Rembr delivers documentation, quick start guides, and secure login for seamless integration into AI workflows.

providers.name: RetainIQ
providers.description: RetainIQ is a full-service retention-marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, delivering lifecycle email and SMS programs. Its work spans automated flows (welcome, cart abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, replenishment), weekly strategic campaign sends with design and copywriting, and deliverability/segmentation/list-hygiene infrastructure. A proprietary 1:1 personalization engine generates variant product blocks at scale. A Klaviyo Gold Master Partner and Omnisend partner, RetainIQ integrates with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Omnisend; plans start at $990/mo on month-to-month terms. It operates as a marketing-services agency and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. RetainIQ Global Inc. previously shipped a self-serve Shopify app (listed 2021, free to install, $999 per 100K personalization credits); that listing is still live but appears retired in place — its application host returns a Cloudflare 522 and the developer website named on the listing now redirects to a domain-for-sale page.

providers.name: Rookout
providers.description: Rookout is a live application debugging platform founded in 2017 in Tel Aviv, Israel that lets developers set non-breaking breakpoints in running production, staging, and development applications to capture full-stack debug data — variables, stack traces, logs, and metrics — without redeploying, restarting, or stopping services. Rookout pioneered the "live debugger" category for cloud-native and Kubernetes-hosted applications and shipped language agents/SDKs for Python, Java/JVM, Node.js, .NET, Go, and Ruby that attach to running processes and stream snapshots back to the Rookout web IDE or developer's IDE. Dynatrace announced its acquisition of Rookout on July 31, 2023 and closed the deal in Q2 of Dynatrace's fiscal year ending September 30, 2023. The standalone Rookout product has since been folded into the Dynatrace platform as the Dynatrace Live Debugger (and Live Logger), and the rookout.com and docs.rookout.com domains now redirect to dynatrace.com. There is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, webhook catalog, or CLI for Rookout — the developer surface consists entirely of language agents, deployment integration examples, IDE extensions, and the Explorook desktop helper that exposes local source folders to the Rookout web debugger. The Rookout GitHub organization remains public and continues to maintain those agents, tutorials, and integration samples under Apache-2.0.

providers.name: Rush Enterprises
providers.description: Rush Enterprises is the largest network of commercial vehicle dealerships in North America, operating Rush Truck Centers with more than 200 locations across the United States. The company offers new and used commercial vehicles, all-makes parts, vehicle technology solutions, collision repair, alternative fuel systems, vehicle and equipment leasing, and financial services. Rush Enterprises provides fleet technology through RushCare, including Service Connect (integrated with OEMs like Peterbilt, International, Hino, and Cummins), Parts Connect, and telematics solutions powered by Geotab.

providers.name: Settle
providers.description: Settle is a financial operations platform built for consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and ecommerce companies, unifying procurement, accounts payable automation, and working capital financing in one back office. Teams create and manage purchase orders, track goods received and true landed costs, collect and approve bills, pay vendors with real-time visibility, and access flexible inventory and growth financing ($20K-$15M) underwritten from payables and purchasing data. Founded in 2019 and backed by Ribbit Capital, Kleiner Perkins, and Founders Fund, Settle has funded more than $3 billion to brands. A developer API covering bill pay, payments, and landed-cost data is in early access via a public waitlist.

providers.name: Siemens Healthineers
providers.description: Siemens Healthineers AG is a German medical technology company (XETRA SHL) covering medical imaging, laboratory diagnostics, point-of-care testing, advanced therapies, and cancer care (following the April 2021 Varian Medical Systems acquisition for USD 16.4 billion). Its digital surface is anchored by the teamplay digital health platform, the Digital Marketplace, syngo.via OpenApps, and the Frontier Development Kit, with developer access offered through a gated teamplay developer portal that exposes APIs for single sign-on, licensing, user roles and permissions, the teamplay receiver plug-in, DICOM image access, customer-specific report submission, and status indicator notifications. No public OpenAPI specifications are published; the API catalog and reference documentation sit behind teamplay developer account authentication.

providers.name: Simon Property Group
providers.description: Simon Property Group is the largest retail real estate investment trust (REIT) in the United States, owning, developing, and managing premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations. Simon's portfolio includes an interest in 254 properties: traditional malls, premium outlets, Mills centers, lifestyle centers, and other retail properties in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company operates ShopSimon, an e-commerce platform, and Simon Innovation Group to advance retail technology innovation. Simon had trailing twelve-month revenue of approximately $6.36 billion as of 2025 and a market capitalization of approximately $67 billion.

providers.name: SkyPilot
providers.description: SkyPilot is an open-source AI compute orchestration platform that enables developers to run large‑scale machine‑learning workloads across multiple clouds, on‑premise clusters, and HPC schedulers. It provides a unified interface for launching, managing, and scaling jobs on Kubernetes, Slurm, and over 20 cloud providers, supporting popular frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and DeepSpeed. The project is backed by a vibrant community and recent $20M seed funding, aiming to simplify AI infrastructure for enterprises and researchers alike.

providers.name: Slurp'it
providers.description: Slurp'it provides open-source network inventory and automation tools, offering plugins for NetBox and Nautobot, a sandbox environment, and extensive documentation. It helps organizations build a single source of truth for IT infrastructure, supports AI-driven mock data generation, and delivers use cases for network onboarding and security transformation.

providers.name: SmartSimple
providers.description: SmartSimple Software builds SmartSimple Cloud, a configurable cloud platform for grants management, research and government funding administration, corporate social responsibility (CSR), scholarships, and case management. The platform exposes three documented programmatic interfaces on each client instance - SmartConnect (a JSON-based RESTful API), an OData reporting API, and a legacy SOAP Web Services API - covering records (UTA Level 1/2/3), users, organizations, transactions, custom fields, and files. Access is instance-scoped - every customer runs on their own alias.smartsimple.com tenant and provisions an API user account or access token, so the documented endpoints are modeled against a customer instance rather than a single public gateway.

providers.name: South State
providers.description: South State Corporation — now SouthState Bank Corporation (NYSE: SSB), the Winter Haven, Florida holding company for SouthState Bank, N.A. — is a Fortune 1000 regional bank serving consumer, mortgage, small business, commercial and wealth customers across the Southeast, Texas and Colorado. It publishes no developer program: the developer.southstatebank.com and api.southstatebank.com hosts that earlier versions of this record pointed at do not resolve in DNS, the bank's own curated llms.txt (served from www.southstatebank.com, last modified 2026-08-24) lists no API, developer or integration page, and commercial connectivity (Treasury Navigator, Integrated Payables) is file-based treasury tooling sold through a banker, not a public API. Consumer data access reaches SouthState through third-party aggregators. The only real programmatic access to the company is the SEC's own EDGAR API, listed here as a clearly labelled third-party government API.

providers.name: Starshipit
providers.description: Starshipit is a shipping and fulfilment platform that helps retailers automate label creation, manage over 60 carriers, and send shipping notifications, delivering better customer experiences across Australia and New Zealand. The service offers a free trial, integrated pricing, and extensive support resources for eCommerce businesses.

providers.name: Stoik
providers.description: Stoïk is a European cyber-insurtech, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Paris, that pairs cyber insurance with active security prevention for small and mid-market businesses (up to roughly €1B revenue). Insurance coverage of up to €10M is backed by Tokio Marine HCC, Swiss Re and Axeria IARD and sold 100% online through a broker platform used by 1,500+ partner brokers across France, Germany, Spain, Austria, Belgium and the Netherlands. Beyond insurance, Stoïk ships a free risk-monitoring suite — Stoïk Protect (external scan, phishing simulation, Active Directory and cloud scanning, leaked-credential monitoring), Managed Detection & Response (MDR), and managed email security — plus 24/7 incident response. Stoïk is a portfolio company of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Anthemis. No public developer API is published today; the developer-adjacent surface is a GitBook help center (docs.stoik.io, with an llms.txt index and a dated changelog), the insured/broker platform at app.stoik.io, and the GitHub org github.com/stoikio.

providers.name: Substly
providers.description: Substly is a SaaS management platform designed for small and medium-sized businesses to track software subscriptions, optimize spend, manage user access, and detect shadow IT across cloud applications. It provides centralized oversight, automated renewal tracking, and integrations with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

providers.name: Syncthing
providers.description: Syncthing is an open-source continuous file synchronization program that securely syncs files across multiple devices in real time. It uses TLS encryption with perfect forward secrecy, operates without central servers, and provides a web GUI for configuration. The project is maintained by the Syncthing Foundation and supported by commercial partners, offering cross‑platform support for Windows, macOS, Linux, BSD, and more.

providers.name: Tendo
providers.description: Tendo is a healthcare software company founded in 2020 by siblings Dan and Jen Goldsmith (previously of Veeva Systems and Instructure) and headquartered in the Philadelphia area. Tendo builds a cloud, purpose-built healthcare platform and a suite of applications that connect patients, clinicians, providers, and caregivers across the care journey — spanning digital patient engagement, quality and clinical documentation improvement, hospital quality rankings analytics, and the Care Connect marketplace for employers, providers, and patients. The company raised a $50M Series B led by Lux Capital (with General Catalyst). Tendo runs public trust and status surfaces (a SafeBase trust center with SOC 2 and HIPAA, an Atlassian Statuspage) but does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI; API integration is delivered under private partner agreements. Surfaced as a Lux Capital portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: tldraw
providers.description: tldraw is an infinite-canvas SDK for building whiteboard and canvas applications. The primary distribution is the `tldraw` React component package; tldraw also offers a multiplayer sync server. License is the tldraw SDK License (free with watermark for small businesses; paid commercial license to remove watermark).

providers.name: Tripo AI
providers.description: Tripo AI (VAST AI Research) is an AI 3D content platform that converts text, images, and multi-view photographs into production-ready 3D assets. The platform exposes a REST API at api.tripo3d.ai that orchestrates a unified "task" abstraction across text-to-3D, image-to-3D, multi-view-to-3D, AI texturing, mesh segmentation, model refinement, stylization, format conversion, automatic rigging, retargeting, and one-shot animation. An official Python SDK, an MCP server, and engine plugins for Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, ComfyUI, Cocos, and Godot wrap the API for creative and game pipelines. Open-source research artifacts (TripoSR, TripoSG, UniRig) ship separately on GitHub under the VAST-AI-Research organization.

providers.name: TytoCare
providers.description: TytoCare is an AI-powered remote physical examination and virtual care company. Its FDA-cleared handheld examination device and Home Smart Clinic / Pro Smart Clinic platforms let clinicians remotely examine heart, lungs, ears, throat, skin, and temperature, serving 240+ healthcare organizations and 1.6M+ patients. TytoCare publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs — EHR and telehealth integrations are delivered through private partner channels. An Insight Partners portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Upmem
providers.description: UPMEM is a French fabless semiconductor company pioneering Processing-In-Memory (PIM). Its Data Processing Units (DPUs) are embedded directly in DRAM on standard DIMM modules, putting thousands of programmable cores inside memory to accelerate data-intensive workloads such as analytics, genomics, and AI inference. Developers program DPUs in C using the UPMEM DPU SDK (LLVM-based compiler, DPU runtime, C/C++/Java/Python host libraries, dpu-lldb debugger, and a functional simulator), distributed from sdk.upmem.com and an APT PPA. UPMEM publishes no hosted web API; its developer surface is the SDK and an open-source GitHub organization. The corporate website (www.upmem.com) is offline as of 2026-07-21, while the SDK documentation and release archive remain live.

providers.name: Useful Sensors
providers.description: Useful Sensors, now operating as Moonshine AI, builds fast, low-resource, private-by-design AI that runs entirely on-device. Founded by former Google TensorFlow leads Pete Warden (CEO) and Manjunath Kudlur (CTO), the company started with plug-and-play hardware like the Person Sensor and Tiny Code Reader and now ships Moonshine, an MIT-licensed family of low-latency speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and intent-recognition models with SDKs for in-browser JavaScript, server-side Python, and C++ on edge devices. There is no hosted cloud API — all speech processing happens locally on the device.

providers.name: Vektor Medical
providers.description: Vektor Medical is a San Diego based medical technology company whose vMap system is an FDA-cleared and CE-marked, AI-based arrhythmia mapping solution. vMap analyzes standard 12-lead ECG data and produces beat-by-beat 2D and 3D cardiac source maps across all four chambers of the heart in about a minute, without requiring an invasive catheter-based mapping procedure. Electrophysiologists use it for triage, procedural planning and ablation guidance across focal and fibrillation-type arrhythmias and atrial and ventricular pacing. The product is delivered as Software as a Medical Device to hospitals and health systems under clinical agreements. Vektor Medical publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Vela Labs
providers.description: Vela Labs, Inc. (Vela, formerly Hive) is a San Francisco company founded in 2018 by Justin Killian and Jason Abaluck that provides an AI-driven platform helping eCommerce sellers manage, optimize, and grow their businesses across multiple channels from a single account. Vela supports Etsy, Shopify, eBay, and Faire, offering bulk listing editing, AI-assisted listing creation and optimization, photo editing, and multi-channel publishing for tens of thousands of sellers. A 500 Global portfolio company that has raised $5.5M. Vela consumes the official APIs of the marketplaces it supports but publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface of its own.

providers.name: Veratrak
providers.description: Veratrak is a supply-chain collaboration and visibility platform for the life-sciences and pharmaceutical industry. Its product, The Hub, aggregates external operations data from contract manufacturers (CMOs/CDMOs), third-party logistics providers (3PLs) and suppliers into a single, secure, compliant view covering batch status, inventory positions, production schedules, quality events and shipment tracking across a partner network. The Hub is format- and protocol-agnostic, exchanging data as CSV, XML, EDI or JSON over SFTP, AS2 or API, and offers API extensions that let pharma organisations connect internal systems to external suppliers with minimal IT effort. The platform is ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certified and GDPR compliant. Veratrak is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: Virgo
providers.description: Virgo builds AI foundation models for gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy, targeting gut-mediated diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer. Its flagship model, EndoDINO, was trained on the largest known endoscopy dataset (130,037 videos / ~3.5 billion frames), and EndoML is the GI-specific tooling environment for building clinical and research workflows on top of it. Virgo Cloud provides video capture and management for endoscopy procedures, while Virgo Trials accelerates clinical trials with automatic data capture, endoscopic scoring, placebo-response prediction, subgroup identification, and AI biomarker discovery. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zama
providers.description: Zama is an open-source cryptography company building state-of-the-art Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) solutions for blockchain and AI. Its developer surface is a suite of libraries and protocols rather than a hosted REST API: TFHE-rs (a Rust implementation of TFHE), Concrete (a Python-to-FHE compiler), Concrete ML (privacy-preserving machine learning), fhEVM and the Zama Protocol for building confidential smart contracts and dApps on EVM-compatible chains, plus TypeScript SDKs (the fhEVM Relayer SDK and React SDK). Zama publishes the ERC-7984 confidential token standard, a developer hub, GitBook documentation, and an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital and enriched from Zama's public developer surface.

providers.name: Zed
providers.description: Zed is an open-source, high-performance multiplayer code editor written from scratch in Rust and built around GPU-accelerated rendering through its own GPUI framework. Created by Zed Industries — founded by Nathan Sobo, Antonio Scandurra, and Max Brunsfeld, the team behind Atom, Electron, and Tree-sitter — Zed combines a native desktop editor with real-time collaboration, native Git integration, Language Server Protocol and Debug Adapter Protocol support, and a first-class AI agent surface that includes edit prediction powered by the open-weight Zeta2 model, an inline assistant, parallel agents, and integrations with external coding agents (Claude, Codex, OpenCode) via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and Model Context Protocol (MCP). The editor itself is free and triple-licensed (AGPL / Apache-2.0 / GPL-3.0) with paid Pro and Business tiers that bundle hosted AI capabilities, edit prediction quotas, organization controls, and data governance. Zed runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows and exposes a WASM-based extension API (themes, languages, debuggers, snippets, MCP servers, agent servers) with extensions published through the zed-industries/extensions repository.

providers.name: 32 Biosciences
providers.description: 32 Biosciences (pronounced "Three Squared") is a North Chicago, Illinois gastrointestinal biotechnology company founded in 2023 that pioneers gut mucosal-immune science to prevent and treat GI disease. It emerged from stealth in September 2024 and is built on research by scientific co-founders John Alverdy MD and Eugene Chang MD of the University of Chicago and Joseph Pierre PhD of the University of Wisconsin-Madison, with Peter Farmakis as CEO. The company runs two platforms - a GI Discovery Platform that measures metabolomic signatures of gut mucosal-immune function for therapeutic discovery and clinical decision-making, and a CS Therapeutic Platform whose lead asset CS-0003 is a Mucosal Immune Modulator intended to restore and protect the GI mucosal-immune barrier across seven indications. It raised $6 million in early funding and announced a $40 million Series A launch at the 2026 J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference. 32 Biosciences publishes no product or developer API and runs no developer program; the only machine-readable surface on 32biosciences.com is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) that serves the company newsroom, marketing and platform pages, leadership profiles, taxonomies and media library as JSON, alongside a WordPress Abilities registry that is present but authentication-gated.

providers.name: AATOS
providers.description: AATOS is a non‑custodial MCP for Stock Tokens on the Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). It enables agents to list, price, check liquidity and obtain unsigned plans that users sign on‑chain, charging about 10 bps in ETH. The service is not a brokerage and is unavailable to US persons. It offers free read‑only actions and paid quoting/execution, with detailed FAQs and pricing information.

providers.name: Accelsius
providers.description: Accelsius LLC is an Austin, Texas thermal-management company founded in 2022 by Innventure to commercialize two-phase, direct-to-chip liquid cooling for AI, HPC and mission-critical data centers. Its NeuCool platform circulates a non-conductive dielectric refrigerant through cold plates mounted directly on CPUs and GPUs, removing heat by evaporation rather than by bringing water into the IT rack, and supports 4,500W+ per socket and rack densities up to 250kW. The product line includes the IR150 in-rack CDU, the MR250 medium-rack CDU, the NeuCool Thermal Simulation Rack and Liquid Simulation System used for evaluation and deployment planning, and multi-GPU cold plate assemblies, backed by professional services spanning system architecture, integration, deployment and maintenance. Accelsius is a hardware manufacturer, not a software or data company: it publishes no developer program, product API, SDK or machine-readable product specification. The only machine-readable interface on its public surface is the WordPress core REST API behind accelsius.com, which serves the company's own blog, news, white-paper, case-study, podcast and video content anonymously and read-only.

providers.name: APITemplate.io
providers.description: APITemplate.io is a templating service that auto-generates PDFs and images programmatically from HTML/CSS templates with Jinja2-style data binding. Drag-and-drop visual editor; sync and async generation with webhooks; regional endpoints in US, EU, Singapore and Australia. SDKs for Python, JavaScript, PHP, C# and Java.

providers.name: Asbestos Disposal Cost
providers.description: Asbestos Disposal Cost provides free quotes and information on the cost of disposing asbestos in the UK. The service explains how material type, quantity, licensing requirements, site access, tip gate fees and other drivers affect pricing. It offers guidance on regulatory compliance, paperwork, and how to obtain quotes from licensed contractors. The site includes FAQs, detailed cost driver tables, and datasets on regional disposal charges, helping homeowners and businesses understand and manage asbestos waste responsibly.

providers.name: Attuned Intelligence
providers.description: Attuned Intelligence is a healthcare voice AI company that automates hospital and community health center call centers with supervised, EHR-integrated Voice AI Agents. Its agents answer every patient call instantly and in the caller's language, resolve needs end-to-end (appointment booking, medication refills, triage routing), and provide real-time human oversight with transcripts and reporting so automation stays safe and auditable. Founded in 2024 by leaders from DeepMind, Google Health, AssemblyAI, and DocuSign, the company emerged from stealth in October 2025 with $13M in funding backed by Threshold Ventures, and serves customers including Cambridge Health Alliance and Lowell Community Health Center. The platform is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant. Attuned publishes no first-party developer/product API; its Wix-hosted marketing site exposes a generic hosted Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content and business details.

providers.name: backlinkmcp-com
providers.description: BacklinkMCP provides an MCP (Machine-Readable) and REST API that delivers domain authority scores, backlink graphs, and link analytics for AI agents and applications. The service offers real-time backlink data without requiring user sign‑up, enabling developers to integrate SEO intelligence directly into their tools. Features include domain rating, referring domain counts, top linkers, and bulk analysis, all accessible via simple HTTP endpoints. Updated regularly, the API aims to provide high‑trust link signals from authoritative sources while remaining affordable and easy to use.

providers.name: beva
providers.description: beva (贝瓦网), operated by ProKids Technology Corp / 芝兰玉树（北京）科技股份有限公司, is a Chinese IP-and-technology driven family education and entertainment company. Its flagship original IP is the little beaver "Beva" (贝瓦) and the "Beva Children's Songs" (贝瓦儿歌) brand, spanning children's music, animation, literature and interactive entertainment, distributed across web, mobile, OTT, IPTV and television channels. Through its ProKids Copyright Content Open Platform (open.beva.com) beva offers online-application and offline content-access APIs that let third-party mobile apps and smart hardware — story machines, smart speakers and kids' robots such as MiTu, Rokid and the Doraemon story machine — embed licensed children's audio and video content. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: BlinkHub Korea
providers.description: BlinkHub Korea provides AI-powered press release creation and distribution through its own newsroom network spanning Korean and US media. Users generate announcements once, which are automatically formatted and sent via XML/FTP to multiple outlets. Features include card‑news and short‑form video generation, SEO audit, post optimization, and free article feeds for publishers. Targeted at PR teams, marketers, agencies, institutions, and companies expanding internationally.

providers.name: BlogSEO
providers.description: BlogSEO is an AI‑powered SEO content generation platform that automates blog writing and publishing. It analyzes your site, writes daily articles matching your brand voice, and publishes them automatically, helping you grow organic traffic without manual effort. The service offers a free trial, pricing plans, and integrates with various tools, positioning itself as the #1 SEO AI solution.

providers.name: Bonfire Interactive
providers.description: Bonfire Interactive is a strategic sourcing and procurement software company serving the public sector, based in the Kitchener-Waterloo region of Ontario, Canada. Its GoBonfire platform digitizes RFP/RFQ sourcing, bid evaluation and scoring, supplier management, and contract workflows for government agencies, education, healthcare, utilities, and nonprofit organizations. Bonfire was acquired by GTY Technology Holdings in 2019, and has since been consolidated — alongside IonWave, EqualLevel, and DemandStar — into Euna Solutions as Euna Procurement, a full-cycle public-sector procurement suite spanning sourcing, contracting, marketplace purchasing, invoicing, and supplier management. The gobonfire.com domain now redirects to eunasolutions.com. Bonfire does not publish a public developer API program or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness and demand tracking.

providers.name: Brújula
providers.description: Brújula es una plataforma que centraliza la gestión de la vida cotidiana, ofreciendo herramientas para organizar tareas, calendario, gastos, proyectos, recetas y turnos, todo desde un solo lugar. Los usuarios pueden interactuar vía WhatsApp, facilitando la anotación y seguimiento de actividades. La solución está diseñada para simplificar la planificación personal y familiar, proporcionando una experiencia integrada y accesible.

providers.name: Carrot
providers.description: Carrot is a global fertility and family-building benefits platform that helps employers, health plans, benefits consultants, and labor unions offer inclusive reproductive care to their members. Carrot supports the full journey — preconception, IVF and IUI, egg, sperm, and embryo preservation, gestational surrogacy, adoption, pregnancy and postpartum care, men's health, and hormonal and menopause support — across 175+ countries and 17,000+ providers. Products include Carrot Intelligence (an AI clinical platform), Carrot Rx medication sourcing, the Carrot Card payment solution, and Carrot Sprints metabolic-fertility programs. Backed by CRV; added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio enrichment.

providers.name: Coinigy
providers.description: Interacting with Coinigy Accounts and Exchange Directly

providers.name: Datasift
providers.description: DataSift provides a real‑estate data platform that aggregates, enriches, and delivers property‑related information to developers, marketers, and analysts. Their APIs enable access to property listings, transaction histories, market trends, and predictive analytics, helping users build applications for property search, valuation, and market intelligence. DataSift focuses on delivering high‑quality, up‑to‑date real‑estate data across multiple regions, with robust documentation and developer support.

providers.name: Datefit
providers.description: Datefit is a health and wellness technology company that offers a platform for tracking and analyzing personal health metrics. It provides APIs for integrating fitness data, scheduling appointments, and accessing personalized health insights. The company aims to empower users to make data-driven decisions about their well-being through seamless data integration and analytics.

providers.name: DeployedByAI
providers.description: DeployedByAI curates a weekly snapshot of AI‑driven deployments, listing every notable release, service, or tool that went live in the past week. The site aggregates publicly announced launches, providing concise summaries and links, and aims to give developers and analysts a clear view of the rapidly evolving AI landscape. Updates are posted every Saturday at 7:00 AM ET, ensuring timely coverage of the most recent AI deployments across cloud, SaaS, and open‑source projects.

providers.name: Donut
providers.description: Donut is an employee experience platform that helps companies design, automate, and scale people programs directly inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. Best known for its intro and coffee-chat pairing bot, Donut runs onboarding journeys, team-connection and watercooler programs, peer recognition, and engagement surveys, and imports data from 50+ HRIS systems (BambooHR, Greenhouse, Workday) alongside Zoom, Google Meet, and calendar integrations. It is trusted by 20,000+ teams including Anthropic, Figma, Carta, and Ramp. Donut authenticates users via Slack OAuth and is SOC 2 compliant. It does not currently publish a public developer API; its GitHub organization ships a Slack app template and internal tooling.

providers.name: Duroflexworld
providers.description: Duroflex (duroflexworld.com) is one of India's most trusted sleep-solutions brands, selling mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, pillows and mattress protectors direct-to-consumer with up to a 10-year warranty, free shipping and EMI options. The online store runs on Shopify and exposes real agent-facing commerce surfaces discovered by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline: a hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (catalog search, cart, product details, and shop policy/FAQ tools that conform to the UCP catalog capability) and a Shopify Customer Account API secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, advertising an agent-oriented customer-account-mcp-api scope. Surfaced originally as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead, the profile is now enriched with its MCP, well-known OIDC discovery, authentication, scopes and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: Ellipsus
providers.description: Ellipsus is a collaborative writing platform built for creative and fiction writers, combining a modern text editor with granular, Git-style version control so authors can draft, branch, share, and merge work together across devices. Founded in 2022 and operated by a small distributed team across Berlin (Germany), Madrid (Spain), and Szczecin (Poland), the product threads collaboration through every stage of writing — organizing drafts, discussing feedback, tracking changes, and preserving public version history — with a writers-first, artist-ownership, anti-AI-generated-content stance. Ellipsus offers a free tier and a paid Plus license, and is backed by Speedinvest. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Epiq
providers.description: Epiq is a global legal operations and technology company providing REST APIs for case management, eDiscovery, settlement administration, bankruptcy services, and class action claims processing. Their API suite includes AACER for real-time bankruptcy case data retrieval and monitoring, EpiqFiling for securities claims management, and EpiqPay for settlement payment disbursement.

providers.name: Fictiv
providers.description: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain platform that connects engineering and hardware teams with a vetted global network of manufacturers to source custom mechanical parts. It provides instant online quoting, automated design-for-manufacturability (DFM) analysis, and end-to-end order visibility across CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, urethane casting, and compression molding — from rapid prototyping through full-scale production. Now part of MISUMI, Fictiv operates a quote-to-order web platform at app.fictiv.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: First Principles Software
providers.description: First Principles Software offers DolphinCSV, an embeddable CSV import widget designed for small SaaS products. The service enables developers to implement CSV import functionality within minutes, providing automatic column matching, data validation, and cleaning. With SDKs for React and JavaScript, comprehensive documentation, and support options, DolphinCSV aims to simplify data onboarding for SaaS applications, targeting developers and product teams seeking quick integration and reliable CSV handling.

providers.name: Gilion (formerly ArK)
providers.description: Gilion (formerly ArK) is an AI-powered financial platform, headquartered in Stockholm, that sits between founders and investors to streamline how growth capital is allocated. For companies it offers non-dilutive growth funding for SaaS and technology businesses, including a Growth Loan and Seasonal Credit, underwritten by AI models of a company's trajectory. For banks, funds, and investors it offers an agentic-AI investment platform covering sourcing, due diligence, monitoring, and portfolio reporting. Gilion was rebranded from ArK and is backed by Creandum. The company publishes a public Trust Center (SOC 2 Type 2, CSA STAR, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) but does not currently expose a public developer API; this profile tracks its security, compliance, and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Greater Good Health
providers.description: Greater Good Health is a Manhattan Beach, California value-based senior healthcare organization founded in 2021 that delivers preventive, whole-person primary care to older adults through a nurse-practitioner-led model. It operates its own senior primary care clinics and an integrated clinical services platform — risk adjustment and annual wellness visits, transitions of care, high-risk and chronic condition management, and behavioral health — delivered on behalf of health plans, medical groups, ACOs and other risk-bearing organizations. Alongside care delivery it runs a nurse practitioner community, the Greater Good Institute education portal, and clinical technology and analytics tooling for its employed NPs. It is a care delivery organization rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: HireLogic
providers.description: HireLogic, Inc. is a US (Great Falls, Virginia) HR-technology company building an AI interview intelligence platform for staffing, recruiting and in-house talent teams. Its AI joins video, phone and in-person interviews to produce automated interview notes, transcripts, structured candidate summaries, topic highlights and hiring-signal analytics, so recruiters stop hand-writing notes and hiring managers can compare candidates on evidence rather than recall. The product surface includes instant interview insights, an interview chatbot for querying past interviews, intake-call insights, smart resume analysis and ranking, automated AI interviews, recruiting-team analytics, and a mobile companion app for in-person interviews. It integrates with Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, and connects to applicant tracking systems through the Merge unified API as a consumer of that service. HireLogic raised a $4M seed round in 2022. It is delivered strictly as an end-user SaaS product: as of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: HNI
providers.description: HNI Corporation (NYSE: HNI) is a manufacturer founded in 1944 and headquartered in Muscatine, Iowa, built around two operating segments. Workplace Furnishings makes office seating, desks, storage, tables, panel systems and ancillary furnishings sold through independent dealers under the HON, Allsteel, Gunlocke, HBF and Kimball International brands. Residential Building Products is the hearth business, operated by Hearth & Home Technologies under the Heatilator, Heat & Glo, Majestic, Monessen, Quadra-Fire, Harman, SimpliFire and PelPro brands. HNI publishes no developer portal, REST API or OpenAPI for either segment. Its one public machine-readable surface is the agent-commerce stack on the Hearth & Home Technologies storefront at hearthnhome.com, which serves an llms.txt, a Universal Commerce Protocol merchant profile and an anonymous MCP endpoint exposing 13 catalog, cart and checkout tools.

providers.name: Homads
providers.description: Homads is an Austin-based mid-term rental marketplace connecting hosts and guests for furnished stays of 30 days or longer. The platform pairs rental listings with neighborhood-matching technology to help relocating professionals, travelers, and people in transition find a place to live. Homads is primarily a consumer and host web application; it does not publish a public developer API. Its rental inventory is exposed to property managers through channel-manager partners (for example Hostfully) via private connectivity, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Impossible Metals
providers.description: Impossible Metals is a deep-ocean robotics and critical-minerals company founded in 2020 by CEO Oliver Gunasekara, headquartered in San Jose, California with a robotics lab in Canada, and a member of Y Combinator's W22 cohort. It builds the Eureka autonomous underwater vehicle, a hovering AUV that uses computer vision and robotic arms to pick polymetallic nodules from the seabed one at a time — leaving visible fauna and the sediment layer in place — as an alternative to the dredge-and-riser designs used elsewhere in deep-sea mining. Eureka I and Eureka II have been sea-tested, Eureka III is slated for a 2026 test in the BGR contract area of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone, and the company has applied for a deep-sea mining lease in U.S. federal waters and for observer status with the International Seabed Authority. It is a certified B Corp and publishes environmental data, policy positions and testimony alongside its technical work. Impossible Metals is a robotics and mining company rather than a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no product API, SDKs or developer portal, and hosts no api. or developer. subdomain. The only machine-readable interfaces it serves are the WordPress REST content API behind impossiblemetals.com and the two OpenAPI documents its events plugin publishes on that same host, which are captured here for discovery purposes and are anonymously readable and read-only.

providers.name: Indifi
providers.description: Indifi Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian digital lending platform that provides collateral-free business loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). Founded in Gurugram, Indifi originates and underwrites term loans, working-capital lines of credit, unsecured lines of credit, invoice discounting, and merchant cash advances (against POS transaction history), funding them through a network of 15+ RBI-regulated NBFCs and banks as well as its own NBFC, Indifi Capital Pvt. Ltd. (RBI Cert. No. B-14.03389). Loans range up to INR 50 lakhs with tenures up to 36 months and rates from 1.5% per month, assessed largely on business cash-flow, GST, and platform transaction data rather than traditional collateral. Indifi works through industry partnerships with e-commerce marketplaces and sector aggregators and through co-lending/DSA lending partners; it does not currently publish a public developer API or portal. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Instatus
providers.description: Post to and update maintenance and incidents on your status page through an HTTP REST API

providers.name: JobNimbus
providers.description: JobNimbus is a CRM and project management platform built for contractors, particularly in roofing, restoration, and home services industries. The platform enables lead tracking, job scheduling, estimating, invoicing, document management, and workflow automation. JobNimbus exposes a REST-like Open API supporting GET, PUT, and POST requests with JSON payloads, authenticated via API keys generated from the user dashboard.

providers.name: kundaly-com
providers.description: Ask your birth chart anything. Vedic and Western astrology computed for your exact birth time and place — every answer names its school and shows the reasoning. No subscription. The service provides tools to handle unknown birth time, offers rectification, and explains different astrological schools.

providers.name: KXN Technologies
providers.description: SyncRivo (KXN Technologies) provides enterprise messaging reliability solutions, enabling seamless interoperability across platforms like Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Founded in 2024, the company offers a unified messaging hub, advanced routing, compliance features, and analytics for businesses worldwide.

providers.name: Lansweeper
providers.description: Lansweeper is an IT asset discovery and management platform that automatically scans and inventories hardware, software, users, and cloud resources across on-premises, cloud, and OT environments. It provides a unified technology asset intelligence platform used for IT asset management (ITAM), cybersecurity asset management (CAAM), software asset management, and compliance. The Lansweeper Data API is a GraphQL endpoint that exposes the technology asset intelligence stored in your Lansweeper sites using Bearer token authentication.

providers.name: Leapcure
providers.description: Leapcure is a clinical-trial patient recruitment company whose mission is "where patient advocacy meets research" — connecting patients with clinical studies and helping research sites and sponsors reach and enroll participants. Leapcure was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no product API of its own; the single machine-readable surface it operates is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2) behind its blog at blog.leapcure.com, which exposes read access to posts, pages, categories, tags, users, media, comments and search, plus authenticated write operations via WordPress application passwords. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from that live surface.

providers.name: Level Frames
providers.description: Level Frames is a New York City based online custom framing company founded in 2014 by Josh Hubball and Damian Sowers and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2015). The company lets customers design and order handcrafted, made-to-order picture frames from home, either by uploading a digital photo for printing and framing or by shipping in physical artwork, posters and prints. Its catalog covers custom frames, framed canvas prints, framed vinyl records, collage frames, gallery walls, personalized framed photos, and framed chalkboards, whiteboards and corkboards, alongside at-home and in-studio framing services. Level Frames operates a direct-to-consumer web storefront and publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Linqto
providers.description: Linqto is a San Jose, California private-markets investment platform that gives individual accredited investors access to equity in mid-to-late-stage private technology companies before an IPO or acquisition. Rather than operating as a marketplace intermediary, Linqto buys shares itself and delivers them to investors as units in a series-LLC private fund ("Liquidshares") that holds the underlying company's stock, with a stated single purchase-premium fee and no carry, profit, legal, or administrative fees. Investing runs through a web and mobile application at app.linqto.com covering accreditation and KYC/identity verification, a cash account funded by bank transfer or wire, order placement, and portfolio and document management. The company filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas in 2025 and has paused transactions while continuing operations. Linqto publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal; the only public machine-readable surfaces are the WordPress REST API and RSS feed behind its marketing site, and the investor application is served by a private, session-authenticated backend at api.app.linqto.com. This profile captures company identity, the discovered public surfaces, and the domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: MQTT
providers.description: MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) is an OASIS-standard, lightweight publish/subscribe messaging transport protocol designed for constrained devices and low-bandwidth, high-latency, or unreliable networks, making it the de-facto messaging protocol for IoT and machine-to-machine (M2M) communication. MQTT is a protocol specification rather than a hosted API: clients connect over TCP/TLS (typically port 1883 or 8883) or WebSocket (8080/8081) to an MQTT broker (such as Mosquitto, HiveMQ, EMQX, or AWS IoT Core) and exchange CONNECT, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE, and other control packets defined by the standard. The current standard is MQTT Version 5.0 (OASIS Standard, 7 March 2019); MQTT 3.1.1 remains widely deployed.

providers.name: MultiOn
providers.description: MultiOn is a technology company focused on providing advanced AI-driven automation solutions for enterprise workflows. It offers a platform that integrates private action AI agents into phone and device interfaces, enabling hands-free task execution, intelligent assistance, and customizable automation. The company emphasizes privacy, security, and high task success rates, targeting businesses seeking to streamline operations through AI-powered agents.

providers.name: NativeSoft
providers.description: NativeSoft develops high-performance native desktop applications for interacting with REST APIs across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms. Their flagship product, NativeRest, offers a lightweight, memory-efficient alternative to Electron-based clients, featuring offline mode, built-in proxy support, and extensive testing utilities. The company focuses on delivering fast, secure, and user-friendly tools for developers and API consumers, emphasizing native performance and cross‑platform consistency.

providers.name: Netflix Hystrix
providers.description: Netflix Hystrix is a latency and fault tolerance library designed to isolate points of access to remote systems, services, and third-party libraries, stop cascading failure, and enable resilience in complex distributed systems where failure is inevitable. Now in maintenance mode, with Resilience4j recommended as a replacement.

providers.name: Nilus
providers.description: Nilus is an AI-powered treasury management platform ("your agentic workforce for treasury") that gives finance teams real-time cash visibility across banks, entities and currencies. Its modular platform pairs pre-built AI agents with connectivity to 20,000+ banks and payment service providers (via SWIFT, host-to-host and API) and major ERPs (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Dynamics 365) to automate reconciliation, cash-flow forecasting, payment workflows, FX exposure tracking, debt-covenant monitoring and idle-cash investment.
