The service aims to enhance AI assistants by giving them real-time web access, supporting both Claude and ChatGPT platforms.

providers.name: Callab AI
providers.description: Callab AI, built by Clusterlabs, is a cloud-based voice AI platform that connects directly to legacy on-premises PBX/SBC telephony (Cisco UCM, Mitel, FreeSWITCH) via SIP trunk integration, routing calls to AI voice agents with no rip-and-replace migration. The platform automates up to 70% of inbound and outbound call volume across support, sales, and scheduling, with no-code agent building, live human supervision and takeover, semantic knowledge bases, post-call transcription and sentiment analysis, CRM data extraction, and batch outbound campaigns. Callab AI exposes a REST API at docs.callab.ai for programmatic control of agents and calls. A Y Combinator Spring 2026 company founded in 2024, it serves hospitality, logistics, retail, and property management across three continents.

providers.name: Cartena
providers.description: Cartena provides a platform for managing investment portfolios, tracking dividends, and visualizing performance. It offers tools for organizing investments, monitoring earnings, and generating evolution charts, helping users stay on top of their financial assets with comprehensive insights and easy-to-use interfaces.

providers.name: Cimento
providers.description: AI-powered human risk management platform offering multi-channel phishing simulations via email, SMS, and voice, coupled with adaptive training that automatically reduces risk. Cimento enables security teams to assess, train, and continuously monitor employee risk, delivering real-time risk scores and personalized security awareness content. The solution integrates with existing security tools, provides detailed reporting, and supports scalable deployment for enterprises seeking to strengthen their human firewall against social engineering attacks.

providers.name: Deckodex
providers.description: Deckodex offers a deckbuilder, card database, price tracking, and collection management tools for trading card games. It supports the Gundam Card Game and the Naruto Card Game, allowing users to search cards by effect text, build and share decks, and view tournament tier lists and daily price data. The service is free to use, with an optional paid Pro tier for unlimited decks and value history.

providers.name: Dedalus
providers.description: Dedalus Group is a European healthcare and diagnostics software provider headquartered in Florence, Italy, supplying clinical information systems, electronic patient records, laboratory and diagnostic imaging software to hospitals, laboratories and care networks across roughly 40 countries. Its product estate includes the ORBIS and ORBIS U electronic patient record suites, the Lorenzo EPR in the UK, X1.V1 in Italy, and DC4H (Digital Connect 4 Health) / Open Health Connect, an HL7 FHIR-based interoperability and longitudinal-patient-record platform the company markets under an "API economy" model. Dedalus states that DC4H exposes an FHIR API management component that third-party developers can build against, and the company participates in the openEHR community, but as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or FHIR CapabilityStatement, and no sandbox on any dedalus.com host — integration access runs through a sales and customer-support motion rather than a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Default Privacy
providers.description: Default Privacy is an independent, vetted directory of privacy tools that offers free tools to check your exposure, a privacy glossary, and practical guides. It curates over 860 privacy tools with no paid placements, providing users with unbiased recommendations. The site also features a privacy score, stacks, and field guides to help individuals protect their digital lives. Its mission is to empower users with transparent, open-source resources for digital privacy.

providers.name: doc2mcp-site
providers.description: Doc2MCP provides a service that transforms any API documentation URL into a hosted MCP (Machine-Readable Code Prompt) server that can be consumed by AI agents such as Cursor, Claude, and Windsurf. It offers a no‑install, no‑API‑key solution with a web UI, CLI, marketplace of pre‑built integrations, transparent pricing plans, and open‑source tooling on GitHub. The platform enables developers to quickly generate AI‑ready documentation endpoints, improving code generation accuracy and reducing hallucinations.

providers.name: Document Crunch
providers.description: Document Crunch is an AI risk intelligence platform for the construction industry. Its construction-specific AI, CrunchAI, reads contracts, subcontracts, specifications, and project documents to surface risky clauses, obligations, and flow-downs with cited sources, and its Project Assist capability automates document reviews, drafts submittals and RFIs, and answers document-grounded questions across the project lifecycle from pursuit through closeout. The platform is used by general contractors, subcontractors, and specialty trades to track risk, align teams on standards, and act on contractual exposure. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, the company is backed by Fifth Wall. This API Evangelist profile is an enriched company lead; Document Crunch does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: dot•requirements
providers.description: dot•requirements (legal name Popover AI Ltd) provides AI‑native, readable, testable requirements that live alongside your code. The platform lets developers write, version, and validate software requirements using natural‑language prompts, integrates with CI/CD pipelines, and offers a sandbox for testing requirement coverage. It aims to improve test coverage, traceability, and collaboration across teams, supporting both open‑source and enterprise workflows.

providers.name: Figure Markets
providers.description: Figure Markets is a blockchain-native digital-asset marketplace built on the Provenance Blockchain that lets individuals and institutions trade, borrow against, and earn yield on crypto and real-world assets from a single account. Its exchange runs on Connamara's EP3 matching engine with FIX and REST APIs, offering a central limit order book for crypto (BTC, ETH, and more), equities, bonds, alternative assets, and YLDS, the first SEC-registered yielding stablecoin. Products include Figure Exchange (pro trading), crypto-backed loans, Democratized Prime (HELOC-backed yield), and self-custodied wallets, bridging traditional order-book finance with on-chain clearing and settlement. The company is backed by DCM Ventures. The trading API is served from api.figuremarkets.com and is access-controlled; no public OpenAPI is currently published.

providers.name: Flux CD
providers.description: Flux is a set of continuous and progressive delivery solutions for Kubernetes that are open and extensible, enabling GitOps-based automation for keeping Kubernetes clusters in sync with sources of configuration like Git repositories.

providers.name: GoTenna
providers.description: goTenna is a mobile mesh networking company that builds off-grid, long-range communication hardware and software. Its consumer goTenna Mesh and professional goTenna Pro devices pair with smartphones over Bluetooth to relay text messages, GPS locations, and data across a decentralized VHF/UHF radio mesh with no cell towers, wifi, or satellite dependency. The Aspen Grove mesh protocol stack and the Radio SDK (RSDK) let third-party developers embed goTenna radio connectivity into Android, iOS, and Linux JVM applications for public safety, defense, and outdoor use. goTenna exposes no public REST/web API; developer integration is via the native RSDK, which requires an SDK app token obtained from goTenna.

providers.name: GS1 US
providers.description: GS1 US is the US member organization of GS1, the global standards body for business communication. It provides a range of services including barcode issuance, product identification, data standards, and supply chain solutions to help businesses of all sizes streamline operations, improve traceability, and meet regulatory requirements. Through its web portal, GS1 US offers tools, resources, and support for obtaining UPCs, GTINs, GLNs, and other identifiers, as well as educational content and industry collaborations.

providers.name: IATA
providers.description: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) is the global trade association representing and serving the airline industry. IATA sets standards for the aviation industry, promotes cooperation among airlines, and operates an Open API Hub providing access to airline-published APIs for flight status, destinations, baggage, ticket validation, cargo, digital identity, and related aviation data services.

providers.name: Imerso
providers.description: Imerso is a construction management and quality-control software company that connects the onsite as-built reality to BIM models. Using 3D laser scanning (including a free Imerso Capture mobile app for Leica BLK360 scanners) and in-house AI models, its Site Checker automatically compares the built status of a jobsite against BIM plan specifications, surfacing deviations, progress tracking, and as-built data grouped by traffic-light categories. The platform targets general contractors and BIM teams for automated site supervision, progress reporting, and issue detection, and promotes 100% open data with direct integrations into tools such as Autodesk Construction Cloud. Imerso is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record.

providers.name: kalicart-com
providers.description: KaliCart provides an open‑agentic commerce network for WooCommerce stores, exposing product catalogs through a read‑only, ARC/1.0 compliant API. Merchants install the free KaliCart Bridge plugin to make their catalog machine‑readable, while AI agents query the federated KaliCart Global discovery service to retrieve offers without handling checkout. The platform emphasizes privacy, provenance, and UCP alignment, offering free GPL‑v2 bridge software, a specification, and MCP endpoints for AI integration.

providers.name: KreditBee
providers.description: KreditBee is a Bengaluru, India digital lending platform founded in 2017 by Madhusudan Ekambaram, Vivek Veda and Karthikeyan Krishnaswamy, operated by Finnovation Tech Solutions Private Limited (CIN U74900KA2016PTC086953) and lending through its in-house RBI-registered NBFC KrazyBee Services Limited alongside partner banks and NBFCs. Its consumer products are instant personal loans from Rs 6,000 to Rs 10 lakh, business loans up to Rs 1 crore, two-wheeler loans up to Rs 5 lakh, loan against property, a flexi personal loan line, 24K digital gold, and free credit score reports, delivered through an Android and iOS app and a single-page web application that the company says serves over 7 crore registered Indian users. KreditBee publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no API reference, no SDKs and no machine-readable API description of any kind. Its only API host, api.kreditbee.in, is an AWS API Gateway behind Cloudflare that answers HTTP 403 ForbiddenException to every anonymous request and exists to serve the company's own mobile and web clients. Partner and lending-partner integrations are transacted through the /partner-with-us and /digital-lending-partners business pages rather than through any self-serve technical surface.

providers.name: Lessen
providers.description: Lessen is a Scottsdale, Arizona based property services and facilities management technology company that connects commercial and residential property owners and managers with a nationwide network of vetted service providers for repairs, maintenance, turns, make-readies and capital projects. The company operates a technology platform stack — One by Lessen for work-order, vendor-sourcing and invoicing workflow, Lessen 360 for multifamily maintenance, Lessen Pro for affiliate contractors, Aiden for AI-assisted work-order creation, and the Lessen Marketplace for procurement — supported by mobile apps for tenants, property managers and vendors. Lessen serves retail, financial services, healthcare, food service, industrial, hospitality and education properties alongside single-family and multifamily residential portfolios. Lessen acquired SMS Assist in 2023 and is backed by Fifth Wall and General Catalyst. Lessen publishes no public developer portal, API reference or OpenAPI definition; its named platform integrations are delivered as private partner connections rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: Local Line
providers.description: Local Line is a farm‑to‑fork commerce platform that enables producers, distributors, grocers, and restaurants to buy and sell local food directly. Trusted by leading farms and retailers, it offers built‑in reporting, traceability, and integrations with ERP, POS, and e‑commerce tools, helping create a transparent, efficient local food supply chain.

providers.name: Mable
providers.description: Mable is an Australian online platform (mable.com.au) that connects people seeking disability (NDIS) and aged care support, including Support at Home and self-funded or out-of-hospital care, with verified independent support workers in their local community, letting clients search, book and build their own support team. Support workers, NDIS support coordinators and aged care managers also use the platform, which handles payments, support notes and safeguards. No public developer API or documentation was found on its site.

providers.name: Machinify
providers.description: Machinify is an AI-powered healthcare payment integrity platform that streamlines and automates payment processes for health plans. Its products - Coordinate (claims coordination), Subrogate (subrogation management), Audit (payment audit), Pay (payment processing), and Pharmacy (pharmacy payment integrity) - run on a unified data layer that combines claims and medical records, healthcare foundation models trained on billions of data points, and task-specific AI agents with continuous-improvement feedback loops. Machinify reports 85+ customers including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, coverage of 270 million member lives, and more than $6B in annual cost avoidance and recoveries. The company is backed by Battery Ventures and GV. Machinify does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference.

providers.name: Meteor (usemeteor.ai)
providers.description: Meteor (usemeteor.ai) provides an AI-driven job application platform that automatically matches users with relevant job openings, tailors resumes, and submits applications through supported job portals. Leveraging large language models, it streamlines the job search process for immigrants and international students, offering a free tier and paid credits for advanced features.

providers.name: Metrobloks
providers.description: Metrobloks, LLC develops and operates multi-tenant colocation data centers in underserved metropolitan markets, positioning capacity at the metro edge so that AI inference, IoT, gaming, streaming, telecom and financial workloads run closer to the users and devices that generate them. Founded by Ernest Popescu (CEO), Scott Couzens (COO), Ryan Shea (SVP Real Estate) and Alejandro Maldonado (CMO), the company came out of stealth in June 2024 with an oversubscribed $5.2M seed round led by Current Equity Partners with participation from Serena Capital, and has since announced a Eurazeo commitment of up to EUR 100 million for European expansion, a financing round led by the Canopy Generations Fund, a Kansas City joint venture with Lincoln Property Company, and a partnership with Soluna. Sites are announced or under development in Miami FL, Phoenix AZ, Detroit MI, Kansas City MO, Indianapolis IN and McAllen TX in North America, plus Paris in Europe. The product is physical: modular standardized halls, scalable power, air and hybrid liquid cooling with near-zero water consumption, and carrier-neutral interconnection including a self-perform cross-connect option. Metrobloks sells infrastructure, not software. It publishes no API, no developer portal, no customer self-service platform and no machine-readable specification of any kind; its only published compliance claim is a SOC 2 and SOC 3 assertion on its ESG page.

providers.name: Mouseflow
providers.description: Mouseflow provides behavior analytics and session replay tools that help website owners understand user interactions, identify friction points, and improve conversion rates. Their platform offers heatmaps, funnel analysis, AI‑driven insights, and feedback surveys, enabling data‑driven UX optimization for businesses of all sizes.

providers.name: MPIRIQ
providers.description: MPIRIQ (MPiriQ Science Technologies GmbH) is a Munich-based healthcare software company that automates clinical documentation for medical practices and study centers. Its AI platform structures patient data directly inside existing EMR/PMS systems, runs quality and billing validation checks in the background, and connects real-world care data to clinical research through decentralized, GDPR-compliant pseudonymization. The platform helps practices participate in clinical trials via automated indication screening and patient recruitment, giving physicians time back while opening a research revenue stream. Founded in 2024 and backed by HV Capital and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Northspyre
providers.description: Northspyre is a real estate development management platform that gives owners, developers, and project teams an end-to-end system for managing deals, projects, and portfolios across the full development lifecycle — acquisition, early planning, pre-development, construction, and stabilization. It unifies siloed project data and automates routine work with tools for financial modeling and deal pipeline management, budget and cost control, vendor procurement and management, forecasting, portfolio analytics, and investor and lender reporting. Northspyre is delivered as a hosted SaaS application and is SOC 2 Type II certified. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity, compliance posture, and domain security.

providers.name: Nutritics
providers.description: Nutritics provides a real-time food and nutrition data API offering access to over one million foods (generic, branded, and recipes), up to 258 nutrient parameters, allergen data, and regional compliance options across the EU, US, Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa.

providers.name: OZON.ru
providers.description: OZON is one of Russia's largest e-commerce marketplaces, offering retail across electronics, apparel, groceries, and more, plus its own logistics and fulfillment network (FBO/FBS). For developers, OZON exposes the OZON Seller API, a POST-based RPC-over-HTTP JSON API at https://api-seller.ozon.ru that lets marketplace sellers manage products, prices, stock, warehouses, orders, returns, analytics, and finances programmatically. Authentication uses two headers, a numeric Client-Id and a secret Api-Key issued in the seller cabinet. OZON was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from live probes of its API host and public developer documentation.

providers.name: Papaya Pay
providers.description: Papaya Payments is a Los Angeles based fintech that operates a mobile-first digital billing and bill-pay platform. Businesses in healthcare, government and municipalities, utilities, insurance, field services, and debt collection use Papaya to let their customers pay bills by photographing a paper statement or scanning a QR code and paying over SMS, email, or the Papaya iOS and Android apps, with no account or login required. Papaya advertises a Quickpay embeddable payment widget for paper-statement and portal integrations, and states that more than 2.5 million Americans have used the service. The company markets PCI, HIPAA, and SOC2 compliance. As of this profile Papaya publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API specification; it is a consumer-facing payments product rather than a developer platform. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Practically
providers.description: Practically is the experiential-learning brand of 3rdFlix Visual Effects Private Limited, a Hyderabad, India edtech company founded in 2018 by Subbarao Siddabattula, Charu Noheria and Ilangovel Thulasimani. The original Practically app delivered 3D, AR and simulation-based STEM learning for classes 6-12 and raised roughly USD 14M. The company's live product is now Wriety, an interactive-whiteboard and classroom-collaboration platform for interactive flat panels (IFPs) that is marketed alongside a set of "Agentic APIs" - a catalogue of 100+ AI features (handwriting and math recognition, transcription, lesson and assessment generation, image analysis) offered to OEM panel makers. As of this pass no machine-readable API contract, developer portal or API reference is published anywhere on the estate; the only API collateral is a marketing PDF spec sheet, and access runs through a sales contact.

providers.name: PriceMetrics
providers.description: PriceMetrics is a price optimization and analytics platform that provides REST APIs for tracking competitive pricing data, performing elasticity analysis, and delivering revenue optimization recommendations. The platform enables businesses to integrate real-time pricing intelligence directly into their applications and workflows, supporting dynamic pricing strategies, margin analysis, and data-driven revenue management across retail, distribution, and manufacturing verticals.

providers.name: Quantive
providers.description: Quantive is a strategy-execution and OKR (Objectives and Key Results) software company, originally launched as Gtmhub and rebranded to Quantive in 2021. Its flagship product, Quantive Results, helps organizations set, align, track, and report on goals and outcomes with dashboards, insights, and integrations. In 2025 Quantive merged into WorkBoard and the Quantive name became a WorkBoard, Inc. trademark; the quantive.com domain now redirects to workboard.com, and the live developer surface is the WorkBoard REST API v1.0 (OAuth 2.0 plus an instant-token flow) hosted on myworkboard.com. Quantive was surfaced through the Index Ventures and Techstars portfolios and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Regrello
providers.description: Regrello is an AI operating system for manufacturing and supply chain operations, giving teams that are stuck in email and stifled by decades-old ERPs an agentic AI platform to accelerate innovation and productivity. Its product, Agentforce Operations, orchestrates enterprise manufacturing and supply chain workflows with generative AI. Regrello was acquired by Salesforce and is backed by a16z and Bloomberg Beta. This profile currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network for its identity, security posture, and published compliance program.

providers.name: Rentals.ca
providers.description: Rentals.ca is a Toronto-headquartered residential rental marketplace and the flagship brand of the Rentals.ca Network, which also operates Rentfaster.ca, Louer.ca, Rentboard.ca, RentCanada.com and TorontoRentals.com across more than 100 Canadian cities. The network is owned and operated by Rentsync (formerly Landlord Web Solutions Inc.), which also acquired the research firm Urbanation in January 2026 and co-publishes the monthly Rentals.ca / Urbanation National Rent Report; Rentals.ca listing data also feeds a Statistics Canada rental housing index. In the Canadian real estate value chain it sits on the rentals side of the market, outside CREA's REALTOR.ca and Data Distribution Facility, which syndicate member boards' for-sale listings. Its API posture is honest but closed: rentals.ca itself publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI, and no documented public endpoint, and the entire consumer site sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge that returns HTTP 403 to anonymous clients. The real developer surface belongs to the parent, at the Rentsync Partners portal (partners.rentsync.ca, branded "LIFT System API"), which publicly names a REST API, an Ad Syndication API and a Search API but places all documentation behind an account whose registration form requires a written application explaining what you intend to build. There is no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData $metadata document, no Universal Property Identifier, and no open dataset published by the company.

providers.name: ResponsiBid
providers.description: ResponsiBid provides a modern pricing and sales software platform designed for home service businesses. Their solution streamlines the sales process, offering tools for quoting, invoicing, and customer management, helping companies improve efficiency and close deals faster. The platform emphasizes ease of use, integration capabilities, and tailored features for service‑oriented enterprises.

providers.name: Roofstock
providers.description: Roofstock is a residential real estate investment platform and online marketplace for buying, selling, and managing single-family rental (SFR) homes. It gives individual and institutional investors research, analytics, certified property listings, and end-to-end services spanning acquisitions, property management (Mynd), portfolio accounting software (Stessa), tenant screening (RentPrep), asset management, and dispositions across dozens of U.S. markets. The company reports hundreds of thousands of users and over $10B in transacted volume. Roofstock operates a private web API (api.roofstock.com) and a GraphQL endpoint powering its marketplace applications; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, first-party SDKs, or documented API access. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Roofstock's public web surface.

providers.name: Savant
providers.description: Savant (heysavant.com) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an operational memory layer for AI-native enterprises. It integrates with existing company tools such as Slack, Salesforce, and Google Workspace to capture both documented and undocumented operational knowledge, including procedures, exceptions, judgment calls, and edge cases, then structures that knowledge and serves it to employees and AI agents at critical decision moments. Founded in 2026 in San Francisco by Anthony Kim (CEO) and Kevin Yu (CTO), Savant positions itself as the company brain that every AI-native enterprise runs on. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, product guides, a changelog, a status page, and support and legal pages, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API reference surface.

providers.name: Sendinblue
providers.description: A service that provides solutions relating to marketing and/or transactional email and/or SMS

providers.name: Shift Technology
providers.description: Shift Technology is an insurance-focused artificial intelligence company that builds purpose-built AI agents automating critical insurance workflows, including claims processing and automation, fraud and financial-crime detection, coverage assessment, subrogation, and payment integrity. Founded in Paris and now operating globally, Shift serves 120+ insurance customers across more than 30 countries and has analyzed billions of policies, claims, and supporting documents. Shift deploys as cloud SaaS and integrates with insurer core systems through its technology, data, and service partner programs. The company does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or self-service developer portal; integrations are delivered as enterprise engagements. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the artifacts here capture the company's public security, compliance, and domain posture rather than a public API.

providers.name: Sia
providers.description: Sia provides decentralized cloud storage built on a blockchain-based network, enabling developers to encrypt, encode, distribute, and retrieve data securely across independent storage providers. The platform offers 50 GB of free storage, SDKs for multiple languages, and a suite of tools for building resilient, privacy‑preserving applications. Sia’s open network ensures users retain control of encryption keys while leveraging global redundancy and cryptographic proofs for data integrity.

providers.name: Simbe Robotics
providers.description: Simbe Robotics (Simbe) is a San Francisco Bay Area physical-AI and retail-robotics company whose Store Intelligence platform combines the Tally shelf-scanning robot, fixed in-store sensors and RFID to give grocery, wholesale-club, home-improvement and specialty retailers real-time inventory, pricing and shelf-condition data. Tally is built on ROS and feeds Simbe's cloud platform, which exposes store data to retailers through a front-end application, a mobile app and virtual store tours, and through an API that pushes shelf, out-of-stock and price-accuracy data into a retailer's existing merchandising, inventory and task-management systems. Deployments include BJ's Wholesale Club, Schnuck Markets, Wakefern/ShopRite, SpartanNash, Ball's Foods, Kaufland, Decathlon and Theisen's. Simbe operates a public status page that monitors a Website, an App and an API component, and a Vanta-hosted trust center, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification — its FAQ states that "standard API documentation" is supplied to customers as part of an integration engagement.

providers.name: Softheon
providers.description: Softheon is a healthcare technology company that provides SaaS software for health plans, brokers, and government agencies to run shopping and enrollment, billing and payments, member renewals, reporting and analytics, and compliance across the ACA marketplace, ICHRA, dental, and Medicare Advantage markets. Its all-in-one platform automates health-insurance administration end to end and is increasingly layering in agentic AI to streamline operations at scale. Founded around 2000 and headquartered in Stony Brook, New York, Softheon operates a developer portal (developer.softheon.com) and a compliance trust center, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: SPREAD
providers.description: SPREAD is a Berlin-based, AI-native engineering intelligence platform for complex product development and manufacturing. It connects fragmented product lifecycle data across PLM, CAD, ERP, requirements, and simulation systems into a unified engineering ontology, so teams building automotive, defense, and industrial products can find issues earlier and ship faster. The platform surfaces a set of engineering intelligence solutions — Requirements Manager, Product Explorer, Error Inspector, and Action Tower — on top of SPREAD Studio, a low-code environment for building custom analyses, with 40+ connectors to systems such as Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, SAP, Polarion, JIRA, CATIA, and Creo. Customers include Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Ford, Bosch, Audi, and Daimler Truck. Backed by HV Capital; added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Streamfold
providers.description: Streamfold is the company behind Rotel, a high-performance, resource-efficient OpenTelemetry collector written in Rust. Rotel focuses on minimal overhead and fast cold-starts for resource-constrained environments such as AWS Lambda, serverless functions, and embedded systems, supporting OTLP/gRPC, OTLP/HTTP, and Kafka receivers with exporters for ClickHouse, Datadog, AWS X-Ray, Kafka, and OTLP. It ships Python (pyrotel) and Node.js (@streamfold/rotel) embeddings, an AWS Lambda extension layer, a CloudWatch Lambda forwarder, and a Rust processor SDK. Rotel is open source under Apache-2.0. In March 2026 Streamfold announced it is joining Cursor to bring observability to agentic, AI-driven software systems. Streamfold was a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: The New Stack
providers.description: The New Stack is a tech media platform covering cloud native, DevOps, AI, and open source technologies, providing news, analysis, podcasts, webinars, and ebooks for developers, software engineers, and operations professionals. Public data access is available via RSS feeds for articles and podcasts.

providers.name: TIAA-CREF
providers.description: TIAA (Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association of America, formerly TIAA-CREF) is a Fortune 100 leading provider of financial services for people in the academic, research, medical, cultural, and government fields. With $1.5 trillion in assets under management, TIAA serves over 4.7 million individual customers and more than 12,000 institutional clients. Founded in 1918, TIAA invented the variable annuity in 1952 via the College Retirement Equities Fund (CREF) and is known for its TIAA Traditional fixed annuity and lifetime income solutions. TIAA wholly owns Nuveen Investments, a major institutional asset management firm. TIAA serves primarily non-profit organizations, universities, hospitals, and government entities with retirement plans including 403(b), 457(b), and 401(k) plans.

providers.name: Tianjin University
providers.description: Tianjin University (天津大学, TJU) is a national public research university in Tianjin, China, founded in 1895 as Peiyang University and recognised as the oldest modern university in the country. It publishes no public API, no developer portal, no open data portal and no specification of any kind: www.tju.edu.cn returns 404 for robots.txt, llms.txt, .well-known/security.txt and .well-known/openid-configuration, and api., data., open., developer. and dev.tju.edu.cn do not resolve. What it does operate — and this is the finding that separates it from most of this cohort — is its own Shibboleth SAML 2.0 identity provider at idp.tju.edu.cn, on the university's own CERNET address with no vendor CNAME, registered as entity 671640 in CARSI, China's national research-and-education identity federation, and visible in eduGAIN since October 2019. Its metadata document is credential-free, machine-readable and genuinely the institution's own engineering rather than a vendor's contract running under the university's name. Beyond that the estate is a set of relationships and gated systems: a Crossref membership with its own DOI prefix but only eleven registered DOIs, a ROR registration, a library discovery front end that answers only an SPA shell, and an institutional repository, OPAC and campus portal that resolve into TJU's own address block but redirect every off-campus request to a soft-403 network notice. There is no DataCite membership and no reachable OAI-PMH endpoint.

providers.name: Time.now
providers.description: Time.now provides a simple, free World Time API delivering current date and time information for any timezone. The service returns JSON data with fields such as datetime, timezone, utc_offset, and day_of_week, enabling developers to integrate accurate time data into applications without managing their own time zone databases. The API is publicly accessible, supports CORS, and offers endpoints like /api/timezone/{area}/{location} for worldwide coverage.

providers.name: Trafikverket
providers.description: Trafikverket, the Swedish Transport Administration, is a government agency responsible for the long-term planning, construction, operation and maintenance of the nation’s road and railway infrastructure. It oversees traffic safety, vehicle registration, and provides extensive data services related to traffic flow, road conditions, public transport schedules, and infrastructure projects. The agency works to ensure efficient, safe, and sustainable transport across Sweden, offering APIs for developers to access real-time traffic information, road work updates, and transport statistics.

providers.name: Tranched
providers.description: Tranched is a London-based fintech building an embedded, on-chain securitisation platform that connects fintech lenders and loan originators directly to professional investors. Its "Deep Tokenisation" approach represents loans as on-chain tokens governed by Smart Loan Agreements and automated waterfall contracts, letting originators structure and launch institutional-grade asset-based financing transactions up to 90% faster and at lower cost than traditional securitisation, with automated compliance, reporting, and monitoring. Tranched connects to a lender's loan management system via API integration to retrieve the data required for assigning and monitoring loans. Founded in 2023 by Clement Larrue and Michael Elalouf, the company raised a $3.4M pre-seed round led by Speedinvest in November 2024.

providers.name: Triple-S Management
providers.description: Triple-S Management Corporation is the largest managed care company in Puerto Rico in terms of membership, providing health, life, and property and casualty insurance. A subsidiary of GuideWell (parent of Florida Blue), Triple-S operates as an independent licensee of the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association for Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Its subsidiaries include Triple-S Salud (managed care), Triple-S Advantage (Medicare Advantage), Triple-S Vida (life insurance), Triple-S Propiedad (property and casualty), Salus (medical clinics), and CarePoint (IPA).

providers.name: Triumph Group
providers.description: Triumph Group designs, develops, manufactures, repairs, and overhauls a broad portfolio of aerospace structures, systems, and components for commercial and military aviation customers. A Fortune 1000 company headquartered in Berwyn, Pennsylvania, Triumph serves the full aircraft lifecycle across actuation products, geared solutions, interiors, systems, electronics, and controls. The company operates a developer portal and supplier portal for partners and customers.

providers.name: Ultimagenomics
providers.description: Ultima Genomics develops high-throughput, low-cost DNA sequencing platforms built on a novel semiconductor-inspired architecture, aimed at driving the cost of a genome dramatically down to unlock population-scale genomics. Its systems support germline and somatic (oncology/MRD) sequencing, single-cell and spatial workflows, methylation/epigenomics, and proteomics, and integrate with an open ecosystem of third-party library-prep providers (10x Genomics, Olink). Rather than a public REST API, Ultima exposes its developer surface as open-source bioinformatics tooling and analysis pipelines: a large GitHub organization (Ultimagen) of UG-adapted variant callers and genomics utilities (GATK, Picard, STAR forks, ugbio-utils) and AWS HealthOmics WDL workflows for running cost-effective secondary analysis in the cloud.

providers.name: Veesion
providers.description: Veesion is a French computer-vision company that sells AI-powered shoplifting detection to retailers. Its gesture-recognition models run against a store's existing CCTV cameras — either on a compact on-site server or through a serverless integration — and analyse body movement and concealment behaviour rather than faces, so no biometric identification is performed. When a pattern associated with theft is recognised, the store team receives a short video alert in a mobile app for review. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Bordeaux, France (Veesion SAS, RCS Nanterre 838 664 274), the company operates across supermarkets, hypermarkets, pharmacies and independent retail stores in more than 25 countries, and raised a EUR 38M Series B to expand its AI-powered loss-prevention platform. Veesion is sold as an end-user product through a direct and partner sales motion; it publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: WABCO Holdings
providers.description: WABCO Holdings was a leading global supplier of technologies and services that improve the safety, efficiency, and connectivity of commercial vehicles. The company developed advanced braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems. WABCO was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen in 2020 and now operates as ZF's Commercial Vehicle Control Systems division, continuing to serve OEMs, fleets, and aftermarket customers worldwide with integrated telematics, fleet management, and vehicle safety technologies.

providers.name: What's Up Docker
providers.description: WUD – What's up Docker? is an open‑source tool that continuously monitors containers across Docker, Kubernetes and other orchestrators, detects new image versions, and can notify or automatically trigger updates. It offers a lightweight, configurable watcher, supports multiple registries, provides a REST API, and can be run as a Docker container. The project is maintained by the WUD community and hosted on GitHub.

providers.name: Wing Cloud
providers.description: Wing Cloud is the company behind Wing (Winglang), an open-source, cloud-oriented programming language created by Elad Ben-Israel, the creator of AWS CDK. Wing unifies infrastructure and application code into a single model: a "preflight" phase compiles to Terraform/CloudFormation while an "inflight" phase compiles to JavaScript for runtime. Developers build and test distributed cloud systems locally with the Wing Simulator and Wing Console, then deploy to any major cloud provider. The project is MIT-licensed, ships the `wing` CLI (npm: winglang) and the standalone Wing SDK (@winglang/sdk, Apache-2.0), and the company is backed by Battery Ventures. Wing is a language and developer-tooling company; it does not publish a public REST/HTTP API.

providers.name: Wugen
providers.description: Wugen, Inc. is a St. Louis, Missouri clinical-stage cell-therapy company founded in 2018 out of Washington University in St. Louis that develops off-the-shelf, allogeneic CAR-T and memory NK cell therapies for blood cancers, using CRISPR deletion of the T-cell receptor so cells from healthy donors can be given without graft-versus-host disease. In July 2026 the company renamed itself Allotera Therapeutics, Inc. and moved to alloteratx.com, closing a $35M financing that brought total capital raised to roughly $150M on top of its $115M Series C; its lead program, soficabtagene geleucel (sofi-cel, formerly WU-CART-007), is a CD7-targeted allogeneic CAR-T in a global pivotal study for relapsed or refractory T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia and T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma, holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation, and was selected for the FDA CMC Development and Readiness Pilot Program. Wugen/Allotera publishes no product or developer API, no OpenAPI, no llms.txt and no agent card. The only machine-readable surface either domain exposes is the WordPress REST API (wp/v2), anonymously readable on both the current alloteratx.com site and the retired wugen.com brand domain, which still serves the complete historical press-release and scientific-publication archive as JSON even though its human-facing site is now a single splash page.

providers.name: Xage
providers.description: Xage Security is a Palo Alto, California zero trust access and protection company whose Xage Fabric Platform enforces identity-based access control across operational technology (OT), IT, cloud and edge environments — covering privileged access management, secure remote access, VPN replacement, zero trust segmentation, critical asset protection and zero trust data exchange for critical infrastructure operators in energy, utilities, manufacturing, oil and gas, transportation, defense, government and space. Xage also markets a control layer that governs how AI agents reach resources over MCP, A2A and REST APIs. The Fabric Manager exposes a REST API that third-party platforms integrate against, but its reference documentation is published only inside the customer-authenticated Xage support portal.

providers.name: Zapata Quantum
providers.description: Zapata Quantum, Inc. (formerly Zapata Computing, and briefly Zapata AI) is a Boston-based, hardware-agnostic quantum software company spun out of a Harvard quantum computing lab in 2017. It sells enterprise engagements — use-case discovery, hardware-readiness assessment and quantum application development across chemistry, optimization, simulation and machine learning — around its Orquestra platform, and publishes the Orquestra Workflow SDK stack as Apache-2.0 open source. The company ceased operations in October 2024 after a debt acceleration, restructured through 2025, and relaunched under the Zapata Quantum name in 2026. It publishes no public API, developer portal, API reference or self-serve signup; its only machine-readable developer surface is the Orquestra Python package stack on PyPI and the `orq` CLI, both frozen at their October 2024 releases.

providers.name: 0xpi-com
providers.description: 0xpi is an independent software studio based in Seattle, Washington that builds AI‑powered tools for marketers, businesses, students, and buyers. Its product suite includes SDSentry for OSHA compliance, PantryPOS food‑pantry software, Ringback missed‑call text‑back, AdCreator AI for ads and SEO, AI Site Builder, Scholarize study tools, and Prime Reviews Pro. The company offers free trials and subscription pricing, with each product providing its own terms of service and privacy policy.

providers.name: Accurx
providers.description: Accurx is a United Kingdom clinical communication and workflow company, founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, whose software is used across NHS primary care, secondary care, and community and mental health services to message patients, run patient triage, batch-message cohorts, book and remind appointments, and (via its Scribe product) draft clinical notes with AI. Accurx integrates around the NHS as an assured IM1 live supplier, using NHS Digital's interoperability standards for primary care and connecting bi-directionally to the GP clinical-system duopoly (EMIS Health, TPP SystmOne) and Vision, plus NHS national services including the Personal Demographics Service (PDS), NHS Single Sign-On, NHS Login, and the NHS App. Accurx is a consumer and integrator of NHS FHIR and IM1 interfaces rather than a publisher of its own public developer API: as of this review it operates no public developer portal, no self-serve REST/FHIR API, and no downloadable OpenAPI or FHIR CapabilityStatement. Third-party and trust integrations are arranged through its partnerships and integration teams under partner agreement.

providers.name: AlphaBridge MCP
providers.description: AlphaBridge MCP provides a WordPress MCP server that integrates Claude and ChatGPT into WordPress sites. It offers AI-powered content creation, editing, and site management through a single switch, with free tools and paid Pro features for deeper capabilities like code and plugin updates. The platform supports multiple languages and includes pricing, documentation, and support resources. Users can deploy the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin repository, configure AI settings via an intuitive dashboard, and access a growing library of AI‑driven tools for content, media, taxonomy, and user management. AlphaBridge emphasizes privacy, offering a clear privacy policy and data handling statements, and provides email support for Pro and Agency customers.

providers.name: Answering Service Compare
providers.description: Answering Service Compare provides a comprehensive comparison of UK answering services, detailing pricing, coverage hours, agent locations, and features. The site aggregates data from multiple providers, offering tables of costs, FAQs on call pricing, service availability, and UK‑based agent staffing. It helps businesses choose the best answering service based on published rates, 24/7 coverage, and other criteria.

providers.name: Appify
providers.description: Appify is an enterprise application platform that lets organizations build, extend, and migrate line-of-business software without traditional development. The company markets a model-driven, AI-native platform — apps are described in natural language and the platform generates the data model, UI, permissions, workflows, and analytics — plus an "Unshackle" AI agent that extends systems of record such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle, or replicates an existing SaaS application on Appify-owned infrastructure. Appify states 40+ enterprise integrations, 12+ industries in production, and 20M+ transactions processed, and its published pricing includes "REST API access" and "unlimited apps, objects, endpoints" as standard capabilities. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification is published; the API surface sits behind the tenant login.

providers.name: Ariadnemaps
providers.description: Ariadnemaps provides a privacy‑first people counting platform that uses hybrid fusion of phone‑signal sensing and time‑of‑flight depth sensors to deliver sub‑meter accuracy without cameras or personal data. The solution offers real‑time occupancy monitoring, queue management, and visitor flow analytics for venues such as retail stores, airports, and smart cities, complying with GDPR and EU AI Act requirements.

providers.name: Bedrock Data
providers.description: Bedrock Data (Bedrock Labs, Inc.) is a data security posture management (DSPM) company that helps organizations discover, classify, and control sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments. Its platform is built on a unified Metadata Lake that combines data sensitivity, lineage, identity and access entitlements, and data-flow analysis, layered with AI-driven classification and a natural-language policy engine, and a zero-data-access architecture in which analysis runs where the data already resides. Bedrock advertises a Graph API (GraphQL) and MCP integration surface for downstream security tooling such as SIEM, Wiz, Sysdig, and Jira, though no public developer documentation or OpenAPI is currently available. The company is backed by Greylock.

providers.name: Boardroom AI
providers.description: Boardroom AI is a UAE‑based AI revenue‑operations platform that builds and runs AI sales agents, CRM automation, follow‑up recovery, executive dashboards and media‑factory tools for businesses across the GCC and international markets. It offers modular AI agents, multi‑channel messaging, integration with major CRMs and a revenue control OS to capture, qualify and convert inbound leads.

providers.name: Boundless
providers.description: Boundless provides Employer of Record (EOR) services that enable companies to hire international employees seamlessly. Through a global network of fully owned legal entities, Boundless handles payroll, taxes, benefits, and HR compliance across dozens of countries, allowing businesses to expand their workforce without establishing local subsidiaries. The platform emphasizes people‑first values, secure and compliant employment, and expert leadership to simplify global hiring and workforce management.

providers.name: Capango
providers.description: Capango provides a hiring suite for the service economy, offering employer portals, seeker mobile apps, a job board, and a Job Launchpad for first‑time workers. It connects employers and hourly workers in retail, restaurants, and hospitality, enabling posting, screening, interviewing, and hiring through a unified platform available in English, Spanish, and French.

providers.name: Carbonchainio
providers.description: CarbonChain provides a carbon accounting platform for supply chain emissions, offering tools for tracking, reporting, and reducing carbon footprints across industries. The service integrates with ERP and trading systems, supports CBAM compliance, and delivers detailed emissions data to help companies meet sustainability goals and financing requirements.

providers.name: Cardboard
providers.description: Cardboard is an agentic AI video editor that runs entirely in the browser. Users import raw footage and describe the edit in natural language — "make a 60-second recap", "cut this into ads" — and Cardboard cuts, captions, reframes (vertical/square/landscape), removes silences, generates and clones voiceovers, translates and dubs across languages, and composes a first draft on a real timeline the user can refine. It is built on multimodal LLMs plus WebGPU/WebCodecs to make a genuine non-linear editor possible in the browser, with real-time collaboration and frame-pinned comments. Cardboard was founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch and is a consumer/prosumer creative application; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Care GP
providers.description: Care GP is a Sydney-based healthcare technology company (Y Combinator Summer 2026) building a suite of AI agents that automate the administrative and operational work of Australian general practice clinics. Its products include Samantha (medical document allocation that files inbound emails, faxes, and scans), Veronica (24/7 inbound and outbound phone and booking management), and a Billing beta for billing and debt-collection automation. Care GP states it is ISO 27001 certified with onshore Australian data storage, multi-factor authentication, and encryption, and reports serving 400+ clinic operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a customer web application (agent.caregp.com.au) but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: CeresAI
providers.description: CeresAI (formerly Ceres Imaging) is an aerial and satellite agricultural intelligence platform that converts high-resolution spectral imagery and machine learning into field-level insights on crop health, water stress, yield, and financial risk. The company serves growers, agribusinesses, lenders, and crop-insurance providers across more than 40 crop types on four continents, drawing on billions of plant-level data points to support yield protection, sustainability scorecards, portfolio risk analysis, and insurance claims. CeresAI operates a customer application and a login-gated developer documentation portal at dev.ceres.ai; pricing is consultation-based rather than self-serve. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Chui
providers.description: Chui, now operating as Trueface (part of BigBear.ai after the Pangiam acquisition), is a facial recognition and computer vision company. Originally launched as "Chui," the world's first faceprint API for access and identity, the technology is delivered today as a licensed developer SDK with C++, Python, Android, and iOS bindings, plus a Dockerized on-premises REST API (Trueface On-Prem / PTOP) for 1:1 and 1:N face matching, spoof and liveness detection, object detection, and identity verification. Deployment options span on-device, self-hosted Docker, and AWS. The technology has been evaluated in NIST FRVT and DHS/CBP testing and is applied across fintech, education, security, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and government. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled by the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CoinMarketCap
providers.description: CoinMarketCap is the leading crypto market data and rankings platform. The CoinMarketCap Pro API exposes 40+ REST endpoints covering cryptocurrency listings, quotes, OHLCV, exchange data, DEX/on-chain data, derivatives, global metrics, Fear and Greed index, content, and tools. Most data refreshes every 1 minute. Authentication uses an X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY header.

providers.name: Colibri
providers.description: ColibrITD (Colibri) is a French quantum-computing deep-tech company founded in 2019 in Paris by Dr. Laurent Guiraud and Hacene Goudjil, with a mission to make quantum computing accessible to any enterprise. It develops quantum software for scientific and industrial applications, including QUICK (a quantum multiphysics simulation platform), QUICK-PDE (a Qiskit function for solving partial differential equations), the H-DES hybrid differential-equation solver, and MPQP (Multi-Platform Quantum Programming) - an open-source Python library for building quantum circuits and executing them across IBM Qiskit, Eviden myQLM, Google Cirq, AWS Braket, and Microsoft Azure Quantum backends. ColibrITD serves the semiconductors, finance, defense, aerospace, automotive, and energy industries. Its primary developer surface is the MPQP Python SDK (PyPI + GitHub) and its documentation, rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: Dash Bio
providers.description: Dash Bio is a technology-driven bioanalysis contract research organization (CRO) that provides automated, AI‑enhanced laboratory services to accelerate drug development. Leveraging robotics, integrated software, and transparent pricing, Dash Bio delivers high‑quality assay results in days rather than months, supporting preclinical to late‑stage clinical programs. The platform aims to modernize bioanalysis with speed, consistency, and guaranteed outcomes for biotech and pharmaceutical companies.

providers.name: Dataful
providers.description: Dataful provides a platform that makes working with public data easy, fast, and simple. It offers datasets, collections, sector data, and AI‑powered products, enabling users to explore, analyze, and integrate public information across districts, HFIs, and other domains. The service includes a showcase, pricing plans, and various insights tools, all built to streamline data access for developers and analysts.

providers.name: DiscoverCloud
providers.description: Discover the best SaaS solutions and B2B services on the DiscoverCloud. Our B2B marketplace features an ever-growing number of SaaS solutions and outsourced services. Operated by Chekkt Limited, DiscoverCloud aggregates crowd-sourced ratings and reviews across software categories including CRM, Project Management, Marketing Automation, Business Intelligence, eCommerce, Invoicing, Help Desk, and Security.

providers.name: EasyGerber
providers.description: easygerber-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Filestack
providers.description: Filestack File Uploader & File Upload API

providers.name: FireHOL IP lists
providers.description: FireHOL IP Lists (iplists.firehol.org) is a free, open-source threat-intelligence site from the FireHOL Project that collects, analyzes, compares and documents publicly available IP feeds focused on attacks and abuse: cybercrime, fraud, botnets, command and control, malware, open proxies and anonymizers. Each list's history, update frequency, retention, overlaps and geography are published, and the ipset/netset files themselves are generated by FireHOL's update-ipsets.sh and served from the firehol/blocklist-ipsets GitHub repository. Maintained by Costa Tsaousis for FireHOL.

providers.name: FireMon
providers.description: FireMon is a cybersecurity company providing firewall and security policy management across hybrid, on-premises, and cloud environments. Its platform normalizes and governs security policies spanning firewalls, cloud security groups, and microsegmentation tools, delivering compliance automation, policy optimization, change automation, and real-time risk insight. FireMon serves more than 1,700 customers across 70+ countries, concentrated in healthcare, financial services, retail, and manufacturing. Its Security Manager platform exposes a REST API, delivered per-install (self-hosted or cloud appliance) rather than as a single public hosted endpoint. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from FireMon's public web and documentation surface.

providers.name: Fission Labs
providers.description: FloTorch, operated by Fission Labs, provides an enterprise platform for building and scaling agentic AI solutions. The company offers research products, LLMOps and FMOps optimization, RAG pipelines, performance and cost analytics, security guardrails, and a no‑code workflow management system. Their services include a unified gateway, cache management, real‑time performance tracking, and extensive documentation and resources for enterprises to evaluate, deploy, and monitor AI models at scale.

providers.name: FloCareer
providers.description: FloCareer provides a platform that connects job seekers with employers, offering tools for resume building, career advice, and AI‑driven job matching. The service includes a public API that enables developers to integrate job listings, applicant tracking, and career resources into their applications, supporting both web and mobile experiences.

providers.name: Flock Freight
providers.description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company and licensed freight brokerage that pioneered shared truckload (STL) shipping through its FlockDirect service. Its AI-powered pooling technology algorithmically combines multiple partial shipments from different businesses into a single multi-stop full truckload, giving shippers truckload-level service, damage rates, and speed without paying for a full trailer, while cutting empty miles and carbon emissions. The platform provides automated spot rating via API, TMS integrations, and EDI connectivity (204/210/211/214/990/997) for shippers and carriers. Backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: Foraged
providers.description: Foraged is a community marketplace for wild and specialty foods, connecting independent foragers, farmers, fishers, and artisan food producers directly with home cooks and professional chefs across the United States. Founded in 2021 and built on a custom Medusa commerce stack, Foraged provides an end-to-end platform covering vendor storefronts, product listings, shipping logistics, and secure payment processing for hard-to-source ingredients like wild mushrooms, truffles, foraged berries, sea vegetables, and other specialty foods. Sellers manage their entire shop from a vendor dashboard while buyers discover seasonal wild foods through the marketplace website and mobile app. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foraged publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Greenlite
providers.description: GreenLite Technologies is a construction permitting and plan-review platform that uses AI-powered technology and expert services to streamline building-permit approval for builders, developers, and jurisdictions. Its products include Atlas (a real-time permit tracking and management dashboard), LiteTable (AI-assisted plan review and code-compliance analysis), Private Plan Review (PPR), and Code Compliance & Pre-Check. GreenLite claims to reduce permitting timelines from 90-120+ days to 21-45 days and serves national QSR, retail, healthcare, education, and financial-institution brands. Backed by Craft Ventures and Insight Partners. GreenLite currently exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its company identity and security posture.

providers.name: HR & People
providers.description: API and integration profile for the HR and people-operations landscape. This topic repo catalogs the API surface of HRIS systems, unified HR APIs, payroll providers, talent acquisition platforms, performance and engagement tools, and people-data services. The focus is a portable Employee record schema (JSON Schema), schema.org/Person aligned semantics (JSON-LD), and a shared vocabulary for the people-operations domain.

providers.name: Immersed
providers.description: Immersed is a spatial-computing company that turns AR/VR headsets into portable multi-monitor workspaces for remote work, coding, and collaboration. Its free desktop agent streams up to five virtual screens into headsets such as Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro, GalaxyXR, and Pico, adding solo focus environments plus multi-user telepresence with screen sharing and whiteboarding. Immersed is also building Visor, its own lightweight 4K-per-eye standalone headset. The company is Techstars-backed. Immersed publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, product, security, and llms.txt surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Immobiliare.it
providers.description: Immobiliare.it is an Italian online real estate portal where people search for homes to buy or rent, with web and native iOS/Android apps. Its technology department, Immobiliare Labs, builds the sites and apps for Immobiliare.it and its sister brand Indomio, from design and software to infrastructure, big data and machine learning, and publishes open-source projects on GitHub (github.com/immobiliare, contact opensource@immobiliare.it). No public developer API or API documentation was found; the main site www.immobiliare.it refuses automated requests (HTTP 403).

providers.name: Interpublic Group
providers.description: The Interpublic Group of Companies (IPG) is one of the world's largest advertising and marketing services holding companies, with networks including McCann Worldgroup, IPG Mediabrands, FCB, MullenLowe Group, and Acxiom. In 2024 Omnicom announced its acquisition of IPG; the combined brand operations now run under omc.com, and www.interpublic.com 301-redirects there. IPG publishes no unified public developer portal and no product REST API at the holding-company level - technology surfaces are delivered through agency-network products such as Acxiom data services and Mediabrands' identity and measurement platforms, all partner-gated. The one live, machine-readable HTTP contract on IPG's own host is the WordPress REST API still served from the apex interpublic.com origin, which carries the corporate newsroom (346 posts) and advertises 254 routes across 17 namespaces through its self-describing route-discovery document.

providers.name: KuCoin
providers.description: Cryptocurrency Trading Platform

providers.name: LexisNexis
providers.description: LexisNexis is a global provider of legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics. Through the LexisNexis Developer Portal and LexisNexis Risk Solutions, partners can integrate access to legal research, fraud detection, identity verification, and risk assessment capabilities into their applications. Most LexisNexis APIs are partner-access only and require contractual agreements before credentials and OpenAPI specifications are released.

providers.name: Lightbeam
providers.description: Lightbeam is an AI data security and guardrails platform that discovers and classifies sensitive data across cloud, SaaS and on-premises systems, ties that data to identity and access context through its Data Identity Graph, and enforces guardrails on how users, applications, copilots and AI agents reach it. Capabilities span AI security and shadow-AI detection, data security posture management (DSPM), data classification, risk scoring, automated remediation, access governance, privacy operations, data retention, breach and ransomware blast-radius reduction, and user entity behavior analytics. Founded by former Nutanix leaders and backed by Vertex Ventures US, 8VC, Village Global, Monta Vista Capital and Dropbox. Lightbeam sells to the enterprise and publishes no public API - its documentation portal is authentication-gated.

providers.name: Liqwall
providers.description: Liqwall provides crypto market data: liquidations, liquidation levels by exchange, order books of 14 exchanges, funding, open interest and Hyperliquid positions. Open endpoints need no key (/api/v1/free/fng, /api/v1/free/liqs, /api/v1/free/xmap), and its MCP server at https://liqwall.com/mcp is included in every plan, the free one too. Data download through the API with a key is on the Advanced plan ($499 a month).

providers.name: Lura Project
providers.description: The Lura Project is an open-source, ultra-high-performance API Gateway framework hosted under the Linux Foundation. Originally known as the KrakenD framework, it provides an extendable, stateless middleware layer for building API gateways that aggregate multiple backend microservice responses into single endpoints, supporting HTTP/HTTPS, response transformation, filtering, and plugin-based extensibility via Go.

providers.name: Mech-Mind Robotics
providers.description: Mech-Mind Robotics provides industrial 3D cameras (the Mech-Eye industrial 3D camera and laser profiler line) together with software suites — Mech-Vision machine-vision software, Mech-Viz robot-programming software, and the Mech-DLK deep-learning toolkit — that give industrial robots embodied AI and 3D vision. Typical applications include bin picking, depalletizing, machine tending, piece picking, and item picking; the company reports 3000+ deployed applications for 1000+ clients worldwide. The developer surface is the Mech-Eye SDK (a C++ core with Python and C# bindings), ROS and ROS2 interfaces, and the Mech-DLK SDK, all published under the MechMindRobotics GitHub organization; there is no public REST/HTTP API.

providers.name: MentorCloud
providers.description: MentorCloud is an AI-enabled, enterprise mentoring software platform that helps organizations optimize employee engagement, retention, and career development through structured mentoring programs. It serves HR and Learning & Development teams and enterprise leaders looking to scale human-led learning across engineering, management, higher education, hospitality, and non-profit contexts. The platform covers mentor/mentee matching, program management, sessions, circles, learning, and community, with use cases spanning new-hire onboarding, leadership development, career progression, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) initiatives. MentorCloud is delivered as a hosted B2B SaaS product with managed, custom two-way integrations to enterprise CRM, HR, and single sign-on systems rather than a self-serve public developer API. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Moviepass
providers.description: MoviePass is a consumer movie-theater subscription service that lets members see films in theaters nationwide for a low monthly fee. The relaunched service (led by co-founder Stacy Spikes after reacquiring the brand) uses a credit-based system: members choose a monthly plan, earn credits, and redeem them for showtimes at over 4,000 participating US theaters, including major chains and independent cinemas, with plans starting around $10/month and no long-term commitment. Members browse showtimes and book through the MoviePass iOS and Android apps. MoviePass was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it is a direct-to-consumer app business and does not publish a traditional public developer API. Its marketing site is Wix-powered and exposes a hosted Wix Site MCP server plus an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Neptune.ai
providers.description: Neptune.ai is an experiment tracker for ML and foundation-model training. As of 2025, Neptune.ai is being acquired by OpenAI and the public pricing page redirects to the OpenAI announcement. Customers continue to use the Neptune Python client and REST API during the transition.

providers.name: Nines
providers.description: Nines was a teleradiology and medical-imaging AI startup founded in 2017 and backed by Accel and 8VC (a $16.5M Series A in 2019), co-founded by CEO David Stavens. It built FDA-cleared AI algorithms — NinesAI Emergent Triage (for intracranial hemorrhage and mass effect) and NinesMeasure (a lung-nodule algorithm) — alongside a live teleradiology practice. On 2022-02-18, Sirona Medical acquired Nines' AI technology, clinical data pipeline, machine-learning engines, and key personnel, folding the FDA-cleared devices into RadOS, Sirona's cloud-native Radiology Operating System (reporter, viewer, PACS, worklist, and platform AI). The nines.com domain now redirects to sironamedical.com. There is no public developer API today; a RadOS "Amplify" SDK (TypeScript/Python, REST + streaming APIs, event subscriptions) is on Sirona's roadmap as an early-access program for design partners.

providers.name: NoScrubs
providers.description: NoScrubs (NoScrubs, Inc., dba NoScrubs Laundry Delivery) is an on-demand wash-and-fold laundry pickup and delivery service operating across US metros including the Bay Area, Los Angeles, Dallas-Fort Worth, Miami, Phoenix, Austin, and Houston. Customers schedule a pickup through the NoScrubs mobile app or website; trained laundry professionals ("Scrubbers") collect laundry from the doorstep within a two-hour window, professionally wash, dry, and fold it using hypoallergenic unscented detergents, and return it the same day in as little as four hours. NoScrubs also offers monthly subscription plans, gift cards, and a wash-and-fold service for businesses. It is a consumer service company with no public developer API; the site publishes an llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: NutriDataX
providers.description: NutriDataX provides AI‑powered nutrition data services, including recipe analysis, meal‑plan generation, ingredient breakdowns, and food‑intelligence tools for both home cooks and professional developers. Their platform offers eight distinct APIs covering nutrition analysis, ingredient search, diet recommendations, grocery list creation, food‑label parsing, recipe suggestions, meal‑planning optimization, and health‑impact scoring, all accessible via REST with robust authentication and rate‑limit controls.

providers.name: One Data
providers.description: One Data is a German enterprise software company (onedata.ai, formerly onedata.de) whose AI-native platform transforms legacy and fragmented enterprise data into trusted, governed, AI-ready data products. Its capabilities span metadata management, data quality assurance, data-product lifecycle management, SAP BW migration optimization, process-mining foundations, and sovereign data management for public-sector organizations. One Data is certified to ISO 27001:2022, ISO 9001:2015, and TISAX, and is a portfolio company of HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass One Data publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or GitHub organization — its customer portal and documentation are authentication-gated.

providers.name: OpenAPI
providers.description: OpenAPI (formerly Swagger Specification) is a standard, language-agnostic specification for describing RESTful APIs in a machine-readable format. It enables automated documentation generation, client code generation, and API testing, serving as a contract between API providers and consumers.

providers.name: OpenVPN
providers.description: OpenVPN is a secure networking company providing VPN and Zero Trust network access solutions for over 20,000 organizations worldwide, offering both the self-hosted Access Server and the cloud-delivered CloudConnexa managed service. The platform supports encrypted tunnels, identity-based access policies, content filtering, IDS/IPS, and domain-based traffic rules across major cloud providers. OpenVPN exposes an XML-RPC management API for Access Server and an OAuth 2.0 protected REST API for CloudConnexa.

providers.name: Parafin
providers.description: Parafin is an embedded finance infrastructure company (founded 2020) that lets software platforms, marketplaces, and payment service providers offer capital, spend, and pay-over-time products to the small businesses on their platform. Parafin abstracts the hardest parts of launching a business-financing product — capital sourcing, regulatory and compliance know-how, underwriting and risk modeling, servicing, and collections — behind white-labeled REST APIs and embeddable UI widgets (Parafin Elements) shipped for React, Vue, and Angular. Products include Capital (revenue-based cash advances and flex term loans), Line of Credit, Spend (card and cash account), and Pay Over Time. Platforms integrate via a no-code option (Parafin Lite), low-code embedded Elements, or a custom API build. Notable customers include DoorDash and Mindbody. Backed by GGV Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and Ribbit Capital.

providers.name: Paz Ai
providers.description: Paz.ai is an AI commerce platform that helps merchants win visibility and sales across AI shopping channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. It runs three autonomous agents — a Monitor agent that benchmarks catalog performance across AI channels, an Optimizer agent that enriches product titles, attributes, and structured data, and a Distributor agent that publishes AI-optimized feeds to agentic commerce endpoints — producing an AI-optimized copy of a product catalog without modifying the live store. It integrates with Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and Salesforce Commerce, plus CSV and a custom API on enterprise plans. Backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: penguindriver-com
providers.description: PenguinDriver (企鵝司機) is a Taiwanese AI‑agent portal that aggregates 21 free public websites into a single entry point, offering price comparison, movie showtimes, daily meals, fuel receipts, holiday calendars, sports scores, game releases, US‑Taiwan stock topics and health information. The service provides a searchable interface and APIs that let developers query these data sources programmatically.

providers.name: Picnicai
providers.description: PicnicHealth (PicnicAI; legally Mission Health Labs, Inc.) is a San Francisco health-data company and Y Combinator alum (S14, founded 2014) that turns patients' fragmented medical records into structured, research-ready real-world datasets. Its consumer product gives patients a unified timeline of care across every provider, while PicnicResearch supplies de-identified, ontology-mapped (RxNorm, SNOMED, LOINC, ICD) real-world data to biopharma via AI extraction plus human clinical curation. The primary developer surface is a first-party R package distributed through PicnicHealth's own Posit/RStudio Package Manager for importing and visualizing research cohorts.

providers.name: Pillar Biosciences
providers.description: Pillar Biosciences is a Natick, Massachusetts molecular diagnostics company, founded in 2014, that develops targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) solutions for precision oncology. Its proprietary SLIMamp (Stem-Loop Inhibition Mediated amplification) chemistry enables highly multiplexed, single-tube PCR library preparation from as little as 2.5 ng of DNA, and its oncoReveal panel portfolio covers solid tumour tissue, liquid biopsy, haematologic malignancy, BRCA/HRD/methylation and inherited disease testing, alongside an InheritReveal line and a VersaTile machine-learning panel-design platform. Sequencing data is processed by PiVAT (Pillar Variant Analysis Toolkit), a secondary-analysis pipeline available as a local install or a HIPAA-scoped cloud deployment, with optional OncoKB-powered tertiary reporting. Pillar ships both research-use-only kits and an IVD product line, and raised a $34.5M round led by Illumina in 2025.
