Pillar publishes no public API, SDK or developer program; PiVAT's integration surface is bioinformatics file formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF, PDF) behind a customer login.

providers.name: policylayer-com
providers.description: PolicyLayer turns your team’s decisions into a signed playbook every coding agent can use, and routes uncovered questions to the right person. PolicyLayer is the system of record for AI agent authority: it turns approved human decisions into reusable rules for every AI agent.

providers.name: Prism Data
providers.description: Prism Data is a cash flow underwriting infrastructure and analytics platform that helps lenders expand approvals and lower losses by turning raw bank transaction data into decisioning signals. Its products include CashScore (a cash-flow-based credit score), transaction Categories, Income verification, and Insights, delivered through an API and the Pulse dashboard for credit underwriting across the United States and Canada. Developer API documentation is published at docs.prismdata.com behind a developer login.

providers.name: Routescan
providers.description: Routescan is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Sage Care
providers.description: Sage Care (sagecare.ai) builds an AI-native, HIPAA-compliant software platform made exclusively for home care agencies. Its product bundles an AI receptionist, a purpose-built CRM, an AI notetaker and a clinical scribe that automate the intake, referral, scheduling and documentation work that home care operators handle every day. Sage Care integrates with existing home care management systems such as WellSky and AxisCare rather than replacing them, and ships native iOS and desktop applications for caregivers and office staff. The company is backed by General Catalyst and surfaced through its portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Sage Care publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation — it is an application vendor rather than an API provider, so this profile captures company identity and security/compliance posture only.

providers.name: Star Therapeutics
providers.description: Star Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 201 Haskins Way in South San Francisco, California, that transforms the lives of patients with serious diseases by discovering and developing best-in-class antibody therapies, with an initial focus on hematology and immunology. It operates a hub-and-spoke model, building a family of companies that each pursue a distinct area of novel biology, and it develops each programme under a pipeline-in-a-product strategy in which a single antibody is advanced across multiple related indications rather than one. The company emerged from stealth in February 2022 having raised $100 million since inception, added a $90 million round in September 2023, and closed an oversubscribed $125 million Series D in September 2025 to move its lead asset into a registrational programme. Its two named spokes are Vega Therapeutics, whose VGA039 is a first-in-class monoclonal antibody against Protein S developed as a subcutaneous therapy for von Willebrand disease and other bleeding disorders, and Electra Therapeutics, which targets SIRP proteins with ELA-026 in secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis. VGA039 has received FDA Orphan Drug, Fast Track, Rare Pediatric Disease and Breakthrough Therapy designations; Incyte completed its acquisition of Vega Therapeutics, a wholly owned subsidiary of Star Therapeutics, in July 2026. Star Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, or API documentation. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind star-therapeutics.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: SurePayroll
providers.description: SurePayroll, a Paychex brand, provides online payroll and HR services for small businesses, households, and independent contractors. It offers payroll processing, tax filing, benefits administration, 401(k) plans, and compliance tools, aiming to simplify payroll management with affordable pricing and dedicated support.

providers.name: Swift Medical
providers.description: Swift Medical develops AI-powered wound and skin care management software for healthcare organizations across acute, post-acute, home health, and hospice settings. Its flagship Skin & Wound app captures calibrated wound images on mobile devices, applies computer-vision tissue analytics and auto-tracing to measure and classify wounds, and coordinates care through longitudinal documentation backed by the company's database of more than 32 million wound images. The platform emphasizes secure, compliant handling of protected health information (SOC 2 Type 2, encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access, MFA) and single sign-on via Okta and Microsoft. Swift Medical does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is handled through direct engagement and enterprise SSO/EHR arrangements. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Tabit
providers.description: Tabit is a mobile-first, cloud-based restaurant point-of-sale and hospitality management platform from Tabit Technologies. Its product suite spans tableside mobile ordering and payments (PAD/Pay), online ordering (Order), kitchen display (Chef), self-service kiosks, delivery (Wheels), guest management, gift cards, and hotel F&B/PMS integration. Tabit does not publish a public, self-service developer API or API reference; integrations are delivered through a partner program and an integration-request process rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Talus Network
providers.description: Talus Network is a decentralized Layer 1 platform for building and running autonomous, verifiable AI agents fully on-chain. Its core product, Nexus, is an agentic workflow engine that lets developers compose agents as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of reusable Tools — LLM calls, HTTP requests, storage, exchanges — executed and settled on-chain. Talus is built on Sui Move smart contracts with a Cosmos SDK / CometBFT Protochain node, and ships a developer surface as Rust crates (nexus-sdk, nexus-cli, nexus-toolkit), a Homebrew/AUR CLI, GitBook developer docs, and on-chain Move module API references. Backed by Polychain, Talus positions itself as infrastructure for the autonomous digital economy. There is no traditional REST / OpenAPI HTTP API; the platform is consumed through the SDK, CLI, and Move contracts.

providers.name: Tomorrow Health
providers.description: Tomorrow Health is an AI-powered platform for home-based care that connects providers, payors, and durable medical equipment (DMEPOS) suppliers, using intelligent automation to simplify ordering, routing, and reviewing home healthcare services. Its Horizon Suite includes AI Ordering, AI Fax Intake, and THEA (Tomorrow Health Expert Assistant). Headquartered in New York and backed by a16z, Bond Capital, and Obvious Ventures. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is currently published; the customer application is a private authenticated web app.

providers.name: Vallor
providers.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Äkkilähdöt
providers.description: Äkkilähdöt.fi on Suomen suurin lomamatkojen hakukone ja turvallisin paikka löytää äkkilähdöt ja muut pakettimatkat. Teemme yhteistyötä kaikkien suurimpien matkanjärjestäjien ja matkatoimistojen kanssa, ja yhdistämme samaan hakutulokseen suuren määrän matkoja yhdellä kertaa. Matkustitpa sitten yksin, perheen kanssa tai isommassa, enintään yhdeksän hengen porukassa, löydät parhaat matkatarjoukset täältä.

providers.name: 4baseCare
providers.description: 4baseCare is a precision oncology company founded in 2018, headquartered in Bengaluru, India with operations in Singapore, that combines next-generation-sequencing comprehensive genomic profiling with AI-driven clinical decision support to personalize cancer treatment. Its portfolio spans the TARGT family of tissue, liquid-biopsy and dual-source (SoLiQ) panels, germline and HRD testing, the OncoTwin AI insights layer, a Global Cancer Diversity Atlas of 30,000+ genomic profiles, molecular tumor board support, and the Oncobuddy patient program. Clinical results and decision support are delivered to oncologists through the Galens web portal at galens.4basecare.com. The company is Illumina Accelerator backed and closed a Series B round in 2024. As of the 2026-09-05 probe it publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract; the only API-shaped host, api.4basecare.com, is the private CodeIgniter application backend behind the Galens single-page app.

providers.name: Admiral Group
providers.description: Admiral Group plc is a FTSE 100 personal-lines insurance group headquartered in Cardiff, Wales, and listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2004. Its home market is the United Kingdom, where it is one of the largest motor insurers, trading through the Admiral, Bell, Diamond, elephant.co.uk and Veygo brands and underwriting through EUI Limited and Admiral Insurance Company Limited. Beyond UK motor it writes household, travel and pet insurance (expanded by the 2024 acquisition of RSA's UK home and pet book, including the MORE THAN brand), runs the Admiral Money consumer lending arm, owns the Confused.com price comparison site, and operates internationally as ConTe.it in Italy, L'olivier in France and Admiral Seguros in Spain. Its Admiral Pioneer venture arm builds new businesses including Veygo, Admiral Business and the API-first embedded insurance venture Connect by Admiral, and in 2026 it agreed to acquire the commercial fleet insurtech Flock. Admiral's API posture is honestly recorded here as closed: it is a direct-to-consumer and price-comparison distributor, not a broker-channel or platform carrier. No developer, developers, docs or api subdomain resolves on admiralgroup.co.uk; the corporate site is bot-blocked to automated probes; admiral.com publishes 837 sitemap URLs with no developer, API, partner or integration page; and the only API hosts that resolve (api.admiral.com, api.veygo.com) are undocumented private mobile and web backends that return 502 and 403 respectively. No public self-serve API, no OpenAPI, no Postman collection, no GraphQL surface, no webhook or event catalog, and no ACORD, AL3 or NGDS reference was found. Distribution integration runs through price-comparison-website connections and partner agreements, not through a published developer program.

providers.name: Aerosend
providers.description: Aerosend provides an email deliverability platform for cold email outreach, offering domain burn alerts, deliverability checking tools, and integrations with cold‑email services. Founded in 2024 by Namit Jindal and Prabhu Rengaswamy, the company builds private infrastructure to improve reply rates and inbox placement for high‑volume campaigns. It offers a suite of tools including domain monitoring, data tools, pricing plans, and a developer API for programmatic access.

providers.name: AgentCrush
providers.description: AgentCrush provides a public, protocol‑neutral index of AI agents, offering rankings, ghost‑index snapshots, and market intelligence. It aggregates signals from GitHub, npm, PyPI, on‑chain x402 payments, and A2A/MCP activity to evaluate agent health, trust, and economic impact. The service is free for basic access and offers a paid Pro API for unlimited calls, with transparent pricing and open methodology.

providers.name: AgingResearch.News
providers.description: agingresearch-news is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: AI Advisors
providers.description: AI Advisors provides an AI marketing SaaS platform that helps mid‑market B2B teams track, optimize, and grow brand visibility across AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok. Founded by Kevin O'Connell, the platform offers modules like AI Analytics, Answer Engine Insights, and AI Ads, delivering actionable intelligence for marketers to lead in AI search. It integrates with tools like Google Ads, WordPress, and Slack, and offers a suite of AI‑driven marketing tools and a public llms.txt generator.

providers.name: Akana
providers.description: Perforce, operating under the Akana brand, provides a comprehensive API management platform that enables enterprises to design, secure, publish, and monitor APIs at scale. The solution supports full lifecycle management, developer portal capabilities, and robust security features, helping organizations accelerate digital transformation and integrate services across cloud and on-premises environments. Akana’s platform is used by large enterprises to streamline API governance, enforce policies, and provide analytics for performance optimization.

providers.name: Alerta
providers.description: Alerta provides an open-source alert management system that aggregates alerts from various monitoring tools, supports deduplication, silencing, and routing via plugins. It offers a RESTful API, web UI, CLI, and SDKs for integration with systems like Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, Zabbix, and many others. The platform enables teams to manage alert lifecycles, define custom views, and extend functionality through a rich plugin ecosystem.

providers.name: Allay Therapeutics
providers.description: Allay Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with operations in San Jose, California and Singapore, developing ultra-sustained, non-opioid analgesic products for post-surgical pain management. Its platform is a tunable drug-biopolymer architecture that pairs validated non-opioid analgesics with dissolvable biopolymers to release pain relief at a targeted surgical site over weeks rather than days, and can be tuned for constant release (chronic pain such as osteoarthritis) or pulsed release (cyclic pain such as gout). Lead candidate ATX-101 is a bupivacaine-based implant placed directly at the surgical site during total knee replacement (TKA), targeting the three-day to two-week analgesia gap that drives breakthrough pain and opioid use; it holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation and entered a pivotal Phase 2b registration trial with first patients dosed in 2025. Additional programs (ATX-201, ATX-301, ATX-401, ATX-501) span new formulations, injectables, additional clinical indications and on-demand anesthetic delivery. The company raised a $57.5M Series D plus a venture debt line in 2025 and has a development and commercialization agreement with Maruishi Pharmaceutical for Japan. It is a therapeutics developer, not a software company, and publishes no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Ateranetworksltd
providers.description: Atera is an IT automation software company providing remote access, billing, reporting, and automation services. Founded in 2011, it offers a data‑science‑based platform combining RMM, PSA, and remote access for MSPs, improving operational efficiency and offering disruptive pricing. The company is listed on EquityZen for pre‑IPO investment opportunities.

providers.name: Beefy Finance
providers.description: Beefy Finance is a decentralized, multichain yield optimizer platform that allows users to earn compound interest on their crypto holdings through automated vaults and strategies.

providers.name: Beep
providers.description: Beep (Just Beep It!) is a visual feedback and web collaboration platform that helps teams review live websites, report bugs, run user testing, and collect ideas directly on the page. Delivered primarily as a browser extension, it lets users annotate any web page, leave comments, attach files, and record their screen so feedback moves faster and projects ship sooner. The product targets agencies, product teams, and builders, offers a free tier plus a paid SuperBeeper plan and enterprise pricing, and is built on Wix. It exposes no bespoke developer REST API, but its Wix-powered site publishes an llms.txt and a public Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bippit
providers.description: Bippit is a UK-based financial wellbeing platform that gives every employee access to personal, qualified financial coaching alongside AI-powered guidance available 24/7, planning and budgeting tools, payroll savings, and educational content and webinars. Sold to employers as a workplace benefit, it also provides organisations with aggregate financial-wellbeing insights and analytics. Bippit is FCA-regulated (No. 845814), ICO-registered (No. ZA533579), ISO 27001:2022 certified, and GDPR / UK DPA 2018 compliant, with data stored in the EEA. Backed by Techstars. Bippit publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and compliance surface.

providers.name: Bloomberg Tax Research
providers.description: Bloomberg Tax Research provides tax professionals with comprehensive access to primary sources, expert practitioner analysis, portfolios, and tax news for conducting in-depth tax research. The platform covers federal income tax, state and local tax (SALT), international tax, estate planning, benefits, payroll, and transfer pricing research.

providers.name: Burger Singh
providers.description: Burger Singh is an Indian quick-service restaurant chain founded in 2014 by Kabir Jeet Singh with co-founders Nitin Rana and Rahul Seth, and operated by Tipping Mr Pink Private Limited out of Gurugram, Haryana. It sells Indian-flavoured "craft" burgers - regional recipes built on Indian spices and chutneys - alongside fries and sides, desserts and beverages, through a hybrid estate of company-owned and franchised outlets that spans high-street, food-court, express and dine-in formats across India and into the United Kingdom. The business grows primarily through franchising, and its public web surface is organised around that motion: a menu, a store locator, franchise investment brackets, property-partner and bulk-order intake, and a complaint and feedback channel. Burger Singh is a restaurant operator rather than a software vendor and publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no commercial or partner-facing API. The only machine-readable interface it exposes is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate site at burgersinghonline.com, captured here for discovery purposes.

providers.name: Caliber Fitness
providers.description: Caliber Fitness, Inc. is a consumer strength-training and fitness-coaching company behind the Caliber: Strength Training app (iOS and Android). Caliber combines data-driven resistance-training and nutrition programming, a library of 600+ exercises, workout tracking, and one-on-one video coaching from certified personal trainers across free, Caliber Plus, and Premium Coaching tiers. Founded by Justin Fauci and Chris Muir, the company is backed by Trinity Ventures. Caliber operates as a consumer mobile app and coaching service; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time. This profile tracks its public web, legal, and membership surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Comet
providers.description: Comet is Perplexity's AI-native browser built on Chromium (Blink), integrating Perplexity Search and an agentic assistant that can summarize pages, draft emails, and complete tasks. Launched July 9, 2025 on Windows and macOS, with Android (Nov 2025), iOS (Mar 2026), and visionOS support added later. Initially gated behind a paid Perplexity subscription, opened free to everyone in October 2025. This is a consumer browser product with no publicly documented REST API surface.

providers.name: crowvault-ai
providers.description: CrowVault provides access to 379 AI‑powered developer tools through a single REST API call. Users can generate production‑ready Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, database schemas, API endpoints, and cloud‑infra for AWS, GCP, and Azure. A free tier is available, with paid Developer, Team, and Enterprise plans offering higher call limits. The platform aims to accelerate project scaffolding, DDD, CQRS, and event‑driven system development.

providers.name: Dezerv
providers.description: Dezerv (Dezerv Investments Private Limited) is an Indian wealth-management platform building a house of investment solutions for affluent Indians. It offers discretionary Portfolio Management Services (PMS), curated mutual-fund portfolios, bonds, an Investment Portfolio Analyser (IPA), a Wealth Monitor for tracking held-away assets, and ESOP financing, alongside a research-led investment philosophy and a weekly money newsletter. Dezerv is a SEBI-registered Portfolio Manager (INP000007377) and Investment Manager to a Category-I AIF / Angel Fund; mutual-fund distribution is via its AMFI-registered subsidiary. The company is client-facing (client.dezerv.in portal) and does not publish a public developer API surface. This API Evangelist profile enriches the company identity, links, and security posture rather than an API.

providers.name: E-Sign
providers.description: E‑Sign provides secure, advanced electronic signature solutions for UK and EU organisations, offering legally‑binding, audit‑ready signatures that meet industry regulations such as eIDAS, GDPR, and sector‑specific standards. Their platform supports high‑value transactions across healthcare, finance, legal, government and education, with features like digital certificates, electronic seals, identity verification, and integrated payment processing. The service includes a robust API, extensive integrations (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Zapier), and a compliance‑focused Trust Centre, aiming to protect data residency in ISO‑27001‑certified UK data centres.

providers.name: ecovanmove-com
providers.description: ecovanmove-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Evidation Health
providers.description: Evidation Health is a San Mateo, California digital health company, founded in 2012, that measures health in everyday life and runs permissioned real-world data research at scale. Its consumer app and platform — Achievement — rewards members for connecting wearables, apps and health records, and its enterprise Research & Engagement Platform gives life-sciences, payer, government and non-profit customers eConsent and onboarding, ePRO and survey capture, passive and active device monitoring, program analytics, and participant education. Evidation combines data from sources including Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin, Dexcom and EHR/claims records (via a partnership with 1upHealth's FHIR-based Patient Connect, and with HealthVerity), and has enabled 175+ virtual real-world studies and 70+ peer-reviewed publications. Evidation publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its programmatic surfaces are the member app backend and enterprise data deliveries, neither of which is publicly documented.

providers.name: EZLynx
providers.description: EZLynx is an insurance agency platform combining real-time comparative rating, an agency management system (AMS), and CRM for independent property and casualty (P&C) insurance agencies. Part of Applied Systems since 2021, EZLynx offers enterprise API solutions that let agencies push and pull data, create and update applicants, contacts, prospects, and opportunities, create policy headers, retrieve policy and quote-result data, and drive high-volume automated quoting through the EZLynx Rating Engine and Quoting Automation Services (QAS). An event-driven layer emits webhooks in XML or JSON for platform changes. API access is partner and enterprise-gated (contact sales, OAuth 2.0), not a public self-serve developer program, so the API surface below is honestly modeled from EZLynx's public product and integration material rather than a published open reference.

providers.name: Headspace
providers.description: Headspace is a global mental health platform offering consumer mindfulness, meditation, and sleep content alongside Headspace Care (formerly Ginger) — on-demand coaching, therapy, and psychiatry — and Headspace EAP. The B2B business (Headspace for Organizations) serves 4,000+ employers, health plans, and consultants in 190+ countries with a stratified care model (AI companion Ebb, coaches, therapists, psychiatrists). Integration surfaces for enterprise customers — eligibility file feeds, SSO, SCIM, benefit-platform connectors — are delivered under enterprise contracts and are not exposed via a public developer portal. There is no public REST API, no published OpenAPI specification, and no self-serve partner onboarding.

providers.name: HomeTouch
providers.description: HomeTouch (myhometouch.com) is a UK-based live-in home care marketplace founded in 2015 by Dr Jamie Wilson, a former NHS dementia specialist. The CQC-regulated service connects families with vetted professional carers for live-in, overnight, and visiting care, with a specialism in dementia and complex-needs support, hospital discharge, end-of-life, respite, and companionship care. Backed by 500 Global and other impact investors, HomeTouch operates a carer marketplace alongside a fully managed care service. The company publishes no public developer program or API; this profile tracks its identity, published web properties, and domain security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Indigov
providers.description: Indigov is a constituent relationship management (CRM) platform purpose-built for government — U.S. Congressional offices, state legislatures, and municipal agencies — that unifies inbound constituent communications from email, web forms, SMS, social media, phone, and scanned mail into a single cross-organizational inbox. It layers casework tracking, constituent routing, smart tagging, and mass-email triage with rapid response, plus a customer data platform for sentiment and engagement analytics and an award-winning mobile app for field staff. Indigov serves government offices across 35 states and 2 territories and was acquired by Granicus, joining its Government Experience Cloud (GXC). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Ingresse
providers.description: Ingresse is a Brazilian ticketing-as-a-service (TaaS) platform that powers event ticket sales, access control, and the attendee experience for organizers and partners. Its public developer platform lets integrators build tools and services on top of Ingresse — creating events, selling and validating tickets, managing users, and handling payments — through a versioned REST API (v1 and v2) authenticated with an individually issued API key. Ingresse publishes first-party SDKs for JavaScript/Node, Android, iOS, and PHP, plus message-queue libraries, and hosts its reference documentation on a ReadMe developer portal. Ingresse is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Insta360
providers.description: Insta360 (Arashi Vision Co., Ltd) is a consumer and professional imaging company best known for its 360-degree and action cameras (the X, GO, ACE, Link, and Pro/Titan lines). For developers, Insta360 runs a first-party developer program through its Insta360Develop GitHub organization and a VitePress developer-documentation site. Cameras expose on-device HTTP control APIs: consumer models implement Google's Open Spherical Camera (OSC) API over the camera Wi-Fi AP, and the Pro/Titan line adds a JSON-over-HTTP command API (ProCameraApi) for capture, live streaming, and file access. Native SDKs wrap this surface for C++ (camera control and media stitching/editing), Android, and iOS so third-party apps can connect to, configure, capture from, and post-process footage from Insta360 hardware.

providers.name: Investly
providers.description: Investly is a European fintech invoice-financing marketplace that helps growing small and medium-sized businesses unlock working capital by financing their outstanding 30-180 day invoices. Businesses sell their approved invoices through a reverse-auction marketplace where investors bid to fund them, giving merchants the best available price from multiple funding providers and access to cash in 1-3 working days rather than waiting on customer payment terms. Founded by Siim Maivel and operating across Estonia and the United Kingdom, Investly is backed by Speedinvest, Startup Wise Guys, and Founders Capital. The platform serves established businesses across manufacturing, wholesale, construction, logistics, and business-services sectors and has funded invoices worth tens of millions of pounds to date. Investly runs a production HAL/HATEOAS backend API at api.investly.co, though it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: JD Technology
providers.description: JD Technology Group (京东科技集团) is the technology and cloud subsidiary of JD.com, delivering digital-transformation services to government, financial institutions, and enterprises. Its primary developer surface is JD Cloud (京东云), a full-stack public cloud offering compute, storage, databases, networking, AI, security, and industry solutions exposed through the JD Cloud OpenAPI. Developers integrate via signed (access-key / secret-key) OpenAPI calls to per-service endpoints, and JD Technology publishes first-party SDKs for Java, Go, Python, PHP, .NET, Node.js and iOS plus a cross-platform command line (jdc) on GitHub. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and enriched from JD Technology's public developer surfaces.

providers.name: KatalistAI
providers.description: Katalist is an AI-powered storyboarding and video platform that turns scripts and ideas into visual stories with consistent characters and scenes. Founded in 2023, it converts scripts (CSV, Word, PowerPoint) into storyboards in one click, keeps characters consistent across shots, lets creators customize framing, angles, poses and scenes, and includes a video studio that layers voiceover, music and sound effects. It targets filmmakers, directors, advertisers, content creators, animators and educators looking to move from concept to visualized story faster. Backed by 500 Global, Katalist is a consumer/creative generative-AI SaaS accessed through its web application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Leal Health (fka TrialJectory)
providers.description: Leal Health (formerly TrialJectory) is an AI-powered, patient-first decision-support platform that matches cancer patients to advanced treatments and clinical trials. Its patented natural language processing engine reads inclusion/exclusion eligibility criteria and connects to ClinicalTrials.gov so patients, caregivers, and oncologists can self-screen against every recruiting oncology trial in roughly two minutes. For pharma, biotech, and CRO customers, the Patient Match Optimizer SaaS dashboard delivers de-identified, aggregate real-time datasets on patient barriers, motivators, geography, and competitive landscape to shorten enrollment timelines and improve minority representation in trials. The company was founded as TrialJectory by Tzvia Bader (CEO), Avital Gaziel, Guy Gildor, and Noam Geva, later rebranded to Leal Health, and lists a Clifton, New Jersey mailing address. Leal Health operates no public developer program: a live platform API host exists at api.leal.health, but every path behind the root returns HTTP 401 and no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Manifest Law
providers.description: Manifest Law operates ManifestOS, a communication and case management platform for the legal industry, and is backed by Menlo Ventures. The platform exposes a standards-based OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authorization server at app.manifestlaw.com, with an `api` scope for programmatic access and dynamic OAuth client management (`oauth_clients:manage`). This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Manifest Law's public discovery documents; no OpenAPI specification was published at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Menlo Security
providers.description: Menlo Security is a cybersecurity company that secures the enterprise browser, positioning the browser as the point of control for protecting both human users and AI agents. Its cloud-native Secure Enterprise Browser and Menlo Cloud Security Platform apply remote browser isolation to prevent zero-day phishing, ransomware, and malware from ever reaching the endpoint. The platform spans AI agent security and governance, AI Adaptive DLP (data loss prevention), file security for downloads and uploads, zero-trust remote access to private applications, and threat prevention. Menlo Security is headquartered in Mountain View, California and is backed by investors including General Catalyst, Vista Equity Partners, JPMorgan, American Express Ventures, and HSBC. Menlo does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface; administration is handled through its cloud console and a customer support portal.

providers.name: Midi Health
providers.description: Midi Health is a virtual care platform for women in midlife, delivering insurance-covered telemedicine from clinicians who specialize in perimenopause, menopause, and related midlife health. Patients get personalized care plans spanning hormone therapy (HRT), GLP-1 and weight management, sexual wellness, mood, sleep, hair and skin, and cancer-survivorship care, plus prescriptions, compounded medications, and supplements, with coverage available across all 50 states. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Midi operates as a direct-to-consumer and employer/health-plan telehealth service. No public API, developer portal, or technical developer surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Nacuity Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Nacuity Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, with operations in Carlton South, Victoria, Australia. It develops targeted therapeutics against oxidative stress, the mechanism it holds responsible for a family of blinding eye diseases and chronic conditions. Its lead asset, NPI-001 (N-acetylcysteine amide) tablets, is in development for retinitis pigmentosa and holds U.S. FDA Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations; the SLO-RP Phase 1/2 trial reported significantly lower photoreceptor loss than placebo from six months through the 24-month study in retinitis pigmentosa associated with Usher syndrome. A second programme, NPI-002, is an intravitreal implant for the delay of cataract progression and has completed implantation in the final cohort of its Phase 1/2 trial. A third programme addresses cystinosis. The company licensed its founding technology from Johns Hopkins University, is backed by Foundation Fighting Blindness and its venture arm the RD Fund, and partners with Arctic Therapeutics on AT-001 for hereditary cystatin C amyloid angiopathy. Nacuity Pharmaceuticals runs no developer program and publishes no product API, no developer portal and no API documentation; the only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind www.nacuity.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: NewCore
providers.description: NewCore is an enterprise identity-security company building an identity platform that governs both human and AI-agent identities across the enterprise. Its three pillars are Identity Discovery (continuously discovering and mapping every identity across directories, PAM, shadow systems, and AI infrastructure), Identity Security (breach prevention through phishing-resistant authentication and device-bound sessions that cannot be stolen or replayed), and Human + AI Agent Governance (minimum-access provisioning, full lifecycle management, and support for ephemeral agentic workloads). NewCore is backed by Index Ventures. It sells to enterprises via demo request and publishes a trust center (SOC 2 Type II, CSA STAR Level 1, GDPR, CCPA) but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: OEN
providers.description: Oen (應援科技) is a Taiwan-based fintech company operating an integrated payments and CRM cloud platform. It provides multi-channel payment processing (credit cards, convenience-store payments, bank transfers, and subscriptions), electronic invoicing, and a supporter-relationship CRM covering event and ticketing management, member and volunteer management, merchandise/reward redemption, and email/SMS communications. The platform serves nonprofits, political organizations, educational institutions, entertainment events, and commercial merchants, with more than 600 organizations and individuals using Oen. The company runs an API Gateway and mobile-payment surface, a public responsible-disclosure and bug-bounty program, and displays PCI DSS Level 1, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701 trust badges.

providers.name: Pagero
providers.description: Pagero provides a cloud-based platform for electronic invoicing, tax and legal solutions, enabling businesses to automate e‑invoicing, accounts payable, and compliance across Europe and Latin America. Integrated with Thomson Reuters, Pagero connects to multiple standards such as Peppol, ViDA, and local tax regimes, offering a unified solution for B2B financial processes and supply‑chain automation.

providers.name: Parse Biosciences
providers.description: Parse Biosciences is a Seattle-based life-sciences company that makes Evercode, a split-pool combinatorial barcoding chemistry for single cell and single nuclei RNA sequencing that runs on standard lab equipment rather than a dedicated microfluidics instrument. Its product line spans Evercode WT Mini, WT, WT Mega and WT Penta whole transcriptome kits, Evercode TCR and BCR immune profiling, Evercode Fixation, Evercode WT FFPE, Gene Select and CRISPR Detect, alongside a GigaLab sequencing service for 10M+ cell projects. Data analysis is delivered through Trailmaker, a cloud application that takes Evercode FASTQ files through a pipeline and into interactive downstream analysis. Parse publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract; Trailmaker is an end-user web application whose backend is authenticated with AWS Cognito and undocumented outside the product.

providers.name: Razer
providers.description: Razer is a global lifestyle brand for gamers that designs gaming hardware (Blade laptops, mice, keyboards, headsets and other peripherals), software (Synapse, Cortex) and services. For developers Razer operates the WYVRN immersive gaming platform, exposing the Razer Chroma RGB SDK and REST API for controlling 16.8-million-color lighting across devices, the Razer Sensa HD Haptics and THX Spatial Audio SDKs, Razer ID for user sign-in, and the Razer Gold / Razer Silver virtual-currency payment and rewards APIs for in-app monetization across 34,000+ integrated games and apps.

providers.name: Royal LePage
providers.description: Royal LePage is Canada's largest residential real estate brokerage brand, founded in Toronto in 1913 as A.E. LePage and operated today under franchise and corporately-owned brokerages by Bridgemarq Real Estate Services (TSX: BRE), an affiliate of Brookfield. It spans roughly 20,000 licensed REALTORS across 600-plus offices nationwide, and sits in the value chain as a brokerage/franchisor rather than as a data platform. Its consumer search at royallepage.ca is a downstream CONSUMER of listing data, not a publisher of it - the site states its inventory is "226,755 active MLS listings via the CREA DDF network," meaning the machine-readable feed belongs to the Canadian Real Estate Association's Data Distribution Facility, not to Royal LePage. On API posture the honest finding is that there is none published for developers - no developer portal, no documented API, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata, no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification anywhere in evidence (RESO is a US NAR-adjacent regime and is simply absent from the Canadian brokerage layer), and no SDKs, webhooks, or Postman collections. Account registration on the site creates a Virtual Office Website (VOW) relationship with Royal LePage Real Estate Services, Brokerage that restricts data to personal, non-commercial use, and the legal notice expressly forbids "spiders, robots, crawlers, data mining tools, or the like." Any programmatic access to the underlying Canadian listing record runs through CREA membership and the DDF licence, not through Royal LePage.

providers.name: SafeGraph
providers.description: SafeGraph is a geospatial data company that builds and maintains high-quality Point of Interest (POI), building geometry, and geocoded address datasets used for location intelligence, site selection, competitive analysis, and machine-learning models. Its core products are Places (millions of POIs with base, rich, and premium attributes), Geometry (building-footprint polygons), Address (structured geocoded addresses across 25+ countries), and Spend (transaction data). Rather than a hosted REST API, SafeGraph delivers data as bulk parquet files via S3, Snowflake, AWS Data Exchange, CARTO, Databricks, and ArcGIS. Surfaced originally as a Sapphire Ventures portfolio company and enriched here from SafeGraph's public documentation, changelog, and packages.

providers.name: Scalera
providers.description: Scalera AG is a Swiss construction-technology company building an AI platform that automates the tender and quotation process for the construction industry across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Its product-matching engine extracts positions from tender documents (PDF, GAEB, Excel/CSV, XML, email) and matches them against supplier product catalogs, while its supplier-matching tools help contractors identify relevant manufacturers and send structured inquiries. Scalera integrates with ERP, CRM, and PIM systems and serves 200+ manufacturers, processors, and traders. Backed by Speedinvest, it positions itself as one of Europe's most funded construction-tech startups. This profile documents the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Squadle
providers.description: Squadle is a food safety and operational compliance platform for multi-unit restaurant and foodservice operations. It combines IoT remote temperature monitoring (its Remote Temperature System) with digital food-safety checklists, shift management, and patented ZeroTouch technology that automates temperature logging and triggers corrective actions. The platform reports 3.3B+ completed tasks and 100M+ temperatures measured. Squadle was acquired by Crunchtime and now operates as part of the Crunchtime Operations Execution platform; the squadle.com domain redirects to crunchtime.com/squadle. No public API or developer platform is currently published.

providers.name: Syncron
providers.description: Syncron provides aftermarket software solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) to optimize inventory, pricing, warranty, and service parts management. Their platform helps manufacturers improve dealer loyalty, maximize parts profitability, and streamline warranty claims across industries such as agriculture, construction, automotive, and transportation. Syncron’s cloud‑based suite supports retail inventory planning, price IQ analytics, and service contract performance, delivering data‑driven insights to boost revenue and operational efficiency.

providers.name: Tacto
providers.description: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH) is a Munich-based AI procurement intelligence platform for manufacturing companies. It unifies internal ERP and engineering data with external market intelligence to power AI agents that automate procurement work across four areas: Supplier Intelligence (centralized supplier management with documents, evaluations and performance data), Spend & Cost Intelligence (spend analysis and savings identification), Sourcing Intelligence (AI-optimized RFQ and price inquiries) and Compliance Intelligence (automated regulatory and supply-chain due-diligence detection). Tacto is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant with EU-only hosting and an audit log of every AI action. It does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures the company's corporate, security and compliance surface.

providers.name: Teabox
providers.description: Teabox is a premium loose-leaf tea brand and direct-to-consumer e-commerce company backed by Accel. It sources fresh Darjeeling, Assam, Nilgiri and other Indian teas direct from gardens and ships them globally through its online store. The storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes an agent-commerce surface built on the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP): a hosted shopping MCP endpoint, a machine-readable llms.txt / agents.md, and OpenID Connect authentication via the Shopify Customer Account API (including a customer-account MCP scope). Buyer checkout always requires explicit human approval. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched from Teabox's public agent-facing surfaces.

providers.name: Ursa Major Technologies
providers.description: Ursa Major Technologies Inc. is an American aerospace and defense propulsion manufacturer founded in 2015 by Joe Laurienti, a former SpaceX and Blue Origin propulsion engineer, and headquartered at 19750 Co Rd 7 in Berthoud, Colorado, with additive manufacturing operations in Youngstown, Ohio. The company designs, builds and hot-fire tests liquid rocket engines, solid rocket motors and in-space propulsion systems for space launch, hypersonics and U.S. and allied defense customers. Its product line includes the 5,000 lbf Hadley oxygen-rich staged-combustion liquid engine — the first Ursa Major engine to reach flight qualification for hypersonic missions — and Draper, a storable, throttleable, restartable engine for tactical hypersonic strike, missile defense and rapid in-space maneuver, alongside a solid rocket motor line validated through static fire and a chemical propulsion capability for tactical satellite bus systems. Ursa Major was the first American company to successfully fire an oxygen-rich staged combustion engine; it states it has delivered more than 100 engines and logged over 100,000 seconds of hotfire testing, with engines and motors more than 80 percent 3D printed by mass. The company is AS9100D, ISO 9001 and CMMC Level 2 certified. Ursa Major is a hardware manufacturer selling to government and prime-contractor customers: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, developer portal or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Vinyl Equity
providers.description: Vinyl Equity is a modern transfer agency providing equity, cap-table, and shareholder-management software for private and public companies. Its platform covers registrar services, proxy and AGM (annual general meeting) management, and shareholder security, replacing legacy transfer-agent workflows with a modern web application. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface is documented at this time; the profile currently captures the company's security and compliance posture.

providers.name: Whirlpool
providers.description: Whirlpool Corporation is the world's only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, with approximately $16 billion in annual net sales and 41,000 employees globally. Its brand portfolio includes Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. Whirlpool offers connected smart appliances integrating with Amazon Alexa, Amazon Dash Replenishment, Google Assistant, and Matter for smart home automation, and provides a cloud-connected appliance API used by the Whirlpool mobile app and third-party integrations.

providers.name: Yampa
providers.description: Yampa is a Paris-based B2B platform for deploying and operating fleets of autonomous AI agents that handle customer service end-to-end across voice, chat, email, ticketing, and messaging channels. Its Y.core orchestration platform provides a visual workflow builder, guardrails, a knowledge layer, multichannel orchestration, QA and auditing tools, and observability, with connectors to CRMs, helpdesks, and telephony systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, Twilio, Genesys, and others). Founded in 2024 by Marin Huet, Baptiste Saintot, and Patrice Mazoyer, Yampa raised a ~EUR 3M seed led by Partech and emphasizes sovereign EU-hosted infrastructure with GDPR and SOC 2 aligned security. Developer documentation at docs.yampa.ai is gated behind an access code; the public status page lists an API component alongside chat, email, calls, and console services.

providers.name: 10x Genomics
providers.description: 10x Genomics is a life sciences technology company building instruments, reagents, and software that resolve biology at single-cell and spatial resolution. Its Chromium platform delivers single-cell gene expression, immune profiling, and multiomic analysis; its Visium and Xenium platforms deliver spatial transcriptomics and in situ single-cell spatial biology. The company supports researchers with analysis software (Cell Ranger, Space Ranger, Xenium Onboard Analysis, Loupe Browser), a cloud analysis platform, and open datasets. 10x Genomics does not publish a general-purpose public REST developer API; its developer surface is command-line analysis pipelines, file-format tooling, and open-source repositories on GitHub.

providers.name: 91Squarefeet
providers.description: 91Squarefeet is a Gurugram, India based design-and-build company delivering turnkey retail and office fit-outs for brands expanding their physical footprint across India. Founded 2018-2019 and backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners and Stride Ventures, it runs a full-stack, non-subcontracted model — in-house project management, a digitized supply chain spanning fixture factories, material OEMs, engineering consultants and labour contractors, and an internal AI-assisted project platform with a field mobile app — and reports 1,100+ delivered projects for brands including TATA, DLF, Godrej, Asian Paints, Kotak and Bluestone. It publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no OpenAPI. The only machine-readable surfaces on its host are the WordPress REST API its public website exposes (serving the company's own portfolio, client, case-study, property, testimonial and press-release content anonymously), a Rank Math llms.txt, and a gated WordPress MCP adapter endpoint.

providers.name: American Greetings
providers.description: American Greetings is a privately held American manufacturer and marketer of social expression products — greeting cards, gift packaging, party goods, stationery, stickers and decals, and digital greetings — headquartered in Westlake, Ohio, and selling through mass retail, grocery, drug and specialty channels in North America and internationally. Its brand portfolio includes American Greetings, Papyrus, Carlton Cards, Jacquie Lawson and Blue Mountain. The company operates no public developer programme: there is no developer portal, no published API documentation, no SDK in any package registry, and no API pricing. The one machine-readable API it serves in public is the WordPress REST API on its corporate site, which exposes the company's own brand and product-line catalogue as custom post types alongside its press releases and media library, readable anonymously.

providers.name: Apero
providers.description: Apero Health is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed healthcare technology company that provides an integrated practice-management and revenue-cycle-management (RCM) platform for medical practices. Its cloud software unifies scheduling, clinical visit notes, insurance eligibility verification and claims billing, patient billing and payments, e-prescriptions, and financial reporting, and claims to reduce billing time by up to 80% while helping practices scale operations. Apero exposes a fully-featured REST API, webhooks, and CSV import that connect healthcare and finance workflows, and integrates with payers (Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and platforms including Stripe, QuickBooks Online, Google, and Snowflake.

providers.name: Apiiroltd
providers.description: Apiiroltd, operating as Apiiro, provides an AI‑driven application security platform that secures the entire software development lifecycle. Their solution offers continuous code analysis, runtime protection, and automated remediation for vulnerabilities in code, APIs, and AI agents. Targeting enterprise DevOps and security teams, Apiiro integrates with CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and developer tools to deliver real‑time risk insights and automated fixes, helping organizations prevent breaches before they happen.

providers.name: Argent
providers.description: Argent (rebranded to Ready, ready.co, in 2025) is a self-custodial smart-contract wallet company focused on Starknet and Ethereum. It builds account-abstraction wallets - the Ready / Argent X browser extension and mobile app, a seedless email and password Web Wallet, and a multisig - plus the open-source developer tooling dapps use to integrate them: the starknetkit connection SDK, session keys (@argent/x-sessions), multicall batching, get-starknet, and the Swift starknet.swift and web3.swift libraries. Argent ships no first-party REST API; integration is via these client SDKs and on-chain smart contracts, with developer documentation hosted at docs.ready.co. Surfaced as an index-ventures portfolio company and enriched here.

providers.name: Artyfile
providers.description: Premium music licensing platform: exclusive recordings by real orchestras and musicians, including the London Symphony Orchestra at Abbey Road Studios. Lifetime worldwide sync + master licenses from €29.90, plus fractional master-rights ownership via Limited Editions.

providers.name: Baton Market
providers.description: Baton Market (baton.com) is a modern online marketplace and technology-driven business brokerage for buying and selling small businesses. It combines self-serve business listings with M&A brokerage support, data-driven business valuations fueled by real financial data pulled from accounting systems, buyer discovery and matching, NDA and deal workflows, and closing support. The company positions itself as a lower-cost, faster alternative to traditional brokers, with the claim that most of its listings close at roughly half the cost of a conventional broker. Baton is backed by Bloomberg Beta. Baton Market has no publicly documented API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its public web, identity, and security surface.

providers.name: BeatBandit
providers.description: beatbandit-ai is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: BIPEYE
providers.description: BIPEYE is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: g2-catalog) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Bonsave
providers.description: Bonsave is a smart financial planning app that syncs your accounts, tracks net worth, and delivers a daily AI insight. It offers subscription plans with a 14‑day free trial, uses Plaid for secure bank connections, and emphasizes data privacy and encryption.

providers.name: Boxabl
providers.description: BOXABL Inc. is a Las Vegas, Nevada manufacturer of factory-built, foldable homes, founded in 2017 and trading on Nasdaq under the ticker BXBL. Its homes are assembled on a production line in a climate-controlled factory rather than on site, then folded to 8.5 by 20 feet for shipment by truck, rail, sea or air and unfolded on the pad in about two hours. The Casita is the current production model, sold as a studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom in unit-only or turnkey configurations, with a Baby Box travel trailer and a multi-unit Developer Series catalog alongside it. BOXABL publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract; its machine-readable surface is an agent-facing llms.txt, a permissive AI-crawler robots.txt, and an RFC 9116 security.txt pointing at a real responsible-disclosure and bug bounty policy.

providers.name: Bristol Myers Squibb
providers.description: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) is a global Fortune 500 biopharmaceutical company committed to discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines for patients with serious diseases. BMS focuses on oncology, immunology, cardiovascular, fibrosis, and cell therapy (CAR T). The company operates BMS Study Connect for clinical trial recruitment, a Medical Information portal for healthcare providers, and the BMS Business Development platform for research partnerships and data sharing. BMS actively pursues technology partnerships in protein degradation, advanced treatment modalities, and digital health.

providers.name: Cargofy
providers.description: Cargofy is a Ukrainian‑American logistics technology firm that develops AI agents, called digital workers, for shippers, freight brokers, carriers and third‑party logistics providers. These agents automate multi‑step logistics workflows, handling tasks such as dispatch, tendering, document processing and shipment tracking across integrated communication and transportation systems.

providers.name: Catch Co / Mystery Tackle Box
providers.description: Mystery Tackle Box, a division of Catch Co, offers a monthly fishing tackle subscription service delivering curated selections of lures, baits, and accessories to anglers across the United States. Founded to simplify the hobby, the company provides flexible plans ranging from beginner to elite tiers, each featuring species-specific assortments, exclusive gear, and educational content. The platform operates an e‑commerce storefront, supports gift subscriptions, and engages customers through a blog and community resources, aiming to enhance the fishing experience for enthusiasts of all skill levels.

providers.name: checkout51
providers.description: Checkout 51 is a consumer cash-back rewards service, delivered as a free mobile app and website, that lets shoppers earn money back on everyday grocery and gas purchases. Members browse weekly offers, buy participating brands at any store, then upload a photo of their receipt to claim cash back; balances are paid out by check once they reach a $20 threshold. The company earns revenue from partner brands that fund the offers. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Slow Ventures portfolio company; it operates a consumer app plus a partner/brands program, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: CIRCOR International
providers.description: CIRCOR International is a flow-control manufacturer headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, building mission-critical pumps, valves and flow-control products for the Industrial and Aerospace & Defense markets through brands including IMO, Allweiler, Warren, RTK, Schroedahl, Hale Hamilton, Aerodyne Controls, Leslie Controls, Circle Seal Controls and Zenith. The company was established in 1999, sells directly and through sales partners to roughly 14,000 customers in about 100 countries with approximately 3,100 employees, and was taken private by KKR on 18 October 2023, after which its shares ceased trading on the NYSE. CIRCOR publishes no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract of any kind: its only software product on the public web is CIRCORSmart, a closed iOS/Android/desktop maintenance-tracking app for IMO pump series whose admin console and backend are unauthenticated-inaccessible Azure applications with no published interface.

providers.name: Civica
providers.description: Civica provides an independent study aid for citizenship and naturalisation test preparation across eight countries, offering free lessons, level‑based quizzes, and practice questions. It also offers a premium tier with timed mock exams, audio, and AI tutoring. Owned by Saaram Labs, Civica emphasizes that it is not affiliated with any government or official test provider.

providers.name: Civitas Learning
providers.description: Civitas Learning is a higher education technology company whose Student Impact Platform unifies student data, predictive analytics, and coordinated workflows to help colleges and universities improve enrollment, persistence, and completion outcomes. The platform consolidates data from SIS, LMS, CRM, and event systems into a data lakehouse, layers institution-specific predictive models (CivIQ) on top, and surfaces real-time, actionable insights to advisors, faculty, and administrators through products such as Explore, Inspire, Impact, Illume, College Scheduler, Degree Map, and Academic Planning. Civitas Learning serves institutions of all sizes and pairs its software with strategic advisory services. It does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public operational, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Clean Notes
providers.description: Clean Notes is a project management SaaS for small teams, offering real‑time notes, tasks, and AI‑assisted features powered by Claude and ChatGPT. Users pay only for the projects they create, while invited collaborators use the platform for free. The service includes free, Pro, and Scale plans, with pricing in Brazilian Real.

providers.name: Clerky
providers.description: Clerky is an online legal service that helps startup founders handle their legal paperwork safely and efficiently. Designed by startup attorneys formerly at a Silicon Valley law firm, Clerky provides software and guided workflows for Delaware incorporation and post-incorporation setup, fundraising (SAFEs, convertible notes, board consents), hiring (offer letters, consulting agreements, equity compensation), commercial documents (NDAs), and ongoing corporate maintenance. Clerky is a Y Combinator portfolio company. It is a legal document assistant rather than a law firm, and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic integrations.

providers.name: Cline
providers.description: Cline (formerly Claude Dev) is an open-source autonomous coding agent. The Cline VS Code extension has 5M+ installs; JetBrains is in early access; the Cline CLI is also available. Edits files, runs commands, uses the browser, and federates to multiple LLM providers. An MCP Marketplace extends Cline with custom tools. There is also a hosted/managed offering (Cline.bot) with free and paid tiers plus enterprise sales.

providers.name: Coachup
providers.description: CoachUp is the nation's leading private sports coaching marketplace, founded in 2012 in Boston by Jordan Fliegel, Arian Radmand, and Gabe Durazo. It connects athletes of all levels — and the parents of young athletes — with vetted, background-checked private and small-group coaches across basketball, soccer, football, baseball, running and track and field, volleyball, swimming, softball, tennis, lacrosse, fitness, and dance. Coaches are discoverable by sport and location, sessions average $40–$60 per hour, and every session is backed by $1 million liability insurance. The platform has hosted more than 13,000 coaches serving over 100,000 athletes, with Boston, New York, Los Angeles, Dallas, and Chicago among its top training markets. CoachUp is backed by General Catalyst, Point Judith Capital, and Techstars. As of this profile CoachUp exposes only a consumer web and mobile experience with no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Dandy
providers.description: Dandy is a digital dental lab platform for dentists, dental practices, and dental service organizations (DSOs). It combines intraoral scanner hardware, cloud-based case management software, and in-house dental lab manufacturing into a single scan-to-lab workflow. Dentists capture digital impressions with a Dandy intraoral scanner, submit cases through Dandy software, collaborate in real time with lab technicians via chat, video, and chairside scan review, and receive finished restorations manufactured by Dandy. Product lines include crowns, bridges, implants, clear aligners, retainers, dentures, night guards, splints, and sleep apnea devices. Dandy positions itself as an AI-powered digital dental lab modernizing restorative and orthodontic dentistry. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes an agent-facing llms.txt and ai-index.json but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Disclo
providers.description: Disclo is a workplace-accommodations software platform that powers end-to-end management of ADA, FMLA, and state-leave requests, medical-certification verification, and the interactive accommodation process for employers. The HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant portal automates accommodation workflows and compliance documentation, adds AI-assisted medical-certification review (Disclo Verify) and candidate accommodations for recruiting (Disclo Hire), and integrates with 50+ HRIS and ATS systems. Disclo is a private B2B SaaS company backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst; it operates a secure customer portal (secure.disclo.com) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI. Access is enterprise, demo/sales-led rather than self-serve.

providers.name: Dubai Diligence
providers.description: Independent due diligence for Dubai real estate, built on verified Dubai Land Department transaction and rent data: developer track records, project analysis, and Diligence Reports. Provides free, commission‑free property price, rental yield, and market analysis tools for investors and professionals.

providers.name: Duckbill
providers.description: Duckbill (formerly The Duckbill Group) provides a unified AI and cloud data platform that helps enterprises manage and negotiate cloud and compute contracts. Their Skyway platform offers AI model labs, GPU capacity deals, and hyperscaler contract negotiations, enabling finance, procurement, and engineering teams to forecast costs, secure optimal terms, and maintain cost awareness without sacrificing product velocity. Duckbill combines strategic expertise with a data-driven approach to streamline cloud cost management and AI infrastructure procurement for large organizations.

providers.name: easybits-cloud
providers.description: easybits-cloud is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Ebix
providers.description: Ebix is a United States insurance software and exchange company headquartered in Johns Creek, Georgia, operating as market infrastructure between carriers, MGAs, brokers and agencies rather than as a carrier itself. Its portfolio spans property and casualty agency management (EbixASP), P&C policy administration and broker systems (EbixEvolution, PlacingHub, Sunrise Exchange, iClose), life insurance and annuity distribution connectivity (EbixExchange), health insurance and employee benefits administration, health content, risk and compliance (RiskEnvision, WCExchange), and — through the EbixCash arm — travel, payments and forex services. Its core P&C plumbing is ACORD-native rather than API-native: TEAM-UP moves policy, claims and direct-bill commission download to agency management systems as ACORD-standard AL3 files, its Translation Services practice converts carrier-proprietary formats into ACORD AL3 and ACORD XML using Java/XML/XSLT, EbixASP maintains a continuously updated ACORD forms library with bi-directional exchange against ACORD applications, and the EbixASP Real-Time Interface synchronizes carrier credentials and service transactions with IVANS. Ebix markets API-driven quote-to-bind workflows and, since October 2025, a plug-and-play connector platform built with 1SilverBullet that exposes quoting, eApp, enrollment, underwriting checks, payments and policy servicing as modular APIs with "a standardized connector fabric with pre-built mappings and a developer portal" — but no public self-serve developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification could be confirmed as of 2026-07-25. Every probed developer path on ebix.com (/developers, /api, /developer, /partners, /integrations) returns the site's single-page-app homepage shell rather than a developer surface; developer.ebix.com and docs.ebix.com do not resolve; api.ebix.com answers with a JSON 404 and no documented routes; and the live EbixCash API Hub at api.ebixcash.com serves an OpenAPI document that returns HTTP 401 "Missing Authorization header". The one agent-facing discovery document Ebix does publish is a real llms.txt at www.ebix.com/llms.txt, which indexes the solution, service and corporate pages but names no API, portal or specification; every /.well-known/ probe across www.ebix.com, api.ebix.com, api.ebixcash.com and ebixasp.com missed, no first-party SDK exists in any public package registry, and no trust center, security.txt or vulnerability-disclosure program was found. Ebix's integration surface is therefore customer- and partner-gated, sold and documented under contract, which is the norm for United States insurance infrastructure where no federal regulator and no open-insurance mandate exists. Ebix filed Chapter 11 in December 2023, sold its North American life and annuity assets to Zinnia, and exited bankruptcy on 30 August 2024 consolidated with Eraaya Lifespaces.

providers.name: GetGoing
providers.description: GetGoing is a cloud-based corporate travel and expense (T&E) management platform for small and midsize businesses, built and operated by BCD Travel. It combines self-service booking of flights, hotels, rental cars and rail with automated travel and expense policy enforcement, pre-trip approval flows, streamlined payments and invoicing, traveler safety and duty-of-care, and analytics dashboards in a single product that can be implemented in under two hours. GetGoing pairs the digital self-service experience with BCD Travel's global travel-management expertise and support, and is offered across the United States, United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Belgium. GetGoing does not publish a first-party public developer API; programmatic travel integration is provided by the separate, authorization-gated BCD Travel Developer Hub.

providers.name: Gyft
providers.description: Gyft is a digital gift card platform and marketplace (a Fiserv / First Data company) for buying, sending, storing, and redeeming digital gift cards from more than 250 retail brands. Consumers use the Gyft web app and mobile apps to consolidate and manage gift cards, while businesses use the Gyft API and Gyft SDK to add digital gift cards to their own apps, websites, employee rewards, and incentive programs, and to place bulk corporate orders through Gyft Business. Developer and API access is provisioned to enrolled partners via the Gyft developer portal. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of 500 Global and GV, and enriched here from Gyft's public developer surface.

providers.name: Hanover Park
providers.description: Hanover Park is an AI-native ERP and fund administration platform for private market investors, unifying fund accounting, portfolio intelligence, and the LP experience in a single system of record. It pairs a proprietary general ledger, waterfall engine, investor portal, and portfolio management layer with AI agents that read email, propose journal entries, and extract portfolio updates, all reviewed by expert fund accountants. The platform automates capital calls, cash reconciliation, general-ledger posting, KPI collection, and reporting for venture capital, private equity, and other private-market firms. Founded in 2024 and headquartered around a modern back-office thesis, Hanover Park raised a $27M Series A led by Emergence Capital (with Lux Capital and Susa Ventures) and has grown from $1B to $15B in assets under administration. The company is SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II certified with a zero-trust, client-isolated AI architecture. No public API or developer program is published at this time; the product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS application.

providers.name: ianacare
providers.description: ianacare ("iana" = I Am Not Alone) is a Boston-based caregiver support and navigation platform that sells to employers, health plans and providers as a benefit for the working family caregivers in their populations. Founded in 2018 by Jessica Kim and Steven Lee, it pairs a consumer mobile app — where a caregiver mobilizes an informal care team, coordinates practical tasks, unlocks employer benefits and finds local resources — with human Caregiver Navigators, and positions itself as a partner for fulfilling CMS GUIDE Model dementia-care requirements. The company raised a $12.1M Series A in January 2022 led by Greycroft with 8VC, SemperVirens, Able Partners and the Brown Angel Group. ianacare ships software only as an end-user product: the iOS and Android apps and the app.ianacare.com web client are backed by first-party hosts (iana.ianacare.com behind a JWT bearer token, api.ianacare.com behind a CloudFront 403) and by ianacare's own Auth0 custom domain auth.ianacare.com, which is the single machine-readable contract the company publishes. There is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, SDK, CLI, webhook catalog, MCP server or agent card on any ianacare host.

providers.name: Imubit
providers.description: Imubit is a Houston-based industrial AI company behind the Optimizing Brain, the process industry's first Closed Loop AI Optimization (AIO) solution powered by deep reinforcement learning. Its cloud-based platform learns a dynamic model from a plant's own historian and DCS data, then writes optimal setpoints back through existing control-system infrastructure to continuously optimize throughput, yield, energy use and emissions. Imubit reports 100+ closed-loop applications deployed across refining, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals and polymers, cement and building materials, and mining, minerals and metals, and is trusted by 7 of the 10 largest U.S. refiners. Imubit publishes no public developer API; its GitHub organization ships open-source Python libraries for pulling data from industrial historians (OSIsoft PI, Aspen IP21) and supporting infrastructure.

providers.name: Invoicely
providers.description: Invoicely provides free online invoicing, billing, and payment solutions for small businesses. Their platform lets users create and send invoices, track time and expenses, accept online payments, and manage subscriptions, all through a web-based interface.

providers.name: Kindred
providers.description: Kindred is a members-only home exchange platform where verified members swap their real homes with one another instead of paying for traditional accommodation. The service runs on a credit economy — members earn one night of travel credit for every night they host, and new members start with five nights of credit. Kindred verifies every member and home, provides professional cleaning before and after each stay, and includes up to $100K in damage protection. There are no membership fees; travelers pay only a cleaning and service fee per trip. The platform operates across 190+ cities in North America and Europe and is backed by a16z, Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Index Ventures, and NEA. Kindred is a consumer travel product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Liquid AI
providers.description: Liquid AI is an MIT spinoff developing Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs) - a new class of generative models based on liquid neural networks. Offers LFM2 (2.6B / 8B-A1B / 24B-A2B) and LFM2.5 (350M / 1.2B variants) with text, vision, audio, and thinking modes. The LEAP platform enables LFM customization and on-device deployment.

providers.name: Merbridge
providers.description: Merbridge is an open source, eBPF-based service mesh acceleration tool that replaces iptables rules with eBPF traffic interception and uses msg_redirect to shorten the datapath between sidecars and services. It is a CNCF Sandbox project and supports Istio, Linkerd2, and Kuma.

providers.name: milemarker-co
providers.description: Milemarker unifies custodian, CRM and planning data into one governed foundation your firm owns — powering AI, reporting and automation. It provides a wealth management data platform that integrates financial data sources, enabling firms to deliver insights, compliance, and client services through a unified API.

providers.name: modernmustardseed-com
providers.description: Modern Mustard Seed is an AI product studio in Kalispell, Montana that designs and builds websites, AI voice agents, AI agents, custom software and Claude connectors for businesses across the United States, and manages them end‑to‑end. It offers AI‑driven web experiences, voice receptionists, and software solutions for enterprises, emphasizing integration with large language models and marketing automation.

providers.name: MUBI
providers.description: MUBI is a London-headquartered global streaming service, film distributor and production company founded in 2007 by Efe Cakarel (originally as The Auteurs, rebranded MUBI in 2010). It operates a curated subscription video-on-demand service for arthouse, independent, documentary and world cinema across more than 190 countries, alongside MUBI GO (weekly cinema tickets), the Notebook film-criticism publication and print magazine, MUBI Editions, a merchandise shop, and theatrical distribution and sales arms including The Match Factory and Cineart. MUBI publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification; the api.mubi.com host serves its own first-party web, mobile and TV clients only.

providers.name: Opalite Health
providers.description: Opalite Health is building the language layer for healthcare.
