Its platform delivers real-time, AI-powered medical interpretation across 150+ languages, validated against certified human interpreters and engineered for HIPAA-aligned, clinical-grade use. Opalite connects providers and patients with limited English proficiency in seconds — through EHR workflows and rapid healthcare deployment — to close language gaps that drive health inequities and poor outcomes. The company publishes a marketing and validation-study presence but does not operate a public developer API program; api.opalitehealth.com is a private application backend. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched with the company's real identity, compliance posture (HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, AES-256 encryption), and domain-security probes.

providers.name: Openly
providers.description: Openly is an independent agent home insurance platform founded in 2017 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. The company provides REST APIs for generating homeowners insurance quotes, binding policies, managing endorsements, and processing renewals. Openly operates as a general agency and program administrator, enabling tech-savvy independent agencies to build custom interfaces and plug into the Openly platform on the backend. The platform leverages actuarial science, machine learning, and advanced technology to provide fully underwritten quotes in seconds, supporting primary residences, secondary and seasonal homes, and landlord (rented-to-others) policies with coverage up to $5M guaranteed replacement cost.

providers.name: Page
providers.description: Page is an AI-powered government relations (GR) platform that tracks legislation, regulatory activity, and policy developments across 70+ jurisdictions in real time. It provides bill tracking, regulatory affairs monitoring, live hearing and vote alerts, lobbying and parliamentary questions data, smart alerts, AI analysis of policy trends, and detailed politician and staff directories, alongside Wonk — an AI assistant for policy research and document generation. Page serves enterprises, multi-client firms, law firms, government agencies, associations, and nonprofits. It is headquartered in Washington, DC with an additional office in Waterloo, Ontario, and is backed by Canaan Partners. Page holds SOC 2 Type II certification. As of this profile Page exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Plannuh
providers.description: Plannuh provides cloud‑based budgeting, planning, and performance management software for enterprises. The platform helps finance teams align strategic goals with operational execution, offering tools for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analytics. Plannuh aims to simplify complex financial processes, improve collaboration across departments, and deliver real‑time insights to drive better business decisions.

providers.name: Qualifyze
providers.description: Qualifyze is a supplier risk management and audit platform for the life sciences and pharmaceutical industries. It helps quality, procurement, and compliance teams qualify suppliers faster, run and manage GxP audits globally, and monitor supplier risk continuously. Its Audit Management Platform streamlines audit execution, CAPA management, and real-time visibility with access to a shared library of 5,000+ audit reports, while its Quality Insights Platform layers AI-driven predictive risk monitoring on top of the supply chain. Qualifyze is a delivered SaaS product for enterprise life-sciences customers; it exposes no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time. The company publishes ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 compliance posture.

providers.name: Reinsurance Group of America
providers.description: Reinsurance Group of America (RGA) is a leading global provider of life and health reinsurance and financial solutions, serving clients in more than 70 countries. RGA is the only global reinsurance company focused exclusively on life and health solutions. The company provides reinsurance, automated underwriting platforms, digital health data scoring, and financial risk management solutions to insurance carriers worldwide.

providers.name: RippleHire
providers.description: RippleHire is an enterprise, AI-powered talent acquisition and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) that automates recruitment workflows end to end - demand creation, sourcing, employee referrals, candidate management, interviews, offers, and onboarding. Built on behavioral science, AI agents, and no-code configuration, it helps large organizations hire faster at scale across 50+ countries. Its RHConnect framework provides API-first and no-code integrations with HRMS, job boards, communication, and assessment tools. RippleHire is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Runsybil
providers.description: RunSybil is an AI-native autonomous offensive security platform. Sybil — a system of AI agents — continuously penetration tests live applications and infrastructure, finding, exploiting, and validating real vulnerabilities without a human in the loop. It tests live applications black-box by default (no source code required), integrates with GitHub and GitLab to trigger targeted change testing on every code push, and validates every finding through a multi-agent pipeline before it surfaces, aiming to eliminate triage and false positives. RunSybil positions as a replacement for point-in-time penetration testing, legacy DAST/SAST scanners, and bug bounty programs, and also offers white-box testing for deeper codebase exploration. Founded in 2023 by Ari Herbert-Voss (OpenAI's first security hire) and Vlad Ionescu (Offensive Security Tech Lead at Meta), the company raised $40M led by Khosla Ventures and is trusted by security teams at Notion, Cursor, Turbopuffer, Baseten, and Thinking Machines Lab. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Sanmina
providers.description: Sanmina Corporation is a global contract manufacturer and leading provider of end-to-end design, manufacturing, logistics, and repair solutions for OEMs across defense, industrial, medical, communications, and computing markets. Through its 42Q subsidiary, Sanmina offers a cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) with APIs for integrating with ERP, PLM, WMS, and other enterprise systems. Sanmina's 42Q MES provides real-time factory visibility, traceability, quality management, and production control across globally distributed manufacturing facilities.

providers.name: Satago
providers.description: Satago is a UK financial-technology platform offering a three-in-one cash flow management solution for small and medium-sized businesses: Risk Insights (real-time credit checks, risk bands, and suggested credit limits), Credit Control (automated invoice chasing with customizable email and SMS reminder sequences, statements, and late-fee handling), and Invoice Finance (fast, flexible funding with advance rates up to 90% on single or multiple invoices, offered as both selective and full facilities). The platform synchronizes with 300+ accounting packages including Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, KashFlow, and FreeAgent to keep debtor data current. Satago sells to businesses directly and through partners; it does not currently publish a public developer API, consuming the accounting platforms' APIs rather than exposing its own.

providers.name: Satellogic
providers.description: Satellogic is an Argentine-founded, U.S.-listed (NASDAQ: SATL) vertically integrated Earth observation company that designs, builds, and operates its own NewSat constellation to deliver sub-meter, high-frequency multispectral and hyperspectral satellite imagery. Its commercial platform Aleph unifies archive search, tasking, analysis, and delivery into a single web and API experience, available in both the legacy Aleph V1 (Tasking, Archive, Analysis, Delivery APIs) and the unified Aleph V2 Orders API. Satellogic also markets Aleph Observer for persistent daily monitoring of designated sites, Constellation-as-a-Service for priority and large-scale tasking, and Space Systems for customers who wish to purchase and operate their own Mark V class satellites. Imagery is delivered via API, FTP, and a reseller network, with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials authentication against auth.platform.satellogic.com and product APIs under api.satellogic.com.

providers.name: Sazabi
providers.description: Sazabi is an AI-native observability platform that helps engineering teams find and fix production issues faster. Autonomous agents watch application logs (stdout/stderr) to detect anomalies, unfamiliar errors, traffic spikes, and failed deployments without traditional dashboards, then deliver contextual, root-cause alerts into Slack and Microsoft Teams. Engineers investigate in natural language by mentioning the Sazabi agent, and the platform can hand off context to coding agents such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex or open pull requests to remediate. Sazabi instruments 35+ hosting providers with no code changes and exposes a hosted Sazabi MCP server so agents can query logs, inspect issues and projects, and discover Sazabi tools. Founded by Sherwood Callaway; part of the Y Combinator P26 (Spring 2026) batch; backed by an $8M seed round led by J2 Ventures, Village Global, and Y Combinator, with an open beta.

providers.name: SFI Solution
providers.description: SFI Solution provides modern accounting software with built-in reconciliation, serving accountants and businesses with end‑to‑end bookkeeping, invoicing, tax, and financial reporting. Their platform integrates bank data, supports VAT/GST, and offers AI‑driven transaction matching, targeting enterprise clients and offering a free trial.

providers.name: Sophtron
providers.description: Sophtron provides a data aggregation platform that connects to financial institutions, enabling developers to retrieve account, transaction, and other financial data via APIs. The service supports connections to thousands of banks and credit cards across the United States and Canada, offering structured data for fintech applications, payroll, insurance, utilities, and more. Sophtron emphasizes security and compliance, offering SOC 2 certification and a developer-friendly API.

providers.name: SpecLynx
providers.description: SpecLynx provides enterprise-ready API tooling for authors and maintainers of OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo specifications. Built by veterans with 15+ years of Swagger and OpenAPI development experience, SpecLynx products prioritize security (specs never leave your machine), accuracy, and developer productivity. Core products include a VS Code extension, browser-based editor, CLI, language service library, and the ApiDOM semantic parsing engine. Every SpecLynx product is open source under the Apache-2.0 license; there are no paid plans.

providers.name: stackgems-com
providers.description: Stack Gems is an agent‑operated catalog of developer tools, offering human‑vetted, opinionated reviews of 955 tools and 527 skills across 13 stacks. It provides a JSON API, MCP server, OpenAPI spec, and llms.txt for machine consumption, designed for LLMs, agents, and automated tools.

providers.name: Twaice
providers.description: TWAICE (TWAICE Technologies GmbH) is a Munich-based battery analytics software company. Its predictive analytics platform turns BMS data from battery energy storage systems (BESS) and electric-vehicle fleets into actionable insights for performance management, warranty management, safety monitoring, digital commissioning, and BESS reporting, alongside a battery simulation model library for engineers. Customers include BESS asset owners and operators, IPPs, utilities, automotive and bus/truck OEMs, and battery manufacturers. TWAICE is ISO 27001 certified, holds the automotive TISAX label, and is backed by investors including Creandum and Speedinvest. It publishes no public API or developer program; the platform is a closed SaaS.

providers.name: Ulysses (Kaminashi)
providers.description: Kaminashi Inc. (株式会社カミナシ) is a Tokyo-based SaaS company founded in December 2016 under its former corporate name Ulysses Inc. (ユリシーズ株式会社). It builds the Kaminashi frontline-operations DX platform for deskless workers — digital checklists and inspections, equipment maintenance (CMMS), frontline employee management, training and manuals, and reporting — serving food manufacturing, machine manufacturing, logistics, hotels, and building maintenance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and a16z. The company is ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001) certified and publishes no public developer API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Uno Health
providers.description: Uno Health is a New York-based healthcare technology company that helps Medicare members enroll in the government assistance programs they are eligible for — such as SNAP and utility assistance — saving members an average of $4,500 per year. Medicare Advantage health plans partner with Uno's technology-driven member engagement platform to simplify eligibility checks, subsidy enrollment, plan optimization, and benefits matching, increasing Part C revenue, member retention, and star ratings. Members run a 5-minute savings check, upload enrollment documents, and track recurring monthly savings through the Uno Health Member Portal. Backed by Cowboy Ventures and General Catalyst. Uno Health publishes no public developer program; its API (api.unohealth.com, AWS API Gateway) is private and partner-facing.

providers.name: UpCodes
providers.description: UpCodes is a comprehensive compliance and product research platform for the construction industry, offering a searchable database of US construction and building codes consolidated by state and city for easier navigation. The platform includes libraries of codes, diagrams, and assemblies, project collaboration and bookmarking, code calculators with a BIM design data import tool, SAML single sign-on for enterprise teams, and an AI Copilot that answers code compliance questions, locates assemblies, and generates project-specific checklists. Plans span Essentials, Professional, and Enterprise tiers. UpCodes does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: UrbanCompany
providers.description: Urban Company (formerly UrbanClap) is an on-demand home services marketplace that connects customers with trained, hand-picked service professionals for beauty and salon services, cleaning, appliance repair, plumbing, electrical work, painting, and pest control. The Accel-backed platform operates across 40+ cities in India as well as the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Singapore, and is delivered through its website and mobile apps. Urban Company does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Zidisha
providers.description: Zidisha is a nonprofit direct person-to-person microlending and crowdfunding platform that connects funders in wealthier countries directly with low-income entrepreneurs in developing countries, with no local intermediary taking a cut. Founded in 2009 and backed by Y Combinator, Zidisha lets entrepreneurs apply for funding, communicate directly with their backers, post updates, and repay at zero interest so that funds recycle into new projects. The platform focuses on agriculture, retail, transportation, and small-business growth across regions including Kenya, Indonesia, Burkina Faso, and beyond. Zidisha operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or integration surface; this profile tracks its public web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 3P Learning Pty
providers.description: 3P Learning is an educational technology company that builds blended learning software for mathematics and literacy used by schools and families worldwide. Its product family includes Mathletics, Mathseeds, Reading Eggs, Writing Legends, LiteracyPlanet and Brightpath, reaching more than 20 million students across 130+ countries. The programs pair interactive student activities with teacher dashboards, reporting and curriculum-aligned content, and integrate into school systems via single sign-on and rostering standards such as Clever and LTI. 3P Learning is backed by Insight Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. This company publishes consumer and school-facing web and mobile products but does not expose a public first-party developer API or documented API surface.

providers.name: Accrual
providers.description: Accrual is an augmented accounting intelligence platform for accounting firms and growing service businesses, offering what it calls the complete accounting workspace spanning engagement management, document intake, data processing, tax return generation, assurance workflows, and client collaboration. Backed by General Catalyst, the company emphasizes secure, US-hosted infrastructure with AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS in transit, data isolation, and SOC 2 Type II attestation, and states that customer data is not used to train AI models. Accrual does not publish a public API or developer program at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published security posture.

providers.name: Actually Asked
providers.description: Actually Asked provides an AI-powered FAQ solution for websites and Shopify stores, enabling inline FAQs, highlighted text queries, self‑improving knowledge bases, weekly gap reports, lead capture, and a suite of free tools such as FAQ gap finder and llms.txt generator. The platform integrates with major site builders like Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Squarespace, and supports AI assistants including Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Codex. It offers a free tier with up to 50 AI answers per month and paid plans for higher usage.

providers.name: Advance Tech Lending
providers.description: Advance Tech Lending Inc. (operating as Advance, advance.ph) is a Philippine fintech lender founded in 2018 by Jaime de los Angeles and Addi Guevara and headquartered in Taguig, Metro Manila. It operates an on-demand salary access and working-capital platform for Southeast Asia: employees of enrolled employers can draw a Salary Advance of up to 50% of their monthly basic salary, and businesses can unlock cash through Direct Disbursement (invoice/receivables financing) and Payroll Disbursement (payroll funding during cash-flow gaps). The company is registered with the Philippine SEC (Company Reg. No. CS201819635) and holds Certificate of Authority No. 2765 as a lending company, and has raised roughly USD 16-17M in pre-Series A funding from investors including Accion Venture Lab, Lendable, Next Billion Ventures and Do Ventures. As of this profile Advance publishes no first-party developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract: advance.ph is a 15-page marketing site with no developer path, partner.advance.ph redirects every path to a login, and the only externally visible API listing for its salary-loan product sits inside UnionBank's api.ph partner marketplace.

providers.name: AI Interview Agents
providers.description: AI Interview Agents provides AI-powered interview tools for recruiters and small agencies, including AI interviewers, video interview software, resume screening, candidate location checks, and career page builders. Their platform helps automate applicant qualification, interview highlights, and resume analysis, offering free and paid plans for scaling hiring needs.

providers.name: Alpha Sophia
providers.description: Alpha Sophia provides a comprehensive healthcare commercial intelligence platform, offering detailed data on providers, organizations, and market insights across pharma, biotech, medtech, and related sectors. Their API enables searchable access to extensive provider profiles, procedure volumes, licensing information, and more, supporting sales, marketing, research, and investment decision-making.

providers.name: Ambarella
providers.description: Ambarella (NASDAQ: AMBA) is a fabless semiconductor company designing low-power system-on-chip (SoC) processors for edge AI and computer vision. Its CVflow architecture accelerates deep neural networks on-device for intelligent cameras, automotive ADAS and autonomous driving, robotics, security, and industrial applications. Ambarella does not publish a public HTTP/REST API; developers engage through the Cooper Developer Platform, the CVflow SDK and toolchain (compiler, debugger, Caffe/TensorFlow support), the Model Garden on HuggingFace, Agentic Blueprints, and an Apache-2.0 set of on-device Agent Skills for Cooper Foundry. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and enriched with the provider's real public developer, security, and agent surfaces.

providers.name: American Water Works
providers.description: American Water Works Company is the largest publicly traded U.S. water and wastewater utility company, providing drinking water, wastewater, and other related services to approximately 14 million people in more than 1,700 communities across 14 states. The company operates through regulated utility subsidiaries and offers customer self-service through its MyWater online portal and mobile app.

providers.name: Arcalune Music
providers.description: Arcalune Music is a Japanese‑origin online music library offering original compositions, fan‑arranged game tracks, and royalty‑free background music and sound effects. All tracks are available for free streaming and download, suitable for use in videos, live streams, and game projects. The site provides high‑quality MP3 files under Creative Commons licensing, with multilingual navigation (Japanese, English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Indonesian, French).

providers.name: Azura
providers.description: Azura is an onchain trading platform that lets users trade any onchain asset priced in USD without managing wallets, bridging assets, or paying gas fees. Under the tagline "If it's onchain, it's on Azura," the app offers cross-chain token swaps across multiple blockchains in a single transaction, spot trading with multiple order types, token discovery and analysis, portfolio and PnL tracking, a referral system, and an Azurite rewards program, all with zero platform trading fees. Smart-contract interactions are algorithmically security-audited. Azura is a consumer-facing DeFi product (web app at app.azura.xyz) backed by Initialized Capital; it publishes user documentation and a blog but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or specification surface.

providers.name: Babylon.js
providers.description: Babylon.js is an Apache-2.0 licensed, TypeScript-first open-source 3D engine and rendering framework sponsored by Microsoft and developed in the public BabylonJS GitHub organization. It targets WebGL, WebGPU, and WebXR in the browser, and DirectX, Metal, Vulkan, OpenGL, and OpenGL ES natively through Babylon Native — including a Babylon React Native binding for mobile. The framework ships as a family of scoped npm packages (`@babylonjs/core`, `gui`, `loaders`, `materials`, `inspector`, `serializers`, `post-processes`, `procedural-textures`, `node-editor`) plus a rich tooling surface — the Playground IDE, Sandbox asset viewer, Inspector, Spector.js, the Node Material / Geometry / Particle / Render-Graph editors, a community Editor, the Babylon Toolkit (Unity / Unreal exporters), and DCC exporters for 3ds Max, Maya, and Blender — all backed by the public Snippet API at `snippet.babylonjs.com` that powers shareable Playground and node-editor assets.

providers.name: BizAway
providers.description: BizAway is a corporate travel management platform that centralizes booking, policy enforcement, and expense control for businesses. It combines powerful technology with 24/7 human support, offering multilingual assistance, automated travel policy rules, and comprehensive visibility over travel spend across teams, entities, and currencies. Trusted by over 2,000 companies, BizAway simplifies complex travel itineraries, provides real‑time support, and ensures compliance with regional regulations, making business travel efficient and cost‑effective.

providers.name: Blockskye
providers.description: Blockskye is an enterprise travel management and payments platform for large corporate travel programs, founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York. It combines a consumer-grade online booking tool sourced through direct supplier and NDC connectivity, BMAX direct settlement that wires a customer's ERP straight to travel suppliers so booked travel bypasses corporate cards and expense reports, B360 for capturing personal co-brand card loyalty on business trips while holding policy compliance, and real-time reporting across every booking channel, with transactions recorded to a tamper-resistant distributed ledger. Blockskye delivers an end-to-end corporate travel solution in partnership with KAYAK for Business. The platform is sold and operated as an enterprise service: the booking, servicing and settlement application runs at horizon.blockskye.com behind a customer login and the knowledge base sits behind a Freshworks OAuth login. Blockskye operates a live production API host at api.blockskye.com but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Bosch
providers.description: Bosch is a German multinational engineering and technology company producing automotive components, industrial technology, consumer goods, and energy and building technology. Bosch operates the Bosch IoT Suite, an open IoT platform offering device management, software rollouts, edge services, and IoT data analytics, along with open source contributions to Eclipse Foundation IoT projects.

providers.name: Briefpoint
providers.description: Briefpoint provides AI‑powered tools to automate legal discovery, draft and respond to interrogatories, manage client collections, and generate discovery playbooks. Their platform helps plaintiffs and defense teams streamline document production, improve efficiency, and reduce costs in litigation.

providers.name: Buzzfy
providers.description: Buzzfy is an Instagram growth platform that re‑edits creators’ best reels, adding new openings, subtitles, backgrounds or reply stickers, then posts them as trial reels to reach new audiences. It offers analytics and comment‑to‑DM features, helping creators expand their reach without needing a large follower base.

providers.name: chargezen-com
providers.description: chargezen-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Clear Tape
providers.description: Clear Tape provides a US stock screener that evaluates companies on quality, value, growth and momentum using rule‑based strategies. It offers transparent backtests, live records of picks, and a free tier to start screening stocks without price predictions. The platform emphasizes honest data, verifiable results, and clear documentation for developers.

providers.name: Cleerly
providers.description: Cleerly is a digital healthcare company building an AI-powered platform for the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease (heart disease). Its software analyzes coronary CT angiography (CCTA) imaging to automatically quantify and characterize atherosclerotic plaque, measure stenosis severity, and stage disease, giving physicians a precise, personalized picture of a patient's heart-disease risk. The goal is to move heart-disease care from symptom-based testing toward direct measurement of plaque, reducing unnecessary invasive procedures while improving diagnostic accuracy. Cleerly operates as an enterprise clinical SaaS delivered to health systems, cardiologists, and imaging centers rather than a public developer API program; it publishes a marketing and clinical-evidence site plus a clinician-facing application (Cleerly Labs) and a public trust center. Cleerly is backed by Battery Ventures and Insight Partners.

providers.name: colabro
providers.description: Colabro provides a collaborative workspace platform where teams can manage tables, boards, journals, and integrate AI agents via MCP. Users can create spaces, share data, and automate tasks with agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. The service emphasizes real-time collaboration, data privacy, and customizable workflows, supporting various business processes such as budgeting, inventory, and client management.

providers.name: Conifer
providers.description: Conifer (YC S26) builds Sage, a local-first AI runtime and workspace that runs models entirely on your own machine. Its inference engine is written from scratch in Rust, reaching up to 60% faster decode than llama.cpp on Apple Silicon, and pairs an editor, integrated terminal, file viewers, and an agent runtime inside a kernel-level sandbox so tool calls only touch what you allow. Conifer routes each request to the cheapest capable model, starting with free on-device inference and falling back to cloud only when needed, cutting AI spend by up to 80%. The desktop app ships as Juniper for macOS, Windows, and Linux with no accounts, no telemetry, and no cloud dependency. Conifer is proprietary and distributed as compiled binaries; it currently exposes no public web API.

providers.name: Contexte Tech
providers.description: Contexte Tech is a French platform offering a library of AI resources, including prompts, datasets, MCP models, and tools. It provides open‑source resources, pricing information, and guidance for selecting appropriate AI models, hardware, and costs. The site emphasizes data privacy, decentralized research, and transparent licensing, aiming to help users make informed AI decisions.

providers.name: creativeLIVE
providers.description: creativeLIVE (CreativeLive) is an online learning platform offering more than 2,300 on-demand courses and live interactive classes taught by working professionals across photography, video and filmmaking, graphic and web design, business and entrepreneurship, arts and crafts, audio and music production, and AI and technology. Learners access practical, skill-based instruction through a subscription, with certificates of completion available. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network; creativeLIVE exposes no public developer API, but does publish a machine-readable llms.txt course index for AI agents.

providers.name: CStorePro
providers.description: CStorePro is a convenience-store back-office and retail-management software platform for independent and chain c-store operators. Founded as CStorePro and later rebranded to CStore Essentials (CSE), it is now part of PDI Technologies and marketed as PDI Essentials. The platform provides back-office operations, pricebook and inventory management, lottery and fuel tracking, automated financial reporting and reconciliation, Skupos scan-data submission for tobacco manufacturer rebates, tobacco loyalty (Skupos Engage), and GasBuddy Business Pages reputation management. It connects directly to POS systems including Gilbarco, Verifone, and NCR for automatic sales and inventory sync. There is no public developer API or documented API program at this time; the product is delivered as a hosted web and mobile application.

providers.name: Dataflexc737
providers.description: DataFlex provides an all‑in‑one development platform combining Studio, Framework, Language and Data to accelerate business application creation. The company offers extensive documentation, pricing details, blog posts, and a developer portal at dataflex.dev, serving a global developer community with tools, tutorials, and support resources.

providers.name: Deeproute
providers.description: DeepRoute provides outreach services connecting high school student-athletes with college athletic programs. By handling email, phone, and social media outreach on behalf of athletes, DeepRoute helps them gain visibility with recruiters. The platform offers a dashboard to track outreach progress, pricing plans for various levels of service, and detailed recruiting packages. It aims to bridge the gap for busy parents and athletes seeking college opportunities, operating as a for‑profit service not affiliated with any NCAA institution.

providers.name: Drivio
providers.description: Drivio (Drivio Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a tech-enabled, omni-channel two-wheeler financing marketplace in India that connects motorcycle, scooter, and electric-vehicle buyers with banks and NBFCs. Founded in 2022 by Saurabh Tripathi and Ankur Bhardwaj and headquartered in the Delhi NCR region (Gurugram / New Delhi), the platform offers EMI calculators, instant eligibility checks, curated finance offers, vehicle comparison, and same-day loan approval and disbursal through lending partners including IDFC First Bank, Bajaj Auto Credit, L&T Financial Services, HDB Financial Services, Moneyplus Financial Services, and Arthmate. Drivio is an ISO/IEC 27001 certified company and is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Endeavor
providers.description: Endeavor was a global sports and entertainment company representing talent and owning and operating events, with subsidiaries including WME, IMG, and UFC. Following the 2024 take-private transaction by Silver Lake and the separation of TKO Group Holdings (UFC and WWE), the remaining talent, media, marketing, and licensing businesses were rebranded as WME Group. This repository tracks Endeavor as a corporate entity. It publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no OpenAPI; the only machine-readable surfaces on its own hosts are the wmegrp.com WordPress content API, which is anonymously readable, and a live but authentication-gated WordPress MCP Adapter endpoint.

providers.name: Flexitricity
providers.description: Flexitricity Limited is an Edinburgh-based energy flexibility aggregator and licensed electricity supplier operating what it describes as the first, largest and most advanced demand response portfolio in Great Britain — a virtual power plant exceeding 1GW. Founded in 2004 by Dr Alastair Martin, acquired by Alpiq in 2014, merged with Quinbrook's Velox Power in 2022, and per the company's own timeline acquired by Drax in 2026, it sits in the value chain between commercial, industrial and aggregated domestic energy assets and the GB wholesale and balancing markets. It routes customer assets — batteries, standby generation, industrial load, hydrogen electrolysers, co-located sites and, through its FlexGO product, residential EV charging — into the Balancing Mechanism, Capacity Market, frequency response, reserve services, the Demand Flexibility Service, DNO flexibility markets and wholesale trading. Its API posture is closed: Flexitricity publishes no developer portal, no documented public API, no OpenAPI, and no open market data of its own. The developer-facing subdomains developer., developers., docs., api. and data. do not resolve; the only interactive surface is portal.flexitricity.com, which requires a customer account. The United Kingdom has no consumer data-portability mandate comparable to Australia's Consumer Data Right, so nothing compels Flexitricity to expose customer usage data through an API. The open, machine-readable data about Flexitricity is published by Elexon, not by Flexitricity — its 63 registered BM Units under lead party FLEXTRCY are retrievable anonymously from the Elexon BMRS Insights API. Open on the regulator's side, closed on its own: that split is the finding.

providers.name: Floy
providers.description: Floy is a Munich-based healthcare AI company (founded 2021) that builds AI-powered radiology software for medical imaging. Its two products — opportunistic screening and diagnostic assistance — analyse CT and MRI examinations to surface additional findings beyond the initial radiologist assessment, enabling earlier diagnosis and better patient outcomes. The models are trained on 17 million medical examinations. Floy is an ISO 13485:2016 certified, EU MDR Class IIb medical-device manufacturer and is GDPR compliant, with research partnerships including DKFZ, LMU Klinikum Munich, Stanford, and the University of Oxford. It is backed by HV Capital, 10x Founders, xdeck, and Acurio Ventures. Floy is a clinical B2B product and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Frete.com
providers.description: Frete.com is the Brazilian road-freight technology group formed in January 2023 when CargoX merged with Fretebras and FretePago, becoming Latin America's largest freight-matching platform and one of Brazil's logistics unicorns after a US$200M round led by SoftBank and Tencent. The group operates three consumer-facing brands: Fretebras, the freight marketplace that connects shippers and carriers with autonomous truck drivers; CargoX Brasil, which bundles working-capital credit, cargo insurance, document issuance and truck tracking for trucking companies; and FretePago, a fintech offering a digital account and freight payment rails for drivers and fleets. It also acquired Rotas Brasil for route mapping and toll pricing. The platform applies machine learning to freight matching, fraud and cargo-theft prevention, and pricing intelligence. Frete.com does not currently publish a public developer portal or machine-readable API contract; the Fretebras integration API is reached through partner and ERP/TMS channels rather than an open reference.

providers.name: Halesis
providers.description: Halesis is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: invokera-com
providers.description: Invokera provides a platform that turns a project URL into tools usable by AI agents. It offers a Claude Skill, an MCP server, and a REST API, enabling agents like Claude and Cursor to interact with projects via generated APIs. Users can import OpenAPI specs, curl commands, or Postman collections, and obtain hosted or self‑hosted endpoints. The service includes a public directory, pricing plans, and documentation for quick start, import, domain verification, and automation.

providers.name: Jetstream
providers.description: Jetstream (jetstream.security) is a security-first AI governance platform for enterprises, backed by Redpoint Ventures. It helps organizations discover, control, and monitor AI systems at scale across five capabilities: AI Visibility (discovering and inventorying AI agents, models, tools, and workflows across environments), AI Design Control (documenting how agentic systems are assembled), Agentic Identity (binding human and AI identities to responsible owners), Runtime Governance (enforcing real-time behavioral compliance against approved designs), and AI FinOps Accountability (tracking usage and spend by model, agent, and workflow). The company positions governance as an accelerator for AI adoption, addressing shadow AI, cost control, accountability, and compliance. No public API, SDK, CLI, or developer portal is published as of this profile; the company pursues SOC 2, FedRAMP High, and DoD IL5 compliance.

providers.name: KiwiCo
providers.description: KiwiCo, Inc. is a direct-to-consumer education company headquartered in Mountain View, California, founded in 2011 by Sandra Oh Lin. KiwiCo designs and ships hands-on STEAM (science, technology, engineering, art and math) project kits — branded as crates — on a monthly subscription, with distinct lines aimed at every age from infants through teens and adults, alongside single-purchase kits sold through its online store. A KiwiCo Education division supplies the same project kits and NGSS-aligned lesson guides to schools, homeschools, after-school programs and camps. KiwiCo operates as a consumer e-commerce and subscription business and publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK, CLI or webhook surface, and no /.well-known/ discovery documents on any of its hosts. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Latent Labs
providers.description: Latent Labs is a London- and San Francisco-based frontier AI lab founded in 2023 by Dr. Simon Kohl, a former senior research scientist on DeepMind's Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold 2 and co-lead of DeepMind's protein design team. The company builds generative AI foundation models to make biology programmable, with the goal of enabling biotech and pharmaceutical partners to computationally generate and optimize therapeutic molecules. Latent Labs emerged from stealth in February 2025 with $50M in total funding ($40M Series A co-led by Radical Ventures and Sofinnova Partners, plus 8VC, Kindred Capital, Pillar VC, Flying Fish, Isomer, and angel investors including Jeff Dean, Aidan Gomez, and Mati Staniszewski). The company's proprietary model family includes Latent-X (atom-level de novo protein binder design for macrocycles and mini-binders), Latent-X2 (drug-like antibodies with low ex vivo immunogenicity), and Latent-Y (described as the first lab-validated agent for drug design). Models are accessed through the Latent Labs Platform (platform.latentlabs.com) — a no-code web application with a free tier and daily credits — and, for Latent-X2, via API for commercial partners. There is no public OpenAPI spec, SDK, or open-source release at this time; programmatic access is gated through partnerships@latentlabs.com and wet-lab validation is performed in-house at the company's San Francisco facility.

providers.name: Maryland Transit Administration
providers.description: The Maryland Transit Administration (MDOT MTA) supports open transit data initiatives and makes resources available to developers and applications. It primarily uses the General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) and GTFS-RT to convey schedule, geographic, fare, vehicle position, and trip update data for Local Bus, Light Rail, Metro Subway, MARC Train, and Commuter Bus services in a standardized format.

providers.name: Mimecast
providers.description: Mimecast provides cloud‑based email security, data loss prevention, and archiving solutions that protect organizations from phishing, malware, and targeted attacks. Their platform secures inbound, outbound, and internal communications, offering advanced threat protection, human risk management, and secure collaboration tools. Mimecast’s services help enterprises maintain compliance, ensure data continuity, and reduce the risk of cyber‑threats across email, web, and other digital channels.

providers.name: Nevis Wealth
providers.description: Nevis (Nevis Wealth) is an AI platform built for wealth management firms, giving financial advisors an AI assistant that automates administrative work — AI-generated meeting summaries, automatic task capture from client interactions, intelligent meeting-prep briefs, unified AI search across advisory systems, personalized client email drafting, and account-opening automation — so advisors spend more time with clients and less on paperwork. The company is used by advisory firms including United Capital, GC Wealth, Apollon Wealth, and Dodds Wealth, is SOC 2 Type I certified, and has raised $40M in venture funding. Nevis does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: OPGG
providers.description: OP.GG is the world's leading League of Legends statistics and performance tracking platform. Founded in Seoul, South Korea and launched in 2013, it grew from a LoL stats search engine into a global gaming platform serving tens of millions of monthly active users across games including League of Legends, Valorant, Teamfight Tactics, Overwatch 2, and PUBG. OP.GG surfaces summoner ranks, win rates, champion mastery, builds, tier lists, match history, and live meta trends. Its programmatic surface centers on an official, hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents access to LoL, TFT, and Valorant game data, plus first-party AI-readable ai.json summoner/match snapshot endpoints advertised in its published llms.txt. OP.GG is backed by 500 Global, SBVA, DS Asset Management, Dunamu & Partners, and others.

providers.name: Ottic
providers.description: Ottic provides an AI agent platform that automates busywork by researching, coding, browsing the web, and delivering results. It offers a cloud sandbox with a real terminal and browser, enabling integrations, custom connectors, and reusable skills. Users can define goals in plain language, and the agent executes end‑to‑end workflows, handling data extraction, analysis, and deliverable generation. Ottic aims to turn AI from a chat assistant into a productive work partner, supporting teams with collaborative tools, automation routines, and secure artifact sharing.

providers.name: Peppy
providers.description: Peppy is a global employee healthcare benefits platform, delivered through a mobile app, that connects workers with specialist clinicians across key life stages. Offered by employers as a benefit, Peppy provides unlimited access to practitioners covering women's health, men's health, fertility, pregnancy and early parenthood, menopause, and neurodiversity, alongside lifestyle support for nutrition, fitness, and mental wellbeing. Peppy operates a consumer and employer facing service and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its published web properties and security posture. Peppy is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: Pi Labs
providers.description: Pi Labs (withpi.ai) is an applied-AI company, backed by Accel and later acquired by Microsoft, that builds tooling to evaluate and enhance AI applications. Its core product, Pi Scorer, is a deterministic, roughly 200ms foundation model that scores any text against a rubric of natural-language questions — reported to be about 500x more efficient than using an LLM as a judge. Teams use it to calibrate rubrics, gate and rank LLM outputs, and close the loop across training, inference, and feedback. The scoring engine is exposed as an OpenAPI-compatible REST API at api.withpi.ai with official Python and TypeScript SDKs (both published as "withpi"), a copilot for building scoring specs, and a Promptfoo integration (Pi Scorer).

providers.name: PitchMe
providers.description: PitchMe is a recruitment data intelligence platform that enriches, verifies, and deduplicates candidate records to turn an existing ATS or CRM database into an activated talent pool. It cleans and appends verified contact details, employment history, and skills data, then surfaces career-intelligence signals that power AI-driven sourcing and outreach. PitchMe connects to applicant tracking systems such as Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Salesforce, Lever, JobDiva, Vincere, Avionte, Jobvite, and Ashby via native and certified integrations, plus a custom API for connecting any ATS or recruitment platform. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Prospect CRM
providers.description: Prospect CRM is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Rain Bird
providers.description: Rain Bird is a global irrigation company providing innovative water management solutions for residential, commercial, and agricultural customers. Their products include sprinklers, drip irrigation, controllers, and smart water‑saving technologies designed to conserve water while maintaining healthy landscapes and crops. The company emphasizes sustainability, advanced technology, and customer support across multiple regions worldwide.

providers.name: RSA
providers.description: RSA provides identity and access management solutions, including multi-factor authentication, passwordless authentication, and security governance. Their platform helps organizations protect digital assets, streamline compliance, and defend against advanced threats through AI‑driven security and robust authentication services.

providers.name: sanctionsscreen-io
providers.description: SanctionScreen provides a per‑call sanctions screening API designed for both human users and AI agents. It enables rapid checks of names against OFAC, UK, EU (when available) and other sanctions lists, delivering enriched results with citations within approximately 110 ms per request. The service offers a free tier of 50 calls per month without requiring a credit card, and includes comprehensive documentation in llms.txt for easy integration.

providers.name: Soketi
providers.description: Soketi is a next-gen, Pusher-compatible, open-source WebSocket server. It implements the Pusher protocol so existing Pusher SDKs and applications can drop-in replace Pusher Channels with self-hosted Soketi. Written in Node/TypeScript with Rust adapter; deployed via npm, Docker, Kubernetes, or systemd. Open source under MIT license.

providers.name: Stepful
providers.description: Stepful is a New York-based healthcare workforce education company that trains people with a high-school education for entry-level allied-health roles in as little as four months. It runs live, cohort-based online programs — Medical Assistant, Pharmacy Technician, Patient Care Technician, Medical Administrative Assistant, Surgical Technologist, Dental Assistant, Phlebotomy Technician, Sterile Processing and Practical Nursing — pairing virtual instructor-led classes and 1:1 coaching with at-home clinical skills kits, employer-site clinical rotations and an AI-assisted practice platform, then places graduates into hospital and clinic jobs. Its "School-as-a-Service" employer product lets health systems stand up in-house training and upskilling pipelines. Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Oak HC/FT and Reach Capital, has raised a $31.5M Series B and a $55M Series C, and reports having served more than 30,000 students. It is a Delaware corporation approved to operate by state career-school boards in Alabama, California, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas and Utah. Stepful publishes no public developer API: its student classroom and staff admin applications are both authenticated-only, and no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or webhook contract is served from any host it controls.

providers.name: Stryker
providers.description: Stryker Corporation is a Fortune 500 medical technologies company offering products in orthopedics, medical and surgical equipment, and neurotechnology and spine. Stryker provides Connected OR integration platforms and Smart Equipment Management (SEM) systems for healthcare facilities. The company does not currently offer a publicly documented developer API. Stryker's digital health products include the Mako robotic arm for orthopedic surgery, iSuite integrated OR technology, and asset tracking systems. Integration with hospital EHR and OR management systems is done through vendor partnerships rather than public APIs.

providers.name: TME
providers.description: TME is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Trellis
providers.description: Trellis, operating under the Savvy brand, offers an AI‑driven insurance marketplace that helps consumers compare and purchase car insurance. By anonymously gathering rate estimates and presenting personalized quotes, Savvy aims to simplify the insurance buying process while protecting user data. The platform partners with over 80 insurers across the United States, providing a streamlined, commission‑free experience for shoppers seeking better rates.

providers.name: Tynker
providers.description: Tynker is a coding platform for kids and teens ages 5-18 that makes it fun to learn programming through game-based, interactive courses, with students starting in visual block-based coding and progressing to real-world languages like Python and JavaScript. The platform powers the creativity of over 100 million students and serves thousands of schools and educators worldwide, spanning home plans for parents, K-12 school curriculum, Hour of Code activities, and Minecraft modding. Tynker is a 500 Global and Felicis portfolio company, now part of CodeHS, and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Varsity Tutors
providers.description: Varsity Tutors, a Nerdy company (NYSE: NRDY), is a St. Louis based live online learning platform that connects K-12, college, graduate and professional learners with expert instructors for private one-on-one tutoring, small-group and large-format live classes, test preparation, practice tests and diagnostics across more than 3,000 subjects. Alongside its direct-to-consumer memberships it sells Varsity Tutors for Schools to school districts, and it ships an AI-enhanced learning surface at ai.varsitytutors.com. The company operates a production API gateway at api.varsitytutors.com that serves its own web and mobile clients, but it publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract; its only documented third-party integration surface is its Clever app-gallery listing, which provides Clever Instant Login SSO and Clever Secure Sync rostering to districts.

providers.name: Velo3D
providers.description: Velo3D builds metal additive-manufacturing systems for aerospace, defense, and energy - the Sapphire family of laser powder bed fusion printers, Flow print-preparation software, the Assure quality-assurance and control system, all powered by the Intelligent Fusion manufacturing process. These are enterprise hardware and software products; Velo3D does not publish a documented public developer API.

providers.name: Verizon Connect
providers.description: Verizon Connect is the fleet management, telematics, and GPS vehicle tracking business of Verizon (it grew out of Verizon's acquisitions of Fleetmatics and Telogis). Its Reveal platform exposes a documented suite of REST APIs and webhooks - the Reveal Integration Services / Fleetmatics Integration Manager (FIM) APIs - covering vehicles, drivers, GPS positions and history, trips (segments), driver status and safety, hours-of-service logbooks, geofences (places), groups, work orders, non-powered asset tracking, fleet inspections, and dash-cam video events. The API is not openly self-service - access is gated to Reveal customers and their approved integration partners, who request Integration Manager and Reveal REST credentials through the Reveal marketplace before they can call the documented endpoints.

providers.name: ДокиДепо
providers.description: ДокиДепо – это онлайн‑склад с интерактивной картой, позволяющий бесплатно печатать ценники, этикетки, сравнивать таблицы и рассчитывать закупки. Сервис предлагает набор бесплатных бизнес‑инструментов: генератор артикулов, баланс склада, публикацию товаров и интеграцию с поставщиками. Всё без регистрации, доступно в веб‑интерфейсе и через публичный API, описанный в каталоге открытых инструментов.

providers.name: 2ULaundry
providers.description: 2ULaundry is a laundry and dry cleaning pickup-and-delivery service headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina and backed by Techstars. Customers schedule pickups through a mobile app, leave color-coded bags at their door, and receive cleaned items back within one to two business days. Services include residential wash-and-fold, delicate garment care, dry cleaning, and household linens, plus commercial laundry solutions for Airbnbs, spas, gyms, salons, and healthcare facilities. The company operates its own processing facilities and a fleet-based delivery network across its Southeast US markets. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Techstars portfolio and enriched; 2ULaundry is a consumer service company and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: AddSign
providers.description: AddSign is an electronic signature platform tailored for small businesses and freelancers. It offers a free forever plan with AI‑powered document analysis, unlimited signers, and legally binding e‑signatures. Users can upload, sign, and send documents in seconds, making it a cost‑effective DocuSign alternative. The service targets industries such as real estate, contracting, law firms, and creative professionals.

providers.name: Blindmate
providers.description: Blindmate is a friend-based dating app that inverts the swipe model: instead of writing their own profile, a single person's friends answer questions about them, and matches are made through character-first "Blindchats" that surface compatibility before appearance. Founded in Germany and available on iOS and Android in German, English, and Spanish, the app reports over one million users and positions itself around trust, reduced harassment, data privacy, and green-energy infrastructure. Blindmate is a Speedinvest portfolio company; it is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its web, security, and policy surface rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Bridgetown Research
providers.description: Bridgetown Research is an AI-powered research and analysis platform that helps organizations analyze businesses with speed and precision. Its AI agents conduct expert interviews, gather primary and secondary data at scale, and execute 300+ of the most common analyses to power autonomous market research and commercial due diligence. The platform serves private equity and venture capital firms, professional services firms, and corporate strategy and development teams, who access it either through a SOC 2-compliant SaaS platform with interactive generative-search reporting or via an email-driven workflow that returns PDF reports. Bridgetown Research also exposes a REST API (documented on Apidog at docs.bridgetownresearch.com) for creating research projects and managing experts, expert actions, and scheduled calls. It is backed by Accel and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Cache
providers.description: Cache provides tax-efficient solutions for diversifying concentrated stock positions, offering exchange funds, long‑short strategies, and collar‑advance financing. It serves individual investors and advisors, delivering tools to manage large stock holdings, reduce tax drag, and access institutional‑grade strategies through a modern digital platform.

providers.name: Casper
providers.description: Casper (Casper Sleep Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer sleep and home goods brand that sells mattresses, bedding, pillows, and sleep accessories online at casper.com and through retail partners. Its casper.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md with agent instructions, the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for AI agents to search, cart, and check out, and Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect authentication. Casper was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP and Slow Ventures and enriched from its live public agent/commerce surface.

providers.name: Cbtnuggets
providers.description: CBT Nuggets provides online IT training videos and certification preparation courses. Founded in 2006, it offers a subscription platform with thousands of video tutorials, practice labs, and quizzes for a wide range of technology certifications. The service aims to help professionals save time and reduce effort while advancing their careers.

providers.name: Circulo de Belleza
providers.description: Círculo de Belleza is an authorized distributor of professional beauty products in Mexico, operating an e-commerce storefront at circulodebelleza.com. It sells salon-quality hair care, hair color, nail, barbershop, and facial/spa supplies from 40+ professional brands (L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Wella, Schwarzkopf, Matrix, Alfaparf Milano) at professional pricing with no minimum purchase, same-day fulfillment, and nationwide Mexico delivery. The store is built on Shopify and exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md, OpenID Connect and OAuth authorization-server discovery documents, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: CoinCryptoRank
providers.description: CoinCryptoRank provides real-time cryptocurrency data, AI‑driven market insights, and institutional‑grade analysis tools for serious traders. It tracks live prices, charts, funding rates, and arbitrage opportunities across 60+ exchanges, offering verified market data and advanced analytics to help users make informed decisions in the crypto space.

providers.name: Columnar
providers.description: Columnar is a data-infrastructure company advancing open standards for database connectivity. It builds and maintains tooling around ADBC (Apache Arrow Database Connectivity), including dbc — a cross-platform command-line package manager that installs and manages ADBC drivers across macOS, Linux, and Windows and eight programming languages — and databow, a command-line SQL query tool over ADBC. Columnar also ships the DuckDB ADBC community extension and publishes Agent Skills so AI agents can connect to and query databases through ADBC. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and is built on the Apache Arrow open-source ecosystem.

providers.name: Crucible
providers.description: Crucible provides premium animated React components for modern web interfaces, offering a library of backgrounds, text effects, cards, and full sections. Users can preview live demos, copy-paste source code, and install via CLI. The platform emphasizes design quality, performance, and ease of integration for developers seeking visually rich UI elements.

providers.name: Datacore
providers.description: DataCore Software is a software-defined storage and data management vendor serving approximately 15,000 customers worldwide, from Fortune 500 enterprises to small and medium businesses. Its portfolio includes SANsymphony (SAN and HCI storage virtualization), Swarm (scalable S3-compatible object storage for archives and backups), Nexus (a high-performance parallel file system for HPC and AI workloads), Puls8 (container-native persistent storage for Kubernetes), and StarWind hyperconverged infrastructure for edge, ROBO, and SMB deployments. DataCore does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI-described REST API; programmatic access is delivered through product-embedded interfaces and open-source integration plugins (CSI, Docker Volume Plugin, OpenStack Cinder) maintained on its GitHub organization.

providers.name: Deltek
providers.description: Deltek provides enterprise software solutions for project-driven work, offering platforms such as Deltek Vantagepoint, Costpoint, and GovWin. Their tools help organizations manage projects, resources, finances, and compliance, delivering speed, clarity, and control throughout the project lifecycle. The company serves government contractors, professional services firms, and other high‑stakes industries with integrated, purpose‑built applications.

providers.name: Dolibarr
providers.description: Dolibarr is an open-source ERP and CRM platform for businesses, freelancers, and foundations. It provides a REST API for managing contacts, invoices, products, orders, projects, banking, HR, and business module integrations. The API uses standard HTTP methods and JSON, with token-based authentication via the DOLAPIKEY header.

providers.name: Effectful
providers.description: Effectful Technologies is the company behind Effect, an open-source ecosystem of production-grade TypeScript libraries. The flagship `effect` library is a composable standard library and execution engine that unifies error handling, resource management, concurrency, dependency injection, observability, schema, and testability, letting developers focus on what a program should accomplish rather than how. Effect is positioned as "Layer 0" of a broader vision extending into distributed systems — RPC, SQL, clustering, AI integrations, and durable execution. The ecosystem ships as first-party npm packages under the `effect` and `@effect/*` scopes (MIT licensed) from the Effect-TS GitHub organization. Effectful is developer-tooling / library company, not an HTTP API provider, and is backed by Amplify Partners.

providers.name: Everything But The House
providers.description: Everything But The House (EBTH) is a Blue Ash, Ohio online estate sale and consignment auction marketplace founded in 2008 by Jacquie Denny and Brian Graves. It runs curated, full-service online estate sales — cataloging, photography, appraisal, payment and shipping — for homeowners, estate managers, dealers and collectors, and sells the resulting antiques, fine art, jewelry, coins, watches, furniture and collectibles to buyers through timed online auctions where most lots open at one dollar. EBTH sells a consumer marketplace and a consignment service, not a developer platform: the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK or webhook catalog. Its public GitHub organization contains only forks of third-party Ruby gems, its mobile apps are webview wrappers around ebth.com, and the only GraphQL endpoint on the site is an internal one that robots.txt disallows. The single machine-facing surface it does operate is a public Uptime Kuma status page at status.ebth.com.

providers.name: goalieip-com
providers.description: Goalie IP provides intellectual property monitoring and enforcement services, built by registered patent attorneys. It offers continuous US trademark, copyright, and patent monitoring, reporting, and a developer API over USPTO trademark data, enabling AI assistants to search federal trademark records via a robust API and MCP.

providers.name: GT Medical Technologies
providers.description: GT Medical Technologies, Inc. is a Tempe, Arizona medical device company founded by brain tumor specialists to commercialize GammaTile, an FDA-cleared, bioabsorbable collagen implant embedded with Cesium-131 radiation seeds. Surgeons place the tiles directly into the resection cavity at the time of brain tumor removal, delivering immediate, targeted radiation without the weeks-long healing delay conventional external beam radiotherapy requires. The company sells a physical, prescription-only implant to hospitals and neurosurgical centers through a direct sales force and a Salesforce-based ordering portal; it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Halo Investing
providers.description: Halo Investing is a Chicago-based financial technology company that operates a marketplace for "protective investments" — structured notes, multi-manager structured note SMAs, buffered ETFs, annuities and insurance — connecting financial advisors, RIAs and financial institutions with more than 40 global banking and insurance issuers. Founded in 2015 by Biju Kulathakal and Jason Barsema, the platform lets advisors analyze, customize, price, execute and then monitor outcome-based products from a single dashboard, with tools such as the Aura portfolio simulator and an asset allocation framework for structured notes. Halo reports more than $45.5B in transactions since 2015 and employs 100+ people. Its affiliate Halo Securities LLC is an SEC-registered broker-dealer and a member of FINRA/SIPC, acting as distributor and selling agent for structured note products. The advisor platform at notes.haloinvesting.com is entirely authenticated behind a login. As of this profiling pass Halo Investing publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK, CLI, MCP server or A2A agent card; advisor-side API integration is offered through the third-party Schwab OpenView Gateway rather than a Halo-published API.

providers.name: IBM Db2
providers.description: IBM Db2 is a family of data management products from IBM that includes relational and hybrid database servers running on cloud, distributed, and z/OS platforms, supporting transactional, analytical, and AI workloads. Db2 exposes RESTful services that let applications create, discover, execute, and manage user-defined services natively against the database, and IBM Db2 as a Service on IBM Cloud provides a managed REST API for administering and querying cloud-hosted Db2 databases. Authentication is performed via HTTP basic auth, client certificates, or IBM Cloud IAM Bearer tokens depending on the deployment.

providers.name: INSIA
providers.description: INSIA provides decision intelligence solutions for manufacturers and business teams, enabling early detection of operational issues through data integration, analytics, and automated insights delivered via WhatsApp, email, and Teams. Their platform offers pre‑built KPIs, benchmarks, and playbooks to help users understand problems, assess impact, and take actionable steps, improving efficiency and profitability across supply chains.

providers.name: James Webb Space Telescope API
providers.description: A free, third-party API for accessing James Webb Space Telescope data sourced from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST). The API provides access to JWST images, observations, and data filterable by program, type, and other parameters. It is built by an independent engineer (not an official NASA, ESA, or CSA service) and data is available under CC-BY 4.0. Authentication is via API key obtained at signup.

providers.name: NAVER Z
providers.description: NAVER Z Corporation is the South Korean metaverse subsidiary of NAVER, headquartered in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, with additional offices in Los Angeles and Tokyo. The company builds immersive digital experiences spanning ZEPETO, its avatar-based metaverse and social app launched in 2018; ZEP, a spatial collaboration and virtual-space platform launched in 2022; and Sticker.ly, a sticker creation and sharing app launched in 2019. NAVER Z's public developer surface is ZEP Script: a first-party JavaScript SDK, CLI, and build toolchain (published on npm under the official @zep.us scope) that creators use to build in-space apps and mini-games, documented in the ZEP Guidebook at docs.zep.us with a dedicated ZEP Script API reference. NAVER Z publishes no REST/OpenAPI web API or OAuth program; ZEPETO Studio remains a Unity-based content-creation tool rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Redwood Bank
providers.description: Redwood Bank is a specialist UK challenger bank for small and medium-sized businesses, headquartered in Letchworth Garden City, Hertfordshire. Launched in 2017 after receiving its banking licence from the Prudential Regulation Authority and Financial Conduct Authority (Financial Services Register firm reference 755924, company number 09872265), it is wholly owned by Redwood Financial Partners Ltd — a vehicle controlled by Jonathan and David Rowland, with Warrington Borough Council holding a roughly one-third stake. Redwood focuses narrowly on business and charity savings accounts and individually underwritten commercial and buy-to-let mortgages, and is not one of the CMA9 mandated banks. Because its product range is deposit- and lending-only (it does not offer a payment / business current account), it falls outside the PSD2 scope that compels UK Open Banking, and as of this review it publishes no public developer portal, no OBIE Read/Write (AIS/PIS/CBPII) APIs, and no confirmed Open Banking Open Data endpoint.

providers.name: Reliance Worldwide
providers.description: Reliance Worldwide Corporation Limited (RWC, ASX: RWC) is a global manufacturer of plumbing, heating and water control solutions, founded in Brisbane, Australia in 1949. Through a family of brands including SharkBite, HoldRite, Cash Acme, John Guest, Eastman, EZ-FLO, RMC, Holman and Auspex, it sells plumbing, water management, irrigation and building services products into residential and commercial new construction, repair and remodel markets across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, distributed through wholesale, retail and OEM channels. RWC publishes no public developer portal or API documentation on rwc.com.

providers.name: Rendezvous
providers.description: Rendezvous is an AI‑powered private matchmaking service that helps users find meaningful connections without public profiles or swiping. Users join a waitlist, answer introductory questions, and let AI matchmakers propose introductions. The platform emphasizes privacy, consent, and curated introductions, offering a waitlist‑based rollout across regions. It aims to reduce the friction of online dating by focusing on conversation quality and mutual agreement before contact details are exchanged.

providers.name: Savana
providers.description: Savana is a Malvern, Pennsylvania based financial software company, founded in 2009, that sells a cloud-native, API-first Digital Delivery Platform to banks, credit unions and fintechs. The platform sits above the core banking system rather than replacing it, unifying banker-facing experiences (CRM, BPM, servicing, assisted account opening) and customer-facing experiences (online and mobile banking, digital account opening) across any core, and shipping 140+ pre-built configurable servicing workflows. Savana markets a set of "Banking APIs" that orchestrate whole servicing processes — not just data exchange — between assisted and self-service channels, but as of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; documentation and the status page are reachable only by authenticated customers. Savana raised a $45M Series A led by Georgian with participation from Fiserv in 2022.

providers.name: Sherpa
providers.description: Sherpa provides an AI‑powered website platform that enables teams and agents to manage, build, and personalize web pages through natural language commands. Backed by Y‑Combinator, Sherpa integrates with tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Slack, offering features such as experiments, page building, adaptation, and pricing plans. The service aims to turn design briefs into production‑ready sites, supporting collaboration and rapid iteration for modern digital teams.

providers.name: Skuad
providers.description: Skuad is a global HR and employment platform (now part of Payoneer as Payoneer Workforce Management) that lets companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage full-time employees and contractors across 160+ countries without setting up local legal entities. It provides employer-of-record (EOR) services, international payroll in 70+ currencies, contractor management and payments, benefits administration, background verification, and built-in compliance with local employment, tax, and labor laws. Skuad was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from Skuad's public web presence. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: sofortfax-de
providers.description: sofortfax-de is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full‑pipeline profiling. During the identity investigation, no public website, documentation, or API endpoints were found that reliably identify the company's services or domain ownership. The domain sofortfax.de currently serves unrelated content and does not reference the company, so the website pointer has been removed. This entry records the limited publicly available information about the provider.

providers.name: Spellbook
providers.description: Spellbook (spellbook.com) is a generative AI platform for commercial lawyers that lives inside Microsoft Word as an add-in. Its product suite includes Review (redlining and risk identification), Draft (clause and document generation from precedents), Ask (cited answers to contract questions), Market (benchmarking contracts against market data), and Associate (multi-document workflow agents). Spellbook is used by 4,500+ in-house teams and law firms across 80+ countries and has processed over 10 million contracts. The product is sold as per-seat SaaS via direct sales and a 7-day free trial; Spellbook does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Spirl
providers.description: Spirl is a non-human identity and access management (IAM) startup that in 2025 rebranded to Defakto (defakto.security); spirl.com now redirects to the Defakto site. The company secures automated systems — workloads, services, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and AI agents — by replacing static secrets and hardcoded credentials with short-lived, cryptographically verifiable identities built on open workload-identity standards (SPIFFE/SPIRE style). Co-founded by Eli Nesterov (ex-ByteDance infrastructure) and Danny Oliveri, it targets the enterprise gap where organizations run millions of non-human identities protected only by static secrets. Defakto was named a 2025 Gartner Cool Vendor in Identity-First Security. It is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, blog, and security page but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, CLI, or developer portal — access is via demo request, so there is no API surface to enrich at this time.

providers.name: Staircase
providers.description: Staircase, Inc. operates the Elephant Protocol (elephant.xyz), a decentralized property-data network that aggregates and cryptographically verifies fragmented county property and address records into trusted, agent-consumable data. It publishes 500,000+ enriched property data points and an unusually agent-native developer surface: a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (@elephant-xyz/mcp, both stdio and hosted), an Elephant CLI (@elephant-xyz/cli) for oracle data transformation and on-chain proof submission to Polygon, a fact-sheet generator, and a library of 14 published Agent Skills for county-data ingestion. An Enterprise API is offered to organizations at scale. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners; originally a mortgage-technology API company, now focused on real estate data infrastructure.

providers.name: terralayr
providers.description: terralayr is a German energy-flexibility company that develops, owns and operates utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and runs LAYR, a cloud platform that aggregates heterogeneous storage assets and makes their flexibility available as bookable capacity to utilities, grid operators, power traders, aggregators and asset owners. The platform lets customers buy and sell dispatchable capacity to balance renewable generation against fluctuating grid demand, with storage bookable via API and no complex hardware onboarding. terralayr is backed by Creandum and Earlybird. Its LAYR product API is B2B/private and publishes no public OpenAPI, SDKs or developer documentation; this profile captures the public well-known discovery, security and operational surface.

providers.name: trakis-io
providers.description: Trakis provides a free SEO audit tool for small websites, counting each SEO problem once and showing which pages are affected. It offers a simple interface to generate reports, integrates with AI assistants, and aims to help site owners and agencies quickly identify and fix issues. The service is free, with optional sign‑up via Google or email, and delivers audit results within an hour.

providers.name: TransparentBusiness
