providers.description: TransparentBusiness is a New York based SaaS company, founded in 2012 by Alex Konanykhin and Silvina Moschini, that sells a cloud platform for managing and monitoring remote workforces: a desktop timer, screenshot-based activity verification, timesheets, task assignment, and real-time project cost and progress reporting for distributed teams and contractors. The company also operates the SheWorks! and Yandiki talent marketplaces and the CloudWorking Academy training platform, and was later renamed Unicoin, Inc. The product is delivered as a hosted web application plus downloadable desktop timer clients; the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Ultromics
providers.description: Ultromics is a UK-based clinical AI company, spun out of the University of Oxford and backed by GV, whose EchoGo platform applies FDA 510(k)-cleared AI to routine echocardiograms to help clinicians detect heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and cardiac amyloidosis. EchoGo integrates into existing hospital echo workflows and PACS environments, delivering results through clinical systems rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Virta Health
providers.description: Virta Health is a virtual, nutrition-first healthcare company delivering sustainable weight loss and type 2 diabetes reversal. Its program combines personalized nutrition plans, continuous expert health coaching, physician-led medication management, and connected devices, delivered through a consumer mobile app and sold to employers, health plans, and healthcare providers. Virta is HITRUST- and SOC 2 Type II-certified and operates as a HIPAA-covered clinical service. As of this enrichment pass Virta publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification surface; this profile captures its public identity, security posture, and compliance certifications.

providers.name: Vuori
providers.description: Vuori is a California-based performance athletic apparel and activewear brand founded in 2015 in Encinitas, offering men's and women's clothing built for training, running, yoga, and everyday wear. The direct-to-consumer business runs on a Shopify storefront at vuoriclothing.com plus a growing retail footprint, and is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners (and later SoftBank Vision Fund). Vuori publishes no public developer API or developer portal; it exposes a consumer web/mobile storefront, a help center, and a brand blog. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's real public web surface — its security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact, domain-security posture, and customer-facing pages — rather than a developer program, which does not exist.

providers.name: Wayhome
providers.description: Wayhome (formerly Unmortgage) is a London-based property technology company founded in 2016 by Nigel Purves and Josef Wasinski. It offers "Gradual Homeownership" — a part-buy, part-rent alternative to a traditional mortgage in which a customer buys at least 5% of a home and pays rent on the remainder, gradually increasing their ownership stake over time. Wayhome pairs aspiring homeowners with institutional investors (including Allianz), letting people who can afford rent but cannot secure a conventional mortgage move into a home of their choice with a deposit as low as 5%. Wayhome is authorised and regulated in the United Kingdom. It is backed by fintech venture investors including Anthemis, Augmentum Fintech, Allianz X and Accelerated Digital Ventures. Wayhome operates as a consumer-facing service and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Zippin
providers.description: Zippin (vCognition Technologies Inc.) builds a checkout-free, cashierless retail platform that uses computer vision, sensor fusion and machine learning to let shoppers enter a store with an app, credit card or campus credential, take what they want and leave without a checkout line. The company sells store formats including the Zippin Retrofit, Zippin Lane, Zippin Walk-Up, Micromarket Lite and Zippin Outdoors, and operates in stadiums, arenas, airports, hotels, theme parks, college campuses and convenience retail. Its integration surface is the Zippin Gateway, an API framework the company says connects the platform to more than 25 third-party systems — payment gateways, loyalty and gift programs, campus card providers, inventory systems, POS and self-service beverage hardware — alongside a Store Dashboard whose Reports Dashboard data can also be pulled through a REST API with nested JSON payloads. Founded by veterans of Amazon and SRI, Zippin is headquartered in San Francisco.

providers.name: Aceable
providers.description: Aceable (Aceable Brands) is an Austin, Texas mobile-first online education company founded in 2013 that builds state-accredited licensing and continuing-education courses across four brands: Aceable (drivers ed, defensive driving and traffic school in 40+ US states), Aceable Agent (real estate pre-license, post-license and CE in 16 states, plus PrepAgent exam prep in all 50), Aceable Insurance (Property & Casualty and Life & Health pre-license in 13 states, CE in CA/IL/TX) and Aceable Mortgage (NMLS-approved MLO pre-license and CE in 7 states plus the required 20-hour national component; NMLS Provider ID 1400102). More than 20 million students have been licensed through Aceable, at roughly 1.5 million per year. The company raised about $106M across five rounds from Silverton Partners, Floodgate, Sageview Capital and HGGC, and operates a B2B partner program (affiliate and bulk-buy) for driving schools, school districts, brokerages, carriers and mortgage employers. Aceable publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its platform API at api.aceable.com is a private, application-ID-gated backend serving the Aceable web and mobile apps.

providers.name: Adrenaline List
providers.description: Adrenaline List is a platform that lets thrill‑seekers discover, track, and share extreme adventure experiences such as bungee jumping, skydiving, zip‑lining, and more. Users can create personal bucket‑list profiles, mark completed feats, read community reviews, and explore record‑breaking activities worldwide—all for free.

providers.name: Advanced Aircraft Company
providers.description: Advanced Aircraft Company (AAC) is a veteran-owned aerospace manufacturer in Hampton, Virginia, founded in 2017 to build long-endurance hybrid fuel-electric VTOL unmanned aircraft systems for commercial, public-safety and defense missions. Its flagship HAMR (Hybrid Advanced Multi-Rotor) UAS flies 3.5+ hours on gas-electric propulsion, and its Greased Lightning tilt-wing is built on technology licensed from NASA Langley Research Center. AAC is a hardware company with no developer program and no product API; its only public machine-readable surface is the WordPress REST API and an OAuth-gated WordPress MCP Adapter server exposed by its own marketing site.

providers.name: ailawframework-com
providers.description: AI Law Framework provides a comprehensive platform integrating artificial intelligence with legal practice. It offers tools for AI-driven legal research, jurisdiction-specific guidance, software catalogues, and policy building to help law firms and in‑house counsel navigate AI regulations, assess compliance, and automate routine tasks across multiple regions. The service includes practice area resources, quick‑check assessments, and a knowledge‑management hub to streamline AI policy implementation and risk management for legal professionals.

providers.name: Allara
providers.description: Allara Health is a virtual women's healthcare platform focused on complex hormonal, metabolic, and gynecological conditions such as PCOS, insulin resistance, endometriosis, thyroid disorders, menopause, and PMDD. Serving more than 85,000 patients across 45 states and D.C., Allara connects members with board-certified OB-GYNs, endocrinologists, women's health nurse practitioners, and registered dietitians for virtual consultations, advanced hormonal and metabolic lab testing, personalized treatment plans, and ongoing care coordination. The company operates consumer-facing web and patient portal applications; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as an index-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Aluna
providers.description: Aluna is a digital respiratory health company behind an FDA-cleared, portable Bluetooth spirometer and companion mobile app that let people with asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis measure lung function (FEV1) at home and share the results with their care teams. The platform pairs a hospital-grade sensor with a gamified app and machine-learning analytics to encourage proper technique, track symptoms, triggers, and medications, and surface trends that help clinicians intervene before an exacerbation. Founded by Charvi Shetty and Inderjit Jutla out of UC Berkeley's bioengineering program, Aluna raised a $15.3M Series B and is a Matrix Partners portfolio company; the product is now operated under Huma Therapeutics. Aluna publishes consumer, clinical-provider, and clinical-trial surfaces but no public developer API.

providers.name: Atlys
providers.description: Atlys is a digital visa application platform that helps travelers obtain tourist, business, and transit visas on time for 150+ destinations, backed by a guarantee. Founded in 2020 by Mohak Nahta and headquartered in San Francisco, Atlys asks travelers a short set of questions and then automates form-filling, document compilation (itineraries, cover letters, NOCs, flight and hotel confirmations), payment, and appointment booking against official government and embassy requirements that are refreshed monthly. It covers e-visas, visa-on-arrival, Schengen, US, UK ETA and more, and serves travelers from India, the United States, the United Kingdom, the UAE, Australia, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Atlys Enterprise adds group processing (up to 1,000 travelers), HRMS/payroll integrations (Workday, Rippling), concierge support, and secure passport logistics for corporate travel teams. Atlys is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Sequoia, Accel, and others, having raised over $40M across multiple rounds.

providers.name: Audiodraft
providers.description: Audiodraft is a Helsinki-founded global audio branding and custom music production company that helps brands design, create, and manage their sonic identity across advertising, video, games, and campaigns. Its service is organized around three offerings — ANALYZE (data-driven audio strategy and brand-attribute analysis), CREATE (custom music, sound design, and voice-over production), and MANAGE (brand-fit validation and sound testing) — drawing on a crowdsourced community of thousands of composers and sound designers across 100+ countries. Audiodraft has worked with brands and agencies including Nokia, Red Bull Media House, Finnair, Fortum, and TBWA. It is a creative audio-branding services provider and does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Aunt Flow
providers.description: Aunt Flow is a woman-owned company on a mission to end period poverty by making menstrual products freely accessible in public restrooms the same way toilet paper is. It manufactures and sells free-vend period product dispensers (models P, E, R, and O), organic cotton tampons and pads, touch-free disposal systems, and retail display boxes, serving schools, universities, offices, airports, stadiums, ski resorts, restaurants, health systems, amusement parks, and coworking spaces. Since 2021 the company has donated over 6 million period products to people in need. Aunt Flow is a physical-products and e-commerce business (Techstars-backed) with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity, commercial links, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Big Sky Health
providers.description: Big Sky Health (now operating as Zero Longevity Science, Inc.) is a Bozeman, Montana consumer digital-health company best known for Zero, one of the most popular intermittent-fasting and nutrition-tracking mobile apps. Zero combines a fasting timer, photo-based meal and protein logging, a personalized Protein Score, and water-intake tracking to help users manage body composition and adopt science-backed longevity practices. The company runs as a direct-to-consumer mobile subscription business (Zero Plus) on iOS and Android. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer program. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Trinity Ventures portfolio company awaiting enrichment.

providers.name: Billforward
providers.description: Billforward provides a comprehensive subscription management and recurring billing platform, offering features such as subscription lifecycle management, usage‑based billing, invoicing, dunning, and integrations with major payment gateways and ERP systems. It targets SaaS, IoT, and digital services companies seeking to automate revenue operations, with a developer‑first API that supports headless commerce and extensive analytics.

providers.name: Birches Health
providers.description: Birches Health is a fully virtual behavioral addiction treatment provider specializing in gambling disorder and related compulsive behaviors such as sports betting, day trading, video gaming, and pornography. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, the company delivers confidential online care from licensed gambling counselors, peer mentors, financial coaches, and group therapy across all 50 states. Birches Health partners with 18+ state governments that have legalized sports betting and 100+ national insurance plans (including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Aetna, and Blue Cross Blue Shield) so most clients pay $0-25 per session, with a core program completed in about 12 weeks. The company has raised approximately $20M from AlleyCorp, General Catalyst, and Will Ventures. Birches Health does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or specification; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Blockpartyapp
providers.description: Block Party is a consumer privacy tool — a browser extension (Chrome, Firefox, and Edge) that helps people deep-clean and secure their social media presence. It scans connected accounts for privacy and security exposures, then automates bulk cleanup across Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, and LinkedIn: deleting old posts, likes, and comments, untagging photos, removing connections, stripping location data, and tightening privacy settings. Founded by Tracy Chou, Block Party (also branded Privacy Party) is a consumer-facing application and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: BloomTech
providers.description: Bloom Institute of Technology (BloomTech) is an online coding bootcamp offering full‑stack web development and AI‑focused courses. Founded to provide low‑risk, high‑impact pathways to tech careers, it boasts over 4,000 graduates since 2017, an 86% job placement rate in 2022, and a tuition‑refund guarantee. The platform combines flexible part‑time and full‑time options, AI‑enhanced learning, and corporate upskilling solutions for diverse learners.

providers.name: BossTax
providers.description: BossTax is a mobile bookkeeping and tax-filing app for 1099 workers, freelancers, and independent contractors. Founded in 2022 and based in Stamford, Connecticut, BossTax lets self-employed users track expenses by photographing receipts, automatically categorize deductions, log expenses hands-free by voice, manage separate business banking, and file federal, state, and local taxes with a licensed tax professional for a single flat fee with no subscriptions. BossTax is an IRS-authorized Electronic Return Originator (ERO) and is backed by Bloomberg Beta and Boyd Street Ventures. The company ships iOS and Android consumer apps; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time, so this profile tracks the company identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Brode
providers.description: Brode provides professional-quality vectorization and machine embroidery services, converting images (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF) into studio-quality vector files (SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF) and ready-to-stitch embroidery files (DST, PES, JEF, VP3, EXP, U01, XXX). Free plan available, no credit card required.

providers.name: btcnode-uk
providers.description: btcnode-uk provides Bitcoin node hosting services in the United Kingdom, offering reliable, secure, and scalable full-node infrastructure for developers, enterprises, and enthusiasts. Their platform enables easy deployment and management of Bitcoin Core nodes, with APIs for blockchain data access, transaction broadcasting, and network monitoring. The service emphasizes high availability, low latency, and compliance with UK data regulations, supporting both mainnet and testnet environments. Customers benefit from automated backups, real-time alerts, and detailed analytics, making btcnode-uk a comprehensive solution for integrating Bitcoin blockchain capabilities into applications and services.

providers.name: Bybit
providers.description: Cryptocurrency data feed and algorithmic trading

providers.name: Caer
providers.description: Caer, Inc. is the company behind YUMI (helloyumi.com), a direct-to-consumer children's nutrition brand that makes nutritionally-engineered organic snacks for babies, toddlers, and kids. The product line includes toddler bars, squeezable smoothies-to-go, freeze-dried smoothie melts, super/breakfast bars, and soft-baked cookies, all formulated as function-first, nutrient-dense, organic, dairy-free, gluten-free, and clean-label. YUMI sells through its own WooCommerce storefront, Amazon, and select retail, offering one-time purchases and recurring subscription memberships. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was seeded as a venture-portfolio stub; it is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Cartography
providers.description: Cartography is an open-source Python security-graph tool originally built at Lyft that consolidates infrastructure assets and the relationships between them into an intuitive Neo4j graph. It ingests data from 30+ cloud, identity, DevOps, and security providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, Okta, Entra ID, GitHub, Kubernetes, CrowdStrike, and more) and lets security teams answer cross-provider questions such as "which identities can reach which datastores," "which compute instances are exposed to the internet," and "what are the blast radii of a compromised credential."

providers.name: CHAMP Cargosystems
providers.description: Champ.aero, also known as CHAMP Cargosystems, is a company that provides comprehensive IT solutions for the air cargo industry, offering a range of software applications and services to manage all aspects of air cargo operations, including booking, handling, accounting, customs clearance, and messaging, primarily through their flagship product called "Cargospot.".

providers.name: Clearvector
providers.description: ClearVector is an identity-driven detection and response platform for cloud production environments. It attributes every action in real time to human, non-human, and third-party identities across AWS, GCP, and Azure, threading together activity across GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, cloud control planes, and runtime (EC2, Lambda, containers). Per-customer predictive behavioral models surface risky behavior, and one-click isolation contains compromised identities and resources without disrupting production. Offered as SaaS, an Enterprise plan, and a ClearVector Private SaaS deployment for teams that need complete infrastructure control. Backed by Menlo Ventures. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; ClearVector publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface — the product is delivered through a login-gated application at app.clearvector.com.

providers.name: Coincheck
providers.description: Coincheck is a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange. It documents a REST Exchange API (public market data plus HMAC-signed private trading, account, deposit and withdrawal endpoints) and WebSocket market feeds.

providers.name: Copa (Project Copacetic)
providers.description: Project Copacetic (Copa) is an open source command line tool that patches container images directly using BuildKit, without requiring a full image rebuild. Copa parses vulnerability scan reports from Trivy and other scanners, applies the corresponding OS package updates via the appropriate package manager (apt, apk, dnf, tdnf, yum, zypper), and produces a new container image with a patched layer. Copa supports multi-platform images, distroless images, and custom scanner plugins through the Vulnerability Exchange (VEX) and pluggable scanner interface.

providers.name: Credit Genie
providers.description: Credit Genie is a consumer fintech operated by Creditly Corp. (Wilmington, Delaware, founded 2019) that runs a mobile-first money app for people living between paychecks. Its Cash Boost product advances $10-$150 with no interest and no hard credit check, funded against a linked bank account rather than a credit score, while Money Manager layers spending tracking, cash-flow prediction and subscription detection on top of that same bank connection. A Line of Credit product and AskGenie, an AI financial assistant, are in early access. Creditly Corp. is registered with the California DFPI under the CCFPL (registration 04-CCFPL-1956127-3514680) and has raised roughly $21M from Fortress Investment Group, Khosla Ventures, Sutter Hill Ventures, Tippet Venture Partners and Gabriel Investments. Credit Genie is a direct-to-consumer app company: it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Crest Deployment Systems LLC
providers.description: Crest Deployment Systems LLC built AgentRank, a settlement-grounded reputation index for AI agents that scored x402 counterparties 0-1000 from real on-chain USDC settlement on Base, weighted by payer standing, and served it as a free read-only REST API, a hosted MCP server and an A2A agent on api.agentrank.info. The service is retired: the source repository is archived with the note "The hosted service no longer runs", the API host refuses connections, and the website's index pages fail, while the whitepaper, research papers, A2A agent card, llms.txt and four npm client packages remain published. Founded by Andy Salvo and Jameson Ackerman.

providers.name: Cryptio
providers.description: Cryptio is an enterprise-grade crypto accounting, reporting, and audit platform that provides an institutional system of record for digital assets. It ingests and normalizes transaction data across 150+ blockchains, exchanges, custodians, and DeFi protocols, then automates sub-ledger accounting, cost-basis and gain/loss calculation, reconciliation, tokenization compliance, and loan management. Cryptio syncs into traditional ERP and accounting systems (NetSuite, Xero, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Oracle Fusion, SAP, Sage) and is used by 400+ institutions including exchanges, banks, asset managers, and DeFi enterprises to produce audit-ready financial reporting for digital assets.

providers.name: cutGPT
providers.description: CutGPT is a free AI chat application available on iPhone, Android, and the web. It offers a ChatGPT‑like experience without subscription fees; ads fund the AI models and users can earn rewards redeemable via PayPal. The service provides a limited‑founder‑cut program and aims to democratize access to powerful language models.

providers.name: DalCor Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: DalCor Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, with offices in Zug, Switzerland, Leatherhead in the United Kingdom, and Sarasota, Florida. It is developing dalcetrapib, positioned as the first pharmacogenetic precision medicine in cardiovascular disease, targeted specifically at patients carrying the AA genotype at the rs1967309 variant of the ADCY9 gene — a genotype present in up to 20% of the general population and in more than 40% of populations of African ancestry. DalCor holds the worldwide exclusive license to develop, manufacture and commercialise dalcetrapib together with rights to the companion genetic marker. The compound is being evaluated in Dal-GenE-2 (DAL-302), a Phase 3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled cardiovascular outcomes confirmatory trial in 2,000 post-acute-coronary-syndrome patients with the ADCY9 AA genotype, coordinated by the Montreal Health Innovations Coordinating Centre and following the dal-GenE (DAL-301) trial, which showed a 21% relative risk reduction in fatal and non-fatal myocardial infarction across 6,149 patients in 34 countries. DalCor runs no developer program and publishes no product API; the only machine-readable surface it exposes is the anonymously readable WordPress REST content API behind dalcorpharma.com, which serves the bilingual English/French corporate site.

providers.name: DataGrail
providers.description: DataGrail is a San Francisco-based data privacy platform founded in 2018 by Daniel Barber and Ignacio Zendejas that helps enterprises automate privacy operations and manage regulatory compliance risk across GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regimes. The platform combines a Live Data Map for real-time visibility into where personal data lives across an organization's SaaS and cloud footprint, a Request Manager for orchestrating Data Subject Requests (access, deletion, opt-out) across thousands of downstream systems, a Consent solution for cookie and tracker compliance with automated enforcement, a Risk Management module for privacy and AI risk assessments (PIA, DPIA, AI risk), and an embedded agentic AI named Vera that surfaces context-aware recommendations across the platform. DataGrail exposes a documented public REST API at /api/v2 covering authentication, assessments, privacy requests, opt-out requests, integrations, webhooks, integration files, and consent audit logs, alongside an open-source ecosystem on GitHub that includes mobile Consent SDKs for iOS and Android, a Google Tag Manager consent template, and a Terraform AWS ECS module for deploying Request Manager Agents. The company serves enterprise customers including Salesforce, HubSpot, Okta, Netgear, and Dexcom, advertises 2,000+ pre-built integrations across CRM, marketing, communications, HR, data, e-commerce, and support platforms, holds patents on its Live Data Map and Smart Verification technology, is SOC 2 and ISO certified, and is backed by Felicis Ventures, HubSpot Ventures, Okta Ventures, Basis Set Ventures, Cloud Apps Capital, Operator Collective, Thomson Reuters Ventures, and Third Point Ventures.

providers.name: Dead Brands, LLC
providers.description: Dead Brands, LLC revives dead brands and offers ERP consulting for small businesses, specializing in SAP Business One and Odoo solutions. They provide AI and automation services, and host the Shark Bite Biz podcast, delivering real talk and results for entrepreneurs seeking growth and technology integration.

providers.name: Dragonfly Therapeutics
providers.description: Dragonfly Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Waltham, Massachusetts, founded in 2016 by Tyler Jacks, Bill Haney and David Raulet to develop natural killer (NK) cell-based immunotherapies. Its proprietary TriNKET (Tri-specific NK cell Engager Therapy) and cytokine engager platforms produce molecules that bind both a tumor or disease antigen and an NK cell activating receptor, recruiting innate and adaptive immunity against cancer, autoimmune disease, fibrosis and neuro-inflammation. Lead clinical candidate DF1001 targets HER2 in advanced solid tumors, and the platform is licensed under multi-target collaborations with AbbVie, Bristol Myers Squibb, Merck and Gilead. Dragonfly is a therapeutics developer rather than a software company: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract. The only agent-readable surfaces on its own host are the llms.txt and Model Context Protocol endpoint automatically provisioned by its Wix website platform.

providers.name: Expansive
providers.description: Expansive is a Mexican real estate crowdfunding platform (crowdfunding inmobiliario) that lets individuals invest collectively in vetted real estate projects from as little as 1,000 MXN, earning returns backed by real guarantees. It operates as a regulated collective financing institution (IFC) under Mexico's Fintech Law and is supervised by the CNBV (Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores). Expansive handles project vetting, funding, quarterly investor reporting, and payouts through its web platform and investor app (app.expansive.mx). The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It is a consumer-facing fintech investing product; it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Express
providers.description: Express is a fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js, providing a robust set of features for building web and mobile applications and APIs. Maintained under the OpenJS Foundation, Express is one of the most widely used HTTP server frameworks in the JavaScript ecosystem.

providers.name: Faro
providers.description: Faro Health is an AI platform for clinical development that helps biopharma and clinical research teams design and execute better studies. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Diego, California, Faro provides study design optimization, automated protocol document authoring, and clinical workflow automation, digitizing and structuring trial protocols so teams can accelerate development without compromising scientific rigor, patient safety, or patient-centricity. Faro is backed by investors including General Catalyst.

providers.name: Fishbrain
providers.description: Fishbrain is a Stockholm-based consumer technology company behind the largest social network and mobile app for recreational anglers, with a community of around 20 million fishermen and roughly 14 million logged catch locations. The app blends a social feed, a digital catch logbook with AI-powered species recognition, depth charts (from Garmin), local fishing reports with weather and bait intelligence, an AI-driven fishing-spot prediction map, and a searchable database of fishing regulations covering seasons, bag limits, and size rules. Fishbrain monetizes through a Fishbrain Pro subscription and is backed by Northzone and Seedcamp. It exposes no public developer API — api.fishbrain.com is a private backend for the iOS/Android apps — so this profile captures the company's public security, engineering, and web surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Floreo
providers.description: Floreo is a research-based virtual reality (VR) digital therapeutics company that delivers immersive lessons teaching social, behavioral, communication, and life skills to neurodiverse individuals, including autistic children and adults. The platform runs across mobile (iPhone with Google Cardboard) and standalone VR headsets (Meta Quest 2/3/Pro, PICO), with a companion clinician portal for supervised sessions, progress tracking, and telehealth-style delivery. Floreo holds an FDA Breakthrough Device designation and participates in the FDA Total Product Life Cycle Advisory Program (TAP), and works with schools, behavioral-health providers, Medicaid programs, and research partners. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Food Market Hub
providers.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.

providers.name: Fort
providers.description: Fort is a Y Combinator (W26) hardware startup building a screenless wearable that automatically tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Founded by three former Tesla engineers, the device uses heart rate and motion sensing to detect gym sessions, workout classes, sleep, and recovery without requiring the wearer to manually log reps, sets, or exercises, then delivers actionable feedback on how lifestyle factors affect strength progress. Fort is styled as jewelry rather than performance gear, ships in three finishes with 7+ day battery life, and pairs with Fort Foundations, an expert-led training program built around core movement patterns. The product is currently available for pre-order and has no public developer API or programmatic surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and commercial presence.

providers.name: Framewise Health
providers.description: Framewise Health is an AI-native patient engagement platform (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) that converts a patient's medical records into personalized, clinically-reviewed educational videos. The platform pulls patient data from electronic health records over any FHIR R4 endpoint, generates discharge and treatment-adherence education tailored to the individual using institutional protocols and drug-information databases, and delivers it by SMS in 75+ languages with no app and no login. It then tracks patient comprehension in real time, giving care teams engagement data to flag which patients need follow-up. Framewise integrates with Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), Athenahealth, ModMed, eClinicalWorks, and NextGen, and is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant with an AWS BAA and end-to-end encryption. It targets hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and private clinics seeking to improve patient outcomes and medication adherence.

providers.name: FreeWill
providers.description: FreeWill is an online estate-planning platform that lets people create legal documents for free, including last wills, revocable living trusts (California only), advance healthcare directives, financial powers of attorney, and beneficiary designations, through a guided questionnaire. It runs a dual model: individuals use the tools at no cost, while more than 2,400 nonprofit organizations partner with FreeWill for planned-giving and legacy-gift features. Related surfaces include the Estately advisor platform and a Nonprofit Solutions offering. FreeWill was surfaced as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital and qed-investors. Enrichment found no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or API documentation — this profile is a consumer/nonprofit company record, not an API producer, with security and legal properties captured from the public site.

providers.name: Fueloyal
providers.description: Fueloyal is an automotive IoT and connected-vehicle platform company that builds proprietary IoT gateway hardware and software for fleet management, fuel management, predictive maintenance, dual dash cameras, EV services, and OEM connected-vehicle solutions. Its products help fleets and vehicle manufacturers monitor, connect, and service vehicles, with an OEM connected-platform and marketplace for delivering connected-vehicle services and mobile apps. Backed by Techstars, Fueloyal was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Gatheround
providers.description: Gatheround (formerly Icebreaker) is a video meeting platform for engaging, interactive, and inclusive virtual gatherings — team all-hands, onboarding, workshops, learning sessions, and community events. It layers structured agendas, breakout rooms, group shares, Q&A, polls, quizzes, and photo booths on top of video, with recording, moderation, upvoting, and ready-made templates aimed at people-operations, community, and team leaders. Founded in 2018 and backed by Bloomberg Beta and Salesforce Ventures, Gatheround was acquired by Donut in December 2024. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: General Magic
providers.description: General Magic provides an AI operating system for insurance brokerages, delivering insurance‑specific artificial intelligence that automates underwriting, servicing, and quality assurance. Their platform enables brokerages to deploy AI agents across messaging channels, improving customer experience, reducing manual effort, and scaling operations without expanding staff. The company focuses on modernizing insurance workflows with AI‑driven insights and automation, targeting the insurance industry’s unique regulatory and operational challenges.

providers.name: Ghostfolio
providers.description: Ghostfolio is an open source wealth management software built with modern web technologies. It enables individuals to track stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies, providing data‑driven insights for personal investment decisions. The platform offers a self‑hosted version and a premium cloud service, supporting continuous portfolio monitoring and financial planning.

providers.name: Gobble
providers.description: Gobble is a meal-kit delivery service that ships chef-prepped dinner kits designed to be cooked in about fifteen minutes, marketed as "restaurant-level delicious in minutes." The company preps and portions seasonal ingredients before shipping them in refrigerated boxes to customers' doorsteps, and offers three flexible subscription plans - Classic, Lean & Clean (650 calories or less, low carb, lean proteins), and Vegetarian - with no long-term commitment. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Gobble operates a direct-to-consumer subscription business and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or developer documentation. This profile captures its public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: golem-team
providers.description: Golem (golem.team), AI Detection and Response for coding agents. Golem sits in the path of every tool call: it detects hijacked agents, blocks or gates the dangerous calls before they run, contains a compromised machine, and signs the evidence so the record can’t be edited afterward. Free public preview.

providers.name: Group 1 Automotive
providers.description: Group 1 Automotive (NYSE: GPI) is an international Fortune 500 automotive retailer operating automotive dealerships, collision centers and service departments across the United States, the United Kingdom and Brazil, representing more than 35 vehicle brands. Group 1 does not operate a public developer program, but it does publish an AI-agent-facing surface: an llms.txt on www.group1auto.com and on its AcceleRide digital-retail site www.shopgroup1.com, each advertising a documented, parameterized, server-rendered vehicle-inventory browse endpoint at /llm/inventory/ that returns live new and used inventory (VIN, year, model, trim, mileage, price) without JavaScript, authentication, or an API key. There is no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, MCP server, agent card, SDK or partner API reference published anywhere on the company's own hosts.

providers.name: hampr
providers.description: hampr is an app-based, on-demand laundry pickup and delivery service founded by Laurel Hess and backed by Techstars. Members bag their dirty laundry, tap the hampr mobile app, and a local independent "washr" collects, professionally washes, dries, folds, and returns it to their door within 24 hours at flat-rate per-load pricing with free pickup and delivery. hampr operates across 16+ US states with 1,500+ washrs, 11,000+ members, and 300,000+ loads completed, and also runs hampr for business, a commercial laundry solution for salons, spas, gyms, and short-term rentals. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; hampr is a consumer/commercial mobile service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: HandUp
providers.description: HandUp is a San Francisco-based public-benefit crowdfunding platform that makes giving to nonprofit organizations and the people they serve easy, secure, and transparent. Launched in 2013 and backed by 500 Global and Version One Ventures, HandUp partners with 501(c)(3) nonprofits whose mission is to serve people experiencing poverty and homelessness. Donors give directly to individual campaigns or to pooled funds such as the National Fund and the HandUp Fund; partner nonprofits then distribute the donations to cover basics like food, clothing, and housing, and report progress and metrics back to donors.

providers.name: Headlight
providers.description: Headlight is a US mental health services company delivering teletherapy, in-person therapy, psychiatry, and medication management through a clinician-centered care model. Founded by Drs. Manish Sheth and Shashita Inamdar, it helps patients move from initial interest to a well-matched therapist or prescriber with less friction, treating conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, bipolar disorder, PTSD, trauma, OCD, panic disorder, postpartum depression, and insomnia. Headlight is in-network with major insurers (Aetna, Blue Cross, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Humana, Kaiser, Moda) and operates across Alaska, California, Colorado, Oregon, Texas, and Washington. The company raised $18M led by Matrix and EPIC Ventures. This is a consumer clinical services provider with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Helpling
providers.description: Helpling is an online marketplace that connects households with vetted, insured independent cleaners for on-demand and recurring home-cleaning services. Founded in Berlin and operating across 200+ cities in Germany and other European markets, the platform lets customers compare cleaner profiles and ratings, book and reschedule appointments, and pay online, with liability insurance covering each booking. Helpling operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile app product (iOS and Android) plus separate provider and agency portals; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. It was surfaced through the point-nine venture portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: hobbyDB
providers.description: hobbyDB is a database and marketplace for collectibles — a platform that lets anyone catalog, offer, buy, and sell just about any collectible (Funko Pops, action figures, trading cards, die-cast, and more) at any time, from anywhere, in auction-style or fixed-price formats. It pairs a community-curated reference database of collectible items and variants with personal collection-management tools (lists, condition and grading tracking, pre-orders, trades, and import/export) and a peer-to-peer marketplace for transactions between collectors. hobbyDB is a Techstars-backed company.

providers.name: Homage
providers.description: Homage is a Singapore-headquartered holistic health and caregiving platform that connects families with screened, professional caregivers, nurses, and therapists to deliver personal care, home nursing procedures, rehabilitation, and health services where people live. Founded in 2016, Homage operates across Singapore, Malaysia, and Australia through consumer mobile apps and a care-management operations platform, offering flexible on-demand and recurring visits, care assessments, custom care plans, and teleconsultations for conditions such as dementia, stroke recovery, and post-surgical care. Homage does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web properties and probed domain security.

providers.name: Honeyhomes
providers.description: Honey Homes is a home-maintenance membership service that pairs each member with a dedicated, vetted handyman who handles repairs, upgrades, seasonal upkeep, and preventive maintenance around the house. Members book visits, add tasks, receive photo updates, and stay connected to their handyman and team through a companion mobile app. Founded in 2021 by Vishwas and Avantika Prabhakara and backed by Khosla Ventures, the company operates as a licensed, bonded, and insured General Contractor and serves select California and Texas markets including the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; the company exposes a consumer mobile app but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Hyperganic
providers.description: Hyperganic is a Munich- and Singapore-based deep-tech software company building algorithmic engineering technology for additive manufacturing (3D printing). Its flagship product, HyDesign, is a browser-based application for creating, customizing, and optimizing 3D-printed latticed parts, combining implicit (meshless) modeling with validated materials and cloud simulation. Capabilities include lattice grading, TPMS structures, shell/offset and emboss/skin editing, image modulation, meshless linear-elastic simulation, topology optimization, and Lattice Boltzmann CFD. It serves lightweighting, thermal management, metamaterials, mass customization, tooling, and bioengineering use cases across aerospace, automotive, and sports. Backed by HV Capital. Hyperganic does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Italic
providers.description: Italic is a direct-to-consumer home goods brand founded in 2018, bringing Mediterranean-inspired beauty to everyday living. The company sells premium bedding, bath towels and robes, beach cabana towels, cashmere throws, decor, and kitchenware (chef knives and flatware), organized into themed collections such as Havana, Amalfi, and Riviera. Italic operates a membership program, "Italic Bold," and runs a Shopify-based storefront with a customer help center, wholesale and trade programs, and an active blog. Backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Kindred Ventures, Italic is a consumer e-commerce retailer with no public developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Joor
providers.description: JOOR is a New York-based SaaS company (founded 2010) operating a leading B2B wholesale fashion commerce platform and digital marketplace that connects fashion brands with retailers to run their wholesale business end to end. The platform digitizes wholesale buying with online linesheets, lookbooks, virtual showrooms, order management, and the JOOR Marketplace, alongside products such as JOOR Pay (wholesale payments), JOOR Passport (virtual trade shows), and Retail data/analytics. JOOR connects thousands of brands with hundreds of thousands of retail doors globally. Its production platform is fronted by a Kong API gateway and secured with Keycloak-based OpenID Connect authentication; API access is partner/integration-oriented rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was enriched from JOOR's live public surface (OIDC discovery, GitHub organization, and status page).

providers.name: Joya Communications
providers.description: Joya Communications Inc. is the consumer software company behind Marco Polo, a video chat application for asynchronous, personal video messaging with the people who matter most. Marco Polo positions itself as a privacy-first alternative to social media, with no ads, no public feeds, and no social engagement metrics, and offers a Marco Polo Plus subscription with premium features. Joya Communications is venture-backed (Battery Ventures) and, as a consumer mobile app company, does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Kismet
providers.description: Kismet is an Australian digital-health marketplace that connects people with disability — primarily National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) participants — to verified, available service providers across occupational therapy, speech therapy, physiotherapy, support coordination and plan management. The platform pairs a searchable provider marketplace and care index with a Concierge AI matching service that builds a shortlist of suitable, available providers within 48 hours, alongside budget-tracking and plan-management tools for participants. Kismet is backed by Prosus Ventures and ships consumer iOS and Android apps. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Linxup
providers.description: Linxup provides GPS fleet tracking, dash cam solutions, and asset management tools for businesses. Their platform offers real‑time vehicle location, driver safety monitoring, equipment tracking, and compliance reporting, helping companies improve operational efficiency and reduce costs. The service includes a web portal and mobile apps for fleet managers to activate devices, view dashboards, and integrate with third‑party systems.

providers.name: LLM Scout
providers.description: LLM Scout provides offline-first verification of large language model (LLM) powered system behavior before production trust or deployment. It helps teams ensure AI outputs are safe, accurate, and aligned with expectations, offering tools to test prompts, monitor responses, and enforce compliance across the development lifecycle.

providers.name: mcpservers.org
providers.description: MCP Servers (mcpservers.org) provides a curated marketplace of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that enable AI agents to interact with a wide range of tools and services. The site lists official and community‑run MCP integrations for productivity, development, data access, web scraping, cloud services, and more, each with documentation and quick‑start guides. It serves as a hub for agents to discover, connect, and leverage specialized MCP servers across domains such as finance, design, communication, and storage, facilitating seamless tool integration for large language models.

providers.name: MedHOK (Hearst Communications)
providers.description: MHK (formerly MedHOK), part of Hearst Health, is a healthcare technology company providing a unified SaaS platform for health plans and payers. Its CareProminence suite spans utilization management, care management, complaints/appeals and grievances, pharmacy management, population health and quality management, and interoperability (the MHK Interop Suite), while its MarketProminence suite covers enrollment and member maintenance, premium billing, financial reconciliation, and member web portals. MHK helps Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plans streamline operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the member experience. The MHK Interop Suite supports FHIR, SMART on FHIR, Da Vinci, and CMS-0057 interoperability requirements. MHK publishes HITRUST and ISO 27001 certification and NCQA prevalidation. The company operates a public marketing and resource site but does not publish a public developer portal or API program.

providers.name: Moneybox
providers.description: Moneybox is a London-based digital wealth management company, operating as Digital Moneybox Limited, whose mobile app helps people in the United Kingdom save and invest — round-ups on everyday spending, Stocks & Shares ISAs, Cash ISAs, Lifetime ISAs, general investment accounts, savings accounts and personal pensions including pension consolidation. It is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and appears in the UK Open Banking app directory as an account aggregator, meaning it CONSUMES bank open banking APIs to read customer transactions rather than publishing an API of its own. As profiled on 2026-08-26, Moneybox runs no public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK, sandbox or partner API surface exists on any Moneybox-controlled host. The one machine-readable artifact it publishes is an RFC 9116 security.txt served from every moneyboxapp.com host.

providers.name: mudko-com
providers.description: Mudko provides an Agent Ready Kit that enables AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to interact with a business website. The service scans, fixes, and generates agent‑callable files, offering a three‑step process: scanning the site, deploying agent‑ready files (via WordPress plugin, Cloudflare Worker, or direct deployment), and verifying the agent readiness level. Mudko’s platform aims to improve customer engagement by allowing AI agents to answer queries, book services, and provide quotes directly from the website, positioning itself as a bridge between traditional web content and conversational AI interfaces.

providers.name: MyBuilder
providers.description: MyBuilder is a UK online marketplace that connects homeowners with local, reviewed tradespeople for home improvement, repair and maintenance work. Founded in 2004 by stonemason Ryan Notz and headquartered in London, the platform lets homeowners post a job for free, review interested tradespeople by their profiles, work history and customer feedback, and shortlist the ones they want to hire. Tradespeople browse leads for free and pay a fee only when a customer shortlists them. MyBuilder was acquired by IAC's HomeAdvisor in 2017 and now operates as part of the Instapro Group of European home-services marketplaces. MyBuilder is a consumer-facing web platform and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, security and domain posture.

providers.name: MyFavorito
providers.description: MyFavorito is a fan-empowered sports sponsorship platform that turns fan loyalty into revenue for sports clubs. Fans choose their favorite club, brands activate campaigns, and clubs earn money through a digital marketplace that connects sponsors, clubs, and supporters. The platform combines sponsorship, fan engagement, and CRM tooling for grassroots clubs, top clubs, and brands. Backed by 500 Global and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api/developer/docs host, OpenAPI, well-known, or llms.txt), so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Naboo
providers.description: Naboo is Reasoning Layer infrastructure for enterprise AI agents, built on a Decision Graph that models how a company actually decides, ships, and unblocks - who decided what, what triggered each decision, what blocks it, and what depends on it - across code, tickets, pull requests, docs, Slack, runtime, and internal services. Any AI agent in the organization queries the graph in GraphQL, or through an MCP server that turns plain intent into a structured query, and gets a structured answer instead of a list of search results. Naboo deploys on-premise or in a customer VPC with zero data egress, integrates with any LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral) and agentic framework (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI), and enforces existing role-based access controls at retrieval time. Founded in 2023 by Gilad Salinger (CEO) and Dror Wolmer (CTO), with production customers Global-E (NASDAQ: GLBE) and Melio.

providers.name: nference
providers.description: nference is a healthcare-AI company that builds an agentic intelligence layer for clinical research and drug development. Its nSights platform aggregates and analyzes de-identified multimodal patient data at massive scale — 1.4 billion+ clinical notes, 10 billion+ radiology images, 20 million+ digitized pathology whole-slide images, 12 million+ ECG waveforms, and 100 million+ echocardiogram videos — extracting 30,000+ clinical biomarkers to help life-sciences and health-system partners design patient cohorts, explore patient journeys, annotate data for model development, and run advanced data-science workflows across cardiology, oncology, immunology, rare diseases, neurology, infectious diseases, and nephrology. nference spun out the venture companies Anumana (ECG-based biomarker discovery) and Pramana (digital pathology). The company operates as an enterprise B2B platform with no public self-serve API; it is profiled here for its security, compliance, and governance posture. Backed by Matrix Partners.

providers.name: OpenSponsorship
providers.description: OpenSponsorship is a two-sided sports sponsorship and influencer marketing marketplace that connects brands with a network of more than 25,000 professional athletes, teams, sports creators, and health and wellness influencers across 150+ sports. Brands pay a monthly subscription to search the roster, post campaigns, submit proposals, manage contracts, and track ROI, while athletes and their agents join for free with OpenSponsorship taking a commission on secured deals. The platform layers AI-based matching, social-content search, campaign management, and reporting on top of a managed service that handles matching, outreach, contracts, and reporting. OpenSponsorship exposes no public developer API at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Oze
providers.description: Oze is an African fintech platform on a mission to help small businesses grow, with a stated vision of building 100 million profitable businesses. Operating across Ghana, Nigeria, Rwanda, and Madagascar, Oze offers a Business App for bookkeeping, invoicing, inventory management, and online sales; no-collateral SME loans; and lending-management software that banks and microfinance institutions use to issue loans to small businesses. The company reports serving over 300,000 businesses. Oze is backed by Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. At the time of this enrichment pass Oze publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Pepper Content
providers.description: Pepper (formerly Pepper Content, peppercontent.io, now pepper.inc) is a content-led growth platform that combines content strategy, AI technology, and a network of subject-matter-expert creators to help brands build predictable organic growth across search (SEO), generative-engine optimization (GEO), social, and creative. Its offerings span SEO/GEO visibility, expert-produced content (ebooks, whitepapers, blogs, thought leadership), creative and video production, and agentic AI workflows that automate content operations. The company reports serving 2,500+ brands including Amazon, Google, Atlassian, and HSBC. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Pepper runs a real first-party API gateway at hub.peppercontent.io (Kong 3.6.1) fronting a pepper-editor-service, a user-service and an atlas-service, and its openapi.json route exists but answers 401 "Session Expired" to anyone without a product session — so the contract is gated, not absent. Pepper publishes no developer portal, no documentation, no SDK, no pricing and no /.well-known discovery document; the only publicly documented integration surface is a single Zapier trigger, and access is granted through a sales demo.

providers.name: Pilot
providers.description: Pilot provides bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for startups and small businesses, pairing purpose-built financial software with a team of finance experts and former operators. Its offerings include monthly bookkeeping, corporate tax preparation and filing, R&D tax credit studies, fractional CFO and COO support, and stock administration. Pilot serves venture-backed startups and growing SMBs, integrating with accounting and payroll tools to deliver accurate books and financial reporting. Pilot is backed by CRV, Foundry Group, Index Ventures, SV Angel, Techstars, and Union Square Ventures. As of this profile Pilot does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its product is delivered as a managed service through its web application.

providers.name: Prenuvo
providers.description: Prenuvo operates a preventive healthcare screening service built around whole-body MRI imaging paired with blood biomarker panels and personalized results reviews. A single scan captures on the order of a billion data points while screening for hundreds of conditions across major organ systems, without radiation or contrast agents, and completes in under an hour. Blood panels measure 80+ biomarkers tied to inflammation, hormone levels, and metabolic health, with optional advanced imaging for brain, heart, and body composition. Prenuvo runs clinics across the US, Canada, Australia, and the UK, and works with research institutions including Mount Sinai, UCLA, Johns Hopkins, Stanford, and Penn. Prenuvo does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: RedCircle
providers.description: RedCircle is a podcast advertising, hosting, and monetization platform founded in 2018 that turns podcast host-read endorsements into measurable results for brands and creators. For podcasters it provides podcast hosting, RSS distribution to directories, dynamic ad insertion, a cross-promotions marketplace, instant payouts, automated transcript and video generation, and audience analytics. For brands it operates a fully managed host-read ad platform that pairs proprietary data with authentic creator voices to run and measure campaigns at scale. RedCircle also documents OpenRAP, its remote ad-pipeline / VAST configuration for dynamic ad insertion. The platform is offered as SaaS tiers (Growth, Pro, and Enterprise) rather than as a public developer API; there is no published developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: Regression Games
providers.description: Regression Games builds AI agents and bots for video games. Its platform lets studios create bots for QA testing, multiplayer simulation, game balancing, and NPC behavior with minimal code. The Unity SDK (gg.regression.unity.bots / RGUnityBots) adds AI-driven automated playtesting, UI and screenshot regression testing, replay and validation, and CI/CD integration for Unity projects, while the earlier rg-bot JavaScript/TypeScript/Python libraries let developers program bots for Minecraft and Capture-the-Flag tournaments. Distribution is via open-source SDKs and templates on GitHub rather than a hosted public REST API. Backed by a16z and NEA ($4.2M seed, 2022).

providers.name: Remoov
providers.description: Remoov is a San Francisco-based full-service removal, resale, donation, and recycling company that helps households and businesses declutter by picking up unwanted furniture and goods, then reselling them on consignment (via reperch.com), donating them to charities, or recycling them responsibly. Customers schedule a pickup, receive a quote, and earn a share of resale proceeds. Remoov also serves realtors, stagers, property managers, and living communities as partners. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; Remoov publishes a consumer web app and help desk but no public developer API.

providers.name: Rinse
providers.description: Rinse is a laundry and dry cleaning delivery service that picks up customers' clothes from home, professionally cleans them, and returns them on a recurring or one-off schedule. It runs a wash & fold and dry cleaning model in which uniformed valets handle evening pickup and delivery (typically 7pm-10pm) across major U.S. metros including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington D.C., Boston, Seattle, and Austin, plus Toronto. Rinse emphasizes convenience, garment care, sustainability, and employing its valets as W-2 employees with benefits. The company is backed by Partech and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Rinse publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Summer Health
providers.description: Summer Health is a pediatric health company offering families fast, board-certified pediatric care. Its flagship consumer service provides comprehensive at-home blood work for children ages 8-18 (one blood draw covering 74 biomarkers) reviewed by board-certified pediatricians over video, alongside text-based urgent-care messaging with pediatric clinicians. The service is HSA/FSA eligible and LegitScript-approved. Summer Health is a consumer-facing telehealth offering and does not currently publish a public developer program, API documentation, or third-party integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Sunflower Labs
providers.description: Sunflower Labs is an innovative technology company focused on developing advanced AI-driven solutions for agricultural optimization. Founded with the mission to empower farmers through data-driven insights, Sunflower Labs offers a suite of APIs that provide real-time environmental monitoring, crop health analytics, and predictive yield modeling. Backed by leading venture capital firms including Sequoia Capital, the company leverages cutting‑edge machine learning and IoT sensor integration to deliver actionable recommendations that improve sustainability, increase productivity, and reduce resource waste across the agricultural sector. Their platform integrates seamlessly with existing farm management systems, offering developers robust documentation, SDKs, and support to build custom applications that drive the future of smart farming.

providers.name: Teal Health
providers.description: Teal Health, Inc. is a women's health company behind the Teal Wand, the first and only FDA-approved at-home self-collection device for cervical cancer screening in the United States. Its end-to-end telehealth service pairs the self-collection kit with virtual Teal medical providers who prescribe the kit, review Roche cobas HPV lab results, and support patients aged 25-65 throughout the screening experience. Now available in all 50 states, Teal Health runs a HIPAA-compliant direct-to-consumer telehealth platform and is a consumer of third-party healthcare APIs (Healthie for scheduling/telehealth, Candid for billing) rather than a publisher of a public developer API.

providers.name: The Mom Project
providers.description: The Mom Project is a talent marketplace that connects skilled professionals (with a focus on mothers and caregivers) to remote, hybrid, and onsite roles at family-friendly employers. The platform pairs a community of hundreds of thousands of vetted candidates with thousands of companies through job matching, curated talent search, and managed hiring services such as pay-per-hire and access plans. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, The Mom Project operates a consumer/employer web product and consumes third-party APIs (for example a Docusign eSignature integration for hiring workflows) but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable API surface of its own.

providers.name: TipLink
providers.description: TipLink is a Solana wallet-link platform that lets anyone create a shareable link or QR code holding crypto or an NFT, so a recipient can claim digital assets without first setting up a wallet. It ships as first-party TypeScript/JavaScript SDKs (notably @tiplink/api) and Solana Wallet Adapter UI components rather than a hosted REST API, and is used for airdrops, tipping, payments, and onboarding new users to Solana. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: usetyton-com
providers.description: Tyton is a Meta Pixel and Conversions API management platform that connects to AI agents to automate the setup, testing, and monitoring of Facebook tracking. It offers a free tier for one site with up to 10,000 events per month and paid plans for larger volumes, providing a dashboard, email support, and tools such as a Pixel checker. The service is operated by Kitra LLC under the brand Tyton and is hosted at usetyton.com.

providers.name: Vertice
providers.description: Vertice is an intelligent procurement platform built for the modern enterprise with agentic workflows, AI insights, and expert buyers that empower finance and procurement teams across 30+ countries to buy smarter and scale faster. The platform covers SaaS purchasing and contract management, cloud spend optimization (AWS, GCP, Azure), and integrates with ERPs, CLMs, ticketing platforms, communication tools, TPRM systems, and SSOs to centralize procurement workflows. Vertice processes over $30B in spend with proven 20%+ savings for customers including ARM, Blackberry, Factorial, and Santander.

providers.name: WGL Holdings
providers.description: WGL Holdings was an integrated energy holding company headquartered in Washington, D.C., serving over 1 million customers across the District of Columbia, Maryland, and Virginia. Its operations spanned regulated natural gas distribution (Washington Gas), retail energy marketing (WGL Energy Services), commercial energy systems, and midstream energy services (WGL Midstream, Hampshire Gas). WGL Holdings was acquired by AltaGas on July 6, 2018, and continues to operate as a subsidiary.

providers.name: Whatifi
providers.description: Whatifi is a visual financial modeling and scenario planning platform for small and medium businesses, letting founders, fractional CFOs, VFX and gaming studios, and startups model, forecast, and share runway, staffing, capacity, and profit scenarios without spreadsheets or formulas. The product uses an event-based canvas of 30+ pre-built business logic "Events" to build and compare "what if" forecasts in real time, and connects to accounting and banking data through integrations with Excel, Google Sheets, Xero, QuickBooks, Plaid, Railz, and OpenAI. Whatifi is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Whatifi publishes a marketing site, a Notion-hosted help center, and a web application, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: ZenBusiness
providers.description: ZenBusiness is a business formation and compliance platform that helps entrepreneurs start, run, and grow their companies. It offers LLC and corporation formation, registered-agent service, annual-report and compliance management, EIN/tax filing, business banking and bookkeeping, domain registration, and website building, alongside an AI business guide called Velo. ZenBusiness is a direct-to-consumer/SMB service with no publicly documented developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 1stdibs
providers.description: 1stDibs is an online marketplace for luxury antiques, vintage and modern furniture, fine art, jewelry, watches, and fashion. It connects a global network of vetted sellers and design dealers with buyers seeking curated, authenticated high-end goods, backed by purchase-protection and authenticity guarantees. 1stDibs does not operate a public REST/OpenAPI developer program; its documented machine-facing surface is an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, registered as com.1stdibs/1stDibs, that lets agents browse and search the marketplace.

providers.name: Agrus
providers.description: Agrus provides private LLM compliance engineering services, helping enterprises deploy AI agents within their own secure perimeter. Their offerings include compliance audits, self‑hosted LLM deployments, and industry‑specific solutions for healthcare, insurance, legal, private equity, and more. Agrus emphasizes data residency, security certifications such as HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and compliance with regulations like the EU AI Act.

providers.name: Aiurion
providers.description: Aiurion provides same-day FDM 3D printing services in San Francisco, offering a range of high-performance materials such as carbon fiber reinforced nylon, PETG, ASA, and flexible TPU. Customers can upload CAD files in formats like STL, OBJ, STEP, and 3MF to receive instant quotes and rapid turnaround, typically within 24‑48 hours. The service includes on‑site support, engineering consultation, and a transparent pricing model with a $100 minimum per job. Aiurion operates from a secure, air‑gapped production facility, ensuring IP confidentiality for hardware startups, robotics teams, and engineers.

providers.name: AlgoTrada
providers.description: AlgoTrada builds trading technology for professional financial markets, offering a platform that connects to crypto exchanges, runs rule‑based strategies, and includes a kill‑switch to protect capital. The system supports multiple exchanges, provides tiered pricing, and operates as software‑as‑a‑service without custodial responsibilities. It emphasizes transparency, real‑time monitoring, and AI‑driven optimization, aiming to democratize algorithmic trading for both individual and institutional users.

providers.name: All Sports API
providers.description: All Sports API is a fast, reliable, and comprehensive sports data API providing livescore feeds, fixtures, standings, and historical data for major sports worldwide. The platform offers JSON pull-based APIs for football (soccer), basketball, cricket, and tennis, with hockey, baseball, and American football available as additional sports. The API base URL is apiv2.allsportsapi.com and uses API key authentication with sport-specific endpoints accessed via the met query parameter. All Sports API also provides free embeddable widgets (results, fixtures, standings, livescore) and WordPress plugins. Plans include a 14-day free trial.

providers.name: Altair AI
providers.description: Altair AI is a financial and AI consulting firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area. They provide market research, AI tool integration, and custom AI workspaces backed by proprietary equity research and market indicators. Their services help teams read markets and deploy AI solutions, offering research agents, indicators, and a workspace platform for AI-driven workflows.

providers.name: Altvia
providers.description: Altvia is fund management software purpose-built for private capital markets, serving private equity, venture capital, fund of funds, real estate, hedge funds, family offices, and placement agents. Built on the Salesforce platform, Altvia unifies a purpose-built CRM, a virtual data room (VDR) and LP investor portal, analytics and reporting, and an AI assistant (AIMe) into one system that spans the full fund lifecycle — capital raising, investor relations, and deal management. Founded in 2006 and based in Broomfield, Colorado, Altvia was acquired by Marlin Equity Partners in 2022. The company exposes no public developer/API portal; integrations are delivered through the platform and the Salesforce ecosystem.

providers.name: BBVA
providers.description: BBVA API_Market is the open banking platform of BBVA, offering a comprehensive suite of APIs that enable businesses to integrate financial services, create digital ecosystems, and comply with regulations such as PSD2. The platform provides APIs for treasury management, digital ecosystems, regulatory compliance, and a variety of payment services across multiple countries, fostering innovation, digital transformation, and new business models for enterprises worldwide.

providers.name: Bold Security
providers.description: Bold Security provides real-time, on-device (endpoint) data security. Its on-device AI classifies data interactions across every application in real time and detects and prevents user- and AI-agent-driven data exfiltration before sensitive data leaves the endpoint, without requiring policy configuration or cloud round-trips. The platform gives security teams visibility into data movement, intent and risky-behavior analysis, and full-context investigation across employees and AI agents.
