Bold Security is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 compliant, and is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, specification, or SDK; this entry captures its identity, security posture, and public properties.

providers.name: BrainHQ
providers.description: BrainHQ, from Posit Science, offers a cloud‑based brain‑training platform with scientifically validated exercises to improve cognition, memory, attention, and overall brain health. Users can access personalized training programs, track progress, and benefit from research‑backed content across multiple devices.

providers.name: Byte
providers.description: Byte Technology provides a platform that helps businesses combat labor shortages and improve customer delight by offering fresh food and retail services on-demand. Their solutions span food service, retail, vending, hospitality, healthcare, education, and workplace environments, delivering data‑driven intelligence to maximize revenue and minimize costs. Byte aims to support growth for retailers and service providers through smart monitoring and flexible staffing solutions.

providers.name: Cadence Solutions
providers.description: Cadence Solutions, Inc. — operating as Cadence — is a New York-based clinical AI and remote patient monitoring company founded in 2020 by Chris Altchek. Cadence partners with large health systems and payers to deliver continuous chronic-care management between clinic visits: FDA-cleared connected devices (blood pressure cuffs, glucometers, weight scales) stream daily vitals to a 24/7 clinical care team backed by supervised AI agents that flag out-of-range readings, close care gaps, and escalate to clinicians for medication titration. The platform covers hypertension, type 2 diabetes, heart failure and COPD, is integrated two-way into partner EHRs (Epic, Oracle Cerner, athenahealth), and supports Medicare RPM/CCM and the CMS ACCESS model. Cadence serves more than 100,000 patients across systems including Community Health Systems, LifePoint Health, Providence, Rush, MemorialCare, Corewell Health, Ardent Health and Duke Health. It raised a $100M Series C led by Spark Capital in June 2026 ($241M total, ~$1.23B valuation). Cadence publishes no public developer program or API: EHR interoperability is delivered as bilateral health system integrations, not a self-serve API surface.

providers.name: Cantor Fitzgerald
providers.description: Cantor Fitzgerald, L.P. is a privately held global financial services firm founded in 1945 by Bernard Gerald Cantor and John Fitzgerald, headquartered in New York with more than 12,000 employees across 60+ offices in 20+ countries. The firm is a U.S. Federal Reserve primary dealer and operates investment banking, fixed-income and equities trading, prime brokerage, commercial real-estate lending (CCRE / Cantor Fitzgerald Income Trust), asset management, a SPAC franchise (Cantor Equity Partners), and corporate-venture investing (Cantor Ventures, Hollywood Stock Exchange). Cantor spun out its voice-brokerage business in 2004 to form BGC Partners (now BGC Group, NASDAQ: BGC), which in turn acquired Newmark in 2011 and spun it out as Newmark Group (NASDAQ: NMRK) in 2017. Long-time chairman/CEO Howard Lutnick became the 41st U.S. Secretary of Commerce on February 18, 2025; his sons Brandon and Kyle Lutnick assumed chairman and executive vice chairman roles, with Pascal Bandelier, Sage Kelly, and Christian Wall serving as co-CEOs. Cantor has no public developer portal — all electronic-trading, market-data, and prime-brokerage connectivity is delivered B2B under institutional client agreements; the closest public data surface is Fenics Market Data, sold by BGC affiliate Fenics under negotiated entitlement.

providers.name: CCXT
providers.description: CCXT is an open-source (MIT) cryptocurrency trading library that wraps the public and private APIs of 100+ crypto exchanges and prediction markets behind one unified API, in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, C#, Go, Java and Rust (npm ccxt 4.5.85). It is a client library, not a hosted HTTP API: there is no CCXT server endpoint and no OpenAPI. It also ships a local stdio MCP server (npm ccxt-mcp), a CLI, and AI coding skills.

providers.name: Cents
providers.description: Cents is an all-in-one laundry business management platform for laundromats and dry cleaners. It combines point of sale, self-service machine payment systems, wash-and-fold order management, online ordering, pickup-and-delivery route management, memberships and recurring billing, inventory tracking, team management, marketing tools, customer-facing websites, commercial invoicing, and reporting and financial tools into a single operating system for local laundry businesses. Cents also offers an AI Receptionist team and laundry-first insurance, and has acquired Insight Systems and Laundroworks to extend support for dry cleaners and card-based self-service payment technology.

providers.name: Charter Communications
providers.description: Charter Communications, operating under the Spectrum brand, is the second-largest cable operator in the United States serving more than 32 million customers across 41 states. Charter offers REST APIs for enterprise network provisioning, service account management, broadband diagnostics, customer support ticket automation, and circuit serviceability. The Spectrum Enterprise Open API enables B2B integrations for ticketing, circuit management, and network operations. Charter's Bryte IQ platform, built on the Linux Foundation's CAMARA framework, provides NaaS (Network-as-a-Service) APIs enabling third-party developers to build services that interact with Charter's wired and wireless networks, including connected device visibility, CPE management, and home network support.

providers.name: ClaraConverts
providers.description: ClaraConverts provides an AI-powered virtual employee that engages website visitors in real-time chat and voice, capturing leads, booking appointments, handling service requests, and driving e‑commerce conversions. It integrates with major CRMs, calendars, and shopping platforms, offering a one‑line install for WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace and more, with plans for agencies, multi‑site businesses, and enterprises.

providers.name: Clarity AI
providers.description: Clarity AI is a sustainability technology and fintech company that provides AI-powered extra-financial intelligence for financial decision-making. Its platform delivers ESG risk ratings, climate and physical-risk analytics, regulatory-compliance reporting (EU Taxonomy, SFDR, MiFID II, ESMA fund naming, Pillar 3), impact and UN SDG alignment, and retail-banking climate engagement tools. Clarity AI reports coverage of 300K+ listed and private companies, 450K+ funds, and 400+ sovereigns, and serves asset managers, asset owners, banks, wealth managers, and corporates. The company exposes its data through a web application, data feeds, APIs, and emerging AI agent / MCP integrations, though its developer surface is gated behind an enterprise platform login rather than a public developer portal. Clarity AI is a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: coachhub
providers.description: CoachHub is a global digital coaching platform (headquartered in Berlin) that lets enterprises deliver scalable, measurable one-to-one coaching to their entire workforce through web and mobile apps. Its network spans 3,500+ certified business coaches across 90+ countries with sessions in 80+ languages, matched to learners via AI, and it ships an AI coaching companion (AIMY). CoachHub serves 1,000+ enterprise clients and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Sofina, HV Capital, Partech and Speedinvest. It offers an account-managed integration approach (SSO, automated provisioning and data sync) with HR/LMS systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle, Ceridian and Microsoft Teams, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs or GitHub repositories. The platform is ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 Type II, TISAX and PCI DSS Level 1 certified and GDPR/CCPA compliant.

providers.name: CodeKarma
providers.description: CodeKarma is a production intelligence platform that maps 100% of production traffic directly to source code, giving engineering teams and AI agents code-level visibility into how software actually behaves in production. Its products include KarmaLens (an IDE plugin for JetBrains and VS Code surfacing dead code, method frequency, and performance hotspots), KarmaDomain (live API-level dependency graphs across microservices, databases, and async systems), KarmaPulse (an operations command center with API health, error drift, and AI root cause analysis), and KarmaIQ (an MCP server that feeds production context to AI coding agents such as Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Claude). Deployed as managed SaaS or bring-your-own-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), CodeKarma is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and collects only behavioral telemetry — no PII, payloads, or request bodies. Founded by Anantharam Vanchi Prakash and Priyanka Nahata, based in Bengaluru, India, and backed by Prosus, Accel, Xeed Ventures, SenseAI Ventures, and Stargazer Ventures.

providers.name: Constants
providers.description: Constants provides a platform for creating user digital twins to simulate and analyze product decisions. Their service lets teams run quick simulations of user behavior on websites or apps, generating reports on conversion, hesitation points, and actionable insights within about 20 minutes. The platform includes features like test files, reports, credit‑based simulation usage, and integrations with Discord, Google, and email for authentication. It aims to help product teams make data‑driven decisions efficiently.

providers.name: Context Pill
providers.description: Context Pill aggregates and verifies AI news, releases, and tools, providing daily curated summaries and fact‑checked claims. The site offers a method archive, latest updates in markdown and JSON, and an MCP endpoint for read‑only AI tool queries. Operated by Agnostify, it aims to help users stay informed about AI developments with transparent sourcing.

providers.name: Curevo
providers.description: Curevo is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company that operates a global healthcare marketplace, connecting patients with verified medical centers, doctors, and wellness providers across more than 150 countries. The platform offers a range of treatments—from cardiology and oncology to regenerative therapies such as stem cell, hyperbaric oxygen, and blood ozonation—facilitating transparent pricing, tele‑assist AI support, and end‑to‑end medical travel coordination.

providers.name: Daffy
providers.description: Daffy (the Daffy Charitable Fund) is a modern donor-advised fund (DAF) platform that helps people be more generous, more often. Co-founded by Adam Nash, Daffy lets members set aside money for charity, invest it tax-free across ETFs, individual stocks, and 300+ crypto assets, and then recommend grants to any of 1.7M+ eligible US charities on their own timeline. It offers flat-rate membership pricing starting at $3/month, family funds for up to 24 members, advisor integration, and Daffy for Work employer giving. Daffy Charitable Fund is a tax-exempt public charity under IRC 501(c)(3). Backed by Ribbit Capital, it operates as a consumer fintech app with no public developer API surface as of this profile.

providers.name: DapperDox
providers.description: DapperDox is an open-source API documentation generator that creates beautiful, customizable reference documentation from OpenAPI specifications. It supports theming, overlays, and cross-referencing across multiple API specifications, making it suitable for teams managing complex API ecosystems. DapperDox is a developer tool rather than a hosted service, so it does not expose its own public web API.

providers.name: Deepjudge
providers.description: DeepJudge is an AI-powered legal knowledge search and intelligence platform for law firms and in-house legal teams, founded by ex-Google search engineers and legaltech veterans. It unifies scattered institutional knowledge across document management systems, SharePoint, HighQ, OneDrive, email, and intranets into a single governed, permission-aware search layer, then layers LLM-agnostic AI agents and workflow automation on top. Products include DeepJudge Knowledge Search, AI Workflows, Negotiation Intelligence, Multi-Document Chat, Matter & Client Overview, and SuperSearch for cross-matter analysis. The platform can be hosted in DeepJudge's cloud, the customer's cloud, or on premises, supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) for governed AI access to firm knowledge, and does not train on customer data. DeepJudge is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified.

providers.name: Desktop Metal
providers.description: Desktop Metal designs and manufactures additive manufacturing (3D printing) hardware and software for metal and polymer parts, including binder jet and Bound Metal Deposition printers, sintering furnaces, materials, and the cloud/desktop Live Suite software (Live Platform, Live Studio, Live Build, Live Sinter, Live Monitor) that replaced the legacy Fabricate applications. As of April 2025 Desktop Metal is a subsidiary of Nano Dimension. No public or partner developer API is documented; the surfaces below are product features rather than published HTTP APIs.

providers.name: Diligent
providers.description: Diligent Corporation is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software company best known for its board management portal (Diligent Boards / Boardbooks) and the broader Diligent One Platform, which unifies board management, enterprise risk, audit, compliance, entity management, and ESG. The board portal itself is a security-hardened product with no public developer API - it is integrated through SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning, and packaged connectors (Okta, Microsoft 365/Teams, Zoom, DocuSign). Diligent does, however, publish a real developer portal at developer.diligent.com covering the GRC side of the platform - the HighBond (Diligent One) REST API for audit/risk/compliance data, a GraphQL Entities API for legal-entity and subsidiary management, an ESG API for activity/usage data, and a Workflow API for jobs, tasks, and campaigns. API access is customer/partner-gated (a HighBond API key or SSO-scoped token is required) and pricing is quote-based via Diligent sales.

providers.name: Dre1mery
providers.description: Dre1mery is an AI-powered real‑estate investment platform offering off‑market deal sourcing, automated underwriting, creative financing, and acquisition tools for US property investors. The web app provides a single MCP server for analysis, modeling, and outreach, with integrated AI agents to streamline the investment workflow.

providers.name: Dubai Data
providers.description: Dubai Data provides a public data platform on the Dubai property market, aggregating registered sales, prices, yields and other real‑estate metrics from the Dubai Land Department. The service offers open methodology, downloadable datasets in JSON and CSV, and interactive tools for market analysis, helping investors, developers and the public understand trends across Dubai’s real‑estate sector.

providers.name: Employee Cycle
providers.description: Employee Cycle is an HR analytics and reporting platform that bills itself as "the first Employee Data Platform." It connects a company's HRIS, ATS, payroll, performance, and engagement systems into one place and turns that data into automated, real-time dashboards and reports covering headcount, turnover, tenure, DEI, and other people metrics. The no-code dashboard and report builder lets non-technical HR teams run multi-dimensional workforce analysis without manual spreadsheets, with a claimed one-day implementation. Employee Cycle integrates with 20+ HR systems (ADP, BambooHR, Greenhouse, Lattice, Rippling, UKG, and more) and is aimed at enterprise HR teams, typically at organizations with 500+ employees. The company is SOC 2 compliant (audited by Sensiba San Filippo, monitored by Drata), GDPR and CCPA aligned, and built on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. It is backed by the Techstars accelerator and venture funding. Employee Cycle offers pre-built data integrations rather than a public developer REST API; this profile tracks the company's identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Evaneos
providers.description: Evaneos is a French online marketplace for tailor-made travel, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Paris. It connects travelers directly with a curated, continuously-evaluated network of 600+ expert local travel agencies across 160+ destinations, who design fully customized itineraries. A certified B Corp since 2022, Evaneos champions an ethical model in which at least 85% of each trip's cost benefits local economies, and it has served more than 800,000 travelers at a 97% satisfaction rate. Backed by Partech, the company runs a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program but publishes no public product API — the only API it markets is a partner/affiliate product-feed API offered on request through partner.evaneos.net — while publishing a real llms.txt for AI agents; its GitHub organization hosts internal DevOps, security, and AI tooling.

providers.name: Federato
providers.description: Federato is an AI-native insurance technology platform built for the full policy lifecycle, from submission through policyholder management. Its RiskOps-style tooling spans underwriting workflow, automated submission triage, portfolio and appetite alignment, rate/price/quote, a configurable forms engine, federated data infrastructure, and producer, partner, and policyholder portals. Federato serves insurance carriers, managing general agents (MGAs), MGA aggregators, and mutual insurers. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and announced a $100M Series D led by Goldman Sachs. No public API or open developer reference was found during enrichment; the developer documentation portal (Archbee) is magic-link protected, and the GitHub organization holds only forks of third-party infrastructure tools.

providers.name: FintechOS
providers.description: FintechOS is an AI-powered financial product operations platform that enables banks, lenders, and insurers to configure, price, launch, and manage financial products with reduced dependency on legacy core systems. The platform combines unified product operations, agentic workflow orchestration, and governed AI to streamline origination, servicing, underwriting, and compliance across banking and insurance. It exposes a low-code development environment with Server SDK and Client SDK layers and REST APIs, documented at docs.fintechos.com, with a gated developer community and an academy for onboarding. Founded in Romania with headquarters in the United Kingdom, FintechOS is a portfolio company of Earlybird and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: GovSignals
providers.description: GovSignals provides a next‑generation AI‑driven acquisition platform for U.S. government agencies and industry partners. Their solution automates market research, drafting, and award documentation, while managing consortia to secure contracts. The platform offers AI agents that generate documents, a marketplace for vendors, and tools for compliance and security, aiming to streamline the procurement lifecycle from request to award.

providers.name: grasp
providers.description: Grasp is a members-based, AI-powered learning platform based in London, England that builds personalized, AI-curated short courses. Learners discuss a goal with an AI mentor, which co-creates a syllabus and assembles a structured "learning path" from the clearest, most credible resources on the web - organized into focused, roughly hour-long lessons with clear outcomes and practice exercises. Grasp is delivered as a client-rendered React single-page app with a 14-day free trial and a single monthly membership; a selection of public courses and lessons is browsable without an account, and a sister product, Grasp Concepts, lives at concepts.grasp.study. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and point-nine.

providers.name: Health Resources and Services Administration
providers.description: The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) is the primary Federal agency for improving access to health care services for people who are uninsured, isolated, or medically vulnerable. HRSA provides data and web services for healthcare resources, facility locations, and program information.

providers.name: jmrp-io
providers.description: jmrp.io is the personal site of José Manuel Requena Plens, an embedded firmware and software engineer based in Valencia, Spain. The site showcases his professional background, open‑source projects, publications, and tools related to firmware, embedded systems, industrial communications, test automation, and network security. It provides a blog, a CV, a list of publications, and links to his GitHub, GitLab and LinkedIn profiles, serving as a hub for his engineering work and community contributions.

providers.name: JusticeText
providers.description: JusticeText is an AI-powered discovery and evidence-review platform built for public defenders and criminal defense attorneys. It transcribes and translates audio and video evidence (body-worn camera, dashcam, jail calls, and courtroom proceedings) in more than 100 languages, syncs multiple camera angles into unified timelines, generates AI summaries of lengthy materials, and produces court-ready exhibits with clipping, redaction, and closed captioning. Its MirandaAI assistant surfaces connections across discovery, builds timelines, and flags inconsistencies. JusticeText is backed by 500 Global and Bloomberg Beta. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; JusticeText ships a web application but does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Klover
providers.description: Klover provides cash advance and budgeting tools via its mobile app, offering users up to $750 in advances with zero interest or fees. The platform includes point-earning features, financial education, and a seamless sign‑up process, targeting consumers seeking flexible short‑term financing and budgeting assistance.

providers.name: Lantern
providers.description: Lantern (legal entity Employer Direct Healthcare, LLC dba Lantern Specialty Care) is a US specialty care platform that connects members with high-quality, lower-cost care for surgery, cancer and infusion therapy — the complex, high-cost episodes that account for roughly half of healthcare spending. Founded in 2011 as SurgeryPlus and later expanded into cancer and infusion care, Lantern sells to employers, public-sector employers, labor union trusts, health plans and benefits consultants, pairing a hand-selected "Network of Excellence" of specialists with dedicated care teams that navigate a member end to end through a treatment journey. Lantern is backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Lantern publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDKs or discovery surface — this profile captures its public company, trust and security posture only.

providers.name: Limehome
providers.description: Limehome is a Munich-headquartered digital hospitality operator founded in 2018 that designs, leases and runs fully-equipped design apartments and aparthotels across Europe, from Berlin to Barcelona and Linz to Lecce. The company runs a 100% digital guest journey: guests browse and book units online, receive an access code, and complete check-in and check-out contactlessly with no on-site reception staff. Limehome operates offices in Munich and Madrid with more than 200 employees, is led by CEOs Dr. Josef Vollmayr and Cesar de Sousa Freitas, and is backed by Picus Capital, HV Capital and Lakestar. Revenue comes from direct bookings (fee-free, with a 15% membership discount) alongside a "Lease to Limehome" real-estate partnership model. Limehome runs a production API host at api.limehome.com behind AWS API Gateway, but publishes no public developer portal, documentation or machine-readable specification; that surface is first-party/private. The company does maintain a public GitHub organization with a small number of open-source engineering libraries, and an engineering blog.

providers.name: LocBox Labs
providers.description: LocBox Labs, operating under the brand FetchRev, provides an automated marketing platform for local businesses. It enables merchants to create instant promotions, capture customer emails, and drive repeat visits through web, social, and mobile channels. The service includes pay‑per‑visit billing, a results dashboard, and integrations with point‑of‑sale systems, aiming to boost revenue and customer loyalty for venues such as family entertainment centers, health & beauty salons, and home services. Backed by 500‑global, the company focuses on effortless, data‑driven marketing automation for local enterprises.

providers.name: Lucis
providers.description: Lucis is a Paris-based, AI-powered preventative health platform (Y Combinator P25; backed by General Catalyst) that helps members understand their biology through comprehensive lab testing and personalised coaching. Members receive two annual lab assessments (blood, urine, and saliva) at 450+ partner labs across Europe, producing 110+ data points across 11 body systems — metabolic, cardiovascular, hormonal, nervous, and more — which an AI engine turns into personalised action plans spanning nutrition, supplementation, sleep, activity, and mental health. The platform ingests wearable data (Garmin, Withings, Oura, Strava; Apple Watch and Whoop coming soon) for ongoing monitoring. Lucis is a consumer health product; as of this profile it exposes a member web/mobile application and a compliance portal but publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Manex AI
providers.description: Manex AI (Manex AI GmbH) is a European enterprise AI company that builds Kosmos, an Autonomous Enterprise AI Platform for industrial and manufacturing OEMs and their suppliers. Kosmos models the domains a business runs on and lets AI agents, workflows, and applications act on full enterprise context instead of fragments. On top of Kosmos, Manex ships purpose-built autonomous suites: Blackbelt (computer-aided quality / CAQ), Takt (manufacturing execution / MES), and Gemba (shopfloor operations), plus Horizon, a distribution platform that makes a solution built at one site instantly available to every other. Manex serves aerospace, automotive, chemistry, electronics, semiconductors, pharma and biotech, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and home-appliance manufacturers. Made in Europe and built for the strictest compliance standards, the platform runs in cloud, on-premise, or hybrid environments with customer-controlled data residency, GDPR options, ISO 27001 and TISAX certification, enterprise access control, and full audit history. Manex AI is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Md Ally
providers.description: MD Ally is a New York-based digital health company that integrates telehealth into the 911 emergency response system. Its platform lets emergency dispatchers route low-acuity, non-emergency callers to a virtual care tier, connecting patients with telehealth clinicians, in-network resources, and social services instead of dispatching EMS or defaulting to an emergency-room visit. MD Ally works with public safety agencies and payers to expand traditional two-tier dispatch models, reduce unnecessary ambulance transports and ER visits, and improve patient navigation. Backed by General Catalyst and Techstars.

providers.name: Moonvalley
providers.description: Moonvalley is an AI research lab building Marey, a studio-grade generative video model for filmmakers. Marey generates cinematic image-to-video and text-to-video with precise creative controls — pose transfer, camera control, motion transfer, and trajectory control — and is trained exclusively on licensed data, which Moonvalley markets as a "commercially safe" model for professional production. Marey launched publicly in July 2025. A first-party public API is announced but currently waitlist-only; developers can run Marey today through inference partners fal.ai and ComfyUI. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst.

providers.name: Morado
providers.description: Morado is a Colombian fintech and B2B marketplace for the beauty and wellness industry across Latin America, founded in 2022 by Angela Maria Acosta (an early Rappi employee). It is the "everything store for beauty shops" — giving salons, spas, and independent beauty entrepreneurs (a workforce that is majority women) access to intelligent credit, working-capital lines, inventory supply, inventory management, last-mile logistics, and digital tools through a 100% digital process, even for businesses without a traditional financial history. Credit applications run over WhatsApp with 30/60/90-day revolving lines and 3-12 month term products, serving 32,000+ micro-business clients. Backed by QED Investors, Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global, H20 Capital, Latitud, and Village Global. Public surface is the moradocolombia.com marketing/credit site (built on Wix) — no first-party developer API, though the Wix site exposes a hosted MCP endpoint and an llms.txt.

providers.name: MyTime
providers.description: MyTime is an all-in-one business management platform for retail service chains and franchises, combining point-of-sale (POS), online appointment scheduling, integrated payments, customer management, inventory, staff and payroll tools, loyalty, reputation management, and marketing automation across single- and multi-location operations. It serves beauty salons, barbershops, pet grooming, wellness spas, and learning services, offering omnichannel booking (web, Google Reserve, Instagram/Facebook, ClassPass) and analytics. MyTime runs a first-party API host (api.mytime.com) that backs its web and native iPhone/Android apps, and offers partner integrations (Stripe, QuickBooks, Shopify, ADP, Zapier), but does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI definition. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Nth Round
providers.description: Nth Round provides a comprehensive shareholder management platform for private businesses and family enterprises, offering cap table management, cost basis tracking, digital ledger, and shareholder portal features to streamline equity administration, communications, and compliance.

providers.name: OpenJS Foundation
providers.description: The OpenJS Foundation is a Linux Foundation project that supports the growth of JavaScript and web technologies through open governance and collaboration. It hosts critical web ecosystem projects including Node.js, jQuery, Electron, webpack, ESLint, Express, Fastify, LoopBack, Appium, Mocha, Jest, and many more.

providers.name: Parambil
providers.description: Parambil provides AI-powered medical record review software that accelerates and improves accuracy in mass tort and complex litigation workflows. The platform generates comprehensive chronologies, case validations, and analytic insights, reviewing over 5 million records with 44% higher data correctness and 95% faster processing than traditional methods. Trusted by plaintiff and defense firms, Parambil’s solution helps legal teams streamline evidence analysis and reduce costs.

providers.name: Queen's University Belfast
providers.description: Queen's University Belfast is a public research-intensive university in Belfast, Northern Ireland, founded in 1845 and a member of the Russell Group. Its programmable footprint is almost entirely a buyer's footprint rather than a builder's: there is no central developer portal, no api.qub.ac.uk, no institutional open-data portal, and no institution-authored OpenAPI. The research surface people mistake for QUB engineering is an Elsevier Pure tenancy — pure.qub.ac.uk and pureadmin.qub.ac.uk both CNAME into eu.prod.elsevierpure.com, and the OpenAPI served there is titled "Pure API" with contact pure-support@elsevier.com, so the data is QUB's and the contract is Elsevier's. The same pattern holds for the VLE (Canvas at canvas.qub.ac.uk, CNAME qub-vanity.instructure.com) and library discovery (Ex Libris Primo at qub.primo.exlibrisgroup.com). What QUB genuinely operates and publishes in machine-readable form is its identity federation: a production Shibboleth SAML 2.0 Identity Provider (entityID https://qub.ac.uk/shibboleth) registered in the UK Access Management Federation, which also hosts federated identity for the Healthcare Library of Northern Ireland and AFBI. Alongside that sit a live OAI-PMH 2.0 harvesting endpoint for the Research Portal, a registered DataCite repository client (BL.QUB, 2015), a school-level Crossref membership, and the NI-HPC / Kelvin2 national high-performance computing service, whose site runs on QUB's own web platform. This profile deliberately records those tenancies as relationships rather than as QUB's own contracts.

providers.name: Storadera
providers.description: Storadera provides fast, secure, and affordable S3‑compatible cloud storage. It offers instant availability, robust data durability, and integrates with a wide range of backup and synchronization tools such as Acronis, AWS CLI, Cyberduck, Rclone, and many more. The platform targets businesses and developers needing reliable object storage with simple pricing and strong security features.

providers.name: Stravito
providers.description: Stravito provides an AI‑powered customer intelligence platform that helps enterprise brands simulate consumer reactions, segment audiences, and accelerate innovation. By leveraging proprietary synthetic population modeling and behavioral insights, Stravito enables teams to test concepts, campaigns, and product ideas quickly, reducing time‑to‑insight and improving decision‑making across marketing, research, and product development.

providers.name: Structure
providers.description: Structure (Structure Financial Inc.) is a Web3 platform for designing, backtesting, and deploying fully automated, permissionless crypto trading strategies without writing code. Its visual strategy editor and AI-assisted code generation let users build algorithmic strategies that compile to Rust and deploy non-custodially to decentralized exchanges including Hyperliquid, Drift, and Jupiter; strategies receive trading-only permissions so funds never leave the user's vault. The company documents live, paper, and backtest execution paths and references MCP-agent and code-based access alongside its no-code visual interface. Founded by MIT and Jump Trading alumni and backed by the investors behind Coinbase and Solana.

providers.name: Transcarent
providers.description: Transcarent is a health and care experience company serving self-insured employers, health plans, and government and labor union clients. Its consumer-facing platform, WayFinding, combines generative AI agents with instant access to human health guides and clinicians to deliver benefits navigation, clinical guidance, virtual primary and specialty care, pharmacy care, surgery care, cancer care, weight-health programs, and 2nd.MD second opinions in a single experience. The platform is built on an API-first, cloud-native architecture with pre-built HL7 FHIR and EDI connectors that integrate with existing eligibility files and medical, pharmacy, and point-solution benefits. Transcarent exposes these integrations to enterprise partners rather than through a public self-serve developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Trovy
providers.description: Trovy (Trovy Technologies, Inc.) is a Kleiner Perkins-backed fintech building "the homeowner platform" -- consumer credit products that turn home equity into a flexible financial tool. Its flagship Trovy HELOC Card is a credit card powered by home equity with variable APRs as low as 5.99%, alongside the Trovy 1Loan home-equity loan, with preapproval in minutes and rewards, balance-transfer, and payment-calculator features. Trovy is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API, docs, or SDK surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Useanything
providers.description: Useanything is a placeholder company currently lacking publicly available documentation or a dedicated website. It appears in the API Evangelist harvest backlog without verifiable online presence, and no concrete API specifications or developer resources have been identified.

providers.name: Wagtail
providers.description: Wagtail is a leading open-source Python content management system built on Django. It provides a REST API v2 for accessing pages, images, documents, snippets, and custom content types in both headless and traditional deployments. The API delivers JSON-formatted content to web, mobile, and other non-web clients, supporting filtering, full-text search, field selection, and pagination. Wagtail is used by NASA, Google, NHS, Mozilla, MIT, and thousands of other organisations worldwide.

providers.name: WeaveGrid
providers.description: WeaveGrid builds grid-orchestration software that lets electric utilities absorb rapid EV and distributed-energy load growth without overbuilding the distribution system. Its DISCO (Distribution-Integrated System Capacity Orchestration) platform ingests vehicle telematics and cloud-connected device data, then sends hyper-local, individualized charging and dispatch signals to EVs, home batteries, smart thermostats and other flexible loads so they respond to real constraints at the transformer, feeder and substation level. The company runs managed-charging and time-of-use programs for utilities including Pacific Gas and Electric, Dominion Energy, DTE, Xcel Energy, Baltimore Gas and Electric, Alabama Power, Ameren Illinois and Portland General Electric, and integrates directly with OEM and device partners such as Toyota, Lexus, Rivian, Hyundai, Kia, ChargePoint, Wallbox, Emporia, SolarEdge, FranklinWH and ecobee. WeaveGrid markets a partner API for aggregators, but publishes no public developer portal, reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Yulife
providers.description: YuLife is a London-founded (2016) technology-driven insurtech and employee benefits platform offering group life insurance, group health insurance, income protection and a gamified wellbeing app. Employees complete everyday wellness activities to earn YuCoin rewards, with access to an EAP, telemedicine and wellbeing apps such as Meditopia. A certified B Corp, YuLife insures 400k+ lives across the UK and US and sells to employers and brokers. It publishes no public developer API or portal; api.yulife.com is the internal app backend (issuer api.uk.yulife.com), and a Vanta Trust Center is at trust.yulife.com.

providers.name: 42 Technologies
providers.description: 42 Technologies is a retail business-intelligence and reporting platform, founded in 2013, that consolidates omnichannel retail data — point-of-sale, ecommerce, wholesale, and online-marketplace sources — into a single unified dashboard. It provides merchandisers, buyers, and retail executives with more than 100 purpose-built retail metrics, NRF retail-calendar-aware analytics, multi-currency support, and automated reporting, integrating with 100+ systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Amazon, Walmart, Magento, and WooCommerce. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; 42 does not publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: About.me
providers.description: About.me is a personal homepage and online-identity platform that lets anyone create a free, one-page website in minutes to showcase their work, links, bio, and story on a claimable about.me/username profile page. Founded in 2009 and acquired by Vistaprint (Cimpress) in 2013, the service has evolved to add an AI "Virtual Twin" that lets visitors chat with an AI version of the page owner to answer questions, capture leads into a CRM, and schedule appointments automatically. About.me offers free, Standard, and Pro tiers with custom-domain connection, portfolio media, Google Analytics, and branding controls. It does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Aceiss
providers.description: Aceiss is a security monitoring and access-visibility platform that gives CISOs and risk managers continuous insight into who has access to their GitHub organizations and repositories. It monitors user access across repositories, detects unauthorized or anomalous activity in real time, and produces governance and compliance reporting mapped to frameworks such as NIST, CIS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CSA STAR, HITRUST, and SOC 2. Aceiss installs from the GitHub Marketplace as a read-only app requiring admin privileges and exposes an API for integrating its real-time access data into existing systems, with spreadsheet and PDF export. The company is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: ANNA Money
providers.description: ANNA Money (a trading name of Absolutely No Nonsense Admin Ltd, company number 10149389, Cardiff, a subsidiary of ANNA Holdings Ltd) is a UK digital business account and tax app for freelancers, startups, and small businesses, positioned as a challenger to the high-street banks. ANNA is not a bank but an e-money proposition: its Mastercard and e-money services are issued by PayrNet Limited, authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority for electronic money service activities (FCA FRN 900594), and its Account Information Services are provided under agency of TrueLayer (FCA FRN 901096). Within UK Open Banking, ANNA is a consumer / third-party provider (TPP) rather than an account-holding ASPSP or a CMA9 mandated bank - it uses TrueLayer's Data and Payments APIs for external account aggregation, automatic VAT calculation, and QR-code "pay by bank" collection. ANNA publishes no public developer portal, no Open Data API, and no OBIE Read/Write (AIS/PIS/CBPII) API surface of its own; its public GitHub organisation hosts open-source engineering tooling (asyncio, aiohttp, and Postgres libraries) rather than product APIs.

providers.name: Antimatter
providers.description: Antimatter is a data platform product offering integrated analytics, AI, and machine learning capabilities, positioned within the Databricks ecosystem. It provides developers with APIs for data ingestion, processing, and model deployment, targeting enterprise workloads. The company is backed by NEA and appears as a subsidiary or product line of Databricks, with documentation hosted on docs.antimatter.io and related resources on Databricks sites.

providers.name: AnywhereRoles
providers.description: AnywhereRoles aggregates remote job listings from multiple sources, providing a searchable platform where users can compare salaries, filter by category, and apply directly. The service offers both a web interface and native mobile apps for iOS and Android, enabling users to save roles, track applications, and receive weekly curated newsletters. Built by an independent developer, the platform remains free to use, supported by voluntary tips, and emphasizes privacy with minimal data collection.

providers.name: Apache Groovy
providers.description: Apache Groovy is a powerful, optionally typed and dynamic language, with static-typing and static compilation capabilities, for the Java platform aimed at improving developer productivity thanks to a concise, familiar and easy to learn syntax. It integrates smoothly with any Java program, and immediately delivers powerful features to your application.

providers.name: Axsome Therapeutics
providers.description: Axsome Therapeutics (NASDAQ: AXSM) is a biopharmaceutical company developing and delivering novel therapies for the management of central nervous system (CNS) disorders. Headquartered at One World Trade Center, New York, Axsome markets three FDA-approved products — Auvelity (dextromethorphan-bupropion) for major depressive disorder, Sunosi (solriamfetol) for excessive daytime sleepiness in narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, and Symbravo (meloxicam-rizatriptan) for the acute treatment of migraine — and is advancing a pipeline including AXS-05 for Alzheimer's disease agitation and smoking cessation, AXS-12 (reboxetine) for narcolepsy, and AXS-14 (esreboxetine) for fibromyalgia. Axsome operates a corporate website and product / HCP microsites but does not expose a public developer API surface; this profile catalogs corporate, product, regulatory, and investor touchpoints rather than programmatic interfaces.

providers.name: Bespinglobal
providers.description: Bespinglobal (베스핀글로벌) is a global AI‑enabled cloud services and consulting company offering end‑to‑end AI platforms, data‑ops, cloud infrastructure, and managed services. It helps enterprises accelerate AI adoption, optimize cloud operations, and modernize digital workflows through its AI Platform, DataOps, Cloud MSP, and automation solutions.

providers.name: Betr
providers.description: Betr (Betr Holdings, Inc.) is a Miami-based real-money gaming and sports media company founded in 2022 by Joey Levy and Jake Paul on a $50M Series A. Betr operates a consumer "real money gaming super app" spanning Betr Picks (real-money pick'em daily fantasy sports across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, UFC and golf), a micro-betting sportsbook launched in Ohio in January 2023, a social sportsbook and social casino, Betr Arcade, and Betr Media (podcasts, creator content and digital sports programming). Betr is a business-to-consumer operator: it publishes mobile apps, a Webflow marketing site, an Intercom-hosted help center and an llms.txt discovery file, but as of this profiling round it publishes no public developer API program, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, and no SDKs. Its API hosts (api.betr.app, and a staging back-office API documentation host) are private and return 500/403 to anonymous callers.

providers.name: BetterBugs
providers.description: BetterBugs offers a platform for tracking, managing, and resolving software bugs and issues. Their website presents the company as an organization dedicated to helping development teams improve software quality through bug reporting, analytics, and collaboration tools. The site includes structured data confirming the organization name and logo, and provides documentation and resources for users.

providers.name: Bloomy eSIM
providers.description: Bloomy eSIM provides a comparison platform for overseas eSIMs, offering plans across 202 countries and regions starting from ¥100. It targets students, working holiday travelers, and tourists, delivering transparent pricing, data limits, and speed information. Users can purchase and activate eSIMs with a single tap, manage usage via a personal dashboard, and receive support in Japanese. The service emphasizes clear terms, unlimited options, and easy setup for short or long stays abroad.

providers.name: Careharmony
providers.description: CareHarmony is a chronic care management company delivering coordinated, personalized health services. Their mission is to make personalized, coordinated care possible for every patient through fee‑for‑service programs, remote patient monitoring, and value‑based care solutions. They offer chronic care management, preventive care programs, annual wellness visits, transitional care management, and address social determinants of health.

providers.name: Chatter Research
providers.description: Chatter Research (now Chatter by Stingray) is a customer feedback and experience management platform built for modern retailers. It engages shoppers in AI-driven conversational text-message and QR-code surveys that deliver higher response rates and real-time feedback, then uses the Stingray-Chatter AI (trained on 7000+ retail topics) to categorize free-text replies into topics and sentiment. Role-based dashboards surface NPS/CSAT, benchmarks, topic explorers, and NPS boosters so store teams can save lost sales, drive loyalty enrollment, and generate online reviews. Founded in 2016 and acquired by Stingray, the company is a former 500 Global portfolio company. The product is a SaaS dashboard with a help center and CSV data exports; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Cincinnati Financial
providers.description: Cincinnati Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: CINF) is a property and casualty insurance holding company in Fairfield, Ohio, whose subsidiaries — The Cincinnati Insurance Company, The Cincinnati Indemnity Company, The Cincinnati Casualty Company, The Cincinnati Specialty Underwriters Insurance Company and The Cincinnati Life Insurance Company — market business, home, auto and life insurance plus fixed annuities exclusively through independent insurance agencies. Cincinnati Insurance does run an API program for integration partners: it publishes an API Terms and Conditions Agreement licensing "the Cincinnati Insurance APIs" and charges no fee at present. But that agreement is a legal instrument only — it names no protocol, endpoint or auth scheme, and the per-API "API Policy" it incorporates by reference is never published. Access starts with an acceptance form, after which Cincinnati contacts the applicant; there is no developer portal, public reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Clivi
providers.description: Clivi is Mexico's largest digital clinic for diabetes and obesity care, delivering fully online telehealth treatment that combines endocrinologists, internists, nutritionists, and psychologists with continuous glucose monitoring and GLP-1 medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Saxenda, Rybelsus). Founded in 2020 and based in Mexico City, Clivi serves patients nationwide through WhatsApp-based virtual care, home medication delivery via its Farmacia Clivi digital pharmacy, and tiered treatment plans (Clivi Pro, Plus, Total, and Zero). Backed by 500 Global and other investors, Clivi operates as a consumer healthtech service; it publishes no public developer API, but does expose an llms.txt content index for AI agents.

providers.name: Cloaked
providers.description: Cloaked is a consumer privacy and identity-protection platform that lets people create unlimited unique identities to shield their real personal data. Each identity bundles a masked email address, a virtual phone number, an auto-generated password, and virtual payment cards so users can sign up for services without handing over their real contact information. The platform adds a built-in password manager, AI-powered spam call screening (Call Guard), dark web and SSN monitoring, automated data-broker removal across 120+ sites, and up to $1M in identity theft insurance. Cloaked emphasizes a zero-knowledge architecture with end-to-end encryption and is SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and PCI DSS compliant. Backed by General Catalyst, Cloaked ships consumer apps (iOS, Android, web, browser extension) and a Cloaked Enterprise offering for businesses; it is a consumer-facing product with no publicly documented developer API at this time.

providers.name: CloseDay
providers.description: Closeday provides end‑to‑end company closure services for UK small and mid‑sized businesses. It combines licensed insolvency practitioners with AI‑driven software to handle solvent strike‑offs, tax‑efficient MVLs and insolvent liquidations, including asset realisation, debt settlement and filings to HMRC and Companies House. Clients receive a free tailored plan and a fixed price before the service begins.

providers.name: Colgate-Palmolive
providers.description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer-products manufacturer operating in oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition through brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Pet Nutrition, Speed Stick, Ajax, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive does not publish a general-purpose public developer REST API. Its B2B integration footprint is centered on EDI exchanges with retail trading partners (X12 messages, AS2, VAN), supplier integrations through SAP Ariba, and internal corporate systems. There is also a corporate sustainability and ESG reporting surface, but it is not exposed as a developer API.

providers.name: CPower
providers.description: CPower Energy is a commercial and industrial (C&I) virtual power plant (VPP) operator that helps organizations monetize the flexibility of their energy assets through demand response and distributed energy resource (DER) programs. Its CPower CONNECT platform lets customers view, manage, and unlock revenue from energy assets while supporting grid reliability and sustainability goals. CPower serves data centers, crypto mining, healthcare, education, retail, commercial real estate, industrial operations, and the public sector, and has operated distributed energy programs across the U.S. since 2015. CPower was acquired by NRG Energy and operates a combined C&I VPP platform. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent deep-tech lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; CPower publishes a customer portal and a security and compliance posture but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Data Theorem
providers.description: Data Theorem provides application security solutions that protect APIs, cloud-native applications, and mobile apps throughout the software development lifecycle. Their platform offers API security, code security, cloud security, and mobile security, leveraging AI to detect and remediate vulnerabilities, enforce compliance, and secure runtime environments.

providers.name: Datao
providers.description: Datao provides AI‑powered monitoring of public procurement opportunities in Morocco. Their platform scans official tender publications, extracts key details, and alerts users to relevant contracts, helping businesses save time and increase win rates. Features include customizable alerts, a Claude‑integrated assistant for summarizing tenders, and a dashboard for tracking opportunities across sectors.

providers.name: depthfirst
providers.description: depthfirst is an applied AI lab building an autonomous application security platform that protects software from design through production. Its General Security Intelligence platform builds context across a company's code, infrastructure, and business logic to detect complex vulnerabilities, cut false positives, and generate merge-ready fixes. Product surfaces include a code scanner, dependency firewall, secrets detection, supply-chain mapping, and agentic pentesting, alongside in-house security models such as dfs-mini1. Backed by Accel, Meritech Capital, Forerunner Ventures, and The House Fund, depthfirst works with companies including ClickUp, Lovable, Supabase, incident.io, and Moveworks.

providers.name: DiscountHub
providers.description: DiscountHub is an AI-powered deal finder that searches current product discounts, promo codes, and partner offers across multiple online stores. Users can describe what they need and the AI scans deals in real time, or browse curated lists manually. No account or registration is required to access the service.

providers.name: Dragoneye
providers.description: Dragoneye is a computer vision platform designed to democratize access to advanced image and video recognition technologies. It enables developers to build and deploy custom models tailored to their specific use cases without the need for coding or data labeling. By automating the entire process from model specification to deployment, Dragoneye eliminates the traditional complexities associated with computer vision development.

providers.name: Duna
providers.description: Duna is an AI-native business identity platform for KYB (Know Your Business), KYC (Know Your Customer), AML (Anti-Money Laundering), and lifecycle compliance. It accelerates enterprise business onboarding by turning compliance policy into auditable code via a policy engine, using AI agents for document verification and periodic reviews, with deep localization across 210+ business registries and 7+ languages. Duna serves fintechs, banks, and platforms including Plaid, Moss, and Bol, and is backed by Index Ventures. Note: docs.duna.com is password-protected, so no public API reference, OpenAPI, or developer portal was available at enrichment time.

providers.name: DynamiCare Health
providers.description: DynamiCare Health provides technology solutions for substance use recovery, offering digital therapeutics, contingency management, and support tools for individuals, families, and health plans. Their platform integrates evidence‑based interventions, insurance navigation, and outcome tracking to improve recovery outcomes.

providers.name: EvolveApp
providers.description: EvolveApp INC. (Evolve) is an AI-native enablement and performance platform for corporate learning and workforce training. Its product suite spans the Evolve LMS for courses, learning paths and branded academies; Evolve Generate for AI-powered course creation from raw materials; Evolve Studio for advanced authoring; an Assessment Center for skills and behavioral evaluation; an AI Knowledge Base instant-answer engine; and AI-driven Simulations for job-critical practice. Evolve serves 100+ enterprise clients and 2.9M+ learners worldwide, is SOC 2 (Type 1 and 2), ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant, and offers iOS and Android apps. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Fiorano Software
providers.description: Fiorano Software provides a hybrid integration platform and API management solutions for enterprises. Their suite includes Fiorano Integration Platform, API Management, FioranoMQ, and B2B integration, enabling real‑time data flow, microservices orchestration, and secure messaging across on‑premise and cloud environments. The company serves industries such as banking, healthcare, logistics, and energy, offering robust tools for digital transformation and enterprise connectivity.

providers.name: Fiverr
providers.description: Fiverr is a global online marketplace for freelance digital services, founded in 2010 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, and publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FVRR). The platform connects businesses and individuals with freelancers offering "gigs" across hundreds of categories including graphic design, writing and translation, programming and tech, video and animation, digital marketing, music and audio, and AI services. Fiverr also operates Fiverr Pro and Fiverr Enterprise for vetted talent and managed teams, Fiverr Workspace for freelancer business tooling, and an affiliate partnership program. Fiverr does not currently publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI-described API; its programmatic surfaces are limited to the consumer marketplace and partner/affiliate integrations. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched with the public identity, security, and discovery signals available.

providers.name: FlowGPT
providers.description: FlowGPT is a community platform for discovering, sharing, and chatting with AI prompts, characters, and chatbots. Backed by DCM Ventures, it operates as a ChatGPT prompt and AI-character marketplace where creators publish prompts, roleplay characters, and AI apps across categories such as programming, marketing, business, and entertainment, and users engage them through free chat, leaderboards, bounties, and paid membership tiers. FlowGPT publishes user- and creator-facing product documentation (guide.flowgpt.com) but does not currently expose a public developer REST API, OpenAPI definition, or first-party SDK; programmatic access today is limited to unofficial community wrappers over its internal endpoints.

providers.name: Goodr
providers.description: Goodr is an Atlanta-based sustainable surplus food management and hunger-relief logistics company founded in 2016 by Jasmine Crowe-Houston. Goodr helps businesses divert edible and inedible food waste from landfills by scheduling pickups, donating surplus edible food to local nonprofits, and providing donors with the tax deductions and impact reporting tied to those donations. Alongside its food-waste solutions, Goodr runs hunger-relief programs including pop-up grocery markets, meal delivery, student snackpacks, and community grocery stores. The company reports more than 30 million meals served and 4 million pounds of food diverted from landfills for enterprise partners such as Amazon, Google, NASA, and Fulton County. Goodr operates through a partner portal rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: growthvector-io
providers.description: GrowthVector.io provides practical guides and tools for SEO, GEO targeting, and growth marketing aimed at small businesses. Their offerings include an SEO audit tool, data extraction utilities, a WebP image converter, and detailed tutorials on paid ads, email, social, and affiliate marketing. The platform focuses on helping businesses improve organic search visibility, optimize ad spend, and leverage data-driven strategies for growth.

providers.name: Herbie
providers.description: Herbie is an AI-powered estate planning platform and law firm that lets individuals and partner organizations create wills, trusts, and related legal documents online. Its agentic engine encodes the principles, laws, and practice of estate planning into a system that drafts and assembles documents at scale, paired with an AI copilot for natural-language guidance and optional attorney review through Herbie Legal. Herbie is offered directly to consumers and as an embeddable "estate planning as a service" offering for wealth management firms, insurance companies, and employers. Herbie was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Indusface
providers.description: Indusface provides web application security solutions, offering a cloud‑based Web Application Firewall (WAF), vulnerability scanning, and continuous security monitoring. Their platform helps organizations protect against OWASP Top 10 threats, detect malicious traffic, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Founded to simplify application security, Indusface serves enterprises across multiple sectors, delivering real‑time threat intelligence and automated remediation capabilities.

providers.name: Infera
providers.description: Infera is an AI-native laboratory automation platform (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) that converts plain-English descriptions of experiments into validated, instrument-ready runs across the lab instruments a team already owns. It compiles protocols into vendor-specific scripts for liquid handlers, plate readers, mass spectrometers, thermocyclers and centrifuges (Opentrons, Hamilton, Tecan and others), limits AI to initial drafts while keeping downstream steps deterministic and fully checkable, supports both automated and manual bench procedures, and maintains an end-to-end audit trail of protocols and runs. Founded in San Francisco by Troy Zhang and Chloe Sow.

providers.name: Interintellect
providers.description: Interintellect is the world's leading salon platform, a creator-led cultural center for intellectual conversation founded in March 2019 by art philosopher Anna Gat. The platform lets people attend and host high-quality salons and discussions online and offline, across philosophy, technology, poetry, history, and the arts, building community around shared intellectual interests. It supports independent thinkers and hosts through ticket revenue, training, and a peer community, with paid membership tiers granting event access, members-only sessions, community forums, and global in-person gatherings. Interintellect is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta; it publishes no public API or developer platform, so this profile carries identity and website-property signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: International Energy Agency (IEA)
providers.description: The International Energy Agency (IEA) provides a REST API for accessing global energy statistics, renewables data, CO2 emissions factors, monthly electricity generation data, oil market reports, and energy policy information. The IEA API enables programmatic access to authoritative energy data covering 150+ countries and offering up-to-hourly real-time emissions factors alongside comprehensive historical datasets.

providers.name: Invaluable
providers.description: Invaluable is the world's leading online marketplace for fine art, antiques and collectibles, founded in 1986. The platform aggregates live and timed auctions from more than 5,000 premier auction houses across 53 countries, giving collectors worldwide a single place to discover, bid on, and win items — with over 260,000 items listed at any time and an archive of 66+ million price records. Invaluable also operates AuctionZip and a Private Label / Connect white-label offering, and provides a partner-only Catalog Upload API that lets auction-management software companies add, edit, and delete lots in timed and live sales directly from their own systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Katonic.ai
providers.description: Katonic.ai provides an operating system for sovereign AI, enabling enterprises to run AI workloads on their own infrastructure. The platform offers a suite of solutions across banking, government, telecommunications, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, energy, and insurance, with tools like AI Factory, Workroom, Studio, Control Room, AI Gateway, and Knowledge Engine. Katonic emphasizes security, responsible AI, and partnership integrations with NVIDIA, Cisco, Red Hat, and others, positioning itself as a comprehensive AI operating system for various industry needs.

providers.name: kelaHealth
providers.description: kelaHealth is a healthcare AI company that improves surgical outcomes through its Surgical Intelligence Service, an AI-enabled API delivering patient-specific predictive insights at critical decision points across the perioperative process. Models trained on millions of surgical procedures predict individual patient risk across nine major complication categories, identify modifiable factors, and recommend stratified interventions tailored to hospital standards. The service integrates into existing medtech and healthcare software applications using EHR, robotic, and social-determinants-of-health data to help providers improve growth, efficiency, quality, and safety. kelaHealth is HIPAA compliant and backed by Techstars. It does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; its API is delivered through partner integrations.

providers.name: lazybird-app
providers.description: Lazybird is an AI voiceover generator for creators, enabling realistic text‑to‑speech for videos, podcasts, audiobooks, courses, and product demos. Users can import scripts, select from a variety of AI voices, generate audio, and download it, with a free tier to start. The platform also offers multilingual support and customizable voice options, aiming to streamline content creation for creators and businesses alike.

providers.name: Libre.fm
providers.description: Libre.fm is an open source music community that lets users track their listening habits across various music players and services. Since 2009, it has recorded hundreds of millions of listens from over 390,000 users, offering public profiles, community charts, and the ability to run a self‑hosted instance. The service integrates with many clients via scrobbling and provides APIs for developers to access user listening data and music metadata.

providers.name: Lumafield
providers.description: Lumafield is a manufacturing technology company that builds accessible industrial X-ray computed tomography (CT) scanning hardware and AI-powered cloud analysis software. Its Neptune and Triton scanners pair with the Voyager cloud platform so engineers and manufacturers can inspect the inside of parts non-destructively, measure dimensions and GD&T against CAD, detect porosity, cracks, inclusions and wall-thickness defects, and automate inspection at production volume. Lumafield delivers CT as a unified hardware, cloud, and analytics system rather than a public developer API; this profile catalogs its public developer-adjacent surfaces (support/knowledge base, release notes, and an llms.txt documentation index) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Meal Ticket
providers.description: Meal Ticket is a Boise, Idaho-based SaaS company (founded 2011) delivering profitability management software for the foodservice supply chain. Its TrackMax+ platform helps food distributors and suppliers manage rebates, allowances, trade programs, payments, and operator-level intelligence at line-item detail, while its MarketMan platform provides AI-powered inventory and food-cost management to 15,000+ restaurant locations across 55+ countries. Meal Ticket serves 100+ distributors and suppliers and processes $40B+ in annual sales and rebate volume. The company operates as a customer-facing SaaS with a single-sign-on login surface (OpenID Connect) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: muffintech
providers.description: muffintech is a Berlin-based InsurTech building generative AI purpose-trained for the insurance industry. Its conversational assistant, muffinGPT, is pre-trained on 30,000+ insurance conversations and passed the German 34D broker certification exam, supporting insurers, brokers, and broker pools across sales enablement, lead generation and direct sales, and after-sales service (contract inquiries, claims reporting, cross-selling). The platform is modular and customizable, with a privacy-first architecture hosted on Microsoft Azure in Frankfurt, Germany, and is ISO 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant. muffintech raised EUR 3.5M in 2025 to scale its AI-driven insurance solutions. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; muffintech does not currently publish a public developer API surface (no docs, OpenAPI, or SDKs found as of this enrichment pass).

providers.name: Nomi Health
providers.description: Nomi Health is a Utah-based direct healthcare and healthcare fintech company founded in 2019 that operates a payments, claims and analytics platform for self-funded employers, health plans, brokers and providers. Its stack spans real-time provider payments and claims adjudication (Healthcare Financial Services), directly contracted provider networks (Direct Network / Open Network), benefits-data analytics through Artemis by Nomi Health, and direct patient care services. Nomi Health operates authenticated web portals for providers, members and employers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: NutriSense
providers.description: NutriSense is a metabolic health and wellness company that pairs continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) with 1:1 registered-dietitian coaching and a mobile app. Members receive glucose biosensors, real-time and historical glucose analytics, AI-assisted pattern insights, stress-management sessions, and video consults with credentialed, glucose-certified nutritionists to build sustainable nutrition, weight-loss, and metabolic-health habits. Nutrisense runs a consumer product with a member web and mobile app experience; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. It does publish a machine-readable llms.txt at nutrisense.io/llms.txt.

providers.name: Peerspace
providers.description: Peerspace is an online marketplace for booking unique venues and spaces by the hour — event spaces, meeting rooms, photo and film studios, production locations, and unconventional rooms and residences — connecting space owners (hosts) with people who need distinctive locations for events, meetings, photo shoots, and productions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network. Peerspace operates a consumer marketplace with web and mobile apps but does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, security posture, and legal and support surface.

providers.name: PiggyVest
providers.description: PiggyVest is a Lagos-based Nigerian fintech (operated by Piggytech Global Limited, RC 1405222) running the country's largest online savings and investment platform, with 6M+ registered users as of 2026. Founded in January 2016 by Somto Ifezue, Odunayo Eweniyi, and Joshua Chibueze as Piggybank.ng and rebranded to PiggyVest in April 2019, the company digitizes the traditional Nigerian "kolo" piggy-bank, layering automated savings, fixed-term safe-locks, naira and dollar wallets, and curated investments on top of licensed banking partners (originally United Bank for Africa) and a PCI-DSS-compliant payment stack. The consumer product family includes Piggybank (automated daily/weekly/monthly savings), SafeLock (fixed-tenor savings with up-front interest), Target Savings (goal-based saving, solo or group), Flex Naira (flexible wallet with free transfers), Flex Dollar / SafeLock Dollar (USD savings), HouseMoney (rent wallet), Investify (curated investment opportunities), GetIT (lifestyle purchase plans), Piggy Points (rewards), and an Accountability Partner feature, all delivered through iOS, Android, and web apps published by Piggytech Global. On the developer side, PiggyVest operates a separate B2B brand — PiggyVest Business — at piggyvest.business and exposes the PiggyVest Business API at api.piggyvest.business, documented at www.piggyvestbusiness.com/docs. The Business API is a Bearer-token authenticated REST API (secret key in Authorization header) covering customer creation and retrieval, customer wallets (create / retrieve / list, accrued-interest tracking, reserved account numbers, funding accounts), wallet-to-wallet and bank transfers (with name inquiry and bank lookup), transactions (status, history, T+1 settlement), scheduled payments (create / cancel / reactivate), webhooks for real-time event notifications, and a "Pay with Pocket" SDK / hosted-checkout integration that lets merchants accept payments funded from a Piggyvest user's Pocket balance. Default rate limits are approximately 100 requests per minute. No public OpenAPI specification, official SDK packages, or open-source client libraries are currently published; access is gated by signing up for a PiggyVest Business dashboard account. Alongside the API, PiggyVest Business offers Invoicing, Customizable Accounts, Business Safelock, Investify for Business, and business savings earning up to 18% per annum. Public engineering presence is limited — the Piggytech Global GitHub org (github.com/PiggyTech) hosts a small set of community wrappers (react-paystack, Smile Identity Node.js and React Native wrappers) and the consumer brand maintains a static piggyvest.github.io site, but there is no developer org publishing official Piggyvest Business SDKs.

providers.name: PlanYear
providers.description: PlanYear provides an AI‑native platform for the benefits industry, offering the BEACON platform for benefits consultants and the RAPID solution for insurance carriers. Built by benefits professionals, the platform reads, cleans, and formats census files, plan documents, RFPs, and renewals, enabling consultants to focus on strategic guidance and carriers to quote efficiently. The service combines deep industry knowledge with modern AI to return time to relationships and growth.

providers.name: Prax Health
providers.description: Prax Health is a healthcare platform that helps nurse practitioners launch and grow their own independent practices. It provides an all-in-one back office that handles business formation, regulatory and clinical compliance, medical billing, insurance credentialing, an integrated EHR, and ongoing practice consulting. The company's stated mission is to put healthcare back in the hands of providers by removing the administrative and operational burden that keeps clinicians from practicing independently. Prax Health is a venture-backed company (Canaan Partners) and operates a consumer/clinician web application rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it exposes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Qard
providers.description: Qard provides consolidated financial and legal data on French companies to support credit decision-making. It aggregates official registers, tax filings, Banque de France data, and banking flows into a single API, offering comprehensive coverage of corporate financial information for risk assessment and lending processes.

providers.name: Rainwalk Technology
providers.description: Rainwalk Technology is a white-label, embedded pet insurance provider founded in 2018 and based in Columbia, South Carolina. Rainwalk lets partners such as shelters, breeders, veterinary practices, and consumer platforms launch and distribute accident-and-illness pet insurance directly at the point of sale through its APIs and hosted quoting/enrollment flows, keeping partners in control of the customer experience. Coverage includes accidents, illnesses, diagnostics, surgery, and medications, with hassle-free reimbursements and free virtual vet consultations. The company operates a partner/embedded API surface (api.rainwalk.io) plus hosted quoting, insured, and agent portals, and is backed by Techstars Ventures, ManchesterStory, Insurtech Gateway, Bridge Capital, and Seaplane Ventures. Rainwalk was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched via the pipeline.

providers.name: Refact.ai
providers.description: Refact.ai is an open-source, local-first AI coding assistant and autonomous software-engineering agent built by Small Magellanic Cloud Ai Ltd. ("SmallCloud"). The product combines an IDE-integrated chat experience (Ask / Explore / Debug / Review / Plan modes), accurate code completion powered by Qwen2.5-Coder with RAG over the workspace, and the Refact Agent — an autonomous mode that plans, executes, and iterates on engineering tasks end-to-end, integrating with Git hosts, databases, shells, browsers, and MCP servers. The full agent stack — a Rust HTTP/LSP engine (`refact-lsp`), a React/Vite chat GUI, and VS Code + JetBrains plugins — is open source under BSD-3-Clause at github.com/smallcloudai/refact and ranked #1 open-source agent on SWE-bench Lite (60.0%) and 93.3% on Aider's Polyglot benchmark with thinking mode. Refact supports a cloud SaaS tier (Free / Pro / Enterprise) — though Refact Cloud is being wound down in favor of BYOK + self-hosting — plus enterprise on-premise deployment with LLM fine-tuning, AWS Marketplace listings, and bring-your-own-key access to Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, GitHub Copilot, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Refact is positioned as a privacy-preserving, self-hostable alternative to closed cloud coding agents — workspace context, checkpoints, knowledge graphs, and trajectories are stored locally; no code is sent to the vendor's servers in self-hosted mode.

providers.name: seorecords-com
