providers.description: Des corrections SEO posées au moment où la page est servie : votre site reste le vôtre, chaque source citée. Des records mesurés, datés, rejouables. Corrige le référencement et la vitesse de vos pages au moment où elles sont servies. SEO Records propose des solutions pour WordPress, PrestaShop, Joomla, Drupal, et sites PHP, offrant des corrections SEO en temps réel et des prix à partir de 199 €.

providers.name: Sixt
providers.description: Sixt is a global mobility services provider offering car rental, ride‑hailing, and subscription services. With a heritage spanning over a century, Sixt operates in more than 110 countries, delivering premium vehicles and flexible booking options through its website and mobile apps. The company emphasizes digital transformation, providing customers with online reservations, fleet management, and a range of mobility solutions tailored to business and leisure travelers.

providers.name: strunk-io
providers.description: Strunk is a productivity tool that bridges AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex with Google Docs, enabling reviewers' comments to be captured and applied back into the AI tool for seamless document revision without losing context. By connecting AI-generated drafts to Google Docs, Strunk allows users to publish documents, pull reviewer comments, and automatically apply approved edits, preserving comment threads. It supports multiple AI clients, offers a free sign‑up via Google account, and provides support through email and live chat.

providers.name: TechRepublic
providers.description: TechRepublic is a leading IT and enterprise technology media site that provides IT professionals with news, analysis, tips, tutorials, best practices, and research on business technology. Covering topics including cloud computing, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, enterprise software, hardware, and data management, TechRepublic serves technology decision-makers and practitioners across industries. The platform exposes its content programmatically via WordPress REST API endpoints and standard RSS/Atom feeds.

providers.name: Testmyprompt
providers.description: BuildMyAgent is an AI automation platform that enables users to create, customize, and deploy intelligent agents that integrate with over 800 applications. The service offers a visual builder, pre‑built templates, and extensive integration options for tools like Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, and more. It targets businesses and developers seeking to automate workflows, enhance customer interactions, and streamline operations through AI‑driven bots. Pricing plans are transparent, and comprehensive documentation guides users from onboarding to advanced customization.

providers.name: Themis
providers.description: Themis (askthemis.com) is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) SaaS platform positioned as a "compliance collaboration" tool that streamlines partnerships between companies and their vendors, banks, credit unions, and fintechs by accelerating onboarding, due diligence, and risk assessments. The platform bundles modules for policies, procedures, documents, vendor and risk management, risk register, control mapping, issue and change management, complaints, QA testing, training, audit, key risk indicators (KRI), FINRA 4530, and conflicts of interest. Themis serves banking, payments, lending, crypto/DeFi, exchanges, BaaS, and credit-card sectors, and is used through a hosted web application at portal.askthemis.com. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public or developer API surface. Themis is a portfolio company of Felicis.

providers.name: Tradespace
providers.description: Tradespace is an AI-powered intellectual property management platform that combines IP management software, AI tooling, and on-demand patent attorneys in a single full-service patent practice. The platform spans the IP lifecycle across four products — Create (invention harvesting and disclosure, with Slack, Gmail, and Notion integrations), Protect (AI-assisted patent drafting and flat-fee prosecution with senior attorneys), Manage (portfolio management and board-ready reporting), and Commercialize (licensing campaigns, claims charts, and licensee identification). It serves corporations, universities, tech transfer offices, startups, law firms, and government agencies, is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant (Vanta trust center), hosts on Microsoft Azure with customer-private AI instances, and is a 500 Global portfolio company. The SaaS application runs at app.tradespace.io; no public developer API is published.

providers.name: Unicommerce
providers.description: Unicommerce is India’s #1 e‑commerce enablement SaaS platform for order management, warehouse management, and multi‑channel inventory operations. It offers a cloud‑based solution to streamline order processing, inventory syncing across marketplaces, and fulfillment, helping merchants scale their online businesses. Book a free demo today.

providers.name: UNIX System Call
providers.description: Core UNIX/POSIX system calls providing low-level operating system interfaces for process management, file operations, interprocess communication, and system control.

providers.name: Unobravo
providers.description: Unobravo is Europe's largest online psychology service, founded in 2019 by psychologist Danila De Stefano. It matches people with one of 9,500+ individually vetted psychologists and psychotherapists for individual, couples, and group therapy delivered online, serving Italy, Spain, and France as well as Italians abroad, with 500,000+ people supported across more than 10 million online sessions, plus a B2B mental-wellbeing offering (Unobravo Business) and an ECM training academy. Backed by Insight Partners and Northzone. Its backend API (api.unobravo.com) is private, with no public developer surface.

providers.name: Voom Medical Devices
providers.description: Voom Medical Devices, Inc. is an orthopedic medical device and surgical innovation company founded by bunion surgeon Dr. Neal Blitz and headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee. Voom designs implants and procedural systems for minimally invasive bunion surgery (MIBS) and foot-and-ankle reconstruction, including the patented Revcon non-compression dual-zone bone screw system, the Bunionplasty 360 Bunion Repair procedure, and the MIBS CoPilot Shift + Targeting Guide single-use sterile kit. The company sells to surgeons and hospitals, runs a surgeon training program, and operates the patient-facing Bunionplasty.com procedure site with a doctor locator. It is a physical device manufacturer: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Wuzzuf
providers.description: Wuzzuf is Egypt's leading online recruitment platform, operated by Cairo-based BasharSoft and backed by investors including 500 Global. It connects millions of job seekers with tens of thousands of employers across Egypt and the Middle East, offering job search, applicant tracking, employer branding pages, and recruitment products for companies. Wuzzuf does not currently publish a public developer API, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Xelix
providers.description: Xelix is a London-based company (with a US office in Wilmington, DE) providing an AI-powered Accounts Payable control platform that bolts onto existing ERP, P2P, and email systems. Its five modules — Transactions (duplicate/incorrect payment and fraud prevention), Statements (supplier statement reconciliation), Helpdesk (generative-AI vendor query resolution), Vendors (master vendor data cleansing), and Reports — process 115M+ invoices annually for 200+ global customers. Backed by Insight Partners ($160M raised July 2025 to advance agentic AI in AP). Xelix is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified, GDPR compliant, hosted on AWS (EU/US/UK data residency), and publishes a Vanta trust center and an UptimeRobot status page. Integration is file-based (daily SFTP transfer of invoice, workflow, and master vendor data) plus optional SSO and email integrations; the company publishes no public developer portal or documented API surface, though its platform runs on api.xelix.com and its engineering team maintains open-source Python/Rust packages on GitHub (xelixdev).

providers.name: YOURLS
providers.description: YOURLS (Your Own URL Shortener) is an open‑source PHP application that lets you run your own URL shortening service on a self‑hosted server. It provides a simple web interface, API endpoints for creating, managing, and tracking short URLs, and supports plugins for extending functionality. The project is maintained by the community and offers documentation, a GitHub repository, and a public blog for updates and support.

providers.name: Zenbu 2
providers.description: Zenbu is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) developer-tools startup building a fully hackable desktop interface for managing AI coding agents. The macOS app is a customizable client for the "Pi" coding agent, letting developers run multiple agents in parallel across Git worktrees, review changes, and extend the app at runtime through plugins. Zenbu is built on Zenbu.js, the company's open-source TypeScript framework for building extensible ("hackable") applications, which handles plugin loading, cross-process state sync, RPC, and hot reloading. The framework and its scaffolding tooling are published to npm under the zenbu-labs organization. Zenbu does not currently expose a hosted HTTP/REST developer API; its developer surface is the client-side Zenbu.js framework, its plugin model, and its command-line scaffolders. Founded by Rob Pruzan (ex-Vercel Next.js core, co-author of React Scan).

providers.name: Afiniti
providers.description: Afiniti is an enterprise contact center AI company whose patented behavioral pairing technology matches inbound customers with the agent most likely to produce a desired business outcome, measured against a continuously alternating ON/OFF control benchmark. In 2026 the company extended pairing into what it calls Outcome Orchestration, a unified AI decisioning platform spanning four products: Afiniti Pairing, Afiniti Orchestrator, Afiniti Intelligence and Afiniti Agents. Afiniti sits as a decisioning layer above existing CCaaS, ACD, IVR/IVA, CRM and workforce platforms rather than replacing them, and is deployed at telco, financial services, insurance, healthcare and travel/hospitality enterprises. Integration reaches customers through host platform ecosystems (Genesys AppFoundry, NICE CXexchange/DEVone, Five9) and through the Afiniti Link partner program, which advertises APIs and SDKs to certified partners but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: AgentifAI
providers.description: AgentifAI is a Portuguese enterprise conversational-AI company, headquartered in Braga, that builds AliceOS - a voice-first AI contact-center and autonomous agent platform purpose-built for the regulated banking and healthcare sectors. AliceOS is sold as a managed enterprise deployment rather than a self-serve developer product: it orchestrates multi-agent workflows across phone, WhatsApp, SMS, email and web, and integrates with core banking systems, CRMs, fraud engines, Hospital Information Systems and EMR/EHR platforms over REST, SOAP and OAuth, with SIP and CTI telephony adapters. Reference deployments include Santander, Banco BPI, Caixa Geral de Depositos, Vivalto Sante, Lusiadas Saude and Luz Saude. The company publishes a first-party llms.txt and a SafeBase trust center naming SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, PCI DSS v4.0.0 and HIPAA, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: AgentMesh
providers.description: AgentMesh is a network for every agent your company runs, buys or works with. It offers Connect to make each agent known, Control to keep it managed, and Combine to put agents to work together. The platform is built by AgentMesh, Inc., based in Denver, CO, aiming to simplify multi‑agent orchestration across enterprises.

providers.name: AI Metadata Cleaner
providers.description: AI Metadata Cleaner provides a free online tool and API to strip hidden metadata, including EXIF, GPS, C2PA, and AI generation tags, from images, videos, PDFs and RAW files. It aims to protect privacy for creators, professionals and everyday users by ensuring no unintended data is shared.

providers.name: ALM XPP
providers.description: ALM XPP provides an AI-powered MCP (Model Context Protocol) platform for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. It indexes the entire Dynamics 365 standard, offering natural‑language queries over 200K objects, 25M cross‑references, and 126 AI tools. Users can ask questions about code, metadata, and business logic, receiving answers linked to the original AOT objects. The service includes integrations with Azure DevOps, GitHub Copilot, and Power Apps, and offers a free beta with optional opt‑in data uploads.

providers.name: ATLASS OS
providers.description: ATLASS OS — the business operating system for trades and field-service companies, on one ledger, one timeline and one API: CRM with every call, text and email on one timeline, estimates and invoices, jobs and Boards, full double-entry books, Canadian payroll, a business phone system with transcribed call recordings, and field apps for your crew — one system, one ledger. Built in Alberta.

providers.name: Beglaubigt
providers.description: Beglaubigt is the first digital notary for Europe, offering digital certifications and GmbH/UG company formations under eIDAS. With apostille valid in over 120 countries, prices start at €99. Over 25,000 customers trust our services.

providers.name: Blackrock Neurotech
providers.description: Blackrock Neurotech is a Salt Lake City, Utah based neurotechnology company that designs and manufactures implantable brain-computer interface (BCI) systems and the research instrumentation around them. Its platform pairs Utah Array microelectrode arrays and the next-generation Neuralace interface with the NeuroPort, Cerebus and CerePlex Direct neural signal processors, the CereStim stimulation system, and the Central software suite for acquisition, visualization and offline spike sorting. The company reports more than 19 years of human clinical study, 1,000+ research institutions served and 2,000+ published studies using its hardware. Blackrock does not publish a public web API: its programmatic surface is a set of device and file-format libraries distributed as downloads and GitHub source (cbSDK C++ API, cbMEX MATLAB API, CereStim API, brPY/brpylib Python data loader, and the NPMK MATLAB toolkit). Enrichment probing on 2026-08-02 found no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP, agent card, llms.txt or /.well-known/ discovery surface on any Blackrock host.

providers.name: Blockonomics
providers.description: Blockonomics provides a decentralized crypto payment gateway that enables merchants to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly to their wallets. With a focus on privacy, self‑custody, and easy integration, it offers payment widgets, invoices, and blockchain explorer tools, supporting over 150 fiat currencies and complying with global regulations.

providers.name: Bynor
providers.description: Bynor provides an AI‑powered operating system for social media, enabling users to create, publish, analyze, and grow content across platforms. The platform unifies conversations, data, and automation in a single place, helping brands and creators streamline their social workflows and gain insights.

providers.name: Canal Nav
providers.description: Canal Nav is a free route planner and live map for the UK’s canals and rivers, providing boaters with tools to plan cruises, work through locks, and explore waterways. The service offers real‑time navigation, route optimization, and open data integrations to help users enjoy the canal network safely and efficiently.

providers.name: Cerebrum
providers.description: Cerebrum is a free scientific literature search tool that uses AI to answer questions by querying open scholarly databases such as Europe PMC, PubMed, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar. It provides citations with DOIs, offers a learning companion called Nova, and operates without ads or tracking. The service is free with usage limits, and a paid tier removes caps. The platform is independent, built by its founder Dusty, and emphasizes transparency and privacy.

providers.name: Certero
providers.description: Certero is an enterprise IT Asset Management (ITAM) software vendor whose flagship CerteroX platform unifies visibility, observability, management, and governance across hardware, software, SaaS, and multi-cloud environments. The CerteroX suite includes CerteroX ITAM (hardware and network discovery), CerteroX SAM (software license optimization with publisher-specific modules for IBM, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Salesforce), CerteroX SaaS (subscription and shadow-IT management), CerteroX Cloud (FinOps for AWS, Azure, and GCP), and the CerteroX Command Center / AI reporting fabric. The platform is FinOps Foundation certified and integrates with ServiceNow, Microsoft, and Oracle ecosystems via APIs and connectors.

providers.name: Chorus Pro
providers.description: Chorus Pro is the French public platform for electronic invoicing and payment processing between public administrations and their suppliers. It provides a portal where businesses can submit, track, and manage invoices, access payment status, and retrieve related documentation, supporting the French e‑invoicing ecosystem.

providers.name: Cleardata
providers.description: ClearDATA is healthcare's dedicated cloud security, compliance, and operations partner, helping providers, payers, health-tech software companies, medical device makers, and life sciences organizations build and run on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud in a HIPAA- and HITRUST-aligned way. Its offering spans Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) with 300+ healthcare-specific safeguards, Managed Detection & Response (MDR), automated Cloud Compliance, and Cloud Operations, delivered through the CyberHealth platform and managed/professional services. ClearDATA is an AWS Level 1 MSSP and Microsoft Gold Partner, and maps controls to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, NIST, ISO, PCI, and GDPR. ClearDATA is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; ClearDATA does not publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Complyance
providers.description: Complyance is an AI-powered Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform for enterprise security, risk, and compliance teams. It automates manual GRC workflows across controls management, policy management, risk management, third-party and vendor risk management (TPRM), and customer trust, using purpose-built AI agents for evidence review, control advice, policy drafting, and vendor questionnaire and risk scoring. Complyance ships 100+ ready-made frameworks (including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST CSF 2.0, CMMC, and GDPR) plus 100+ enterprise integrations to centralize evidence and support audits at scale.

providers.name: Conductor AI
providers.description: Conductor AI (ConductorAI) is a defense- and intelligence-focused artificial intelligence company that turns disparate policy documents and organizational knowledge into agentic decision trees to accelerate document approvals and complex regulated workflows. Its Conduit platform combines agentic search across structured and unstructured data (Office documents, HTML, images, and video), workflow orchestration that encodes policy and expertise into AI-augmented decision steps, and review-and-collaboration tooling for redactions and compliance checks. Applications include ITAR/EAR export-control review, e-discovery and investigations, security-classification review, FOIA processing, and foreign-disclosure decisions. Conductor AI serves U.S. government and commercial customers and is backed by Lux Capital and Andreessen Horowitz. The company exposes no public developer API; integration is delivered as an enterprise platform.

providers.name: Contexter
providers.description: Contexter enables users to share AI context across multiple large language model assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Telegram. It provides a unified workspace where prompts, notes, and data can be persisted and accessed by different AI tools, facilitating seamless collaboration and continuity. The platform includes a Telegram bot, ChatGPT plugin, and Claude connector, allowing teams to maintain a single source of truth for AI-driven projects, improve productivity, and avoid redundant re‑prompting.

providers.name: Continual
providers.description: Continual was an operational-AI / MLOps platform for the modern data stack, founded by Tristan Zajonc (previously Sense, acquired by Cloudera) and Tyler Kohn (co-founder of RichRelevance). It let data and analytics teams declaratively build, deploy, and continuously maintain production predictive models directly inside cloud data warehouses — Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery — using SQL and dbt as the primary interface rather than bespoke ML pipelines. The company raised a seed round led by Amplify Partners and a $14.5M Series A in 2022. The product is now dormant: continual.ai is a parked single-page shell, the documentation host redirects to the homepage, and the last release of the first-party Python CLI + SDK on PyPI was in March 2023. This profile captures the verifiable public artifacts that remain — the PyPI package, the GitHub organization, and a live domain-security posture.

providers.name: Credit Sesame
providers.description: Credit Sesame is a consumer financial health platform that provides free daily credit-score monitoring, credit reports, and personalized recommendations for credit cards, loans, and insurance based on a member's approval likelihood. Members can build credit through everyday debit purchases and upgrade to the Sesame+ premium tier for three-bureau credit reports, advanced credit tools, and identity-theft protection. Credit Sesame operates consumer web and mobile applications and, as of this profile, does not publish a public developer API; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile backed by Menlo Ventures.

providers.name: DayDream Dental
providers.description: DayDream Dental is a full-service dental billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) provider that runs the insurance and billing operations for dental practices and DSOs so clinical teams can focus on patient care. Services span insurance verification with custom coding breakdowns saved directly to the practice management system (PMS), clean claims submission with attachments and narratives, payment posting with accurate insurance adjustments, diligent claim follow-up every seven days until paid with denials appealed, and patient billing via text, email, and mail. DayDream operates a HIPAA-focused trust center and a client dashboard app, and publishes a blog, CDT-code and payer references, videos, and demo scheduling for onboarding new offices. This is a service company rather than an API provider — it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: DecaData
providers.description: DecaData provides daily customer insights and market data for savvy buyers, delivering real‑time analytics and nowcasts on consumer trends, pricing and inflation. The platform aggregates diverse data sources to help businesses make informed decisions.

providers.name: Ediphi
providers.description: Ediphi is a cloud-native preconstruction platform for commercial construction contractors that unifies estimating, cost modeling, general conditions and general requirements (GCs & GRs) tracking, bid-package contracting, and a shared cloud unit-price catalog in one real-time collaborative workspace. Founded by Dustin DeVan (founder of BuildingConnected, acquired by Autodesk), it is used by ENR Top 400 general contractors including Hensel Phelps, Suffolk Construction, and DPR Construction. Its "Last Mile" module provides API-driven automation for Excel integration and reporting. Ediphi runs a private application API at api.ediphi.com; as of this profile there is no public developer portal or published API specification.

providers.name: Eudia
providers.description: Eudia is an enterprise augmented-intelligence platform for in-house legal, compliance, and procurement teams at large organizations and government agencies. Its "Enterprise Brain" ingests a company's contracts, policies, precedents, and prior decisions and codifies the judgment of its legal experts into governed AI workflows, while "Expert Digital Twins" let business teams self-serve governed legal guidance without direct attorney involvement. Products span compliance automation, contracting, decision self-service, mergers and acquisitions, and litigation support, with connectors into Microsoft, Google Drive, SharePoint, Box, Salesforce, DocuSign, OnIt, and LinkSquares. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, Eudia raised a Series A of up to $105M led by General Catalyst with Sierra Ventures, Floodgate, and Defy Partners. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, trust, and security posture.

providers.name: Figures
providers.description: Figures is a European compensation management and pay transparency platform that helps HR teams and managers make strategic salary decisions using real-time market data. It combines salary benchmarking across 3.5M+ datapoints, dynamic salary bands, collaborative compensation review workflows, and pay equity analysis, with modules built for the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Figures connects to 30+ HRIS and performance-review systems to enrich internal pay data, and is used by organizations including KPMG, EY, Qonto, and TotalEnergies. It is backed by Point Nine and Seedcamp. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; Figures does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Firstory
providers.description: Firstory is a podcast hosting and monetization platform for creators, holding the leading share of the Mandarin-language podcast market and a growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region with over 14,000 shows. Creators upload an episode once and distribute it to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, KKBOX, YouTube, Amazon Music, Pocket Casts, and more than ten other players, then use AI Studio to auto-generate transcripts, summaries, highlights, and newsletter drafts. Firstory layers on second-by-second analytics, dynamic ad insertion, membership subscriptions, listener donations, cross-promotion, a personal website builder, the Flink universal link, and embeddable players. It does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public surface and infrastructure signals.

providers.name: FranConnect
providers.description: FranConnect is a franchise and multi-location management platform used by 1,500+ brands across roughly one million locations, covering franchise development and sales, franchisee/unit information management, field operations and audits, financials and royalties, and CRM. Its FranConnect Sky product exposes a RESTful API - organized by module (Franchise Sales "fs", CRM "cm", Info Manager "fim", Finance "manage-finance", and Admin "admin") - that lets customers import and export data between FranConnect Sky and third-party applications. All API calls are made over HTTPS and authenticated with an Authorization-Token header. API access is not open/self-serve - it is gated behind a FranConnect Sky customer or partner account, with credentials provisioned by FranConnect, and the reference documentation portal (docs.franconnect.net) requires a signed-in account.

providers.name: Graneet
providers.description: Graneet is a French vertical-SaaS ERP for the construction and public-works (BTP) sector, built for small and mid-sized contractors (roughly EUR 2M to 100M in revenue) to protect project profitability from the office to the job site. It unifies cost estimating and quotations, progress (situation) invoicing, purchase and supplier-invoice management, project planning and labor tracking, cash and bank reconciliation, and real-time margin dashboards, with a companion mobile app and prebuilt integrations to accounting tools such as Sage 100 and Pennylane. The product is delivered as a cloud application (app.graneet.com) backed by internal Main, BFF, and Quotation APIs; there is no public developer API or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Granthika
providers.description: Granthika is a writing-software company founded by novelist Vikram Chandra (author of Sacred Games) and Borislav Iordanov. Its product is a first-of-its-kind semantic editor for professional and aspiring writers that lets authors capture and manage the knowledge inside a manuscript — characters, locations, events, and narrative structure — as they write, then integrate that knowledge back into the text. Features include universe/knowledge building, a timeline, semantic search, an intelligent analyzer, and language assistance, delivered as both an online app and a desktop application with free trials and educational subscriptions. Granthika was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. It publishes no bespoke developer/product API; its marketing site runs on Wix, which exposes a public Wix Site MCP endpoint and an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Gruve
providers.description: Gruve Inc. is an AI-driven enterprise services and technology company that helps large organizations adopt and secure artificial intelligence. Its portfolio spans private AI infrastructure (PulseAI, deployable in under two weeks for data sovereignty), AI-powered cybersecurity (AI SOC, digital forensics and incident response, and managed AI security services), Data & AI strategy and infrastructure, and Customer Experience delivered on Salesforce. Gruve targets enterprises of roughly 5,000 to 50,000 employees and serves CXOs, IT, security, and data leaders globally. Backed by Mayfield, the company operates a public trust center (SafeBase by Drata) attesting SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Gruve is a services and platform provider and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Illumix
providers.description: Illumix is an enterprise-grade spatial AI company spun out of Stanford's Computer Science Department, providing a core stack for real-world location intelligence that runs at the edge with centimeter-level precision. Its hardware-agnostic platform delivers sub-second localization and 3D mapping across mobile devices, AR/VR wearables, and robotics using standard cameras — with no LiDAR or GPS dependency — combining multimodal vision-language AI with long-term memory that learns behavior over time. Illumix serves AI/XR wearables, enterprise and logistics, defense and security, location-based entertainment, and robotics, with deployments referenced for Disney, Six Flags, Cedar Fair, MGM Resorts, Warner Bros, Verizon, and Sony. The company markets developer APIs and an SDK as part of a full-stack offering, but publishes no public developer portal, reference documentation, or machine-readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: India Meteorological Department
providers.description: India Meteorological Department (IMD; Hindi भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग) is the national weather agency of India under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India, responsible for weather forecasting, climate monitoring and meteorological services. Through its IMD API Management portal (api.imd.gov.in), with self-service account registration, IMD offers developers JSON APIs for current weather observations, city-level forecasts, district nowcasts and warnings, rainfall data and marine bulletins, documented in an HTML API reference and a PDF API document.

providers.name: Julaya
providers.description: Julaya is a West African B2B fintech, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, that digitizes corporate financial operations across the UEMOA zone (Cote d'Ivoire, Senegal, Benin and Togo). Its pro account lets businesses send mobile money and bank transfers, collect cash and mobile-money deposits, pay suppliers and run payroll, and receive UEMOA-wide transfers via a Julaya IBAN, with multi-company sub-wallets, approval and signature workflows, real-time transaction tracking and accounting exports. Julaya is licensed as a payment establishment in Cote d'Ivoire and connects businesses to mobile-money rails including Orange Money, Wave, MTN MoMo, Moov and Wizall. A partner integration API (api.julaya.co) exposes disbursement and collection programmatically for enterprise customers.

providers.name: Kenect
providers.description: Kenect provides AI-driven customer engagement tools for dealerships, enabling texting, voice, reviews, payments, and reputation management. Their platform integrates messaging, AI chat, and analytics to help automotive businesses improve sales, service, and online presence. The service offers a suite of products including Engage AI, Voice AI, Text Messaging, Reviews, Payments, and a mobile app, all designed to streamline communication and boost customer satisfaction.

providers.name: kenwea-com
providers.description: Kenwea Protocol is a marketplace where AI agents sell digital products and custom work and people buy them, beside free open-source Kenwea Labs Picks, with sandbox-gated listings and escrow-protected checkout.

providers.name: LiveAuctioneers
providers.description: LiveAuctioneers is the world's largest online marketplace for fine art, antiques, jewelry, collectibles, and luxury goods, connecting bidders with thousands of vetted auction houses worldwide. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in New York, it is part of Auction Technology Group (ATG). The platform offers live and timed online bidding, absentee and proxy bids, an auction-results and price-research database, seller consignment services, and an auctioneer partner portal. It is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-marketplace company profile surfaced from the Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: MoonLake AI
providers.description: Moonlake AI Inc. is a San Francisco based company building world models and simulation infrastructure for embodied AI. Its platform turns an image, video, or text description into physically accurate, simulation-ready 3D models of the world — assets shipped with baked-in physics and articulation (joints, ranges, drive limits) that export directly to USD, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and MuJoCo. Teams generate sim environments and digital twins in hours instead of weeks via a hosted generation API. Moonlake is backed by Threshold (formerly DFJ), AIX Ventures, and NVIDIA's venture arm, and was named to the CB Insights AI 100 in 2026.

providers.name: MostlyPDF
providers.description: MostlyPDF provides a free online suite of PDF tools and a flat‑priced API that consolidates 38 PDF operations—merge, split, compress, OCR, conversion and more—into a single endpoint. Users can process files via base64 payloads with a bearer token, enabling automation of everyday document workflows without per‑operation credit weighting. The service is offered by Mostly Tiny Ltd and includes a free plan with no sign‑up, watermark, or daily limits.

providers.name: NumberHub
providers.description: NumberHub provides a REST API for a prepaid USD wallet offering SMS verification numbers, number rentals, travel eSIM data plans, email OTP services, and residential proxy data packages. The platform enables developers to programmatically receive verification SMS and email, rent phone numbers, buy prepaid data-only travel eSIMs, and access proxy endpoints, with pricing and catalog updates reflected in real time. It supports idempotent operations via Idempotency-Key and detailed retry semantics for action endpoints.

providers.name: Numina
providers.description: Numina is a New York City-based urban street-intelligence company (founded 2014, backed by 500 Global and SOSV) whose privacy-first, edge-processing computer-vision sensors measure how people, bicycles, and vehicles move through the public right-of-way. Its "Know Your Streets" platform turns anonymous, aggregated activity into multimodal mobility data for urban planners, municipal departments of transportation, and facilities managers, and exposes that data through the Numina Graph GraphQL API and a developer sandbox. (This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio stub under the placeholder label "CTY"; its Website pointer and 500 Global backing identify it as Numina / numina.co.)

providers.name: Orum
providers.description: Orum provides an agentic AI-powered cold calling software and sales dialer platform that automates dialing sessions, improves rep performance, and integrates with various sales tools. The solution offers features like intelligent call routing, real-time coaching, analytics, and compliance tools, targeting sales teams seeking to increase efficiency and scale outreach.

providers.name: Oviva
providers.description: Oviva is a European digital health company, founded in 2014, delivering personalized, dietitian-led care for people managing type 2 diabetes, obesity, and other diet-related conditions. It combines a mobile app for logging food, activity, and progress with human coaching from a network of 420+ dietitians, psychologists, and doctors, operating across the UK, Germany, and Switzerland and serving 900K+ people. Oviva is delivered as a regulated digital therapeutic (CE-marked, ISO 27001, NHS DTAC and CQC assessed) rather than through a public developer API; this profile captures its security, compliance, and legal surface. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: Pontem
providers.description: Pontem is a Web3 product development studio building with the Move language on Aptos and other Layer 1 blockchains, in partnership with Aptos Labs. Its product portfolio spans the Pontem Wallet (a browser-extension and mobile crypto wallet for APT, MOVE, ETH, SOL and more), the Liquidswap decentralized exchange and AMM, the Lumio L2 VM-abstraction framework, and a Move developer tooling suite that includes the Move Code Playground, the IntelliJ Move IDE plugin, the ByteBabel Solidity-to-Move bytecode translator, and the Dove Move package manager. Pontem publishes first-party TypeScript SDKs, an embeddable Liquidswap web-component widget, wallet adapters, and CLIs. Backed by Pantera Capital, Animoca Brands, and Aptos Labs.

providers.name: PREDIK Data-Driven
providers.description: PREDIK Data-Driven is a big-data analytics and location-intelligence research firm (founded 2008, Coral Gables, Florida) that builds enriched geospatial datasets for site selection, demand forecasting, and web/reference intelligence. Its products cover Point-of-Interest (POI) data, aggregated foot-traffic and human mobility data derived from anonymized mobile devices, company and commercial-area intelligence, and socio-demographic enrichment - divided into geohash-7 (150x150m) cells with 100-200+ variables and coverage of up to 96 countries. PREDIK is a data-delivery / contact-sales provider - datasets are licensed and delivered as managed feeds via REST API, SOAP API, Feed API, or S3 bucket in JSON, CSV, and SQL formats. There is no public self-serve developer API portal or published API reference; access is arranged directly with PREDIK or through the Datarade marketplace. Endpoints are not publicly documented and are therefore not modeled here.

providers.name: Qevlar AI
providers.description: Qevlar AI is an autonomous Security Operations Center (SOC) platform that investigates every security alert the way a top analyst would — without playbooks, without hallucinations, and without adding headcount. Founded in 2023 by Ahmed Achchak and Hamza Sayah and headquartered in Paris, France, the company runs a proprietary graph-based AI orchestrator (not an LLM agent) that delivers deterministic, evidence-based investigations across the full security stack. As soon as an alert fires from SIEM/EDR tools, Qevlar autonomously pulls, enriches, and analyzes internal and external data, then returns a conclusive malicious/benign verdict, a full investigation report, and recommended remediation — typically in under three minutes, closing up to 80% of tickets automatically. The SaaS platform is SOC 2 Type 2 certified, hosted in the EU (Belgium) on GCP, and connects via API to 50+ security tools (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Cortex, Google SecOps, and more). It is trusted by Fortune Global 500 enterprises and leading MSSPs/MDRs across Europe and the US. Backed by EQT Ventures and Partech.

providers.name: ReadSpeaker
providers.description: ReadSpeaker provides text-to-speech (TTS) cloud and embedded solutions used to add voice to websites, mobile apps, e-learning, transportation systems, and more. The speechCloud API converts text into high-quality audio in multiple languages and voices that can be returned in formats such as MP3 for use within applications.

providers.name: RetailNext
providers.description: RetailNext is an AI-powered in-store retail analytics platform that helps physical retailers understand shopper behavior and optimize store operations. Its product suite spans traffic analytics (real-time foot-traffic counting and benchmarking across locations), shopper journey and zone insights (which layouts convert and where shoppers are lost), asset protection and loss prevention that combines video intelligence with shopper analytics, and Pulse AI, a conversational layer for answering retail questions in plain language. The platform is used by 600+ retailers across 100+ countries, including brands such as Macy's, Sephora, and Calvin Klein. RetailNext is a Battery Ventures portfolio company. It maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source infrastructure tooling and publishes a responsible-disclosure security program, but does not currently expose a publicly documented developer API or portal.

providers.name: Route
providers.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Rx Redefined
providers.description: Rx Redefined Inc is a healthcare technology company in Arroyo Grande, California, founded in 2018, that operates a patented, compliance-focused DMEPOS (durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics and supplies) platform for physicians. The platform lets a medical practice become a licensed physician-owned DMEPOS supplier and distribute medical supplies — insulin pumps, breast pumps, ostomy pouches, urinary catheters — directly to its own patients instead of handing the order to a third-party supplier. It ships two products: a Full-Service product built around physician personal performance, and an In-Office product built around the in-office ancillary services exception. The platform covers CMS licensing onboarding, electronic ordering with per-order compliance and eligibility checks, supply-chain integration with 10+ U.S. distribution centers, and end-to-end revenue-cycle and audit management. The company reports use across 350+ U.S. clinics and runs on ISO 27001 certified infrastructure with HIPAA controls. The product is a customer-only web application at app.rxredefined.com; Rx Redefined publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Southwestern Energy
providers.description: Southwestern Energy Company (SWN) is one of the largest producers of natural gas in the United States, with exploration and production operations focused primarily on the Marcellus and Haynesville shales. In October 2024, Southwestern Energy completed a merger with Expand Energy Corporation (formerly Chesapeake Energy), though the SWN brand and investor relations infrastructure continues to operate under swn.com. As a Fortune 500 energy company, SWN focuses on responsible development of natural gas resources in the Appalachian Basin and Gulf Coast regions.

providers.name: Speaker Deck
providers.description: Speaker Deck is an online platform that enables users to upload, share, and embed presentation decks easily. It offers features such as private URLs, password protection, custom URLs, scheduled publishing, branding removal, and embedding restrictions, catering to professionals, educators, and developers who want to showcase their slides publicly or within teams.

providers.name: Suzy
providers.description: Suzy is an AI-driven consumer insights platform that unifies quantitative surveys (Suzy Insights), qualitative research (moderated Suzy Live IDIs and AI-moderated Suzy Speaks voice interviews), real-time cultural trend intelligence (Suzy Signals), and on-demand access to 1M+ verified consumers protected by BIOTIC fraud detection (Suzy Audiences). Its AI Suite adds screeners, summaries, themeing, and predictive heatmaps so enterprise brand, product, marketing, shopper, and insights teams can validate ideas and move at the speed of culture. Surfaced as a foundry-group portfolio company and enriched from public web sources; Suzy publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Tabcorp
providers.description: Tabcorp Holdings Limited is an ASX-listed (TAH) Australian wagering, media and gaming services company headquartered in Melbourne. Its Wagering and Media business runs the TAB brand (totalisator and fixed-odds betting through retail venues, online, mobile and phone channels) and Sky Racing television and Sky Sports Radio; its Gaming Services business operates under the MAX brand, monitoring electronic gaming machines for regulators and supplying and maintaining venue gaming systems. Its former Lotteries and Keno arm was demerged in 2022 as The Lottery Corporation. Tabcorp publishes open-source technology projects through its GitHub organization and runs the TAB Studio developer portal (studio.tab.com.au) for the TAB API at api.beta.tab.com.au, both geo-restricted to licensed jurisdictions. Surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (australia-apidays-2026).

providers.name: The Block
providers.description: The Block is a New York-based digital-assets research, analysis, and news brand founded in 2018, covering cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Web3 markets. Its subscription platform, The Block Pro, packages breaking news, in-depth research, proprietary datasets, and venture-funding intelligence for professional investors, funds, and enterprises. The Block Pro also exposes a set of license-gated APIs - a real-time News API (REST, request-only, JSON), a Deals/Funding API, an Ecosystems/Data API, and a WebSocket news stream - available only to organizations holding a Block Pro subscription. The APIs have no public developer portal or OpenAPI definition; access and technical documentation are arranged through The Block's client-services team.

providers.name: The Carlyle Group
providers.description: The Carlyle Group (NASDAQ: CG) is a global investment firm that deploys private capital across Global Private Equity, Global Credit, Global Investment Solutions (AlpInvest), and carveouts such as Carlyle Direct Lending. Carlyle does not publish a public developer API. Institutional LPs, co-investors, and portfolio companies interact with the firm through a set of private, authentication-gated portals: LP Connect for fund investors, Carlyle Direct Lending's portal for direct lending clients, the Carlyle Global Portfolio Solutions (resources.carlyle.com) portal, and brand experiences such as Carlyle & Co. Integrations with fund administrators, custodians, and placement agents run through bespoke secure file exchange and vendor-managed APIs.

providers.name: Thematic
providers.description: Thematic is a copyright-free music licensing platform that connects independent content creators with emerging artists. Creators get a permanent, no-cost license to use tracks in their videos in exchange for including a promotional link in the description, which activates YouTube Content ID whitelisting and prevents copyright claims across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and podcasts. Premium ($9.99/mo) and Pro ($24.99/mo) plans unlock the full catalog, podcast licensing, and unlimited downloads. Co-founded with YouTube pioneer Michelle Phan, Thematic serves 1M+ creators and 10,000+ independent artists across 220+ countries. Thematic runs a consumer web and mobile app and does not currently publish a public developer API. Backed by 500 Global and Lux Capital.

providers.name: TraceAir
providers.description: TraceAir is a construction site intelligence platform for homebuilders and land developers, combining drone photogrammetry and LiDAR scans with cloud analytics to track sitework progress, verify earthwork cut/fill quantities, generate lot layouts and yield estimates, and document builds with 360-degree interior scans across the full project lifecycle from land acquisition to handover. The company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the platform is accessed through its web application.

providers.name: TurboTenant
providers.description: TurboTenant is a rental property management platform designed for independent landlords and property managers. It provides tools for advertising rental listings across 28+ syndication sites, managing tenant applications, conducting background and credit screening, creating lease agreements, collecting rent online, handling maintenance requests, and in-app messaging. The platform integrates with partner services via API for renters insurance, accounting, and other property management workflows.

providers.name: VanHack
providers.description: VanHack is a SaaS hiring platform that connects employers with pre-screened senior software engineers from a global community of over 500,000 vetted candidates who are ready to relocate or work remotely. The platform pairs expert human recruiters with Vanna, an AI recruiter that matches candidates from natural-language job descriptions, and coordinates interviews with calendar sync, Slack, and ATS integration. VanHack reports 2,300+ hires at 520+ companies and charges a flat monthly fee with no placement fees. The company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Vennre
providers.description: Vennre is a Sharia-compliant private-market investing platform built for HENRYs (High Earners, Not Rich Yet). It curates and vets institutional-grade opportunities across real estate, private equity, venture capital and private credit from leading global managers, lowering entry thresholds so members can start building wealth from as little as $5,000. Delivered through a mobile app and web experience with a smart wallet, portfolio tracking and personalized wealth coaching, the platform is regulated in the UK as an appointed representative of Talbot Capital Ltd (FCA FRN 489839) and operates in Saudi Arabia under the Capital Market Authority (CMA License 19206-20). Vennre is a consumer wealthtech product; no public developer API or developer platform is published at this time.

providers.name: Verax
providers.description: Verax AI is an enterprise AI security platform that gives organizations real-time visibility and control over how employees and agents use generative AI. Its flagship product, Verax Protect, discovers shadow AI usage across every LLM tool, enforces identity- and role-aware access policies, and applies content-aware data-loss prevention to stop sensitive data from leaking into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and other AI services. Verax Control Center adds monitoring and governance for LLM-based products running in production. Verax deploys via an endpoint agent and integrates with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace for identity. Founded in 2023 (Dallas, Tel Aviv, London) and backed by TQ Ventures, Seedcamp and others.

providers.name: Viome
providers.description: Viome (Viome Life Sciences) is a health technology company founded in 2016 by Naveen Jain that uses metatranscriptomic RNA sequencing — a technique originally developed for biodefense at Los Alamos National Laboratory — combined with artificial intelligence to measure active gene expression across the gut microbiome, oral microbiome, and human cells. From at-home stool, saliva, and finger-prick blood samples the company produces over 50 health scores across eight categories (BioAge, Gut Health, Oral Health, Energy, Inflammaging, Mood/Memory/Focus, Immunity, and Heart and Metabolic Health), personalized food recommendations across more than 370 foods, and custom-blended precision supplements and biotics. Products include the Full Body Intelligence, Gut Intelligence, and Oral Health Intelligence tests plus the CancerDetect saliva screening test for oral and throat cancer. Viome operates in over 100 countries, publishes peer-reviewed research in NPJ Genomic Medicine, iScience, and Microbiome, and runs a Life Sciences research division. Viome publishes no public developer API or machine-readable API contract; its consumer app at my.viome.com is served by an undocumented private backend, and the only agent-facing artifact the company publishes is a curated llms.txt.

providers.name: Waste Connections
providers.description: Waste Connections is the third-largest integrated provider of solid waste services in North America, serving approximately nine million residential, commercial, and industrial customers across 46 U.S. states and six Canadian provinces. The company provides non-hazardous waste collection, transfer, disposal, and recycling services, primarily in exclusive and secondary markets. Waste Connections is investing in AI-powered dynamic routing and expanding customer connectivity features through its online customer portal.

providers.name: Wattpad
providers.description: Wattpad is a Toronto-based social storytelling platform where a global community of more than 90 million writers and readers create, share, and read serialized original fiction across every genre. Founded in 2006 and acquired by Naver (WEBTOON) in 2021, Wattpad extends its stories into publishing, film, and TV through Wattpad WEBTOON Studios. Wattpad formerly operated a public developer API (developer.wattpad.com), but public access was discontinued around April 2018 and the API is now internal-only, so this profile captures the company's web properties and operational surface rather than an active API program.

providers.name: xChange
providers.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

providers.name: Zania
providers.description: Zania provides AI‑driven compliance agents that automate third‑party risk management, security controls testing, and audit workflows. Leveraging large‑language models, Zania’s platform delivers high‑accuracy risk assessments, SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR, PCI‑DSS compliance automation, and real‑time security insights for enterprises.

providers.name: Zibra AI
providers.description: Zibra AI is a Ukrainian deep-tech company building AI-powered real-time volumetric rendering and compression technology for VFX, gaming, virtual production, film, and TV. Its flagship product, ZibraVDB, compresses OpenVDB volumetric datasets to roughly five percent of their original size while preserving visual quality, enabling real-time playback of smoke, fire, fog, and other volumetric effects. Zibra ships a native C++ ZibraVDB SDK (DirectX 12, Vulkan, and Metal on Windows, Linux, and macOS) alongside plugins for Unreal Engine, Houdini, and Unity, with Blender support in progress. It exposes no public REST/HTTP API; integration is through the SDK and digital-content-creation plugins. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zumper
providers.description: Zumper is a rental listing marketplace that connects renters with landlords and property managers across the United States and Canada. The platform provides access to apartment listings, property data, rental price insights, and tenant application management. Zumper offers a REST API and syndication feeds enabling property management software providers and partners to publish listings, retrieve rental market data, and integrate tenant screening and leasing workflows. The platform processes over 76 million site visits annually and syndicates listings across PadMapper, ChatGPT, Microsoft Bing, and Realtor.com.

providers.name: 2Ship
providers.description: 2Ship provides shipping software solutions for businesses of all sizes, offering a platform that integrates carrier services, logistics management, and advanced shipping features. Their offerings include packages and pricing plans for small businesses, corporate mailrooms, 3PL providers, and freight forwarders, as well as APIs, ODBC, and embed options for developers to integrate shipping capabilities directly into their applications.

providers.name: Afori
providers.description: Afori is a Barcelona- and Germany-based insurtech building an AI software platform designed specifically for insurance brokers (Versicherungsmakler). Its first product is an AI Sidebar that lives inside Microsoft Outlook and broker management systems (Maklerverwaltungsprogramme), turning unstructured emails and documents into structured, review-ready cases with tasks and reminders, context-aware email drafts, and prefilled claim notifications. Specialized AI agents (KI-Helfer) automate insurance-specific back-office work while keeping every action documented and auditable. The platform is EU-hosted, GDPR (DSGVO) compliant, ISO 27001:2022 certified, and built within the European regulatory framework (IDD, EU AI Act). Founded in 2025 by former wefox leaders Fabian Wesemann (CEO) and Sergi Banos (CTO), Afori raised a EUR 4M round led by General Catalyst. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched from Afori's public web surface; the company currently publishes no developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Akeana
providers.description: Akeana is a semiconductor IP company building high-performance RISC-V processor system IP, with the stated mission of elevating RISC-V to world-class performance levels. It licenses customizable processor cores across three families (the ultra-low-power 100 Series for deeply embedded controllers, the 1000 Series for high-performance edge AI and automotive compute, and the ultra-high-performance 5000 Series for data center, networking, and mobile application processors), plus hardware accelerator IP, AMBA-compliant interconnect fabric IP (AXI, ACE, CHI), and system IP (interrupt controllers, IOMMU, PCIe, UCIe). Backed by Kleiner Perkins and Mayfield, Akeana partners with Samsung Foundry, Canonical, Innatera, Axiomise, and proteanTecs. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

providers.name: Ampere Computing
providers.description: Ampere Computing is a Santa Clara, California semiconductor company founded in 2018 by Renee James and now part of the SoftBank Group. It designs Arm-based Cloud Native Processors — the Ampere Altra and Altra Max families (up to 128 cores) and the flagship AmpereOne family (up to 192 single-threaded cores) — for cloud, AI inference and edge deployments. Alongside the silicon it ships a software stack: Ampere Optimized AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime, llama.cpp, Ollama) distributed as first-party container images, tuned GCC/glibc/binutils builds, performance and porting tooling, and an arm64 developer community. Ampere publishes no public developer API — its developer program is a hardware, tooling and porting program rather than an API program.

providers.name: Ask My Envoy
providers.description: Ask My Envoy provides AI‑driven meeting coordination software that automates scheduling across calendars, handling complex constraints and multi‑company meetings. The platform offers booking links, integrates with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook, and includes trust, control, and pricing tiers. It aims to replace paper planners with intelligent agents that manage availability, routing rules, and meeting logistics.

providers.name: Assured
providers.description: Assured is an AI platform for end-to-end property and casualty (P&C) insurance claims processing, positioning itself as the most widely deployed AI in P&C and processing tens of millions of claims annually. Its modular, interconnected products span the claims lifecycle: FNOL (First Notice of Loss) digital intake, Voice AI telephonic intake, First Contact document gathering, Service Assignment contractor scheduling, omnichannel Messaging, the Emma agentic claim-analysis assistant, the Sidekick telephonic FNOL assistant for adjusters, Fraud Detection, and CAT catastrophe triage. The platform is model-agnostic (working across multiple frontier AI providers), with claims-specific safety controls, explainability, human-in-the-loop workflows, and enterprise-grade monitoring and guardrails. Assured serves personal and commercial auto, homeowners, commercial property, and workers' compensation lines. It is an enterprise, sales-led product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or self-serve documentation. Backed by Costanoa Ventures, DCM Ventures, ICONIQ Capital, Kindred Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins.

providers.name: baipiaoji-com
providers.description: baipiaoji-com operates a Chinese-language platform that aggregates free AI tools, quota comparisons, and practical toolboxes for developers and end‑users. The site curates AI services, provides detailed usage limits, commercial terms, and offers a catalog of over 700 third‑party tools with verified free tiers. It also hosts a developer API directory, guides on integrating AI models, and resources for building agents and MCP (Machine‑Centric Platforms). The platform emphasizes transparency, source verification, and regular updates to ensure users can quickly find cost‑effective AI solutions.

providers.name: Bespree
providers.description: Bespree provides AI-powered tools for job seekers, including resume building, cover letter generation, interview practice, and local job search. The platform offers a free account with no credit card required, aiming to streamline the job application process through automation and personalization.

providers.name: Bigfinite
providers.description: Bigfinite (now Aizon) is a B2B SaaS provider of AI-powered manufacturing intelligence for pharmaceutical manufacturers and CDMOs. The platform turns GxP manufacturing process data into ML-driven recommendations to improve yield, reduce deviations, and prevent batch loss without replacing existing MES, LIMS, or historian systems. Its product stack spans Aizon Execute (intelligent electronic batch records), Aizon Unify (a GxP manufacturing data platform with ALCOA++ integrity), Aizon Predict (operationalized ML for yield optimization, CPV, and predictive quality), and Aizon Agentic Studio (a natural-language application builder). Aizon runs single-tenant on AWS and maintains ISO 27001, ISO 27017, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11 compliance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from public web surfaces; the company publishes no public API.

providers.name: Bigvalue
providers.description: Bigvalue is a South Korean proptech company providing AI‑powered real‑estate valuation services. Its platform offers automated property value assessment for the Korean market, delivering data‑driven pricing intelligence to buyers, sellers, agents, and financial institutions.

providers.name: Brightpearl
providers.description: Brightpearl provides a cloud‑based retail operating system for multichannel ecommerce businesses, offering inventory, order, accounting, CRM, and analytics capabilities. The platform helps retailers streamline operations, integrate with major ecommerce marketplaces, and gain real‑time insights to improve efficiency and customer experience.

providers.name: CADProps
providers.description: CADProps provides a multi-format CAD viewer and online measurement tools. Users can quickly view and measure SolidWorks, NX, Inventor, CATIA, Parasolid X_T, SAT, JT, STEP, IGES, and mesh formats directly in the browser. The service also offers file conversion and sharing via link with optional password protection. It aims to simplify 3D model inspection and collaboration without installing specialized software.

providers.name: Cato Digital
providers.description: Cato Digital is a sustainable bare metal cloud provider that repurposes large-scale, second-life servers from hyperscalers like Meta and NVIDIA to deliver AI & GPU servers (up to 512GB VRAM), ephemeral application servers, and build-your-own storage arrays at 60-75% below major cloud providers. Led by CEO Dean Nelson, the company operates on a "use what we have before we build more" circular-economy principle, tapping underutilized data center capacity and clean energy, and is a founding member of the Infrastructure Masons Climate Accord. Customers provision and manage infrastructure through the Cato console rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Chewy
providers.description: Chewy, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American online retailer of pet food, pet products, prescription medications, and veterinary services headquartered in Plantation, Florida. Chewy is one of the largest e-commerce pet retailers in the United States and supports a customer-focused operating model centered on subscription Autoship orders, Chewy Pharmacy prescription fulfillment, Connect with a Vet telehealth, and Chewy Health insurance. Chewy provides vendor and supplier integration primarily through the Dsco supplier integration platform rather than a public consumer-facing developer API. The Dsco-based integration supports core EDI transactions for purchase orders, inventory updates, shipment confirmations, and invoices, enabling brands and third-party logistics providers to connect with Chewy's e-commerce marketplace.

providers.name: CloudNuro
providers.description: CloudNuro is an enterprise SaaS management and FinOps platform that combines SaaS discovery (shadow IT), SaaS subscription and license optimization, user lifecycle and compliance management, SaaS-Chargeback and cost allocation, and Cloud FinOps for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. It offers 400+ pre-built connectors to leading SaaS, IaaS, IAM, ITSM, HR, and security platforms. CloudNuro is SOC 2 Type II certified and has been recognized by Gartner in the SaaS Management Platforms market guide.

providers.name: Crosswire
providers.description: Crosswire provides a financial infrastructure orchestration platform offering modular banking, cross‑border payments, digital assets, acquiring, KYC, and technology APIs. It targets complex, high‑risk businesses such as crypto exchanges, iGaming, forex brokers, marketplaces and adult services, delivering embedded finance stacks with real‑time settlement, virtual IBANs, and compliance automation. The platform enables companies to build and price custom stacks, integrate with multiple rails, and manage identity verification, all via unified APIs.

providers.name: cryptopulse-uno
providers.description: cryptopulse-uno is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Dance
providers.description: Dance is a Berlin-based electric mobility subscription company that offers e-bikes and e-mopeds as an all-in-one monthly subscription. A single fixed monthly fee bundles the vehicle together with on-demand repairs and maintenance, fast replacements, and theft protection, so members can ride without owning or servicing the hardware themselves. Dance operates in Berlin, Hamburg, and Paris, with product lines including the Dance One and Dance One Step e-bikes and the Dance Moped. Founded in 2020 by SoundCloud co-founders Alexander Ljung and Eric Quidenus-Wahlforss with Jimdo co-founder Christian Springub, Dance is a consumer-facing, app-based service backed by HV Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, help, and security surface.

providers.name: Dazbench
providers.description: Dazbench provides a platform where users can turn a single line of instruction into a fully‑fleshed AI‑generated task. It offers context‑ready work cards, allowing AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, or Codex to receive purpose, background, and acceptance criteria, then produce the completed output. The service includes a free starter tier, integration via MCP, and a UI for managing AI‑driven workflows.

providers.name: Denticon
providers.description: Denticon is a cloud-based dental practice management platform built for dental service organizations (DSOs) and multi-location group practices, owned and operated by Planet DDS (which also owns Cloud 9 Ortho and Apteryx imaging). The Denticon API program - relaunched in July 2024 on a new developer portal powered by Azure API Management - exposes RESTful APIs, webhooks, and batch data extracts covering patient, appointment, financial/ledger, insurance and claims (Revenue Cycle Management), clinical, and practice/office data, with OAuth 2.0 auth, an event-driven architecture for synchronized updates, and writebacks into Denticon. API access is partner-gated - Planet DDS must approve vendors and each client practice authorizes vendor access to specific office locations (OIDs). Public documentation exists, but keys and interactive access require program enrollment, so the endpoint surface below is modeled from the published API categories rather than a downloadable OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Drivepoint
providers.description: Drivepoint offers an AI‑driven finance platform for consumer brands that consolidates finance, operations, and market data into a single source of truth. The platform provides dynamic financial modeling, automated scenario analysis, and board‑ready reporting, as well as autonomous AI agents that monitor data and surface insights for founders, CEOs, CFOs, and finance teams.

providers.name: EAS Innovations Inc
providers.description: EAS Innovations Inc, operating under the brand Elev8, provides a comprehensive dealer management system for automotive dealerships. Their platform streamlines operations across accounting, inventory, CRM, loan servicing, and more, targeting independent auto dealers and finance companies. Elev8 offers real‑time data, integrated tools, and cloud‑based access to improve efficiency and growth.

providers.name: Empathy
providers.description: Empathy is a support platform that helps organizations guide people through loss, leave, and legacy moments, combining AI with human care to serve individuals navigating grief, estate planning, and major life transitions. Its products include LifeVault digital estate planning, Loss Support for beneficiaries handling claims and grief, Leave Support for employees during difficult life events, and Client Connect for advisors. Empathy sells to life insurance companies, banks and wealth managers, employers, health plans, and benefit consultants, covering 50M+ individuals. Backed by General Catalyst and Index Ventures. As of this profile Empathy publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Farmbot Monitoring Solutions
providers.description: Farmbot Monitoring Solutions, founded in Sydney in 2014, is a leading Australian AgTech company providing water level monitoring and sensor solutions for farms. Their experienced team understands farmers' daily challenges and delivers user‑friendly products that reduce costs, boost productivity, and streamline farm management.

providers.name: Field Medical
providers.description: Field Medical, Inc. is a Carlsbad, California clinical-stage cardiac electrophysiology company founded in 2022 by Dr. Steven Mickelsen to build a second-generation pulsed field ablation (PFA) platform. Its FieldForce Ablation System pairs a focal catheter design with proprietary FieldBending energy and is positioned as the first PFA system purpose-built for ventricular arrhythmia ablation, with atrial fibrillation applications in development. The company holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and a place in the FDA TAP Pilot Program for its VT indication, has published first-in-human VCAS data in Circulation, and has raised roughly $75M across Series A and Series B. Field Medical is a medical device manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public REST/GraphQL API and no SDKs. Its only machine-readable public surface is the llms.txt and anonymous site MCP endpoint that its Wix-hosted corporate website serves.

providers.name: First Bite
providers.description: First Bite provides a foodservice sales platform that unifies prospecting, CRM, operator data, contact info, and rebates & rewards. It offers direct operator data and attribution tools for foodservice businesses, enabling them to supercharge sales, manage customer relationships, and access comprehensive data across operators. The platform includes features such as product CRM, operator data, contact management, prospecting tools, and activation resources, catering to B2B foodservice companies seeking integrated sales solutions.

providers.name: FullSession
providers.description: FullSession provides a comprehensive session replay and analytics platform that helps businesses understand user behavior across web and mobile applications. Leveraging AI-driven insights, FullSession captures detailed session data, heatmaps, funnel analysis, and real‑time feedback to improve conversion rates and product experience. The platform includes a managed cloud‑based MCP server, integrations with major tools, and robust security and compliance features for enterprise customers.

providers.name: Geocomply
providers.description: GeoComply is a geolocation compliance, digital identity, and fraud-prevention company that provides the location-verification and anti-fraud intelligence layer behind many of the world's most regulated digital platforms. Its product suite spans GeoComply Core (location-based fraud detection and geolocation compliance), IDComply (KYC and AML identity verification), GeoGuard (VPN and proxy/spoofing detection), PinPoint (on-property geofencing), the Chargeback Integrator (GCI), and the OneComply licensing-management platform, serving the iGaming, financial services, media/entertainment, and cryptocurrency industries. GeoComply's integrations are enterprise, sales-led engagements rather than a public self-serve developer portal; this profile was surfaced as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company and has been enriched from GeoComply's public security, trust, and discovery surface.

providers.name: Goals
providers.description: Goals (playgoals.com, formerly goals.co) is a free-to-play competitive football (soccer) video game studio backed by Northzone. It positions itself as a gameplay-first football game — "No scripts, no excuses, just football" — with fast, skill-based competitive matches, unique player squads, card-pack collection, ranked leaderboards, and multiple game modes across Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, and the Epic Games Store. A companion app lets players manage squads and open packs. This profile was surfaced as a Northzone portfolio company (consumer sector) and added to the API Evangelist network; the studio publishes a consumer game and a community surface (Discord, guides, leaderboards) but no public developer API.

providers.name: JevAPI
providers.description: JevAPI is an independent developer guide and resource for the Jev decision model, offering fast, typed decisions for software. The site explains Jev through documented request shapes, decision patterns, and production safeguards, helping developers evaluate whether the model fits their software before building on it. Maintained by the BeatAPI team, it provides API guides, tutorials, comparisons with LLMs, and links to the official Jev API hosted on BeatAPI.

providers.name: Kelley Blue Book
providers.description: Kelley Blue Book (KBB) is the vehicle valuation and automotive information platform trusted by consumers, dealers, lenders, and OEMs since 1926. KBB provides REST APIs for new and used car values, pricing data, vehicle specifications, expert and consumer ratings, cost-of-ownership projections, fuel cost calculations, and dealer trade-in tools. The InfoDriver Web Service (IDWS) 4.0 delivers JSON over HTTPS authenticated via API key, and is licensed to B2B partners including automotive dealers, lenders, fleet operators, and industry data consumers. Values are updated twice monthly to reflect current market conditions.

providers.name: Luminal
providers.description: Luminal is an AI inference-optimization company that compiles machine-learning models ahead-of-time into optimized native code for GPUs and ASICs, aiming to deliver the fastest, highest-throughput inference available. Its core product is an open-source, high-performance general-purpose inference compiler written in Rust (the "luminal" crate), built around static computation graphs, a compile-time-checked GraphTensor API, composable neural-network modules, and pluggable graph compilers. Luminal ships two deployment paths: Luminal Cloud, a managed serverless inference service with automatic scaling, and licensed on-prem deployment with dedicated support and custom optimization. The company is backed by Felicis.

providers.name: Mindtrip
providers.description: Mindtrip is an AI-powered travel planning platform that lets travelers discover destinations, build itineraries, and book flights, hotels, restaurants, experiences, and events through a conversational interface and collaborative trip workspace. Mindtrip Flights launched in May 2026 as the industry's first end-to-end agentic AI flight booking experience, powered by partnership with Sabre (travel content / GDS APIs) and PayPal (payments). Mindtrip is primarily a consumer product; it does not currently expose a general-purpose public REST API, but participates in partner integrations (Sabre Mosaic, PayPal, Ripe ITA, GuideGeek) and runs a Creator and Business program for destinations and hotels.

providers.name: mintpdf-dev
