providers.description: MintPDF provides a simple HTTP API that converts HTML or Markdown documents into PDF files. It is designed for developers and AI agents, offering a single POST endpoint that returns PDF bytes or a temporary download URL. The service runs headless Chromium under the hood, supports custom page sizes, headers, footers, and styling, and enforces automatic deletion of rendered files after one hour. No account or credit card is required for the free tier, which allows up to three renders per day. Paid plans increase limits and add features such as higher monthly render quotas. The API is open-source, MIT‑licensed, and can be self‑hosted via a Docker container.

providers.name: Mitmproxy
providers.description: mitmproxy is a free and open source interactive HTTPS proxy that allows developers and security researchers to intercept, inspect, modify, and replay HTTP and HTTPS traffic flows. It includes mitmproxy (interactive console), mitmweb (web-based interface), and mitmdump (command-line tool), providing powerful capabilities for debugging, testing, and analyzing API traffic and web applications.

providers.name: Moola
providers.description: Moola Market is a non-custodial, decentralized liquidity protocol on the Celo blockchain that democratizes access to yield and credit. Depositors earn compound interest that is paid by borrowers who take out over-collateralized loans, delegated loans, or flash loans. The protocol shares ancestry with the Aave v2 codebase, is open source and independently audited, and issues interest-bearing mTokens (mcUSD, mcEUR, mcREAL, mCELO) redeemable one-to-one for the underlying Celo stable assets. Moola is a smart-contract protocol rather than an HTTP API: developers integrate by calling on-chain contracts (deposit, withdraw, borrow, repay, flash loan) from a supported wallet. Backed by Polychain Capital.

providers.name: Nano
providers.description: Nano is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: vc-portfolio; backed by partech) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Napatech
providers.description: Napatech is a Danish provider of programmable FPGA-based SmartNICs and network-acceleration hardware used for high-speed network monitoring, cybersecurity, and telecom/5G workloads. Its Link-Capture and Link-Inline software, together with the NTAPI/NTPL developer SDK, let applications capture, filter, and process network traffic at line rate with zero packet loss. The developer surface is a C/C++ hardware SDK (NTAPI) plus the NTPL programming language rather than a web/REST API; integrations ship as open-source additions to DPDK, VPP, Open vSwitch, Scapy, and Zeek via the napatech GitHub organization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Nexiu
providers.description: Nexiu (Nexiu AI LLC) is a Latin America-focused recruiting automation platform that uses AI agents to source, contact, screen, and schedule high-volume candidates over the official WhatsApp Business API, integrating with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and existing ATS systems and job boards. It offers a fully managed pay-per-hire service (Nexiu Managed) and a self-service SaaS platform (Nexiu Platform) for internal talent-acquisition teams, and is backed by 500 Global (500 Latam) and NVIDIA Inception. As of this pass Nexiu consumes third-party APIs (WhatsApp Business, Google, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) but does not publish a public developer API of its own.

providers.name: Nomad
providers.description: Nomad provides a platform that lets organizations query and extract insights from unstructured text across thousands of documents and centralize data relationships like a CRM. It offers access to over 5,600 external data providers and tools for data spend audit, request routing, and AI‑powered search, enabling knowledge workers to obtain instant, source‑linked answers and manage data subscriptions in one system.

providers.name: OpenEvidence
providers.description: OpenEvidence is a clinical decision-support search platform that uses generative AI grounded in peer-reviewed medical literature to answer clinical questions for verified clinicians. The product is free for U.S. licensed clinicians and is monetized through pharmaceutical advertising; partnerships include the New England Journal of Medicine, JAMA, NCCN, and the Cochrane Library. As of 2026 it serves more than 860,000 verified clinicians. OpenEvidence does not currently expose a public self-service developer API.

providers.name: Pasito
providers.description: Pasito is an AI-native workspace for employee benefits that helps benefits consultants, insurance carriers, and employers simplify every part of the benefits journey — from proposal and quoting through enrollment to year-round employee engagement — using agentic AI workflows. The platform turns unstructured plan documents and census data into a structured data layer that powers a conversational AI benefits assistant, automated proposal/RFP intake, benefits guides and microsites, decision support, and communications. Pasito reports supporting over 6.6 million employees, managing $106B in premiums, and serving 3,600+ employers, integrating with 950+ TPA systems and 260+ HRIS platforms. Backed by Google, Y Combinator, and Core Innovation Capital, the company is building a public-facing API but does not yet publish a developer portal, documentation, or API reference.

providers.name: Percent
providers.description: Percent is a private credit platform that opens privately negotiated loans and debt financing from non-bank lenders to accredited and institutional investors, specialty-finance borrowers, and debt underwriters. The marketplace lets individual accredited investors access institutional-grade private credit deals (asset-backed securities and corporate loans) with entry points from $500 for direct deals, $5,000 for diversified Blended Notes, and $50,000 for Separately Managed Accounts, alongside a secondary market for eligible positions. Percent Securities, LLC is a U.S. registered broker-dealer and member of FINRA and SIPC; Percent Advisors LLC provides advisory services. Investor, borrower, and manager workflows run through authenticated portals; the public percent.com surface is marketing, education, performance, and regulatory disclosure. Percent has no public developer API — programmatic/deal-level access is not published.

providers.name: pgvector
providers.description: pgvector is an open-source PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search, created and maintained by Andrew Kane. It adds vector, halfvec and sparsevec data types, six distance operators (L2, inner product, cosine, L1, Hamming, Jaccard) and two approximate-nearest-neighbour index access methods (HNSW and IVFFlat) to a Postgres server, so embeddings live beside the rest of an application's data with full ACID semantics, JOINs, point-in-time recovery and existing backup and replication tooling. It is not a service and exposes no HTTP API: the interface is SQL, the contract is the extension's own installation DDL, and consumers reach it through an ordinary Postgres driver. The project also publishes first-party client libraries for seventeen languages, which handle vector encoding for each language's Postgres driver.

providers.name: profitpather-com
providers.description: Profitpather provides AI‑powered analytics for Shopify stores, turning e‑commerce data into real‑time insights that can be queried by large language models like Claude and Codex. By installing a simple pixel, merchants gain unsampled, privacy‑first event tracking, customizable dashboards, and the ability to ask natural‑language questions about sales, traffic, and customer behavior. The platform offers a free tier with basic tools and a paid Pro plan with full history, unlimited tool access, and integration across multiple AI assistants.

providers.name: Resolve Systems
providers.description: Resolve Systems (resolve.io) is an enterprise IT automation and AIOps platform that helps IT and operations teams automate incident resolution, service-desk workflows, and cross-domain remediation at scale. Its "Agentic Resolution Fabric" combines a Knowledge Agent (contextual answers across chat, portals, and collaboration tools), an Automation Agent (autonomous cross-domain workflows that remediate, configure, and orchestrate IT processes in real time), and Agent Assist (enriched diagnostics, related incidents, and next-best actions). Product lines include Resolve Actions, Actions Pro, Actions Express, and Barista, spanning IT process automation (ITPA), robotic process automation, and agentic service management. The company positions itself around cutting manual tickets by up to 90% and reports large aggregate customer savings. Resolve is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. This profile was enriched from public web sources; Resolve does not appear to publish a public, self-service developer API, OpenAPI definition, or open developer portal — integration and automation are delivered through the platform's connectors and customer-gated documentation.

providers.name: SJ
providers.description: SJ is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: stockholm-trip) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: SpecFlow
providers.description: SpecFlow was an open-source BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) testing framework for .NET that allowed teams to write executable specifications in natural language using the Gherkin syntax. Originally developed by TechTalk, it was acquired by Tricentis in 2020 and reached end-of-life on December 31, 2024. The community continuation is Reqnroll, a fork maintaining full backward compatibility.

providers.name: Stericycle
providers.description: Stericycle is a Fortune 500 compliance company specializing in regulated medical waste disposal, sharps management, pharmaceutical waste, secure information destruction, and healthcare compliance training. In November 2024, Stericycle was acquired by Waste Management (WM) for approximately $7.2 billion. The company operates as WM Healthcare Solutions division, serving hospitals, clinics, medical offices, dental practices, veterinary facilities, and other healthcare organizations. Stericycle's MyStericycle customer portal enables online account management, scheduling, compliance training, and billing.

providers.name: Stone
providers.description: Stone is a Brazilian financial technology company offering REST APIs for payment processing, Pix instant payments, digital banking accounts, boleto issuance, credit products, payment links, and stone-terminal management for merchants. Their platform enables businesses to authorize, capture, cancel, and query transactions across online and physical sales channels.

providers.name: Strut
providers.description: Strut is an AI‑powered workspace and notebook that helps users create, expand, and organize long‑form content such as essays, articles, reports, and manuscripts. It offers a free tier with daily AI token limits and a Pro plan that removes limits. The platform provides features like AI‑assisted drafting, note organization, and export options, positioning itself as a collaborative writing environment for creators and professionals.

providers.name: Sunairio
providers.description: Sunairio is a grid forecasting company that provides integrated weather, climate, and energy insights for power markets. Its flagship platform, Sunairio ONE, generates 1,000-member ensemble forecasts across horizons from hourly to decadal, capturing extreme-weather and grid-stress scenarios that traditional forecasts miss. The company also publishes SHED (Sunairio High-resolution Earth Data), a proprietary historical weather dataset for the Continental US from 1950 to present at roughly 100x the resolution of ERA5, with asset-level wind and solar variability. Customers such as energy traders, grid operators, utility-scale asset developers, and demand-response aggregators access forecasts and data through a web UI, an API, and (on higher tiers) direct Snowflake data delivery. Founded in 2020 by Rob Cirincione, the company has been recognized by the National Science Foundation, American Clean Power, and EPRI.

providers.name: symplr
providers.description: symplr (symplr software LLC, Houston) sells healthcare operations software to hospitals, health systems and payers: provider data management and credentialing (symplr Provider, Directory, CVO, Payer), workforce and talent management (Smart Square, symplr Workforce, formerly API Healthcare), quality and safety (Midas), clinical communications, spend, access, contract and compliance management, unified as the symplr Operations Platform. It markets APIs, webhooks and a certified partner program, but publishes no public API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Telesair
providers.description: Telesair, Inc. is a Southern California MedTech company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Irvine, California, that builds respiratory care hardware for patients with respiratory insufficiency. Its flagship product is Bonhawa, a purpose-built High Flow Oxygen Therapy (HFOT) respiratory humidifier that delivers warmed and humidified respiratory gases to spontaneously breathing pediatric and adult patients (10 kg and up) across a 2-80 L/min flow range, with separate pediatric and adult modes, a streamlined disinfection process and a touchscreen interface. Bonhawa holds both FDA 510(k) clearance (October 2023) and the CE Mark under the European Medical Device Regulation (August 2023), and is distributed to US hospitals under an exclusive agreement with Tri-anim Health Services. Telesair also supplies AVEA disposable expiratory filters. Telesair is a medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract. Its only machine-readable agent surface is the Wix platform's Site Visitor Assistant MCP endpoint and an llms.txt served from its own marketing host.

providers.name: The Chancery Lane Project
providers.description: The Chancery Lane Project is a UK‑registered charity that helps organisations reduce emissions by leveraging legal documents and processes. Operating in over 110 countries, it provides tools and guidance to embed climate‑positive clauses into contracts, enabling measurable impact on carbon footprints. The project publishes impact reports, resources and guidance for businesses seeking sustainable legal frameworks.

providers.name: Tiptapp
providers.description: Tiptapp provides an on-demand platform for moving, delivery, and recycling services across multiple European markets. Users can schedule moves, request shopping assistance, arrange item removal and recycling, and even give away items through the app. The service emphasizes safety, sustainability, and circular economy principles, supporting cities and promoting reuse of goods.

providers.name: Tokamak Energy
providers.description: Tokamak Energy is a private fusion energy company founded in 2009 as a spinout from the UK Atomic Energy Authority, headquartered at 173 Brook Drive, Milton Park, Oxfordshire OX14 4SD, with subsidiaries in the United States and Japan and more than 300 employees. It runs a two-track strategy: advancing commercial fusion energy through compact spherical tokamaks, and developing high temperature superconducting (HTS) magnet technology as a business in its own right. Its flagship device ST40 is the world's highest field spherical tokamak and is undergoing a USD 52 million upgrade co-funded with the US Department of Energy and the UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. Demo4 became the first HTS fusion magnet system to achieve fusion-relevant magnetic fields in 2025, and the company was selected as Magnet Systems Partner for the UK's STEP programme under a GBP 70 million contract running to 2029. The group is organised into three integrated businesses — TE Magnetics (HTS technology, established 2024), Ridgway Machines (manufacturing, acquired 2025) and Fusion. Tokamak Energy is a fusion and superconducting hardware company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no commercial or developer-facing product API, no developer portal, no SDKs and no OpenAPI of its own. The only machine-readable interface it exposes publicly is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website at tokamakenergy.com, which is anonymously readable, read-only for unauthenticated callers, and is captured here for discovery purposes. Its public engineering output is instead released as open-source plasma physics code — GSFit, RTGSFit and FORGE — through the tokamak-energy GitHub organisation.

providers.name: Upciti
providers.description: Upciti is a French smart-city company that equips cities with intelligent computer-vision sensors and the Upciti OS platform, turning streets into clear, anonymous data for informed municipal decisions across parking, mobility, energy, water, gas, lighting, temperature, weather, air quality, pollen, illegal dumping, and noise. Sensors process video 100% locally with no image storage (GDPR-native, DTPR-supporting), and the platform advertises an open API for connecting GIS, BI, and business tools with no proprietary lock-in. Product documentation is customer-gated.

providers.name: Validus Capital
providers.description: Validus is a Southeast Asian SME supply-chain and working-capital financing platform operated by Validus Investment Holdings Pte Ltd (UEN 201803167H), headquartered at Asia Square Tower 2 in Singapore and founded in 2015 to address the unmet financing needs of small and medium enterprises. The group runs country businesses across four markets — Batumbu (PT Berdayakan Usaha Indonesia) in Indonesia, Siam Validus in Thailand, Validus Vietnam, and, until April 2025, Validus Capital Pte Ltd in Singapore — offering invoice financing, purchase-order financing, vendor/supply-chain financing programs, working capital loans, SME business accounts and corporate cards funded by accredited and institutional investors. Validus Capital Pte Ltd, the Singapore subsidiary and the entity this profile is named for, was acquired outright by GXS Bank on 15 April 2025 and now trades as GXS Capital; the validus.sg domain redirects to the group site. The group has disbursed more than US$5 billion across its markets and has raised capital from Vertex Ventures, FMO, Citi, HSBC, Oikocredit and K3 Ventures. Validus publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract on any of its group or country domains.

providers.name: Vodafone
providers.description: Vodafone Group plc is a UK-headquartered (Newbury, England) multinational telecommunications company and one of the world's largest mobile and fixed network operators, with operations in 15 country markets and partner-market agreements covering 40+ additional countries across Europe and Africa. The group serves 279 million mobile customers, 5 million business customers, and manages 215+ million IoT connections through its Vodafone IoT platform. Beyond mobile and broadband connectivity, Vodafone operates one of the largest IoT/M2M businesses in the industry, invests in 70+ subsea cables, and runs financial services like M-PESA (Africa) and Vodapay. Through Vodafone Business it sells connectivity, cloud, security, and managed-mobility services to enterprises, and through the GSMA Open Gateway and CAMARA initiative it exposes a growing portfolio of standardised network APIs (Number Verify, SIM Swap, Quality on Demand, Device Location, Match, MVNO Discovery, and more) via the Vodafone Developer Marketplace (developer.vodafone.com), which publishes 27+ commercial and CAMARA APIs across Identity, Mobile, Analytics, Boost/QoS, and Partner categories. The Marketplace exposes sandbox and live endpoints under api-sandbox.vf-dmp.engineering.vodafone.com and api.vf-dmp.engineering.vodafone.com, with OAuth2 (Consumer Key / Consumer Secret) authentication and Postman collections for every product. Vodafone is a premier member of the CAMARA alliance hosted at the Linux Foundation, a founding participant in the GSMA Open Gateway, and one of the principal telco operators driving network-as-an-API adoption globally.

providers.name: waapi-app
providers.description: WaAPI provides a unified WhatsApp API for developers, enabling sending and receiving messages, managing chats, groups, and channels through a single REST interface. It offers a flat-rate pricing model per connected account with unlimited messages and requires no prior approval, simplifying integration for businesses and developers alike.

providers.name: Whelp
providers.description: Whelp is an omnichannel customer messaging and support platform that unifies Live Chat, WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and Viber into a single shared team inbox. It pairs a built-in CRM and unified customer view with a drag-and-drop AI chatbot builder, outbound bulk-messaging campaigns, and reporting and analytics for sales, marketing, and support teams. Whelp is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: WorkForce Software
providers.description: WorkForce Software, an ADP company since October 2024, makes the WorkForce Suite, an enterprise workforce management platform covering time and attendance, employee scheduling, absence and leave management, labor forecasting, data capture, and payroll compliance for large, complex organizations. The Suite integrates with leading HCM and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, ADP) via RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs, and file-based interfaces, with SSO/SLO and MFA support; API and integration documentation is provided to customers through the WorkForce Software community portal rather than a public developer portal.

providers.name: Zeffy
providers.description: Zeffy is a 100% free fundraising platform for nonprofits - donation forms, event ticketing, peer-to-peer campaigns, memberships, e-commerce, and donor management - with no platform, transaction, or credit-card fees, funded entirely by optional tips from donors. Zeffy exposes a free public REST API that gives organization admins read-only access to their Payments, Contacts, and Campaigns data (base https://api.zeffy.com/api/v1), authenticated with a per-organization API key sent as a Bearer token, plus outbound webhooks that POST payment details to a configured URL when a payment is completed. Zeffy also integrates via Zapier, QuickBooks, and WordPress.

providers.name: 123RF
providers.description: 123RF is a global stock content platform offering millions of royalty‑free photos, vectors, videos, audio and AI‑enhanced creative assets. It provides a developer API for integrating searchable media, image enhancement tools, and white‑label solutions into websites and applications, serving creators, marketers and businesses worldwide.

providers.name: 28 labs
providers.description: 28labs Inc. operates She's Well (sheswell.co), a consumer fertility-care platform that bundles egg freezing, fertility testing, IVF coordination, clinic visits, labs, medications, and concierge nurse support into a single transparent subscription plan starting at $249/month over up to 60 months. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a business-to-consumer digital-health service with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Aethero
providers.description: Aethero designs and manufactures radiation-hardened, space-rated edge computing systems and AI/ML software for satellites, space stations, and orbital data centers, enabling autonomous on-orbit processing of imagery and sensor data rather than downlinking raw feeds. Its NVIDIA Jetson Orin/Thor-based NxN-ECM and NxA-ECM edge computing modules, Titan and Phobos platforms, the Aether fleet-management software framework, and the AMATDT model annotation/training/deployment tool let spacecraft run AI inference in orbit. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, Aethero raised an $8.4M seed round led by Kindred Ventures in June 2025. Aethero exposes no public web API today; this profile captures the company's identity and its live domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Afficiency
providers.description: Afficiency is a New York-based insurtech that designs, digitally underwrites and issues life insurance products on behalf of carrier and reinsurance partners, and distributes them through a 100% digital, API-first platform. Its product suite spans level term, final expense whole life, participating whole life, indexed universal life and annual renewable term, all issued without a medical exam and with instant underwriting decisions in a single session. Partners integrate through one of three models — a hosted white-label storefront, a direct REST API integration covering the full quote-to-policy-issue journey, or a hybrid of the two — which lets agencies, P&C agents, financial advisors, worksite and affinity channels and embedded fintech partners offer life insurance inside their own customer journeys. Afficiency states it is SOC 2 Type II certified. Its REST API suite is marketed publicly, but the reference and any machine-readable contract are reachable only through the customer support portal or a sales conversation.

providers.name: Aicut
providers.description: Aicut provides an AI-powered video generation platform enabling creators to produce faceless YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram videos automatically. Leveraging advanced text‑to‑video models, it offers voiceover, captions, and auto‑scheduling features, targeting marketers and content creators seeking scalable video content. The service includes a free tier and paid plans with higher resolution outputs and brand customization.

providers.name: Aiqbee
providers.description: Aiqbee offers an enterprise AI memory platform that lets organizations centralize documents, URLs and institutional knowledge into AI‑ready “Brains” that can be accessed from IDEs, Microsoft Teams and any MCP‑compatible application. The service includes governance controls, audit trails and data protection features, and is sold on a per‑user subscription starting at $15 per user per month.

providers.name: Almanac Labs
providers.description: Almanac Labs, Inc. builds Almanac, an enterprise wiki and async collaboration platform that consolidates a team's scattered documents into a single, organized source of truth. Almanac combines fast document editing, wikis, version control, approvals, and workflow/task management to replace tools like Confluence, Notion, and Asana, and it publishes company handbooks and community-powered documentation. The Almanac API (V1, private beta) lets workspaces import and move files and folders, view users and groups, read and update document properties, manage who has access to documents, and access and update metadata for documents and folders. Almanac integrates with Slack, Figma, Loom, and GitHub, and is backed by General Catalyst. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Almanac's public surface.

providers.name: Aperiatechnologies
providers.description: Aperiatechnologies (operating as Aperia) provides automatic tire inflation solutions for commercial truck fleets. Their Halo platform monitors and maintains optimal tire pressure, reducing roadside breakdowns, safety violations, and fuel costs. The company combines IoT sensors, cloud analytics, and real‑time alerts to improve fleet safety and efficiency across North America.

providers.name: Apiphani
providers.description: Apiphani is a technology-enabled application managed-services company dedicated to helping businesses minimize the effort and risk of running their tier-1, mission-critical applications. It combines decades of enterprise operations experience with intelligent automation and machine learning to drive efficiency and reliability across SAP environments (S/4HANA, Business Suite, Cloud ERP) running on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Services span application technical management (ABAP, SAP Basis, application security), application hosting (ALM/APM), application infrastructure (auto-scaling, HA/DR), security management, and cloud migration and optimization. Apiphani's Luumen platform is an AI-native observability product with "Deep Automation" that detects and resolves issues before users notice, unifying application telemetry, security, and self-healing. The company is certified SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and CSA STAR, and is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: AppBrilliance
providers.description: AppBrilliance is revolutionizing digital transactions with its novel Agentic Payments Platform. It enables seamless integration of instant payment systems (RTP & FedNow) and open banking protocols for secure, frictionless transactions. The company holds 9 US patents and focuses on secure, agentic payment solutions for enterprises.

providers.name: Appriss
providers.description: Appriss Inc. was a Louisville, Kentucky data and analytics holding company whose business units were broken up in 2021: Appriss Insights was sold to Equifax in a $1.825 billion deal, and Appriss Health was rebranded as the independent company Bamboo Health. The surviving Appriss Retail business (apprissretail.com) is an AI-powered retail loss-prevention platform that helps retailers combat total retail loss across in-store and online channels through returns-fraud prevention, shrink and exception analytics, and case and audit management. Its products include Appriss Engage (returns and claims management), Appriss Secure (shrink and exception analytics), Appriss Incident (case and audit management), and the Sidekick AI collaborator. Appriss Retail publishes no public developer API program — its APIS Online portal is an authenticated Asset Protection Information System (customer login), not a developer API surface.

providers.name: Arf
providers.description: Arf is a Switzerland-regulated liquidity and settlement platform for cross-border payments, providing short-term, receivable-backed, revolving working capital to licensed payment institutions and money-transfer operators. Its core product, Arf Liquidity, lets payment companies settle across any corridor 24/7 without prefunding destination accounts, using regulated real-world-asset-backed digital assets and stablecoins (including USDC) for native on-ramp/off-ramp value transfer and real-time treasury management. Arf is a compliance-first, VQF self-regulatory-organization member serving only licensed financial institutions, and partners with Circle, Stellar, and Visa. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from Arf's public web presence; Arf does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Aristotle
providers.description: Aristotle (heyaristotle.com) is an AI tutoring platform that delivers personalized, one-on-one, dialogue-based instruction across all subjects. Rather than lecturing or simply marking answers wrong, it uses a Socratic, voice-first approach to diagnose conceptual misconceptions and verifies each response turn-by-turn before delivering it to the student. Positioned as an affordable alternative to human tutors, its methodology is grounded in learning science (Bloom's two-sigma work, ICAP, LearnLM benchmarks). Backed by True Ventures. Sector: EdTech / AI education. No public developer API or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Atom Learning
providers.description: Atom Learning is a UK edtech company providing an online, adaptive exam-preparation and learning platform for children aged 7 to 16. Its consumer product, Atom Home, delivers personalised practice, unlimited mock tests with instant marking, and progress tracking for 11+ grammar and independent-school entrance exams (GL, CEM, CSSE, ISEB), CAT4, Key Stage 2 SATs, and GCSE revision. Its schools product, Atom School, gives teachers curriculum-mapped resources and assessment tools and is used by over 1,000 schools. Founded by educators and assessment specialists, Atom has supported hundreds of thousands of families as a lower-cost alternative to private tutoring. The company was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a consumer web/app product surface but no public developer API.

providers.name: Backbone
providers.description: Backbone is a mobile gaming company that makes the Backbone One controller — a snap-on gamepad for iPhone and Android — and the Backbone app, a mobile gaming platform that unifies a player's game library across cloud gaming, console Remote Play, and streaming services with game discovery, capture, and social features. The company sells hardware and accessories through a Shopify-hosted storefront (backbone.com) that exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint and Shopify Customer Account OIDC. Backbone is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. This profile was enriched from Backbone's public web surface; the company publishes no first-party developer API.

providers.name: BananaBanana
providers.description: BananaBanana, operated by Rari LTD in Tbilisi, Georgia, offers metered access to AI image, video, and speech generation models from Google, OpenAI, Alibaba, and xAI. Users top up a balance; each generation deducts its price (images from $0.03, video from $0.10, speech from $1.00) with no subscription and balances never expire. The service is independent, not affiliated with Google, and supports crypto and card payments.

providers.name: Barn2Door
providers.description: Barn2Door is a Seattle-based commerce and business-management platform purpose-built for independent farmers and local food producers. It gives farms an online store, order and subscription management, inventory tracking, delivery and pickup logistics, integrated payments, and built-in marketing and customer-relationship tools, consolidating the systems a farm needs to sell direct-to-consumer and wholesale into a single dashboard. Barn2Door connects to partners including Mailchimp, QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Avalara, Shippo, Routific, Squarespace, and Facebook, but does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal at this time.

providers.name: Betula
providers.description: Betula is a free self‑hosted single‑user federated bookmark manager for the independent web, offering archival support. It lets users organize bookmarks, maintain a linklog, and create personal web archives with Mycomarkup formatting, tag management, and privacy controls for public or private sharing.

providers.name: BioMind
providers.description: BioMind Health is an award‑winning artificial intelligence company delivering a Biological Operating System that merges AI, ancient wisdom, and biotechnology to provide educational health intelligence. The platform offers modules on nutrition, emotion, and biology, serving hospitals, clinicians, and individuals worldwide, aiming to make biological literacy accessible and empower personalized health insights.

providers.name: Bobw
providers.description: Bob W is a hospitality brand offering short‑stay, fully equipped apartments across Europe. It combines hotel‑level service with local design, sustainable practices and tech‑enabled check‑in. The company offsets all guest emissions, sources local furniture, and aims for net‑zero hospitality by 2050. With over 60 properties in 21+ cities, Bob W delivers flexible stays for business and leisure travelers, emphasizing sustainability and community integration.

providers.name: Boise Cascade
providers.description: Boise Cascade is a leading North American manufacturer and distributor of building materials for the residential and commercial construction industry. The company produces engineered wood products (EWP) including I-joists, LVL beams, and glulam, as well as structural panels and lumber, and distributes a broad range of building materials through its wholesale distribution network.

providers.name: Bordet
providers.description: Bordet provides a multi‑LLM boardroom platform where multiple AI models such as Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok collaborate with users in shared rooms. It offers persistent shared memory, an auditable decisions log, and flexible pricing with free starter access and prepaid credit packs. The service emphasizes data privacy, model‑agnostic integration, and team collaboration, targeting AI‑enhanced business workflows.

providers.name: Boundless
providers.description: Boundless is a Seattle-based technology-enabled immigration company that pairs an intuitive online platform with licensed immigration attorneys to help individuals and businesses navigate U.S. immigration. Its consumer products cover family-based green cards, marriage and fiancé (K-1) visas, naturalization and citizenship, and employment-based visas such as H-1B, EB-1, O-1, and E-2, while its business offering adds corporate case management, workflow automation, employee engagement, compliance management, HR-system integration, and global mobility support for immigration teams. Boundless is backed by Foundry Group and Seedcamp. No public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Branchtrack
providers.description: BranchTrack is a browser-based authoring platform for building interactive branching scenarios and conversation simulations used in corporate learning and development. Instructional designers and L&D teams create decision-tree simulations with no coding or design skills, then deploy them inside existing LMS platforms or embed them into courses authored in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Adobe Captivate, Gomo, and Lectora. Simulations export as SCORM and xAPI (Tin Can) packages and can be shared as responsive, mobile-native experiences with learner analytics and completion tracking. BranchTrack is a portfolio company of Seedcamp. The platform exposes no first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; third-party embedding is available via the Embedly oEmbed provider, and LMS delivery via SCORM/xAPI.

providers.name: Buy Me a Coffee
providers.description: Buy Me a Coffee is a creator-support platform that lets fans tip creators ("buy a coffee"), subscribe to recurring memberships, and buy extras from a creator's shop. Its developer API is a read-only REST interface (base https://developers.buymeacoffee.com/api/v1) authenticated with a personal access Bearer token created self-serve in the Developer Dashboard. The API exposes a creator's own one-time supporters, memberships/subscriptions, and extra purchases, and the platform also delivers server-push webhooks for donation, membership, and shop events. Buy Me a Coffee charges a flat 5% platform fee on transactions with no monthly fee.

providers.name: Capella University
providers.description: Capella University is an accredited online university owned by Strategic Education, Inc. (SEI), offering competency-based bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees plus graduate certificates across business, counseling and therapy, education, health sciences, information technology, nursing, psychology, and social work. Capella is regionally accredited by the Higher Learning Commission and delivers coursework through two learning formats — FlexPath, a self-paced competency-based model, and GuidedPath, a structured-timeline model — serving working adults and professional learners entirely online.

providers.name: Car Import Calculator
providers.description: Car Import Calculator provides a free online tool and guides to calculate UK import duty, VAT and registration costs for vehicles imported from any country. It sources rates from gov.uk, offers detailed examples, classic‑car relief information, and links to official customs and tax resources. The site also offers newsletters, data tables, and contact support for import queries.

providers.name: Carefull
providers.description: Carefull is a financial safety platform that protects the personal finances of older adults and their family caregivers from fraud, scams, and identity theft. It monitors bank accounts, credit cards, and investment accounts across 12,000+ financial institutions (via Plaid, MX, and Finicity) to detect suspicious activity, duplicate billing, and unusual withdrawals in real time. The service bundles $1M identity theft insurance, dark web and credit-file monitoring, home-title monitoring, a ScamCheck message tool, a secure document Vault and LegacyKit, and view-only access for trusted contacts. Carefull is offered direct to consumers (about $29.99/month with a free trial) and B2B to banks, credit unions, wealth advisory firms, and employers. It is SOC 2 certified. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile enriches the company as a network lead; Carefull publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface (all /.well-known/* paths return the SPA HTML shell).

providers.name: ChipAgents
providers.description: ChipAgents is the Agentic AI Chip Design Environment, helping semiconductor engineers iterate on chip design and verification up to 10x faster by collaborating with AI agents inside their favorite code editor. The platform spans design and verification workflows, coverage analysis, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA), surfaced through a project dashboard and the ChipAgents CLI, and is powered by the company's first model, Renoir. ChipAgents is delivered as a managed, authenticated web application (agent.chipagents.ai) rather than a public API; the company holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and is backed by Micron, Samsung, MediaTek, and Bessemer Venture Partners, with a team drawn from Cadence, Synopsys, and Mentor Graphics.

providers.name: Citant.ai
providers.description: Citant.ai is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) agency focused on boosting B2B SaaS visibility in large language model (LLM) search results. They offer a 9‑week citation guarantee, promising to place your SaaS product in AI‑generated answers or refund the pilot payment. Services include AI‑driven SEO, citation management, and strategic content creation to improve AI citation rankings, targeting enterprises seeking AI‑enhanced discoverability.

providers.name: Clutter
providers.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Complori
providers.description: Complori is a Berlin, Germany based online education company that teaches children and young people to code through live, small-group video classes led by qualified coaches in a protected digital space. Its programs span programming with Minecraft, Python, JavaScript game development, app development, and financial literacy, backed by a learning platform with challenges and exercises, a mobile learning app, completion certificates, flexible family-friendly scheduling, and holiday camps. Complori operates a B2C consumer education service (with parents as the decision-makers) rather than a developer-facing API product, and runs an education scholarship program to broaden access across socioeconomic backgrounds. Backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Confide *
providers.description: Confide is a confidential messaging application that lets people communicate digitally with the same level of privacy and security as the spoken word. Messages are end-to-end encrypted, ephemeral (they disappear after being read), and screenshot-protected so recipients cannot capture or forward them. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, and Windows across 200+ countries and 15 languages, with a free tier for individuals and small groups and a Confide Plus subscription that unlocks unlimited attachments, message retraction, incognito mode, nicknames, and themes. Confide is a consumer product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record backed by GV in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cradlewise
providers.description: Cradlewise offers an all‑in‑one smart bassinet and crib that converts from a newborn bassinet to a toddler crib for up to 24 months. It includes a built‑in baby monitor, sound machine, and sleep‑tracking features, aiming to simplify nighttime care for parents. The product integrates IoT sensors and a companion app to provide real‑time insights and soothing sounds, positioning Cradlewise at the intersection of baby care and smart home technology.

providers.name: d-Matrix
providers.description: d-Matrix builds ultra-low-latency, energy-efficient AI inference infrastructure for generative AI in the datacenter. Its memory-centric compute architecture, next-generation I/O, and stacked-DRAM approach are delivered through the Corsair inference accelerator (chiplet-based, supporting models up to 100B parameters), the JetStream accelerator-to-accelerator communications platform, the SquadRack disaggregated rack-scale solution, and the 3DIMC 3D digital in-memory compute technology. Founded by Sid Sheth and Sudeep Bhoja and headquartered in Santa Clara, the company has raised roughly $450M (including a $275M Series C) from investors such as Qatar Investment Authority, Temasek, and SK Hynix. d-Matrix also maintains the open-source dmx-compressor (DMX) PyTorch toolkit for co-designing models to its inference hardware. This API Evangelist network profile tracks d-Matrix as a compute-hardware provider; it does not currently publish a public web API.

providers.name: DatiTuristici
providers.description: DatiTuristici.it provides institutional tourism data for Italian municipalities. It offers searchable information on arrivals, stays, accommodation capacity, and estimated short‑term rental revenues, sourced from ISTAT and re‑processed. Users can query data per municipality via a web interface or programmatically through a read‑only MCP server exposing nine tools such as cerca_comune and leggi_dati_comune. The service is free, requires no registration, and includes downloadable reports in PDF and Excel formats.

providers.name: DELLI
providers.description: DELLI is a UK online marketplace for independent food and drink makers, founded in 2022 by Depop founder Simon Beckerman with co-founder Marie Petrovicka. Often described as "the Depop for food," DELLI curates niche and small-batch products — snacks, sauces and condiments, pantry staples, drinks, alcohol, sweets and lifestyle goods — from micro-bakers, picklers, olive-oil producers and drink makers, and sells them to consumers, in part through a drop-style release model. The platform has since evolved into an AI-powered companion for makers and retailers, adding tools that cut the operational overhead of running a small food business. DELLI is backed by Balderton Capital and HV Capital, the original investors in Depop. The storefront runs on Shopify; DELLI publishes no first-party developer API at this time.

providers.name: DevPlane
providers.description: DevPlane provides AI development operations, checking AI coding agents' done claims against git remotes, deployments, and live pages across repositories and vendors. It offers free tools, support resources, FAQs, and integrates with developer workflows to ensure AI-generated code meets expectations and compliance.

providers.name: Docquity
providers.description: Docquity is a Singapore-headquartered digital health company operating Asia's largest verified professional network for licensed healthcare practitioners, with more than 500,000 verified doctors across nine markets including Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore and Taiwan. Its flagship product, Dx, is an AI clinical thinking partner that bundles clinical search and decision support, accredited continuing medical education, peer community and case discussion, and patient-ready summary notes into an invite-only mobile and web platform gated behind medical-credential verification. For life-sciences and enterprise partners Docquity sells an Intelligence Suite comprising Pulse, which measures healthcare-professional conviction and engagement, and Dialog, which runs field engagement and activation programs against that audience. Docquity also operates Docquity Jobs, a medical recruitment board. The company publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable specification; its api.docquity.com backend and id.docquity.com identity service exist to serve its own first-party applications and are not offered to third-party developers.

providers.name: DonorDock
providers.description: DonorDock provides a donor development platform for growing nonprofits, offering tools for donor management, online giving, fundraising, and project management. The SaaS solution integrates with thousands of apps and supports AI-driven fundraising, aiming to help nonprofit teams build relationships and increase donations.

providers.name: Feather
providers.description: Feather Robotics builds a bimanual, mobile humanoid robot platform for physical AI applications. The open‑hardware robot offers 23 degrees of freedom, hot‑swappable batteries, and an open SDK in Python and C++ for rapid development. Targeted at manufacturing, food service, and research, Feather ships ready‑to‑run units starting at $29,990, with enterprise pricing for fleets. The company provides US‑based support, extensive documentation, and a developer portal for integration.

providers.name: FlexGen Power Systems
providers.description: FlexGen Power Systems is a Durham, North Carolina energy storage technology company founded in 2009 that designs, integrates and operates grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and the software that runs them. Its flagship product is HybridOS, a hardware-agnostic energy management system (EMS) for multi-source, multi-site battery and solar portfolios, alongside HybridOS Control BMS (a US-built battery management system), a solar power plant controller (PPC), EMS retrofit, activation and lifecycle services, and data-center power solutions. FlexGen has been named a BloombergNEF Tier 1 energy storage company, acquired Clean Energy Services (CES) and the assets of Powin, and states that HybridOS exposes automated APIs and historian data API access to customers. No public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published; the HybridOS API surface is reached only through customer deployments and the login-gated FlexGen customer portal.

providers.name: Gaia
providers.description: Gaia (Gaia Family) is a value-based family-building company that makes fertility treatment financially accessible. Founded by Nader AlSalim after his own multi-year IVF journey, Gaia replaces unpredictable cycle-by-cycle IVF billing with fixed-price, all-inclusive plans and monthly payments, backed by a protection model that offers more tries — or money back — if treatment does not succeed. It partners with 180+ fertility clinics across the US and UK, covering IVF, egg freezing, embryo transfer, hormone and lab testing, and fertility navigation, and also offers fertility benefits to employers. This profile is a company lead (no public API surface) maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GoPillar
providers.description: GoPillar (operated by CoContest Italy Srl, Rome, Italy) is a crowdsourced architectural and interior design marketplace where homeowners, businesses, and small construction firms launch online design contests and receive dozens of proposals from a global community of 70,000+ registered architects and designers. Clients set a project timeline, brief the community, message participating designers, and select the winning concept, with follow-on one-to-one and offline executive-project services. GoPillar also runs GoPillar Academy, an e-learning platform offering professional BIM, 3D, and design courses plus custom corporate training for architecture and construction firms. GoPillar is a consumer/SMB web platform and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web identity and domain security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GORGIE
providers.description: GORGIE is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand making a sparkling, zero-sugar energy drink with functional benefits from green tea, natural flavors, Biotin, B Vitamins, and L-Theanine — only 5 calories, no preservatives. Built by a women-led team on a mission to make wellness fun, GORGIE sells its variety of flavors through a Shopify-powered online store at getgorgie.com and on retail shelves including Target, supported by a store locator, wholesale program, and an Instagram/TikTok community. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods brand it exposes an ecommerce storefront and customer-account surface rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: GreenFi
providers.description: GreenFi is a climate-focused consumer financial technology company — the rebranded continuation of Aspiration's consumer banking arm. It offers a combined checking and savings account, high-yield savings with goal-based "Savings Pods", a debit card, a GreenFi Plus subscription tier, investing through its Redwood fund, and a cash-back Marketplace of sustainable brands, alongside impact programs such as Plant Your Change, tree planting and carbon offsetting. GreenFi is a financial technology company, not a bank; banking services and the debit card are provided by Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC. Aspiration spun its consumer unit out in 2024 to Mission Financial Partners, LLC, which rebranded it GreenFi in April 2025; Coastal Financial Corporation acquired the GreenFi brand in January 2026. It is a separate company from Aspiration Partners, Inc., the enterprise carbon business that entered Chapter 11. GreenFi ships iOS, Android and web applications to end users and publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Gronda
providers.description: Gronda is a professional community and learning platform for chefs and hospitality professionals, offering 70+ masterclasses and 20,000+ exclusive restaurant recipes from leading chefs, a chef directory and creator program, and team and culinary-school plans. Members share culinary creations, follow world-class chefs, and access PRO subscription content through the Gronda web and mobile apps. Backed by Speedinvest, Gronda was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and profiled through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; it is a consumer/community product that does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Hadrius
providers.description: Hadrius is an AI-native compliance platform for SEC- and FINRA-regulated financial firms, including broker-dealers, registered investment advisors (RIAs), private funds, and compliance consultants. The platform consolidates multiple compliance functions into a single system of record with human governance: a testing program that automates compliance testing and audit reporting, AI-powered marketing review and content approval workflows, people oversight for personal trading, attestations and certifications, communications archiving that supervises email, chat, and social media with zero-retention AI, and account surveillance that monitors trades against restricted lists and blackout windows. Hadrius serves 500+ institutions managing over $5 trillion in AUM, raised a $22M Series A, and is backed by Y Combinator and CRV. The company is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant. This profile currently documents no public developer API; it is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HDFC Bank
providers.description: HDFC Bank Ltd. is one of India’s leading private sector banks, offering a wide range of financial services including retail banking, corporate banking, loans, credit cards, and digital payments. The bank provides an open banking developer portal that publishes APIs for account information, transaction history, fund transfers, and other services to enable fintech integration. The portal is hosted at https://developer.hdfc.bank.in/ and requires registration for full access.

providers.name: Hitachi Construction Machinery
providers.description: Hitachi Construction Machinery provides operational data about machines and equipment on construction sites through the Telematics API, which complies with the ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0) standard. The API enables higher efficiency, productivity, and safety while reducing life cycle costs. API access, data elements and supported regions are arranged through Hitachi dealers; no public API reference or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: Home From College
providers.description: Home From College (H\FC) is an AI-powered growth platform that connects college students with paid work from consumer brands. Students earn money and build professional experience through microGIGs (quick paid tasks such as app installs, surveys, product feedback, and social sharing with instant payment) and GIGs (larger, ongoing opportunities including content creation, brand-ambassador roles, product testing, and internships), while brands reach and activate Gen Z talent for marketing campaigns. Backed by GV, Home From College runs a two-sided marketplace across a student mobile app and a brand-facing web platform. No public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Infini-AI (无问芯穹)
providers.description: Infini-AI (无问芯穹 / Infinigence AI) is a Chinese AGI compute and model-service platform, backed by Qiming, that helps teams optimize model development, fine-tuning, and inference across heterogeneous compute. Its GenStudio large-model service (MaaS) exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API over a broad catalog of open- and closed-source models (LLM chat/completions plus image and video generation), with LoRA/SFT fine-tuning and multi-LoRA deployment. The platform also offers a fully managed ComfyUI workflow-hosting service (with a WebSocket API) and an Agent Service Platform for building and deploying agent applications and skills. Developers authenticate with a tenant-managed API Key sent as a Bearer token; tenant/IAM, usage analytics, rate limits, billing, and error-code references are documented at docs.infini-ai.com and the cloud console.

providers.name: Kernex Limited
providers.description: Kernex Limited provides a headless CMS platform that enables developers to create, manage, and deliver content via flexible APIs. The service offers a modern, cloud‑based solution for building websites, mobile apps, and other digital experiences, with features such as content modeling, versioning, and multi‑channel publishing. It targets developers and enterprises seeking API‑first content management and integrates with popular frameworks and tools.

providers.name: Kredete
providers.description: Kredete is an intelligent global finance app for diaspora and emerging-market communities, founded in 2022 and operating across four continents. It moves money across 60+ markets at the mid-market rate with settlement in about ten seconds, issues US dollar Visa cards accepted in 170+ countries, opens multi-currency accounts in the customer's own name, pays yield on US dollar savings held through partner US chartered institutions, and reports rent and repayment history to the major US credit bureaus so customers build a US credit file. Kredete for Business adds multi-currency operating accounts, corporate cards, FedWire routing, payroll, and invoicing. An in-app agent runs these actions on the customer's behalf with confirmation. Kredete is a financial technology company, not a bank; remittance and banking services are provided by partner US licensed financial institutions. Backed by Partech and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass Kredete publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: LegiScan
providers.description: LegiScan is a national legislative tracking service providing real-time data on bill activity, voting records, and legislative actions across all 50 US states and Congress. The LegiScan API offers a JSON-based RPC-style interface supporting both pull and push data delivery models. Developers and organizations can monitor legislation in near real-time, search full-text bill content, retrieve roll call votes, access sponsor and legislator information, and download bulk session datasets. The free public tier provides 30,000 queries per month, with paid subscription plans offering higher limits and push-based real-time updates pushed every 15 minutes to 4 hours as changes are detected.

providers.name: LS Retail
providers.description: LS Retail provides modular point‑of‑sale (POS) and business management software solutions for retail, hospitality, and other industries. Their flagship LS Central platform integrates POS, inventory, e‑commerce, and analytics, enabling seamless operations across stores, restaurants, hotels, pharmacies, and forecourts. LS Retail serves global brands with cloud‑enabled, Microsoft Dynamics‑based solutions, offering extensive customization, scalability, and support for omnichannel experiences.

providers.name: MarketerHire
providers.description: MarketerHire is a curated marketing-talent marketplace that matches startups, growth-stage businesses and Fortune 500 brands with pre-vetted senior freelance and fractional marketers — growth marketers, paid-media buyers, SEO and content strategists, email/lifecycle specialists, brand and creative talent — typically within 48 hours, backed by a two-week trial. The company operates a public marketing site and blog on Webflow, a client/talent application at app.marketerhire.com, and a talent portal on talent.marketerhire.com. MarketerHire publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; its only public engineering surface is a small GitHub organization, including mh-brain, the source for its internal "BrightMatter" growth-intelligence HTTP service.

providers.name: measureQuick
providers.description: measureQuick provides a residential HVAC commissioning platform that reads technician probes, scores systems against live conditions, and generates trusted reports. It supports over 80 tools across 17 brands, offering free and paid plans with advanced diagnostics, cloud dashboards, and training resources.

providers.name: Meitu
providers.description: Meitu (美图) is a Chinese visual-technology company best known for its photo- and video-editing apps (Meitu, BeautyCam, Meitu Xiuxiu). It operates the Meitu AI Open Platform, which exposes 100+ image and video AI capabilities as a Web API (OpenAPI) plus native/mobile SDKs — image generation and editing, portrait beautification, face and body analysis, cutout and segmentation, virtual try-on, and image/text-to-video. Access uses a per-application access key and secret key signature; an official Node.js CLI (meitu-cli) wraps the OpenAPI. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: MommaZoo
providers.description: MommaZoo is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: vc-portfolio; backed by 500-global) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Monaire
providers.description: Monaire provides AI‑powered HVAC/R management for multi‑site operators, delivering real‑time equipment monitoring, runtime optimization, predictive issue detection, coordinated work orders, and energy‑saving analytics across restaurant, retail, fitness and convenience‑store portfolios. Their platform claims 10‑30% lower energy use, up to 30% repair savings and up to 95% reduced downtime, all accessible via a unified web interface and API.

providers.name: Moviation
providers.description: Moviation, Inc. is a Seoul-based advanced air mobility and premium travel company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. It operates Vonaer, an AI-powered luxury mobility platform that orchestrates on-demand travel across private aviation (jets and helicopters), luxury ground transportation (limousines), super yachts, and curated experiences, with planned expansion into electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) urban air mobility (UAM). Moviation currently runs air-taxi service with conventional helicopters and has partnered with hybrid-eVTOL developer Plana to build out an advanced air mobility (AAM) ecosystem in South Korea. The company reaches customers through the consumer Vonaer app and a concierge membership program; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: NumPy
providers.description: The fundamental package for scientific computing with Python. NumPy provides multi-dimensional array objects, various derived objects, and an assortment of routines for fast operations on arrays, including mathematical, logical, shape manipulation, sorting, selecting, I/O, FFT, and random number generation.

providers.name: Oferteo
providers.description: Oferteo (oferteo.pl) is a Polish online services marketplace that connects people and businesses seeking services (Zlecający) with local contractors and service providers (Wykonawcy). Clients post a request across hundreds of categories — construction and renovation, IT, legal, health, events, transport and more — and matched providers respond with competitive quotes. The platform layers on verified reviews, a buyer-protection program (Ochrona Zlecających), and native iOS/Android apps for both sides of the marketplace. Oferteo operates nationwide across Poland and reports tens of millions of submitted requests and offers, millions of registered clients, and hundreds of thousands of registered providers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; this profile currently carries verified identity, website link-properties, and infrastructure/security probes.

providers.name: PayTrace
providers.description: PayTrace provides payment processing solutions for merchants, offering a suite of APIs that enable online, mobile, and in‑store transactions. The platform supports credit, debit, ACH, and tokenized payments, with features such as fraud detection, recurring billing, and detailed reporting. PayTrace’s developer portal offers comprehensive documentation, SDKs, and sandbox environments to help businesses integrate payment capabilities quickly and securely.

providers.name: Pemo
providers.description: Pemo is a UAE-based fintech offering smart corporate cards and an all-in-one spend management platform for businesses across the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia. The product combines physical and virtual corporate cards with expense management, automated receipt capture, invoice management, and accounting automation, giving finance teams real-time control and visibility over company spending. Pemo serves more than 10,000 companies and is backed by investors including Speedinvest. Pemo does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile tracks the company's identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Peregrine
providers.description: Peregrine Connect offers an industry‑leading API, application, and workflow integration platform that simplifies messaging, system integration, and web service enablement. It helps companies accelerate integration projects, reduce costs, and improve operational efficiency with a flexible, high‑performance solution. Free 30‑day trial available.

providers.name: Polly
providers.description: Polly is a .NET resilience and transient-fault-handling library that allows developers to express resilience strategies such as Retry, Circuit Breaker, Hedging, Timeout, Rate Limiter, and Fallback in a fluent and thread-safe manner. A .NET Foundation member project.

providers.name: Porter Airlines
providers.description: Porter Airlines is a Canadian carrier headquartered in Toronto, operating as Porter Airlines (Canada) Limited and Porter Airlines Inc. under IATA designator PD, IATA ticketing plate 451, and ICAO code POE. It is the challenger to the Air Canada / WestJet duopoly in Canada, flying an Embraer E195-E2 and De Havilland Dash 8 fleet across domestic, transborder and sun destinations, and it joined IATA as a member in 2026 following IOSA certification. Porter sits in the distribution chain as a conventional GDS-intermediated carrier: agencies reach its inventory through the GDSs (Sabre is named explicitly in Porter's agency terms, and Travelport is the channel Duffel uses to resell Porter content) or through Porter's own ticketless Travel Agency Portal on flyporter.com. Porter's API posture is honestly stated as none-published. There is no developer portal, no public or partner API documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC endpoint of any kind. The developer, developers and apis subdomains do not resolve; api.flyporter.com resolves but does not answer on 80 or 443; docs.flyporter.com redirects to an internal Google Drive. Every well-known spec path returns 404 and the whole site sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge with ai-train=no content signals. Access is accreditation-gated: an agency must hold ARC accreditation or an IATA Passenger Sales Agency Agreement, register on flyporter.com, and accept Porter's Agency Terms and Conditions, which assert Porter ownership of all Porter Data, prohibit scraping and redistribution, and revoke all data rights the moment an appointment is suspended or terminated. There is no exit path beyond a written PIPEDA access request to Porter's Privacy Officer.

providers.name: Prenetics
providers.description: Prenetics Global Limited (NASDAQ: PRE) is a consumer healthcare and longevity company whose flagship brand is IM8, a science-backed daily-nutrition and longevity supplement line co-founded with David Beckham that reached roughly $120M in annual recurring revenue within its first year. The company's IM8 Health direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp that advertises a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, letting AI agents search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout via Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Shopify card handlers. Prenetics itself publishes no separate developer/API program; the agent-commerce surface is the IM8 Health UCP/MCP storefront.

providers.name: Resolve
providers.description: Resolve provides construction teams with high‑performance Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools that run on iPad, web browsers, and immersive VR. Its products—Resolve Field and Resolve VR—enable field crews, superintendents, owners, and reviewers to access large, federated models, verify measurements, and conduct issue tracking without specialized training. The platform integrates with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore, and Revizto to keep models and issues synchronized across workflows.

providers.name: Rupa Health
providers.description: Rupa Health (now a Fullscript company) is a healthcare platform that lets functional and root-cause medicine practitioners order, track, and receive results from specialty and functional lab tests across hundreds of lab companies through a single unified dashboard. It provides a lab test catalog, patient result portals, practitioner ordering and billing, phlebotomy coordination, and educational resources (Rupa University, the Root Cause Medicine podcast, and a lab reference guide). Rupa integrates with a range of EHR/EMR systems used by independent practitioners but does not publish a public developer API or developer portal at this time. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: SAP America
providers.description: SAP America, Inc. is the US subsidiary of SAP SE, headquartered in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, and serving as the Americas headquarters for the parent company's enterprise software portfolio (ERP, SCM, CRM, HCM, analytics, and cloud platform). SAP America itself does not publish a US-specific developer portal or APIs distinct from the parent SAP SE surface — all API documentation, SDKs, and OpenAPI artifacts are catalogued under the sibling `sap` repository (api.sap.com, SAP Business Accelerator Hub, SAP BTP). This repo is a subsidiary placeholder that exists to (1) record SAP America as a distinct US legal entity for partnership, public-sector, procurement, and FedRAMP / GovCloud contexts, and (2) cross-link to related US-only sibling subsidiaries — most importantly SAP NS2 (SAP National Security Services), the independent US subsidiary that operates SAP workloads in the Cloud Intelligence Enterprise (CIE), the DoD cloud environment, and the Commercially Regulated Environment (CRE) for federal, defense, and intelligence community customers. No tier-1 API artifacts (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, capabilities, plans, rate limits, FinOps) are generated in this repo per the api-evangelist no-empty-artifact rule — they are maintained under the parent `sap` repo and the per-product child repos (`sap-business-technology-platform`, `sap-successfactors`, `sap-ariba`, `sap-concur`, `sap-fieldglass`, `sap-api-management`, `sap-integration-suite`).

providers.name: Scrutiny
providers.description: Scrutiny Global provides a market research and intelligence platform offering quantitative and qualitative survey programming, online panels, and API integration for B2B and healthcare sectors. Their services include CAWI, CATI, API-driven data collection, and compliance with ISO standards, serving global markets across Americas, EMEA, APAC, and MEA.

providers.name: Sevaro
providers.description: Sevaro (Sevaro Health) is a physician-led virtual neurology company that delivers telestroke, teleneurohospitalist rounding, remote EEG, neuro-intensive care, neuro-rehab and ambulatory neurology clinic services to hospitals across the United States. Its clinical delivery runs on Synapse AI, an integrated telemedicine platform that unifies EMR access, imaging, video, automated urgent call routing (Sevaro OneCall), AI stroke triage, ambient documentation and analytics, with companion Sevaro Video, Synapse for Providers, Synapse Analytics and Triage by Sevaro mobile surfaces. Sevaro sells to hospital systems through a demo-and-contract motion; it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: SmartHop
providers.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

providers.name: Smore
providers.description: Smore is a newsletter and flyer builder purpose-built for educators, schools, and districts, letting teachers and administrators create accessible, mobile-friendly digital newsletters from customizable templates to keep families and staff informed. The product emphasizes WCAG AA accessibility, translation for multilingual families, and engagement analytics on opens and clicks. Smore is now part of SchoolStatus, the family-engagement platform. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Smore publishes no public developer program, API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface — this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture only.

providers.name: Sofia
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican digital health insurance company that modernizes traditional medical coverage for enterprises, individuals, and families. Its plans combine zero-deductible major and minor medical care, preventive care with an assigned primary-care physician, and unlimited no-cost video consultations, all managed through a mobile app and an HR administrative portal. Sofía operates its own integrated medical network (SofíaMed) of hospitals and specialists, offers add-ons such as maternity, mental health, dental, and international coverage, and reimburses claims in an average of five business days. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Sofía positions insurance as a digital-first, member-centric health experience rather than a paper policy.

providers.name: Speero
providers.description: Speero (سبيرو) is Saudi Arabia's online marketplace for authentic automotive spare parts, accessories, and professional vehicle services. The platform helps car owners find OEM and aftermarket parts for their specific make and model across all major categories (engine, brakes, suspension, lighting, AC, exhaust, and more) and book maintenance, detailing, paint and dent repair, tinting, and tire care at trusted workshops across the Kingdom. It supports browse-by-vehicle, installment payment options, and WhatsApp-based customer support. Speero is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer marketplace and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose a machine-discovery surface (llms.txt, RFC 9116 security.txt, and an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset).

providers.name: Sprinter Health
providers.description: Sprinter Health is an in-home preventive and diagnostic healthcare company that pairs trained community health workers ("Sprinters") who visit patients at home with a virtual team of physicians, nurses, and care navigators. Its hybrid Sprinter Care+ model delivers vitals, blood draws, ECGs, cancer and diabetic screenings, wellness visits, medication reconciliation, care-gap closure, health risk assessments, and social-needs screening, and partners with health plans such as Humana, Molina Healthcare, and Anthem. Backed by a16z, Accel, General Catalyst, and GV. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture, and legal/trust properties.

providers.name: Stability Audio
