Environment files define reusable variables across global, request, and secured scopes; the cookie jar, request history, run/debug configurations, and Services tool window response viewer round out a workflow tightly integrated with the IntelliJ-based IDE family.

providers.name: IKI AI
providers.description: IKI AI is an AI-native workspace for knowledge, research, strategy, and creative work, backed by 500 Global. It pairs an AI assistant that summarizes, highlights, and connects saved content with an AI editor that grounds writing in a user's personal knowledge base, plus shared Team Spaces and a browser extension for one-click webpage saving with notes. The product targets researchers, students, consultants, copywriters, coaches, lawyers, founders, and venture teams, and emphasizes privacy with a choice of top-tier LLMs. IKI AI is delivered as a consumer and team SaaS (web app at app.iki.ai and a Chrome extension) with subscription plans; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI. This profile tracks its public identity, commercial, and security surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Insperity
providers.description: Insperity is a professional employer organization (PEO) headquartered in Kingwood, Texas that provides human resources and business performance solutions to small and medium-sized businesses, including payroll processing, employee benefits, workers' compensation, HR compliance and the Insperity Premier HR technology platform. Insperity Premier exposes a REST Public API at https://api.insperity.com/public organized into four categories — Onboarding, Payroll & Tax, HRIS and Core — covering 45 publicly listed operations that let a client's applicant tracking system, HRIS or payroll application send new-hire records, submit employee change events, retrieve post-payroll general ledger data, and read the company-scoped reference code lists those writes must resolve against. Access is not self-service: a key is issued per customer by an Insperity Integration Specialist after an API Terms of Use Agreement is signed, requests must originate from allow-listed IP addresses, and the developer portal's Swagger documents require a Premier account.

providers.name: KareInn
providers.description: KareInn is a UK-based digital care management and care-home planning software provider whose cloud platform helps residential and nursing care providers streamline operations, evidence CQC compliance, and improve resident care. The product suite spans a care-management dashboard with occupancy and management reporting, a customizable care-plan builder, clinical policy and procedure workflows, care-delivery task assignment and monitoring, pre-admissions and occupancy pipeline management, event and incident tracking, and a resident and family engagement portal. KareInn integrates with partner systems including Civica/Coldharbour income processing, Camscope electronic medication management, and Ally Cares acoustic monitoring, and is positioned as an NHS assured supplier. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio lead; KareInn does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or a machine-readable discovery surface — the artifacts below capture its public product, commercial, and policy pages only.

providers.name: KoRo
providers.description: KoRo (KoRo Handels GmbH) is a Berlin-based direct-to-consumer food retailer that sells nuts, dried fruit, nut butters, snacks, protein products, baking ingredients and drugstore goods in bulk packaging at wholesale-style prices, shipping across Europe from country storefronts in Germany (korodrogerie.de), Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy and the Benelux/EU shop at koro.com. Founded in 2014 and backed by HV Capital and Partech, KoRo runs a headless commerce stack — a Shopware 6 backend fronted by a Nuxt storefront deployed on Vercel — and publishes its engineering work as open source through the KoRoHandelsGmbH GitHub organization, including a Nitro-based Shopware Store-API proxy and several Shopware 6 build-tooling packages on npm under the @korodrogerie scope. KoRo publishes no public developer portal, no documented partner or commerce API, and no API specifications; its Store-API surface is internal and gated behind per-sales-channel access keys.

providers.name: Libravatar
providers.description: Libravatar provides a free, federated avatar service that lets users host their profile pictures and serve them to other websites via a simple API. The open‑source platform allows anyone to run their own instance, integrates with many applications, and offers libraries for various languages. Developers can easily add avatar support to forums, blogs, and comment systems using the documented API endpoints.

providers.name: Linnworks
providers.description: Linnworks provides a multichannel inventory and order management platform for small and medium-sized e‑commerce businesses. Their SaaS solution centralises inventory, automates order processing, integrates with multiple marketplaces and shipping carriers, and offers AI‑driven forecasting and reporting tools. The platform aims to help retailers scale operations across channels while reducing manual effort and errors.

providers.name: marian-coach
providers.description: Marian Coach provides engineering leadership mentorship and career coaching services. It helps engineers and technical leaders advance their careers, increase salaries, and secure senior roles through personalized coaching, workshops, and mentorship programs. The platform offers tailored guidance for roles such as CTO, VP of Engineering, Engineering Director, Manager, Senior Engineer, and AI leadership, as well as corporate mentorship-in-residence services.

providers.name: Navro
providers.description: Navro (formerly Paytrix) is a London-based payments curation platform that lets large businesses move money globally through a single contract and API integration. Rather than stitching together a patchwork of banks and payment providers, Navro routes each payment via the right rail, currency and compliance model, executing millions of payouts across 140+ currencies and 200+ regions. Its products span Navro Workforce (global payroll, contractor and pension payouts), Navro Life (cross-border pensions), Navro Digital (payments for digital platforms and enterprises) and Navro Capital (international fund flows). Clients integrate once via the Navro API or use the no-code Navro Hub portal for real-time payment visibility and reporting. Founded by Aran Brown (CEO) and Eddie Harrison, Navro operates from London with offices in Ireland and the United States, and is authorised by the UK Financial Conduct Authority, the Central Bank of Ireland and FinCEN in the US.

providers.name: Netflix Zuul
providers.description: Netflix Zuul is an open-source L7 application gateway that provides dynamic routing, monitoring, resiliency, and security for edge services. Originally developed by Netflix, Zuul 2 uses Netty for non-blocking I/O and is commonly used as an API gateway and edge service.

providers.name: Northwestern Mutual
providers.description: Northwestern Mutual is a Milwaukee-based Fortune 500 mutual insurance and financial services company founded in 1857, providing life insurance, disability income insurance, long-term care insurance, annuities, investment products, brokerage and wealth management services to individuals, families and businesses through a nationwide network of financial advisors. The company operates a large internal API estate — domain and experience APIs behind an API gateway, with GraphQL used to harmonize them — but publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable contract; its public engineering presence is an open source GitHub organization and a Bugcrowd-managed responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Ordana
providers.description: Ordana provides AI agents that run wholesale order-desk operations for distributors, reading every order across email, fax, PDF, EDI, voice, SMS and chat, resolving exceptions, communicating with retailers, and closing orders directly into the customer's ERP. Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PartySlate
providers.description: PartySlate is a Chicago-based dual marketplace and SaaS platform for the events industry, connecting people planning weddings, galas, corporate events, birthdays, and holiday parties with the leading venues, event professionals, and vendors across the country. The photo-rich platform lets vendors showcase their work through millions of real event photos, build networks of industry partners, and connect directly with prospective clients, while PartySlate Pro provides venues, planners, and vendors an AI-powered SaaS suite to organize, search, and share their photo portfolios with Canva integration and content-management tools built for events. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pienso
providers.description: Pienso is an interactive no-code AI and machine learning platform, founded in 2016 out of MIT by Karthik Dinakar and Birago Jones and headquartered in the Washington, DC / Arlington, VA area. It lets subject-matter experts explore, train, fingerprint, annotate, and deploy deep-learning and large language models over unstructured text — customer calls, emails, documents, and social content — through a point-and-click interface with no coding required. Product capabilities include Ingest, Train & Fingerprint, Annotate, Dataset Analysis, and PromptFactory, applied to use cases such as customer insight, content moderation, document intelligence, and risk detection. Pienso is deployed into the customer's own environment — AWS, Azure, GCP, Gcore, or on-premises — so data never leaves the customer's control, and the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; integration is sales-led and the platform runs as a self-contained system. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Sumary
providers.description: Sumary is a Denmark-based fintech building an AI-native workflow engine for finance and accounting teams. Its platform layers autonomous accounting agents, anomaly detection, and on-demand reporting over a company's existing accounting systems — automating reconciliations and variance explanations, validating transactions to catch errors and potential fraud, and generating management reports, margin analyses, and cost breakdowns for bookkeepers, controllers, CFOs, and finance leaders. The company raised a $4.2M (27M DKK) pre-seed round led by byFounders with participation from Partech and Tenity. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface has been located; this profile captures the company's web, trust, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Tab
providers.description: Tab (tab.travel) is a London-based payment platform built specifically for independent tourism and hospitality businesses — hotels, hostels, tour operators, retreat centers and activity providers. It lets these merchants take card payments wherever their guests are, from in-advance deposits and online booking pages to in-person, on-the-move transactions via a mobile app, and to plug into an existing booking engine, PMS or OTA ecosystem. Tab natively handles 140+ currencies, pays out weekly in the merchant's local currency, and advertises transparent pricing from 2.9% per transaction with no hidden fees. Founded in 2015 by Mark Datta and backed by Y Combinator (W2015), Tab also operates a consumer-facing social-commerce guide for discovering and booking travel. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Tab does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs or API documentation.

providers.name: Tech Soft 3D
providers.description: Tech Soft 3D builds developer SDKs and enterprise applications that power 3D data exchange, visualization, and analysis across engineering, manufacturing, and design. Its HOOPS toolkits (Exchange for CAD data translation and access, Visualize for high-performance 3D graphics, Access, Mesh, Solve, and Envision) are licensed to OEMs and independent developers building CAD, CAM, CAE, and PLM software, and it also distributes Siemens Parasolid and Polygonica. Alongside the native toolkits it publishes the HOOPS Visualize Web Components (open, first-party npm packages), SpinFire enterprise viewing/conversion apps, and OEM technologies such as AutoCAD OEM, Inventor OEM, and RealDWG. Tech Soft 3D is backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Tencent Music Entertainment Group
providers.description: Tencent Music Entertainment Group (TME) is a leading Chinese online music entertainment platform offering streaming services, digital music distribution, and live concert experiences across brands such as QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo, and JOOX. It provides a comprehensive ecosystem for artists, listeners, and partners, integrating social features, AI-driven recommendations, and extensive licensing across domestic and international markets. TME is publicly listed and actively expands its audio content through acquisitions and strategic partnerships.

providers.name: Virtual Instruments
providers.description: Virtual Instruments provides a platform for virtual instrumentation and data acquisition, enabling developers to integrate hardware-like measurement capabilities into software applications via APIs. The company focuses on delivering scalable, cloud‑native solutions for test and measurement, supporting a range of industries including manufacturing, research, and IoT. Their services include virtual sensor data streams, real‑time analytics, and SDKs for multiple programming languages, aiming to simplify complex instrumentation workflows for modern developers.

providers.name: Walgreens Boots Alliance
providers.description: Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA) is a global pharmacy-led health and wellbeing enterprise operating in more than 25 countries, with pharmacy chains Walgreens in the US and Boots in the UK, pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution through Alliance Healthcare, and specialty pharmacy operations. WBA operates as a Fortune 100 company and global healthcare platform, leveraging data science, AI, and digital health technologies to serve patients, customers, and health systems. While WBA's primary developer APIs are offered through the Walgreens Developer Program, the enterprise also uses healthcare data platforms for population health management, specialty pharmacy integration, and digital health services.

providers.name: Wazuh
providers.description: Wazuh provides an open source security platform for threat detection, integrity monitoring, incident response, and compliance. It offers a unified XDR solution that combines SIEM, log analysis, and endpoint security, enabling organizations to monitor and protect their infrastructure across cloud, on‑premise, and hybrid environments. The platform includes real‑time alerting, file integrity checking, vulnerability detection, and powerful dashboards for security operations.

providers.name: Weedmaps
providers.description: Weedmaps is a cannabis discovery and ordering marketplace connecting consumers with dispensaries, delivery services, and brands. For its business customers it publishes a partner integration API suite - a Menu API for keeping a retailer's product menu, pricing, and availability in sync with their point-of-sale, a Brand Catalog API for mapping and enriching menu items against the Weedmaps brand and product taxonomy, a Taxonomy API for categories, cannabinoids, strains, terpenes, and discovery tags, and an Orders API for receiving and updating online orders in a partner POS. The developer documentation is public, but production access is partner-gated - integrators apply by email, receive OAuth2 client-credentials credentials and a test listing, and a Listing Owner must grant access. New integrations are noted as not currently being onboarded, so the endpoints below are documented but modeled from the public reference rather than exercised against a live account.

providers.name: Wiselayer
providers.description: WiseLayer is an AI-powered accounting automation platform that provides named "digital workers" (AI agents) for finance and accounting teams, automating tasks such as accruals, vendor communications, payroll accounting, bank reconciliations, depreciation and amortization, lease accounting, and prepaid expenses. The platform emphasizes transparent, explainable AI ("AI that shows its work") with natural-language interaction, automated email digests, and 300+ integrations into ERPs, billing, procure-to-pay, and HRIS systems. WiseLayer was acquired by BlackLine (NASDAQ: BL) and its product is now offered as Verity Accruals by BlackLine. WiseLayer was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. The company operates a SaaS application at app.wiselayer.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Zetagen Therapeutics
providers.description: Zetagen Therapeutics is a private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2015 and based in Syracuse, New York, where it has operated from laboratory space in the Central New York Biotech Accelerator at SUNY Upstate Medical University since 2017. It develops locally administered small-molecule therapies for metastatic and primary cancers to bone and other organs, built on a proprietary "Zeta" platform derived from the company's discovery of a new molecular pathway acting through the Met5-enkephalin / opioid growth factor receptor signalling axis. Its oncology pipeline includes ZetaMet (Zeta-BC-003) for metastatic breast cancer to bone, which received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in December 2021 and Health Canada authorisation for a Phase 2a study in January 2022 and reported Phase 2a results at ASCO in June 2026; ZetaMet-P (Zeta-PC-004) for prostate cancer; ZetaMAST (Zeta-MBC-005) for metastatic breast cancer in liver; Zeta-BC-007; and ZetaOnc. Its osteologic programme is ZetaFuse, a synthetic osteoinductive bone graft studied in anterior cervical discectomy and fusion. The company reached 64 worldwide patents in 2024, has been funded by NCI and NIAMS grants, a $5.34M Series A, a $9.79M Series B and an oversubscribed Series B1 closed in November 2025, and its shares trade on secondary markets. Zetagen Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal or API documentation. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind zetagen.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: 3DR
providers.description: 3DR, Inc. is an American designer and manufacturer of electronic systems for unmanned vehicles, drones and UAVs, based in Chula Vista, California, and focused on open-source and open-hardware flight control: Control N1 / Control Zero / Pixracer Pro autopilots, Location One and ZED-F9P RTK GNSS receivers, SiK and Dualband Wi-Fi telemetry radios, DroneCAN power modules and sensors, ESCs, and an ArduRemoteID-based Remote ID module. The company states on its own site that "3DR Inc was a distinct entity before the year 2023" and does not support products sold under the earlier 3D Robotics label (Solo, Site Scan, DroneKit). Its published surface is a hardware knowledge base and a storefront; it operates no public web API.

providers.name: Acheel
providers.description: Acheel is a French digital insurance company — a néo-assureur that carries its own insurance licence rather than broking someone else's. Founded in 2020 by Ralph Ruimy and Francky Défossé, it received its ACPR agrément and launched in 2021, and now reports more than 800,000 policyholders. ACHEEL SA (879 605 350 RCS Paris) underwrites; ACHEEL FRANCE (ORIAS 21003575) distributes. The range spans nine lines — habitation, auto, santé, animaux, PNO (propriétaire non occupant), emprunteur, scolaire, protection juridique and RC pro — sold 100% digitally, with a quote in about two minutes and subscription in five. Roughly 70% of revenue comes from B2B2C distribution: partner brokers are served under the Charlee brand (charlee.fr, broker portal "Acheel Omega" at back.charlee.fr) and partners embed a per-tenant white-label customer area served from *.widget.acheel.com. Acheel's own partner FAQ stated it makes its APIs available to partners ("nous mettons à votre disposition nos APIs afin de vous faire bénéficier de notre Tech et de nos produits"), but no developer portal, API reference, base URL or machine-readable specification is published anywhere on its public surface; API access travels with a brokerage partnership. Acheel is a certified B Corp.

providers.name: Achriom
providers.description: Achriom provides a unified platform to track books, movies, TV shows, music, anime, games, and podcasts. Users can create personal libraries, discover new content, and see connections between media they love. The service offers detailed metadata, recommendations, and the ability to share collections with friends, aiming to be a one‑stop hub for entertainment enthusiasts.

providers.name: Agent Hideout
providers.description: Agent Hideout is a persistent, shared world for AI agents, offering lists, notes, statistics, stories, shared projects, and messages. Users can keep lists, track world events, maintain scoreboards, collect notes, exchange messages, or create entirely different content, all accessible via MCP or HTTP.

providers.name: Agent World
providers.description: Agent World is a living AI agent economy where over 380 autonomous agents work jobs, trade goods, and pay each other real USDC on the Base L2 blockchain. Users can watch the live scene, join the economy, and interact with agents that earn, spend, and manage digital assets in real time, showcasing the potential of decentralized AI-driven commerce.

providers.name: Agents Commons
providers.description: Agents Commons provides a read‑only help‑desk style interface for autonomous agents to register, search, and answer tickets without requiring human login. The platform logs basic HTTP telemetry for transparency and enforces operator‑installed registration policies. It offers a public MCP read endpoint and a read‑write MCP endpoint (POST‑only) for agents to interact programmatically. Documentation is minimal, consisting of plain‑text markdown pages describing usage, privacy, and skill definitions. The service is hosted on Vercel and serves its API under the agentscommons.io domain.

providers.name: AiSeek
providers.description: AiSeek provides a platform that aggregates and visualizes economic and market data, offering real‑time dashboards, forecasts, and analytical tools for investors, analysts, and businesses to track macro‑economic indicators, financial markets, and industry trends across the globe.

providers.name: AlertD
providers.description: AlertD is an AI‑powered conversational agent platform designed for DevOps and SRE teams to manage AWS infrastructure. It provides read‑only, natural‑language queries across services like EC2, S3, RDS, and CloudWatch, delivering structured, actionable insights without requiring scripts or CLI commands. Founded in 2024, AlertD aims to reduce toil, improve reliability, and enhance team collaboration by acting as a “Slack for production uptime,” offering transparent execution plans, multi‑service support, and secure read‑only AWS access.

providers.name: Allocate
providers.description: Allocate is a technology platform positioned as an "operating system for private markets," enabling wealth advisory firms, family offices, and asset managers to source, transact, and manage private-market investments across venture capital, growth equity, buyouts, and private credit. The platform offers white-label fund creation for advisors, AI-powered portfolio management with document aggregation, curated manager access, and SPV infrastructure for aggregating smaller commitments. Allocate reports over $4.9B in assets on platform, 370+ wealth advisory firm clients, and 1,500+ manager relationships. It is a private company backed by investors including Anthemis, a16z, Portage, and M13. Allocate does not currently publish a public developer program or API; this API Evangelist profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Anheuser-Busch
providers.description: An American brewing company and subsidiary of AB InBev producing iconic beer brands including Budweiser, Bud Light, Michelob, and Stella Artois. One of the largest beverage producers in North America with operations across brewing, distribution, and marketing.

providers.name: API Evangelist
providers.description: The API Evangelist network as one REST API and an MCP server for agents — sixteen years of API research, served from developer.apievangelist.com.

providers.name: Aqta
providers.description: Aqta builds AI verification products that ensure autonomous agents act within approved parameters. Their flagship Seal product checks and signs AI decisions before they are executed, providing an auditable receipt. Testera offers free language‑learning AI tutors in over 20 languages. Based in Dublin, the team combines AI safety expertise with cloud security and risk consulting to create transparent, verifiable AI workflows for enterprises and developers.

providers.name: ARVI SA
providers.description: ARVI SA operates a premium online wine shop offering a curated selection of over 5,000 fine and rare wines from renowned regions such as Bordeaux, Burgundy, and Tuscany. Based in Switzerland, the company provides secure shipping and 24‑hour delivery throughout the country. Customers can browse an extensive catalog, filter by producer, vintage, price, and region, and purchase directly through the website. The platform emphasizes high‑quality service, authenticity guarantees, and a seamless shopping experience for wine enthusiasts and collectors.

providers.name: Aryakanetworks
providers.description: Aryaka Networks offers a Unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform delivered as a service, combining networking and security functions such as SD‑WAN, zero‑trust network access, next‑gen firewall, and multi‑cloud SaaS acceleration. The solution is targeted at enterprise customers seeking to modernize, scale, and secure global WAN connectivity without trade‑offs between performance and protection.

providers.name: Atolls
providers.description: Atolls (formerly Global Savings Group) is a Munich-based consumer commerce-content company that operates the world's largest shopping engagement platform, running coupon, cashback, deals, and shopping-community destinations across more than 20 markets. Its brand portfolio includes Coupons.com, Cuponation, iGraal, Shoop, Pouch, mydealz, hotukdeals, and Deala, connecting millions of shoppers with offers from thousands of retailers and brands through affiliate marketing, cashback, and AI-enhanced shopping insights. Founded in 2012 as CupoNation with Rocket Internet and rebranded to Atolls in 2024, it is backed by investors including HV Capital, RTP Global, and Rocket Internet. Atolls publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI document or SDK — api., developer. and docs.atolls.com do not resolve — but it does serve real machine-readable documents: RFC 9116 security.txt files on five owned hosts pointing at a single group-wide Intigriti vulnerability disclosure program, and OpenID Connect discovery documents on seven Pepper community properties (mydealz, hotukdeals, Dealabs, Preisjaeger, Chollometro, Pepper PL, Promodescuentos) that expose an OAuth 2.0 authorization server for consumer sign-in. This profile captures that security, identity, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Azibo
providers.description: Azibo provides a free, cloud‑based platform that simplifies rental property financial management for landlords. It offers tools for rent collection, tenant screening, lease agreements, document storage, maintenance requests, accounting, and reporting, all integrated to help property owners achieve financial flexibility and streamline operations.

providers.name: backtest360-com
providers.description: Backtest360 provides a cloud-based backtesting platform for systematic traders, quants, and developers. It offers a REST API, Python client, and MCP to run structured-rule strategies with realistic costs, slippage, and stops. The service includes AI‑assisted analysis, real‑time data controls, and a web UI, currently in private beta as of June 2026.

providers.name: baseframelabs-com
providers.description: Baseframe Labs is an independent software studio focused on developer tools. It builds local, deterministic tools that surface the real state of a codebase, enabling trust in code changes. The studio offers a suite of products including ProjScan, AgentLoopKit, AgentFlight, VerisKit, TokenTrace, Swiss Auto Data, EndpointOS, CampaignPacks, Nightmark, and SparkPath, providing market data, API infrastructure, and daily utilities for engineers.

providers.name: BLOCKTRUST
providers.description: BLOCKTRUST provides a French digital identity certification solution that protects against identity theft and phishing. Leveraging blockchain on Polygon, it offers monthly subscription plans, customizable verification tools, and compliance with European data protection standards. The platform enables businesses and individuals to securely verify identities, reduce fraud, and integrate trusted digital credentials into their services.

providers.name: Boon
providers.description: Boon AI delivers AI‑powered construction estimating software that reads architectural drawings and specifications, automatically performs takeoffs, detects conflicts, and levels bids for general contractors and specialty subcontractors. The platform offers accuracy metrics, pricing tiers for teams of any size, and tools such as ROI calculators, RFI generators, and bid‑leveling templates, positioning Boon as a modern, AI‑driven solution for the construction industry.

providers.name: BrightInsight
providers.description: BrightInsight is a regulated digital health platform for biopharma and medtech. Its cloud-based, microservices platform captures, transmits and analyzes data from CE-marked and FDA-regulated medical devices, combination products, apps and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) in compliance with global security, privacy and regulatory requirements. The platform integrates with 400+ medical devices across 50+ manufacturers, connects to EHRs in 500+ U.S. provider networks, and is available in 48 countries. Founded in 2017 (formerly Flex Digital Health) and based in Alviso, California, BrightInsight is used by top biopharma and medtech companies to build and launch commercial regulated digital health solutions. It is a sales-led enterprise platform with no public developer portal or public API; integration is delivered under managed engagements.

providers.name: Built Robotics
providers.description: Built Robotics is a San Francisco robotics company, founded in 2016 by Noah Ready-Campbell and Andrew Liang, that turns conventional heavy construction equipment into AI-powered autonomous robots. Its Exosystem retrofit kit converts excavators and other earthmoving machines into self-operating robots for trenching, foundation excavation and pad grading, while the RPD 35 and RPS 25 autonomous pile drivers install foundations for utility-scale solar farms. Machines are supervised from the Everest command center, and field deployment is run through its Built Solar Technologies (built.solar) division. The company reports $114M raised and 25+ commercial deployments across the United States and Australia. Built Robotics publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract; its only public developer artifact is the open-source rsplan Reeds-Shepp path-planning library on PyPI and GitHub.

providers.name: capital.new
providers.description: capital.new is building the funding layer for AI agents. It enables agents to request capital and operate under a mandate. The platform is pre‑seed, not a lender, and aims to provide a seamless funding interface for AI applications. It offers an MCP endpoint for integration with AI agents and provides documentation for developers.

providers.name: Choco Communications
providers.description: Choco Communications provides an AI‑powered growth platform for food distributors, enabling automated ordering, digital storefronts, sales tools, and payment solutions. The platform helps businesses increase margins, reduce waste, and streamline restaurant‑supplier communication through real‑time insights and integrated CRM features.

providers.name: CleanVector
providers.description: cleanvector-ai is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: CloudQix
providers.description: CloudQix provides an iPaaS platform enabling API connections and workflow automation for enterprises. It aims to reduce integration complexity, cost, and time by offering a unified solution for data movement, process orchestration, and application linking across finance, sales, IT, and marketing functions. The platform includes tools for building, managing, and monitoring integrations, with a focus on scalability and security.

providers.name: Coconut
providers.description: Coconut provides a modern accounting and financial management platform for small and medium businesses, offering automated bookkeeping, invoicing, expense tracking, and real-time financial insights. The company integrates with banks, payment processors, and popular SaaS tools to streamline operations and reduce manual effort. Backed by Techstars and part of the VC portfolio, Coconut aims to simplify finance for entrepreneurs through a robust API-first approach.

providers.name: Crozdesk
providers.description: Crozdesk helps businesses find and compare software across all major software categories. The platform indexes 43,000+ products across 377+ categories with expert reviews, user ratings, and AI-powered recommendations to guide software purchasing decisions. Vendors can list and advertise their products through the SoftwareSelect vendor portal.

providers.name: Cureskin
providers.description: Cureskin is an AI‑powered dermatology and hair‑care platform founded in 2017 in Bengaluru, India. It offers a mobile app that provides free AI skin and hair analysis, connects users with board‑certified dermatologists, and delivers personalized, prescription‑strength treatment kits. The service combines machine‑learning diagnostics with clinician oversight to address conditions such as acne, hair loss, and skin aging, aiming to make professional dermatological care accessible and continuous for everyday health needs.

providers.name: Cyral
providers.description: Cyral is a data security and governance platform (founded 2018, Milpitas CA; acquired by Varonis in March 2025) that provides an agentless, stateless data-layer sidecar for monitoring and governing access to data repositories such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Amazon S3, Kafka, and Oracle. Cyral was built API-first: its Control Plane exposes a REST API secured with OAuth2 client-credentials, fully automatable through the official Cyral Terraform provider (cyralinc/cyral) and supporting Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, and Okta. Following the Varonis acquisition, cyral.com now redirects to Varonis' Database Activity Monitoring product, but the first-party developer tooling remains published on the cyralinc GitHub organization and the Terraform Registry.

providers.name: Dash
providers.description: Dash is a peer-to-peer cryptocurrency network offering fast, low-cost payments with InstantSend, privacy via CoinJoin mixing, and decentralized governance through Masternodes. Developers can query blocks, transactions, addresses, UTXOs, governance objects, and real-time network events through the open-source Insight REST and WebSocket API, and can access Dash Platform layer-2 (DashPay identity, data contracts, documents, tokens) through the Decentralized API (DAPI) over gRPC and JSON-RPC.

providers.name: Dework
providers.description: Dework is a Web3-native task-management and bounty platform for DAOs and decentralized teams. Organizations create bounties, projects, and task boards; contributors build an on-chain reputation profile, claim or apply to tasks, and get paid in the DAO's own token or stablecoins from supported wallets (Gnosis/Safe, MetaMask, Phantom, WalletConnect). Dework offers token- and Discord-role gating, two-way Discord and GitHub sync, Notion and Coordinape integrations, batch payments, reputation staking, roadmaps, and leaderboards. It aggregates bounties and grants from hundreds of DAOs. The app is backed by an Apollo GraphQL API at api.dework.xyz; product documentation lives on GitBook. Backed by Paradigm.

providers.name: FOCUS (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification)
providers.description: FOCUS, the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification, is an open standard maintained under the FinOps Foundation that normalizes cost and usage data across cloud, SaaS, data center, and other technology vendors. FOCUS defines a common data schema, a controlled vocabulary of column names, allowed values, and pricing attributes so that practitioners can apply a consistent set of FinOps practices regardless of which provider generated the underlying billing dataset. FOCUS is purely a data specification rather than a REST API; conforming providers expose exports of their billing data in the FOCUS format, and tooling consumes those exports against the published column library, data model, and validator.

providers.name: Graffer
providers.description: Graffer, Inc. (株式会社グラファー) is a Tokyo-based GovTech and generative-AI company founded in 2017 whose mission is to change behavior and society through the power of products. It operates two pillars: the Graffer Platform, a suite of digital-government services for municipalities and national agencies (Smart Application for online applications, Procedure Guide, Window Reservation, and Graffer Call AI voice guidance), adopted by 179+ Japanese municipalities including Fukuoka, Sapporo, Kyoto, and Oita; and Graffer AI Solution, a generative-AI adoption offering for enterprises (consulting, training, and the Graffer AI Studio product). Graffer also runs the citizen-facing お悩みハンドブック benefits-discovery service and the Govtech Trends media. In 2023 it entered a capital and business alliance with Change Holdings. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Gridcog
providers.description: Gridcog provides intelligent energy decision software that enables large‑scale asset developers, consultants, energy majors, and e‑mobility planners to accurately evaluate and design utility‑scale hybrid, co‑located, and EV charging projects. Their platform offers multi‑market, multi‑site, and multi‑asset simulation tools, delivering transparent, reliable modeling for commercial and industrial energy projects. Gridcog’s solutions help clients assess feasibility, optimize designs, and accelerate investment decisions in the clean energy transition.

providers.name: Harpoon
providers.description: Harpoon is a no-code Kubernetes deployment platform that lets teams deploy commercial or open-source software to Kubernetes clusters in seconds using a drag-and-drop interface, without writing code or configuration scripts. It automates cloud account security, cluster provisioning and autoscaling across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and VMware, and integrates with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Argo, Docker Hub and Harbor. The product is delivered as a hosted web application (app.harpooncorp.com) aimed at both startups and enterprises; it is surfaced here as an a16z portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass Harpoon publishes no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI or webhook surface.

providers.name: Illuminate Education
providers.description: Illuminate Education is a K-12 education technology company providing assessment, data analytics, and Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) tools to schools and districts. Its platform serves roughly 17 million students across 5,200 schools and districts in all 50 states, taking a "whole child" approach that combines academic and social-emotional-behavioral data. Marquee products are FastBridge (universal screening and progress monitoring), DnA (standards-based assessment creation and scoring), and eduCLIMBER (MTSS collaboration and district data management). Illuminate does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI; data exchange runs through education-interoperability standards (LTI 1.0/1.1 Certified, OneRoster, Ed-Fi 2.5+, QTI) and partner/SIS/LMS integrations. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners, headquartered in Irvine, California.

providers.name: Innoviti
providers.description: Innoviti Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based payment technology company and RBI-authorized payment aggregator (online and, since January 2026, in-store) operating under India's Payment & Settlements Act 2007. Founded in 2002, Innoviti builds collections, reconciliation, and revenue-assurance infrastructure for large organized retail. Its products include innoviti unipay (an enterprise payment and reconciliation platform for omnichannel settlements and leakage control), innoviti genie (a sales acceleration and dealer-margin platform for mobile and electronics retail), and innoviti link (a POS-free mobile collection app accepting cards, UPI, and EMI). The company serves enterprise retailers including Samsung, Reliance Retail, Tanishq, Shoppers Stop, and More Retail, holds multiple payment-communication patents, and maintains PCI DSS, PCI P2PE, and PCI PIN certifications. Added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Intenseye
providers.description: Intenseye is an AI-powered workplace safety platform that applies computer vision to a facility's existing CCTV cameras to detect unsafe conditions and behaviors in real time and prevent Serious Injuries and Fatalities (SIF). Its Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) product surfaces hazards, compliance gaps, and operational risks across manufacturing, logistics, food & beverage, and other high-risk industries, and can trigger Hard Stop emergency alerts. Intenseye offers cloud, private cloud, and on-premise deployment, is SOC 2 / AICPA certified and GDPR-aligned, uses AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS in transit, and does not use facial recognition. Backed by Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Point Nine. Intenseye publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal; product access is through its dashboard and login. It maintains a public GitHub organization of mostly open-source forks and workshops rather than first-party client libraries.

providers.name: Jala
providers.description: JALA is an Indonesian aquaculture technology company providing end-to-end solutions for the shrimp farming industry, describing itself as a fully connected system powered by data farmers can trust. It connects farmers, processors, and buyers through the JALA App for real-time pond monitoring and data analytics, the Baruni technology platform, farming supplies (post-larvae, feed, technical assistance), harvest and cold-chain logistics services, and traceable certified supply chains for processors and buyers. Backed by 500 Global, JALA operates a consumer/operator SaaS platform (app.jala.tech) rather than a public developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Joby Aviation
providers.description: Joby Aviation is a California-based aerospace company developing an all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft intended to operate as part of a fast, quiet, and convenient air taxi service. Joby's piloted four-passenger S4 aircraft is designed for a top speed of 200 mph and zero operating emissions, and the company is pursuing FAA Type Certification under Part 23. Joby has strategic relationships with Toyota for manufacturing, Delta Air Lines, Virgin Atlantic and ANA for distribution, Uber for ground integration, the U.S. Department of Defense (Agility Prime), and operates a vertically integrated program covering aircraft, batteries (JoeBen cell technology via Joby's battery group), software, and pilot training. Joby acquired Uber Elevate and is co-located with manufacturing facilities in Marina and Santa Cruz, California, with plans for early commercial passenger service in Dubai and U.S. cities.

providers.name: Kayrros
providers.description: Kayrros is an environmental-intelligence and geospatial-AI company that independently tracks human activity and its physical footprint worldwide by combining satellite imagery, alternative data, and machine learning. Its products span energy markets — crude oil and jet fuel intelligence, LNG, renewables, solar and battery-storage construction monitoring, industrial and on-road energy demand, and stockpiles — and environmental risk — methane emissions via Methane Watch, wildfire risk, forest-carbon and deforestation monitoring, and carbon accounting. Kayrros delivers asset-level data feeds, APIs, and dashboards to traders, operators, financial institutions, regulators, insurers, and the public sector. The company was acquired by Energy Aspects in May 2026.

providers.name: Lalilo
providers.description: Lalilo is an adaptive reading and literacy web application for primary-school classrooms, founded in Paris in 2016 and acquired by Renaissance (Wisconsin Rapids, USA) in 2021. It delivers roughly 90,000 interactive phonics, fluency and comprehension exercises that adapt in real time to each student, uses speech recognition to assess oral reading aloud, and gives teachers a dashboard for tracking progress and running differentiated small-group instruction. It is used by around 40,000 teachers and 400,000 students a year in France across cycles 2 and 3, with explicit support for DYS, allophone, ULIS, SEGPA and IME learners. Lalilo publishes no public API, developer portal or API documentation: the product is consumed through the teacher and student web applications at app.lalilo.com, and integration or rostering questions are handled through Renaissance support rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Litify
providers.description: Litify is a legal operating system built on Salesforce that provides REST APIs for managing matters, intakes, documents, tasks, time tracking, billing, and client communications for law firms and legal departments. Integrators access Litify functionality via the Salesforce REST API and the Litify Docrio API under the terms of the Litify API Integration Agreement.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Multiverse
providers.description: Multiverse is a British education-technology company (founded 2016 by Euan Blair and Sophie Adelman, headquartered in London) that operates an AI-adoption and workforce-upskilling platform. It delivers apprenticeships and training programmes in AI, data, software engineering, and digital skills, pairing on-the-job learning with expert coaching so employers can close skills gaps and build future-ready teams. Backed by investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and StepStone Group, Multiverse serves enterprise clients across the UK and US. The company exposes no public developer API; its digital surface is a marketing site, a learner/employer login, a help centre, a community hub, a blog, a service status page, and a trust centre.

providers.name: NETGEAR
providers.description: NETGEAR is a global networking hardware company that designs, manufactures, and sells a wide range of wired and wireless networking products for consumers, small businesses, and enterprises. Their portfolio includes Wi‑Fi routers, mesh systems, switches, modems, and network-attached storage, serving millions of customers worldwide. NETGEAR focuses on delivering reliable connectivity, advanced security features, and easy‑to‑use management tools across home and business environments.

providers.name: NewsData
providers.description: NewsData.io provides live breaking news and historical news data going back to January 2018, sourced from over 82,000 sources worldwide. The API supports searching, filtering by source, language, country, and category, and returns results in JSON format suitable for analytics, monitoring, and AI training.

providers.name: Nfinite
providers.description: Nfinite (formerly Hubstairs) is a visual intelligence platform for the digital shelf. It helps consumer brands and retailers automatically analyze, generate, and monitor compliant product visuals — detecting visual compliance gaps across every retailer and brand and fixing them at scale using AI-generated 3D and synthetic product imagery. The product is delivered as a web application (my.nfinite.app) rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or published documentation exists at the time of enrichment. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: oddiwire-com
providers.description: Oddiwire provides a real-time esports odds API covering major titles like League of Legends, CS2, Dota 2, Valorant, and more. The service offers REST and SSE endpoints delivering raw no‑vig probabilities, market names, and totals. It includes documentation, pricing, a dashboard, and status page, and is not affiliated with ODDIN.GG. The platform aims to give developers easy access to live esports betting data.

providers.name: Our Place
providers.description: Our Place is a direct-to-consumer kitchenware and cookware brand, best known for the multi-purpose Always Pan, selling cookware, bakeware, appliances, tableware, and kitchen tools at fromourplace.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, its digital storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a native agentic-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect authentication, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the company's live public agent surface.

providers.name: Paro
providers.description: Ottimate, formerly Plate IQ, provides AI‑powered accounts payable automation for finance teams, offering invoice capture, coding, approval workflows, and direct vendor payments. The platform integrates with major ERP systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage, and Microsoft Dynamics, delivering real‑time spend visibility, error reduction, and compliance support across industries like hospitality, healthcare, and retail.

providers.name: Primodium
providers.description: Primodium Inc. (primodiumxyz) is a developer-focused studio building fully on-chain applications and games on Ethereum and Solana. It ships two on-chain games — Primodium, a space-based factory-building game, and Primodium: Empires, a turn-based prediction-market game — both built with MUD and Phaser, alongside a suite of open-source developer libraries and infrastructure: Reactive Tables (a strictly-typed reactive table library for MUD apps), a Solana DEX Indexer Stack exposing a GraphQL API over Hasura/Timescale, a tRPC transaction-sponsoring DEX server, an off-chain MUD indexer, and gasless-transaction relayers. All tooling is published open-source under the MIT license via the primodiumxyz GitHub organization and the @primodiumxyz npm scope.

providers.name: Qwikwire
providers.description: Qwikwire, now operating as Aqwire, is a Philippine-founded cross-border payments company backed by 500 Global that bridges international payers with Philippine recipients, with a primary focus on the real estate sector. The platform lets overseas home buyers and investors pay property developers in multiple currencies while handling collection, reconciliation, and delivery of Philippine pesos to local bank accounts. Aqwire for Enterprise provides a payment dashboard for creating payment links, tracking transactions in real time, running auto-debit enrollments, and receiving daily automated reports, plus the Aqwire Connect (Access) API so merchants can integrate payment transaction creation into their own applications. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Scribd
providers.description: Scribd Inc. is an American digital-content media company founded in 2007 by Trip Adler, Jared Friedman and Tikhon Bernstam and headquartered in San Francisco, California. It operates four consumer platforms: Scribd (a document-sharing library), Everand (a subscription service for ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, podcasts and sheet music, formerly the flagship Scribd subscription), SlideShare (presentation hosting) and Fable (a social reading app). Scribd was an early Y Combinator company. Its historical public "Platform" API for uploading, converting and displaying documents is now legacy — the official Ruby client (scribd/rscribd) was archived in 2019, Scribd no longer accepts new API accounts, and the SlideShare developer portal has been retired — so this profile documents the company's identity and the remaining first-party developer artifacts rather than a live API surface.

providers.name: Simpleclub
providers.description: Simpleclub is a German digital learning platform serving over two million students (grades 5-13), apprentices, and organizations across school, vocational training (Ausbildung), continuing education, retraining, and workforce upskilling. The product pairs curriculum-aligned content (including IHK-aligned vocational tracks) with an AI-powered learning assistant, trainer/learning-management tooling, and the ability for organizations to upload custom content. It counts 750+ corporate clients such as Deutsche Bahn, Bosch, and Vodafone. Simpleclub maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source Flutter tooling (math keyboard, flutter_math, design-token builder) but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile is an end-user/EdTech company record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: skywalkapi-com
providers.description: Skywalk API provides a JSON REST API enabling integration with AppFolio® Property Manager. It offers over forty endpoints for reading and writing property management data, supports OAuth for platforms, and includes AI agent MCP capabilities. The service targets developers, teams, and executives seeking automated data access and AI-driven workflows, with consulting and custom integration options.

providers.name: slate-hq-uk
providers.description: Slate HQ Ltd builds AmbientOS, AMBI, and the .slate format to enable contextual AI integration across personal and work data. Their platform offers developers APIs to connect AI tools, manage memory ambience, and integrate health and productivity services, emphasizing privacy and user control.

providers.name: TapAd
providers.description: Tapad is a digital identity and cross-device graph technology company, founded in 2010 and headquartered in New York City. Its flagship product, the Tapad Graph, is a probabilistic device graph that lets marketers, agencies, and platforms recognize a brand's customer or related household across the many devices they use, powering programmatic targeting, media measurement, attribution, and personalization. Tapad was acquired by the Norwegian telecom Telenor in 2016 and then by the credit-and-data company Experian in 2020, and by 2026 its product and company pages redirect into Experian's Consumer Sync marketing suite while docs.tapad.com redirects to Experian's client-only Marketing Knowledge Base. Tapad runs no public developer program — no portal, no OpenAPI, no pricing and no self-service signup — but it does still operate two live first-party HTTP endpoints, the Tapestry Web API and an event tracking beacon, both requiring a partner id that only Tapad can issue, and it published four open-source mobile SDKs that it has since archived as unmaintained. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Teamtailor
providers.description: Teamtailor is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and employer branding platform that helps companies attract, engage, and hire candidates with customizable career sites, recruitment workflows, candidate communications, and analytics. The platform supports collaborative hiring, GDPR compliance, and a marketplace of integrations. Teamtailor's API follows the JSON:API specification with regional base URLs and uses token-based authentication with Public, Internal, and Admin key permission levels.

providers.name: US Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board
providers.description: The US Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board (CSB) is an independent federal agency responsible for investigating chemical accidents and hazards across the United States. The board conducts thorough investigations into incidents involving the release of hazardous chemicals, explosions, fires, and other accidents that pose a threat to public safety and the environment. The CSB publishes investigation reports, safety recommendations, and incident data, and maintains a public database of completed investigations and safety recommendations. While no formal public API is available, the CSB makes incident data available through its website and periodic compiled reports under its Accidental Release Reporting Rule transparency initiative.

providers.name: VanMoof
providers.description: VanMoof is an Amsterdam-based e-bike company that designs and sells smart electric city bikes with integrated anti-theft technology, GPS tracking, and a companion rider app. Originally backed by Balderton Capital and relaunched after its 2023 restructuring, VanMoof operates a connected-bike platform, but publishes no public developer API — the app and bike APIs are private, and existing client libraries are community-built and reverse-engineered.

providers.name: Venta
providers.description: Venta AI provides an AI‑powered outbound platform for manufacturers and distributors to acquire new customers, expand existing accounts, and revive cold deals. The SaaS solution offers hyper‑personalized messaging, optimized email delivery, social automation, CRM integration, and buying‑signal detection. Developed in the EU and hosted in Germany, Venta complies with GDPR and local laws, delivering secure, compliant outreach for B2B sales teams.

providers.name: voize
providers.description: voize is a German healthcare AI company (voize GmbH) building a voice-documentation platform for long-term care, skilled nursing, and disability-support facilities. Caregivers speak naturally on a smartphone during patient care and voize's on-device and cloud speech models convert the free speech into structured, categorized entries that sync bi-directionally in real time into the facility's electronic health record (EHR) system. The product reduces documentation burden for nursing staff, works offline, recognizes patient names and corrects grammar, and integrates directly with major EHRs used in skilled nursing. voize is backed by HV Capital and operates in Germany and the United States. It ships a mobile application rather than a public developer API, but exposes EHR integrations, a trust center, and a vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty program on its public surface.

providers.name: Weco Ai
providers.description: Weco AI is a platform focused on recursively self‑improving artificial intelligence, offering collaborative tools, research publications, and open‑source resources. The company builds AI systems that can iteratively improve themselves, publishes research such as AIDE and Autoresearch, and provides a developer-friendly ecosystem with documentation, APIs, and community channels.

providers.name: William
providers.description: William is the operator named in the A2A agent card for Agent Communication Mesh (meshgateway.app), a public, anonymous, chat-only room for AI agents run as a Discord server behind a small gateway. Agents join by fetching the agent-mesh discovery document and POSTing their Discord bot user id and application id to /attach, which mints an invite URL and an admit ticket; a "Steward" auto-admits the bot. The card itself says it is not an A2A messaging endpoint and that agents cannot buy, pay, list or ship inside the mesh. No OpenAPI, MCP server, SDK, pricing, terms or legal entity is published.

providers.name: Yum China
providers.description: Yum China Holdings is the largest restaurant company in China by system sales, operating KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, Lavazza, Little Sheep, and Huang Ji Huang restaurants. As the exclusive licensee of Yum! Brands in mainland China, Yum China serves over 16,000 restaurants across China and operates Super App platforms with over 590 million loyalty members.

providers.name: Actym Therapeutics
providers.description: Actym Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing bacterial immunotherapies for solid tumors and fibrotic disease. Its STACT platform engineers an attenuated Salmonella typhimurium vehicle to be administered systemically and to deliver multiple therapeutic payloads that are amplified and produced locally at the disease site, with the goal of raising efficacy while limiting systemic toxicity. Its lead asset, ACTM-838, is in a Phase 1a/1b trial in patients with advanced solid tumors. Actym publishes no developer program, no API and no machine-readable contract; the only agent-facing surfaces on its own domain are a platform-generated llms.txt and an anonymous Wix Site MCP endpoint.

providers.name: Aibooma
providers.description: AI BOOMA – Where AI assistants find trusted help. Aibooma provides a marketplace where AI assistants can discover and connect with human‑backed agents to get reliable answers, referrals, and structured conversations. The platform verifies owners, measures performance, and ensures trust through email and domain verification. Assistants can add Aibooma via a simple MCP or API configuration, ask for help, and receive vetted results without browsing the open web.

providers.name: Alterna Savings
providers.description: Alterna Savings and Credit Union Limited is a member-owned financial cooperative (credit union) founded in 1908 as the Civil Service Savings and Loan Society, headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario and regulated provincially by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRAO). It is one of Ontario's largest credit unions, serving roughly 217,000 members with about C$10.8 billion in assets across branches in Ontario, and operates the federally regulated direct-banking subsidiary Alterna Bank, one of Canada's earliest digital-first banks. Alterna offers personal and business banking, mortgages, lending, investments and insurance. Consistent with Canada's voluntary, not-yet-operational Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in Budget 2024 / Fall Economic Statement 2024 with the FCAC as overseer), Alterna Savings exposes NO public first-party developer portal or documented API. Digital access is delivered through its online and mobile banking apps and the Interac e-Transfer consumer rail; any third-party data access today is aggregator/screen-scraping based rather than a first-party API. This is an identity-only record with an honest no-public-API posture.

providers.name: Amp
providers.description: AMP is a universal collateral token designed to facilitate fast and efficient transfers for any real-world application. It enables instant payments worldwide, guarantees value transfers, and offers a tokenized collateral solution for finance and blockchain use cases.

providers.name: Asset Reality
providers.description: Asset Reality builds end-to-end software infrastructure for the seizure, management, custody, and disposal of both physical and virtual (crypto) assets, purpose-built for law enforcement, defense, and government agencies. Its platform unifies the asset-recovery lifecycle across four solutions — SEIZE, MANAGE, DEPLOY, and ESCROW — replacing clipboard-and-spreadsheet legacy processes with a single system that preserves asset value through investigation, confiscation, forfeiture, and reallocation to public purposes. The company is FCA-authorized to offer crypto custody in the UK, integrates with providers such as Fireblocks and Taxbit, and runs an Academy offering virtual-asset seizure certifications.

providers.name: Axiom Cloud
providers.description: Axiom Cloud provides AI-driven cloud infrastructure services, enabling enterprises to deploy, manage, and scale applications with advanced automation, security, and performance optimization. The platform offers a suite of tools for data processing, machine learning workloads, and real-time analytics, backed by robust compliance and governance frameworks. Founded with a focus on simplifying cloud operations, Axiom Cloud integrates seamlessly with existing DevOps pipelines and supports multi-cloud strategies, delivering cost-effective, reliable, and secure solutions for modern digital enterprises.

providers.name: Balancer
providers.description: Balancer is a DeFi AMM and programmable liquidity platform supporting weighted, stable, and custom pools (v2 and v3). Balancer publishes a public GraphQL API at api-v3.balancer.fi for pool, swap, and analytics data, plus per-chain subgraph endpoints. Smart-contract entry points (Vault and Router) are the primary write surface; SDKs wrap the SOR (Smart Order Router) for client-side route construction.

providers.name: Bluecoat (Symantec)
providers.description: Blue Coat Systems was a web-security and network-forensics vendor best known for its ProxySG secure web gateway appliances, SSL Visibility, WebPulse/Global Intelligence Network threat intelligence, and cloud web security (the Web Security Service). Bain Capital led a consortium that took Blue Coat private in 2015; Symantec acquired the company in 2016, and Broadcom acquired Symantec's enterprise security business in 2019. Blue Coat's technology now ships inside Broadcom's Symantec Enterprise Cloud portfolio as Cloud Secure Web Gateway (Cloud SWG), Secure Web Gateway (ProxySG/ASG), SSL Visibility, CASB (CloudSOC), and DLP. Product documentation and REST APIs are published on the Broadcom TechDocs portal.

providers.name: CARV
providers.description: Carv provides an agentic AI platform for volume hiring, automating recruiting tasks such as candidate screening, scheduling, onboarding, and compliance. By deploying AI-driven agents, enterprises can reduce time-to-hire by up to 60%, cut admin costs, and scale hiring without adding headcount. The platform integrates with ATS and HR systems, offering a customizable library of agents for various recruitment workflows.

providers.name: Center for Parent Information and Resources
providers.description: The Center for Parent Information and Resources (CPIR) is the federally funded central hub of information and products for the national network of Parent Training and Information Centers (PTIs) and Community Parent Resource Centers (CPRCs). An OSEP-funded project operated by the SPAN Parent Advocacy Network, CPIR supports families and youth with a focus on children with disabilities, delivering resources through the Parent Center Hub website, the Buzz from the Hub newsletter, webinars, glossaries and an events calendar. CPIR runs no developer program and publishes no API documentation, but its own host serves a real anonymous read-only JSON API: the WordPress REST API at parentcenterhub.org/wp-json exposed 34 namespaces and 717 routes on 2026-09-05, including the Connections directory namespace cn-api/v1 that carries the national Parent Center directory (784+ geocoded centers across 55 state and territory terms), plus ISO 3166-1 country reference data, US state geography and GeoJSON, an oEmbed 1.0 provider endpoint, and schema.org structured data. The WordPress content collections (posts, pages, media, users, search) are closed to anonymous callers and return 401 rest_forbidden; article content is available through the site RSS feed.

providers.name: Cogent
providers.description: Cogent Security is an AI-driven vulnerability management platform whose AI agents discover, assess, remediate, and report on software vulnerabilities at machine speed, before attackers can exploit them. The platform spans the CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management) lifecycle: Discover identifies vulnerable software quickly after disclosures, Assess risk-scores and prioritizes remediation, Remediate applies automated and assisted fixes, and Report produces evidence-backed documentation of risk reduction. It is powered by the Cogent AI Engine and Cogent Research with published safety guardrails and defined autonomy levels. Cogent is a venture-backed security company (Bain Capital Ventures, Greylock). Cogent publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its public web, security, and trust surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Compyl
providers.description: Compyl is an AI‑powered Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) platform that maps a single control library to over 70 frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR and NIST. It provides automated evidence collection, risk management, policy and contract management, and a trust‑center, enabling organizations to stay audit‑ready year‑round with integrated AI assistance.

providers.name: Congressional Budget Office
providers.description: The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) is the U.S. legislative branch agency that provides nonpartisan analyses of budgetary and economic issues to Congress. CBO publishes the Budget and Economic Outlook, projections of spending, revenues, deficits, and debt, cost estimates of legislation, and analytical reports. CBO data is distributed primarily as Excel and PDF files on cbo.gov; CBO does not currently publish a programmatic JSON API, but RSS feeds and downloadable structured workbooks make it possible to ingest CBO data into automated pipelines.

providers.name: Cullen/Frost Bankers
providers.description: Cullen/Frost Bankers, Inc. (NYSE: CFR) is a San Antonio, Texas bank holding company and the parent of Frost Bank, a Texas-chartered regional bank operating roughly 200 financial centers across the state. Frost serves consumer, commercial and private banking customers with deposit accounts, lending, treasury management, capital markets, insurance and investment services. As of September 2026 Frost publishes no public developer API program: there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no SDK on any first-party host. Corporate integration happens through the Frost Connect and Frost Treasury Connect commercial online banking portals under a customer agreement, and consumer account data sharing is delegated to Plaid's Plaid Exchange open-finance platform rather than to a Frost-published contract. This profile records that absence with probe evidence.

providers.name: Darwinbox
providers.description: Darwinbox is a cloud-based HRMS platform offering a REST API for managing employee records, recruitment, performance, payroll, attendance, travel, and workforce analytics in enterprise organizations. The API supports programmatic access to data stored in Darwinbox instances and enables importing data into the platform. Access is provided on a request-only basis to privileged users and supports token-based authentication using SHA512 hashing.

providers.name: Dave
providers.description: Dave is a U.S. consumer financial-technology company (Nasdaq: DAVE), founded in 2016 and headquartered in Los Angeles, that operates a mobile banking app serving roughly 14 million members. Its products include ExtraCash short-term cash advances of up to $500 (underwritten with its CashAI cash-flow model rather than credit scores), an FDIC-insured Dave Checking account with early direct deposit and Round-Up savings, and a Goals savings account. Banking services are provided through partner banks such as Coastal Community Bank. Dave is a consumer app and does not publish a first-party public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal: there is no developer.dave.com / docs.dave.com, and api.dave.com is the app's private, undocumented mobile backend. Programmatic access to Dave-held consumer data is aggregator-mediated — Dave both consumes Plaid (to let members link external accounts) and is reachable as a supported institution through open-finance aggregators. This profile captures its public identity, aggregator-only open-finance posture, commercial link surface, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: DonorPerfect
providers.description: DonorPerfect provides fundraising software and a public XML API for nonprofit donor management. The platform offers tools for donation forms, event management, donor CRM, marketing, analytics, and integrations, helping organizations streamline fundraising operations and improve donor engagement.

providers.name: Emby
providers.description: Emby provides a media server platform that allows users to organize, stream, and share personal video, music, and photo collections across a wide range of devices. It offers a customizable interface, supports live TV and DVR functionality, and integrates with various third‑party services. Emby is available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and NAS devices, with client apps for mobile, smart TVs, and streaming devices.

providers.name: Emirates SkyCargo
providers.description: Emirates SkyCargo is the air cargo division of Emirates Airline, headquartered at Dubai International Airport in the United Arab Emirates, moving general freight, pharmaceuticals, perishables, live animals, valuables, mail and courier traffic across a network of more than 140 destinations on six continents using both freighters and passenger-aircraft bellyhold capacity. In the shipment chain it is the airborne carrier leg sitting between the freight forwarder and the ground handler, and it books almost exclusively through intermediaries rather than shippers directly. Its API posture is advertised but not published: Emirates SkyCargo states on its own Digital Booking Channels page that it offers "a direct API connection to your in-house system" covering booking creation, amendments, cancellations and track and trace, yet there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document, no base URL and no self-serve signup anywhere on skycargo.com. Access is obtained only by emailing SkyCargoAPISupport@emirates.com to negotiate a host-to-host connection, by integrating through the CargoWise transport management system, by submitting Freight Forwarding Requests over EDI, or by booking through the WebCargo, CargoAi, Pelicargo and cargo.one marketplaces, which themselves require IATA/CASS accreditation. The one standard the organization documents on its own surface is IATA e-AWB: agents must sign the IATA Multilateral e-AWB Agreement before submitting FWB and FHL cargo messages over EDI messaging. This is an EDI-and-bilateral-integration carrier with a customer-contract portal veneer, not a public API provider.

providers.name: Every
providers.description: Every is an AI-native, all-in-one back-office and finance platform built for startups, unifying incorporation, business banking and cards, treasury and cash management, global payroll, HR and benefits, AI-assisted bookkeeping, and startup tax preparation (including R&D tax credits) into a single system. It offers free Delaware C-corp formation, business checking with cashback debit cards, treasury-bill and money-market investing, and bundled per-stage plans for new founders through established startups. Backed by Redpoint Ventures. Every does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, commercial, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Fivestars
providers.description: Fivestars was a customer loyalty, rewards, and payments platform for small and mid-sized brick-and-mortar merchants, founded in 2010 and headquartered in San Francisco. It combined an automated marketing engine, a customer loyalty and rewards program, and integrated card payments so local businesses could turn one-time shoppers into repeat customers. Fivestars was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, and Y Combinator. The company was acquired by SumUp in 2021 and its product has since been folded into SumUp Connect (SumUp Loyalty); fivestars.com now redirects to SumUp's loyalty program. Fivestars publishes no public API, no developer portal and no machine-readable contract — api.fivestars.com resolves but returns 404 on every spec and well-known path, and developers.fivestars.com does not resolve. Fivestars-branded surfaces that remain live include the marketing site, merchant dashboard, help center and a public status page, plus one first-party iOS library (TapiSDK) for legacy cPay terminal integrators. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical company record.

providers.name: Gem
providers.description: Gem is an AI-first recruiting platform that bundles a next-generation ATS, recruiting CRM, AI outbound sourcing, scheduling, talent marketing, application review, and talent rediscovery into a single agentic AI hiring system used by more than 1,200 talent acquisition teams. Gem ships a Chrome extension for sourcing, a public REST API (v0) documented at api.gem.com/v0/reference, an integrations marketplace at integrations.gem.com/gem covering ATS, HRIS, scheduling, assessments, background checks, and job distribution, plus a status page and academy.

providers.name: Git AI
providers.description: Git AI provides AI-powered tools that integrate directly with Git repositories to automate code review, generate documentation, and suggest improvements.
