By leveraging large language models, Git AI helps developers write higher-quality code faster, offering features such as automated pull‑request comments, commit message generation, and repository insights. The platform is designed for seamless integration into existing CI/CD pipelines and supports multiple Git hosting services, aiming to enhance developer productivity and code quality across teams.

providers.name: Grype
providers.description: Grype is an open source vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems developed by Anchore. It works with Syft-generated SBOMs and supports major OS package ecosystems and language-specific packages including Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Ruby, Rust, and .NET.

providers.name: Immigram
providers.description: Immigram is a UK relocation and immigration platform that helps IT specialists, engineers, founders, and entrepreneurs move to the United Kingdom, primarily via the Global Talent Visa (Tech Nation endorsement route) as well as Skilled Worker, settlement (ILR/naturalization), family, US O-1, and Spanish Startup visa paths. The company pairs immigration legal expertise with an AI-assisted platform that scores eligibility in advance, collects and reviews applicant data into a case, and tracks the process through a live dashboard with data-driven guidance and support. Founded in 2019 and backed by the 500 Global accelerator, Immigram is a services/SaaS provider and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Inkling
providers.description: Inkling is a frontline employee training and enablement platform (now part of Echo360) that delivers mission-critical knowledge, learning pathways, and operational workflows to essential workers across retail, hospitality, healthcare, and manufacturing. Its products include the Habitat content authoring tool, mobile Knowledge & Training modules, InkForms operational checklists, certification pathways, reporting and analytics, and LMS/LXP integrations. Inkling publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through LMS/LXP connectors and professional services. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Sapphire Ventures portfolio company and enriched with the provider's public identity, security posture, and site properties.

providers.name: IXL Learning
providers.description: IXL Learning is a K-12 personalized practice platform with 17,000+ skills across Math, Language Arts, Science, Social Studies, and Spanish, plus the IXL Real-Time Diagnostic and skill recommendations. IXL is sold primarily as a SaaS subscription to families, teachers, schools, and districts. Its integration surface is school-rostering and SSO, not a public developer API: IXL supports Clever (SSO + rostering), ClassLink (SSO + OneRoster auto-rostering), OneRoster CSV/REST, LTI, Google Classroom, and SAML SSO for district deployments. There is no public REST API portal, no published OpenAPI, and no partner developer program.

providers.name: Jinx
providers.description: Jinx is a direct-to-consumer pet nutrition brand selling premium dog and cat food, toppers, and treats at thinkjinx.com. Its product lines span dry kibble, wet food (pate, stews, homestyle), fresh refrigerated meals, jerky and training treats, and meal toppers, formulated with high-quality proteins, probiotics, and superfoods. Backed by Initialized Capital, Jinx sells online and through retail partners. The storefront runs on Shopify; it exposes no first-party public developer API, but the store's Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth discovery is served live from the domain and is captured in this profile.

providers.name: Kartos Therapeutics
providers.description: Kartos Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at 275 Shoreline Drive, Redwood City, California, developing navtemadlin (KRT-232), an orally administered, potent and selective small-molecule inhibitor of MDM2. The company was founded in 2016 by Wayne Rothbaum, president of Quogue Capital and co-founder of Acerta Pharma, around an MDM2 inhibitor in-licensed from Amgen. Navtemadlin blocks the MDM2 protein that suppresses p53, restoring p53 function in tumours that retain wild-type TP53 and driving cell-cycle arrest through p21 and apoptosis through pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins. The clinical programme is centred on myelofibrosis and includes the enrolling global Phase 3 POIESIS trial of navtemadlin added to ruxolitinib (NCT06479135), the Phase 1b/2 KRT-232-109 combination study (NCT04485260), and the completed Phase 3 BOREAS study of navtemadlin versus best available therapy in JAK-inhibitor relapsed or refractory myelofibrosis (NCT03662126), with reported activity also in acute myeloid leukaemia and Merkel cell carcinoma. Kartos is led by CEO Jesse McGreivy, MD, with Srdan Verstovsek, MD, PhD as chief medical officer, and is backed by Quogue Capital, OrbiMed Advisors, Amgen, SR One, Fidelity, BlackRock, T. Rowe Price, Invus and Soleus Capital. Kartos Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, no developer portal and no API documentation; the only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind kartosthera.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: KSQ Therapeutics
providers.description: KSQ Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 4 Maguire Road in Lexington, Massachusetts, founded in 2015 by pioneers of CRISPR screening and functional genomics. Its proprietary CRISPRomics platform runs genome-scale CRISPR/Cas9 functional genomic screens across cancer models and immune cell types to identify therapeutic targets that directly correlate genomic function to disease. The company applies those targets in two directions: CRISPR/Cas9-engineered tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (eTIL) cell therapies, where a single gene is inactivated to increase the tumor-killing capacity of a patient's own T cells — KSQ-001EX (SOCS1 inactivated) and KSQ-004EX (SOCS1 and Regnase-1 inactivated) — and small molecules such as KSQ-4279, a first-in-class USP1 inhibitor for advanced solid tumors. KSQ has run broad discovery collaborations with Takeda, licensed cell-therapy technology with CRISPR Therapeutics, partnered manufacturing with CTMC, and sold multiple research-stage oncology programs to Ono Pharmaceutical. Investors include Flagship Pioneering, ARCH Venture Partners, Polaris Partners, Alexandria, Alpha Wave Global, Baillie Gifford, Invus, LG and Lilly Asia Ventures. KSQ Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, OpenAPI or API reference. The only machine-readable surfaces reachable without credentials are the WordPress REST content API behind ksqtx.com, an All in One SEO generated /llms.txt, and the open-source bioinformatics code in its public GitHub organization — all catalogued here.

providers.name: MaiCall
providers.description: MaiCall is an AI-powered debt collection platform for non-bank lenders, microfinance companies, and collection agencies. Its self-learning voice agents place outbound collection calls, negotiate payment plans, and follow up across WhatsApp, SMS, and email in 30+ languages and native accents, capturing promises to pay and tracking recovery, contact, and cost metrics in real time. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. MaiCall advertises custom API integrations to loan-management systems, CRMs, SIP trunks, and payment gateways on request, but publishes no self-serve public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition at this time.

providers.name: Manticore Games
providers.description: Manticore Games is a San Mateo-based game developer and publisher, and the studio behind Core — a free, Unreal Engine-powered game-creation platform and metaverse where a global community of creators builds, publishes, and plays multiplayer games and experiences. Core exposes a rich Lua scripting API (namespaces, types, and events for Players, Weapons, Abilities, Storage, Leaderboards, Chat, UI, and World) that lets creators program game logic directly in the editor. Manticore is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Mar Egeu
providers.description: Mar Egeu is a family‑owned Brazilian swimwear manufacturer founded in 1971 in São Paulo. They design, develop and produce high‑quality swimwear for brands worldwide, offering custom designs, premium fabrics, and international shipping to over 100 countries. Their website showcases collections, pricing, and a full guide for partners looking to launch their own swimwear line.

providers.name: mcpgatepro-com
providers.description: MCPGatePro provides hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that integrate with Claude Desktop and Claude Code, enabling users to quickly connect AI tools for cloud cost analysis, PostgreSQL performance auditing, and other infrastructure insights. The platform offers a simple three-step setup: subscribe for an API key, add the provided configuration to Claude, and start querying AI for actionable recommendations on AWS spending, database optimization, and more. With plans starting at 79 zł per month, MCPGatePro targets teams seeking hassle‑free AI‑driven operations without self‑hosting or complex infrastructure.

providers.name: Pangea
providers.description: Pangea provides a powerful financial risk management platform built by treasury and trading veterans to reduce FX volatility, improve transparency, and lower total cost of ownership. Their AI‑powered foreign exchange hedging solutions help enterprises mitigate currency risk, automate hedging strategies, and gain real‑time insights across global markets.

providers.name: Periphery
providers.description: Periphery is a cybersecurity company providing embedded, device-level threat management for critical industrial and defence platforms. Its lightweight, architecture-agnostic agent secures, fingerprints, and continuously monitors devices, detecting unauthorized changes and hardening what is risky even in constrained, offline, or air-gapped environments. The platform spans three products: Insights (point-in-time security evaluation with agent-based pen-testing and SBOM risk analysis), Vantage (on-prem intelligence that establishes a known-good baseline, detects change, and restores devices), and Outpost (real-time on-device threat detection and prevention for air-gapped deployments). Periphery targets regulatory compliance across NDAA, EU CRA, NIS2, UN R155, UN R156, and IEC 62443. It is a Techstars portfolio company.

providers.name: PickTrace
providers.description: PickTrace is an agricultural workforce and harvest management SaaS platform for large-scale farms, founded by brothers Austin and Harrison Steed and a Y Combinator (Summer 2015) alumnus headquartered in Glendale, California. The platform captures time-and-attendance, piecework, productivity, onboarding, payroll, and receiving data in the field, office, and packinghouse, giving growers real-time visibility across their entire workforce year-round. It is used daily by tens of thousands of farm workers at some of the largest berry, citrus, and apple growers in the United States, Mexico, Peru, Chile, and Australia. PickTrace exposes a RESTful API that lets customers and third-party developers create, update, and extract objects from all PickTrace tools and bi-directionally sync labor data into and out of the platform for automation, payroll efficiency, and audit-ready compliance.

providers.name: Precium
providers.description: Precium is a South African fintech that provides local payment infrastructure for global merchants expanding into Africa. Its enterprise-grade platform handles payment processing across cards, instant EFT, mobile wallets and debit orders, plus intelligent smart routing, network tokenization, automated reconciliation, cross-border settlement, and payment recovery through retries and mandates. Precium exposes a public API and a mandates API (per its status dashboard) and integrates via server-to-server, redirect, and orchestrator paths with webhook status updates, though it does not publish a public API reference or OpenAPI. Backed by Partech, QED Investors, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: ProcessBolt
providers.description: ProcessBolt, now operating as Perimeter, provides a painless Vendor Risk Management (VRM) platform for regulated industries. The solution offers continuous monitoring, automated assessments, AI‑powered document extraction, and real‑time risk scoring to help organizations reduce manual effort, improve vendor oversight, and meet compliance requirements. Backed by Techstars, Perimeter serves healthcare, finance, and enterprise customers with a cloud‑native, scalable service.

providers.name: Publish.fun
providers.description: Publish.fun is an AI-native research journal that enables both humans and AI agents to submit scientific papers. Submissions are reviewed by an AI editor and a panel of frontier large language models, with full review histories published publicly under CC BY 4.0. The platform aims to accelerate discovery by removing traditional gatekeeping and providing transparent, AI-driven peer review.

providers.name: Quantexa
providers.description: Quantexa provides decision intelligence solutions using entity resolution and network analytics to help organizations connect disparate data and make better decisions across financial crime, risk, customer intelligence, and public sector use cases.

providers.name: Retrocausal
providers.description: Retrocausal builds AI-powered copilot software for manufacturing operations, applying patented computer vision and machine learning to manual assembly lines. Its products include Assembly Copilot (real-time AI-tracked work instructions, poka-yoke error prevention, and cycle-level video traceability), Kaizen Copilot (AI-powered time studies, standard work, automatic line balancing, and ergonomic analysis for industrial engineers), and Ergo Copilot (ergonomic risk assessment from smartphone video). The platform runs on AWS, is ISO 27001 certified, and integrates with MES systems, OPC UA for PLCs and smart tools, barcode scanners, torque wrenches, light towers, and projectors, with SSO via Azure Active Directory and Okta. Retrocausal is a Techstars portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API; integrations are delivered as custom MES/OPC UA and identity connections rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Risotto
providers.description: Risotto is an AI help desk platform that automates internal support tickets, knowledge requests, access management, and troubleshooting with context‑aware AI. It integrates with Slack, Jira, Zendesk, Notion, Confluence and more, offering cross‑department functionality and IAM automations for IT teams.

providers.name: Roborock
providers.description: Roborock is a global consumer robotics company best known for its robot vacuum and mop cleaners, wet/dry wash-and-fill floor washers, and connected home-cleaning appliances controlled through the Roborock mobile app. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Beijing, the company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Roborock operates a private cloud that backs its consumer mobile app but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program. It does operate a public Trust Center documenting the security and privacy design of its IoT products, including TÜV Rheinland EN 303 645 and UL Diamond IoT Security certifications.

providers.name: Roofr
providers.description: Roofr is an all-in-one roofing software and CRM built for roofing contractors, bundling aerial roof measurement reports, an instant online estimator, digital proposals with e-signature, integrated payments, material ordering, a job calendar, and pipeline/CRM tooling into one platform to help roofers win, run, and close jobs. Roofr does not publish a public developer API or self-serve documentation: the only API key it issues (under Settings and Integrations) exists to connect Roofr to Zapier, and any broader programmatic access is sales-gated behind a demo. Automation for external systems is delivered primarily through Zapier triggers (new Instant Estimator lead, proposal signed, proposal marked lost) rather than a documented REST API. Roofr is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital.

providers.name: Scytale
providers.description: Scytale is an AI-powered Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform that automates security compliance for cloud and SaaS companies. It combines AI agents with in-house compliance experts to automate evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, cross-framework control mapping, and audit-readiness across 80+ frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, SOX ITGC, C5, and CMMC. The platform connects to cloud providers, LLMs, HRIS, and security tooling, and offers a customizable customer-facing Trust Center plus integrated penetration testing. Scytale is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Shell Scripting
providers.description: A collection of APIs and resources for Shell Scripting development, including utilities, documentation, and tools.

providers.name: shippingrates-org
providers.description: ShippingRates provides a freight rate API, quote builder, and shipping intelligence platform. It offers tools for calculating shipping costs, historical carrier rates, detention, local charges, and demurrage. The service includes a public API for freight data, rate comparisons, and landed cost calculations, targeting logistics agents and developers seeking shipping rate automation.

providers.name: SiFi
providers.description: SiFi (الحلول المبسطة المالية) is a Saudi Arabian fintech company offering a comprehensive corporate spend-management platform for businesses in the Kingdom. Licensed by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and serving more than 5,000 clients, SiFi provides physical and virtual corporate cards with spending controls, real-time expense tracking, employee reimbursements, accounting automation, local vendor payments and international transfers (coming soon), and a cashback rewards program, delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. SiFi is backed by QED Investors. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Spark Shipping
providers.description: Spark Shipping provides an eCommerce dropshipping automation platform that enables merchants to import products with one click, synchronize inventory and pricing across multiple vendors, generate AI-powered product descriptions, and automate order routing and tracking updates. Their SaaS solution integrates with major marketplaces and shopping carts, offering tools for inventory management, price automation, and vendor integrations to streamline online retail operations.

providers.name: Strikingly
providers.description: Strikingly is a mobile-first website builder platform that enables users to create gorgeous, mobile-optimized websites without coding. The platform provides tools for managing site content, sections, blog posts, store products, form submissions, and membership settings through its web interface and internal REST APIs.

providers.name: subdomain-app
providers.description: Subdomain API provides a free, no‑signup JSON API that returns the subdomains associated with any given domain. Leveraging one of the largest publicly available subdomain indexes, the service enables developers and security researchers to automate discovery, enrich threat intelligence, and integrate subdomain enumeration into CI/CD pipelines. The API is publicly accessible via HTTPS GET requests and returns results in a simple JSON array, making it easy to consume in scripts and applications.

providers.name: SyncSpider
providers.description: SyncSpider provides eCommerce automation and integration tools for online shops, multivendor marketplaces, and brick‑and‑mortar stores. It enables businesses to sync inventory, orders, and product data across platforms, offering a universal API layer that simplifies complex integrations and streamlines operations for retailers and partners.

providers.name: TicketRev
providers.description: TicketRev (TICKR Holdings, Inc.) is a buyer-first ticketing platform for live sports and entertainment, founded in 2022. Its marketplace lets fans name their own price on tickets while giving teams and venues offer-based selling, flow purchasing, seat upgrades, and premium-inventory tools. Products span four solutions - Core (offer-based purchases), Breeze (flow purchasing), Upgrades (in-seat upgrades), and Premium (premium seating revenue) - and are used by MLB clubs including the Houston Astros, Miami Marlins, and Tampa Bay Rays. TicketRev is backed by Soma Capital, Groove Capital, 500 Global, and Techstars. The company publicly commits to SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS security and compliance. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: TNL Mediagene
providers.description: TNL Mediagene is a next-generation digital and technology media group serving millennial and Gen Z audiences across Asia. Formed from the 2023 merger of Taiwan's The News Lens and Japan's Mediagene, the group operates more than twenty media brands spanning news, business, technology, lifestyle, and sports — including The News Lens, INSIDE, Cool3c, Gizmodo Japan, Business Insider Japan, Lifehacker Japan, Roomie, and licensed titles such as Digiday Japan and Glossy Japan. Beyond publishing, the company runs advertising and marketing technology (the Ad2iction DSP), an AI-driven customer data and audience analytics platform, e-commerce properties, and market-research services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is listed on Nasdaq as TNMG. The group publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI, and no SDK. Its one public, machine-readable integration surface is the Ad2iction header-bidding adapter shipped inside Prebid.js — a first-party-maintained open-source module that posts bid requests to https://ads.ad2iction.com/html/prebid/, documented on the Prebid.org bidder registry rather than on a TNL Mediagene developer site.

providers.name: TransferRoom
providers.description: TransferRoom is football's real-time transfer marketplace, connecting clubs, agents and players to buy, sell and loan players and to recruit head coaches. Its API delivers verified, real-time market intelligence — Expected Transfer Value (xTV) benchmarks, player availability and deal-viability signals, contract-expiry and estimated-salary data, agent and coach representation, and head-coach ratings — returned as JSON for clubs to integrate directly into their own systems (SQL databases, BI dashboards, spreadsheets and code notebooks). Trusted by 800+ clubs across 130 leagues and 500+ agencies, covering 130,000+ players and 7,000+ head coaches, and powering 7,500+ transfer deals. The API is sales-gated: technical reference (endpoints, authentication, base URL) is provided to clubs on engagement and is not published publicly.

providers.name: TrueNAS
providers.description: TrueNAS provides enterprise-grade, open-source storage solutions, offering both hardware appliances and software-defined storage platforms. Their product line includes the TrueNAS Enterprise series for mission-critical workloads, TrueNAS Community Edition for free use, and a range of scalable options like the F-Series and R-Series. The company focuses on data protection, high performance, and flexible deployment across on-premises, edge, and cloud environments, supporting a wide array of industries from media to healthcare.

providers.name: Unraid
providers.description: Unraid provides a flexible, easy-to-use operating system for self‑hosted servers, network‑attached storage, Docker containers and virtual machines. It enables users to combine drives of any size, run applications via Community Apps, and manage VMs, all through a web UI. The platform is supported by an active community, extensive documentation, and paid support options, making it suitable for hobbyists and professionals building homelab solutions.

providers.name: XAG
providers.description: XAG (Guangzhou, China) is an agricultural technology company building autonomous farming solutions: agricultural drones (P150 Max, P150, P100 Pro, P60), R100/R200 agricultural ground rovers, the APC2 AutoPilot console, and smart-farm IoT devices. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. XAG operates a Chinese-language developer Open Platform (open.xa.com) that integrates application management, device data authorization, secure data communication, and message subscription, providing APIs for second-party development on XAG products; public API documentation is still largely unpublished.

providers.name: Zot
providers.description: A decentralized communication protocol and platform for federated social networking, enabling secure and private content sharing across distributed servers.

providers.name: AdaptX
providers.description: AdaptX is a Seattle-based clinical performance management company (founded 2016 as MDMetrix, renamed AdaptX in 2021) whose self-serve platform reads a hospital's existing electronic medical record data and turns it into near-real-time analytics that clinical, quality, operational and finance leaders use to measure and reduce clinical variation. Customers include Seattle Children's, Memorial Hermann, Children's Minnesota, USA Health and Kittitas Valley Healthcare, with published case studies covering surgical capacity, emergency department time-to-triage, length of stay, anesthetic greenhouse-gas reduction and health-equity stratification. The product is delivered as a hosted SaaS application on AWS to contracted health systems; as of this profiling pass AdaptX publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: AIMECH.APP
providers.description: AIMECH.APP provides an AI-powered car diagnostics platform that helps users identify vehicle issues through text, photo, or sound inputs. The service offers a free diagnosis with limited queries and paid plans for deeper analysis, including suggested parts and repair cost estimates. It aims to simplify automotive troubleshooting for both DIY owners and professionals, integrating AI insights with real-world repair data.

providers.name: Aledade
providers.description: Aledade is a physician-led public benefit corporation and national leader in value-based care, partnering with independent primary care practices, community health centers, and health systems. It pairs data analytics, guided clinical workflows, integrated care solutions, and payer contracts to help primary care organizations succeed in accountable care organizations (ACOs) and value-based payment models, improving patient outcomes while supporting the business sustainability of independent practices. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of gv, ivp, and lightspeed-venture-partners.

providers.name: Arc
providers.description: Arc (arc.dev, formerly CodementorX, and sister to the Codementor mentorship marketplace) is a remote talent marketplace that connects companies with vetted freelance and full-time software developers, designers, marketers, and product managers across 190 countries. Arc screens applicants down to roughly the top 2%, and partners with Deel and Remote for cross-border payroll and compliance. Arc operates as a hiring platform and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface.

providers.name: ArtifactDeploy
providers.description: ArtifactDeploy is a platform that enables Claude AI users to instantly publish generated artifacts—such as web pages, dashboards, slide decks, markdown docs, and full‑site prototypes—to permanent, shareable URLs. It provides rich link previews on WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and other social channels, personal link analytics showing who opened each link and when, and a suite of templates and tools for freelancers, creators, small businesses, and teams. The service offers a free tier with no credit‑card required and paid plans with higher limits, custom domain support, and team collaboration features.

providers.name: AuditFile
providers.description: AuditFile provides secure, cloud‑based audit software for CPA firms, combining AI‑enabled workflows, risk assessment, workpapers, reporting, and client portal features. Founded in 2011, AuditFile pioneered cloud audit and continues to innovate with patented AI tools, offering integrations with popular accounting platforms and a suite of products for modern audit practices.

providers.name: BBC
providers.description: The British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) is the United Kingdom’s public service broadcaster, providing news, television, radio, and online content worldwide. It operates a vast digital platform, offers a range of APIs for developers, and maintains extensive documentation for its services, including news feeds, media assets, and data services. The BBC is a trusted source of information and cultural programming, serving millions of users across the globe.

providers.name: Big Red Cloud
providers.description: Big Red Cloud provides AI-powered accounting and payroll software, with Turbo Inventory for inventory management and business operations across Ireland and the UK. Their solutions help growing businesses manage finances, people, stock, purchasing, sales and service, delivering an integrated platform for efficient financial and operational management.

providers.name: Bikemap
providers.description: Bikemap is a Vienna-based cycling platform (backed by Speedinvest) offering a route planner, turn-by-turn bike navigation, and one of the world's largest communities of user-generated cycling routes across road, mountain, gravel, and e-bike riding. Riders plan routes in a web and mobile route editor, discover millions of community routes, record and share rides, download offline maps, and sync with Garmin, Wahoo, Apple Watch, and Wear OS devices. Bikemap operates a consumer product surface (web, iOS, Android) and does not publish a documented public developer API; this profile captures its identity, published web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: BillionToOne
providers.description: BillionToOne is a molecular diagnostics company using proprietary single-molecule Quantitative Counting Template (QCT) technology to detect disease at the DNA level from cell-free DNA. Its Unity prenatal screening suite (Unity Complete, Unity Confirm, and Unity fetal antigen tests) delivers non-invasive prenatal testing from maternal blood at nine weeks, and its Northstar oncology line (Northstar Select and Northstar Response) provides liquid-biopsy therapy selection and real-time treatment-response monitoring. BillionToOne integrates with electronic medical records through a collaboration with Epic and delivers results through its provider and patient portals. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Norwest Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Bloomboard
providers.description: BloomBoard is a talent development provider for K‑12 school districts and higher‑education institutions. It offers turnkey programs that help educators advance through apprenticeship, certification, and degree pathways, addressing educator pipeline, advancement, and retention challenges. The platform connects districts with partner institutions to deliver on‑the‑job learning and professional growth solutions.

providers.name: Boatsetter
providers.description: Boatsetter is a Fort Lauderdale, Florida founded and Miami headquartered peer-to-peer boat rental marketplace that connects boat owners with renters and with United States Coast Guard licensed captains. Founded in 2012, the platform lists more than 50,000 boats across 600 to 700 locations worldwide and 20,000 makes and models, spanning fishing boats, pontoons, sailboats, party boats, watersports vessels and luxury yacht charters, bookable either bareboat or with a captain. Boatsetter layers identity verification, an insurance program underwritten through its Buoy partnership, payments, messaging, calendar and pricing tools for owners, and trust and safety on top of owner supplied inventory, and takes a marketplace commission on each booking. The company also operates a separate Boatsetter Owner application for hosts, and in December 2025 announced a merger with Getmyboat to form a combined boat rental marketplace expected to process roughly 500 million dollars in bookings across 50 countries, with both platforms and apps continuing to operate. Boatsetter does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, developer portal, or partner API documentation; its only public GitHub presence is a single archived fork of a jQuery form serialization plugin, and its third party surface is limited to consumer facing partnerships (Airbnb) and an affiliate marketing program.

providers.name: Bold
providers.description: Bold (Age Bold, Inc.) is an AI-enabled healthy-aging company founded in 2019 by Amanda Rees and Hari Arul that combines age-friendly virtual care with senior-focused exercise and nutrition programs for Medicare members. The platform delivers personalized at-home programs — live and on-demand classes, balance and fall-prevention regimens, pain and mobility programs, nutrition coaching, and telehealth visits with clinicians — to adults 65 and older, distributed through Medicare Advantage plans, provider groups, and the CMS ACCESS program rather than sold as a developer platform. Bold reports its balance programs lower fall risk and its pain programs reduce joint pain among participating members, and states its platform is HIPAA compliant and requires no lengthy IT integration for plan partners. The company has raised roughly $27M, with a $17M Series A led by Rethink Impact alongside Andreessen Horowitz Bio + Health, Khosla Ventures, Samsung Next, GingerBread Capital, and Primetime Partners. As of this enrichment pass Bold publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or partner API surface — integrations are handled through its partnerships team.

providers.name: BorrowMyDoggy
providers.description: BorrowMyDoggy is a UK-based platform that connects dog owners with trusted local borrowers for dog walking, sitting, boarding, and holiday care. Owners who cannot always be with their dog are matched with nearby dog lovers who want to spend time with a dog without the full-time commitment, so dogs get more walks, company, and care. Membership is free to join, with optional Premium tiers for owners and borrowers that unlock messaging, insurance cover, and a 24/7 vet line. The company operates a consumer web and mobile application built on Ruby on Rails; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from public web surfaces.

providers.name: BotSharper
providers.description: BotSharper provides a free web tool to test and tune Solana trading bots on real pump.fun data. Users can replay bot settings, check profitability, view token launch rankings, and access a Pro API for private connector integration. The service operates without requiring wallet connections, offering analytics, token checks, and multilingual support.

providers.name: Braincorporation
providers.description: Braincorp (formerly Braincorporation) develops AI‑driven autonomous robotics platforms for enterprises, enabling automated floor‑care, inventory scanning, and fleet management across retail, logistics, and industrial settings. Founded in 2009, the company offers the BrainOS® autonomy platform, ShelfOptix™ scanning‑as‑a‑service, and a suite of AI solutions that integrate with existing infrastructure to improve efficiency, safety, and operational insight.

providers.name: BreachLock
providers.description: BreachLock provides comprehensive attack surface discovery, penetration testing, and red‑team services. Their platform offers Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), continuous testing, breach‑response automation, and attack surface management solutions for enterprises seeking proactive security validation and risk reduction.

providers.name: Broadly
providers.description: Broadly provides an AI‑powered customer engagement platform for local service businesses. The platform combines tools for attracting customers, generating and managing online reviews, handling messaging across SMS, email, and social channels, and enabling self‑service appointment scheduling. It is designed for businesses such as HVAC, plumbing, dental, legal, and other service providers that rely on local search visibility and customer relationships.

providers.name: Buildvision
providers.description: BuildVision is an AI bid-management and equipment-procurement platform for the construction industry. It monitors email inboxes and construction plan rooms for incoming bids, extracts equipment specifications from construction documents, matches them against a company's line card, and drafts quotes with automatic conflict detection and RFI generation. Products span bid triage automation, a "spec memory" of historical engineer data, equipment quoting, and channel intelligence for OEMs. BuildVision integrates with Microsoft Outlook and BuildingConnected and offers direct API / browser-agent integration to selection software by request, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from BuildVision's public surface.

providers.name: casuyi-com
providers.description: Casuyi provides a suite of lightweight, privacy‑first mobile applications designed for everyday life, including protein tracking, QR discount code scanning, bill and payment management, price history lookup, package pickup coordination, AI‑generated complaint drafting, and subscription tracking. All apps operate offline, require no user account, and prioritize user privacy.

providers.name: Change.io
providers.description: Change offers a donations and compliance platform that enables businesses and legal teams to automate charitable giving, handle state filing requirements, and manage nonprofit verifications. The cloud‑based solution provides a Donations API, disbursement tools, and a dashboard for tracking contributions and legal documents. It serves companies, law firms, and charitable fundraising platforms that need to run compliant giving campaigns worldwide.

providers.name: Chasi
providers.description: Chasi (Chasi AI) is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company building an AI revenue engine for the equipment industry — sales, rental, and service. Chasi deploys AI agents that plug into an equipment dealer or rental company's existing stack and work around the clock to handle lead intake, quoting, CRM updates, follow-ups, and booking coordination, so teams respond faster, sell more, and maximize fleet utilization without adding headcount. Founded in 2025 by Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh, the company targets an industry where fleet utilization often sits below 60% and reps lose hours each day to email, voicemail, and manual data entry. Chasi ships a Clerk-authenticated tenant application at app.chasi.ai, a first-party iOS app, an interactive demo, a Rootly-hosted status page, and a trust center, and is live with equipment businesses in the US and Europe — but as of August 2026 it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP server, agent card, or SDK, and its go-to-market is sales-led through a booked demo and a 90-day pilot.

providers.name: Choco
providers.description: Choco is an AI-powered digital ordering platform that simplifies how restaurants order from their food suppliers and distributors. Serving tens of thousands of distributors and over one hundred thousand buyers across the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC, Choco lets restaurateurs place orders and chat with all their suppliers in one app while converting orders into a supplier's preferred format (email, WhatsApp, text, fax, or direct ERP integration). Choco connects to supplier ERP systems such as Entree, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Target Data System, NCR, Sage, and Odoo, and uses AI — including OrderAgent for multimodal order capture and VoiceAgent built on OpenAI's Realtime API — to turn emails, texts, images, and documents into structured, ERP-ready orders. Choco does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP connections, and its public GitHub organization (chocoapp) hosts only internal data-engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs or API specifications.

providers.name: Combyne
providers.description: Combyne is a complete grain accounting and marketing platform for farmers and their advisors. It simplifies tracking of sold positions, grain contracts, and brokerage trades while ensuring both parties work with unified, accurate data. This synergy allows for informed decisions, making crop marketing and risk management more efficient.

providers.name: ConnectRN
providers.description: connectRN is a Waltham, Massachusetts based per-diem (PRN) healthcare staffing marketplace that connects nurses, CNAs and allied clinicians with open shifts at hospitals, home health and hospice agencies, and skilled nursing facilities across the United States. Clinicians browse and claim shifts through the connectRN mobile app with no minimum commitment, no required weekends or holidays, and same-day pay; facilities post shifts, auto-backfill open coverage and approve timesheets through a web platform at app.connectrn.com. In April 2026 connectRN merged with SnapCare, combining connectRN's PRN clinician community with SnapCare's Booker workforce technology platform. connectRN operates a public status page but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its API host api.connectrn.com serves the first-party mobile and web applications only.

providers.name: Contendeo
providers.description: Contendeo provides AI-powered video comprehension for Claude, turning video URLs into structured context with transcript, vision, OCR, and chart extraction. It supports YouTube, Instagram, Vimeo, Twitter/X, TikTok, and direct MP4 URLs, offering tools like quick_transcribe, deep_analyze, clip_context, and batch_analyze with credit‑based pricing. Users connect via a custom Claude connector and benefit from free cache hits, auto‑refunds on failures, and scalable credit plans.

providers.name: CoStar Group
providers.description: CoStar Group is the dominant commercial and residential real estate data, analytics, and marketplace company. The portfolio spans the flagship CoStar commercial real estate intelligence platform, LoopNet (CRE marketplace), Apartments.com network (residential rentals, including ForRent.com and Westside Rentals), Homes.com and Homesnap (for-sale residential), Ten-X (online CRE auctions), BizBuySell (business-for-sale marketplace), STR (hotel data), Visual Lease (lease management), Matterport (3D spatial capture), and international properties including OnTheMarket (UK), Emporis (Germany), and a controlling stake in Domain Group (Australia). Distribution to partners is via enterprise data licensing, syndication feeds, and brand-specific marketplace tooling rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Crux
providers.description: Crux is a capital platform for the clean economy, connecting clean energy and manufacturing developers with buyers, lenders, and investors. Its marketplace facilitates the sale of transferable clean energy tax credits created under the Inflation Reduction Act, alongside debt capital markets, tax equity, and preferred equity solutions and advisory services. Crux pairs a transaction platform and secure data room with market intelligence drawn from tens of billions of dollars in deal data, serving project developers, manufacturers, tax credit buyers, banks, tax advisors, and legal teams. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Crux operates a customer application but does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Cubyn
providers.description: Cubyn is a Paris‑based logistics platform founded in 2014 that provides e‑commerce merchants with end‑to‑end fulfillment services, including parcel delivery, B2B shipments, freight, custom packaging, and reverse logistics. Their cloud‑based solution integrates with major marketplaces and shop platforms such as Shopify and Prestashop, offering real‑time inventory and order tracking. Cubyn ceased operations in 2024, but its former services aimed to give online retailers a high‑performance network for fast, cost‑effective deliveries worldwide.

providers.name: Cult.fit
providers.description: Cult.fit (Curefit / cure.fit, operated by Diverse Retails Private Limited) is an Indian health and fitness company offering a connected consumer experience across group fitness classes, gyms, at-home workouts, mental well-being and meditation, healthy food, and diagnostics. Its flagship products include CultPass gym and class memberships, sport and fitness centers, live and on-demand digital workouts, and the cult.fit and cure.fit mobile and web apps. Backed by Accel and other investors, the company operates a large consumer platform but does not publish a public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, corporate web properties, and engineering surface (the curefit GitHub organization and engineering blog).

providers.name: Datopian
providers.description: Datopian is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: El-Dokan
providers.description: El-Dokan (El Dokan Software) is a Cairo, Egypt-based enterprise eCommerce software company founded in 2019 that provides an API-first, headless and composable commerce platform for the MENA region. Its 300+ REST API endpoints and developer tools let brands and retailers make any digital experience shoppable across web, mobile apps, POS, and multi-vendor marketplaces, supporting B2C, D2C, B2B, and marketplace models with 100+ payment, shipping, SMS, and ERP integrations and MENA localization. Customers include Procter & Gamble, Misr Pharmacies, Mobily, Zahran, Switch Plus, and Appetito. El-Dokan raised a $550,000 pre-seed round in 2022 backed by Flat6Labs, EFG EV, 500 Global, and Hala Ventures. Public API documentation (data model, getting started, and API reference) is gated behind a get-access signup.

providers.name: Fiveable
providers.description: Fiveable is an Advanced Placement (AP) exam preparation platform covering all 38 AP subjects. It provides study guides, unit-organized subject review hubs, practice questions modeled on real AP exam formats, AI-scored free-response questions (FRQs), cheatsheets, key-term glossaries, and AP score calculators that predict likely exam outcomes. Fiveable serves three audiences - secondary students cramming and reviewing for AP exams, teachers seeking classroom and assessment materials, and schools needing district-wide exam-prep support. The platform blends traditional study resources with AI-powered scoring and feedback. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Fiveable publishes a consumer web application but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Game Theory
providers.description: Game Theory is a Bengaluru-based recreational sports and fitness membership platform operating 25+ centers across the city. Its consumer mobile app offers unlimited multi-sport coaching for kids and All Access adult memberships spanning 8+ sports — swimming, badminton, basketball, football, pickleball, squash, and table tennis — alongside pay-per-use slot booking, live game feeds, and corporate wellness programs. A Techstars-backed company, Game Theory publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record awaiting any future developer platform.

providers.name: Grow Therapy
providers.description: Grow Therapy is a mental-health platform that connects individuals with licensed therapists and prescribers, offering virtual and in-person talk therapy plus medication management in one insurance-integrated experience. The company operates a two-sided marketplace: a client-facing product for finding, booking, and paying for care (with insurance verification and an average session cost around $21 for covered clients) and a provider portal that gives clinicians scheduling, billing, telehealth, and practice-management tooling. Grow also partners with employers, physicians, and payors on B2B mental-health access. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Grow Therapy publishes a public Statuspage but does not expose a public developer API, so this profile captures its company identity, operational transparency, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hello Heart
providers.description: Hello Heart is a digital health company that combines a mobile app, connected blood-pressure monitors, a smart pill box, and the Nia AI assistant (trained on ACC/AHA guidelines) to help people proactively manage cardiovascular health. Sold primarily to employers, health plans, unions, and public-sector benefits programs as a covered heart-health benefit, the platform pairs self-monitoring with clinically-grounded, "safe AI" coaching to lower blood pressure and reduce cardiac risk. Hello Heart is HITRUST CSF certified, SOC 2 Type 2 audited, NIST CSF aligned, and HIPAA compliant, with data encrypted in transit and at rest and stored within U.S. borders. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public identity, security, and compliance posture.

providers.name: Integuru
providers.description: Integuru provides a platform that generates production‑ready APIs for websites and web systems without using browser automation or traditional RPA. Backed by Y Combinator, it powers over 10 million API calls monthly, offering fast, reliable, high‑throughput integrations across industries such as AI, healthcare, finance, logistics, and more. Users can start for free via a CLI or the web UI, and the service includes authentication support, auto‑healing, and 24/7 on‑call maintenance.

providers.name: Jify
providers.description: Jify is an India-based financial wellness platform (part of the Moneyview group) that partners with employers to give employees earned wage access: its On-Demand Salary lets workers draw already-earned pay before payday. Beyond earned wage access it offers salary advances, a rewards and discount marketplace, micro-savings, digital gold investing, credit-score tracking, smart tax tools, and a money manager for budgeting and expense tracking, delivered through Android and iOS apps. Jify is a consumer / B2B2C fintech app and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, domain-security posture, and published compliance claims (ISO 27001, CISA-certified, independently tested by Appknox).

providers.name: KakaoPay
providers.description: KakaoPay is a Korean mobile payment platform and fintech service by Kakao Corp providing REST APIs for payment processing, QR code payments, online checkout, subscription billing, money transfers, and financial product management. The platform enables merchants and developers to integrate KakaoPay's payment infrastructure via secure REST APIs authenticated with admin keys or bearer tokens.

providers.name: Keelvar
providers.description: Keelvar provides AI‑native agentic sourcing software that empowers procurement teams to automate and scale sourcing, rate management, and cost reduction. Their platform combines large‑language‑model driven assistants with integration to ERP systems, delivering intelligent recommendations, workflow automation, and analytics for industries such as manufacturing, retail, and pharmaceuticals.

providers.name: Kodo
providers.description: Kodo is a Customer Delight Platform that helps businesses engage with their customers through personalized experiences, feedback collection, and loyalty programs. The company provides a suite of APIs enabling integration of its services into existing applications, allowing developers to retrieve customer insights, manage campaigns, and automate interactions. Founded with a focus on delighting end‑users, Kodo aims to empower brands to build stronger relationships and drive growth through data‑driven engagement tools.

providers.name: Kusari
providers.description: Kusari provides software supply chain security solutions, offering a verified graph of every dependency shipped, built from source. Their platform enables reachability analysis, blast radius assessment, and automated fixes, integrating with existing CI pipelines and registries. Targeting complex stacks across financial services, insurance, and regulated SaaS, Kusari helps teams detect transitive CVEs, secrets, license issues, and end‑of‑life packages, delivering autonomous security reviews on pull requests.

providers.name: Lastro
providers.description: Lastro is a Brazilian proptech company building artificial intelligence for the real estate market. Its product, Lais (lais.ai), is a generative-AI platform for real estate agencies that engages and qualifies inbound leads over WhatsApp and other channels, then follows the customer journey from first contact through to a closed deal — covering property listing and management, marketing and lead generation, pre-qualification, visit scheduling, administrative service and strategic reporting. Human agents and the AI work the same queue inside Casa da Lais, the operator dashboard. Lastro reports more than 1,000 real estate agency customers, over 5 million people served and more than R$ 12 billion in sales volume (VGV) managed in Brazil. The company is backed by Prosus Ventures and QED Investors. Lastro publishes no public developer API; the only programmatic surface found is the Wix platform-provisioned site MCP endpoint on lastro.co.

providers.name: LevelTen Energy
providers.description: LevelTen Energy operates a two-sided digital marketplace and transaction platform for carbon-free energy, describing itself as the transaction infrastructure for the energy transition. Clean energy buyers, advisors, project developers, utilities and financiers use the LevelTen Energy Marketplace to compare thousands of power purchase agreement (PPA) offers, run NPV and settlement cashflow analysis, evaluate risk scenarios and track a Development Maturity Score across projects in North America and Europe. The platform also covers granular certificates, hybrid and storage PPAs, and performance monitoring, alongside market intelligence products including MarketPulse, the LevelTen PPA Price Index and Market Transparency Reports. The marketplace is served by an authenticated API at api.levelten.energy, which is gated behind marketplace login and publishes no public developer documentation, SDKs or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Listia
providers.description: Listia is a peer-to-peer marketplace where members give away and acquire secondhand goods using an internal virtual currency ("Points") rather than cash. Launched in 2009 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the service lets members list unwanted items in auction-style listings, earn Points when an item sells, and spend those Points to claim items from other members — a closed-loop credit-and-reputation economy layered on a classic online-auction flow. The site reports over 10 million members, operates iOS and Android apps alongside the web marketplace, and runs adjacent programs including Listia Rewards (redeeming Points for gift cards and retail goods) and Listia Assurance (buyer and seller protection). Listia publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, and no first-party SDKs on npm, PyPI, RubyGems or Packagist. The api.listia.com host serves the same Rails application as the website and acts as the private backend for the mobile apps, not a documented public API.

providers.name: LoopNet
providers.description: LoopNet is the leading commercial real estate marketplace, owned by CoStar Group, offering access to property listings, sale comparables, lease rates, market analytics, and CRE investment data. Brokers, owners, and investors use LoopNet to market and discover office, retail, industrial, multifamily, land, and hospitality properties across the US, Canada, and the UK. Integration is available via LoopLink for embedding property search on third-party websites, and data access for enterprise clients is arranged through CoStar Group agreements.

providers.name: M2P Fintech
providers.description: M2P Fintech is Asia's largest API infrastructure company, powering banking, lending, and payment solutions for fintechs, banks, NBFCs, and enterprises. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Chennai, India, M2P operates across 30+ countries and processes 20+ billion transactions for 50+ million end customers. Its modular, cloud-native, API-first product suite lets businesses embed financial services — core banking (Turing CBS), card issuance (credit, debit, prepaid, forex), UPI, cross-border payments, loan origination and management (Finflux), merchant management, BNPL, microfinance, KYC (Syntizen), reconciliation (Recon360), fraud and AML monitoring, 3DS access control, and neobanking — with up to 5X faster go-to-market.

providers.name: Mainspring Energy
providers.description: Mainspring Energy is a Menlo Park, California power-infrastructure company that designs, manufactures, and deploys the Linear Generator, a modular, fuel-flexible onsite power generation system. Its technology delivers firm, dispatchable, and low-emission electricity for data centers, utilities, and industrial and enterprise facilities, running today on natural gas and biogas with a seamless transition to zero-carbon fuels such as hydrogen and ammonia. Backed by Khosla Ventures and other investors, Mainspring has more than one gigawatt of Linear Generator capacity in late-stage development and operation. Mainspring is a hardware and power-systems company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Matic
providers.description: Matic is a digital insurance marketplace and independent insurance agency that lets consumers compare and buy home, auto, pet, umbrella, jewelry and other personal-lines insurance from a network of 60+ A-rated carriers in one place. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Matic is best known for its embedded-insurance model: it integrates insurance shopping into the digital experiences of mortgage lenders, servicers, banks and other financial-services partners so borrowers and account holders can obtain coverage at the point of need. Matic is a licensed agency operating in all 50 states and is backed by investors including Anthemis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; this enrichment pass confirms Matic operates as a consumer-facing insurance marketplace with a partner/embedded-insurance business but no publicly documented developer API surface.

providers.name: Morphologic AI Inc.
providers.description: Agentzia provides a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform that tests how AI agents like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok perceive and recommend products. Users can simulate AI interactions, generate sample reports, and receive actionable insights to improve website content for better AI-driven recommendations. The service includes a browser‑based MCP for secure credential‑free integration, various pricing plans, and extensive documentation covering methodology, data handling, and acceptable use.

providers.name: Mortgage Tools by Jenny
providers.description: Mortgage Tools by Jenny provides a set of Canadian mortgage calculation tools accessible via AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, as well as directly through its website. Users can compare renewal offers, model extra payments, evaluate break-or-stay scenarios, and explore debt consolidation options. The tools are free, require no account, and are intended for educational purposes only, offering illustrative calculations without financial advice or lender recommendations.

providers.name: Naluri
providers.description: Naluri is a digital health and corporate wellness platform operating across Southeast Asia. It delivers Employee Assistance Programmes, chronic disease management (mental health, obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and cholesterol), health coaching and consultations, performance workshops, and Mental Health First Aid training for employers, insurers, and individuals. The company reports serving over one million members and 200-plus companies, and states it is certified for HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO/IEC 27001. No public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: National Cheng Kung University
providers.description: National Cheng Kung University (NCKU, 國立成功大學) is a public research university in Tainan, Taiwan, founded in 1931 and the second-largest comprehensive university in the country. Its programmable footprint is narrow and almost entirely accounted for by one surface: the NCKU Open Data Platform at data.ncku.edu.tw, a CKAN 2.0 deployment NCKU runs on its own host and its own domain, carrying 108 datasets and two NCKU-authored CKAN extensions (nckumetadata, nckutemplatehelper), released under Taiwan's Open Government Data License v1. Its Action API answers anonymous callers with valid JSON and is the only endpoint in this profile that returns machine-readable institutional data without credentials. Everything else is either a vendor tenancy or barely reachable. Library discovery is Ex Libris Primo VE under an NCKU tenant view (886NCKU_INST) and is recorded as a relationship, not as NCKU's engineering — no Ex Libris contract is saved here. The NCKU institutional repository (NCKUR) at nckur.lib.ncku.edu.tw is NCKU's own DSpace, confirmed live and self-identifying as "Powered By DSPACE, MIT" Version 7.0 during one of only three responsive windows in roughly thirty probes on 2026-09-01 — the host refuses TCP the rest of the time. No OAI-PMH or REST interface survived probing: /oai/request?verb=Identify returns a genuine 404 and every other candidate path fell inside a refusal window, so the 2026-06 profile's DSpace REST and OAI-PMH claims stay unverified. NCKU's Shibboleth identity provider resolves in DNS at idp.ncku.edu.tw but its ports do not answer from outside Taiwan, and Taiwan has no federation in eduGAIN, so the IdP is named as an unverified lead rather than credited as a surface. NCKU registers no DOI prefix with either DataCite or Crossref. There is no central developer portal, no API key program and no institution-authored OpenAPI anywhere on the ncku.edu.tw estate.

providers.name: Nicereply
providers.description: Nicereply is a customer satisfaction and NPS survey platform providing a REST API for managing surveys, accessing ratings and comments, tracking CSAT, CES, and NPS scores, and integrating with helpdesks such as Zendesk, Front, and Helpscout.

providers.name: Ophelia Health
providers.description: Ophelia is a telehealth company providing private, evidence-based medication-assisted treatment (MAT) for opioid use disorder from home. Founded in 2019 by Zack Gray and Mattan Griffel and headquartered in New York City, Ophelia connects patients with licensed clinicians for video visits, prescribes Suboxone (buprenorphine + naloxone) sent to a local pharmacy, and provides ongoing care-team support seven days a week. The subscription service accepts most major insurance plans, including Medicaid, and is licensed to provide care across 49 states and Washington, D.C. Ophelia is a direct-to-consumer clinical service and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner API program; this profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Oradian
providers.description: Oradian is an AI-native, cloud-based core banking platform that helps banks, lenders, microfinance institutions, and fintechs in Asia, Africa, and Europe replace legacy core systems and launch, operate, and scale modern banking services from the cloud. Its product, Instafin, is built API-first around an open data model, an extensible architecture, and a native Model Context Protocol surface, exposing capabilities such as ledgers, transactions, deposits, cards, loans, and applications through stable, versioned APIs, webhooks, and event streams. Oradian is independently audited to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 and aligns to CBN, BSP, and OJK regulatory requirements.

providers.name: Ordr
providers.description: Ordr provides AI-powered security for connected devices, delivering a Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) platform that discovers, classifies, and secures IT, IoT, OT, and IoMT devices across enterprise networks. The platform combines device intelligence, risk and vulnerability management, network segmentation, and zero-trust enforcement to move organizations from visibility to action. Ordr integrates with existing security and networking infrastructure (Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Fortinet, Aruba, Juniper) and serves healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, government, and retail sectors. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and enriched from Ordr's public web surface; Ordr does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Parallel Universe
providers.description: Parallel Universe Inc. (Parallel Studios) is the Toronto-based game studio behind Parallel, a free-to-play sci-fi trading card game, and the broader Parallel Universe franchise that includes Colony, an AI agent simulation game, and Sanctuary, a third-person extraction shooter. The studio anchors the Echelon Prime web3 gaming ecosystem, where players truly own their cards and in-game items as blockchain assets and the PRIME token powers governance and rewards. Backed by a16z (Andreessen Horowitz) and Paradigm, Parallel is a consumer game franchise distributed via the web, Epic Games, Steam, the Apple App Store, and Google Play. It publishes no public developer / REST API surface today; this profile captures the studio's public web, community, and legal properties as harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Pensando *
providers.description: AMD Pensando (formerly Pensando Systems, acquired by AMD in 2022) builds programmable Distributed Services Cards (DPUs) and the Policy and Services Manager (PSM) control plane that operates them across cloud, distributed services switch, and enterprise deployments. PSM exposes a REST API — surfaced through auto-generated, first-party Python bindings on PyPI (pensando-cloud, pensando-dss, pensando-ent) and a Terraform provider — for managing clusters, networks, security policy, and services on Pensando infrastructure. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Physiohome
providers.description: Physiohome, operating as Ameen (رعاية أمين), is a Saudi Arabia-based, tech-enabled provider of home rehabilitation and physical therapy services. Founded in 2021 out of a Ministry of Health sector accelerator, the company delivers physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, nutritional therapy, and personal training for adults and seniors in patients' homes and rehabilitation centers. Its platform manages the full care journey from assessment and treatment planning through session tracking, provider equipping, and reporting, with 100+ active service providers operating across nine cities and a wider network of 700+ providers. Ameen offers iOS and Android apps, an online booking flow, and a patient portal, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. It is a portfolio company of Sanabil 500 (500 Global) and Saudi Venture Capital.

providers.name: Pioneer AI Technologies LLC
providers.description: Pioneer AI Technologies LLC provides an AI‑powered API management platform that enables organizations to design, build, test, maintain, and govern APIs at scale. The platform offers features such as API governance, developer studio, documentation portal, end‑to‑end test automation, and integrated pricing resources. It aims to streamline the API lifecycle, improve collaboration, and ensure compliance across development teams.

providers.name: Power
providers.description: Power (withpower.com) is a clinical-trial search and matching platform that helps patients find and enroll in research studies. It maintains a database of tens of thousands of active clinical trials searchable by condition, location, and drug type, and connects patients, providers, research coordinators, and trial sponsors. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Anthemis and CRV; no public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: powerline-ai
providers.description: Powerline builds AI-accessible APIs that enable agents to interact with real-world services. Their flagship product, Inbox Preview, renders HTML emails across Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo Mail, providing screenshots without requiring sign‑up. The company focuses on bridging AI models with operational tools, offering free utilities like domain and email header checks. Powerline aims to simplify AI integration for developers and enterprises.

providers.name: Radical Health
providers.description: Radical Health is a Khosla Ventures-backed healthcare AI company that produces personalized, expert-reviewed cancer treatment reports for patients in the United States. Its platform ingests a patient's medical records and synthesizes oncology research, clinical trials, and prior patient outcomes into a tailored report within days, drawing on 5.3 million research papers, 11.8 million patient journeys, 20,000 treatment options, and 48,800+ active US clinical trials. The service pairs an always-on AI nurse navigator ("Alice") with human oncology oversight from institutions including UCLA, Johns Hopkins, Stanford, and Kaiser Permanente, and connects to 70,000+ US healthcare institutions (Epic, Kaiser, Ascension, HCA, Medicare) for records access. Reports are informational and educational only, not medical advice. Radical Health is HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II certified and operates as a consumer subscription product ($110/month with a 7-day free trial); it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Rafay Product Documentation
providers.description: Rafay product documentation, API references, Kubernetes platform guides, and resources covering the Rafay Kubernetes Operations Platform (KOP), GPU PaaS, AI workloads, and ecosystem integrations.

providers.name: Rain Financial
providers.description: Rain is a Middle East and North Africa (MENA) cryptocurrency exchange and digital-asset platform, operated through Rain Financial Inc. and its Bahrain entity Rain Management W.L.L. Founded in 2017 by Abdullah Almoaiqel, AJ Nelson, Joseph Dallago, and Yehia Badawy, Rain became the first crypto-asset company accepted into the Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) regulatory sandbox and, in 2019, the first CBB-licensed crypto-asset service provider in the region. Rain Trading Limited later received approval from Abu Dhabi Global Market's Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) to expand across the UAE. Rain lets retail and institutional customers buy, sell, store, and manage Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies against multiple fiat currencies, with a Rain Pro offering for advanced traders and the majority of customer assets held in multi-signature cold storage. The company raised seed, Series A, and a $110M Series B (Paradigm, Kleiner Perkins), and is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: rapidlasso GmbH - LAStools LiDAR processing
providers.description: rapidlasso GmbH provides LAStools, a suite of efficient LiDAR processing tools for point cloud data. The company offers high-performance software for filtering, classification, tiling, and visualization of massive LiDAR datasets, serving industries such as surveying, forestry, and autonomous vehicle mapping. Their tools are widely used for extracting accurate terrain models and feature extraction from raw LiDAR point clouds.

providers.name: Raven
providers.description: Raven is a runtime security platform that protects applications from the inside, detecting and preventing malicious code execution as it happens rather than relying only on perimeter defenses. Its capabilities span Runtime Prevention (blocking exploit execution regardless of CVE availability), Runtime ADR (application-level attack detection and response with forensics), Runtime AI-Agents (discovering and monitoring AI agents in an environment), Runtime SCA (prioritizing vulnerable dependencies by actual execution), and Runtime Gatekeeper (keeping risky applications out of production). The platform is self-hosted on Kubernetes, deployed via Helm/OCI charts and a sensor operator across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and is positioned as an application-level alternative to WAF, EDR, RASP, SCA, and ASPM tools. Raven is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Regard
providers.description: Regard is an AI-powered clinical diagnosis and documentation platform for hospitals and health systems. It reviews 100% of a patient's electronic health record (EHR) to surface and recommend evidence-supported diagnoses, then generates clinical documentation at the point of care. Regard positions itself around "earning revenue through better care, not queries," spanning clinical notes, mid-revenue-cycle denial prevention and revenue capture, HCC risk-adjustment capture, and screening for care gaps. The company reports 12.9M+ recommended diagnoses accepted by clinicians and $50M+ in revenue generated for health systems. Regard integrates directly with EHRs rather than exposing a public developer API; its Health IT Module is ONC 2015 Cures Update certified. Backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Reggora
providers.description: Reggora is a modern appraisal management platform that connects mortgage lenders and appraisal vendors on a single system, automating the appraisal lifecycle from order placement and product selection through payment, document submission, revision review, and delivery back into the loan origination system (LOS). Reggora exposes a documented Lender API and Vendor API so lenders can manage 100% of their appraisal orders directly from their own LOS or proprietary tech stack. All key platform functionality is available via secure REST endpoints (JWT bearer token plus a per-integration API key), with sandbox and production environments and webhook callbacks for loan and order events. Endpoint paths in this catalog are modeled from Reggora's documented resource areas; the full reference is partner-facing at api.reggora.io/docs.

providers.name: Sable Bio
providers.description: Sable Bio is a London-based drug-safety intelligence company building an AI-augmented platform, Sable Target Intelligence, that helps toxicologists, informaticians, and drug discovery scientists assess and mitigate target safety risk earlier in the drug development process. The platform aggregates and quantifies clinical, genetic, experimental, and literature evidence into a unified Target Safety Intelligence surface so safety teams can systematically prioritize and de-risk drug targets faster than traditional manual review. The company is headquartered in East London (Runway East Aldgate) and is backed by Episode One, Seedcamp, and MMC Ventures. Sable Bio was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass it operates a public marketing and product site with a Vanta-hosted trust center but does not yet publish a developer-facing API, documentation, or data-access surface.

providers.name: Securiti
providers.description: Securiti is a San Jose, California data security, privacy, and AI governance company that markets the Data Command Center, a unified hybrid multicloud platform for sensitive data discovery, classification, security posture management, privacy operations, and AI governance. The platform is built on the Data Command Graph, a knowledge-graph layer that correlates data assets, identities, regulations, and AI systems across 1,000+ pre-built connectors spanning AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, and major SaaS applications. Securiti's product surface includes Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Sensitive Data Intelligence, Data Access Intelligence, Data Flow Governance, Data Minimization, Breach Impact Analysis, Data Subject Request (DSR) Automation, Universal Consent Management, Mobile App Consent SDKs, Assessment Automation, Data Mapping, Privacy Center, the People Data Graph, Data Catalog, Data Lineage, Data Quality, Compliance Management, AI Security and Governance, Agent Commander for AI risk detection, Security for AI Agents and Copilots, and the Gencore AI suite for safe enterprise AI copilots, vector-database synchronization, unstructured data curation, and context-aware LLM firewalls. The platform exposes REST-based APIs, a turnkey JavaScript consent library, standards-based webhook interfaces, no-code/low-code workflow integrations, and native mobile SDKs for iOS and Android consent capture. The API reference, SDKs, consent banner generators, and connector catalog are all reached through the Securiti app and Privacy Center; full API documentation requires an authenticated tenant. Securiti was founded in 2018 by Rehan Jalil and has been recognized as a Gartner Customers' Choice and an IDC Worldwide Leader in data privacy and data security. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscription with usage-based connector and module pricing; no public free tier or self-serve API key issuance is currently offered.

providers.name: Seer
providers.description: Seer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SEER) is a Redwood City, California life-sciences company pioneering proteomics, the large-scale study of proteins. Its Proteograph Product Suite pairs engineered nanoparticles with automated sample preparation and mass spectrometry to profile tens of thousands of proteins across biological samples at scale, and its cloud-based Proteograph Analysis System (PAS) software processes and interprets the resulting proteomic data for pharmaceutical, biopharma, and academic research.
