Seer exposes no public developer API; its software surface is the login-gated PAS platform delivered to customers of the Proteograph suite.

providers.name: ShadowBot
providers.description: ShadowBot is a free browser gaming platform offering thousands of HTML5 games that can be played instantly without downloads or installations. It provides a wide catalog ranging from arcade classics to puzzles, racing, and strategy games, supporting daily challenges, tournaments, and community features like clans and leaderboards. The service aims to make gaming accessible to everyone across devices, with a focus on easy access and a vibrant collection for casual and dedicated players alike.

providers.name: ShapeCI
providers.description: ShapeCI is software for industrials — a next-generation PDM (product data management) platform enabled by modern version control that helps hardware enterprises go from design to start of production in weeks rather than years. It brings a Git-style workflow to hardware and CAD: teams and projects hold design files under version control with merge requests, documents, and the ability to review 3D models in-browser and auto-sync engineering knowledge with the model-base. A desktop Connector application lets engineers clone a project, create workstreams, and publish or sync changes. ShapeCI is currently an invite-only beta and does not publish a public developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: sophiagenetics
providers.description: SOPHiA GENETICS (NASDAQ SOPH) is a healthcare technology company democratizing data-driven medicine through its cloud-based SOPHiA DDM Platform, which analyzes genomic, radiomic, and multimodal data to support clinicians and researchers across oncology, hereditary disorders, rare diseases, and precision medicine. The platform spans SOPHiA DDM for Genomics, Multimodal, and Radiomics, plus Alamut Visual Plus for variant interpretation and the OncoPortal knowledge base. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS platform; no public developer API or portal is currently published.

providers.name: sornkan-com
providers.description: sornkan-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Tattle
providers.description: Tattle is an AI-powered Customer Experience Improvement (CXI) platform built for hospitality, supporting 220+ restaurant and hospitality brands across 11,000+ locations globally — including Chili's, MOD Pizza, Hooters, Freddy's, Mellow Mushroom, and The Halal Guys. It collects real-time guest feedback at the point of transaction across ordering channels, then turns it into actionable insights with smart analytics, an AI Coach that delivers each general manager monthly action plans tied to their own guest feedback and SOPs, guest-recovery tools, cross-platform review management, and item-level menu performance tracking. Pricing is per location per month, starting at $59/location. Tattle markets an open, REST-based, API-first design and integrates with 34+ restaurant technology platforms across POS, online ordering, loyalty/CRM, and kiosk categories — such as Olo, Toast, PAR Brink, Square, Punchh, Paytronix, Revel, Thanx, and Checkmate. Public, self-service API reference documentation is not published; the open API and custom integrations are coordinated through Tattle's integrations team (customersuccess@gettattle.com).

providers.name: TemperPack
providers.description: TemperPack is a Richmond, Virginia based sustainable packaging manufacturer, founded in 2015 and a Certified B Corporation, that designs and manufactures curbside recyclable and compostable alternatives to expanded polystyrene (EPS) and single-use plastic for cold chain and protective shipping. Its three material platforms are ClimaCell, a starch-and-paper thermal liner for cold chain shipments; Green Cell Foam, a certified compostable starch-based insulation with EPS-level performance; and WaveKraft, paper-based cushioning produced on demand. Products span cushioning, mailers, qualified shippers and stock shippers, serving life sciences, food and beverage, pet and veterinary, wine, and packaging distribution customers from ISO 9001:2015 certified plants in Richmond VA, Lansing MI and Las Vegas NV, with in-house ISTA thermal and mechanical testing at its Proving Ground lab. TemperPack operates a customer portal for order tracking, thermal testing results, billing and WaveKraft analytics, and an e-commerce store, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition or developer portal as of August 2026.

providers.name: The New Flat Rate
providers.description: The New Flat Rate provides flat‑rate pricing software with built‑in menu options for HVAC, plumbing, electrical and chimney contractors. Its platform lets technicians present five service options on each job, enabling customers to choose the level of service while businesses increase ticket value and reduce pricing guesswork. The solution includes training, coaching and a suite of resources to help contractors grow profitably and streamline operations.

providers.name: Tonk
providers.description: Tonk, built by Tonk Labs, is an open-source containerized format, host environment, and protocol for multiplayer, local-first software you keep and share like files. A .tonk bundle packages an application together with its data into a single self-contained file that runs anywhere, works offline, and stays under user control. It is built on a document-based virtual file system using Automerge CRDTs, a browser/WebAssembly runtime compiled from Rust, and peer-to-peer synchronization through WebSocket relays. Tonk ships first-party npm client libraries, a CLI, a sync relay, an authentication library, and an MCP worker rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Electric Capital.

providers.name: Upstream
providers.description: Upstream is a no-code, full-stack platform for launching and operating DAOs (decentralized autonomous organizations), letting communities create a DAO with a Gnosis multi-signature wallet, DAO contract, and vote delegation contract without technical experience. The platform blends on-chain smart contracts (built on OpenZeppelin, audited by Upshield) with off-chain forums, proposals, polls, and events, and maintains the open-source Fortuna service that indexes ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 transfer events on Ethereum. Upstream is backed by Bloomberg Beta. The company does not currently publish a public developer API; its backend at api.upstreamapp.com is undocumented and product documentation lives at guide.upstreamapp.com.

providers.name: Verdant
providers.description: Verdant is an AI-native land-use permitting and planning software platform for local governments, spanning the entire process from a resident's first question through plan review to a commission's final vote. Applicants file complete, compliant applications upfront, and Verdant's AI reads documents, site plans, and diagrams to flag issues and draft staff review reports that municipal staff can approve. The platform is modular, letting jurisdictions buy only the modules they need, configured to their ordinances, workflows, and forms, and includes ordinance-research tooling to benchmark against peer jurisdictions and find gaps in local codes. Verdant is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company; it currently ships an application product for cities and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Vested
providers.description: Vested Finance is an investment platform that enables Indian residents to build globally diversified portfolios by investing in US markets. It provides access to 10,000+ US stocks and 2,000+ ETFs, professionally managed portfolios (Vests), global mutual funds spanning 50+ countries, and private-market opportunities, alongside INR-to-USD remittance handling and US tax-reporting tools for Indian investors. Vested also operates a login-gated Partner API developer portal at developer.vestedfinance.com that exposes its brokerage and investing capabilities to partners. The company was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and is profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vested
providers.description: Vested Finance is a fintech platform that enables Indian investors to access global equities, ETFs, mutual funds, private market opportunities, and ESOP/RSU liquidity through a regulated, user-friendly interface. The service offers a single account to buy and hold international stocks, diversified portfolios, and manage tax-efficient investments, backed by partnerships with global custodians and compliance with Indian financial regulations. Vested aims to democratize global investing for retail investors, providing educational resources, low fees, and a seamless onboarding experience.

providers.name: WizerMe
providers.description: WizerMe (Wizer) is an edtech platform used by more than 700,000 teachers to build interactive, self-grading digital worksheets. Educators turn existing PDFs and documents into engaging assessments with multiple-choice, video, audio, open-response, and puzzle question types, record video or audio instructions, apply differentiation rules, monitor student work in real time, schedule availability and time limits, and sync grades with Google Classroom. Students submit answers as text, audio, or video. Wizer offers a free tier (Wizer Create) and a premium tier (Wizer Boost) plus school and district plans, and is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is currently published.

providers.name: XtGem
providers.description: XtGem is a visual mobile website builder operated by UAB XtGem of Vilnius, Lithuania, letting anyone build and host mobile sites on *.xtgem.com subdomains (10 million+ sites hosted) with a drag-and-drop builder, file hosting, community blocks (forums, blogs, guestbooks), and the XtScript templating language. XtGem publishes no public developer API, webhooks, or SDKs; its GitHub organization ships the open-source XtFramework PHP framework.

providers.name: Yum Brands
providers.description: Yum! Brands is one of the world's largest restaurant companies, with global brands including KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, and The Habit Burger Grill. The company operates the Byte by Yum! AI-driven technology platform that powers digital ordering, loyalty programs, point-of-sale, kitchen operations, inventory management, and team member tools across over 63,000 restaurants in 155 countries.

providers.name: Abstract Security
providers.description: Abstract Security is a security data platform and AI-powered composable SIEM founded in 2023 by Colby DeRodeff and Aaron Shelmire. Its streaming-first architecture ingests security telemetry from cloud, SaaS, endpoint and on-prem sources, then filters, normalizes, enriches and routes it in real time to SIEMs, data lakes and low-cost archives. The platform separates high-value detection data from long-term compliance retention so teams can cut SIEM ingest cost without losing visibility. Named components include Collection (the security data control plane), Detection Fabric, AI-Enabled SecOps, Retention, and the Abstract Intel Gallery (AIG) for operationalizing threat intelligence. The company publishes a catalog of roughly 230 source, destination and action integrations covering AWS, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Splunk, Google SecOps, Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM, SentinelOne, Elastic and Netskope, and its threat research group (ASTRO) publishes open YARA rulesets on GitHub. Abstract Security has raised roughly $28.5M from Munich Re Ventures, Crosslink Capital, Rally Ventures and Liquid 2 Ventures. As of this profiling pass the company operates no public developer portal, publishes no API reference or machine-readable contract, and routes platform access through a sales/demo motion.

providers.name: Actium Health
providers.description: ActiumHealth is the conversational AI platform for healthcare patient communication, operated as a division of Syllable Corporation. Its voice, SMS, chat and email agents automate inbound and outbound patient calls across appointment scheduling, prescription refill, call routing, referral management, patient surveys, care coordination and revenue cycle workflows for health systems, patient access centers, healthcare contact centers and practice groups, with more than 70 million calls reported handled. The agents integrate with Epic, Cerner and Meditech EHRs through those vendors' APIs, and the platform is marketed as built to SOC 2, HITRUST and HIPAA standards. ActiumHealth consumes EHR APIs rather than publishing one and runs no developer program on actiumhealth.com; the underlying agentic platform API, SDKs, CLI, MCP server and documentation are published by its parent at syllable.ai and catalogued here as `syllable`.

providers.name: AdKit
providers.description: AdKit provides a comprehensive ads toolbox for marketers and AI agents, enabling them to research competitors, create ad copy, launch advertising campaigns, and track performance. The platform integrates with popular AI models such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and more, offering client libraries for each. Users can manage multiple ad accounts, collaborate with team members, set access levels, and upload creative media directly through the interface. Documentation includes detailed getting‑started guides, pricing information, privacy policy, terms of service, and a trust & security center.

providers.name: Aeva
providers.description: Aeva Technologies is a Mountain View, California sensing and perception company that builds 4D LiDAR based on proprietary Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) technology, measuring instant velocity in addition to 3D position for every point in a scene. Its product line spans Atlas and Atlas Ultra long-range automotive-grade sensors, the Omni wide-view short-range sensor, and Eve 1 precision laser speed sensors for factory automation, serving autonomous vehicles, robotics, industrial automation, security, and physical-AI markets. Aeva is a hardware and perception-software provider rather than a web-API company: its developer surface is open-source software on the aevainc GitHub org (the AevaScenes Python SDK and Doppler ICP), the AevaScenes dataset, and product SDK/EULA-gated software delivered with its sensors. No public REST or web API is published.

providers.name: Apitally
providers.description: Apitally provides API monitoring and analytics solutions that simplify tracking usage, performance, and errors across your APIs. By integrating a lightweight SDK into your services, developers gain real‑time visibility, customizable dashboards, and alerting without the complexity of traditional monitoring platforms. The platform supports popular frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, Flask, Express, and more, offering a unified view of traffic, errors, performance metrics, and consumer data. Apitally aims to help teams quickly diagnose issues, improve reliability, and make data‑driven decisions for their API products.

providers.name: Arrived Homes
providers.description: Arrived (Arrived Homes) is an SEC-qualified real estate investing platform that lets anyone buy fractional shares of income-producing single-family rental homes and vacation rentals for as little as $100. Arrived curates and acquires properties nationwide, handles acquisition, financing, property management, tenant placement, maintenance, and financial reporting, and passes rental income to investors as quarterly dividends alongside long-term appreciation. The platform also offers pooled funds including a Single Family Residential Fund and a Real Estate Income (debt) Fund. As of profiling it reports roughly 981K registered investors, $445M invested, and $95M distributed. Backed by Forerunner Ventures, it operates as a consumer fintech / proptech product with a web and mobile app; it publishes no public developer API. This API Evangelist profile is enriched from public company surfaces.

providers.name: Axamer
providers.description: Axamer is the company behind Menteo (menteo.ai), an AI-agent platform for restaurants and restaurant chains, focused on Latin America. Menteo deploys a team of specialized AI agents for marketing (WhatsApp and email campaigns), 24/7 WhatsApp order taking, loyalty and rewards programs, and customer service, integrating with existing POS systems, delivery platforms, and messaging channels to unify customer data and automate marketing, sales, and retention. Plans start from $149 USD/month with no long-term contract. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this pass Menteo publishes a public marketing site with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy but no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Back
providers.description: Back is a Berlin-based employee experience and internal service platform that gives HR, IT, Finance, and Office teams one place to receive, automate, and resolve employee requests. It brings conversations from Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email into a single shared inbox, answers common questions with a self-service knowledge chatbot, and automates lifecycle journeys such as onboarding, offboarding, and leave with approvals, forms, and integrations. Founded in 2018 and backed by Point Nine and Seedcamp, Back is used by companies including Loom, Netlify, Choco, Pleo, Marley Spoon, and Statista. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Back offers an API for custom integrations on select plans, but publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or reference at time of enrichment.

providers.name: BioCatch
providers.description: BioCatch is a financial-fraud and financial-crime prevention platform that uses behavioral intelligence — analyzing how people physically interact with their devices — to detect threats that static rules and device recognition miss. The platform monitors account-opening fraud, account takeover, social-engineering scams, mule accounts, and money-laundering networks across the digital banking session. Marquee products include BioCatch Connect (the core telemetry and behavioral-analysis platform), Scams360, BioCatch Trust (an inter-bank fraud intelligence network), DeviceIQ / DeviceIQai device-trust assessment, mule and account-takeover protection, and Strong Customer Authentication. Integration is delivered under contract through platform components such as the Push API, Align SDK, Link, Fuse, the Insights Query Engine, and Rule Manager; developer documentation lives behind a login at docs.biocatch.com rather than a public developer portal. BioCatch serves 350+ global retail banks, protects over 680 million accounts, and analyzes roughly 18 billion sessions monthly.

providers.name: BoardClic
providers.description: BoardClic provides a digital platform that enables boards and private equity firms to conduct board, CEO, management and committee reviews, generate governance scores, and receive data‑driven insights. The service includes advisory modules, document analysis with secure digital signing, and AI‑enhanced assessments such as ESG maturity. It is used by over 600 boards worldwide to improve board performance and alignment.

providers.name: BoostUp.ai
providers.description: BoostUp.ai provides an AI‑driven revenue acceleration platform that combines pipeline forecasting, conversation intelligence, and automated deal‑closing tools. The solution helps sales teams uncover hidden opportunities, prioritize high‑value prospects, and automate follow‑ups, driving higher win rates and faster revenue growth. Powered by advanced machine learning, BoostUp.ai integrates with CRM systems to deliver real‑time insights and actionable recommendations across the sales funnel.

providers.name: Butternut Box
providers.description: Butternut Box is a London-headquartered direct-to-consumer pet nutrition company that cooks and delivers fresh, gently-steamed dog food on a personalised subscription. Customers complete an online profiling wizard covering their dog's breed, age, weight, activity level and health needs, and Butternut Box calculates a portioned meal plan from human-quality meat and vegetables, batch-cooks it at low temperature, freezes it, and ships it on a recurring schedule. Founded in 2016 and certified as a B Corporation, the company operates nine locale storefronts covering the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Belgium (Dutch and French), Germany, Italy, Sweden and Denmark, and runs its own production facility alongside a React / React Native / Ruby on Rails engineering stack. Butternut Box publishes no public developer API, developer portal or machine-readable specification; its customer-facing surfaces are the marketing site, the subscription web app and the iOS/Android apps.

providers.name: buyer.sh
providers.description: buyer.sh provides a product-search API layer for AI agents, enabling them to query live commerce data across marketplaces, stores, and seller feeds via MCP, CLI, or REST. It offers structured product information, pricing, and relevance ranking to power autonomous purchasing decisions for agents.

providers.name: Calypso Workstation
providers.description: Nasdaq Calypso Workstation is the user-facing desktop component of the Nasdaq Calypso (formerly Adenza / Calypso Technology) capital markets platform. It gives capital markets professionals access to market data, trading operations, risk management, and portfolio analytics across asset classes. The Workstation is an integrated client application rather than a publicly documented REST API; programmatic integration is delivered through the broader Calypso platform interfaces used by banks, asset managers, central banks, and clearing houses.

providers.name: Cardinal Health
providers.description: Cardinal Health is a Fortune 15 global integrated healthcare services and products company that provides pharmaceutical distribution, medical-surgical product distribution, and customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. Cardinal Health does not publish a public developer portal, but it exchanges high volumes of B2B trading data with customers and suppliers via standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 810, 855, 856, 846, 832, 867) over AS2, SFTP, and private API channels. Third-party EDI platforms such as Orderful, Crossfire, SPS Commerce, Zenbridge, DataTrans, Alluvia, ConnectPointz, and Spark Shipping offer managed connectors into Cardinal Health for order-to-cash, inventory, and supply-chain automation.

providers.name: Chai Research
providers.description: Chai Research Corp. (CHAI) is a Palo Alto consumer AI company building a character-and-story chat platform, where users create and talk to AI characters on iOS, Android and the web. Founded in 2021 by William Beauchamp, the company trains and serves its own conversational language models on an in-house GPU cluster, and runs Chaiverse — a developer platform where outside model builders submit HuggingFace-hosted language models, have them deployed to real Chai App users, and compete on a public leaderboard. A public Chat API (api.chai-research.com) and a chaiverse pip package were previously documented; both have since been withdrawn — see x-coverage.

providers.name: chain-ops
providers.description: Chain-ops provides pay-per-call on-chain data APIs for AI agents, offering live gas price comparisons across 9 EVM chains via the x402 protocol. Pricing starts at $0.001 per call in USDC on Base, with no API key required. The platform includes an open-source SDK for Node.js and supports ERC‑8004 agent identity.

providers.name: Cogoport
providers.description: Cogoport is a global logistics and supply chain platform offering freight booking, customs, trade finance, and supply chain visibility for businesses across ocean, air, and inland transport. It provides ocean (FCL and LCL) and air freight booking with real-time rate discovery, customs clearance and compliance support, trade finance including invoice financing and pay-later solutions, end-to-end shipment tracking, and logistics tools such as an HS Code Finder, container trackers, and shipping cost calculators. Cogoport is backed by Accel and headquartered in India, serving importers and exporters worldwide.

providers.name: ConstructionOnline
providers.description: ConstructionOnline is UDA Technologies' cloud construction project management platform covering estimating, scheduling, budgets, change orders, daily logs, file sharing, and client and subcontractor collaboration. UDA exposes the platform through a documented REST API available to ConstructionOnline Business and Enterprise customers, with read and write access for projects, contacts, schedules, and financials. Access is gated by an application process (api@uda1.com), authenticated with company-issued credentials, and rate-limited to 500 requests per hour per account.

providers.name: Convey
providers.description: Convey is an enterprise AI platform for building and running autonomous "digital teammates" — AI workers that non-technical operators train by describing a workflow or sharing their screen, after which the teammate runs business processes end to end across existing enterprise systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, ad operations, reporting) with role-based access, isolated agent identities, dedicated credentials, audit logs, and escalation to a human on high-stakes decisions. Founded by former DoorDash and project44 engineers, Convey raised a $38M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz in June 2026 (with Khosla Ventures and Pear VC) and reports 1.1M+ hours of work completed for customers including NBCUniversal, TelevisaUnivision, Unity, and Samsara. The platform is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant. Convey is an enterprise, contact-sales product with no public developer API or documentation surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Cookunity
providers.description: CookUnity is the first chef-to-consumer meal marketplace, connecting award-winning chefs with food lovers nationwide. Chefs craft restaurant-quality meals in local kitchens and deliver them fresh, ready to heat in two minutes, with more than 300 rotating dishes spanning a wide range of cuisines and dietary options (keto, vegan, paleo, high-protein, gluten-free and more). Subscribers choose four to sixteen meals per week on a flexible weekly plan. The company also runs a chef marketplace onboarding culinary entrepreneurs, a CookUnity for Business program for corporate, healthcare and education clients, and gift cards. CookUnity is a consumer brand and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, identity, and domain-security surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Dataverse
providers.description: Dataverse is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Descartes Systems Group
providers.description: Descartes Systems Group, operating as Sellercloud, provides a cloud‑based inventory and order management platform for marketplace sellers. The solution centralizes product catalogs, synchronizes inventory across channels, automates order processing, and integrates with major e‑commerce marketplaces and shipping carriers, enabling scalable, efficient commerce operations.

providers.name: Desktop Commander
providers.description: Desktop Commander provides AI-powered remote control of your computer, allowing ChatGPT and Claude to read files, execute commands, and automate workflows directly on your machine. It emphasizes privacy by running on the user’s own device rather than a cloud sandbox, and offers integrations for popular AI assistants, supporting natural‑language interaction with the desktop environment.

providers.name: DZone
providers.description: DZone is one of the world's largest online communities and a leading publisher of knowledge resources for software engineering professionals. Founded in 1997 with roots in Javalobby, DZone reaches millions of developers each month with articles, tutorials, research guides, and Refcards covering topics including cloud architecture, Java, JavaScript, microservices, containers, data, DevOps, AI, and more.

providers.name: EverBank
providers.description: EverBank, N.A. is a Jacksonville, Florida based national bank (Member FDIC) focused on high-yield consumer deposits, business and treasury banking, and commercial lending, serving customers nationwide online plus a small network of financial centers in Florida, California and New York. The bank operated as TIAA Bank from 2017 until 2023, when it was acquired by an investor group and reverted to the EverBank brand as an independent institution. Like most US banks, EverBank publishes NO first-party public developer API or developer portal; there is no documented open-banking, FDX, or CFPB Section 1033 data-access API exposed directly. Consumer-permissioned account data is reached only through third-party aggregators (e.g. Plaid, MX, Finicity), which is the honest, non-fabricated posture recorded here.

providers.name: EXIGER
providers.description: Exiger is an AI-native supply chain, third-party, and software supply chain risk and compliance company. Its 1Exiger platform unifies supplier, product, part, component, and risk data into a single system to help organizations map and orchestrate compliant, resilient physical and software supply chains. Product areas span supply chain visibility and optimization, trade and third-party risk and compliance, due diligence intelligence (DDIQ), and software supply chain security (SBOM analysis, from its Ion Channel acquisition). Exiger serves government and commercial customers and is FedRAMP authorized. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched from Exiger's public corporate, trust, and legal surfaces; Exiger does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs.

providers.name: F.N.B. Corporation
providers.description: F.N.B. Corporation (NYSE: FNB) is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and the parent of First National Bank of Pennsylvania, an FDIC-insured, state-chartered commercial bank. With roughly $50 billion in total assets at year-end 2025, FNB is a regional super-community bank operating around 350 branches across seven states and Washington, D.C. (Pennsylvania, Ohio, Maryland, West Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Virginia), offering commercial banking, consumer banking and wealth management through its eStore digital platform. On open finance, FNB exposes NO first-party public developer portal or documented API: the developer/api subdomains of fnb-online.com redirect to the marketing homepage and no developer documentation is published. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is reachable only through third-party aggregators (notably Plaid), not a first-party FNB API. No direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership or public CFPB Section 1033 posture is documented by the institution as of this profile.

providers.name: Feedough
providers.description: Feedough is a media platform and entrepreneurship resource covering startup ideas, business models, and entrepreneurship. Founded in December 2013 by Aashish Pahwa to bridge the information gap in the startup industry, Feedough explains startup concepts in plain language without the fluff. The platform is ranked among the top twenty startup websites globally and is cited as a resource by institutions including Harvard Business School and the University of Washington.

providers.name: Fintor
providers.description: Fintor is an enterprise software company that provides an agentic AI workforce for mortgage lending operations. Its purpose-built, autonomous AI agents execute mortgage workflows end to end - from application through closing - with human-in-the-loop oversight, integrating with existing loan origination systems (LOS), CRMs, and contact centers rather than replacing them. Product modules include a Loan Officer Assistant (document intake, borrower communication, gap analysis), a Processor Assistant (third-party orders, condition tracking, disclosures), Predictive Conditioning, a Closing Agent, and a Manager Assistant for forecasting and reporting. Fintor ships pre-built connectors for Encompass, Salesforce, Five9, Polly, and Blend, exposes documented API integrations, and is SOC 2 Type II certified with encryption, RBAC, approval chains, and audit logging.

providers.name: Fintract
providers.description: Fintract provides a Financial Document Extraction API that converts PDFs such as bank statements, invoices, and receipts into validated JSON. The service offers high‑accuracy OCR and data extraction with a simple usage‑based pricing model (e.g., $0.05 per page). Users can start for free without a credit card, and the platform includes tools for converting PDFs to Excel, CSV, and QuickBooks formats. Fintract’s API aims to streamline financial data processing for developers and businesses, supporting integrations with popular accounting software and offering a range of document‑type specific endpoints.

providers.name: Folio3 Software
providers.description: Folio3 Software is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: g2-catalog) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: GEODNET
providers.description: GEODNET (Global Earth Observation Decentralized Network) is a Web3/DePIN blockchain-based RTK (Real-Time Kinematics) GNSS correction network. It incentivizes operators to deploy permanent GNSS reference stations ("Satellite Miners") that broadcast real-time correction data, letting nearby devices achieve centimeter-level positioning accuracy. Station operators earn GEOD token rewards, with a target of 100,000 evenly distributed base stations worldwide — roughly twenty times larger than existing CORS networks. The correction data fuels robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, precision agriculture, construction, surveying, and consumer mapping. Developer-facing surfaces are the GEODNET Console web platform, the RTK coverage service, and DAO governance; the GEOD token spans Polygon and Solana. This profile was seeded as a Multicoin Capital portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: HealthEngine
providers.description: HealthEngine is Australia's largest consumer healthcare marketplace and patient-engagement platform, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. Its consumer app and website let millions of Australians search a national directory of primary-care providers and book, manage, and attend appointments (including telehealth) across GP, dental, allied-health, and specialist practices. For practices, HealthEngine sells a SaaS suite - GP Complete, Patient Connect, Online Booking, Appointment Reminders and Recalls, Featured Listings, online payments, patient reviews, and Scripts - that plugs into the practice's existing software. It maintains private, real-time integrations into 25+ Australian practice management systems (Best Practice / Bp Premier, MedicalDirector Pracsoft, Zedmed, Cliniko, Genie, Gentu, Medtech, Nookal, PracSuite, Dental4Windows, and others) so appointment availability and bookings sync directly with the front desk. Home market is Australia. HealthEngine does NOT publish a public developer portal, REST OpenAPI, or HL7 FHIR endpoint - its API surface is a set of gated, partner-only PMS integrations rather than a self-serve developer program, so this profile is an honest identity stub with no public machine-readable contract to harvest.

providers.name: Hubert
providers.description: Hubert provides an AI‑powered platform that streamlines high‑volume hiring by automating candidate shortlisting, interview scheduling, and assessment. Their solution helps recruiters and hiring teams quickly identify top talent, reduce manual screening time, and improve candidate experience across industries such as social care, retail, and logistics. The platform offers integrations, pricing plans, and a candidate pledge to ensure transparent hiring practices.

providers.name: IBM App Connect
providers.description: IBM App Connect is an integration platform that enables organizations to connect applications, data, and services across cloud and on-premises environments. It provides low-code integration capabilities with pre-built connectors and a flow editor for building integration flows.

providers.name: Icertis
providers.description: Icertis is an AI-native contract intelligence company that turns enterprise contracts into structured, actionable data and measurable business outcomes. Its Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform manages agreements across their full lifecycle — authoring, negotiation, execution, obligation management, and ongoing analytics — spanning sell-side, buy-side, and corporate contracts. The platform pairs a configurable contract data model with AI capabilities (the "Vera" AI assistant and agent-powered drafting, redlining, and negotiation) trained on millions of contracts. Icertis serves large enterprises across manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, technology, financial services, and the public sector, and integrates with ERP, CRM, CPQ, and procurement systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and Coupa. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Icertis' public web presence.

providers.name: Irhythmtech
providers.description: iRhythm Technologies is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: IRTC) digital healthcare company specializing in ambulatory cardiac monitoring for the detection and management of heart arrhythmias. Its Zio service pairs a wearable single-lead ECG biosensor patch (Zio monitor and Zio AT) with FDA-cleared AI/deep-learning algorithms, qualified cardiac technician verification, and cloud-based data analytics to produce end-of-wear diagnostic reports for clinicians. The platform includes the ZioSuite clinician portal for report interpretation and patient management, the MyZio patient app for symptom logging and education, EHR integration, and telehealth workflows. iRhythm was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; enrichment is limited to public identity, trust, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Island
providers.description: Island is the developer of the Enterprise Browser, a Chromium-based browser purpose-built for the enterprise that embeds security, data protection, and governance directly into the last mile of work. The platform unifies an Enterprise Browser, Enterprise AI, and an Enterprise Network (SASE) so organizations can control how users interact with SaaS and internal applications, enforcing data-loss prevention, privileged access, insider-risk controls, and zero-trust policy at the browser layer, and replacing VDI/DaaS for many contractor and BYOD scenarios. Island is a private cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners and other investors. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is published; administration is via the management console at management.island.io.

providers.name: Kabal
providers.description: Kabal is the energy industry's leading logistics management SaaS platform. Founded in Norway in 2011 (formerly Wellit), Kabal provides an integrated, cloud-native platform that manages cargo, marine, transport, personnel, warehouse, rig and installation logistics across both offshore and onshore operations for oil & gas operators. The platform spans planning, execution and optimization, plus cost and emissions tracking and KPI reporting, connecting operators with their suppliers and vessels to share business-critical logistics data. Kabal is trusted by energy supermajors including ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, BP, TotalEnergies, Equinor, Petronas, Repsol, Eni and ADNOC, with tens of thousands of users across dozens of countries. Kabal received a growth investment from Insight Partners in 2023.

providers.name: Lavante
providers.description: Lavante was a SaaS supplier information management (SIM) and profit-recovery company built on its patented Lavante Connect platform. Its products — Lavante SIM, Lavante Recovery and Vendor File Cleanse — cleansed vendor master files, verified addresses and TINs, ran OFAC screening, onboarded suppliers onto the Lavante Supplier Network, and drove dispute resolution and recovery audit across the procure-to-pay (P2P) ecosystem for Fortune 1000 clients in hospitality, retail, entertainment, manufacturing and medical. Lavante was acquired by PRGX Global and its standalone site was retired; www.lavante.com now 302-redirects to www.prgx.com, where the supplier-facing capability lives on as PRGX Supplier Connect. Lavante never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or API documentation — the Internet Archive holds no api/developer/docs/swagger paths for the domain.

providers.name: LHMT (Lithuania)
providers.description: LHMT (Lithuania) operates the national meteorological service, providing weather forecasts, climate data, and a public API (api.meteo.lt) that offers access to current observations, forecasts, and historical weather information for Lithuania. The service supports developers with JSON endpoints and documentation, enabling integration of meteorological data into applications and research.

providers.name: Linas Matkasse
providers.description: Linas Matkasse is a Swedish meal-kit subscription service that delivers pre-portioned ingredients and nutritionally calculated recipes to customers' homes each week. Customers pick from more than 150 weekly recipes across concepts such as Chef's Choice, Family Favorites, Quick & Easy, Calorie-Smart, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free and Lactose-Free, and can change their selection until Tuesday night before a Saturday-to-Monday delivery. The brand is operated by Cheffelo, a Scandinavian meal-kit group listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market that also runs Godtlevert in Norway and RetNemt in Denmark and delivers roughly 17 million meals a year. Linas Matkasse runs a consumer subscription e-commerce storefront and a "Mina Sidor" customer account area; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Lore
providers.description: Lore is a multichain wallet for groups to win together, a co-ownership platform that lets collectives launch shared, multi-signature Safe wallets across Solana, Ethereum, Base, Blast, and Arbitrum. Its Co-Ownership Framework is an equity-tracking system over shared Vaults that lets a group start small and grow both assets and members over time, using Proposals, Group Deposits, Exits, Distributions, and Valuations to manage on-chain treasuries and investment clubs together. Lore provides a consumer application and documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Max Retail
providers.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: MeaningCloud
providers.description: MeaningCloud is a cloud-based text analytics and natural language processing REST API platform providing sentiment analysis, topic extraction, text classification, language detection, document clustering, corporate reputation analysis, document structure extraction, and deep semantic analysis across multiple languages.

providers.name: Newneek
providers.description: Newneek (뉴닉) is a South Korean knowledge and media platform that makes news and current events easy and fun to follow. Founded by Kim So-yeon and operated by Newneek Co., Ltd. from Seoul's Mapo district, the company is best known for its conversational email newsletter delivered by the mascot "Gosuni," alongside a mobile app, a Slack news bot, and active social channels. Newneek is a consumer content brand rather than an API producer: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface. It appears in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company, and this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture. Enrichment probes found no OpenAPI, well-known, OAuth, MCP, or webhook surface to harvest.

providers.name: Planera
providers.description: Planera is a modern construction scheduling platform for builders and general contractors, purpose-built around the Critical Path Method (CPM). It lets teams build, manage, and optimize project schedules through a visual, collaborative interface with drag-and-drop editing, a digital whiteboard (Canvas), Gantt views, DCMA quality checks, resource planning, and an AI scheduling assistant (Manny) for scenario analysis and risk identification. Planera spans pursuits, preconstruction, operations, and enterprise portfolio management, offers an iPad field app, and integrates with Procore, Autodesk, Primavera P6, and Microsoft Project. The company is SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 certified and is backed by Sierra Ventures.

providers.name: Pluto
providers.description: Pluto (Pluto Health, trypluto.com now pluto.health) is an AI-powered clinical intelligence and care-delivery platform that unifies fragmented health data from roughly 90% of US health systems. It aggregates medical records, insurance data, and social determinants of health, then applies AI-driven clinical intelligence to surface care gaps, coordinate preventive care, screenings, vaccines and at-home lab testing, and match patients to clinical trials. Pluto offers turnkey, white-label, or API-based deployment of its clinical operations. It is backed by Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Prodigal
providers.description: Prodigal is an AI company building purpose-built agents and intelligence for the loan-servicing and debt-collections industry. Its products include proAgent (end-to-end collections automation across voice and digital), PIE (an intelligence layer trained on more than half a billion consumer-finance interactions), proCollect (omnichannel digital orchestration), proScore (propensity-to-pay scoring from 500+ consumer attributes), proPay (an AI-native self-serve payment portal), proNotes (automated call notes), proInsight (QA automation, scorecards, and revenue analytics), and proAssist (real-time agent assistance). Prodigal serves auto finance, collections, healthcare revenue-cycle management, and lending, integrating with dialers and contact-center platforms such as Five9, Genesys, NICE, TCN, and DialConnect. It is backed by Accel and Menlo Ventures. Prodigal exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance program.

providers.name: Promolta
providers.description: Promolta is a self-service video advertising platform that promotes YouTube and other videos across a network of blogs, websites, mobile apps, and social networks to grow views, subscribers, and engagement. Advertisers fund campaigns and target audiences, while publishers in the Promolta network earn by distributing sponsored video content. Promolta is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Campaigns start at a $10 minimum budget, go live within 24 hours, and can be optimized for views, YouTube likes, YouTube subscribers, or mobile app installs, with targeting by age, gender, location, and keyword. As of the 2026-08-12 enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/GraphQL contract, developer portal, or webhook surface — this profile captures its public web, legal, blog, and domain-security footprint.

providers.name: Regular Expressions
providers.description: A sequence of characters that define a search pattern, commonly used for string matching, validation, and text manipulation across programming languages and data processing pipelines. Regular expressions are supported natively in virtually every programming language and are foundational to text processing, log analysis, data validation, and search tooling.

providers.name: Remesh
providers.description: Remesh is an AI-powered market research and audience insights platform that runs live, asynchronous, and video conversations with customers or employees at scale, using machine learning to cluster, rank, and surface representative opinions from large groups in real time. Its products span live AI-moderated focus groups, employee listening, and healthcare research, with an embedded research assistant (Remy). Remesh is delivered as a hosted SaaS workspace at live.remesh.chat; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface as of this profile. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Techstars and enriched with the provider's real published identity, security, and trust artifacts.

providers.name: Rialo
providers.description: Rialo is an early-stage Layer 1 blockchain building high-throughput infrastructure with configurable privacy for real-world finance and the emerging agent economy. Developed by Subzero Labs and backed by Pantera Capital, Rialo positions itself as the infrastructure for the next generation of intelligent systems, replacing the fragile stack of off-chain automation with native, event-driven execution. Its architecture spans several first-class capabilities: the Rialo Omni Account (one account that transacts across multiple networks), Rialo Interop (native, fast, cheap cross-chain interoperability), Rialo IPC (Identity, Privacy, and Compliance built in), Rialo Stream (native data feeds for DeFi and real-world assets), and an event-driven Execution Engine supporting reactive transactions and conditional automation. The project is pre-mainnet; its developer surface consists of a dev portal, gated technical documentation, an interactive playground, a Learn hub of technical demos, and an active engineering blog.

providers.name: RSS-Bridge
providers.description: RSS-Bridge is an open-source PHP project that provides RSS/Atom feeds for websites that do not natively offer them. By running the bridge on a server, users can generate feeds for a wide variety of sites, including social media, video platforms, news sites, and many niche services. The project ships with hundreds of individual “bridges” that scrape content and expose it as standard RSS, enabling easy aggregation in any feed reader. RSS-Bridge can be self-hosted, customized, and extended, making it a flexible tool for developers and hobbyists who need universal access to web content through RSS.

providers.name: Sweep
providers.description: Sweep is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed company (originally launched as "Sweep — AI-powered junior developer") that has pivoted from being a GitHub App which turned issues into pull requests into an AI coding assistant delivered primarily as a JetBrains IDE plugin, with autocomplete-only support for VS Code and Zed. The current Sweep product pairs a proprietary "Tab model" next-edit autocomplete with an in-IDE Agent for chat, inline editing, AI commit messages, and AI code review across IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, Android Studio, RustRover, RubyMine, CLion, and Aqua. The plugin indexes the local codebase for context, supports Remote MCP Servers with OAuth, web search and fetch tools, and ships under a commercial credit-based pricing model (Free Trial, Basic $10/mo, Pro $20/mo, Ultra $60/mo) with enterprise SOC 2 and zero-data-retention options via contact sales. Sweep has no public developer REST API, no SDK, and no documented webhooks; the company's primary distribution surfaces are the JetBrains Marketplace, the VS Code Marketplace, and the Zed extension registry, and its open-source footprint on GitHub has narrowed to research forks (SWE-bench, SGLang), tokenizer/diff utilities (bpe-qwen, difflib-rs), and the now-legacy sweepai/sweep repository that documented the original GitHub PR agent. Sweep is profiled here as an AI developer-experience vendor rather than as an API provider.

providers.name: terradev-cloud
providers.description: Terradev.cloud provides infrastructure primitives for the agentic economy, offering hosted ledgers, live observability, and GPU provisioning tools. Their platform includes services like Templum for tamper‑evident ledgers, Telinea for trace visualization, and a suite of MCP servers for randomness, consensus, and dead‑drop networking. Pricing starts at $9.99/month with free trials, and they emphasize open‑source components under Apache 2.0. The company targets developers building autonomous agent systems needing verifiable proof of actions.

providers.name: TMRW Life Sciences *
providers.description: TMRW Life Sciences is a medical technology company that builds the world's first and only FDA-cleared automated platform for the safe management and storage of frozen eggs and embryos used in IVF and fertility treatment. Its cryo-storage hardware combines robotic specimen handling with digital tracking, chain-of-custody monitoring, and real-time visibility for fertility clinics and their patients, replacing manual, paper-based handling of irreplaceable reproductive tissue. Deployed at clinic networks including CCRM Fertility, Pinnacle Fertility, RFC, and IVIRMA North America. TMRW is a private company backed by GV (Google Ventures). It publishes a Security & Trust program (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27018) but does not expose a public developer portal, API, or specification surface.

providers.name: Tom's Shit Jokes
providers.description: Tom's Shit Jokes is the No. 1 Shit Jokes website with 350+ really bad jokes across many categories. All profits from advertising and shop sales are donated to Macmillan. The API provides free JSON jokes without a key, accessible via the WP-JSON endpoint.

providers.name: Tory Burch
providers.description: Tory Burch LLC is an American luxury women's fashion label founded in February 2004 by designer Tory Burch and headquartered in New York City, trading under the legal entity River Light V, L.P. The privately held company designs and sells ready-to-wear clothing, designer shoes, handbags, small leather goods, jewellery, watches, eyewear, fragrance and beauty, swimwear and home decor, together with the Tory Sport activewear line, through roughly 400 boutiques worldwide, wholesale partners and a direct-to-consumer storefront at toryburch.com serving the United States, United Kingdom, the European Union and Asia. Its affiliated Tory Burch Foundation funds and educates women entrepreneurs. Tory Burch is a fashion and retail business rather than a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract, and holds no public GitHub organisation. Its storefront is a Next.js front end on Akamai over a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) commerce platform with Adobe Scene7 media, and an Apigee API gateway fronts www.toryburch.com/api/ for first-party storefront traffic only, exposing no publicly registered proxy. The one machine-readable artifact the company does publish is a site-wide llms.txt.

providers.name: Track Titan
providers.description: Track Titan is a sim racing analytics and coaching platform that records in-game telemetry from simulators including iRacing, Assetto Corsa and ACC, the F1 series, Automobilista 2, Forza Motorsport, and Le Mans Ultimate, turning laps into time-loss analysis, AI coaching feedback, auto-installed esports car setups, and structured Academy learning content for a community of over 295,000 sim racers on PC and console. Founded by former professional sim racer and Porsche coach Max Teichert and backed by investors including Partech, Track Titan is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of July 2026 (api.tracktitan.io serves only an internal backend service).

providers.name: Unicorn Auctions
providers.description: Unicorn Auctions is a Chicago-based online auction marketplace for rare spirits and fine wine, founded in 2019 by A.J. Heindel, Cody Modeer and Phil Mikhaylov out of the city's restaurant and bar trade. Every lot is sold on consignment: Unicorn authenticates, appraises, photographs and digitizes each bottle before listing it in one to three weekly online auctions that can carry several thousand lots spanning bourbon, scotch, Japanese whisky, tequila, agave spirits and wine. The company also runs a bonded vault storage service for collectors, and publishes The Unicorn Review, an editorial and auction-intelligence blog. Bidding is entirely digital, through the web platform and native iOS and Android apps. Unicorn Auctions publishes no public developer program - no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer portal - and the api.unicornauctions.com backend that serves its own clients is private, undocumented and disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: waply-online
providers.description: Waply Online provides a WhatsApp integration platform tailored for Kommo CRM, enabling businesses to send messages, make calls, and deploy AI-driven voice agents directly through WhatsApp. The service offers tools for agencies and enterprises across various industries, including retail, education, healthcare, and automotive, with customizable solutions, pricing calculators, and extensive documentation to streamline communication workflows.

providers.name: Wave AI
providers.description: Wave AI (WaveAI) is a Sunnyvale, California AI music company founded in 2017 by David Loker, Dr. Maya Ackerman, and Chris Cassion, building foundational generative AI models for music and songwriting. Its flagship product LyricStudio is an AI-powered lyric-writing assistant used by millions of artists and creators to generate genre- and topic-aware lyrical suggestions, rhymes, and full songs, and MelodyStudio adds generative vocal-melody and chord generation. The company is backed by 500 Global, Horizon 3 Venture Capital, Kilowatt Capital, and angel investors. Wave AI ships consumer web applications rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with a domain-security probe and verified public link properties.

providers.name: WEC Energy Group
providers.description: WEC Energy Group (NYSE: WEC) is one of the nation's premier energy companies, serving 4.4 million customers across Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan, and Minnesota with electricity and natural gas service. The company operates through regional utilities including We Energies, Wisconsin Public Service, Peoples Gas, North Shore Gas, Minnesota Energy Resources, Michigan Gas Utilities, and Upper Michigan Energy Resources. WEC Energy Group offers customer-facing digital services including account management portals, mobile apps, and Green Button energy usage data access.

providers.name: Yaak
providers.description: Yaak is an open-source desktop API client for organizing and executing REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC requests. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it is a privacy-first, fast desktop client with no telemetry and no cloud lock-in.

providers.name: Yabie
providers.description: Yabie is a technology company focused on providing innovative solutions in the digital marketplace. It aims to connect businesses with advanced API-driven services, enhancing integration capabilities and streamlining workflows across various industries. The company emphasizes scalability, security, and developer-friendly tools to foster ecosystem growth and enable seamless data exchange.

providers.name: Zions Bancorporation
providers.description: Zions Bancorporation is one of the nation's premier financial services companies, operating under local management teams and distinct brands in 11 western U.S. states. The company offers a comprehensive suite of banking, treasury management, lending, and wealth management services for individuals, businesses, and public sector clients. Zions provides ERP-to-bank integration capabilities, ACH payment origination, wire transfers, and cash management tools for corporate treasury operations. The company does not currently publish a public REST API developer portal; integrations are delivered via Treasury Internet Banking import/export, NACHA-compliant ACH files, and direct file-transfer arrangements with corporate customers.

providers.name: Zweitag
providers.description: Zweitag GmbH offers kamium, an enterprise‑AI platform that enables companies to deploy generative AI in a data‑sovereign, scalable and flexible manner. Hosted in private cloud, the solution integrates with existing workflows across sales, IT, HR, legal and more, providing multimodal processing, RAG over corporate data, and AI assistants. Built in Germany, it emphasizes GDPR compliance, vendor‑agnostic architecture, and on‑premise deployment, allowing enterprises to retain control over their AI models and data while benefiting from modern AI capabilities.

providers.name: AcreScout
providers.description: AcreScout is a Canadian land‑for‑sale platform that aggregates rural property listings across Canada, ranking them by price per acre, water frontage and value. Operated by Buretto Technologies Inc., the service provides data from public sources such as Kijiji, CREA, Centris and Zillow, and offers tools for filtering by region, size, price and amenities. It includes detailed information on taxes, approvals and ownership limits for Canadian citizens and residents, and supplies open‑data credits and licensing information.

providers.name: Addus HomeCare
providers.description: Addus HomeCare Corporation (NASDAQ: ADUS) is a US provider of personal care, home health and hospice services delivered in the home and community, headquartered at 6303 Cowboys Way, Frisco, Texas. It serves consumers across roughly three dozen states through a large field workforce of caregivers, nurses and therapists, with revenue coming predominantly from Medicaid and Medicaid-managed-care programs, Medicare and managed-care payers rather than from software. Addus is a care-delivery organization, not a software vendor: contract discovery on 2026-08-30 found no developer program, no public API, no SDK, no published package on any registry and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its clinical and operational systems are supplied by partners — Homecare Homebase for the home-based care platform under a joint development agreement announced in April 2021, and CellTrak for Electronic Visit Verification — and any system-to-system exchange (HL7, payer X12 EDI, state EVV aggregators) is scoped by partner contract rather than by a public developer portal. Two earlier hosts on this profile, api.addus.com and developer.addus.com, were probed and do not resolve; they have been removed.

providers.name: Adscanner
providers.description: AdScanner — now trading as all eyes on screens (AEOS), the legal entity all eyes on screens d.o.o. of Zagreb, Croatia, formerly Adscanner d.o.o. — is a European TV and video advertising measurement, planning and activation platform founded in 2012. In-house AI video-recognition software matches broadcast ad creatives second-by-second against viewing data supplied by IPTV and telco partners, producing cross-channel reach, frequency and attribution measurement for linear, addressable and connected TV. Products include the AdScanner/AEOS Cockpit analytics dashboard, the Apollo AI-based ex-ante planning module, TV Boost data activation on post-code segments, and TV Match cross-device targeting and TV-sync signals that fire digital campaigns when a spot airs. AEOS operates in Croatia, Austria, Germany, Bulgaria and Switzerland. The company states in its own FAQ that its data can be obtained via reporting (PDF, Excel, CSV, JSON) and API on request, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Air France-KLM
providers.description: Air France-KLM is a leading European airline group operating worldwide, offering passenger and cargo services through its Air France, KLM, and Transavia brands. The group serves over 320 destinations, emphasizing sustainability, innovation, and customer experience. It provides extensive travel solutions, loyalty programs, and digital services, reflecting its commitment to responsible aviation and global connectivity.

providers.name: Angular
providers.description: Angular is an open-source TypeScript-based web application framework maintained by Google and a community of contributors. It provides a comprehensive platform for building single-page applications with a component-based architecture, reactive Signals, deferrable views, built-in control flow, zoneless change detection, server-side rendering, and the Angular CLI. Angular follows a major release cadence of two versions per year.

providers.name: Apyflux
providers.description: Apyflux is an API marketplace that connects API providers with developers, offering a curated catalog of APIs across various industries. The platform enables seamless API publishing, discovery, and monetization, providing tools for documentation, analytics, and billing. It aims to simplify integration for businesses and empower developers to find and use high‑quality APIs efficiently.

providers.name: Archestack
providers.description: Archestack is a platform that ranks open-source AI and vibe coding projects using public GitHub data, providing reviews of strengths and weaknesses for over 1,600 projects. In addition, Archestack builds AI applications for startups and enterprise teams based on the curated stacks.

providers.name: Bending Spoons
providers.description: Bending Spoons S.p.A. is a Milan, Italy technology company founded in 2013 that acquires established digital products and operates them for the long term rather than reselling them. Its portfolio spans more than 50 acquisitions and includes AOL, Brightcove, Eventbrite, Evernote, Harvest, Issuu, komoot, Loomly, Meetup, Remini, Splice, StreamYard, Tractive, Vimeo and WeTransfer, serving over 500 million monthly active users and more than 9 million monthly paying customers. The company listed its ordinary shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker BSP on 1 July 2026. Bending Spoons itself publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at the holding-company level: every API surface in the group belongs to an individual acquired product, each profiled separately in the API Evangelist network. What the corporate entity does publish is a PGP-signed RFC 9116 security.txt, a compliance hub, a support center, an investor relations site, and a small set of first-party open-source Swift frameworks (Katana, Tempura).

providers.name: Bind AI
providers.description: Bind AI provides an AI-driven platform for insurance brokers, automating the quote‑to‑bind workflow, extracting data from inbound communications, and delivering actionable insights. Backed by Bonfire Ventures, the company aims to make insurance and risk management affordable and efficient through machine‑learning models that streamline underwriting, pricing, and compliance tasks.

providers.name: Blooma
providers.description: Blooma is an AI‑powered commercial real‑estate (CRE) lending platform that provides data‑driven origination, portfolio intelligence, and workflow automation solutions for lenders. The company helps lenders make faster, data‑driven decisions, monitor portfolios with real‑time alerts, and integrate data sources to streamline CRE lending operations.

providers.name: Bobyard
providers.description: Bobyard is an AI takeoff and estimating software company for the construction industry. Its platform reads construction drawings and blueprints to automatically extract quantities and organize takeoffs, cutting manual estimation work by 50-90% for trade contractors in landscaping, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, and finishes. Trained on millions of drawings, Bobyard automates AI takeoff, manual takeoff, OC conversions, and estimate generation so contractors can increase bid capacity without expanding estimating staff. Bobyard was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes product documentation and a live status page (including an Inference API component) but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs.

providers.name: BoxGreen
providers.description: BoxGreen (BoxGreen Pte. Ltd., incorporated 2014 in Singapore) is a Certified B Corporation and social enterprise selling all-natural, individually packaged healthy snacks direct to consumers and to businesses. Its consumer offering is a Shopify-based e-commerce store with build-your-own snack boxes, curated collections (nut mixes, crunchies, vegan and gluten-free ranges), gift and party packs, and a subscription delivery model; its B2B side covers corporate gifting, office pantry supply, and cashless healthy-snack vending machines. Every BoxGreen snack is packed in prison by beneficiaries of Singapore's Yellow Ribbon Project to build skills and employability. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company, BoxGreen publishes no first-party API or developer program; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is Shopify's New Customer Accounts OIDC/OAuth discovery.

providers.name: Calfeed
providers.description: Calfeed is a calendar publishing web app that lets users paste schedules, upload PDFs, photos, or spreadsheets, and instantly generate shareable calendar links for Apple, Google, or Outlook. Built by founder Ryan Scherf, Calfeed aims to simplify broadcasting schedules to audiences, offering features like event validation, gap detection, and quick calendar feed generation.

providers.name: Caliber Collision Centers
providers.description: Caliber Collision Centers provides automotive collision repair, auto glass replacement, and fleet services across a national network of locations. The company emphasizes trusted service, skilled technicians, and a purpose-driven approach to restoring customers’ vehicles and lives. It offers online estimates, appointment scheduling, and flexible payment options, serving both individual drivers and commercial fleets.

providers.name: Campus
providers.description: Campus (campus.edu) is an accredited, for-profit online community college offering associate degree programs built on the CUNY ASAP high-touch support model, with live classes taught by faculty from top universities, personal success coaching, and tuition capped at the Pell Grant maximum. Founded by Tade Oyerinde and backed by Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Bloomberg Beta, 8VC, Rethink Education and others, Campus focuses on affordable, accessible higher education and career preparation across programs such as applied AI, business, information technology and healthcare administration. This profile was surfaced as a venture portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web surface; Campus is a consumer education provider and publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Chekin
providers.description: Chekin provides a comprehensive online check‑in platform for hospitality businesses, automating guest registration, identity verification, e‑invoicing, tax compliance and remote key access. Their solution includes a developer SDK and API that enable property managers to integrate check‑in, compliance reporting and payment processing into their own systems, supporting multi‑language and multi‑country regulations.

providers.name: Chief Human Capital Officers Council
providers.description: The Chief Human Capital Officers (CHCO) Council is the principal interagency forum to advise and coordinate the activities of members on matters of modernization of human resources (HR) systems, improved quality of human resources information, and legislation affecting human resources operations and organizations across the U.S. federal government. Established under the Chief Human Capital Officers Act of 2002 (5 U.S.C. 1401-1402), the Council is chaired by the Director of the U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) with the Deputy Director for Management at OMB serving as Vice Chair. The CHCO Council coordinates federal human capital management strategy, supports the Federal HR workforce, advances workforce planning and talent acquisition, and oversees performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, and HR policy implementation across departments and agencies.

providers.name: CircuitLab
providers.description: CircuitLab, Inc. is an in-browser schematic capture and circuit simulation platform that lets engineers, students, educators, and hobbyists design and analyze analog and digital electronics systems before building a physical prototype. Running entirely in the browser with no installation, it offers schematic capture, mixed-signal SPICE-style simulation (DC, AC, transient, frequency-domain), custom device models and symbols, expression-based parameters, and shareable, exportable documentation. CircuitLab also publishes an electronics curriculum (CircuitLab Academy, the Ultimate Electronics textbook), community forums, and an electronics Q&A. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. At the time of this enrichment pass CircuitLab publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API description, so this profile captures its public web identity only.

providers.name: claimsforce
providers.description: claimsforce GmbH is a Hamburg-based insurtech building AI-powered software for property and casualty claims management and underwriting. Its platform helps insurers, loss-adjusting and expert organizations, and independent adjusters digitize the end-to-end claims process - automating report and calculation generation, enabling video-based remote case assessment, optimizing adjuster disposition and route planning to cut travel time, and surfacing real-time analytics for claims handling and risk management. Named customers include Zurich Gruppe Deutschland, HanseMerkur, Concordia, Crawford, Sedgwick and Die Regulierer. The product is a private, login-only SaaS with no public API or developer portal as of July 2026. The company is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (TUV Rheinland) and backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Click Mechanic
providers.description: ClickMechanic is the UK's leading online car-repair marketplace, founded in 2012, that connects car owners with vetted mobile mechanics and independent garages for repairs, servicing, diagnostics, and MOTs. Customers enter their registration and symptoms to get an instant fixed-price quote, then book a vetted mechanic for same- or next-day work at home or the roadside, with payment taken only after the job is completed. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. ClickMechanic operates a consumer- and mechanic-facing web platform (Ruby on Rails on Heroku) and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API catalog at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cloover
providers.description: Cloover is a climate-fintech company building an all-in-one, "Shopify of energy" platform for the residential renewable-energy transition. It connects the stakeholders of home energy - installers, homeowners (prosumers), manufacturers, energy providers and investors - so small and mid-sized installation firms can sell, quote, finance and manage solar panels, home batteries, heat pumps and EV charging in a single package. The platform pairs installer sales and operations software with embedded financing and energy management, and offers homeowners flexible subscription and financing options. Founded in 2023 and operating primarily in Germany, Austria and wider Europe, Cloover has raised sizeable seed and Series A equity plus a large debt facility and is backed by QED Investors, MMC Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital and others.

providers.name: CloudLab Works
providers.description: CloudLab Works provides open-source, MIT‑licensed reliability tools for hybrid multicloud and AI infrastructure. The platform offers a suite of MCP utilities, event processing libraries, and detailed write‑ups to help developers build robust AI agents. It emphasizes privacy‑first data handling, extensive documentation, and community‑driven support, aiming to simplify complex cloud‑lab environments for both research and production workloads.

providers.name: Corduro
providers.description: Corduro is a payments-as-a-service company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Southlake, Texas, offering a mobile, online, and point-of-sale payment platform for small businesses, enterprises, and organizations. Its platform enables merchants to accept credit-card and electronic-check payments, bill pay, recurring billing, text giving, and event and donation payments through a single intelligent payment gateway that is advertised to reduce processing fees by 20% or more. Corduro bundles eCommerce, Engage, Events, Text Giving, and Developer Tools products, provides embeddable iFrame and API-based payment integrations, and markets PCI compliance as a managed capability. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and enriched from the company's public web presence; Corduro publishes no public OpenAPI, developer portal, or API reference, gating developer/API access behind sales contact.

providers.name: Craigslist
providers.description: Craigslist is a classified advertisements website founded in 1995, offering sections for jobs, housing, for‑sale items, services, community, and events across many U.S. cities and international locations. It operates as a simple, user‑generated platform without a formal public API, relying on web interfaces and RSS feeds for data access.

providers.name: Dolphin Industrial Parts
providers.description: Dolphin Industrial Parts supplies EU‑made compatible spare parts for marine and industrial equipment, including pumps, fresh water generators, filters, UV sterilizers, heat exchangers, tank cleaning machines, and compressors. They quote in USD, ship from Michigan, and serve engineers in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The company offers a broad catalog of non‑OEM parts sourced from leading manufacturers, providing alternatives for pumps, fresh water generators, self‑cleaning filters, UV sterilizers, re‑hardening filters, plate heat exchanger gaskets, and more.
