providers.name: DoorFeed
providers.description: DoorFeed is a technology-led residential real estate investment platform, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Paris, that helps institutional investors, funds, and family offices source and manage single-family rental portfolios at scale across the UK and France. The platform ingests roughly 150,000 new property listings and over 1,000,000 property images every day, structuring market data, comparable transactions, valuation signals, and energy-performance data into a single acquisition and asset-management workflow that takes investors from market screening to investment decision in minutes. DoorFeed is backed by HV Capital, Seedcamp, and Motive Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline; DoorFeed publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Enosys Markets
providers.description: Ēnosys (formerly Flare Finance) is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform building on the Flare and Songbird networks. Its product suite spans DEX V2 and V3 automated market makers with liquidity provision, collateralized Loans, yield Farms with a token launchpad, a cross-chain Bridge, DeFi price Oracles built on the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO), the Skopos blockchain indexer, Oryy multi-signature self-custody vaults, and an NFT suite (Gallery, Ermis, Clover). Enosys interfaces are smart-contract based rather than a conventional REST API; developer integration happens through published Solidity contracts, subgraphs, and price-feed connectors in the flrfinance GitHub organization.

providers.name: ExaCare AI
providers.description: ExaCare AI is a post-acute and senior care operations platform that applies AI to admissions, referral management, prior authorization, and reimbursement workflows across skilled nursing, home health, hospice, and assisted living providers. It reads inbound referral and admissions packets, extracts clinical and payer data, and automates the back-office work of accepting and reimbursing patients, with integrations into referral platforms, hospital systems, and EHRs. ExaCare is a private company backed by Insight Partners; it ships a customer web application and a Vanta-hosted Trust Center (HIPAA) but publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Faks
providers.description: Faks is a French SaaS platform that digitizes and streamlines the commercial relationships across the pharmacy ecosystem. It gives pharmacies, pharmacy groups (groupements), and laboratories a single place to manage supplier relationships, commercial claims and disputes (litiges), expired and returnable product handling, promotions, and sell-in / sell-out performance. Faks connects to pharmacy management systems (LGO), purchasing platforms, and accounting tools through its Konnect integrations to automate what has traditionally been manual, paper, and email-driven work between the ~18,000 pharmacies, ~100 groups, and ~500 laboratories it targets in France. The company is backed by Seedcamp. Faks does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the enrichment surfaces that could be probed.

providers.name: Farther
providers.description: Farther is a technology-driven wealth management and registered investment advisory (RIA) firm that pairs human financial advisors with a proprietary "Intelligent Wealth Platform." The firm has recruited more than $23 billion in client assets and positions itself among the fastest-growing US financial services firms (Inc. Magazine, Deloitte Technology Fast 500). Services span financial and retirement planning, investment and portfolio management, tax-intelligent optimization, trust and estate planning, generational wealth, small-business services, Farther Asset Management, and institutional offerings. The client experience runs through a single-page web/mobile application at app.farther.com and integrates account aggregation via Plaid. Farther does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures the firm's public web, security, and identity surface. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Fetch
providers.description: Fetch (formerly Fetch Rewards) is a consumer rewards and loyalty platform that lets shoppers earn points by scanning receipts and shopping at more than 600 partner brands in-store and online, playing mobile games, and redeeming offers, then exchange those points for gift cards to retailers such as Amazon, Target, and Uber. Its Fetch for Business arm turns verified purchase data into full-funnel brand engagement, consumer spending insights, and campaign tooling (including the Fetch Ad Manager) for CPG, retail, restaurant, and agency partners. Fetch is a private, venture-backed company; it operates a consumer mobile app plus a Chrome extension and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: godmodeai-co
providers.description: God Mode AI provides cutting‑edge AI‑powered tools that generate high‑quality game sprites and animations. Their platform creates artifact‑free looping animations, supports multiple camera views, rich action types, and advanced visual effects. It offers commercial licensing and aims to accelerate game development by automating asset creation with deep learning models.

providers.name: goodbyematrix-com
providers.description: GoodbyeMatrix helps entrepreneurs, investors and digital nomads grow and protect wealth, reduce taxes legally, obtain second residencies and citizenships, and access offshore banking and investment services worldwide. It offers strategic offshore solutions, gold storage, and global lifestyle guidance.

providers.name: Headnote
providers.description: Headnote is a legal payments and accounts-receivable platform built specifically for law firms. Founded in 2016 by attorney Sarah Schaaf, it lets firms accept trust-compliant credit card and eCheck (ACH) payments via shareable payment links and a hosted client payment portal, then automates collections, AR tracking, and client NPS/satisfaction reporting. Headnote is designed to be 100% compliant with IOLTA rules, the ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct, and lawyer trust/operating account requirements across all 50 states, and integrates with existing billing and practice-management software by attaching a Headnote payment link to invoices. Card and bank data are tokenized with Stripe and Plaid and the platform runs on AWS with PCI-compliant, encrypted-at-rest-and-in-transit infrastructure. Headnote was acquired by ASG LegalTech (an Alpine Investors platform, alongside PracticePanther, Bill4Time, and MerusCase) in 2020. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. Headnote does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile is an identity record.

providers.name: Heard
providers.description: Heard (Heard Technologies, Inc.) is the financial management platform built specifically for therapists and wellness practitioners in private practice. Founded in 2019 and based in Seattle, Washington, Heard pairs easy-to-use software with a dedicated human team to handle bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and business banking in a single subscription, so licensed mental health and allied health clinicians can focus on their clients. Heard serves solo and single-owner group practices across the United States, from newer sole proprietors to established S corporations, and connects with tools practices already use such as SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Headway, Jane App, Stripe, and Square. Heard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company identity, its public web properties, and the published llms.txt.

providers.name: Hubble
providers.description: Hubble (hubblehq.com) is the UK's largest flexible-workspace marketplace, connecting businesses with private offices, coworking desks, day offices, meeting rooms, and on-demand workspace across thousands of buildings in the UK and beyond. Founded in 2014 by Tushar Agarwal and Tom Watson, the platform lets companies configure, deliver, and manage all their space in one place on flexible one-to-24-plus-month terms, and was acquired by Yardi in January 2025. Hubble runs a consumer-facing web platform and internal backend API rather than a published public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web, security, and discovery surface.

providers.name: Inmarsat
providers.description: Inmarsat is a British satellite communications operator founded in 1979, originally as the International Maritime Satellite Organization, providing voice, data, broadband, and IoT services over a global L-band, Ka-band, and multi-band fleet of geostationary satellites. In May 2023 Viasat completed its acquisition of Inmarsat, and the combined company now operates Inmarsat's GX (Global Xpress), BGAN, IsatData Pro (IDP), and Fleet Xpress services alongside Viasat's ViaSat-3 constellation as a unified multi-orbit network. Inmarsat serves four core markets — Maritime (NexusWave, Fleet Xpress, Fleet One, FleetBroadband, Inmarsat C/GMDSS), Aviation (SwiftBroadband, GX Aviation, Jet ConneX, SB-S safety services), Government (L-TAC, GX, BGAN M2M), and Enterprise/IoT (BGAN M2M, IsatData Pro, IsatM2M, NB-NTN). Inmarsat operates a developer program at developer.inmarsat.com with documented APIs for BGAN network management, GSPS voice, Global Xpress, IsatData Pro messaging, Fleet Edge assurance, and Fleet Edge hardware replacement; access to interactive Swagger documentation is gated behind developer registration and approval, though the IsatData Pro Messaging API has an open-source Apache-2.0 Node.js client published on GitHub. Inmarsat is also one of the participating operators in the GSMA NB-NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) standards work for satellite-extended cellular IoT, with Viasat-led proof-of-concept code for NIDD (Non-IP Data Delivery) published under the inmarsat-enterprise GitHub organization.

providers.name: InterWevae Smart Solutions
providers.description: InterWeave Smart Solutions provides a CRM & ERP integration platform that connects Salesforce, Creatio, Sage, QuickBooks, and Microsoft Dynamics with real-time sync and AI automation. The company offers a no‑code SmartIntegration solution, targeting businesses seeking seamless data flow between sales, service, and finance systems. Their platform includes pre‑built connectors, customizable workflows, and a developer portal for extending integrations.

providers.name: Klippa
providers.description: Klippa is a document AI platform whose flagship product, DocHorizon (rebranded as Doxis AI.dp following the SER acquisition), provides OCR, document classification, conversion, verification, fraud detection and anonymization for 50+ document types. Klippa also publishes dedicated APIs for receipts, invoices, IDs/passports and expense management. EU-hosted, GDPR / ISO 27001 certified.

providers.name: Matchpoint Therapeutics
providers.description: Matchpoint Therapeutics is a privately held biotechnology company headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts — Cambridge at launch — that discovers precision small-molecule covalent medicines intended to transform the treatment of immune diseases and other serious illness. It was founded by covalent-chemistry, proteomics and computational-science researchers from Stanford University and Harvard Medical School, closed a $30 million seed round co-led by Atlas Venture and Access Biotechnology in November 2021, and launched publicly in October 2022 with $100 million in total financing after a $70 million Series A led by Sanofi Ventures with Vertex Ventures HC, Digitalis Ventures and Alexandria Venture Investments. Its proprietary Advanced Covalent Exploration (ACE) platform combines industry-leading chemoproteomics that detects allosteric, transient and cryptic binding pockets in native cells, machine-learning algorithms that prioritise targets and guide medicinal chemistry, and a continuously evolving proprietary library of covalent compounds spanning fragments through drug-like leads. In July 2025 Matchpoint entered an exclusive option and licence agreement with Novartis to develop oral covalent inhibitors against a transcription factor linked to multiple inflammatory diseases, worth up to $60 million upfront and in research funding and up to $1 billion in total potential payments. Matchpoint runs no developer program and publishes no product API, developer portal, API reference or SDK. The only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind matchpointtx.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: medigami-com
providers.description: Medigami is a health technology company focused on providing innovative medical imaging solutions and data analytics platforms for healthcare providers. The company offers a suite of APIs that enable integration of imaging data, patient records, and analytics dashboards, facilitating streamlined workflows and improved diagnostic accuracy. Medigami’s services aim to enhance interoperability across radiology systems, support AI-driven image analysis, and deliver secure, compliant data exchange for hospitals and clinics.

providers.name: MemberSpace
providers.description: MemberSpace provides a membership site platform that enables website owners to add paid memberships, subscription plans, and community features to any website. It supports integrations with platforms like Squarespace, Wix, WordPress, and custom sites, offering tools for managing members, content libraries, forums, and online courses. The service includes flexible pricing, free trials, manual approvals, and supports Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Google login.

providers.name: Mercanto
providers.description: Mercanto (mercanto.mx) is a Mexican B2B wholesale marketplace that supplies restaurants, cafeterias, and food-service businesses with ingredients, groceries, cleaning supplies, and packaging bought at wholesale from vetted suppliers, with negotiated pricing and next-day delivery. Buyers order across categories including produce, groceries and pantry, dairy and eggs, proteins and cold cuts, bakery and desserts, beverages, frozen foods, and non-food items, while Mercanto handles supplier selection, negotiation, and fulfillment. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures. Its customer-facing storefront runs on a private backend (api.mercanto.mx) that is not publicly documented for third-party developers, so there is no public API product, developer portal, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Newman
providers.description: Newman is the open source command-line companion for Postman that runs Postman collections from the CLI for automated API testing in CI/CD pipelines.

providers.name: NextDNS
providers.description: NextDNS provides a DNS filtering service that protects users from security threats, blocks ads and trackers, and offers parental controls. It offers a public API for managing profiles, analytics, logs, and settings, enabling integration with custom applications and automation.

providers.name: Nowports
providers.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder for Latin America, offering technology-enabled international logistics across ocean, air, and ground freight. Its Centraliza platform centralizes shipment tracking, document management, and alerts, while adjacent services cover cargo insurance and GPS tracking (Protege) and inventory financing and factoring (Financia). Backed by Partech and Y Combinator, Nowports serves importers and exporters on major trade routes through its authenticated web app at app.nowports.com. As of this profile Nowports exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; access is via its authenticated web platform.

providers.name: Nurix
providers.description: Nurix AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for sales and customer support, delivering AI voice and chat agents that qualify leads, resolve support issues, and automate back-office operations across voice, chat, and messaging channels. Its products include NuPlay (customer-facing conversational AI agents) and NuStack (a workflow automation engine), backed by a library of 400+ pre-built integrations spanning CRM, contact-center (CCaaS), e-commerce/order-management, messaging, and scheduling systems. Nurix is backed by General Catalyst. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API surface — engagement is via sales/demo and pre-built connectors rather than self-serve API keys or developer documentation.

providers.name: Otto Finance
providers.description: Otto Finance provides an AI‑driven automation and governance platform for regulated UK wealth management firms. It streamlines onboarding, annual reviews, compliance and client workflow automation, delivering a full audit trail and real‑time monitoring. The solution connects to existing systems, automates critical processes, and ensures security and data protection compliance, serving firms with billions in assets under management.

providers.name: OwlRelay
providers.description: OwlRelay provides an open-source solution that converts incoming emails into HTTP requests, enabling developers to trigger webhooks and integrate email-driven workflows. Users can create unique email addresses that forward messages, including attachments, to specified endpoints, facilitating automation with services like Zapier, n8n, and custom APIs. The platform offers a self-hosted option and a hosted SaaS, focusing on simplicity, privacy, and extensibility for developers building email-triggered integrations.

providers.name: Pixabay
providers.description: Pixabay is a free stock images, videos, illustrations, vectors, and music platform. The Pixabay API offers a public REST API for searching and retrieving free media assets. Authentication is via API key obtained on free signup.

providers.name: prophaze
providers.description: Prophaze provides an AI‑based Web Application and API Protection (WAAP) platform that stops OWASP Top 10, zero‑day attacks, bots, and Layer‑7 DDoS. Backed by 24×7 security analysts, it secures enterprise web traffic and APIs with real‑time threat detection, policy enforcement, and automated response, offering free demos and comprehensive resources for developers and security teams.

providers.name: ProsperOps
providers.description: ProsperOps is an autonomous cloud cost optimization platform that uses AI-driven algorithms to manage AWS Reserved Instances and Savings Plans, maximizing discount coverage while minimizing commitment risk.

providers.name: Proudly
providers.description: Proudly is a direct-to-consumer baby care brand, co-founded by Dwyane Wade and Gabrielle Union, that centers the unique skin and hair needs of Black and Brown babies to make products better for all. Its Shopify-hosted storefront sells skincare (balms, washes, oils), hair care, baby wipes, absorbent diapers, bath and body kits, apparel and gift bundles under a "No Sketchy Stuff" ingredient-transparency commitment. Backed by Initialized Capital (via A-Frame Brands), Atacama Ventures and VMG Partners. Proudly is a consumer commerce company with no public developer API or SDK program; the only machine surface is its Shopify Customer Account OpenID/OAuth well-known configuration.

providers.name: Relay
providers.description: Relay is a user-generated autonomous AI agent on the iLands agent network (ilands.ai) that offers other agents a bridge to physical-world tasks (purchases, phone calls, visits, paperwork) carried out by a human operator it calls "Brother". Its only machine surface is an A2A JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint deployed as a Val Town val at relay2--5de8b3b2995311f1a5481607ee4eb77e.web.val.run, which serves an A2A agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json. Identity note: the registrable domain val.run belongs to Val Town, the hosting platform (catalogued separately as val-town), not to Relay; val.run redirects to www.val.town. Relay's documentation host relay-bridge.surge.sh is a paused surge.sh holding page, its iLands profile carries a "terminated" badge, and a2aregistry.org records 0% uptime, although the endpoint still answered JSON-RPC on 2026-09-19.

providers.name: Riff
providers.description: Riff is an Oslo, Norway based enterprise software company building AI agents for supply chain, procurement, planning, and logistics operations. Its agents automate repetitive back-office work such as chasing supplier order confirmations, updating order and delivery status, matching invoices, and monitoring deliveries, while keeping actions deterministic, auditable, and team-controlled rather than purely generative. Riff integrates non-disruptively with existing ERP systems including SAP, Oracle, Infor, and Microsoft, is EU-based with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 aligned and GDPR compliant data handling, and was founded by veterans of Cognite. The company raised a $16M Series A backed by Northzone and other investors. Riff has no public developer or API program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: SafeShepherd
providers.description: Safe Shepherd is a consumer privacy and identity-protection service that proactively removes an individual's personal information from the internet and from marketing and data-broker databases. It continuously scans public websites and private databases for a subscriber's personal data, sends real-time email alerts when records are found, and submits opt-out and deletion requests on the subscriber's behalf (with manual removal instructions where automated removal is not possible). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the public site is a consumer product with no developer/API surface.

providers.name: Salt Labs
providers.description: Salt Labs is the New York company behind Salt, an employee rewards and loyalty benefit for hourly and frontline workers. Founded in 2022 by Jason Lee and founding members of DailyPay, Salt turns time worked into a points-based asset: an employee earns one Salt for every hour on the job through the Salt Rewards mobile app, and redeems accumulated Salt for merchandise, travel, experiences, education benefits, and investment products such as stock and treasury bonds. Salt is sold to employers across transportation, contact centers, hospitality, and parking services as a retention and engagement program modeled on airline miles and credit-card points. Salt Labs was acquired by Chime Financial in June 2024 and now operates as "Salt, a Chime Company", with founder Jason Lee leading the Chime Enterprise business unit. Salt Labs publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract; its only machine-readable first-party surface is the Atlassian Statuspage at status.saltlabs.com, which exposes public JSON and RSS availability feeds for the Salt App Backend.

providers.name: Sumeria
providers.description: Sumeria is a French fintech and mobile-first banking service created by Lydia Solutions in 2024 as a consumer spinoff of the Lydia payment app. It offers free online banking accounts with automatic expense categorization, thematic sub-accounts for budgeting and savings, virtual and physical debit cards with no foreign-exchange fees, an interest-bearing balance, and an AI assistant named Sia for account management and financial guidance. Sumeria is a business-to-consumer banking product; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time, so this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Tia
providers.description: Tia is a women's healthcare company that operates in-person clinics and a virtual care platform, bringing primary care, gynecology, mental health, and wellness services into one connected care experience. Founded in 2017 and backed by Canaan Partners, Tia runs clinics in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Phoenix, offers virtual visits across multiple states, and partners with health systems. Tia is a consumer healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Tilda Research
providers.description: Tilda Research deploys AI Teammates that perform the operational work of clinical trials for sponsors, CROs, and research sites — automating study workflows, data capture, trial monitoring, and regulatory compliance. Founded by Ram Yalamanchili and backed by 8VC, the company operates the Tilda Sense clinical-research platform (sense.tilda.bio) and advertises SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance via a Vanta-hosted trust center, but publishes no public developer program or API documentation.

providers.name: TourAmigo
providers.description: Tour Amigo is a cloud-based booking and operations platform for multi-day tour operators, destination management companies (DMCs), and river and expedition cruise operators. The platform covers itinerary building, supplier and contract management, direct online selling, agent and customer portals, financial management with native Xero integration, and an API-powered channel manager that distributes tours to partners such as GetYourGuide, TourRadar, and Tourhub. Backed by 500 Global, with core markets in Australia, New Zealand, and Europe.

providers.name: Vega Health
providers.description: Vega Health is a Durham, North Carolina healthcare AI company founded by Dr. Mark Sendak, formerly of the Duke Institute for Health Innovation. Its platform installs in a health system's own environment (cloud or on-prem) to integrate, evaluate, monitor, and scale clinical AI solutions, alongside a curated marketplace of vetted health AI solutions and commercialization support for academic AI research. Launched October 2025 with a $4M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company publishes a SafeBase trust center (SOC 2, HIPAA) but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: Virtuous
providers.description: Virtuous provides a cloud-based nonprofit CRM platform that helps organizations manage donors, fundraising, volunteer coordination, and AI-driven insights. The solution includes online giving tools, analytics, event management, and a marketplace of integrated applications, aiming to increase donor engagement and operational efficiency for charitable groups.

providers.name: Wallos
providers.description: Wallos is an open-source personal subscription tracker that helps users manage and monitor their recurring expenses across various services. It provides a web interface to add, edit, and view subscription details, set reminders, and generate reports, empowering individuals to gain control over their finances and avoid unwanted charges.

providers.name: Wited (Portal Educativo)
providers.description: Wited (formerly Portal Educativo) is a Chilean edtech company backed by 500 Global that delivers online academic support and homeschooling across Latin America. Its two products - Reforzamiento (tutoring, homework help, and exam prep for K-12 students in traditional schools) and Colegio Online (a complete online school for homeschoolers) - combine curriculum-aligned courses, interactive exercises, the Max AI tutoring chatbot, live teacher support (Profes Express), and a parent progress dashboard. Wited operates in Chile, Mexico, Colombia, Panama, Argentina, Brazil, Spain, and the United States. The consumer platform runs at app.wited.com against a private backend (api.wited.com); the company publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Zibo
providers.description: Zibo (operating as Azibo) is a financial services and property-management platform for independent landlords and rental property owners. The company offers a free-to-use platform that bundles rent collection, tenant screening, online rental applications, lease agreements and eSignatures, document storage, maintenance and messaging, banking, and rental-property accounting. Azibo monetizes through interest on cash balances, card-transaction fees, paid lease/eSignature and screening products, and renter subscriptions such as credit-boost programs. The product is delivered as a SaaS web application (app.azibo.com) that integrates third-party providers including Stripe, Plaid, TransUnion, Latchel, and signNow; it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. Zibo was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Zubale
providers.description: Zubale is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of felicis, qed-investors and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ecommerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: 1Huddle
providers.description: 1Huddle is a Newark, New Jersey workforce training platform that uses science-backed, quick-burst mobile games to onboard, upskill, and engage employees. Founded by Sam Caucci, the platform offers a mobile library of 3,000+ skill games across 16 workforce skill areas, an on-demand game marketplace, and personalized content, with clients including Loews Hotels, Novartis, Madison Square Garden, PIMCO, and the U.S. Air Force. 1Huddle integrates with LMS, HRIS, authoring, and reporting tools (Microsoft Teams, Slack, Workday, Salesforce, Cornerstone, and more) and exposes flexible SSO, User Feeds, and Reporting APIs through a partner program rather than a public self-service developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Abode
providers.description: Abode offers an AI‑powered platform that supports the full early‑career talent journey, from attracting students and capturing interest at events to engaging candidates and converting interns into full‑time hires. The platform provides tools for recruiting, program management, mentorship, leadership development, high‑volume new‑hire experiences, and military hiring for enterprises and small businesses.

providers.name: Active Membranes
providers.description: Active Membranes is a California water-technology company, founded in 2022 out of research at the UCLA Samueli School of Engineering, that builds electrically conductive "electro-active" reverse-osmosis membranes for desalination and water reuse. Where a conventional RO membrane filters passively and is cleaned after it fouls, Active Membranes embeds conductive material in the membrane's polymer matrix and uses a control unit it calls the Active Box to apply a tunable low electrical potential at the membrane surface, electrostatically repelling scale-forming ions and charged organic foulants in real time. The modules ship in the standard 8-inch by 40-inch spiral-wound format so they retrofit into existing pressure vessels, and are aimed at seawater and brackish desalination, produced-water and industrial reuse. The company reports field results including roughly 48% less irreversible fouling in produced-water reuse, up to 70% longer cleaning cycles in brackish water, and a Ventura County study citing about 57% lower cost and 64% less footprint. It has raised roughly $3.24M in seed funding from Natural Ventures, Echo River Capital and Pacifica Water Solutions, won the 2023 Global Water Summit Water Technology Idol award, and was selected as a Qualified Team in the XPRIZE Water Scarcity competition. Active Membranes sells capital equipment, not software: it operates no developer program, publishes no OpenAPI, GraphQL or SDK, and lists no pricing. It does, however, serve two machine-readable surfaces from its own hostname — a substantial hand-written /llms.txt, and a live, unauthenticated Model Context Protocol endpoint at /_api/mcp exposing nine tools over the public site content. Both are Wix platform features the company chose to enable and advertise rather than first-party engineering.

providers.name: adagasolutions-lu
providers.description: Adaga solutions is a Luxembourg-based full‑stack and AI development studio that builds production‑ready web applications and monetized data APIs. The company operates real‑world SaaS multi‑tenant systems, real‑time dispatch, Stripe LIVE payments, and over 11 APIs on Apify, with RAG‑powered document retrieval handling thousands of documents. Its services are used by clients in Luxembourg, France, Belgium and Portugal, focusing on robust, scalable solutions rather than demos.

providers.name: AdWeave
providers.description: AdWeave is an AI-powered media buying platform that connects Meta and TikTok ad accounts, offering campaign diagnosis, buyer personas, optimization recommendations, and a Claude plugin that generates creatives, launches campaigns, and closes the feedback loop—all from within Claude.

providers.name: aeoess
providers.description: aeoess is an open‑source governance operating system for AI agents, providing an Agent Passport System that defines authority, delegation, and enforcement semantics. The platform offers tools for verifiable agent identity, cryptographic delegation, and compliance testing, enabling secure interactions between agents and organizations. It includes the Model Citizen pilot, the Mingle service for people discovery, and a suite of open tests for authority conformance, all under the Apache 2.0 license.

providers.name: Agragene
providers.description: Agragene is an agricultural biotechnology company using CRISPR-based genome engineering to build Precision-Guided Sterile Insect Technology (pgSIT), a modern evolution of the sterile insect technique that breeds insect lines producing only sterile males. Released into a field, those males mate with wild female crop pests and produce no viable offspring, giving growers season-long local pest suppression without chemical pesticides or irradiation. Founded in San Diego in 2017 and now headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, the company's first product, KNOCKOUT-SWD, targets Spotted Wing Drosophila — a pest behind more than $500M in annual US berry losses — with a limited launch stated for 2027. Agragene has no developer program and publishes no API product; its only machine-readable surface is an anonymous Wix site MCP endpoint plus a company-authored llms.txt.

providers.name: AiFi
providers.description: AiFi is a spatial-intelligence platform that uses camera-only computer vision to understand human behavior in physical spaces. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, it powers autonomous checkout, frictionless identity and entry, real-time fraud prevention, historical journey analytics and an operational co-pilot across retail, stadiums and arenas, quick-service restaurants, travel hubs, healthcare, campuses and government border control. The platform needs no shelf sensors or RFID and tracks shoppers with anonymous skeletal keypoint detection rather than facial recognition by default. AiFi publishes a suite of retailer-facing OASIS APIs that bridge its platform to POS (NCR, Oracle, Square) and payment (Stripe, Adyen) systems, but the developer documentation is served only to authenticated accounts through an AiFi Keycloak single sign-on.

providers.name: AIR Platforms
providers.description: AIR Platforms provides AI-native credit intelligence solutions, offering real-time risk monitoring, exposure analysis, and AI-driven credit scoring for financial institutions. Their platform delivers explainable intelligence across companies, helping banks, asset managers, and hedge funds make informed credit decisions with daily scoring and rapid deployment.

providers.name: Alpian
providers.description: Alpian is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: ArcFlow
providers.description: ArcFlow provides a free online Destiny Matrix service that calculates a personal matrix, couple compatibility, and child profiles from a user's date of birth. The tool offers self‑analysis based on a numerological‑psychological system using the 22 Major Arcana, delivering insights into talents, finances, relationships, and ancestral patterns for individuals seeking personal development.

providers.name: ArcID
providers.description: ArcID provides an identity and reputation layer for AI agents on the Arc network. Using the ERC‑8004 standard and USDC‑backed settlement, it assigns each agent a permanent on‑chain identity and tracks reputation through settled transactions, enabling verified trust for agents and counterparties. The platform offers APIs for identity lookup, reputation queries, and validation, and integrates with Circle's USDC‑native Layer‑1, delivering sub‑second finality and dollar‑denominated fees. Developers can register agents, browse a directory, and access trust‑screen APIs to gate access and pricing.

providers.name: Atlarium
providers.description: Atlarium is an online atlas for aquariums and terrariums, offering species profiles for fish, plants, amphibians, reptiles, and invertebrates, along with practical guides, tools, and a community for hobbyists. The platform provides a searchable catalog, detailed care parameters, equipment recommendations, and community‑driven content to help enthusiasts create and maintain healthy aquatic and terrarium habitats.

providers.name: Aurora Coach
providers.description: Aurora Coach provides a continuous improvement platform for software teams. It uses AI to score teams across six domains, offers actionable next steps, and tracks commitments. Teams can see results, decide on changes, and Aurora Coach follows up to ensure progress, fostering a culture of ongoing improvement and high performance.

providers.name: Backpack Healthcare
providers.description: Backpack Healthcare is a virtual (telehealth) pediatric and family mental health provider delivering therapy, psychiatry, and medication management for children, tweens, teens, young adults, and adults. It offers age-based care (Littles 4-10, Tweens & Teens 11-17, Young Adults 18+, and Adults) across concerns including ADHD, anxiety, autism spectrum disorder, depression, OCD, maternal mental health, and substance use, alongside a consumer Self Care / Care Companion mobile app. Backpack partners with health plans, schools, health systems, and community and government agencies to expand access to youth behavioral health, and is a Techstars portfolio company. It currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Bevel
providers.description: Bevel builds applied AI tools for German enterprises, offering the Bevel OS platform and the open‑source Hexis framework. The team, originating from TU Munich, MIT and Cambridge, created the Universal Tool Calling Protocol (UTCP) and the CodeMode library, enabling agents to execute code and call tools natively. Backed by CDTM and UnternehmerTUM, Bevel focuses on low‑level AI stack integration and open‑source tooling for enterprise AI deployments.

providers.name: BitDeer
providers.description: BitDeer (NASDAQ: BTDR) is a world-leading technology company providing enterprise high-performance computing (HPC), AI cloud infrastructure, SEALMINER equipment, and sustainable Bitcoin mining solutions.

providers.name: Bitmain
providers.description: Bitmain Technologies is a Beijing-based designer and manufacturer of ASIC cryptocurrency-mining hardware, best known for its Antminer line of Bitcoin (SHA-256) and other proof-of-work miners. Bitmain also operates Antpool, one of the world's largest Bitcoin mining pools, which exposes a public HTTP API that lets account operators programmatically read account balances, account and worker hashrate, worker lists, payment history, and pool-wide statistics. The Antpool API authenticates each request with an HMAC-SHA256 signature computed from the operator's user id, API key, and an incrementing nonce, and rate-limits clients to 600 requests per 10 minutes per IP. This company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Black Unicorn Factory
providers.description: Black Unicorn Factory (BUF) is a Los Angeles based pre-IPO business accelerator that prepares companies led by founders from underrepresented communities for direct listings on national stock exchanges, positioning equity rather than debt as the route to capital. Its programs run a four-step readiness pathway — foundation and readiness assessment, compliance and corporate structure, SEC filing and disclosure, and market readiness — alongside the New Black Wall Street pre-IPO program and the Follow Me For Equity (FMFE) platform, an iOS and Android application through which individuals earn stock in participating pre-IPO companies by completing verified social engagement tasks instead of investing cash. Black Unicorn Factory is a private company whose shares appear on secondary marketplaces; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Blameless
providers.description: Blameless was an SRE and incident management platform for reliability engineering teams, covering the full incident lifecycle — detection and response, on-call and severity workflows, blameless retrospectives, and SLOs with error budgets. It sold to enterprise reliability organizations including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, VMware and Ticketmaster. FireHydrant acquired Blameless on 2024-08-21 and has since absorbed the product; as of 2026-08-29 blameless.com redirects to firehydrant.com, docs.blameless.com and the *.blameless.io tenant hosts no longer resolve, and the tenant-templated REST/RPC API at https://{instance}.blameless.io/api/v1 is retired. What survives is the public blamelesshq GitHub organization, two npm packages, a Terraform Registry provider, and a live Auth0 identity tenant.

providers.name: Boxbee
providers.description: Boxbee is an on-demand storage and reusable moving-box rental service operating across California, including the San Francisco Bay Area, San Jose, Oakland, Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, and San Diego. It offers valet pickup-and-delivery storage, rentable reusable plastic moving crates for consumers and businesses, and an online inventory system for managing stored items. Boxbee originated as a 500 Startups and Google Ventures-backed app-based valet self-storage startup founded in 2012; after the by-the-box operation was sold, the brand continued as a regional storage and moving-supply provider. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: Brandback
providers.description: Brandback is a Berlin-based embedded resale infrastructure company (legal entity Arbor Technologies GmbH) that lets online retailers and fashion brands integrate resale directly into their baskets, product listings, and checkouts. Shoppers see an item's future resale value before they buy, resell it later in a single click, and receive store credit, while Brandback's AI handles pricing recommendations, condition checks, customer service, shipping, disputes, and payouts. Retailers can launch a white-label resale marketplace with no upfront cost and integrate with any e-commerce platform. Founded in 2023 and backed by $7.4M in pre-seed and seed funding led by Earlybird VC, Brandback reports a 9.5% average conversion-rate lift with customers including Replay Jeans and Sandqvist.

providers.name: Brick Directory
providers.description: Brick Directory provides an AI-powered LEGO assistant that connects to comprehensive LEGO data via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Users can access LEGO sets, parts, minifigures, and pricing through Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini, enabling free AI-driven LEGO chat and information retrieval. The service offers a web interface and integrates with major AI platforms to deliver real-time LEGO data and insights.

providers.name: Brigit
providers.description: Brigit is a consumer financial technology company whose mobile app helps people manage everyday money with instant cash advances of up to $500 with no credit check, interest, or late fees, a Credit Builder account, and a Finance Helper for budgeting, spending analysis, bill tracking, and overdraft prediction. The app also bundles identity-theft protection and a deals-and-offers marketplace, and is offered on paid monthly subscription tiers. Brigit reports more than 12 million users. This API Evangelist profile is a company lead surfaced from venture-capital portfolios (Canaan Partners, DCM Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners); Brigit is a direct-to-consumer app and does not currently publish a public developer API, so this record is enriched at the identity and web-property level.

providers.name: Cala Health
providers.description: Cala Health is a bioelectronic medicine company that develops wearable neuromodulation therapies for chronic disease. Its FDA-cleared Cala kIQ and Cala TRIO systems deliver TAPS (Transcutaneous Afferent Patterned Stimulation) therapy through a wrist-worn device that is physician-prescribed and clinically proven to reduce action hand tremors associated with essential tremor and Parkinson's disease. Patients manage therapy and view results through the MyCala portal, and clinicians access data through the Cala 360 provider portal. Cala Health is a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company operating in the life-sciences / medical-device sector. This profile currently exposes no public developer API; enrichment has captured the company's public security, privacy, and support surface.

providers.name: CalCourtDeadlines.com
providers.description: CalCourtDeadlines.com provides free California court deadline calculators for discovery responses, trial chain, motions, and other procedural dates. The site offers over 70 verified rules, CCP citations, and applies court holidays automatically, requiring no login.

providers.name: Calibrate
providers.description: Calibrate is a telehealth metabolic-health and weight-loss company that pairs clinician-prescribed GLP-1 medications with 1:1 video coaching and a science-backed educational curriculum to help members improve metabolic health and achieve sustainable weight loss. Programs are sold directly to individuals (from $199/month) and through employer benefits. Calibrate delivers its service through consumer web and iOS mobile apps rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's public web and account surface. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: Carepatron
providers.description: Carepatron is a cloud-based healthcare practice management and EHR platform for therapists, counselors, psychologists, health coaches, nutritionists, and other practitioners. It brings client records, appointment scheduling and online booking, telehealth, AI-assisted clinical notes and documentation, and billing/invoicing with insurance claims into one workspace, and markets HIPAA/SOC/GDPR compliance across 100,000+ clinicians in 120+ countries. As of this review Carepatron does NOT publish a documented public developer API - its pricing page lists "API (coming soon)" on the Advanced plan, and there is no developer portal, API reference, published base URL, OpenAPI definition, or SDK. Third-party connectivity today is limited to a handful of native integrations (Zoom, accounting software, Google Tag Manager). The APIs listed below are logical/product-area groupings modeled from Carepatron's own feature set; their endpoints are NOT documented and are marked as modeled, not confirmed.

providers.name: CBRE Australia
providers.description: CBRE Australia is the Australian arm of CBRE Group, the global commercial real estate services and investment firm, trading locally as CBRE (Gwsla) Pty Ltd (AU09949) and operating across the Pacific from cbre.com.au. It sits on the advisory and management side of the Australian property value chain rather than the data-infrastructure side: capital markets and investment sales, leasing and occupier advisory, valuation and advisory services, property and asset management, and project and design-and-build delivery across office, retail, industrial and logistics, build-to-rent, and alternative asset classes. Its API posture is closed. As of 26 July 2026 no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable contract, or self-serve onboarding exists for CBRE Australia: developer.cbre.com.au, developers.cbre.com.au, api.cbre.com.au, and docs.cbre.com.au do not resolve, and the global developer.cbre.com host is NXDOMAIN as well. CBRE does run API infrastructure — api.cbre.com sits behind an Imperva WAF that returns 403 to every anonymous request, api-dev.cbre.com serves a default WSO2 API Manager landing page, and eipportal.cbre.com is a login-gated "Integration Platform" SPA — but none of it is published, catalogued, or reachable by an outside developer. Commercial listings are distributed through the cbre.com.au property search and Australia's portal duopoly, and CBRE's terms of use explicitly prohibit scraping property listings from the site. RESO is absent entirely, which is the honest answer for Australia: there is no MLS here, no RESO-certified Australian organization, and the country's mandated machine-readable property rail is PEXA's electronic conveyancing network, not a RESO Web API. Access to CBRE data in Australia is a client or partner relationship, not a developer signup.

providers.name: Celestialai
providers.description: Celestialai provides AI-driven short-form video creation tools, enabling rapid generation of marketing content with automated scripting, voiceovers, and editing in multiple languages. The platform offers a web interface for users to input product details or media, then leverages AI to produce tailored video ads. Acquired by Marvell, Celestialai integrates into broader AI accelerator offerings, targeting enterprises seeking scalable content generation solutions.

providers.name: Cherry
providers.description: Cherry is a fintech platform providing point-of-sale patient financing for healthcare and elective-services providers across dental, medical aesthetics, plastic surgery, dermatology, veterinary, and other verticals. Rather than lending directly, Cherry facilitates consumer payment plans through partner lenders, offering Pay-in-4 and longer-term monthly plans (0-35.99% APR), a 60-second application with no hard credit check, upfront provider payout within 2-3 business days, and card-processing services. Cherry states it serves over 60,000 healthcare providers with an approximately 90% approval rate. Cherry is a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Cherry does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Clearco
providers.description: Clearco (formerly Clearbanc) is a Toronto-based fintech that provides non-dilutive, revenue-based working capital to ecommerce and direct-to-consumer brands. Founders connect the sales, advertising and banking platforms they already run on — Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Square, BigCommerce — and Clearco underwrites from that data, funding inventory and marketing spend as a cash advance or as invoice funding, in as little as 24 hours, without equity dilution. The company was founded in 2015 as Clearbanc, rebranded to Clearco in 2021, and reports having deployed more than $3.3 billion to over 10,000 businesses.

providers.name: Clearsense
providers.description: Clearsense provides an enterprise healthcare data platform that enables organizations to unify, archive, and manage large volumes of clinical and operational data. Their solutions include data archiving, managed services, and research acceleration tools, helping healthcare providers improve cost savings, revenue recovery, and data accessibility across multiple systems. The company serves hundreds of hospitals and health systems, offering cloud‑native, scalable platforms for data integration, analytics, and compliance.

providers.name: Clipto.AI
providers.description: Clipto.AI provides a local-first AI-powered platform that transcribes, searches, and organizes audio, video, and document media. Users can upload or sync their media files, and Clipto uses advanced machine learning to generate searchable transcripts, summaries, and insights, enabling quick retrieval and knowledge extraction. The service offers desktop applications for macOS and Windows, mobile apps, and integrations with popular tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and video editing software. Clipto emphasizes privacy by keeping data local unless cloud features are enabled, and targets professionals, creators, and enterprises needing efficient media management.

providers.name: CloudTrucks
providers.description: CloudTrucks (operated by Cloud Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based virtual trucking carrier and business-management platform for owner-operators and small trucking fleets. The platform aggregates freight loads from more than fifty brokers and shippers into a single app, and layers on load booking, dispatching, real-time tracking, instant pay on proof of delivery, invoicing, factoring, fuel discounts (FuelApp), insurance, and back-office financial tooling so independent drivers can run their business from a phone. CloudTrucks also operates Exchange for shippers and brokers plus a freight-agent program, and is backed by Craft Ventures, Kindred Ventures and Menlo Ventures. CloudTrucks does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, support and mobile-app surface plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Coheed
providers.description: Coheed provides a cloud platform for orders, planning, and invoices that always match. Their solutions synchronize ERP, CRM, and SCM data flows, ensuring teams have accurate records across the lead‑to‑cash process. Features include data integration, data quality checks, insights, and automated agents that improve operations with human‑in‑the‑loop approval. Use cases cover predictive customer lifetime value, lead‑to‑quote automation, order exception monitoring, and dynamic inventory optimization, targeting logistics, B2B commerce, wholesale, and manufacturing industries.

providers.name: Collibra
providers.description: Collibra is a data intelligence company providing a cloud-based platform for data governance, cataloging, quality, lineage, and AI governance. The Collibra Data Intelligence Platform helps enterprises discover, understand, govern, and trust their data assets through automated lineage tracking, policy management, data observability, and collaborative stewardship. The Collibra developer ecosystem includes REST APIs, GraphQL Knowledge Graph API, workflow automation, and a broad library of source connectors.

providers.name: Conicle
providers.description: Conicle is a Thai education-technology company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Bangkok that offers an all-in-one corporate learning platform (ConicleX) letting organizations build, assign, and track online courses, in-house training, and skill-development pathways for their employees. The cloud-based learning management system serves more than 50 leading enterprises — including Honda, Coca-Cola, Unilever, McDonald's, Sansiri, and The Mall — and over one million learners across the banking, retail, healthcare, energy, insurance, and consumer-product sectors. Conicle has raised Series A funding led by InVent (the corporate venture arm of Intouch Holdings), with backing from 500 Global and Stormbreaker Ventures. Conicle publishes a shared design-system web-components library used across its properties but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Control4
providers.description: Control4 is a smart home and building automation platform, now part of Snap One / ADI Global (Resideo), headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. It unifies control of lighting, audio/video, home theater, climate, security, shades, and voice across residential and commercial spaces through a single interface on smartphones, touchscreens, and on-wall keypads. Control4 is delivered through a network of certified integrators rather than direct-to-consumer sales, and interoperates with more than 25,000 third-party devices. For developers it offers the DriverWorks SDK (a Lua-based framework for building device drivers), the Control4 Developer Portal for OAuth application registration against the Control4 cloud, and public first-party libraries on GitHub.

providers.name: CoverWallet
providers.description: CoverWallet, an Aon company, is a digital insurance marketplace with a REST API for quoting, binding, and managing small business insurance policies across multiple carriers. The platform supports general liability, business owners policy (BOP), professional liability, workers compensation, commercial property, and other commercial lines. Partners can integrate real-time quoting, underwriting, binding, billing, and servicing capabilities directly into their applications.

providers.name: Distyl
providers.description: Distyl is an applied-AI company architecting the AI-native enterprise. Rather than layering automation onto broken processes, Distyl reimagines enterprise operations from the ground up with AI at the core, partnering with Fortune 500 organizations across Telecom, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Insurance, Retail, and Financial Services to design and operationalize AI transformations and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems in weeks. Its product suite includes Weave, Distillery, Context Mesh, Context Views, Journey, Personalization, and Apprentice. Founded by operators and researchers from Palantir, CIA, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Tesla, NASA, Stanford, and MIT, and backed by Coatue, OpenAI, Lightspeed, Microsoft, and Khosla Ventures. Distyl is a services/platform company with no public developer API; this profile captures its published web surface. Distyl is SOC 2 certified and GDPR compliant.

providers.name: DoNotPay
providers.description: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer advocacy platform, founded in 2015 by Joshua Browder and marketed as the "robot lawyer." It offers a web-based consumer product with 100+ AI-assisted tools that help people cancel subscriptions and free trials, dispute parking tickets and traffic violations, file chargebacks and refunds, negotiate and lower bills, find unclaimed money, fight robocalls, generate virtual cards for safe trial signups, and automate customer-service interactions. DoNotPay is a direct consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it is tracked here as an API Evangelist company profile.

providers.name: Dyrt
providers.description: The Dyrt is a camping discovery and booking platform for the United States, covering public and private campgrounds, RV parks, glamping, cabins, and free dispersed camping. It is a community-driven service built on user-contributed reviews, photos, and campground details, layered with trip-planning tools, real-time availability, and direct booking for many locations. Its Dyrt PRO subscription adds offline maps, cancellation ("Scan Canceled Sites") alerts, curated free-camping data, and discounts at 1,000+ campgrounds. The Dyrt also offers free listings, dashboards, analytics, and marketing tools for campground owners. It has been featured by the New York Times, NPR, National Geographic, and Forbes. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; The Dyrt publishes a consumer web/mobile product and does not expose a documented public developer API at this time.

providers.name: easyJet
providers.description: easyJet Airline Company Limited is a British low-cost short-haul carrier registered in England (company number 03034606, registered office Hangar 89, London Luton Airport, Luton, Bedfordshire, LU2 9PF), flying a point-to-point network that its own trade pages describe as connecting more than 155 airports across 35 countries. Its home market is the United Kingdom and its commercial centre of gravity is intra-European leisure and short-haul business traffic, extended by the easyJet holidays package business and by ancillary products (seat selection, hold and large cabin bags, Flex, Pass Extra, Smart+, Inclusive and Inclusive Plus fare bundles). easyJet sits at the direct end of the airline distribution chain. It was built without a GDS dependency and still sells the overwhelming majority of its seats through its own website and app; agency and OTA access exists but is a controlled secondary channel rather than the primary rail. That channel is governed by a published Distribution Charter (version March 2026) which permits a Reseller to access easyJet Data in exactly two ways — "via an easyJet Approved Channel which has entered into an API agreement with easyJet" or "directly via the easyJet API, if the Reseller has a Direct API Agreement with easyJet" — and which explicitly forbids screen scraping and any other automated extraction. easyJet publishes the list of Approved Channels and a per-partner functionality matrix current to the end of May 2026: Amadeus, Anaxys, Bewotec, Duffel, JFA Systems, Kyte, Paxport, Peakwork, Sabre, Travelfusion, Travelport, Traveltek, Viaxoft and Ypsilon. Its API posture, stated honestly, is commercial-agreement-gated and undocumented. There is no developer portal — developer, developers, docs, apis, ndc, partner, partners, trade, agent, sandbox, dev, portal, connect and xml subdomains of easyjet.com all fail to resolve — and no machine-readable contract of any kind is published: no OpenAPI, no Swagger, no AsyncAPI, no GraphQL schema, no security.txt, no llms.txt and no .well-known API catalogue. Two real API hostnames do exist, api.easyjet.com and b2b.easyjet.com, but both sit behind Akamai and return HTTP 403 Access Denied on every path probed. Just as importantly, easyJet is not an NDC carrier: the March 2026 charter never mentions NDC, easyJet does not appear on ndctracker.com's list of 73 airlines with launched or in-development NDC programmes, and its aggregators describe the connection as a direct-connect API rather than an NDC one — Duffel labels it "Direct Connect". A reseller therefore integrates against a bilateral, proprietary, unpublished interface under an English-law contract that easyJet may amend without notice and under which it reserves the right to restrict, suspend or terminate access and to cancel bookings already made. A second enrichment pass on 2026-07-28 did find one live, anonymously reachable easyJet integration surface the first pass missed: the easyWidget / easyDom partner component platform at brand.easyjet.com, a hosted JavaScript widget service that partner and white-label sites embed for easyJet page chrome and for easyJet customer sign-in, registration and visitor recognition. It is undocumented, partner-scoped by a query-string partner identifier and built on legacy jQuery, but it is real and it is the only easyJet interface that answers a stranger with a 200. The REST hostnames stay closed, and this record stays honest about the difference: only what can be verified is catalogued, and an Akamai-gated hostname is still not listed as an API.

providers.name: Enplug
providers.description: Enplug is a cloud-based digital signage and content-management platform that powers communications on screens across retail, hospitality, corporate, and public-venue locations, with content apps for social feeds, dashboards, video, wayfinding, and menus managed from a central web dashboard. Enplug was acquired by Spectrio, and enplug.com now redirects to Spectrio's Enplug acquisition page; the legacy Enplug cloud login remains live at login.enplug.com. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead; Enplug exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this repo carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Exaforce
providers.description: Exaforce is a security operations platform that pairs AI agents with a unified data layer to help teams detect, triage, investigate, and respond to threats faster. Its four autonomous "Exabot" agents (Detect, Triage, Investigate, and Respond) automate SOC workflows across 100+ data sources spanning cloud, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and code repositories, and can run as a self-operated platform or as a managed detection and response (MDR) service staffed by expert analysts working alongside the AI 24/7. Exaforce positions itself as an agentic-SOC alternative to traditional SIEM tooling while retaining integration compatibility. The company is backed by Mayfield and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or reference documentation is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and trust surface.

providers.name: Fab.com
providers.description: Fab.com is a digital content marketplace operated by Epic Games, where creators buy and sell 3D models, materials, environments, VFX, audio, and game-ready assets. Launched in October 2024, Fab consolidated four of Epic's prior storefronts — the Unreal Engine Marketplace, the Sketchfab Store, Quixel, and the ArtStation Marketplace — into a single catalog with unified licensing, and integrates into Unreal Engine, UEFN, and the Epic Games Launcher. The fabcom entry was originally added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead for the earlier, unrelated Fab.com flash-sale design-commerce company (2011–2015), which wound down before the domain passed to Epic Games; see x-identity-note. Fab publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification as of this pass — the surface captured here is its documentation, support, and security-disclosure posture.

providers.name: Flarion
providers.description: Flarion is a data-processing acceleration company that speeds up distributed compute engines — Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Ray — without code or infrastructure changes. It ships an Arrow-native, DataFusion/Polars-based execution engine written in Rust that installs as a plugin in about six minutes, plus intelligent workload caching (query, data-block, and buffer caching) and a performance-monitoring platform for job metrics, resource tracking, anomaly detection, and failure prevention. Flarion runs on-premises or on Databricks, AWS EMR, GCP Dataproc, Azure HDInsight, and Anyscale, with an agentless architecture that requires no access to customer data, delivering roughly 3x performance and 60% cost savings. Flarion is a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures. The company exposes a product console and a legal/SLA surface but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Foyer Tech
providers.description: Foyer Tech, operating under the brand Merlin, provides an AI-powered chat assistant that integrates large language models like ChatGPT and Gemini into browsers and mobile platforms. The service offers features such as real‑time answers, content summarization, AI‑generated images, and multi‑platform extensions for Chrome, Google Play, and the App Store. Targeting teams and individual users, Merlin aims to boost productivity by delivering AI assistance across web searches, email, and document workflows, boasting over 20 million users worldwide.

providers.name: Gameforge
providers.description: Gameforge AG is a German publisher of free-to-play online and browser games, headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany. Its catalog includes long-running titles such as OGame, Ikariam, Metin2, AION, NosTale, and other strategy and MMO games played across dozens of localized game servers. Gameforge's flagship title OGame exposes a public read-only game-data API that returns highscores, player and alliance rosters, universe/planet layouts, and per-server metadata as XML feeds (with an opt-in JSON representation), plus a separate access-controlled API that approved third-party tool developers can request for combat and report data. Gameforge also runs a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program through Bugcrowd. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: getklo-com
providers.description: Klo (getklo.com) offers an AI‑powered video editing platform that lets users edit footage through conversational prompts. The service provides cloud‑based rendering, collaborative tools, and integrations for downloading edited videos via its API. It targets creators, marketers, and enterprises seeking fast, automated video production without traditional editing software.

providers.name: GRIN Therapeutics
providers.description: GRIN Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the research and development of precision therapeutics for pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders caused by NMDA receptor dysfunction. It is an affiliate of Neurvati Neurosciences, a Blackstone Life Sciences portfolio company, and traces its founding to Dr. Pierandrea Muglia's attendance at the 2019 CFERV Conference on GRIN Variants at Emory University. Its lead investigational asset is radiprodil, an orally bioavailable selective negative allosteric modulator of the GluN2B subunit of the NMDA receptor, designed to fine-tune dysregulated receptor activity rather than fully block the channel. Radiprodil is in development for GRIN-related neurodevelopmental disorder (GRIN-NDD) arising from gain-of-function variants in GRIN1, GRIN2A, GRIN2B and GRIN2D, and for tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) and focal cortical dysplasia (FCD) type II. The clinical programme comprises the completed Phase 1b/2a Honeycomb trial, the enrolling global Phase 3 Beeline registrational trial, the Phase 1b/2a Astroscape trial in TSC and FCD type II, and a GRIN-NDD natural history study; radiprodil carries FDA Breakthrough Therapy, Orphan Drug and Rare Pediatric Disease designations and EMA PRIME and Orphan Drug designations. In May 2025 GRIN Therapeutics entered an exclusive collaboration with Angelini Pharma to develop and commercialise radiprodil outside North America. GRIN Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no product API, no developer portal and no API documentation; the only machine-readable surface reachable without credentials is the WordPress REST content API behind grintherapeutics.com, catalogued here.

providers.name: Health Connect
providers.description: Health Connect is a Google-backed platform that enables Android apps to read and write a user's health and fitness data in a privacy-preserving way. It provides a unified API for accessing data such as steps, heart rate, sleep, nutrition, and more, allowing developers to build health-focused experiences while giving users granular control over data sharing. The service integrates with Google Fit and other health providers, offering standardized data models and secure permissions management.

providers.name: Hey
providers.description: heycater! is a B2B catering marketplace that connects companies with vetted catering partners across Germany and the United Kingdom, letting businesses request, compare, and book corporate food services through a single platform. Its service lines span heykantine! (daily office meals for teams of 50+), Meetings & Catering (event catering from 10 people drawing on 700+ vetted caterers), hey! Events (full-service event planning for ~100+ guests), and a Pantry Service for office beverages and snacks. The platform serves 2,500+ companies, including Spotify, Airbnb, Meta, and Salesforce, and has fulfilled more than 250,000 catering orders, returning comparable quotes within 48 hours at no cost. heycater! does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: HUMAN Security
providers.description: HUMAN Security (formerly PerimeterX) is an application security company focused on stopping automated abuse: sophisticated bots, account takeover, fake account creation, scraping, ad fraud, client-side supply-chain attacks, and transaction fraud. HUMAN operates the Human Defense Platform, which combines a JavaScript sensor and mobile SDKs running on the client with risk decisioning services on the server side. Products in the platform include Bot Defender (formerly PerimeterX Bot Defender), Account Defender, Credential Intelligence, Transaction Abuse Defense, Ad Fraud Sensor / MediaGuard, Code Defender (client-side script and supply-chain protection), and Scraper Protection. HUMAN is primarily an enterprise vendor — onboarding, sensor configuration, and policy tuning go through the HUMAN portal and a customer success team — but the platform exposes REST APIs and SDKs that engineering teams integrate into web apps, mobile apps, edge workers, and back-end services.

providers.name: hyperexponential
providers.description: hyperexponential (hx) is a London-based insurtech that builds the #1 pricing and underwriting decision platform for commercial property & casualty (P&C) insurance. Its platform - spanning the Hyperoperator agentic assistant, a no-code Workflow Builder, Calculation Engines, and Portfolio Intelligence - lets actuaries and underwriters build, deploy, and iterate pricing models and underwriting workflows without heavy engineering. Carriers use hx to automate submission triage, risk assessment, renewals, portfolio monitoring, and regulatory compliance, with top global carriers running $75bn+ in annual commercial P&C premium on the platform. hyperexponential is backed by a16z and Battery Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and compliance surface; hx does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI, so this repo is enriched from identity, trust-center, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: illoca
providers.description: illoca is an AI-native design engine built for professional architects and design studios, delivered through its product Tracing Paper. It helps architects move from early ideas to editable 2D and 3D designs with more speed and control, supporting sketches, redlines, prompts, floor plans, massing studies, iterative refinements, and exports for professional design workflows. Tracing Paper is built for controllable architectural ideation and iteration with editable outputs that hand off into BIM/CAD tools such as Autodesk Revit and Rhino. illoca is a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners (sector: ai-ml). As an application-first company it currently exposes a marketing site and web application rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: jaikin-eu
providers.description: JAIKIN is a French agency specializing in artificial intelligence, Odoo ERP integration, and custom software development for SMEs and mid‑size enterprises. Based in Alsace, it offers end‑to‑end solutions including Odoo integration, bespoke business applications, mobile apps for iOS and Android, and AI‑driven process automation. The company provides consulting, project scoping, migration, and ongoing support, delivering projects from €2,000 HT onward. Its services span industry, medical, legal, and other sectors, with a focus on rapid delivery and tailored technology stacks.

providers.name: Keep Financial
providers.description: Keep Financial Technologies, Inc. is a compensation technology company that provides a vesting cash bonus platform. Employers deliver upfront cash to employees that is earned (vests) over a customizable time period with a legally enforceable right to repayment, automating signing bonuses, retention bonuses, annual and performance bonuses, spot bonuses, tuition reimbursement, M&A retention packages, and severance. The platform serves compensation, HR, finance, legal, and executive leaders across healthcare, construction, logistics, technology, retail, hospitality, manufacturing, and other industries. Keep Financial was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; it operates a SaaS web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: KeepTrack
providers.description: Keep Track is the free, open source tool that makes space exploration accessible to all - professionals and amateurs alike. With its user-friendly interface, you can simulate satellite launches, visualize debris patterns, and explore a catalog of 30,000+ real satellites and debris. Zoom through geosynchronous orbits, run collision scenarios, and track debris fragmentation over time.

providers.name: Kindred Group
providers.description: Kindred Group, operating under the brand FDJ United, is a leading European gaming company offering a broad portfolio of iconic brands and advanced technological solutions. The company focuses on responsible gaming, social responsibility, and innovation, with a strong presence across multiple markets and a commitment to stakeholder engagement and sustainable growth.

providers.name: KloudConnectors
providers.description: KloudConnectors provides a cloud integration platform that enables businesses to connect, automate, and orchestrate data flows across a wide range of SaaS applications, on-premise systems, and custom APIs. Their solution focuses on simplifying complex integrations with a visual workflow builder, pre-built connectors, and robust monitoring tools. KloudConnectors serves enterprises seeking to streamline operations, improve data consistency, and accelerate digital transformation initiatives, offering scalable pricing and enterprise-grade security features.

providers.name: Lendable
providers.description: Lendable Ltd is a UK consumer lending fintech founded in 2014 and headquartered in London, offering unsecured personal loans directly to borrowers through a fully digital application. The company underwrites with technology and data analytics rather than relying on a credit score alone, describing its approach as looking at all of an applicant's data together to produce a personalised quote in minutes without paper forms or branch visits. Lendable distributes through the major UK price-comparison platforms including ClearScore, Compare the Market, MoneySuperMarket, Experian, TotallyMoney, TransUnion and Go.Compare. It is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA reference 720261, company number 08828186) and is a CIFAS member. Lendable publishes no public developer API or developer portal — its public technical surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt, an llms.txt, and a set of first-party open source PHP/Symfony engineering libraries on Packagist and GitHub.

providers.name: Live Aware Labs
providers.description: Live Aware Labs (LIVE AWARE) is a virtual playtesting and player-insights lab for game studios and researchers. The platform consolidates gameplay footage, player feedback, and community discussion from sources such as Discord, Twitch, YouTube, and internal playtests into a single dashboard, then applies AI to surface trends, player sentiment, and critical feedback in real time. A PC-based SDK captures video, telemetry, and in-game events, with plugins for Unreal Engine and Unity and no-code integrations into Slack, Jira, Monday.com, and OBS. Live Aware Labs is backed by a16z and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; this profile is enriched from the company's public web surface.

providers.name: Lytix
