providers.description: Lytix provides an open‑source evaluations layer for LLMOps, offering continuous monitoring, custom evaluation workflows, and real‑time scoring to ensure AI model performance, accuracy, and empathy. The platform includes a console, playground, and integrations for medical and other domain‑specific use cases, helping teams assess and improve their AI systems.

providers.name: Meditopia
providers.description: Meditopia is a holistic mental-wellbeing platform founded in 2017 that blends psychology, technology, and wellness to support the mental, emotional, and physical health of individuals and organizations. For consumers it ships a meditation and mindfulness mobile app (sleep programs, guided meditations, personalized assessments, self-guided content) available in nine-plus languages and used by 40+ million people across 60 countries. For organizations it offers Meditopia for Work: a modern Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 1-on-1 expert sessions, a WellnessPass benefits platform, online trainings, and Soul, an AI wellbeing coach. Meditopia is backed by Creandum. The company operates a consumer mobile app and a B2B web platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile was surfaced as a Creandum portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Mero
providers.description: Mero is a Canadian SaaS platform for commercial building cleaning operations that uses smart sensors and analytics to automatically log, validate, and prove cleaning activity without manual input from janitorial staff. Its product is organized into three modules: Validate (hands-free proof that cleaning was completed), Dispatch (occupancy- and supply-driven scheduling), and Inspect (in-app QA and inspection tooling). Mero serves janitorial companies, property managers, and commercial facilities, with data captured across roughly 100M square feet at customers including Harvard, Colliers, and Toronto Pearson Airport. The company advertises a data-integration API and a Zapier connector to send and receive data with other tools, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; API access is gated behind a sales demo.

providers.name: Monarch Tractor
providers.description: Monarch Tractor is a Livermore, California agricultural-technology company that builds the MK-V, a fully electric, driver-optional smart tractor, together with WingspanAI (Wingspan Ag Intelligence) — an AWS-hosted farm-management and fleet-telemetry platform that collects in-field video, machine telemetry, energy and emissions data from connected tractors and presents it to growers through web and mobile apps. The company markets an "open ecosystem" in which third parties integrate with the MK-V and WingspanAI, and has pivoted toward selling autonomy as software and licensing its autonomy stack to other equipment makers. Monarch publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; the WingspanAI platform is reachable only through a customer login.

providers.name: Monash University
providers.description: Monash University is a public research university in Melbourne, Australia, and a member of the Group of Eight. Its genuinely institution-operated programmable footprint is small but real, and it is not where a company's would be. Its three institution-operated surfaces all belong to Monash eResearch and all resolve into Monash's own APNIC address space: the Cloud Resource Allocation and Management System (CRAMS) portal, a public documentation site for the M3/MASSIVE HPC estate, and a Shibboleth service provider federated through the Australian Access Federation. None of the three publishes an open specification, so Monash's only evidenced domain-standard conformance (SAML, Shibboleth) rests on that one federation entry. The Monash-branded identity provider at idp.monash.edu.au looks like the strongest contract here and is not Monash's: it CNAMEs to idp-cname.aaf.edu.au on Amazon address space, making it a tenant of AAF's fully managed Rapid IdP. Everything else that looks like a Monash API is a vendor platform running under a Monash hostname: the Bridges research repository is Figshare (bridges.monash.edu is a CNAME to figshare.com), research.monash.edu is Elsevier Pure, the Handbook course catalog runs on CourseLoop, and library discovery is Ex Libris Primo. Those are recorded here as tenant relationships, not as Monash contracts. No central institutional developer portal, no open data portal, and no institution-operated OAI-PMH endpoint were found.

providers.name: Mondial Relay
providers.description: Mondial Relay provides parcel delivery and locker services across Europe, operating a dense network of over 12,000 lockers and 94,500 pickup points. It offers e‑livraison solutions for both consumers and e‑commerce merchants, enabling flexible parcel sending, tracking, and collection through its web portal and mobile apps. The company focuses on reliable, simple, and convenient logistics for shipments within France and across European markets.

providers.name: Motif
providers.description: Motif is an AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) software company building an intelligent, browser-based workspace for building design. Founded in 2023 by former Autodesk leaders Amar Hanspal and Brian Mathews, Motif unifies sheet review, live 3D streaming, AI-assisted visual exploration, and real-time collaboration in a single cloud platform that bridges 2D and 3D workflows as a step toward making Building Information Modeling (BIM) a practical reality. The company has raised $46M led by Redpoint Ventures (seed) and Alphabet's CapitalG (Series A), and was named to Forbes' 2025 Next Billion-Dollar Startups list. Motif is a collaboration SaaS product for design and construction teams; it publishes product learning docs and a help center but does not yet expose a public developer API — a plugin/API surface is part of its stated long-term strategy.

providers.name: Ntuple
providers.description: SyncTree (Ntuple) provides a no‑code backend development solution, enabling developers to build cloud‑based SaaS applications without installing or configuring servers. It offers block‑based visual tools for logic, data processing, and database management, targeting rapid prototyping and production workloads. The platform emphasizes ease of use, scalability, and integration with modern APIs, positioning itself as a backend‑as‑a‑service for startups and enterprises alike.

providers.name: Office Luv
providers.description: OfficeLuv is office management and purchasing software that centralizes all of a workplace's ordering into a single platform. It aggregates dozens of vendors and thousands of products (supplies, snacks, cleaning supplies, groceries, and more) into one unified marketplace with consolidated invoicing, spend analytics and reporting, multi-user approval workflows, employee stipends for remote and in-office staff, and optional on-site service for program design, pricing negotiation, and restocking. Customers include Wayfair, Braze, Glassdoor, Hulu, and Upwork. Office Luv was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is delivered as a private SaaS web application (app.officeluv.com); no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time.

providers.name: OnStation
providers.description: OnStation is a digital stationing platform for road and highway construction projects, replacing paper station logs and manual chaining with GPS-based field documentation. Its iOS and Android mobile app lets crews, inspectors, and project managers identify exact station locations, drop and share flags, capture timestamped photos and notes, and complete forms in the field without extra hardware. A cloud Data Portal aggregates that field documentation into searchable, exportable DOT-ready reports for compliance and dispute resolution, while Active Worksite alerts drivers through Waze and OEM systems when crews are working. OnStation offers pre-built integrations with construction and survey systems including HCSS HeavyJob, Trimble and Bad Elf GNSS receivers, TransTech density gauges, FleetWatcher e-ticketing, and ESRI GIS, but does not currently publish a public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners and Techstars.

providers.name: Opti
providers.description: Opti is an AI-native identity and access management (IAM) platform for enterprises struggling with access sprawl across human, non-human, and agentic identities. Founded in 2024 by Barak Perelman, Mille Gandelsman, and Ido Trivizki, Opti deploys pre-trained, domain-specific large language models trained on curated identity data to interpret risk, recommend least-privilege access decisions, and orchestrate safe permissions. The platform spans Access Intelligence, Risk Mitigation, Lifecycle Management (joiner/mover/leaver), and Compliance, integrating with 250+ identity solutions, IdPs, IGAs, HRIS, and ITSM systems without rip-and-replace. Opti raised a $20M seed round led by YL Ventures, Mayfield Fund, and Hetz Ventures.

providers.name: Panjiva
providers.description: Panjiva is a supply chain intelligence platform owned by S&P Global Market Intelligence that delivers data-driven insights for the global trade community. It combines global import/export shipment records with machine learning analytics to profile companies, map supply chains, benchmark competitors, surface sales leads, and assess counterparty and supply-chain risk. Panjiva covers roughly 9 million companies and more than 2 billion shipment records spanning an estimated 35% of global trade flows. Trade data is also delivered programmatically to CRM systems, quantitative models, and research workflows through S&P Global's XpressFeed data-feed service and is surfaced inside S&P Capital IQ Pro. Access is enterprise and subscription based; Panjiva does not publish a public self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Pear Suite
providers.description: Pear Suite is a care management platform built for community health workers, care navigators, doulas, and community-based organizations, describing itself as an operating system for community-based work. The platform provides custom assessments and care pathways, goal and outcome tracking, patient communication over phone, SMS, and encrypted email, client and population-level analytics, and billing and claims integration, connecting community health initiatives with health plans and health systems. Pear Suite reports serving 2,500+ community workers across 300+ organizations nationwide.

providers.name: Phononic
providers.description: Phononic is a Durham, North Carolina solid-state cooling company founded by CEO Tony Atti that replaces compressor-based refrigeration with semiconductor thermoelectric devices. Its products cool optical and fiber transceivers, co-packaged optics, GPU high-bandwidth memory, LiDAR sensors, medical and vaccine cold chain, grocery retail merchandising and HVAC. The current focus is AI data centers, where the Thermal Kit and Thermal Fabric combine thermoelectric cooling chips with embedded control firmware that the company markets as API-accessible and Redfish-compatible, delivering millisecond thermal response plus real-time telemetry and analytics. Phononic publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification; technical access runs through sales and customer support.

providers.name: Poka
providers.description: Poka is a manufacturing-focused connected worker platform that helps industrial and frontline teams standardize work execution across learning, daily management, and operations. It combines digital work instructions, on-the-job training, skills management, and factory-floor knowledge sharing with embedded Industrial AI. Poka exposes a RESTful Poka API for building integrations with third-party systems (MES, CMMS, LMS, QMS, ERP, BI), SCIM for automated user provisioning from identity providers, the Poka Automate iPaaS, and a Poka Data Lake for BI/reporting. Poka is part of IFS and runs regionally in the US, Canada, and EU.

providers.name: polopan-com
providers.description: Polopan offers a free AI-powered personal stylist platform that curates a discovery-first fashion experience. Leveraging advanced machine learning, the service provides users with a personalized feed of clothing recommendations, helping them discover items they want to wear before they even know what to search for. The platform aims to democratize fashion advice, making AI-driven styling accessible to everyone, and integrates with e‑commerce partners to facilitate seamless shopping.

providers.name: PreFix
providers.description: PreFix is a Techstars-backed residential home-maintenance service company operating in Austin, Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Denver. For a flat monthly membership, homeowners get a dedicated neighborhood Home Manager who handles general repairs, twice-yearly 30-point preventive maintenance, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, painting, appliance and garage-door work, and vetted contractor management through a single email, call, or text. Customers manage their homes through the HomeHub member portal. PreFix operates a consumer home-services business and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and demand-side intelligence.

providers.name: Prodigy Finance
providers.description: Prodigy Finance is a fintech lender providing collateral-free, no-cosigner postgraduate education loans to international master's students at top business, engineering, and STEM schools worldwide. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in London, it uses a borderless, forward-looking credit model based on a borrower's projected future earnings rather than local credit history, funding students from more than 150 countries. Prodigy Finance operates consumer web and mobile (iOS/Android) applications, an accounts portal, and a customer help center, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Prudential
providers.description: Prudential plc is a life and health insurance and asset management group incorporated in England and Wales and listed on the London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York exchanges, with its principal operating office in Hong Kong and roots in London going back to 1848. Its home market for this profile is the United Kingdom, but its book is almost entirely Asian and African: life protection, health and medical, savings and retirement, takaful, pensions and Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Funds, plus asset management under the Eastspring brand, across Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan, India, mainland China, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and a dozen African markets including Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Zambia. It is no longer a UK retail insurer at all - the UK and Europe business was demerged as M&G plc in 2019 and the US business as Jackson Financial in 2021 - so the familiar UK "Pru" brands at pru.co.uk belong to M&G, not to this company. Its API posture is that there is no public API posture. Prudential plc publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger document and no partner integration surface of any kind: developer, developers, docs, api, apis, partners, portal and sandbox subdomains of prudentialplc.com all fail to resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer, /partners and /integrations on the corporate site all return HTTP 404. The group's stated technology strategy is inward-facing - AI, automation, cloud and a global AI Lab running over a hundred internal use cases - and its distribution is built on tied agency forces and exclusive bancassurance partnerships with banks such as Standard Chartered, CIMB, MSB, SeABank, Bank Syariah Indonesia and UOB, which are commercial and contractual relationships rather than published API programmes. The Pulse by Prudential health and wealth app onboards health-tech and wealth-tech partners (Babylon, Tictrac, Halodoc, Smarter Health, Prive Technologies, OVO, Google Cloud) but every announcement describes the arrangement in commercial terms and none exposes a developer programme, SDK or public API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference was found anywhere in Prudential plc's public estate. Recorded honestly as a large carrier with a fully partner-gated, non-public integration surface. One genuine machine-readable surface does exist, and it is not an API: six of the group's market operating companies - Prudential Hong Kong, Prudential Singapore, Prudential Indonesia, Prudential Vietnam, Pru Life UK in the Philippines and Prudential BSN Takaful in Malaysia - publish real first-party llms.txt documents for grounding large language models, with Prudential Vietnam declaring a per-user-agent bot access policy for gptbot, claudebot, google-extended, perplexitybot and six other crawlers. The corporate domain publishes none. Underneath that, the group runs a visibly centralised security posture: TLS 1.3 and HSTS on every market host, and one shared PowerDMARC/PowerSPF tenant with a common aggregate-report mailbox across all seven domains, at p=reject on the corporate domain and p=quarantine in the markets, with no CAA record anywhere.

providers.name: Resourcify
providers.description: Resourcify (Resourcify GmbH) is a Hamburg, Germany based digital platform for waste management and circular-economy operations, describing itself as "the operating system for a circular future." Its cloud software helps enterprises digitize and optimize their waste streams end to end - automating waste and recycling operations, optimizing cost, CO2 and recycling rates, tracking compliance, and running take-back systems - across manufacturing, construction, retail, healthcare, and airports. The platform connects waste producers with a network of recyclers and haulers, captures waste data and documentation, and reports on sustainability and material recovery. Resourcify is backed by Speedinvest. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Roger
providers.description: Roger (operated by Sanos Services GmbH, Berlin, Germany) is a B2B SaaS practice-management platform for dental clinics. It layers automation and AI onto existing German dental practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM Z1, Charly, Dampsoft, Evident and Dento Office, adding patient recall, digital intake forms, WhatsApp/SMS communication, AI-assisted documentation with billing-position capture, digital treatment-plan signing, factoring with default protection and instant payout, and outsourced ZMV/reception staffing. The product is DSGVO/GDPR-compliant and hosted in Germany. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery, Roger publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Scripbox
providers.description: Scripbox is an Indian direct-to-consumer wealth management and mutual fund investment platform operated by Scripbox Wealth Managers Private Limited. It helps families pursue financial freedom through personalized mutual fund recommendations shaped by expert advisors and data-backed algorithms, offering both regular (commission-based, zero monthly fee) and direct (advisory-fee) plans. The platform bundles portfolio construction and monitoring, financial planning, goal-based investing, tax-saving tools such as its Smart Withdraw algorithm, and multi-channel support. As of this enrichment pass, Scripbox operates purely as a consumer application and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Snap-on
providers.description: Snap-on Incorporated is a global manufacturer and marketer of tools, equipment, diagnostics, repair information, and systems solutions for professional users in vehicle repair, industrial, and other industries. The company provides diagnostic tools, electronic parts catalogs (EPC), repair information systems (ShopKey Pro, SureTrack), and shop management software. Snap-on integrates with dealer management systems (DMS) through its EPC integration program and strategic technology partnerships.

providers.name: Spill
providers.description: Spill is a UK-based employee assistance programme (EAP) that delivers mental health support to employees directly inside the tools teams already use, such as Slack and Microsoft Teams. The platform offers same-day, message-based counselling, structured multi-session therapy courses for specific mental health conditions, drop-in group sessions, manager mental-health training, and self-guided wellbeing content, all through a single subscription. Spill serves over 600 companies on month-to-month terms and is backed by Seedcamp. It is a B2B software-as-a-service wellbeing product rather than an API provider; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK has been published.

providers.name: SportsAPI
providers.description: SportsAPI.com is a sports data API comparison and directory platform that helps developers find and evaluate sports data providers. It enables side-by-side comparison of live scores, statistics, odds, and fantasy sports APIs filtered by pricing, sport coverage, data categories, and vendor features. The platform covers providers for football, soccer, basketball, baseball, cricket, horse racing, and more.

providers.name: Storetasker
providers.description: Storetasker is a curated freelance marketplace that connects direct-to-consumer and e-commerce brands with vetted, expert Shopify developers, designers, and marketers for projects and ongoing retainers. Founded in 2016 and backed by Techstars, the platform has helped over 30,000 brands hire trusted Shopify talent across 200+ countries, handling expert matching, communication, project management, and payments. Storetasker operates as a two-sided hiring marketplace rather than a public API provider — as of this pass it publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Terapify
providers.description: Terapify is an online therapy platform for the Spanish-speaking market, connecting individuals in Mexico and Latin America with certified psychologists for private, secure video-call sessions. Founded in 2019 and backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator, the platform matches patients to therapists via a therapeutic-affinity test, offers individual and couples therapy, parent orientation, and workplace mental-health programs for companies, plus mindfulness, yoga, and breathing resources. It operates as a consumer web and mobile (iOS/Android) product and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: TryPromptly
providers.description: TryPromptly is a startup that provides AI‑enhanced prompting tools for developers and marketers, enabling rapid generation of high‑quality text, code snippets, and conversational agents. Their platform offers a web UI and API endpoints for creating, managing, and retrieving prompts, with features such as template libraries, versioning, usage analytics, and integration hooks for popular development environments. The service targets SaaS product teams looking to accelerate content creation and automate repetitive writing tasks, positioning itself as a flexible, low‑latency solution for prompt engineering at scale.

providers.name: Upsales
providers.description: Upsales provides a comprehensive AI‑driven sales platform that helps businesses identify new opportunities, expand existing accounts, and prioritize deals. The solution offers end‑to‑end tools for lead recommendation, pipeline management, and performance analytics, empowering sales teams to close more deals efficiently. Founded in Sweden, Upsales serves customers across Europe and integrates with major CRMs and marketing tools.

providers.name: VALID8 Financial
providers.description: VALID8 Financial is a Verified Financial Intelligence (VFI) platform founded in 2017 in Seattle that turns raw banking evidence and accounting records into reconciled, evidential-grade transaction data for forensic accountants, CPA firms, law firms, bankruptcy trustees, and government investigators. The AI-powered platform automates extraction and verification of financial evidence across use cases including forensic investigations, financial crime, expert witness support, transaction advisory, bankruptcy and restructuring, and family law. A Techstars portfolio company, VALID8 is SOC 2 Type II audited, HIPAA compliant, and GDPR aligned with a Vanta-hosted trust center, but does not currently publish a developer portal or public API documentation; customers sign in through regional portals (us/ca/eu/uk/aus.valid8.io).

providers.name: Venue
providers.description: Venue is an all-in-one internal communications platform that makes it easy for teams to host, organize, and share all hands, webinars, AMAs, and fireside chats. It combines HD live streaming, recording, automatic transcription and summarization, branded Q&A, engagement tracking, and Channels for centralizing events and videos. Aimed at internal comms and employer-brand teams at companies like Shopify, PwC, Wealthsimple, and Yelp, Venue is a Toronto-based, Accel- and Y Combinator-backed productivity company. As of this enrichment pass Venue publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface — this profile captures its identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Wishup
providers.description: Wishup is a remote-work outsourcing platform that matches businesses with pre-vetted virtual assistants, bookkeepers, and automation specialists, typically onboarding a trained professional within 60 minutes. Its managed talent handles inbox and calendar management, CRM and social-media work, bookkeeping, project management, and AI-driven workflow automation across industries such as healthcare, e-commerce, real estate, startups, nonprofits, and legal services. Wishup runs a client-facing Employee Management App for task tracking and real-time feedback, but publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Zaapi
providers.description: Zaapi is an all-in-one conversational AI and chat-commerce platform built for Southeast Asia's micro, small, and medium-sized e-commerce sellers. Founded in 2021 by Wilfried Buiron and launched in Thailand, Zaapi unifies customer conversations from Facebook, Instagram, LINE, WhatsApp, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, email, and a seller's own website into a single shared inbox, then layers AI agents, automations, broadcast campaigns, and analytics on top to turn those channels into revenue. It is backed by Partech, Global Founders Capital, and Flourish Ventures. As of this profile Zaapi exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; webhook connectivity was signalled on the product roadmap but is not yet published.

providers.name: Ziro
providers.description: Zíro (somosziro.com) is a Colombian fintech that provides interest-free credit for small retailers in the traditional commerce channel. Its platform lets distributors and manufacturers extend "crédito sin intereses" to the small shops they supply, while the supplier receives guaranteed payment and Zíro assumes the credit risk. The service bundles identity verification (Colombian cédula), automated credit evaluation, and fraud prevention into the ordering flow. Zíro is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes only a public marketing site and a customer-facing credit application (an Angular SPA at creditos.somosziro.com); no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server was found. The api.somosziro.com host exists but responds 403 (internal, not publicly documented).

providers.name: 80,000 Hours
providers.description: 80,000 Hours is an independent nonprofit, founded in 2011 by Benjamin Todd and William MacAskill out of Oxford, that provides free research and support to help people use their careers to help solve the world's most pressing problems. The name refers to the roughly 80,000 hours a typical person works over their lifetime. It publishes an evidence-based career guide, in-depth problem profiles, a long-form podcast, and one-on-one advising, and runs a curated high-impact job board at jobs.80000hours.org. Since 2016 it has ranked helping navigate the transition to advanced AI as its top priority. It is a content and career-advice organization rather than an API producer; no public developer API is published, though it does serve a machine-readable llms.txt index of its content.

providers.name: ACHIVX
providers.description: ACHIVX is an ecosystem of open products around stablecoin settlement and machine-to-machine payments. It offers the Stablecoin Scanner for telemetry across multiple networks, the x402 Payment Scanner tracking AI agent payments, a community Forum, portable Reputation system, and an open-source Reward System, all aimed at providing transparent public infrastructure for on‑chain dollars and the agents that move them.

providers.name: Adlane
providers.description: Adlane is an AI assistant for Google Ads and Meta Ads that helps users review campaign performance, research keywords, and draft campaigns in a single AI workspace. It offers read‑only MCP servers for Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Adlane accounts, providing tools to explore ad data, generate insights, and make informed decisions without changing campaigns.

providers.name: Agency AI
providers.description: Agency AI provides an AI‑powered platform that automates Meta and Google advertising for Shopify merchants. Built by operators who have scaled Shopify stores into the top 0.1% of merchants, the service offers a creative studio, campaign automation, and real‑time optimization, aiming to keep margins high while removing the need for a retainer. It integrates Claude and ChatGPT for ad copy generation and supports a free trial with no credit‑card required.

providers.name: agenticshelf-ai
providers.description: Agentic Shelf delivers Multi-Channel Presence (MCP) tools, live audits, and AI‑driven visibility for e‑commerce platforms. It offers adapters for Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and custom headless stores, enabling merchants to measure and improve how large language models cite their products. The platform provides a free audit console, methodology documentation, and a roadmap for future AI commerce capabilities.

providers.name: AIO
providers.description: AIO (AI Integrity Organization) is a global non‑profit that standardizes and operates a common vocabulary for AI decision‑making. It builds a trusted AI integrity ecosystem by measuring, recording, and openly verifying how AI systems reach judgments, offering open standards, verification, and governance to ensure transparent and accountable AI outcomes.

providers.name: AlertMedia
providers.description: AlertMedia offers a unified risk intelligence and response platform that provides mass notification, threat intelligence, travel risk management, employee safety monitoring, incident response, and social intelligence. The platform is designed for organizations that need to protect people and operations across global locations. It delivers real‑time risk visibility, analyst‑verified alerts, and built‑in workflows to coordinate and resolve incidents.

providers.name: Amperecloud
providers.description: Amperecloud (Amperecloud GmbH) is a German renewable-energy management software company whose cloud platform provides an operating system for monitoring, operating, and commercially managing solar, wind, and other renewable-energy assets at scale. The platform brings asset performance monitoring, maintenance and ticket management, commercial and technical asset management, and virtual power plant (VPP) capabilities into a single system, supported by migration, consulting, and custom-integration services. It is used by more than 300 customers worldwide managing over 8,000 installations and 10+ GWp of capacity. Added to the API Evangelist network as a point-nine portfolio company; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published, so this profile captures verified company identity and a domain-security probe pending any future public API surface.

providers.name: Anyvoice
providers.description: Anyvoice provides AI-powered voice cloning and text‑to‑speech services, enabling developers to integrate realistic synthetic speech into applications, games, and accessibility tools. The platform offers a suite of APIs for voice generation, customization, and management, supporting multiple languages and voice styles. Founded to democratize voice technology, Anyvoice aims to deliver high‑quality, low‑latency audio synthesis for a wide range of use cases, from entertainment to enterprise solutions.

providers.name: APIpie
providers.description: APIpie offers businesses a single OpenAI‑compatible API that aggregates flagship, premium, and budget models from major AI providers. It provides model aliases, key‑level controls, redundant connections for uptime, and detailed usage and spend visibility, allowing companies to manage AI models without rewriting code.

providers.name: appealgo-com
providers.description: AppealGo provides an online service that helps drivers appeal parking tickets and Penalty Charge Notices (PCNs) across the UK. Using AI, the platform processes uploaded ticket images or PDFs, generates appeal letters, and can file them with the relevant council or parking operator on the user’s behalf. The service offers a free initial check and charges a fee only if the appeal proceeds, with refunds if filing fails. It supports multiple councils, offers fleet management tools, and provides resources such as deadline calculators and contravention code guides.

providers.name: Applied Compute
providers.description: Applied Compute is a San Francisco AI company founded in 2025 by former OpenAI researchers, building "Specific Intelligence" for the enterprise. It operates a cloud platform for training, inference, and continuous improvement of custom, open AI models and long-horizon, tool-using agents grounded in a company's own proprietary data. Rather than selling a generic model, Applied Compute embeds engineers with customer teams to fine-tune models, mine production data, run online/reinforcement learning, and deploy autonomous agents that operate inside the customer's environment with observability over rollouts. The company emerged from stealth in October 2025 and is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital, Greenoaks, Neo, Elad Gil, and others at a reported ~$1.3B valuation. Named customers include DoorDash, Cognition, Harvey, and Mercor.

providers.name: Apricot
providers.description: Apricot is an AI-native clinical documentation platform for home health and post-acute care agencies, founded by home-health operator Trent Smith and headquartered in Oklahoma. Its software cuts start-of-care (SOC) and OASIS documentation time by up to 85% and QA time by up to 40%, automating medication reconciliation, wound documentation, ICD coding recommendations, and narrative generation while capturing vitals, photos, signatures, and voice notes in the home and syncing to each agency's EMR configuration. Apricot is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant and raised a Series A led by Insight Partners in 2025. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web presence; Apricot currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Autoridad Digital
providers.description: Autoridad Digital es una agencia especializada en SEO avanzado, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) y construcción de autoridad digital para dominar nichos. Fundada por Federico Noya y operada por TONYBERIA SL en Fuengirola, España, ofrece servicios de SEO, GEO, Answer Engine Optimization, Topical Authority, Authority Stacking y Digital PR, atendiendo a clientes en España y América Latina.

providers.name: Banquet Health
providers.description: Banquet Health provides a modern software platform that transforms hospital foodservice operations. It automates meal management, reduces errors, ensures compliance, integrates with EMR systems, and improves patient satisfaction by delivering the right meal at the right time. The solution helps healthcare providers cut food waste, boost operational efficiency, and enhance the overall patient experience through personalized menus and real-time ordering.

providers.name: Bible Glide
providers.description: Bible Glide is a reading and study app that lets users read the Bible online for free, keep passages in context, and ask Scripture questions using AI chat. It offers daily reading, group study features, and a simple interface without requiring an account. Founded by Nicholas, the service aims to provide honest, context‑rich Scripture engagement for individuals, small groups, and churches.

providers.name: Boeing
providers.description: Boeing is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and sells airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and telecommunications equipment. Boeing Developer Tools provides aviation data APIs powered by Jeppesen aeronautical databases, covering aircraft models, airport data, airspace information, NOTAMs, flight events, and runway operations.

providers.name: Bookd
providers.description: Bookd is a platform that helps travelers find and book independent hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, and vacation rentals directly with the property. It connects guests with property owners through its website and AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, enabling direct bookings without holding guest money. Bookd is operated by Caius Data LLC in Wyoming, USA, with an EU representative in Ireland.

providers.name: bordeaux.guru
providers.description: Independent Bordeaux vintage intelligence: en primeur tasting notes written first‑hand at the barrel, daily growing‑season climate for every appellation, and terroir mapped down to the parcel. We publish only what we tasted or measured ourselves — no third‑party scores.

providers.name: Brit + Co
providers.description: Brit + Co is a lifestyle and entertainment media platform founded by Brit Morin that publishes content and creative education for a primarily women audience. It covers self-care, food, home and DIY, travel, relationships, celebrity and entertainment news, horoscopes, shopping guides, and games, and operates a learning platform (learn.brit.co) offering more than one hundred creative online classes. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures. It is a consumer media and e-learning brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: bttn
providers.description: bttn (bttn Inc., trading online as bttnusa.com) is a Seattle, Washington based business-to-business e-commerce marketplace and wholesale distributor of medical supplies, lab equipment and pharmaceuticals, selling name-brand consumables to clinics, dental, veterinary and physical-therapy practices, clinical laboratories, home-healthcare providers and other healthcare buyers across the United States. Founded in 2021 by JT Garwood and Jack Miller and backed by Tiger Global, the company operates a self-serve online storefront carrying 60,000+ catalog products with bulk and volume pricing, same- or next-business-day shipping, quote requests, purchase-order and invoice payment, shopping lists, quick-order pads and recurring reorder tooling. The storefront is a BigCommerce commerce back end fronted by a Catalyst/Next.js application. bttn publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; its e-commerce surface is buyer-facing only.

providers.name: Bulk Transcripts
providers.description: Bulk Transcripts is an independent, one‑person product that downloads every available transcript from YouTube channels, playlists, or videos in bulk. It offers a REST API, an MCP server, and an agent skill, enabling AI agents to retrieve transcripts in formats like JSON, Markdown, CSV, and more. Built by @attenisalluneed since July 2026, the service provides free access to up to 30 transcripts and paid plans for larger volumes, targeting developers, podcasters, and content creators who need large‑scale transcript extraction.

providers.name: City University of Hong Kong
providers.description: City University of Hong Kong (CityUHK) is a publicly funded (UGC) research university in Kowloon, Hong Kong SAR. IT Services runs a real API programme — a gateway and API management practice on MuleSoft Anypoint connecting campus systems — but none of it is published or callable outside the university, and there is no public developer portal. The publicly reachable machine-readable footprint is small and, with one exception, TENANTED rather than built: CityUHK Scholars is an Elsevier Pure deployment (scholars.cityu.edu.hk CNAMEs to cityu.elsevierpure.com) with an open OAI-PMH endpoint and a gated REST service on Elsevier's contract; Canvas is an Instructure tenant; single sign-on is an Okta tenant at auth.cityu.edu.hk. The exception is the one contract CityUHK operates itself: its Shibboleth Identity Provider at idp2.cityu.edu.hk, registered in eduGAIN via the Hong Kong Access Federation. The official GitHub organisation publishes zero public repositories.

providers.name: Cladwell
providers.description: Cladwell is a smart-closet and outfit-planning consumer application that helps people build capsule wardrobes and get more wear out of the clothes they already own. The service digitizes a user's closet, then uses AI styling ("Ask Cladwell") together with weather and personal preferences to recommend daily outfits, reduce over-buying, and encourage sustainable, intentional dressing. With more than one million app downloads, Cladwell is delivered primarily as iOS/Android and web apps (app.cladwell.com) with a subscription model; it currently exposes no public developer API. Founded and led by CEO Erin Flynn, it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment tracking.

providers.name: Clausely
providers.description: Clausely provides UK compliance packs for SMEs, covering AI, GDPR, and workplace regulations. Their platform offers a range of ready‑made compliance packages, white‑label services, and a free risk check tool. Targeted at small and medium businesses, they aim to simplify adherence to the EU AI Act, the Worker Protection Act 2023, and UK GDPR without hiring a dedicated compliance team.

providers.name: Coast Capital Savings
providers.description: Coast Capital Savings is a member-owned financial co-operative headquartered in Surrey, British Columbia, serving over 600,000 members across roughly 45 branches. On November 1, 2018 it became Canada's first British Columbia-based federal credit union (regulated federally rather than provincially), and in May 2026 it completed a merger with Prospera Credit Union. With approximately $21.9 billion CAD in total assets it is one of Canada's largest credit unions. As a cooperative credit union rather than a Schedule I/II bank, Coast Capital operates within Canada's voluntary and still-fragmented open-finance landscape: the federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework legislated under Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC) as overseer, is not yet operational. Coast Capital publishes NO public first-party developer portal or documented API; consumer financial-data access today is aggregator-mediated (e.g. Plaid) via screen-scraping/credential-based connections rather than a first-party API.

providers.name: Comfi
providers.description: Comfi (Comfi Holdings Limited) is a UAE-based financial technology company providing B2B working capital solutions for small and medium enterprises and trading businesses. Its three core products are invoice discounting (turning outstanding invoices into immediate cash), Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) for flexible B2B credit terms, and automotive dealer inventory financing. Comfi positions itself around speed — "capital in hours, not weeks" — and reports 1,000+ SMEs served, 15,000+ invoices financed, and $100M+ capital deployed across the UAE market. Eligibility requires a UAE-registered B2B business with at least six months of operating history and AED 100,000+ monthly revenue. Backed by 500 Global. No public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Constrafor
providers.description: Constrafor provides a construction‑focused platform that streamlines payments, risk management, and back‑office operations for general contractors and subcontractors. Their SaaS suite includes early‑pay financing, contract management, invoicing, and compliance tools, helping firms accelerate cash flow and reduce administrative overhead while ensuring regulatory adherence.

providers.name: Dayforce
providers.description: Dayforce provides a comprehensive, AI‑powered Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that unifies HR, payroll, talent, workforce management, and analytics. The cloud‑based solution helps enterprises automate HR processes, gain real‑time insights, ensure compliance, and improve employee experiences across global workforces.

providers.name: Decagon
providers.description: Decagon is an enterprise AI customer service platform that builds and operates voice, chat, and email AI agents on top of natural-language Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs). The platform includes the AI Agents Studio for authoring agents, Watchtower for continuous quality assurance, Voice of the Customer analytics, A/B testing and simulations, and tool connectors for back-office integrations. Decagon is enterprise sales-led; its developer documentation is gated behind an access code and no self-serve public API is published.

providers.name: Dental Monitoring
providers.description: Dental Monitoring provides AI-powered dental monitoring solutions that enable remote orthodontic care, allowing clinicians to track patient progress through a patented scanning device and cloud platform. The company offers a suite of tools for dentists and orthodontists to monitor treatment, engage patients, and integrate data into practice workflows, supporting multiple languages and regulatory compliance.

providers.name: Dreamforge
providers.description: DreamForge.ai is an AI-powered game creation platform for building, iterating on, and publishing 2D and stylized 3D games directly in the browser. Creators use AI to generate gameplay systems, game-ready art and textures, animation, and playable web builds, then share public play pages under dreamforge.ai/play. The platform pairs a creator-facing web studio (including an Asset Studio) with a consumer application distributed on Steam, iOS, and Android. Founded in 2025 and based in Miami, Florida, DreamForge is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). DreamForge supports stylized 3D world generation, textures, voxels, and billboarding workflows; native 3D model generation is not currently provided. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Eksab
providers.description: Eksab is a Cairo-based daily fantasy sports and football-prediction platform for the MENA region. Founded in 2017 by Aly Mahmoud, it lets fans predict the scores and outcomes of live football matches, earn points based on the accuracy of their picks, and win prizes through free and paid competitions. The platform has grown to over 700,000 registered users making more than a million picks each month, and in 2022 became the exclusive fantasy sports partner of the Egyptian Premier League. Eksab is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), 4DX Ventures, and others across roughly $3.7M in seed funding. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Eksab is a consumer mobile/web product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Exa Finance
providers.description: EXA Finance is a French Web3 company, founded in 2021, that builds EXA Market — a peer-to-peer NFT and multi-asset marketplace on the Algorand blockchain. Because Algorand represents both fungible tokens and NFTs under the single ASA (Algorand Standard Asset) standard, the EXA Market protocol lets users bundle up to four assets into a "basket" and trade them in a single transaction, sell NFTs for any ASA rather than only the native ALGO token, make peer-to-peer offers, and run standard sales, normal and Dutch/reverse auctions, and multi-mints. Creators set an on-chain royalty fee of up to 15% globally against their creator address, payable in ALGO, USDC, USDT and other opted-in assets. The protocol is governed by the EXA token (ASA ID 1888888888) through the EXA Community DAO, whose EXRC/EXIP proposal lifecycle is modeled on Uniswap, dYdX, Tinyman and Blur. EXA raised a $2M seed round in January 2022 with Speedinvest, Lemniscap, Big Brain Holdings, Borderless Capital, Encode Club, Meld Ventures, 11-11 DG Partners and 0x Ventures. EXA Market publishes no public HTTP/REST API: its programmable surface is on-chain Algorand smart contracts (listing, offer and auction contracts, published as TEAL approval programs), reached through standard Algorand algod and indexer node APIs and the Algorand SDKs.

providers.name: FitOn
providers.description: FitOn is a consumer digital fitness and wellness platform offering free, on-demand workout classes (cardio, strength, yoga, Pilates, HIIT), guided meditation, personalized meal plans and nutrition tracking, recipes, and social challenges. FitOn serves 15 million+ members with celebrity and world-class trainers across mobile, web, and connected-TV apps (Apple TV, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV). Its FitOn Health arm delivers an enterprise wellness benefit to employers, health plans, and brokers. FitOn is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass FitOn publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; consumer and B2B integration is handled through partnership programs rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: FLYR Labs
providers.description: FLYR (formerly FLYR Labs) is a San Francisco-headquartered travel technology company, founded in 2013, that builds an AI-native commercial operating system for airlines, cargo carriers and hospitality operators. Its airline portfolio spans the Cirrus Revenue Operating System (deep-learning forecasting, dynamic pricing and revenue management) and an Offer & Order Management System built on IATA open standards — NDC and ONE Order — with a certified NDC+ API, an NDC Gateway for indirect and B2B channels (GDS, OTAs), and a Legacy Translator for backward compatibility with existing PSS estates. Its hospitality arm, FLYR Hospitality (built on the acquired Pace Revenue platform), ships Optimize, Insights, Planning and Groups to 2,300+ properties with native two-way integrations into property management systems including Mews, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Apaleo, Cloudbeds, RMS Cloud, Stayntouch and Planet/Protel. FLYR has raised over $500M and employs more than 700 people. Its APIs are commercial and partner-gated: the developer portal at developer.flyr.com requires an account, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL schema is published to anonymous callers.

providers.name: Gap
providers.description: Gap Inc. is a Fortune 500 American clothing and accessories retailer operating the Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic and Athleta brands. Gap Inc. publishes no public developer API, no machine-readable contract and no developer portal: probing found an Apigee gateway at api.gap.com that exposes no proxy to an anonymous caller, and a dangling developer-portal CNAME at developer.gap.com (gap-api-docs-portal.apigee.net) whose service is gone and whose TLS certificate does not cover the hostname. What Gap does publish is a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure programme and one first-party open-source Android HTTP library. This repository is an independent third-party profile of that public surface.

providers.name: GetHarley
providers.description: GetHarley is a UK-based telehealth and skincare platform delivering personalised, medical-grade skincare through online consultations. Patients answer questions about their skin concerns, book a video consultation, and are matched with one of a network of over 1,000 licensed dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, and plastic surgeons, who recommend a tailored regimen of medical-grade products delivered to the patient. GetHarley operates both a patient-facing storefront and a practitioner platform used by clinicians to manage recommendations, orders, and client relationships. Backed by Index Ventures, the company addresses concerns such as acne, fine lines, pigmentation, and ageing. As of this profile, GetHarley does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an MCP server; this record captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Go Kit
providers.description: Go Kit is a programming toolkit for building microservices in Go, emphasizing domain-driven design, transport-agnostic service definitions, and best practices for distributed systems.

providers.name: Hipcamp
providers.description: Hipcamp is the #1 app to find and book campsites globally, with real-time availability across more than 500,000 sites in the United States, Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom. Campers search national parks, state parks, RV resorts, and private land stays (farms, ranches, vineyards) in one app, with filters, Pro map layers (BLM/USFS land, cell coverage, dark skies), road-trip search, and free availability alerts. Hosts list and manage campsites, sync calendars, and take weekly payouts. Hipcamp integrates with campground reservation systems (ResNexus, Cloudbeds, Newbook, RMS, Bedful) but publishes no public developer API — /api and /graphql are internal-only. Surfaced as an a16z / Bond Capital / Slow Ventures portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Horizon Quantum Computing
providers.description: Horizon Quantum Computing is a Singapore-based quantum software company founded in 2018 by Dr. Joe Fitzsimons. It builds software infrastructure for quantum applications, centered on Triple Alpha, an integrated development environment that lets developers write hardware-agnostic quantum programs at multiple levels of abstraction and deploy them to quantum processors. Triple Alpha's final workflow step packages a program and deploys it as an API so developers can invoke quantum backends from Python scripts, web pages, and other technologies. Horizon operates its own quantum computing testbed at its Singapore headquarters and supports a range of external quantum processors, aiming to bridge the gap between today's quantum hardware and real-world applications. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or client SDK; API-based program deployment is offered to early-access users of the Triple Alpha platform.

providers.name: Hostie
providers.description: Hostie is an AI-powered virtual concierge for restaurants that answers every call, text, email, and message in the restaurant's own voice so operators never miss a guest and staff can stay focused on in-room service. The conversational AI platform handles phone volume, captures reservations and takeout orders, fields private-event inquiries, and unifies guest communication across calls, texts, emails, Instagram, and Google Maps, with live call transcripts, multilingual support (20 languages), guest history, and data ownership. Restaurant partners include Tonchin, Trader Vic's, Flour + Water, The Slanted Door Group, and The Stinking Rose Group. Hostie raised a $12M Series A led by Obvious Ventures (July 2026), bringing total funding to $16M. Hostie is a business SaaS product and does not currently publish a public API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: iMotorbike
providers.description: iMotorbike is a Southeast Asian online marketplace and service platform for buying, selling, and servicing pre-owned motorcycles, operating across Malaysia and Vietnam. Sellers submit their bike details, book a free inspection, receive a quotation, and get paid fast, while iMotorbike handles loan settlement and JPJ ownership transfer on their behalf. Buyers shop iM Certified motorcycles backed by a 170-point inspection, a 12-month warranty, and a 6-day return policy, and can book test rides, inspections, and roadside assistance (iM Rescue) through the platform. Founded in 2017 and backed by 500 Global, Headline, Gobi Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst, iMotorbike closed a US$10M Series A in 2025 to expand across the region. The company runs a consumer-facing web marketplace and an internal admin platform; it does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: InvestaX
providers.description: InvestaX is a Singapore-based, MAS-licensed tokenization platform for real-world assets (RWAs), operated by IC SG Pte. Ltd. under a Capital Markets Services license (CMS100635) and a Recognised Market Operator license from the Monetary Authority of Singapore. The platform provides end-to-end infrastructure for the issuance, distribution, secondary trading, and custody of security tokens and tokenized securities, plus a Tokenization SaaS product for institutional issuers and RWA investment products such as tokenized money market funds and private credit. It supports multiple blockchain protocols including Ethereum, Polygon, BASE, Algorand, Tezos, and Hedera. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Kafene
providers.description: Kafene is a New York-based point-of-sale financing platform that lets retailers offer transparent lease-to-own (LTO) purchase options to prime and non-prime consumers. Founded in 2019 by Neal Desai and James Schuler, the company underwrites shoppers with an AI-driven risk model that pulls 20,000+ data points to return an approval — up to $5,000 — in seconds, then pays the merchant directly on delivery confirmation while the customer pays weekly or biweekly until ownership. Merchants originate applications from their in-store POS or by sending a text-to-apply link; consumers manage leases and payments in a self-service dashboard. Kafene raised a ~$31M Series B and reaches merchants through financing-waterfall networks such as Versatile Credit and LendPro. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment probe Kafene publishes no public developer program, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP contract, no SDKs, and no /.well-known discovery surface; its merchant and consumer surfaces are authenticated single-page web applications and integration is arranged through Kafene's partner team, not self-serve documentation.

providers.name: Kallyope
providers.description: Kallyope, Inc. is a New York City clinical-stage biotechnology company, founded in 2015 by Columbia University scientists Charles Zuker, Tom Maniatis and Richard Axel, that translates the biology of the gut-brain axis into medicines. It launched with a $44M Series A and has since raised a $66M Series B, a $112M Series C and a $236M Series D co-led by Mubadala Investment Company and The Column Group, with backers including Bill Gates, Lux Capital, Polaris Partners, Casdin Capital and Alexandria Real Estate Equities. Its proprietary Klarity platform integrates single-cell sequencing, pathway circuit mapping, optogenetics and chemogenetics, proprietary human genetics, mouse and human organoid systems, and small-molecule and peptide chemistry to map the neural circuits underlying migraine and metabolism; lead candidate elismetrep, a TRPM8 blocker, is in Phase 3 development for acute migraine. Kallyope publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDKs, CLI, status page or public GitHub organization, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP or A2A agent-card surface was found on any host. Enrichment probing did find one real, anonymous, read-only REST surface: kallyope.com runs WordPress and exposes the WordPress REST API publicly at https://kallyope.com/wp-json, carrying the company news feed, site pages, media library and a first-party "document" content type of scientific posters, presentations and publications classified by the custom program, event, content-type and document-type taxonomies.

providers.name: Lala
providers.description: Lala (meetlala.io) is an AI content platform for educators that turns recordings of online classes into publishable social media content. Instructors either host lessons natively on Lala's own video-call product or upload an existing recording by file or link, and Lala automatically curates short-form Reels in Instagram and TikTok aspect ratios, assembles packaged courses, and returns a transcription and summary after each class. It is sold in three tiers -- Free, Pro and Enterprise -- metered on upload minutes, video-call participants and Reels generated per class, and is aimed at tutors, music instructors, teacherpreneurs, schools and universities. Lala is a 500 Global portfolio company that came out of the 500 Georgia program. As of July 2026 Lala publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Lamudi
providers.description: Lamudi is an online real estate classifieds marketplace focused exclusively on emerging markets, founded in 2013 and today operating consumer property portals in the Philippines (lamudi.com.ph), Indonesia (lamudi.co.id) and Mexico (lamudi.com.mx). The platform lets buyers, renters, sellers and landlords search and list houses, condominiums/apartments, land, commercial space and offices, filtered by geography, property group and operation (buy/rent). Search results pages carry area market statistics, interactive maps and nearby points of interest, alongside country-specific features such as Philippine foreclosures and home-loan comparison, Indonesian KPR mortgage simulators, and Mexican Infonavit-eligible listings and bank repossessions. Agencies and developers publish inventory through the pro.lamudi.com professional portal. Lamudi operates as part of LIFULL Connect, which supplies its legal notice, privacy policy and contact surface. Lamudi publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal; its notable machine-readable surface is a first-party llms.txt on each country site that documents the URL grammar of its search, new development and project pages for AI agents.

providers.name: Lazada
providers.description: Lazada Group is a Southeast Asian e-commerce platform owned by Alibaba Group since 2016, operating localized marketplaces in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Lazada Open Platform (openapi.lazada.com) provides a partner-facing REST API for sellers, brands, ERP / OMS vendors, and TP (TaoBao Partner) developers — covering Product / Category catalog, Order processing, Logistics and shipping label generation, Finance and payout reconciliation, Shop and Seller profile, Promotion management (vouchers, FlexiCombo, Sponsored Solutions), Image / asset upload, Returns and reverse logistics, and Bidirectional message webhooks. Authentication uses an App Key + App Secret plus a per-seller access token issued via OAuth-style seller authorization, with all requests signed using HMAC-SHA256 in Alibaba's TOP signature scheme.

providers.name: Lenskart
providers.description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer eyewear company operating an omnichannel retail business across prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses and eye-care services. It sells through localized storefronts (India, United States, Singapore and other markets) and mobile apps, and merchandises its own house brands including Vincent Chase, John Jacobs, Lenskart Studio and Lenskart Boost alongside third-party labels. The digital experience layer includes 3D/AR virtual try-on and look comparison, a saved-prescription and prescription-history profile, order tracking and a loyalty program. Lenskart is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this enrichment pass Lenskart publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or client SDKs; the developer- and docs-named subdomains that resolve are gated behind Cloudflare and return 403 to unauthenticated clients, so no API surface could be verified.

providers.name: LightSource
providers.description: LightSource is an AI-native direct materials procurement platform that connects engineering, procurement, and suppliers across the full sourcing lifecycle from concept to award. The product automates RFX creation and distribution, AI-assisted bid analysis, supplier collaboration and quote normalization across custom quote formats, and ongoing cost tracking, with more than 20,000 suppliers live on the network. It is sold to procurement and supply-chain teams in automotive, electronics, chemicals, medical devices, construction, and forest products, and the company reports sourcing cost reductions of 3-25% for customers including Time Manufacturing (Versalift), Arxada, BRP, and Canada Goose. LightSource is SOC 2 Type 2 attested and supports SSO and role-based access control. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; its docs host is an end-user and supplier help center.

providers.name: mactechsolutionsllc-com
providers.description: MacTech Solutions LLC is a veteran‑owned Small Disadvantaged Business (SDVOSB) specializing in federal cybersecurity and compliance services. It helps DoD primes and subcontractors achieve CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800‑171, DFARS 252.204‑7012, and RMF readiness, offering expertise in Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) protection, STIG compliance, and supply‑chain cyber risk management. Founded in 2024, the company provides consulting, assessment, and implementation services to secure mission‑critical programs and maintain authorization to operate (ATO) for defense industrial base contractors.

providers.name: MISP
providers.description: MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform & Threat Sharing) is an open source threat intelligence platform that enables sharing, storing and correlating of structured threat information. It provides a robust set of features including taxonomies, galaxy clusters, warning lists, and a flexible API for integration. The project is community‑driven and widely adopted by security teams, CERTs, and researchers worldwide to improve collaborative defense against cyber threats.

providers.name: Nannostomus
providers.description: Nannostomus provides a sex offender search API covering 771k+ offender records across all 50 U.S. states and 14 territories. It supports search by state and name, with monthly per-state record updates, deduplication, and 99.9% uptime backed by cloud infrastructure. A free tier covers up to 100 requests per month with tiered pay-as-you-go pricing beyond that.

providers.name: Neurelis
providers.description: Neurelis, Inc. is a privately held San Diego neuroscience and specialty pharmaceutical company founded in 2007 that licenses, develops and commercializes therapies for epilepsy, psychiatry and other central nervous system disorders with high unmet need. Its lead commercial product is VALTOCO (diazepam nasal spray), an FDA-approved acute treatment for intermittent, stereotypic episodes of frequent seizure activity (seizure clusters) in adult and pediatric patients two years of age and older, built on Intravail transmucosal absorption-enhancement technology acquired with Aegis Therapeutics. Neurelis also holds the ProTek and Hydrogel drug-delivery platforms, licenses Intravail to partners such as ARS Pharmaceuticals and Dr. Reddy's/Upsher-Smith, and is advancing the NRL-1049 and NRL-1004 pipeline programs. Neurelis publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract; its only agent-facing machine-readable surface is a set of llms.txt documents served on its corporate, product and patient-support properties.

providers.name: nsKnox
providers.description: nsKnox is an Israeli fintech-security company that protects business-to-business payments against fraud and misdirection for corporations and banks. Founded and led by Alon Cohen, the founder and former CEO of CyberArk, nsKnox built its platform on a patented Cooperative Cyber Security (CCS) architecture in which payment and bank-account data is shredded and distributed across multiple independent "Knoxer" systems so that no single breach reveals anything. Its PaymentKnox product line covers outgoing payments (accounts payable), incoming payments (accounts receivable), Bank Account Certificates, Master Data Guard, Payment Check, and an Adaptive Payment Security service that validates payee bank accounts worldwide using Quick Check in-network lookups and Knox Verify out-of-network mini-transactions against the banking system. Customers connect through a hosted portal, scheduled file transfer, or a direct ERP API integration with systems such as SAP and Oracle. nsKnox publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; the API surface is documented to onboarded customers only.

providers.name: Octave Bioscience
providers.description: Octave Bioscience is a precision neurology company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, that develops blood-based multi-protein biomarker tests for chronic neurological disease. Its commercially available Octave Multiple Sclerosis Disease Activity (MSDA) Test measures a panel of serum proteins to produce a quantitative disease activity score used alongside clinical and imaging assessment, and is available across the United States through a strategic collaboration with Quest Diagnostics. The company is also developing a Multiple Sclerosis Disease Progression (MSDP) test and a Parkinson's disease biomarker assay supported by a Michael J. Fox Foundation grant. Octave publishes a public trust center documenting HITRUST, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, HIPAA and GDPR posture, but operates no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Opto
providers.description: Opto (Opto Investments) is an end-to-end private markets investment platform built for wealth managers - RIAs, family offices, and private banks. The platform helps advisors build, fundraise for, and manage private investment programs across asset classes including infrastructure, private credit, private equity, real estate, and venture capital. Opto covers the full workflow: modeling allocations and automating operations to build a program, creating client materials and streamlining subscriptions to fundraise, and deploying capital with automated post-trade reporting to manage it. The company connects to existing custodians, investment-management tools, and reporting providers, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; access is through the advisor application and partner program.

providers.name: OSARO
providers.description: OSARO is a San Francisco-based industrial AI company that builds machine-learning software for warehouse and fulfillment robotics. Its SightWorks perception platform and AutoModel learning system let industrial robot arms perceive, grasp and place highly variable goods without per-SKU pre-training, 3D object models or fixed programming, powering piece picking, robotic bagging, kitting and mixed-case depalletizing in production deployments across five countries. OSARO sells complete robotic work cells and licenses its perception software to robot makers and system integrators, wrapping deployments in its HyperCare support program. The company publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; integration with customer estates (WMS/WCS, conveyors, ASRS, AMRs) is delivered as a professional-services engagement through OSARO and its integrator partners rather than through a self-serve API.

providers.name: Overture Maps Foundation
providers.description: Overture Maps Foundation is a Linux Foundation collaborative project that produces free, open, and interoperable map data. Overture publishes cloud-native GeoParquet datasets, on a regular release cadence, across six themes - Addresses, Base, Buildings, Divisions, Places, and Transportation - governed by a common conflation pipeline and an open schema. Rather than a hosted REST API, Overture distributes data through Amazon S3 and Microsoft Azure (and via partner mirrors on BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Fused, Wherobots), and provides an open Python CLI, a tile generator, and an Explorer site for developers. Founding members include Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, and TomTom.

providers.name: Patronus AI
providers.description: Patronus AI is a research lab developing training data and simulated environments for frontier AI. Its work spans reinforcement learning environments and digital world models for agents operating in software.

providers.name: PermitFlow
providers.description: PermitFlow is an AI-powered construction permitting platform that simplifies permit preparation, submission, and tracking nationwide for contractors, home builders, commercial contractors, architects, developers, and home-services businesses. The product handles permitting paperwork across municipalities with AI agents for intake, research, submission, coordination, and issuance, and covers permit management, inspections and closeouts, and license and registration management. Backed by Accel, Felicis, and Initialized Capital, PermitFlow operates an internal product API (api.permitflow.com) and web application (app.permitflow.com) but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Poshmark
providers.description: Poshmark is a social commerce marketplace where people in the US, Canada, Australia and India buy and sell new and secondhand fashion, accessories, home goods, beauty products, and electronics. Sellers list items from their closets, share and cross-promote listings across the community, host live selling shows, and ship using prepaid labels while Poshmark handles payments and buyer protection. Founded 2011, IPO 2021, acquired by Naver in 2023. Poshmark runs a consumer web and mobile marketplace backed by internal APIs but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prism
providers.description: Prism is an open source HTTP mock and validation server from Stoplight that generates dynamic mock responses and validates requests against OpenAPI specifications.

providers.name: QwikCilver
providers.description: QwikCilver is India's largest gift card and prepaid commerce company, founded in 2006 and acquired by Pine Labs in 2019. It powers gift card issuance, distribution, and redemption for retailers, banks, and enterprises, and operates the consumer and corporate gifting marketplace Woohoo (woohoo.in), which sells digital and physical gift cards from 300+ brands. Its API platform (hosted on woohoo.in) lets partners programmatically browse catalogs, place bulk gift card orders, activate and redeem cards, check balances, and run reward, incentive, and channel-engagement programs. QwikCilver is an Accel portfolio company in the consumer / fintech sector.

providers.name: RatedPower
providers.description: RatedPower, part of Enverus (ENVERUS RATEDPOWER S.L.U., Madrid, Spain), is a cloud software platform for the design and engineering of utility-scale renewable energy projects. Its pvDesign product automates solar photovoltaic (PV) plant layout, energy-yield simulation, battery energy storage system (BESS) and hybrid plant design, substation and grid-connection engineering, earthwork estimating, and bankable proposal documentation. The platform is delivered as a browser-based SaaS application (login at ratedpower.enverus.com) and reports 64,000+ projects designed and 5.1 TW of simulated capacity. No public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal is published; enterprise automation access exists only behind the authenticated application. This profile was seeded as a Techstars portfolio lead and has been run through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Rebellions
providers.description: Rebellions is an AI infrastructure company that designs energy-efficient AI inference hardware (NPUs) and the software stack to deploy large language and multimodal models on it at scale. Its products include the Rebel100 inference chip (FP8, HBM3e), the ATOM-Max Server and POD, and RebelServer. The RBLN SDK compiles and serves HuggingFace Transformers/Diffusers, PyTorch, and TensorFlow models on RBLN accelerators, with integrations for vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, TorchServe, and Kubernetes. Rebellions does not expose a public REST/HTTP API; developers integrate through first-party Python SDKs (optimum-rbln, vllm-rbln), the RBLN compiler and driver, and the model zoo. Backed by Kindred Ventures and partnered with Samsung, Arm, IBM, and AWS.

providers.name: Robby
providers.description: Robby is an AI-powered growth and job-documentation platform for home-services businesses, focused on HVAC contractors. It automates job documentation and paperwork for technicians so they can focus on servicing equipment and talking to customers, combines customer and third-party data to surface new leads daily, equips technicians with talking points to increase sales, and gives management a dashboard to monitor the revenue opportunities captured from every visit. Robby is an early-stage Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup that currently publishes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: scanbimlabs-io
providers.description: scanbimlabs-io is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: ScreenPoint Medical
providers.description: ScreenPoint Medical is a Netherlands-based healthcare AI company, founded in 2014 by Professor Nico Karssemeijer and Professor Sir Michael Brady, that develops Transpara Breast AI for earlier detection of breast cancer in 2D (FFDM) and 3D (DBT) mammography. Transpara is vendor-agnostic, integrates into PACS and reading workflows via medical-imaging (DICOM) pipelines rather than a public developer API, and is FDA cleared (K241831, K232096) and CE marked (0344). The product is used in over 200 clinics across 25+ countries and is backed by three randomized controlled trials (including MASAI in The Lancet). The company is backed by Insight Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline: no public developer/API surface exists, but real security-disclosure and compliance posture were captured.

providers.name: Selency
