Diagon publishes no public developer API today; its /api surface is an authenticated first-party application API (Clerk-based session auth) and is disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Everself
providers.description: Bariendo Inc. (now operating as Everself) is a science-forward digital health company pioneering non-surgical, endoscopic weight-loss care. Founded in 2023 by Harvard Medical School physicians Dr. Christopher C. Thompson (the inventor of Endoscopic Sleeve Gastroplasty) and Dr. Pichamol Jirapinyo, the company delivers minimally invasive procedures — ESG Stomach Tightening, gastric balloon, and revision of prior bariatric surgery — alongside weight-loss medication and a 12-month concierge care program. Its consumer platform streamlines access to these interventions across a dozen-plus U.S. locations, with financing, telehealth consultations, and ongoing weight tracking. Bariendo/Everself is a consumer and clinical health service; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Foresight Diagnostics
providers.description: Foresight Diagnostics is a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited cancer diagnostics company founded in 2020 in Boulder, Colorado by Stanford physicians and scientists, and since February 2026 a wholly owned subsidiary of Natera. Its Foresight CLARITY minimal residual disease (MRD) platform is a liquid-biopsy test powered by proprietary PhasED-Seq phased-variant sequencing and bioinformatics, detecting circulating tumor DNA at an analytical sensitivity below one part per million across lymphoma, lung and other solid tumors. The company sells laboratory testing services to biopharma sponsors, academic researchers and clinicians rather than software: it operates a central laboratory and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Freed
providers.description: Freed is a San Francisco-based AI medical scribe and clinician assistant designed to reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers. The product listens to patient visits and generates SOAP-style clinical notes, visit summaries, patient instructions, referral letters, and ICD-10 / CPT coding suggestions, then transfers the finalized note into the clinician's EHR via a browser-resident agent. Freed was founded in 2023 by former Facebook engineers Erez Druk (CEO) and Andrey Bannikov (CTO) after Druk's wife, a practicing family physician, experienced the daily toll of manual charting. The company is consumer self-serve: clinicians sign up for a 7-day free trial and then a monthly Starter, Core, Premier, or custom Groups plan with no enterprise sales required. As of 2025 Freed reported more than 20,000 paying clinician users and raised a $30M Series A led by Sequoia Capital, bringing total funding to $34M. The platform is HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and HITECH-ready; patient recordings are not stored. Rather than ship a traditional public REST API, Freed pursues an "anti-integration" model in which a Chrome-extension AI agent navigates any web-based EHR (Athena, Tebra, PracticeFusion, TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, Elation, AdvancedMD, Cerbo, and others) to place the finished note in the correct fields. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: Gigster
providers.description: Gigster is an enterprise software-development services company that connects businesses with top-tier global talent for custom software development, AI solutions, and digital transformation. Through a network of 50,000+ vetted developers, designers, and product experts, Gigster delivers work under three engagement models: Fully Managed (Gigster owns scoping through delivery), Dedicated Teams (skilled teams that scale with a client's goals), and Talent On Demand (specialists who blend into an existing team). Specialized practices cover AI development, innovation/design/UX, applications and platforms, and system modernization. Gigster reports 1,000+ enterprise engagements, a 95% on-time/on-budget delivery rate, and average staffing under 10 days, and is backed by a16z, Bloomberg Beta, and Redpoint Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Harness Wealth
providers.description: Harness — the company that launched as Harness Wealth, and today a wholly owned business of Multiplier, Inc. — is a New York City firm that runs an advisory platform for tax and wealth practices. It operates three connected surfaces: a marketplace that matches individuals with complex financial situations (equity compensation, liquidity events, business owners, real estate, high net worth) to vetted tax advisors; a client portal and workflow platform that tax firms run their engagements, documents, questionnaires and e-file on; and Harness Wealth Advisers, LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser that recommends third-party advisers. Harness publishes no public developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, CLI or webhook documentation on any Harness host, and the product is delivered entirely as an end-user web application at app.harness.co.

providers.name: Hebbia
providers.description: Hebbia provides institutional-grade AI for finance and high-stakes enterprise work, centered on its Matrix product that reasons across massive volumes of unstructured documents. The platform connects to enterprise data sources such as Snowflake, AWS S3, SharePoint, Box, Dropbox, and Egnyte, and financial data providers including FactSet, S&P Capital IQ, PitchBook, Guidepoint, and Thirdbridge. Hebbia is a sales-led enterprise product without a fully public developer portal; API and integration access is granted to customers through their account team.

providers.name: Hilltop Holdings
providers.description: Hilltop Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HTH, dual-listed on NYSE Texas) is a Dallas-based financial services holding company that operates through three wholly owned subsidiaries: PlainsCapital Bank, a Texas commercial bank; HilltopSecurities, a full-service investment bank covering public finance, wealth management, fixed income capital markets and structured finance; and PrimeLending, a national residential mortgage originator. Hilltop Holdings itself is a holding company, not a software vendor — it publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable specification at the holding-company level, and the subsidiaries surface their technology as end-user platforms (MOmentum Advisor, HilltopBancSystems, loan servicing portals) rather than as public APIs. This profile records that public surface as it actually is: a corporate site that serves an llms.txt and nothing else a machine can consume.

providers.name: Humanitru
providers.description: Humanitru is an integration-first CRM and fundraising platform built for nonprofits, museums, zoos, aquariums, botanic gardens, and food banks. Rather than forcing organizations into an all-in-one ecosystem, Humanitru consolidates donor, membership, ticketing, email marketing, accounting, and volunteer data from more than 40 partner tools into a single 360-degree view, then layers automated insights, reporting, and donor-engagement workflows on top. The company positions itself around data consolidation and retention, citing customer outcomes such as increased active donors and improved donor retention, and pairs the platform with one-on-one support staffed by former fundraisers and database managers. Humanitru (formerly operating as Totem Insights) is a Techstars portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation; all connectivity is delivered through its curated native integration catalog.

providers.name: jQuery
providers.description: jQuery is a fast, small, and feature-rich JavaScript library that makes HTML document traversal and manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax much simpler with an easy-to-use API that works across a multitude of browsers. Only about 30kB minified and gzipped, available as an AMD module, and CSS3 compliant. jQuery 4.0 is the current release; jQuery 3.x receives critical updates only.

providers.name: Lemonaide
providers.description: Lemonaide is a Bangkok-headquartered B2B used-car and insurtech platform operating across Southeast Asia, positioning itself as a technology and services layer that reduces asymmetric information in the automotive market. The company sells software to used-car dealerships and insurers, including a Dealer Management System, a Dealer CRM with microtargeting, and a Digital Escrow settlement product, alongside operated services such as after-sales BPO, warranty third-party administration, 24-hour digital roadside assistance, vehicle inspection, and repair-workshop audit assessment. Lemonaide states that more than 2,000 dealers use its platform and names Carro, Carsome, and Toyota Sure among its partners. It is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Lemonaide publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Midas
providers.description: Midas, kullanıcıların Borsa İstanbul, Amerikan borsaları, Avrupa borsaları, yatırım fonları, kripto varlıklar, VİOP, opsiyon piyasası, varantlar ve emtialar gibi farklı yatırım araçlarına tek bir uygulama üzerinden erişmesini sağlayan bir yatırım platformudur. 2020 yılında kurulmuş ve İstanbul, Türkiye merkezli bir fintech şirketidir. Platform, hem bireysel hem kurumsal yatırımcılara kapsamlı piyasa verileri, alım satım hizmetleri ve eğitim içerikleri sunar.

providers.name: nChannel
providers.description: nChannel is a SaaS integration platform that empowers retailers and wholesalers to synchronize data across eCommerce, ERP, POS, and 3PL systems. It automates processes such as order fulfillment, inventory synchronization, and supply chain management, providing a unified hub for seamless data flow between disparate business applications.

providers.name: Newfront
providers.description: Newfront is a modern business insurance brokerage and technology company headquartered in San Francisco. It combines a traditional insurance brokerage (commercial business insurance, employee benefits, retirement services, and risk management) with a software platform that gives clients transparent data and analytics to understand and lower their total cost of risk. Formed from the merger of Newfront and ABD Insurance, the company serves technology, venture-backed, and enterprise clients across property and casualty, health and benefits, and personal lines. Backed by Index Ventures, Susa Ventures, and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass Newfront exposes a client-facing web application (app.newfront.com) but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Nexthop AI
providers.description: Nexthop AI is a networking infrastructure company building next-generation, highly efficient AI and cloud networking for hyperscalers and neo-cloud operators. Founded by former Arista Networks operations leader Anshul Sadana, it designs scale-out and scale-across Ethernet switches, a networking software portfolio, and optics and cables engineered to lower the cost per token of large GPU clusters by improving power efficiency, cost, reliability, and speed of deployment. The company raised a $500M Series B led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Andreessen Horowitz at a $4.2B valuation and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio lead. It publishes no public web/REST API surface; this profile captures company identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Noozra
providers.description: Noozra provides a free News API that aggregates articles across categories such as politics, science, world, weather, finance, sports, entertainment, health, and AI. Users can retrieve up to 100 articles per day with a bearer token, and a Pro plan offers higher limits for $9 per month. Each article includes headline, summary, source, URL, and publication date, and links back to the original publisher. The platform also hosts community features like forums and games.

providers.name: Odeko
providers.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

providers.name: One
providers.description: OnePay (formerly One / One Finance) is a Walmart-backed consumer fintech that delivers a single mobile app combining banking, high-yield savings, a CashRewards debit card, a credit-building card, buy-now-pay-later, investing, cryptocurrency trading, and tax filing. Banking services are provided through partner banks Coastal Community Bank and Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The product is consumer-facing with no public developer API; a partner/developer portal exists behind authentication at developer.onepay.com. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Operto
providers.description: Operto provides industry-leading hospitality management software that streamlines operations, enhances guest experiences, and drives growth for hotels, vacation rentals, student housing, and multi‑family properties. Its platform includes modules for guest access, mobile keys, contactless check‑in, housekeeping, scheduling, inventory, preventative maintenance, payroll, and digital guidebooks, helping property owners automate tasks and increase revenue.

providers.name: Orchid Labs
providers.description: Orchid Labs is the company behind Orchid, an open-source, decentralized marketplace for bandwidth and a privacy-focused VPN. Orchid lets users pay for VPN service through nanopayments settled on a probabilistic payment layer built on Ethereum, using the OXT utility token and Orchid Accounts rather than traditional subscriptions. The stack includes an open-source multi-hop VPN client (Dart), the Orchid DApp for account creation and management, a decentralized directory of bandwidth providers running as smart contracts, and an L2/L3 nanopayment protocol. Backed by a16z, Sequoia Capital, DFJ, and Polychain, Orchid Labs focuses on decentralized privacy infrastructure rather than a conventional developer REST API.

providers.name: Paro
providers.description: Paro is an AI-powered professional services marketplace that connects businesses and accounting firms with vetted, on-demand finance and accounting experts. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Chicago, Paro uses proprietary AI matching to pair clients with the top 2% of finance professionals across 60+ industries and 250+ skill sets — spanning bookkeeping, fractional CFO and controller services, financial planning and analysis, tax and compliance, and full-time recruiting. For accounting firms it provides staff augmentation, busy-season support, and service-expansion consulting. Paro operates a talent platform (app.paro.io) but does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, content, and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Protecto
providers.description: Protecto, operating under the brand GPT Guard, provides enterprise‑grade AI chat solutions that ensure zero data leakage and privacy compliance. Their platform masks sensitive information in real‑time, enabling organizations to safely leverage large language models without risking PII or PHI exposure. Targeting banks, fintechs, and regulated industries, Protecto offers data loss prevention, encryption, and policy enforcement for AI interactions, backed by demos, documentation, and a privacy‑first approach.

providers.name: Rapidminer
providers.description: RapidMiner (now Altair RapidMiner / Altair AI) is a data science and machine learning platform that unites data preparation, machine learning, and predictive model deployment in a visual, low-code environment. The developer surface is centered on the official `rapidminer` Python package for interacting with Altair AI Studio and Altair AI Hub — reading and writing data, running and scheduling processes, managing git-based versioned projects and connections, and calling deployed Web API and Scoring endpoints — plus a Java/Python extension SDK for building custom operators. AI Hub authenticates via OAuth (offline token against a Keycloak-style authentication server). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Earlybird; RapidMiner was acquired by Altair, now part of Siemens.

providers.name: Red 6
providers.description: Red 6 (Red Six Aerospace, Inc.) is a defense technology company founded in 2018 that builds outdoor, high-speed augmented reality for military aviation training. Its flagship product, ATARS (Advanced Tactical Augmented Reality System), pairs the EVE (Enhanced Visual Environment) helmet-mounted display — 160-degree field of view, 18,000 nits, 10ms latency, full color — with an AI-driven multiplayer network so real pilots in real aircraft can fly and maneuver against synthetically generated adversaries in real time, in daylight. A companion system, ARCADE (Augmented Reality Command and Analytic Data Environment), handles mission planning, briefing and three-dimensional debrief. ATARS has been integrated or trialed on the USAF F-16 and MC-130, the RAF Hawk T-2, Boeing's AH-64E Apache CATT, and the Lockheed Martin / Korea Aerospace Industries T-50/TF-50. Red 6 is ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certified. It publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract — its software surface is delivered through defense programs and OEM integrations rather than a self-serve developer platform.

providers.name: Replica Studios
providers.description: Replica Studios (operated by Replica Media Pty Ltd) built AI voice, text-to-speech (TTS) and speech-to-speech (STS) technology for creators, game developers, and software teams. Its platform offered an AI Voice Library of 40+ expressive voices, Voice Lab for blending up to five voices into a custom character, and Voice Director for generating voice overs and dialogue. Developers integrated these capabilities through the Replica API v2 (OpenAPI 3.0.0) — a REST API supporting text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, and voice-listing operations, authenticated with API keys or Bearer JWTs minted at the /v2/auth endpoint. Replica Studios was a Techstars portfolio company. The company ceased operations on 2025-06-30; the marketing site now shows a farewell page and the api.replicastudios.com host no longer resolves, so this profile is a historical/discovery record captured from public documentation.

providers.name: Serve First
providers.description: Serve First is a UK-based AI-driven customer experience (CX) platform that unifies reviews, surveys, receipts, in-location feedback terminals, operational audits, and mystery shopping into a single dashboard. It turns real-time customer feedback into role-based, actionable insight, with sentiment analysis and unified reporting across retail, hospitality, facilities management, health & wellness, and franchise businesses. Serve First also provides Client Connect journey/workflow automation and Martyn's Law public-protection compliance management. Serve First does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures company identity plus verified security and compliance posture (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 via a Sprinto-hosted trust center).

providers.name: Showbie
providers.description: Showbie is a K-12 learning platform for iPad that streamlines teaching workflows across assignments, feedback, grading, and classroom communication for teachers, students, and parents. Backed by Point Nine, it combines a digital classroom, annotation and file-sharing tools, and messaging into a single app used by schools worldwide. Showbie exposes no public developer API, SDK, or docs surface; this profile captures the company's public web, support, compliance, privacy, and terms properties, plus a live domain security probe.

providers.name: Spiffy
providers.description: Get Spiffy, Inc. (Spiffy) is a B2B SaaS and operations company that sells a mobile service operating system to franchise car dealerships. Its core product, Mobile 360, is an enterprise platform covering scheduling, dispatch, route optimization, technician management, digital vehicle inspections, DMS integration and customer communication, sold as a turnkey program alongside van upfits, connected devices (Easy Tread, Easy Flow, Smart Tumbler) and technician training. Spiffy also runs fleet and Amazon DSP service programs, and operates a customer booking portal and a fleet portal. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Apex, North Carolina, the company has raised more than $90M and reports over 4 million completed services, with OEM work including a Hyundai Motor America pilot. Spiffy publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; its Fleet portal API is an internal, credentialed surface with no published contract.

providers.name: Stainless
providers.description: Stainless is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: vc-portfolio; backed by sequoia-capital) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company
providers.description: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited is a Japanese multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1781 and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (4502) and the New York Stock Exchange (TAK). It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Japan and Asia, and operates globally across oncology, rare genetic and hematologic diseases, neuroscience, gastroenterology, plasma-derived therapies and vaccines, a portfolio substantially expanded by its 2019 acquisition of Shire. Takeda is a software consumer rather than a software vendor: it runs large internal API and data platforms, but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract. The one machine-readable document it does serve to automated clients is an llms.txt at its corporate root, which indexes its verified country websites and states an explicit LLM usage and attribution policy.

providers.name: Tia Health
providers.description: Tia Health is a Canadian telehealth platform that connects patients with licensed Canadian providers - family doctors, nurse practitioners, specialists, and naturopaths - for on-demand virtual care by phone, video, and secure messaging. Its services span virtual walk-in and family-practice appointments, prescription renewals, sick notes, lab requisitions, and mental health therapy (via partner Focus Mental Wellness), with visits covered by provincial health plans in Ontario (OHIP), British Columbia (MSP), and Alberta (AHCIP) and paid options elsewhere. Tia Health is part of the WELL Health Technologies Corp. clinic network, one of the largest outpatient networks in Canada. As of this review Tia Health is a consumer-facing virtual-care product with no public developer portal, no documented REST/OpenAPI, and no exposed HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement or SMART-on-FHIR configuration; interoperability in the Canadian market is stewarded federally through Canada Health Infoway's pan-Canadian FHIR (CA Core / CA Baseline) specifications, which this platform does not publicly surface.

providers.name: Uni
providers.description: Uni (Uni Cards) is an Indian consumer credit fintech founded in 2020 by Nitin Gupta, Prateek Jindal, and Laxmikant Vyas that delivers clutter-breaking credit products to consumers in India, including pay-later style credit cards and flexible repayment products. Uni is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. The company is a consumer-facing app-first business and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: Womaness
providers.description: Womaness is a women-founded midlife wellness brand created to modernize aging for women and to help them navigate the phases their bodies move through around menopause. The direct-to-consumer company sells clean, estrogen-free, doctor-approved and clinically tested skincare, supplements, sexual-health and menopause-support products (including Let's Neck serum, Melt for You inserts and Daily V Soothe) through a Shopify-hosted online store and select retail partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API surface.

providers.name: AbleSky
providers.description: AbleSky, Inc. (能力天空) is an online-education SaaS company incorporated in 2007 in Mountain View, California, operating in China through its wholly owned subsidiary 能力天空科技（北京）有限公司 in Beijing. Its platform lets a school, training institution or instructor stand up a branded online school — website, Android and iOS apps, WeChat micro-school and official account — with course hosting, live classes, exams, educational-administration workflow, course distribution and learner payment collection, marketed as roughly 3,000 features to training organisations across more than 2,000 Chinese cities. It also sells an independent deployment onto a customer's own cloud or hardware. It publishes NO public API: contract discovery on 2026-09-06 found no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, gRPC service, MCP server, agent card, SDK or developer portal on any AbleSky host. The one machine-readable document it does publish is a valid, auto-discoverable OpenSearch 1.1 course-search descriptor.

providers.name: Acerta
providers.description: Acerta (Acerta Analytics Solutions Inc.) is a Canadian industrial-AI company whose LinePulse platform delivers AI-driven manufacturing quality analytics for discrete manufacturing. Founded in 2017 in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Acerta helps Tier-1 automotive and powertrain manufacturers detect defects early, reduce scrap and rework, and root-cause complex production issues in real time. LinePulse replaces statistical process control software, spreadsheets, and custom querying tools with real-time SPC, predictive monitoring, and machine-learning root-cause analysis, and ingests production data through a proprietary secure ingestion API. The platform is built on Microsoft Azure, is SOC 2 Type 1 certified, and is proven across 300+ production lines in 12 countries with customers including BorgWarner, Dana, Linamar, Ford, ZF, Ballard, and BMW. Acerta is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. Acerta exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, self-serve sign-up, or SDKs; integration is delivered through enterprise deployment with the LinePulse ingestion API.

providers.name: Agentic BI
providers.description: Agentic BI lets users ask a single natural‑language prompt and receive full analytics results, including charts, Slack alerts, and scheduled reports, without their data ever reaching OpenAI or Google. The platform runs on private AI models or lets users choose third‑party models, connects to any data source—SQL, NoSQL, REST APIs—without custom pipelines, and delivers answers in Slack, Teams, email, or via Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP clients. It offers a free trial and emphasizes data privacy and flexibility for businesses.

providers.name: AI Resume Master
providers.description: AI Resume Master provides an online resume builder platform that leverages artificial intelligence to help users create professional resumes, cover letters, and optimize them for applicant tracking systems. The service offers AI‑generated content, voice dictation, template selection, and tools for tailoring resumes to specific job roles, aiming to improve job seekers’ chances of landing interviews and offers.

providers.name: Amalgament
providers.description: Amalgament provides on-demand technical teams for small businesses, offering integration, automation, internal tools, and practical AI solutions for a flat monthly fee. They learn business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and build and maintain technology solutions, positioning themselves as a cost-effective alternative to hiring full‑time engineering staff.

providers.name: Apixio
providers.description: Apixio provides AI-powered healthcare data solutions, improving operations, payments, and clinical outcomes for health plans and providers. The company, now part of Datavant, offers a Connected Care Platform that leverages actionable AI technology and flexible services to enable accurate payments, high‑quality patient care, and value‑based reimbursement models.

providers.name: AppFactor
providers.description: AppFactor provides an agentic platform that discovers, assesses, modernizes, builds, deploys, and maintains enterprise software systems. The platform is self‑hosted and runs within a customer’s network, supporting regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, government, retail, and manufacturing. It uses AI agents to automate SDLC steps while engineers retain governance through approval gates.

providers.name: Apple Nyheter Sverige
providers.description: Apple Nyheter Sverige is a Swedish news portal delivering Apple-related news, reviews, and rumors since 2008. It provides daily updates on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, offering test results, product comparisons, and community discussions. The site aims to keep Swedish-speaking Apple enthusiasts informed with timely articles and multimedia content.

providers.name: Arbohq
providers.description: Arbohq provides an IRS‑Integrated Finance Platform designed for regulated teams such as accounting firms, lending underwriters, and government agencies. The solution automates transcript workflows, ensures compliance, and offers a suite of APIs for data services, 1099 filing, financial planning, and embedded finance, enabling secure, end‑to‑end financial operations.

providers.name: Arcdeck
providers.description: Arcdeck is an AI-powered presentation creation platform that transforms user-provided topics, notes, or documents into fully designed slide decks. Leveraging large language models, it generates slide content, designs layouts, and exports editable PowerPoint files in multiple formats such as PDF, DOCX, and PPTX. The service supports 12 languages, offers 48 templates, and provides both free trial decks and premium subscription plans for unlimited use. Arcdeck operates from Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, and emphasizes data privacy, not selling user data or displaying ads.

providers.name: ASOHawk
providers.description: ASOHawk is an agent‑first App Store Optimization (ASO) platform for indie iOS developers. It provides AI‑driven keyword tracking, app store ranking monitoring, keyword difficulty analysis, and competitor tracking, all powered by a built‑in MCP server that lets your AI agent run ASO tasks on your behalf. A free plan is available. The service aims to simplify ASO by automating data collection and analysis, enabling developers to improve visibility and downloads without manual effort.

providers.name: Aspire Learning
providers.description: Aspire Learning is a SaaS platform that provides personalized, affordable digital learning experiences for students and classrooms. Leveraging technology, community, and traditional education, Aspire aims to increase social mobility through education by offering systematic, customizable courses and tools for both individual learners and institutions.

providers.name: Axxess
providers.description: Home health, hospice, and private duty software with REST APIs for managing patient plans of care, visit documentation, billing, scheduling, and OASIS assessments. Axxess provides certified EHR technology with FHIR-compliant interoperability, supporting data exchange across care settings via HL7, TEFCA, FHIR, HITRUST, and HIPAA standards.

providers.name: Background Check Quotes
providers.description: Background Check Quotes aggregates pricing information from U.S. employment and tenant background screening providers. It lists 25 companies from the CFPB consumer reporting list, showing which publish prices (median $29.99) and which require quotes. The site is run by Joseph Ellul and provides data, guides, and tools for professionals needing background check cost insights.

providers.name: Bravo Sierra
providers.description: Bravo Sierra is an American personal care company founded in New York City in 2018, building high-performance, clean body care for the most active people. Its "military-native" line — deodorant, body wash, cleansing bars, body fragrance, hair styling paste, and antibacterial body wipes — is designed and field-tested with U.S. Special Operations Forces (starting with the 75th Ranger Regiment's 2nd Battalion) and manufactured in the USA. The direct-to-consumer brand runs on Shopify, offers subscriptions, and gives back a portion of every sale to programs supporting active service members, veterans, and their families. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures identity and the store's first-party well-known discovery and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Cabinet
providers.description: Cabinet is a calendar management and scheduling automation platform built for executive assistants and the leaders they support. It brings group scheduling polls, copy-and-paste availability, unique booking links, shadow holds, and a shared meeting log into one all-in-one workspace, and integrates with Outlook and Google Calendar plus Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Trusted by over 2,000 companies, Cabinet is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and continuously monitored by Secureframe. It was founded by former executive assistant Julia Leibowitz and is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Carbon & Cashmere
providers.description: Carbon & Cashmere is a German-language crypto community and data service offering on‑chain market regime analysis, funding classification and real‑time market data without hype or investment advice. The platform provides transparent, subscription‑based access to market metrics, charts and community insights, emphasizing substance over speculation.

providers.name: Classin
providers.description: ClassIn is a leading edtech company that provides a one‑stop solution for digital learning. Its platform enables interactive classrooms, in‑school social apps, lesson scheduling, homework management, and a school management dashboard, supporting hybrid and virtual learning environments for educators and students worldwide.

providers.name: Coin98
providers.description: Coin98 is a crypto super-app built around a non-custodial, multi-chain wallet spanning 80+ blockchains across iOS, Android, a Chrome browser extension, Telegram, and web. Its product surface includes the Coin98 Super Wallet, an AI wallet with autonomous agents (Cypheus), the SwapX DEX aggregator routing across 50+ DEXs, on-chain perpetual futures (Coin98 Perps), the Fusion Visa debit card, PowerPool C98 staking, the Zen hardware card, Coin98 Markets data, and a token distribution Vault. For developers, Coin98 publishes a Developer Guide and the Coin98 Adapter — a React/Next.js wallet-connection SDK with useWallet and useWalletModal hooks and prebuilt connect UI — plus a Connect SDK and Telegram Mini App SDK, integrating dApps with the wallet across 40+ chains. Surfaced originally as a multicoin-capital portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Command Zero
providers.description: Command Zero, Inc. is an autonomous and AI-assisted security operations center (SOC) platform for enterprise security investigations. Founded in 2023, it applies "Governed AI" and a question-based investigation method to run complete investigations across identity, endpoint, email, cloud, and SaaS data sources — from initial alert through verdict — with every agent step logged, visible, auditable, and reproducible. Rather than a SOAR, SIEM, or XDR, it connects read-only to existing data sources via a federated data model (no ingestion, no data migration) and runs Tier-1 through Tier-3 triage, breach, phishing, malware, identity, insider-threat, incident-response, and threat-hunting workflows. The company reports 500K+ investigations completed, a 90% reduction in Tier-1 escalations, and 40%+ efficiency gains, and holds SOC 2 Type II. Command Zero is a portfolio company of a16z and Insight Partners; this profile was enriched from the provider's public website and llms.txt.

providers.name: CommerceIQ
providers.description: CommerceIQ is an AI-powered ecommerce platform that helps consumer brands win in algorithmic retail across sales, digital shelf, retail media, and content execution. Its unified platform, Ally AI, packages four AI agents (Content, Shelf, Media, and Sales) that optimize product content and SEO, monitor digital-shelf availability and search rankings across 1,450+ retailers globally, manage and automate retail media bidding and spend, and forecast and execute sales strategy from Amazon and Walmart to Instacart and Criteo. Founded in 2019, CommerceIQ serves enterprise brands including PepsiCo, P&G, Coca-Cola, and Colgate-Palmolive, and is backed by Insight Partners, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Trinity Ventures. The company operates as a managed enterprise platform and does not publish a public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services
providers.description: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services, now operating as CPS Solutions, LLC, is a healthcare company with more than 50 years of experience providing pharmacy and hospital solutions across the care continuum. It serves independent hospitals, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), and specialized health facilities with specialty pharmacy, pharmacy management, telepharmacy (24/7/365 support), 340B program compliance, supply chain management, rehabilitation services, and consulting. The company operates two proprietary SaaS platforms — CPS Optimizer for pharmacy management and TherigySTM for specialty pharmacy management — supported by 2,500+ healthcare professionals serving 800+ customers across the United States and Puerto Rico. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Compstak
providers.description: CompStak is a commercial real estate (CRE) data platform, founded in 2012, that crowdsources and verifies lease comps, sale comps, loan data, and property data from a network of tens of thousands of brokers and appraisers across US markets. Its products include CompStak One (an all-in-one CRE data platform), CompStak Exchange, CompStak AI, and a contact-sales Data API offering Market Insights, Property Insights, Space Insights, and Property Standardization. CompStak was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its developer surface is enterprise/contact-sales only — there is no public self-serve developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or API reference.

providers.name: Comstruct
providers.description: Comstruct is a Munich-based construction technology company that provides AI-powered agents to automate the procurement of construction materials. Its platform runs the full procurement workflow from the bill of materials (Leistungsverzeichnis) through supplier inquiry, offer comparison, contract negotiation, digital delivery notes, AI-based invoice verification, and sustainability reporting. Customers include HOCHTIEF, Implenia, Marti, and Leonhard Weiss. Comstruct is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of enrichment the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network from its public web presence.

providers.name: con terra GmbH
providers.description: con terra GmbH is a German GeoIT integrator offering solutions and services around geodata, digital transformation, GeoAI, digital twins, and cloud-based data integration for public administration, infrastructure operators, and enterprises. The company connects geodata, expert information, and leading technologies to deliver tailored solutions, emphasizing innovation and sustainability in the geospatial domain.

providers.name: CQuotient
providers.description: CQuotient is the artificial intelligence and shopper-data technology that powers personalization and predictive commerce for Salesforce B2C Commerce (Commerce Cloud) Einstein. Originally an independent commerce-personalization startup, CQuotient was acquired by Demandware in 2013, and Demandware was in turn acquired by Salesforce in 2016. Today the CQuotient engine underpins Einstein product recommendations, predictive sort, Einstein search dictionaries, and shopper activity capture. Its developer surface is the Salesforce B2C Commerce Einstein API (also referred to as the CQuotient API), documented within the Salesforce Developers documentation rather than on a standalone CQuotient portal.

providers.name: Cricket API
providers.description: A cricket data API advertised at cricket-api.net -- live scores, fixtures, ball-by-ball events, player and team statistics, betting odds and win-probability predictions, over REST and a documented WebSocket stream. ACCESS REALITY, stated plainly: the production base URL is not published; the docs describe every endpoint against the placeholder api.example.com and carry their own implementation notice that the base URL, paths, headers, quotas and responses are documentation examples to be replaced after signup. Four plan tiers are named but no price or quota is published for any of them. Listed on the surfaces that are actually served; the rating reflects what is published.

providers.name: Crux OCM
providers.description: CruxOCM builds AI-powered automation software for industrial control-room operations in the energy-infrastructure sector. Its Industrial Automation Hub (IAH) delivers closed-loop automation on top of existing SCADA and DCS systems to increase pipeline throughput, cut operating and energy costs, and improve safety without replacing installed control infrastructure. The product family includes pipeBOT, gatherBOT, draBOT, maxOPT, leanOPT, and powerOPT, supported by a Deployment Manager, Log Analyser, and real-time Status Dashboard. Founded by control-room engineers and operators (CEO Vicki Knott, co-founder Roger Shirt) and headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, the company raised a $17M Series A led by Microsoft's M12 and serves midstream operators including ONEOK, Delek US, Enbridge, HF Sinclair, and Alliance Pipeline. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Curated
providers.description: Curated provides human‑curated recommendation lists for books, restaurants, software and more. Users create and share lists with personal notes, ensuring recommendations stay current and trustworthy. The platform emphasizes community‑driven content, easy sharing, and a clean UI for discovering the things people love.

providers.name: details.page
providers.description: details.page is a platform that aggregates and presents event details, RSVPs, tickets, menus, pricing, and music information on a single page. It offers free starter access and allows users to create and share detailed pages for various activities, integrating images and social sharing features. The service aims to simplify event management and information dissemination for organizers and attendees alike, providing a centralized hub for all relevant details.

providers.name: Digbi Health
providers.description: Digbi Health is a digital therapeutics company delivering a precision-biology virtual clinic for food-related and inflammatory illnesses — obesity, cardiometabolic disease, type 2 diabetes, digestive disorders (IBS, GERD), MSK chronic pain, PCOS, sleep and mental health. Its FoodRx program combines host-genetics and gut-microbiome testing with app-based coaching, precision nutrition, and pre/probiotic therapies, delivered to members through health plans and employers. Digbi Health is backed by Accel. The company operates a consumer-facing storefront and member app rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the public web, agent, and security surfaces observable at digbihealth.com.

providers.name: DPO Pay
providers.description: DPO Pay provides secure online payment solutions across Africa, offering a range of products such as mobile POS, network POS, easy‑scan, ecommerce payment links and invoicing. Operating in over 20 countries, it enables merchants to accept multiple payment methods, including cards and mobile money, with fraud protection and PCI‑DSS Level 1 compliance. The platform serves thousands of businesses, delivering fast, reliable transactions and comprehensive integration options for shopping carts and hotel management platforms.

providers.name: drwho-me
providers.description: drwho.me provides free, browser‑based DNS, email, and web security tools, plus an MCP server for AI agents. Built by Hikmah Technologies, the team behind Domain Posture, it offers open‑source code on GitHub and runs checks without requiring accounts, storing no personal data. The service acts as a front‑door to the paid Domain Posture product, giving users a taste of comprehensive domain monitoring.

providers.name: Feign
providers.description: Feign (OpenFeign) is a declarative Java HTTP client binder inspired by Retrofit, JAX-RS, and WebSocket. It turns annotated interfaces into templated HTTP requests with pluggable encoders, decoders, error handlers, and HTTP transports. The OpenFeign organization maintains a large set of modules covering serialization (Jackson, Gson, Moshi, FastJSON2, JAXB, SAX, SOAP), HTTP transports (OkHttp, Apache HttpClient, Java 11 client, Ribbon), JAX-RS contracts, resilience (Hystrix), logging (SLF4J), form encoding, GraphQL, and metrics.

providers.name: findbroadbanddeals-com
providers.description: Find Broadband Deals helps UK households compare broadband offers from major providers, highlighting savings and contract details. The service aggregates plans, prices, speeds, and terms, enabling users to input their address and view personalized recommendations, ensuring they avoid overpaying for internet services.

providers.name: Gatekeeper
providers.description: Gatekeeper is a SaaS contract lifecycle management (CLM) and vendor management platform that helps procurement, legal, and finance teams capture, approve, store, and renew supplier contracts with workflow automation, e-signature, spend analytics, and risk monitoring. The Gatekeeper REST API exposes vendors, contracts, employees, custom data records, files, workflows, and events so customers can integrate Gatekeeper with ERP, HRIS, and finance systems. API access is per-tenant and authenticated with a tenant-specific API key.

providers.name: Goldbelly
providers.description: Goldbelly is a curated online marketplace for gourmet food and mail-order culinary gifts, shipping iconic meals, desserts, regional specialties, and artisanal products from renowned restaurants, bakeries, and celebrity chefs across the United States directly to consumers' doors. The platform partners with thousands of local and legendary food makers to make hard-to-get regional foods available nationwide, and operates a merchant program ("Sell on Goldbelly") plus corporate and subscription gifting. Goldbelly is a consumer e-commerce brand with no publicly documented developer API; this profile captures its public web, merchant, and corporate identity. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Greenwork
providers.description: Greenwork builds software for the HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) industry and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). Its flagship product, Onsite Pro, is a digital pricebook and proposal platform for HVAC distributors and their dealers: it replaces Excel and PDF catalogs with searchable product data, automated AHRI equipment matchups, incentive and rebate application, and one-click proposal generation, while giving distributors visibility into dealer catalog performance, win rates, and share of wallet. Greenwork does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and its public web and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HomeToGo
providers.description: HomeToGo is the world's largest marketplace and search engine for vacation rentals, aggregating roughly 20 million offers from thousands of providers worldwide across cabins, condos, houses, and apartments. Its B2B segment, HomeToGo_PRO, powers the supply side of travel with SaaS and tech-enabled services for individual hosts, property managers, and agencies. Through its Doppelgänger program HomeToGo offers partners multiple integration surfaces — API, White Label, Travel Agency Hub, ad placement, and pop-under — to embed its vacation-rental inventory. HomeToGo is a publicly listed company (Frankfurt Stock Exchange) and a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It does not publish a public, self-serve API specification; API access is arranged through its partner and supply programs.

providers.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (trading as IHG Hotels & Resorts) is a British asset-light hotel group headquartered at Windsor Dials, 1 Arthur Road, Windsor, Berkshire SL4 1RS, United Kingdom, with an Americas office at 3 Ravinia Drive, Atlanta, Georgia. Its own corporate site states 7,014 hotels and 1,035,589 rooms across more than 100 countries, around 400,000 colleagues, 20 brands and the IHG One Rewards loyalty programme (figures read from ihgplc.com on 2026-07-28). The brand portfolio spans Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, voco, HUALUXE, Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Resorts, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Garner, avid, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites, IHG Army Hotels and Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. In the distribution chain IHG sits on the supply side as a franchisor and manager rather than an owner: it aggregates independently owned and operated properties into a single central reservation system and pushes that inventory out through its own ihg.com and app direct channels, through the three GDSs and their agency terminals, through OTAs and wholesalers, and through corporate and group channels. Critically, IHG does not run its own reservation platform any more. It announced a partnership with Amadeus in 2015 to build a cloud Guest Reservation System to replace HOLIDEX, its proprietary system in service since 1965, and migrated onto it across 2018 and early 2019 — so the hotel group most likely to be a lock-in vendor is itself a customer of a GDS company's platform, and group bookings land in Amadeus Delphi and Meeting Broker. Its API posture, stated honestly, is gated and undocumented. There is no live developer portal. The one that existed — PartnerConnect RoomService at pcroomservice.ihg.com, a TIBCO Mashery portal publishing five rate, availability and hotel-content APIs — is decommissioned: the hostname is NXDOMAIN on Google, Cloudflare and Quad9 resolvers as of 2026-07-28 and the Internet Archive holds no page capture after 2019. What remains live is partnerconnect.ihg.com (HTTP 200), an affiliate marketing programme whose signup routes to Commission Junction and which still advertises "access to real-time hotel rates, availability and hotel content API's" without linking to any technical resource. Real API hostnames exist — api.ihg.com CNAMEs to ihg.api.mashery.com with an sb-ihg.mashery.com sandbox, and apis.ihg.com, b2b.ihg.com, mcp.ihg.com, booking.ihg.com and concerto.ihg.com all sit behind Akamai — but every one returns 403 Access Denied or 401 on every path probed, including /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/. No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, XSD, OpenTravel/OTA or HTNG reference is published anywhere by IHG. apis[] is deliberately empty: listing an Akamai-gated hostname or a decommissioned 2017 portal as a live API would be fabrication. The value of this record is the switchingCost block in review.yml, which captures what published IHG documents actually say about what it costs to leave — including the archived RoomService Terms of Use classing "API parameters" as Confidential Information and binding partners to the Master PartnerConnect Terms and Conditions plus the Six Continents Hotels E-commerce Master Service Agreement, and the current IHG One Rewards member terms stating that members whose accounts are cancelled "by IHG or by the Member, will forfeit all Points, Point vouchers, Reward Nights, and any other benefits associated with the account".

providers.name: Indie Hackers
providers.description: Indie Hackers is an online community where founders of profitable businesses and side projects share their stories, strategies, and revenue numbers to help each other build successful companies.

providers.name: Inspire
providers.description: Inspire (Inspire Clean Energy) is a consumer clean-energy company on a mission to transform the way people access clean energy and accelerate a net-zero carbon future. It gives residential customers access to renewable energy for their home electricity supply through flat-rate subscription plans designed to deliver predictability and reduce exposure to electricity rate volatility. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI surface — this is a non-API consumer brand.

providers.name: InterSystems
providers.description: InterSystems is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: gartner-mq) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: INZMO
providers.description: INZMO is a European insurtech, founded in 2017, delivering 100% digital, embedded insurance for consumer goods and rental deposits. Its products cover mobile phones, laptops and tablets, bicycles, e-scooters, and rental deposit warranties, sold direct-to-consumer and embedded into partner checkout flows. INZMO offers partners an embedded-insurance API that adds insurance to the customer journey with real-time policy issuance, payment, and delivery of policy documents, and applies AI and large language models to streamline fraud prevention and claims handling. INZMO is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Join
providers.description: Join (Join Stories, join-stories.com) is an AI video commerce platform that helps e-commerce brands create, distribute, and measure short-form video across their sales channels. Its products include shoppable video embedded on product and collection pages, user-generated content (UGC) activation from social media, video analytics with A/B testing, an AI Studio that generates video and images from product data, and interactive web stories. Deployment is a single embed snippet with native integrations for Shopify, PrestaShop, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce, and headless storefronts. The company is backed by Canaan Partners and Seedcamp.

providers.name: Kodi
providers.description: Kodi is an open-source home theater software project that provides a media center platform for playing videos, music, pictures, and games on a wide range of devices and operating systems. It supports a large catalog of community add-ons, offers a customizable 10-foot user interface for TVs, and enables streaming, live TV, and media library management. The project is maintained by the non-profit Kodi Foundation and a global volunteer community, emphasizing openness, extensibility, and cross‑platform compatibility.

providers.name: KYC Hospitality
providers.description: KYC Hospitality provides a platform that connects hospitality businesses with compliance and identity verification services. The company aims to streamline guest onboarding, ensure regulatory adherence, and enhance security for hotels, resorts, and short‑term rentals. By integrating KYC processes directly into property management systems, it helps operators reduce fraud, meet local laws, and improve the guest experience through faster check‑in and automated document verification. Founded with backing from Bonfire Ventures, KYC Hospitality focuses on the hospitality sector to deliver tailored compliance solutions.

providers.name: LIFT Aircraft
providers.description: LIFT Aircraft is an Austin, Texas experiential aviation company founded by former Boeing engineer Matt Chasen, built around HEXA — an amphibious electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft with eighteen independent electric motors and propellers, a 432lb carbon fibre airframe, a triply redundant autopilot flown with a single three-axis joystick, an autonomous ballistic parachute, and enough redundancy to fly and land safely with up to six motors disabled. Because HEXA is compliant with the FAA's powered ultralight classification, no pilot's licence is required, and LIFT sells flight as a paid experience rather than selling aircraft — a short training session followed by a solo flight from waterfront bases in Austin and other US cities. The company has raised over $25 million from venture capital, accredited investors and US government grants, has worked with the US Air Force Agility Prime programme and the US Army, and has begun the FAA type certification process for a commercial edition. LIFT publishes no developer REST API or OpenAPI; its only machine-readable surface is a live, unauthenticated Model Context Protocol endpoint and an llms.txt served by its Wix-hosted site.

providers.name: Long-Term Stock Exchange
providers.description: The Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) is a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission-registered national securities exchange headquartered in New York, built to support companies and investors committed to long-term value creation. LTSE operates a principles-based equities trading platform that accepts order entry over the MEMO FIX and MEMO SBE (Simple Binary Encoding) protocols and distributes real-time market data - depth of book, top of book, and last sale - via the MEMOIR multicast feed. Beyond the exchange it offers private-markets and cap-table software plus long-term listing standards. LTSE does not publish a public REST/OpenAPI developer API; participant connectivity (Direct, Extranet, Telco via NY4) and technical specifications are provided through its Market Operations team.

providers.name: MIT
providers.description: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) operates an internal developer portal that exposes APIs for the institution's information systems. The MIT developer environment publishes APIs such as the Roles API for managing institutional roles and authorizations. Access to the developer portal and most APIs requires MIT authentication via Shibboleth / Touchstone single sign-on, making the catalog primarily available to community members, partners, and authorized integrators rather than to the general public.

providers.name: Modern
providers.description: Modern is an AI‑powered accounts‑receivable platform that automates the order‑to‑cash process for businesses. It connects to ERP, banking, and payment systems to collect invoices, manage disputes, and accelerate cash flow. The service offers automation templates, AI‑driven payment matching, and real‑time analytics, helping companies reduce days sales outstanding and free finance teams for higher‑value work. Backed by Y‑Combinator, Modern aims to modernize finance operations with end‑to‑end encryption and customizable workflows.

providers.name: MONI (Ex-Monisnap)
providers.description: MONI, formerly Monisnap, is a Paris-based remittance fintech founded in 2017 by Raphaël Rivière, Jean-Baptiste Bouvier and Jonathan Brossard. It lets diaspora customers in France, Spain and the United Kingdom send money to roughly 150 countries — as cash pickup across a partner network of some 350,000 payout points, as a transfer into a mobile money wallet, as mobile airtime top-up with more than 800 operators, or as a prepaid card recharge — through a consumer app and the monisnap.com and allo.monisnap.com storefronts. Alongside the consumer product MONI runs a B2B "Moni-as-a-Service" remittance-as-a-service platform that banks and neobanks such as Nickel and Bnext embed white-label in their own applications. MONISNAP SAS is registered with the French ACPR as a payment services agent of MPS SAS, an authorised payment institution (CIB 17738). MONI publishes no public API: there is no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract on any MONI host — the partner platform is reached through a sales conversation.

providers.name: Nexamp
providers.description: Nexamp is a Boston-based clean energy company, founded in 2007 by two U.S. Army veterans, that develops, builds, owns and operates distributed solar generation and battery storage across the United States and is one of the country's largest fully integrated community solar providers. The company runs end-to-end: project development and acquisition, engineering and design, construction, asset operations, and subscriber management for residential and commercial community solar customers, alongside power purchase agreements, land leasing for solar farm hosts, energy storage, and standalone development and asset-management services. Customer-facing software is delivered through the community.nexamp.com subscriber portal and the portal.nexamp.com Decarbonization Platform. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment pass Nexamp publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract; the api.nexamp.com host that exists is gated behind Microsoft Entra ID and is not publicly documented.

providers.name: Nixpacks
providers.description: Nixpacks is an open-source build tool that converts application source code into OCI-compliant Docker images by combining language-specific providers, Nix packages, and Buildkit. Originally created by Railway as the build system powering the Railway platform, Nixpacks inspects a project's source, selects one or more providers (Node, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, Rust, PHP, Elixir, Deno, Crystal, .NET, Swift, Scala, Dart, Haskell, Gleam, Zig, Clojure, Lunatic, Cobol, Scheme, F#, Staticfile, and more), and produces a reproducible build plan composed of setup, install, build, and start phases. The plan declares Nix packages, apt packages, environment variables, commands, and cache directories, and can be customized via a `nixpacks.toml` file, CLI flags, or environment variables. Compared with Cloud Native Buildpacks, Nixpacks uses Nix as its package layer, ships as a single Rust CLI, and outputs a plain Dockerfile/OCI image without requiring a buildpack lifecycle. The project is MIT licensed and currently in maintenance mode; Railway recommends Railpack as the actively developed successor.

providers.name: Octane Lending
providers.description: Octane (Octane Lending, Inc.) is a New York City fintech founded in 2014 that makes powersports, outdoor power equipment and recreational-vehicle financing as simple as paying cash. It runs an end-to-end digital lending platform — instant soft-pull prequalification for consumers, real-time credit decisioning and eContracting through its in-house lender Roadrunner Financial, Inc., and loan servicing — connecting more than 4,000 dealer partners and 30-plus OEMs with prime through non-prime buyers. Its Dealer Portal 2.0 and dealer-management-system integrations (AppOne, Ekho and similar DMS platforms) submit credit applications and return decisions over a partner API whose credentials are coordinated privately by Octane account managers; Octane publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Payaut
providers.description: Payaut was a fintech company offering embedded payment solutions for platforms. The payaut.com domain now redirects to Nuvei’s embedded payments page, indicating that Payaut has been acquired or integrated into Nuvei. The company focused on seamless payment integration, supporting global payment methods, payouts, and real‑time transactions for marketplaces, SaaS platforms, and other digital services.

providers.name: Purely B
providers.description: PurelyB is a natural superfood and wellness brand founded by Raja Jesrina Arshad, rooted in ancestral Asian health traditions and selling halal-certified, vegan, gluten-free herbal supplements (Pegaga, Tiger Milk Mushroom, Manjakani, Super Immune-C and a SuperKids line) direct to consumers across Malaysia and Singapore. The storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a standards-based agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a hosted MCP shopping server, Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC, and a published llms.txt for AI shopping agents. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from its public developer/agent surface.

providers.name: Qore Technologies
providers.description: Qore Technologies provides an integration platform that connects business applications, data sources, and IoT devices. Their solution offers low-code workflow automation, API orchestration, and AI-driven data processing to streamline enterprise processes, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation across various industries.

providers.name: Quanta
providers.description: Quanta is a San Francisco-based accounting services company built for SaaS businesses, pairing expert human accountants with proprietary software that "shows its work." The platform delivers continuous accounting and reconciliation, explainable financial reporting through its agentic reporting layer (Prism), SaaS revenue and accounts-receivable insights, and real-time visibility into cash, burn, and runway alongside department-level spend tracking. Quanta is a managed-services and software product for finance teams rather than a developer-facing API provider; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Homebrew and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Raydiant
providers.description: Displai, the brand formerly known as Raydiant, provides digital signage, employee engagement tools, visitor insight analytics, and self‑service kiosks for brick‑and‑mortar businesses, including restaurants, retail, hospitality, commercial, education, and public services. It sells these solutions to enterprise brands that operate multiple locations.

providers.name: Restroworks
providers.description: Restroworks provides a comprehensive restaurant management platform offering front‑of‑house and back‑of‑house solutions. Their suite includes a scalable POS system, tablet ordering, customer order displays, table layout management, reservation software, inventory and supply‑chain management, recipe tracking, and kitchen operations tools. Designed for global chains, Restroworks aims to streamline operations, reduce waste, and enhance guest experiences across all restaurant functions.

providers.name: Rimac Automobili
providers.description: Rimac Automobili d.o.o. is a Croatian electric hypercar manufacturer and automotive technology company founded by Mate Rimac in 2009 and headquartered at the Rimac Campus in Kerestinec, near Zagreb. It designs and builds the Nevera and Nevera R all-electric hypercars, and develops the vehicle software, infotainment, connectivity and telemetry stack that runs them in-house. Since the 2021 formation of the Bugatti Rimac joint venture with Porsche, the group's component and OEM-supply business was carved out into the sister company Rimac Technology, while Rimac Automobili remains the vehicle brand. Rimac operates a private, customer-only connected-vehicle backend — an MQTT-based telemetry platform feeding first-party iOS and Android owner apps with location, charging, battery and driving-performance data, plus over-the-air update and remote command channels — but it publishes no public developer program, developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract of any kind. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Rodeo
providers.description: Rodeo was a career‑focused startup that offered job‑search tools and resources to help professionals advance. The platform has now closed, with all user data deleted as of 16 October 2026. Rodeo’s mission was to simplify career progression through a suite of applications and community support.

providers.name: Roper Technologies
providers.description: Roper Technologies is a diversified technology holding company (NASDAQ: ROP) that acquires, manages, and develops niche market-leading software and technology-enabled businesses. Over three-quarters of revenue comes from software products across three segments: Application Software (legal, healthcare, government, education, and insurance vertical SaaS), Network Software (construction, transportation, and insurance network platforms), and Technology Enabled Products (medical devices, industrial, and RF identification). Key subsidiaries include Aderant (legal software), Clinisys (laboratory informatics), Deltek (project-based business ERP), Frontline Education (K-12 HR software), Vertafore (insurance technology), IntelliTrans (supply chain visibility), ConstructConnect (construction information), DAT Solutions (freight matching), and iPipeline (life insurance SaaS).

providers.name: Sirius
providers.description: beSirius is an Amsterdam-based AI platform for the critical minerals and metals value chain. It builds a continuously verified digital Twin of every supplier, mapping each company's data to the frameworks, questionnaires, and regulations its buyers, auditors, and regulators require - including CSDDD, CMRT/EMRT/AMRT conflict-minerals reporting, EcoVadis, CDP, S&P CSA, UN Global Compact, LME Passport, and the Consolidated Mining Standard Initiative (CMSI). The platform automates supplier due diligence, sustainability and ESG data collection and verification, certification readiness, customer KYC, and ratings improvement across mining, processing, and trading supply chains, reducing manual audit and disclosure effort. beSirius is backed by Techstars and other investors.

providers.name: SurePath AI
providers.description: SurePath AI (now part of F5) is an enterprise AI governance and security platform that lets organizations safely adopt generative AI across their workforce. The platform gives security and IT teams visibility into GenAI usage by recording conversations, mitigates risk by detecting and redacting sensitive data in prompts and enforcing role-based access guardrails to public and private models, and increases safe adoption through a branded enterprise GenAI portal that enriches interactions with enterprise data. It is delivered as a SaaS product with an admin console rather than a public developer API, and maintains SOC 2 compliance.

providers.name: YAZIO
providers.description: YAZIO GmbH is an Erfurt, Germany based digital health company whose nutrition app pairs calorie and macro tracking with barcode scanning, AI photo food logging, an intermittent-fasting timer, a 3,000-recipe library and body-metric tracking across iOS, Android and the web. The company describes itself as remote-first, cites more than 100 million downloads across over 150 countries, and sells a freemium product: a free tier plus a "YAZIO PRO" subscription transacted through the Apple App Store and Google Play rather than through a pricing page on yazio.com. YAZIO publishes no developer program of any kind — no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract, no SDKs, no CLI, no MCP server, no changelog, no status page and no security.txt. Its apps talk to a private backend at https://yzapi.yazio.com, which is live but answers 401 with an empty body to anonymous requests and issues OAuth client credentials through no public process. Every YAZIO OpenAPI description, client library and MCP server in circulation is third-party reverse-engineering that states in its own README that it is unofficial and unaffiliated.

providers.name: 智匠云
providers.description: 智匠云是面向具身智能的零代码云训练平台，无需 AI 背景与 GPU 硬件，用自然语言描述任务即可生成仿真场景、训练机器人技能并一键部署。支持机械臂、人形机器人等多种本体，覆盖智能制造、物流仓储、餐饮服务等场景。该平台为个人开发者、科研团队与职业院校提供机器人技能训练、仿真验证与部署服务，倡导零代码零硬件，训练你的专属机器人。核心技术涉及具身智能、机器人技能训练、机器人仿真、强化学习、遥操作数据采集、机械臂控制。

providers.name: 410 Labs
providers.description: 410 Labs is a lean product studio based in Baltimore, Maryland, founded in 2010 by Dave Troy and Matthew Koll with the mission of helping people communicate and access information in new and better ways. The company is best known for Mailstrom, a web-based inbox management and email cleanup tool that groups messages by sender, subject, time, and size so users can act on thousands of related emails at once across Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Apple, AOL, Exchange, and any IMAP mail service. 410 Labs also built the Chuck iPhone app for fast on-the-go email triage, and earlier products Shortmail and Replyz. It is a consumer productivity software company that does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties for the API Evangelist network. 410 Labs was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Acretrader
providers.description: AcreTrader is a farmland investment platform headquartered in Fayetteville, Arkansas that lets accredited investors buy fractional, passive ownership stakes in individual US row-crop, permanent-crop and timberland farms. AcreTrader sources and vets each farm, then handles the legal entity, farm management and administration while investors earn returns from annual cash rent and long-term land appreciation. Securities are offered through North Capital Private Securities Corporation, a FINRA/SIPC member broker-dealer that is not an affiliate of the platform. Since 2018 AcreTrader has enabled investment in over 140 farmland properties spanning roughly 44,000 acres across 20 states, and its investment management arm, AcreTrader Management LLC, reports net IRR of 9.4% to 30.3% on realized deals. Proterra Investment Partners LP acquired AcreTrader in August 2025. AcreTrader publishes no public developer API, no developer portal and no machine-readable specification; contract discovery was run in full against acretrader.com and api.acretrader.com on 2026-08-10 and every discovery path returned 404.

providers.name: Activ Surgical
providers.description: Activ Surgical is a Boston, Massachusetts digital surgery company building intraoperative surgical intelligence for the operating room. Its flagship product, the ActivSight Intelligent Light imaging module, attaches to existing laparoscopic and robotic surgical systems and renders augmented-reality overlays on a standard monitor, letting surgeons see physiology the naked eye cannot. ActivPerfusion delivers dye-free, real-time blood-perfusion imaging using laser speckle contrast imaging, while ActivICG supports conventional indocyanine green visualization of structures such as bile ducts. The module is powered by the ActivEdge platform, a hardware-agnostic computer-vision, AI and machine-learning stack the company is building to turn intraoperative data into real-time surgical guidance. Activ Surgical performed the first autonomous robotic soft-tissue surgery in 2018, received FDA 510(k) clearance for ActivSight in April 2021 and CE Mark approval in December 2022, and sells on a subscription model with no capital-equipment purchase. The company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract as of this profiling pass; its public technical surface is regulatory (EU MDR declarations of conformity, ISO 13485:2016) and clinical (peer-reviewed studies and white papers).

providers.name: AEssenseGrows
providers.description: AEssenseGrows is the operating brand of AEssense Corporation (held as AEssense Holding), a precision agtech manufacturer founded in Silicon Valley in 2014 by Robert Chen and headquartered at 205 E Alma Ave, San Jose, California, with a second facility in Jiading, Shanghai. It designs and builds fully automated zero-soil aeroponic SmartFarms for commercial indoor growers — the modular, stackable AEtrium-2.1 cloning and vegging system, the AEtrium-4 and Double Deck AEtrium-4 bloom systems, the compact Nursery-6, and the AEtrium Automated Dosing Unit — together with the AExcel, Aerix, AEdge and Blaze LED and horticultural lighting lines and a design-build-test-train-transfer consulting practice. The hardware is wired with a blanket of precision sensors and driven by Guardian Grow Manager, the company's own control software, which automates nutrient dosing, irrigation, photoperiod, pH, CO2, humidity and temperature against customer-authored Grow Plan recipes, logs and analyzes the resulting grow data, and offers remote access and alerting from any browser. A second brand, AEssenseFresh (aessensefresh.com), takes the same platform to leafy greens and fresh produce; the cannabis line has been licensed to integrate California's Metrc seed-to-sale system, which makes Guardian a consumer of a third-party regulatory API rather than a producer of one. AEssenseGrows operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL or Postman collection, no first-party SDK on any package registry, and no GitHub organization. Guardian ships only as an end-user product bundled with the hardware it controls, and the public Technical Document Library is product brochures and UL/CE datasheets in PDF. Customer documentation beyond that sits behind a Grow Partner Portal private-access request form.

providers.name: AgentPixel
providers.description: AgentPixel provides a consent-first website pixel that transforms visitor clicks on an Accept button into identifiable contacts. By installing a simple tag, businesses can capture visitor details such as name, job title, company, and email, turning anonymous traffic into actionable leads. The service offers a 30‑day free trial, then charges $1 per account per month, supporting up to three pixels and 500 new contacts monthly. It integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, and Cline, enabling automated contact retrieval without requiring user accounts or API keys.

providers.name: Aily Labs
