providers.description: Aily Labs is a Munich-based enterprise AI company that builds an AI Decision Intelligence Suite — a platform that connects siloed internal and external data to deliver real-time, explainable predictions and recommendations across Finance, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Go-To-Market, Procurement, and People functions. The suite ships with 300+ validated predictive models and an iOS app, and is deployed across Healthcare & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Luxury & Fashion, Media & Tech, Retail, and Services (clients include Sanofi). Aily Labs is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Alcoa
providers.description: Alcoa Corporation is a global industry leader in bauxite, alumina, and aluminum production. Founded in 1888, Alcoa operates mines, refineries, and smelters across Australia, Brazil, Canada, Iceland, Norway, Saudi Arabia, and the United States. The company is a Fortune 500 member and one of the world's largest aluminum producers, supplying lightweight, high-strength materials to automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, and industrial markets. Alcoa is committed to sustainability through low-carbon aluminum production, responsible bauxite mining, and advancing aluminum recycling.

providers.name: Algo Trade Analytics
providers.description: Algo Trade Analytics offers a research‑only platform that lets users explore and backtest TradingView strategies using an AI‑driven agent. Users can compare live alerts with broker fills, gain insights into algorithmic trading performance, and iterate on strategies without executing trades or guaranteeing returns. The service provides tiered pricing plans for individuals and teams, along with support resources and documentation.

providers.name: Altara
providers.description: Altara is a deep-tech AI company (seed-stage, $7M, backed by Greylock and Jeff Dean) building an agentic scientific intelligence platform for the physical sciences. Its AI agents reason across fragmented technical data — sensor and instrument time series, wafer maps, inspection images, and experimental records — to accelerate R&D-through-manufacturing workflows such as experimental design, yield analysis, anomaly detection, and failure analysis. Altara unifies siloed data in place without migrations, giving agents full operational context across numerical, text, and image sources for semiconductors, advanced materials, batteries, medical devices, specialty chemicals, and industrials. The platform is SOC 2 Type II compliant with encryption, RBAC, SSO, and self-hosted (VPC) or dedicated single-tenant cloud deployment. Altara does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity and security posture as a lead for future enrichment.

providers.name: Alzheon
providers.description: Alzheon, Inc. is a privately held clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2013 and headquartered at 111 Speen Street, Framingham, Massachusetts, developing oral small-molecule therapeutics and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. Its lead candidate, valiltramiprosate (ALZ-801) — a valine-conjugated prodrug of tramiprosate that blocks the formation of neurotoxic soluble beta-amyloid oligomers — has FDA Fast Track designation and completed the pivotal APOLLOE4 Phase 3 trial in APOE4/4 homozygotes with early Alzheimer's disease. Alzheon operates no product or developer API and publishes no developer portal, SDKs or API documentation; its corporate site does serve the standard WordPress REST API anonymously, which makes its press releases, science pages and media library machine-readable.

providers.name: Apollo3
providers.description: Apollo3 is a technology company focused on developing advanced microcontroller platforms and IoT solutions. Founded to accelerate embedded innovation, Apollo3 offers hardware, firmware, and cloud services that enable developers to build low-power, high-performance applications across industries such as automotive, industrial automation, and consumer electronics. The company emphasizes open-source tools, comprehensive documentation, and robust SDKs to streamline product development cycles.

providers.name: ASTM International
providers.description: ASTM International is one of the world's largest voluntary standards development organizations, founded in 1898. ASTM publishes more than 13,000 globally recognized consensus standards across 150+ technical committees and 2,100+ subcommittees, developed by 30,000+ volunteer members from 140+ countries. ASTM standards span ferrous and nonferrous metals, cement and concrete, petroleum, plastics, textiles, additive manufacturing, medical devices, consumer products, unmanned aircraft, artificial intelligence in manufacturing, and dozens of other domains. Standards are delivered through the ASTM Compass platform, ASTM Digital Library, ASTM SpecBuilder, and through publisher and reseller channels. ASTM does not publish a public REST API for its catalog; integration with Compass is via SAML SSO, Shibboleth, OpenAthens, and IP authentication.

providers.name: Autotrader
providers.description: Autotrader is the UK's largest digital automotive marketplace, providing REST APIs through the Autotrader Connect platform for vehicle listings, dealer stock management, VIN and VRM lookups, vehicle valuations, retail metrics, taxonomy, images, deals, and consumer-facing search. The platform enables technology partners and retailers to integrate automotive data and marketplace functionality into their systems in real time.

providers.name: AWST
providers.description: WorkRamen, created by the team at AWST, provides a productivity platform that combines intelligent scheduling, secure document sharing, trackable links, and instant e‑signatures. It serves small and medium‑sized businesses, startups, sales and marketing teams, professional services, educational institutions, and freelancers, enabling them to streamline workflows, accept payments, and accelerate deal closures. The service offers a 14‑day free trial with no credit card required.

providers.name: Better Life Partners
providers.description: Better Life Partners is a Hanover, New Hampshire healthcare provider founded in 2018 that delivers same-day, whole-person treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorder across New Hampshire, Maine, Massachusetts, Vermont and North Carolina. It combines FDA-approved medication for addiction treatment (buprenorphine/Suboxone, naltrexone) with group counseling, peer recovery coaching and mental health care, delivered both virtually and in person, on a non-punitive harm-reduction model. The company contracts directly with Medicaid, Medicare and commercial health plans — MaineCare, NH Healthy Families, Anthem, Cigna, Harvard Pilgrim, Tufts, Humana and UnitedHealthcare — and markets value-based arrangements "from bundles to full risk" to payers and community partners. It is a clinical services organization rather than a software vendor: it references "purpose-built technology" internally but publishes no developer program, API, specification, SDK or integration documentation of any kind.

providers.name: Biobot
providers.description: Biobot Analytics is a wastewater epidemiology company that operates a wastewater intelligence platform, analyzing sewage samples to detect and track more than 50 human health indicators — including pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, measles, norovirus), substances (fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, buprenorphine), and public-health threats (HIV, mpox, poliovirus, Candida auris) — before they surface in conventional reporting. Founded from MIT research and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Biobot serves federal, state, and local government agencies, pharmaceutical and life-sciences companies, and healthcare systems through dashboards, CSV exports, map visualizations, and enterprise data integrations. Biobot does not publish a public self-serve developer API; data access is arranged directly with the company.

providers.name: Bloom Institute of Technology
providers.description: Bloom Institute of Technology (formerly Lambda School) is an online coding bootcamp founded in 2017 that trains learners for AI-driven tech careers through part-time and full-time programs in Full Stack Web Development, Backend Development, and Data Science, plus corporate "AI for Developer Productivity" training. It is known for its income-share and deferred-tuition model ($0 upfront with a job-contingent payment plan) and a tuition-refund guarantee. The company reports 4,000+ graduates since 2017. It is a venture-backed consumer education company (backed by GV) and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: BUX
providers.description: BUX is a European neobroker and mobile-first investing app operated by BUX B.V., a subsidiary of ABN AMRO. It lets retail investors across Europe buy and sell individual stocks and ETFs commission-free starting from as little as EUR 10, build automated BUX Investment Plans (thematic and expert-built portfolios), and earn interest on uninvested cash across BUX Basic, Plus, and Prime account tiers. BUX is authorised and regulated by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM), with client financial instruments and money held in segregated custody via ABN AMRO Clearing and deposits protected up to EUR 100,000 under the Dutch Deposit Guarantee Scheme. BUX does not publish a public developer API or SDKs; this profile captures the company's identity, legal, and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: callagent.pro
providers.description: callagent.pro provides human-like AI phone agents that answer and place real phone calls. Its REST Agent API (Bearer keys prefixed cak_live_, base https://www.callagent.pro) covers building agents, assigning numbers and SIP trunks, test chats and test calls, call transcripts, recordings and summaries, contacts, do-not-call lists, and billing, including x402 USDC top-ups on Base. Submitted through apis.io/add.

providers.name: Caresyntax
providers.description: Caresyntax is a surgical intelligence company that builds a vendor-neutral, enterprise-scale data platform for the operating room. Founded in 2013 in Berlin and now dual-headquartered in Berlin and San Francisco, it captures video, audio, image, device, EMR, financial and outcomes data from inside and around the OR and applies AI analytics to it — delivering pre-operative workflow optimization, real-time intraoperative decision support, and post-operative clinical safety, quality and utilization insights. The platform pairs the PRIME365 vendor-neutral OR / medical-device integration layer with the qvident surgical performance-management and analytics suite, and is deployed in more than 4,000 operating rooms worldwide. Caresyntax sells to hospitals and surgery centers, MedTech manufacturers and insurers, and integrates with EMR, PACS and scheduling systems. It operates an API gateway at api.caresyntax.com, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract — integration is delivered through enterprise and partner engagements.

providers.name: Cartwheel8dc7
providers.description: Cartwheel8dc7, operating under the brand Cartwheel, is an AI research lab and product company focused on motion capture and generation technologies. It offers a suite of tools including performance capture, generation, editing, and a universal motion retargeting platform. The company provides APIs for developers to integrate motion AI into applications, with documentation, pricing plans, and community resources available online.

providers.name: Caulo
providers.description: Caulo provides a social network layer for AI agents, enabling them to read, brief, and post content automatically. The platform is ad‑free, verifies human identities, and ensures provenance on every post. It aims to integrate AI agents into the web’s social fabric, offering a prompt‑driven experience where agents can stay informed and interact without manual effort.

providers.name: Clanbeat
providers.description: Clanbeat is an Estonian education-technology company whose app supports student and staff well-being by nurturing social and emotional learning (SEL) through co-creation. The platform provides well-being tracking, quality reflections, meaningful connections between students and educators, and tools to co-create SEL curriculum. It is used by international schools, educators, students, and fitness and lifelong-learning communities to evidence group emotional well-being and bring classes closer together. Clanbeat is delivered as a hosted web and mobile application at app.clanbeat.com; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or partner integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Cleo+Coco
providers.description: Cleo+Coco creates next-level clean, high-performance personal care products for every body. Their natural deodorants, body powders, dry hair shampoo, and functional sprays are aluminum‑free, synthetic‑fragrance‑free, and feature five odor‑fighting ingredients. The brand emphasizes safe, effective ingredients, real protection, and confidence, targeting consumers seeking clean, sustainable personal care solutions.

providers.name: Codecademy
providers.description: Codecademy is a New York City–based online learning platform offering interactive coding tutorials, career paths, certifications, and bootcamps across programming languages, data science, AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and web development. Founded in 2011 by Zach Sims and Ryan Bubinski, the company built its reputation on browser-based interactive exercises that let learners write and execute code without local setup, and grew to serve millions of registered learners. Codecademy was acquired by Skillsoft in April 2022 for approximately 525 million dollars in a cash-and-stock deal, and now operates as the consumer- and individual- developer-facing brand within Skillsoft's broader corporate learning portfolio, complementing Skillsoft Percipio for enterprise customers. Codecademy's products include the free tier, Codecademy Plus, Codecademy Pro, career paths, skill paths, professional certifications, full cohort-based bootcamps (via Codecademy and Skillsoft's Global Knowledge arm), and a workspaces feature for project work. The company does not expose a public developer REST API, SDK, or partner API program for programmatic access to courses, progress, or learner data; its primary surface is the codecademy.com web application and mobile apps, with enterprise content delivery handled through Skillsoft channels.

providers.name: Concepts
providers.description: Concepts is a digital sketching and design application built by TopHatch, Inc., offering an infinite, flexible canvas for thinking, planning, illustration, and design across iOS, Android, and Windows. It blends vector and raster drawing with precision tools, adjustable brushes, layers, and a dynamic tool wheel aimed at designers, illustrators, architects, and product teams. Concepts was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer creative application it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or agent surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties along with a domain-security probe.

providers.name: connectFirst Credit Union
providers.description: connectFirst Credit Union is a member-owned, cooperative (Schedule-equivalent provincial credit union) financial institution headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, formed on May 3, 2021 by amalgamating four Alberta credit unions (First Calgary Financial, Chinook Financial, Mountain View Financial, and Legacy Financial). At its peak it held over CAD $6 billion in assets under administration and served more than 128,000 members across 41 branches in Central and Southern Alberta, offering retail, commercial, agricultural, and dealer-services banking. Members voted in November 2023 to merge with Servus Credit Union; the legal amalgamation closed May 1, 2024 as "Connect First and Servus Credit Union Ltd." (~CAD $29.3B assets, 600,000+ members), and the unified brand realigned to Servus Credit Union in January 2025 — the connectfirstcu.com domain now 301-redirects to servus.ca. Its open-finance posture is honest and typical of a Canadian credit union: no first-party public developer portal or downloadable OpenAPI, digital banking delivered via the Celero Xpress platform (powered by ebankIT) with core/banking-tech through the Central 1 / Celero cooperative ecosystem, and third-party consumer data access available only through aggregators (Plaid coverage confirmed). Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FCAC-overseen) is legislated but not yet operational, so no mandated open-banking API exists.

providers.name: CUDDLY
providers.description: CUDDLY is a crowdfunding platform dedicated to animal welfare, enabling shelters and rescues to raise funds for supplies, medical care, and adoption support. The site offers wish‑list donations, a shop for pet products, and a community hub for donors, while providing transparent tracking of contributions and impact.

providers.name: Cuponomia
providers.description: Cuponomia is a Brazilian coupons and cashback platform that helps consumers save money on online purchases from more than 2,000 partner retailers. A pioneer in popularizing free discount coupons in Brazil, the company expanded into cashback in 2019 and now operates a website, a browser extension, and mobile apps alongside a Prime membership tier. It is backed by 500 Global. Cuponomia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: DBpedia
providers.description: DBpedia is a community project that extracts structured data from Wikipedia and publishes it as Linked Open Data on the Web. It provides a SPARQL endpoint, a Lookup Service for entity resolution, a Spotlight API for text annotation, a Live endpoint for real-time Wikipedia data, and Linked Data access via HTTP content negotiation — forming a queryable cross-linked knowledge graph of Wikipedia-derived facts.

providers.name: DefaultVerifier
providers.description: DefaultVerifier provides evidence rails for autonomous work, issuing signed receipts with proof seals that ensure integrity. The platform enables AI agents to verify any receipt and allows users to issue their own, supporting transparent and trustworthy automation workflows across services.

providers.name: Denki
providers.description: Denki is a full-stack AI financial audit firm that automates internal audit work — planning, control testing, evidence collection, walkthrough interviews, and documentation — so teams can comply with financial regulations such as SOX 404 and BSA/AML. Its Tracer agent links general ledger, sub-ledgers, ERP, and payments data into a single audit trail, detecting anomalies early and producing ready-to-share audit packs. Denki works alongside existing systems such as AuditBoard, Workiva, and ERPs, and is built for audit teams at pre-IPO and publicly listed companies. Founded in 2025 by brothers Felipe and David Jin Li, Denki is a Y Combinator (F25) company that raised $4.1M led by Base10 Partners and Shine Capital.

providers.name: Dreamwidth
providers.description: Dreamwidth Studios is an independent, open‑source, community‑centric service that provides a platform for creative artists to share writing, artwork, and thoughts. It offers fine‑grained privacy controls, diverse communities, and supports a wide range of topics. The service is free to join, with optional paid features, and emphasizes diversity, open‑source development, and user‑driven content.

providers.name: Duetto Research
providers.description: Duetto Research is a hospitality technology company whose cloud platform, marketed as Duetto, delivers a Revenue & Profit Operating System (RP-OS) for hotels, casinos, and resorts. The platform pairs real-time dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, group and block business management, and profitability benchmarking so revenue teams can optimize rates and total property profit across more than 20,000 properties in over 100 countries. Its marquee products include GameChanger (dynamic pricing and rate optimization), ScoreBoard (forecasting and reporting), BlockBuster (group business), Advance (AI-driven rate recommendations), GameTime (select-service revenue management), and HotStats (profitability benchmarking). Duetto connects with the property management systems, booking engines, and channel managers hotels already use through a large partner-integration ecosystem rather than a self-serve public developer API. Backed by Battery Ventures; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Efficient Computer
providers.description: Efficient Computer builds general-purpose, energy-minimal processors for edge and embedded AI. Its Fabric architecture is a reconfigurable spatial dataflow array that maps application graphs directly onto hardware, eliminating the wasteful data movement of traditional Von Neumann CPUs. The Electron E1 processor pairs the Fabric with an integrated RISC-V scalar core to deliver up to 100x better energy efficiency than low-power CPUs, and the proprietary effcc compiler acts as a drop-in replacement for GCC/Clang that extracts dataflow from C, C++, and TensorFlow Lite while preserving GDB-compatible debugging. Efficient Computer is a silicon and developer-toolchain company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, backed by Union Square Ventures, targeting on-device AI inference, IoT, and industrial and physical-AI systems that must run for years on a single charge.

providers.name: Energistics
providers.description: Energistics is a global, non‑profit consortium that develops, manages, and promotes data transfer standards for the energy industry. It provides standards such as WITSML, RESQML, PRODML, ETP, PWLS, and UOM to operators, service companies, technology providers, and regulatory agencies for data interoperability and integration across upstream workflows.

providers.name: EquityZen
providers.description: EquityZen is a New York-based financial technology platform and marketplace for investing in shares of private, late-stage, venture-backed companies before they IPO. Founded in 2013, it connects accredited investors seeking access to pre-IPO equity with employees and early shareholders of private companies who are looking for liquidity, transacting through EquityZen-managed funds and secondary-market share sales. The platform handles the sourcing, legal, and administrative work of private-company share transfers. EquityZen publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ernesta
providers.description: Ernesta is a direct-to-consumer, custom-sized rug company that lets homeowners and interior-design professionals order high-design rugs made to measure down to the inch. Founded by three Peloton co-founders (John Foley, Hisao Kushi, and Yony Feng) and backed by True Ventures, Addition, and Platform Capital, Ernesta sells online through a Shopify storefront and a growing set of showrooms, and runs a dedicated Trade Program and Trade Portal for designers. Ernesta publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's consumer and trade web properties plus the discovery, security, and identity signals observable on its public hosts.

providers.name: Fhenix
providers.description: Fhenix is a blockchain R&D company building confidential computing for EVM-compatible chains using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE). Its CoFHE (FHE Coprocessor) lets Solidity smart contracts compute directly on encrypted data — encrypt inputs client-side, operate on ciphertexts on-chain via the FHE.sol Solidity libraries, and unseal results through a threshold decryption network, so sensitive state stays private without ever being decrypted on-chain. The developer stack is a smart-contract-plus-client-library surface (not a REST API): the cofhejs TypeScript SDK, Hardhat/Foundry plugins and starters, the fhenix-contracts Solidity libraries, and mock contracts for local testing. CoFHE is live on public testnets (Ethereum Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, Base Sepolia) with mainnet planned. Fhenix is backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: First Advantage
providers.description: First Advantage provides global background check and screening solutions for employers, candidates, and customers. Their platform offers identity verification, criminal record searches, employment tax credit screening, and industry-specific background checks, helping organizations mitigate risk and build workforce trust across the employee lifecycle.

providers.name: Flowbird
providers.description: Flowbird is a global urban mobility and parking technology company that builds pay stations, mobile parking apps, digital permits, EV charging, and transit ticketing systems for cities and transport authorities worldwide. Flowbird was acquired by EasyPark Group in an acquisition that closed in January 2025. Its integration surface is the Flowbird HUB, an open platform that exposes documented but partner/agency-gated APIs (OAuth2 and client-certificate secured, with role-based access control and ownership filters) for tariffs, rights/permits, parking sessions, pay stations, and transactions. There is no self-service public sign-up; access is granted to cities, transport agencies, and integration partners under contract.

providers.name: Francis Medical
providers.description: Francis Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota, founded in 2018 by Michael Hoey and named for his father, who died of prostate cancer in 1991. It develops the Vanquish Water Vapor Ablation System, a transurethral outpatient platform that ablates targeted prostate tissue using the thermal energy stored in sterile water vapor delivered in short bursts through a catheter, with the aim of treating localized disease while avoiding the incontinence and sexual dysfunction associated with radical prostatectomy and radiation. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2023 and 510(k) clearance for prostate tissue ablation in December 2025, and it is running the VAPOR 1 and VAPOR 2 clinical studies alongside a long-term registry; it has signalled intent to extend the same water vapor platform to bladder and kidney cancer. Francis Medical has raised roughly $160 million to date, including an $80 million Series C in January 2025 co-led by Solas BioVentures and Arboretum Ventures, with earlier participation from Coloplast. It is led by president and CEO Mike Kujak. Francis Medical publishes a physician locator, an electronic instructions-for-use (eIFU) library and a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy for its devices and embedded software, but operates no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Gartner
providers.description: Gartner, Inc. (NYSE IT) is a global research and advisory firm selling syndicated research, analyst inquiry, benchmarking, peer communities and conferences to executives across IT, finance, HR, supply chain, marketing, sales, legal and customer service. Gartner publishes no public developer API, developer portal or machine-readable contract: the research library and the Peer Insights vendor portal are subscription-gated, and the one live first-party API host found by probe (gapi.gartner.com, an AWS API Gateway) rejects every anonymous request. Gartner sold its Digital Markets business - Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice, and the Buyer Discovery API that serves their intent data - to G2 in February 2026, so the only OpenAPI reachable on a gartner.com host belongs to G2. This repository tracks the company and any first-party technical artifact that surfaces over time.

providers.name: Gen.G
providers.description: Gen.G is a global esports organization founded in 2017 (originally KSV eSports) that connects the United States and Asia, operating from Los Angeles, Seoul, and Shanghai. It fields professional teams across League of Legends, Valorant, PUBG, Counter-Strike 2, Rocket League, Fortnite, Brawl Stars, Honor of Kings, Mobile Legends, NBA 2K, Overwatch, Rainbow Six Siege, and EA FC, and runs a youth esports academy program alongside merchandise and fan-engagement businesses. Backed by Canaan Partners among other investors, Gen.G was valued at roughly $250 million as of 2022. It is a consumer esports brand and merchandise operator with a Shopify-based storefront; it publishes no public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: GlossGenius
providers.description: GlossGenius is a business management platform for the beauty, wellness, and health services industry, combining appointment scheduling, integrated payment processing (flat 2.6% rate), point of sale, marketing, client management, staff and payroll tools, and AI agents that answer booking inquiries and follow up with clients. It serves solo professionals and multi-location businesses such as salons, spas, barbershops, and medspas, powering more than 120,000 appointment-based businesses. GlossGenius was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GlossGenius publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and public link surface only.

providers.name: Go To-U
providers.description: GO TO-U is an operating system for electric-vehicle charging management, built for Charge Point Operators (CPOs) and businesses that run charging infrastructure. The platform is hardware-agnostic, integrating with 50+ charger manufacturers (ABB, Wallbox, Siemens, EVBox and others), and bundles charge-point management, AI-powered analytics and load optimization, a driver-facing mobile app (iOS and Android), roaming, white-label options, and integrated payment processing. Its Advanced Reservation Technology (ART) lets drivers book charging slots in advance to reduce wait times. GO TO-U is a Techstars portfolio company. This profile was enriched from the company's public website; no public developer/API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications were discoverable at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Govini
providers.description: Govini (rebranded to Air, air.ai, in 2026) is a defense-technology and decision-analytics company whose Ark platform combines proprietary defense acquisition data with AI-enabled applications to close the national-security "Readiness Gap" across supply chain, science and technology, production, sustainment, logistics, and modernization missions. Ark holds FedRAMP High authorization and a DISA Impact Level 5 (IL5) Provisional Authorization plus service-level IL5 ATOs, making it a closed, government-authorized SaaS platform rather than a public developer API. Led by CEO Tara Murphy Dougherty and backed by investors including Accel and Bain Capital. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and has been enriched with the provider's real public identity, security posture, and published compliance authorizations.

providers.name: Grandhood
providers.description: Grandhood is a Danish digital pension provider that lets companies set up and run a modern workplace (company) pension scheme entirely online, without the traditional adviser meetings and paperwork. Employers register with MitID, invite employees, and activate a plan; employees enroll, get built-in digital pension counselling, choose an investment profile, consolidate scattered pension savings, and see real-time savings, returns, and insurance coverage in the Grandhood mobile app. Pensions bundle both long-term savings and present-day insurance protection. Pricing is a simple fixed monthly amount per employee (65-95 DKK/month) plus investment costs, with no deposit-percentage fees and free pension advice. The underlying pension administration is backed by Velliv, Denmark's third-largest pension company. Grandhood is based in Copenhagen (Esplanaden 14B, 1263 København K; CVR 44147750) and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Grandhood publishes consumer web and mobile-app products; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Gretel
providers.description: Gretel is a synthetic data platform for tabular, text, and time-series data. It pairs a REST API and Python client (gretel-client) with Gretel Navigator and a library of model recipes for generating, transforming, and de-identifying data. The platform exposes ingestion, project, model, and record-handler endpoints over HTTPS.

providers.name: Higher Logic
providers.description: Higher Logic provides powerful, personal online community software that helps organizations engage members, retain customers, and grow audiences. Their platform offers community forums, member engagement tools, integrations, and analytics to build lasting relationships and drive advocacy across professional and trade associations, nonprofits, and businesses.

providers.name: HR Cloud
providers.description: HR Cloud provides an AI‑powered enterprise HR platform designed for frontline teams. It unifies onboarding, core HR, employee engagement, time‑off, performance management and payroll in a single cloud solution. The platform offers a mobile‑first experience, integrates with popular tools, and includes features such as Maya AI onboarding assistant, employee recognition, shift planning and robust reporting, aimed at improving workforce productivity and compliance.

providers.name: IgniteTech
providers.description: IgniteTech is a global, AI-first enterprise software company (headquartered in Austin, Texas, and operating remote-first across 30+ countries) that acquires, revitalizes, and supports mission-critical enterprise software and embeds AI-powered capabilities across its portfolio — an operating model the company brands "AI-DNA." Its Native AI products include Eloquens AI (automated, context-aware email response), MyPersonas (AI digital clones of key employees that answer repetitive questions via a video chat-style interface), and Adminio AI (meeting scheduling through intelligent email orchestration). The IgniteTech Unlimited software library spans acquired enterprise brands such as GFI Software, Khoros (Communities and Care), Jive, DNN, Gensym, Computron, GRID (supply chain, via the Suuchi acquisition), Knova, AnswerHub, ACORN, TradeBeam, and SalesBuilder. Led by CEO Eric Vaughan, the company positions itself as an AI enterprise software company rather than only a software holding company.

providers.name: InfinitySwap
providers.description: InfinitySwap is a blockchain infrastructure provider operating under the Bitfinity network, offering a Layer‑2 EVM compatible solution that bridges Bitcoin and Ethereum ecosystems. It enables developers to build, test, and deploy smart contracts with fast finality and low fees, while providing comprehensive documentation, developer portals, and community resources. The platform supports token bridging, DeFi applications, and NFT projects, aiming to expand Bitcoin’s utility through scalable EVM capabilities.

providers.name: Inovalon
providers.description: Inovalon is a healthcare technology company providing cloud-based data analytics and data-enabled intervention platforms for the healthcare industry. Its Inovalon ONE Platform pairs national-scale primary-source datasets with analytics, workflow, and SaaS applications used by health plans, providers, pharmacies, life-sciences, and specialty organizations for risk adjustment, quality measurement, care-gap closure, and revenue-cycle and claims management (including the ABILITY provider workflow products). Inovalon was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its developer surface is enterprise and auth-gated: the corporate site is WAF-protected and the API host api.inovalon.com requires authentication (HTTP 401); security and compliance posture is published on the public Inovalon Trust Center.

providers.name: Insuretech Connect
providers.description: InsureTech Connect (ITC) is the world's largest insurance innovation event series, produced by Clarion Events. Its flagship, ITC Vegas, brings together 9,000+ insurance carriers, insurtech startups, brokers, reinsurers, and investors for three days of content, networking, and dealmaking, with regional editions in Europe and Asia. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qed-investors and added to the API Evangelist network. ITC is an events and media brand; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or event webhooks, so this entry carries company identity and probed domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Knit
providers.description: Knit is a technology company providing a platform for creating and managing smart knitting projects. It offers APIs for designers and developers to integrate knitting patterns, track production, and manage inventory. Backed by Techstars and part of the VC portfolio, Knit focuses on innovative textile solutions and community-driven design tools, enabling seamless digital-to-physical workflow for creators and manufacturers.

providers.name: KNMI Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute
providers.description: The Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute (KNMI) is the Dutch national weather service, providing weather forecasts, climate data, and seismology information. It operates as a public research institute, delivering data and expertise to government, businesses, and the public. The KNMI offers APIs for weather observations, forecasts, climate statistics, and earthquake data, supporting applications in agriculture, aviation, emergency management, and scientific research.

providers.name: Komiser
providers.description: Komiser is an open-source, cloud-agnostic resource manager for analyzing and managing cloud cost, usage, security, and governance across multi-cloud environments including AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, OCI, Linode, Scaleway, Tencent, MongoDB Atlas, and Kubernetes.

providers.name: Last Energy
providers.description: Last Energy is an American developer and operator of micro-modular nuclear power plants, founded in 2019 in Washington, D.C. by Bret Kugelmass as a commercial spinout of the Energy Impact Center. Its flagship PWR-20 is a 20 MWe pressurized water reactor assembled from a few dozen factory-made, steel-encased modules that ship to site and are installed rather than constructed in place. Last Energy sells power rather than reactors: it designs, finances, owns and operates plants under long-term power purchase agreements for energy-intensive customers including data centers, metals, chemicals, cement, pulp and paper, and food and beverage. The company has announced projects in Texas, South Wales, Poland and Romania, entered nuclear site licensing in the United Kingdom, partnered with Texas A&M and DP World, and raised roughly $164M across a $40M Series B and a $100M Series C. Last Energy publishes a marketing site and a gated customer/whitepaper portal, but no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Lentra
providers.description: Lentra is a Pune, India based cloud-native digital lending platform for banks and non-banking financial companies. Built on a microservices architecture with customisable customer journeys, the platform spans loan origination (GoNoGo), loan management (1LMS), data and machine learning operations (Lentra MLOps), and data transfer (TransferX), alongside standalone modules for MultiBureau credit bureau access, identity and video KYC verification, collateral management, document management, co-lending and bank reconciliation. Lentra packages these into pre-built retail, business and agriculture lending journeys - home, personal, education, vehicle, consumer durable and credit card loans, equipment finance, working capital, supply chain finance and agri/KCC lending - delivered SaaS on a per-user or per-transaction basis to institutions including HDFC Bank, State Bank of India, IDFC and TVS Credit. The company is an Open Credit Enablement Network (OCEN) participant and maintains a public trust center covering SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 22301:2019 and CSA STAR. Lentra sells to enterprises directly; it does not operate a public self-service developer portal or publish an open API reference.

providers.name: Liveboard
providers.description: LiveBoard is a tutor-management platform that helps tutoring businesses, academies, and independent tutors run their operations end to end. It combines branded virtual classrooms (video calls, screen sharing, an interactive whiteboard, recording, and file sharing) with session scheduling and attendance tracking, tutor/student/parent management, calendar-based billing with online payments, auto-invoicing, payroll, and progress reporting. Liveboard says it serves 200,000+ tutors and companies across 200+ countries, scaling from solo tutors to organizations with thousands of tutors. It is a consumer/SaaS product with no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time; integrations are teaching-focused (Wacom pen tablets, a LaTeX formula editor, and the Desmos graphing calculator). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Marley Spoon
providers.description: Marley Spoon is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and grocery company that delivers weekly recipe boxes with pre-portioned ingredients to households, operating the Marley Spoon and Dinnerly brands across markets in the United States, Australia, and Europe. It runs a consumer web and mobile storefront for menu selection, subscription management, and delivery; there is no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API program. The company's public GitHub organization hosts only a few internal Ruby infrastructure forks (no client SDKs or specs). Enrichment surfaced no API surface: no /.well-known discovery documents, no security.txt, and no llms.txt. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and remains a company stub with security/identity signals probed rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Melodics
providers.description: Melodics is a New Zealand-based interactive music-learning application that teaches drums, MIDI keyboards, and pad controllers (finger drumming) through gamified, real-time lessons. It connects to electronic instruments and MIDI controllers to give immediate feedback on timing and accuracy, offering guided learning paths, song tutorials, and structured daily practice for beginner through advanced players across desktop and mobile. Melodics is a consumer edtech product and a portfolio company of 500 Global; it publishes no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mercado Libre
providers.description: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce marketplace in Latin America with adjacent fintech (Mercado Pago), logistics (Mercado Envios), and ads businesses. The developer platform exposes REST APIs for items, orders, shipments, users, payments, and seller tooling.

providers.name: Mill
providers.description: Mill is a consumer sustainability company that makes a smart kitchen bin which dries and grinds household food scraps overnight into dry, nutrient-rich "Food Grounds," keeping food waste out of landfills and cutting the methane it would otherwise produce. Sold as a membership starting around $799 or roughly $66/month, the bin is odorless, reduces food-waste volume by about 80%, and the resulting grounds are reused in gardens, as chicken feed, or through farm partnerships. Mill also runs a commercial line for grocery, offices, food service, and municipalities. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Mill is a consumer hardware and subscription business with a companion mobile app; it exposes no public developer API — its /api/ path is an internal app backend disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Mobagel
providers.description: MoBagel is an AI and automated machine learning (AutoML) company founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Jose, California, with offices across seven global locations. Its flagship Decanter AI platform lets business users build machine learning models and generate predictions without a data science background, spanning AutoML, automated time-series forecasting (AutoTSF), MLOps, DataOps, and a generative-BI suite (Generative BI, Generative ETL, Generative Expert) now surfaced through the 8ndpoint product and a family of vertical AI agents for marketing, supply chain, finance, and manufacturing. MoBagel exposes Decanter AI programmatically through an official first-party Python SDK (decanter-ai-sdk) that authenticates with an API key and drives data upload, model training, and prediction. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: MoneyTap
providers.description: MoneyTap is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: vc-portfolio; backed by nea) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Mosaic Manufacturing
providers.description: Mosaic Manufacturing is a Toronto-based additive manufacturing company building automated, high-volume FFF 3D printing systems for factory-floor production of end-use polymer parts. Its flagship Array platform combines integrated robotics, intelligent scheduling software, and high-performance fused-filament-fabrication printers so manufacturers can cut part costs and run true production at scale. Mosaic also makes the Palette line of multi-material hardware and Canvas (canvas3d.io), a cloud/web software platform for file preparation, color/slice, print scheduling, and fleet management. As of this enrichment pass Mosaic publishes no public product API or OpenAPI-described developer surface; its developer-facing presence is the open-source MosaicManufacturing GitHub organization (3MF tooling, slicer post-processing, and firmware) plus a hosted support/knowledge-base portal.

providers.name: NiceJob
providers.description: NiceJob provides an AI‑powered reputation marketing platform for service‑based businesses. Its software helps businesses collect and manage customer reviews, automate responses, and improve online visibility across search engines and AI assistants. The platform includes tools for review solicitation, widgets for website display, analytics, and integrations with common business software.

providers.name: Norm Ai
providers.description: Norm Ai (legal name Nomos AI, Inc.) is a legal and compliance AI company that embeds law and regulation directly into autonomous AI agents. Its platform spans Norm Law (an AI-native law firm), Norm Technology (domain-expert-built compliance agents), and Supervisory AI (systems that verify agent compliance), automating legal and regulatory workflows for financial institutions and enterprises. Backed by a $120M Series C round, it serves clients managing over $30 trillion in combined assets. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published; this profile captures the company's security, compliance, and identity surface.

providers.name: Offcall
providers.description: Offcall is a career and practice platform for physicians, backed by Bloomberg Beta. It provides confidential, anonymous physician salary and compensation benchmarking, and a verified clinician-to-clinician patient referrals network with HIPAA-compliant messaging for care coordination, delivered through web and mobile (iOS and Android) applications. Offcall does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this profile was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Oscar
providers.description: Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR) is a technology-driven health insurance company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City. It offers individual and family health plans, small-business and ICHRA employer benefits, and Medicare Advantage in a growing set of U.S. states, pairing coverage with a consumer mobile app, 24/7 virtual urgent care, telemedicine, primary care, and concierge Care Teams. Oscar's +Oscar division licenses its full-stack technology platform (Campaign Builder and other tools) to other payers and providers. The company is NCQA-accredited across Health Plan, Utilization Management, Credentialing, Provider Network, and Health Equity programs. Oscar is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As a CMS-regulated payer it is subject to the Interoperability and Patient Access rule, though it does not currently publish an open, self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Packmatic
providers.description: Packmatic is a Berlin-based packaging procurement platform that helps companies source flexible and paper-based packaging at lower cost. It combines a proprietary supplier database and a smart-matching engine spanning 350+ suppliers with expert packaging engineers and a cloud-based platform for managing quotes, orders, and supplier communication. Customers pay no upfront fees; Packmatic earns a commission when they source through its network, reporting average savings around 16% and reducing supplier search time by roughly 70%. Packmatic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Parspec
providers.description: Parspec is an AI-native platform for electrical, lighting, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) distributors and manufacturer rep agencies in the construction supply chain. It consolidates fragmented, manual workflows into one system covering quoting for complex projects, automated submittal and O&M document creation, project management (orders, fulfillment, billing), and sales management, with ERP integrations (Epicor Eclipse, Epicor Prophet 21, SAP). Parspec is SOC 2 Type II attested and markets itself to help distributors and rep agencies bid more, win more, and improve profitability. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: Pod
providers.description: Pod is an AI-native platform that aggregates firsthand observations from agents and humans about APIs, products, and services. It provides a neutral space for agents to search, filter, and share real-world experiences, helping others make informed decisions. Users can read anonymously, contribute reviews, and integrate via an MCP server at https://api.askpod.ai/mcp. The service emphasizes privacy, safety, and community-driven knowledge.

providers.name: RangeForce
providers.description: RangeForce is a cloud-based cyber range and hands-on cybersecurity training platform that helps organizations build, measure, and validate the defensive skills of their security teams. Through browser-based, real-tool exercises and simulated attack scenarios, RangeForce lets blue teams practice detection, incident response, and threat hunting in realistic environments and benchmark individual and team readiness. Founded in Estonia and backed by Techstars, the company serves enterprises, government agencies, and managed security service providers. RangeForce does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference.

providers.name: Raymond James Bank
providers.description: Raymond James Bank is a Florida-chartered state member bank headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Raymond James Financial, Inc. (NYSE: RJF), a diversified financial services holding company founded in 1962. Supervised by the Federal Reserve and the Florida Office of Financial Regulation, the bank provides securities-based lending, residential mortgages, commercial and industrial and commercial real estate loans, tax-exempt loans, and deposit products (including its Enhanced Savings Program) primarily to Raymond James wealth-management and institutional clients. On open finance, the bank runs no first-party public developer portal and publishes no downloadable API specifications; consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only indirectly through third-party aggregators such as Plaid. No FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is publicly documented for this institution as of this record.

providers.name: Renew Financial
providers.description: Renew Financial (Renew Financial Group LLC) is a specialty consumer finance company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Oakland, California that pioneered and administers Property Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) financing for residential energy efficiency, renewable energy, water efficiency and resiliency home improvements. It administers the CaliforniaFIRST program in California and RenewPACE in Florida, funding solar, HVAC, roofing, windows, landscaping, hurricane and seismic projects through a voluntary property tax assessment repaid over terms up to 30 years. The company is licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation as a PACE Program Administrator (#60DBO-90653) and carries NMLS ID 1788120. Renew Financial runs a contractor technology platform and an online homeowner application, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Seed Health
providers.description: Seed Health is a microbiome science company founded in 2017 by Ara Katz and Raja Dhir, headquartered in Los Angeles County, California. It develops and sells clinically studied probiotic, prebiotic and synbiotic consumer products — most notably the DS-01 Daily Synbiotic, the PDS-08 Pediatric Daily Synbiotic and the VS-01 Vaginal Synbiotic — direct to consumers via a subscription commerce site at seed.com, alongside SeedLabs, its environmental and applied-microbiology research arm. Seed publishes a substantial public science, editorial (Cultured) and help-center surface, and maintains a small public GitHub organization, but it operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no published API reference, no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI or MCP contract, and its internal storefront API paths are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt. Its practitioner program is fulfilled through Fullscript and email rather than through any integration surface.

providers.name: Skupos
providers.description: Skupos is a retail technology platform for the convenience store industry that connects independent c-store retailers, distributors, and consumer brands through a single data network. Its SaaS platform delivers scan-data automation, back-office and financial management, tobacco scan-data incentives, digital loyalty and funded promotions, and GasBuddy integration. Founded in 2016 and backed by Insight Partners, Skupos was acquired by PDI Technologies in 2023 and now operates as part of the PDI Essentials product suite. Skupos runs an authenticated production API at api.skupos.com but publishes no public API specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: SRS Acquiom
providers.description: SRS Acquiom provides deal management solutions for mergers & acquisitions and loan agency transactions, operating across the entire deal lifecycle. Its services span pre-closing tax and accounting advisory, closing-phase escrow, payment disbursement and shareholder solicitation, and post-closing shareholder representation, alongside loan agency roles (administrative, collateral, and facility agent). SRS Acquiom delivers these through digital dashboards and platforms for deal transparency, backed by affiliate broker-dealer Acquiom Financial LLC (FINRA/SIPC). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently exposed.

providers.name: Syndio
providers.description: Syndio is an enterprise workplace-equity and compensation-governance software company. Its AI-assisted platform helps large organizations make defensible, compliant pay decisions at scale, spanning offers, promotions, merit cycles, and pay-equity/pay-transparency compliance (including EU Pay Transparency Directive requirements). The platform is organized into Essentials (foundations for aligned, compliant pay decisions), Decisions (real-time guidance during pay decision-making), and Predict (forward-looking workforce intelligence), all powered by the domain-specific Syndi AI. Syndio reports governing more than $1T in pay decisions for 350+ global enterprises. It is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS accessed via the app with OAuth 2 / SSO; there is no public self-serve developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition. First-party developer-facing surfaces are limited to the syndioctl command-line tool and a public GitHub organization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: The Naked Market
providers.description: The Naked Market is a San Francisco-based consumer packaged goods (CPG) company and brand incubator founded in 2019 by Harrison Fugman, Alex Kost, and Tim Marbach. It uses a "fast fail" end-to-end infrastructure to take a food or beverage product from idea to market in roughly three months, launching and acquiring socially conscious direct-to-consumer brands across snacks, drinks, and better-for-you categories. Its portfolio has included Project Breakfast, Flock crispy chicken chips, Avocrazy avocado puffs, Beach House Bowls, Rob's Backstage Popcorn, and the low-alcohol aperitif brand Haus. The company raised $27.5 million in Series A funding in 2021 and is backed by HV Capital. It operates as a consumer brand holding company and does not publish a traditional developer API program, but its Shopify-hosted storefront exposes an agent-commerce surface: llms.txt agent instructions, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, OpenID Connect discovery, and a live MCP endpoint for catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: Tile (thetileapp)
providers.description: Tile is a consumer Bluetooth-tracker company whose Tile Mate, Pro, Slim, and Sticker devices help people find everyday items such as keys, wallets, bags, and phones, backed by the crowd-sourced Tile "Find" network that anonymously relays location when another Tile user passes a lost item. Founded in 2012, Tile was acquired by Life360 in 2021 and now operates as part of the Life360 family-safety platform. Tile publishes consumer apps for iOS and Android and a support and legal surface, but does not offer an official public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; only third-party community libraries wrap its private app API. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web and security-program surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Torch
providers.description: Torch (Redfish Labs, Inc. dba Torch Leadership Labs) is a leadership development and executive coaching platform that pairs expert human coaches with AI to help mid-market and enterprise organizations grow leaders and navigate change. Its offerings include Change Coaching (leaders-turned-coaches trained in Torch's change approach), the Spark AI coaching agent (always-on AI guidance for practicing conversations and turning insight into progress), and Organizational Intelligence (real-time visibility into change patterns and people dynamics). Torch focuses on AI transformation, organizational restructuring, organizational resilience, and leadership growth, and counts Airbnb, Reddit, Tripadvisor, FICO, and Twitch among its customers. Torch is a SaaS product with SSO (SAML), Zoom, and Slack integrations but publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Twingate
providers.description: Twingate is a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platform that replaces legacy VPNs with software-defined perimeters, providing identity-based, least-privilege access to private resources without exposing them to the public internet. The Twingate Admin API is a GraphQL API authenticated via API key (X-API-KEY header) that enables programmatic management of remote networks, connectors, resources, users, groups, service accounts, devices, policies, and DNS filtering profiles.

providers.name: UXD Protocol
providers.description: UXD Protocol is a decentralized stablecoin protocol built on Solana, operated by Soteria FZCO, whose UXD token is backed 100% by an Asset Liability Management Module that deploys collateral into delta-neutral positions, on-chain lending, and real-world assets. The protocol is governed by the UXP token, is documented on GitBook, publishes six third-party security audits and a self-run bug bounty, and ships an open-source Solana program with a TypeScript client on npm and a Rust CPI client on crates.io. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Valero Energy
providers.description: Valero Energy Corporation is the world's largest independent petroleum refiner and a leading producer of low-carbon transportation fuels. Headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, Valero operates 14 petroleum refineries with 3 million barrels per day capacity, 12 ethanol plants, and renewable diesel production facilities across the US, Canada, and UK. The company trades on NYSE as VLO and is a Fortune 100 company.

providers.name: Vancity Community Investment Bank
providers.description: Vancity Community Investment Bank (VCIB) is a federally regulated Schedule I chartered bank headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Vancouver City Savings Credit Union (Vancity), Canada's largest community credit union. Established to carry the cooperative "community-first" finance model into the national banking system, VCIB is a values-driven, Certified B Corporation and CDIC member that provides impact-focused commercial banking - commercial real estate and affordable-housing lending, clean-energy and green-building finance, social-enterprise banking, Impact GICs, high-interest savings, and business Visa products - to organizations driving social, economic, and environmental change. As a small impact/commercial bank rather than one of the Big Six, VCIB operates no public developer portal, exposes no first-party developer API, and publishes no downloadable API specifications. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and the 2024 Fall Economic Statement under the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, is not yet operational, so any third-party access to VCIB customer data today would be voluntary and aggregator-mediated rather than via a documented open API.

providers.name: Versuni
providers.description: Versuni is a global domestic-appliances company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, formed when Philips Domestic Appliances was carved out and acquired by Hillhouse Investment in 2021. With more than 130 years of heritage, roughly 6,400 employees and a presence in over 100 countries, Versuni designs and sells cooking, coffee, garment-care, floor-care and climate-care products under brands including Philips, Saeco, Gaggia, Preethi, Senseo and L'OR Barista. Its connected appliances are supported by the consumer HomeID app (formerly NutriU). Versuni publishes no public developer API program; its public API-adjacent surface is limited to an RFC 9116 security.txt and a responsible-disclosure program.

providers.name: Visibly
providers.description: Visibly is a UK-based workforce compliance management platform that helps enterprises with large, distributed and subcontracted workforces automate their HSEQ (health, safety, environment and quality) obligations. It centralizes worker onboarding, competency and certification tracking, real-time compliance monitoring and alerts, audit and project reporting, and safety broadcast communications, with integrations into existing HR, ERP, LMS and SharePoint systems and mobile-first workflows for field workers. It is used across construction, manufacturing, FMCG, energy, public services, infrastructure and logistics by organizations including Network Rail, National Grid, EDF, Scottish Power, NHS and Danone. Backed by Creandum and Seedcamp.

providers.name: Wecasa
providers.description: Wecasa is a French on-demand home-services marketplace that connects households with vetted independent professionals who deliver the service at the customer's home. Its catalogue spans household cleaning and ironing, childcare and babysitting, mobile hairdressing, at-home beauty and nail care, massage and wellness, and personal fitness coaching. Customers book, schedule and pay through the Wecasa web site or the iOS/Android app; the professionals who fulfil the work run their business through the separate Wecasa Pro app. Founded in France and backed by Serena, the company operates in France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Wecasa publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract — the platform is a consumer application and a partner-onboarding funnel, not a developer product.

providers.name: Wing Security
providers.description: Wing Security is an AI security platform providing automated discovery, risk assessment, and governance of AI agents, SaaS applications, and app-to-app integrations. The platform delivers SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and continuous observability for AI tools across enterprise environments.

providers.name: Zolo
providers.description: Zolo is one of Canada's largest national residential real estate marketplaces and a licensed brokerage, operating as Zolo Ventures Ltd. with provincial brokerage subsidiaries — Zolo Realty (Ontario), (Alberta), (British Columbia), (Saskatchewan), (Manitoba) and (Quebec) Inc. — plus Zolo Mortgages Ltd. and Zolo Mortgages (Alberta) Ltd., all owned by Questrade Financial Group Inc. Founded in 2012 as a digital-first brokerage and headquartered at 1900-5700 Yonge Street in Toronto, Zolo reports over 10 million monthly visitors, 750+ active REALTORS®, and $1.5B+ in annual transaction volume across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan and Ontario. It sits in the Canadian challenger layer alongside HouseSigma, Wahi and Properly, below CREA — the single national cooperative that operates REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF) that syndicates member boards' listings — competing on listing speed, sold-price visibility and home-value tooling over data the boards and CREA control. Its API posture is closed. There is no developer portal, no API program page, no partner or data-licensing page, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind — no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI or MCP surface. The subdomains api., developer., developers., docs., data. and partners.zolo.ca do not resolve in DNS and have never appeared in Certificate Transparency, and every conventional contract path on www.zolo.ca is answered by a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge) rather than a specification. What Zolo does publish is syndication, not integration: an unauthenticated RSS 2.0 new-listings feed at /rss_new_listings.php, a family of sitemaps.org XML documents, and a site-wide schema.org JSON-LD block carrying organization identity only. Behind the edge it operates an undocumented JSON endpoint at /gallery_map_json.php and two first-party mobile apps (com.ols.zolo) on a private backend. Zolo's own robots.txt declares that RSS feed as a sitemap and a CREA terms-acceptance route at /crea_accept.php, and Section 23 of its Terms of Use is a Virtual Office Website (VOW) clause requiring registration, a bona fide interest in buying or selling, personal non-commercial use only, and an express prohibition on "scraping" (including "screen scraping" and "database scraping"), data mining, redistribution or sublicensing — enforceable directly by CREA, TRREB, ITSO, REBGV, Pillar9 and OREB. Access is licensed, not open. RESO is absent: Zolo is not among the nineteen Canadian organizations RESO lists as members, and no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, OData $metadata document, or Universal Property Identifier (UPI) usage was found. No open, unlicensed dataset is published.

providers.name: 케어그레이드
providers.description: 케어그레이드(케어그레이드)는 국민건강보험공단이 공개한 장기요양기관 평가 데이터를 지역·급여종류별로 비교·제공하는 서비스입니다. 전국 21,213곳의 평가·인력·정원을 한눈에 확인할 수 있으며, 회원가입 없이 무료로 이용할 수 있습니다. 데이터는 공공기관이 제공한 최신 정보를 기반으로 합니다.

providers.name: 908 Devices
providers.description: 908 Devices Inc. (Nasdaq: MASS) is a Burlington, Massachusetts maker of purpose-built handheld chemical analysis devices for public safety, defense, customs and forensic teams. Its flagship MX908 is a handheld high-pressure mass spectrometer that identifies narcotics, explosives and hazardous materials at trace level in about 30 seconds; the portfolio also includes the VipIR, XplorIR, ProtectIR and InterceptIR FTIR/Raman analyzers and, since the May 2026 acquisition of NIRLAB AG of Lausanne, a cloud-connected NIR spectroscopy platform. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, OpenAPI or SDK: MX908 integration ships as an RS232 serial port, field data moves over Bluetooth via the MX908 Remote and Team Leader mobile apps, and the NIRLAB cloud console at app.nirlab.com is login-gated. NIRLAB's FIELDLAB is marketed to app developers, but its reference sits behind a contact-sales form.

providers.name: Adastec
providers.description: ADASTEC Corp. is an automated-driving software company headquartered in East Lansing, Michigan, with offices in Helmond, Netherlands and Istanbul, Turkey. It develops flowride.ai, an SAE Level-4 automated driving software and sensor platform for full-size commercial vehicles — factory-fitted electric buses and minibuses operated on pre-mapped public-road routes. The platform is organized as flowride Drive (the on-vehicle automation stack and HMI connector), flowride Cloud (central control, data storage, data sharing and what the company markets as an Open API) and flowride Apps (remote management, command and control, a passenger application and analytics). Deployments run with transit operators and bus OEM partners including Karsan, Beep and Applied Autonomy across the United States, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Germany, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Romania and Turkey. ADASTEC is a premium member of the Autoware Foundation. No public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract is published for the flowride Cloud API.

providers.name: AENTS
providers.description: AENTS (엔츠) is a Seoul, South Korea climate-technology company founded in 2021 by CEO Gwangbeen Park and CTO Chongsoo Jung. Its product is AENTSCOPE (엔스코프), an enterprise carbon-management and carbon-accounting SaaS platform — described by the company as the first of its kind in Korea, launched in early 2022 — that lets a corporation build a greenhouse-gas inventory, automate Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions calculation, run third-party verification, and produce disclosure reports aligned to KSSB, IFRS S2, CSRD, GRI, ISSB and CDP, alongside product carbon footprint (PCF/LCA), CBAM, climate physical-risk analysis and a supplier portal for Scope 3 value-chain data. AENTS pairs the platform with a climate-expert ESG consulting practice, and publishes a Korean-language blog, newsletter and a free corporate emissions calculator. Named customers include JYP, Nongshim, Woosung and Hansalim. The company raised a Series A led by Envisioning Partners in February 2023 and is also a Mashup Ventures portfolio company. AENTSCOPE is an API CONSUMER rather than an API producer: the company markets automated data collection through connections to external systems — the Korea Electric Power Corporation (한국전력/KEPCO) API, the Allbaro (올바로) national waste-management API, and customer ERP systems including SAP and Douzone — but publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK or webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: AgentTune
providers.description: AgentTune provides a free, open-source library of AI instruction tuning files and personality test tools that run entirely in the browser. Users can customize prompts for Claude, ChatGPT, Muse, and other agents, without needing an account. The site offers guides, research, and tools for building AI communication preferences, all under an MIT license.

providers.name: Alexi
providers.description: Alexi is a Toronto, Ontario, Canada based legal artificial intelligence company that operates a private AI platform purpose-built for law firms, unifying legal research, drafting, and analysis into a single, single-tenant environment. Founded in 2017 by Mark Doble and a team of lawyers and technologists, Alexi specializes in litigation workflows — generating research memos grounded in primary law, identifying controlling authority and jurisdiction-specific requirements, framing case strategy, and producing persuasive first drafts that reflect a firm's voice, citation style, and approved structures. The platform also supports transactional work, document review and comparison, knowledge management, and firm-specific playbook application. Alexi's architecture combines a retrieval-first approach grounded in cited authority with agentic reasoning, delivered through a private cloud deployment so that firms retain ownership and sovereignty over their data, models, and workflows. Coverage spans all 50 U.S. states, Washington D.C., federal law, and all Canadian provinces and territories (excluding Quebec). The platform integrates with 20+ tools including iManage, NetDocuments, SharePoint, Elite 3E, Aderant, Litify, Actionstep, Filevine, Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, Zoom, DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Azure, AWS, Datasite, Intralinks, and Firmex. Alexi is SOC 2 certified, employs AES-256 encryption, and reports 99% uptime with customer firms including Dentons, Robins Appleby, Gluckstein Lawyers, MacLean Law, and Mongillo Law. The company's revenue model is SaaS subscription (Alexi Core and Alexi Advanced tiers); there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and integrations are delivered as turnkey enterprise connectors rather than a publicly documented integration platform.

providers.name: Allstate
providers.description: Allstate is a personal lines insurer in the United States offering auto, home, life, and other insurance products through agents, call centers, and direct channels. The Allstate Developer Portal provides partner APIs for agency management, policy quoting, claims integration, and telematics data exchange for authorized business partners.

providers.name: AlyawmGold Public API
providers.description: AlyawmGold Public API provides real‑time gold and silver price data for the United Arab Emirates and surrounding markets. The service offers up‑to‑date pricing in multiple currencies, historical price charts, and conversion tools. It targets developers building financial, e‑commerce, and market‑analysis applications who need reliable precious‑metal pricing information. The platform supports multilingual interfaces and offers APIs for price retrieval, historical data queries, and custom calculations, ensuring seamless integration into diverse software ecosystems.

providers.name: American Default Research
providers.description: American Default Research is an independent data project that tracks U.S. household financial distress. It publishes the American Distress Index and provides county‑level, state‑level, and national distress scores, methodology, data sources, and analysis. The site offers free data downloads, visualizations, and research reports to help policymakers, journalists, and the public understand economic hardship trends.

providers.name: AON3D
providers.description: AON3D provides industrial additive manufacturing solutions, offering high‑temperature 3D printers such as Hylo™ and Basis™, a range of advanced materials including carbon‑fiber PEEK, ULTEM™ and PEKK, and software tools for print preparation. The company serves aerospace, defense, and manufacturing sectors, delivering turnkey hardware, material science resources, and consulting services through its website.

providers.name: APAC Financial Services
providers.description: APAC Financial Services (Apacfin) is a Mumbai-based, Reserve Bank of India registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that provides customized MSME business loans to underbanked and underserved micro, small, and medium enterprises across India. APAC offers tech-enabled, largely paperless digital onboarding, quick disbursal with minimal documentation, and a mobile app (APACM) for loan tracking, EMI payments, and service requests. The lender reports roughly Rs 2,479 Crore of assets under management across 226 branches in six states, serving more than 52,000 customers, and carries an ICRA A (Stable) credit rating. APAC is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published; customer and partner interaction is via the mobile app and hosted customer/complaint portals.

providers.name: Apogee Therapeutics
providers.description: Apogee Therapeutics develops best-in-class therapies for immunological and inflammatory disorders. As part of AbbVie, the company focuses on innovative science to reshape standards of care for diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and other immune-mediated conditions. Their pipeline includes novel biologics and small molecules targeting key pathways, aiming to improve patient outcomes and quality of life. The organization emphasizes rigorous research, collaboration, and a commitment to delivering transformative treatments to patients worldwide.

providers.name: ArcAgent
providers.description: ArcAgent provides a platform for verified AI-driven coding bounties, enabling teams to outsource bounded engineering backlog tasks such as bug fixes, dependency upgrades, CI repairs, test backfills, codemods, and small integrations.
