Its online platform connects candidates with disabilities to inclusive employers, offering job listings, virtual training courses, scholarships, and mentorship for individuals, alongside inclusive-hiring consulting, talent sourcing, staff training, and physical/web accessibility evaluation for companies. Operating across roughly a dozen countries in Latin America (Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Mexico, Uruguay, Paraguay and more), it has registered hundreds of thousands of people with disabilities and placed thousands into roles with 100+ corporate clients. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: InFact
providers.description: InFact (InFact UK Ltd, trading as Infact — Solutions in public health) builds software for communicable-disease control and public-health service delivery. Founded in 2003 by Dr Chakib Kara-Zaitri and Bob Hamilton, the company's flagship product HPZone is an integrated suite for infectious-disease control built on two decades of frontline work with the national health services of the United Kingdom and the Netherlands: HPCore for case, contact and outbreak management with decision-support protocols and enquiry handling, EpiQ for epidemiological questionnaires, and HPInsight for surveillance dashboards, reporting and modelling. A second product line, Ampara (the successor to SHDirect), covers the clinic patient journey from triage through consultation, diagnostics, prescribing and follow-up. InFact is a Silver Industry Partner of openEHR International. HPZone exposes a credential-gated GraphQL API over cases, contacts, situations, enquiries, actions and contexts; the API exists and is in production use by national public-health bodies, but InFact publishes no public developer portal, reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Kita Bisa
providers.description: Kitabisa is Indonesia's largest donation-based crowdfunding and mutual-aid platform, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Jakarta. It lets individuals, nonprofits, and corporations raise and give funds transparently for medical causes, disaster relief, education, and community development, and operates a dedicated Islamic-philanthropy surface for zakat, wakaf, and qurban. The group has grown beyond crowdfunding into digital fundraising services for NGOs (ngo.kitabisa.com), a CSR and social-marketing practice for corporate partners (csr.kitabisa.com), a cooperative, and the SalingJaga mutual-protection and insurance product. Kitabisa publishes no public API or developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on any Kitabisa surface, and partner integrations are arranged through business channels. It does run a substantial first-party open source estate of 75 public Go, TypeScript, and GitHub Actions repositories, plus a public responsible-disclosure program backed by an RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: Leflair
providers.description: Leflair is a Vietnamese online retail brand selling discounted authentic international brands across fashion and accessories, beauty and health, home and lifestyle, and children's products. Its own terms of service describe it as Vietnam's first members-only flash-sale platform, running daily promotional events on branded goods. The live storefront at leflair.com is operated by Cong ty TNHH Sopa Technology of Ho Chi Minh City on the Haravan commerce platform, and is supported by a Vietnamese-language editorial blog, an account/sign-in surface, and published terms, privacy, payment-security, shipping, and tax policy pages. Leflair is a consumer retail brand: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API definition, and its historical leflair.vn domain no longer serves the storefront. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: LF Connectivity
providers.description: LF Connectivity is a Linux Foundation umbrella initiative, launched with Meta, that improves access to networks through open source projects. Sub-projects include Magma (a next-generation packet core), Terragraph (gigabit wireless last-mile access), Open M-Plane (RAN configuration and management), Maveric (AI/ML cellular network simulations), and the ISP Toolbox (planning and analytics for ISP operators).

providers.name: Lightship
providers.description: Lightship is an American manufacturer of all-electric travel trailers, co-founded by former Tesla leaders Toby Kraus and Ben Parker, with design and manufacturing in Colorado and offices in San Francisco. Its flagship product, the AE.1, is marketed as the first mass-produced all-electric travel trailer, offering up to 77 kWh of battery capacity, 1.8 kW of integrated solar, and named technologies including TrekDrive self-propulsion, CampQuiet silent operation, and Aero-Electric Design. Owners control the trailer through an onboard Atlas tablet and companion mobile app. Lightship sells direct to consumer and states that more than 85% of its supply chain is in the United States. Enrichment probes on 2026-07-19 found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; this is a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API listing.

providers.name: MANTL
providers.description: MANTL is an account and deposit origination software company for banks and credit unions. Its omnichannel platform lets financial institutions open consumer and business deposit and loan accounts across online and in-branch channels, integrating with existing core banking systems to modernize onboarding and accelerate deposit growth. More than 100 institutions raise over $1 billion in deposits monthly through the platform. MANTL was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public API or developer portal — this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and system-status surfaces.

providers.name: May
providers.description: May is a French digital-health company, operated by LN CARE SAS, whose mobile app supports future and new parents from fertility and pregnancy through the first years of a child's life. It pairs a medical messaging service staffed by French-qualified midwives, pediatric nurses and doctors — answering questions seven days a week from 8am to 10pm — with an expert-reviewed content library, roughly hour-long audio masterclasses, everyday tracking tools for sleep, feeding and weight, and Mya, an in-app AI medical assistant. Founded in Paris in 2020 by Cécilia Creuzet, Antoine Creuzet and Adrien Brunet, it reported more than 400,000 users and a team of around 80 health professionals, raised €7M in September 2024 to expand into Spain and the United Kingdom, and also sells a parental-support benefit to employers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Serena and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog and an Intercom help center, but no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: MelodyArc
providers.description: MelodyArc is an enterprise AI operations platform that orchestrates data, business rules, AI agents, and human workers in one governed system, so the right judgment is applied at the right moment, every time. It turns messy, cross-system, high-consequence operational work into modular building blocks: Points (atomic units of work capturing context, action, state, and ownership), Point Sets (reusable workflow configurations), a Point Engine (a dynamic decision graph routing tasks through rules, automation, AI, and human intervention in real time), AI Operators (configured workers with instructions and tools), a Portal for oversight and intervention, and Record for built-in traceability. It targets enterprise operations teams handling high-consequence work at scale and runs on managed or self-hosted infrastructure. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: memmo
providers.description: Memmo is a platform that enables users to request personalized video messages from celebrities, athletes, and influencers. It offers a marketplace where talent can record custom greetings, birthday wishes, and promotional content, with secure payment processing, fast delivery, and a global audience. The service caters to both individual consumers and businesses seeking unique marketing or engagement tools.

providers.name: Mitek Systems
providers.description: Mitek Systems provides digital identity verification and fraud detection solutions, offering products such as mobile check deposit, biometric authentication, and AI‑driven fraud defense. The company serves financial institutions, enterprises, and developers with APIs for identity verification, document liveness, and compliance workflows, enabling secure onboarding and transaction security across channels.

providers.name: Oatfi
providers.description: OatFi is a fintech infrastructure company that describes itself as "The Modern Credit Network for B2B Payments." It provides embedded credit, lending, and working-capital products that platforms and marketplaces can offer inside their own payment workflows. Its product surface spans Accounts Payable (flexible payment terms for buyers), Accounts Receivable (guaranteed or early supplier payouts), and Commercial Charge Cards (scaled credit and capital for commercial card programs), backed by modular components for KYB and fraud verification, underwriting, origination, loan management, capital-markets access, and collections. OatFi exposes these capabilities through APIs for approvals, settlements, and reconciliation. The developer documentation (docs.oatfi.com, a ReadMe hub) and dashboard are access-gated, so no public OpenAPI or API reference is available for cataloging at this time. Backed by QED Investors.

providers.name: pandy-cloud
providers.description: Pandy is an all‑in‑one scheduling, ERP and CRM SaaS platform that helps businesses ditch spreadsheets and scattered chats. It lets you manage clients, quotes, invoices and payments from a single app, streamlining bookings, payments and follow‑ups while providing a unified dashboard for sales pipelines, finance and team collaboration.

providers.name: Popsa
providers.description: Popsa is a UK-based, mobile-first photo printing company that uses AI to help customers create photo books, calendars, prints, tiles, boxes and ornaments in minutes. Founded in the UK and a certified B Corporation that offsets 100% of production and shipping carbon emissions, Popsa serves over 10 million customers and ships to more than 50 countries with localised storefronts across Europe, North America and Australia. Its differentiators are AI-powered automatic layouts, generative captions, facial recognition, print-quality scoring and dynamic colour themes, delivering an average five-minute creation time. Popsa was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal; this profile captures its public discovery surface (llms.txt, security.txt) and domain security posture instead.

providers.name: Prophet Security
providers.description: Prophet Security is a cybersecurity company building an agentic AI Security Operations Center (SOC) platform. Its product, Prophet AI, uses autonomous AI agents to automate alert triage, investigation, response, and threat hunting across the security operations lifecycle. The platform ingests from SIEMs, EDRs/XDRs, identity providers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), email and network security, threat intelligence, and case-management tools to deliver full-context investigations inside existing analyst workflows. Prophet Security is a Series A company founded in 2023, backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. It is SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR aligned. Prophet does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server; integration is via read-only connections into a customer's own security tooling.

providers.name: Qu POS
providers.description: Qu POS provides a comprehensive restaurant point‑of‑sale (POS) and intelligent commerce platform. Their solutions span omnichannel ordering, kitchen orchestration, smart payment processing, and unified data reporting, enabling restaurants to streamline operations, enhance guest experiences, and leverage AI‑driven insights. The platform integrates POS, kiosk, drive‑thru, online, and third‑party ordering, as well as energy and equipment intelligence, positioning Qu POS as a versatile partner for modern food service businesses.

providers.name: Railinc
providers.description: Railinc, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Association of American Railroads, delivers IT and information services to the North American freight rail industry. Railinc's suite of APIs empowers customers to simplify and automate business processes essential to the lifecycle of freight rail operations.

providers.name: Realtyna
providers.description: Realtyna provides real estate technology including IDX, RESO Web API integrations, MLS data routing, and a WordPress-based property platform (WPL). Their API Plugin exposes the WPL platform via a RESTful, JSON-based HTTP interface for building custom front-ends and mobile applications. Realtyna also offers MLS API, Organic RESO API, and the MLS Router API for enterprise MLS integration.

providers.name: RippleMatch
providers.description: RippleMatch is an AI-powered early-career recruiting platform that matches college students and recent graduates with internships and entry-level jobs based on their background, skills, and career goals rather than mass applications. For employers it offers "Campus OS", an all-in-one recruiting operating system for sourcing, skills validation, and campus event management, and it transfers matched candidates into most major applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR). RippleMatch was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook/event surface; its integrations are one-way ATS data transfers rather than an openly documented API.

providers.name: Rondo Energy
providers.description: Rondo Energy is an Alameda, California industrial decarbonization company led by CEO John O'Donnell that builds the Rondo Heat Battery (RHB), a thermal energy storage system that converts intermittent wind and solar electricity into heat stored in thousands of tons of refractory brick at temperatures up to 1,500C and returns it as continuous steam, thermal oil, superheated air, or combined heat and power at rated outputs from 2MWth to over 100MWth. The RHB is sold as a drop-in replacement for a fossil-fuel boiler, via capital purchase, lease, or heat purchase agreement, into cement, food and beverage, chemicals, fuels and ethanol, textiles, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceuticals, and direct air capture. Rondo operates the world's largest industrial heat battery and has announced a 90GWh factory plan with Siam Cement Group, backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Catalyst, Energy Impact Partners, Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund, Rio Tinto, SABIC, Aramco Ventures, and the European Investment Bank. Rondo sells hardware and delivered heat, not software: it publishes no developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Samautomation
providers.description: Beheer je WP is a Dutch SaaS service that lets users manage their WordPress sites through AI chat assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Grok. Users can add a website, install a plugin, connect their preferred AI, and approve changes via natural language. The platform offers a free tier for one site and paid plans for multiple sites, emphasizing privacy and security. It is operated by Samautomation, a Dutch company (KvK 68369492) based in Wognum.

providers.name: SAVA
providers.description: SAVA (sava.health) is a health-monitoring company developing a minimally invasive, continuous multi-molecule biosensor worn just beneath the skin. The platform is designed to capture real-time molecular data - glucose, lactate, ketones, sodium, histamine, urea, alcohol, and cortisol - and surface it through a connected mobile app, aiming to shift healthcare toward preventative monitoring and personal wellness. The company is early stage and pre-launch, operating a waiting-list model for early access to its device rather than a public product. It publishes no first-party developer API or health-data API; its marketing site is built on Wix and exposes the Wix Site MCP endpoint and a published llms.txt for agentic access to public site content only. Backed by Balderton Capital.

providers.name: Slate Auto
providers.description: Slate Auto is an American electric-vehicle manufacturer building a radically simple, affordable, and customizable electric pickup truck. Designed in California and Michigan, engineered in Michigan, and assembled in the Midwest, the "Blank Slate" starts around $24,950 and offers roughly 205 miles of range, with interchangeable body panels and 200+ accessories that let owners reconfigure the vehicle over its life (including SUV and Fastback body styles). Slate sells direct through a preorder/reservation model, rejects mandatory feature packages and large touchscreens in favor of durability and owner control, and offers fleet solutions. Backed by General Catalyst. As a consumer automaker, Slate Auto publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Solvely Ai
providers.description: Solvely is an all-in-one AI study platform for students from K-12 through graduate level, trusted by more than 10 million students across 5,000+ universities worldwide. It combines multi-model homework help with step-by-step solutions, an AI note taker that transcribes lectures into structured notes, a quiz maker, an essay writer, math and equation solvers (algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics), auto-generated flashcards and study guides, mock exams, an exam predictor, and cheat sheets. Solvely is available on the web, iOS, Android, and as a Chrome/Edge browser extension, with free and paid (Solvely Unlimited) tiers. It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: The Coca-Cola Company
providers.description: The Coca-Cola Company is the world's largest non-alcoholic beverage company, owning and marketing more than 200 brands across sparkling soft drinks, water, hydration, sports, coffee, tea, juice, dairy, and plant-based drinks. The company sells its products in more than 200 countries through a bottling and distribution partner network. While Coca-Cola does not currently publish a broadly available public REST API, it is a heavy enterprise API consumer running an internal API program on MuleSoft that connects ERP, manufacturing, distribution, retail, marketing, and consumer engagement systems through a Center for Enablement (C4E) model. Historical Coca-Cola Enterprises (CCE) Product and Location APIs at developer.cokecce.com are no longer maintained as a public-facing developer program.

providers.name: ToolsPad
providers.description: ToolsPad provides a connected workspace that integrates CRM, sales, scheduling, delivery, billing, publishing and everyday operations for small and service businesses. With 21 built‑in applications such as Notes, Whiteboards, Tasks, Lead Forms, Surveys, Polls, Landing Pages, Subscription Tracker, Estimates & Quotes, Invoice Maker, Testimonial Collector, Business Calculators, Appointment Scheduling, Time Tracking, Smart Links, CRM, Opportunities, QR Code Generator, Dashboards, Documents & Media, and Blogs, it enables teams to run their entire workflow from a single platform, offering a free plan with 30‑day Premium trial and paid tiers starting at $19 per workspace.

providers.name: TopKey
providers.description: TopKey is an AI-powered financial operating system purpose-built for professional short-term rental, vacation rental, and long-term rental property managers running 50-5,000+ units. It automates property-level and owner-level expense management, corporate and bring-your-own cards (BYOC), bill pay / AP, banking through partner banks (Thread Bank, Member FDIC), AI-assisted accounting, inventory, invoicing, work-order expense tracking, and revenue reconciliation. TopKey integrates deeply with property management systems (Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Streamline, Track, Hostfully) and accounting software (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite). Backed by a16z and Felicis. TopKey consumes partner APIs for its integrations but does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI at this time; it ships a product help center and a machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: tradebasis-net
providers.description: TradeBasis provides used‑vehicle appraisal software for U.S. auto dealers, offering real‑time wholesale and retail pricing data, mileage adjustments, and market velocity insights. Their platform enables dealers to quickly generate accurate vehicle valuations, compare pricing against competitors, and access research reports, helping streamline inventory decisions and improve profitability.

providers.name: Triblio
providers.description: Triblio is an account-based marketing (ABM) platform now owned by Foundry, the marketing services and data unit of International Data Group (IDG). Originally founded in Reston, Virginia, Triblio was acquired by IDG/Foundry in June 2020 as the cornerstone of a multi-year strategy to combine first- party publisher data, third-party intent signals, and ABM advertising, web personalization, and sales acceleration into a single platform. The product combines account-based advertising, intent-driven audience segmentation, website personalization, and a Smart Score that ranks accounts using behavioral signals from first-party web visits, third-party intent providers (notably Bombora Company Surge and G2 intent), CRM data, and Foundry's own publisher network. Triblio integrates with major CRMs and marketing automation systems including Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SugarCRM, Marketo, Pardot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, and Slack. Foundry positions Triblio as the engine behind its broader Sales Acceleration and Foundry ABM offerings, with intent data feeds from Bombora ingested weekly and G2 intent ingested nightly. Triblio does not publish a public developer API portal, OpenAPI specification, or open-source SDKs; the GitHub organization at github.com/triblio was archived in January 2026 with no public repos. Customer integrations are delivered through pre-built CRM and MAP connectors, an Apps Marketplace, and platform-internal automation rather than a self-serve developer API. As of a 2026-08-12 probe the Triblio brand has no web surface of its own: triblio.com remains registered to MarkMonitor through 2027 but its Route 53 hosted zone has been deleted, so the marketing site, the app.triblio.com login, and the learning.triblio.com knowledge base all fail DNS resolution. The product now ships as "Foundry ABM, powered by Triblio" at foundryco.com, and the knowledge base has moved to learning.foundryco.com — a Cloudflare-fronted CNAME to triblio.zendesk.com. Foundry's sole developer portal covers the KickFire APIs, a different Foundry product, and is not attributed to Triblio.

providers.name: Trudenty
providers.description: Trudenty is a fraud and risk intelligence platform that operates The Trust Network — a distributed, privacy-preserving infrastructure delivering real-time consumer trust and fraud intelligence across the payments ecosystem. It combines behavioural, transactional and network-level signals with machine learning and behavioural science to distinguish trusted consumers from fraudsters and prevent first-party (friendly) fraud, producing an explainable Trust Score across the checkout, claims and dispute lifecycle. Trudenty serves PSPs, acquirers and processors, and merchants, processing data where it lives so that no data leaves a client's organisation. It is a Mastercard Start Path and Techstars-backed startup, ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited.

providers.name: UBIO Automation Cloud
providers.description: UBIO (ubio.ai, formerly ub.io) is a London-based, Techstars-backed web automation company. Its Automation Cloud platform runs automation scripts as jobs through a REST API, automating end-to-end website flows such as flight and hotel booking, broadband signup, insurance quotes, and job applications. Developers create jobs with inputs, receive outputs and lifecycle events, and handle deferred inputs and 3-D Secure through official JavaScript/TypeScript client libraries, with the ubio Automation Protocol defining typed input/output schemas for more than 50 automation domains.

providers.name: Umony
providers.description: Umony is a London-based communications compliance platform, founded in 2017 and backed by Seedcamp, that captures, records, and archives employee voice calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and Microsoft Teams conversations at the telecom-network level for banks and other regulated financial institutions. Its platform spans the Umony App (BYOD softphone), Umony Mobile (eSIM carrier-level capture), and Umony Archive with AI risk scoring, and the company holds BSI-certified ISO 27001:2022, ISO 42001:2023, and ISO 22301:2019 certifications. Umony publishes no public developer API surface today.

providers.name: UniSuper
providers.description: UniSuper is an Australian superannuation (retirement savings) fund, originally for employees in the higher education and research sector, offering accumulation super accounts, retirement income and pension products, investment options, insurance through super and financial advice. Its website states it has helped Australians prepare for retirement since 1982 and does not pay profits to shareholders or commissions to advisers. UniSuper does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation; members, employers and advisers use its online portals and mobile app.

providers.name: Universal Electronics
providers.description: Universal Electronics Inc. (UEI) is a global leader in universal control and sensing technologies for the smart home, known for its QuickSet software platform, UEI TIDE smart thermostats and sensors, the Nevo white-label control platform, and the One For All retail remote-control brand. QuickSet Cloud provides device discovery, interoperability, and entertainment control via a device knowledge graph spanning roughly one million devices across 12,000 brands, with web APIs and native SDKs (Linux, Android, RDK, Android TV) offered to OEM and service-provider partners through a gated developer portal at developer.quicksetcloud.com. Surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company; UEI publishes no public self-serve API.

providers.name: VAT API
providers.description: EU and UK VAT compliance REST API providing VAT rate retrieval, VAT number validation via the European Commission VIES system and UK HMRC, currency conversion, and VAT-compliant invoice generation. Operated by Eventured Ltd and launched in 2015, it connects directly to authoritative EU and HMRC sources to deliver audit-ready consultation numbers and real-time rate data.

providers.name: Virgin Pulse
providers.description: Virgin Pulse is a corporate health and employee wellbeing platform that in 2024 merged with HealthComp and rebranded as Personify Health, operating today at personifyhealth.com. The company delivers a personalized health platform that unites wellbeing, healthcare navigation and advocacy, benefits administration, third-party administration (TPA), and rewards into a single employee experience for enterprises, health plans, and health systems. Integration with Personify Health is handled through an authentication-gated developer portal (developer.personifyhealth.com) and a partner marketplace (marketplace.personifyhealth.com); there is no publicly documented, open API specification. This profile was seeded as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched from the company's live public surface (llms.txt, status page, developer portal, and DNS/TLS probes).

providers.name: Vivun
providers.description: Vivun is a B2B software company building AI teammates for revenue and sales teams using structured reasoning. Its flagship product, Hero, is an AI teammate built to help sellers win, and it pioneered the PreSales management category with tooling for sales engineering teams. Vivun also promotes a Sales Reasoning Model (SRM) and Agent Intelligence approach. The company is venture-backed by Accel and Menlo Ventures. As of this profile Vivun exposes a public product and trust surface (website, blog, resources, trust center) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this record captures its verified security, compliance, and web identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wexler
providers.description: Wexler AI operates a Fact Intelligence Platform built for legal disputes and investigations. Its AI system, including an assistant named Kim, extracts, structures, and verifies facts across large document sets with source attribution, surfaces inconsistencies and contradictions in evidence, builds chronological case timelines, and produces confidence-scored, testable facts grounded in source materials. It is used by enterprise and AmLaw100 law firms for early case assessment. Wexler currently exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Yuanfudao
providers.description: Yuanfudao (猿辅导) is a Beijing-based online education technology company founded in 2012 and operated under Kanyun Holdings (看云控股集团). Its consumer products include the Yuanfudao tutoring platform, Zebra AI Learning (斑马AI学), Xiaoyuan AI / Xiaoyuan Kousuan (小猿AI / 小猿口算), Xiaoyuan Souti (小猿搜题), Ape Programming (猿编程) and Haitun Zixi (海豚自习), delivering live classes, smart practice and problem-solving analysis to K-12 and preschool learners in China. The company publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; its visible public engineering surface is the kanyun-inc GitHub organization of open-source libraries and developer tooling, and the Kanyun Security Response Center (YSRC) vulnerability disclosure program at security.kanyun.com.

providers.name: 10% Happier
providers.description: 10% Happier (now branded Happier Meditation) is a consumer meditation and mindfulness app founded on the best-selling book "10% Happier" by ABC News anchor Dan Harris. The service delivers personalized, science-backed guided meditations, courses, and sleep content from well-known teachers through native iOS and Android apps and a web player, aimed at helping skeptics and busy people build a sustainable mindfulness practice for stress, sleep, focus, and relationships. It operates on a subscription model. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; 10% Happier is a direct-to-consumer app and does not publish a public developer API, so this record captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: 3D Printer on Demand
providers.description: 3D Printer on Demand provides an instant quote service for 3D printed parts. Users can upload STL files and receive a flat per-part price without login. The service offers FDM parts made in the USA, handling orders from a single sample up to 10,000 units, with typical shipping in 3 to 5 business days. It targets rapid prototyping and low‑volume manufacturing, delivering quick turnaround and transparent pricing for developers and makers.

providers.name: 7bridges
providers.description: 7bridges provides a SaaS platform that uses AI to give end‑to‑end visibility and resilience for supply chains. The platform combines data integration, optimisation, simulation and automation to help enterprises monitor carrier performance, predict disruptions, and make data‑driven logistics decisions. Recognised with the 2023 SaaS Awards, the company serves global shippers and logistics providers, offering a digital twin of the supply network and a knowledge base for onboarding and API integration.

providers.name: 82 Labs
providers.description: 82 Labs, Inc. (doing business as More Labs) is a Los Angeles-based, science-backed wellness beverage company founded in 2016 by former Tesla engineer Sisun Lee. More Labs makes functional drink supplements sold direct-to-consumer, including Morning Recovery (hydration and post-alcohol recovery with electrolytes and DHM), Liquid Focus (a nootropic caffeine energy shot), and Dream Well (a melatonin and lemon-balm sleep aid). It is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) and e-commerce business with no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; it was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Enrichment on 2026-07-17 confirmed no API surface exists to harvest.

providers.name: Abra
providers.description: Abra is a digital asset wealth and treasury management platform founded in 2014 that provides institutional-grade services for high-net-worth individuals, institutions, corporations, and family offices across all 50 US states. Its products include Vault (segregated-account custody built on Fireblocks MPC wallet technology), proprietary Yield strategies on BTC, ETH, SOL and stablecoins, crypto-backed loans up to 50% LTV, and institutional treasury management, OTC execution, staking, and advisory. The company reports $10B+ in transaction volume and $2.5B+ in loans processed, and is backed by Pantera Capital. Abra does not currently publish a public developer API, API documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its public identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Administration for Native Americans (ANA)
providers.description: The Administration for Native Americans (ANA) is an agency within the Administration for Children and Families (ACF), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. ANA promotes self-sufficiency and cultural preservation for Native Americans, Alaska Natives, Native Hawaiians, and other Pacific Islander communities by providing social and economic development opportunities through financial assistance, training, and technical assistance. ANA administers a $45 million discretionary grant program in three primary areas: Social and Economic Development Strategies (SEDS), Native Language Preservation and Maintenance, and Environmental Regulatory Enhancement. ANA data on funded projects is publicly available through data.gov and healthdata.gov.

providers.name: AdminLanding
providers.description: AdminLanding is a bilingual French‑administration SaaS that helps residents and expats generate legally‑valid leases, rent receipts, tax forms and other official documents. The platform guides users step‑by‑step through more than 25 French government portals, offering free tools and paid packs. Founded by Julien Maurice, the service provides English‑language explanations while all generated documents remain in French to satisfy legal requirements. It includes mobile apps, a Chrome extension, and a secure EU‑hosted backend with AES‑256 encryption.

providers.name: Agebold
providers.description: Agebold, which operates as Bold, is a digital healthy-aging platform for adults 65 and older, delivered as a covered benefit through Medicare Advantage plans and other Medicare organizations. Bold offers personalized, science-backed exercise programs shown to reduce fall risk, ease musculoskeletal pain, and increase physical activity, alongside nutrition and weight-loss support (including GLP-1 care), live classes, expert talks, and virtual access to doctors, therapists, and nurse practitioners in select states. The company partners with health plans to improve quality measures, Star Ratings, HOS performance, and total cost of care. Agebold is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: AiDOOS
providers.description: AiDOOS provides outcome-based delivery through Virtual Delivery Centers (VDCs), enabling enterprises to outsource and manage complex projects with a focus on results, flexibility, and scalability. The platform offers tools for building, managing, and optimizing VDCs, along with resources, case studies, and pricing options for various industries.

providers.name: AiESphere
providers.description: AiESphere is an AI career ecosystem based in India, helping users discover suitable roles, build relevant skills, improve their resumes, and apply for jobs with AI assistance. The platform offers role recommendations, skill pathways, resume building tools, and end‑to‑end application tracking, aiming to empower the future of work through upskilling and personalized guidance.

providers.name: Air Doctor
providers.description: Air Doctor is a digital health platform that connects travelers and people living abroad with a global network of vetted private doctors and specialists, offering in-person clinic visits, home visits, and telemedicine appointments in multiple languages across more than 75 countries. Users search for and book local doctors through the Air Doctor mobile app and web app, and the company operates a large B2B business embedding its provider network into travel insurance, assistance, and health-plan partners (including brands such as Allianz Global Assistance, ERGO, World Nomads, and Charles Taylor). Air Doctor is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, partner, and web surface; Air Doctor does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time, so this profile is maintained as an identity and web-property record.

providers.name: Albert
providers.description: Albert Invent (Albert Invent Corp.) builds an AI-native operating system for chemistry and materials R&D, giving scientists a unified platform for electronic lab notebooks, chemical drawing, experiment and formulation management, and machine-learning models trained on millions of molecular structures. The platform centralizes fragmented R&D data and workflows for teams inventing new materials across adhesives, coatings, batteries, and life sciences, with role-based access control and regulatory compliance coverage across hundreds of thousands of chemical substances. Albert Invent does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation (its docs surface is password-protected); this profile captures the company's public web, product, legal, and domain-security surface as a lead awaiting a public API. Headquartered in Oakland, California.

providers.name: Angstrom Bio
providers.description: Angstrom Bio is a biotechnology company focused on machine intelligence for human health, leveraging amplicon sequencing and machine learning to develop diagnostic solutions. Their goal is to maximize the reach of amplicon sequencing diagnostics to save, prolong, and improve human lives. The company operates from 2020-2026 and provides research, news, and privacy policy information on their website. Angstrom Bio aims to revolutionize diagnostics by integrating advanced sequencing technologies with AI-driven analysis, delivering scalable, accurate, and affordable tests for a wide range of diseases, ultimately enhancing patient outcomes worldwide.

providers.name: AnimeHunt
providers.description: AnimeHunt is a free anime, manga and webtoon discovery directory and tracker that lists independent series next to studio titles. Discover hidden anime, manga and webtoons you will love, from studio hits to indie series.

providers.name: Apache Polaris
providers.description: Apache Polaris is an open‑source, cloud‑native data platform project under the Apache Software Foundation. It provides a unified catalog, governance, and data management capabilities across multiple storage backends such as Apache Ozone, Ceph, and RustFS. Polaris supports analytics engines like Spark, Trino, and Flink, and includes tools for migration, benchmarking, and synchronization. The project aims to simplify data lake management, enable observability via Prometheus and Jaeger, and integrate with authentication providers like Keycloak.

providers.name: ApplyAll
providers.description: ApplyAll provides AI‑powered job search support, guaranteeing real interviews or a money‑back refund. The service combines automated application submission with human review, having delivered over 50,000 interviews and offers from 2 million+ applications. Founded by Tal Flanchraych after a layoff, it serves individual jobseekers and partners such as career coaches, universities, and employers, offering white‑label solutions and outplacement services. ApplyAll emphasizes outcomes over activity, ensuring applications appear authentic and remain invisible to recruiters.

providers.name: Approve.com
providers.description: Approve.com is a cloud-based procurement platform founded in 2019 in Israel that lets businesses stand up a proper purchase-order process quickly, streamlining purchase requisitions, multi-step approvals, real-time budgets, and vendor onboarding with real-time spend controls and insights. Tipalti acquired Approve.com in April 2021 and now operates it as Tipalti Procurement (Tipalti Approve). Its Procurement REST API is still served from the approve.com domain (production https://triggers.approve.com, sandbox https://triggers.sandbox.approve.com), authenticating with an x-api-key header and exchanging JSON with ISO 8601 dates; the purchase-orders API exposes GET and Update purchase-order operations so an external system can stay in sync with Tipalti.

providers.name: Aquaria
providers.description: Aquaria makes water from thin air—delivering abundant, safe water for your entire home with no pipes, no wells, no PFAS. The company provides atmospheric water generators for residential, commercial, and community use, aiming to solve water scarcity with sustainable technology.

providers.name: Aquifer Motion
providers.description: Aquifer Motion provides an instant animation platform enabling brands and creators to produce studio‑quality animated videos quickly, without needing animation expertise. The SaaS solution offers text‑to‑animation, automatic lip‑sync, facial expressions, body movements, and export options for social media, marketing, education, and entertainment, empowering teams to create dynamic content at scale.

providers.name: Arta
providers.description: Arta Finance (Arta Finance Wealth Management LLC) is a global digital wealth management platform that gives accredited investors and professionals from leading technology companies access to sophisticated investment strategies historically reserved for the ultra-wealthy and institutions. Its products include a High-Yield Cash Reserve (an automated U.S. Treasuries portfolio), curated private-market funds spanning private equity, private credit, real estate, venture capital and hedge funds, bespoke structured investments, private placement life insurance, and AI-assisted portfolio tools (AI for Wealth). Founded by former Google executives and backed by Ribbit Capital and other venture investors, Arta is an SEC-registered investment adviser (with a Singapore entity regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore), with clearing and custody provided by Pershing LLC. Arta operates as a consumer/member wealth application and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Ash Wellness
providers.description: Ash Wellness provides at‑home health testing solutions for organizations, enabling health plans and public health entities to close care gaps with convenient, accurate diagnostics. Their platform offers a range of testing kits for infectious disease, cancer screening, chronic conditions, hormonal health, and environmental health, supported by a digital health integration and robust data reporting.

providers.name: Atoms
providers.description: Atoms is a direct-to-consumer footwear brand founded in 2019 by Waqas Ali and Sidra Qasim and headquartered in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, New York. The company designs, develops, and sells minimalist everyday sneakers - notably its Model 000 and Model 001 lines - and differentiates itself with quarter-size sizing and the ability to buy a pair in two different sizes for each foot. Product features include lightweight foam cushioning, a copper-infused antimicrobial lining, stretch slip-on laces, and an 8mm heel-to-toe drop. Atoms sells online via a Shopify storefront and is backed by Initialized Capital, Kleiner Perkins, DST Global, and Serena Ventures. It has no public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Banner Technologies
providers.description: Banner Technologies provides a real‑estate CapEx management platform for owners and operators, enabling unified planning, execution, and tracking of capital expenditure projects across multifamily, commercial, and developer portfolios. The solution replaces spreadsheets with a purpose‑built operating system, offering financial and project management tools, case studies, and a demo experience to streamline budgeting and execution.

providers.name: Belong Home
providers.description: Belong is a residential property management platform and rental marketplace that helps homeowners rent out their homes and helps residents find and live in professionally managed homes. Marketed as "Property Management Made Loveable," Belong pairs AI-driven pricing and operations with a human care team to deliver guaranteed rent, resident screening and placement, listing distribution across 26+ sites (Zillow, Apartments.com, and more), 24/7 maintenance via a network of Pros, rent collection, and financial tools for both homeowners and renters. The company operates across a growing set of US markets including the SF Bay Area, Seattle, Arizona, Florida, and the East Coast, and is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Belong is a consumer and homeowner-facing product; no public developer API, SDK, or machine documentation surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: BeMe Health
providers.description: BeMe Health, operating under the brand Hazel Health, provides K‑12 telehealth services, offering virtual mental and physical health care for students through school district partnerships. The company focuses on equitable access to pediatric care, integrating therapy, medical consultations, and wellness resources via its online platform.

providers.name: Bennie
providers.description: Bennie provides modern, cost-effective employee benefits through a top‑rated app and brokerage platform. It offers consulting, health plans, business insurance, and a seamless digital experience for employers and employees. Bennie partners with leading providers to deliver self‑funded health plans, P&C coverage, and HR technology solutions, aiming to reimagine the employee experience.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: BetterPost
providers.description: BetterPost is a writing tool that surfaces this week’s most relevant articles, blogs, and news, then drafts a complete post with working links. It provides timely, well‑sourced drafts for newsletters, blog articles, LinkedIn, and social threads, grounded in dated sources. Ten free generations are available with no signup, making it easy for agents to call and get publish‑ready content.

providers.name: Block Renovation
providers.description: Block Renovation is a home renovation and construction platform that connects homeowners with vetted, local contractors and provides free design, cost-estimation, and project-planning tools for kitchen and bathroom remodels, home additions, basement renovations, ADUs, new construction, and commercial projects. It operates across all 50 US states and layers on a protection program covering price assurance, progress-based payments, a workmanship warranty, and dedicated Project Planner support. Backed by Obvious Ventures and the SoftBank Vision Fund, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass Block Renovation publishes a consumer-facing marketplace but no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Brightside
providers.description: Brightside (Brightside Benefit, Inc.) is an employer-sponsored financial care benefit that helps working families reduce everyday money stress. Delivered as an employee benefit through employers, Brightside pairs each employee with a human Financial Assistant and a mobile/web app offering emergency cash and loans, debt management and credit-score improvement, savings and early wage access, bill negotiation, crisis support (eviction, utilities, food), and guidance through major life events. The company is backed by a16z, Obvious Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Brightside is a consumer-facing benefits platform and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: Brinker International
providers.description: Brinker International is a leading casual dining restaurant company that owns, operates, and franchises Chili's Grill & Bar and Maggiano's Little Italy. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Brinker operates over 1,600 Chili's locations across 29 countries and over 50 Maggiano's locations in the United States. The company leverages digital ordering platforms, loyalty programs, mobile apps, in-restaurant kiosks, and point-of-sale integrations for restaurant operations, running a unified open-source e-commerce environment built on Red Hat (RHEL, Satellite, Lightspeed) and using Prismic CMS for digital content management. Brinker runs a real but entirely partner-facing API program on Google Apigee: an Apigee Edge gateway at api.brinker.com and an Apigee Integrated Developer Portal at developer.brinker.com whose API catalog is approval-gated (accounts are approved by the Brinker API Team and API Products assigned by entitlement). The portal's anonymous catalog endpoint returns an empty apiDocs/apiProducts list; its QA sibling names six API product families — LoyaltyEA, Promos, ITSM ServiceNow, GMS, OrderManagement and POS — but exposes no paths, schemas or base URLs. There is no public, self-service developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, agent card, or open GitHub organization. Consumer-facing surfaces are the Chili's and Maggiano's mobile apps and websites and their loyalty programs, with online ordering powered by Olo and site content by Prismic.

providers.name: CareLuLu
providers.description: CareLuLu is a consumer marketplace that helps parents find and compare licensed child care — home daycares, child care centers, and preschools. Families can search across roughly 200,000 licensed programs and filter by location, age, hours, tuition, and availability, then view photos, verified parent reviews, and schedule tours or consultations. The service is positioned as an easy, fast, and free way to find safe, high-quality, affordable child care, and it also lets providers list and market their programs to local parents. Backed by 500 Global. Note — CareLuLu runs a consumer web application (an AMP/React SPA) and an internal API host (api.carelulu.com), but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — this profile captures its public website and identity surface only.

providers.name: Cartwheel
providers.description: Cartwheel is a generative motion platform for games, film & TV, advertising, and robotics. It gives creators a new way to animate 3D characters — turning ordinary video into clean, usable character motion (video-to-motion), and posing and rendering characters as images in any visual style. Cartwheel is delivered as a hosted web studio (studio.getcartwheel.com) with exportable animation formats for downstream 3D, game, film, and social pipelines. The product is in private beta and is backed by Accel, Craft Ventures, and Menlo Ventures. At this time Cartwheel exposes no public developer/REST API; this profile captures its public web, documentation, and security surface.

providers.name: Catalant
providers.description: Catalant is a consulting platform that connects organizations with a global marketplace of experienced independent consultants and boutique firms, positioning itself as "Consulting 2.0" fit-to-purpose consulting that is faster, more flexible, and more cost efficient than traditional large consulting firms. Its network spans 10,000+ vetted consultants (many from Fortune 500 companies and top-tier consulting firms, averaging 19+ years of experience) and serves 700+ businesses across 20+ countries. Catalant covers engagement areas including Digital & AI, Transformation & Value Creation, Operations, Sales & Marketing, M&A / Integration & Separation, Strategy & Finance, and Organization & People. Catalant is a General Catalyst portfolio company. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: Causalyinc
providers.description: Causalyinc (Causaly) provides an agentic AI platform for life sciences, offering a biomedical knowledge graph, AI‑powered research tools, and data‑fabric solutions to accelerate drug discovery and development. The platform integrates generative AI copilots, scientific workflows, and enterprise data integration to help pharma and biotech teams uncover insights, mitigate clinical failures, and streamline target identification.

providers.name: Ciao
providers.description: Ciao (meetciao.com) is a home-sharing platform that connects travelers with locals, letting members rent homes at local rates within a private, trust-based community of travellers while homeowners earn income from their properties. The service emphasizes affordability, community trust, and authentic local experiences over commercial short-let alternatives, and operates across major European cities including London, Lisbon, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, and Tbilisi with 20,000+ community members and 1,000+ available homes. Ciao is a Seedcamp portfolio company; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. Ciao is a consumer mobile/web product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: CLUBZERO
providers.description: CLUBZERO (CLUBZERØ) is a London-based reuse system administrator helping the food and beverage industry transition from single-use to reusable packaging. Its AI-powered platform serializes every reusable item with a GS1-standard QR, RFID, or barcode identifier, then coordinates the drop points, collection, washing, and redistribution logistics that keep packaging in circulation across on-trade, online delivery, and retail channels. CLUBZERO reports 95-98% return rates and 3.3M+ packaging rotations, running reuse programs for brands including McDonald's, Nestlé, Aramark, Compass Group, Just Eat, and the Wimbledon Championships. Backed by Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API surface is currently documented.

providers.name: Courier Health
providers.description: Courier Health is the patient experience platform for life sciences and biopharma. It gives pharmaceutical patient services, market access, and field reimbursement teams a single command center to manage the patient journey from prescription through long-term treatment adherence, using AI-generated patient summaries, workflow automation and orchestration, and integration of data across systems and partners. The company reports gains in patient starts, six-month persistency, and team productivity, and delivers the product as a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II SaaS platform. Courier Health is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: Coursebase
providers.description: Coursebase is an AI-powered corporate Learning Management System (LMS) used by over 1,000 organizations to create, deliver, and manage employee training across online, in-person, and blended formats. The platform offers a library of 1,000+ pre-built eLearning courses, AI-assisted content generation (auto-generated test questions and course summaries), analytics and reporting dashboards, single sign-on, multi-language support, and API-based integration with external HR systems for syncing user account information. Coursebase was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched in the API Evangelist network; the public surface is a marketing site with an enterprise "contact us" API integration offering rather than a self-serve developer portal or published OpenAPI.

providers.name: Creative Market
providers.description: Creative Market is an online marketplace for community-generated design assets, where independent creators sell fonts, graphics, illustrations, templates, photos, icons, mockups, add-ons, and 3D assets to designers and businesses. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, the platform operates a storefront and seller dashboard model with per-product commercial licensing, an affiliate and ambassador program, a design blog, and enterprise sales. As of this enrichment pass Creative Market publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity, published policy and support surfaces, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Crowdboticsinc
providers.description: Crowdboticsinc, now operating as CoreStory, provides an AI‑powered platform that modernizes and maintains software applications. Their services include code generation, automated testing, and continuous deployment, aimed at accelerating development cycles for enterprises. The company emphasizes a mission to radically transform the software development lifecycle through AI, offering resources such as documentation, blogs, events, and support to help users adopt their platform.

providers.name: Curtsy
providers.description: Curtsy is a mobile-first resale marketplace for secondhand women's fashion, focused on Gen Z and young-millennial shoppers roughly ages 15 to 30. Through its free iOS and Android apps, users buy and sell trending clothing, shoes, and accessories from brands like Lululemon, Free People, and SKIMS, saving up to 70% off retail. Curtsy holds no inventory of its own — sellers ship directly to buyers using prepaid shipping labels and free Curtsy-branded starter kits — and the company earns a 20% fee on each completed sale. Founded in 2016 as part of Y Combinator's Summer 2016 batch and headquartered in San Francisco, Curtsy has raised venture funding from Canaan Partners and Index Ventures. Curtsy is a consumer app with no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Datumate
providers.description: Datumate is a construction technology company whose cloud-native SaaS platform, DatuBIM, turns drone imagery, laser-scanning, and site data into real-time progress tracking, deviation detection, automated reporting, and actionable analytics for heavy civil infrastructure projects. It serves asset owners, general contractors, and engineering and consulting firms across roads, highways, rail, bridges, and earthworks, giving multi-site visibility from design validation through construction to final inspection. The company reports 125+ active customers, thousands of managed sites, and tens of thousands of processed drone flights. Datumate has Israeli engineering roots (Technion) with leadership based in Miami, Florida, and is backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Deakin University
providers.description: Deakin University is a public research university in Victoria, Australia, with campuses in Geelong, Warrnambool and Melbourne. Its genuinely institution-operated programmable footprint is small, real, and entirely in identity federation. Deakin self-publishes a complete SAML 2.0 EntityDescriptor at signon.deakin.edu.au/idp/shibboleth for a Shibboleth identity provider it runs on its own APNIC address space (128.184.0.0/16, netname DEAKINUNIVERSITY) under a Deakin-procured DigiCert certificate, and it registers that IdP plus three production service providers — the Deakin Data Portal, Envirocare and OT Simulations — in the Australian Access Federation. That metadata document is the only institution-operated machine-readable contract in this profile, and it is what earns Deakin its SAML and Shibboleth conformance. Deakin is also the registrant behind 4,597 DataCite DOIs (prefix 10.26187, repository ARDCX.DEAKIN under ARDC) and 1,303 Crossref deposits (member 8935, prefix 10.21153). Everything else that looks like a Deakin API belongs to a platform Deakin buys: Deakin Research Online is figshare (dro.deakin.edu.au CNAMEs to proxy-eu-01.figshare.com), CloudDeakin is D2L Brightspace (d2l.deakin.edu.au CNAMEs to deakin.brightspace.com, and its keyless Valence version manifest is the only JSON API answering on any deakin.edu.au host), library discovery resolves into Ex Libris address space, and the federated SSO endpoints registered with AAF sit on AAF's managed Rapid IdP on Amazon infrastructure. Those are recorded here as tenant relationships, not as Deakin contracts. There is no central developer portal, no institution-operated OAI-PMH endpoint, and no public course or campus API. The wider deakin.edu.au web estate — www, blogs, the Data Portal, the handbook — sits behind F5/Shape bot protection that answers automated clients with a JavaScript challenge, so it is not machine-readable at all.

providers.name: DeepScribe
providers.description: DeepScribe is a San Francisco, California ambient AI medical scribe company that automates clinical documentation and coding for specialty healthcare providers. Founded in 2017 (incorporated 2019) by Matthew Ko, Kairui Zeng, and Akilesh Bapu, DeepScribe captures the natural conversation between clinician and patient and produces structured clinical notes inside the provider's existing EHR workflow. The platform is HIPAA-compliant and is deployed across more than 1,500 healthcare organizations, with reported traction of 8 million+ visits captured and a 99.92% note-satisfaction rating. Core products include the AI Medical Scribe (ambient documentation), SmartPrep (pre-visit intelligence), AI Coding (E/M, ICD-10, and HCC automation), Customization Studio (provider-specific note personalization), and DeepScribe Assist (point-of-care insights). DeepScribe ships bi-directional EHR integrations with Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, AdvancedMD, drchrono, ModMed, Flatiron (OncoEMR), Ontada (iKnowMed Generation 2), and Objective Medical Systems, with a focused practice in oncology, cardiology, gastroenterology, neurology, orthopedics, urology, and value-based care. The company partners with AWS, Anthropic, Deloitte, and Panda Health for infrastructure, model, and go-to-market support. DeepScribe is sold as enterprise SaaS through a contact-sales motion; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and authentication into the clinician workspace happens through canvas.deepscribe.ai.

providers.name: Doctor on Demand
providers.description: Doctor on Demand is a telehealth platform offering 24/7 virtual medical care through video visits with board-certified clinicians. Services span urgent care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, primary care, and preventive health, with prescriptions routed to local pharmacies. Now part of Included Health, it serves consumers directly and through employer and health-plan benefit programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, GV, and Shasta Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Doctor on Demand publishes no public developer or partner API program; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: dwell
providers.description: Dwell is a digital publication and lifestyle brand focused on modern home design, architecture, and interior inspiration, published by Ziff Davis. It offers curated home tours, architectural features, renovation and before/after projects, design photography, real estate listings, shopping guides, and design news, plus a Dwell+ subscription for ad-free access and subscriber exclusives, a shop for furniture and decor, and a "Find a Pro" professional directory. Dwell was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent lead in the API Evangelist network; the public dwell.com property is a consumer media site with no developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so no API artifacts are captured for it.

providers.name: ecoa
providers.description: ecoa-dev is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Edison Scientific
providers.description: Edison Scientific is an AI research company building Kosmos, an autonomous "AI Scientist" for R&D teams in drug discovery and biopharma. Kosmos reads scientific literature, analyzes experimental data, generates and tests hypotheses, and executes research workflows autonomously, collaborating with scientists through tools like Slack and Teams. The model-agnostic platform spans the drug development lifecycle from target identification through clinical development and filing, learning from proprietary organizational and scientific data. Edison Labs publishes open science research including the PaperQA line of multimodal deep research agents. The company is backed by Spark Capital and maintains an enterprise Trust Center with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Eloquent AI
providers.description: Eloquent AI builds autonomous AI operators for financial services and other regulated industries, automating complex customer operations end-to-end without requiring engineering or custom APIs. Its agents observe standard operating procedures and team actions, then securely drive CRMs, browsers, and desktop applications to resolve inquiries, process refunds, and manage returns. Marquee products include Fixer (a 24/7 autonomous customer-service agent), Closer (an AI sales representative), Navigator (an onboarding and support co-pilot), and Custom Agent (tailored enterprise agents). The platform layers a self-healing engine and an evals framework for quality assurance and regulatory compliance, and deploys across email, chat, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice with integrations into Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot, and Stripe. Founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, it serves banking, insurance, fintech, cash advance, debt recovery, and SaaS. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the developer documentation portal is currently password-protected, so no public API specification is available yet.

providers.name: Erebor
providers.description: Erebor is a digital-first, FDIC-insured national bank built for the innovation economy — technology startups, cryptocurrency and stablecoin businesses, and AI and defense companies that traditional banks have historically underserved. Co-founded by Palmer Luckey (Anduril) and Joe Lonsdale (8VC) and backed by Founders Fund, Lux Capital, Haun Ventures, and 8VC, Erebor received OCC preliminary conditional approval in October 2025, FDIC deposit-insurance approval in December 2025, and launched in February 2026. It offers deposit accounts, wires and money movement, and stablecoin operations. Erebor exposes a developer API at api.erebor.bank secured with API keys, an Auth0-authenticated developer dashboard at developer.erebor.bank, and Fern-based developer documentation at docs.erebor.bank. The public developer docs are login-gated, so the machine-readable surface captured here is limited to what is observable without credentials.

providers.name: Ergeon
providers.description: Ergeon is a nationwide outdoor residential construction company that installs fencing (wood, vinyl, metal, and chain-link), artificial grass, wooden decks, and concrete driveways, patios, and walkways. It pairs a distributed workforce with technology — live video estimates, a 3D fence-quoting calculator at fencequoting.com, satellite site-plan tooling, and a customer portal — to deliver fast, accurate quotes plus managed installation with permit handling, financing (Wisetack), and workmanship warranties. Ergeon runs internal software and vendor integrations (Stripe, Twilio, Talkdesk, AWS, Lob) but does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, status, and open-source surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eton Solutions
providers.description: Eton Solutions, L.P. is a Morrisville, North Carolina wealth-technology company that builds AtlasFive, a purpose-built ERP platform for single-family offices, multi-family offices, private funds and the ultra-high-net-worth families they serve. AtlasFive consolidates general ledger and partnership/fund/trust accounting, investment management and performance, bill pay and transaction processing, tax workflow, CRM and document management onto one data core, and aggregates positions and transactions from more than 1,500 banks and custodians via direct electronic feeds, portal scrapes, PDF statement extraction and partner aggregators. The EtonAI product line layers a knowledge graph and generative-AI assistants over that core. Integration is delivered through customer-scoped Reporting APIs and a Power BI connector rather than a public developer program: Eton Solutions publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK or sandbox as of August 2026. The company does publish a substantial compliance posture — ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management), ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II, with GDPR and CCPA alignment — and the platform is hosted on Microsoft Azure. Founded out of the multi-family office Eton Advisors and led by CEO Robert Mallernee with Executive Chairman Satyen Patel, with additional offices in Dubai and Bengaluru.

providers.name: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)
providers.description: The European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) is an intergovernmental organization that provides comprehensive numerical weather prediction services and climate data to its member states and the broader scientific community. Operating one of the world’s most powerful supercomputing facilities, ECMWF conducts cutting‑edge research in atmospheric science, data assimilation, and climate modelling, delivering high‑resolution forecasts, reanalysis datasets, and specialized products for sectors such as aviation, marine, and emergency management. Its open data initiatives and collaborative platforms support global efforts to understand and mitigate weather‑related risks.

providers.name: Eventnoire
providers.description: Eventnoire is an event discovery and ticketing platform centered on Black culture, helping attendees find and buy tickets to concerts, festivals, parties, and community events while giving organizers tools to create and manage events, sell tickets, and grow their audiences. A Techstars-backed company, Eventnoire runs consumer discovery at eventnoire.com alongside an organizer/partner portal and a culture-focused blog. It currently exposes no public developer API, so this profile captures the company's public web surface (blog, legal, organizer sign-up, attendee login, support) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Ferra
providers.description: Ferra is a smart home strength-training system for adults aged 50 and over, built by Aroleap Fitness Private Limited in Bengaluru, India. It pairs a compact wall-mounted adaptive-resistance machine with a mobile app that queues a short guided daily workout of seven functional movements, adapts the weight in real time, tracks progress, and lets users share achievements with family. The service is sold as a no-lock-in monthly subscription (Individual, Duo, and Family tiers) billed through UPI auto-debit. Ferra is a consumer product with no public developer platform or API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: FIFOplus
providers.description: FIFOplus is a B2B smart-procurement marketplace for the HORECA sector (hotels, restaurants, cafes, and catering) in Saudi Arabia, connecting food-service buyers with suppliers across a webstore and mobile app that lists more than 5,000 food and non-food items spanning meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen goods, condiments, beverages, packaging, and cleaning supplies. The platform layers ordering, real-time order tracking, inventory, menu, and finance optimization with AI and integrates with point-of-sale systems and credit-terms payment. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jeddah, FIFOplus operates across Jeddah, Makkah, Riyadh, and Taif and is backed by the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator (500 Global) and Palm Ventures. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; FIFOplus publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Filmhub
providers.description: Filmhub is a global film and television sales and distribution company that operates a self-service marketplace connecting independent filmmakers and rights holders directly to more than 100 streaming channels and platforms worldwide, including Tubi, Plex, Xumo, Amazon, Fandor, and others across AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, and FAST business models. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Los Angeles, Filmhub charges no upfront listing fees and instead earns a 20 percent share of the royalties generated by the distribution deals it facilitates. Filmmakers upload their titles, technical specifications, and metadata to the Filmhub app; channel partners browse the catalog and license the content they want; and Filmhub manages technical delivery, revenue collection, and reporting. The company is backed by a16z and other investors. Filmhub does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Fleek
providers.description: Fleek is a B2B wholesale marketplace for vintage and secondhand clothing that connects resellers with a global network of verified suppliers, letting new resellers, full-time resellers, and retail businesses source pre-owned inventory in bulk at wholesale margins. The platform aggregates more than a thousand secondhand suppliers worldwide, handles discovery, ordering, and logistics through its website and mobile apps, and is backed by HV Capital. Fleek operates a consumer/reseller storefront (built on Shopify) and a separate vendor onboarding flow for suppliers; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from the HV Capital portfolio and enriched from Fleek's public web surface.

providers.name: FoodA
providers.description: Fooda is a Chicago-based workplace food-service marketplace that brings meals from local, independent restaurants directly to corporate offices, hospitals, universities, retail locations, and distribution centers. Its technology-enabled platform runs restaurant popup dining events, employer-paid meal programs, contactless lunch delivery, event catering and boxed lunches, coffee, pantry, and micro-market services, plus full cafeteria replacement under the Orange by Fooda brand. Fooda works with 2,000+ restaurant partners and serves upwards of ten million meals per year, using AI predictive modeling and machine learning to match restaurants to locations and schedule thousands of events. Sibling brands include Foodsby and Fooda for Restaurants. Fooda is a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API or partner developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Freshop
providers.description: Freshop is an eCommerce platform purpose-built for grocery and specialty retail, now part of NCR Voyix. It powers branded online storefronts, mobile shopping, order fulfillment, pickup, and delivery for independent and regional grocers, and integrates third-party services for loyalty, coupons, email, SMS, and fulfillment. Freshop exposes a live REST API at api.freshop.com that serves store and product data to Freshop-powered storefronts and apps, authenticated with an application key (app_key) query-string parameter and versioned by a numeric path segment.

providers.name: Gamma Technologies
providers.description: Gamma Technologies develops GT-SUITE, the multi-physics system simulation software used by engineers to model, simulate, and optimize complex systems across automotive, HVACR, aerospace, industrial machinery, and shipbuilding. GT-SUITE combines 0D/1D/3D physics-based modeling, prebuilt model libraries, digital-twin workflows, and native AI tooling (GT Intelligence Studio and a Machine Learning Assistant). The company is a desktop/engineering CAE vendor rather than an API-first provider and publishes no public REST API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Garmentory
providers.description: Garmentory is a Seattle-based online fashion marketplace that connects shoppers with more than 1,000 independent boutiques and emerging designers across 30+ countries. Backed by Techstars, the platform curates apparel, accessories, and footwear from independent retailers, letting boutiques list inventory manually or sync it through a Shopify integration. Garmentory runs a heavily customized Spree Commerce (Ruby on Rails) storefront and consumes third-party APIs (payments, retail media, and merchant onboarding) rather than publishing a first-party public developer API. This profile tracks Garmentory's identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API reference is published at this time.

providers.name: Gathern
