providers.description: Gathern (جاذر) is the first licensed peer-to-peer vacation-rental marketplace in Saudi Arabia, founded in Riyadh in 2016 and licensed by the Saudi Ministry of Tourism. Through its iOS, Android, and web apps, travelers book short-term private accommodations directly from local hosts — chalets, apartments, villas, farms, resorts, rest houses (istrahat), camps, caravans, and rooms — across more than 200 cities and provinces in the Kingdom, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Taif, Al Khobar, Dammam, Mecca, Medina, and AlUla. The platform lists tens of thousands of units, has served more than five million users, and holds a leading share of the alternative-hospitality sector in Saudi Arabia. Backed by 500 Global, STV, Sanabil Investments (a Public Investment Fund subsidiary), and others, Gathern raised a $72M Series B and is preparing for a Tadawul listing. Gathern operates as a consumer marketplace app and does not currently publish a public developer API surface; this profile tracks its public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Genopets
providers.description: Genopets is a free-to-play, move-to-earn NFT game built on the Solana blockchain that gamifies an active lifestyle. Players nurture a digital pet — a Genopet — that evolves from real-world physical activity tracked via step counting, then battle, craft, stake, and trade in-game NFTs and Habitats. The economy pairs the GENE governance token with the in-game KI utility token earned by moving. Genopets is developed by a studio backed by Pantera Capital and operates a consumer mobile/web game rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Getteal
providers.description: Getteal (Teal Health) is a women's health company offering an FDA-authorized at-home cervical cancer screening kit, the Teal Wand, a self-collection device that lets people collect a sample privately at home and mail it to a laboratory for Primary HPV testing (the same cobas HPV test used in clinics). The service pairs the device with virtual provider consultations, a patient portal for results, insurance and HSA/FSA billing, and support for major U.S. health plans. Getteal is backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it is a consumer digital-health brand with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: GigFinesse
providers.description: GigFinesse is a live-entertainment talent booking platform that connects hospitality venues — hotels, restaurants, bars, and clubs — with musicians, DJs, and performing artists. Venues discover and book vetted talent and manage contracts, insurance, scheduling, and payments through a centralized dashboard, while artists gain access to consistent, recurring gig opportunities. Clients include premium hospitality brands such as St. Regis, The Ritz-Carlton, Fairmont Hotels, and Hard Rock Hotel. GigFinesse is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Glambot
providers.description: Glambot is an online marketplace for buying and selling gently used and new makeup and beauty products. Shoppers can purchase discounted cosmetics from more than 100 brands including MAC, Urban Decay, Charlotte Tilbury, and Chanel across categories such as eyes, lashes, brows, face, cheeks, lips, skincare, palettes, and brushes, while sellers can mail in their unwanted makeup for cash payouts. Glambot operates a two-sided consumer resale platform and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. The company does not currently publish a public API, SDK, developer portal, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Glofox
providers.description: Glofox is boutique gym and fitness studio management software - member management, class/appointment scheduling, bookings, memberships, credits, payments, and lead conversion for studios, gyms, and fitness franchises. Glofox was acquired by ABC Fitness Solutions in August 2022 and now operates as the ABC Glofox business unit within ABC's fitness technology platform. Glofox publishes a partner/developer REST API (the "ABC Glofox API Developer Portal") covering members, memberships, plans, credits, classes, bookings, purchases, branches, and leads, plus CDC (change data capture) webhooks for member and access-control events. Access is gated - integrators request x-api-key and x-glofox-api-token credentials by email before they can call the API.

providers.name: Grove Health
providers.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

providers.name: Hazel Health
providers.description: Hazel Health is the nation's leading provider of school-based telehealth, delivering virtual physical and mental health care to K-12 students. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hazel partners directly with school districts and families to connect students with licensed, linguistically and culturally diverse clinicians and therapists — at school or at home — often within minutes for medical care and within days for teletherapy, at no cost to families. The company serves more than two million students across 100-plus districts nationwide, helping reduce chronic absenteeism and address gaps in access to care as an extension of the school health team. Hazel operates HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant systems with full encryption and secure access controls. It is a B2B/B2G healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: HeavyConnect
providers.description: HeavyConnect is a digital documentation and compliance platform purpose-built for agricultural operations, serving growers, harvesters, shippers, and processors. Its mobile-first, offline-capable modules cover food safety compliance, worker training and certification, time and productivity tracking, quality assurance inspections, end-to-end traceability, and supplier management. The platform replaces paper-based recordkeeping with audit-ready digital documentation and real-time analytics dashboards, helping food and agriculture operations stay inspection-ready. HeavyConnect reports 2,600+ active users across operations including Sysco, Naturipe, Talley, and Empire. It is offered as a month-to-month subscription with a request-a-demo onboarding path. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio-company lead (500 Global, Techstars) and enriched from the company's public web presence; no public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Imperfect Foods
providers.description: Imperfect Foods is a consumer grocery delivery service focused on reducing food waste. It sources surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and excess-inventory food — produce that is too large or small, packaging overstock, near best-by-date items, and manufacturing byproducts — and delivers them to members at a discount through a weekly, customizable grocery order of produce, meat, seafood, dairy, pantry staples, and snacks. Imperfect Foods was acquired by Misfits Market in 2022 and now operates as part of that company; its consumer web and mobile apps remain live. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment — this profile is maintained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Indigo Agriculture
providers.description: Indigo Agriculture is a Boston-based agriculture-technology company combining microbial seed and foliar treatments (biotrinsic) and on-farm seed treatment hardware (CLIPS) with two large supply-chain programs: Carbon by Indigo, a soil-carbon program that pays growers for verified carbon credits using Indigo's proprietary measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) stack; and Source by Indigo, a Scope-3 program that connects consumer-goods buyers to sustainably grown crops with greenhouse-gas, water, and low-carbon-biofuel outcome reporting. Indigo does not publish a public developer portal; partner and supply-chain integrations are negotiated directly through their team.

providers.name: Inspirato
providers.description: Inspirato is a luxury travel subscription company that gives members access to a curated portfolio of 300+ private branded residences, 200+ five-star hotels, and 170+ destinations worldwide, paired with dedicated concierge care, curated experiences, and signature hotel partnerships. Members book vacations through Inspirato's website and app with predictable, service-first delivery. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IVP and added to the API Evangelist network. Inspirato does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Intro
providers.description: Intro is a consumer marketplace, founded in 2020 by Raad Mobrem and headquartered in Los Angeles, that connects people with vetted, in-demand experts for one-on-one advice over scheduled video calls. Experts span career and business, interior design and home decor, style and beauty, health and wellness, fitness and nutrition, astrology, and more, with per-session pricing set by each expert. Intro also lets creators and professionals monetize their audience by publishing a bookable profile. The company raised a $10M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) with participation from Seven Seven Six. Intro operates as a consumer web and mobile product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: Ixlayer
providers.description: Ixlayer is a direct-to-patient healthcare technology company that helps biopharmaceutical companies transform the patient experience through an integrated, AI-enabled platform. Its unified platform spans virtual patient onboarding and intake, telehealth for primary and specialty care, at-home and in-center lab testing with mobile phlebotomy, prescription fulfillment (retail, specialty, and home delivery), benefits verification and claims, connected care with provider directories and scheduling, and the ixAI patient concierge for AI-powered support and care coordination. Ixlayer says it has powered more than 1,100 nationwide programs and enabled over 4 million patient care journeys, and states its services are SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. The company is backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Josh Wood Colour
providers.description: Josh Wood Colour is a UK-based at-home hair colour brand founded by celebrity colourist Josh Wood, selling permanent and semi-permanent hair dye, root touch-up, gloss, toners, blonde and grey-blending products, and haircare direct to consumers through a Shopify-powered online store at joshwoodcolour.com. The brand pairs its retail catalogue with a free personalised colour-matching consultation service and editorial hair-care advice. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail e-commerce brand it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; this profile captures its web identity, security posture, and customer-facing properties.

providers.name: Kriptos
providers.description: Kriptos is an AI-driven unstructured data security platform that automatically discovers, classifies, and labels documents across endpoints, servers, and cloud storage, then feeds that business and risk context into the DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, and IAM tooling an organization already runs rather than replacing it. The platform spans data discovery and classification, data compliance and risk management, data access governance across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, insider threat management with UEBA, DSPM, and AI governance covering shadow-AI monitoring for tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini. Classification results are written back as native Microsoft Purview and Google Drive labels. Founded in Ecuador and backed by Techstars, Kriptos reports more than 1.2 billion documents classified for over 150,000 users, with customers concentrated in banking, insurance, healthcare, and utilities across Latin America. Kriptos is a sales-led product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation.

providers.name: LawnGuru
providers.description: LawnGuru is a lawn and landscape services marketplace that connects homeowners with vetted local service providers through a mobile-first platform. It offers instant pricing via aerial property mapping, real-time job tracking, and a satisfaction guarantee, spanning 17+ outdoor services including lawn mowing, snow clearing, yard cleanup, weeding, hedge trimming, gutter cleaning, tree work, seeding, aeration, mulch installation, pressure washing, sprinkler services, and junk removal. The company reports over 1,000,000 completed jobs. As of this enrichment pass, LawnGuru publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Legion
providers.description: Legion provides an intelligent workforce management platform that automates labor planning, schedule optimization, time‑and‑attendance, and employee engagement. The solution leverages AI to forecast demand, reduce attrition, and improve compliance for enterprises across retail, hospitality, healthcare, and other industries. Founded with backing from Norwest Venture Partners, Legion serves thousands of locations worldwide, delivering measurable cost savings and productivity gains.

providers.name: magicteams-ai
providers.description: Magic Teams AI provides an AI Operating System (AIOS) for founders, delivering a daily brief, approved follow‑through, and a unified operating layer across inboxes, meetings, and files. It also offers a voice conversation platform with real‑time transcription, call management, campaign automation, and webhook events, powered by edge computing, Supabase, and Twilio integration.

providers.name: Memberful
providers.description: Memberful is a membership and subscription platform (owned by Patreon) that lets independent publishers, educators, and creators sell memberships, subscriptions, digital downloads, podcasts, and courses on their own site while Memberful handles checkout, recurring billing (via Stripe), and member management. Its public developer surface is a GraphQL API served per account at https://ACCOUNT.memberful.com/api/graphql, authenticated with an API key (bearer token) or OAuth 2.0 access token, covering Members, Subscriptions, Plans/Passes, Coupons, and Orders through queries and mutations. Memberful also provides OAuth 2.0 single sign-on for apps and HMAC-signed webhooks for member, subscription, plan, order, and download events.

providers.name: Merchbar
providers.description: Merchbar, Inc. is the official merchandise retailer for top musicians, selling vinyl records, CDs, t-shirts, hoodies, posters, and other band merchandise across thousands of artist storefronts at merchbar.com. It runs a consumer shopping experience alongside a "Merchbar for Artists" program and official merchandise integrations with YouTube and Spotify. Merchbar is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Merchbar publishes no public API, developer program, SDKs, or technical documentation — no developer/api/docs subdomain resolves and there is no /.well-known/security.txt — so this profile captures only its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Meritfirst
providers.description: MeritFirst is a skills-based hiring platform that replaces resume- and credential-based recruiting with practical, real-world assessments. Candidates prove their craft through work samples (Build, Try, Get Seen) and companies evaluate and match them on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree. MeritFirst exposes a hosted, authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so agents and tools can manage assessments, review candidates, and analyze hiring data. Backed by 8VC and Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Mind Foundry
providers.description: Mind Foundry is an Oxford University spin-out, founded in 2016 and headquartered at Ewert House in Oxford, United Kingdom, that builds applied machine learning for high-stakes, real-world problems across defence, national security, insurance, infrastructure and government. Its current products are SENTRY, a multi-modal sensor-fusion capability that detects, classifies and tracks objects in time and space from raw sensor data, and NIGHTINGALE, AI-enabled acoustic intelligence for anti-submarine warfare that has been integrated with Thales systems. Mind Foundry delivers these as deployed and integrated systems for customers and prime contractors rather than as a public, self-serve developer API, and it publishes no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification. The company previously operated OPTaaS (Optimization as a Service), a Bayesian optimisation API with first-party Python and R clients; the OPTaaS service hosts and its GitHub client repositories are no longer reachable, and the PyPI client has had no release since January 2024. Mind Foundry publishes ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus and JOSCAR certifications on its own site.

providers.name: Misfits Market
providers.description: Misfits Market is a subscription-based online grocery delivery service founded in 2018 by Abhi Ramesh and headquartered in Philadelphia. It rescues surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and near-best-by organic produce, pantry staples, dairy, and meat, then delivers them to customers at a discount to reduce food waste. Members shop a personalized storefront during a weekly delivery window with no subscription fees or order minimums, and can skip or cancel anytime. The company acquired rival Imperfect Foods in 2022 and The Rounds in 2025. Backed by Accel and SoftBank Vision Fund. Misfits Market operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: MonkeyTilt
providers.description: MonkeyTilt is a crypto-native online casino and sportsbook where players deposit, wager, and cash out in cryptocurrency across slots, table games, live dealer, and sports betting. The platform rewards play with points, prize drops, and the Tilt Club VIP program (bonuses and merch drops), and is backed by Pantera Capital. MonkeyTilt is a consumer gaming product: it runs an internal application API (disallowed to crawlers in robots.txt) but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Musely
providers.description: Musely is a telehealth platform, founded in 2012 by Jack Jia and Carrie Jiao and based in San Jose, California, that connects patients with U.S. board-certified dermatologists for personalized, prescription-strength skincare and related care. Patients share skin concerns online, physicians craft personalized treatment plans, and freshly compounded formulas are shipped to the patient. Since pivoting from a wellness community to prescription skincare in 2019, Musely has expanded into hair loss, hormonal/menopause health, and longevity, serving more than 1.2 million patients. Musely is a consumer/health company in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a direct-to-consumer web and mobile telehealth experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Neara
providers.description: Neara is a physics-enabled digital twin platform for electric utilities and network operators. It builds a single, physics-accurate 3D model of a utility's entire network from LiDAR, GIS, and imagery, then runs engineering-grade simulations across vegetation management, wildfire and flood mitigation, severe-weather response, clearance and conductor-clash analysis, pole utilization and FEA, asset inspection and lifecycle management, and transmission and distribution network design. Utilities use Neara to plan, harden, and operate their grids at scale — forecasting and backcasting resilience, prioritizing risk, and optimizing capital spend across millions of assets. Founded in Australia, Neara operates regionally across ANZ, the USA, and Europe.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Nintex
providers.description: Nintex provides a low-code workflow automation platform enabling businesses to design, execute, and optimize processes across cloud, on-premises, and major SaaS ecosystems. Its solutions include workflow automation, document generation, e‑signatures, and robotic process automation, helping organizations accelerate digital transformation.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Paladin
providers.description: Paladin is a legal technology company whose software platform connects the pro bono community and empowers legal teams to run pro bono programs more efficiently. The platform provides centralized program management dashboards, volunteer matching that connects attorneys to pro bono opportunities based on interest and expertise, and impact measurement that visualizes and reports on program outcomes across a nationwide network of legal services organizations, law firms, in-house legal teams, law schools, and bar associations. Customers include Clifford Chance, Dentons, Holland & Knight, and Wilson Sonsini. Paladin is a Techstars portfolio company. It exposes a customer-facing web application at app.joinpaladin.com but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Perimeter VRM (formerly ProcessBolt)
providers.description: Perimeter (formerly ProcessBolt) is a vendor risk management (VRM) platform built for regulated industries. It covers the full third-party risk lifecycle through six modules — Monitor (continuous vendor surveillance and alerts), Assess (automated risk assessments with a drag-and-drop template builder), Extract (AI-powered document intelligence), Verify (attack-surface validation), Share (a document management and collaboration hub), and Respond (RFP and assessment response automation). The product centralizes vendor information, scores and reports vendor risk, and supports no-code integration and API-based / CSV vendor imports across US, EU, and Australia data regions. ProcessBolt rebranded to Perimeter and now serves the platform from perimeter.net; processbolt.com redirects there. No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs are published — the platform's integration APIs are exposed to customers rather than through an open developer surface.

providers.name: Phaidra
providers.description: Phaidra builds AI agents for autonomous data center and industrial operations, using reinforcement learning to control cooling, power, and workloads in mission-critical facilities. Its products include Phaidra Prism, an LLM for data center operations that helps technicians identify, prioritize, and resolve infrastructure issues, and Phaidra Factory, self-learning AI agents that continuously monitor and optimize thermal reliability, energy efficiency, and IT capacity to maximize tokens per watt across AI factories. Phaidra is an enterprise vendor with no public API or developer program; this profile captures its public security, compliance, and web posture. Backed by Index Ventures.

providers.name: Planet FWD
providers.description: Planet FWD is a decarbonization software platform that helps consumer brands measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions. It provides AI-powered product life cycle assessments (LCAs), corporate greenhouse-gas inventories across Scope 1, 2, and 3, and supply-chain decarbonization scenario planning for food & beverage, retail, and apparel companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Provi
providers.description: Provi is a B2B beverage alcohol marketplace that digitizes procurement across the three-tier distribution system, connecting buyers (bars, restaurants, and retail stores) with distributors, sales representatives, and suppliers/brands. The platform consolidates product discovery across distributor catalogs, direct messaging with sales reps, order management and processing, and brand showcase tools into a single ordering experience. Provi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Publishizer
providers.description: Publishizer is a book crowdfunding platform and literary agency that connects authors with readers and publishers. Authors create book proposals and run pre-order campaigns; readers pre-order copies to signal demand; and publishers use data such as pre-order volume and proposal quality to discover and acquire promising manuscripts. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web platform and blog but no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Qognitive
providers.description: Qognitive, Inc. is an AI company that develops QCML (Quantum Cognition Machine Learning), an analytical AI architecture positioned as an alternative to classical statistical modeling. Its product, Hone, targets high-dimensional, multi-modal, and noisy structured data — claiming near-linear scaling with feature count and accuracy improvements over industry-standard models, with peer-reviewed backing in Nature Scientific Reports and Risk.net. Hone is distributed as first-party Python packages (hone-io community edition and hone-io-enterprise) exposing scikit-learn-compatible regression and classification wrappers. The company was surfaced as a Ribbit Capital portfolio company. There is no public REST/HTTP API surface; integration is via the Python SDK.

providers.name: Qolab
providers.description: Qolab, Inc. is a superconducting quantum computing hardware company founded in 2022, with offices in Los Angeles, California and research laboratories in Madison, Wisconsin. Co-founded by 2025 Nobel laureate in physics John Martinis and Alan Ho — both of whom led hardware and product for Google's 2019 quantum supremacy milestone — Qolab builds high-coherence superconducting qubits by applying advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes to qubit fabrication, targeting the yield and integration problems that stand between quantum research and utility-scale machines. Its first deployable offering is Qolab Start, a turn-key superconducting QPU platform for pulse-level and device-level hardware research, sold to university labs, national laboratories and semiconductor R&D teams and delivered either on-premise or through secure cloud connectivity. Qolab has raised roughly $70M across a $16M Series A and a $54.2M Series B led by UC Investments, with strategic investment from Applied Ventures and Western Digital, and leads hardware development for DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. Qolab publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no machine-readable API contract and no self-serve sign-up, and the API and control interface guides that ship with Qolab Start are released to customers after a Request Access review.

providers.name: Raydiant
providers.description: Raydiant is a digital signage and in-location experience management platform for brick-and-mortar businesses, now operating under the Displai brand (raydiant.com redirects to displai.ai). The platform lets restaurants, retail stores, hospitality venues, commercial buildings, and schools manage branded content across networks of screens and kiosks from a central cloud dashboard. Core products include Displai Signage (multi-location content management), Displai Engage (employee engagement and gamification), Displai InSight (AI foot traffic and visitor analytics), and self-service ordering kiosks integrated with point-of-sale systems. Customers include Chick-fil-A, Macy's, Toyota, T-Mobile, and Red Bull. It runs a production cloud API at api.raydiant.com / api.displai.ai, but that surface is not publicly documented — there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or API reference. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a Bloomberg Beta portfolio lead.

providers.name: Reedsy
providers.description: Reedsy is a marketplace and toolset for authors and publishers, connecting writers with a curated network of more than 3,700 vetted publishing professionals including editors, book designers, marketers, ghostwriters, web designers, and translators. Beyond the marketplace, Reedsy offers Reedsy Studio (a free writing and book-formatting application), Reedsy Learning (courses and events), Reedsy Discovery (book reviews), and Reedsy Prompts (weekly writing prompts). It supports authors across the full self-publishing journey from manuscript development through market launch. Reedsy is backed by Seedcamp and publishes no public developer API today.

providers.name: Rent-A-Center
providers.description: Rent-A-Center is a lease-to-own retail company providing furniture, electronics, appliances, and computers through its Rent-A-Center stores and Acima (formerly AcceptanceNOW) in-store kiosk program. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Rent-A-Center operates thousands of stores across the United States, Mexico, and Puerto Rico. The company's technology platform supports online store management, customer account self-service, lease agreement processing, and the Preferred Lease virtual store integration program for retail partners. No public developer API is currently documented. The Acima platform provides a lease-to-own integration capability for partner retailers via a separate developer program.

providers.name: Resy
providers.description: Resy is a restaurant reservation and discovery platform owned by American Express. Resy does not maintain a publicly self-serve developer portal; integration is restricted to approved partners (POS, CRM, loyalty, marketing, and discovery) under direct partnership agreements. The primary public surface is the consumer web and mobile app and an embeddable "Book with Resy" booking widget for restaurants. The unofficial internal client API at api.resy.com has been widely reverse-engineered by the community, but it is undocumented, unsupported, and may change without notice.

providers.name: Revel Ai Health
providers.description: RevelAi Health is a healthcare technology company building a conversational AI platform for orthopedic and musculoskeletal care teams. Its AI agent, "kimi," automates patient outreach, triage, clinical documentation, and follow-up across the care episode, supporting value-based care models, quality reporting, and Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROM) collection. The platform offers multilingual population-health outreach across voice, text, and email, ambient clinical documentation, and AI-augmented staffing and task management for ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals and health systems, and physician practices. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and maintains SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance programs. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: Rose Bounty
providers.description: Rose Bounty provides independent verification for autonomous transactions, offering a public API that evaluates submitted tasks against agreed acceptance criteria and returns a machine‑readable receipt with a deterministic recommendation. The service records agent identity where available, preserves evidence, and issues immutable receipts without moving funds, enabling secure, transparent verification for payment systems and other automated workflows.

providers.name: Safqah
providers.description: Safqah Holdings Limited operates Safqah (Safqah Capital / Safqah Financial), a Saudi Arabian fintech platform headquartered in the Al-Malqa district of Riyadh and regulated by the Saudi Capital Market Authority (CMA). Safqah provides Sharia-compliant, debt-based real estate investment opportunities that let qualified individual and institutional investors fund real estate development deals starting from 1,000 SAR, alongside a financing arm that offers land acquisition, residential development, commercial development, raw land, and bridge financing to real estate developers. Investors track deal performance through periodic reporting and live project camera feeds. The platform is a consumer- and investor-facing web application with no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Sapio Sciences
providers.description: Sapio Sciences provides an AI-native lab informatics platform that unifies LIMS, ELN, and Scientific Data Cloud capabilities for life sciences research. The platform exposes a RESTful API enabling programmatic access to laboratory workflows, experimental data, LIMS processes, sample management, and instrument integrations. The official Python client library sapiopylib wraps all REST API functions, supporting data record manipulation, picklist services, notebook experiments, webhook servers, and batch request processing for high-performance lab automation.

providers.name: Sciket
providers.description: Sciket (科研市集, operated by STAREK Scientific / 勢得科研股份有限公司) is Taiwan's specialized online marketplace for scientific research and technology procurement. The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: Sellersfi
providers.description: SellersFi is a financial technology company providing working capital and inventory financing to e-commerce merchants, including sellers on Amazon and direct-to-consumer channels. It offers flexible funding lines with approvals in as fast as 48 hours, helping online businesses manage cash flow, purchase inventory, and scale operations. Backed by Northzone, SellersFi operates a lending platform and applicant portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sesh
providers.description: Sesh (Sesh Products US, Sesh+) is an Austin, Texas consumer packaged goods company that manufactures and sells tobacco-free nicotine pouches. Products ship in multiple flavors (Mint, Wintergreen, Clear, Mango, Cappuccino, Raspberry Lemon) and strengths (4mg, 6mg, 8mg), sold direct-to-consumer via subscription and through 5,000+ retailers. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a physical-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront, so the profile carries identity and domain-security only.

providers.name: Sidekick
providers.description: Sidekick is a UK-based online wealth management and investing platform that offers expert-led investments and savings products once reserved for the ultra-wealthy, delivered through a mobile app and web platform. Its product range spans managed investment portfolios, savings accounts, private equity access, and cryptocurrency exposure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp, Sidekick is a consumer (B2C) fintech and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Silq
providers.description: Silq (OneSilq) is a digital freight forwarder delivering fast, transparent global shipping and supply-chain services. Offerings span ocean freight (full container load, less-than-container load and shared container load), air freight, buyer's consolidation, cargo value protection, customs brokerage and trucking/drayage, plus quality-control inspections across China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh. The platform layers real-time shipment visibility, live ocean-carrier freight rates, expert trade advisory and built-in risk protection for importers and small shippers.

providers.name: Smiler
providers.description: Smiler is an Amsterdam-based on-the-spot photography marketplace that connects travelers and consumers with a network of professional freelance photographers at popular tourist hotspots and leisure locations worldwide. Founded in 2020, Smiler lets people book fast, affordable photoshoots in advance across 100+ destinations, with photos delivered within 48 hours and free cancellation up to 24 hours before the shoot. The company also operates the Smiler Photographer Suite, an all-in-one tool for photographers to build portfolio websites, manage bookings, deliver mobile-friendly client galleries, and handle payments. Smiler is trusted by tens of thousands of photographers across 50+ countries and is backed by Speedinvest, Mosaic Ventures, Dutch Founders Fund, and PROfounders.

providers.name: Sourceday
providers.description: SourceDay is an AI-driven supplier collaboration and purchase order (PO) management platform for manufacturers and distributors. It synchronizes buyers, suppliers, and ERP systems in real time to prevent supply chain disruptions, automating PO change management, shipment visibility, supplier scorecards, and request-for-quote (RFQ) workflows. SourceDay reports managing more than $5B in quarterly direct spend across 100K+ activated suppliers, with 500+ certified ERP integrations spanning Acumatica, Epicor (Kinetic and Prophet 21), Infor, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through certified ERP connectors rather than a public self-serve developer API; there is no public API documentation, developer portal, or published OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Spoiler Alert
providers.description: Spoiler Alert is a Boston-based software company (a Techstars portfolio company) that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers manage and sell excess, short-dated, and obsolete inventory. Its purpose-built platform digitizes discounting and liquidation processes, matching surplus inventory with the right buyers at the right price through a secondary marketplace, with automated listing generation, dynamic pricing optimization, freight cost management, and performance analytics to recover margin and reduce food and product waste. The platform is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.spoileralert.com); no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Stacks
providers.description: Stacks is an AI-native financial close and accounting platform for controllers, CFOs, and accounting teams. It automates the monthly close across existing ERPs with agentic tooling for account reconciliations and transaction matching, journal-entry posting and review, close-management checklists and approvals, and AI-powered analysis, variance explanation, and reporting. Stacks connects directly to ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, SAP S/4HANA, Workday), data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift), file storage, and spreadsheets, and offers an Excel add-in for manual journals. A developer API for custom reconciliation logic is announced as "coming soon." Stacks is a fintech company backed by EQT Ventures, General Catalyst, Lux Capital, Union Square Ventures, and Version One Ventures. Profile enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from public web surfaces (no public API specification is yet available).

providers.name: SteadyMD
providers.description: SteadyMD is a telehealth infrastructure and clinical-workforce company (a DocGo company) backed by Lux Capital. It supplies board-certified physicians and nurse practitioners, clinical operations, and 50-state licensing and credentialing, plus technology and telehealth APIs that let healthcare and digital-health partners launch branded, fully managed virtual care. Its APIs cover patient data submission, synchronous and asynchronous consult requests, two-way patient-clinician messaging, intake forms, clinician availability, real-time status updates, document attachments, scheduling, and reporting/SLA retrieval, offered as either a Limited (partner-EMR) or Complete (SteadyMD-EMR) integration. API documentation is provided under a business agreement via a request form; there is no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Sunnyside
providers.description: Sunnyside is a digital health platform for alcohol moderation, founded in 2020, that helps members cut back on or quit drinking through personalized weekly plans, drink tracking and analytics, human text-based coaching, habit-building exercises, and a supportive community. Its separate Sunnyside Med telehealth service connects members with licensed providers who can prescribe compounded naltrexone. Sunnyside is a consumer mobile app and telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Tanda
providers.description: Tanda provides cloud‑based workforce management software for Australian businesses, offering tools for roster creation, time‑clock integration, payroll processing, and HR administration. Their platform helps companies automate scheduling, track employee hours, manage leave, and ensure compliance with local labor regulations, all through an intuitive web interface and mobile apps.

providers.name: Tapstitch
providers.description: Tapstitch is a premium, fashion-focused print-on-demand (POD) and dropshipping platform that lets creators and brands design, produce, and sell custom apparel with no inventory, no minimums, and no subscription fees. It provides heavyweight streetwear blanks (250-400+ GSM), DTG and DTF printing, white-label fulfillment, and fashion collection development, with native integrations into Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace, and TikTok Shop for automatic product syncing, order routing, and fulfillment tracking. Founded to empower self-expression through clothing, Tapstitch has served 60,000+ creators, shipped over one million garments, and raised a $24.8M Series A led by Forerunner Ventures. Tapstitch does not currently publish a public developer/REST API for headless or custom storefronts; integration is delivered through its e-commerce platform apps and connectors.

providers.name: Tend
providers.description: Tend (Tend Dental) is a consumer dental-care company offering modern, judgment-free dentistry through a network of design-forward "studios" across New York City, Boston, Atlanta, Washington DC, Nashville and Connecticut. The brand pairs a soothing in-person studio experience and top-rated dentists with a fully online booking and patient-intake flow at hellotend.com. Services span preventive hygiene, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, veneers, Invisalign and clear aligners, orthodontics, dental implants, endodontics, sedation and emergency care. Backed by GV and Redpoint Ventures. This is a consumer web/ booking business with no public developer API surface; the profile is enriched with identity, security-posture and discovery-probe artifacts only.

providers.name: Tennr
providers.description: Tennr is a New York City-based healthcare technology company (founded 2021) building agentic patient-orchestration software that automates referral-based care operations for providers and health systems. Its proprietary vision-language model, RaeLM, is trained on over 100 million anonymized medical documents to read faxes, referrals, and unstructured records, then automates document classification, data extraction, patient qualification, insurance eligibility verification, and prior-authorization submission by integrating directly with existing EHR systems. Tennr processes over 10 million documents monthly and is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant. It raised a $101M Series C at a $605M valuation led by IVP, with a16z, Lightspeed, GV, ICONIQ, and Foundation Capital participating. Tennr does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or specification; integrations are delivered through EHR connections and professional services.

providers.name: Terminal Logistics
providers.description: Terminal Industries (Terminal Logistics) is the company behind the Terminal Yard Operating System (YOS), an AI-native, fully-integrated platform for yard operations across logistics and supply chain. It unifies gate management, carrier risk assessment and driver ID, dispatch and spotter orchestration, yard visibility, load verification, carrier appointments, and end-to-end yard security from the gate to the dock, using computer vision and agentic AI. It serves third-party logistics, retail and grocery, consumer packaged goods, refrigerated warehousing, contract carriers, manufacturing facilities, and drop lots. Backed by 8vc. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and status surface.

providers.name: Tessitura
providers.description: Tessitura provides a unified platform for arts and cultural organizations, delivering integrated CRM, ticketing, admissions, fundraising, memberships, marketing, education, and e‑commerce solutions. Their cloud‑based system helps nonprofits manage audiences, revenue, and engagement across multiple channels, supporting venues, museums, festivals, orchestras, and other cultural institutions worldwide.

providers.name: The Expert
providers.description: The Expert is a consumer marketplace that connects people with top interior designers worldwide through paid one-on-one video consultations, paired with an Expert-curated home shopping marketplace where those designers' product picks can be purchased directly. Founded by celebrity interior designer Jake Arnold and tech entrepreneur Leo Seigal, the company is backed by Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, WndrCo, and others. It operates as a business-to-consumer platform with a trade program for design professionals; it publishes no public developer API. This profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Thorin
providers.description: Thorin is an applied-AI startup incubated and backed by 8VC (Joe Lonsdale), building a workbench for company agents. Its product at app.thorin.com pairs a personal agent that acts as your delegate with project agents that own shared team workflows, connecting business systems (Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Gong, Salesforce, Affinity, and MCP) and organizing company context into feeds that power reusable skills and scheduled automations. Thorin observes work across email, chat, meetings, and documents to build a real-time model of how a business operates, then automates recurring processes such as deal flow, deal-prep briefs, and inbox switchboards. Seed-stage, based in San Francisco. This profile documents Thorin's product and documentation surface; no public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Timberhub
providers.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: UNest
providers.description: UNest is a Los Angeles-based fintech app that helps parents and families save and invest for their children's futures through UTMA/UGMA custodial investment accounts, with brand rewards contributions, gifting, financial literacy content, and term life insurance offered through Ladder. UNest Advisers, LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, with brokerage through UNest Securities, LLC (FINRA/SIPC) and clearing through Apex Clearing. The company is a consumer mobile-app business and publishes no public developer API, though its site ships a real llms.txt. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Velocia
providers.description: Velocia is a transit ridership solutions company that uses real-time rewards, incentives, and digital tools to increase public-transit ridership and engagement for transit agencies and cities. Its programs include a Rider Incentive Program, Transit Ambassador Program, Mobility Wallet, rider surveys, an Automated Guaranteed Ride Home Program, and Major Event Solutions, integrated into transit apps to drive behavior change. Velocia partners with agencies and mobility services such as Miami-Dade County, King County Metro, Seattle DOT, Lime, Zipcar, Uber, Lyft, and CitiBike Miami. Founded in 2018 and based in Toronto, Velocia is a Techstars-backed company. This profile has no public developer/API surface at enrichment time.

providers.name: Vinted
providers.description: Vinted is a European consumer-to-consumer (C2C) online marketplace for buying and selling secondhand clothes, shoes, accessories, and other lifestyle items, operating across web and mobile apps in dozens of markets. Founded in Vilnius, Lithuania, it is one of Europe's largest secondhand fashion platforms and is backed by Accel, Insight Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Vinted does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public identity, legal, and security (security.txt / domain-security) surfaces.

providers.name: wacai
providers.description: Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fintech and personal-finance company founded in 2009, best known for its "挖财记账" personal accounting and bookkeeping app and its internet wealth-management platform. Beyond its consumer apps, Wacai operates a partner-facing open API gateway (挖财开放平台) at open.wacai.com that exposes services through a single JSON-over-HTTPS entry point using appKey/appSecret signed requests, with official client SDKs published for Java (Maven Central), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Wag!
providers.description: Wag! is a US pet-care marketplace that connects dog and pet owners with local, background-checked caregivers for on-demand and scheduled dog walking, drop-in visits, pet sitting, boarding, daycare, and 24/7 vet chat. Operating across 5,300+ cities in all 50 states, the platform has completed more than 16 million services and is delivered primarily through its iOS and Android consumer apps. Wag! (Wag Labs, Inc.) is backed by Battery Ventures, Bullpen Capital, and General Catalyst. As of July 2026 Wag! exposes no public developer API or documented partner API; its production API hosts (prod-*-api.wagwalking.com) are internal mobile-app backends. This profile captures the company's public security and identity surface pending any future developer program.

providers.name: WalkerCo
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands (WalkerCo) is a health and beauty company founded by Tristan Walker that designs grooming and personal-care products for people of color. Its flagship brand, Bevel, sells shaving systems, razors, skin, hair, and beard-care products direct-to-consumer, and the company also operates the FORM hair-care line. Walker & Company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and its storefronts run on Shopify. The company does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its programmatic surface is limited to the Shopify-provided Customer Account OAuth/OIDC endpoints on the Bevel storefront and an internal-tooling GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: wayup
providers.description: WayUp is a US early-career job and internship marketplace that connects college students and recent graduates with roles at 3,800+ vetted employers. Founded as Campus Job and rebranded WayUp in 2015, it was acquired by campus-recruiting company Yello in 2021. Candidates upload a resume and are matched to entry-level jobs, internships, and virtual career fairs, while employers use WayUp for early-talent sourcing and diversity recruiting. As of this profile WayUp publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its surface is a consumer web application plus a Help Scout knowledge base. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

providers.name: WiredScore
providers.description: WiredScore is the global standard-setting organization for digital connectivity and smart technology in the built environment. It assesses, benchmarks, and certifies buildings through two programs — WiredScore (digital connectivity) and SmartScore (smart building technology) — across office, residential, industrial, and hotel asset types. Landlords, developers, and occupiers in more than 40 countries use its certifications and its network of Accredited Professionals to demonstrate that a building meets modern technology and connectivity expectations; over 4,000 buildings covering roughly one billion square feet have been certified. WiredScore is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Fifth Wall. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface.

providers.name: WOO Sports
providers.description: WOO Sports makes a sensor-based performance-tracking system for kitesurfing, wingfoiling, and windsurfing. The WOO 4.0 device mounts to a board and measures jump height, airtime, G-force, and landing impact, syncing sessions through the WOO Sports mobile apps (iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, and Garmin) to a global community platform with leaderboards, spots, activity feeds, and events. More than 100,000 riders use WOO to track sessions and compete, including on the GKA Kite World Tour. WOO Sports is a Techstars-backed brand operated under Boards & More. This profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; no public developer API was found (docs.woosports.com is a consumer user guide, not an API reference).

providers.name: YQN
providers.description: YQN is a global digital logistics platform and NVOCC / digital freight forwarder founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. It lets shippers compare rates, book, and manage international sea freight, air freight, and rail freight, multimodal transport, trucking, customs clearance, cargo insurance, and overseas warehousing online. YQN operates 25+ global branches across North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East with 1,500+ employees, 300+ shipping and airline partners, and 3,500+ supplier resources. It integrates directly with carriers such as Lufthansa Cargo via carrier APIs for rate-checking, allotment booking, and digital bill-of-lading generation. YQN holds FIATA, IATA, and NVOCC certifications, but publishes no public developer API portal or documentation.

providers.name: ZOE
providers.description: ZOE (joinzoe.com, canonically zoe.com) is a personalized nutrition and health science company founded on data from one of the largest nutrition research studies in the world. Its membership program pairs at-home testing (gut health, blood sugar, and blood fat responses) with an AI-powered app that scores meals, tracks personal food responses, and delivers science-backed dietary guidance. ZOE also sells consumer products including the Daily30+ whole-food supplement and Gut Health products, and publishes the ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer health brand rather than an API provider, and is tracked here as a Balderton Capital portfolio company; it currently exposes no public developer platform, API, or developer portal.

providers.name: Zynga
providers.description: Zynga is a mobile and social game developer and publisher, founded in 2007 in San Francisco and a wholly owned subsidiary of Take-Two Interactive since May 2022. It operates a portfolio of free-to-play franchises including FarmVille, Zynga Poker, Words With Friends, CSR Racing, Empires & Puzzles, Toon Blast, Merge Dragons, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Top Eleven and Golf Rival, built across studios such as NaturalMotion, Peak, Rollic, Socialpoint, Small Giant Games, Gram Games, Nordeus and StarLark. Zynga publishes a corporate website, an engineering blog, a player support center and a responsible disclosure program, but as of September 2026 it operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no API reference, and no machine-readable contract on any Zynga-controlled host. The third-party "Zynga API" announced at Zynga Unleashed in 2011-2012 was retired with the zynga.com third-party publishing platform, and developers.zynga.com no longer resolves.

providers.name: 3PAR (HPE 3PAR StoreServ)
providers.description: 3PAR is an enterprise storage platform, now part of Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE acquired 3PAR in 2010), that powers mission-critical applications with HPE 3PAR StoreServ and Primera arrays. For developers and automation engineers, 3PAR exposes the HPE 3PAR Web Services API (WSAPI) — a REST interface that manages storage provisioning, virtual volumes, hosts, ports, CPGs, snapshots, and remote copy on 3PAR/Primera/Alletra arrays, offering a more flexible and programmable alternative to the 3PAR Command Line Interface. HPE publishes first-party client libraries (Python, Ruby, PowerShell) plus Ansible, Puppet, Chef, OpenStack Cinder, and Docker volume integrations against WSAPI. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead (Mayfield, Menlo Ventures backed the original 3PAR before its IPO and HP acquisition) and enriched from HPE's public developer surface.

providers.name: A-to-Mind
providers.description: Verse by A-to-Mind is an AI‑powered personal assistant platform that lets users ask for anything and get instant results – from clocks and notes to maps, weather, translations, calculations, or detailed pages on any topic. It operates without requiring an account, offering a seamless, on‑demand knowledge and productivity service.

providers.name: Aeon Life
providers.description: Aeon Life Insurance Company, Ltd. (百年人寿保险股份有限公司, "AEON LIFE") is a Chinese life insurer headquartered in Dalian, Liaoning, established on 1 June 2009 with registered capital of RMB 7.9048 billion. Its licensed scope covers life, health and personal accident insurance and other personal-insurance lines, reinsurance of those lines, and regulated insurance-fund investment business, sold across twenty provinces and municipalities including Dalian, Liaoning, Beijing, Hubei, Hebei, Henan, Jiangsu, Shandong, Sichuan, Guangdong, Zhejiang and Chongqing. Its public web presence is a Chinese-language corporate site with an online insurance mall, claims and policy-service sections, and the information-disclosure pages Chinese insurance regulation requires. The company publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract; its group flexible-benefits platform (o2o.aeonlife.com.cn) and e-insurance customer portal both sit behind logins.

providers.name: agentlookups-ai
providers.description: agentlookups.ai provides a suite of public‑record lookup tools for consumers and agents, offering APIs for contractor license verification, drug price transparency, environmental record access, and property‑assessment fairness. The platform hosts six services—license, drug price, environmental, property, food, and water—each exposed via a simple, unauthenticated MCP (Machine‑Connect‑Protocol) endpoint that returns JSON. Documentation is available at /docs/, with privacy and terms pages. The service is operated by TopHat Monkey Software LLC and aims to champion open data for everyday decisions.

providers.name: AgentSQL
providers.description: AgentSQL（中文名：智盾）是面向 AI Agent 的数据库安全网关与 MCP Server。模型发出的 PostgreSQL / MySQL 请求在到达数据库前，经过身份认证、SQL 解析、静态与动态风险检查、四态决策与受控执行；结果按配置脱敏，并在应用层留下持久审计。AgentSQL 自有问数、图表、仪表板和嵌入应用页面，模型生成的 SQL 继续经过数据库安全网关。已有 SQLBot 部署也可接入 AgentSQL 做数据库访问控制；完整社区版功能、全部页面和现有系统零改动替换仍待逐项验收。

providers.name: AISO Tools
providers.description: AISO Tools is a curated directory of AI tools across 27 categories, helping users discover, compare, and evaluate the best AI solutions for tasks ranging from writing and coding to image generation and analytics. The platform offers free audits, pricing information, and a marketplace for tool providers, aiming to streamline AI tool selection for individuals and businesses.

providers.name: Amulet
providers.description: Amulet is an agentic AI platform for post-sales and customer success teams, backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026). It connects to a company's existing stack — CRM, support desk, product analytics, calls, and email — reads every ticket, call, and usage trend across the entire book of business, and puts AI agents to work monitoring account health and surfacing risk, renewal, expansion, and adoption signals with the supporting evidence attached. Teams can ask natural-language questions about any account (in-app or from Slack), deploy scheduled agents from templates for renewals, onboarding, and QBRs, and audit every agent run, with anything customer-facing held for human approval. As of this profile Amulet does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures the company's public web surface (product, pricing, legal) as a network stub.

providers.name: Appviewx
providers.description: AppViewX provides machine and AI agent identity security solutions, offering certificate lifecycle management, PKI modernization, post‑quantum cryptography readiness, and comprehensive compliance tools for enterprises. Their platform automates identity governance, secure code signing, and IoT device security, helping organizations manage digital certificates and keys at scale.

providers.name: Arbor
providers.description: Arbor is a consumer energy savings service operating in deregulated electricity markets across 13 states in the U.S. Northeast, Midwest, and Texas. The Arbor app analyzes a household's current electricity supply rate, matches the customer with vetted alternative suppliers, and automatically switches them to a lower-cost plan when one becomes available, all without changing the utility provider, interrupting service, or charging the customer. Arbor earns revenue through referral fees from energy suppliers rather than from consumers. Founded in 2022 by Andrew Meyer (previously co-founder of Swell Energy), Arbor is backed by First Round Capital, Obvious Ventures, Spring Tide Capital, and Blisce. Arbor is a consumer-facing application and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: AstroLab
providers.description: Astrolab designs, builds, and operates planetary surface mobility platforms and infrastructure for sustained human and commercial activities on the Moon and Mars. Their flagship rovers, FLIP and FLEX, aim to deliver payloads, power, and logistics support for lunar missions, with upcoming launches scheduled for 2026 and beyond.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Brandcompete
providers.description: Brandcompete provides competitive intelligence tools that help businesses monitor and analyze brand performance across various digital channels. The platform aggregates data from social media, search trends, and market research to deliver actionable insights, enabling companies to benchmark against competitors, track sentiment, and identify emerging opportunities. With customizable dashboards and reporting features, Brandcompete supports strategic decision‑making for marketing, product development, and executive leadership.

providers.name: Branddu
providers.description: Branddu (Branddu Colombia / Branddu AI) is a B2B MerchTech platform that digitizes corporate merchandising and promotional-product procurement across Latin America. Operating in Colombia and Mexico, it centralizes the full purchasing workflow - product discovery, inventory, quotations, customization, online design, and checkout - through a single online catalog of more than 15,000 fully customizable products across 46+ categories. Branddu AI (formed via a merger with Reno) combines AI, proprietary software, and a regional supplier network to simplify how companies source branded merchandise. The public storefront runs on Shopify. The company is backed by a US$300K pre-seed from 500 Global, bringing total capital raised to roughly US$800K.

providers.name: Bureau
providers.description: Bureau provides AI‑powered real‑time fraud prevention and identity decisioning platform. It unifies risk data across the customer lifecycle, offering KYC, KYB, AML compliance, credit underwriting, and fraud detection for fintech, e‑commerce, and other digital businesses. The service combines device, behavior, identity, network, and transaction signals to deliver instant decisions across onboarding, authentication, and payments.

providers.name: Capim
providers.description: Capim is a Sao Paulo-based vertical SaaS and fintech company for the dental sector in Brazil, founded in 2021 by Marcelo Lutz and Roberto Biselli. Its platform pairs dental-clinic management software - appointment scheduling (Agenda Capim), digital patient records, and AI-driven patient reactivation - with embedded financial products: buy-now-pay-later patient financing (Financiamento Capim, up to 36 installments), direct-credit collections (Carne Capim), and an integrated card/PIX payment terminal (Maquininha Capim). Capim serves more than 6,000 dental clinics, has issued over R$450 million in credit, and raised a US$26.7M Series A co-led by Valor Capital and QED Investors. No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Carma
providers.description: Carma is an Australian online used-car retailer that lets consumers buy, sell, and trade in pre-owned vehicles entirely online. Every car is inspected and reconditioned, and the platform bundles financing through partner lenders, home delivery, trade-in valuations, a 7-day money-back guarantee, a 3-month warranty, and NRMA roadside assistance as an alternative to the traditional dealership experience. Backed by General Catalyst since 2022, Carma is headquartered in Sydney, Australia. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and enriched from Carma's public web surface; Carma publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Cavendo AI
providers.description: Cavendo AI provides a human‑led AI platform for teams and agencies, enabling them to set up, run, and review AI‑driven workflows across tasks such as monthly reports, content creation, site audits, client updates, proposals, development tasks, support replies, and lead follow‑up. The service integrates with popular models like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, and connects to tools like email, Slack, WordPress, and CRMs, ensuring human oversight before any output is delivered. Pricing starts at $299/mo for teams, with higher tiers for agencies and custom enterprise solutions.

providers.name: Circle Medical
providers.description: Circle Medical is a San Francisco-based online and in-person primary care clinic offering telemedicine and clinic-based visits with same and next-day availability. Founded through Y Combinator, the company operates 20+ physical locations and provides virtual appointments across multiple US states through Circle Medical Care of California, an independent medical practice. Its 400+ board-certified physicians, physician assistants, and nurse practitioners treat primary care, mental health (ADHD, anxiety, depression), hormone and sexual health, urgent care, weight loss (GLP-1s), sleep, and dermatology. Circle Medical is a HIPAA-covered, patient-facing digital health provider; it publishes no public developer API or SDK program, and this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CLAAS
providers.description: CLAAS is a German manufacturer of agricultural machinery, producing a wide range of tractors, combine harvesters, forage harvesters, balers, and other equipment for modern farming. The company focuses on innovative technology, precision farming solutions, and global service networks to support farmers worldwide.

providers.name: Clerkie
providers.description: Clerkie, operated by Henry Labs Inc. and founded in San Francisco in 2016, is an AI-powered debt management and loan-recovery platform serving both consumers and institutional lenders. The consumer side offers a conversational financial assistant for budgeting, debt negotiation, and personalized repayment planning, while the B2B side — marketed as Fiber, launched in 2021 and now sold on its own domain getfiber.ai — gives lenders, banks, credit unions, and collection agencies an AI-driven recovery suite spanning CRM, an inventory management system (IMS), an AI agent, omnichannel communications, borrower scoring, a self-service payment portal, and workflow automation. Clerkie markets a RESTful API and multi-currency payment processing for lenders to integrate loan portfolios, real-time reporting, and automated repayment arrangements, but publishes no public developer documentation, machine-readable API contract, or self-serve developer portal — integration is arranged through a sales conversation. The company has raised over $41M from Left Lane Capital, Flourish Ventures, Vestigo Ventures, and Citibank.

providers.name: Corgi
providers.description: Corgi is an AI-native, full-stack business insurance platform for startups, offering modular coverage (Commercial General Liability, Directors & Officers, Tech Errors & Omissions, Cyber, EPLI, and fiduciary) quoted in minutes. Founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco, Corgi is a licensed insurance carrier rather than a broker, underwriting and issuing policies directly with pricing tailored to a startup's stage (pre-seed, Series A, growth). Backed by Kindred Ventures and TCV, the company was reported as an AI insurance unicorn in 2026. This API Evangelist profile was seeded from Kindred Ventures' portfolio; Corgi does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: dartmonitor-dev
providers.description: DartMonitor provides a web interface, MCP server, and Python CLI for checking outdated Flutter and Dart dependencies in a pubspec.yaml file. It lists newer package versions, shows changelog entries between the used and latest versions, and can send email digests and alerts for breaking changes, security fixes, or deprecations. The service also offers an MCP endpoint that AI agents such as Claude Code can query, and the CLI can be used in CI pipelines with an exit code indicating available updates.

providers.name: Defense Intelligence Agency
providers.description: The Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) is the U.S. Department of Defense combat support agency that produces, analyzes, and disseminates military intelligence on foreign militaries and operating environments to support warfighters, defense planners, and national-security policymakers. As an intelligence agency, DIA does not publish a general-purpose public API; its developer-facing surface is largely internal or restricted to the Intelligence Community. Public touchpoints include the GAMECHANGER policy analytics initiative, the DIA FOIA reading room, public news and article feeds, and procurement and recruiting portals.

providers.name: Dentrix
providers.description: Dentrix is a dental practice management platform from Henry Schein One, used by dental offices to manage patients, scheduling, clinical charting, treatment planning, insurance, and billing. Dentrix exposes third-party integration APIs through two distinct channels. The original Dentrix Developer Program (DDP, launched 2012) targets the on-premise Dentrix desktop application: integrations run locally against the office's Dentrix database over password-protected ODBC connections, stored procedures, table views, and DLL functions (authenticated via a RegisterUser call) - it is NOT a public REST/cloud API, and cloud integrations require a locally installed desktop agent. The newer Dentrix Ascend API Exchange (launched July 2023) is a cloud, REST/JSON API over HTTPS secured with OAuth 2.0 on the SOC 2 Type II Dentrix Ascend platform, exposing patient, scheduling, claims, and inventory data. Both channels are partner-gated: access requires an application, a signed agreement, and paid developer fees. There is no public self-serve API key or published OpenAPI, so the APIs below are modeled from Henry Schein One's public developer materials rather than an official machine-readable specification.

providers.name: DiscoverSeniorBenefits
