providers.description: DiscoverSeniorBenefits provides an AI‑assisted, source‑cited eligibility checker that helps seniors and caregivers discover federal, state, and county benefit programs they may qualify for. The service is free, requires no Social Security number, and aggregates information from .gov pages to present personalized benefit options in about five minutes.

providers.name: Droid
providers.description: Droid provides a structured reference platform for commercially available robots. It aggregates specifications, source documents, and manufacturer data, offering searchable, comparable units for each robot model. The site presents detailed provenance for every figure, enabling engineers, researchers, and hobbyists to verify and explore robot specifications across the industry.

providers.name: EnerZam
providers.description: EnerZam, a division of UctriX inc., delivers WebSynco, a modern, customizable, modular, cloud‑based Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). Leveraging over 20 years of experience, the platform helps organizations improve asset performance through flexible, reliable, and secure software. WebSynco is ISO‑27001 certified, supports multiple languages, and offers mobile apps for iOS and Android, positioning it as a next‑generation solution for asset management and maintenance.

providers.name: Ensembl
providers.description: Ensembl is a genome annotation database and browser maintained by the European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI) and the Wellcome Sanger Institute. It provides comprehensive genome data for vertebrates and other eukaryotic organisms, covering gene annotation, variant data, regulatory features, comparative genomics, and evolutionary analysis across hundreds of species. The Ensembl REST API offers language-agnostic HTTP access to this genome data without requiring local database installations or Perl API dependencies.

providers.name: Fluid
providers.description: A responsive front-end framework for building flexible and adaptive web layouts.

providers.name: Fuse
providers.description: Fuse Energy is a UK retail energy supplier providing gas and electricity to homes and businesses, alongside EV charging, solar and battery storage tracking with grid export, and smart home energy management. The company emphasises savings against the UK price cap, a fast (~3 minute) online sign-up, automated supplier switching, and 24/7 customer support including an AI assistant called "Plugs". Fuse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a consumer/business energy web and mobile experience and does not publish a public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Galileo
providers.description: Galileo (galileo.io, formerly reached at galileohealth.com) is a value-based, digitally enabled healthcare delivery company founded by Tom X. Lee (previously Epocrates and One Medical). It delivers 24/7 primary and multi-specialty care through a mobile app, in-home visits, mobile clinics, and virtual care, combining a proprietary clinical technology platform, a recruited network of primary-care and specialist clinicians, and hospitality-style member support. Galileo operates a fully bilingual (English/Spanish) platform and serves individuals and families, employers, small businesses, and health plans through membership and population- health partnerships. It is a care-delivery business, not an API platform: as of this profile Galileo publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: GeekWire
providers.description: GeekWire is a leading technology news site covering startups, innovation, and the Pacific Northwest tech scene. Founded in Seattle, GeekWire delivers breaking news, analysis, and commentary on technology, business, and entrepreneurship, with a particular focus on companies like Amazon, Microsoft, and the broader Seattle and Pacific Northwest startup ecosystem. GeekWire also operates GeekWork, a technology job board, and produces popular podcasts and weekly radio programming.

providers.name: getbotlens-com
providers.description: BotLens identifies every visitor — human, bot, AI agent, or threat. See what’s polluting your funnel. Expose what’s slipping past your security. Know which AI shopping agents belong and which ones don’t. Insights for your next move. Your Analytics Has a Bot Problem. We Fixed It.

providers.name: Good Dog
providers.description: Good Dog is a marketplace that connects people looking for a dog with a vetted national network of ethical breeders, animal shelters, and rescues. The platform screens every source against standards developed with veterinary experts, requires all payments to be processed securely on-platform to protect both buyers and sellers, and supports new owners with a Learning Center, lifetime access to Care Specialists, puppy training resources, and pet insurance options. Over 250,000 families have found their dog through Good Dog. It is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this profile no public developer API, SDK, or integration program is published. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ideal Invest
providers.description: Ideal Invest (operating as Pravaler) is a Brazilian fintech founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sao Paulo that provides private student financing for higher education. Through its Pravaler platform, students can split tuition payments across roughly twice the duration of a course, with a 100% digital, low-bureaucracy application, competitive monthly interest rates, and no ENEM requirement. Pravaler works with a network of 500+ partner higher-education institutions and has financed more than 400,000 students, channeling over R$12 billion into Brazilian education. The company is backed by Ribbit Capital. As of this enrichment pass Pravaler exposes a consumer web platform (simulation, application, digital signature) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Internxt
providers.description: Internxt provides encrypted cloud storage and a suite of privacy‑focused services including Drive, Antivirus, VPN, Cleaner, Mail and Send. Based in Europe, it offers zero‑knowledge encryption, open‑source audits and a commitment to sustainability, targeting individuals and enterprises seeking secure, private data storage.

providers.name: Invesdor
providers.description: Invesdor is a pan-European crowdinvesting and digital investment platform that connects private and professional investors with companies raising capital through equity, subordinated loans, and bonds, with minimum tickets starting around EUR 250. Founded in Finland in 2012 and expanded through mergers with Finnest, Kapilendo, and Oneplanetcrowd, Invesdor now serves more than 180,000 investors across Europe and has channeled over EUR 600 million into more than 1,000 renewable-energy, scale-up, and SME financing rounds. It operates as a regulated investment firm under the EU Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP) regime. Invesdor does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, investor, and legal surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lato
providers.description: Lato (LATO Labs) is a San Francisco company building an agent-native research and simulation platform for investors. Its agents source and conduct hundreds of voice interviews with verified domain experts and customers in any language, each returned with a recording, transcript and thematic analysis, then combine those interviews with thousands of documents from public sources and a fund's own proprietary knowledge into a single commercial study. The study becomes a live simulation of the market that analysts can question and run scenarios against to predict where a market is headed. Investors use Lato for commercial due diligence, expert interviews, market sizing, competitive mapping, customer interviews, pricing studies, deal sourcing, inbound screening and portfolio value creation, compressing research that traditionally costs hundreds of thousands of dollars and takes weeks into hours. The product integrates with the tools investment teams already run on, including Outlook, SharePoint, Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, Teams, Excel, Affinity, Attio, Harmonic and Granola. Lato was founded by Tymek Staniszewski (CEO) and Tien Chu (CTO), is backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026), and builds on Anthropic, OpenAI and ElevenLabs. As of this profile Lato publishes no public developer API, documentation or SDKs; the company surface is captured here for discovery and the repository will be re-enriched when a developer program appears.

providers.name: Leland
providers.description: Leland is a marketplace for ambitious people to access the coaching, classes, and community they need to reach career and educational goals. It connects individuals with vetted 1-on-1 coaches across MBA and college admissions, management consulting, investment banking, private equity, product management, law, medicine, and executive and career development, and sells structured live programs, bootcamps, and test prep for the GMAT, GRE, LSAT, MCAT, SAT, and ACT. Leland+ is a subscription content library of video guides, essay and resume examples, templates, and expert-built AI tools. For organizations Leland offers AI-native talent training, agentic workflow deployment, recruiting, and outplacement, plus university and HR partnerships. Leland publishes no public API or developer portal as of 2026-07-19.

providers.name: Lovepop
providers.description: Lovepop is a Boston-based consumer greeting-card and gifting company, founded in 2014 and known for its intricate laser-cut 3D pop-up cards inspired by Vietnamese "kirigami" paper engineering. The company sells directly to consumers through its Shopify-powered storefront at lovepop.com and through retail partners, offering pop-up greeting cards, gift boxes, flowers, and personalized gifting. Lovepop was accelerated by Techstars and appeared on ABC's Shark Tank. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this pass Lovepop publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer portal, and its public digital surface is a standard Shopify commerce storefront (including Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth well-known documents served on the domain).

providers.name: M7 Health
providers.description: M7 Health is an AI-powered workforce operations platform for healthcare, focused on nurse scheduling and labor optimization. The platform forecasts staffing demand, auto-balances schedules, fills open shifts, and deploys staff to close coverage gaps while reducing premium labor spend, administrative burden, and nurse turnover across hospitals and health systems. Surfaced as a portfolio company of threshold-ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer or API surface was found — the product is delivered as an enterprise SaaS engaged via a sales demo.

providers.name: maindex-io
providers.description: Maindex provides a memory graph platform designed for both AI agents and human teams. It captures, stores, and organizes facts, code snippets, and contextual information in a structured, searchable graph. The service emphasizes provenance, accountability, and collaborative editing, allowing agents to read from and write to shared memory while humans can trust the source and history of each fact. Maindex aims to improve productivity and knowledge sharing across development teams and AI-powered workflows, offering APIs for integration and a web interface for exploration.

providers.name: Mimo
providers.description: Mimo (short for "Money In, Money Out") is a London- and Stockholm-based B2B fintech that gives small and medium-sized businesses a single platform to manage, understand and control their cash flow. Founded in 2023, Mimo bundles supplier payments, invoice collection, multi-currency accounts, access to working capital and automated bookkeeping, and has grown to offer an AI "Associate" that automates recurring accounting workflows such as financial close, bank reconciliation, accounts payable and payroll for finance teams and accounting firms. Mimo integrates with accounting tools such as Xero. It is backed by Northzone, Seedcamp, Cocoa Ventures, Project A and others, and has secured a $125M+ embedded-funding partnership with Froda. This profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network; Mimo currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Minu
providers.description: Minu is Mexico's leading employee benefits and financial wellness platform, serving more than 2,000 companies and over 1 million workers. Its flagship product is Salary On-Demand (earned wage access), which lets employees withdraw wages they have already earned before payday, alongside a high-yield savings account, low-interest payroll loans, food and gas vouchers (vales de despensa y gasolina), a rewards card, a corporate expense card, telemedicine, insurance and assistance coverage, a discount club, and a financial-education program. Employers adopt Minu to reduce talent turnover and improve workforce financial wellness. Minu is a QED Investors portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Minu publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: MYR
providers.description: MYR (formerly Koomi) is a cloud-based point-of-sale (POS) platform built for quick-service restaurants (QSRs) across North America, serving 1,500+ locations including coffee shops, food trucks, burger joints, pizzerias, sushi shops and bubble tea shops. The all-in-one system handles order processing across in-store, online-ordering and delivery channels, inventory management, digital loyalty programs, real-time reporting and hardware (iPads, payment terminals, receipt printers). MYR ships pre-built integrations with delivery marketplaces (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub, Skip, Ritual), accounting (QuickBooks Online, Wave, Sage, Acumatica), scheduling (7shifts), inventory (WISK) and loyalty/gift-card platforms (DataCandy). It does not publish a public developer program or API at this time; the merchant back office runs at admin.koomi.com.

providers.name: Newton Research
providers.description: Newton Research builds a team of specially trained AI agents for marketing analytics. Pre-built or custom agents connect to a customer's existing data infrastructure, write and execute code, and automate analytics workflows — data exploration and preparation, audience management, Customer 360, planning and activation, cross-channel measurement and attribution, anomaly detection, yield management, and automated reporting — with data remaining on the customer's own instance. Founded by John Hoctor, Matthew Emans, and Steven Bennett, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program. Newton states SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA compliance. No public developer API surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Nitra
providers.description: Nitra is an integrated financial and operational platform — an "operating system" — for independent medical practices, unifying business banking, spend management, payments, accounting, capital, and front-desk automation in one system. Its core products include the Nitra Card (a Visa business card with cashback and vendor pricing), NitraMart (a medical-supplies marketplace), BillPay payment processing, accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Nextech), Trina (an AI assistant for phone reception and invoice matching), and capital products such as lending, equipment financing, and insurance factoring. Nitra primarily serves eye care, aesthetics, dental specialty, and fertility practices as well as multi-site groups. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA-aware, holds funds at FDIC-insured banks, and is backed by a16z and Pantera Capital. Nitra publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Om1
providers.description: OM1 is an AI-powered healthcare analytics and real-world data company that generates real-world evidence from clinical, EMR, and claims data. Its PhenOM foundation model is trained on billions of patient-years to identify patient phenotypes, accelerate diagnosis, and predict future medical events, risks, and responses to treatment. OM1 delivers clinical registries, automated observational studies, patient-finding and outcomes-prediction solutions, and curated real-world datasets covering hundreds of millions of patients to life sciences, biopharma, payer, and provider organizations. OM1 does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation surface.

providers.name: Partsimony
providers.description: Partsimony is an intelligent supply chain platform that helps hardware companies turn engineering designs into manufactured products with less time, cost, and friction. Its software analyzes component designs to recommend manufacturing methods, materials, price estimates, and lead times, then matches each part to the optimal manufacturers inside and outside a company's network — batching components for volume leverage across processes like 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, castings, electronics, and assemblies. The platform also coordinates RFPs, proposals, orders, messaging, and payment terms between OEMs and their manufacturing partners. Partsimony operates a web application and product documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and based in Brooklyn, NY; backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Perch
providers.description: Perch is a computer-vision weight-room performance monitoring system that captures athlete movement — velocity-based training, jump testing, and strength programming — from 3D cameras mounted on the rack, without wearables or tethers. Spun out of MIT and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Techstars, Perch was acquired by sports-technology company Catapult; the perch.fit domain now 301-redirects to catapult.com/perch, where the product is sold and supported as part of Catapult's athlete-monitoring suite. Perch exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification — this profile is retained as an identity record for the acquired brand.

providers.name: Property Capsule
providers.description: Property Capsule (PropertyCapsule) is a retail and commercial real estate marketing automation and prospecting platform for landlords and brokers. It centralizes property, tenant, and availability data in one place and automatically publishes it as flyers, tourbooks, interactive site plans, aerials, demographics, and competition maps across web and iPad leasing apps. Founded around 2014, the company was acquired by VTS in October 2019 and its capabilities were folded into the VTS Market product. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of trinity-ventures.

providers.name: PureSpectrum
providers.description: PureSpectrum provides a self‑service research platform delivering high‑quality survey respondents across 125+ countries. Their AI‑driven PureScore™ system ensures data quality, while offering API automation and managed services for market research agencies, corporate insights teams, consulting firms, and enterprises.

providers.name: Quizlet
providers.description: Quizlet is a San Francisco-based global learning platform offering flashcards, practice tests, and AI-powered study tools used by students, teachers, and lifelong learners. Core features include user-created and expert-verified study sets, Learn mode (adaptive practice), Test mode, Match game, Spaced Repetition, and an AI tutor (Q-Chat / Magic Notes) that generates flashcards, summaries, practice questions, and explanations from uploaded notes, PDFs, slides, and textbooks. Quizlet Plus is the company's consumer subscription, and Quizlet for Schools / Teachers provides licensed offerings for classrooms. The platform integrates with Google Classroom (share-as-assignment) and Canvas (embeddable widgets) but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK — the legacy Developer API 2.0 (`quizlet.com/api/2.0`) was effectively wound down to partners-only and is not openly registrable. Quizlet's GitHub organization (`github.com/quizlet`) hosts internal tooling, GitHub Actions, and forks of OSS dependencies (HHVM/Hack, PHPUnit, Mockery, Stylus, etc.) rather than a developer-facing API platform.

providers.name: RMIT University
providers.description: RMIT University is a public research university in Melbourne, Australia, specializing in technology, design and enterprise, and ranked #123 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. RMIT does not operate a centralized, publicly documented developer portal. Its most accessible programmatic surface is its research output: the RMIT Research Repository runs on Clarivate's Esploro platform, and RMIT's research data is published via a Figshare-hosted repository whose records are exposed through the public Figshare REST API (api.figshare.com) and syndicated to Research Data Australia. Student-facing systems such as timetables, the curriculum catalogue, and identity/SSO sit behind authentication and are not offered as public APIs.

providers.name: Roadrunner
providers.description: Roadrunner provides an AI-native CPQ platform that enables users to create, configure, and approve quotes using natural language prompts. The solution automates pricing rules, licensing models, and approval workflows, integrating with existing tech stacks and CRMs. Backed by Founders Fund and Kleiner Perkins, Roadrunner aims to simplify complex quoting processes for sales, finance, and RevOps teams.

providers.name: Ruby Receptionists
providers.description: Ruby Receptionists offers 24/7 live virtual receptionist support and live chat services for small businesses, ensuring every call is answered by a trained human, not a bot. Their solutions capture leads, schedule appointments, and integrate with existing tools across industries such as legal, home services, and financial services. With customizable coverage, businesses can choose full call handling or backup support, improving customer engagement and reducing missed opportunities.

providers.name: Runwise
providers.description: Runwise provides wireless smart-control systems that automate heating, cooling, water, and gas infrastructure in multifamily and commercial buildings. Its retrofit hardware and cloud platform replace legacy boiler, steam, and HVAC controls, cutting heating, cooling, and water bills by roughly 23% with same-day installation. Runwise reports more than 10,300 buildings under management and over $175 million in cumulative utility savings for customers. The company is backed by Fifth Wall, Initialized Capital, and Menlo Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks Runwise's public web presence; as of this pass no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface has been identified.

providers.name: SafelyYou
providers.description: SafelyYou is an ambient-AI platform for senior living communities that reduces falls, reveals resident risk, and surfaces operational and staffing insights without requiring residents to wear devices. Its computer-vision system detects and reviews fall incidents, and the broader product suite spans Safety AI for fall detection, Staffing AI for labor allocation and care tracking, Wellness AI for resident well-being, the Halo next-generation eCall system, and Guardian hardware sensors. SafelyYou reports serving over 1,000 communities and 50,000 residents, with outcomes including roughly 45% fall reduction and longer length of stay. The company integrates with senior-living EHR and eCall systems (Yardi, ALIS, PointClickCare and others) and offers SSO, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Salient
providers.description: Salient (Skwid Inc.) is an AI-native loan servicing and collections platform for consumer lenders — banks, credit unions, captive lenders, and specialty finance companies. It builds compliance-first AI voice and chat agents that automate servicing, collections, audit, insurance claims, chargebacks, and chargeoff workflows with native FDCPA, TCPA, and CFPB compliance. Its named agent products include Taylor (omnichannel servicing and collections), Marshall (automated audit), Flyn (total-loss insurance claims), Alex (chargebacks and disputes), and Melanie (chargeoffs). Founded in 2023 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Matrix Partners, and Y Combinator, Salient exposes a partner integration and onboarding API behind an authenticated developer portal. This profile was enriched from public web surfaces; the API reference is gated behind login so no public machine-readable specification was harvested.

providers.name: Serena & Lily
providers.description: Serena & Lily is a California home furnishings and lifestyle brand founded in 2003 in Sausalito by textile designer Serena Dugan and entrepreneur Lily Kanter. It sells furniture, custom upholstery, bedding, rugs, lighting, wallpaper, art and home decor direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, a printed catalog, and a network of physical Design Shops, alongside a Designer Circle trade program for interior designers. The storefront runs on a headless, composable commerce stack — Elastic Path for commerce and Amplience for content, served from a Vercel-hosted front end in front of AWS AppSync and Amazon API Gateway — but Serena & Lily publishes no developer program, no public API documentation, and no machine-readable specification of any kind. The GraphQL endpoint backing the storefront answers anonymous requests with introspection disabled, and the api.serenaandlily.com gateway rejects every unauthenticated path.

providers.name: ShuttleAI
providers.description: ShuttleAI is an artificial intelligence company advancing the systems and ideas that shape what comes next. It builds AI infrastructure, developer tools, and intelligent products that make advanced models easier to access, integrate, and use, helping developers and enterprises accelerate AI adoption.

providers.name: SKUSafe
providers.description: SKUSafe provides AI‑native product lifecycle management (PLM) software tailored for the food, beverage, and supplement industries. The platform unifies specifications, formulations, labeling, approvals, and audit trails in a single system, enabling R&D, quality, and supply‑chain teams to collaborate efficiently. Features include digital sign‑off, multi‑geo label generation, lot traceability, purchase‑order management, and automated compliance reporting. SKUSafe helps companies accelerate product development while maintaining regulatory compliance and improving supply‑chain visibility.

providers.name: Sprague Resources
providers.description: Sprague Resources (operating as Sprague Energy) is one of the largest independent suppliers of energy products and related services in the northeastern United States and Quebec, founded in 1870. The company distributes refined fuel products (heating oil, diesel, gasoline, kerosene, biofuels), natural gas, and electricity to commercial and industrial customers, and operates 20+ port terminal facilities for materials handling. Sprague was acquired by Hartree Partners in 2024 and continues to expand through strategic acquisitions. While Sprague does not publish a public developer API, the company operates SpraguePORT, a digital customer portal for account management, pricing, and order history, and Sprague Real-time for market pricing.

providers.name: Suite
providers.description: Suite Studios provides cloud storage and file streaming solutions for creative teams, offering S3‑native streaming, fast file sharing, and enterprise‑grade security. Their platform enables seamless collaboration on large media projects, with features like shared cache, transactional writes, and scalable storage across the cloud.

providers.name: Taptap Send
providers.description: Taptap Send is a mobile money-transfer (remittance) application that lets people send money from Europe, the UK, the US, and Canada to family and businesses across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. The service supports bank deposits, mobile-money wallets, and cash pickups in 100+ receiving countries with competitive exchange rates and low fees, and operates as a licensed and regulated money transmitter (FCA regulated, SOC 2 and PCI DSS attested) with bank-level encryption. Taptap Send is a consumer-facing app and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its company identity, security posture, and compliance program.

providers.name: The House Of LR&C
providers.description: The House of LR&C (Love, Respect & Care) is a Seattle-based, mission-driven direct-to-consumer fashion company founded in 2020 by Russell Wilson, Ciara, and retail veteran Christine Day. A Certified B Corporation, it operates a portfolio of apparel brands including Good Man Brand, LITA by Ciara, and Human Nation, donating 3% of net revenue to the Why Not You Foundation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its public commerce runs on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. The only machine-readable surface on the storefront host is Shopify's platform-level Customer Account API OIDC discovery document.

providers.name: Thyrocare
providers.description: Thyrocare Technologies Limited is an Indian chain of diagnostic and preventive-care laboratories headquartered in Navi Mumbai, founded in 1996. Built around a centralized, highly automated laboratory model, it focuses on affordable preventive health checkups, thyroid and pathology testing, and sells through a nationwide network of DSA (Direct Selling Agent) franchise partners. Norwest Venture Partners invested pre-IPO, and PharmEasy (API Holdings) acquired a majority stake in 2021. Its partner order-booking API (TechSo/BTS) is gated behind the DSA program and publishes no public OpenAPI.

providers.name: TREBEL Music
providers.description: TREBEL Music (operated by M&M Media, Inc.) is an advertising-sponsored, legally licensed music download and streaming service that lets people download and listen to music offline at no cost. Founded in 2014 by Gary Mekikian, Corey Jones and Luis Soto Durazo and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut with offices in Mexico City, Jakarta, Bogota, Los Angeles and Miami, TREBEL licenses catalog from Universal Music Group, Sony Music Entertainment, Warner Music Group and independent labels, and monetizes through digital advertising, branded experiences, virtual goods and a TREBEL Max tier rather than a conventional paid subscription. TREBEL is a consumer mobile product distributed through the Apple App Store, Google Play and Huawei AppGallery; it publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Typless
providers.description: Typless provides an AI‑powered Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platform that automates extraction of data from invoices, receipts, contracts and other documents. Leveraging machine learning, the service reads PDFs, images and scanned files to deliver structured line‑items, tables and key fields with high accuracy, integrating via a REST API into ERP and business applications. The platform offers continuous learning, plug‑and‑play integration, and a cloud‑based dashboard for workflow automation, targeting enterprises seeking to reduce manual data entry and improve operational efficiency.

providers.name: Universal Music Group
providers.description: Universal Music Group N.V. (UMG) is the world's largest music company, headquartered in Hilversum, Netherlands with operational headquarters in Santa Monica, California. Spun off from Vivendi and listed on Euronext Amsterdam (ticker: UMG) on September 21, 2021 at a EUR 54 billion valuation, UMG operates Recorded Music, Music Publishing (Universal Music Publishing Group / UMPG), and Merchandising (Bravado), plus film and television production (PolyGram Entertainment) and the artist services and catalog arm Universal Music Enterprises. The company is led by Chairman and CEO Sir Lucian Grainge. Major label families include Republic Corps (Republic, Island, Def Jam), Interscope Capitol Labels Group (Interscope, Geffen, A&M, Capitol, Blue Note, Motown), Virgin Music Group, Verve Label Group (Verve, Decca, Deutsche Grammophon, Impulse!, Philips), UMG Nashville (MCA Nashville, Mercury Nashville, EMI Records Nashville, Capitol Records Nashville), Universal Music Latin Entertainment, and Universal Music UK. Catalog scale exceeds 3 million recordings and 4 million compositions. Ownership is split among Bolloré / Vivendi (~28%), Tencent Music (~11%), Pershing Square (~10%), and the public float. UMG operates no public developer portal: catalog and metadata reach developers only indirectly through downstream DSPs (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music) and through partner / aggregator programs (7digital exposed UMG catalog under a partner API; that integration is the only third-party developer-facing surface that has ever been openly documented). Royalty and publishing portals (UMG Royalty Portal, UMPG Window) exist for songwriters and rights holders behind authentication, not as APIs. AI is the active integration vector in 2025-2026: UMG has announced licensed generative-music partnerships with Udio, Splice, KLAY Vision, SoundLabs, ProRata, BandLab, YouTube, TikTok, Meta, and KDDI, and has filed 15+ AI patents with Liquidax Capital across collaboration, rights management, music & health, and AI threat protection. These integrations operate through bilateral commercial agreements, not a self-serve developer program. The official Universal-Music-Group GitHub organization (created May 15, 2024) has 0 public repositories.

providers.name: Velexa
providers.description: Velexa provides WealthTech solutions for institutions serving next‑generation investors. The platform offers a fully customisable investing‑as‑a‑service model with access to all markets through a single integration. Velexa consolidates integration and support functions under its partner EXANTE, offering white‑label and API solutions to scale financial businesses. It aims to deliver seamless, end‑to‑end wealth management capabilities, supporting institutions in delivering modern investment experiences to their clients.

providers.name: Vera
providers.description: Vera was a data-centric security company delivering information rights management (IRM) as a service, letting businesses encrypt, track, audit, and revoke access to files anywhere they travel, with an SDK and REST API for embedding AES 256-bit encryption and policy enforcement into applications. Backed by Amplify Partners, Battery Ventures, and Sutter Hill Ventures, Vera was acquired by HelpSystems (now Fortra) in December 2020 and lives on as Fortra's Digital Guardian Secure Collaboration product; its developer surface (SDK/REST API) is now available to Fortra customers rather than as a public developer program.

providers.name: ViaLoop
providers.description: ViaLoop provides smart vehicle tracking and monitoring solutions through a pocket-sized OBD device and companion app. It offers real-time location, fuel intelligence, vehicle health monitoring, and safety alerts for individual drivers and fleet operators. The platform supports plug‑and‑play setup, live tracking, and analytics to improve fuel efficiency and fleet management.

providers.name: Voatz
providers.description: Voatz is a remote voting technology company providing secure, mobile-based voting for public elections and organizational governance. Voters cast ballots from a smartphone, tablet, or web browser, with identity assured through hardware-backed authentication and biometric verification, ballots anchored to a permissioned blockchain, and a voter-verifiable paper audit trail produced for every vote. The platform pairs the voter-facing mobile app with an administrative dashboard for election officials and supports accessibility features for voters with disabilities. Voatz has run elections across seven countries for more than five million voters, with pilots and deployments for U.S. counties (West Virginia, Utah County, Denver), political parties, and international election authorities. The company is a Techstars-backed startup. Voatz publishes no public developer API; its surface is a security, audit, and disclosure program rather than an integration platform.

providers.name: Zortec
providers.description: Zortec International provides enterprise software solutions focusing on data integration, application modernization, and digital transformation. Their platform offers tools for RAD development, legacy system modernization, and database independence, helping organizations streamline operations and accelerate innovation across various industries.

providers.name: 0nMCP
providers.description: The white-label AI engine behind the agency stack — an agency copilot, a US-based agency CRM and client portals on one connection to 1,630 tools across 97 services. White-label AI infrastructure for marketing agencies: an agency copilot, a US-based agency CRM, client portals, and consulting to finish stalled or half-built applications under the agency own brand.

providers.name: 8B
providers.description: 8B provides a free website builder that requires no sign‑up, allowing users to create real websites from a single sentence. The platform offers an easy‑to‑use interface, multilingual support, and a variety of themes, all hosted on a fast CDN. It targets individuals and small businesses seeking a quick online presence without the hassle of accounts or templates, emphasizing privacy and simplicity.

providers.name: Aarna AI
providers.description: Aarna AI operates the Tokenization Bridge for India's Capital Markets, building regulated on-chain infrastructure to tokenise Indian financial assets. Based in GIFT City, it offers permissioned digital tokens backed by Category II alternative investment funds, settled in USD or USDC, targeting accredited investors worldwide. The platform provides APIs for subscription, redemption, reporting, and compliance, leveraging ERC-3643 standards and ONCHAINID identity. It is approved in the IFSCA FinTech Sandbox (Stage 1) with Stage 2 under review, aiming for launch Q4 2026.

providers.name: AcoustID
providers.description: AcoustID is an open-source audio fingerprinting service providing a REST API for identifying music tracks by audio fingerprint and linking results to MusicBrainz metadata records. Built on the Chromaprint library, it offers a crowdsourced fingerprint database free for non-commercial use, with commercial plans available through AcoustID OÜ.

providers.name: Adalo
providers.description: Adalo is a visual no-code app builder that lets users design, build, and publish native iOS, Android, and web applications without writing code, combining a drag-and-drop canvas with AI-assisted generation and hosted Postgres-backed collections. The platform supports external data sources, pre-built feature templates, and 2,000+ integrations via Zapier and Make, hosting over a million apps. The Adalo API provides REST access to app collections and push notifications, secured with a per-app Bearer API key.

providers.name: AgentoolRank
providers.description: AgentoolRank is a directory that ranks open-source AI agent tools, MCP servers and frameworks by live GitHub and package-registry activity. It tracks over 600 tools, providing data-driven rankings, submission portals, and resources for developers building AI agents. The site offers blueprints, comparisons, weekly updates, and a marketplace for featured listings, helping users discover and evaluate AI agent tooling.

providers.name: Ajax
providers.description: Ajax is an AI-powered timekeeping platform built specifically for law firms. It automatically captures attorney work across applications, documents, emails, phone calls, and video meetings, then generates OCG-compliant, voice-matched time-entry narratives and syncs them with one click to practice-management and billing systems. Ajax integrates with SurePoint, Clio, MyCase, Filevine, PracticePanther, Centerbase, Actionstep, and Soluno, and positions itself around recovering otherwise-lost billable hours. The company is SOC 2 aligned, encrypts data in transit and at rest, does not train models on customer data, and enforces rolling data deletion. Ajax is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface — it is a product/SaaS company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Ameriprise Financial
providers.description: Get financial planning advice and retirement investment advice from Ameriprise financial advisors at ameriprise.com. Ameriprise Financial is a diversified financial services company offering comprehensive financial planning, wealth management, retirement planning, investment management, insurance, and annuities through a nationwide network of financial advisors.

providers.name: Atolio
providers.description: Atolio delivers an AI‑powered enterprise search platform that enables organizations to securely index and retrieve data across cloud and on‑premise sources. It offers self‑hosted deployment, sovereign data control, and integrations with tools like Atlassian, GitHub, Google Workspace, and Microsoft services, empowering teams in sales, support, engineering, and more to find critical information instantly.

providers.name: Beewise
providers.description: Beewise is an agricultural technology company building the BeeHome, an AI- and robotics-enabled beehive that autonomously monitors, cares for, and protects honeybee colonies to reduce colony loss and deliver reliable pollination. Founded to address bee colony collapse, Beewise combines computer vision, robotics, and cloud software to detect pests and disease, regulate hive climate, and dispatch precision pollination for growers. The company serves growers with guaranteed pollination services, beekeepers with technology-enhanced hive management, and property owners through its Bees for Buildings program. Beewise is a venture-backed company (Insight Partners portfolio) surfaced into the API Evangelist network; it operates a customer grower portal but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Bench IQ
providers.description: Bench IQ is a legal technology company building an AI-powered judicial intelligence platform that analyzes how individual judges reason and rule. Rather than limiting analysis to the roughly 3% of matters that produce written opinions, Bench IQ studies the reasoning behind all of a judge's rulings so litigators can anticipate decisions, craft stronger arguments, and shape case strategy. Founded by the team behind ROSS Intelligence — CEO Jimoh Ovbiagele and CTO Maxim Isakov — together with former Kirkland & Ellis restructuring partner Jeffrey Gettleman, the company says four of the top five AmLaw 100 firms rely on its analysis. It is backed by Battery Ventures, Inovia Capital, and Haystack, along with leading law firms including Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati, Fenwick & West, and Cooley.

providers.name: Bitstrips
providers.description: Bitstrips was a Toronto-based consumer software company, founded in 2007 by Jacob "Ba" Blackstock, that created the personalized comic platform Bitstrips and the personal-avatar app Bitmoji. Snap Inc. acquired Bitstrips in March 2016, retired the original Bitstrips comic product, and now operates the technology as Bitmoji. The public developer surface today is the Bitmoji Direct API (Bitmoji for Developers): an OAuth2 authorization-code-with-PKCE flow via www.bitmoji.com/connect that grants third-party apps access to a user's avatar ID, sticker packs, and sticker search, served from bitmoji.api.snapchat.com/direct. Note that Snap has deprecated the "Bitmoji For Identity" product; the standalone stickers and search integrations remain documented. This profile was surfaced as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company and enriched from the public Bitmoji developer documentation.

providers.name: Bolagsverket
providers.description: Bolagsverket is Sweden’s official register of companies, providing public access to corporate information, filings, and open data APIs. It enables businesses, authorities, and developers to retrieve and submit company data such as registration details, annual reports, and ownership information. The agency supports digital services for company formation, changes, and compliance, offering both free and fee‑based APIs, downloadable datasets, and XML feeds for integration into external systems.

providers.name: BridgeU
providers.description: BridgeU is an education technology company providing a university and careers guidance platform for international schools. Used by more than 1,200 partner schools across 150+ countries, the platform helps students from Grade 9 onward explore careers, research over 26,000 global universities, build shortlists, and manage applications in one connected system, with analytics dashboards for counsellors and AI-assisted guidance. BridgeU is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass; integration with school systems (for example ManageBac+) is handled via partner single sign-on rather than an openly documented API.

providers.name: buynomics
providers.description: Buynomics is a Cologne, Germany-based software company providing an AI-powered Revenue Growth Management (RGM) platform for consumer goods, retail, telecom, and consumer software companies. Its proprietary "Virtual Shoppers AI" runs agent-based simulations of consumer purchasing behavior so commercial teams can optimize pricing, promotions, price pack architecture (product mix), and trade terms before going to market — capturing cross- effects, cannibalization, and competitive response. The platform's Decision Guide generates prescriptive recommendations from thousands of evaluated scenarios. Buynomics is used by brands including Unilever, Nestle, L'Oreal, Danone, General Mills, Vodafone, and Ferrero, and is backed by Insight Partners and Seedcamp. The product is delivered as a web application; no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: Cambly
providers.description: Cambly is an online English-language learning platform, founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, that connects English learners in more than 190 countries with native-speaking tutors over on-demand video chat. Its consumer products include Cambly (adult learners), Cambly Kids (ages 4-15), Cambly Pro, and Cambly for Organizations/Business. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, and Y Combinator, the company operates a marketplace connecting students and tutors with weekly payouts. Cambly does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public company surface, GitHub organization, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Canadian Tire Bank
providers.description: Canadian Tire Bank (operating as Canadian Tire Financial Services) is a federally regulated Schedule I bank, wholly owned by Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited and federally chartered in 2003. Headquartered in Oakville, Ontario with operations in St. Catharines and Welland, the bank is the financial-services arm of one of Canada's best-known retailers. It issues the Triangle Mastercard, Triangle World Mastercard, Triangle World Elite Mastercard, Gas Advantage and Cash Advantage Mastercards, and offers high-interest savings accounts and GICs, all tied to the Triangle Rewards loyalty program. On open finance, the bank exposes no first-party public developer API or banking API portal. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / Fall Economic Statement 2024, overseen by the FCAC) is legislated but not yet operational, so consumer data access today is voluntary and aggregator-based — Canadian Tire Bank card and account data is reached through aggregators such as Finicity (by Mastercard), Flinks and Plaid rather than a first-party API. The cantire.com developer portal is run by the retail parent Canadian Tire Corporation, not the bank, is gated behind sign-in, and its TLS certificate expired in February 2026.

providers.name: Caresense
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: CarNow
providers.description: CarNow is an AI-enabled conversion platform built specifically for automotive dealerships, helping them turn more website visitors into leads, more leads into sales, and more buyers into lifelong service customers. Its product suite spans website solutions (AI-powered chat, digital retail, and shop-by-payment experiences), sales follow-up automation (Cruise Control, which prioritizes high-intent shoppers and automates nurture workflows), and service retention (Lane Assist, which drives post-sale engagement and service scheduling). CarNow works with more than 4,000 dealer partners and integrates with major OEM programs including Acura, Audi, BMW, Ford, General Motors, Honda, Hyundai, Kia, Land Rover, and Lexus. The company is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina and is backed by Battery Ventures. CarNow does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; its api.carnow.com endpoint is a partner/internal AWS API Gateway that requires authentication.

providers.name: CERPRO
providers.description: CERPRO is a Berlin-based industrial software company building AI-powered quality-assurance and process automation for small and medium-sized manufacturers. Its flagship product, QualiSpec, uses computer-vision and large-model AI to automatically extract features, dimensions, tolerances and drill-hole specifications from technical drawings (PDF, JPG, DXF) and generate inspection reports and quality documents in customized templates such as VDA, EMPB and inspection plans. This removes manual copy-paste and data-entry work from quality control, cutting documentation time by up to 70-90% and reducing errors while creating a unified data foundation that connects OEMs and suppliers. Since launching in December 2024 the software has been adopted by more than 100 SMEs across aerospace, medical devices and mechanical engineering. CERPRO is a Techstars portfolio company and raised a ~EUR 2M pre-seed round in 2025. The product is delivered as a cloud SaaS platform (platform.cerpro.io) hosted on AWS in Germany, with an ISO 27001 certified, GDPR/BDSG-compliant data-security posture.

providers.name: Charter
providers.description: Charter is a media and research platform focused on the future of work, AI, management, and hybrid workplace strategies. It provides newsletters, research reports, playbooks, case studies, and tools to help organizations navigate workplace trends, improve leadership, and adopt AI responsibly. With a community of over 100k readers, Charter offers insights, webinars, and consulting services to drive strategic decision‑making in modern enterprises.

providers.name: Clean Energy Fuels
providers.description: Clean Energy Fuels Corp. (Nasdaq: CLNE) is North America's largest provider of renewable natural gas (RNG) for the transportation industry. It produces RNG at dairy-farm and landfill facilities and delivers it as CNG or LNG through a network of more than 600 fueling stations across the United States and Canada, alongside hydrogen fueling, bulk LNG and turnkey fleet services. The company publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract; its only machine-readable surface is an llms.txt at the apex domain and a React station locator that reads static JSON from a contractor's GitHub repository.

providers.name: Cleanshelf
providers.description: Cleanshelf was a San Francisco enterprise SaaS management platform that discovered and inventoried an organization's SaaS applications, optimized software licenses, tracked subscription spend, and surfaced shadow IT. At acquisition it claimed more than 3,000 integrations and managed roughly $700 million in SaaS spend for its customers. LeanIX acquired Cleanshelf on 24 March 2021 and relaunched the technology on 1 May 2021 as LeanIX SaaS Intelligence, with SaaS discovery and cataloging folded into the LeanIX Application Portfolio Management module; LeanIX itself was later acquired by SAP. Cleanshelf publishes no API, developer portal or documentation of its own today — cleanshelf.com 301-redirects to www.leanix.net and its former api, app and docs hostnames no longer resolve. The successor API surface is profiled separately under the LeanIX record.

providers.name: CNCF
providers.description: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) is part of the Linux Foundation and hosts critical components of the global cloud-native technology infrastructure - including Kubernetes, Prometheus, Envoy, etcd, OpenTelemetry, CloudEvents, gRPC, and CNI. CNCF stewards open-source project governance and publishes the Cloud Native Interactive Landscape, a community-curated dataset (landscape.yml) of cloud-native projects and products with metadata such as GitHub stars, contributor counts, funding, and headquarters location.

providers.name: Coinbase OnchainKit
providers.description: Coinbase OnchainKit is a TypeScript React framework from Coinbase for building onchain applications on Base and other EVM networks. It bundles ready-made React components (wallets, identity, transactions, swap, checkout, fund, NFT), TypeScript utilities, and integrations with Smart Wallet, Base Account, Frames, and Mini Apps. OnchainKit is distributed as the @coinbase/onchainkit npm package along with companion CLIs (create-onchain) and a MiniApp manifest generator. It is built on top of Wagmi, Viem, and TailwindCSS and is the recommended client SDK for the Base ecosystem.

providers.name: Conservation Labs
providers.description: Conservation Labs is a Pittsburgh-based smart water technology company, backed by Techstars, Amazon, RET Ventures and SustainVC. Its flagship product, H2know, is a clamp-on acoustic smart water monitor that measures a building's inbound pipe every second and uses patented sound-detection technology and machine learning to translate those signals into accurate water-flow estimates, leak alerts and water-usage insights delivered through a companion mobile and web app. The company also offers Sustainable Machines, an edge-to-cloud platform for machine condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Conservation Labs serves residential homes, commercial real estate, restaurants and hotels, and industrial operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing app but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook documentation.

providers.name: Controlant
providers.description: Controlant provides real‑time, GxP‑validated pharma supply‑chain visibility through its Saga devices and platform. It monitors temperature, location and status of shipments across the globe, offering data sharing via Delta Sharing, streaming, and an Integrations API. Founded in 2009, Controlant serves top pharma companies, delivering millions of shipments in over 180 countries with 24/7 monitoring and rapid response.

providers.name: Curve Dental
providers.description: Curve Dental is a cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia. Its flagship platform, Curve Hero, serves more than 80,000 dental professionals across the United States and Canada, unifying scheduling, clinical and perio charting, imaging, billing, insurance, smart forms, reporting, patient engagement, and business analytics in a single browser-based system. Curve is privately held and backed by Battery Ventures, and connects to a growing ecosystem of integration partners (including DentalXChange, DentalHQ, Pearl AI, Bola AI, and Mango Voice) rather than exposing a public self-serve developer API. This profile was seeded from Battery Ventures' portfolio and enriched from Curve Dental's public web surface; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Delta Airlines
providers.description: Delta Airlines (alias of Delta Air Lines) is a major U.S. airline providing scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo throughout the United States and across the world. This repository is an alias of the canonical delta-air-lines profile and points to the same partner developer portal at apiportal.delta.com.

providers.name: DevAI
providers.description: DevAI (DevAI Solutions, Inc.) is a Silicon Valley enterprise IT company, founded in 2024 by Susie Wee (CEO) and Edwin Zhang, that builds agentic AI for IT operations teams. Its DevAI Network Intelligence Engine reconciles data across fragmented IT tools of record (CMDB, vCenter, NetBox and other infrastructure, network, compute, and security systems) into a single trustworthy operational view, and its Network Intelligence Agent "Neo" streamlines IT planning, incident response, patch management, and security and compliance workflows through a chat interface. DevAI reports deployment at Fortune 50 enterprises and won Best-in-Show (Automation) at the AI Networking Summit 2025. The company raised a $6M seed round led by Emergence Capital with Pear VC, Base10 Partners, and Benchstrength. No public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: DriveNets
providers.description: DriveNets is a networking software company that applies the disaggregated cloud model to telco-grade and AI networking. Its DriveNets Network Cloud runs DNOS, a cloud-native distributed network operating system, across shared white-box hardware to serve core, aggregation, access, peering, DCI, and AI-fabric use cases. The Network Cloud AI fabric delivers Ethernet-based GPU-cluster interconnect positioned as an alternative to InfiniBand. Founded in 2015, DriveNets powers disaggregated backbones for operators including AT&T, Comcast, Orange, and KDDI. Device management is exposed programmatically via NETCONF/gNMI over OpenConfig and DriveNets YANG models, with a first-party drivenets.dnos Ansible collection for automation; there is no public REST API.

providers.name: EcoMap Technologies
providers.description: EcoMap Technologies is an ecosystem intelligence software company (Baltimore, MD) that helps economic development organizations, chambers of commerce, universities, arts agencies, bioscience associations, and state and local governments map, connect, and measure their entrepreneurial ecosystems. Its platform turns scattered regional resource directories, referrals, and stakeholder relationships into a measurable, reportable network. Products span EcoMap Discover (resource hub and navigation), the Ecosystem Relationship Manager, an AI-powered Ecosystem ChatBot, the Economic Intelligence Monitor for regional benchmarking, and a Nonprofit Intelligence Dashboard. EcoMap reports 250,000+ resources mapped across 100+ ecosystems nationwide.

providers.name: Edgescan
providers.description: Edgescan provides a continuous exposure validation platform that combines automated vulnerability scanning with expert human assessment. Their services include API security testing, dynamic application security testing, penetration testing as a service, network vulnerability management, and attack surface management. The company helps organizations identify, prioritize, and remediate security risks across cloud, web, and mobile environments, delivering actionable insights and compliance support.

providers.name: Eunice
providers.description: Eunice is a London-based AI fintech building institutional-grade due diligence and monitoring infrastructure for digital assets and private markets. Its platform automates token due diligence, classification, risk analysis, and disclosure requirements — including an AI-powered MiCA whitepaper library for streamlining compliance with the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation — and delivers insights through a dashboard and API to exchanges, funds, custodians, issuers, and regulators. Founded in 2021 by Yi Luo, a second-time fintech entrepreneur and former VC, Eunice raised $8M in combined Seed and Pre-Seed funding led by Moonfire Ventures and Speedinvest with participation from Openspace Ventures in 2026, and counts Coinbase, Crypto.com, Copper, and Zodia Custody among its clients.

providers.name: Fertifa
providers.description: Fertifa is Europe's reproductive healthcare benefits provider for employers, giving companies a way to offer fertility, family-forming, women's health, maternity, menopause, men's reproductive health, and neurodiversity support to their employees. The platform pairs an in-house clinical team with education and training, diagnostics and testing, prescriptions and medication delivery, and financing/reimbursement, delivered to staff through a mobile app and to HR teams through enterprise and SME plans. Fertifa is London-based, backed by Speedinvest, and works with employers including Lululemon, Meta, Bain Capital, and Virgin. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: Fillable Document
providers.description: Fillable Document provides a platform for creating, managing, and processing fillable PDF and web forms. Their service enables businesses to design interactive documents, collect data securely, and integrate submissions via webhooks or API calls. The company focuses on compliance, data privacy, and customizable workflows, supporting industries such as legal, finance, and healthcare. With a user-friendly editor and robust API, developers can automate form generation, retrieval, and submission handling, enhancing digital transformation initiatives.

providers.name: Flatiron Health
providers.description: Flatiron Health is a healthcare technology company focused on oncology, combining real-world data from millions of cancer patients with software and AI to support life sciences research and clinical care. Its platforms include OncoEMR and OncoCloud for oncology practices, Flatiron Vessel (clinical research EDC, formerly Protocol First) and Clinical Pipe for clinical trials, and real-world evidence products for life sciences. Flatiron data has informed thousands of peer-reviewed publications and regulatory submissions. The company is part of Roche.

providers.name: Georama
providers.description: Georama is now QualSights (qualsights.com), a consumer-insights research technology company that helps brands understand human behavior across the product lifecycle. The platform combines Smart Sensors that passively capture product consumption and usage in real time, a participant app that collects video, photo, and survey feedback, and an AI-powered analytics layer that turns that data into actionable insights. Marquee offerings include UseSights (Physical AI for product usage), VoiceSights (AI-moderated conversations), and the moment-based XMOT feedback method, spanning opportunity identification, concept optimization, product development, pre-launch validation, market launch, and acceleration. Georama entered the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead; QualSights publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: GrowthHackers
providers.description: GrowthHackers (Growth Hackers Company, LLC) is a growth-marketing community and software company built around the growth-hacking discipline Sean Ellis named. It runs an invite-only community for founders, heads of growth, marketers and product managers, publishes growth research, case studies, opinion pieces and the State of Growth survey, and hosts webinars, AMAs and a conference. Alongside the community it sells growth and AI marketing services and ships Growth OS, an AI-powered growth and optimization platform for agencies that combines experiment planning, content creation, digital marketing execution and reporting. GrowthHackers publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Haven Connect
providers.description: Haven Connect is an affordable-housing software company (founded 2014, San Jose, CA) that streamlines the affordable-housing application and waitlist process for both property managers and low-income applicants. Its web platform lets property managers publish waitlists, collect and screen online applications, and automate waitlist updates — eliminating paper forms and manual data entry — while giving applicants a single portal to find and apply for affordable housing. Haven Connect is a Techstars Impact portfolio company and has raised roughly $2.9M. It is a SaaS product company with no public developer API; this profile captures its public website, support, and commercial surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Haz
providers.description: Haz (operated by Vend Solutions Ltd) is a London-based AI social commerce mobile app that connects friends through the things they own and makes it easier to track, buy, and sell second-hand belongings. Its proprietary receipt-reading technology scans digital purchase receipts in a user's email inbox to automatically digitize owned items in real time, removing the manual listing, photography, and description work traditionally required for resale. Users get real-time valuations of everything they own and can offer items to their social circle in a live feed, increasing the liquidity of everyday goods such as clothing and electronics. Haz launched on iOS in March 2024 and raised a $1.4M pre-seed round led by Speedinvest. It is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Highstock
providers.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Invisible AI
providers.description: Invisible AI is a next-generation computer vision company delivering a Vision Execution System (VES) for manufacturing. NVIDIA Jetson-powered edge devices with Intel RealSense 3D depth cameras and on-device SSD storage mount to existing factory infrastructure and, within hours, encode and segment the production floor in real time. The no-code, edge-based platform captures 100% of production cycles across every station without wearables, operator disruption, or cloud integration, then analyzes human motion and objects to surface cycle-time variability, process drift, quality escapes, and safety/ergonomics risk. Founded in 2018 by autonomous-vehicle veterans and backed by Sierra Ventures, it serves automotive and aerospace OEMs including Toyota, Ford, General Motors, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Nissan. Invisible AI publishes no public API or developer platform today; this profile captures its company identity, security posture, and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Joyful
providers.description: Joyful Health provides AI-assisted revenue recovery for healthcare organizations, combining automated claim investigation with expert billing teams to recover unpaid and denied insurance claims. Its platform runs inside an organization's existing revenue-cycle-management (RCM) systems rather than replacing them, covering denial investigation and root-cause analysis, claims recovery and appeals management, historical accounts-receivable (A/R) assessment, payer follow-up, documentation review, and financial insight to prevent future denials. The company operates a customer application at app.joyfulhealth.io and maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center. Joyful is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; Joyful does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Kaniko
providers.description: Kaniko is an open-source tool from Google that builds container images from a Dockerfile inside a container or Kubernetes cluster without requiring a Docker daemon. It executes each command within a Dockerfile in userspace, enabling secure container builds in environments where running a Docker daemon is impractical or insecure. The project was archived on June 3, 2025, and is now read-only.

providers.name: Kantar
providers.description: Kantar is a global data, insights, and consulting firm that helps brands understand consumer behavior, market trends, and brand performance. Through extensive research, advanced analytics, and strategic advisory services, Kantar delivers actionable intelligence to drive business decisions across advertising, media, retail, and product development. The company operates in over 100 markets, offering a wide range of solutions including brand health tracking, audience measurement, and digital transformation consulting.

providers.name: Lendorse
providers.description: Lendorse GmbH is a Berlin-based education-finance company that funds international master's students studying in Europe through Income Share Agreements (ISAs) instead of traditional credit-scored loans. Students receive between EUR 3,000 and EUR 20,000 toward tuition, visa deposits, relocation and living costs, then repay a fixed 6-12% share of gross monthly income for 12 to 60 months once they earn above a EUR 2,500 monthly salary floor, with total repayment capped at 2.3x the funded amount. No collateral, co-signer, parental guarantor or credit check is required, which opens funding to students from developing and emerging markets who are normally excluded. Lendorse also provides mentorship, CV review, mock interviews and industry introductions. It covers universities in Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland, went through the Techstars and ABN AMRO Future of Finance Accelerator, and raised EUR 1.75M co-led by LUMO Labs and Soulmates Ventures. Lendorse publishes no public API, SDKs or developer portal as of July 2026; this profile is a company record rather than an API profile.

providers.name: LLM Status
providers.description: LLM Status provides a service that tracks AI model deprecations and retirements, offering developers timely alerts and migration guidance. It includes a CLI tool to scan codebases for model usage and a web dashboard showing model lifecycle status, pricing plans, and documentation. The platform helps prevent broken integrations by notifying users of upcoming model changes, enabling proactive updates.

providers.name: Makrwatch
providers.description: Makrwatch is a creator representation and sponsorship management platform that sits between independent content creators and brands. It sources and filters brand-deal opportunities, negotiates terms and rates, protects creator IP and creative freedom, and handles the administrative work of briefs, timelines, revisions, invoicing, and payment tracking so creators can focus on producing content. Founded out of Y Combinator (W15) and based in New York City, the platform reports $27M+ distributed to creators across 34,000+ sponsorships for 7,400+ creators operating in 118 countries. The company was founded in 2013 as themidgame and still operates its GitHub organization under that name. Makrwatch does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface at this time: there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, SDK, MCP server or agent card anywhere on its public surface, and its two AWS API Gateway hosts (api.makrwatch.com and platform.makrwatch.com) are private backends for its own Creators and Brands applications, answering every unauthenticated request with HTTP 403.

providers.name: Meecrogate
providers.description: Meecrogate is a French‑based sovereign cloud API platform offering low‑code, modular, composable solutions for API exposure, security, orchestration and governance. The platform provides an API gateway, identity server, orchestrator and process executor, all configurable without code, targeting European data‑privacy standards and offering a single‑price annual edition covering all components.

providers.name: Milkman
providers.description: Milkman is an open-source, JavaFx-based, plugin-driven request/response workbench and desktop alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It supports multiple protocols including HTTP/REST, GraphQL, gRPC (with server reflection and streaming), WebSocket, Socket.IO, JDBC/SQL, Cassandra CQL, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

providers.name: Mill (heaters)
providers.description: Mill is a Norwegian company designing smart and beautiful heating and indoor climate products. It creates modern, minimalist heating solutions that blend Scandinavian design elegance with functional comfort. The company emphasizes sustainable indoor climate control, offering aesthetically pleasing heaters that integrate seamlessly into homes. Mill focuses on innovative, energy-efficient technology to provide reliable warmth while maintaining a sleek, contemporary look.

providers.name: Moneta Health
providers.description: Moneta Health provides an at‑home memory rehabilitation program delivered via phone and video. It offers personalized cognitive therapy to improve memory, focus, and daily functioning for patients with mild cognitive impairment. Backed by True Ventures, the service is covered by insurance in several U.S. states and aims to make brain health care accessible remotely.

providers.name: Motilal Oswal
providers.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited (MOFSL) is a diversified Indian financial services company offering equity and derivatives broking, wealth management, asset management, mutual funds, IPO access, investment banking, private equity, and home finance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. The public surface is a consumer/corporate investing website built on Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services; no public developer API or OpenAPI is published (algorithmic/partner trading access sits behind a partner login).

providers.name: Neysa
providers.description: Neysa is on a mission to democratise AI and machine‑learning technologies at scale for enterprises, offering a high‑performance GPU‑accelerated cloud platform, managed MLOps, and AI‑native services. Their Velocis platform provides scalable inference and training, a marketplace for AI applications, and security features like the Aegis LLM Shield. Serving banking, insurance, e‑commerce, manufacturing and more, Neysa aims to simplify AI infrastructure and compete with major cloud providers.

providers.name: Nodar
providers.description: Nodar develops advanced 3D sensor technology that transforms standard cameras into LiDAR alternatives, delivering dense point clouds up to 1,000 meters for autonomous vehicles, robotics, and industrial applications. Their stereo vision solutions enable intelligent machines to perceive depth with high accuracy, supporting a range of use cases from autonomous navigation to site inspection. Founded with backing from NEA, Nodar aims to accelerate adoption of affordable, high‑performance 3D sensing across industries.

providers.name: Novee Security
providers.description: Novee Security (Novee) is a cybersecurity company delivering AI-driven penetration testing that finds vulnerabilities faster, validates defenses, and reduces cyber risk. Its autonomous offensive-security platform performs penetration testing at machine speed across web applications and APIs, and spans solutions including DAST, AI red teaming, manual penetration testing, bug bounty, and compliance testing. Backed by Canaan Partners, Novee is building continuous, AI-native security testing as an alternative to traditional DAST scanning and slow, periodic manual pentest cycles. The company publishes a marketing and product site, a vulnerability glossary, and a blog, but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Over
providers.description: Overworld is an open-science AI research lab building interactive world models - AI-generated video environments that respond in real time to text prompts and controller input at game-level framerates.
