The platform fuses high-resolution satellite and aerial imagery with machine learning to detect vegetation encroachment, hazard trees, and wildfire risk along power line corridors, helping utilities prioritize trimming, optimize vegetation management spend, and improve grid reliability (SAIDI). Overstory was founded as 20tree.ai and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company. As of this profile the company delivers its intelligence through a customer platform and services rather than a public developer API; no public API documentation, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Photys Therapeutics
providers.description: Photys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Waltham, Massachusetts advancing proximity-based, targeted protein modulation medicines across three heterobifunctional modalities: PROTAC-based protein degradation (lead program PHT-776/HPB-143, an oral IRAK4 degrader that entered Phase I in August 2026 for autoimmune and inflammatory disease), PHICS (Phosphorylation-Inducing Chimeric Small molecules, partnered with Novo Nordisk since December 2024 for cardiometabolic disease), and tPRIME for restoring protective proteins such as p53 Y220C in oncology. Founded in 2022 out of Amit Choudhary's lab at the Broad Institute and Brigham and Women's Hospital with a $75M Series A led by MPM Capital and Longwood Fund. Photys operates no developer program and publishes no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, WSDL or gRPC contract; its only machine-readable, agent-facing surface is the platform-provided Wix Site MCP endpoint served from its own host at www.photys.com/_api/mcp, which answers anonymously with nine tools over site content and business details.

providers.name: Primary
providers.description: Primary (Primary Kids, Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer children's apparel brand selling simple, slogan-free, mix-and-match clothing "in all colors, for all kids" — babies through age 14, plus adult sizes, swimwear, school uniforms and licensed Sesame Street collaborations. The company operates a Shopify-hosted online store at primary.com and is a portfolio company of Homebrew. Primary has no first-party developer API, but its storefront is agent-accessible: it serves a live hosted Shopify Storefront MCP server (catalog search, product lookup, cart, checkout, policy/FAQ lookup) and exposes Shopify's Customer Account API (OAuth2/OIDC) for customer-scoped operations, along with a published llms.txt agent-instructions document.

providers.name: RentSpree
providers.description: RentSpree is a Los Angeles-headquartered rental real estate technology platform that streamlines the long-tail rental transaction for real estate agents, landlords, property managers, and renters. Its consumer-facing product suite covers online rental applications, TransUnion-powered tenant screening (credit, background, eviction, and income verification), e-sign and lease workflows, ACH/card rent payments, AI-assisted listing pages and syndication, rent estimate, and renters insurance. RentSpree positions itself as the rental layer for the MLS and brokerage ecosystem and has built named integrations with Multiple Listing Services (Bright MLS, CRMLS, Beaches MLS, CJMLS, Florida Realtors) and PropTech partners (SkySlope, Lone Wolf, ZipLogix, C.A.R. OnlineEd). It also runs an Enterprise API Integration program for MLSs, associations, brokerages, and PropTech vendors that want to embed rental application intake and tenant screening into their own platforms — documentation is not publicly published; partners are onboarded through a sales/integration process with implementation quoted at as little as three weeks. There is no self-serve developer portal, no public OpenAPI specification, and no public SDK or CLI; the RentSpree GitHub org is effectively empty (only a .github org-defaults repo). RentSpree is SOC 2 Type II certified and reports more than four million agents, landlords, and renters on the platform.

providers.name: Rynse
providers.description: Rynse provides a comprehensive fleet washing and vehicle care platform that connects fleet managers with a nationwide network of mobile and brick‑and‑mortar wash providers. The solution offers centralized billing, spend controls, fraud monitoring, and real‑time vehicle activity tracking, plus additional services such as fuel, EV charging, and maintenance, serving public and private sector fleets across the United States.

providers.name: Savvy
providers.description: Savvy (Savvy Advisors, Inc.) is a technology-driven, SEC-registered investment advisory firm founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY. It combines licensed fiduciary financial advisors with proprietary technology — including Savvy Intelligence, an AI workspace for advisors — to deliver personalized wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and independent financial advisors. Savvy manages $5B+ in assets across 100+ advisors in 30+ U.S. locations, custodying at Fidelity and Charles Schwab. The firm serves two audiences: clients seeking wealth management (financial planning, investment management, direct indexing, tax optimization, retirement, trust and estate planning) and advisors looking to join or build a practice on its platform. Savvy publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain security posture, and the verbatim /llms.txt it exposes for agents.

providers.name: Seagate
providers.description: Seagate is a global leader in data storage solutions, providing a wide range of hard disk drives, solid-state drives, and enterprise storage systems for consumers, businesses, and data centers. The company focuses on high-capacity, high-performance storage technologies, supporting cloud, AI, and big data workloads worldwide.

providers.name: SKALE Labs
providers.description: SKALE Labs is a blockchain scaling platform that provides elastic sidechains for high‑throughput, low‑cost decentralized applications. Backed by multicoin‑capital, the company focuses on enabling developers to deploy scalable dApps without compromising security, offering tools for rapid deployment, monitoring, and governance across multiple networks.

providers.name: Soundtrap
providers.description: Soundtrap is an online music creation platform that lets users create, record, and collaborate on music projects directly in the browser. It offers a digital audio workstation with virtual instruments, loops, and effects, supporting both individual creators and educators. Users can share their tracks, collaborate in real-time, and access a library of royalty‑free sounds, making music production accessible without installing software.

providers.name: Sunyur
providers.description: Sunyur (商越科技 / Beijing Sunyur Network Technology Co., Ltd, 北京商越网络科技有限公司) is a Chinese enterprise procurement digitalization company providing AI-driven procurement solutions for large and medium enterprises. Its products include an intelligent procurement middle-platform (采购中台), an SRM supplier relationship management system, an e-procurement SaaS platform, and a procurement mall (采购商城), helping each customer build a dedicated online, digital, and intelligent enterprise procurement platform to raise efficiency and lower cost. Sunyur operates an open integration platform ("聚贤阁", open.sunyur.com) that connects enterprises to 30+ mainstream e-commerce platforms and 10+ third-party applications through a single accessToken-authenticated API surface. Sunyur is backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Swell
providers.description: Swell provides an AI‑powered healthcare reputation management and patient experience platform for multi‑location healthcare groups. It centralizes operational visibility, automates review invitations, gathers patient and employee feedback, and offers AI‑generated, HIPAA‑compliant responses. The solution supports various specialties, integrates with major EHR/PMS systems, and includes tools for reputation monitoring, employee NPS, and analytics across clinics.

providers.name: University of Maryland Dept. of Geographical Sciences
providers.description: The University of Maryland Department of Geographical Sciences focuses on research, education, and outreach in geography, GIS, remote sensing, and spatial analysis. It offers undergraduate and graduate programs, conducts interdisciplinary research on environmental change, land use, and geospatial technologies, and provides resources and collaborations for students, scholars, and partners.

providers.name: Up&Up
providers.description: Up&Up (legal name Homevest Inc.) is a New York-based rental housing platform that lets renters build wealth while they rent. Instead of a traditional security deposit, renters contribute to an Up&Up Wallet that grows through their own contributions, a share of monthly rental profits, and appreciation in the home's value; at lease end they can buy the home, transfer the wallet to another Up&Up rental, renew, or cash out. Founded by Michael Wong, Ryan Brown, and Ben Wong, and backed by Khosla Ventures, Up&Up operates a consumer web application and a private backend at api.upandup.co, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Upwave
providers.description: Upwave (formerly Survata) is the Brand Outcomes Measurement Platform — it brings science to top-of-funnel advertising by measuring Brand Lift, validating Brand Reach, and surfacing optimization insights for brand campaigns across CTV, digital, linear TV, audio, and social channels. Advertisers, agencies, and media platforms use Upwave dashboards and its Bayes AI layer to quantify how campaigns move awareness, favorability, consideration, and intent. Upwave is delivered as a SaaS application with a managed partner ecosystem of ad servers and DSPs, and does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation. It is a portfolio company of Y Combinator, Uncork Capital, and Initialized Capital.

providers.name: US Foods
providers.description: US Foods is one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, serving restaurants, healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, government institutions, and educational facilities. As a Fortune 500 company, US Foods operates a national distribution network with over 70 distribution centers and serves approximately 250,000 customers. The company's digital platform includes the MOXe eCommerce application for ordering and business management, EDI integration for B2B transactions, and a supplier PIM system for product data synchronization. US Foods has undergone significant digital transformation building a data mesh architecture on Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and cloud platforms to support its eCommerce and supply chain operations.

providers.name: USgeocoder
providers.description: USgeocoder provides robust US sales tax rates and political district data for every address and geocode, including congressional, state legislative, county, municipality, school districts, elected officials, and census geographies. Their API enables developers to integrate accurate location-based tax and district information into applications, supporting compliance, analytics, and service personalization across the United States.

providers.name: Vastu Housing Finance Corporation
providers.description: Vastu Housing Finance Corporation Limited (Vastu HFC) is an Indian, technology-enabled affordable housing finance company backed by Norwest Venture Partners. It provides home purchase, construction, extension, and improvement loans, plot-plus-construction loans, commercial property loans, and loans against property through 200+ branches across 17 states, serving 1.6+ million customers, and participates in government subsidy schemes such as Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban 2.0. Vehicle, business, and construction-equipment lending is offered through its subsidiary Vastu Finserve. The company operates as a digital-first lender with a customer mobile app, but publishes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: Velvet
providers.description: Velvet is a multimodal AI model R&D company (the "multimodal data lab") based in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch. It partners with frontier AI labs and enterprises to build state-of-the-art video datasets and evaluation frameworks that improve models' spatial reasoning and interactive, low-latency capabilities. Velvet operates an invite-only platform for sourcing and contributing multimodal training data, with contributor payouts via Stripe and Wise. It was founded by Lucas Mantovani (CEO, formerly video data at Meta FAIR) and Lucas Tucker (CTO, formerly Adobe). As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: Vocus
providers.description: Vocus is Australia's specialist provider of fibre, network, and business solutions for businesses, government, and wholesale customers, operating an Australian and international fibre network. Its wholesale arm publishes Wholesale APIs for connectivity, real-time data access and automated network solutions, served through the Vocus Developer Portal (developer.vocus.com.au), where the full API catalogue is visible only after login and access is granted to customers with an active agreement via their Vocus Account Manager.

providers.name: Walker & Co.
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands is a health and beauty products company founded in 2013 by Tristan Walker, best known for Bevel, an end-to-end shaving and grooming system designed for people of color, and for the Form hair-care line. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and others, the company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and now operates as a consumer brand whose direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify at getbevel.com. It is a consumer packaged goods company with no first-party developer API program; it was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead. This profile captures its real public web surface (storefront, security.txt, well-known documents, P&G legal and vulnerability-disclosure programs) rather than an API product.

providers.name: Web3Auth
providers.description: Web3Auth (now MetaMask Embedded Wallets) is a non-custodial threshold-key wallet and authentication platform. It provides client SDKs (Web, React, Vue, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Unreal, Node.js) and a backend Auth Network for OAuth-anchored MPC key shares. Public HTTP surface is limited and SDK-first.

providers.name: WellTheory
providers.description: WellTheory is a virtual autoimmune care platform that provides whole-person support for people living with autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, pairing members with a dedicated care team for nutrition, lifestyle, and clinical guidance across more than 100 conditions. The company sells to employers and health plans as a covered benefit as well as direct to consumers, and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. WellTheory publishes no public developer API surface today; its api.welltheory.com backend and docs are private/internal.

providers.name: Wholesail
providers.description: Wholesail is an all-in-one accounts receivable and B2B payments platform for food & beverage wholesalers, distributors, and service vendors. It helps vendors onboard customers, manage credit risk, automate collections, accept ACH and card payments, and drive autopay — all connected to the vendor's ERP or accounting system. Wholesail is a fintech company backed by Foundry Group. As of enrichment it publishes no public developer API; it integrates with ERP systems using their native API protocols, scheduled file exchange, and robotic process automation, and it partners with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, JP Morgan, and SVB for payment processing. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 4bl1ty
providers.description: 4bl1ty provides a marketplace that connects AI agents with human workers to perform physical tasks that AI cannot execute. The platform lets agents publish missions, humans on the ground accept and complete them, and payments are escrowed until proof of completion is verified. It targets use‑cases like last‑mile delivery, on‑site inspections, and in‑person meetings, bridging the gap between digital intelligence and real‑world action.

providers.name: Ambr Technologies
providers.description: Ambr Technologies provides AI-driven role‑play simulations for enterprise training, enabling teams to practice high‑stakes conversations such as sales negotiations, performance reviews, and customer service interactions. Their platform offers customizable scenarios, real‑time feedback, and analytics to improve communication skills across industries.

providers.name: Armstrong World Industries
providers.description: Armstrong World Industries (NYSE: AWI) is a leading global designer and manufacturer of innovative commercial and residential ceiling, wall, and suspension system solutions. Armstrong offers a broad portfolio of ceiling and wall products across mineral fiber, fiberglass, wood, metal, and specialty substrates for use in commercial construction and renovation projects worldwide. The company provides BIM content, product data, and specification tools for architects and designers but does not offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Astro Sea
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia), operating at astronauts.id, is an Indonesian quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and everyday essentials in as little as 15 minutes. Its consumer mobile apps (iOS and Android) offer more than 3,000 curated products spanning fresh produce, frozen goods, groceries, beauty, household items, and electronics, with 24/7 service across the Greater Jakarta (JADETABEK) region. Astro is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio into the API Evangelist network. Astro is a business-to-consumer application company; it publishes a consumer app, a corporate site, and an RFC 9116 security contact, but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Ataraxis
providers.description: Ataraxis AI is a precision-medicine company building clinical AI foundation models that make disease predictable, beginning with oncology. Founded in 2022 by Jan Witowski, MD, PhD, and Krzysztof Geras, PhD (both formerly of NYU), Ataraxis trains multi-modal AI on hundreds of millions of pathology images to assess disease aggressiveness and predict cancer recurrence, treatment response, and survival. Its first product, Ataraxis Breast, is an AI-native, clinically validated prognostic and predictive test suite for breast cancer (Recurrence Risk, Chemotherapy Benefit, and Neoadjuvant Response) delivering same-day results without exhausting physical tissue. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures, AIX Ventures, and Giant Ventures, and advised by Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. Ataraxis operates a clinician portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: AtomBeam
providers.description: AtomBeam Technologies is a Moraga, California software company founded in 2017 that sells "Compaction" — a machine-learning approach to shrinking machine-generated data that replaces recurring bit-level patterns with codewords drawn from a trained codebook, rather than compressing bytes. Its Neurpac product is an on-premises, protocol-agnostic bidirectional compaction tunnel that reduces IoT, telemetry and file payloads by roughly 75% while encrypting and obfuscating them in transit; Neurcom and PCM are earlier-stage research products. AtomBeam licenses the software to IoT device and gateway makers, satellite and LPWAN operators, telcos, and the US Department of Defense, and has raised capital through Regulation A and Regulation CF crowdfunding on StartEngine. There is no public developer API program: the customer-facing surface is the login-gated AtomBeam Customer Portal (codebook generation and simulation) plus a Jira Service Management support portal.

providers.name: Awesome Indie
providers.description: Awesome Indie is a community‑driven launchpad that showcases the best indie tech products launching each day. The platform features a daily‑updated list of indie tools, apps, and services across categories such as AI, design, development, productivity, and more. Users can discover, upvote, and comment on products, while makers can submit their launches for free, connect with a growing audience, and access analytics. The site also offers a Pro subscription for enhanced features and runs regular promotions such as seasonal discounts.

providers.name: Axiamatic
providers.description: Axiamatic is an enterprise-transformation AI platform that aims to de-risk and accelerate large modernization programs, claiming to cut up to 50% off the cost and timeline of enterprise transformations. Its agentic platform combines a Living Context Graph (a digital twin of a transformation program built from structured and unstructured data), autonomous Transformation Agents that detect risks such as translation loss, resistance, and cross-stream drift, role-specific Playbooks delivered into existing workflows, and Axia, an AI assistant available via voice, chat, Microsoft Teams, or Slack. It targets ERP modernization (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365), CRM consolidation (Salesforce, Dynamics), and supply-chain and business transformation. The company is backed by Greylock and announced a $54M raise. It was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it currently publishes a marketing site and a login application (app.axiamatic.com) but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Baselane
providers.description: Baselane is an all-in-one financial platform (financial operating system) for independent landlords and real estate investors, combining FDIC-insured landlord banking, automated rent collection, bookkeeping and expense tracking, analytics and reporting, and cash-flow tools in a single product. Banking services are provided through partner Thread Bank, and account connectivity to external banks is powered by Plaid. Baselane is a consumer/SMB fintech application (web and mobile apps) rather than an API platform: it publishes no first-party public developer API, developer portal, or API reference. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Sector: fintech / proptech.

providers.name: Bibit
providers.description: Bibit is an Indonesian retail investment application that lets everyday users invest in mutual funds (reksa dana), government bonds (SBN/SBR/ORI), fixed-rate bonds, and stocks. Built for beginner investors, it uses robo-advisor technology to recommend diversified portfolios and is licensed by Indonesia's financial regulator OJK. Bibit operates within the Stockbit group and is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. As of this profile no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published; this repo tracks the company's public surface (security.txt, legal, help, blog) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bitwiseassetmanagement
providers.description: Bitwise Asset Management provides crypto index funds and ETFs, offering institutional and retail investors diversified exposure to the cryptocurrency market. The firm delivers research, portfolio simulation tools, and a suite of crypto‑focused investment products, operating from its headquarters in the United States and serving global clients through its website and investor portals.

providers.name: Boyd Gaming
providers.description: Boyd Gaming is a multi-jurisdictional casino entertainment company that owns and operates 28+ gaming properties across 10 U.S. states. The company offers casino gaming, hotel accommodations, dining, entertainment, and sports betting through its Boyd Sports platform. Boyd Rewards is the company's loyalty program spanning all properties, accessible via web portal and mobile app.

providers.name: Brumbrum
providers.description: Brumbrum is an Italian online used-car marketplace, part of the pan-European Aramis Group, that sells certified pre-owned vehicles fully online with home delivery, financing, trade-in (permuta), warranty coverage, a 14-day return trial and a best-price guarantee. Vehicles are inspected and reconditioned at its Reggio Emilia facility (300+ quality checks) with retail presence near Milan. Brumbrum is a consumer e-commerce brand rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification. This profile in the API Evangelist network captures the company's public web identity and the security/discovery signals probed from its domain.

providers.name: Burro develops
providers.description: Burro develops is a robotics company building autonomous, electric workhorse platforms for agriculture and industrial tasks. Founded in 2017, Burro creates collaborative robots that automate repetitive labor, improving productivity in farms, nurseries, vineyards, and warehouses. The company offers modular, plug‑and‑play robots capable of towing, load‑carrying, mowing, spraying, and monitoring, targeting specialty crop operations and heavy‑duty material handling.

providers.name: Businestptyltd
providers.description: Businest Pty Ltd provides step‑by‑step monthly advisory training and certification for accountants and bookkeepers, helping them transition into advisory services. Their platform offers various subscription plans, live sessions with accredited experts, and resources aimed at improving client outcomes and business growth.

providers.name: C6 Bank
providers.description: C6 Bank is a Brazilian digital bank offering a full suite of financial products including checking accounts, credit cards, loans, investments, and international banking, all accessible via a mobile app. It emphasizes innovative features such as C6 Carbon, C6 Graphene, and AI-powered assistance, targeting both individuals and businesses with competitive rewards and low fees.

providers.name: caimitech
providers.description: caimitech.com is the domain of Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co.), a Chinese personal-finance and wealth-management company founded in 2009 that offers accounting/bookkeeping apps, personal financial management (PFM) tools, wealth-management services, and credit solutions. Its developer surface is the Wacai Open Platform (挖财开放平台) — an HMAC-signed API gateway addressed by (api_name, api_version) pairs rather than REST paths, with first-party client SDKs in Java (published to Maven Central under com.wacai), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#, plus a separate topic-based message gateway (pull/ack). Access uses an app_key/app_secret credential with MAC or RSA request signing and an optional token service. No OpenAPI document is published; this profile was enriched from the provider's public GitHub SDKs and package registries.

providers.name: CAKE POS
providers.description: CAKE POS provides a cloud‑based point‑of‑sale (POS) platform designed for restaurants and retail businesses. It offers tools for order management, payment processing, inventory tracking, employee scheduling, and analytics, all accessible via web and mobile interfaces. The service integrates with popular payment gateways and third‑party services, enabling seamless operations for small to medium‑size enterprises seeking modern, scalable POS solutions.

providers.name: Chubb
providers.description: Chubb Limited is the world's largest publicly traded property and casualty (P&C) insurance company, serving consumers, small businesses, and multinational corporations across 54 countries and territories. Chubb offers commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance. The company manages more than $200B in global assets, paid $21B in claims (2023), and offers more than 200 insurance products and services. Key personal lines include homeowners, auto, valuables (jewelry, arts, wine), boat and yacht, pet (through a Healthy Paws partnership), and travel insurance. Commercial lines include small business, accident and health, commercial package, cyber, management liability, marine, professional liability, workers' compensation, and industry-specialty programs (construction, financial institutions, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, real estate, technology, climate). Chubb Studio is the company's embedded insurance technology platform offering APIs and SDKs for partners to integrate Chubb insurance products into their own digital experiences.

providers.name: Cloudgenix
providers.description: CloudGenix was a cloud-native SD-WAN (software-defined wide area network) company founded in 2013 and backed by Mayfield. Its AppFabric platform let enterprises build application-defined, policy-driven WANs managed from a cloud controller, with a full REST API (the CloudGenix Cloud Controller / AppFabric API) and first-party SDKs in Python, C#, Java, and JavaScript plus a CI-capable configuration CLI. Palo Alto Networks acquired CloudGenix in April 2020 for more than $420M and rebranded the product as Prisma SD-WAN, now part of the Prisma SASE portfolio. The public developer tooling remains published under the official CloudGenix GitHub organization.

providers.name: Corca
providers.description: Corca is an AI-native, collaborative workspace for mathematics — a browser-based editor that lets people write math naturally (without special syntax), run calculations in real time, and collaborate the way teams do in Figma or Google Docs. Typing keywords like "sum" or "integral" surfaces the right symbols and functions, documents import from and export to LaTeX, and built-in AI helps solve problems, manipulate expressions, and generate code without switching tools. It is used for lab research, lecture creation, team knowledge bases, and publishing academic work. Founded in 2023 and based in New York, Corca raised a $7.8M round (led by NEA, with Bloomberg Beta, NVIDIA's NVentures, Daft Capital, Slow Ventures, Liquid 2, Path Ventures, and Mana Ventures). The product is a consumer/team SaaS application; no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Cropio
providers.description: Cropio was an independent Eastern European farm management and precision agriculture platform (fields, satellite/NDVI imagery, weather, scouting, machinery telematics, and yield) founded in 2013. Syngenta acquired Cropio in September 2019 and folded it into its Cropwise digital agriculture portfolio; the product now operates as Cropwise Operations, and cropio.com redirects to operations.cropwise.com. The original Cropio API v3 was not shut down - it continues to run as the documented Cropwise Operations Platform API v3, reachable at operations.cropwise.com/api/v3 (the legacy cropio.com/api/v3 host has redirected there since April 1, 2022). It is a per-account HTTP JSON REST API (not a self-serve developer marketplace) - a Cropwise Operations login is required to obtain a USER_API_TOKEN, and there is no published self-signup API key flow or API-specific price list. Syngenta separately launched a broader "Cropwise Open Platform" for partners in 2025, which is a distinct, newer developer program outside the scope of this entry.

providers.name: Dianxiaomi
providers.description: Dianxiaomi (店小秘) is a free cross-border e-commerce ERP platform operated by Shenzhen Meiyunji Network Technology Co., Ltd., serving more than 1.8 million cross-border sellers worldwide. It unifies product listing and data collection, multi-platform order processing, warehouse and inventory management, procurement, financial and profit analytics, and customer service across 70+ marketplaces including AliExpress, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with integrations to 1,700+ logistics providers and 130+ overseas warehouses. The platform is user-facing SaaS; no public developer/API open platform is currently published.

providers.name: Digitap.AI
providers.description: Digitap.AI provides an AI‑powered end‑to‑end API platform tailored for banking and fintech institutions. Their solutions include expense management, account aggregation, alternate data suites, onboarding, bank statement analysis, PAN verification, and mobile number verification. Founded with a vision to deliver cutting‑edge artificial intelligence and machine learning SaaS solutions, Digitap serves financial services, fintechs, and related enterprises, offering tools that automate risk management, scorecards, and data enrichment to streamline operations and improve decision‑making.

providers.name: Dock
providers.description: Dock is a Latin American financial technology infrastructure provider — formerly Conductor Technology — that delivers card issuing and processing, core banking, digital accounts and wallets, Pix instant payments, bank slips, acquiring, loyalty/benefits and transactional anti-fraud from a single cloud-native platform marketed as Dock One. Dock operates in Brazil as a payment institution regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil (bank code 301) and states that it serves more than 400 companies across 11 countries, processes roughly R$1.4 trillion in annual card volume and supports around 70 million active digital accounts. Its API estate is branded Caradhras and is reached through the api.caradhras.io gateway; the developer reference at developers.dock.tech is a private ReadMe hub that redirects anonymous visitors to a login, and the previously public Caradhras reference at lighthouse.dock.tech no longer resolves.

providers.name: doinstruct
providers.description: doinstruct is an AI-powered frontline training and compliance platform for deskless and shift-based workforces. Founded in Osnabrück, Germany in 2021 and now headquartered in Brooklyn, New York with an office in Berlin, it turns internal SOPs, documents, and expert knowledge into mobile-first courses delivered in 35+ languages. Its Genius AI authoring tool, a 400+ lesson training library, a manager dashboard for assigning and documenting training, and a mobile learner experience serve 400+ frontline teams across food & beverage, logistics, manufacturing, construction, and general compliance, with audit-ready reporting for standards such as HACCP, GFSI, and ISO 27001. Backed by Creandum and HV Capital.

providers.name: dollea-de
providers.description: Dollea Beauty Studio is a cosmetics and wellness salon located in Munich Haidhausen, Germany. It offers a range of exclusive treatments including manicures, pedicures, eyelash extensions, eyebrow styling, and facial care, focusing on high-quality, personalized services for clients seeking aesthetic enhancements and relaxation. The studio also provides coworking spaces and multilingual support (German, English, Russian).

providers.name: Dubb
providers.description: Dubb is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: EPEX SPOT
providers.description: EPEX SPOT SE, the European Power Exchange, operates the organised short-term electricity markets across thirteen European countries - day-ahead and intraday auctions on the MATS trading system and continuous intraday trading on the M7 trading system. Day-ahead prices set on EPEX SPOT are the reference for much of the European power sector. EPEX SPOT exposes real machine-readable interfaces, but none of them are open self-serve APIs - trading APIs (MATS, M7) require exchange membership, and read-only market data APIs and SFTP file feeds require a paid Market Data Services subscription ordered through the EEX Group Webshop.

providers.name: EventMobi
providers.description: EventMobi is an event management platform for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events - event apps, registration and ticketing, event websites, badges and check-in, and live engagement - all configured through its Experience Manager. EventMobi exposes a documented public Unified API (UAPI) that lets organizers programmatically read and manage the data behind an event: events, people (attendees, speakers, and other participants), sessions, companies (sponsors and exhibitors), and groups. Access is gated by an EventMobi Organizer account - API keys are generated inside Experience Manager and carry the same access rights as the Organizer they belong to - so the API is available to paying customers rather than through open self-service signup.

providers.name: Eversettled
providers.description: EverSettled is a digital estate-settlement platform that guides families through the probate process after a death. Positioned between expensive probate attorneys and overwhelming do-it-yourself paperwork, it combines an adaptive, state-specific estate checklist, automated asset discovery across bank accounts, insurance policies and subscriptions, subscription cancellation and debt negotiation, secure document organization, a dedicated human estate-care specialist, and Sage, a 24/7 AI probate assistant. Available across all 50 U.S. states, EverSettled is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. Backed by a $5M seed round led by Emergence Capital with participation from Seedcamp.

providers.name: Fable
providers.description: Fable Security is an AI-powered human risk management (HRM) platform that helps security teams reduce incidents by changing employee behavior. It combines behavioral interventions (targeted nudges and AI-generated content), phishing simulations, short-form video awareness briefings, and human-risk reporting into a single platform positioned as a modern replacement for legacy security-awareness training. Fable's AI Studio, Composer, and Briefing Agent generate custom video and audio content - including deepfake and voice-fake simulations - and produce audience-targeted briefings from emerging threats in minutes. The platform reports on human risk and compliance across the workforce and integrates with an organization's identity framework, workspace, and security tooling. Fable serves healthcare, financial services, and technology customers including Sisense, SanDisk, Red Hat, PennyMac, Genesys, and Dayton Children's Hospital, and is backed by Greylock and Techstars.

providers.name: Finn
providers.description: FINN (finn.com) is a Munich-based consumer car-subscription service that lets individuals and businesses lease a car on a flexible monthly subscription, with insurance, maintenance, registration, taxes, and roadside assistance bundled into one all-inclusive price. Subscribers pick from more than twenty vehicle brands on terms from six to twenty-four months, and the company also runs a fleet/business offering. Backed by HV Capital, FINN operates in Germany, the United States, and other European markets. FINN is a consumer, direct-to-customer business with no public developer API or partner API program surfaced at this time; this profile captures its public web, security, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Freja eID
providers.description: Freja eID provides a digital identity platform enabling secure electronic identification, authentication, and signing for individuals and businesses across the EU/EEA. Users can register with national ID cards or passports, and integrate Freja eID into services for login, payments, and compliance. The service supports multilingual access, wide international coverage, and is approved by Swedish authorities and the EU.

providers.name: Garage
providers.description: Garage (Garage Technologies, Inc.) is America's online marketplace for buying and selling specialized vehicles and equipment — fire trucks, ambulances, and heavy-duty municipal apparatus. The platform helps fire departments, EMS services, municipalities, and dealers list surplus equipment and buy what they need in seconds, bundling AI-powered appraisals, virtual inspections, live auctions, payments, freight, financing, and warranties into one consumer marketplace. Garage raised $13.5M and is backed by Initialized Capital. It operates a public consumer web marketplace (shopgarage.com / withgarage.com); no public developer API program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Grabr
providers.description: Grabr is a peer-to-peer cross-border shopping marketplace, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that connects shoppers wanting products unavailable or expensive in their home country with travelers who deliver those items during trips in exchange for a reward. Grabr handles secure online payments, calculates duties and fees upfront, and holds funds in escrow until delivery is confirmed, operating across 75+ countries. It is a consumer mobile-app marketplace (iOS and Android) with a sibling fintech product, GrabrFi (US banking for non-residents). Grabr does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, support, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hithium
providers.description: HiTHIUM (Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese energy storage company founded in 2019 that designs and manufactures lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells, modules and complete battery energy storage systems (BESS) for utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and residential applications. The product line runs from large-format prismatic ESS cells through liquid-cooled multi-megawatt-hour container systems to the HeroEE residential and portable range marketed at hero-ee.com. Company material reports roughly 8,000 staff, more than 1,100 R&D engineers and over 3,900 patents. Product pages publish named certifications including UL 1973, UL 9540, UL 9540A, NFPA 855, IEC 62619, IEC 62477, IEC 63056, IEC 61000 and UN 38.3. HiTHIUM operates a Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) running an IEC 62443-aligned vulnerability management process, and publishes numbered cybersecurity bulletins with CVE references and remediation guidance at hithium.com/support/security.html. HiTHIUM publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL or Postman contract, no SDKs, no CLI, no webhook catalog and no MCP or A2A agent surface; third-party integration happens over Modbus/CAN interfaces described in datasheets and manuals that sit behind the download-center account gate, and the HeroEE consumer app's backend is undocumented.

providers.name: HZO
providers.description: HZO is a protective coating company specializing in Parylene and thin-film conformal coatings that safeguard electronics from moisture, humidity, salt fog, corrosion, and harsh chemicals. Founded in Salt Lake City and now headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, HZO delivers turnkey coating services and manufacturing solutions across consumer electronics, automotive and mobility, industrial, medical device, IoT, and battery markets, with coating facilities and centers of excellence in the United States, Hungary, China, and Vietnam. HZO is a physical-materials and contract-manufacturing business ("Protection from the Inside Out") rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract. This profile records the public web hygiene surface it does serve — an llms.txt discovery file, an RFC 9116 security.txt, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Imperson
providers.description: Imperson is an enterprise conversational-AI company and creative studio that builds turnkey, premium chatbots to automate the customer journey through natural, two-way dialogue. Its platform spans lead generation, customer support, sales and e-commerce, and engagement/entertainment, with a conversation engine, dashboard analytics, and a knowledgebase, activating across channels including Facebook Messenger, Amazon Alexa, websites, SMS, Google Assistant, native apps, and phone. Imperson operates an enterprise-sales model (no public self-serve developer API is published) and has produced chatbot experiences for brands such as Disney, Microsoft, Amazon, National Geographic, and Universal. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: KakaoBank
providers.description: KakaoBank is South Korea's leading internet-only bank, offering REST APIs for account management, fund transfers, loans, credit scoring, and open banking data connectivity for the Korean market. Founded in 2016 and backed by Kakao Corp., KakaoBank serves over 26 million customers through a fully mobile and API-first digital banking platform.

providers.name: Leona
providers.description: Leona is a healthcare communication company building an AI co-pilot for doctors and medical teams who run their practices over WhatsApp. Patients keep messaging WhatsApp as they always have, while the clinician side moves into Leona, where work conversations are separated from personal ones, categorized and prioritized, summarized for context, and voice notes are transcribed. Teams delegate chats by role, keep internal notes on a patient that the patient never sees, and reuse templates for repeated answers. Founded by Caroline Merin (CEO, formerly COO at Rappi), Tom Chokel (CTO, formerly CTO at Modern Fertility) and Arela Solis (Head of Operations), Leona launched publicly in December 2025 and serves physicians across Latin America. It ships as iOS, Android and web clients and publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: LIQUiDITY Group
providers.description: LIQUiDITY Group (branded simply "Liquidity") is an AI-native private credit lender and alternative asset manager founded in 2018, headquartered in New York with offices in Tel Aviv, London, Singapore, Tokyo and Abu Dhabi. It underwrites and deploys non-dilutive debt and growth capital — typically $10M to $200M — to late-stage technology and mid-market companies across 35+ countries, using its proprietary DYNAMiCs decision-science platform to compress due diligence from months to days. The firm manages several billion dollars across multiple debt and equity funds, including Mars Growth Capital, a joint venture with MUFG Bank, and is backed by MUFG, Apollo Asset Management, Spark Capital and Meitav Dash. Liquidity is a lender that runs on software rather than a software vendor: its DYNAMiCs platform is operated for its own analysts, borrowers and fund investors at app.liquiditygroup.com and is not offered as a public developer product. No public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/GraphQL schema, SDK or machine-readable contract is published on any host the company controls.

providers.name: Lysa
providers.description: Lysa is a Swedish fintech company offering automated investment and savings services. It provides a digital platform where users can open accounts, invest in diversified portfolios, and benefit from automatic rebalancing and tax optimization. The service emphasizes low fees, transparency, and a user-friendly experience, aiming to make investing accessible to a broad audience. Lysa also offers pension transfers, savings accounts, and financial education resources.

providers.name: Matsmart
providers.description: Matsmart (operating internationally as Motatos) is a Swedish e-commerce company that fights food waste by selling surplus, short-dated, and overstocked groceries and household goods at a discount, with average savings of up to 50%. Its catalog spans pantry staples, beverages, snacks, candy, baby food, health and beauty, cleaning supplies, pet food, and non-food surplus, sourced from manufacturers and retailers and shipped across Sweden and other European markets via partners including Bring, Airmee, and PostNord. The company runs a consumer web storefront and iOS/Android apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or documentation, so this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: MTech Systems
providers.description: MTech Systems provides full supply chain data management with artificial intelligence and business intelligence functionality for poultry and animal protein producers, including the Amino, Sonar, Proline, and Axis products.

providers.name: MultiModel
providers.description: MultiModel provides enterprise AI solutions tailored for banking and financial services. Their platform offers AI‑driven loan application pre‑review, CRM upsell analysis, compliance operations, audit response drafting, customer support, sales coaching, complaint triage, reconciliation review, and more. By integrating with existing banking systems, MultiModel helps institutions automate decision‑making, improve risk management, and enhance customer experiences across branches and digital channels.

providers.name: NDBC — National Data Buoy Center
providers.description: The NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC) operates a global network of over 1,000 moored buoys, drifting buoys, Coastal-Marine Automated Network (C-MAN) stations, and partner stations that continuously measure and transmit meteorological and oceanographic conditions. Real-time and historical data — wind direction and speed, wave height and period, sea surface temperature, atmospheric pressure, air temperature, dew point, visibility, and salinity — are distributed freely via HTTP file URLs, a THREDDS/OPeNDAP server (NetCDF), an RSS observation feed, and a latest-observations snapshot updated every five minutes. No API key or authentication is required; data is in the public domain under U.S. government open-data policy.

providers.name: OnFrontiers
providers.description: OnFrontiers is the first and largest expert network for U.S. federal contractors, an Expertise Intelligence Platform connecting government contractors with 17,000+ subject matter experts and growth professionals across 1,300+ federal agencies to win and execute more government contracts. Engagements range from one-hour consultations to multi-month projects, with a 92% project success rate across 6,000+ engagements, and the platform is integrated with GovTribe's contractor intelligence tools. Added to the API Evangelist network as a techstars portfolio lead; this enrichment pass found no public developer API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public well-known discovery documents), but the provider does publish a real llms.txt.

providers.name: Open Mainframe Project
providers.description: The Open Mainframe Project is a Linux Foundation project encouraging the use of Linux-based operating systems and open source software on mainframe computers. Founded in 2015 with IBM, it hosts projects such as Zowe (modern interfaces for z/OS), Feilong (z/VM cloud connector), Galasa (testing), and a range of community programs that promote mainframe skills and open source on IBM Z and LinuxONE platforms.

providers.name: openmediavault
providers.description: OpenMediaVault provides a free, open‑source network attached storage (NAS) solution built on Debian Linux, enabling individuals and small businesses to store, share, and back up data on their own hardware. It offers a web‑based admin interface, extensible plugins, and features such as S.M.A.R.T., snapshots, and remote access, emphasizing data sovereignty and ease of use without requiring deep technical expertise.

providers.name: Oracle NetSuite
providers.description: Oracle NetSuite is a cloud-based business management suite that combines ERP, financials, CRM, inventory, supply chain, ecommerce, and human capital management into a single platform for mid-market and enterprise companies. NetSuite's SuiteCloud platform exposes both REST web services (SuiteTalk REST, with OpenAPI 3.0 metadata, SuiteQL queries, and CRUD on standard and custom records) and SOAP web services (SuiteTalk SOAP), plus the RESTlets framework for exposing custom server-side SuiteScript as REST endpoints.

providers.name: Orbital Materials
providers.description: Orbital Materials (rebranded Orbital Industries in 2026) is an AI industrial company founded in 2022 by Jonathan Godwin, a former DeepMind researcher, with offices in London and San Francisco. It applies frontier AI to the discovery, testing and deployment of advanced materials and to the hardware and manufacturing built around them, co-designing materials and hardware together rather than sequentially. Its public technical output is a family of open-source machine-learned interatomic potentials — the Orb, Orb-v2/v3 and OrbMol foundation models for atomic simulation — distributed as the Apache-2.0 licensed `orb-models` Python package on PyPI and GitHub and as model weights on Hugging Face. Its internal platform, CurieOS, and its Orbital IT data-center module business are marketed through a contact form rather than a developer program. The company publishes no public HTTP API, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Pabbly Connect
providers.description: Pabbly Connect is a workflow automation platform for connecting cloud applications and automating business processes.

providers.name: PartyDAO
providers.description: PartyDAO is the decentralized autonomous organization behind Party Protocol, an open, GPL-3.0 protocol for on-chain group coordination that aims to make Ethereum "multiplayer." Party Protocol lets groups form a Party (a shared Ethereum account with members, an inventory, and governance), collectively crowdfund to acquire assets, govern shared holdings, and distribute value to members — all through audited Solidity smart contracts rather than a hosted HTTP API. PartyDAO also ships Party (party.app), a consumer application built on the protocol. The developer surface is entirely on-chain: smart contracts, deployed contract addresses, and technical documentation for integrating via web3 libraries and direct contract calls. There is no REST/HTTP API, hosted SDK, or OAuth surface; integration happens by calling the deployed contracts.

providers.name: Pendulum
providers.description: Pendulum (Pendulum Therapeutics, pendulumlife.com) is a microbiome-management and metabolic-health company that develops clinically validated probiotic supplements built on novel, patented anaerobic microbial strains such as Akkermansia muciniphila. Its consumer products - including Glucose Control, Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, and a GLP-1 probiotic - are formulated to fuel and maintain the gut lining, support immunity, relieve gas and bloating, and help keep blood glucose in a healthy range, differentiated by double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials rather than off-the-shelf probiotic blends. Pendulum is a direct-to-consumer health and supplement brand and is a portfolio company of DCVC; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Pensive
providers.description: Pensive is an AI grading platform for educators at schools and universities. Its "AI Grader" helps instructors evaluate student work — grading assignments and returning feedback at scale — alongside an AI tutor product for students. Pensive serves distinct teacher, student, and administrator surfaces, publishes case studies with university instructors, and maintains a SOC 2 trust center. It is a seed-stage company backed by Mayfield. As of this profiling Pensive operates a private, authenticated web product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: phoenixNAP
providers.description: phoenixNAP is a global IT services provider offering a diverse portfolio of data center and cloud infrastructure solutions. Founded in 2009, it operates multiple data centers worldwide, delivering IaaS, dedicated servers, colocation, and managed services to enterprises and developers. The company emphasizes high performance, security, and scalability, supporting a range of workloads from web hosting to complex enterprise applications.

providers.name: Plural Ai
providers.description: Plural is an AI platform built for private markets professionals across private debt, private equity, and banking. Its AI agents ingest and analyze complex financial documents and data-room sources (documents, SharePoint, data rooms) to generate auditable, fully-referenced outputs — deal screeners, investment committee (IC) memos, term-sheet drafts, portfolio reports, and compliance documentation. Plural emphasizes EU data residency, end-to-end encryption, ISO 27001-aligned controls, and GDPR/DORA readiness, with no training on customer data. The company is backed by Speedinvest, Creative Destruction Lab, AI SEED, Innovate UK, and the European Commission. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is published; the product references MCP and agent integrations for private-markets workflows.

providers.name: Polaron
providers.description: Polaron is a London-based AI software company that builds "the intelligence layer for materials science." Its platform applies machine learning to microscopy and image data to automate microstructure analysis, connecting process, structure, and performance so materials engineering teams can characterise, design, and manufacture materials faster and with less uncertainty. The platform centers on three core model families: Segmentation (identifying and measuring microstructural features), Reconstruction (converting 2D micrographs into 3D representations), and Design (optimising microstructural parameters). It is applied across batteries, metals and alloys, composites, ceramics, additive manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, spanning R&D, quality and qualification, and modelling and simulation workflows. Polaron is backed by Speedinvest and research institutions including Imperial College London, Manchester, Oxford, and Cambridge.

providers.name: Pomelo Care
providers.description: Pomelo Care is a value-based virtual healthcare company delivering 24/7 clinician-led care for women and children across fertility and preconception, prenatal and postpartum, pediatric and NICU, and midlife and menopause health. Operating as a telehealth platform contracted with employers and health plans, Pomelo pairs licensed clinicians, doulas, and care teams with remote monitoring to close the gaps between doctor visits, reduce NICU admissions, and improve maternal and infant outcomes. The company reports covering 25 million lives across all 50 states and raised a $92M Series C at a $1.7B valuation. Pomelo Care is a patient-, employer-, and payer-facing platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and First Round Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Qiz Security
providers.description: QIZ Security is a cybersecurity company delivering a cryptography management platform for quantum-safe security. The platform helps organizations discover, prioritize, remediate, and govern their cryptographic assets across on-premises and cloud environments, making hidden cryptography visible and preparing them for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) adoption. Founded by experts in cybersecurity, networking, and post-quantum cryptography, QIZ Security is API-first and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, with offices in Lewes, Delaware (US) and Ra'anana, Israel.

providers.name: QNAP
providers.description: QNAP Systems, Inc. provides secure, intelligent data and storage solutions, including network attached storage (NAS), high‑availability systems, networking, edge AI servers, video surveillance, and myQNAPcloud services. Their products accelerate workflows, protect data, and strengthen IT/OT resilience for enterprises and consumers worldwide.

providers.name: Quantum Machines
providers.description: Quantum Machines is a Tel Aviv, Israel-based quantum control company that builds the Quantum Orchestration Platform (QOP) — a unified hardware and software stack for controlling quantum processors at the pulse level. Its hardware portfolio centers on the OPX+ and OPX1000 controllers, which are built around a custom Pulse Processing Unit (PPU) architecture that executes classical control and real-time feedback alongside arbitrary waveform generation, with sub-microsecond classical-quantum round trips and 160 ns active reset latency. The platform is programmed in QUA, the company's domain-specific pulse-level language, exposed to developers through the qm-qua Python SDK and an extensive open-source ecosystem under the qua-platform GitHub organization (QUAlibrate, QUAM, qua-libs, py-qua-tools, qua-dashboards). Quantum Machines also ships peripheral hardware including the Octave up/down converter (to 18 GHz), QDAC-II ultra-low-noise DACs, QSwitch, QBox, and the QCage/QBoard/QFilter cryogenic line. The platform is qubit-modality agnostic, supporting superconducting, semiconductor spin, trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and color-center systems, and is used by university labs (MIT, Caltech, Harvard, Princeton, Weizmann) and quantum startups (Alice & Bob, Diraq, EeroQ). Quantum Machines has partnered with NVIDIA on the DGX Quantum hybrid quantum-classical compute platform and acquired the Delft-based QHarbor Bioscience team as a European R&D hub. Quantum Machines does not currently publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or self-service developer signup; the QOP control surface is reached exclusively via the qm-qua Python SDK against an OPX/OPX1000 controller (hardware or qm-saas cloud simulator).

providers.name: Raisin
providers.description: Raisin is a fintech savings and investment marketplace that gives consumers access to high-yield savings accounts, CDs, and cash deposit products from a network of banks and credit unions through a single account and login. Founded in Berlin (originally as WeltSparen / SavingGlobal) and operating in the US, Germany, and across Europe, Raisin connects more than one million customers with partner banks, handling onboarding, KYC, account management, and deposit brokerage. Its sister entity Raisin Bank provides a Banking-as-a-Service platform for fintechs. Raisin exposes no public, self-serve developer API or documentation portal; integrations are partner-only and its consumer surface is web and mobile apps. Backed by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead.

providers.name: ReadyAPI
providers.description: ReadyAPI is SmartBear's enterprise-grade automated API testing platform. It unifies functional, security, performance, and virtualization testing for REST, SOAP, GraphQL, Kafka, JDBC, and JMS APIs. ReadyAPI is delivered as a desktop and CI/CD tool rather than as a public REST API, integrating with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, and other automation platforms via TestEngine.

providers.name: Runbooks
providers.description: Runbooks is an all-in-one IT operations platform purpose-built for IT teams and managed service providers (MSPs). It consolidates ITSM (service desk, ticketing, incident management, knowledge base, SLA management), ITAM (hardware and software asset tracking, lifecycle management, warranty tracking, QR code asset labels), BizOps (CRM, client management, quarterly business reviews, budget forecasting, vendor management), SecOps (audit logs, MFA, password management), and Insights (automated reports, satisfaction tracking, quality assurance, KPI analytics) into a single integrated system. The platform targets IT departments and MSPs managing 50-5,000 users at a flat $25 per tech per month pricing model with no tiers or hidden fees. Runbooks is SOC 2 compliant with 99.9% uptime.

providers.name: Sonder
providers.description: Sonder is a hospitality company that designs, leases, and operates a global portfolio of boutique, design-forward apartment-style accommodations and hotels for short- and extended-stay travelers. Guests book directly through Sonder's website and mobile app, where a tech-enabled experience spans contactless check-in, in-app service requests, and 24/7 local support across cities in North America, Europe, and the Middle East. In 2024 Sonder entered a long-term licensing agreement with Marriott that lists its properties in the Marriott Bonvoy program. The company is publicly traded and was backed by venture investors including Greylock. Sonder publishes no public developer API; the only machine-facing surface documented here is its responsible security-disclosure program and the site's domain-security posture.

providers.name: Stader Labs
providers.description: Stader Labs is a non-custodial, smart-contract-driven liquid staking platform for Proof-of-Stake networks. It lets retail users, exchanges, and custodians stake crypto and receive tokenized liquid staking tokens (ETHx, MaticX, BNBx, NEARx and others) that stay usable across 40+ DeFi protocols while earning auto-compounding rewards, with no lock-up and no minimum stake. Stader operates as multi-chain middleware infrastructure across Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Hedera, Fantom, and NEAR, and its contracts have been audited by Sigma Prime, Halborn, Peckshield, Code4rena, and OtterSec. The project is on-chain and open source rather than a REST/OpenAPI provider; developer surface area is Solidity/Go/Rust smart contracts, node software, and CLI tooling on GitHub.

providers.name: Sumer
providers.description: Sumer (Sumer.Money) is a blockchain liquidity infrastructure protocol positioning itself as the most capital-efficient way to put crypto assets to work across chains. Users deposit native assets such as liquid staked ETH, and Sumer's correlation-aware risk engine matches assets and liabilities to mint synthetic suTokens (suETH, suUSD) that act as "money multipliers" — travelling across connected blockchains as collateral while the underlying deposit keeps accruing staking rewards and lending interest. The protocol runs an omnichain lending/borrowing market, a points and veSumer staking program, and its Supernova EVM chain, drawing price data from Chainlink, Pyth, RedStone, and Supra oracles. Backed by Pantera Capital and other crypto investors, with contracts audited by Certik, Ancilia, Tikkala, and CD Security.

providers.name: Upkid
providers.description: Upkid is a childcare staffing marketplace that connects early childhood programs such as daycares and preschools with qualified, pre-vetted substitute and full-time teachers. Programs post shifts and roles while educators find flexible teaching opportunities through the Upkid web and mobile apps, with an ATS-style Hiring Hub for full-time childcare hiring. Upkid operates across metro areas in Georgia, Utah, and Arizona and is a Techstars portfolio company. Upkid publishes no public API or developer portal; its web app is a client of a Firebase backend.

providers.name: Vali
providers.description: Vali provides an AI‑powered workforce platform for home‑care agencies, automating caregiver scheduling, shift fulfillment, and operational oversight. Founded after personal experiences with gaps in in‑home care, Vali’s mission is to strengthen the operational backbone of agencies, ensuring reliable care delivery and reducing caregiver turnover. The platform combines intelligent matching, real‑time coordination, and human oversight to improve efficiency and patient outcomes across the US and Canada.

providers.name: Web Methods
providers.description: Web Methods (webMethods) is an enterprise integration platform pioneer, founded in 1996 by Phillip and Caren Merrick in Fairfax, Virginia to connect software applications in real time using web standards such as HTTP and XML. Its 2000 IPO was one of the largest first-day pops of the dot-com era. webMethods was acquired by Software AG in 2007 for $546 million, and its integration portfolio - now including webMethods.io Integration (iPaaS), API Gateway and API Management, the Developer Portal, B2B/EDI, messaging, managed file transfer, and event-driven integration - was acquired by IBM in July 2024 as IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration. Mayfield was an early venture backer of the company.

providers.name: 1World Online
providers.description: 1World Online is an audience-engagement and interactive-advertising company, operating since 2012, that serves media publishers, advertisers and travel brands. Its platform embeds Interactive Media Units — polls, quizzes, trivia, debates and surveys — into publisher pages in 30+ languages, turns the resulting engagement into interactive ad inventory and first-party audience insight, and rewards participants through a points-based loyalty program and Web3 collectables (TravelVerse). The company also operates a technology center offering custom development and integration services. Its platform backend is live at app-wleu.1worldonline.com and serves the publisher portal, widget frontend and loyalty applications, but 1World Online publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract today, and the historic public Swagger UI host api.1worldonline.com no longer resolves.

providers.name: Abodu
providers.description: Abodu designs, manufactures, and installs prefabricated accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and backyard homes across California. It offers state-approved plans with fixed all-in pricing and installation as fast as one day, spanning seven models from the 385 sq ft Abodu Studio to the 1,195 sq ft Abodu Three+, plus an Abodu Office. The homes target homeowners seeking rental income, aging-in-place, home offices, and guest houses, as well as multifamily operators, and feature fire-resistant construction with an optional Net Zero solar package. Abodu is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Admittedly
providers.description: myOptions (myoptions.org redirects to encourageme.com; operated as the Encourage platform by Encoura, LLC) is a free college and career planning platform for middle- and high-school students, families, and educators across the United States. Students explore colleges, majors, careers, and scholarships and get matched to institutions, while educators deliver guidance through lesson plans, preference forms, and reporting dashboards. The platform reports serving roughly 4 million students across 5,000 school districts and 10,000+ high schools in all 50 states and D.C., funded through partnerships with colleges and education providers rather than user fees. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or documentation surface, and no real /.well-known/ documents (all such paths return the SPA/404 catch-all). Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead under the stub slug 'admittedly'.

providers.name: Affinity Technology (The Lobby)
providers.description: Affinity Technology, Inc. operates The Lobby (fromthelobby.com; app at tryaffinity.com), an invite-only creator-marketing marketplace connecting direct-to-consumer brands with content creators for product seeding, paid partnerships and user-generated content. Brands stock a Creator Closet that vetted creators request from, and the platform handles standardized one-click partnership offers, contracts, Shopify-driven fulfilment and shipment tracking, deliverable reminders, a content library and social-listening reporting. The company began as Affinity, an AI personalized-fashion recommendation service for brands and retailers (San Francisco, backed by 8VC, EquityZen ticker AFFI) and pivoted the same entity and domain to the creator-marketing product. It publishes NO developer program: no portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP surface, no api.* host, no public code org. Its only advertised integration is a Shopify connection configured inside the authenticated brand dashboard.

providers.name: Agent Switchboard
providers.description: Agent Switchboard is a curated directory of AI agents, MCP servers, and agentic developer tools. It lists 900 agents from 757 providers, offering API, MCP, CLI, or browser extension access, and provides a JSON index, MCP server, OpenAPI description, and plain-language guide for machine consumption. The site is maintained by Assaf Barnir and open source, with contact and submission forms for listings.

providers.name: AllCare
providers.description: AllCare is a Philippines-based digital employee-benefits and healthcare membership platform for freelancers and small-to-medium enterprises. It aggregates worker benefits that individuals and small teams would otherwise struggle to access, bundling HMO coverage, group life insurance, 24/7 teleconsultation, dental and optical care, mental-health counseling, annual physical exams, and productivity perks into flat-rate membership packages. Its SME Benefits Package is sold on an annual per-employee basis (minimum five employees) and is managed through a web dashboard for enrollment, member management, and benefit utilization. AllCare is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare/insurtech company profile.

providers.name: Amber Box
providers.description: AmberBox is an indoor gunshot detection company (San Francisco, CA) that builds sensor hardware and a response platform for schools, offices, and public buildings. Its patented tri-factor detection algorithm combines percussion, audio, and infrared signatures to identify a firearm discharge with a near-zero false-alarm rate, then automatically notifies on-site security and law enforcement to cut emergency response time by an average of five minutes. AmberBox integrates with existing physical-security estates (access control, IP video/VMS, PSIM, mass-notification, and fire-alarm-style life-safety systems) via closed-contact relay switches and TCP/IP relay input modules rather than a public developer API. Surfaced as an Uncork Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company publishes no public REST/GraphQL API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Apono
providers.description: Apono provides a cloud‑native privileged access management (PAM) platform that delivers just‑in‑time, zero‑standing‑privilege access for humans, machines and AI agents. Now part of 1Password, Apono helps security, IAM and DevOps teams reduce risk by granting scoped permissions only when needed and automatically revoking them, while offering audit evidence for compliance.

providers.name: Aramex
providers.description: Aramex is a Dubai-headquartered global logistics and express transportation company. It publishes SOAP web services (Shipping, Shipments Tracking, Location and Rate Calculator) at ws.aramex.net/ShippingAPI.V2, with WSDLs published for public download; API credentials are issued through an Aramex account.

providers.name: Arcanika
providers.description: Авторский сервис онлайн-раскладов Таро и значений карт. Эксклюзивная авторская система толкования Arcanika. Любую страницу можно получить в Markdown: допиши `.md` к адресу или пришли заголовок `Accept: text/markdown`. ## Значения карт - Полный справочник Таро: 22 Старших Аркана и 56 Младших арканов по 4 мастям. Школы Уэйт-Смит, Марсельская, Тота. Поиск, фильтр по типам, переключатель колод, прямое и перевёрнутое значения. ## Расклады - Онлайн‑расклады Таро на любовь, карьеру, деньги, будущее и выбор. Первый расклад бесплатно. Тёплый, человечный подход без шаблонов.

providers.name: Argus Investor
providers.description: Argus Research Company is an independent equity research firm founded in 1934, providing institutional-quality investment research, stock ratings, and analyst recommendations for 500+ publicly traded companies. The firm publishes fundamental research, earnings estimates, target prices, and Buy/Hold/Sell ratings across all major sectors including healthcare, technology, financial services, and industrials. Research is distributed to institutional clients and through financial data platforms including Bloomberg, Fidelity, Schwab, and Interactive Brokers.

providers.name: Asseta
providers.description: Asseta is a San Francisco-based online marketplace for the secondary market in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. Founded in 2013, the platform lets fabs, refurbishers, and dealers list and discover used, refurbished, and new components, ranging from chamber assemblies and power supplies to smaller parts like o-rings, with more than 450,000 listings from suppliers around the world. Buyers request quotes from global suppliers with a single click and typically save 50-60% versus OEM pricing. Asseta is a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published web properties.

providers.name: Atrandi
providers.description: Atrandi Biosciences (founded 2016 in Lithuania as Droplet Genomics) is a life-sciences tools company building droplet-microfluidic platforms and its patented Semi-Permeable Capsule (SPC) technology for single-cell analysis. SPCs isolate individual cells while letting reagents diffuse freely, enabling complex multi-step single-cell genomics, multiomics, and microbial whole-genome sequencing workflows. Atrandi ships instruments (Flux, Onyx, Styx), application kits, and consumables used by 200+ research groups worldwide. The company is a wet-lab instrumentation and consumables vendor and publishes no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched with verified public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Automotus
providers.description: Automotus is a smart-city and urban-mobility technology company that provides automated curb management using computer vision. Its CurbSight AI cameras use automatic license plate recognition (ALPR), 5G connectivity, edge processing, and privacy-by-design to monitor curb activity, while CurbPass handles curb access payment and invoicing and CurbSuite delivers an enforcement and analytics dashboard. Automotus works with cities, airports, and commercial fleets to reduce congestion, improve safety and compliance, cut emissions, and generate new curb revenue. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer/API surface has been found yet.

providers.name: Axtria
providers.description: Axtria is an AI-first cloud software and data analytics company built for the life sciences industry, founded in 2010 and headquartered in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey. Its cloud product suite — Axtria DataMAx (AI-driven data management), Axtria InsightsMAx.ai (agentic AI and cloud analytics), Axtria SalesIQ (sales planning and operations), Axtria MarketingIQ (marketing analytics and omnichannel measurement) and Axtria CustomerIQ (omnichannel customer engagement) — helps pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, animal health and consumer health commercial teams turn data into targeting, segmentation, incentive compensation, field force and brand decisions. Axtria reports 3,600+ employees serving 100+ life sciences companies, including 16+ of the top 20 pharmaceutical enterprises.
