Axtria publishes no public developer portal and no open API documentation: the product documentation host docs.axtria.com is HTTP Basic-auth gated to customers, and platform integration (Veeva CRM, Salesforce, Marketo and 20+ structured and unstructured life sciences data sources over SFTP and APIs) is delivered under enterprise contract rather than through a self-service developer surface.

providers.name: Baania
providers.description: Baania (Baania (Thailand) Co., Ltd.) is a Thai proptech and real-estate marketplace that aggregates new and second-hand houses, condos, and townhomes for sale across Thailand. The consumer portal provides property listings, project data, reviews, and price comparison to help home buyers make decisions in one place, and connects them directly with property developers and real-estate agents. Backed by 500 Global. Baania is a consumer-facing web portal; no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bankrolled.ai
providers.description: Bankrolled.ai provides a free, regulator‑sourced API hub for AI agents to access deposit‑insurance limits, savings, retirement and related financial limits across multiple jurisdictions. It offers a Machine‑Callable Protocol (MCP) endpoint and a REST API that return up‑to‑date limits with citations to official regulator sources. The service is open, requires no API key, and includes tools for money‑fact queries, scheme lookups, cross‑border checks, and pricing lists. Documentation is available via llms.txt and a GitHub docs repository.

providers.name: Basis Desk
providers.description: Basis Desk is an AI‑native crypto newsroom that delivers source‑verified news, live market data, and daily briefs without hype. It aggregates information from regulators, protocol teams, exchanges, and client releases, offering readers quick, sober insights into the cryptocurrency market.

providers.name: Baton Media
providers.description: Baton is a music collaboration and IP-management platform for unreleased music, built by Baton Media Inc. (New York, Techstars '23). It gives musicians, producers, managers, and talent scouts tools to securely upload, organize, version, and share unreleased tracks, beat packs, and sample libraries across iOS and web. A proprietary media player shows creators exactly who is listening to their material, while collaboration spaces (private, invite-only, or public), an in-app audio studio (looping, pitch shifting, EQ, effects, sample pairing), and a creator-to-fan marketplace support discovery, placement opportunities, and monetization. Baton is building collaboration protocols to track IP rights and automate crediting and compensation across the creator economy. As of this enrichment the company publishes a consumer product (iOS app + web) with no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Bevi
providers.description: Bevi is a smart beverage-dispenser company that manufactures connected, filtered-water machines for offices and commercial spaces. Its IoT-enabled Standup and Countertop dispensers deliver still and sparkling water plus dozens of fruit flavors and functional enhancements (vitamins, electrolytes, energy, focus), connect directly to a building's water supply, and track plastic bottles saved in real time. Bevi is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Techstars, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API surface (OpenAPI, docs, or developer portal) was found during enrichment; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Bindery
providers.description: Bindery (Bindery Books) is a community-driven, influencer-led book publishing platform and marketplace founded by Matt Kaye and Meg Harvey. It pairs established book "tastemakers" — social-media book reviewers and BookTok / Bookstagram creators — with emerging authors, letting each tastemaker run their own micro-imprint (Ezeekat Press, Boundless Press, Skies Press, and others), acquire titles, weigh in on creative decisions, and promote them to their communities in exchange for a share of net earnings. Often described as "Patreon meets publishing," Bindery combines traditional trade distribution and marketing with paid membership communities, a bookshop, exclusive reviews and author interviews, and iOS and Android apps. The company is backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Blur
providers.description: Blur is a New York-based NFT marketplace and aggregator built for professional traders on Ethereum, founded by the pseudonymous "Pacman" (Tieshun Roquerre) in October 2022 and backed by Paradigm and Standard Crypto. The flagship product, blur.io, offers zero marketplace fees, multi-marketplace sweeping, bulk listing/bidding, real-time mempool reveal sniping, and a portfolio-grade analytics surface that aggregates liquidity from OpenSea, X2Y2, LooksRare, and other Seaport-compatible venues. Blur also operates Blend, a peer-to-peer perpetual NFT lending protocol designed by Paradigm researchers that powers ETH-against-NFT borrowing and Buy-Now-Pay-Later flows without oracles or fixed expiries — Blend has captured the dominant share of NFT lending volume on Ethereum. The BLUR token, distributed via multi-season airdrop campaigns, governs the Blur DAO through the Blur Foundation. The same team launched Blast, an Ethereum L2 with native yield, which now hosts its own NFT activity. Blur does not publish an official public developer API or SDK; on-chain integration happens via the deployed marketplace and Blend smart contracts (Seaport-compatible), and marketplace data is reached through third-party indexers such as Bitquery, SimpleHash, and Alchemy rather than a Blur-operated REST or GraphQL endpoint.

providers.name: Boomerang
providers.description: Boomerang, from Baydin Inc, is a productivity software company founded in 2010 that builds email management and meeting scheduling tools. Its products include Boomerang for Gmail and Boomerang for Outlook browser extensions, Boomerang mobile apps for iOS and Android, and GQueues, a task manager for Google Workspace teams. Boomerang lets users schedule email to send later, snooze messages back to the inbox, track responses with read receipts and follow-up reminders, share availability and book meetings without back-and-forth, and use AI writing assistance. With over 2 million active customers, the platform has processed more than 500 million messages. Boomerang is a consumer and team-facing productivity suite delivered as browser extensions and apps rather than a developer API platform; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BuzzFeed
providers.description: BuzzFeed Inc. is a digital media company founded in 2006 and headquartered in New York City, best known for its viral entertainment, quizzes, pop-culture coverage, and commerce content. The company operates a portfolio of brands including the flagship BuzzFeed site, the news operation HuffPost, and the food brand Tasty, and produces video, podcasts, and shoppable content across web and social platforms. BuzzFeed is a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: BZFD) and monetizes through advertising, brand partnerships, and commerce. It does not publish a general-purpose public developer API program; its public machine-readable surface consists of content syndication (RSS feeds), an advertising/partnerships business, and a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure program via HackerOne. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from an a16z portfolio lead and enriched with the provider's real public surface.

providers.name: Candy Fanatics (fka Candy Digital)
providers.description: Candy Digital (branded simply as "Candy") is a digital collectibles platform operating at candy.io under the tagline "Crave. Collect. Connect." It is best known for officially licensed Major League Baseball (MLB) digital trading cards and NFT drops, sold through a consumer-facing, wallet-native web application for buying, collecting, and trading licensed digital collectibles. Founded in 2021 and backed by investors including Insight Partners, the company runs an active consumer product (e.g. the 2026 MLB Base Series drops). The former candy.com domain has since been divested and is now listed for acquisition via Hilco Digital Assets; the live brand and product run at candy.io. Candy Digital is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API program, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI — this profile captures its real public web surface.

providers.name: Carbon Clean
providers.description: Carbon Clean is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Careship
providers.description: Careship (operated by Care Companion GmbH, Berlin) is a German senior-care marketplace that connects elderly people and their families with vetted, non-medical everyday helpers ("Alltagshilfen") from their own neighborhoods. The platform covers companionship, shopping, household support, mobility and leisure, light personal care, and dementia support, and helps families finance care through statutory long-term care insurance (Pflegekasse). Careship operates across 20+ German cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, and Dresden. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Creandum; it is a consumer care-services business with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Carta Healthcare
providers.description: Carta Healthcare, Inc. is a San Francisco based clinical data management company that applies a "Hybrid Intelligence" model — proprietary AI paired with certified human clinical abstractors — to extract, validate and submit structured clinical data on behalf of hospitals and health systems. Its product family covers Voyager (the underlying AI data platform trained on electronic medical record content), Lighthouse and Atlas (AI-assisted clinical registry abstraction and submission, including the ACC NCDR, STS/ACC TVT and Vascular Quality Initiative registries), Navigator (clinical data intelligence and analytics), Harbor (cohort selection and clinical trial matching) and outsourced expert abstraction services. Carta Healthcare is an NCDR certified software vendor and has completed a Type 2 SOC 2 examination with an unqualified opinion covering security, availability and confidentiality. The company sells and integrates directly with hospital EMR environments under enterprise agreements; it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract on its public web surface.

providers.name: Cerebral
providers.description: Cerebral is an American telehealth company providing online mental health and wellness care, including therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management delivered through its website and mobile app on a subscription basis. Founded in 2020 by Kyle Robertson and Ho Anh, the company treats conditions such as depression, anxiety, insomnia, ADHD, and substance use disorder. Cerebral is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, which led a $300M Series C in December 2021 valuing the company at roughly $4.8B. Cerebral is a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public company and website properties.

providers.name: ChangEd
providers.description: ChangEd (Changed) is a consumer financial-technology company whose mobile app helps people pay off debt faster by automatically rounding up everyday purchases to the nearest dollar and directing those micro-savings toward student loans, credit cards, mortgages, personal loans, and auto loans. Founded by brothers Dan Stelmach and Nick Sky, the app launched in 2017, appeared on Shark Tank and took investment from Mark Cuban, and is a Techstars portfolio company. It links to a user's bank account, tracks spending, automates extra debt payments, supports savings goals, and visualizes payoff progress for a $4/month subscription, with banking services provided by nbkc bank (Member FDIC). ChangEd is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cheaf
providers.description: Cheaf is a mobile food-rescue marketplace that connects supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, and food retailers holding surplus inventory with consumers who buy it as discounted "surprise packages" at pickup, cutting food waste while helping merchants recover value on stock that would otherwise be thrown away. Founded in Mexico in 2020, the consumer app operates across Mexico, Chile, and Argentina, has more than 3.5 million users, and reports millions of kilograms of food rescued and greenhouse-gas emissions avoided. Businesses list surplus through a merchant onboarding portal and pay a commission on sales; consumers browse and reserve packages through the mobile app. This API Evangelist profile tracks Cheaf's public web and developer surface; Cheaf is a consumer/merchant mobile platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Cherrypick
providers.description: Cherrypick is a London-based food-tech company (backed by Speedinvest) behind an all-in-one meal-planning and grocery-shopping mobile app. The app helps home cooks discover personalized recipes tailored to their dietary preferences, automatically plan their weekly meals, and turn those plans into a supermarket basket at real supermarket prices for home delivery or in-store pickup. Positioned as a lower-cost alternative to recipe-box subscription services, Cherrypick combines recipe discovery, meal planning, and grocery ordering into a single consumer experience aimed at saving people time and money while reducing food waste. Cherrypick is a consumer mobile application with no public developer, API, or partner-integration surface at this time; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a network entity rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Chinese Medicine Online
providers.description: Chinese Medicine Online (中医在线) is a Beijing-based traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) continuing-education and academic-exchange platform, founded in 2015 and operated by Beijing Universe In Nutshell Technology Co., Ltd. (北京果壳宇宙教育科技有限公司) on behalf of the Beijing TCM Online Education Center (北京中医在线教育中心). Through its web platform at tcmmooc.com and its iOS/Android app, it publishes recorded and live video continuing-education courses from national TCM masters and senior practitioners, runs the 经方学社 (Classical Formulas Society) learning community and 精医社 membership, livestreams academic conferences, and sells course material through a paid knowledge marketplace. The company states a catalogue of roughly 19,600 courses from 3,900+ TCM experts and around 4 million registered users, the majority of them licensed practitioners. It has since extended into AI and SaaS for grassroots clinics, including the "Yi Yin" (伊尹) TCM classical-reasoning large language model launched in Songxian, Henan in September 2025, and clinic workflow tooling (prescription, patient and follow-up management). The platform is delivered strictly as an end-user web and mobile product — it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Citruslabs
providers.description: Citruslabs is a clinical research organization (CRO) that designs and runs clinical trials, consumer perception studies, and randomized controlled trials for consumer health brands across supplements, skincare, pet health, food and beverage, longevity, and women's health. It handles IRB approval, protocol design, participant recruitment, decentralized data collection, and statistical analysis, then turns results into regulator-reviewed, marketing-ready product claims for retailers, advertising, and packaging. Studies range from DIY consumer perception studies to full randomized controlled trials, typically completing in four to sixteen weeks.

providers.name: Coinsquare
providers.description: Coinsquare provides a platform for Canadians to buy, sell, and trade Bitcoin, Ethereum, and over 60 other cryptocurrencies. It operates as a CIRO‑registered investment dealer and marketplace member, offering more than 3,000 trading pairs and custodial services with external licensed custodians. The service includes identity verification to meet AML/KYC regulations and offers in‑app support for users.

providers.name: Conceive
providers.description: Conceive is a telehealth platform for fertility and pregnancy support. It offers 24/7 text access to fertility and pregnancy nurses, coaches, and dietitians, personalized fertility coaching, fertility test interpretation, virtual video visits with providers, expert-led community events, and an educational library. Membership is delivered through Conceive Plus and Conceive Premium tiers. The company is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. As a consumer telehealth app it publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its published identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Dawaai
providers.description: Dawaai is Pakistan's leading digital healthcare platform, operating a licensed online pharmacy alongside telehealth and diagnostic services. Founded on a licensed retail pharmacy (License #1265, 2014) and headquartered in Karachi, Dawaai lets patients order authentic prescription and OTC medicines for temperature-controlled doorstep delivery, book doctor and mental-health consultations, order home-based lab tests and checkups, arrange home nursing and medical services, and subscribe to chronic-care programs for diabetes and obesity. It is a LegitScript-certified healthcare merchant that sources directly from manufacturers and distributors, with qualified pharmacists handling procurement, storage, and dispensing. Dawaai is backed by 500 Global and operates across Pakistan, including Karachi and Rawalpindi. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via the venture portfolio pipeline; Dawaai publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Dawn
providers.description: Dawn (Sleepedy, Inc. dba Dawn) is a digital-health company offering a clinician-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) program delivered through a mobile app. The service pairs users with licensed sleep coaches and therapists for weekly video sessions and between-session chat, daily 5-7 minute sleep lessons, live sleep-performance insights, and weekly progress reports, with the goal of treating primary and chronic insomnia and reducing reliance on sleep medication. Dawn is in-network with major U.S. insurers (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, United Healthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and offers an employer/enterprise workplace-wellness program. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Dawn publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Defense Logistics Agency
providers.description: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is the U.S. Department of Defense combat support agency that manages a global supply chain spanning roughly five million items in nine supply chains plus storage, distribution, fuel, construction, and disposition missions. DLA operates an extensive catalog of business applications used by suppliers, the military services, and federal partners. Most DLA applications require account registration and operate behind authentication; public-facing surfaces include the DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS), the DLA Disposition Services storefront, the FedMall procurement marketplace, and federated logistics search tools.

providers.name: Defense Security Cooperation Agency
providers.description: The Defense Security Cooperation Agency (DSCA) is the U.S. Department of Defense agency that leads, directs, and manages security cooperation programs and resources to support U.S. policy and interests with foreign partners. DSCA administers the Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program, Foreign Military Financing (FMF) execution, International Military Education and Training (IMET), and humanitarian assistance programs. Public-facing surfaces include the Major Arms Sales notifications published in cooperation with Congress, the DSCA newsroom and library, and the Security Cooperation Workforce certification portal. DSCA does not publish a general-purpose developer API; partner-nation systems interact through controlled, government-to-government channels such as the Security Cooperation Information Portal (SCIP).

providers.name: Defense Threat Reduction Agency
providers.description: The Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) is the U.S. Department of Defense combat support agency that counters and deters weapons of mass destruction (WMD) and improvised threats. DTRA leads the chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and high-yield explosive (CBRNE) mission for DoD and supports the Cooperative Threat Reduction (CTR) Program with partner nations. Public-facing surfaces include the DTRA website, the DTRA Information Analysis Center (DTRIAC) for technical reports, the DTRA Mission Network public information, and small-business and broad-agency-announcement procurement portals. DTRA does not publish a general-purpose developer API; partner systems interact through controlled, government-to-government channels.

providers.name: Divi Official
providers.description: Divi Official Inc. (Divi Growth Care) is a direct-to-consumer haircare and scalp-care brand formulated "for women by women," selling vegan, science-backed serums, shampoos, conditioners and supplements aimed at the hair-growth journey. The company operates an e-commerce storefront hosted on Shopify at diviofficial.com, with a subscription "Club Divi" program, a content blog, and a customer-account experience. Divi is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It is a consumer packaged goods / beauty commerce business and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the only machine-readable surfaces on its domain are the Shopify Customer Accounts OAuth/OIDC discovery documents that the storefront platform exposes. This profile captures the company's public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: DJZS
providers.description: DJZS AI, LLC provides deterministic pre‑execution audit services for autonomous trading agents. It reads the reasoning behind a trade and refuses it when the reason does not hold up, protecting bots from bad trades. The platform offers five free verdicts per day and charges 2.00 USDC per receipt on Base mainnet, with on‑chain proof of audit. It serves markets like Kalshi, Polymarket, Hyperliquid perps, and treasury bots, aiming to prevent erroneous orders before they fire.

providers.name: Dollar Shave
providers.description: Dollar Shave Club is a direct-to-consumer men's grooming and personal-care brand founded in 2011 and acquired by Unilever in 2016, best known for pioneering the subscription razor model that ships blades, shave butter, skincare and body-care products to members on a recurring schedule. The company sells through its own e-commerce storefront (dollarshaveclub.com, built on Shopify) as well as retail channels, offering razor handles and cartridges, grooming kits and gift sets. It surfaces in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Dollar Shave Club does not operate a public developer program or documented API; its digital surface is a consumer Shopify storefront whose only machine-discoverable interface is Shopify's customer-account OAuth/OIDC (including a customer-account MCP API scope) exposed at the store's /.well-known/ discovery endpoints.

providers.name: DubClub
providers.description: DubClub is an all-in-one platform to create and join sports betting communities. It is a marketplace connecting sports betting content creators known as cappers or handicappers with subscribers who want timely, reliable betting picks and analysis. Creators monetize their expertise by selling picks and predictions through paid subscriptions, while subscribers receive content directly via notifications and messaging rather than scattered across social media and Discord. DubClub has facilitated tens of millions in payments for creators and delivered hundreds of millions of messages containing informational sports betting content. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital; DubClub publishes a consumer web product and does not expose a public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Emporia Energy
providers.description: Emporia Energy provides smart energy monitoring and management solutions for residential and commercial customers. Their platform offers real-time electricity usage data, device control, and insights to help users reduce consumption and save on utility bills. Through a robust API, developers can integrate energy data, control smart devices, and build applications that promote energy efficiency and sustainability across the IoT ecosystem.

providers.name: Endowus
providers.description: Endowus is a Singapore- and Hong Kong-based digital wealth management platform founded in 2017 by Gregory Van and Samuel Rhee. It gives retail, accredited, and private-wealth clients access to low-fee institutional share-class funds, advised and self-directed portfolios, and private-market and alternatives strategies across Cash, CPF (Central Provident Fund), and SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) accounts. Its conflict-free model rebates 100% of trailer fees and fund-manager commissions to clients. Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (CMS License 101051), serves 300,000+ clients, and manages over US$10 billion in assets. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company operates consumer apps but publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Ethos Systems
providers.description: Ethos Systems is an AI-powered human readiness platform that unifies learning, performance, and outcomes management in a single system built for enterprise and government deployment across both commercial and classified networks. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Ethos delivers personalized training with algorithm-driven interventions, rapid AI content development, and real-time readiness dashboards that connect learning to operational outcomes. It serves the U.S. military, federal civilian agencies, life sciences, manufacturing, freight and logistics, hospitality, athletics, utilities, insurance, and government contractors, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the Westly Group, and Pear VC. The company operates the Ethos and Learn to Win platforms; its developer and product documentation is gated behind authentication and it exposes no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Ezra
providers.description: Ezra (Ezra AI, Inc.) is a preventive-health company offering full-body MRI and CT cancer-screening scans directly to consumers. Its screening service scans up to 13 organs in as little as 22 minutes to detect early signs of cancer and hundreds of other conditions without harmful radiation, with plans spanning a full-body MRI, MRI with spine, a comprehensive skeletal/neurological MRI, and heart and lung CT scans, plus couples pricing and locations across the United States. Ezra was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp; this profile is a consumer healthcare company with no public developer API, and was enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline against its public web surface.

providers.name: Factris
providers.description: Factris is a European fintech that provides invoice financing (factoring) for small and medium-sized enterprises, converting unpaid B2B invoices into working capital within 24 hours. Its services span invoice financing, debtor management and collections, credit insurance, and credit-risk assessment, delivered through the self-service FAB platform where customers upload invoices and track payments. Factris operates across the Netherlands, Lithuania, and other European markets and has financed over two billion euros in receivables. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is being enriched in the API Evangelist network; Factris publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Fightcamp
providers.description: FightCamp is a consumer connected-fitness company that sells an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system combining physical equipment (a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and Bluetooth motion-tracking punch trackers) with a subscription app of on-demand classes led by professional fighters. The trackers use motion sensors and AI to measure punch output, speed, and workout stats, syncing to a member app and customer dashboard for progress tracking. FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer hardware-plus-membership business (backed by IVP) and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, commerce, support, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fiture
providers.description: Fiture is a consumer smart-home fitness company that makes interactive AI-powered fitness mirrors for at-home workouts. Its hardware line includes the Fiture Core flagship mirror and the compact Fiture Mini, each pairing a wall-mounted display with a camera and on-device AI that delivers real-time motion tracking, gesture recognition, rep counting, and posture feedback across a library of live and on-demand fitness classes sold through a membership. The company was founded in China and is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Fiture operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership website but does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or SDK; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its public web surface (support, legal, and account pages).

providers.name: Frontera
providers.description: Frontera (Frontera Health) is an AI-assisted clinical documentation company for behavioral health. Its software automates assessment and diagnosis report writing for Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and clinical psychologists working in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and autism care, cutting report time from 6-10 hours to 2-3 hours. The platform pairs a BCBA-trained AI Assessment Builder and Diagnosis Builder with digital phenotyping, and is delivered as a HIPAA-compliant web application (customer login at portal.fronterahealth.com) rather than a public API. Frontera is a venture-backed portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and security surface; as of this pass Frontera publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Goodfellow
providers.description: Goodfellow (Goodfellow Advanced Materials) is a global specialty-materials supplier founded in 1946 and headquartered in Cambridgeshire, United Kingdom, serving research, prototyping and specialized manufacturing markets in more than 111 countries. Its catalog spans over 70,000 stocked products drawn from 700+ different materials in many forms, including metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, compounds and glass, alongside custom fabrication and laboratory testing services. Customers include universities, government research facilities, laboratories and advanced manufacturers, served through subsidiaries in the United States, China, France and Germany. Goodfellow was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2021 to help digitize its operations and fund materials acquisitions. Goodfellow is a business-to-business e-commerce and catalog operation; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks.

providers.name: Groover
providers.description: Groover is a music promotion platform that connects independent artists and their representatives with a network of more than 3,000 vetted music-industry professionals — playlist curators, bloggers, journalists, radio stations, record labels, and managers. Artists submit a track and spend credits ("Grooviz", roughly €2 each) to reach individual curators, and Groover guarantees personalized feedback within seven days or refunds the credit. Founded in Paris in 2018, the company also operates Temple by Groover, a fanbase-growth toolset. Groover runs a consumer web application on a credit-based, pay-per-submission model and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Grove Collaborative
providers.description: Grove Collaborative is a digital-first consumer products company and online marketplace for sustainable everyday household essentials — eco-friendly cleaning supplies, bamboo and recycled paper products, personal care, beauty, pet, and vitamins & supplements from hundreds of vetted brands. Orders meet strict ingredient standards and are carbon neutral, and the company operates as a plastic-neutral, sustainability-focused retailer sold through grove.co (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and retail partners. Grove is a public benefit company (NYSE: GROV) that was an early portfolio company of 500 Global and Bullpen Capital. It publishes no first-party developer API or public developer program; this profile captures its public web, security, and Shopify-platform discovery surface.

providers.name: HealthEquity
providers.description: HealthEquity is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The HealthEquity API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Heartbeat Health
providers.description: Heartbeat Health is a New York-based modern cardiology practice delivering remote and virtual cardiovascular care. The company combines early detection, home-based cardiac diagnostics, remote patient monitoring, risk stratification and evidence-based care coordination to proactively identify, treat and manage moderate-to-high cardiovascular risk. It serves hospitals and health systems, payors and employer groups, providers and ACOs, and in-home care providers, reporting outcomes such as 90%+ of patients reaching target blood pressure and a 53% reduction in cardiac readmissions. Backed by Optum Ventures, DaVita Venture Group and Echo Health Ventures, it is a care-delivery organization rather than a public API provider; no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Helu Io
providers.description: helu.io is a financial management, controlling, and reporting platform for startups and small-to-medium businesses. It connects directly to DATEV accounting data (via a certified DATEVconnect interface) to produce automated, real-time financial reports, customizable dashboards and KPIs, budget vs. actuals comparisons, multi-entity consolidation, and planning, so finance teams can analyze, plan, and collaborate without manual spreadsheet work. The company is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and hosts data on German servers in compliance with DSGVO/GDPR. helu.io is a SaaS product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI — its integrations are product-level (DATEV, plus data upload from HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Excel, and Personio).

providers.name: Highbeam
providers.description: Highbeam is a business banking and finance platform built for modern consumer brands (direct-to-consumer and e-commerce). It brings together operating and high-yield accounts, a charge card that pays cashback on advertising spend, working capital and credit lines, automated bill pay, and spend intelligence, alongside Luma, an applied-AI finance assistant. Banking services are delivered through partner banks (Thread Bank, member FDIC) and Airwallex. Highbeam is based in New York City. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this entry captures the company identity, its public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Icite
providers.description: Icite provides an Identity Intelligence Platform for Security Operations, enabling correlation of identity, access, and activity across all connected systems. It helps detect threats that traditional EDR, cloud, and SIEM solutions miss, offering comprehensive ITDR capabilities for enterprises seeking unified security visibility and response.

providers.name: Impress
providers.description: Impress (legal entity Smile2Impress SL) is a Barcelona-founded chain of clear-aligner orthodontic clinics, launched in 2019 by Vladimir Lupenko, Diliara Lupenko and Dr. Khaled Kasem, and today Europe's largest invisible-orthodontics clinic network. It runs 110+ doctor-led clinics across ten countries — Spain, Italy, Portugal, France, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, Ukraine and the United States — has treated more than 500,000 patients, and pairs in-clinic 3D intraoral scanning and patented diagnostics with AI-assisted treatment planning and remote monitoring through its patient mobile app. Impress publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, CLI, status page, changelog or machine-readable specification of any kind: contract discovery found no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, MCP server, A2A agent card or .well-known document on any host it operates. Its one API host, api.smile2impress.com, is the private backend for the Impress patient app and the Impress Clinics practitioner app; it resolves and is live but answers HTTP 403 to every anonymous request, including every spec and .well-known path probed. Its GitHub organization, github.com/smile2impress, is real but carries only internal engineering tooling — five forks of Node.js/TypeScript infrastructure libraries and one first-party static-analysis tool, fe-explorer — and no client library for any Impress service. Products sold are orthodontic treatment, retainers and teeth whitening, priced and booked through the consumer site.

providers.name: Invygo
providers.description: Invygo is a car subscription and flexible rental platform founded in 2018 in Dubai, offering an alternative to traditional car ownership across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers subscribe to a car on a weekly or monthly basis, or enroll in a 36-month, Sharia-compliant "Subscribe to Own" plan, with insurance, maintenance, registration, and roadside assistance bundled into an all-inclusive fee and no deposit, salary certificate, or bank loan required. Invygo reports 20,000+ active subscriptions across 15+ cities in the GCC. There is no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its public web, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: joinzoe
providers.description: JoinZoe (operating as ZOE) is a gut‑health science company that translates world‑leading research into everyday nutrition products and services. It runs the world’s largest gut‑health and nutrition study, amassing a database of over 300,000 DNA‑sequenced gut samples. Through its app, supplements, food products, and scientific podcasts, ZOE aims to improve the health of millions by providing personalized nutrition advice based on cutting‑edge microbiome science.

providers.name: Jome
providers.description: Jome is a real estate technology marketplace for buying new construction homes, describing itself as the most joyful way to buy a new home in the age of AI. Buyers can search and compare thousands of new-construction homes and communities from multiple builders, view pricing and builder incentives, instantly book and confirm home tours, and receive AI-powered personalized recommendations, with new-home experts guiding them from contract to closing. Jome operates as a licensed real estate brokerage across 18+ U.S. metros, primarily in Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Arizona, Georgia, Colorado, South Carolina, and Tennessee, and runs dedicated portals for builders and agents. Backed by Techstars. Jome publishes no public API or developer program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence.

providers.name: Katoomi
providers.description: Katoomi provides Katoomi Connect, a native NetSuite integration platform offering pre‑built bidirectional data flows between NetSuite and eCommerce, marketplace, and marketing systems such as Shopify, Mirakl, Extensiv, Klaviyo, Loop Returns, PayPal, and more. The solution runs entirely inside NetSuite as a SuiteApp, eliminating middleware and external hosting, and supports real‑time sync of orders, inventory, customers, and payouts. Katoomi aims to simplify complex integrations for enterprises, delivering a low‑code, scalable connector ecosystem that enhances operational efficiency and reduces integration overhead.

providers.name: Kibin
providers.description: Kibin is a consumer study and academic-writing company operating at kibin.com, trusted by students since 2011. Its newest product is an AI-powered study partner (iOS app) that turns lectures, notes, PDFs, and YouTube videos into personalized study guides, quizzes, flashcards, transcripts, and explanations to help students learn faster and build mastery. Alongside the study app, Kibin also runs its long-standing academic-writing surface — professional essay editing, a paper grader, a thesis-statement generator, essay examples, and a writing blog. Kibin is a B2C, mobile- and web-delivered product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Kickstarter
providers.description: Kickstarter is a public-benefit crowdfunding platform where creators launch funding campaigns for creative projects — film, music, art, design, games, technology, publishing, and more — and backers pledge money to help bring them to life on an all-or-nothing funding model. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York, it has channeled billions of dollars in pledges to hundreds of thousands of successfully funded projects. Kickstarter does not currently operate a public developer API program or developer portal; its GraphQL and REST endpoints power its own web and mobile clients and are not documented for third-party integration. The company does maintain an active open-source GitHub organization (including its iOS and Android app source), a help center, and a company blog. This API Evangelist profile tracks Kickstarter's public developer, security, and platform surface for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: L'Oréal
providers.description: L'Oréal is the world's largest cosmetics and beauty company, producing skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance products. The group operates a portfolio of over 35 brands, including Lancôme, Maybelline, Garnier, NYX Professional Makeup, Kérastase, La Roche-Posay, and Kiehl's, sold in over 150 countries. L'Oréal's primary developer surface is the ModiFace platform (a wholly owned subsidiary), which exposes an AR virtual try-on SDK and API for partner brands and retailers. L'Oréal Group itself does not operate a general-purpose corporate developer portal.

providers.name: LabLabee
providers.description: LabLabee is an AI-powered enablement, testing and troubleshooting platform for telecom teams, positioning itself as "the Copilot for Telco Engineers." The platform delivers on-demand, hands-on labs, sandboxes, learning paths and skill tests covering 4G/5G and Open RAN, IMS, network OAM, SDN and IP networking, telco cloud (OpenStack, OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker), DevOps and GitOps automation (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD), Linux, IAM and cybersecurity, and Industry 4.0 and IoT. Three AI capabilities sit on top of the lab catalog: AI Ask (search across telecom standards, vendor documentation and enterprise knowledge), AI Test (automated test execution and configuration validation) and AI Troubleshoot (automated trace analysis and root-cause identification). LabLabee serves telcos, universities, system integrators, network vendors and industrial private-network operators. Founded by Samir Tahraoui (CEO) and Mahfoud S. A. Mebarek (CPO), the company is backed by Accel, Kima Ventures, Reach Capital, Brighteye Ventures and 500 Global, and has been recognized as Best Telecom Startup by the World Communication Awards and with the TM Forum Growth Challenge Award. As of this enrichment pass LabLabee publishes no public developer program - no API documentation, API reference, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI or public package artifacts were found on any of its surfaces.

providers.name: LawTrades
providers.description: LawTrades is a legal talent marketplace, founded in 2016, that matches companies with vetted independent attorneys, paralegals, and legal operations professionals on flexible, on-demand terms rather than through traditional law firms or ALSPs. The platform covers eleven practice areas — commercial contracts, corporate law, data privacy and cyber security, intellectual property, labor and employment, legal operations, litigation, M&A, product counsel, real estate, and regulatory compliance — and handles matching, work-log management, invoicing, payments, and real-time spend analytics in-product. A human-in-the-loop AI layer drafts documents and flags risk for lawyer review. LawTrades raised a $6M Series A backed by 500 Global, Draper Associates, Social Capital, and AngelList. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Lica
providers.description: Lica is an AI research company building a substrate to train and evaluate AI models to be capable design partners across expressions of taste and consumption. Its research spans spatial reasoning and composition, layout generation and editing, vector-graphics (SVG) understanding, personalization and brand identity, and animation generation. Lica publishes the LICA dataset of layered graphic-design compositions and GDB (Graphic Design Benchmark), a real-world benchmark that scores frontier models on designer workflows across layout, typography, infographics, template semantics and animation. The company is backed by Accel, South Park Commons and Village Global. As of July 2026 Lica ships no public API, developer portal or API reference; product access is an email waitlist and its public developer surface is the lica-world GitHub organization, including the first-party DesignMCP MCP server.

providers.name: Marcopolo Learning
providers.description: MarcoPolo Learning is an award-winning early childhood education technology company, founded in 2013, that builds premium video content, instructional support, and learning apps for preschool and kindergarten. Its products include MarcoPolo For Educators (curriculum-aligned classroom video and educator guides), MarcoPolo For Families (Emmy-nominated videos plus literacy and math games), MarcoPolo World School (kindergarten readiness), MarcoPolo Professional Development for teachers, and The Polos animated series. The company was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass MarcoPolo Learning publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface; it is a consumer/educator app business, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Material Bank
providers.description: Material Bank is a B2B digital marketplace that lets architects, interior designers, and other design professionals search, sample, and specify building and design materials from 650+ brands across hundreds of categories through a single platform, with free overnight sample delivery. The platform provides project boards, brand collections, sustainability filters (EPDs, CDPH), and a manufacturer portal for brands. Backed by bain-capital-ventures and general-catalyst. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: MEAL PLANET
providers.description: MealPlanet (MEAL PLANET HOLDING LTD) is a UAE-based foodtech company, founded in 2024 by Khalid Baareh, that operates a meal-plan aggregation marketplace. Its consumer mobile app lets customers browse, compare, and subscribe to more than 500 personalised meal plans from 100+ trusted brands across the UAE, filtering by goal, calories, and dietary preferences, with flexible delivery and nutrition tracking. In 2024 the company closed a $6M seed round led by Middle East Venture Partners (MEVP) with participation from Sanabil 500 (the Sanabil Accelerator by 500 Global), AlTouq Group, Faith Capital, and Alturki Ventures, funding regional expansion beginning with Saudi Arabia. MealPlanet is a consumer-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mindbloom
providers.description: Mindbloom is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering at-home ketamine-assisted therapy for anxiety, depression, and PTSD, combining psychiatric clinician oversight, guided therapeutic sessions, and peer support. Clients complete a psychiatric evaluation, receive either sublingual tablets or subcutaneous injectable treatments, and are supported through a structured program with monitoring and integration guidance. The company reports having facilitated over 200,000 ketamine therapy sessions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, or developer documentation — Mindbloom is a consumer healthcare service, not an API provider.

providers.name: Modern Fertility
providers.description: Modern Fertility is a women's health company offering at-home fertility and hormone testing along with pregnancy, ovulation and prenatal products. Its flagship Modern Fertility Hormone Test lets people measure reproductive hormones from home and review results with providers. The company was acquired by telehealth provider Ro and is now operated as part of Ro: modernfertility.com redirects to ro.co/fertility and the brand's products, accounts, legal terms and security program are served under the parent Ro platform. Modern Fertility exposes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks it as a consumer health brand within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mozi
providers.description: Mozi is a private social network mobile app founded by Twitter and Medium co-founder Ev Williams and Molly DeWolf Swenson, and backed by Obvious Ventures. Rather than public profiles or follower counts, Mozi privately matches your phone contacts so you learn when friends are in the same city, attending the same events, or checking in nearby — designed to spark in-person "social serendipity" and get people off their screens. Launched in December 2024 and available in 135+ countries, Mozi is a consumer iOS/Android application with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Myclubs
providers.description: Myclubs is a Vienna- and Zurich-based digital sports membership company, founded in 2014 by Tobias Homberger, that gives members flexible access to a network of more than 1,200 sports and fitness providers across Austria and Switzerland through a single subscription. One membership covers over 35 sport and activity types and more than 10,000 bookable workouts per week, from gyms and yoga studios to tennis, boxing and cross training. Myclubs also runs a corporate fitness program used by over 300 employers as an employee benefit. The company was acquired by Urban Sports Club in August 2024 and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Myclubs is a consumer-facing membership brand and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: myLaurel
providers.description: myLaurel is a New York-based healthcare company delivering acute and transitional care in patients' homes. Its hybrid model pairs hands-on clinical teams with virtual technology support to prevent unnecessary hospitalizations, free critical hospital bed space, improve patient outcomes, and lower the total cost of care for both health systems and health plans. Reported results include a 49% reduction in 30-day readmissions, an average 1.5-day length-of-stay reduction, a 97 Net Promoter Score, and 3:1+ ROI within 90 days. myLaurel is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This profile has been enriched from the company's public web surface; it currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: NoBroker
providers.description: NoBroker Technologies Solutions Pvt Ltd is an Indian proptech company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bengaluru, that operates a brokerage-free real estate marketplace connecting property owners directly with tenants and buyers across Indian metros. Beyond listings for flats, houses, villas, plots, PGs and commercial space, NoBroker sells adjacent home services — rental and lease agreement drafting, legal assistance, packers and movers, painting and cleaning, home loans and rent payments — and operates NoBrokerHood, a gated-community and housing-society management / ERP product covering visitor management, billing, accounting and complaints. NoBroker became India's first proptech unicorn in 2021. The company ships software only as an end-user web and mobile product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its application endpoints under /api/v1..v5 are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Novel Effect
providers.description: Novel Effect is a Techstars-backed interactive read-aloud technology company whose voice-recognition platform listens as a person reads a children's picture book aloud and plays perfectly synchronized music, sound effects, and character voices in response, turning any book into an immersive shared experience. Delivered through iOS, Android, and web apps, Novel Effect is used by families, teachers, and libraries to make reading aloud more engaging for young children. Novel Effect is a consumer and education (EdTech) product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: numeratica-com
providers.description: Numeratica provides a developer-first API suite for U.S. household finance calculations, offering 76 calculators covering retirement, tax, Social Security, equity compensation, insurance, education funding, mortgages, benefits, debt, and portfolio mechanics. It includes a batch endpoint for up to 20 calculations per call, ensuring deterministic and reproducible results. The platform emphasizes security with API key authentication and public health probes, and offers extensive documentation, quickstart guides, and a changelog for developers.

providers.name: Nutmeg (J.P. Morgan Personal Investing)
providers.description: Nutmeg is a UK digital wealth manager and robo-advisor founded in 2011 and acquired by JPMorgan Chase in 2021, now operating as J.P. Morgan Personal Investing. It offers consumer investment accounts including Stocks and Shares ISAs, Lifetime ISAs, Junior ISAs, personal pensions, and general investment accounts, with fully managed, Smart Alpha, socially responsible, thematic, fixed allocation, and income portfolio strategies plus free financial guidance and paid advice. Nutmeg is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA register #552016). It is a consumer-facing wealth platform and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Omatic Software
providers.description: Omatic Software provides cloud-based integration and data management solutions tailored for nonprofit organizations. Their platform enables seamless data flow between fundraising, donor management, and financial systems, offering features such as data transformation, record matching, deduplication, and bulk cleanup. By centralizing data, Omatic helps nonprofits improve operational efficiency, ensure data accuracy, and support strategic decision‑making across various departments.

providers.name: Onebrief
providers.description: Onebrief is a defense-technology company building a unified command workspace for military planning, decision-making, and staff collaboration. The web-based platform centralizes live, synchronized operational data into reusable "Cards" that produce C2 charts, maps, timelines, presentations, documents, and whiteboards from live data rather than static content, with doctrine-aware AI assistance (built on Anthropic Claude) that anticipates dependencies and surfaces critical information early. In August 2024 Onebrief launched a policy-aware, versioned API that accepts data in common DoD formats and connects key mission systems such as Maven Smart System and Advana into a live, shared mission picture, supporting bidirectional data flow across classified and unclassified networks (SIPR, NIPR, JWICS) in alignment with JADC2 data interoperability goals. Backed by Battery Ventures, General Catalyst, Insight Partners, and Sapphire Ventures. The API is a government-deployed product with no public developer portal, specification, or self-serve base URL.

providers.name: OpenDNS
providers.description: OpenDNS is a cloud-delivered recursive DNS and internet security service founded in 2005 and acquired by Cisco in 2015, where its enterprise capabilities now form the foundation of the Cisco Umbrella platform. OpenDNS continues to offer free consumer products - OpenDNS Home and OpenDNS Family Shield - providing recursive DNS resolution, phishing and malware blocking, and content filtering with parental controls across every device on a home network, all managed through the OpenDNS dashboard. Enterprise DNS-layer security, secure web gateway, and the Investigate threat-intelligence API have migrated to Cisco Umbrella (umbrella.cisco.com). Added to the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company in the cybersecurity sector.

providers.name: Orbitel
providers.description: Orbitel is an Indian Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS) provider offering SMS, WhatsApp, Voice, Email, and RCS solutions. The company markets enterprise‑grade messaging infrastructure with regulatory compliance, high delivery uptime, and multi‑channel support. While Orbitel promotes its services on its website, it does not publicly expose API documentation or specifications, focusing instead on reseller and enterprise sales channels.

providers.name: Outsite
providers.description: Outsite is a coliving and community platform for remote workers, digital nomads, and distributed teams. It operates a global network of fully-furnished coliving spaces, curated stays, and cowork cafes across more than twenty destinations including Lisbon, Barcelona, Bali, Oaxaca, and Costa Rica, pairing dedicated coworking areas and fast WiFi with a built-in community of remote professionals. Outsite sells yearly and lifetime memberships, curated month-long Outsite Trips, and team retreat and business membership offerings for companies. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Outsite is a consumer hospitality and travel brand and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: pdfzen-site
providers.description: pdfzen.site provides an HTML‑to‑PDF rendering service via a REST API. Developers can POST HTML or template data to receive PDF bytes, use stored templates, and integrate with AI agents through the x402 pay‑per‑render protocol. The platform offers free starter credits, volume‑based pricing, and browser‑based tools for one‑off PDF tasks. Documentation, SDKs, and webhooks are publicly available.

providers.name: Petsapp
providers.description: PetsApp is a veterinary client engagement and practice communication platform used by more than 1,000 veterinary practices worldwide, with millions of pets registered and millions of dollars in payments processed. It gives clinics two-way SMS and in-app messaging, appointment booking, video consultations, digital payments, wellness and health-care plan management, automated reminders, and a lightweight CRM for building client relationships. PetsApp does not publish a public developer portal or open API; API access and documentation are offered privately to technology and PIMS integration partners through its partner program, and its public docs subdomain is a Jira Service Management customer help center rather than API reference documentation.

providers.name: Pharmeasy
providers.description: PharmEasy is one of India's largest digital healthcare platforms, operating a consumer online pharmacy and health marketplace at pharmeasy.in. It lets users order prescription and over-the-counter medicines (with prescription upload and verification), buy health and wellness products, book diagnostic lab tests and health checkup packages, and consult doctors via telemedicine, plus a PLUS subscription for recurring savings. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. PharmEasy runs an internal API at api.pharmeasy.in but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI; it does operate a responsible-disclosure security program (infosec@pharmeasy.in). Sector: healthcare / e-pharmacy.

providers.name: Picnic
providers.description: Picnic is a London-based, privacy-first photo-organization app for iOS that helps people declutter and organize their camera roll through a swipe-based, gamified experience — sorting photos into albums, comparing and removing duplicate shots, building streaks, and resurfacing "on this day" memories. All processing happens on-device, so photos never leave the user's phone: no cloud upload, no ads, and no tracking or selling of user data. Founded in 2019 and a certified B Corporation, Picnic grew to more than 1.5 million users and roughly €4M ARR before being acquired by Paris-based mobile app publisher MWM in April 2026. Picnic is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pipy
providers.description: Pipy is a high-performance, programmable network proxy designed for cloud, edge, and IoT environments. Written in C++ with an embedded JavaScript engine (PipyJS), it provides a small footprint, broad CPU architecture support, and a modular filter-based architecture for protocol conversion, traffic recording, message signing, and other networking tasks. Pipy is developed by Flomesh.

providers.name: Plum
providers.description: Plum is a UK-based personal finance "money app" that helps consumers save and invest automatically. Its mobile app pairs automated savings algorithms (eight saving automations) with a range of regulated products including Easy Access Savings, a Cash ISA, a 95-day Notice Account, a money-market Interest pocket, a Stocks & Shares ISA, a Self-Invested Personal Pension (SIPP), and access to thousands of stocks and funds. Plum operates under FCA oversight through multiple entities covering payment services, e-money, investment broking, and account information services, and monetizes via subscription tiers (Basic, Plus, Boost, Max). It is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Partech and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Premise
providers.description: Premise is a global data-intelligence platform that combines machine learning with a distributed network of on-the-ground human contributors to collect, structure, and analyze local ground-truth data across 140+ countries. The platform reports 6M+ contributors, 25M+ submissions per year, and 2.3M+ unique points of interest, and serves three primary markets: precision mapping and geospatial intelligence, international development, and public-sector organizations. Premise is a portfolio company of a16z, Anthemis, and GV. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; data is delivered through managed engagements and its customer platform.

providers.name: Presso
providers.description: Presso is a garment-care automation company (operated by parent LaundrySucks.io Inc.) that builds robotic, AI-driven systems for dry cleaning and laundry businesses. Its flagship AirTouch product is a compact, plug-and-play unit that runs on a standard 110V outlet and combines automatic fabric recognition, built-in non-toxic cleaning formulas, and smart temperature control to deliver same-day wash, fold, and dry cleaning under one roof. Presso positions itself around faster, greener, and gentler garment care without compressors, boilers, or skilled labor. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Presso publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface — it is a hardware/robotics and equipment business, not an API provider.

providers.name: PromptPoint
providers.description: PromptPoint provides a no‑code platform that enables teams to design, test, and deploy prompt configurations for large language models at speed. Their playground lets users create and organize prompts, run automated tests, and evaluate outputs to ensure high‑quality LLM responses. With features like collaborative prompt engineering, versioning, and integration with hundreds of models, PromptPoint aims to make prompt development predictable and scalable for both technical and non‑technical users. The service offers a free tier, pricing plans for teams, and comprehensive documentation covering getting started, API reference, and best practices.

providers.name: Protolabs
providers.description: Protolabs provides rapid prototyping and on‑demand production services, offering digital manufacturing across injection molding, CNC machining, 3D printing, and sheet‑metal fabrication. Customers can upload CAD files, receive instant quotes, and order low‑volume production parts with fast lead times. The company serves engineers, product developers, and manufacturers worldwide, emphasizing quick turnaround, material variety, and automated manufacturing workflows.

providers.name: Q Bio
providers.description: Q Bio is a Redwood City, California health-technology company offering the Q Exam and the Q Bio Health Dashboard, sold directly at its clinic and through enterprise partners. The Q Exam is a comprehensive preventive-health assessment that combines whole-body non-contrast MRI, 120+ blood biomarkers, analysis of 163 risk-relevant genes, wearable data, medical history, and board-certified physician review into a single longitudinal health baseline. Imaging is quantified by Constellation, the company's FDA-cleared AI image-analysis software that segments organs and measures anatomy, and results are stored in the Q Bio Health Dashboard for year-over-year comparison. Q Bio is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Qeepsake
providers.description: Qeepsake is a family memory-keeping and baby-journaling service that helps parents capture their children's milestones and everyday moments by responding to scheduled text prompts or free-journaling in the mobile app, then turning those entries into digital and printed family storybooks. Operated by Tinybeans USA Ltd, Qeepsake is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with membership tiers; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass.

providers.name: Quadric
providers.description: Quadric is a semiconductor IP company based in Burlingame, California that licenses the Chimera GPNPU (general-purpose neural processing unit) processor IP and its accompanying software stack for on-device and edge AI inference. The Chimera architecture unifies scalar, vector, and matrix compute in a single fully C++ programmable core so both AI graph operators and classic DSP/C++ code run on one pipeline, giving SoC designers a future-proof target for evolving model roadmaps. Quadric ships a developer toolchain rather than a hosted web API: the cloud-based DevStudio portal, the Chimera SDK (ONNX import from PyTorch and TensorFlow), the ChiPy Python programming interface, an LLVM-based C++ extensibility path, and an instruction-set simulator for pre-silicon performance modeling. This profile catalogs Quadric's developer surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Quinto Andar
providers.description: QuintoAndar is a Brazilian proptech real-estate marketplace that lets people rent and buy homes online without a guarantor, with digital visit scheduling, digital contract signing, rent and sale pricing intelligence (QPreço), owner financial management, and a real-estate consortium financing program. It operates a two-sided marketplace across major Brazilian cities including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre, Campinas, and Curitiba, earning revenue on rental and sales commissions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ribbit-capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found; the company does publish a security.txt with a Bugcrowd bug bounty program.

providers.name: Rational
providers.description: Rational (rational.to) is a Y Combinator (S26) company building AI employees, or "AI coworkers," for accounting and finance teams. Its AI agents onboard themselves to a firm, build a company "brain," and perform recurring accounting work — accounts payable, AR collections, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, document collection, expense review, and month-end close — while keeping postings, payment release, and policy-sensitive decisions behind explicit human approval gates with an inspectable review history. Founded in 2026 in San Francisco by Jibril Moinuddin and Christ Xu, Rational targets accounting firms and finance teams facing a structural capacity and labor shortage. As an early-stage company it currently exposes a marketing and agent-discovery surface (llms.txt, ai-discovery.json, RFC 9116 security.txt) rather than a public developer API; this profile captures that surface and will be enriched as a developer platform ships.

providers.name: Reflex Careers
providers.description: Reflex (Reflex Careers) is an on-demand labor platform for retail stores, connecting brands and store operators with vetted, background-checked associates for short-notice shift coverage. The platform handles employer-of-record responsibilities including payroll, tax withholding, and compliance, lets retailers post shifts with as little as two hours' notice, and uses a two-way review system to build worker track records and brand-specific training per shift. Reflex serves retail brands including Ariat, Faherty, Fossil, and Everlane and is backed by Canaan Partners. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Canaan Partners portfolio; as of this enrichment pass Reflex publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Renault Group
providers.description: Renault Group is the French automotive group behind the Renault, Dacia, Alpine and Mobilize brands. Its developer program, the Renault Group Developer Portal (developer.renaultgroup.com, launched May 2025), targets in-vehicle app development on the openR and openR evo infotainment platforms built on Android Automotive OS with Google Automotive Services: an RG Android SDK setup guide, public Android Automotive emulators for Renault 5 and Renault Scenic, UX/UI guidelines for driver-distraction-safe partner apps, and partner-only Android vehicle properties (onboard vehicle APIs and signals) for the software-defined-vehicle platform. No public web/REST API contract is published; vehicle access is onboard via the SDK.

providers.name: Replenysh
providers.description: Replenysh is an enterprise circularity platform that runs circular supply chains for brands and recovery facilities. It routes, recovers, verifies, and optimizes material recovery flows across a network of 5,000+ partners, giving enterprises a single control layer for reverse logistics with audit-ready chain-of-custody, pricing, settlement, and compliance documentation. Customers include PepsiCo, Disney, Marriott, and Live Nation. Backed by Kindred Ventures and M13. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Rever Moto
providers.description: REVER (Rever Moto) is a motorcycle-focused navigation, ride-tracking, and social platform for riders. It offers a web-based route planner and mobile apps (iOS, Android, and Apple CarPlay) that let motorcyclists discover more than 3,000 curated routes worldwide, plan and sync trips, record rides with offline GPS tracking, and get turn-by-turn voice navigation. Social features include live friend tracking, ride sharing, challenges, and stories. REVER offers a free tier and a paid "Pro" subscription, and partners with brands including Honda, Cycle Gear, and Quad Lock. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass REVER publishes no public developer API, documentation, or integration surface — it is a consumer mobile/web product.

providers.name: Rex Airlines
providers.description: Rex Airlines (Regional Express, IATA ZL / ICAO RXA) is Australia's second-largest regional carrier, headquartered in Mascot, New South Wales, flying a Saab 340 fleet to roughly 45 regional destinations across every Australian state. Formed in 2002 from the merger of Hazelton and Kendell Airlines, Rex entered voluntary administration in July 2024 and was acquired by US holding company Air T in December 2025 with Australian federal government debt support. In the distribution chain Rex is the inventory owner, not an intermediary — it runs Sabre's SabreSonic passenger service suite (inventory, reservations, ticketing, ancillaries, check-in) per Sabre's February 2021 announcement, sells direct through its own ASP.NET booking engine at ibe2.rex.com.au, and reaches trade through a web-only Travel Agent portal gated on an IATA, DAPA or TIDS agency number. Its API posture is honest to state plainly: no developer portal, no public documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC claim anywhere on rex.com.au. The only published trace of a programmatic interface is a bare "Request API Access" checkbox on the agent registration form — accreditation required, contract unspecified, nothing documented, and no exit path beyond a privacy-law request to the Customer Contact Centre.

providers.name: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD)
providers.description: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD) is the community-owned, not-for-profit electric utility serving Sacramento County, California. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI contract, open data portal, or Green Button Connect My Data developer program on its own domains as of 2026-10-13.

providers.name: Safely
providers.description: Safely (SafelyStay, Inc.) is an InsurTech company providing short-term rental insurance, guest screening, and travel insurance for vacation rental property managers and their guests. The Safely Protection Policy offers up to $1,000,000 in short-term rental insurance covering guest-caused accidental and intentional damage, theft, pet damage, and bodily injury liability, while its guest screening verifies guests before check-in. Safely connects to property management systems through turnkey partner integrations (Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Track, Streamline, Escapia, Lodgify, and more) rather than a public developer API. A Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network; this profile was enriched by the pipeline, which found no public API surface.

providers.name: Saysh
providers.description: Saysh is a direct-to-consumer athletic footwear and apparel brand founded by Olympic champion sprinter Allyson Felix, designing sneakers engineered specifically for women's biomechanics under the banner "Women Deserve Better." Its lineup spans performance running shoes (the Felix Runner and Evelyn Runner) and the everyday Saysh One, plus apparel, accessories, and the Saysh+ Run Club membership. The saysh.com storefront runs on Shopify, so customer-facing commerce is served through the Shopify platform rather than a first-party Saysh developer API; no public Saysh API program, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal were found. Backed by Redpoint Ventures.

providers.name: Secure Exchanges
providers.description: Secure Exchanges provides a Canadian‑based platform for confidential document exchange, encrypted email, and digital signatures. It enables organizations such as legal, finance, insurance, HR, healthcare, and education to send and receive messages, large files up to 25 GB, and signed documents with end‑to‑end encryption, self‑destruction, code protection, and event logs. The service complies with standards including GDPR, HIPAA, Quebec Law 25, and Adobe AATL.

providers.name: Shef
providers.description: Shef is a consumer marketplace for homemade food, connecting home cooks and chefs with nearby customers who order freshly prepared, culturally diverse meals delivered to their door. Cooks build a menu, take orders, and ship weekly; eaters browse local shefs, order meals, and reheat at home. The company operates a business-to-consumer web and mobile ordering experience and does not publish a public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or webhook surface. This API Evangelist profile was created as a lead from venture-capital portfolio data and enriched via live web and DNS/TLS probing; the honest result of that pass is that Shef exposes no public API artifacts, only a consumer storefront and standard company pages.

providers.name: Shweproperty
providers.description: Shweproperty (ShweProperty.com) is Myanmar's leading online real estate marketplace, founded in 2015, connecting buyers, renters, sellers, and agents across the country. The consumer-facing portal lists residential and commercial properties for sale and rent — apartments, condos, houses, land, shops, offices, and industrial zones — in Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, and beyond, alongside new-development project listings, home-loan assistance with Myanmar banking partners, property events and expos, and real estate news and buyer guides. The platform carries over 200,000 listings with 500+ added daily and handles tens of thousands of monthly sales inquiries. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this remains a consumer web and mobile property portal.

providers.name: Signos
