providers.description: Signos is a metabolic health technology company founded by Sharam Fouladgar-Mercer and Bill Tancer that pairs a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) sensor with an AI-powered mobile app to help people understand their individual metabolic responses to food and make data-driven lifestyle changes for weight management. In August 2025 Signos received FDA clearance as the first over-the-counter glucose monitoring system for weight loss, making it available without a prescription to adults not on insulin. The platform integrates with the Dexcom Stelo sensor, Apple Health, Google Health Connect, smartwatches and smart scales, delivers real-time glucose insights, personalized meal and movement recommendations, registered-dietitian support, and daily and weekly metabolism scores, with optional GLP-1 medication access through partner healthcare providers. Signos was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Slalom
providers.description: Slalom is a global business and technology consulting firm headquartered in Seattle, Washington, founded in 2001 and privately held, with roughly 12,000 employees across dozens of markets in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. The firm delivers strategy, artificial intelligence, data, cloud and engineering, customer experience, legacy modernization, digital product building, and privacy and security consulting, and operates the Slalom Build brand for custom software, data platform and product engineering work. Slalom is a delivery partner for Microsoft, AWS, Salesforce, Google Cloud, Adobe and NVIDIA. It sells consulting engagements rather than software, and publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; the machine-readable surface it does publish is an llms.txt at its marketing root and a security.txt on the Slalom Build site.

providers.name: Sol
providers.description: Sol Reader is a wearable e-reader — marketed as the world's first wearable e-reader — built by Sol and backed by Initialized Capital. The device is a lightweight (104g) headset with dual 1.3" 271ppi side-lit E Ink displays, adjustable diopter optics and IPD, a handheld remote, and 25+ hours of battery for a distraction-free reading experience. It reads a connected Kindle library and DRM-free EPUB uploads, offers the Sol Store with over one million titles, plus AI question-answering and an AutoPilot speed-reading mode. Sol is a consumer hardware company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Somnee
providers.description: Somnee is a consumer sleep-technology company behind a smart sleep headband that uses personalized neurostimulation to improve sleep. Developed over roughly eight years by a team of UC Berkeley neuroscientists (co-founders include sleep scientist Dr. Matthew Walker, Dr. Robert T. Knight, Dr. Rich Ivry, and CSTO Dr. Ram Gurumoorthy, with CEO Tim Rosa, former Fitbit CMO), the wearable pairs clinical-grade EEG+ sensors with a companion app and proprietary AI to deliver a 15-minute pre-bedtime session that the company says helps users fall asleep about 50% faster and cut nighttime wake-ups by roughly a third, without medication. Somnee sells the headband, accessories, and a sleep-service membership direct to consumers, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Somnee publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Songfinch
providers.description: Songfinch is a Chicago-based direct-to-consumer music gifting platform that pairs customers with a curated community of independent professional singer-songwriters to produce one-of-a-kind personalized songs. A buyer picks an artist by genre, mood and tempo, submits the story and details behind the occasion through a guided song builder, and the artist writes, records and delivers an original recording to a shareable song page, with add-on products spanning lyric prints, vinyl, CDs, sheet music, QR plaques, streaming release and rights upgrades. Songfinch operates a two-sided marketplace — a consumer storefront plus an artist application and artist admin — and has paid out tens of millions of dollars to independent artists. It publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract; api.songfinch.com is a private first-party application backend for its own storefront.

providers.name: Sphero
providers.description: Sphero designs programmable robots and STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts and math) learning tools for K-12 education. Its product line spans indi, Mini, Snap, BOLT+, littleBits, RVR+ and Blueprint robots, paired with standards-aligned curriculum (NGSS, CSTA, ISTE) delivered through Sphero Central. For developers and educators, Sphero publishes a public robot-control SDK (sdk.sphero.com) that programs Sphero RVR+ / RVR robots from development boards — Raspberry Pi, micro:bit and Arduino — using Python, Node.js/TypeScript and C++. Sphero exposes robot-control SDKs and a locally-run Node.js RESTful interface rather than a hosted public web API. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist as part of the APIs.io network.

providers.name: SplashLearn
providers.description: SplashLearn (operated by StudyPad, Inc.) is a game-based learning platform offering math and English/ELA curriculum for preschool through Grade 5 students, used by parents, teachers, schools, and homeschoolers. It delivers interactive games, worksheets, lesson plans, and progress tracking across web and mobile (iOS/Android) apps, plus homeschool, summer-learning, and SpringBoard programs. Surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web/security surface.

providers.name: Squares
providers.description: Squares is a marketplace platform for discovering and booking curated, personally-vetted workspaces around the world — lofts, photo studios, rooftops, and villas suited to remote workers, creatives, and digital nomads. Spaces are scouted across 13+ cities including Almaty, Da Nang, and Austin, and hosts can list their own spaces on the platform. Squares is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer marketplace website but no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Squire
providers.description: Squire is a barbershop management software platform that gives barbers and shop owners the tools to run their business: online booking and scheduling, client management and loyalty, integrated payment processing with same-day deposits, a custom-branded client mobile app, point-of-sale, inventory and business analytics. Booking is surfaced through Google, Instagram and Squire's own consumer channels. Squire operates as a closed SaaS product with login-gated web and mobile applications; no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or partner/integration program is published as of this profile. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of CRV, ICONIQ Capital and Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: Storytel
providers.description: Storytel is a leading subscription-based audiobook and e‑book streaming service, founded in Sweden. It offers a vast library of titles across multiple languages, allowing users to listen to or read on mobile apps, web, and compatible devices. Storytel operates in dozens of countries, providing personalized recommendations, offline listening, and family plans. The platform focuses on delivering high‑quality audio productions and exclusive content, catering to readers and listeners worldwide.

providers.name: TableApp
providers.description: TABLEAPP (Tableapp Sdn Bhd, part of FunNow Ltd) is a real-time restaurant discovery and reservation platform serving diners across Malaysia (Klang Valley) and Thailand. Consumers discover restaurants and book tables with instant confirmation through the TABLEAPP website and iOS/Android apps, and the TABLEAPP ELITE membership unlocks free signature dishes at partner restaurants, alongside dining vouchers and gift cards. Restaurateurs list on both TABLEAPP and FunNow and manage reservations and guest preferences with the TABLEAPP Manager tools. TableApp is a 500 Global portfolio company; it operates a private mobile-app backend (api.tableapp.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
providers.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO) is a US interactive-entertainment holding company headquartered in New York City that develops and publishes video games through its labels Rockstar Games, 2K, Zynga and Ghost Story Games. It is a Fortune 1000 corporation. Take-Two operates real API infrastructure — api.take2games.com and the T2GP (Take-Two Game Platform) API at api.t2gp.take2games.com, the backend behind its launcher and account system — but it runs no public developer program: no developer portal, no published reference, no machine-readable contract, no SDKs, and no plans or rate limits. Its developer-surface hosts (docs.take2games.com, dev.take2games.com) redirect every request to a FusionAuth SSO login.

providers.name: Tavio
providers.description: Tavio is an integration platform (iPaaS) focused on HR technology and supply chain, offering a unified vision to solve the integration crisis. It provides tools for building, distributing, monitoring, and managing connectors across applicant tracking systems, assessments, background screening, HRIS/HCM, learning, onboarding, payroll, performance management, and sourcing/CRM. The platform includes on‑prem agents, EDI, public APIs, and a knowledge hub for developers, with managed services, data extracts, and extensive documentation.

providers.name: Taxfix
providers.description: Taxfix is a Berlin-based fintech that lets individuals and self-employed people in Germany prepare and file their annual income tax return from a mobile app or web browser. Users either answer a guided set of roughly 70 questions to self-file (Taxfix Basic) or hand the return to an independent tax expert via the Expert Service, with data transmitted to the tax authority over the official ELSTER interface. The company reports more than 10 million tax returns filed and over 5 billion euros in refunds. Taxfix is a consumer (B2C) product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Creandum, Index Ventures and Speedinvest.

providers.name: TeamSense
providers.description: TeamSense provides an all‑in‑one attendance management and employee communication platform for frontline workers. Built for manufacturing, HR, and operations teams, it offers features like attendance tracking, shift start, forms, insights, points‑system calculations, and integrations. The SaaS solution helps reduce turnover, improve visibility, and streamline absence reporting across industries.

providers.name: The Helper Bees
providers.description: The Helper Bees is an Austin-based aging-in-place technology company that operates one connected platform linking benefits, in-home service providers, and support so older adults can safely age at home. Its products include Care Concierge human guidance, an Aging-in-Place Marketplace for OTC products and nonmedical services (home care, safety modifications, meals, transportation), the Helpful benefits card, digital invoicing and claims processing for home and facility care, and digital nurse eligibility assessments for long-term care insurance. The company runs one of the nation's largest networks of vetted in-home care agencies and sells to Long-Term Care Insurance, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid plan administrators. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The Helper Bees publishes member and provider applications (the api.thehelperbees.com app host, the myhomealign.com provider portal, and mobile apps) but does not currently expose a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: The Learning Experience
providers.description: The Learning Experience is an early childhood education and childcare franchise operating academies of early education for children from six weeks to six years old across a nationwide network of centers. Its programs span infant, toddler, preschool, and pre-kindergarten care built on a proprietary curriculum. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer-facing childcare operator it publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Threat Stack
providers.description: Threat Stack was a Boston-based cloud security company providing full-stack cloud security observability, intrusion detection, and compliance monitoring for infrastructure and applications across cloud-native workloads including virtual machines, containers, and Kubernetes. Its platform combined rules and supervised machine learning to detect threats, vulnerabilities, and attacks in real time. Threat Stack exposed a RESTful V2 API (HAWK/HMAC authenticated) and trigger-based webhook alerts, along with first-party SDKs, a Go CLI, and configuration-management modules (Chef, Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm). The company was acquired by F5 in 2021 and the product is now F5 Distributed Cloud App Infrastructure Protection (AIP); the original threatstack.com and api.threatstack.com domains have been decommissioned.

providers.name: Truemeds
providers.description: Truemeds is an India-based online pharmacy and digital healthcare platform operated by Intellihealth Solutions that lets consumers order branded and generic prescription and over-the-counter medicines for home delivery across India, typically positioned around savings on genuine medicines, free teleconsultation with doctors, and substitute-medicine recommendations. It runs a consumer web and mobile app experience (order medicines, upload prescriptions, health blog, help center) rather than a public developer API program; no public API documentation, developer portal, OpenAPI, or partner API surface was found during enrichment. Backed by Accel and other investors, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Tryadonis
providers.description: Adonis (Adonis Technology, Inc., tryadonis.com redirects to adonis.io) is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) software company that applies AI to medical billing. Its platform connects in real time with a practice's existing EHR, practice-management, billing, and patient-portal systems to surface revenue-related insights, automate claims and billing workflows, and reduce manual work for revenue teams. The company is backed by Homebrew. This is a B2B SaaS product with a private, authenticated product API (api.adonis.io) and a customer app (app.adonis.io); it does not currently operate a public developer program, OpenAPI documentation, or API portal.

providers.name: Tuniu
providers.description: Tuniu (途牛旅游网) is a leading online leisure travel company in China, headquartered in Nanjing and listed on NASDAQ under ticker TOUR. It offers packaged tours, self-guided tours, and a broad range of travel-related services and products including hotels, flights, train tickets, cruises, visas, and local activities. For partners, Tuniu runs an Open Platform (途牛开放平台) at developer.tuniu.com that exposes supplier and retail-partner integration APIs behind developer registration, letting suppliers publish inventory and retail partners distribute Tuniu travel products. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Twisty
providers.description: Twisty, operated by Bright Live Inc. (dba Twisty) of Santa Monica, California, is an AI character creation platform that lets creators generate lifelike AI characters and produce personalized, expressive video messages as an alternative to generic talking-head videos. The product ships as a web app plus iOS and Android apps with a free tier and a paid monthly plan, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Twisty does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Vori Health
providers.description: Vori Health is a nationwide, virtual-first musculoskeletal (MSK) medical practice headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee and founded in 2020 by neurosurgeon Dr. Ryan Grant (co-founder and CEO) and orthopedic surgeon Dr. Mary O'Connor (co-founder and Chief Medical Officer), formerly chair of orthopedics at Mayo Clinic in Florida. It treats back, neck and joint pain through physician-led, integrated care teams that pair board-certified physiatrists licensed in all 50 states with physical therapists, registered dietitians and health coaches, delivered virtually and in person through a patient mobile and web application, and sold to employers, health plans, benefits consultants and risk-bearing provider groups as a value-based alternative to surgery-first MSK care. The company raised a $53M Series B led by NEA with AlleyCorp, Intermountain Ventures, Echo Health Ventures and Max Ventures participating, and partners with payers and enablers including Humana, Pearl Health, Allstate Benefits, Marpai, Contigo Health, WholeHealth Living, Firefly Health and Ophelia.

providers.name: Weekend Health (Found)
providers.description: Weekend Health, Inc. (operating as Found / Found Health) is a consumer telehealth company offering personalized, science-based weight-loss care, including GLP-1 and other obesity medications, clinician oversight, coaching, and habit-change support delivered direct-to-consumer and through employer and health-plan channels. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile carries the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Wikifolio
providers.description: wikifolio (wikifolio Financial Technologies AG) is a European social- and copy-trading platform that lets everyday investors follow, compare, and invest in the strategies of experienced traders. Traders build virtual portfolios ("wikifolios") that are published transparently; in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland the best-performing wikifolios can be securitized as exchange-listed wikifolio certificates that investors buy through their bank or broker. The platform surfaces thousands of trading ideas with published rules, fees, and live performance tracking. wikifolio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it does not appear to publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Wisq
providers.description: Wisq is an AI platform for human resources that automates HR service management, HR operations, and employee relations. Its conversational AI HR agent, Harper, answers employee requests across chat, email, Slack, Teams, SMS, and mobile, while its proprietary HR Language Model (HRLM) provides HR-specific reasoning, aiming to resolve the majority of routine HR cases without a human in the loop. Founded by Jim Barnett and Chih-Po Wen (formerly of Glint), Wisq is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Shasta Ventures, and True Ventures. Wisq operates a private, login-gated product and publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Worldover
providers.description: Worldover is the AI operating system for chemicals and cosmetics companies, replacing fragmented ERP, PLM, QMS, LIMS, and regulatory tools with one AI-orchestrated system custom-built around each team's workflows. Powered by Willow, its chemical and regulatory intelligence engine, it runs AI agents for demand planning, regulatory monitoring, quality, formulation R&D, supply chain, SDS authoring, and PLM updates. Headquartered in London and backed by Index Ventures, Chalfen, and EF, Worldover serves beauty brands, manufacturers, ingredient providers, distributors, and pharma and supplements companies. No public developer API is published.

providers.name: xTool
providers.description: xTool is a Shenzhen-based digital-fabrication brand, spun out of Makeblock and backed by HongShan, making CO2, fiber, and diode laser cutters and engravers, laser welders, and DTF printers for makers and small businesses, driven by its xTool Creative Space (XCS) desktop software. xTool sells through a Shopify storefront and runs a support and academy portal, a user community, and the Atomm maker-project platform, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Z1
providers.description: Z1 is the API Evangelist network profile for the consumer social gaming app operated by Bunch Live, Inc., known publicly as Bunch and now rebranded as Mini Party (mini.party). The product lets friends hang out, play party games, and video chat together in real time on mobile, and connects with external services such as Discord. Bunch raised early venture funding (including a $3.8M round) and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Bunch formerly operated a Bunch Developer Platform (the "Party Kit" voice/video SDK for iOS, Android, and Unity plus a Party Reservation API), but that developer program has been discontinued and the company currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal — this profile captures its identity, legal surface, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Zeel
providers.description: Zeel is an on-demand wellness marketplace that connects consumers with licensed, background-checked massage therapists for in-home, in-hotel, in-office, and event chair massage delivered same-day and often within an hour of booking. The platform covers a range of modalities including Swedish, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, sleep, and couples massage, and offers memberships, gift certificates, and a spa-staffing service (Zeel Spa Staffing) that supplies therapists to hotels and spas. Zeel operates a consumer-facing web and mobile booking experience across dozens of US metros; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration program.

providers.name: Zoog
providers.description: Zoog.A.I. Ltd. (Zoog) is a consumer application that lets families create personalized video books and songs for children. Parents and kids can read classic children's books, sing popular nursery rhymes, and turn them into personalized videos featuring their own family, then share those magical creations. Zoog is delivered as an iOS app (with an Android waitlist) and a companion website, and is backed by 500 Global. It has no public developer API surface, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures its identity and web presence within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 3T Biosciences
providers.description: 3T Biosciences is a clinical-stage immunotherapy company based in South San Francisco, developing next-generation T-cell receptor (TCR) therapeutics for solid tumors and other immune-mediated diseases. Founded in 2017 on research from K. Christopher Garcia's lab at Stanford University, the company operates its proprietary 3T-TRACE (T-Cell Receptor Antigen and Cross-reactivity Evaluation) platform, which combines high-diversity yeast-display target libraries with active machine-learning to screen billions of protein fragments and identify novel shared TCR targets and specificities. 3T has raised a $40M Series A from Westlake Village BioPartners and Lightspeed Venture Partners and has struck cancer-immunotherapy collaborations with Boehringer Ingelheim worth up to $268M in milestones. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched into the API Evangelist network; 3T publishes no public developer API, SDK, or specification surface.

providers.name: A Better Route Planner (Iternio)
providers.description: A Better Route Planner (Iternio) provides an advanced route planning platform for electric vehicle (EV) owners, offering real‑time navigation, charging station integration, and energy consumption forecasts. The service includes a public API that enables developers to access routing, charging point data, and vehicle telemetry, supporting integration into third‑party apps, fleet management tools, and in‑car infotainment systems. ABRP aims to simplify EV travel by optimizing routes based on battery state, charger availability, and user preferences.

providers.name: AdsKub
providers.description: AdsKub is an online classifieds platform focused on the Phuket region of Thailand, enabling users to buy, sell, and rent a wide range of items including vehicles such as cars, motorcycles, and scooters, as well as real‑estate like apartments, condos, and villas. The service provides a localized marketplace that connects buyers and sellers through a web interface, supporting multiple languages and offering image‑rich listings to facilitate transactions.

providers.name: Agenty
providers.description: agenty-im is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Alitheon
providers.description: Alitheon provides FeaturePrint®, an optical‑AI technology that creates a unique digital fingerprint of any physical object from a single photograph. It enables organizations to identify, authenticate, and trace items without labels, tags, or chips, serving sectors such as luxury goods, healthcare, automotive, government, and electronics.

providers.name: Angel One
providers.description: Angel One is India’s leading stock broker offering online trading in stocks, mutual funds, commodities, IPOs, futures & options, and ETFs. It provides a smart SuperApp with tools for seamless investing, market insights, and portfolio management for retail investors across India.

providers.name: Asepha
providers.description: Asepha is an AI workflow automation platform built specifically for pharmacies, positioning itself as "the context graph for the therapy-start journey" with a stated vision to make medication delays impossible. Its AI agents automate repetitive pharmacy operations across automated prescription data entry, back-office work, 340B management (TPA matching, accruals, purchase-order automation), medication reconciliation (Best Possible Medication History), a conversational voice call assistant, benefits verification and prior-authorization (BV/PA) automation, REMS compliance reporting, and medication therapy review. The company reports outcomes such as a 32% reduction in manual labour cost within one month and tasks completed 4x faster than baseline. Asepha is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, with AES-256 encryption at rest. Founded by CEO Eunice Wu, PharmD and CTO Can Uncu, the company operates from New York, NY and Toronto, ON, and is a Techstars portfolio company. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Asepha publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: AskAgent
providers.description: AskAgent provides a platform where developers can submit, share, and monetize AI agent solutions. The service offers a searchable repository of agents that solve specific problems, with detailed error logs, fixes, and community insights. Pricing starts at $1 per month, with annual plans available. The site includes documentation, pricing, and a signup flow, emphasizing rapid access to AI-driven tooling for developers.

providers.name: Astronergy
providers.description: Astronergy (Chint New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.) is the photovoltaic cell and module manufacturing arm of China's CHINT Group. Founded in 2006, it is one of the earliest private Chinese enterprises in the PV sector and is ranked among the world's largest module suppliers. It designs, manufactures and sells high-efficiency crystalline-silicon PV cells and modules — notably the n-type TOPCon ASTRO N series in bifacial and monofacial form — for utility-scale power stations, commercial and industrial rooftops, and residential systems. Astronergy sells into more than 140 countries and regions and operates manufacturing bases and sales centers in markets including Germany, Spain, the USA, Brazil and Turkey. Its public web surface is a marketing and product-download site: datasheets, installation manuals, warranty and certification PDFs, a module-authenticity checker and a PV Planner yield calculator. It publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Autoblogging.ai
providers.description: Autoblogging.ai is an AI-powered article writing and autoblogging platform that researches top-ranking content, generates SEO-optimized blog posts in bulk, fact-checks them, and auto‑publishes to WordPress and other platforms. Founded in 2022 by Vaibhav Sharda, it serves over 40,000 content creators across 38 languages, offering features like keyword research, AI‑generated images, and brand visibility tracking.

providers.name: Avec
providers.description: Avec is a free, AI-powered email application for Gmail, built by Nearly Extraterrestrial Technology, Inc. The iOS app prioritizes a user's inbox and surfaces important messages one at a time in a card-based interface, learning individual preferences over time so the most relevant email rises to the top. Users swipe to mark messages done or save them for later, compose replies by voice in their own writing style, receive smart notifications with email summaries, and search their mailbox with natural-language AI. Founded in 2024 by CEO Jonathan Unikowski and backed at seed stage by Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Avec is a consumer productivity product rather than an API provider - it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: AWST
providers.description: AWST is the software company behind WorkRamen, a productivity and business-operations platform aimed at small and medium businesses, startups, agencies, and freelancers. WorkRamen brings meeting scheduling (with Google Calendar and Outlook sync, plus Google Meet and Zoom), trackable document sharing, secure e-signatures, routing forms, visitor management, and Stripe-based payment acceptance into a single workspace. AWST is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a SaaS product only — its brand domain awst.io redirects to workramen.com, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or API documentation surface could be found.

providers.name: axenomia-cl
providers.description: axenomia-cl is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Bank of Hawaii
providers.description: Bank of Hawaii is a state-chartered commercial bank organized under the laws of the State of Hawaii in 1897, a member of the Federal Reserve System and FDIC-insured. It is the principal banking subsidiary of Bank of Hawaii Corporation (NYSE: BOH), a Honolulu-headquartered regional financial services company serving Hawaii, Guam, and other Pacific islands with consumer, commercial, and wealth-management banking. As a regional US institution, Bank of Hawaii publishes no first-party public developer portal and exposes no documented public API surface; probes of developer.boh.com and developers.boh.com do not resolve. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and consumer-permissioned data access to Bank of Hawaii accounts is available in practice only through third-party aggregators (for example Plaid), not through a direct bank-operated API. No Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership and no published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture were found at the time of this record.

providers.name: Beyond Limits
providers.description: Beyond Limits (trading as BeyondAI) is an enterprise and industrial artificial intelligence company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Glendale, California, built on cognitive and neuro-symbolic AI technology licensed from Caltech and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Its Hybrid AI Platform combines machine learning, generative AI and rule-based symbolic reasoning so that industrial operators get explainable, auditable recommendations instead of black-box predictions. Products include the Hybrid AI Platform (with Data, ML Ops/PRE, KB Ops and a low-code API available under a development license), Operations Advisor, Beyond Search generative AI, AI in a Box on-premises infrastructure, and DocLink document process automation from its Altec subsidiary. The company sells into energy and LNG, oil and gas, refining, petrochemicals, utilities, mining, manufacturing, aerospace and critical infrastructure. Beyond Limits publishes no public developer portal, API reference or self-service sign-up; platform API access is granted to licensed customers, so there is no publicly discoverable machine-readable contract for this provider.

providers.name: Bhub
providers.description: BHub (bhub.com) is a Brazilian accounting and financial back-office company serving small and medium-sized businesses across Brazil. It combines bookkeeping and tax accounting (contabilidade), financial business-process outsourcing (BPO financeiro) covering accounts payable/receivable and reconciliation, tax consulting (consultoria tributaria), and corporate/legal structuring (societario), delivered through its online client hub at app.bhub.ai. Specialized divisions Agrocontar (agribusiness) and Quality Associados (nonprofit/third sector) extend its sector coverage. Backed by QED Investors, BHub reports processing tens of millions of invoices and reconciling billions of reais annually. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; BHub currently exposes an internal application backend (api.bhub.com) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: BiltOn
providers.description: BiltOn empowers construction owners and general contractors to streamline site operations, improve safety, reduce risk, and stay compliant. The AI‑powered platform offers crew safety visibility, risk compliance management, and integrated solutions for building loops, labor management, and site safety, delivering real‑time data and analytics across field, trailer, and office.

providers.name: Binkey
providers.description: Binkey enables loyalty programs to seamlessly add FSA and HSA claims filing to the customer experience, allowing merchants to accept pre‑tax health benefit payments directly at checkout. Founded in 2022, the fintech provides an API‑enabled payment platform that automates eligibility verification and claim processing, improving the intersection of healthcare financing and e‑commerce.

providers.name: BizzyCar
providers.description: BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS platform for automotive dealerships that automates service recall management, customer outreach and mobile service. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Saint Peters, Missouri, the company ingests VIN-level open-recall data from OEM partners, matches it against a dealer's market area and DMS records, then uses AI-driven outreach (SMS, email, voice) to book service appointments and dispatch mobile service vans. Products include Recall Outreach, Recall Scout, Recall Radar, Service Engine, Mobile Service and Fleet IQ. BizzyCar is primarily an API *consumer* rather than an API producer: it ships pre-built connectors into dealer management systems (Dealertrack, DMS Plus, Open/Mate, Asbury, PBS, Tekion, Fortellis, Reynolds & Reynolds) and service schedulers (Xtime, TCC, DealerFX, Affinitiv, Update Promise), but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract of its own.

providers.name: Boardroom Governance
providers.description: Boardroom is a governance aggregation platform that helps developers fetch and display governance data across DAOs and decentralized networks. The Boardroom Governance API provides access to proposals, votes, protocols, and voter data for Web3 governance applications.

providers.name: Boards
providers.description: Boards is a mobile-first collaboration and duplication platform for network marketing and direct sales teams. It lets leaders turn what works for them into a simple, repeatable system that new team members can follow, sharing content, training, and workflows so a business can scale beyond its founder. The product centers on team alignment, faster onboarding of new members, and giving distributors a single place with everything they need to succeed, alongside a Success Academy for training and a brand and referral program. Boards is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; its surface is a consumer web and mobile app.

providers.name: Bonnet
providers.description: Bonnet is a UK-based electric vehicle (EV) charging app that aggregates multiple charging networks into a single platform, letting drivers find, access, and pay for chargers across Europe through one membership. Headquartered in Bristol and acquired by OVO Energy, it gives consumers real-time charger status, route planning, membership plans with per-charge savings, and weekly charging-credit rewards, while offering charge point operator (CPO) and fleet solutions with white-label integration for businesses. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Bonnet publishes a consumer mobile app but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: BraFinder
providers.description: BraFinder helps consumers find bras that truly fit by aggregating real fit data across 12 brands and 34 size translations. The service offers a free, no‑account‑required size‑finder, guides, and product recommendations, covering over 1,500 bras including large‑cup options often omitted by retailers. It aims to simplify bra shopping with accurate sizing and brand comparisons.

providers.name: Brain Corp
providers.description: Brain Corp builds BrainOS, an autonomy platform that powers commercial service robots for floor care, inventory scanning, and remote site management across retail, warehouses, education, airports, malls, healthcare, and hospitality. The product portfolio includes the BrainOS Sense Suite, Clean Suite, ShelfOptix scanning-as-a-service, RFID localization, and remote site management tools. Brain Corp integrates with OEM partners and operators rather than offering a public developer portal, and does not publish open APIs.

providers.name: Bristle
providers.description: Bristle (Bristle Health) is a consumer health company that makes the world's first at-home oral microbiome saliva test, helping people measure, understand, and improve their oral health. Customers order a mail-in saliva collection kit, and Bristle sequences the oral microbiome to report on bacteria associated with cavities, gum disease, and bad breath, then pairs the results with guidance and a line of targeted oral-care products including probiotics. Bristle also works with dental professionals who offer microbiome testing to their patients. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted storefront at bristlehealth.com and is backed by Initialized Capital. There is no first-party public developer API; this profile captures Bristle's public web, commercial, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Buyandship
providers.description: Buyandship is a parcel forwarding and global shopping service based in Hong Kong. It allows users to shop from international retailers, consolidates shipments from over 10 countries, and provides affordable shipping, protection plans, and a user-friendly platform with mobile apps. The service supports major marketplaces like eBay, Mercari, and JDirectItems, offering price monitoring, coupons, and a help center for customers worldwide.

providers.name: Capeprivacy
providers.description: Capeprivacy provides AI-driven automation solutions for financial institutions, enabling banks and trust companies to process client instructions, loan servicing, risk operations, and compliance tasks with increased speed, accuracy, and auditability. Their platform, DirectiveIQ, leverages agentic AI to transform unstructured requests into structured, executable actions, reducing manual effort and errors while enhancing control and transparency for operations teams.

providers.name: Caremessage
providers.description: CareMessage is a healthcare technology non-profit that operates one of the largest patient engagement platforms serving low-income and underserved populations across the United States. Since 2013 the platform has reached more than 20 million patients and is used by roughly 1 in 7 federally qualified health centers plus 200+ free clinics. Its products include 1:1 direct messaging, appointment lifecycle messaging, population outreach, health coaching, closed-loop referrals, Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) workflows, and Wellness Copilot, an AI-backed diabetes-management automation. CareMessage does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference; access to the platform is through its web application and a login-gated help center. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched from CareMessage's public web surface.

providers.name: carmotif-com
providers.description: carmotif-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Ceresti Health
providers.description: Ceresti Health provides a caregiver‑enabled dementia care platform that helps families monitor and intervene early to reduce hospitalizations for people living with dementia. By combining data‑driven alerts with personalized support, Ceresti aims to lower Medicare costs and improve outcomes for patients, health plans, and ACOs. The company offers health‑plan specific programs, tools for caregivers, and validated cost‑savings evidence.

providers.name: Ciro
providers.description: Ciro (Ciro Technologies Inc.) is an AI sales platform that finds a revenue team's best accounts, deeply qualifies each contact, runs a contact data waterfall for verified emails and phone numbers, and writes signal-based outbound that is pushed directly into existing sales tools. Reps command Ciro in plain English from Slack, where it runs prospect searches, enriches contacts, queries the CRM, analyzes CSVs, drafts multi-step personalized email sequences, and recommends the highest-ROI campaigns. It integrates with Salesforce and HubSpot (CRM); Salesloft, Outreach, Gong Engage, and Instantly (sales engagement); Slack; and webhook-based export to Clay and Zapier. Ciro is sold through a sales-led motion with no published pricing, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and was backed by Y Combinator and CRV. On 2026-07-08 Reevo announced it had acquired Ciro and is folding the prospecting agent into its revenue operating system; ciro.io remains live and still sells, and every page now carries an "acquired by Reevo" banner. Ciro was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched into the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, no developer documentation, no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or AsyncAPI contract, no SDK in any package registry, and no /.well-known/ document — every one of those was probed on 2026-08-14 and missed.

providers.name: Coris
providers.description: Coris is an AI platform for merchant and payment risk, providing modern risk infrastructure for vertical SaaS platforms, payment processors, ISOs, PayFacs, and sponsor banks. Its MerchantProfiler product returns 100+ structured data attributes on any business — pulled from Secretary of State records, online presence, customer reviews, website/content signals, adverse media, and operational data — to power faster, more accurate merchant onboarding, KYB, underwriting, and ongoing risk monitoring. The platform also spans transaction monitoring, AI risk agents, and managed risk workflows, exposed through both a no-code console and REST APIs so customers can automate the full merchant lifecycle. Founded in 2022 and based in Palo Alto, Coris is backed by Lux Capital, Exponent Founders Capital, and Y Combinator, and works with companies including GoFundMe, Kajabi, Clio, and Cherry. Developer documentation is published on a password-gated ReadMe portal; this profile was enriched from public surfaces (marketing site, status page, trust center, legal pages).

providers.name: Cubox
providers.description: Cubox provides an AI‑enhanced reading assistant that helps users collect, annotate, and organize web articles and documents across devices. The platform offers features such as automatic content extraction, AI‑generated summaries, tagging, and a personal knowledge vault that syncs between iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and browser extensions. Users can subscribe to free or paid plans for increased storage, AI credits, and advanced collaboration tools, while the service emphasizes data ownership and privacy.

providers.name: CyberTalents
providers.description: CyberTalents is a global cybersecurity platform that ranks and connects security talent with employers based on real, hands-on skills. The platform automates Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, delivers cybersecurity courses and training camps, runs technical assessments for enterprises, and provides recruitment and headhunting services to close the global cybersecurity skills gap. Backed by 500 Global, CyberTalents operates from Egypt, the UAE, and the United States and hosts one of the largest cybersecurity practice communities in the world. This API Evangelist profile tracks CyberTalents as a company; no public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: DealMaker
providers.description: DealMaker is a capital‑raising platform that enables businesses to raise funds from everyday investors through an end‑to‑end online solution. Founded by capital‑markets lawyers, the service has facilitated over $2 billion in raises for more than 500 k investors across diverse industries such as sports, robotics, cleantech, hospitality and media. DealMaker provides tools for campaign creation, investor relations, compliance, and marketing, positioning itself as a comprehensive fintech solution for private capital formation.

providers.name: Delve Bio
providers.description: Delve Bio is a genomic diagnostics company commercializing clinical metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) for infectious disease diagnosis. Its flagship test, Delve Detect, analyzes all nucleic acids in a single cerebrospinal fluid sample to simultaneously detect bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites, screening against a curated database of more than 68,000 pathogen species to diagnose meningitis and encephalitis with results in roughly 48 hours. The company is the exclusive licensee of the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) mNGS technology developed at the Center for Next-Gen Precision Diagnostics, founded by Charles Chiu, Joe DeRisi, Michael Wilson, Pardis Sabeti, and Matthew Meyerson, and backed by investors including GV. Delve Bio operates as a CAP/CLIA-certified clinical laboratory serving labs and clinicians; it exposes no public developer API surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a gv portfolio lead.

providers.name: Egab
providers.description: Egab is a journalism platform founded in late 2020 and headquartered in Cairo, Egypt, that connects local journalists across the Global South — the Middle East, Africa, and beyond (60+ countries) — with international media outlets. It specializes in solutions journalism, offering journalists mentoring, editorial support, skills development, and fair compensation from pitch to publication, while giving newsrooms cost-efficient access to authentic, exclusive stories and diverse local contributors without flying in reporters.

providers.name: EnerSys
providers.description: EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications, manufacturing batteries, chargers, accessories, and outdoor equipment enclosures. EnerSys serves motive power, reserve power, aerospace and defense, and specialty markets. While EnerSys offers a number of customer-facing web tools (Battery Sizing Program, Motive Power configurator, CARB Compliance Calculator) and product-level telemetry such as the Wi-iQ battery monitoring system and NexSys iON connected fleet platform, no public developer APIs or open specifications have been published as of this index.

providers.name: engineeringleaders-io
providers.description: Engineeringleaders.io is a community platform for engineering leaders in Central and Eastern Europe, offering meetups, conferences, mentorship, peer circles, and AI toolkits. It provides membership options for individuals and companies, organizes events across Prague, Brno, Bratislava, and Kraków, and supports leadership development through workshops, an academy, and networking opportunities. The platform aims to foster knowledge sharing and professional growth among senior engineering professionals.

providers.name: Ennoble Care
providers.description: Ennoble Care is a physician-led home-based healthcare provider delivering primary care, palliative care, and hospice care to seniors in the comfort of their own homes. Founded to bring the doctor back to the housecall, the company offers in-home primary care and chronic disease management, post-acute care transitions, advance care planning, bereavement services, and respite care across 13 states and Washington, DC (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia). Ennoble Care is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile has been enriched by the API Evangelist network; Ennoble Care is a healthcare-services company and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Enzo Biochem
providers.description: Enzo Biochem, Inc. (operating as Enzo Life Sciences) is a life sciences company specializing in labeling and detection technologies for biomedical research and drug development. Trading under the tagline "Scientists Enabling Scientists," Enzo develops and manufactures research reagents and assays including AMPIVIEW RNA probes for in-situ hybridization and FISH, antibodies, ELISA immunoassays, immunohistochemistry (IHC) products, and CELLESTIAL cell-based assays. Its biopharma arm provides drug discovery services, target identification and validation, assay development, in vitro toxicology, and GMP manufacturing. Products are sold through an online catalog and account portal at enzo.com rather than a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub company lead and enriched with the identity, website, and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.

providers.name: exein
providers.description: Exein is a Physical AI and embedded/IoT cybersecurity company (Italy) that secures connected devices, firmware, and Linux/RTOS embedded systems. Its platform pairs on-device runtime threat detection (Exein Runtime) with AI-powered firmware analysis and SBOM ingestion (Exein Analyzer), mapping findings to standards including the EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI EN 303-645, IEC 62443, RED 3.3, and the US Cyber Trust Mark. Exein does not publish a hosted public REST API; its developer surface is open-source security tooling in the exein-io GitHub organization — notably Pulsar (an eBPF-powered runtime security agent) and Kepler (a NIST-based CVE lookup store and API). Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital, hv-capital, and partech.

providers.name: Fig 1
providers.description: Fig.1 (Figure 1 Beauty) is a direct-to-consumer skincare brand created through 8VC's Build program, co-founded with Harvard-trained dermatologist Dr. Courtney Rubin, focused on demystifying and democratizing skincare through transparent, efficacy-driven, in-house formulations sold across a small launch line of cleansers, treatments, and moisturizers. Its public surface is a Shopify-hosted ecommerce storefront at fig-1.co; Fig.1 publishes no first-party developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation. This API Evangelist profile records the brand's identity, storefront policy pages, and domain-security posture. The /.well-known/openid-configuration served on the host is Shopify's shared Customer-Account platform OIDC, not a Fig.1 API.

providers.name: FIGS
providers.description: FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS) is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2013 by Heather Hasson and Trina Spear and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. FIGS designs and sells premium scrubwear and non-scrubwear offerings — lab coats, underscrubs, outerwear, footwear, compression socks, loungewear, and accessories — directly to healthcare professionals through its Shopify-based online store at wearfigs.com. FIGS is a consumer e-commerce and retail brand with a customer help center and investor-relations presence; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Flock Homes
providers.description: Flock Homes is a real estate investment platform, founded in 2020 and backed by a16z, that lets individual rental-property owners retire from active landlording by contributing their single-family and multifamily homes into a professionally managed, diversified residential real estate fund. Flock uses a 721 Exchange (an UPREIT contribution) so owners can trade appreciated rental property for fund shares on a tax-deferred basis, deferring capital gains and depreciation-recapture taxes while eliminating repair, vacancy, and eviction responsibilities. Fund investors receive quarterly cash-flow distributions and long-term appreciation across a nationwide portfolio, with Flock handling all property management, maintenance, and tenant operations. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Freterium
providers.description: Freterium is a cloud-native AI Transport Management System (TMS) and unified logistics operating system that connects shippers, carriers, and fleets on a single intelligent layer. It spans first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile operations across eight integrated modules — order management, AI-powered route planning, collaborative shipper and carrier portals, real-time GPS tracking with predictive ETAs, fleet management, freight billing and costing, intelligent document control, and analytics and reporting — and exposes a documented REST API for ERP/WMS integration alongside 50+ off-the-shelf telematics and hardware integrations. Surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: Geneoscopy
providers.description: Geneoscopy is a commercial-stage molecular diagnostics company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, focused on gastrointestinal health. Its platform analyzes stool-derived eukaryotic RNA (seRNA) biomarkers, a proprietary approach the company applies to colorectal cancer screening, inflammatory bowel disease and other gastrointestinal conditions. Its lead product, ColoSense, is a noninvasive multi-target stool RNA (mt-sRNA) colorectal cancer screening test approved by the FDA in May 2024 for adults aged 45 and older at average risk; it evaluates eight colorectal neoplasia-associated RNA markers together with occult hemoglobin, and has since been added to the American Cancer Society and NCCN colorectal cancer screening guidelines. Geneoscopy operates a CLIA-certified (26D2253457) and CAP-accredited clinical laboratory with permits in New York, California, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island and the District of Columbia, and partners with biopharma and research organizations on stool-biomarker diagnostics and prognostics. Geneoscopy is a diagnostics and clinical-laboratory company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: GoWork
providers.description: GoWork is Indonesia's largest premium coworking and flexible office space provider, operating more than 25 locations across Jakarta, Tangerang, Surabaya, Bali, and Medan. Formed from the 2018 merger of GoWork and Rework, the company offers private offices, dedicated desks, coworking memberships, virtual offices, meeting and event spaces, plus podcast and live-streaming studios. It also bundles business services such as company incorporation, tax and accounting, visa and work-permit processing, and legal support. Members discover, book, and manage workspace through the GoWork mobile apps and web booking platform. GoWork is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Heirloom
providers.description: Heirloom Carbon Technologies, Inc. is a San Francisco Bay Area direct air capture (DAC) company that removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere by accelerating the natural mineralization of limestone. Heirloom spreads calcium oxide on vertical trays where it re-absorbs atmospheric CO2 in days rather than years, then uses electric kilns to release the captured CO2 for permanent geologic or in-concrete storage. The company opened the first commercial DAC facility in the United States, sells permanent carbon removal credits to individuals, businesses and enterprises, and has signed offtake agreements with Microsoft, Frontier, United's Sustainable Flight Fund and CarbonCure. It is an industrial climate-technology company; it does not operate a public developer program or API.

providers.name: HelloTech
providers.description: HelloTech is a consumer technology-services company providing in-home and online tech support across the United States through a nationwide network of vetted technicians. Services span computer and printer repair, WiFi and home-networking setup, mobile-device support, audio/video and home-theater installation, TV mounting, smart-home device installation, and home-security setup, offered on-demand or through a HelloTech Home membership plan. HelloTech operates as a consumer services brand and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HiGuest
providers.description: HiGuests (Hi Guests Vacation Homes Rental LLC, License 765614) is a Dubai-based short-term rental property management company. It offers full-service management for vacation homes and furnished apartments, listing owners' properties across 20+ booking channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, and others), and handling profile creation, dynamic pricing, booking and guest communications, 24/7 guest support, check-in/check-out, housekeeping, and maintenance, alongside transparent owner reporting. HiGuests markets a zero-commission subscription plan for landlords and operates a guest-facing booking site. It is a hospitality services business, not an API/developer platform; no public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: IPKit
providers.description: IPKit provides a simple API to retrieve IP address information. The service returns JSON data about the queried IP, including geolocation, ISP, and security details, wrapping data from the ipregistry service. It is designed for developers needing quick IP lookups without authentication, supporting public access via the root endpoint. IPKit aims to offer reliable, low-latency IP data for integration into applications, analytics, and security tools.

providers.name: Jenfi
providers.description: Jenfi is a Singapore-headquartered SME credit platform for digitally-enabled businesses in Southeast Asia, operating principally in Singapore and Vietnam. Founded in 2019 by Jeffrey Liu and Justin Louie and backed by Y Combinator, Monk's Hill Ventures and Headline, it started with revenue-based financing — non-dilutive growth capital repaid as a percentage of monthly revenue rather than on a fixed schedule — and has since broadened into growth financing, working capital and supply-chain financing, alongside a B2B buy-now-pay-later product marketed as PaidFi ("b2b BNPL by Jenfi"). In May 2026 the company reported passing US$100 million in cumulative originations across more than 2,400 financings, from over 30,000 evaluated enquiries. Jenfi publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable contract: its only integration surface is a login-gated partner console at partners.jenfi.com and a contact-sales "Embedded Financing" offer on its partner page.

providers.name: JivoChat
providers.description: JivoChat provides live chat, messaging, and AI‑powered customer support software for websites and mobile apps. Its platform enables businesses to engage visitors via chat widgets, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and other channels, offering features such as chatbot integration, webhooks, and a robust API for developers to customize and automate interactions. The service includes AI assistants, analytics, and multi‑channel communication tools, helping companies improve conversion, support efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

providers.name: JobToday
providers.description: JobToday is a mobile-first hiring marketplace that connects job seekers directly with employers for fast, chat-based hiring, primarily across service industries such as hospitality, retail, and customer service. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Luxembourg (JobToday S.A.), the app lets employers post jobs and message candidates directly, with the company reporting that roughly 70% of matches happen within 24 hours. JobToday operates across 20+ countries including the UK, US, Spain, Mexico, and France, and reports tens of millions of job seekers and hundreds of thousands of hiring businesses. It is backed by Accel. JobToday is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: KupiVIP
providers.description: KupiVIP (kupivip.ru) is a Russian online outlet retailer for luxury and premium fashion, selling women's and men's apparel, footwear, bags, accessories and home goods from more than 250 international designer brands at discounts of up to 90% on previous-season collections. The 1C-Bitrix storefront ships across Russia, publishes a 100% authenticity guarantee backed by expert verification, offers free delivery on orders over 30,000 RUB, and runs telephone, email, WhatsApp and Telegram customer support. The company was originally surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment probe KupiVIP publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Kyrok
providers.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: La Fraise Pro
providers.description: La Fraise (LA FRAISE PRO SAS) is a French SaaS platform that digitizes the administrative patient journey for dental practices and dental centers: interactive treatment quotes (devis), patient-education video, informed consent, mutual-insurer coverage requests, and compliant electronic signature, all handled remotely. The product integrates natively with the French dental practice-management market — LOGOSw, Julie, Veasy, CS Trophy, Visiodent, Ardion, WeClever, Desmos, Galaxie and Effigie — with real-time bidirectional sync for LOGOSw, Veasy and Desmos. More than 3,500 dentists are equipped. Patient data is hosted on HDS-certified AWS infrastructure in the European Union, in line with article L.1111-8 of the French Code de la sante publique, and electronic signature follows Agence du Numerique en Sante (ANS) norms. La Fraise publishes no public developer API; practice-management integrations are provisioned by its own technical team.

providers.name: Landlord Studio
providers.description: Landlord Studio is a property management platform founded in 2014 that helps landlords and property managers track rental income and expenses, collect rent online, screen tenants, manage documents, and generate financial reports including Schedule E tax-ready summaries. The platform integrates with Xero for accounting synchronization and Plaid for bank feed connectivity. Nexus by Landlord Studio is a Making Tax Digital (MTD) compliance layer for UK letting agents connecting to Reapit, PayProp, SME Professional, LettsPay, and Alto.

providers.name: LinkDrip
providers.description: LinkDrip provides a no‑code link engagement platform that lets users create, customize, and track short links with advanced analytics, QR codes, and call‑to‑action overlays. The service supports custom domains, real‑time performance dashboards, and easy integration via a pixel or API, helping marketers and businesses maximize link effectiveness without writing code.

providers.name: Linux Foundation
providers.description: The Linux Foundation is a nonprofit technology consortium that supports open source projects and ecosystems. It provides a neutral home for collaboration on open source software, hardware, standards, and data, and hosts hundreds of projects including the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, Node.js, PyTorch, OpenSSF, CNCF, RISC-V, and FINOS. The LFX platform offers tooling and insights for open source contributors and member organizations.

providers.name: Luel
providers.description: Luel is a two-sided marketplace and multi-modal data lab for AI training data, connecting companies that need high-quality, rights-cleared datasets with verified contributors who supply and license on-demand video, audio, and image data. Contributors can earn money by submitting media from their own devices (for example, footage from their camera roll) or by completing requested data tasks, while buyers purchase premium, curated, rights-cleared multimodal datasets from the Luel catalog. Positioned as "the frontier of data," Luel powers the foundations of machine perception through a proprietary, continuous data engine. The company is backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Luel does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Moai.cash
providers.description: Moai.cash is a Telegram-native cryptocurrency super app operated by Sloika Industries, Inc. that bundles digital-wallet, payments, and Web3 financial services into a familiar messaging interface. It advertises zero-fee transactions, support for 1,000+ tokens, multi-chain deposits, token swapping, peer-to-peer money transfers, prediction markets for real-world events, and an on-chain lottery (Megapot). The company promotes an embedded-apps "API" that lets third-party applications run inside the Moai experience (payment processing, wallet management, token operations, lending/borrowing, real-world assets, Web3 gaming, and tokenized stocks), but that API is gated behind an email access request with no public documentation, OpenAPI specification, base URL, or self-service developer portal at this time. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Monese
providers.description: Monese is a London-founded fintech that provides mobile money accounts to consumers across Europe. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) rather than a traditional bank, Monese lets over two million users open an account in minutes and then spend, send, and save money directly from a smartphone app. Its product surface covers multi-currency and local accounts, international money transfers, physical and virtual debit cards, budgeting and savings tools, and credit-building features. Monese is a consumer-facing mobile application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Murphy
providers.description: Murphy is a Barcelona-based fintech building AI voice and omnichannel agents that automate debt collection and servicing for banks, fintechs, utilities, telecoms and debt collection agencies. Founded in 2024 by Borja Sole and Marc Sanchez, the platform runs 24/7 AI agents across voice, SMS and email in 15+ languages, handling inbound and outbound recovery with human escalation, behavioural personalisation and fully audited, compliance-bounded interactions (ISO 27001, GDPR and EU AI Act aligned). Murphy claims materially higher recovery rates and 50-70% lower operational cost. It raised roughly $15M (seed + pre-seed) led by Northzone with ElevenLabs, Lakestar, Seedcamp and Enzo Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: NuORDER
providers.description: NuORDER by Lightspeed is a global B2B commerce platform for wholesale buying and selling between brands and retailers. It combines a fully-branded wholesale eCommerce storefront with account-specific pricing and discounts, an Assortments planning tool for data-driven buying and reduced markdowns, and a Marketplace that connects buyers to 3,000+ brands across fashion, footwear, and apparel. NuORDER exposes a partner-gated REST API at api.nuorder.com for syncing products, orders, catalogs, and customer data with ERP, PIM, and other commerce systems. Acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, it is used by brands including Arc'teryx, Kendra Scott, TOMS, Barbour, and Canada Goose.

providers.name: OWASP API Security Project
providers.description: The OWASP API Security Project focuses on strategies and solutions to understand and mitigate the unique vulnerabilities and security risks of Application Programming Interfaces. The project produces and maintains the OWASP API Security Top 10, a community-driven list of the most critical API security risks for developers, architects, and security professionals.

providers.name: Palette 2
providers.description: Palette 2, operating as Palette, is a multimodal content creation platform that lets users generate, edit, and storyboard media across formats such as text, images, video, and audio. The service provides a unified canvas for marketing, education, entertainment, and brand storytelling, leveraging AI-driven tools to accelerate production and ensure consistency across audiences.

providers.name: Passes
providers.description: Passes is a creator monetization and accelerator platform founded in 2022 by Lucy Guo and headquartered in Los Angeles. Creators use Passes to build direct, paid relationships with their audiences through subscriptions, paid DMs, livestreams, one-on-one video calls, merchandise, automated message sequences, and instant payouts, while keeping 90% of what they earn. Backed by Bond Capital and Multicoin Capital, the company rebranded in 2026 as a creator accelerator. Passes does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its real public web surface — llms.txt, security.txt, mobile deep-link association files, and domain-security posture — harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Piinpoint
providers.description: PiinPoint is an AI-powered location intelligence and site selection platform for retailers, restaurants, brokers, and commercial real estate teams. The software combines demographic, mobile-location, traffic, and competitive data to help teams validate sites, forecast sales, model cannibalization, run network simulations, and plan expansion. Delivered as a B2B SaaS web application (app.piinpoint.com), PiinPoint does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Pintarnya
providers.description: Pintarnya is an Indonesian technology startup, launched in May 2022, that operates an employment and financial-services super-app for the country's blue-collar and entry-level workforce (education levels from elementary school through bachelor's degree, "SD-S1"). The platform aggregates tens of thousands of daily-updated job listings across 300+ Indonesian cities and pairs job search with Cari Cuan side-income tasks, Siap Kerja skill-building video courses, a CV builder, and an employer/recruiter posting product used by tens of thousands of companies. Pintarnya reports more than 10 million registered job seekers and is registered with Indonesia's Ministry of Labor (KEMNAKER). It is a consumer web and mobile product; no public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Qventus
providers.description: Qventus is a healthcare technology company that provides an AI-powered automation platform for hospital operations. Its "AI teammates" combine machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to streamline care-coordination workflows across surgical growth and operating-room utilization, perioperative and pre-admission-testing coordination, inpatient capacity and discharge planning, and care-gap and coding automation. Qventus sells to health systems and hospitals as a B2B SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Mayfield, Norwest Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: RapidFort
providers.description: RapidFort is a software supply chain security platform focused on container hardening and automated CVE remediation. Its platform analyzes container vulnerabilities across build and runtime, profiles what software actually executes, and removes unused components to shrink the attack surface - remediating up to 95% of CVEs without code changes. RapidFort publishes a registry of 9,000+ near-zero-CVE curated container images and malware-scanned open-source libraries, and its CART capability automates compliance validation and remediation reporting for programs such as FedRAMP, cATO, CMMC, NIS2, and SOC 2. The company operates its platform through a hosted web application and a command-line workflow (analyze, profile, harden), with an open-source community-images catalog and the Kimia Kubernetes-native OCI image builder published on GitHub.

providers.name: Root Global
providers.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Ross Stores
providers.description: Ross Stores, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROST) is the largest off-price apparel and home fashion retailer in the United States, operating over 1,700 Ross Dress for Less and 320+ dd's DISCOUNTS stores across 43 states, the District of Columbia, and Guam. The company sources a broad assortment of in-season, name-brand merchandise at deep discounts (20-60% below department and specialty store prices) through opportunistic buying. Ross operates a highly efficient supply chain powered by AI-driven inventory management, distribution automation, and integrated supplier and partner technology platforms.

providers.name: Rylo
providers.description: Rylo (Nagish Inc. d/b/a Rylo) is a New York-based accessibility technology company building free communication tools for people who are Deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability. Its consumer mobile app provides FCC-certified real-time phone-call captioning, in-person Live Transcribe, and Sign features, with automatic language detection across 50+ languages. Rylo raised $85M and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. The company operates a consumer application only and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Sabbar
providers.description: Sabbar is a leading local employment and recruitment platform in Saudi Arabia that connects job seekers with employers across many sectors. Job seekers search listings, build a free CV, and apply to roles, while employers use subscription-based recruitment packages and candidate matching. The platform reports more than 12,000 companies and over 1 million Saudi and non-Saudi job seekers, with iOS and Android mobile apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sarwa
providers.description: Sarwa is a UAE-based fintech platform and mobile app that lets everyday investors trade U.S. stocks and ETFs, invest passively through managed portfolios, and save in high-yield accounts, all in one place. The company is regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and operates as Sarwa Digital Wealth (Capital) Limited. Sarwa is a portfolio company of 500 Global and offers consumer products (Sarwa Trade, Sarwa Invest, Sarwa Save) through its web and mobile apps; it does not currently publish a public developer API. This profile captures the company's public identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Setu
providers.description: Setu (a Pine Labs company) is an API-first embedded finance infrastructure provider for India.
