Its product catalogue covers UPI acceptance and payouts, BBPS bill collection and bill payment, WhatsApp-based payment journeys, Account Aggregator (RBI's consent-based financial data sharing framework), KYC for individuals and businesses, and Aadhaar eSign. The Bridge is Setu's developer console for configuring products, issuing credentials, and reviewing transactions and settlement. All products are exposed as REST APIs documented at docs.setu.co.

providers.name: Siteline
providers.description: Siteline is billing and accounts receivable software built specifically for commercial subcontractors (trade contractors). It centralizes pay applications (including AIA G702/G703 progress billing), lien waivers, lien rights, compliance documents, change orders, collections, and A/R reporting in one workflow, replacing the spreadsheets, PDFs, and GC payment-portal logins that AP/AR teams juggle every month. Siteline integrates with construction accounting systems (Sage, Foundation, Viewpoint/Vista, Spectrum, QuickBooks, Acumatica, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, CMiC, and others) and with GC payment portals (Textura, GCPay, Procore Pay) so billing data flows without double entry. Founded in 2019 by Claire Wilson and Gloria Lin, backed by Menlo Ventures and First Round Capital; subcontractors have billed over $10B across 200,000+ projects on the platform. Siteline publishes no public developer API — integrations are managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Sondermind
providers.description: SonderMind is a Denver-based mental health company operating a measurement-based behavioral healthcare platform that connects people to licensed therapists and psychiatrists who have availability, accept insurance, and specialize in their needs. It offers virtual and in-person therapy and psychiatry across all 50 U.S. states, along with enterprise offerings for health systems, physician practices, payers, and Veterans. SonderMind is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer and clinician web platform (with a member/provider sign-in at api.sondermind.com) but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this repository tracks SonderMind's public web, content, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Start Playing
providers.description: StartPlaying (startplaying.games) is the largest online marketplace connecting tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) players with professional Game Masters for systems including Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder, Starfinder, Warhammer, and many more. Players discover, book, and join online sessions filtered by system, platform, genre, playstyle, and GM reviews, while Game Masters build careers by hosting paid games across virtual tabletops. The platform also offers gift cards, learn-to-play one-shots for beginners, kids' games, and corporate team-building events. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a consumer web product with no public developer API.

providers.name: Sustaira
providers.description: Sustaira is a modular, AI-powered sustainability and ESG application platform built on a low-code architecture in partnership with Mendix. Customers use Sustaira to run carbon accounting (Scope 1, 2, and 3), ESG disclosure and reporting aligned to CSRD, CDP, PCAF, and SASB, sustainability project and KPI tracking, supply chain data collection, and industry-specific sustainability workflows across construction, finance, logistics, healthcare, and other sectors. Integration into customer systems is handled through web services and APIs on the underlying Mendix platform, plus a marketplace of 150+ sustainability accelerators. Sustaira does not publish a public, self-service developer API portal; integration access is delivered through customer enterprise contracts and partner programs.

providers.name: Teamworks
providers.description: Teamworks is a sports technology company that builds "The Operating System for Sports" — an integrated software platform used by elite collegiate, professional, and national-team organizations to digitize the athlete lifecycle and consolidate their technology stack. The platform spans four product areas: Personnel (roster management, recruiting, scouting, player evaluation), Performance (strength & conditioning, nutrition, and a sports EMR / athlete-management system), Coaching (sport-specific game preparation and strategy for football, baseball, and hockey), and Operations (Hub communication, compliance, academics, inventory, camps, and influencer management), plus Wallet for athlete payments and Teamworks Intelligence for predictive analytics. Teamworks is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes customer-facing SaaS products and a public status page but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Theom
providers.description: Theom is a cloud Data & AI Operations Center that governs and secures enterprise data estates, providing automated data security, compliance, and safe generative-AI data activation across multi-cloud environments. Founded in December 2020 by former Cisco, Google, and Yahoo security practitioners (creators of Tetration Analytics), Theom detects active data breaches, maps real-time data lineage, analyzes identity-aware data usage and insider threats, and enforces data-usage policy agentlessly. Its product spans Theom Core (data security and lineage), Theom AI (GenAI leak prevention), and Theom Trust (real-time data contracts). Theom is backed by Wing Venture Capital, Ridge Ventures, Snowflake Ventures, Databricks Ventures, SentinelOne Ventures, and M12, and was named a Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave for Sensitive Data Discovery and Classification. Theom is delivered as an enterprise platform; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API docs.

providers.name: Tolan
providers.description: Tolan is a consumer AI companion application built by Portola and backed by Homebrew. The product is a friendly alien character that users befriend for emotional support, daily check-ins, and relationship guidance through conversational AI on iOS. Tolan reports 100,000+ subscribers, over two million hours of user engagement, and a 4.8-star App Store rating across 160,000+ reviews. It is a mobile-first, direct-to-consumer product with no public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface; this profile captures the company identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: True Anomaly
providers.description: True Anomaly is a defense-technology company building spacecraft, software, and payloads for space superiority. Its products include Jackal, a multirole space-superiority platform positioned as a tactical fighter-interceptor for contested orbital environments, and Mosaic, an autonomy software platform that transforms commander intent into autonomous action. The company serves U.S. government and allied defense customers from facilities in Centennial and Colorado Springs, Colorado; Long Beach, California; and Washington, DC. True Anomaly publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; its only machine-readable public surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact.

providers.name: Ummeed Housing Finance
providers.description: Ummeed Housing Finance Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian affordable-housing finance company registered with the National Housing Bank (NHB), providing home loans, loans against property, business loans, and MSME business loans to low- and middle-income households. Headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, it operates 130+ branches across 9 states and has served 45,000+ families. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Ummeed publishes no public developer portal or API surface; its digital channels are the customer website and a customer mobile app.

providers.name: University of Newcastle Australia
providers.description: The University of Newcastle (UON) is a public research university in Callaghan and Newcastle, New South Wales, ranked #179 in the QS World University Rankings order used by this cohort. It is a federation of buyers rather than an API producer: there is no central developer portal and no institutional API gateway — api.newcastle.edu.au, apis.newcastle.edu.au, developer.newcastle.edu.au, data.newcastle.edu.au and status.newcastle.edu.au all fail to resolve — and UON publishes no OpenAPI description for anything. What it genuinely operates is small and specific: a Shibboleth identity provider at idp.newcastle.edu.au serving live SAML 2.0 metadata under its own entityID and scope, registered in the Australian Access Federation; and a self-hosted XNAT 1.9.1.1 imaging-informatics platform at xnat.newcastle.edu.au, run with the Hunter Medical Research Institute on the university's own AWS estate, whose REST API answers on UON's host and is registered as a SAML service provider in the same federation. UON also holds two DataCite repository clients in its own name, ARDCX.UON and UONAU.FIGSHARE. Everything else that looks programmable is a tenancy on someone else's platform and is recorded as such, never as UON engineering: Open Research Newcastle is a Figshare tenancy, the course handbook is a CourseLoop tenancy, the learning management system is an Instructure Canvas tenancy, library guides are Springshare, site search is Squiz Funnelback, the student portal is PeopleSoft behind Okta, and the service desk is Oracle B2C Service. This profile was corrected on 2026-08-30: ten OpenAPI documents previously held here were Figshare's generic api.figshare.com/v2 contract, not the university's, and were removed along with everything derived from them.

providers.name: Unmanic
providers.description: Unmanic is an open‑source library optimisation tool that automates the management of media files. It can automatically organise, convert, and compress files, freeing up storage space while supporting plugins for extensibility. Users can run it in the background, configure tasks via a web UI, and integrate custom plugins, making it suitable for both casual home users and advanced media enthusiasts.

providers.name: Valerie Health
providers.description: Valerie Health is an AI-powered front office platform for independent healthcare provider groups, automating referral management, fax and document classification and data extraction, appointment scheduling, and growth analytics on top of existing EMR and practice management systems. Founded by Pete Shalek and Nitin Joshi and backed by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures with a $30M Series A, the company operates as a HIPAA Business Associate for its provider customers and publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center, but does not currently publish a developer portal or public API documentation.

providers.name: Volocopter
providers.description: Volocopter is a German urban air mobility company developing electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for passenger and cargo use. Its product portfolio includes VoloCity, a two-seat multicopter air taxi pursued under EASA SC-VTOL certification; VoloRegion, a longer-range fixed-wing transition design for inter-city flights; VoloDrone, a heavy-lift cargo drone; and VoloIQ, a digital operations platform built on Microsoft Azure for fleet, route, and vertiport management. Volocopter has demonstrated flights in numerous cities including Paris, Singapore, Seoul, and Dubai, and worked toward operations around the Paris 2024 Olympics. The company experienced significant financial restructuring in 2024-2025 and ownership changes affecting commercial timelines; current status should be verified against the latest newsroom updates.

providers.name: Xamarin
providers.description: Xamarin was the San Francisco company behind the Mono-based cross-platform mobile development framework, letting developers build native iOS, Android, and Mac apps from a single C#/.NET codebase. Backed by investors including Insight Partners, it was acquired by Microsoft in 2016. Microsoft retired the Xamarin SDKs on May 1, 2024, with Xamarin.Forms succeeded by .NET MAUI. Xamarin shipped developer tooling and SDK packages rather than a public web API; its NuGet packages, docs, and GitHub organization remain its primary artifacts.

providers.name: Xfactor.io
providers.description: Xfactor.io is an AI-powered revenue operations platform founded by Mike Carpenter and backed by Accel and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Its Growth AI engine, together with the Xfactor Central, OpenInsights, and Simulation products, builds a live digital twin of a company's go-to-market operations — connecting CRM, pipeline, usage, and financial data so revenue teams can test decisions through simulation before rolling them out. The platform is delivered as a closed B2B SaaS application (app.xfactor.io) and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or client SDKs; security posture is documented on a Secureframe trust center with a SOC 2 Type II attestation.

providers.name: Yogaia
providers.description: Yogaia is a Finnish online fitness company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Espoo, that streams live and on-demand yoga, Pilates, meditation, and workout classes to members on any device. Backed by Point Nine, Inventure, and Sanoma, the service runs as a consumer subscription product (web and mobile apps) with sessions ranging from three-minute quick practices to sixty-minute relaxation programs. As of this enrichment pass Yogaia publishes no public developer program, API reference, or SDKs; its api.yogaia.com host serves the session-based web application backend rather than a documented public API. This profile was surfaced as a Point Nine portfolio lead and is enriched here with verified identity, public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: 2021.AI
providers.description: 2021.AI is a European AI governance platform offering secure, compliant AI operations for enterprises. It provides AI security, governance, developer tools, and agentic AI modules, enabling organizations to manage, monitor, and regulate AI models and applications in line with EU AI Act and GDPR. The platform supports on‑premise, private‑cloud, and SaaS deployments, with pricing under €2 per chat user for public sector and flexible plans for private sector.

222 is a consumer social app that matches compatible strangers for curated, in-real-life group experiences — dinners, events, and pop-up hangouts — to help people meet new people, discover their city, and deepen relationships. There are no profiles, DMs, or swiping: members complete a personality/values survey that builds a curation profile, then receive invites to nearby experiences where the app seats them with the people they are most compatible with. Founded in Los Angeles and now operating in cities including Los Angeles and New York, 222 is backed by General Catalyst and Y Combinator. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; 222 is a consumer mobile application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Abonnement24
providers.description: Abonnement24 is a Dutch comparison platform that helps consumers compare mobile phone contracts, sim‑only plans, internet and TV bundles. It aggregates live prices from major providers such as Odido, Vodafone, KPN, Youfone and others, presenting the total cost over the full contract term, including action prices, regular prices and cashback. The service aims to show transparent, real‑world pricing without hidden fees, enabling users to find the most affordable options.

providers.name: All4Clinic
providers.description: Sistema de gestão para clínicas com IA de verdade: agenda multi-profissional, prontuário com transcrição da consulta, documentos com assinatura digital ICP-Brasil, cobrança do paciente por Pix, boleto e cartão, estoque com lote e validade, CRM e oito automações de WhatsApp. Dados no Brasil, conformidade com a LGPD.

providers.name: Allswell
providers.description: Allswell is an online mental health platform providing virtual, trauma-informed therapy for the LGBTQ+ community. Licensed therapists with master's degrees in social work, counseling, or marriage and family therapy deliver individual telehealth sessions alongside peer support groups and skills-building resources, covering trauma, anxiety, depression, identity exploration, and relationship dynamics. Allswell serves clients in Maryland, DC, and Virginia, accepting Medicaid and major insurance plans as well as cash-pay. Backed by Techstars, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: ams OSRAM
providers.description: ams OSRAM (ams-OSRAM AG) is a global leader in innovative optical solutions, designing and manufacturing intelligent sensors, emitters, and light-based semiconductors. Formed from the 2020 combination of ams AG (Austria) and OSRAM (Germany), the company builds LEDs, VCSEL and edge-emitting lasers, CMOS image sensors, ambient light and proximity sensors, direct time-of-flight (dToF) sensors, photodiodes, and LED/VCSEL driver ICs. Its sensing, illumination, and visualization technologies serve automotive and mobility (headlamps, interior lighting, ADAS), industrial automation and robotics, medical and healthcare devices, mobile and wearable devices, computing, and general lighting. Headquartered in Premstaetten, Austria and Munich, Germany, ams OSRAM employs roughly 18,500 people across 25 R&D sites and holds over 12,000 patents. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital and enriched from ams OSRAM public web pages; the company exposes product/design support and a download center rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Anagram
providers.description: Anagram (operated by Enigma Analytics, Inc.) is a security-awareness and human-risk training platform for enterprises, positioned in the defense and government sector and backed by General Catalyst. The product replaces check-the-box compliance training with engaging, gamified experiences proven to change risky behavior: role- and geography-adaptive phishing simulations (Smart Phishing), developer-designed secure-coding challenges for engineering teams, and a real-time AI coaching layer (Anagram Agent). Anagram is not currently a public API provider — this profile captures the company identity, product surface, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ardent Privacy
providers.description: Ardent Privacy is a data privacy and protection company that helps businesses strengthen data privacy, adopt a data‑centric approach, and secure critical data where it resides. By providing tools and services for data‑centric security, Ardent Privacy enables organizations to protect personal information, comply with regulations, and build trust with customers.

providers.name: Argus
providers.description: Argus provides AI‑enhanced analytics on Belgian public procurement tenders, delivering bid/no‑bid insights, winning price trends, and detailed award report analysis. By aggregating data from the Belgian Federal eProcurement platform, TED, and user‑uploaded award reports, Argus helps businesses understand market dynamics, identify competitors, and craft stronger proposals. The service is offered via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for seamless integration with AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT.

providers.name: AutoLeap
providers.description: AutoLeap is cloud-based shop management software for independent auto repair shops, covering repair orders, digital vehicle inspections, scheduling, parts ordering, invoicing, and reporting. Standard subscription plans (Essentials, Pro, Elite) are software-only and expose no public API. A separate, gated AutoLeap Partner API exists at developers.myautoleap.com - documented, versioned (v2), token-authenticated REST covering repair orders, customers, vehicles, appointments, inventory, items, payments, purchase orders, suppliers, and partner/company settings - but credentials (Partner ID and Auth Key) are only issued to approved integration partners on request, not to individual shop subscribers.

providers.name: AvoMD
providers.description: AvoMD (Avo) is a clinical AI platform that integrates directly with electronic health record (EHR) systems to power AI copilots for healthcare workflows. It combines EHR data with trusted clinical knowledge bases to support decision-making, documentation, and care delivery across inpatient and outpatient settings. Avo's product line includes Chart Assist, an AI Scribe for ambient clinical documentation, and AI Consult, serving rural and small hospitals, large and mid-size hospitals, and ambulatory care, in partnership with medical societies and knowledge partners. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant and backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Berrystreetafa3
providers.description: Berry Street provides nutrition therapy services covered by insurance, connecting patients with board‑certified dietitians via an online platform. The company offers personalized diet plans, condition‑specific programs, and enterprise solutions for health providers, aiming to improve health outcomes through evidence‑based nutrition care.

providers.name: Betterleap
providers.description: Betterleap is an AI-powered healthcare recruiting platform that automates candidate sourcing, credential verification, and multi-step outreach for talent acquisition teams. Its agentic search lets recruiters describe an ideal candidate conversationally and surfaces qualified matches from a database of 35M+ verified healthcare professionals, with licensing verified through 25+ state board partnerships. The platform autonomously drafts and sends personalized email sequences with follow-ups, integrates with ATS platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and UKG for talent rediscovery and data refresh, and reports recruiting performance and ROI through an insights dashboard. Betterleap is a venture-backed company (a16z portfolio) added to the API Evangelist network; it operates as a SaaS web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: BirdBuddy
providers.description: Bird Buddy (Buddy Bird Inc, backed by General Catalyst) makes the world's most recognized smart bird feeder and companion mobile app for discovering and learning about birds. An AI vision-and-sound model identifies bird species from the photos and audio captured by its camera feeders, notifies owners of feathered visitors, and organizes captures into a personal collection with postcards and monthly reports. Bird Buddy does not publish an official public API; the app is powered by a private, account- authenticated GraphQL backend hosted on AWS, which the community has reverse-engineered through the third-party pybirdbuddy Python library and a Home Assistant integration.

providers.name: Blaze Sports Intel
providers.description: Blaze Sports Intel is a sports intelligence company that turns difficult ideas into usable perspective through the language of sport. Performance is the outcome, perspective is the mechanism, sport is the interface, and college baseball is the flagship proof. It provides detailed college baseball scores, standings, polls, team and player pages, and original editorial, all with source attribution and fetched timestamps.

providers.name: Blue White Robotics
providers.description: Blue White Robotics Ltd. — operating as Bluewhite — is an Israeli off-road autonomy company founded in 2017 by Ben Alfi, Yair Shahar and Aviram Shmueli, headquartered in Tel Aviv with a US operation in Fresno, California. Bluewhite builds an OEM-agnostic autonomy stack that retrofits conventional vehicles into unmanned ground vehicles: Pathfinder, an aftermarket autonomy kit combining control, intelligence and perception modules over a distributed CAN network, and Compass, a cloud fleet-operations SaaS that lets operators remotely supervise, task and monitor an autonomous fleet. The company began in permanent-crop agriculture — autonomous spraying, mowing and harvest support across roughly 150,000 US acres for 20-plus growers — and has since extended the same GPS-denied navigation and perception stack to defense and homeland-security ground robotics. Elbit Systems' FUSE acquired 100% of Blue White Robotics in 2026. Bluewhite markets a Software SDK and an "API platform" for OEM and system integration, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; the Compass operator platform sits behind a Keycloak/OIDC login and integration access runs through a contact-sales form.

providers.name: Braavocapital
providers.description: Braavocapital, operating as Braavo Capital, provides on‑demand funding for mobile apps and games. It offers financing solutions such as app‑store payout advances, user‑acquisition financing, and financial analytics, enabling developers to scale growth without giving up equity. Since 2015, Braavo has funded over 10,000 apps with $2 billion invested, supporting a portfolio that includes popular consumer apps and games.

providers.name: Brightmoney
providers.description: Bright Money (Bright) is a San Francisco-based financial technology company that describes itself as the world's first AI Loan Assistant. Its consumer mobile app helps people pay off credit-card debt faster, build credit history, and access affordable credit through products including Bright Builder (a secured 0% APR credit line reported to the major bureaus), Bright Plan debt-payoff and budgeting, Smart Round-Ups automated savings, rent reporting, personal loans up to $10,000 through network partners, and cash advances up to $750 for all credit scores. Bright is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: CaaMTech
providers.description: CaaMTech is a pharmaceutical drug discovery company in Issaquah, Washington, founded by Dr. Andrew Chadeayne, engineering next-generation psychedelic-inspired small-molecule therapeutics for mental health conditions. It synthesizes and characterizes novel tryptamines, screens natural and synthetic compounds for safety and efficacy, publishes fundamental crystallographic and pharmacological research, and builds a patent portfolio around the results. CaaMTech operates no developer program and publishes no product API; the only machine-readable surface on caam.tech is the standard WordPress REST API that serves the company site, which does make its research updates, pages and media programmatically readable without credentials, alongside an authenticated WordPress MCP adapter endpoint.

providers.name: CapConnect
providers.description: CapConnect+ provides a digital platform that simplifies fixed income primary market issuance, connecting corporate issuers, dealers, and investors. The solution offers live book building, pricing optimization, and automated investor management, aiming to lower funding costs and increase transparency in bond and commercial paper issuance.

providers.name: Carbon
providers.description: Carbon is a digital manufacturing company that builds an integrated 3D printing platform combining Digital Light Synthesis (DLS) printing hardware, advanced photopolymer resins, and cloud-connected computational design software. Its technology enables production-scale additive manufacturing of end-use polymer parts across automotive, medical, dental, consumer goods, and industrial applications, with the Design Engine tool for lattice and part design and the Carbon Academy knowledge base for operational guidance. Carbon is a frontier-tech portfolio company backed by GV. As of this profile Carbon exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or event surface; enrichment is limited to verified company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Card Centering Tool
providers.description: Card Centering Tool provides a platform for grading, centering measurement, live pricing, and portfolio tracking of trading cards, including Pokémon, TCG, sports and entertainment cards. Users can measure card centering, obtain AI-driven grades, view real-time market values for over 1.5 million cards, and manage their collections through a comprehensive dashboard.

providers.name: Catalent
providers.description: Catalent is a global pharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey, and owned by Novo Holdings since December 2024. It develops, manufactures and supplies medicines and consumer health products for biopharma, biotech and self-care brands across biologics, cell and gene therapy, oral and injectable dose forms, clinical supply and consumer health, from roughly forty facilities. Catalent has no developer program: it publishes no API, OpenAPI, SDK, package, MCP server or agent card, and the developer.catalent.com and api.catalent.com hosts an earlier catalog record assumed do not exist in DNS. Its only customer-facing software surface is the OneHub clinical-supply portal, a login-gated Salesforce Experience Cloud site. It does publish a first-party llms.txt index of its corporate site and a working privacy-request form; both are captured here, and nothing has been authored on its behalf.

providers.name: Cenos
providers.description: CENOS is an engineering simulation software company founded in 2017 in Riga, Latvia, that packages academically proven open-source solvers (Salome, GetDP, and Elmer FEM) into focused, affordable desktop applications for practical engineers. Its products cover electromagnetic and thermal simulation use cases including induction heating, radio-frequency antenna design, wireless charging, electromagnetic stirring of liquid metals, and busbar heating, promising faster product development and lower cost than traditional CAE suites. CENOS is a subscription desktop product with CAD import, one-click PDF reports, and live expert support; it does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by 500 Global, Startup Wise Guys, and Capitalia.

providers.name: Censia
providers.description: Censia AI provides workforce intelligence solutions for the AI enterprise, delivering dynamic talent intelligence that enables organizations to understand, develop, and mobilize their workforce. Their platform offers capabilities such as upskilling, benchmarking, skills‑gap analysis, succession planning, and talent mobility, helping companies transform talent data into actionable insights.

providers.name: CentralComs
providers.description: CentralComs is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) proptech company building AI agents that automate maintenance coordination and leasing for residential and small-commercial property managers. Its agents field tenant, prospect, and owner messages 24/7, triage and dispatch maintenance work orders to ranked vendors, follow up until tickets close with verification photos, and answer lease/listing/HOA questions with the exact clause cited. A leasing agent captures multi-channel leads, scores qualification, matches units, analyzes documents, and runs background screening. CentralComs bills flat monthly per door with no per-message fees and keeps records aligned with AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, Rent Manager, and DoorLoop via CSV today, with native two-way PMS integrations on the roadmap. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company; the company does not yet publish a public API — it is an AI agent product with PMS integrations planned rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: CGC Airport Transfers
providers.description: CGC Airport Transfers provides private, pre‑booked airport transfer services on the Gold Coast and Brisbane. Customers can book fixed‑price rides from $55 for sedans or $85 for Kia Carnivals, with GST and tolls included. The service covers Gold Coast Airport (OOL), Brisbane Airport (BNE), Byron Bay and Northern NSW, offering door‑to‑door transport, in‑terminal meet‑and‑greet, 24/7 reservations via SMS or WhatsApp, and child‑seat options. Operating since 2020, the company holds a Queensland Booked Hire Service Licence and complies with Australian tax regulations, retaining records for five years.

providers.name: Charter Space
providers.description: Charter Space is a London-based space technology company, founded in 2021, building software and financial infrastructure for the New Space economy. Its flagship product, Ubik, is a browser-native, model-based systems engineering and program management platform that unifies requirements management, project management, block diagrams, test procedures, and scheduling in a single collaborative environment, cutting manual systems-engineering admin for spacecraft programs. Ubik is in beta with organizations including teams at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and exposes native integrations (OneDrive, Google Drive, Jira, GitHub) plus an API for connecting specialized tooling. Charter has also expanded into space insurance, capturing manufacturing and test data at the source to feed an underwriting interface tied to the largest space-insurance carriers, and operates an insurance brokerage for New Space companies insuring satellites and spacecraft. Backed by Techstars and Capital Factory.

providers.name: City Block
providers.description: Cityblock Health is a value-based healthcare provider delivering integrated primary care, behavioral health, and social-services support to Medicaid and lower-income (dual-eligible) Medicare populations across multiple U.S. markets. Cityblock pairs community-based care teams with a proprietary care-delivery technology platform to coordinate wraparound care for historically underserved communities. The company is backed by 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio profile; it operates as a care provider and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Cogent Communications
providers.description: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCOI, AS174) is a facilities-based Tier 1 internet service provider headquartered in Washington, DC, selling Dedicated Internet Access, IP Transit, Ethernet, MPLS IP-VPN, SD-WAN, optical wavelength transport, Global Peer Connect peering ports and colocation across its own global fiber network. Cogent publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable contract: a full probe on 2026-09-14 found no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP server or agent card on any host it operates, and the api.cogentco.com and developer.cogentco.com names a prior scaffold recorded do not exist in DNS. Its programmatic-adjacent surfaces are two login-gated portals — eCogent for billing, orders, tickets, DNS changes and IP/BGP requests, and the Global Peer Exchange portal for peering ports. What it does publish openly is a dated Network Services SLA with quantified latency, jitter and packet-delivery commitments, plus monthly network performance statistics.

providers.name: Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety Board
providers.description: The Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety Board (DNFSB) is an independent organization within the executive branch of the United States Government chartered to provide recommendations and advice to the President and the Secretary of Energy on public health and safety issues at Department of Energy defense nuclear facilities. The DNFSB publishes recommendations, letters, technical reports, weekly site-representative reports, and rulemaking notices through its public website and FOIA reading room. The agency does not publish a developer-oriented API; programmatic users rely on document downloads, RSS feeds, and Federal Register integrations.

providers.name: Dick's Sporting Goods
providers.description: DICK'S Sporting Goods is a Fortune 500 omni-channel sporting goods retailer selling sports equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories across the DICK'S, House of Sport, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone banners. It publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract: the storefront is an Angular single-page app that answers HTTP 200 with the same shell for every path, and neither api. nor developer.dickssportinggoods.com resolves in DNS. Its B2B integration surface is X12 EDI over AS2/SFTP through third-party trading networks, with vendor guidelines handed out as PDFs. The company does run a named Vulnerability Disclosure Program on Bugcrowd.

providers.name: Doctronic
providers.description: Doctronic is a consumer telemedicine platform that pairs an AI doctor with licensed physicians for anonymous, low-cost health care. Users describe their symptoms to an AI assistant that performs a free symptom assessment and health consultation, then can escalate to a real doctor for a video visit ($39/visit), prescription refills, lab orders, and follow-up care. Positioned as "Free. Anonymous. Built by doctors," the product is direct-to-consumer web and mobile rather than a developer platform: it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation. The only public machine-readable surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt with a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure policy. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: DogNote
providers.description: DogNote is a pet journal mobile application for iOS and Android that helps owners log events, care activities, and important information about their dogs and cats. The app consolidates pet health records, vaccination dates, feeding schedules, and daily activities into a single digital journal, providing reminders and insights to improve pet care.

providers.name: Double AIgents
providers.description: Double AIgents provides private, on‑premise AI solutions for law firms, wealth managers and regulated professionals. Their platform runs on isolated hardware, offering control, accountability and provability across three pillars. The company focuses on secure, compliant AI deployment for the financial and legal sectors, emphasizing data sovereignty and regulatory adherence.

providers.name: dugganusa-com
providers.description: Duggan USA is listed as a stub company in the API Evangelist harvest backlog. No public website or documentation could be retrieved despite attempts using standard and rendered fetch methods, indicating the company may not have an active online presence or may restrict access. Further investigation is required to confirm its identity and any available API offerings.

providers.name: Easyhealth
providers.description: EasyHealth delivers better health outcomes for the 100M+ members on government sponsored insurance. Empowering healthy communities through proactive care in collaboration with health plans and provider groups. Focused on clinical excellence to engage members where they want to receive care: in the home, in the clinic, and through virtual health.

providers.name: Efflux Systems
providers.description: Efflux (Efflux Systems, Inc.) is a Baltimore, Maryland cybersecurity company founded in 2014 that operates a near real-time asset intelligence and attack-surface platform. Efflux delivers fresh intelligence about the assets of organizations, networks, and services — offered as a one-time Asset Map, scheduled monitoring, or on-demand custom scanning. Its differentiator is radical transparency: rather than opaque risk scores and surface-level abstractions, Efflux records and exposes every scan it runs, every asset it discovers, and every attribution it makes, so teams can see what was found, how it was discovered, and why it matters — raw information and formatted insights side by side. Data is accessible via export, download, share, and a programmatic API. The company is backed by 500 Global, Granite Hill Capital Partners, TEDCO, and Three Tree Ventures, and is currently in early access with a public waitlist.

providers.name: Finkargo
providers.description: Finkargo is a Latin American foreign-trade commerce platform that helps importers overcome the operational and financial barriers to growing their import businesses. Its product suite spans Paga (alternative supplier financing with revolving USD credit lines and 30-150 day terms), Analiza (market-intelligence dashboards that turn trade data into strategic decisions), Verifica (global supplier verification for product quality and legitimacy), and Protege (warehouse-to-warehouse cargo insurance). Operating across Colombia and Mexico and backed by QED Investors, Finkargo digitizes the full import-operations lifecycle from evaluating suppliers and planning imports to financing, transport, and arrival. Finkargo does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures the company's public product, legal, and security surfaces.

providers.name: Fluor
providers.description: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) is a Fortune 500 engineering, procurement, construction and maintenance company headquartered in Irving, Texas. Fluor designs and builds capital projects and provides project-management services for energy, chemicals, life sciences, mining and metals, advanced technologies, infrastructure and government clients worldwide, and licenses its own process technologies such as Econamine FG Plus and Fluor Solvent. Fluor sells engineering and construction services rather than software: it operates no developer program, publishes no API reference, and serves no machine-readable API contract. Its business-to-business integration with suppliers runs inside SAP Ariba and Workday, whose contracts belong to those vendors. This is an independent API Evangelist profile of Fluor's public surface.

providers.name: FYLD
providers.description: FYLD is an AI-native frontline intelligence platform for the global critical-infrastructure sector, turning field-operations data into real-time, structured intelligence for utilities, energy, and heavy-civils operators. Its products include the FYLD Platform for work execution, FYLD Control Room for remote supervision, and FYLD ShowMe for customer self-service reporting, serving managers, fieldworkers, contractors, and civil engineers via web and mobile (iOS and Android) apps. FYLD is a Partech portfolio company. As of this profile FYLD publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integration is delivered through partnerships such as Procore, and this record captures its public identity, security, and trust surface.

providers.name: Gireve
providers.description: Gireve is a B2B digital platform for electric-vehicle charging and new-mobility services, connecting charge point operators (CPOs), e-mobility service providers (eMSPs), and EV drivers across Europe. Its interoperability hub powers EV charging roaming, clearing and transaction settlement, Plug & Charge, smart charging, and mobility data services, spanning 680,000+ connected charging points and roughly one million monthly roaming transactions across 13,000+ signed agreements. Technical integration is delivered to connected operators over an OCPI-based hub through the Connect Place B2B platform; Gireve does not publish a public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: GLORRI
providers.description: Glorri is a cloud-based applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruitment automation platform for talent acquisition teams. It spans the entire hiring process, from sourcing candidates across multiple channels and job boards, to automating recruiting workflows and candidate communication, AI-assisted applicant screening, and analytics on team performance and hiring efficiency, with GDPR-compliant data handling. Glorri markets plans (Pay as you go, Flex, Corporate, and Enterprise Plus) for companies of different sizes, with custom integrations and a branded career page available on higher tiers. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Glorri publishes a web application and marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: GraniteShares
providers.description: GraniteShares is an independent exchange-traded fund (ETF) issuer that builds alternative, single-stock and thematic investment products for investors who want differentiated exposure. Its lineup spans 2x leveraged and inverse single-stock ETFs (such as NVDL for NVIDIA and TSLR for Tesla), YieldBOOST options-income ETFs, autocallable ETFs, physically-backed gold and broad commodity ETFs, and diversified income and equity strategies across U.S. and European markets. GraniteShares publishes no public developer or data API program; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's public web surface and the machine-readable discovery documents (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 member authentication for its Umbraco-powered site) that were probed from its domain. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: greenerahead-com
providers.description: Greener Ahead provides ESG software solutions for voluntary sustainability reporting, CSRD compliance, carbon accounting, and climate strategy. Their platform helps businesses collect, analyze, and report environmental data, offering tools for emissions tracking, regulatory reporting, and strategic planning to turn sustainability into a competitive advantage.

providers.name: Growatt
providers.description: Growatt New Energy is a global manufacturer of solar PV inverters, energy storage systems, and smart energy management products for residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations. Growatt operates the ShineServer / ShinePhone cloud monitoring platform and publishes a token-authenticated Open API (V1) that lets third-party systems read plant and device telemetry, retrieve historical energy data, and read or write inverter parameters for MIN (TLX) string inverters and SPH (MIX) hybrid inverters across regional endpoints. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital; enriched from Growatt's public developer surface.

providers.name: HAAS Alert
providers.description: HAAS Alert operates Safety Cloud, a connected-vehicle safety platform that delivers real-time digital alerts to nearby motorists about active emergency responses, roadside hazards, work zones, stopped vehicles, and slow-moving equipment. Using vehicle-to-everything (V2X) and cellular messaging, Safety Cloud gives drivers up to roughly 30 seconds of advance warning to help reduce collisions with first responders, tow operators, and roadway workers. HAAS Alert integrates with telematics platforms, fleet manufacturers, OEM vehicles, in-car navigation (including Waze), and roadway infrastructure to form a large connected-vehicle alerting ecosystem. The company is a Techstars portfolio company. This profile was enriched from HAAS Alert's public web surface; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs were found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Helloworld Travel
providers.description: Helloworld Travel Limited (ASX: HLO) is an Australian travel distribution group headquartered in Sydney, operating retail agency networks, corporate travel, wholesale packaging, air ticket consolidation and inbound tour operations across Australia, New Zealand, Fiji and Europe with more than 700 staff and over 2,700 retail members. It sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain — an aggregator and reseller of third-party air, hotel and land content rather than an inventory owner — reaching travellers through its member agencies and reaching air supply through GDS-based consolidation and ticketing (Air Tickets, Express Tickets, SmartTickets). Its API posture is closed. There is no public developer portal, no OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI or Postman artifact, and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Every trade system is behind an agent login — ReadyRooms (B2B hotel and activity booking), AOTonline.net (inbound trade booking engine), Air Tickets and Express Tickets. A developer host is provisioned at developer.readyrooms.com.au but returns HTTP 401 with a Basic auth challenge on every path probed, so access is partner-only. There is no published exit path — the only documented way to get data back is a Privacy Act access request to the Helloworld Privacy Officer.

providers.name: heva
providers.description: heva is an AI-native healthcare and medical-tourism platform that connects patients with vetted medical practices, specialists, and providers across borders, with an initial focus on Spanish-speaking markets. The platform offers practice discovery by specialty and location, deposit-based online appointment booking, a conversational AI booking assistant (Heva AI), an online store for purchasing procedures and services, and secure payments via Stripe. Provider-facing tools cover practice management, patient acquisition, communications, and appointment coordination, delivered through the web and native iOS and Android provider apps. heva is a Techstars-backed company building "care without borders."

providers.name: Hidden Door
providers.description: Hidden Door is an interactive storytelling platform where roleplay meets fan fiction, letting players step into imaginative worlds and shape branching narratives through their choices. Players pick a pre-built world, add modifiers, create a character, and experience a unique story with a full cast of characters, where every playthrough differs. Creators can build playable worlds in as little as thirty minutes, then share, publish, and get paid when others play. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Homebrew and Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. Hidden Door ships a consumer web experience and publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. Sector: AI / entertainment.

providers.name: IrisVR
providers.description: IrisVR is a virtual-reality software company for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, best known for its two products: Prospect, a desktop application that converts Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Navisworks and other 3D/BIM models into immersive VR walkthroughs in one click, and Scope, a mobile app for viewing and sharing 360-degree panoramas on standalone and phone-based VR headsets. Founded in New York, IrisVR was acquired by The Wild in 2021, and The Wild (together with IrisVR) was subsequently acquired by Autodesk in 2022. The products and support site remain available. IrisVR does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, packages, and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lockton
providers.description: Lockton Companies is the world's largest privately held, independent insurance brokerage, founded by Jack Lockton in 1966 and headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, United States. Lockton is a broker and intermediary rather than a risk carrier: it places commercial property and casualty, specialty and financial lines, employee benefits and people solutions, private client coverage, and — through Lockton Re — treaty and facultative reinsurance, for tens of thousands of clients across a global network of associates and offices reaching more than 140 locations. Its API posture is honestly characterized as partner-gated with no public API surface. As of July 2026 Lockton publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, no GraphQL endpoint, no Postman workspace, and no webhook or event catalog. The hostnames developer.lockton.com, developers.lockton.com, docs.lockton.com and api.lockton.com do not resolve in DNS, and a crawl of the 6,953 URLs in global.lockton.com/sitemap.xml surfaces no developer, API, ACORD, IVANS, OpenAPI or Swagger path. Client-facing technology is delivered through authenticated regional Lockton Client Portals and the proprietary Lockton SAGE intelligence and analytics ecosystem, which is presented on the website behind a contact form with no self-serve access, no documented data feed and no published integration surface. This is the expected posture for a US broker-intermediary: the United States has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate, so data exchange between carriers, brokers and agency management systems runs on ACORD standards in an EDI and forms idiom rather than a public API idiom. Lockton's most substantive standards signal is governance rather than implementation — in July 2026 Nidhi Howell, Chief Business Technology Officer of Lockton Re, was appointed to the ACORD Solutions Group Board of Directors representing the reinsurance broking channel — but no ACORD AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS or IVANS agency-download implementation is documented on any public Lockton property.

providers.name: Lumeon
providers.description: Lumeon is a clinical automation and care orchestration platform that uses intelligent automation and real-time data integration to remove inefficiencies from care-coordination processes. It lets health systems scale best-practice care pathways across the enterprise so clinicians can focus on patients while operational cost falls and outcomes improve. Lumeon serves 70+ health systems globally — including Optum, NYC Health+Hospitals, and the NHS — and is now part of Health Catalyst. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published; this profile captures the company identity and its security and compliance posture.

providers.name: Lunabill
providers.description: LunaBill is an AI revenue cycle management (RCM) platform for hospitals, health systems, and RCM/BPO firms, built by LunaHealth Technologies, Inc. and backed by Y Combinator. A coordinated team of AI agents works the entire accounts receivable queue end to end — placing real calls to payers and waiting on hold, navigating IVR phone trees, checking payer portals (Availity, Waystar), working denials, filing appeals, and resubmitting claims — while running inside the EHR and clearinghouses a provider already uses (Epic, Cerner, GoRev, Waystar, Availity) and leaving a full audit trail on every claim. Pricing is performance based (1.5% of net collections recovered, nothing upfront). LunaBill is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type I (Type II in progress). It does not currently publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through EHR and clearinghouse connectors rather than a documented API surface.

providers.name: Manara
providers.description: Manara is an upskilling and professional development platform focused on the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, specializing in training for emerging technologies including AI and cloud computing. It runs enterprise workforce-development programs, national government training initiatives, and individual learning and certification courses, connecting a community of MENA software engineers and technologists with global career opportunities. The company reports 300,000+ learners trained, 2,500+ certifications awarded, operations across 40+ countries, and 500+ job placements. Manara publishes no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: MaxLinear
providers.description: MaxLinear, Inc. (NASDAQ: MXL) is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Carlsbad, California that designs radio-frequency (RF), high-performance analog, and mixed-signal communications systems-on-chip (SoCs) for critical network infrastructure, the connected home, and industrial and multi-market applications. Its products integrate RF, analog, mixed-signal, digital signal processing, security engines, data compression, networking, and power management into single chips that power cable and fiber broadband modems, Wi-Fi 6/7 and wireline home routers, optical transceivers, 4G/5G base-station and backhaul infrastructure, and high-speed data-center interconnects. MaxLinear exposes developer surface primarily as hardware/firmware SDKs and C APIs (for example the Panther Storage Acceleration SDK and the MxL890x Raw Acceleration API) delivered with its silicon, along with design tools, simulation models, and a technical documentation library — it does not publish a public web/REST API. This profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Melonn
providers.description: Melonn is a third-party logistics (3PL) and multichannel fulfillment operator for e-commerce businesses across Colombia and Mexico. Through its proprietary Órbita platform it centralizes inventory, processes and packs orders, manages returns, and offers same/next-day delivery, unifying multiple sales channels into a single operation. Melonn connects to platforms such as Shopify, VTEX, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, MercadoLibre, Amazon, Walmart, Rappi, TikTok Shop, Liverpool, and Coppel, and exposes a REST API with real-time webhooks so any external platform can drive order management, inventory queries, shipment tracking, and returns. Melonn was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Public developer documentation and a sandbox are provided on request via the Melonn advisory/contact form rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Mira
providers.description: Mira is a San Francisco-based consumer hardware startup building AI-powered smart glasses positioned as an always-on "second brain." Founded in 2024 by Harvard builders AnhPhu Nguyen and Caine Ardayfio (rebranded from Halo), the camera-free glasses pair a dual-waveguide display, microphone, and iOS companion app to deliver live transcription, real-time translation across 60+ languages, hands-free AI assistance, and searchable memory of everyday conversations. Mira raised a $6.6M seed round led by General Catalyst and began shipping its first devices in January 2026. It is a privacy-first consumer wearable with an iOS companion app and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: MySpeed
providers.description: MySpeed is an open-source, self-hosted application that automatically runs internet speed tests to monitor download, upload, and ping metrics over time. It provides detailed analytics, visualizations, multilingual support, and integrations with services like Discord, Telegram, and webhooks. Users can schedule tests at flexible intervals, view historical data, and keep their connection data private on their own servers.

providers.name: Nile
providers.description: Nile is a San Jose, California enterprise networking company delivering an AI-native Secure Network as a Service (NaaS). Founded in 2018 by former Cisco executives Pankaj Patel and John Chambers (chairman), Nile replaces traditional campus and branch LAN/Wi-Fi hardware-and-license procurement with a subscription-based, outcome-guaranteed wired and wireless network stack delivered as a service. The Nile Access Service combines its purpose-built Zero Trust Fabric (switches, access points, gateways, and sensors) with cloud-based autonomous operations, the Nile Services Cloud, Nile AI, Nile Nav, and Nile Digital Twin to plan, deploy, monitor, and self-heal enterprise networks. The platform emphasizes built-in Zero Trust segmentation, continuous performance guarantees (coverage, capacity, availability), and consumption-based pricing — marketed against 60%+ breach reduction, 99%+ ticket reduction, ~3x faster change management, and ~40% TCO savings versus traditional enterprise networking. Nile does not publish a general-purpose public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or Terraform provider; its programmable surface is limited to a closed admin/portal API and outbound webhooks used for documented integrations with ServiceNow (ticket and alert webhooks), Splunk HEC, CrowdStrike, Zscaler ZIA, Microsoft Entra (SCIM), Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Global Secure Access, Palo Alto Networks, Forescout (device inventory API), SecureW2, Aruba ClearPass, VeloCloud, Graphiant, Hamina, and Ekahau. Nile is available through the AWS Marketplace as a SaaS subscription.

providers.name: Nirvana Tech
providers.description: Nirvana Insurance (Nirvana Tech, Inc.) is a technology-driven commercial trucking insurance provider that pairs A-rated fleet insurance coverage with an AI-powered active safety platform. Nirvana ingests telematics and connected-vehicle data from motor carriers to price risk more accurately, help fleets save up to 20% on premiums, and reduce accidents through real-time safety alerts, driver coaching, and predictive risk scoring. The company serves fleets and independent insurance agents through a digital quoting and policy-management agent portal, and is backed by General Catalyst. Nirvana raised a Series D round to expand its data-driven insurance and safety products across the trucking industry. As of this profile Nirvana operates a marketing site plus an agent sign-in portal and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Orca Security
providers.description: Orca Security is an agentless cloud security platform that uses its patented SideScanning technology to provide visibility into risks across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, Kubernetes, and serverless environments, covering CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, DSPM, vulnerability management, malware detection, API security, and AI security in a single platform. Orca exposes a region-aware REST API for assets, alerts, integrations, automations, and user management, plus SCIM 2.0 for identity provisioning and a Terraform provider for infrastructure-as-code workflows.

providers.name: OrderCircle
providers.description: OrderCircle is a B2B wholesale order management software platform, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that gives fast-growing brands one system to automate wholesale orders, track inventory in real time, generate invoices, and run a self-service B2B eCommerce portal for their buyers. It targets wholesale operations in apparel, coffee, jewelry, food and beverage, hemp, vape, and CBD, and connects to existing tools through pre-built integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, QuickBooks, Xero, ShipStation, Stripe, Square, PayPal PayFlow, and Authorize.Net. OrderCircle does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its programmatic surface is limited to its packaged third-party integrations. This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: OurCrowd
providers.description: OurCrowd is a global private-market investment platform that gives accredited and institutional investors access to curated venture and alternative-asset deals. Through a single online account, members can invest in pre-vetted startups, thematic and targeted venture funds, and a range of alternatives such as private equity and private credit. The platform handles deal sourcing, due diligence, syndication, and post-investment management. OurCrowd is a consumer-facing investment product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Papernest
providers.description: Papernest is a French technology company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Paris, that provides a digital platform for managing, switching, and cancelling household subscriptions — energy, telecom and internet, mobile plans, and home insurance — through a single interface. Built around the moment people move home, the service is free to end users and monetized through commissions from supplier partners across France, Spain, Italy, and the UK, having helped more than 3 million customers. Papernest does not publish a public developer API; it runs a private B2B partner integration program and maintains an official GitHub organization of archived open-source utilities.

providers.name: Paradigm Health
providers.description: Paradigm Health is an AI-native clinical trial platform connecting biopharma sponsors with a research-ready provider network spanning roughly 2,100 care locations across the United States. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, the company operates infrastructure implemented at healthcare provider organizations to make clinical research part of routine care. Its Study Conduct platform captures data directly from electronic health records and other structured and unstructured sources, algorithmically evaluates FDA-defined data points in real time, and transmits the critical safety and efficacy signals needed for regulatory determinations to trial sponsors and the FDA. Paradigm serves both trial sponsors (protocol optimization, feasibility and site selection, patient identification and enrollment, data collection and delivery, post-approval evidence) and research sites. The company acquired Flatiron Health's Clinical Research business, announced a research collaboration with the U.S. FDA, and is backed by ARCH Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and GV. Paradigm currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity, legal, and published security/compliance surface.

providers.name: Polymorph
providers.description: Polymorph is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building adaptive consumer internet infrastructure that personalizes user experiences with AI agents. Founded in San Francisco by Andrew Sy, the platform runs thousands of continuous product and lifecycle-engagement experiments for its customers, each carrying the craft of that product's direction and brand, so consumer teams can scale experimentation in product surfaces without being bottlenecked by headcount or design capacity. Its stated vision is to make the consumer internet polymorphic — one that adapts to each user and optimizes for delightful experiences. As of this profile the company operates a marketing site only; it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: PostgreSQL
providers.description: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development. It provides advanced SQL compliance, ACID transactions, and extensibility. PostgreSQL exposes a binary wire protocol via libpq and language bindings rather than a public HTTP REST API, so there is no canonical OpenAPI specification. HTTP access is typically layered on top via PostgREST, Hasura, or application code.

providers.name: Printavo
providers.description: Printavo is print shop management software for screen printers, embroiderers, and other decorated-apparel businesses, covering quotes, invoices, orders, customers, line items, production statuses, tasks, payments, and merch stores. Printavo exposes a public GraphQL API (API v2) at www.printavo.com/api/v2 that supersedes its legacy REST API. The GraphQL API is authenticated with an account email plus an API token and is gated to Printavo's Premium subscription tier; the API reference and GraphQL schema are publicly documented at www.printavo.com/docs/api/v2.

providers.name: Pylon (formerly Braid Lending)
providers.description: Pylon (formerly Braid Lending) is an AI-native mortgage infrastructure company founded in 2022 and headquartered in New York, New York, backed by investors including 500 Global and Citi. Pylon operates as "America's mortgage rails," an API-first, MCP-native platform that lets brokers, fintechs, lenders, and banks build and automate mortgage origination end to end — from application through underwriting, decisioning, compliance, and capital markets settlement. Every aspect of mortgage fulfillment is powered by APIs, complemented by a white-label "Elements" UI component library for embedding fully digital, autonomous mortgage experiences. The public developer surface (API reference, integration guides, and a live playground) is gated behind a developer-access request form, so no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or hosted docs were discoverable during enrichment.

providers.name: Quuu
providers.description: Quuu provides an AI‑powered social media automation platform that creates, schedules, and publishes posts across X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, and Bluesky. The service learns a brand’s voice from existing content, generates AI‑crafted captions and images, and offers a dashboard for review and control. It targets creators, agencies, small teams, and businesses seeking consistent online presence without hiring a social media manager. Pricing is per connected profile with a free trial and no credit‑card required.

providers.name: Repl.it
providers.description: Replit (formerly Repl.it) is an online IDE and collaborative coding platform that lets users write, run, and host code in many programming languages directly from a browser. It provides instant development environments, multi-user collaboration, deployment tools, and a marketplace for apps and extensions, serving developers, educators, and enterprises worldwide.

providers.name: Ruckus Networks
providers.description: Ruckus Networks provides AI-driven enterprise Wi‑Fi and networking solutions, offering cloud‑managed access points, switches, and AI‑enhanced radio resource management. Their portfolio includes RUCKUS One, AI, Unleashed, and services for education, hospitality, public venues, and enterprises, emphasizing zero‑trust security and network‑as‑a‑service.

providers.name: SambaTV
providers.description: Samba TV is a media and advertising intelligence company that measures television and streaming viewership across screens using data collected from millions of opted-in smart TVs and connected devices. Its platform gives advertisers, agencies, and publishers cross-screen audience targeting, campaign measurement, and content analytics built on privacy-first, deterministic viewing signals rather than cookies or traditional identifiers. Samba TV operates a gated partner portal (developer.samba.tv, which redirects to partner-portal.tvp.samba.tv) for licensed data partners; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish an open, public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Sentisis Analytics
providers.description: Sentisis (Sentisis Intelligence) is a Spanish-language AI consumer-intelligence and sentiment-analysis platform that turns social media conversations, surveys, emails, and online reviews into actionable business insight using proprietary natural-language-processing built for Spanish and its regional variants. Products span Social Media listening, Customer Experience analytics, Reviews analysis, and sector consulting, serving brands such as Vodafone, Santander, Bancolombia, ALDI, Iberdrola, and Sony Pictures from offices in Madrid, Bogota, and Mexico City. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a domain security probe.

providers.name: SIEMonster
providers.description: SIEMonster is a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) vendor whose flagship SIEMonster V5 platform ingests, correlates, and alerts on 2M+ security events per second for threat detection and response, deployed via AWS Marketplace or as a managed SaaS. Its EDG3 product is an autonomous AI SOC built on an edge-resident security lakehouse. Documentation covers platform deployment and agent installation, a knowledgebase, and FAQs; SIEMonster does not publish a public developer REST API, SDKs, or API reference at this time.

providers.name: Sonar Mental Health
providers.description: Sonar Mental Health provides 24/7 text-based wellbeing coaching and care navigation for youth. Trained Wellbeing Coaches lead the conversations, supported by AI tooling that surfaces context and flags risk without making independent decisions, delivering between-visit and after-hours support, escalation and care coordination to higher levels of care, and real-time insights dashboards for measurement-based care across schools, health systems, primary care, and EAP pathways. The company reports serving 20,000+ young people with higher engagement between visits, and is backed by 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture (SOC 2, HIPAA), and public web properties.

providers.name: Star Micronics CloudPRNT
providers.description: Star Micronics, founded in 1947, is a global manufacturer of point‑of‑sale (POS) hardware and technology. It offers a range of printers, label printers, kiosks, cash‑drawers and cloud‑based solutions such as CloudPRNT, enabling retailers and hospitality venues to print receipts and labels directly from cloud services. The company serves millions of businesses worldwide across retail, food service and other verticals, emphasizing reliable hardware, broad compatibility and developer resources.

providers.name: Startup Buffer
providers.description: Startup Buffer is a community-driven directory and platform for discovering new startups, products, and innovations across various industries. The platform offers startup submission, browsing, and discovery features through web and mobile applications.

providers.name: Startup Ranking
providers.description: Startup Ranking is a platform that tracks, ranks, and indexes startups worldwide based on web presence, social metrics, and growth signals. It provides startup discovery, competitive benchmarking, and market intelligence for investors, entrepreneurs, and researchers.

providers.name: Stuck
providers.description: STUCK? is a content creation, translation, and localization platform based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia that pairs AI efficiency with human expertise. Customers can request work fully AI-powered, fully human-expert-led, or as a hybrid (AI drafting with human review) across translation, content writing, video subtitling, editing, and dialect localization. The platform matches requesters to vetted experts in under ten minutes, supports direct chat and document upload, and runs a quality-assurance review step. Pricing spans pay-as-you-go, monthly and annual subscriptions, and custom enterprise plans. Stuck is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a web/app product but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: TrueCommerce
providers.description: TrueCommerce provides end‑to‑end supply‑chain solutions, including EDI, e‑invoicing, VMI, and B2B eCommerce platforms. Their services connect trading partners, automate order management, and ensure compliance with global invoicing standards, helping manufacturers, retailers, and distributors streamline operations.

providers.name: viridis-security-com
providers.description: Viridis Security provides security assessments for AI agents and MCP (Machine Control Protocol) systems. Their services include agent resilience assessments, authority and architecture reviews, AI control‑boundary reviews, and vulnerability evidence reviews. They offer a proof‑of‑work middleware product called Maxwell’s Defense and publish research on AI agent security. The company helps customers understand risks, choose controls, and obtain inspectable evidence with clear limits.

providers.name: WalkMe
providers.description: WalkMe is a Digital Adoption Platform delivering in-app guidance, walkthroughs, and analytics that help users navigate and adopt enterprise applications.

providers.name: 3ProTV
providers.description: 3ProTV (삼프로TV), operated by E-Broadcasting Co. of Seoul, South Korea, is the country's largest economic and financial media platform — a YouTube-native economics broadcaster founded in 2018 that has grown into a subscription content business spanning live market programming, original news and research (PDS) archives, premium lectures and seminars, paid membership clubs, and a publishing arm. Its content is distributed through the 3ProTV web application at apps.3protv.com and native iOS and Android apps backed by a private application API at api.3protv.com. 3ProTV is an end-user media and education product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, machine-readable contract, SDK or webhook surface.

providers.name: Adentro
providers.description: Adentro (formerly Zenreach) is a WiFi marketing and customer-intelligence platform that connects online marketing spend to real-world, in-store visits for brick-and-mortar businesses. Branded guest-WiFi portals capture and enrich first-party customer profiles, measure foot traffic and a "Walk-Through Rate" attribution metric, and power automated email and audience-targeting campaigns across roughly 100 million verified US consumer profiles. Adentro serves retail, food and beverage, venues and arenas, and entertainment and hospitality brands. It exposes a partner/customer-gated Contacts API and a Location & Scanning API (V2/V3) for syncing captured contacts, visits, and location data into CRMs and loyalty platforms such as Fishbowl and Alpine IQ; access is granted via an Adentro-issued token passed in the Authorization header rather than through a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Amperos Health
providers.description: Amperos Health (Amperos) is an AI-native insurance revenue recovery platform for healthcare providers. It uses agentic AI together with experienced revenue cycle management (RCM) specialists to run the full insurance collections process, from claim submission through denial resolution to payment. The platform automates first-touch routine tasks, works complex denials with specialist oversight, and adapts configurable workflows to each organization's procedures across specialties including orthopedics, cardiology, behavioral health, DME/HME, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, dermatology, urology, dental, and oncology. Amperos reports outcomes such as higher claim recovery, reduced accounts receivable backlogs, and lower cost to collect for the healthcare providers it serves. The company is backed by Uncork Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company. Amperos currently exposes a marketing and demo-request surface rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties and security posture.

providers.name: Anker Innovations
providers.description: Anker Innovations is a global consumer-electronics company headquartered in Shenzhen, China, known for its Anker charging and power products, Soundcore audio, eufy smart-home and security devices, Nebula projectors, and Anker SOLIX portable power and solar storage. Through the Anker Open Platform (developer.anker.com) the company exposes a developer surface that lets partners integrate and control Anker devices from their own applications via API and SDK, gated behind an Open Platform login. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and is being enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Anytime AI
providers.description: Anytime AI provides an AI‑powered legal assistant platform for plaintiff lawyers, offering tools for case analysis, discovery, demand letters, and settlement strategy. The company focuses on complex litigation, delivering a personalized agentic co‑worker that helps settle cases faster and at higher values. Its SaaS solution includes practice‑area specific modules such as personal injury, nursing‑home litigation, medical malpractice, truck accidents, and traumatic brain injury, with a roadmap for version 3.0.

providers.name: AssessLane
