Its products project GPS navigation, speed, intercom, radar and call information into the rider's line of sight: EyeRide, a universal HUD accessory compatible with any motorcycle helmet; the GT-AIR 3 Smart, an integrated head-up display visor built into a SHOEI helmet; the APEX HUD glasses for general aviation; and Pulse Ultra, a universal Bluetooth intercom. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at eye-lights.com and runs customer support on Odoo. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; EyeLights publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time, so this record captures its consumer web, identity, and security posture rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Fantastical (Flexibits)
providers.description: Fantastical, developed by Flexibits, offers powerful calendar and productivity applications across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Googlebook platforms. Their flagship apps, Fantastical and Cardhop, focus on intuitive scheduling, contact management, and seamless integration with various services, helping users stay organized and efficient. The company emphasizes flexibility, user-friendly design, and continuous feature enhancements to improve personal and professional productivity.

providers.name: Fastwork
providers.description: Fastwork is Thailand's leading freelance and services marketplace, connecting businesses and individuals with roughly 200,000 vetted service providers across about 300 categories — including design and graphics, web and app development, AI development and automation, marketing and advertising, writing and translation, photography and video, and lifestyle services. An escrow-based "Fastwork Guarantee" holds payment until work is delivered, protecting both buyers and freelancers. The platform serves individuals, SMEs, and enterprises with a dedicated business portal, and is expanding from Thailand into Indonesia and Vietnam. Fastwork is backed by 500 Global and Partech. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: FirstCry
providers.description: FirstCry (operated by Brainbees Solutions Ltd) is India's largest omnichannel retailer of baby, kids, and maternity products, founded in 2010 by Supam Maheshwari and Amitava Saha and headquartered in Pune, India. It sells apparel, footwear, toys, diapers, feeding and nursery gear, and personal-care products across its website, mobile apps, and a large network of physical stores, alongside in-house brands such as BabyHug. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and listed publicly on the NSE and BSE in 2024. FirstCry publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, policy, and security-disclosure surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Flow Commerce (Global E)
providers.description: Flow Commerce (now part of Global-e) is a cross-border ecommerce platform that lets online merchants localize the entire international shopping experience. It provides localized pricing in 100+ currencies, localized checkout with international payment methods, guaranteed landed-cost (duties and taxes) calculation, international shipping and returns, fraud and compliance handling, and localized product feeds. Flow exposes these capabilities as a REST API defined in APIBuilder, with first-party Ruby and Node.js client SDKs generated from that service definition. Flow.io was acquired by Global-e and now operates as part of the Global-e cross-border enablement platform.

providers.name: Freshket
providers.description: Freshket is a Thai agri-food supply chain technology company that operates a B2B online marketplace connecting farmers and food producers directly with restaurants, hotels, catering operations, and food manufacturers. The platform uses technology to manage the fresh-produce and ingredient supply chain more efficiently and transparently, giving buyers quality ingredients at fair prices with reliable next-day delivery while giving growers better market access and pricing. Founded in Bangkok and backed by 500 Global, Freshket covers ordering, sourcing, cold-chain logistics, and account management for foodservice businesses across Thailand. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Freshket publishes a customer-facing web and mobile ordering platform but no public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Geode
providers.description: Geode Finance is a decentralized, trustless staking infrastructure protocol on Ethereum (with an earlier Avalanche v1 deployment) that lets anyone create and operate permissionless, configurable liquid-staking pools without intermediaries. Through its Portal router, isolated storage, dual governance, staking derivatives (gETH / gAVAX), an operator marketplace, withdrawal contracts, bound liquidity pools, and the Telescope oracle system, entities can launch their own liquid staking derivatives, isolate risk profiles, run KYC/AML-segregated pools, and earn sustainable maintenance-fee revenue. Developers integrate via the geodefi Python SDK and geo-vue UI components.

providers.name: Get
providers.description: Get (useget.com) is a Singapore-based fintech company offering a mobile banking and financial-literacy platform for children, teens, and their families. The Get app pairs separate kid and parent accounts with prepaid Visa cards, parental spending controls, automated weekly allowances, a chore-based reward system, real-time spending analytics, and savings-goal folders, so young people can practice using real money tools in a safe, supervised environment. Get sells consumer subscription tiers (Get Core and Get Plus) plus a family account, and operates under a Payment Services exemption in Singapore. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification is published at this time; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Giftly
providers.description: Giftly is a digital gifting platform that lets anyone send a flexible monetary gift redeemable at a specific local or national business, or as cash. Senders pick a place or category, customize the card design and tagline, choose a gift amount up to $1,000, and deliver it by email, text, print, or mail. Recipients redeem a Giftly gift as a Visa or Mastercard gift card by mail, as a credit to their bank account, or as a credit to their PayPal account; gifts never expire and carry no inactivity fees. Giftly also runs a corporate and business program for companies sending gifts at scale. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital; Giftly publishes a consumer web product and a business portal, but no public developer API, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Girlboss
providers.description: Girlboss is a community and media brand for ambitious women, positioned as a navigator for the future of work — created to spark the thrill of possibility and to inspire and inform so members can find success on their own terms. Founded by Sophia Amoruso (author of #GIRLBOSS and founder of Nasty Gal), Girlboss grew from editorial content, newsletters, and the Girlboss Rally events into a community brand. Today girlboss.com runs as a Shopify-hosted storefront and brand site. Girlboss was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners; it publishes no first-party developer API, so this profile captures its public web, policy, and agent-facing (llms.txt / well-known) surface rather than an API.

providers.name: instabridge
providers.description: Instabridge is a global internet connectivity company operated by Degoo Backup AB in Stockholm, Sweden, and backed by Balderton Capital and Creandum. Its mobile apps give users access to a crowdsourced map of roughly 20 million free WiFi hotspots and to prepaid eSIM mobile-data plans covering 190+ countries with no roaming fees. With more than 200 million app downloads, Instabridge combines community-shared WiFi, pay-as-you-go global data, a data-saving browser, VPN, and cloud storage, and runs a distribution-partner program for prepaid top-up resellers. It is a consumer app company with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Intact Financial
providers.description: Intact Financial Corporation is the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada, headquartered in Toronto and trading on the TSX as IFC. It underwrites personal auto, personal property, and commercial P&C lines through the Intact Insurance, belairdirect, BrokerLink, Intact Prestige, Intact Public Entities, and On Side Restoration brands in Canada, through Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions in the United States, and through Intact Insurance UK, EU, IE and 123.ie internationally following the 2021 acquisition of RSA. Distribution runs through a network of more than 6,000 independent broker offices plus direct-to-consumer channels. Its API posture is partner-gated and closed. There is no public, self-serve developer portal, no published API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI artifact on any Intact domain probed. developer/developers/docs/api subdomains on intactfc.com and intact.ca do not resolve; /developers, /api, /developer and /partners return 404. The only integration surfaces are login walls — the Intact Portal for brokers at portal.intactinsurance.com (brokers.intact.ca redirects there) and the customer Client Centre behind IBM Security WebSEAL at apps.intactinsurance.com. Broker connectivity in Canada is mediated by CSIO, the industry standards body whose EDI, XML, eDocs and JSON API standards are the Canadian analogue of ACORD. Intact Insurance is listed in the CSIO member directory but appears on none of CSIO's certified-member lists (eDocs, CL Data, Compliance/Z-code, API Security Standards, JSON API Standards) and is recorded as "Not Yet Rated" on both the personal and commercial tracks of CSIO's 2026 Standards Certification Ratings. No ACORD reference was found anywhere on the company's public web properties.

providers.name: Ipid
providers.description: iPiD (International Payments Identity) is a fintech providing real-time Know Your Payee (KYP) verification for cross-border and domestic payments. Its single, payment-rail-agnostic API lets banks, PSPs, and corporates validate bank account ownership and match payee names before funds move, reducing authorized push payment (APP) fraud, business email compromise losses, and failed transactions. Products include iPiD Validate (global payee / bank account verification with name-matching), iPiD Node (a scheme-compliance layer for EU Verification of Payee, UK Confirmation of Payee, FATF Recommendation 16, and US Nacha), and a Payment Agent agentic verification layer. Founded in 2021, iPiD is backed by QED Investors, Monk's Hill Ventures, Quona Capital, Jungle Ventures, Saison Capital, and others. Public API access is gated behind a sales/demo process; no machine-readable specification is published publicly.

providers.name: K3s
providers.description: K3s is a lightweight Kubernetes distribution designed for resource-constrained environments, edge computing, IoT devices, and CI/CD pipelines. K3s is a fully compliant Kubernetes distribution with a reduced memory footprint and simplified installation.

providers.name: Karat.io
providers.description: Karat (trykarat.com) is a fintech platform providing integrated business banking and financial tools built for entrepreneurs, content creators, agencies, and small businesses managing irregular income. Its product suite spans FDIC-insured business checking accounts with high APY, the Karat Card and Karat Max charge/credit cards with rewards and no annual fees, mass and international contractor payments, AI-powered bookkeeping with automatic transaction categorization, invoicing, and multi-entity team management. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass Karat publishes a consumer web and mobile app but no public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Kasheesh
providers.description: Kasheesh is a consumer fintech platform that lets people split a single purchase across up to five credit and debit cards in one transaction. Instead of a traditional buy-now-pay-later loan, Kasheesh combines the funds and credit a customer already holds into a single digital Kasheesh Card that works at any Mastercard-accepting merchant online or in-store via tap-to-pay. The service charges a flat service fee, returns card rewards on spend, and requires no sign-up fee or credit check. Kasheesh is offered through iOS and Android apps and a web app, targeting everyday shopping, bill payment, and rent. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Anthemis; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kestrl: Muslim Money App
providers.description: Kestrl is a UK-based, FCA-regulated ethical fintech offering a values-aligned money app for Muslim and ethically-minded consumers. In partnership with Maybank Islamic, it provides interest-free (Sharia-compliant) banking, a Mastercard debit card with values filtering, goal-based sub-accounts, interest purification and Zakat calculation, transaction monitoring that alerts users to payments toward ethically questionable companies, and security features such as card freezing and biometric authentication. Kestrl is a consumer mobile application on iOS and Android; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: King
providers.description: King operates a leading digital entertainment company offering popular casual games like Candy Crush Saga, Farm Heroes, and Bubble Witch across web, mobile, and tablet platforms. With millions of daily active users worldwide, King delivers engaging, free‑to‑play experiences that sync progress across devices, fostering a vibrant community of players. The company focuses on fun, accessible gaming and continuous innovation in the online gaming space.

providers.name: Konvex
providers.description: Konvex provides a universal MCP (Multi‑Channel Platform) server that exposes REST APIs for major accounting and ERP systems such as SAP, NetSuite, Siigo, QuickBooks and over 30 others. Designed for fintech, B2B SaaS and AI agents, the service offers a free 7‑day trial and aims to simplify integration of financial data across platforms, enabling developers to build robust financial applications quickly.

providers.name: Layer 2
providers.description: Layer 2 provides data integration and file synchronization solutions for Microsoft Cloud services such as Office 365, SharePoint, and Azure. It enables synchronization across 150+ systems and apps, serving over 2,500 companies worldwide with products like Layer2 Cloud Connector and Business Data List Connector.

providers.name: LendingClub
providers.description: LendingClub is a US consumer-finance company and national bank, founded in 2006 as a peer-to-peer marketplace lender and now a Fortune 1000 digital bank following its 2021 acquisition of Radius Bancorp. In 2026 it rebranded as Happen Bank, N.A. and moved its web presence from lendingclub.com to happen.com. It no longer operates a public developer program: the /developers tree and the LCX Primary and Secondary Market API technical documentation were withdrawn during the rebrand and now return HTTP 404, while the legacy investor host api.lendingclub.com remains live but gated and undocumented. The API the company still markets - "API-driven purchasing" inside Marketplace Connect for institutional loan buyers - is reachable only through an institutional contact-sales form, with no published reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Loft
providers.description: Loft is a Brazilian real estate technology (proptech) company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Sao Paulo. It operates a marketplace for buying, selling, and renting residential property alongside a broad platform of software and financial services for the real estate sector, including a CRM and property-management tools for agencies, digital proposals and e-signatures, lead generation, rental administration, and fintech products such as rental guarantees (Fianca Aluguel), home financing, credit with property collateral, and residential and commercial insurance. Backed by a16z, QED Investors, Fifth Wall, D1 Capital, Thrive Capital, and Baillie Gifford, Loft is a market leader in Brazil's real estate fintech space. Loft does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization (loft-br) hosts internal engineering and data-science tooling.

providers.name: Luko
providers.description: Luko is an online home, travel, and auto insurance provider founded in France in 2016 and now operating as Luko by Allianz Direct after its acquisition by the Allianz group. It sells rental, owner-occupied, non-occupant-owner (PNO), student, and co-housing home policies from around EUR 5 per month, plus travel and Eurofil-partnered auto cover, with sub-two-minute online subscription, instant attestations, digital claims declaration through a customer account portal, and 24/7 emergency support. Originally a VC-backed insurtech (Accel, Speedinvest), Luko today runs as a consumer insurance brand with no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable security and identity footprint.

providers.name: Memorick
providers.description: Memorick is a 500 Global-backed company operating a live web application at memorick.com. Based on its observable application surface, it is a destination photography booking platform connecting customers with photographers across destinations, handling packages, orders, reviews, coupons, and messaging. The product is built on Laravel (Inertia.js single-page front end) and exposes an OAuth2 authorization server via Laravel Passport (authorize/token/clients/scopes plus personal access tokens), Sanctum first-party session auth, and optional two-factor authentication. It publishes no public API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; the /api/* routes back the first-party application and are authentication-gated. This profile was enriched from live probing of the public surface.

providers.name: Meshcrafts
providers.description: Meshcrafts, operating publicly as CURRENT (Current Eco AS, formerly Meshcrafts AS, of Oslo, Norway), is a charge point management system (CPMS) provider for electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. Its cloud platform lets location owners and charge point operators manage EV charging points, handle payment and invoicing, apply smart energy management and load balancing, and offer white-label charging experiences to drivers. The platform is hardware-agnostic and OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) certified for OCPP 1.6 and OCPP 2.0.1, including Advanced Security, and advertises 99% uptime. Current was the first in the Nordics to reach OCPP 2.0.1 CORE and Advanced Security. The company is backed by 500 Global and surfaced in the API Evangelist network through that portfolio.

providers.name: Mirage JS
providers.description: Mirage JS is an open source API mocking library for JavaScript that lets you build, test, and share complete frontend features without depending on a backend. It runs alongside your frontend code as in-browser middleware, providing a built-in database, factories for seeding data, route handlers, and serializers. It is framework-agnostic and works with React, Vue, Angular, Ember, and any modern test runner. Mirage JS is itself a library (not a hosted REST API), so this entry indexes its documentation and project resources.

providers.name: MkDocs
providers.description: MkDocs is a fast, simple, and beautiful static site generator designed for building project documentation from Markdown source files. Written in Python, it reads a single YAML configuration file (mkdocs.yml) and converts a directory of Markdown documents into a self-contained static HTML site. MkDocs supports multiple built-in themes (mkdocs, readthedocs), a rich plugin ecosystem via Python entry points, live-reloading development server, and one-command deployment to GitHub Pages.

providers.name: Myndlift
providers.description: Myndlift is a digital neurofeedback and mental-health company that pairs a consumer/clinical mobile app with a wearable EEG brain-sensing headband (Muse) to deliver therapist-guided, personalized brain-training programs. The platform provides brain mapping and assessments, gamified real-time neurofeedback sessions, progress tracking, and remote-monitoring dashboards used by both individuals and mental-health practitioners for attention, anxiety, stress, sleep, and peak-performance goals. Backed by 500 Global, the company reports 26,000+ members and more than one million neurofeedback sessions delivered. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record with verified identity links.

providers.name: National Grid US
providers.description: National Grid US is the US arm of National Grid plc, delivering electricity and natural gas in New York and Massachusetts. Its developer-facing data surface is Green Button Connect My Data: customers authorize registered third parties to receive their energy usage data, and customers can get API access (XML or JSON) to their own data, via the greenbuttonconnect.nationalgrid.com portal.

providers.name: Nibbles PBC
providers.description: Nibbles PBC is a public benefit company building consumer financial and insurance products that make pet ownership easier. Its flagship product is the Nibbles credit card, a Mastercard that bundles built-in pet insurance and pet- focused rewards for cardholders. The company operates a consumer web application and account portal at nibbles.com (formerly reached via the nibbl.es short domain) covering sign-up, sign-in, card management, insurance policies, and rewards. Nibbles PBC was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; its public surface is a consumer product site, help center, and legal agreements. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Nova Benefits
providers.description: Nova Benefits is an India-based employee health and benefits platform that provides group health insurance, super top-up plans, and COVID-19 cover alongside wellness services such as telehealth consultations, mental-wellness support, fitness programs, maternity benefits, and annual health, dental and vision checkups. It gives HR teams an employer dashboard for administering benefits and managing claims, and gives employees web and mobile (iOS/Android) apps to view coverage, book consultations, and file and track claims. The company reports serving 500+ companies covering 200,000+ employees, is ISO 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II compliant, and operates as an IRDAI-regulated insurance broker. Nova Benefits publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Onefinestay
providers.description: Onefinestay is a British luxury hospitality company founded in 2009 that curates and manages a portfolio of upmarket private homes, villas, apartments and chalets for short-term and extended vacation rentals, pairing hand-picked properties with hotel-grade concierge service. AccorHotels acquired Onefinestay in 2016 for around $168 million; in 2025 Exclusive Resorts took a controlling operational stake while Accor retained a majority interest. Onefinestay operates as a consumer travel brand with a booking website and a technical/engineering organization on GitHub, but it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK program, or developer portal. This profile is maintained as a network company record.

providers.name: OpenFX
providers.description: OpenFX is a cross-border payment infrastructure provider delivering real-time foreign exchange liquidity and settlement for institutional clients across emerging markets. Backed by Accel and Northzone, it pairs traditional-finance reliability with blockchain-rail speed to settle fiat and stablecoin payments in minutes across 40+ currency pairs and 25+ local payment rails, and exposes a programmatic Trading API (REST, FIX and Streaming) to automate quotes, trades, deposits and withdrawals. Serves remittance companies, FX on/off ramps, payment service providers and stablecoin infrastructure providers.

providers.name: Ottonova
providers.description: Ottonova is a Munich-based digital private health insurance provider (private Krankenversicherung) founded in 2015, positioned as "the insurance for the mobile age." It sells private full health insurance and supplementary dental and hospital coverage to consumers in Germany, delivering onboarding, claims, a concierge medical service and digital health records through its mobile app rather than through a public developer API. Ottonova is backed by venture investors including Earlybird and HV Capital and operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio-lead stub and has been through one enrichment pass: probing confirmed a consumer web presence with a published RFC 9116 security.txt but no public API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, OAuth/OpenID metadata, or API catalog).

providers.name: Overview
providers.description: Overview (overview.ai) builds AI-powered machine vision systems for manufacturing quality control. Its edge-computing platform runs vision transformer models directly on smart cameras with on-device NVIDIA GPUs to perform automated defect detection, assembly verification, and real-time inspection without cloud dependency. Overview serves connector, semiconductor, packaging, automotive, pharmaceutical, aerospace, renewable energy, food, and textile manufacturers, and integrates with factory-floor systems (PLCs, ERPs, SCADA) over MQTT and digital I/O rather than a public REST API. Backed by GV and Homebrew. Profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PACER Case Locator (PCL)
providers.description: The PACER Case Locator (PCL) is a nationwide index of federal court cases. The public PCL API allows users to programmatically search the PCL for federal cases across U.S. district, bankruptcy, and appellate courts using the same search functionality and dataset as the PCL web application.

providers.name: Paris Open Data
providers.description: Paris Open Data provides open public data from the City of Paris, offering datasets across themes such as administration, finance, culture, environment, mobility, and urban planning. The portal enables search, download, and reuse of data for citizens, developers, and researchers, fostering transparency and innovation.

providers.name: PCA SKIN
providers.description: PCA SKIN is a professional skincare brand specializing in dermatologically tested chemical peels and result-oriented corrective products, positioned as a leading professional chemical-peel brand among estheticians and skincare professionals. The brand's direct-to-consumer store at pcaskin.com is built on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: it implements the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) with a hosted MCP endpoint plus read-only storefront JSON, so AI shopping agents can discover the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the store's published agent surface (/llms.txt, /.well-known/ucp).

providers.name: Piazza
providers.description: Piazza is an online question-and-answer platform for higher education that connects students, teaching assistants, and professors in a single wiki-style collaborative space for each class. Instructors run a Piazza for their course where students ask and answer questions, post anonymously, use a LaTeX and code editor for technical content, and receive instructor-endorsed answers. Piazza integrates with every major learning management system (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Sakai, Desire2Learn, and others) via the LTI standard for single-click class creation, roster-based automatic enrollment, and automatic single sign-on. It is used across thousands of universities in more than 90 countries and is FERPA-compliant. Piazza does not publish an official public developer API; LMS connectivity is delivered through LTI, and only community projects wrap its internal endpoints.

providers.name: Pingo
providers.description: Pingo is a language learning platform that uses AI-driven conversational practice to help users improve speaking skills across multiple languages. Backed by Matrix Partners, Pingo offers personalized lesson paths, real-time correction, and progress tracking, serving over 8 million learners worldwide. The service includes mobile apps for iOS and Android, and integrates with popular language curricula to provide immersive, practical conversation experiences.

providers.name: Players Lounge
providers.description: Players' Lounge is a skill-based competitive gaming platform where users win money by completing personalized head-to-head gaming challenges (money matches) or by staking and watching other players compete. The platform supports popular console and PC titles including Madden, NBA 2K, Call of Duty Warzone, Marvel Rivals, and others, and states it has paid out over $200M to players to date. Players' Lounge is a consumer product surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation at this time. This profile captures the company's public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prime Roots
providers.description: Prime Roots is a Berkeley, California foodtech company making koji- and plant-based deli meats and bacon marketed as "the clean deli meat" — no preservatives, nitrates, or celery salt. It sells direct-to-consumer and through foodservice, running its online store on Shopify. That storefront exposes a native agent-commerce surface: an llms.txt / agents.md agent guide, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, https://ucp.dev) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted MCP endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Prosus Ventures portfolio company and enriched from its live public discovery surfaces.

providers.name: PromptWave AI
providers.description: PromptWave AI is a web platform that enables users to save, organize, share, and explore AI prompts across various models. It offers a community-driven marketplace where creators can publish prompts, discover new ideas, and collaborate. Features include prompt collections, AI‑generated content, and tools for customizing prompts for scientific papers, image generation, and more. The service aims to boost AI productivity by simplifying prompt management and fostering a vibrant ecosystem of prompt engineers and enthusiasts.

providers.name: QXO Building Products
providers.description: QXO is a publicly traded company focused on building a tech-forward leader in the building products distribution industry through acquisitions and operational improvements. QXO offers a suite of customer-facing APIs for ordering, pricing, account management, product catalog, delivery tracking, and invoicing.

providers.name: Raenest
providers.description: Raenest (formerly Geegpay) is a global money platform for freelancers, creators, remote workers, students, and businesses in Africa and beyond. It provides multi-currency accounts in USD, GBP, EUR, USDT, and USDC, virtual and physical Visa cards, international payment collection from 190+ countries, smart invoicing tools, US stock investing, stablecoin support, and a rewards program. Raenest is delivered through its mobile and web apps (app.raenest.com); as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. Backed by QED Investors and Techstars.

providers.name: Redsys
providers.description: Redsys is a leading Spanish payment services provider with over 40 years of experience. It offers a comprehensive suite of acquiring, issuing, and interbank services, supporting merchants, financial institutions, and digital platforms. The company focuses on innovation, security, and high‑quality payment solutions across Spain and Latin America, serving a wide range of industries including retail, health, and e‑commerce.

providers.name: Render
providers.description: Render (operating as Render Network) is a decentralized GPU computing platform that enables developers and enterprises to harness distributed GPU resources for high‑performance workloads such as AI model training, rendering, and scientific simulations. The platform provides a marketplace for GPU providers, APIs for job submission, monitoring, and billing, and aims to lower costs while increasing accessibility to powerful compute resources across the globe.

providers.name: River Health
providers.description: River Health is an employer-sponsored virtual-first health plan operated by Mountain (joinmountain.com) that gives employees comprehensive primary and behavioral care at no cost to them. Members get unlimited virtual primary care and in-person doctor visits, behavioral health and therapy, thousands of free medications with home delivery or pharmacy pickup, free preventive care and screenings, after-hours urgent care, no-cost specialty and chronic- condition care, and free lab testing through Quest Diagnostics. Employers from small businesses to the Fortune 500 sponsor the plan; members enroll and manage care through the River Health member app at app.helloriver.com. River Health is a portfolio company of Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal has been published.

providers.name: Robco
providers.description: RobCo is a Munich- and Austin-based industrial robotics company building software-defined, modular robotic automation delivered as Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) with zero upfront capital expenditure. Its modular robot arms (up to 8 axes, 40 kg payload, 2.5 m reach, 0.1 mm repeatability), the Alfie autonomous robot, the RobFlow no-code programming platform, RobCo Studio configuration and simulation tooling, and the RobVision AI vision system let manufacturers automate machine tending, palletizing, materials handling, and finishing tasks. RobCo serves manufacturing, food and beverage, logistics, automotive, wood, and defense customers, and is backed by Lightspeed, Sequoia Capital, Lingotto, Kindred Capital, and Promus Ventures.

providers.name: Ronin Network
providers.description: Ronin is an Ethereum sidechain originally built by Sky Mavis to power Axie Infinity and a wider game and NFT economy. The network exposes a standard Ethereum-style JSON-RPC interface on mainnet and the Saigon testnet, the Ronin Explorer, a canonical bridge to Ethereum, and the Skynet Web3 data API for indexed accounts, NFTs, contracts, and transactions. Sky Mavis layers on game and platform APIs (Axie Infinity Origins, AXP, Ronin Market Partner, Ronin Store, Account, Wallet, Gas Sponsoring, Katana Swap) administered through the Ronin Developer Console.

providers.name: Rula
providers.description: Rula is a telehealth mental health platform that connects patients with licensed therapists and psychiatric providers who accept their insurance. Operating as an in-network behavioral health marketplace across all 50 states, Rula matches individuals with more than 23,000 licensed clinicians for individual, couples, family, child, and teen therapy as well as psychiatric medication management, covering 90+ conditions including anxiety, depression, ADHD, PTSD, OCD, and addiction. Rula is in-network with 120+ insurance plans nationwide (Aetna, Cigna, Optum, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross, Kaiser), with patients paying an average of about $15 per session with insurance. Rula publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or partner API surface as of this profile; care is delivered through its patient and provider web applications.

providers.name: safeship-app
providers.description: Safeship provides real‑time API monitoring that validates response bodies, not just status codes. Users configure checks via natural‑language prompts to an AI‑powered MCP, receiving alerts via email, webhook, SMS or WhatsApp. The SaaS platform offers a 15‑day free trial, tiered pricing from €3/month, and supports multi‑region checks. Features include HTTPS endpoint monitoring, JSON response validation, and AI‑driven fix suggestions.

providers.name: Satchel
providers.description: Satchel provides the award‑winning Show My Homework platform and the Satchel One learning suite, helping schools and teachers streamline homework tracking, attendance, timetables and classroom management. Based in London, the company focuses on reducing teacher workload through a SaaS solution that integrates behavior monitoring, content delivery and wellbeing tools for educators.

providers.name: Seccl
providers.description: Seccl provides an embedded investment platform offering services such as client onboarding, portfolio management, digital pensions, custody, and payments. Their technology enables financial advisers, neobanks, and fintechs to deliver a fully digital client experience with low-cost, scalable solutions. The platform emphasizes data control, integration flexibility, and comprehensive reporting, positioning Seccl as a modern fintech infrastructure provider.

providers.name: Secret Escapes
providers.description: Secret Escapes is a members-only luxury travel and holiday flash-sales platform that negotiates exclusive, time-limited discounts on hand-picked hotels, city breaks, and package holidays for its members, surfacing over 200 curated sales each week across the UK and international markets. Founded in London and backed by GV and Index Ventures, it operates on an invitation/membership model rather than a public developer platform; no public API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Setmore
providers.description: Setmore provides free online appointment scheduling software for businesses of all sizes. Its platform enables customers to book appointments, manage staff schedules, accept payments, and integrate with popular calendars and marketing tools. Setmore aims to help businesses deliver their magic by connecting them with customers through a seamless, customizable booking experience across web, mobile, and social channels.

providers.name: Simpleclosure
providers.description: SimpleClosure is a business-dissolution and wind-down platform for founders, startups, and business owners, positioning itself as "the shutdown standard." It guides a company through the full closure process end to end - from the first decision to wind down through the final state and federal filings - covering entity dissolution (Delaware corporations, LLCs, S-corps), final tax returns, creditor and vendor notifications, asset liquidation, distributions to stakeholders, and compliance obligations. The company offers software plus expert handling, with tailored solutions for lawyers, investors, and financial services firms managing portfolio-company or client wind-downs. SimpleClosure was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list and operates a customer application at app.simpleclosure.com. It is a services-and-software company rather than a developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Simplifeye
providers.description: Simplifeye is a dental practice management platform that helps practices grow and streamline front-office operations through integrated payments, online scheduling, live webchat, and patient-engagement campaigns. Its HIPAA-compliant payments product supports in-office transactions, invoicing, and customizable payment plans; its 24/7 real-time online scheduler lets patients self-book appointments; and its live webchat is staffed by real people who answer patient questions and qualify leads outside business hours. Simplifeye was acquired by Vyne Dental and integrates with the Vyne Trellis billing platform for claims, eligibility, and revenue acceleration. Simplifeye operates a private, authenticated backend (api.simplifeye.co) that powers its dashboard and patient-facing widgets, but publishes no public developer program, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Spinitron
providers.description: Spinitron provides a web-based music playlist management platform for radio stations and music businesses. It offers tools for scheduling, charting, and audience engagement, supporting both community and commercial broadcasters. The service includes features such as automated playlists, detailed analytics, and integration with various streaming services, helping stations curate and manage their music content efficiently.

providers.name: Svastia
providers.description: Svastia (Svastia Genetics Inc.) is a precision-genomics and oncology data company that bundles clinical research products with cutting-edge bioinformatics to accelerate precision cancer therapy. It offers DNA/RNA sequencing, exome and gene-panel assays, immune (B/T-cell) repertoire sequencing, cell-based drug-efficacy screening, therapeutic-antibody development toolkits, and siRNA design, together with biomarker analytics (Tumor Mutational Burden, Microsatellite Instability) and clinical reporting based on ACMG/ASCO guidelines. Svastia serves hospitals, diagnostics labs, researchers, and CROs, and runs a bespoke clinical/genetic data-collection service across a hospital network, with HL7-FHIR data exchange between EHR and Clinical Trial Management Systems. Products are delivered through a login-gated web portal; the company does not publish a public developer API. Backed by 500 Global; offices in San Francisco (USA) and Cambridge (UK).

providers.name: Swvl
providers.description: Swvl provides on‑demand bus transportation solutions for commuters, students, and enterprises across multiple countries. The platform offers a rider app for booking and tracking rides, a partner portal for fleet operators, and an admin dashboard for managing operations. Swvl’s services include Mobility‑as‑a‑Service, software solutions for fleet dispatch, and customizable transit options for businesses, schools, and events.

providers.name: Symbiotic
providers.description: Symbiotic is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of paradigm and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto-defi. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: SyncSmart
providers.description: SyncSmart, a Lynton subsidiary based in Katy, Texas, offers self‑service and custom HubSpot integration solutions, including packaged apps and extensions, to help organizations align sales and marketing data and workflows. The platform provides usage‑based pricing and supports both SaaS and on‑premise deployments, enabling businesses to scale their HubSpot ecosystem efficiently.

providers.name: Syngenta
providers.description: Syngenta is a global agribusiness that develops and markets seeds, crop protection products, and digital farming solutions. The company focuses on sustainable agriculture, research and innovation to help farmers increase productivity while reducing environmental impact. It operates worldwide, offering a portfolio that includes crop protection chemicals, seeds, biologicals, and digital tools for farm management.

providers.name: Transfercar
providers.description: Transfercar is a free vehicle relocation marketplace that connects rental car and motorhome companies who need vehicles moved between their depots with travelers willing to drive those vehicles one-way. Rental operators list relocation deals for cars and campervans that need to be repositioned, and drivers book them to travel between cities at little or no rental cost, often with extras such as free days, fuel allowances, or ferry contributions. The service operates across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States as a consumer-facing web booking platform rather than a developer API provider. Transfercar was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: United Kingdom Hydrographic Office (UKHO)
providers.description: The United Kingdom Hydrographic Office (UKHO) is an executive agency of the UK Ministry of Defence that sells hydrographic and marine geospatial data, nautical charts, publications and digital navigation services under the Admiralty brand. It supplies these products to mariners, shipping companies, defence users and other maritime stakeholders worldwide to support safe, efficient and compliant navigation.

providers.name: Waffle Labs
providers.description: Waffle Labs, Inc. (Waffle Insurance) is a consumer InsurTech company and licensed digital insurance agency, founded at MIT and accelerated through Barclays Techstars and MIT Delta V. Waffle offers an all-in-one, mobile-first platform that lets consumers get quotes and bind coverage in under 90 seconds across renters, pet, home & auto, term life, personal cyber, and travel insurance in all 50 US states, partnering with vetted carriers rather than underwriting risk itself. The company also runs an embedded-insurance program that lets partners offer Waffle products through a no-code embed. Waffle is a consumer/partner product with no public developer program or API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wallester
providers.description: Wallester provides a modern card issuing platform that enables businesses to embed financial services directly into their products. Through a robust set of APIs, Wallester offers virtual and physical card issuance, transaction processing, compliance, and risk management tools. Their solution targets fintechs, marketplaces, and SaaS platforms seeking to integrate payment capabilities without building banking infrastructure from scratch. With global coverage and customizable workflows, Wallester aims to simplify the complexities of card issuance and payments for developers and enterprises alike.

providers.name: Youtrip
providers.description: YouTrip (You Technologies Group, you.co) is a Singapore-based fintech that operates a multi-currency mobile travel wallet paired with a prepaid Mastercard, letting consumers hold and spend in over 150 currencies with no foreign-exchange fees and competitive in-app exchange rates. Launched in 2018, the company also runs YouBiz, a business account and corporate card product for SMEs, and offers international transfers to more than 40 countries. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, YouTrip processes billions of dollars in transactions annually across Singapore, Thailand, and Australia. As of this enrichment pass YouTrip exposes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or GitHub organization; consumer-facing account access is available only indirectly through open-banking aggregators.

providers.name: Zeen
providers.description: Zeen is an AI-powered autonomous personal finance platform — a money copilot that connects to your financial accounts and uses background AI agents to manage money on your behalf. Its features include an interactive AI financial copilot that answers questions in real time, Guard (loss prevention that avoids overdraft fees and cancels unused subscriptions), Grow (yield optimization that moves idle balances to higher-interest accounts), and Guide (spending insights). As of mid-2026 Zeen is in pre-launch with a public waitlist. Zeen is backed by Cowboy Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: A24
providers.description: A24 is an American independent entertainment company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City that produces, finances, and distributes films and television, including award winners such as Everything Everywhere All at Once, Moonlight, and Hereditary. Beyond production, A24 runs a direct-to-consumer business spanning a merchandise shop, the AAA24 membership program, editorial "Notes," podcasts, and a mobile app. A24 is a portfolio company of Thrive Capital. A24 does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: AfterHour
providers.description: AfterHour is a social copy-trading and investing community for retail investors, founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco. The mobile app lets verified traders connect their real brokerage accounts and share live, proven positions — more than $300M in live trades every day — so members can follow top traders, copy trades, discuss tickers in real-time stock chat rooms, receive alerts, and track their own portfolios. AfterHour is backed by Founders Fund and General Catalyst. This provider was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: AI Mail MCP
providers.description: AI Mail MCP provides a unified email inbox for AI agents, enabling them to receive, sort, draft, and manage messages across multiple roles such as support, sales, billing, legal, and HR. The platform offers tools for DNS security, documentation, pricing, and account management, with a sandbox environment for free trials. It emphasizes security with token scoping, audit logs, and outgoing guard mechanisms, and supports custom domains and integrations via MCP endpoints. Pricing is usage‑based, with per‑mailbox and per‑recipient rates, and data is automatically deleted after the trial period unless extended.

providers.name: aimlds
providers.description: aimlds.org is a curated space for developer knowledge, offering ideas, notes, long reads, and tools. It provides clean, concise, and clear content across papers, books, and various AI‑related utilities such as Sanity Check, CodeTopo, AECP, Research Analyst reports, TransformationSpine, Budget & Economy Engine, CipherNotes, PDF Extractor, and AppDocStudio. The platform emphasizes minimal filler, focusing on high‑quality, actionable information for software engineers and researchers.

providers.name: Aitocall
providers.description: Aitocall is an AI‑powered telephony service that enables users to place phone calls simply by speaking to large language models such as Claude or ChatGPT. By connecting these AI chat agents to a telephone gateway, Aitocall translates spoken prompts into calls, records conversations, summarizes them, and provides call logs. The platform offers a web interface with pricing tiers, FAQs, and documentation for developers to integrate voice calling into AI applications. It targets Korean users but is accessible globally.

providers.name: Alluvia
providers.description: Alluvia provides an ERP integration and EDI automation platform that simplifies data integration for fast‑growing companies. Their solutions remove costly development work, unpredictable timelines, and rigid systems by offering pre‑built connectors, automated compliance, and scalable automation. Alluvia serves over 500 companies across industries, delivering real‑time sync, flexible workflows, and a partner‑focused approach to integration challenges.

providers.name: appearhere
providers.description: Appear Here is the leading online marketplace for short-term retail space, connecting property owners with brands, designers, and entrepreneurs who want to rent shops, pop-up stores, market stalls, showrooms, and event venues on a flexible, short-term basis. Founded in London in 2014 and backed by Balderton Capital, the two-sided marketplace lets tenants search available space by city and date, book securely online with standardized legal agreements, and message landlords directly, while landlords list and monetize idle retail units. Appear Here operates across the UK, US, and France and has facilitated the opening of more than 10,000 stores for over 250,000 brands and creative entrepreneurs. Appear Here does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its public web, brand, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Applied Systems
providers.description: Applied Systems is a leading global provider of cloud-based software for the business of insurance, best known for the Applied Epic agency management system (plus TAM, Applied CSR24, and related products). Applied exposes a RESTful developer platform for Applied Epic through the Applied Dev Center at devcenter.myappliedproducts.com, superseding the older Applied Epic SDK. The APIs let certified partners and agencies read and write core Epic data - clients/accounts, policies, contacts, attachments, and activities - over OAuth 2.0. Access is gated: developers register, build and test an app against a sandbox, then submit a production request (name, email, organization, enterprise ID, and Epic database name) that Applied must approve before production credentials are issued. Base URL for the platform is https://api.myappliedproducts.com.

providers.name: Artios
providers.description: Artios Pharma is a clinical‑stage oncology company focused on developing novel DNA Damage Response (DDR) medicines to treat cancer. Founded in 2016 and based in Cambridge, UK, it advances a pipeline including ATR inhibitor alnodesertib, Polθ inhibitor ART6043, and DDRi‑ADC candidate ART21934, aiming to deliver meaningful survival benefits to patients with high unmet need.

providers.name: AttendMeet
providers.description: AttendMeet is an AI‑powered meeting assistant that automatically joins video calls on Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Zoom, records them, transcribes speech with speaker attribution, and generates structured summaries and action items. It offers both a self‑hosted deployment for privacy‑first customers and a managed SaaS version, supporting multiple AI model providers and providing participation metrics, all secured with AES‑256 encryption and compliance with GDPR, CCPA and Colombian data protection laws.

providers.name: August AI
providers.description: August AI is a consumer health-AI companion that helps people understand their symptoms, lab reports, prescriptions, and medications, and connects them to licensed physicians through asynchronous, chat-based telehealth visits. Founded in 2022 by Anuruddh Mishra after a four-month misdiagnosis, August operates as a 24/7 health assistant available on iOS, Android, and WhatsApp, storing lab reports and conversation history in long-term memory to deliver personalized guidance. The service pairs a free AI symptom-assessment experience with paid online doctor consultations from board-certified MDs licensed across all 50 US states. August reports serving millions of users across 160+ countries in 30+ languages, and publishes medical benchmarks including 100% accuracy on the USMLE, 97.4% on MedQA, 99.4% on lab-report document processing, and 100% precision/recall on emergency escalation. It is backed by Accel and Claypond Capital. August is a consumer application and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Autograph
providers.description: Autograph is a fan engagement and digital collectibles platform co-founded by Tom Brady and operated by LFG NFTs Corp. It recognizes and rewards fans by turning their passion for athletes, artists, and celebrities into access, experiences, and exclusive rewards. The platform consolidates fan communities and content into a single app, using web3 and NFT technology to let creators and public figures collaborate directly with their supporters. Autograph is a consumer product with no public developer API program at this time; api.autograph.io serves the app backend and docs.autograph.io is a private GitBook.

providers.name: Avail
providers.description: Avail is a landlord-focused rental management platform offering tools for property listings, tenant applications, screening reports, lease agreements, rent payments, and maintenance requests. Designed for DIY independent landlords, Avail enables listing syndication across 19+ rental sites, state-specific digital lease signing, online rent collection, and maintenance request tracking through an all-in-one platform.

providers.name: Aveni
providers.description: Aveni is an award‑winning FinTech and RegTech company based in Edinburgh, United Kingdom. It provides AI‑powered solutions for financial services, automating compliance, risk management, client interactions and workflow efficiency. Its FinLLM technology and domain‑specific AI help banks, advisers and wealth managers ensure regulatory compliance while improving productivity. Trusted by major UK financial institutions, Aveni combines natural language processing with enterprise‑grade AI to deliver real‑time risk monitoring and automated case reviews.

providers.name: Avoice
providers.description: Avoice is an AI-native workspace for architects and engineers that automates the non-design work of running an architectural practice. Its AI agents understand drawings, specifications, schedules, materials, building codes, and research to generate specs, run automated QA/QC quality control on specs and drawings, auto-produce door/window/finish schedules and quantities, draft RFIs and submittals for construction administration, and manage a client portal alongside searchable detail and material libraries. A Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, Avoice positions itself as the operating system for architectural practice, with firms managing over $300 million in active projects using it across five countries. Avoice publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation at this time; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: Backlotcars
providers.description: BacklotCars, Inc. is a dealer-to-dealer wholesale used-vehicle marketplace, founded in Kansas City and acquired by KAR Global (now OPENLANE, Inc.), whose technology was consolidated into the OPENLANE US marketplace. It connects thousands of franchise and independent dealers through a 24/7 bid-ask marketplace, "Buy It Now" listings, and timed auctions scheduled throughout each week, backed by native mobile apps, in-lane vehicle inspections with AI-analyzed engine recordings, transportation, and floor-plan financing. Commercial sellers and dealer groups can push inventory straight from their own systems into OPENLANE Sell via OPENLANE Connect, a lightweight dealer integration API with a dedicated test environment. This profile began as a 500 Global portfolio lead surfaced into the API Evangelist network and was enriched from OPENLANE's public marketing and product surface; the platform publishes no public OpenAPI or open developer portal.

providers.name: BBDO Worldwide
providers.description: BBDO Worldwide is a global advertising agency network founded in 1928 and headquartered in New York City. It is the largest of the creative-agency networks owned by Omnicom Group, with roughly 15,000 employees across approximately 289 offices in 81 countries (per Wikipedia, citing company data). The agency's positioning is "Do Big Things," and its public work is campaign-led — Pepsi, Budweiser, McDonald's, M&M's, Snickers, Visa, AT&T Business, Volkswagen, Skoda, Whiskas, and many more. BBDO has been named Cannes Lions Network of the Year multiple times since 2007 and Network of the Decade in 2020. BBDO does not publish a developer portal, public REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, status page, or pricing — its product is creative work delivered to brand clients, not software offered to developers. The one machine-readable surface bbdo.com serves is the WordPress REST API behind the site itself: /wp-json/ answers anonymously with a 200-route discovery document, and the agency's own `work` and `news` custom post types are readable without credentials — 46 campaign case studies and 60 press items with draft-04 JSON Schemas available from each collection's OPTIONS response. That is a CMS byproduct, not a product BBDO designed, documents, prices, or supports. This repository indexes the public properties (homepage, network site, news, parent company, GitHub org, and notable agency network members), captures what the WordPress API actually serves, and links BBDO to its parent Omnicom and sibling networks (DDB Worldwide, TBWA Worldwide).

providers.name: Beamtrace
providers.description: Beamtrace provides an AI brand visibility tracking platform that monitors how businesses appear in AI‑powered search results and conversational answers. It offers tools to measure visibility scores, track competitor mentions, analyze trends over time, and generate actionable insights for agencies, freelancers, startups, and enterprises seeking to understand and improve their presence in emerging AI search ecosystems.

providers.name: BeonX
providers.description: BeonX provides an AI‑driven revenue management system (RMS) for hotels, enabling autonomous pricing, distribution and profitability decisions 24/7. The platform combines real‑time data, machine learning and agentic automation to optimize occupancy and revenue while offering transparent explanations for each decision.

providers.name: Better Health Supplies, Inc.
providers.description: Better Health Supplies, Inc. (Better Health) is a modern medical supply e‑commerce company that provides a wide range of products for diabetes, incontinence, urology, ostomy, and wound care. It operates an online storefront offering continuous glucose monitors, catheters, ostomy bags, and related accessories, serving both consumers and healthcare professionals across the United States.

providers.name: Bidwell Health
providers.description: Bidwell Health is a clinician‑led online telehealth practice serving adults in eleven U.S. states. It offers cash‑pay $45 clinician visits for urinary‑tract infections, bacterial vaginosis, yeast infections, erectile dysfunction, hair loss, eyelash growth, herpes, and prescription refills, all via video or chat. The service emphasizes privacy, licensed providers, and evidence‑based care.

providers.name: birchbox
providers.description: Birchbox is a beauty and grooming subscription-box retailer that sends members a monthly assortment of personalized deluxe samples across skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance, then lets them purchase full-size versions of what they like in its online shop. Originally a New York startup and later acquired, the brand today runs a direct-to-consumer subscription and e-commerce storefront at birchbox.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Blacklane
providers.description: Blacklane is a global chauffeur service offering on‑demand rides, hourly hires, and city‑to‑city journeys in over 64 countries. Founded in 2011, the company provides premium transportation for business travelers, corporate clients, and individuals, emphasizing punctuality, safety, and a seamless booking experience through its web platform and mobile apps. Blacklane’s services include airport transfers, hourly car service, and long‑distance trips, all backed by professional drivers and a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction.

providers.name: Bloomfilter
providers.description: Bloomfilter provides a context layer that connects frontier AI models to enterprise workflow systems, enabling organizations to measure, scale, and optimize the value of AI agents. The platform focuses on process intelligence, governance, and regulated software, offering tools for model integration, value tracking, and compliance with standards such as IEC 62304 and DO-178C. Backed by Techstars, Bloomfilter aims to bring frontier efficiency to enterprises across industries.

providers.name: Briya
providers.description: Briya builds AIRE (AI Research Environment), a privacy-first AI platform for healthcare and clinical research that lets researchers analyze real-world medical data without writing code. AIRE trains AI models on real-world data and provides domain-specific agents for literature review, hypothesis testing, population and cohort analysis, study design, and manuscript-ready output with built-in validation. Data is accessed across multiple sources without centralizing it into a warehouse, with a compliance posture aimed at HIPAA, GDPR, and FDA/EMA regulatory standards. Briya serves emerging biotech, life sciences organizations, academic institutions, and healthcare systems, with offices in New York, Nashville, and Tel Aviv. The company is backed by Insight Partners. This API Evangelist profile is an enrichment pass on a portfolio lead; Briya publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: BWX Technologies
providers.description: BWX Technologies is a manufacturer of nuclear components and provider of nuclear services to the U.S. government and commercial customers worldwide. The company delivers innovative nuclear solutions across naval propulsion, small modular reactors, nuclear fuel, medical isotopes, and complex site operations.

providers.name: Calypso Migration
providers.description: Nasdaq Calypso Migration services support financial institutions in migrating data and configurations between Calypso environments. Calypso (formerly Adenza / Calypso Technology) is a cross-asset front-to-back capital markets technology platform used by banks, asset managers, central banks, and clearing houses worldwide. Migration capabilities cover upgrading between Calypso versions, moving between on-premise and cloud deployments, and consolidating multiple Calypso installations. These services are delivered through Nasdaq professional services rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Candid Co.
providers.description: Candid Co. (candidco.com), operating today as CandidPro, is a New York-based dental-technology company that delivers custom clear aligners for teeth straightening. Founded in 2017 as a direct-to-consumer brand backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Greycroft, and e.ventures, Candid pioneered at-home impression kits and remote monitoring, and has since pivoted to a dentist-directed model: aligners are prescribed and overseen by a licensed dentist with orthodontist support and convenient virtual visits (CandidMonitoring). Candid handles the clinical treatment plan, 3D-printed aligner manufacturing, and patient communication for crowding and common bite misalignments. This is a consumer/health brand with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain security posture, and commercial link properties.

providers.name: Caravelo
providers.description: Caravelo provides travel subscription solutions that increase revenue and market share, reduce seasonality, and create better customer experiences. It offers a platform for travel operators to sell subscription-based travel plans, enabling flexible, recurring travel purchases and improving cash flow.

providers.name: Casa
providers.description: Casa is a home management membership service that helps homeowners handle maintenance and everyday household tasks through a mix of digital home documentation and professional services. A $199/month membership bundles a concierge for project research, vendor negotiation and scheduling, monthly handyman hours, an Autopilot maintenance care plan, a 3D home inventory (appliances, paint colors, safety systems), utility and property-tax tracking, package handling, and recurring-vendor management. Casa is available in the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, and Austin, and is backed by Forerunner Ventures and True Ventures. No public developer/API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Chamber Cardio
providers.description: Chamber Cardio is a Washington, D.C.-based healthcare technology company building a cardiology-focused platform for value-based care. Chamber partners with cardiology practices and health plans to align clinical signals, workflows, and patient data so cardiologists can identify high-risk patients earlier, close gaps against treatment guidelines, and reduce administrative burden. Its workflow-integrated AI surfaces clearer signal from the large volumes of cardiovascular data generated in care, supporting better patient outcomes and financial predictability for payers as cardiology moves beyond fee-for-service. The company supports more than 500 cardiologists across seven states and raised a $60M Series A led by Frist Cressey Ventures, with participation from General Catalyst, AlleyCorp, American Family Ventures, Company Ventures, Optum Ventures, Healthworx Ventures, and Black Opal Ventures. Chamber does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; its platform is built on a FHIR-based data stack (Medplum) with internal REST and GraphQL services.

providers.name: Changelog
providers.description: Changelog is a media company and podcast network for developers covering open source and software development. Founded by Adam Stacoviak and Jerod Santo, Changelog produces world-class developer podcasts including The Changelog, which features deep technical interviews and conversations with the people and teams driving open source software forward. Changelog also publishes a weekly developer news newsletter and operates an open source platform (changelog.com) built with Elixir and Phoenix.

providers.name: ChangeNOW
providers.description: ChangeNOW is a crypto super‑app that empowers newcomers, professionals and businesses to handle their Web3 finances in a simple and secure way. Since 2017 it has evolved from a fast, secure instant crypto exchange to a platform where millions of users worldwide safely store, exchange, trade and stake over 1,000 crypto assets, supporting 47 fiat currencies across 175+ countries.

providers.name: Chief
providers.description: Chief is a private membership network built to connect and support senior women leaders, serving executives across more than 10,000 companies with roughly 44% of members in C-suite roles. Membership combines vetted peer Core Groups, one-on-one and group executive coaching, business training (including programming with partners such as The Wharton School), member Clubhouses, and ChiefX events, plus an enterprise offering for companies sponsoring their women leaders. Chief is a membership-and-community company rather than an API provider, so this profile is an identity record in the API Evangelist network with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Chift
providers.description: Chift provides a unified API platform that connects accounting, POS, payment, PMS, e‑commerce and invoicing systems. It offers ready‑made bidirectional data flows, real‑time synchronization, and AI‑ready endpoints, enabling developers to integrate financial tools quickly and securely across Europe.

providers.name: Clad Labs
providers.description: Clad Labs is a San Francisco developer-tools startup (Y Combinator, Fall 2025) building Chad IDE, a desktop development environment that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor CLI, and OpenAI Codex — from a single interface. Developers spin up teams of parallel agents, keep each task isolated in its own workspace, then merge clean changes back together, while a built-in analytics dashboard tracks coding habits and productivity metrics. The IDE also fills AI-inference downtime with an in-app "Chad Browser" for entertainment that automatically hands focus back to the code when generation completes. Clad Labs ships a downloadable macOS and Windows application rather than a public web API; it exposes no REST/OpenAPI developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Classiq
providers.description: Classiq Technologies is a Tel Aviv, Israel headquartered enterprise quantum software company founded in 2020 by Nir Minerbi (CEO), Amir Naveh (CPO), and Dr. Yehuda Naveh (CTO), positioning itself as a high-level quantum algorithm design platform that lets organizations build, scale, and deploy quantum algorithms across any hardware or simulator without writing low-level gate code. Its flagship offering centers on Qmod, an intuitive quantum modeling language, and a hardware-aware synthesis engine that compiles functional quantum models into optimized circuits with constraint-driven optimization, transpilation, and execution session management across cloud quantum providers including AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, GCP, IBM Quantum, IonQ, OQC, Alice and Bob, and C12. The platform is delivered through the Classiq Studio web IDE at platform.classiq.io, a public Python SDK (`pip install classiq`) currently at version 1.14.0 covering synthesis, execution, analysis, and application libraries for chemistry (QSP), finance (IQAE), and quantum machine learning (QSVM, QML), plus an AI-assisted natural language interface for algorithm design. Classiq publishes the largest open quantum algorithm library on GitHub at github.com/Classiq/classiq-library (2,000+ stars, Jupyter Notebook, MIT license) with reference implementations across optimization, linear solvers, quantum machine learning, chemistry, finance, logistics, cybersecurity, and physical systems. Customers include Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, HSBC, Citibank, BMW, and Rolls-Royce; the company is SOC 2 and GDPR compliant. Classiq has raised over $200M including a $110M Series C in May 2025 with backers such as AMD Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, IonQ, Bank Leumi, Mirae Asset Capital, and SoftBank. Classiq's developer surface is the Python SDK and Qmod language — there is no public REST API or OpenAPI specification; the Mintlify-hosted `docs.classiq.io/api-reference/openapi.json` endpoint currently returns the default Mintlify Plant Store placeholder rather than a real API contract.

providers.name: Composer
providers.description: Composer is a consult‑before‑you‑act AI service that helps users perform multi‑step data and research tasks by generating a workflow, providing a free price quote, and executing the plan for a paid x402 fee. It aggregates results from multiple providers, offering pricing comparisons, diligence packs, and other AI‑driven analyses, while handling payments and delivering synthesized answers.

providers.name: Concirrus
providers.description: Concirrus Ltd is a London-headquartered insurtech founded in 2012 that builds AI-driven underwriting software for the specialty and commercial insurance market — marine (hull, cargo, P&I), aviation, construction, property, and political violence and terrorism. Its platform (Quest, Marine One, the Underwriting Workbench, Exposure Management, Loss Run Intelligence, and an "Enterprise Model" universal submission-ingestion layer) ingests broker submissions, structures the risk data, scores behavioural risk, and returns rating and exposure decisions to carriers, MGAs and brokers — much of it aimed at the Lloyd's and London subscription market. Concirrus is a vendor to insurers rather than an insurer itself, so it touches quote and rating rather than bind, issue or FNOL. Its API posture is partner-gated: marketing describes "a modular, API first platform" and "seamless integration with London Market platforms", but as of 2026-07-25 there is no public developer portal, no published API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, no Postman collection, and no public GraphQL or webhook catalog. Every developer and docs hostname probed (developer./developers./docs./api. on both concirrus.com and concirrus.ai) does not resolve, and every on-site developer path returns 404. Integration is obtained through a commercial engagement or the partner ecosystem programme, not self-serve signup. No ACORD, AL3, NGDS or ACORD XML reference appears anywhere on the public site. Concirrus does publish a real compliance posture: in August 2025 it announced ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management), ISO/IEC 27001 (information security) and SOC 2 certification, claiming to be the first insurtech to hold all three — though no trust center or downloadable report accompanies the announcement.

providers.name: connectbiopharm
providers.description: Connect Biopharma is a clinical‑stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing next‑generation therapeutics for inflammatory diseases, primarily asthma and COPD. Based in San Diego, CA, the company advances its pipeline of novel molecules such as Rademikibart (CBP‑201) to improve patients’ lives.

providers.name: Copley
providers.description: Copley provides an AI Operating System for Demand Engineering, enabling companies to automate and optimize their marketing, sales, and product development processes through AI-driven analysis, planning, creation, and iteration of campaigns. The platform connects data from CRM, ad platforms, and analytics to generate actionable insights and continuously improve performance across channels.

providers.name: Cosm
providers.description: Cosm is a Los Angeles-based immersive technology, media and entertainment company formed in 2020 from the merger of LiveLike VR (now Cosm Immersive) and C360, followed by the acquisition of planetarium pioneers Evans & Sutherland and Spitz. It operates three lines: Cosm Tech (the CX System LED dome, Digistar planetarium software, and end-to-end immersive display systems sold to planetariums, museums and attractions), Cosm Media (immersive content production and licensing through Cosm Studios) and Cosm Venues (the "Shared Reality" experiential venues in Los Angeles and Dallas, with Atlanta, Detroit and Cleveland following). Cosm sells and operates systems and venues rather than a developer platform: it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification. The one API it markets — the Digistar scripting/automation interface, advertised as "the most fully featured API across the planetarium industry" — is documented only inside the customer support portal at partners.cosm.com, which requires a login.

providers.name: CreativeX
