providers.description: CreativeX provides the foundation for data‑powered creative decisions, giving marketers a single source of truth to measure, optimize, and scale creative excellence. The platform unifies creative, content and media measurement, offering tools for creative quality, salience, lifecycle, and inclusive representation, helping brands improve ROI across channels.

providers.name: Crosslayer Labs
providers.description: Crosslayer Labs is a network and web-infrastructure security company spun out of a Princeton University security research lab. Its founding team invented Multi-Perspective Issuance Corroboration (MPIC), an industry standard now required of every publicly-trusted Certificate Authority, which secures the issuance of every HTTPS certificate (~8 million per day). The company protects enterprises from website and API hijacks by discovering, analyzing, and continuously monitoring every layer of first- and third-party network infrastructure, correlating attack signals across the network stack for advanced threat detection and rapid mitigation.

providers.name: Cuida Mi Mascota
providers.description: Cuida Mi Mascota (CuidaMiMascota SAPI de CV) is a Mexican pet-care marketplace that connects pet owners with vetted, trusted caregivers for boarding (hospedaje), daycare, in-home visits, and dog walking across cities in Mexico. Delivered primarily as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps, the platform has served more than 250,000 pet owners and lets caregivers register to offer services. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. The company exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK today; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead with identity and domain-security signals captured for discovery.

providers.name: Cur8
providers.description: CUR8 is a carbon removal intelligence platform based in Oxford, United Kingdom, building the global market for high-quality carbon removals with a mission to remove one billion tonnes of carbon a year. Founded in 2021 by Mark Stevenson, Marta Krupinska and Gabrielle Walker, CUR8 combines financial and scientific expertise to source, evaluate and manage diversified carbon removal portfolios spanning nature restoration, biochar, direct air capture, enhanced weathering, superpollutant abatement and sustainable aviation fuel. Its platform surfaces (Discover for sourcing removal assets, Manage for tracking portfolio performance and risk, Finance for capital provision, and the Carbon Planner for strategy) help enterprises invest in carbon impact with confidence on the path to net zero. Clients include Microsoft, Coca-Cola HBC, Standard Chartered, Arup and UBS. CUR8 is backed by Google Ventures (GV) and Airbus Ventures. No public API, SDK or developer program is advertised as of this profile; access is via the CUR8 dashboard and platform.

providers.name: Current
providers.description: Current (Finco Services, Inc.) is a New York City-based U.S. financial technology company operating a mobile-first consumer banking platform serving over six million members. Through partner banks Choice Financial Group and Cross River Bank it offers fee-free spending accounts with early direct deposit (up to two days early), fee-free overdraft, and paycheck advances; Savings Pods earning competitive APY with automated Round-Ups; the Build Card for responsible credit building without a traditional credit check; fee-free cryptocurrency trading; and teen banking accounts with parental controls and automatic allowances. Current is a technology company, not a bank. It does NOT publish a first-party public developer API or developer portal — no developer.current.com (does not resolve), current.com/developers and current.com/api return 404, and api.current.com is an undocumented mobile-app backend. Programmatic access to member account data is available only through third-party open-finance aggregators (Plaid), on a consumer-permissioned basis. This profile captures the company's public web, legal, and security surface and its aggregator-only data-access posture.

providers.name: Dhan
providers.description: Dhan is an online stock trading and investing platform based in India, offering a wide range of products including equities, commodities, mutual funds, ETFs, and US stocks. It provides advanced trading tools such as the DEXT T3 terminal, options and futures platforms, margin trading, and a gold vault service. The platform also supports algorithmic trading via APIs, integrates with TradingView, and offers educational resources through its blog and community.

providers.name: Dorsata
providers.description: Dorsata is a women's health technology company based in Arlington, Virginia that reimagines the electronic health record (EHR) experience for obstetrics and gynecology providers, life sciences, and health plans. Its flagship Dorsata Prenatal platform overlays a practice's existing EHR with an ACOG-aligned prenatal flowsheet and a clinical rules engine that surfaces the right guidance at the right point of care, improving diagnosis, treatment, and documentation while reducing physician burnout. Additional products include Dorsata Insights, which gathers standardized real-world clinical data from women's health providers (including populations historically underrepresented in clinical studies), Dorsata Pathways, and an Adnexal Mass solution. The platform serves 300+ practice sites and thousands of clinical users across roughly 20 states, documenting hundreds of thousands of pregnancies. Dorsata raised a $5.2M Series A with participation from QED Investors, Women's Health USA, LabCorp, Fool Ventures, and Gore Range Capital. This API Evangelist profile tracks Dorsata as a healthtech company; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Double
providers.description: Double is a New York-based future-of-work company that pairs busy executives and founders with highly vetted, US-based remote executive assistants, augmented by an AI copilot (Mingo) that helps assistants summarize tasks, draft communications, prompt follow-up questions, and report time. Founded in 2018 by the former Sunrise Calendar team (Alice Default, Christophe Lamperti, Pierre-Elie Fauche), Double delivers operations, marketing, scheduling, inbox, and administrative delegation through a managed platform and shared secure workflows built around a per-client 1Password vault. Double is not a public API provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: Draftboard
providers.description: Draftboard provides a platform that automatically maps your network and delivers warm introductions to enterprise prospects. It eliminates the need for CSV exports by integrating directly with target accounts, offering insights into each connection’s value. The service focuses on account‑based marketing, helping sales teams discover and engage potential customers efficiently.

providers.name: EAT Club
providers.description: EAT Club is a corporate meal-delivery platform founded in 2010 in Redwood City, California by Kevin Yang and Rodrigo Santibanez, built around the idea of a "virtual cafeteria" for offices with no on-site dining. Instead of tray-style catering, each employee picks an individually packaged meal from a rotating daily menu produced by EAT Club's own kitchens and restaurant partners, and every order for a building arrives in one synchronized delivery. The company markets the program as an employee lunch benefit and reports 21 million meals delivered to roughly 1,145 companies across nine cities. Compass Group USA acquired EAT Club in October 2020 and folded its ordering, production and delivery technology into Compass Digital Labs, where it now underpins workplace, education and healthcare dining accounts across the US and Canada. The consumer-facing product is a React ordering app served from www.eatclub.com; EAT Club publishes no developer program, no API reference, no SDK and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Eclypsium
providers.description: Eclypsium is a supply-chain and infrastructure security company that delivers firmware, hardware, and low-level software assurance for enterprise and national infrastructure. Its cloud-based platform continuously scans laptops, servers, network gear, and other devices for firmware implants, rootkits, backdoors, vulnerable components, and integrity drift below the operating system, giving security teams device-level visibility, threat detection, and supply-chain risk management across the hardware and firmware lifecycle. Eclypsium integrates with SIEM, SOAR, and IT workflows and is used to defend against firmware-level attacks, enforce device integrity, and meet supply-chain security and compliance requirements. The company was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and is profiled here in the API Evangelist network. No public self-service developer API is currently published; enrichment captured the company's security, trust, and disclosure posture.

providers.name: EcomExperts
providers.description: EcomExperts is a Latin American ecommerce ERP and technology platform that helps online sellers manage, synchronize, and automate their stores from a single screen. It centralizes omnichannel operations across marketplaces and sales channels (including multi-account Mercado Libre management), synchronizes prices and stock in real time, and issues electronic invoices automatically in bulk. Delivered as a SaaS application with a hosted dashboard and a 7-day free trial, EcomExperts operates across Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, and Peru. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EcomExperts does not currently publish a public developer platform, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures company identity and public-surface signals only.

providers.name: Eden Network
providers.description: Eden Network is an Ethereum MEV, block-building, and orderflow infrastructure project (EDEN token, launched 2021, evolving from the earlier Archer DAO relay). It operated a gRPC mempool streaming service, an Eden block builder and reverse proxy (eden-geth / eden-proxy), subgraph-backed data tooling, and a DEX API for the Ethereum ecosystem. The original edennetwork.io web property has since lapsed; the canonical, still-live developer surface is the eden-network GitHub organization and the published npm and Go packages. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital and enriched from those public sources.

providers.name: EDITED
providers.description: EDITED is an AI-powered retail intelligence platform that helps retailers, buyers, merchandisers, planners, designers, and eCommerce teams make data-driven decisions across assortment, pricing, and promotions. Its Market API (the EDITED Data product) exposes a large normalized retail market data set — SKUs, brands, categories, pricing, and assortment signals across thousands of retailers and many countries — so organizations can benchmark against competitors in real time, spot emerging trends early, and integrate competitive intelligence into their own systems. The company is a Seedcamp portfolio company; access to the Market API is sales-gated (demo / contact sales) with no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Ellis
providers.description: Ellis is a modern business immigration platform and law firm that helps company People and HR teams secure U.S. work visas and green cards for skilled talent. The platform combines licensed immigration attorneys with software for centralized case management, document storage, status tracking, and program analytics, covering employment-based visas (H-1B, TN, O-1, L-1, J-1, E-1/E-2, E-3), green cards (EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, EB-2/EB-3 PERM), and naturalization. Ellis is a Kindred Ventures portfolio company. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Ellis publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable artifacts at this time.

providers.name: Enjoei
providers.description: Enjoei is a Brazilian online marketplace (brechó) for buying and selling new and pre-owned fashion, shoes, accessories, electronics, furniture, home goods, and collectibles. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it operates a peer-to-peer resale platform and mobile app ("enjuapp") that connects individual sellers and buyers, handling listings, payments, shipping, and buyer/seller protection. Enjoei is publicly traded on Brazil's B3 exchange (ticker ENJU3). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, MCP server, or SDKs were found during enrichment; this profile carries the consumer-facing identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Entera
providers.description: Entera is an AI-powered SaaS and services platform for single-family rental (SFR) real estate investing, describing itself as the operating system for single-family real estate. It helps operators, funds, new-construction companies, agents, and service partners buy, sell, and operate homes at scale across 34+ U.S. residential markets. The platform spans acquisitions (asset discovery, underwriting, diligence coordination), dispositions (pricing, buyer targeting, offer management), transaction enablement, market data and intelligence, and expert brokerage services. Entera is backed by investors including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Entera exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI/SDK surface; this profile captures its published company, legal, and brand properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: ePallet
providers.description: ePallet is an online wholesale marketplace that enables bulk purchasing of a wide variety of products. The platform offers a curated selection of brands and categories, providing real‑time pricing, secure checkout, and hassle‑free delivery coordination. Shoppers can explore brands, business categories, and mixed pallets, while the site emphasizes safe and secure checkout, customer service, and guarantees. ePallet’s mission is to make bulk buying easy and efficient for both consumers and businesses.

providers.name: Essex Open Data
providers.description: Essex Open Data is a local council open-data portal for United Kingdom running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately an open datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Evie Networks
providers.description: Evie Networks is an Australian electric-vehicle charging infrastructure company, founded in 2017 and backed by the St Baker Energy Innovation Fund, that owns and operates one of the country's largest DC fast and ultrafast public charging networks across 300+ locations in every state and territory. It sits downstream of the electricity retail market as a charge point operator (CPO) and e-mobility service provider, buying energy and reselling it as charging sessions to drivers and fleets, and it also builds and operates charging assets for site hosts, councils, dealerships and commercial property owners. Its API posture is closed: as of 2026-07-27 there is no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no named support for the EV charging interoperability standards (OCPP, OCPI, ISO 15118). Evie is not a designated data holder under Australia's Consumer Data Right energy regime — the CDR Register's public energy data-holder brand summary lists 84 brands and Evie is not among them — so the statutory data mandate that produced identical APIs across Australian banks and energy retailers does not reach the EV charging layer at all. A live production API host exists at api.goevie.com.au serving the Evie Charging mobile app, but it is undocumented, unadvertised and returns a Google Cloud Endpoints 404 to anonymous callers. Neither consumer charging-session data nor network/market data is published through any documented public interface; charger location data reaches developers only through third-party aggregators.

providers.name: fomo
providers.description: fomo (FOMO Labs Inc.) is a social-first cryptocurrency trading platform available as a mobile app and web platform. It lets mainstream retail investors trade memecoins, altcoins, and stablecoins across multiple blockchains without managing wallets, paying gas fees, or transferring assets manually, wrapping on-chain trading in a social layer where users discover tokens, follow top traders, view real-time buy alerts, copy trades, and compete on leaderboards. Onboarding is quick with Apple Pay funding, and trading is multichain and gasless. Founded in 2025 by former Deutsche Bank and dYdX team members (CEO Paul Erlanger, Se Yong Park, Prashan Dharmasena), the New York company reports 500,000+ active traders, 625,000+ total users, and $4B+ in trading volume. In June 2026 it raised a $75M Series B led by Index Ventures with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark at a $550M valuation. fomo is a consumer-facing product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Fortem Technologies
providers.description: Fortem Technologies is an airspace security and defense company based in Lindon, Utah that builds counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) for military, government, critical infrastructure, and commercial customers. Its SkyDome System combines TrueView AESA radars, long-range TrueView cameras, RF sensors, and the autonomous DroneHunter interceptor into a single detect-track-defeat capability, orchestrated by SkyDome Manager command-and-control software. SkyDome Manager exposes REST, realtime, and track-only integration APIs so third-party C2 platforms (such as the U.S. Army FAAD C2 and Lockheed Martin systems) can exchange over a hundred fields and commands for airspace awareness and drone mitigation. Fortem is backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, Boeing, and other strategic investors, and its systems have been selected for high-profile deployments including protection of venues at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

providers.name: Fundera
providers.description: Fundera by NerdWallet is a small business financial guidance and lending marketplace platform that helps small business owners compare and access loan products, business credit cards, checking accounts, and financial health tools. Fundera connects borrowers with a vetted network of lenders offering SBA loans, term loans, lines of credit, equipment financing, invoice factoring, merchant cash advances, and commercial real estate loans. Acquired by NerdWallet in 2020, Fundera has secured over $5.4 billion in funds for more than 77,000 small businesses.

providers.name: Galley
providers.description: Galley Solutions provides culinary resource planning software that helps kitchens manage inventory, scheduling, and financial reporting. The platform offers tools for menu planning, supplier coordination, and real‑time analytics to improve operational efficiency and reduce waste. Targeted at restaurants, catering services, and food‑service enterprises, Galley aims to align kitchen creativity with financial accuracy, supporting both small independent eateries and large multi‑site operations.

providers.name: Greator
providers.description: Greator (formerly GEDANKENtanken, founded 2012) is Germany's largest personal- development platform, headquartered in Cologne and serving roughly 234,000 customers. It runs a B2C ecosystem of free content (masterclasses, podcasts, a YouTube channel, magazine articles and personality tests) alongside paid, certified training programs such as The School of Life, Momentum Mastery, the Finance Academy and TheKey speaking training. Greator also produces live events including the annual Greator Festival (15,000+ attendees, 400+ speakers) and operates Greator Business, a B2B corporate offering. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Greator publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Hashtag Paid
providers.description: Hashtag Paid Inc., which trades as #paid, is a Toronto-headquartered creator marketing platform that connects brands and agencies with social media creators. The product is a marketplace and campaign workspace: brands brief a campaign, are matched to vetted creators, review and approve content, license and amplify that content as paid social advertising across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and Pinterest, then measure results and pay creators automatically. #paid is a badged TikTok Marketing Partner and consumes the social platforms' advertising APIs on its customers' behalf. It runs as an end-user SaaS product with brand and creator web applications; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Hesai Technology
providers.description: Hesai Technology is a global leader in 3D LiDAR perception, designing and manufacturing high-performance lidar sensors for autonomous driving, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, and industrial automation. Its sensors are deployed by major automotive OEMs and autonomous-vehicle companies across more than 40 countries. Hesai does not expose a public REST/HTTP API; its developer surface is source-distributed C++ SDKs, ROS and ROS2 drivers, and integration plugins (including an NVIDIA DriveWorks plugin) published on the HesaiTechnology GitHub organization, alongside a developer portal and downloadable firmware, manuals, and tools. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Hesai's public developer resources.

providers.name: Hobnob
providers.description: Hobnob is a consumer event and community-organizing platform (hobnob.app) for iOS, Android, and web. It lets people create custom video and photo invitations, deliver them by text message, track RSVPs, sell tickets, run sign-up lists, time polls, and announcements, and coordinate private group "Spaces" for chat and content sharing. Built on a Hawaii-inspired philosophy of real-world connection over engagement-maximizing social media, Hobnob reports 20 million invitations sent, roughly 35,000 events per month, 650,000 Spaces created, and 90,000+ five-star reviews. It is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hokan
providers.description: Hokan, Inc. (株式会社hokan) is a Japanese InsurTech company that builds hokan®, a cloud-based customer and contract management (CRM) system for insurance agencies and brokerages. The platform consolidates customer and policy information, digitizes proposal and activity workflows, and adds modules for intent capture (意向把握), case management (案件管理), dashboards, accounting/cashiering (出納), and staff management (People). It targets paperless operations, stronger audit and compliance controls, renewal and aftercare tracking, and mobile access for agents. Customers include Orix Life, ANA, Sekisui, and other Japanese insurers and agencies. Hokan is backed by 500 Global. The company exposes API-based website integration for its product but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Hykso
providers.description: Hykso, Inc. is the company behind FightCamp, an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system that pairs a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and wireless motion-tracking punch trackers with an on-demand library of trainer-led workouts. The Hykso punch trackers began as standalone wearable sensors that measure punch count, speed, and output for boxers and gyms, and now power FightCamp's real-time performance stats and workout scoring. This profile is a company stub in the API Evangelist network; Hykso/FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer connected-fitness brand and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Hyperpad
providers.description: Hyperpad (hyperPad) is a no-code, visual game development platform for iPad, often described as "HyperCard for iPad." Founded in 2013 and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2014), the London, Ontario company lets non-programmers build media-rich 2D games and interactive apps using a drag-and-drop, node-based behavior system with a built-in physics engine, particle effects, animation and audio tools, and a bundled asset library, then publish them to the Apple App Store as native apps while keeping 100% of royalties. Products include the paid hyperPad app, a free hyperPad Starter edition, and hyperPad Hub, a community arcade for playing games made with the platform. hyperPad is a consumer-facing creation tool and does not currently publish a public web API or developer platform.

providers.name: Instaread
providers.description: Instaread is a media and audio technology company with two products. Its consumer app delivers ~15-minute audio and text summaries of bestselling books across business, self-help, history, health, politics, and fiction on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Its publisher product, Instaread Player, is a free embeddable audio widget that uses AI text-to-speech (including custom voice cloning) to convert website articles, blogs, and newsletters into natural-sounding audio, monetized for publishers through programmatic audio advertising. The Player is used by 200+ brands, ships ADA/WCAG accessibility support, an analytics dashboard, podcast distribution, and a WordPress plugin, and works on Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, and custom sites via a single embed code. Instaread does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Instil
providers.description: Instil is a purpose-built fundraising CRM and revenue-intelligence platform for nonprofit organizations, built for major-gifts and development teams. It manages the full donor lifecycle across major gifts, capital campaigns, planned giving, grant tracking, and moves management, and layers AI on top with One-Click Briefings that assemble a constituent's giving history and contact record on demand and Voice AI Logging that transcribes calls and writes interactions back to Instil or Salesforce. Instil connects to the nonprofit tech stack through Salesforce, Stripe, Classy, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Eventbrite, Google, Outlook, and Zapier. It is backed by Threshold Ventures. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time; integrations are delivered through packaged connectors and Zapier.

providers.name: InventoryQuant
providers.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.

providers.name: Jakarta EE
providers.description: Jakarta EE is the open source successor to Java EE, providing a set of specifications for enterprise Java development. Jakarta EE is developed under the Eclipse Foundation and includes specifications for web services, messaging, persistence, security, and other enterprise computing needs.

providers.name: kema-studio-com
providers.description: Kema Studio is a Lisbon‑based software studio that builds its own management applications—such as Olia for law firms and Kema Invoice for automated billing—and also develops custom solutions for other businesses. Its tools are used daily by teams, and the company highlights that AI agents can now pilot these applications, positioning itself at the intersection of SaaS and AI‑enabled automation.

providers.name: LF Broadband
providers.description: LF Broadband is a Linux Foundation Directed Fund established in late 2023 that supports open source broadband networking projects, including reference designs and virtualization tools for broadband access networks. Its flagship projects, SEBA and VOLTHA, virtualize multi-vendor Passive Optical Network (PON) systems and are deployed by major operators such as Deutsche Telekom and Turk Telekom.

providers.name: Meross
providers.description: Meross is a global smart home and IoT device manufacturer offering a wide range of Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, and Thread‑enabled products such as smart plugs, switches, lighting, thermostats, cameras, and sensors. The company provides a public API for developers to integrate device control, status monitoring, and automation into third‑party applications and platforms, supporting standards like HomeKit, Alexa, and Google Assistant.

providers.name: Natural Cycles
providers.description: Natural Cycles is a Swedish women's-health company behind the first birth-control application cleared by the US FDA (2018) and CE-marked in Europe as a Class IIb medical device. Its subscription app uses a proprietary temperature-based algorithm to identify fertile and non-fertile days from a user's daily basal body temperature, supporting both preventing and planning pregnancy as well as cycle, ovulation, and perimenopause tracking. Temperature is captured with a paired Bluetooth basal thermometer or through consumer wearables the app integrates with — Apple Watch, Oura Ring, and the NC B1 band. Natural Cycles publishes clinical research, an educational content library (CycleMatters), an e-commerce shop for thermometers and tests, and a public bug-bounty / responsible-disclosure program, but it does not expose a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. Backed by EQT Ventures.

providers.name: NeoTaste
providers.description: NeoTaste is a restaurant discovery and dining-deals mobile app operated by NeoTaste GmbH (Osnabrück, Germany). Under the tagline "Discover more. Pay less." it surfaces curated local restaurants and exclusive member deals such as 2-for-1 main courses and a free starter with a main, letting diners try new places while saving money and helping restaurants attract new guests. The consumer product ships as native iOS and Android apps and currently operates across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. NeoTaste is a venture-backed (Series A) company surfaced through the Earlybird portfolio. It exposes no public developer API — its api.neotaste.com backend is a private, authentication-gated service for the first-party mobile apps — so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an integration surface.

providers.name: Nexus AI
providers.description: Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as "Nexus AI", a 500 Global portfolio lead, but its recorded domain conceptdrop.com now permanently redirects (301) to hiresource.io — the site of Source (formerly ConceptDrop), a freelance creative-talent management platform. Source lets teams find, vet, and manage freelance designers, writers, animators, and consultants through a single contract with a dedicated account manager, replacing traditional creative-agency procurement. The customer application lives at app.hiresource.io; the public site is a WordPress marketing property. During enrichment no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface was found — this remains a non-API company profile.

providers.name: NOCD
providers.description: NOCD is a virtual mental-health provider specializing in the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder. Through its web and mobile applications the company matches members with licensed therapists trained in Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy, delivers live video sessions, and provides between-session messaging, a peer community, and in-app therapeutic tools. NOCD is in-network with a large number of US health plans and serves children, adolescents, and adults. The product is delivered as an end-user clinical service — the company operates a private mobile/web application backend at api.treatmyocd.com but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Nuro
providers.description: Nuro is a Mountain View-based autonomy company that has pivoted from its original autonomous-goods-delivery vehicle program (R1, R2, R3) to a licensable, vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving stack. The Nuro Driver is an AI-first Level 4 self-driving system, validated through 5+ years of driverless deployments and more than 1.7 million autonomous miles with zero at-fault incidents, paired with the Nuro Toolkit suite of supporting technology. Partners and customers include Uber and Lucid (premium robotaxi program with production-intent vehicles announced for CES 2026), Mercedes- Benz, Toyota, Kroger, Domino's, and Walmart, with NVIDIA participation in recent funding rounds. Nuro has offices in Mountain View, San Francisco, Santa Clara, Las Vegas, Houston, Toronto, Washington DC, Shenzhen, Tokyo, and an upcoming Munich expansion. Nuro does not publish a public developer API; the Driver and Toolkit are commercialized through B2B licensing rather than a self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Nvidia
providers.description: Nvidia is a Fortune 500 company that provides developer APIs and integration capabilities through its developer platform. NVIDIA provides developer APIs for GPU computing, AI/ML model training and inference, and graphics. The platform includes APIs for CUDA, TensorRT, Omniverse, and cloud GPU services.

providers.name: Open Data Schleswig-Holstein
providers.description: Open Data Schleswig-Holstein is a state government open-data portal for Germany running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 32,414 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Opsee
providers.description: Opsee provides an open, modular manufacturing execution system (MES) and industrial data platform for factories. It offers data logging, historian, analytics, OEE, quality, production order management, and AI-driven insights. The platform is container‑based, open‑source, and designed for plant‑floor operators, allowing incremental module adoption without vendor lock‑in.

providers.name: Paraform
providers.description: Paraform is an agentic hiring marketplace where expert recruiters and custom AI agents work together to fill companies' most important roles. Companies post open roles and work with multiple vetted recruiters from a network of 10,000+ professionals in one place, while Paraform's AI toolkit handles sourcing, candidate matching, CRM, notetaking, and scheduling. The platform charges a listing (subscription) fee to publish roles and a success fee when a hire is made. Paraform does not publish a public developer API; instead it integrates into customers' existing ATS and productivity tools (Ashby, Greenhouse, Slack, Gmail, Calendly, Google Calendar) by consuming those partners' APIs and webhooks to keep candidate, role, and interview status in sync bidirectionally.

providers.name: Plenful
providers.description: Plenful is an AI-powered workflow automation platform for pharmacy and healthcare operations, founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York City. The platform automates complex, high-ROI administrative pharmacy workflows — 340B audit and optimization, 340B referral capture, rebate and Maximum Fair Price (MFP) reconciliation, benefits verification and prior authorization, and infusion order intake — using large language models and machine learning tuned to each organization's data. It ingests PDFs, flat files, APIs, HL7 feeds, and databases, supports unlimited organizational logic rules, and serves 100+ healthcare organizations including Prisma Health, Renown Health, Temple Health, Cencora, and Samaritan Health Services. Plenful is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Notable Capital (formerly GGV Capital), SUSA Ventures, TQ Ventures, and Waterline Ventures. Plenful ships an enterprise SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Portex
providers.description: Portex is a freight procurement and management platform that replaces the emails, spreadsheets, and PDFs of traditional freight quoting with a single collaborative workspace. Shippers, brokers, carriers, and forwarders use Portex to create, send, receive, compare, and award freight quotes up to 90% faster, centralize shipment documents and tracking, chat with carriers, and analyze freight spend for cost-saving recommendations. Founded by Brittany Ennix (previously Uber and Flexport) and backed by Cowboy Ventures, Portex is a seed-stage logistics technology company. As of this profile the platform is delivered as a hosted web application at portexpro.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Pratilipi
providers.description: Pratilipi is India's largest digital storytelling platform, democratizing story creation and consumption across languages, formats, and boundaries. Built by Nasadiya Technologies Private Limited and headquartered in Bangalore, it lets more than 300,000 self-published writers reach roughly 25 million monthly readers across twelve Indian languages (Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Urdu, and Odia). The ecosystem spans Pratilipi Literature, Pratilipi FM (audio books, podcasts, and folk songs), Pratilipi Comics (the largest Hindi online comic platform), Westland Publications, and IVM Podcasts, carrying a story "from someone's draft to someone's screen." Pratilipi does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Praxis
providers.description: Praxis is a New York-based company building an internet-native community and city-development venture — "an online community starting a new city" — founded in 2019 by Dryden Brown and Charlie Callinan. It operates a membership community at praxisnation.com whose stated purpose is to create a new culture and a resident-owned physical city, and a members-only account portal at portal.praxisnation.com where members view their PRAX holdings and manage their account. In October 2024 Praxis announced $525M in financing toward development of its first city. Praxis is a real-estate, community and smart-cities company, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Produce Pay
providers.description: ProducePay is an agtech fintech platform for the global fresh-produce supply chain, giving growers, distributors, and buyers a combination of trade financing and operational tooling. Its offerings include Pre-Season Financing (working capital ahead of the growing season), Quick-Pay (converting produce shipments into immediate cash during peak season), Visibility (real-time shipment tracking, quality control, and data-driven insights), Sourcing (connecting buyers and sellers for long-term partnerships), and Predictable Commerce programs that bundle capital, visibility, and partnerships for year-round supply stability. The company operates a marketplace for its members but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Prosper Health
providers.description: Prosper Health is a telehealth provider focused exclusively on autistic and neurodivergent adults, offering virtual autism diagnostic assessments and ongoing affirming, strength-based therapy delivered by licensed psychologists and therapists who specialize in adult autism. Its adult-validated, telehealth-native assessment (an alternative to the child-oriented ADOS) runs entirely online across two psychologist sessions plus a feedback session, with results reported within roughly two weeks. Prosper Health accepts major insurers (Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Oscar, Oxford, United) across 20-plus US states. It is a direct-to-consumer clinical care company with no public developer API surface; this profile tracks its web, security, and identity properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Red Access
providers.description: Red Access (redaccess.io) is a cloud-based enterprise browsing and Secure Service Edge (SSE) security platform delivering agentless, browser-native protection — Zero Trust browsing, DLP, SWG, CASB, EDR-for-the-browser and GenAI security governance — without network rewrites or endpoint agents. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners and headquartered in New York, it was named a Leader in the 2025 GigaOm Radar for Secure Enterprise Browsing. As of this enrichment pass Red Access publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: RenoFi
providers.description: RenoFi is a home-renovation financing platform that partners with credit unions and lenders to offer renovation-specific loans underwritten against a home's projected after-renovation value (ARV) rather than its current equity, letting homeowners borrow significantly more without refinancing their first mortgage. RenoFi is not itself a lender: it originates and prepares applications, performs renovation underwriting, and connects homeowners, contractors, realtors, and credit-union partners to its lending network for RenoFi Home Equity Loans and HELOCs. The company maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source Ruby infrastructure libraries (GraphQL and Salesforce tooling) but publishes no public product API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal.

providers.name: Revivn
providers.description: Revivn provides an integrated hardware lifecycle platform for managing end-of-life IT equipment. The company handles secure device pickup, certified data sanitization and destruction, and redistribution of usable hardware to underserved communities through nonprofit partnerships. Its software surface (the Revivn App at app.revivn.com) lets IT and asset-management teams schedule retrievals, track chain-of-custody, generate compliance and sustainability reporting, and — per Revivn's marketing — integrate Revivn's API with their IT software stack for customized workflows. No public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDK is published; the integration API appears to be a private, enterprise-only surface. Revivn is a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Ro
providers.description: Ro (ro.co) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company that connects patients with US-licensed healthcare providers entirely online, offering prescription treatment, provider visits, and pharmacy fulfillment across categories including men's and women's health, weight management (Ro Body), dermatology (Ro Derm), hair loss, fertility (Ro Fertility), and sexual health. Ro deliberately operates a "Zero-API" vertically integrated online-visit experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; its only public machine-readable surface is a security posture (RFC 9116 security.txt and a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure program). Ro is backed by Canaan Partners, General Catalyst, and Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Rome2Rio
providers.description: Rome2Rio is a multi-modal travel planning platform founded in Melbourne, Australia in 2011, and part of the Omio Group since 2019. It covers 240+ countries, 10 million+ locations, and 20,000+ transport operators, enabling door-to-door route discovery across flights, trains, buses, ferries, and driving. Developers can access route search, geocoding, and autocomplete capabilities through the Rome2Rio REST API, which returns JSON responses covering routes, segments, duration, and operator information for any two points worldwide.

providers.name: Safety Wing
providers.description: SafetyWing is a fintech and insurtech company providing global health and travel insurance for remote workers, digital nomads, and distributed teams. Its consumer product Nomad Insurance offers travel-medical and full health coverage across 180+ countries, while Remote Health lets companies cover employees and contractors worldwide under a single plan. Backed by Creandum, the company positions itself as building a global social safety net so that geography is no barrier to equal opportunity. As of this enrichment pass SafetyWing publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Shuttle Central
providers.description: Shuttle Central (shuttlecentral.com) is a ground transportation booking platform for airport and point-to-point shuttle transfers across Mexico, the Caribbean, the United States, and Latin America, covering 100+ destinations including Cancun, Punta Cana, Nassau, Los Cabos, Mexico City, Puerto Vallarta, Montego Bay, and Miami. Travelers book confirmed transfers online with secure payment, instant confirmation, and 24/7 support, and a separate transportation-provider program (shuttlecentralinc.com) lets ground operators sell transfers through the platform. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Sidechat
providers.description: Sidechat is an anonymous, campus-based social networking app for college students, built by Flower Ave Inc in New York City and backed by Canaan Partners. Students verify with a school email to join their college's private, location- and campus-scoped community where they post text, images, and polls, vote, and chat anonymously in a Reddit-like feed. Sidechat launched in early 2022, acquired Yik Yak in 2023, and operates primarily as an iOS consumer app. It publishes no official public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; this profile captures the company's public web presence and identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Siolla
providers.description: Siolla is a Saudi financial-technology company offering a consumer investment-management mobile application. It provides professionally managed, fully Sharia-compliant investment portfolios, an in-app academy and educational resources covering financial fundamentals, budgeting and investment strategy, and simplified access to investing for modern investors. Siolla is licensed and regulated by the Saudi Capital Market Authority. The company presents a consumer app and website only; no public developer program, API, or developer documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: SiteAware
providers.description: SiteAware is the construction industry's first AI-powered Digital Construction Verification and Quality Management Platform for buildings. It verifies every installed element and flags real-time deviations across structure, envelope, and interior construction, giving field teams and business executives actionable data and analytics to catch issues before they lead to expensive rework. SiteAware is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Sonnet Insurance
providers.description: Sonnet Insurance is a Canadian direct-to-consumer digital property and casualty insurer launched in 2016 and a member of the Definity family of companies, underwriting its own auto, home, condo, tenant, landlord and pet policies through Sonnet Insurance Company. It sells auto, home, condo, tenant and landlord coverage in Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island, and home-only coverage in British Columbia and Alberta, positioning itself as "Canada's original digital-first home and auto insurance company" with a fully online quote-and-buy flow and licensed agents for support. Sonnet is an explicit direct writer -- its own FAQ states that "a third party -- even a licensed broker -- cannot purchase a Sonnet policy on your behalf" -- so it operates no broker or agency distribution channel and therefore no ACORD/AL3 agency-download path. Its API posture is closed -- no developer, developers, docs or api subdomain resolves in DNS, every first-party developer path probed returns HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, Postman collection, webhook catalog or partner technical onboarding surface is published. The only third-party integrations Sonnet describes -- the Kanetix.ca (RATESDOTCA) quote-and-buy partnership and the Sonnet Connect brand referral program -- are privately negotiated commercial arrangements with no public technical documentation. Two machine-readable surfaces do exist and are captured here. Sonnet serves a real llms.txt at www.sonnet.ca/llms.txt that declares per-agent AI-Training, AI-Generation, AI-Summarization and AI-Crawling directives (Allow for OpenAI, Google-DeepMind and Anthropic) alongside a curated reference-content index -- an AI consent signal rather than an API contract. And the secure.sonnet.ca quote-and-buy application is driven by an undocumented first-party REST/JSON surface under /api/v1 covering quoting, binding, policy servicing, payments and identity; it is observable from Sonnet's own public JavaScript bundle but carries no documentation, no specification and no third-party terms of use, so it is recorded as observed evidence, not as an integratable API.

providers.name: Spacebase
providers.description: Spacebase is an online marketplace for booking meeting rooms, event venues, and flexible workspaces, connecting businesses and event planners with more than 18,000 unique spaces across 4,000+ venues in 12 countries and 550+ destinations. The platform offers self-service online booking with transparent pricing, instant confirmation, add-on extras such as WiFi and catering, and a Spacebase booking guarantee, alongside consultant support for complex bookings and business accounts with negotiated rates and monthly invoicing. Spacebase is a portfolio company of Point Nine. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company operates a consumer/business booking marketplace and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Spacetime Studios
providers.description: Spacetime Studios is an Austin, Texas mobile game developer and the creator of the free-to-play "Legends" series of cross-platform MMORPGs, including Arcane Legends, Pocket Legends, Star Legends, and Dark Legends. Founded by veteran game developers, the studio operates a consumer-facing community forum, an in-game item web store, and player support channels. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its verified public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: Splitero
providers.description: Splitero is a San Diego, California fintech founded in 2021 by Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler that originates Home Equity Investments (HEIs) — a lump sum of cash, up to $500,000, paid to a homeowner today in exchange for a share of the home's future value, with no monthly payments, no income requirement, credit scores accepted from 500, and terms of up to 30 years. The company operates a consumer application and servicing portal at my.splitero.com, funds its originations through institutional capital commitments (including a $350M facility led by Blue Owl Capital), and has expanded into a licensed residential brokerage, Splitero Homes. Splitero is an end-user consumer finance product: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Storyraise
providers.description: Storyraise provides donor engagement software that helps nonprofits and foundations build real connections with supporters. Their platform offers tools for fundraising, donor stewardship, impact reporting, and analytics, enabling organizations to manage campaigns, major gifts, and communications across sectors such as education, healthcare, and social justice.

providers.name: Subway
providers.description: One of the world's largest fast-food restaurant chains specializing in submarine sandwiches and salads. Operates over 36,000 locations in more than 100 countries through its franchise model. Subway has no public developer API or self-service developer portal; ordering, store locator, nutrition, and MyWay/MVP loyalty integrations are handled through internal systems and direct franchise/partner agreements.

providers.name: TaTiO
providers.description: TaTiO is a recruitment and candidate-assessment platform that replaces traditional resume-based screening with immersive, AI-driven virtual job simulations. Candidates perform real job tasks - a forklift pre-shift check, a customer service call - so employers see how they actually work rather than how they describe themselves, producing a prediction score, a skills snapshot, and a report drawn from roughly 150 data points per candidate. The platform aims to increase application and engagement rates, reduce hiring mismatches, and integrate with existing hiring tools (ATS) so candidate status syncs automatically. TaTiO is a Techstars-backed company; its public website runs on Wix and exposes a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access.

providers.name: Tenex
providers.description: Tenex is a PropTech platform for real estate and hospitality operators across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, offering an all-in-one suite that unifies property management, tenant and landlord experience, facility and asset management, real estate accounting, VR for off-plan developments, and a hospitality guest experience app. Trusted across 500+ buildings and communities, it advertises integrations with ZATCA, SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft Dynamics to automate compliance and unify operations. Tenex is backed by 500 Global and the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator. As of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is published.

providers.name: Terminal
providers.description: Terminal (terminal.io) is a talent platform for hiring vetted remote and nearshore software engineers for full-time, contract, and contract-to-hire roles. It combines AI-fluency assessment and technical vetting (accepting roughly the top 7% of applicants) with Employer of Record (EOR) services that handle HR, payroll, and benefits across 180+ countries, sourcing engineers from Latin America, Canada, and Europe. Terminal is a B2B staffing and hiring platform rather than an API provider — it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Backed by 8VC and Lightspeed Venture Partners; added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Trackonomy
providers.description: Trackonomy is a supply chain visibility company that digitizes real-world operations with barely-there smart label sensors. Its SmartTape and THL Tape products provide item-level tracking, monitoring location, temperature, humidity, and light in real time, while its platform connects, automates, controls, and remediates operations processes at global scale for logistics, industrial, utilities, healthcare, government, and airline customers. Trackonomy is backed by 8VC. It advertises a customizable RESTful API and webhook-based real-time data exchange for platform customers, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: traderwai-com
providers.description: TraderWAI provides a platform that connects large language model AIs such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and others directly to users' brokerage accounts, enabling AI-driven analysis, order suggestions, and automated execution with user-defined risk controls. The service offers a free forever plan, no credit-card required, and supports multiple brokers. It includes documentation, pricing details, a blog, investor information, and a status page, all accessible via its website.

providers.name: Transport for NSW Open Data Hub
providers.description: Transport for NSW Open Data Hub is a open data portal open-data portal for Australia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 230 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: usefulapi-io
providers.description: UsefulAPI provides a platform hosting 469 remote MCP servers that expose APIs of popular SaaS tools across payments, CRM, messaging, healthcare, and DevOps. Users can access these services via standardized endpoints with a free tier and paid plans, enabling rapid integration without managing individual vendor credentials.

providers.name: Vectren (CenterPoint Energy)
providers.description: Vectren Corporation was a Fortune 1000 energy holding company headquartered in Evansville (Newburgh), Indiana providing regulated natural gas and electric distribution services to customers in Indiana and Ohio, along with non-regulated infrastructure services and energy efficiency programs. Vectren merged with CenterPoint Energy on February 1, 2019 in a $6 billion transaction, becoming part of the combined company which serves over 7 million metered customers across Arkansas, Indiana, Louisiana, Minnesota, Mississippi, Ohio, Oklahoma, and Texas. Vectren customer-facing portals continue to operate at vectren.com redirecting to CenterPoint Energy services.

providers.name: Vital Lyfe
providers.description: Vital Lyfe is a Torrance, California hardware company building portable water purification technology designed to scale where infrastructure cannot reach. Its flagship product, Access, is a portable watermaker that converts naturally occurring water, including saltwater, into clean drinking water through a simple place-a-hose, press-start, hydrate workflow. The company sells the Access device and branded gear through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront and publishes a mission, team, careers, and journal. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Vital Lyfe is a consumer-hardware and e-commerce brand with no public API, SDK, or developer program surface.

providers.name: Vocca Ai
providers.description: Vocca is a healthcare voice-AI company (backed by Speedinvest) that builds AI voice and text agents acting as a 24/7 receptionist for medical groups and practices. Vocca handles inbound and outbound patient calls, appointment bookings, reminders, and follow-ups across specialties including imaging, dental, cardiology, gynecology, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, general medicine, hospitals, and multi-practice clinics, so clinical teams spend less time on admin and more time on care. The company operates a customer-facing product with French and English coverage; it does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile carries company identity and website link-properties only.

providers.name: Vouch
providers.description: Vouch is a San Francisco, California business insurance broker and risk advisor purpose-built for high-growth startups and the venture ecosystem. Founded in 2018 by Sam Hodges and Travis Hedge and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital, SVB Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Y Combinator, and MS&AD Ventures, Vouch offers a tailored portfolio of commercial coverages — Directors & Officers (D&O), Errors & Omissions (E&O / Tech E&O / Professional Services E&O), Cyber, Employment Practices Liability (EPL), General Liability, Business Property, Fiduciary, Crime, and contract-required coverages — sold to technology, healthcare and life sciences, financial services, and professional services companies. The business model is broker-of-record commissions and, since 2021, a Vouch-owned insurance carrier underwriting select lines. Vouch is best known in the developer community for its embedded insurance program, which lets ecosystem partners (Carta, StartupOS, and similar founder platforms) pre-fill applications, surface quotes, and bind coverage inline via Vouch's partner API. Public developer documentation, an OpenAPI specification, and a self-serve sandbox are not exposed; the partner API and Vouch Corporate documentation (hosted on GitBook) are gated to onboarded venture, technology, and service-provider partners contracted through hello@vouch.us.

providers.name: Wikimapia
providers.description: Wikimapia is a collaborative geographic wiki that layers crowdsourced place information onto satellite imagery. Launched in 2006, the platform covers over 32 million geographic objects contributed by its community. The REST API provides programmatic access to places, categories, streets, and geographic searches using API-key authentication. Responses are available in JSON and KML formats. The API supports bounding-box queries, coordinate-based nearest-place lookups, full-text search, and detailed place retrieval including geometry, photos, comments, and community-tagged categories.

providers.name: Wisk Aero
providers.description: Wisk Aero is an autonomous, all-electric eVTOL air taxi developer and a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company. Wisk is developing its Generation 6 aircraft, a four-passenger self-flying eVTOL designed to operate under human supervisor oversight from a multi-vehicle supervision center, pursuing certification under three FAA programs: Type Certification, Production Certification, and Operation Certification. Wisk evolved from earlier Kitty Hawk programs and has logged over 1,750 autonomous test flights across five aircraft generations since 2010. Announced launch communities include Houston, Texas and Brisbane, Australia (in support of the 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games). In March 2026 Wisk was selected by the White House to help lead the safe U.S. introduction of autonomous air taxi flight. Wisk is hardware- and operations-focused, with no public consumer or developer APIs.

providers.name: Xh
providers.description: xh is a friendly and fast command-line HTTP client written in Rust, designed as a modern, high-performance alternative to HTTPie. It reimplements HTTPie's request-item syntax and design with improved startup speed, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support, and availability as a single statically-linked binary. xh supports JSON and form data serialization, session management, authentication (basic, bearer, digest), SSL/TLS customization, multipart uploads, proxy configuration, and built-in curl command translation. Installable via Homebrew, Cargo, apt, pacman, and other package managers.

providers.name: Yukon Open Data
providers.description: Yukon Open Data is a territorial government open-data portal for Canada running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 3,773 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Zehitomo
providers.description: Zehitomo is a Tokyo-based online marketplace that matches consumers in Japan with local professionals across hundreds of service categories — including photographers, personal trainers, house cleaners, graphic and web designers, videographers, tax accountants, interpreters, construction and repair trades, and business consultants. Clients describe the job they need done and receive quotes and proposals from vetted local pros, while professionals pay to respond to matched leads. Founded in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, Zehitomo runs a consumer-facing web and mobile product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: 9GAG
providers.description: 9GAG is a Hong Kong-based global entertainment platform founded in 2008 with the mission to "make the world happier." It is one of the largest meme and user-generated humor communities on the internet, distributing funny images, GIFs, and videos across its website and iOS/Android apps to an audience of 150-200 million people and billions of monthly video views. 9GAG operates consumer-facing products (the 9GAG feed, 9GAG Pro subscription, and related community features) rather than a public developer API program; it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-backed company (500 Global, Y Combinator, Freestyle Capital, True Ventures, First Round Capital, Greycroft) and has been enriched with its real public web, policy, and security surfaces. No official public API or developer portal is published as of this enrichment; the community libraries that exist are unofficial and reverse-engineered.

providers.name: Affiliate MCP
providers.description: Affiliate MCP is an open-source, local-first automation platform that connects every affiliate network to large language models such as Claude or Codex. Users can ask plain-English questions to retrieve affiliate performance data, generate reports, and approve actions. The service runs locally, ensuring data never leaves the user’s environment, and is free to use. It aims to streamline repetitive affiliate checks and empower marketers with AI-driven insights.

providers.name: Agent Reliability
providers.description: Agent Reliability provides testing, benchmarking, and auditing tools for autonomous AI agents. It offers a public knowledge corpus, open data, and APIs for accessing evidence, metrics, and evaluation results, supporting developers to improve agent reliability and transparency.

providers.name: Amer Sports
providers.description: Amer Sports is a global group of premium sports and outdoor brands with Nordic roots and more than 75 years of history, employing roughly 15,400 people and selling products in over 100 countries. Its portfolio spans ten brands including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, Atomic, Armada, ATEC, DeMarini, EvoShield and Louisville Slugger, covering technical apparel, footwear, winter sports, racquet sports and ball sports equipment. Amer Sports was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). As a consumer sports and outdoor manufacturer it publishes a corporate and investor web presence and a security.txt contact, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Anixter International
providers.description: Anixter International was a leading global distributor of network and security solutions, electrical and electronic solutions, and utility power solutions. In June 2020, Anixter was acquired by Wesco International for approximately $4.5 billion, creating a combined company with over $17 billion in annual revenue. Anixter now operates as Wesco Anixter, providing B2B distribution, supply chain services, and digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout catalogs, and procurement system integrations.

providers.name: AOne
providers.description: AOne is a Malaysia-based learning-centre management software company (operating publicly as AOneSchools) whose all-in-one platform is used by 4,000+ tuition centres, preschools, enrichment centres, sports academies, and language centres to automate billing, LHDN e-invoicing, attendance tracking, student and class management, and parent communication across connected web and mobile apps. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. The company's public surface today is a marketing website (aone.com.my) and a customer login/app at app.aoneschools.com; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface is currently published.

providers.name: Aurora Networks
providers.description: Aurora Networks is the broadband and access networks brand of Vistance Networks, Inc. (Nasdaq: VISN), the company CommScope renamed itself to in January 2026 after divesting its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment to Amphenol. Aurora Networks builds end-to-end access network infrastructure for global cable and broadband service providers: HFC and PON access systems, cable headend optics platforms, CMTS and CCAP gear, Distributed Access Architecture (DAA) devices, optical hubs, nodes and passives, RF and RFoG equipment, and video processing, security and delivery systems. Its ServAssure NXT family adds network performance management, alarm handling and service assurance software on top of that hardware estate. The brand originates with Aurora Networks, Inc., founded in Santa Clara, California in 1999 as a pure-play optical transport supplier to cable operators, backed by Battery Ventures among ten investors across roughly $60M raised, and acquired by Pace plc for $323M in 2013 before passing through ARRIS and CommScope. Aurora Networks is a network equipment vendor rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, no public API reference, and no machine-readable API specification. Product and integration documentation, including the ServAssure NXT web service and message-bus integration surfaces, sits behind authenticated customer support portals.

providers.name: Avocode
providers.description: Avocode was a design handoff platform with a REST API for managing projects, design files, shared screens, annotations, and design spec exports for developer-designer collaboration. Acquired by Ceros in October 2021 and sunset on October 1, 2023, Avocode supported design files from Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, and Illustrator, enabling developers to inspect designs, extract CSS, SVG, image assets, fonts, and colors without requiring access to the original design tools.

providers.name: Besoundbreast
providers.description: BeSound (Besoundbreast) is a women's-health technology platform offering modern, radiation-free breast imaging using ABUS ultrasound to help find cancers that mammograms can miss, particularly in women with dense breast tissue. BeSound connects patients with independent partner medical groups who deliver the imaging; results reach a secure patient portal within 24-48 weekday hours. Screening breast ultrasound is $349, with locations in Los Angeles (Melrose Ave) and Beverly Hills. BeSound is a consumer healthcare service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the machine-readable llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Board Intelligence
providers.description: Board Intelligence provides board management software and services that help companies run secure, efficient board meetings, track actions, draft minutes with AI, and manage governance. Their platform includes a board portal, agenda planning, reporting tools, and entity management, serving boards across financial services, enterprises, and high‑growth companies.

providers.name: Botco.ai
providers.description: Botco.ai provides generative AI chatbot solutions that augment workforce productivity across industries such as healthcare, city services, and pharmaceuticals. Their platform enables organizations to automate compliance, streamline navigation, and scale operations with AI agents, offering customizable chat experiences, integrations, and analytics. Founded to empower teams with conversational AI, Botco.ai delivers enterprise-grade chatbot technology and consulting services to drive efficiency and innovation.

providers.name: Cameo
providers.description: Cameo is a consumer marketplace for personalized video messages from celebrities, athletes, musicians, comedians, and creators. Fans book a custom shout-out by sending a short script with personal details, and the talent records and delivers a bespoke video, typically within seven days, for occasions like birthdays, milestones, and celebrations. Cameo also runs Cameo for Business for branded talent content, sells gift cards, and offers a Red Carpet Rewards loyalty program. Cameo does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; this profile tracks the company's public web, help, and security surface.

providers.name: Cantina AI
providers.description: Cantina is a social AI platform founded by Sean Parker (Cantina Labs, San Francisco) that lets people create AI-powered social characters that talk, perform, and interact, then turn them into short videos to share and go viral. The consumer product (cantina.com) centers on building characters with personality, chatting with friends and AI, and generating video in seconds across a public directory of trending bots and creators. Backed by a16z, Benchmark, Greycroft, and Salesforce Ventures. Cantina is a consumer social application and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its real public identity and link properties while no external API is available to enrich.

providers.name: Chain of Thought
providers.description: Chain of Thought is a podcast exploring AI infrastructure, featuring hosts and guests from leading tech companies. It discusses evolving AI tools, platforms, and research, providing insights for builders and enthusiasts. The show covers topics like hardware, software, and industry trends, aiming to inform and inspire the AI community.

providers.name: Choice Hotels
providers.description: Choice Hotels International (NYSE: CHH) is a United States hotel franchisor headquartered in North Bethesda, Maryland, operating 7,575 hotels with 656,825 rooms open across 49 states, the District of Columbia and 50 countries and territories as of December 31, 2025. Its brands include Comfort, Quality, Clarion, Sleep Inn, Econo Lodge, Rodeway Inn, MainStay Suites, Suburban Studios, WoodSpring Suites, Everhome Suites, Cambria Hotels, Ascend Hotel Collection and the Radisson Americas brands. Choice sits on the supply side of the travel distribution chain as a franchisor rather than an owner: its proprietary choiceEDGE central reservation system pushes rate, inventory and availability to ChoiceHotels.com, the Choice Privileges mobile apps, the global distribution systems (Sabre, Amadeus), the OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com) and metasearch (Kayak, Tripadvisor), while its proprietary choiceADVANTAGE property management system runs the majority of its franchised properties. API posture is honestly none-published — no public developer portal, no published API reference, no machine-readable contract, and no exit path. A TIBCO Mashery API gateway answers at api.choicehotels.com but every probed path returns ERR_596_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND, and developer.choicehotels.com is an unprovisioned Mashery CNAME returning 404 under a mashery.com certificate. All real integration is reached through gated franchisee and vendor channels (connect.choicehotels.com, choicecentral.com, the SkyTouch /CONNECT interface program) that require a commercial agreement.

providers.name: CINTAP
providers.description: CINTAP provides an enterprise integration platform (iPaaS) that connects applications, APIs, files, documents, and partners through a no-code environment. Their suite includes products like Orbit, Kepler, Nova, and AI Mapping Engine, enabling data flow automation, B2B integration, and document intelligence. CINTAP serves businesses seeking to streamline integration, reduce handoffs, and accelerate digital transformation with a unified platform.

providers.name: ClassWallet
providers.description: ClassWallet is a patented digital wallet and public-funds disbursement platform used by government agencies, school districts, and program administrators to distribute, control, and reconcile public money. Recipients access and spend allocated funds online or in-store while administrators get spending controls, approved marketplaces, reimbursement workflows, direct vendor payments (DirectPay), and audit-ready reporting and compliance. ClassWallet powers K-12 education programs, Education Savings Accounts (ESAs), scholarships and grants, government assistance, and vocational rehabilitation initiatives. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes product and program surfaces but no public developer API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Composite
providers.description: Composite (Composite Sciences, Inc.) is an AI‑powered browser autopilot that runs locally in Chrome, Edge, or Arc to automate repetitive web tasks. The platform lets users describe a task in natural language and watches it get done, offering a free beta with no setup required. It targets professionals seeking to streamline data entry, research, CRM updates, and other browser‑based workflows, providing a downloadable product at zero cost. Founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco, Composite integrates AI to predict user actions, extract information, and interact with web applications without requiring custom API integrations.

providers.name: Crosschq
providers.description: Crosschq is a hiring intelligence platform that helps talent acquisition and people-analytics teams improve quality of hire. Its cloud product suite spans AI-powered interview agents, automated reference checks, candidate assessment and screening, identity and interview-fraud detection, and quality-of-hire analytics that tie hiring decisions back to on-the-job outcomes. Crosschq connects to major applicant tracking and HCM systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Oracle, Lever, Ashby, Bullhorn, and others) through pre-built integrations rather than a public self-service API. Founded in Danville, California, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and GGV Capital.

providers.name: Cuboai
providers.description: CuboAi provides AI‑enhanced baby monitoring solutions that combine high‑resolution video, real‑time safety alerts, sleep tracking, health monitoring, and memory capture. Their smart monitor and sensor pad use computer‑vision and motion detection to notify parents of potential hazards, breathing irregularities, and sleep patterns, while a companion app stores moments and health data securely. The company emphasizes proactive safety, privacy, and seamless integration across devices, targeting modern families seeking peace of mind through advanced technology.

providers.name: Desjardins Group
