providers.description: Optivolt Labs (operating as Optivolt) is a Burlingame, California solar technology company building intelligent home solar systems with power electronics embedded directly inside each panel. Its patented Balancer device shuffles power from stronger to weaker zones within a panel to keep energy flowing in shaded and non-ideal conditions, delivering up to 50% more annual energy and improved shaded performance versus conventional panels. The product line includes 450W N-type mono half-cut panels, universal battery and inverter compatibility, and a real-time monitoring app for tracking energy and savings. Optivolt is a Techstars-backed hardware company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Peace Corps
providers.description: The Peace Corps is a U.S. government agency that sends American volunteers abroad to work with communities on development projects. They provide data APIs for accessing Peace Corps volunteer data, country information, and project statistics.

providers.name: Plobal Apps
providers.description: Plobal Apps is a no-code mobile app builder for Shopify merchants that turns online stores into native iOS and Android shopping apps without engineering. The platform offers drag-and-drop app design with HTML/CSS/JavaScript code blocks, push-notification marketing campaigns, live selling, AI-powered product recommendations, advanced search and smart filtering, and real-time analytics tracking 60+ in-app actions, plus omnichannel flows such as in-app ordering with in-store pickup. It installs through the Shopify App Store and is used by direct-to-consumer brands to grow mobile commerce revenue and customer retention.

providers.name: Provenmetal
providers.description: ProvenMetal is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building fast-turn, American-made printed circuit board (PCB) assembly. The company lets customers upload a Gerber file, automatically infers the board specification, and returns instant quoting for a 7-day standard turnaround with no expedite fees. ProvenMetal automates the traditional manufacturing bottlenecks — part procurement, design for manufacturability (DFM) review, and assembly — and performs 100% X-ray inspection of every board (AI-assisted, cited at 99.8% confidence) before shipment, including the inspection data with each order. It is a domestic B2B PCB manufacturing service aimed at reshoring electronics production, operated out of San Francisco. As of this profile ProvenMetal exposes a customer ordering portal at order.provenmetal.com but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Provide
providers.description: Provide is a financial services division of Fifth Third Bank offering banking and financing built specifically for owners of professional practices — dental, medical, veterinary, optometry, childcare, financial advisory, funeral, and insurance businesses. The company provides conventional and SBA loans to start, acquire, or expand a practice, alongside a full suite of customized banking products. Provide was acquired by Fifth Third Bank and operates as a specialty lending and banking brand. Surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: RapidRatings
providers.description: RapidRatings provides enterprise‑level risk management solutions that assess supply‑chain, third‑party, and credit risk for businesses. Their platform offers tools such as Financial Health Ratings (FHR), RiskPulse, ActionPath, and MCP integration to help companies evaluate and improve the financial stability of suppliers and partners. RapidRatings also offers professional services, workshops, and a badge program to support risk mitigation and compliance across industries.

providers.name: Ray White
providers.description: Ray White is Australasia's largest real estate group, a family-owned brokerage network founded in 1902 and headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, running 550+ Australian offices and roughly a thousand offices in total across Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, Hong Kong, China, Papua New Guinea, the Middle East and Atlanta USA, spanning residential sales, auctions, commercial (Ray White Commercial / rwc.com.au), rural and livestock, property management, projects, marine, hotels, valuations, business sales, insurance and mortgage broking through sister brand Loan Market. In the Australian property value chain Ray White sits on the AGENCY side of a portal duopoly — it lists into REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain rather than operating a portal or a registry of its own — and it is an API CONSUMER, not an API producer. In December 2025 Ray White named realestate.com.au and PropTrack its data partners explicitly for their "industry leading API architecture", piping that licensed market data into its proprietary OneSystem, NurtureCloud and Pulse platforms. Its API posture is therefore honestly stated as none-published — as of 2026-07-26 no developer portal, no public API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published partner-API application path could be found on raywhite.com or any developer/api/docs subdomain (all of which fail DNS resolution). RESO is absent — Ray White does not appear in the RESO certification directory, which is unsurprising because RESO is a North American, NAR-driven mandate with no Australian counterpart; Australia's closest thing to a required machine-readable property rail is PEXA electronic conveyancing, which Ray White transacts through as a participant rather than exposes.

providers.name: ReverbNation
providers.description: ReverbNation is a music platform that helps artists grow their careers by offering distribution, promotion tools, publishing, and opportunities to connect with industry professionals. Musicians can release music to major streaming services, access marketing resources, and explore revenue options through cash advances and sync licensing. The service provides a suite of tools for audience building, fan engagement, and career development, supporting both emerging and established artists worldwide.

providers.name: Sama
providers.description: Sama is a data annotation and labeling company that provides a platform for AI developers to create high‑quality training data. Offering services such as image, video, 3D lidar, and text annotation, Sama supports foundation model training, computer vision, autonomous vehicles, and other AI applications. The company is B Corp certified and publishes impact reports, emphasizing ethical AI data practices.

providers.name: scheir-eu
providers.description: Scheir is the personal brand of Pieter‑Jan Scheir, an AI‑first full‑stack developer based in Belgium. He builds web applications, AI‑driven tools, and MCP servers using TypeScript, React, and Next.js, leveraging Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. His work blends legal‑tech expertise with modern AI development practices, offering innovative solutions across multiple languages and platforms.

providers.name: Shoppr
providers.description: Usetrace provides a platform for automated end‑to‑end testing, functional, performance and QA automation. It enables teams to create automated E2E tests in minutes, achieve high test coverage quickly, and ship reliable code without manual regression testing. Trusted by innovative companies, it promises fewer bugs, faster releases, and a no‑flaky‑test guarantee.

providers.name: ShopRaise
providers.description: ShopRaise enables organizations, charities, schools, teams, clubs, and faith‑based groups to raise funds through everyday online shopping. Users shop at over 2,000 retailers and earn up to 10 % of purchases for their chosen cause at no extra cost. The platform offers a free app, gift‑card options, and integrates with numerous retailers, turning routine purchases into charitable contributions.

providers.name: Songtrust
providers.description: Songtrust is a New York City-based music publishing administration platform and a Downtown Music company. The service helps songwriters, producers, composers, and independent publishers register their compositions and collect global publishing royalties — including performance, mechanical, digital, micro-sync, and neighboring rights — through a network of 65+ collection societies and pay sources across 240 countries and territories. Songtrust's web-based dashboard provides song registration, catalog management, writer and publisher splits, royalty statement matching, metadata enrichment, weekly song monitoring, and quarterly payouts, while letting clients retain 100% ownership of their copyrights. The commercial model is a one-time $100 sign-up fee per songwriter plus 15% of collected performance royalties and 20% of non-performance royalties — positioned as a transparent flat-rate alternative to traditional publisher deals. As of this profile, Songtrust does not expose a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or partner integration portal; the platform is consumed exclusively through the Songtrust client dashboard at app.songtrust.com. Integrations and data exchange with PROs, mechanical rights societies, DSPs, and Downtown sister companies are operated internally rather than through a documented public surface.

providers.name: Sparkle
providers.description: TAAI Labs, Inc operates Sparkle (sparkle.security), an AI-first secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, currently in beta, that aims to prevent vulnerabilities across the entire SDLC by embedding AI-powered security analysis into existing engineering workflows. Sparkle works across five phases — contextualize, design, build, validate, and govern — and deploys "Secure Agents" that surface risks, gather evidence, and track security decisions to give product security, AppSec, platform engineering, and engineering leadership teams audit-ready visibility across the secure SDLC. The company markets outcomes such as increased security-team productivity, reduced AI-generated risk, and full visibility, and is backed by 500 Global. The product is pre-general-availability and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation as of this profile.

providers.name: STORI AI
providers.description: STORI AI is a San Francisco-based AI content-marketing platform that helps brands define their identity — archetype, tone, tagline, and colors — and turn that identity into on-brand social posts, graphics, images, videos, and go-to-market marketing materials. The product generates personalized branded content, schedules and publishes it across digital platforms, and offers analytics, content storage, and multi-brand, multi-language, team-collaboration tiers. A Product Hunt Golden Kitty Award recipient, STORI AI is a web SaaS application for marketers and brand teams; it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Tangerine
providers.description: Tangerine is a Canadian direct (branchless) bank headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and a federally regulated Schedule I bank chartered as Tangerine Bank (institution number 614). Founded in 1997 as ING Direct Canada, it was acquired by Scotiabank in 2012 and rebranded as Tangerine in 2014; it remains a separate legal entity operating as Scotiabank's digital-banking arm, serving roughly two million clients with no-fee chequing and savings accounts, GICs, mortgages, mutual funds, and a cash-back Mastercard delivered entirely through mobile and web. On API and open-finance posture, Tangerine publishes no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications; Canada has no operational consumer-driven-banking mandate yet (the federal framework is legislated but not live), so third-party access to Tangerine account and transaction data today is aggregator-based via Plaid and Finicity (Mastercard) rather than through a documented first-party API.

providers.name: Tax ID Pro
providers.description: Tax ID Pro provides an API service that validates tax identification numbers for over 100 countries worldwide. It offers a simple REST endpoint and an MCP integration, enabling developers to quickly verify business and personal tax IDs in applications, supporting batch checks and CSV processing. The platform emphasizes ease of integration, comprehensive country coverage, and reliable validation for fintech, compliance, and SaaS solutions.

providers.name: TED
providers.description: TED is a global nonprofit devoted to ideas worth spreading, offering a platform for talks, performances, and educational content across a wide range of topics including science, technology, design, and global issues. Its mission is to spark curiosity and inspire change through powerful storytelling and accessible media, reaching millions worldwide via its website, mobile apps, and partner initiatives.

providers.name: Topia
providers.description: Topia is a global mobility platform for distributed workforces, used by HR, Finance and Legal teams at mid-market and enterprise companies to manage international assignments, relocations, business travel, remote work and cross-border compliance across 190+ countries in a single system. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in the United States, with additional offices in the United Kingdom, Ireland and Estonia, Topia spans global talent mobility, a tax and compliance engine, cost estimation and tracking, global workforce planning, cost and immigration risk management, and business travel. In April 2026 Topia launched Horizon, an agentic AI workspace for mobility teams that the company describes as built natively into MCP (Model Context Protocol) environments. Topia integrates with HRIS, payroll, travel and expense systems including Workday (a Workday Approved Integration), SAP, ADP, Oracle, Ceridian, SAP Concur and BCD Travel. Topia publishes an llms.txt at its marketing host, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification; the support center sits behind a customer login.

providers.name: TourHero
providers.description: TourHero is a social travel platform and end-to-end group trip operations partner that lets creators, coaches, and community leaders host fully customized group trips in 50+ countries, with itinerary design, vetted local operators, payments, and on-the-ground logistics handled by TourHero. Travelers can browse and book public trips on its Explore page, and hosts plan for free while TourHero earns commission from local suppliers. Backed by 500 Global and Lightspeed Venture Partners, it is a consumer platform with no publicly documented developer API surface at this time, though it publishes an llms.txt profile for AI agents.

providers.name: UGI
providers.description: UGI Corporation is a Fortune 500 international energy distribution and services company headquartered in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. UGI distributes natural gas, liquid propane, and electricity primarily through four business segments: UGI Utilities (natural gas and electric distribution in Pennsylvania), AmeriGas Propane (largest US propane marketer), Midstream and Marketing, and UGI International (European energy distribution). No public developer API has been identified; the company primarily uses EDI and utility industry standards for B2B data exchange.

providers.name: US Central Command
providers.description: US Central Command (CENTCOM) is a unified combatant command of the United States Department of Defense responsible for overseeing American military operations across a region encompassing the Middle East, Central Asia, and parts of East Africa. Its primary mission is to ensure the security and stability of this strategic area by deterring and defeating threats from terrorist organizations, rogue states, and other adversaries. CENTCOM coordinates joint military operations and exercises, supports partner nation capacity building, and maintains operational readiness across its area of responsibility spanning 21 countries. Headquartered at MacDill Air Force Base in Tampa, Florida, CENTCOM does not currently offer a public developer API. Public information is accessible through its official media and press releases portal.

providers.name: Virgin Australia
providers.description: Virgin Australia (IATA code VA, ASX:VGN) is Australia's second-largest airline group, founded in 2000 and headquartered in Brisbane, operating a domestic and short-haul international network alongside charter and cargo services with more than 8,000 team members and the 13-million-member Velocity Frequent Flyer loyalty program. It sits on the airline side of a concentrated Australian duopoly with Qantas, and reaches travel agents and travel management companies almost entirely through GDS intermediation — Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport/Galileo — rather than through any direct machine interface of its own. Virgin Australia selected Sabre as its preferred NDC IT technology provider in October 2023 and renewed a multi-year Amadeus distribution agreement covering EDIFACT today and NDC in future, but as of July 2026 no Virgin Australia NDC endpoint, developer portal or API documentation is published anywhere on virginaustralia.com. Its API posture is honestly stated as none-published: developer.virginaustralia.com, developers., api., apis. and docs. subdomains do not resolve; /developers, /api, /api-docs, /openapi.json and /swagger.json all return 404; and the only partner surface is the Agency Hub, whose Travel Agent Main Agreement requires current IATA or ATIS accreditation, GDS access for BSP sales, and Virgin Australia's absolute discretion to approve an account. The one genuinely public programmatic-adjacent surface is the Virgin Australia app in ChatGPT, launched 10 June 2026 for flight and Velocity Reward Seat search only — it cannot book, amend, cancel or take payment, and its underlying interface is not documented.

providers.name: Watsi
providers.description: Watsi is a San Francisco-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit crowdfunding platform that lets donors directly fund surgeries and medical care for patients in low-income countries, working through vetted medical partners across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Founded in 2011 and the first nonprofit funded by Y Combinator, Watsi has directed more than $20 million to patient healthcare. Watsi previously published a read-only JSON API at developers.watsi.org, but that developer portal and api.watsi.org no longer resolve, so no public API surface is currently available.

providers.name: Web3D Consortium, Inc.
providers.description: Web3D Consortium, Inc. is a non‑profit standards organization that develops and promotes open standards for real‑time 3D communication on the web and other platforms. It maintains the X3D specification, provides resources, tools, and documentation for developers, and fosters a community through working groups, events, and educational materials. The consortium aims to enable interoperable 3D content across browsers, devices, and applications, supporting use cases such as virtual reality, augmented reality, gaming, scientific visualization, and digital heritage.

providers.name: Workload
providers.description: Workload provides AI‑driven agents and self‑healing automation platforms that enable businesses to automate workflows across their existing software stack. By connecting to popular SaaS applications, Workload orchestrates tasks, monitors execution, and automatically repairs failures, ensuring continuous operation without manual intervention. The solution targets enterprises seeking to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and accelerate digital transformation through intelligent automation.

providers.name: Worktrace AI
providers.description: Worktrace AI is an enterprise workflow-automation platform that helps organizations discover, reimagine, and automate repetitive work. A desktop application observes work across existing tools to identify high-ROI AI automation opportunities, surfaces process-optimization recommendations aligned with company KPIs, and generates blueprints for building automations on third-party platforms such as n8n, Crew AI, and Asteroid. The 8VC-backed company targets financial services, healthcare, high tech, insurance, logistics, and telecom, and publishes a Vanta trust center covering SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. No public API or developer documentation is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: xRocket Exchange API
providers.description: Telegram-native centralized crypto exchange (CEX) developer program exposing a REST Exchange API for trading and market data (with a WebSocket stream) and a REST Pay API for payments, cheques, invoices, transfers and withdrawals. Bearer-token authenticated with public read endpoints and Swagger/OpenAPI contracts.

providers.name: XSquare
providers.description: XSquare (listed as XSquire in the 500 Global portfolio) is a Dubai-based B2B financial operations platform for the GCC, live across the UAE and Qatar. It unifies e-invoicing, receivables collection via embedded payment links and QR codes (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank), supplier payables on corporate card, and automatic invoice-to-payment reconciliation on a single ledger, with native ERP integrations (Zoho, Xero, Wafeq, Odoo) and a PSP network (Tess, Telr, Geidea). PCI DSS Level 1 v4 certified, UAE FTA e-invoicing ready (PEPPOL, structured XML), and non-custodial by design through licensed PSP partners regulated by CBUAE and QCB. Founded in 2023 by Tanvir Shah and Ashwin Shenoy; operates as XSquare Payment Services LLC (Dubai) and XSquare LLC (Doha). No public developer API, docs, or SDKs are published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Zoomin
providers.description: Zoomin is a content and knowledge orchestration platform that unifies unstructured product content — documentation, in-product help, knowledge base and community answers — into personalized self-service and in-app experiences across customer support, success and experience teams. Founded in Tel Aviv, Zoomin was acquired by Salesforce on November 1, 2024 and now powers the Unified Knowledge and Agentforce/Data Cloud offerings. Its products include the Content Delivery Platform, Documentation Portal, In-Product Help, Zoomin for ServiceNow, Unified Knowledge and Zoomin Analytics. Zoomin does not publish a public, self-serve developer API surface; its integrations are delivered through customer implementations and the Salesforce platform. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: 86 Repairs
providers.description: 86 Repairs is a restaurant equipment repair and maintenance (R&M) management platform founded in 2018 in Chicago by Daniel Estrada and Joe Gallagher. It manages the repair lifecycle for restaurant operators — 24/7 intake and troubleshooting, warranty verification, dispatch to a vetted service provider network, preventative maintenance scheduling, equipment and asset inventory, invoice assurance and R&M spend analytics — and is used by operators and franchisees of brands including McDonald's, Wendy's, Taco Bell, Jersey Mike's, Five Guys and Wingstop. The product is delivered as an end-user web portal (portal.86repairs.com) and iOS/Android mobile apps, backed by a private NestJS service at eightysix-api.86repairs.com; it is not offered as a developer platform. Parts Town, the Addison, Illinois OEM foodservice parts distributor, acquired 86 Repairs in June 2026 to connect parts availability with repair and service workflows. As of this profile 86 Repairs publishes no public API: no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, no SDK or package on any public registry, no webhook catalog, no MCP server and no A2A agent card were found on any host it controls.

providers.name: Aaptiv
providers.description: Aaptiv is a digital fitness and wellness platform offering 10,000+ on-demand audio and video workout classes, AI-powered coaching, access to a network of gyms and studios, and wellness resources such as meditation and mindfulness. It is sold to employers as an employee benefit, to health plans, and to individuals seeking personalized fitness. Backed by Insight Partners. Aaptiv publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, support, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: AdGuard Home
providers.description: AdGuard Home provides network-wide ad blocking and privacy protection software for routers, servers, and all devices on a local network. It blocks ads, trackers, and malware at the DNS level, offering customizable filtering, parental controls, and optional integration with AdGuard DNS and VPN services.

providers.name: Agrolend
providers.description: Agrolend is a Brazilian agricultural-credit fintech — legally Agrolend Sociedade de Credito, Financiamento e Investimento S/A (CNPJ 43.774.196/0001-84), a Banco Central do Brasil regulated SCFI headquartered in Sao Paulo. Founded in 2020, it originates working capital, receivables discount, liability-extension and inter-chain credit for small and mid-sized rural producers, distributing through agricultural retailers, cooperatives and input industries rather than direct to farm, and funds the book partly through FGC-covered LCA notes sold on third-party investment platforms. Its stated differentiator is a cloud-native, AI-assisted credit engine that underwrites without requiring farm or grain collateral. Agrolend publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract; the only API surface reachable from the public internet is the partner-area backend at parceiro.agrolend.agr.br, which answers HTTP Basic 401 on every path.

providers.name: Alcock
providers.description: Alcock is an autonomous AI that makes forecasts in public on markets, sports, policy and tech, gets graded by what actually happens, measures itself against the market, and rewrites its own rules only when a blind test shows the new rules do better. Any AI agent can join the arena and train the same way, free.

providers.name: Aletheia Analytics SASU
providers.description: bitcoincreditstack-com is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: mcp-registry) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Aletiq
providers.description: Aletiq is a French software company building a next-generation, AI-powered Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Product Data Management (PDM) platform for regulated manufacturers. The platform centralizes technical data (CAD files, drawings, bills of materials, configurations, and work instructions), enforces traceability and regulatory compliance, and automates business processes such as approvals, engineering change management, and project milestones. Aletiq emphasizes rapid deployment and high adoption across operational teams, and integrates with major CAD tools (SolidWorks, CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, Siemens NX, Creo) and ERP systems (SAP, Sage, Cegid, Infor, Odoo) via connectors and a custom-integration API. It serves aerospace and defense, medical devices, energy, electronics, automotive, and luxury-goods industries. Aletiq is backed by Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead profile.

providers.name: Alvarez & Marsal
providers.description: Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a leading global professional services firm, founded in 1983 by Tony Alvarez II and Bryan Marsal and headquartered in New York City. Privately held, the firm employs more than 10,000 people across six continents and is best known for turnaround and restructuring engagements (Lehman Brothers, HealthSouth, Tribune, FTX, Arthur Andersen) and for performance improvement, tax advisory, transaction advisory, disputes and investigations, valuation, and private equity performance improvement (PEPI) services. A&M does not operate a public developer portal; technology is delivered through client engagements, internal proprietary tools, A&M Capital Partners (the firm's investment arm), and a public Insights / thought-leadership surface published on alvarezandmarsal.com.

providers.name: AmplifyMD
providers.description: AmplifyMD is a virtual care platform for hospitals and health systems, providing a nationwide network of remote specialists across more than 15 essential fields. It powers telemedicine across emergent, inpatient, asynchronous, SNF/LTAC, virtual clinic, and direct-to-patient care models, and integrates with major EHR systems including Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, Allscripts, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, TruBridge, and MedHost to help organizations build sustainable clinical staffing models. Backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Angel Studios
providers.description: Angel Studios operates a streaming platform that offers uplifting movies and TV shows for families and individuals seeking inspirational content. The service combines a subscription-based model with a community-driven guild where members can support filmmakers, vote on projects, and access exclusive content. Angel Studios emphasizes purpose-driven storytelling, providing a diverse library across genres such as drama, comedy, documentary, and faith-based programming, while also offering theatrical releases and a marketplace for merchandise.

providers.name: AnimateMyTravel
providers.description: AnimateMyTravel is a free web‑based tool that lets users create animated travel route videos and map visualizations directly in the browser. Leveraging AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, users can describe a trip, a historical campaign, a wildfire or any dataset and the service builds a customizable map animation that can be edited, exported to MP4 or WebM up to 4K, and shared without requiring an account or watermark. The platform offers quick‑route creation, AI‑driven suggestions, and a library of example guides covering history, nature, travel and data‑driven stories. It is operated by the AnimateMyTravel team and is hosted at animatemytravel.com.

providers.name: Aptiv
providers.description: Aptiv is a Fortune 500 Tier-1 automotive and aerospace technology supplier headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, formed from Delphi Automotive in 2017. It sells electrical architecture and interconnect systems (connectors, cabling, busbars, HellermannTyton fastening), advanced driver-assistance systems, digital cockpit and advanced compute hardware, and embedded software: the Aptiv LINC software platform, ADAS software, and Aptiv Connect Qualifier preproduction validation analytics, with Wind River (acquired 2022) as its intelligent-edge software business. Aptiv publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract; its software platforms are delivered to OEMs under program contracts, and its only public developer-facing material is marketing prose about the "open APIs" inside those platforms.

providers.name: Arria NLG
providers.description: Arria NLG provides enterprise generative AI solutions, offering a platform that combines deterministic natural language generation with large language model capabilities. Their products include Studio for authoring analytics, Author for hybrid deterministic‑plus‑LLM content creation, and Answers for conversational AI. Arria serves industries such as financial services, pharma, energy, and consumer goods, delivering automated reports, portfolio commentaries, and custom analytics. The company emphasizes compliance, security, and integration with BI tools like PowerBI, Tableau, and Qlik.

providers.name: Aspose
providers.description: Aspose provides a comprehensive suite of file format SDKs enabling developers to create, edit, convert, and render over 100 document, spreadsheet, presentation, email, PDF, and image formats across multiple platforms including .NET, Java, C++, Python, Android, and more. Trusted by more than 80% of Fortune 100 companies, Aspose offers products such as Aspose.Words, Aspose.Cells, Aspose.PDF, Aspose.Slides, Aspose.Email, and Aspose.Imaging, delivering robust, office-independent solutions for document processing, conversion, and rendering without requiring Microsoft Office or Adobe dependencies.

providers.name: Augmedix
providers.description: Augmedix is a San Francisco-based health technology company providing ambient AI medical documentation (AI scribe) services that capture patient-clinician conversations and generate clinical notes so that physicians can focus on patient care instead of EHR data entry. Founded in 2012, the company went public on Nasdaq in 2021 (AUGX) and was acquired by Commure in October 2024, becoming part of Commure's clinician-workflow platform alongside HCA Healthcare-aligned tooling. Augmedix's product line spans three service tiers — Augmedix Go (self-service AI scribe), Augmedix Assist (AI drafting with human editing, coding, and referral-letter support, notes ready within an hour), and Augmedix Live (full-service dedicated medical documentation specialist before, during, and after the visit) — plus specialty variants for Emergency Medicine, oncology, and other specialties. The platform integrates with major EHRs including Epic, Oracle Cerner, athenahealth, Meditech, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, and iKnowMed, and is HIPAA-compliant and HITRUST-certified. Augmedix's GitHub presence consists of internal QA, scribe-app base, and ambient API automation repositories; there is no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI specification — integration with Augmedix is handled through enterprise EHR partnerships and the Commure clinician platform rather than a self-service developer surface.

providers.name: Aurentia
providers.description: Aurentia provides AI-powered tools for entrepreneurs to manage, grow, and develop their businesses. Their platform offers modules for forecasting, action planning, market monitoring, branding, and productivity, integrating AI assistants across finance, sales, marketing, and project management. Users can access free trials, customize pricing plans, and leverage resources such as legal tools, domain registration, and graphic design support.

providers.name: Avina Clean Hydrogen
providers.description: Avina Clean Hydrogen, part of Avina Inc., develops and delivers cutting‑edge clean energy solutions, focusing on low‑carbon ammonia, synthetic aviation fuel, and especially clean hydrogen produced via renewable electrolysis. The company aims to accelerate the global transition to clean fuels for heavy transport, shipping, steel and chemicals, with commercial plants slated for operation from 2025. Avina’s mission is to provide affordable, reliable clean energy, scaling next‑generation fuels worldwide.

providers.name: Baby2Body
providers.description: Baby2Body is the flagship consumer wellness app from Body Collective, a female-focused health and wellness company founded by sports psychologist Melinda Nicci. The app delivers personalized fitness, nutrition, and mental-health support across the fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and broader women's-health stages, paired with an AI health coach named Bella, on-demand programs (prenatal fitness, meal plans, labor prep), expert-backed articles, and a stage-specific newsletter. Baby2Body reports over two million users and is backed by 500 Global. This profile has been enriched from the company's public consumer surfaces; no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Bank Jago
providers.description: PT Bank Jago Tbk is a technology-based digital bank in Indonesia, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX: ARTO) and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital and GoTo. Rather than a branch network, Bank Jago is delivered through the life-centric Jago mobile application and is deeply embedded into partner ecosystems — Gojek/GoPay for payments, and Bibit/Stockbit for investing — via API-based integrations. Its Open API payment surface is exposed through Indonesia's national SNAP (Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran) programme, administered through the ASPI developer directory, rather than a self-hosted public developer portal. Bank Jago is regulated by the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) and Bank Indonesia. This API Evangelist profile is compiled from public sources as a fintech company lead; the bank publishes no self-hosted OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: BDOW!
providers.description: BDOW! is a lead generation and email capture platform that provides tools for creating forms, pop‑ups, and landing pages to grow website visitor lists. The service offers customizable templates, A/B testing, analytics, and integrations with marketing and CRM systems. It targets marketers, small businesses, and agencies looking to increase conversions and capture leads directly from their sites.

providers.name: Bellhops
providers.description: Bellhops (branded as Bellhop) is a US technology-enabled moving-services company that operates an online booking platform for residential and commercial relocations. Customers get a free estimate and reserve local moves, long-distance relocations, hourly moving labor, packing help, and last-minute moves with no money down, then manage their reservation through an online dashboard staffed by background-checked movers. The company reports more than 300,000 completed moves and a 4.8/5 average rating across 20,000+ reviews. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Bellhops is a consumer-facing service with no publicly documented API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Binadox
providers.description: Binadox is a SaaS spend management and optimization platform providing usage monitoring, license optimization, shadow IT discovery, and cloud cost management to help organizations reduce wasted SaaS and cloud spend while gaining complete visibility into their software and infrastructure portfolio. Binadox integrates with AWS, Azure, GCP, and 100+ SaaS applications.

providers.name: Blidz
providers.description: Blidz is a membership-based social and gamified e-commerce platform ("Make Money, Save Money, Have Fun") offering deeply discounted deals across grocery, electronics, home goods, and other consumer categories through its iOS and Android shopping apps. Backed by General Catalyst, Blidz operates a consumer mobile marketplace rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface. This APIs.json profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web domain.

providers.name: Bodyport
providers.description: Bodyport is a San Francisco healthcare technology company delivering remote heart-failure monitoring. Its FDA-cleared Cardiac Scale captures hemodynamic biomarkers through a patient's feet in under 30 seconds and transmits the readings over cellular to care teams within minutes. The company's Congestion Index algorithm combines multiple hemodynamic biomarkers to detect worsening heart failure earlier than standard weight-based rules, and its connected Care Platform surfaces monitoring, alerts, and care coordination through a clinical dashboard and a patient portal. Bodyport works with health systems and pharma partners including Geisinger, Boehringer Ingelheim, Stanford, Brigham and Women's Hospital, Duke, and Yale. The company publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its product, portal, and compliance surfaces.

providers.name: Bongo Learn
providers.description: Bongo Learn provides an assessment and skills development platform for partners and higher education, offering AI role‑play, video assessments, scoring, and coaching tools to certify and measure partner enablement and student learning outcomes.

providers.name: Booqed
providers.description: BOOQED is a Hong Kong-based proptech company building flexible workplace technology that turns underutilized real estate into bookable, on-demand workspace. Its flagship product QUBIC is a line of sound-isolating, modular smart booths and work pods (for one to six people) with soundproofing, ventilation, power, and a proprietary access-control system managed through a mobile web app. Alongside the hardware, BOOQED offers space-management SaaS that makes existing meeting rooms and desks bookable and trackable with utilization analytics, plus the BOOQED app for individuals to book hot desks and meeting rooms on demand across Hong Kong, Singapore, and Shenzhen. Founded by David Wong, Charles Oh, and Ken Huang, BOOQED went through the Colliers and Techstars proptech accelerator and raised seed funding in 2019. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; BOOQED does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Boston Heart Diagnostics (Eurofins Scientific)
providers.description: Boston Heart Diagnostics is a specialty cardiovascular diagnostics laboratory, part of Eurofins Scientific, that has been improving patient outcomes since 2007 through a combination of integrated diagnostics, advanced lipid and metabolic testing, genetic risk evaluation, personalized reporting, and a scientifically designed nutrition and lifestyle program. It serves clinicians and patients through a provider portal and a patient portal (mybostonheart.com) rather than a public developer API; there is no published developer portal, OpenAPI, or programmatic surface at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the identity and security-posture fields below are captured from the provider's public web presence.

providers.name: Brilliantdotorg
providers.description: Brilliant.org is an online learning platform that offers interactive problem‑solving courses in mathematics, science, and computer programming. It provides a personal tutor named Koji that adapts to each learner, delivering adaptive lessons, practice sets, and instant feedback. The service targets students, educators, and lifelong learners, aiming to develop critical thinking and STEM skills through engaging, gamified content. With millions of users worldwide, Brilliant.org combines educational research with AI‑enhanced tutoring to help learners master concepts efficiently.

providers.name: Cayaba Care
providers.description: Cayaba Care provides a community‑based maternity care platform offering comprehensive support throughout pregnancy and postpartum, including coaching, nutrition, mental health, and care coordination. The service aims to improve maternal health outcomes for underserved women in the United States.

providers.name: Ceres Imaging
providers.description: Ceres Imaging is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: vc-portfolio; backed by lemnos-labs) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: changedetection.io
providers.description: changedetection.io provides a simple, open‑source web‑page change detection service that monitors websites for visual or content changes and sends alerts via email, Slack, or other channels. Users can configure monitoring intervals, custom selectors, and receive notifications when a page updates, making it useful for tracking price changes, content updates, or compliance monitoring. The platform offers a web UI and API for integration, supporting multiple sites and flexible alerting options.

providers.name: ChurnZero
providers.description: ChurnZero provides AI‑powered customer success software that helps businesses grow revenue by reducing churn, improving onboarding, and increasing customer engagement. The platform offers digital customer success tools, AI agents, analytics, and integrations to enable teams to retain and expand accounts, automate workflows, and gain actionable insights across the customer lifecycle.

providers.name: Club Feast
providers.description: Club Feast is a technology-enabled restaurant delivery and corporate catering company founded in 2020 by Atallah Atallah, Ghazi Atallah, and Chris Miao. It began as a subscription-based consumer meal service delivering signature dishes from neighborhood restaurants at deep discounts through a pre-order, scheduled batch-delivery model, and has since focused on corporate catering, group meal ordering with individual customization, event catering, and managed office pantry services for teams. Club Feast handles restaurant partnerships, menu curation, driver logistics, and delivery while employees select meals through its web app. The company raised seed funding led by General Catalyst and operates primarily in the San Francisco Bay Area. Club Feast does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or specification; this profile tracks its company identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clubessential
providers.description: Clubessential is a Cincinnati-based provider of club management software for private country, golf, city, athletic, and yacht clubs. Its cloud suite unifies club websites and mobile apps, tee-time and dining reservations, membership CRM, point-of-sale, accounting, business intelligence, and integrated payments so club staff can manage operations and member experiences from a single platform. Part of Clubessential Holdings (unified under Xplor Technologies alongside ClubReady, foreUP, Vermont Systems, PrestoSports, and Exerp), the company serves more than 1,300 private clubs and, with its sister brands, thousands of courses and clubs worldwide. Backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: CNC24
providers.description: CNC24 is a German online manufacturing platform for ordering custom CNC parts and precision components. Customers upload CAD files (STEP, STP, DWG, DXF, PDF and 3D data) and receive a binding quote within 48 hours, with production routed through a vetted network of 500+ manufacturers across 21 countries and roughly 5,500 machines. An AI-powered matching algorithm assigns each request to partners with the right expertise and production environment. Supported processes include CNC milling, turning, laser and waterjet cutting, sheet metal bending, punching, EDM, 3D printing, injection molding and die casting, serving aerospace, automotive, medical, robotics, construction and energy customers. The platform runs a fully digital workflow from quoting to delivery with order tracking, ISO 9001:2015 quality assurance, AES-256 encryption and anonymized drawings shared with partners. CNC24 is a Seedcamp portfolio company. No public developer API, SDKs or API documentation are published.

providers.name: Con.doit
providers.description: Con.doit (condoit.io) is a digital platform for electrical contractors that turns field-captured electrical infrastructure data into recurring service revenue. Its mobile capture app collects on-site photos, thermal scans, and system data, then generates same-day infrared thermography reports, auto-updating single-line diagrams, asset tags, arc flash studies, and NFPA 70B preventive-maintenance programs. Con.doit is a FLIR Global Approved App and reports over 4.5 million electrical assets under management across 2,000+ critical facilities nationwide. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification is currently published; this profile is enriched from the public marketing surface only.

providers.name: Crossave
providers.description: Crossave is an e‑commerce platform that aggregates product listings from multiple online marketplaces, providing price, shipping, duty and VAT calculations for collectors and shoppers. It offers detailed guides on collectibles, import duties, and currency conversion, helping users compare costs across borders and make informed purchasing decisions.

providers.name: Crossoverhealth
providers.description: Crossover Health is an advanced primary care provider that delivers integrated, team-based healthcare for employers and their members through its proprietary Care Platform. Its services span primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation, and occupational medicine, delivered through on-site and near-site health centers and a 50-state virtual provider network. Crossover Health is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification has been found on its web properties.

providers.name: Cyence
providers.description: Cyence is a cyber risk analytics and modeling solution — originally an independent InsurTech startup (backed by IVP and others) and acquired by Guidewire in 2017 — that helps insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and managing general agents quantify, underwrite, and manage cyber insurance risk in financial terms. It combines internet-scale data collection, data science, and economic loss modeling to produce exposure signals, breach-probability estimates, and portfolio accumulation and catastrophe scenarios. Cyence data and scores are delivered to carriers through Guidewire Cloud and are available via a REST API for pricing, risk selection, and underwriting workflow automation. API access is partner-gated through a Guidewire account rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Daily Calendar
providers.description: Daily Calendar (dailycalendar.in) is an Indian platform providing daily Panchang, Tithi, Nakshatra, Rahu Kalam, festivals and timing information. It offers accurate Vedic calendar utilities, including today’s Panchang, city‑specific calendars, Muhurat calculators, and festival listings, serving users seeking traditional astrological timing for events and daily planning.

providers.name: Data Sutram
providers.description: Data Sutram is an enterprise AI trust platform for the financial services sector, using external and alternative data intelligence plus agentic workflows to power fraud detection, identity and address verification, credit assessment, and collections. Its products - Trust (fraud and trust scoring), Auth (authentication and verification), and Echo (collections intelligence) - are applied across the customer lifecycle from acquisition and onboarding through portfolio monitoring and debt recovery. Data Sutram serves leading Indian banks and fintechs including HDFC, Axis, ICICI, Kotak, IndusInd, Jupiter, Navi, and Fibe, and maintains ISO 27001, ISO 27018, and SOC 2 certifications along with DPDP compliance. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and is also backed by B Capital.

providers.name: DataArt
providers.description: DataArt is a global AI software development and data consulting partner founded in 1997. With over 6,000 employees across 20+ countries, DataArt delivers AI‑first solutions, custom software engineering, cloud and DevOps services to Fortune 500 enterprises in finance, healthcare, retail, media, travel, automotive, and more. The company emphasizes enterprise‑scale AI pipelines, data strategy, and industry‑specific digital transformation.

providers.name: defi SOLUTIONS
providers.description: defi SOLUTIONS is an auto and consumer lending technology company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Westlake, Texas. It provides cloud-native, API-enabled loan origination software (defi ORIGINATIONS), a servicing platform for account, collateral, and default management, digital borrower acquisition and self-service portals, and outsourced (BPO) managed servicing. The platform serves captive auto finance companies, banks, credit unions, and consumer finance companies, and ships 135+ pre-built partner integrations (Dealertrack, RouteOne, TransUnion, Equifax, LexisNexis, Experian, Black Book, J.D. Power, Zest AI, and more). APIs move borrower and loan data between origination and servicing but are exposed to enterprise customers and integration partners rather than through a public developer portal.

providers.name: Destaire
providers.description: Déstaire is a curated guide to exceptional hotels and private stays, offering travel writing, paid city guides, and a selection of unique accommodations worldwide. The platform blends editorial content with curated listings to inspire discerning travelers.

providers.name: Digital Iron
providers.description: Digital Iron is an AI platform delivering aftersales intelligence for heavy machinery. It helps equipment dealers and OEMs turn scattered service data — machine history, product documentation, customer records, bills of materials, work orders, and technician notes — into faster troubleshooting, accurate parts identification, and reliable job quoting. The platform surfaces recurring failure patterns across fleets (excavators, crushers, compaction rollers, and similar equipment) to improve first-time fix rates. Digital Iron is backed by Seedcamp and tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; the product is delivered as a hosted web application and no public API has been identified to date.

providers.name: disclose.io
providers.description: The open, vendor-neutral infrastructure that powers vulnerability disclosure and security reporting. Safe, simple, and standardized for everyone. disclose.io provides tools to create policies, manage security.txt files, and host public directories of disclosure programs, enabling coordinated vulnerability reporting across the ecosystem.

providers.name: DiversyFund
providers.description: DiversyFund is a San Diego based private-markets investment platform that packages institutional-style fixed income and multifamily real estate offerings for individual accredited investors. Formed in 2016 and qualified under SEC Regulation A+, the firm acts as sponsor, developer and manager of its own funds rather than as a broker, and reports having acquired more than $300 million across 20+ multifamily properties for a base of 28,000+ investors. Its current offering, the Distressed Income Fund, is a Reg D 506(c) preferred-equity vehicle sold to accredited investors with a target allocation of $100K to $1M. Investing is transacted through a private, authenticated investor portal at portal.diversyfund.com (WorkOS AuthKit); DiversyFund publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Dokku
providers.description: Dokku is an open-source Docker-powered self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service that helps you build and manage the lifecycle of applications from initial push to scaling out. Often described as "the smallest PaaS implementation you've ever seen" and a self-hosted mini-Heroku, Dokku turns a single Linux host (or a multi-host scheduler such as K3s or Nomad) into a git-push deployment target that builds applications from Heroku-compatible buildpacks, Cloud Native Buildpacks, Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfiles, or pre-built Docker images. Dokku is MIT licensed, written primarily in Bash, and maintained by the Dokku organization on GitHub since 2013. It ships an extensive plugin ecosystem covering data stores (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Meilisearch, Typesense), TLS via Let's Encrypt, HTTP basic auth, maintenance mode, redirects, schedulers for Docker, K3s and Nomad, multiple HTTP proxies (Nginx, HAProxy, Caddy, Traefik, OpenResty), CI integrations, and an official GitHub Action. Dokku's primary interface is the `dokku` CLI invoked over SSH; there is no first-party public HTTP REST API in core (the historical `dokku-api` Ruby wrapper is archived and unmaintained).

providers.name: EquityBee
providers.description: EquityBee is a fintech marketplace that helps startup employees fund the exercise of their stock options before those options expire, giving them the cash needed to purchase their equity while the company is still private. On the other side of the marketplace, EquityBee connects accredited investors with the opportunity to invest in pre-IPO companies by funding those employee option exercises in exchange for a share of the future proceeds. Founded in 2018, the company operates a two-sided platform spanning startup employees, accredited investors, and the private companies whose equity underlies each funded position. EquityBee publishes a public marketing and account website but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: European Commission eTranslation
providers.description: European Commission eTranslation provides AI-powered language translation and related tools as part of the European Commission’s multilingualism initiatives. It offers free, secure translation, summarisation, and content generation services across all 24 EU official languages, targeting public sector users, language professionals, and educators. The service builds on decades of EU translation expertise and aims to enhance accessibility and communication within the European Union.

providers.name: Experiential Labs
providers.description: Experiential Labs is an applied AI research laboratory (Y Combinator Summer 2026, San Francisco) building world models that let AI agents simulate reality with high fidelity. Founded by Kion Fallah (former staff research scientist at Waabi) and Silen Naihin (AutoGPT and agent-benchmark contributor, co-founder of Stackwise), the company adapts techniques from autonomous-vehicle development to reconstruct environments at high accuracy and pursue recursive self-improvement and continual learning across domains. Its public work is open source on GitHub, including the world-model-harness (world-model-as-a-harness for simulating AI agent environments), OpenCLaaS (Continual Learning as a Service), and autoresearch-distillation. The company does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: EZVIZ
providers.description: EZVIZ provides smart home security cameras, video doorbells, and related IoT devices, offering cloud storage, AI-powered motion detection, and mobile app control. The company operates globally, with regional sites for the US, Europe, and Asia, and publishes developer resources, API documentation, and support portals for integration with third‑party services.

providers.name: First Horizon
providers.description: First Horizon Corporation is a Fortune 500 financial services holding company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. Through First Horizon Bank it provides commercial, private, consumer, and mortgage banking, wealth management, and capital markets services across the southern United States. First Horizon operates a real API Banking developer portal for Treasury Management clients, exposing RESTful products for money movement, ACH origination, real-time account information, and routing-number lookups, secured with OAuth 2.0 and a sandbox for build-and-test integration. Onboarding is partner/relationship gated and no OpenAPI/Swagger specifications are publicly downloadable — this repository captures the documented API surface honestly, humanURL-only.

providers.name: flatfair
providers.description: flatfair is a UK-based tenancy deposit platform for letting agents, landlords, and Build-to-Rent operators, offering deposit alternatives and deposit administration products. Its products include No Deposit (tenants pay 28% of one month's rent plus VAT instead of a five-week cash deposit), Deposits, Unlock Deposits, Deposit Boost, tenant Referencing, and Tenant Guarantor. flatfair is used by more than 850 agents and Build-to-Rent operators to reduce move-in friction and cut deposit administration time by around 60 minutes per tenancy. The company operates a web application for agents and tenants but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Flease
providers.description: Flease is a French vehicle-leasing marketplace offering flexible long-term (LLD, 24-50 month) and medium-term (LMD, 1-12 month) car and utility-vehicle rental to SMEs and small businesses. It sources quasi-new vehicles (under two years old, fewer than 30,000 km), delivers within a week for LMD and a month for LLD, and bundles a fleet-management web application (webapp.flease.fr) for tracking mileage, drivers, maintenance, contracts, and invoices. Flease positions on transparent pricing and a roughly 20% lower total cost of ownership versus traditional leasing, with a circular-economy angle of redeploying used vehicles. Backed by Partech. No public developer API or documentation is published; the customer-facing webapp is a Vue single-page app authenticated with AWS Cognito.

providers.name: FleetSharp
providers.description: FleetSharp provides GPS-based fleet tracking solutions, offering real-time vehicle location, driver behavior monitoring, equipment tracking, dash camera integration, and fuel cost reduction tools. Their platform enables businesses to improve safety, efficiency, and asset utilization through powerful mapping, alerts, and analytics.

providers.name: Foodsmart
providers.description: Foodsmart is a telenutrition company that pairs the nation's largest network of registered dietitians with a digital food-benefits platform, delivering personalized nutrition care via telehealth to more than three million members. The company partners with health plans and employers to reach Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial members, combining one-on-one dietitian counseling with meal planning, grocery ordering, and SNAP benefits enrollment. Foodsmart's "Foodscription" model connects clinical nutrition guidance to affordable, healthy food access to improve outcomes and lower the cost of diet-related chronic disease. This profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foodsmart exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Foresight
providers.description: Foresight is a predictive project-delivery platform for complex construction and infrastructure megaprojects, with a particular focus on data centers, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded by Dr. Atif Ansar and Igor Shifrin (Oxford) and headquartered in London, it layers on top of existing scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project and Excel to turn raw schedule data into forecasts, risk assessment, delay prediction, and portfolio-wide project assurance. The company reports managing $100B+ in mission-critical projects and is backed by Creandum and Macquarie Capital. Foresight is delivered as a SaaS web application and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: FruitScout
providers.description: FruitScout provides plant-level crop measurement, AI-driven harvest planning, crew management, and audit‑ready compliance solutions. Their platform, proven at industrial scale in agave, offers advanced inventory, field measurement, forecasting, and regulatory audit tools, helping producers optimize timing, quality, efficiency, and yield across high‑value crops. The system integrates computer‑vision and data analytics to deliver real‑time insights, supporting both enterprise producers and field crews with mobile apps and compliance modules.

providers.name: Genome Medical
providers.description: Genome Medical is a telehealth-enabled genetic services provider offering expert genetic counseling, test selection and ordering support, results interpretation, and clinical trial matching for individuals with rare and hereditary conditions. It partners with health systems, life sciences organizations, and genetic testing labs to scale genetic care, reduce diagnostic backlogs, and accelerate diagnoses through a proprietary clinical platform and patient portal. Genome Medical does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Guidelight Health
providers.description: Guidelight Health is a mental healthcare provider delivering evidence-based day treatment programs — Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHPs) and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOPs) — for people managing anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, and personality disorders. Care combines group therapy, individual psychotherapy, and medication management, offered in-person and virtually across Colorado, California, Massachusetts, North Carolina, and Washington. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company operates a patient-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; its client portal runs on the third-party Kipu (kipuworks.com) EHR platform, so there is no first-party API, SDK, or developer surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Halogen Capital
providers.description: Halogen Capital is Malaysia's first and only licensed digital asset fund manager, regulated by the Securities Commission Malaysia (License eCMSL/A0388/2023) and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. The firm gives high-net-worth individuals, family offices, corporates, and institutional investors regulated access to cryptocurrency and traditional assets through unit trust structures, offering Shariah-compliant Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Crypto Titans basket funds alongside a MYR liquid fund, a ringgit income fund, and an enhanced income fund, all secured with multi-signature custody. Backed by Kenanga Investment Bank and 500 Global, Halogen manages roughly RM400 million in assets under management and is expanding into real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence and domain-security posture; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Harmonycares
providers.description: HarmonyCares is a physician-led, value-based, in-home primary care organization headquartered in Troy, Michigan, and one of the nation's largest house-call practices. It brings primary care, palliative care, and ancillary services such as in-home laboratory, radiology, and comprehensive health assessments directly to older adults living with serious and complex chronic conditions. Operating across roughly a dozen states, HarmonyCares supports more than 70,000 patients through value-based arrangements with Medicare Advantage plans and Medicare ACO programs. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a public marketing site, a patient portal, and corporate policy documents, but no public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hippo
providers.description: Hippo is a US homeowners insurance carrier headquartered in Palo Alto, California, operating as the insurance subsidiary of Hippo Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HIPO). Founded in 2015, Hippo modernizes home insurance with instant online quotes — typically under sixty seconds — and a smart home oriented approach that pairs policies with proactive home maintenance guidance through the Hippo Home mobile app, DIY checklists, home health scoring, and partnerships with smart device makers. The company writes homeowners, condo, landlord, flood, auto, and pet policies and operates as both a direct-to-consumer brand and an MGA distributing through a network of 70+ carrier partners, including Bamboo, Stillwater, Nationwide, American Integrity, Liberty Mutual, and Progressive. Hippo's underwriting capacity is anchored by its wholly-owned admitted carrier, Spinnaker Insurance Company, acquired in 2020. Hippo serves 500K+ homeowners across the United States, with concentrated presence in Texas, California, Arizona, Colorado, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia. There is no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Hippo or Spinnaker; the GitHub organization hippoinsurance exists but has no public repositories, and the api.hippo.com hostname is not exposed to the public internet. Integrations with smart home device partners, agents, and MGA carriers are handled through private partner channels rather than an open developer program.

providers.name: Hornet
providers.description: Hornet is a queer social networking platform operated by Queer Networks, Inc., serving the global LGBTQ+ community with more than 100 million users worldwide. The Hornet app combines profiles, feeds, live video, one-on-one video chat, messaging, and location-based discovery into a privacy-first digital home for gay men and the broader queer community. Backed by 500 Global (and previously part of BlueCity Holdings), Hornet operates as a consumer social/media company rather than an API provider — it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs — so this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public identity, policy surface, and domain-security posture rather than developer artifacts. Hornet is number one in several key markets including France, Brazil, Turkey, and Taiwan, and monetizes through premium subscriptions and queer-audience advertising.

providers.name: Hum Capital
providers.description: Hum Capital operates an AI-powered funding marketplace that connects growth companies with the right institutional capital. Through its Intelligent Capital Market platform, companies share their financial and operating data once and are matched to a network of 900+ lenders and investors for non-dilutive and structured financing (typically $1M-$50M), while investors receive curated, data-driven deal flow. Hum reports more than $700M in capital deployed across 6,000+ companies. Headquartered in New York, the company operates in the financial services, capital markets, and alternative-financing sector. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and enriched from the company's public web surface; Hum publishes no public developer API, so this entry is identity- and security-focused.

providers.name: Hyper 4
providers.description: Hyper (heyhyper.ai) is a Y Combinator-backed startup building "the self-driving company brain" — a knowledge-management platform that assembles a centralized, self-maintaining knowledge graph from a team's emails, Slack, GitHub, calendars, and other work sources, then feeds that context back into AI agents and tools so they act with accurate company memory and require fewer repeated corrections. Founded in 2026 by Shalin Shah and Kanyes Thaker and based in San Francisco, the company was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of this profile Hyper is very early-stage, publishing only a marketing landing page at heyhyper.ai with no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface yet available; this record captures verified company identity and will be re-enriched as a developer platform is published.

providers.name: Improbable
providers.description: Improbable (Improbable Worlds Ltd) is a London-based technology company and venture builder. Founded in 2012, it originally built SpatialOS, a distributed simulation and networking platform for large-scale real-time multiplayer games, and later Morpheus / M² (MSquared), a network of interoperable metaverse worlds. Today Improbable operates primarily as a venture builder and capital allocator, partnering with founders to launch and scale companies across AI, Web3 and the metaverse. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and the SoftBank Vision Fund. Its historical developer surface centered on the SpatialOS Platform SDK, Worker SDK and the `spatial` CLI (distributed via NuGet), plus the improbable-eng and spatialos GitHub organizations; the standalone documentation, status and IMS subdomains have since been retired as the company pivoted away from a standalone developer platform.

providers.name: Industrious
providers.description: Industrious is a global flexible workspace provider operating private offices, dedicated and open coworking memberships, and on-demand meeting rooms across hundreds of locations worldwide. Members manage access, bookings, and workspace services through the Industrious member portal and iOS/Android mobile apps. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Industrious publishes a consumer/member web and mobile experience but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile therefore captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Influence Mobile
providers.description: Influence Mobile is a rewarded-play mobile user-acquisition company that runs its Pull platform, which pays players cash and gift cards funded by mobile-gaming advertisers and helps game developers acquire and retain players while giving brands and creators a reward program for their audiences. Founded in 2012 as Affinity Influencing Systems, it serves app developers, brands and players; it publishes no public developer API documentation.

providers.name: Inkblot Therapy
providers.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.

providers.name: Jiraaf
providers.description: Jiraaf (Jiraaf Platform Private Limited, Bangalore, India) is an online fixed-income investment platform that lets retail investors discover, analyze, and invest in listed and secured bonds. Its curated product shelf spans listed corporate bonds, sovereign gold bonds, treasury bills, G-Secs and State Development Loans (SDLs), securitized debt instruments (SDIs), and fixed deposits, each surfaced with transparent yields, credit ratings, and a documented credit-evaluation process. Alongside the investing surface it publishes research reports, a bond analyser, a bond directory, a glossary, calculators, and educational content (Bond Gurukul webinars, blogs, and newsletters). Backed by Accel. Jiraaf is a consumer-facing web and mobile investing product and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kace
providers.description: KACE is the endpoint and systems management product line from Quest Software, originally founded in 2003 as KACE Networks (backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Sigma Partners, and Focus Ventures), acquired by Dell in 2010, and now sold as Quest KACE. The portfolio centers on the KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) for inventory, patching, software distribution, scripting, and service desk; the KACE Systems Deployment Appliance (SDA) for OS imaging and provisioning; and KACE Cloud for mobile device management and modern endpoint management. The KACE SMA ships a REST API (JSON and XML) that lets administrators programmatically manage assets, inventory, managed installations, scripting, users, and service-desk tickets on the customer-hosted appliance. This profile enriches the original Norwest portfolio lead with the real Quest KACE identity and its documented API surface.

providers.name: Kiavi
providers.description: Kiavi (formerly LendingHome) is a technology-driven private lender for residential real estate investors, providing fix-and-flip bridge loans, new-construction financing, and DSCR rental loans across 49 states plus Washington, D.C. The company has originated more than $30 billion in loans and funded over 100,000 investment properties, pairing a digital application and portfolio-management experience with institutional capital. Kiavi is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Ribbit Capital. As of this enrichment pass Kiavi publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, a real-estate-investing blog, legal/policy pages, and a HackerOne-based security vulnerability disclosure program.

providers.name: Ko
providers.description: ko is a simple, fast container image builder for Go applications that does not require Docker, producing small images by building Go binaries and layering them on a minimal base image for deployment to Kubernetes.

providers.name: Kundo
providers.description: Kundo provides a comprehensive AI‑enhanced customer service platform that combines ticketing, knowledge management, and self‑service tools into a single SaaS solution. Built for enterprises, Kundo leverages artificial intelligence to keep knowledge bases up‑to‑date, automatically suggest answers, and streamline multi‑channel support. The platform offers AI Forms, AI Chat, and a knowledge agent that learns from existing content, helping support teams respond faster and improve customer satisfaction across various industries.

providers.name: Kustomize
providers.description: Kustomize is a Kubernetes-native configuration management tool that lets you customize untemplated YAML files for multiple purposes, leaving the original YAML intact and usable as-is, using a template-free approach to configuration customization.

providers.name: LetsVenture
providers.description: LetsVenture (operating under the brand LVX) is a technology platform that enables investors to discover and invest in early‑stage startups across India and beyond. It offers AI‑driven deal sourcing, a marketplace for private market investments, and a suite of founder‑focused programs such as accelerators, cohorts, and educational resources. The platform reports over 36 K investors, 300+ family offices and funds, and has committed more than ₹1,160 Cr in gross deal value across 715 deals, supporting founders with capital, mentorship, and growth tools.

providers.name: Loft Dynamics
providers.description: Loft Dynamics is a Swiss aviation technology company (founded 2016, headquartered in Dübendorf, Switzerland with a North American office in Santa Monica) that builds virtual reality flight simulation training devices (FSTDs) for helicopters, fixed-wing aircraft, and eVTOLs. Its simulators combine full-scale replica cockpits, dynamic motion platforms, 360-degree VR visuals, and advanced pose tracking, and were the first VR aircraft simulators to earn EASA and FAA qualification. Products include VR simulators for the Airbus H145, Airbus H125, and Robinson R22 helicopters, with Boeing 737 and eVTOL platforms in development. Customers include Alaska Airlines, the FAA, Airbus Helicopters, the LAPD, and Marshall University. The company operates the LoftHUB customer platform but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Lola
providers.description: Lola is a consumer travel booking platform at lola.com that lets travelers discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and trips in one place, built around insider access to the world's leading travel brands, competitive rates, and a simple "just ask" booking experience.
