providers.description: GlobaliD (global.id) is a decentralized digital-identity platform that lets people create a portable, self-sovereign identity and lets developers add "Sign in with GlobaliD" login, issue verifiable credentials, and verify identity claims (such as proof of being 18+) through server-side issuer and verifier toolkits built on Hyperledger Aries. Developers create apps in the invitation-based developer portal to obtain OAuth2 client credentials, then integrate using the official @globalid npm SDKs. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Gradiant
providers.description: Gradiant is a global water and wastewater infrastructure company founded in 2013 out of MIT and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, that designs, builds and operates end-to-end industrial water systems from intake to discharge. It positions itself as "the Water Layer of the AI Economy", supplying ultrapure water, process water, wastewater recycling, minimal- and zero-liquid-discharge and resource-recovery systems to semiconductor fabs, AI data centers, energy producers and applied industries including pharmaceuticals, mining, food and beverage, refining and chemicals, textiles and renewables. Its proprietary technology portfolio includes Counterflow Reverse Osmosis (CFRO), Semi-Batch Reverse Osmosis (SBRO), Carrier Gas Extraction (CGE), Selective Contaminant Extraction (SCE), Free Radical Oxidation (FRO), Bio Infinity, the ForeverGone PFAS destruction process, the HyperSolved data-center cooling-water platform, the CURE Chemicals specialty-chemicals line and SmartOps AI, a machine-learning platform for optimizing and predicting plant operations. Gradiant raised a Series E at a $2 billion valuation in May 2026. It is an industrial equipment, chemicals and build-own-operate services company: it publishes no public developer portal, no developer API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and SmartOps AI is delivered as a customer-facing operations platform rather than as a public API.

providers.name: Gravity
providers.description: Gravity provides a suite of WordPress plugins, including Gravity Forms and Gravity Flow, enabling businesses to create advanced forms, automate workflows, and integrate with numerous services. The company offers a marketplace of trusted developers and regularly runs promotional discounts, such as the Black Friday 2026 ecosystem price drops.

providers.name: Gridwiz
providers.description: Gridwiz Inc. is a South Korean clean-energy software and hardware company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Seoul. It operates one of Korea's largest demand response (DR) aggregation portfolios, gathering electricity that industrial and commercial customers curtail and selling it into the national power market, and it pairs that with energy storage (ESS), renewable energy / RE100 and PPA advisory, and an e-mobility line covering EV charging controllers, CCS communication modems (EVCC/SECC), bidirectional V2G chargers and the Skyblue consumer charging service. Its e-mobility products are built to the international EV charging standards DIN SPEC 70121, ISO 15118 (including 15118-20 AC/DC) and OCPP, and its demand response management system is described as OpenADR-based. Gridwiz sells energy services and certified hardware to utilities, EVSE suppliers and enterprises; it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Grouper
providers.description: Grouper, operated by Element3 Health, Inc. (d/b/a Grouper) and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, is a healthy-aging benefit company that connects older adults to social clubs, group activities, and virtual community programming through health plans. Its consumer product, "Hello by Grouper," is a membership platform offering live and on-demand instructor-led virtual classes, research-based monthly brain-health challenges, and members-only online events, with the goal of keeping members active, socially connected, and healthier as they age. Grouper distributes primarily through Medicare Advantage and other health-plan partners rather than a direct developer channel; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface as of this profile, which was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture (a16z-associated) portfolio lead.

providers.name: Hallmark Cards
providers.description: Hallmark Cards, Inc. is a privately held, family-owned greeting card, gift, gift wrap and ornament company headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, founded in 1910 by J.C. Hall. Its portfolio spans Hallmark greeting cards and Keepsake Ornaments sold through Hallmark Gold Crown stores and mass retailers, the Crayola and Hallmark Business Connections (B2B greeting card programs) subsidiaries, and Hallmark Media (Hallmark Channel, Hallmark+). Hallmark publishes no public developer program: developer.hallmark.com does not resolve, api.hallmark.com serves a stock ASP.NET template with no documented endpoints, and no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A agent card, llms.txt or /.well-known discovery document was found on any Hallmark host on 2026-09-17. Retail and supply-chain partners integrate through bilateral EDI (Hallmark Global Services) and Hallmark Business Connections' CRM/SSO integrations, none of which are documented publicly.

providers.name: Hatch
providers.description: Hatch offers a variety of smart sleep devices to help you sleep better night after night. Create healthy sleeping habits for the whole family with Hatch. Their flagship Hatch Sleep Clock is a sleep tracker designed to get you to sleep without relying on scores, offering customizable light and sound routines.

providers.name: HomeLight
providers.description: HomeLight is a San Francisco–based real-estate technology company that matches home buyers and sellers with top-performing local real-estate agents and operates a stack of consumer-facing products that span the entire residential transaction: agent matching, Simple Sale cash-offer marketplace, Buy Before You Sell (BBYS) bridge financing, HomeLight Home Loans (NMLS #1529229), the HomeLight HELOC Card, and HomeLight Closing Services for title and escrow. The company ranks agents using historical performance data on home sales (price, speed, volume, geography, property type) and routes consumer leads to a curated network of agents, lenders, and cash-buyer investors. HomeLight exposes a private Partner API to lenders, brokerages, CRMs, and marketing partners (NerdWallet is its largest partner) for submitting leads (`/api/partner_lead/v2`), Simple Sale seller leads (`/leads/partner_simple_sale_lead`), and duplicate-lead checks (`/api/partner_dupe_lead_check`); credentials are issued on a per-partner basis via support@homelight.com. Beyond the Partner API, HomeLight has direct integrations with most major real-estate agent CRMs (Follow Up Boss, BoomTown, Sierra Interactive, Firepoint, Real Geeks, Brivity, Chime, LionDesk, KW Command). HomeLight has no public, self-service developer portal — the Partner API is gated by a commercial relationship, and there is no public OpenAPI spec, SDK, or open-source client published by the company.

providers.name: Identify3D
providers.description: Identify3D, part of Materialise, offers a secure digital manufacturing asset control platform that enables companies to manage and protect their 3D printing workflows, data, and intellectual property across distributed manufacturing networks. The solution provides encryption, access control, and traceability to ensure secure collaboration and compliance in the medical device and industrial sectors.

providers.name: Insify
providers.description: Insify is a Dutch insurtech offering fully digital business insurance for freelancers, self-employed professionals (ZZP'ers) and small-to-medium enterprises in the Netherlands. Its online-first product line covers disability/income protection (arbeidsongeschiktheid, AOV), professional liability (beroepsaansprakelijkheid, BAV), business liability (bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, AVB), business inventory and goods, electronics, in-vehicle equipment and auto cover, sold and managed entirely online with no setup, advisory or cancellation fees and daily cancellation. Serving more than 40,000 entrepreneurs across professions from IT and photography to care and construction, Insify pairs instant quoting and fast claims with AI-assisted guidance (SmartGuide). Backed by Accel, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an insurance-tech provider profile; it is a consumer-facing insurer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Jenkins Pipeline
providers.description: Jenkins Pipeline is a suite of plugins for the Jenkins automation server that supports implementing and integrating continuous delivery pipelines as code. It provides an extensible domain-specific language (DSL) with two syntax styles - Declarative and Scripted - and core building blocks (agents, stages, steps) for modeling simple-to-complex CI/CD workflows that are versioned with application source code via a Jenkinsfile.

providers.name: Kasa Living
providers.description: Kasa Living, Inc. (operating as Kasa) is a San Francisco-founded, tech-enabled hospitality company that partners with institutional real-estate owners to convert multifamily, single-family and hotel inventory into professionally managed, apartment-style flexible accommodations across 90+ U.S. cities. Founded in 2016 by Roman Pedan, Kasa runs a proprietary hospitality operating system covering dynamic pricing, automated operations, keyless self check-in and a 24/7 remote "Virtual Front Desk" instead of an on-site front desk, and distributes inventory direct at kasa.com plus through OTAs and GDS via the NextPax supply API. Kasa publishes no public developer API, developer portal or machine-readable API specification; its one machine-readable, agent-facing artifact is a hand-authored llms.txt served at kasa.com/llms.txt.

providers.name: KCL
providers.description: KCL (Kusion Configuration Language) is a constraint-based record and functional programming language designed for configuration and policy scenarios. It provides features like type safety, automation, and validation for cloud-native configurations.

providers.name: Kognity
providers.description: Kognity provides a digital curriculum and online learning platform for schools, offering interactive textbooks, built‑in assessments, and analytics. Trusted by over 2,000 schools worldwide, it supports IB, IGCSE, NGSS and other curricula, helping educators deliver engaging, standards‑aligned content and track student progress.

providers.name: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd.
providers.description: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd. (주식회사 곳간, branded KOKKAN / 도심창고 곳간) is a South Korean urban self-storage and logistics operator headquartered in Gangnam-gu, Seoul. It rents managed storage units in five sizes (S, M, L, XL, XXL, from 1.0m cubes up to 2.0 x 2.0 x 2.0m) across 22 branches in Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Gyeonggi and Chungbuk, serving households storing seasonal appliances, clothing, bedding and baby goods as well as businesses storing samples, inventory, documents and office equipment. Customers select a branch, choose a unit size, pay and manage their contract through the KOKKAN mobile apps for iOS and Android, with recurring monthly card billing through a Korean payment gateway, long-term and promotional discounting, an address-rental (주소지 임대) product, and an optional pickup service for moving stored goods. The company also runs a franchise and partnership program for operators who want to open a KOKKAN branch. It was surfaced through the 500 Global portfolio. As of this profile KokkanLogis publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or technical documentation — the product surface is a consumer website plus native mobile apps.

providers.name: LARQ
providers.description: LARQ is a direct-to-consumer water technology company that designs self-cleaning and filtering drinkware and home water products. Its flagship Bottle PureVis uses UV-C light to neutralize up to 99.9999% of harmful, odor-causing bacteria in the bottle and on the water surface, and the range extends to filtered bottles, filtered pitchers, an under-sink water filter, and the cuva beverage flavor line. The company positions itself around sustainable hydration — reducing single-use plastic bottle consumption — and funds environmental nonprofits from a portion of each purchase. LARQ is a consumer hardware and e-commerce business: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and no /.well-known/ discovery documents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: LendingPad
providers.description: LendingPad is a cloud-based mortgage loan origination system (LOS) that lets brokers, lenders, and institutions originate, process, underwrite, close, and fund residential mortgage loans with real-time, multi-user collaboration across the borrower, broker, lender, and service-provider lifecycle. It ships in Broker, Lender, Processing, and Institution editions and runs a large Partners Marketplace of integrated vendors (credit, AUS, AVM/appraisal, title, compliance, doc-prep, pricing/PPE, POS, CRM, and investors such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, UWM, and Rocket Mortgage). LendingPad exposes an Enterprise API for loan data exchange, but access is gated - it is limited to Lender Edition clients under an executed API Agreement and NDA, keys and testing-site access are issued by the support desk, and there is no public developer portal or self-serve API reference. The API entries below are honestly modeled from the vendor-integration and marketplace capabilities LendingPad describes publicly; endpoint-level surfaces are not published and are not fabricated here.

providers.name: Limepay
providers.description: Limepay was a Melbourne-based Australian embedded-payments and white-label buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) company that let merchants and platforms accept card payments and offer pay-in-instalments through a single drop-in checkout and a REST API. Its developer surface covered an embeddable Checkout, a Payments API (orders, order-pay, transaction capture/void, refunds, 3-D Secure and wallet payments such as Apple Pay and Google Pay), and a Platform API for marketplaces to onboard and manage sub-merchants, run KYC/identification, and pull settlement reports. Authentication used a Publishable API key for frontend/checkout calls, a Secret API key for server-to-server calls, and a platform API key for administrative onboarding, all passed as Bearer tokens. After a failed 2021 IPO, Limepay was acquired by ASX-listed Spenda in 2024 and its product line was continued under the April Solutions brand; the primary domain limepay.com.au now redirects to meetapril.com and the docs.limepay.com.au developer portal is gated behind a Redocly login. This profile documents Limepay's real, historically public API family honestly; no machine-readable OpenAPI is currently downloadable.

providers.name: Lina
providers.description: Lina is a medical coworking company providing space, community, and support for independent healthcare practitioners in private practice. Founded by Vicrum Puri and Rachel Puri, Lina offers turnkey private office suites alongside on-demand medical, therapy, and bodywork spaces that are HIPAA and OSHA compliant and bookable by the hour or by the day. Locations operate in NoMad and Grand Central in New York City and Aventura, Florida, with expansion announced for Washington DC, West Palm Beach, the Upper West Side, and Brooklyn. Lina is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. It operates a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: LVX (formerly LetsVenture)
providers.description: LVX — formerly LetsVenture — is an India-based private market investing platform founded in 2013 by Shanti Mohan and headquartered in Bengaluru, with teams in Delhi and Mumbai. The platform connects startup founders raising capital with angel investors, family offices and VCs, and has been a SEBI-regulated entity since its Angel AIF was approved in 2018. Its product surface spans LVX start (early-stage angel investing), LVX grow (growth-stage and co-investment deals), LVXschool (private market investor education), LVX Debt (non-dilutive debt financing for startups) and LVX Track (portfolio dashboards), alongside the sister platform trica. The company publicly reports 35K+ startups, 14K+ investors and over Rs 1500 Cr of AIF assets under management. LVX rebranded from LetsVenture in July 2025 and letsventure.com now redirects to lvxventures.com. LVX operates no public developer API program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDKs were found, and the platform-backing API at api.lvxventures.com is a private token-authenticated service.

providers.name: Meanwhile
providers.description: Meanwhile is the first BMA-licensed innovative life insurer in Bermuda, offering whole life insurance policies denominated entirely in Bitcoin rather than fiat. Its BTC Life product lets customers pay premiums in Bitcoin that grow at a guaranteed rate in Bitcoin terms, borrow tax-free against up to 90% of policy value after one year, and pass a full day-one death benefit to beneficiaries without managing wallets or seed phrases. The company is backed by Pantera, Bain Capital Crypto, Sam Altman, Northwestern Mutual, and Framework Ventures, and raised $82M in October 2025. Meanwhile publishes no public developer API, portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Medely
providers.description: Medely is a healthcare workforce orchestration platform and staffing marketplace that connects healthcare facilities with a network of qualified nurses and allied health professionals. What began as a marketplace to match facilities with per-diem talent has grown into a full workforce management platform, helping hospitals, surgery centers, skilled nursing facilities, and other providers fill open and per-diem shifts, support their core clinical teams, and maintain high-quality patient care. Medely offers credentialing, scheduling, and flexible workforce management tools, and holds the Joint Commission's Gold Seal of Approval for its staffing services. The company is backed by General Catalyst and Wing Venture Capital. Medely does not currently operate a public developer program or documented API; its GraphQL backend at api.medely.com powers the first-party web and mobile applications only.

providers.name: Medix Infusion
providers.description: Medix Infusion, Inc. is a technology-enabled infusion care provider headquartered in Addison, Texas, that administers infusion and injectable therapies — anti-infectives, biologics, IVIG and other specialty medications — to chronically and acutely ill patients through a network of ambulatory infusion suites and in the home. The company concentrates on rural, suburban and other under-served markets, coordinating benefits investigation, prior authorization, scheduling, pharmacy and nursing around each referral, and is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC). It raised a $35M Series B led by Echo Health Ventures in January 2023 alongside existing investor Noro-Moseley Partners. Medix Infusion operates as a care-delivery organization: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract on any public host as of this profile.

providers.name: Metric Insights
providers.description: Metric Insights provides a governed business intelligence (BI) platform that enables organizations to discover, govern, and operationalize data across BI tools, analytics, and AI. Their cloud SaaS and self‑hosted solutions offer data catalog, metadata management, security, alerting, and a conversational AI concierge to help users explore insights. The platform integrates with Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, Sigma and many others, delivering a unified data governance experience for modern enterprises.

providers.name: Mind Candy, Moshi
providers.description: Mind Candy Ltd is a London-based children's media and technology company, originally known for the Moshi Monsters online game and now operating Moshi, an award-winning children's app for sleep, relaxation and learning. Moshi offers hundreds of hours of bedtime stories, sleep sounds, music, white noise and educational activities delivered through iOS and Android consumer apps. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. Moshi is a direct-to-consumer subscription product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Mindful Health Solutions
providers.description: Mindful Health Solutions is a behavioral-health-care provider specializing in innovative, evidence-based psychiatric treatments for depression, anxiety, PTSD, OCD, and other treatment-resistant conditions. Founded in 2007 (originally as TMS Health Solutions) by Dr. Richard Bermudes, the company pioneered TMS-focused clinics in the United States and offers Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), SPRAVATO (esketamine) nasal spray, IV Ketamine infusion therapy, medication management, and psychiatric care across roughly 20 clinics in California, Texas, and Washington. Mindful Health Solutions maintains one of the world's largest TMS and esketamine patient-outcome repositories. It is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As a clinical healthcare provider it publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, an AI-crawler llms.txt it publishes, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mitchell 1
providers.description: Mitchell 1 is a division of Snap-on Incorporated providing repair information (ProDemand, TruckSeries) and shop management software (Manager SE, SocialCRM) to independent auto repair shops. Mitchell 1 is a legacy enterprise software provider, not an API-first company - it has no public, self-serve REST API reference. It does operate a gated Web-Intent / Data API integration program for approved third-party partners (shop management systems, CRM, parts and marketing platforms) to embed or link into ProDemand labor, parts, and maintenance data, fronted by a token-based (TAPE) auth flow and an Intent Registry discovery service. Access requires submitting an integration request, a Mitchell 1 review (roughly two weeks), and a signed partner agreement; no public API reference, OpenAPI document, or SDK is published. Note - Mitchell 1 (mitchell1.com, Snap-on) is a distinct company from Mitchell International (mitchell.com, part of Enlyte) - the two share a historical "Mitchell" lineage but are separately owned; Mitchell International's public developer.mitchell.com RepairCenter API belongs to the other company and is out of scope here.

providers.name: Modern Meadow
providers.description: Modern Meadow is a bio-design and materials-science company founded in 2011 in Brooklyn by Andras Forgacs, Francoise Marga, Gabor Forgacs and Karoly Jakab, now headquartered in Nutley / Pine Brook, New Jersey, where it operates an innovation lab opened in 2017. The company applies synthetic biology and protein engineering to build animal-free, bio-fabricated alternatives to leather and other petrochemical-derived materials, through the Bio-Alloy technology platform (an alloy of engineered proteins and bio-based polymers), the BIO-VERA material launched in 2023, and its current flagship INNOVERA, a next-generation leather alternative made from plant proteins, biopolymers and recycled rubber with more than 80% renewable carbon content. It sells into interiors, fashion and accessories, footwear, and automotive, and has partnered with BASF, tannery HELLER-LEDER (a 2026 European joint venture) and Allbirds (the Terralux footwear line). Modern Meadow has raised roughly $236M. It is a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: profiling on 2026-08-01 found no public API, no developer portal, no documentation, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP surface, no /.well-known/ documents, and no GitHub organization. Its corporate site (modernmeadow.com, Craft CMS) largely redirects to the product site innovera-world.com.

providers.name: Mona Ai
providers.description: Mona AI GmbH (mona-ai.de) is a German AI recruiting-automation company backed by Earlybird. Its platform combines AI agents and digital avatars to automate recruiting and HR processes for staffing agencies and enterprises: 24/7 candidate outreach, automated pre-qualification and candidate-profile generation, and "digital branch" structures — built to be fully GDPR- and EU-AI-Act-compliant. Products include MONA Recruiting, MONA Recruiting Light, MONA Agents, MONA Digital Branch, MONA Consulting and MONA ARS, an autonomous prompt-driven recruiting system that sources, screens, schedules and reports automatically. The website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for AI-agent access; the recruiting product itself runs behind a login and does not publish a public developer API, SDK or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Nanoleaf
providers.description: Nanoleaf designs and manufactures smart lighting products, including LED light panels, light strips, and interactive lighting systems for homes and commercial spaces. Their platform integrates with major smart home ecosystems, offering AI‑powered experiences, wellness features, and developer APIs for controlling lighting, retrieving device status, and building custom integrations.

providers.name: Next Insurance
providers.description: Next Insurance (ERGO NEXT Insurance) provides small business insurance solutions with fast quotes, instant coverage, and competitive rates tailored for over 1,300 professions. Founded in 2016 and part of ERGO Group AG under Munich Re, the company offers a digital platform for businesses to obtain insurance quickly and efficiently.

providers.name: OakNorth
providers.description: OakNorth is a UK-based commercial bank and business-lending institution founded in 2015, providing debt financing to mid-market and lower-mid-market businesses in the UK and, through its New York team, the United States. Its products span business loans (from roughly GBP 1m to tens of millions), commercial real estate lending, commercial & industrial cash-flow financing, fund finance, and business and personal savings accounts. OakNorth is backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund. It publicly exposes no developer API, open-banking API, or developer portal; its public technical surface is limited to a HackerOne responsible-disclosure program and standard web/legal properties. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Olist
providers.description: Olist is a Brazilian commerce technology company headquartered in Curitiba, Paraná, offering an integrated ecosystem of solutions that automate business management for online sellers. Its products include an ERP for inventory, invoicing and order automation, a multi-marketplace Integration Hub (Mercado Livre, TikTok Shop and others), a POS for physical stores, a digital account with Pix payments, shipping and fulfillment (Envios), and storefront creation. Olist exposes robust partner APIs through its Technology Partner program ("Parceiro Tecnológico"), where approved developers receive test credentials and Swagger documentation to build and homologate integrations reaching 60,000+ merchants. The public API surface is gated behind partner registration; no open developer portal or OpenAPI specification is published.

providers.name: OnePay
providers.description: OnePay is a Walmart-backed financial technology company that delivers mobile banking and money services through a single consumer app, with banking provided by Coastal Community Bank or Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The app bundles everyday checking and high-yield savings, a Credit Builder loan and credit score monitoring, the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard credit card, buy-now-pay-later (OnePay Later, powered by Klarna/WebBank), a digital wallet, commission-free stock and ETF investing (cleared by DriveWealth), crypto buying (powered by Zero Hash), free tax filing, global transfers (powered by MoneyGram), and cash back tied to Walmart. Originally launched as ONE (One Finance), OnePay is backed by Ribbit Capital and Walmart. It operates a gated developer/partner surface at developer.onepay.com (currently access-controlled) rather than a public API program.

providers.name: Ortivus
providers.description: Ortivus provides digital solutions for emergency medical services, offering platforms such as MobiMed ePR, Insight, Clinical Scribe, Rapid Capture, Monitor, FleetCtrl, EnRoute, and Life. Their technology aims to improve ambulance response times, enhance patient data handling, and support healthcare professionals with real-time information, ultimately saving vital seconds in critical situations. The company focuses on integrating AI-powered documentation and advanced analytics to streamline emergency care workflows.

providers.name: Orus
providers.description: Orus is a French online insurance broker ("l'assurance professionnelle en ligne") offering professional-liability and business insurance to independent professionals and small businesses across France. Products include RC Pro (professional liability), Multirisque Professionnelle, Assurance Décennale (ten-year construction liability), Assurance Bureau (office insurance), Mutuelle Santé TNS (self-employed health), and Prévoyance TNS (income protection), serving sectors from consultants and construction to hospitality, retail, and wellness. Backed by Partech and Speedinvest, Orus operates a self-service quote-and-buy app (app.orus.eu) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at this time. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched via public web and domain probes.

providers.name: Outschool
providers.description: Outschool is an education-technology marketplace for live, small-group online classes for learners ages 3-18. It connects families and independent teachers across 140,000+ subjects — from math and coding to art, music, and hobbies — offered as one-time sessions, ongoing courses, camps, and social clubs delivered over live video. Outschool also serves schools and districts through its for-organizations program. Backed by Bond Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Union Square Ventures, and Y Combinator, the platform is a consumer web application; it exposes no publicly documented developer API. The site is powered by an internal, undocumented GraphQL endpoint (outschool.com/graphql) used only by its own front end and largely blocked to crawlers. This profile is an API Evangelist network company record enriched from the provider's public web surface.

providers.name: Parallel Learning
providers.description: Parallel Learning is a special education services and staffing platform that connects K-12 schools and districts with a nationwide network of licensed clinicians for the remote delivery of specialized student support. Through its proprietary, HIPAA/FERPA-compliant Pathway platform it delivers virtual psychoeducational and neurodevelopmental assessments, speech-language therapy, behavioral and mental-health counseling, specialized instruction in reading, writing, and math, and executive-function coaching, pairing secure teletherapy with progress tracking and clinical oversight so districts can meet compliance requirements and improve student outcomes. The company serves thousands of students across dozens of states and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: PawnHero
providers.description: PawnHero is the Philippines' first online pawnshop, offering instant collateral-based cash loans against jewelry, gold, luxury designer bags, watches, gadgets, and Apple devices. Customers create a pawn ticket online, an in-house courier ("Pawntrooper") collects the item for appraisal, and approved funds are disbursed within minutes via bank transfer or e-wallet, with loan terms up to 180 days and renewal options. The business is supervised by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). PawnHero operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Pixyalbum
providers.description: Pixyalbum is a Mexican consumer photo-printing service that turns digital photos from a mobile device into physical printed products delivered across Mexico. Its catalog includes Fotolibros (soft- and hard-cover photo books of 40-100 pages), Imanes (packs of square photo magnets), and Pixycuadros (photographic prints with optional framing). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. Pixyalbum is a direct-to-consumer product with no public API, developer portal, or documentation at the time of enrichment; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Plex Systems
providers.description: Plex Systems provides the Plex Smart Manufacturing Platform, a cloud‑based, elastic Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that integrates people, processes, machines and supply chains. Hosted by Rockwell Automation, Plex delivers real‑time visibility, AI‑driven insights, and scalable SaaS tools for manufacturers to improve operations, quality, and agility across the enterprise.

providers.name: Plus Simple
providers.description: +Simple (Plus Simple) is a French digital insurance underwriting agency (agence de souscription) founded in 2015 and headquartered in Marseille. Operating as one of France's largest wholesale insurance brokers, it runs a fully digital extranet platform that lets partner insurance brokers prospect, price, underwrite, issue, and manage professional insurance contracts across more than 1,200 covered activities and 30+ niche product lines, including RC Décennale (ten-year construction liability) coverage. +Simple distributes on a 100% brokerage model in partnership with carriers such as Hiscox, Allianz, Wakam, QBE and Beazley, serving a network of 8,000+ partner brokers. The company is backed by Anthemis and Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time (its broker and insured portals are authenticated web applications, not open APIs).

providers.name: Pointee
providers.description: Pointee is an agentic automation platform for enterprise business process automation, guiding organizations through the full automation journey from discovery to running AI at scale. Its Process Discovery maps how work actually runs to surface automation potential and ROI, Workflow Automation orchestrates people, bots, and AI agents in unified workflows, and Guardian Agents continuously monitor automation to detect quality drops, automate incident response, and prevent cost overruns and security threats. Pointee also offers a dedicated offering to maximize existing RPA investments. The product is operated by Pointee Interactive s.r.o. (Liberec, Czech Republic) and is a portfolio company of Earlybird; customers include KBC, Intel, Deloitte, AXA, Microsoft, and Mutual of Omaha.

providers.name: Portman
providers.description: Portman is an open source CLI tool that auto-generates Postman collections with contract and variation tests from OpenAPI specifications, supporting OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1, fuzzing, request customization, pre-request scripts, and direct upload to Postman or execution via Newman in CI/CD pipelines.

providers.name: Prepared
providers.description: Prepared is an AI-powered emergency response platform for 911 communications, now operating as the intelligence layer of Axon 911. Its assistive AI helps call-takers, dispatchers, and supervisors across the emergency response lifecycle with non-emergency call triage and deflection, real-time transcription and automated detail capture, live translation (40+ spoken languages and 200+ for text), multi-channel dispatch monitoring, and real-time quality assurance and training. The company reports supporting 1,000+ PSAPs (public safety answering points) and protecting 90M+ people, with claims of up to 50% faster call processing. Prepared is backed by a16z and General Catalyst and was surfaced through the API Evangelist venture-portfolio pipeline. The company runs a hosted dispatch console at preparedapp.com but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Privoxy
providers.description: Privoxy is a non-caching web proxy with advanced filtering capabilities for enhancing privacy, modifying web page content, and managing cookies.

providers.name: Puro.earth
providers.description: Puro.earth provides a certification infrastructure for carbon removal, turning durable carbon removal into a global, investment‑grade market. It offers a registry, standards, and tools for issuing, trading, and verifying carbon removal credits, supporting transparency and trust in the emerging CDR sector.

providers.name: ROMTech
providers.description: ROMTech (ROM Technologies, Inc.) is a privately held medical technology company headquartered in Brookfield, Connecticut that builds connected orthopedic rehabilitation technology. Its flagship product, the PortableConnect Adaptive Telemed Technology, is a prescription, clinician-delivered home rehabilitation device for patients recovering from total knee replacement, total hip replacement, joint manipulation and ACL repair. Adaptive pedal technology adjusts automatically to a patient's current range of motion across four therapy modes (passive, active-assisted, active and resistance); the AccuAngle Bluetooth wearable measures knee flexion and extension during each session; and the PortableConnect App runs a prescribed protocol of three to five daily sessions over a typical four-to-eight-week plan. Session data — range of motion, adherence and key health metrics — streams to a Clinician Portal where the prescribing surgeon reviews real-time reports and adjusts the protocol remotely, with in-app telemedicine for face-to-face follow-ups. The technology began as the ROM3 Rehab device. ROMTech was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list for 2025 and to the LexisNexis Top 100 Global Innovators for 2026, and sells to clinicians, health systems and the Department of Veterans Affairs. ROMTech runs no public developer program: it publishes no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer documentation, and the Clinician Portal at portal.romtech.com is a closed single-page application backed by a private, undocumented API at middleware.romtech.com/api.

providers.name: Roofline
providers.description: Roofline (RooflineAI GmbH, Köln, Germany) is a 2024 RWTH Aachen University spin-off building a retargetable AI compiler stack for edge deployment. Its three products are an SDK that compiles models ahead of time from any framework — the product page shows a single Python call, attic.compile(model, (input,)) — a lightweight C runtime with Python bindings that executes the compiled model and orchestrates heterogeneous SoCs, and a Performance Dashboard fed by a roofbench command-line tool running nightly benchmarks across hundreds of models for latency, throughput and memory footprint. The stack is built on open-source MLIR and IREE with proprietary hardware-specific optimization on top, and targets NPUs, MCUs and heterogeneous SoCs with quantization (INT8, blocked, symmetric, asymmetric, dynamic), dynamic shapes for on-device LLMs and mixture-of-experts support. Published work includes NXP eIQ Neutron NPU LLM enablement, Vulkan 1.3 and Arm SVE support in IREE, and day-0 support for Liquid AI LFM2. Roofline is a strategic partner of the Edge AI Foundation and raised a seed round from Serena and First Momentum Ventures. It sells compiler licenses to hardware vendors and embedded software teams: there is no developer program, no public API, no documentation host and no registry-published package. Every product page ends at a Contact Sales form, and the only machine-readable document Roofline publishes anywhere is an llms.txt on its marketing site.

providers.name: Salesape
providers.description: SalesAPE.ai (operated by AI AGENT GROUP LTD, a UK-registered company) builds AI sales assistants that automatically engage and qualify inbound leads across email, SMS, web chat, and WhatsApp. Its AI agents respond to prospects 24/7, qualify them, and book sales appointments so human teams focus on closing. SalesAPE connects to CRMs and automation tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and Zapier (100+ integrations), logging and summarizing conversations back into the CRM. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass SalesAPE publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI; it exposes a customer app, a hosted status page, and standard legal pages. Sector: enterprise; AI.

providers.name: Semasio
providers.description: Semasio is a Hamburg, Germany advertising-technology company whose semantic targeting platform builds audience, contextual and brand-fit segments for brands, agencies and DSPs across roughly 30 languages and 50 countries. Founded in 2010, it was acquired in 2022 by Casters Holdings, Inc. operating under the Fyllo brand; the combined business traded as Fyllo|Semasio, rebranded to Semasio in April 2024, and was acquired by Samba TV on 31 October 2024. Products include Audience Targeting, Audience Extension, Contextual Targeting, ContextualPLUS, Brand Fit, Interactive Screens, HypertailPMP and the Semasio Factory data onboarding and modeling service. Semasio operates a login-only platform (uip.semasio.net) behind an authentik single sign-on host and publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Simplyinsured
providers.description: SimplyInsured is a small-business health insurance brokerage and online enrollment platform. It aggregates medical, dental, and vision plans from major carriers, provides unbiased plan recommendations, and lets small employers compare, quote, and enroll their teams entirely online at no cost to the business. Founded in 2012 and backed by Y Combinator, SimplyInsured is frequently embedded as the health-insurance offering inside partner payroll and HR platforms. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing web application and a support/help surface but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Skello
providers.description: Skello is a European (French) workforce management SaaS for shift-based businesses in retail, hospitality, restaurants, and health. It provides employee scheduling and shift planning, time and attendance tracking, absence and leave management, labor-cost and legal-compliance controls, team communication, and payroll preparation exports. Skello is a Partech portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Skello publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or status page; integrations are delivered through its own partner program rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: SlashNext
providers.description: SlashNext is an AI-native phishing and social-engineering threat detection company founded by Atif Mushtaq (an architect of FireEye's core malware sandbox). Its Real-Time Phishing Threat Intelligence is delivered through the SlashNext On-demand Threat Intelligence (OTI) REST API at oti.slashnext.cloud, which offers URL and host reputation lookups, real-time cloud SEER-engine URL scanning in both asynchronous and blocking modes, and forensic downloads (screenshot, HTML, and rendered text) keyed by scan id, plus per-tenant API quota status. Responses are available as JSON, CSV, or plaintext and every request authenticates with a per-tenant API key passed as the authkey parameter. SlashNext was acquired by Varonis Systems in August 2025 and its detection capabilities are being integrated into the Varonis Email Security and MDDR platform.

providers.name: Spectinga
providers.description: Spectinga is an online marketplace for buying and selling agricultural and construction machinery. It offers dealer‑only prices, vetted trader access, inspection services, logistics handling, and dedicated support. Users can browse exclusive stock, make offers, and have machines delivered worldwide. The platform emphasizes transparent pricing, no hidden fees, and a secure transaction process.

providers.name: SquareTrade (Allstate)
providers.description: SquareTrade, an Allstate company, provides consumer product protection plans and extended warranties for smartphones, electronics, appliances, furniture, and other goods, marketed in North America as Allstate Protection Plans. It serves more than 140 million customers through partnerships with major retailers and mobile carriers across the US, Europe, Japan, and Australia, handling plan registration, claims filing, same-day repairs, and in-home service. SquareTrade was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its digital surface is consumer- and partner-facing (plan portal, claims, partnerships).

providers.name: Syneos Health
providers.description: Syneos Health is a fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization (contract research and commercial services) headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina. It runs a WSO2 API Manager gateway at api.syneoshealth.com, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable contract; integrations are scoped inside customer engagements.

providers.name: Think Parametric
providers.description: Think Parametric is an online learning platform for architecture, engineering, and design professionals, offering expert-led courses and professional certifications in computational and parametric design tools including Rhino, Grasshopper, Revit, Dynamo, SketchUp, and V-Ray. Membership plans give individuals and organizations access to a library of 60+ courses taught by practitioners from leading firms such as SOM, BIG, Gensler, AECOM, and Arup, alongside community forums, downloadable assets, and progress tracking. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Truehold
providers.description: Truehold is a St. Louis, Missouri-founded residential real estate company that buys homes from owners and rents them back to those same owners through a residential sale-leaseback, letting a homeowner convert home equity into cash without moving. Launched in 2021, the company expanded across the Midwest and into the South and Southwest, and in 2025 added Truehold Financial, a Jacksonville, Florida-based lending arm offering DSCR loans, fix-and-flip financing and other investor lending products. Truehold also transacts portfolio sales and multifamily sales with real estate investors. Its public surface is a marketing and lead-generation website plus two authenticated web applications for customers and borrowers; it publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Turing Labs
providers.description: Turing Labs (turingsaas.com) is a product-led growth platform for consumer packaged goods companies. Its "Growth OS" helps CPG and consumer-product teams pressure-test which product bets will win before spending, perfect formulations, and fund launches from recovered margin, consolidating product development, formulation R&D, and go-to-market decisioning into a single engine rather than a stack of disconnected tools. The company is backed by Insight Partners and Menlo Ventures. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; the product is delivered through a login-gated web application at app.turingsaas.com.

providers.name: UL Solutions
providers.description: UL Solutions is a global leader in applied safety science, providing testing, inspection, certification, advisory, and software solutions to help customers innovate safely, demonstrate compliance, and bring trusted products to market. The company offers software products such as ULTRUS and ComplianceWire, customer portals (myUL, Product iQ), and the Marks and Labels Hub. UL Solutions does not currently expose a public developer-facing API portal with open documentation.

providers.name: Valence Discovery
providers.description: Valence Discovery is an AI-first drug discovery company, now operating as Valence Labs, the AI research engine of Recursion. Formed from the merger of Datamol and InVivo AI, the team builds machine-learning methods and foundation models for molecular design, cellular perturbation prediction, and biological discovery, trained on petabyte-scale phenomics and transcriptomics data. Rather than a public REST API, Valence's developer surface is a suite of first-party open-source Python libraries - datamol, molfeat, graphium, SAFE and OpenQDC - published under the datamol-io and valence-labs GitHub organizations for cheminformatics, molecular featurization, graph neural networks and ML-ready quantum datasets.

providers.name: Ventura
providers.description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It reads inbound requests in any format - emails, PDFs, images, and phone calls - matches products against the customer's catalog, drafts a quote or order for a sales rep to review and approve, and pushes the approved result into the customer's ERP, with sales intelligence and a phone agent that transcribes rep calls and creates the resulting quote or order. Ventura plugs into the ERP and CRM a distributor already runs, follows the team's documented procedures, and learns from every correction. Ventura (formerly Autola) is operated by Gradient Ascent Labs, Inc., a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company based in San Francisco founded by Swen Koller and Jack Collins. As of 2026-08-14 the company publishes a marketing website and a privacy policy only: no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, OpenAPI, MCP server, or agent card was found on any Ventura host, and the customer application at app.ventura.ai redirects every path to a login.

providers.name: Vervoe
providers.description: Vervoe is an AI-powered skills assessment and skills-based hiring platform. Employers build their own assessment content or select from a public Assessment Library - assessments can include video, spreadsheets, presentations, and code challenges that simulate real work - then invite candidates and let Vervoe's AI grade and rank them by predicted on-the-job performance in "Talent Trials". The Vervoe API is a partner/integration REST API, accessed over HTTPS, that lets an external system (typically an ATS or internal hiring dashboard) list an employer's assessments, invite candidates to complete an assessment, retrieve candidate assessment reports and scores, and receive real-time report notifications through a signed webhook. API access is provisioned by Vervoe - partners contact sales to set up credentials. Detailed REST endpoint paths are not published in the public documentation, so the logical APIs below are modeled from Vervoe's documented Example Scenarios and webhook reference.

providers.name: Web3 Foundation
providers.description: Web3 Foundation is a Swiss nonprofit founded in 2017 by Gavin Wood that funds research and development teams building the foundation of a decentralized web (Web3). It stewards and supports the Polkadot and Kusama networks, operates a research hub and an education/wiki program, and historically ran the Web3 Foundation Grants Program (now discontinued) to seed open-source software and protocol research. It is a funding and research organization rather than a traditional API provider: it publishes no public REST/OpenAPI surface, but does maintain an RFC 9116 security.txt and a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program.

providers.name: 3ammiya
providers.description: 3ammiya is an online Egyptian Arabic dictionary and slang platform that crowdsources word meanings, expressions, and colloquial phrases. Users can submit new words, browse trending and latest entries, and explore definitions in both Arabic and English. The site offers social media integration, community contributions, and a searchable database of everyday language used across Egypt.

providers.name: 402MCP.org
providers.description: 402MCP.org is the open registry for agentic commerce and HTTP 402 payment solutions. It provides a platform where autonomous AI agents can discover, compare, and integrate self‑custodial payment rails. The site lists solutions, offers documentation, an llms.txt index, and exposes an OpenAPI specification for its MCP API, enabling developers to build and interact with payment endpoints designed for AI-driven transactions.

providers.name: 7 Chord
providers.description: 7 Chord is a New York-based financial technology company providing AI-driven, real-time pricing and analytics for fixed income (corporate bond) markets. Its flagship engine, BondDroid, ingests 100 million-plus data points per day - firm and indicative quotes, post-trade prints, and macro and country risk factors - and distills them into risk-neutral bid, ask, and mid prices, yields, and option-adjusted spreads, including for thinly traded bonds. Founded in 2017, 7 Chord delivers BondDroid pricing in streaming, delayed, and historical bulk formats, and can run behind a client's firewall so proprietary data never leaves their environment. Its pricing powers platforms including Broadridge's LTX, TS Imagine, and PortfolioBI, and is distributed through partners such as Bonds.com and Dewey Data.

providers.name: AccuVein
providers.description: AccuVein, Inc. is a Medford, New York medical device manufacturer that builds handheld, near-infrared (NIR) vein visualization systems used by clinicians for peripheral vascular access. Its AV500 and AV600 devices project a real-time green image of superficial vasculature onto the surface of the skin, letting nurses and phlebotomists see veins, valves and bifurcations that are not visible to the naked eye before a needle stick. The company sells into acute care, non-acute care and aesthetics, and supports the product line with published instructions for use, product manuals, troubleshooting guidance and a knowledge center. AccuVein is a hardware business: as of this profile it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Aerial Partners
providers.description: Aerial Partners (株式会社Aerial Partners, Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo) builds digital-asset accounting, tax and data-management software for the Japanese market. Its current product line is AWA (Aerial Web3 Accounting), an accounting-support tool for Web3 businesses handling crypto assets and NFTs, and ADM (Aerial Data Management), a management-accounting and statutory-ledger data platform for crypto-asset exchange operators and Type I financial instruments business operators. The company also resells Lukka Insights, the crypto data platform of its parent, Lukka, which acquired Aerial Partners in January 2025. Aerial Partners originated Gtax, the consumer and tax-accountant crypto profit-and-loss calculator, and Guardian, its tax-filing support service; both moved to 株式会社Gtax, which pafin acquired in July 2026 and is folding into Cryptact on 5 October 2026. Aerial Partners publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract: the only API it markets is the "Gtax Network API", a joint-development BtoBtoC offering for exchange operators reachable only through the corporate inquiry form.

providers.name: AgentiScript
providers.description: AgentiScript provides an open visual language for the agentic economy, enabling shared meaning for concepts, ideas, processes, and relationships. It offers tokenization and agentification to give digital form and precise identity to intangible assets, supporting both humans and AI agents to discover, understand, and use them together. The platform is built as a public good, integrating with the XRP Ledger for payments while remaining open and extensible.

providers.name: Amedisys
providers.description: Amedisys, Inc. is a United States home health, hospice, palliative and high-acuity in-home care company headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Founded in 1982, it delivers skilled nursing, physical and occupational therapy, medical social work, hospice and palliative care through a nationwide network of care centers, and — through Contessa, an Amedisys company — hospital-level and skilled-nursing-level care delivered in the patient's home in partnership with health systems and payers. Formerly listed on Nasdaq as AMED, Amedisys was acquired by UnitedHealth Group's Optum in a $3.3 billion all-cash transaction that closed in August 2025 after a Department of Justice settlement requiring the divestiture of 164 home health and hospice locations; it continues to operate under the Amedisys brand. Amedisys publishes no public API: there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, gRPC or SOAP contract, no SDK on any package registry, no MCP server and no A2A agent card. Clinical data moves between Amedisys, its referral sources, its EHR vendors and payers under HIPAA business-associate agreements and bilateral integration contracts rather than through a documented public interface.

providers.name: App-CM
providers.description: App-CM, Inc. (株式会社アップシーエム) is a Tokyo-based technology company that operates a proprietary video-advertising delivery platform for smartphones, using in-house compression, delivery, and targeting-algorithm technology to serve video ads smoothly in mobile environments. App-CM also develops and publishes consumer mobile apps including FriendQuiz, SunQ, and Shakin. The company is backed by 500 Global and is profiled in the API Evangelist network. It ships a publisher-side iOS/Android video ad SDK, but distributes it only through a sales conversation: there is no public API, developer portal, SDK download, package-registry release, or machine-readable specification, and every /.well-known/ discovery path returns 404. This profile captures its identity, commercial model, and security posture.

providers.name: Apphive
providers.description: Apphive is a no-code, AI-assisted platform for building native iOS and Android mobile applications without writing code. A visual drag-and-drop editor with live phone previews lets makers assemble screens and app logic, add native device capabilities (GPS and maps, push notifications, camera, authentication, databases, in-app purchases), connect third-party APIs and payment gateways such as Stripe and Openpay, and then compile and publish finished apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play. Vertical marketplace templates cover delivery, taxi, e-commerce, real estate, gym management, and more. Apphive is backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aramya
providers.description: Aramya is a direct-to-consumer (D2C) women's ethnic wear brand from India, operated by DSLR Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Founded by Ankush Goyal, Aramya sells premium cotton kurtas, kurta sets, bottoms, dresses, co-ord sets, and dupattas with a strong focus on inclusive sizing (XS to 10XL) and affordable, comfortable everyday, office, and occasion wear. The brand runs on a Shopify-based storefront at aramya.in with weekly launches, cash on delivery, and free returns, and has raised multiple rounds (seed, pre-Series A, and an ~INR 80 Cr Series A) co-led by Accel India and Z47 (formerly Matrix Partners India). Aramya is a consumer retail brand and does not publish a public developer API; it does publish an llms.txt describing its shopping surface for AI assistants.

providers.name: Artificiallabs
providers.description: Artificiallabs is an AI‑powered coding platform that automates software development. It provides an autonomous AI engineer named Lloyd that writes, runs, tests, and validates code in real cloud VMs, delivering live proof of functionality. Users interact via a chat‑like interface to describe features, bugs, or refactors, and watch the AI build and verify the solution, with support for web‑based IDE, LLM Lab, and integration tools.

providers.name: Aspect Health
providers.description: Aspect Health is a digital health company offering a science-backed program for women managing PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome). Its PCOS program combines continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), personalized coaching from board-certified health coaches, at-home lab testing for inflammation, hormonal, cardiovascular, and metabolic markers, and the Aida AI dietitian, all delivered through a mobile app. Additional programs cover weight loss, general women's health, and a 21-day check up, with HSA/FSA-eligible plans. Aspect Health is a Techstars-backed company and operates as a consumer (B2C) health platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: Astrobotictechnology
providers.description: Astrobotic Technology is a Pittsburgh‑based space robotics company that contracts payloads for lunar missions. It offers customers the ability to configure missions, reserve flight slots, and access technology for delivering payloads to the Moon. The firm provides services ranging from mission planning to hardware integration, aiming to enable scientific and commercial exploration of lunar space.

providers.name: Auranetworksystems
providers.description: Auranetworksystems, operating as AURA Network Systems, provides aviation communications infrastructure and services for both crewed and uncrewed aircraft. Leveraging licensed aviation spectrum, the company delivers secure, reliable voice and data solutions to enable advanced autonomy and FAA‑compliant operations across the National Airspace System. Their offerings include spectrum management, ground and airborne radio systems, and a nationwide network supporting BVLOS missions and other advanced aviation use cases.

providers.name: AvantStay
providers.description: AvantStay is a technology-enabled luxury vacation rental management and hospitality company operating professionally designed short-term rental homes built for group travel across premium destinations throughout the United States. Beyond curated beachfront villas, desert estates, and mountain cabins, AvantStay runs a full-service homeowner property-management program through its Lighthouse owner portal, a 24-hour guest concierge, and a real-estate brokerage for buyers acquiring investment vacation homes. It is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass AvantStay publishes a consumer booking website and homeowner portal but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Bacon
providers.description: Bacon develops a gig‑work app that connects established businesses to local gig workers. The platform allows businesses to post shifts and workers to find and accept them, featuring rating, reviews, and flexible staffing across multiple industries. Founded in 2018 and based in Provo, Utah, Bacon aims to simplify on‑demand temp labor for both employers and employees.

providers.name: Bamboo Health
providers.description: Bamboo Health (formerly Appriss Health + PatientPing) is a healthcare technology company delivering Real-Time Care Intelligence across the physical and behavioral health continuum. It operates one of the nation's largest care-collaboration networks, connecting health systems, health plans, pharmacies, and state agencies through prescription drug monitoring (PDMP), care coordination, and behavioral healthcare navigation. Flagship solutions include Bamboo Bridge, OpenBeds, Pings, NarxCare, and the PMP AWARxE state monitoring platform. Backed by Insight Partners, the company supports over a billion patient encounters annually. Bamboo Health does not publish a public developer API; integrations are delivered through EHR workflows and partner/state programs. Security posture is documented in a public Trust Center (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST CSF, HIPAA, NIST 800-53).

providers.name: Bandana
providers.description: Bandana (operated by Workwise Solutions Inc.) is a two-sided marketplace and job-search platform for hourly and entry-level workers. Job seekers get free tools to find better-paying local jobs with benefits, generate resumes, auto-match to openings via Bandana Apply, and track applications; employers post jobs for free, reach local talent, promote listings across social platforms, and use a built-in ATS or integrate their existing hiring flow. Backed by Craft Ventures and General Catalyst, Bandana operates across California, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Chicago, and Washington, D.C. As of this profile Bandana publishes no public developer/API surface — no docs portal, OpenAPI, GitHub organization, or /.well-known discovery documents were found; this record captures its public identity and product links.

providers.name: Banyansoftware
providers.description: Banyan Software is a global acquirer and permanent operator of vertical market software (VMS) businesses, headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Built as an "evergreen" alternative to private equity, Banyan buys profitable, growing enterprise software companies that hold dominant positions in niche markets (typically $2M-$30M in annual revenue) and holds them for the long term rather than reselling. It has acquired 100+ companies across sectors including healthcare IT, education, manufacturing, broadcast, public sector, and fintech, and supports them through a Growth Ops team spanning AI, talent, sales and marketing, payments, product, finance, cybersecurity, and legal. Banyan Software is a holding/operating company and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Benchlight
providers.description: Benchlight is a website builder and host for small businesses: a free website made with the free starter or in Claude at a benchlight.page address, a full website built for you with a .com included, redesigns of the website you have, and hosting on your own domain.

providers.name: Biofourmis
providers.description: Biofourmis is a health technology company founded in 2015, with offices in Boston, Singapore and India, that partners with health systems, hospitals, payers and life science companies to deliver care in the home. Its platform combines medical-grade device connectivity, FDA-cleared algorithms and digital biomarkers, a patient mobile app and clinician dashboard, and 70+ dynamic care pathways to support Hospital at Home, Timely Discharge, SNF at Home and Remote Patient Monitoring programs. Biofourmis merged with CopilotIQ in October 2024 to form an end-to-end platform for AI-driven in-home care; ActiGraph acquired the Biofourmis life science business in January 2025. The company markets EMR integration and device-agnostic connectivity to enterprise healthcare customers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: BioInteractive Technologies
providers.description: BioInteractive Technologies operates Tenzr Health, a configurable digital care layer that helps health systems, rehabilitation programs, orthopedic groups, and therapy organizations extend care beyond the clinic. The platform gives patients structured guidance, education, tasks, check-ins, and recovery support while giving clinicians better visibility into patient progress, adherence, symptoms, and recovery signals across the episode of care. Tenzr supports musculoskeletal, orthopedic, and stroke rehabilitation, acquired brain injury recovery, outpatient therapy, Remote Therapeutic Monitoring, and hybrid or virtual care pathways. The company does not currently publish a public developer API or developer program.

providers.name: Bizible Marketing Analytics
providers.description: Bizible was a B2B marketing attribution and revenue analytics platform that connected marketing activity to pipeline and revenue across advertising, web, CRM, and marketing-automation channels. Acquired by Marketo in 2018 and subsequently by Adobe, the product now ships as Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly Bizible); the bizible.com domain 301-redirects to Adobe and its product documentation has moved to the Adobe Experience League. It has no standalone public developer portal, OpenAPI, or API reference of its own — integration is handled through Adobe/Marketo Measure and CRM connectors.

providers.name: Bluestonelane
providers.description: Bluestone Lane is an Australian‑origin coffee brand operating cafés across the United States. It offers ethically‑sourced, meticulously‑roasted coffee beans, a subscription service, wholesale programs, and a loyalty app that rewards frequent customers. The company emphasizes sustainable packaging, community‑centric café experiences, and corporate coffee solutions for businesses. While it runs a robust retail e‑commerce site and provides corporate coffee services, it does not currently expose a public API for external developers. The brand focuses on quality, sustainability, and a distinctive Australian café culture brought to American neighborhoods.

providers.name: BlueTrace
providers.description: BlueTrace provides a cloud‑based platform that streamlines seafood supply‑chain operations, offering tools for inventory management, order processing, pricing, traceability, and compliance. Their solution connects distributors, processors, and retailers, enabling real‑time data sharing, automated invoicing, and analytics to improve efficiency and sustainability across the seafood industry.

providers.name: Boletia
providers.description: Boletia (Boletia Mexico SA de CV) is a Mexican event ticketing, registration, and access-management platform headquartered in Monterrey, Nuevo Leon. Event organizers use Boletia to create and promote events, sell tickets online, manage attendee registration, assign numbered seating, publish billboards (cartelera) and venue pages, and control event-day access and check-in. The platform spans concerts, comedy and stand-up, sports, expos and congresses, festivals, theater, and workshops across Mexico, and provides the payment and infrastructure backend that powers ticket sales for its event organizers. Boletia is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Branch8
providers.description: Branch8 is a digital solutions and managed contracting company headquartered in Hong Kong with operations across Asia (Singapore, Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines). Founded in 2015, it provides managed technical squads and blended onshore/offshore teams that deliver e-commerce implementation (Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, and marketplace operations on Shopee, Lazada, and Amazon), CRM and CDP strategy (Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, mParticle, Braze, Dynamics 365), digital product and mobile engineering, AI and workflow automation (n8n, Make, Windmill), and data engineering (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, Fivetran). Branch8 serves mid-market to enterprise clients including Chow Tai Fook, Chow Sang Sang, Lacoste, Hong Kong International Airport, Hotai/Toyota, and HKBN. It is a services firm rather than an API producer and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose an agent-native llms.txt describing its services.

providers.name: Breezebio
providers.description: BreezeBio (formerly GenEdit) is a South San Francisco genetic-medicine company developing precision-delivered nucleic acid therapies for autoimmune disease and oncology. Its proprietary NanoGalaxy platform uses non-lipid, hydrophilic polymer nanoparticles of tunable size, charge, and composition to selectively deliver DNA, RNA, and ribonucleoprotein payloads to specific tissues and cell types beyond the liver — including immune cells and targets in the heart, lung, and central nervous system. The company is advancing an internal therapeutic pipeline led by BRZ-101, which aims to restore immune tolerance in type 1 diabetes, and in February 2026 closed a $60M Series B backed by DCVC Bio, Sequoia Capital, and other investors. BreezeBio is a research-stage biopharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile tracks its corporate and identity surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BRT Biotechnologies
providers.description: BRT Biotechnologies advances drug discovery by providing high-quality macrocycle libraries that enable rapid identification of promising drug leads. Their platform accelerates the creation of diverse macrocycles, unlocking new possibilities for treating hard‑to‑drug targets and precision therapeutics.

providers.name: Bureau of Indian Affairs
providers.description: The Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA) is the oldest bureau in the U.S. Department of the Interior. Its mission is to enhance the quality of life, promote economic opportunity, and carry out the federal responsibility to protect and improve the trust assets of American Indians, Indian tribes, and Alaska Natives. The BIA administers services directly or through contracts, grants, and compacts with 574 federally recognized tribes serving approximately 2.5 million people. BIA publishes geospatial datasets, directories, and forms through the Indian Affairs GIS Open Data portal, the Tribal Leader Directory, and official agency websites.

providers.name: Cagent Vascular
providers.description: Cagent Vascular is a privately held endovascular medical device company based in Wayne, Pennsylvania, that develops and commercializes Serration Remodeling Therapy (SRT). Its flagship product, the Serranator PTA Serration Balloon Catheter, embeds stainless-steel serrated strips into a semi-compliant angioplasty balloon to create linear, interrupted micro-fissures along the artery wall, producing controlled lumen expansion at lower pressures when treating peripheral artery disease (PAD) and chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI). The Serranator is FDA 510(k) cleared and CE marked, and the portfolio has expanded to include Serranator SL-PRO and the Serranator SONIC intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) system. Cagent Vascular is a device manufacturer rather than a software or platform company: it publishes clinical data, case studies, webinars and reimbursement material on its website, but no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Calastone
providers.description: Calastone operates the world's largest global funds network, connecting asset managers, distributors, custodians and platforms to automate and digitalize the investment funds marketplace. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in London, it provides order routing, settlements, share-class conversions, dividends, transfers, reporting, money market services and tokenized fund distribution. More than 4,500 clients across 58 countries and territories use the network, processing over £300 billion of investment value each month. API and messaging connectivity is delivered through client onboarding rather than a public self-service developer portal. Calastone is a wholly owned subsidiary of SS&C Technologies Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: SSNC).

providers.name: Calysta
providers.description: Calysta, Inc. is a cellular agriculture company founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, with operations in Memphis, Tennessee (NouriTech), Wilton/Teesside in the United Kingdom (Calysta UK Ltd.) and Singapore (Calysta Asia Pte Ltd.). It produces protein ingredients through a patented gas-fermentation platform in which a naturally-occurring microorganism converts carbon and energy into a non-GMO single-cell protein, using no arable land and no plant or animal inputs. Its product family includes FeedKind for aquaculture and livestock, FeedKind Pet, FeedKind Net Zero and Positive Protein for human food ingredients; FeedKind Aqua is sold globally through Calysseo, a 50/50 joint venture with Adisseo whose first production plant in China manufactures thousands of tonnes per year. Calysta sells physical protein ingredients to feed and food manufacturers — its fermentation platform is industrial process technology, not commercial software — and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: CDW
providers.description: CDW is a leading multi-brand provider of information technology solutions to business, government, education, and healthcare customers. CDW offers eProcurement integration capabilities including a Catalog API, PunchOut (cXML/OCI), electronic purchase ordering, and electronic invoicing to enable procurement system integration with partners such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, and Jaggaer.

providers.name: CelLink
providers.description: CelLink (CelLink Technologies / CelLink Corporation) manufactures large-format, high-conductance flexible circuits that consolidate power, data, and sensing into thin, lightweight layers, replacing traditional wire harnesses and busbars. Its product lines are Battery Pack Interconnect, Flex Harness, and Data Center power delivery, serving automotive, aerospace, industrial, data center, and grid-storage electrification markets. Founded by CEO Kevin Coakley and VP Engineering Malcolm Brown, the company is headquartered in San Carlos, California, with sites in Georgetown, Texas; Wixom, Michigan; Hamburg, Germany; and Shanghai, China. CelLink circuits have been in electric-vehicle production since 2020. CelLink is a hardware manufacturer and publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Chaevi
providers.description: Chaevi provides comprehensive electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions, offering a network of charging stations, a mobile app for locating and managing charging, and services for property owners and businesses to install and operate chargers. The company focuses on expanding EV infrastructure across multiple regions, delivering fast charging, membership programs, and integrated payment solutions to support the growing demand for sustainable transportation.

providers.name: Clarapath
providers.description: Clarapath is a medical robotics company headquartered in Hawthorne, New York that automates the tissue sectioning step of the clinical histopathology workflow. Its FDA-registered SectionStar platform pairs patented tape-transfer sectioning with precision robotics, integrated optics and sensors, and computational quality control to turn paraffin blocks into standardized slides with quantitative quality metrics. The company also ships the TrimStar Pro trimming system, a HistoStation data repository for sample and image traceability, remote Telehistology operation, and histology consulting services for hospital, reference, and veterinary laboratories.

providers.name: Clean Air Data
providers.description: Clean Air Data provides independent air quality rankings for over 1,000 U.S. cities using EPA monitoring data from 2021‑2025.
