Users can search current AQI, view historical trends, compare cities, and access detailed PM2.5 scores and other metrics to understand local air quality conditions.

providers.name: Curbio
providers.description: Curbio is a home renovation and remodeling service that helps homeowners increase property value by managing on‑market concierge renovations. They provide a full‑service platform covering design, permits, construction, and financing, enabling sellers to showcase upgraded homes to buyers. The company operates nationwide across multiple US markets, offering services such as kitchen and bathroom remodels, exterior updates, and basic listing preparation.

providers.name: Dagangan
providers.description: Dagangan is an Indonesian tech-enabled wholesale e-commerce platform serving small and medium retailers (SMEs) in tier 3-4 cities and rural areas. Through a hub-and-spoke network of 50+ micro-warehouses across remote regions, it connects large suppliers to traditional local retailers, giving them affordable mobile access to daily necessities and groceries while reducing delivery costs and supply-chain friction. The company operates a consumer/retailer Android shopping application (Dagangan Mall), is backed by 500 Global, and is recognized as a Rural Digitalization Partner of Indonesia's Ministry of Villages, Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration. As of this profile, Dagangan publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Data I Am
providers.description: DataIAm builds Salesforce-native products that integrate and manage data for financial services customers. Its offerings include DataIAm for FSC, a core banking integration with over 200 field mappings across more than 10 objects, and DataIAm Fix & Load, an AI‑powered loader that cleans addresses, dates, phone numbers, and currencies while validating picklist values. The solutions target Salesforce users needing industry‑specific data integration and spreadsheet uploads.

providers.name: Design Patterns
providers.description: Reusable solutions to commonly occurring problems in software design, including the Gang of Four catalog (creational, structural, behavioral) and core API design patterns such as HATEOAS, idempotency keys, webhooks, and sagas.

providers.name: Design Standards
providers.description: Design Standards encompasses the frameworks, guidelines, and best practices used in product, interface, and system design to ensure consistency, usability, and accessibility. Includes API design guidelines, naming and format conventions, accessibility conformance, deprecation policy, and governance practices.

providers.name: Diigo
providers.description: Diigo is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: new-submission) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Dil Mil
providers.description: Dil Mil is a South Asian dating and matchmaking platform built to help singles find meaningful, culturally-grounded connections. Its mobile app offers matching algorithms, interest-based community chat rooms, global matching that reaches beyond geography, and a VIP Elite membership tier with premium features such as unlimited likes, rewind, and advanced filtering. The company markets itself under the tagline "Find Something Real" and highlights thousands of documented success stories among South Asian singles worldwide. Dil Mil is a consumer mobile application with no public developer or API surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking.

providers.name: Diraq
providers.description: Diraq is a quantum computing company headquartered in Sydney, Australia, with offices in Palo Alto, California and Boston, Massachusetts. Spun out of UNSW Sydney in 2022 by Professor Andrew Dzurak, Diraq builds quantum processors from silicon spin qubits — quantum information encoded in the spin of single electrons held in quantum dots formed inside structures derived from conventional CMOS transistors, so the qubits can be fabricated on standard semiconductor foundry lines. The company works with imec, NVIDIA and Quantum Machines, has advanced through DARPA's utility-scale quantum computing initiative, and targets a first commercial processor toward the end of the decade. Diraq is a pre-commercial hardware and research organization: as of this profile it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind, and its stated commercial pathway — cloud access to its processors — is still on the roadmap rather than in market.

providers.name: DistroKid
providers.description: DistroKid is a Brooklyn, New York based digital music distribution service founded in 2013 by Philip Kaplan that lets independent musicians and labels upload an unlimited number of songs and albums to Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, TikTok, Instagram, Pandora, Tidal, Deezer, and dozens of other streaming and download stores for a flat annual subscription fee while keeping 100% of their royalties. By 2020 the platform was distributing roughly a third of all new music released worldwide and serving more than two million artists; Spotify and Insight Partners both hold equity stakes following a 2021 valuation around $1.3B. Around the core distribution product DistroKid has built out a suite of artist services including Teams for automated royalty splits, cover-song mechanical licensing, YouTube Content ID monetization, DistroVid music-video distribution, Upstream label matching, Mixea AI mastering, and DistroKid Direct for fan merchandising and pre-orders. The company has historically operated without a public developer API — integrations with stores, DSPs, rights organizations, and partners are handled through private B2B arrangements, and the only public web endpoints exposed under distrokid.com/api are unauthenticated pre-save widgets used to drive Spotify follow/save campaigns. DistroKid is actively hiring API engineers to scale partner and AI-facing integrations, suggesting a more formal developer surface may emerge, but as of 2026 there is no published OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, sandbox, or developer portal. Third-party reverse-engineered wrappers such as the unofficial Golang `distrogo` library exist but are not endorsed.

providers.name: domainium-io
providers.description: Domainium.io offers a suite of domain name generation and branding tools, including bulk domain checks, price comparisons, and creative name generators for businesses, startups, podcasts, and more. The platform provides a developer portal, API access, and various utilities to help users discover and secure domain names efficiently.

providers.name: Drag Bot
providers.description: drag&bot is a web-based industrial robotics software platform for the intuitive setup, programming, and operation of industrial robots without prior robotics or coding skills. Founded in Stuttgart in 2016 and acquired by KEBA in 2021, it lets production workers assemble robot programs by dragging and dropping reusable Function Blocks. The platform is built on ROS (Robot Operating System), making it vendor-neutral across robot brands such as KUKA, ABB, Universal Robots, FANUC, Denso, Kinova, and Aubo, as well as a wide range of grippers and peripheral tools. Developers extend the platform with Python/JSON Function Blocks and ROS-based Components (hardware drivers), and integrate with factory equipment over Modbus TCP/IP and MQTT. drag&bot has been integrated into KEBA's Kemro X automation platform. Its programmatic surface is exposed as ROS services, topics, and messages rather than a public REST/HTTP API.

providers.name: Easop
providers.description: Easop is a global equity compensation platform that helps startups and growing companies award and manage employee stock options and equity incentives across 70+ countries. It automates the legal workflows, board consents, country-specific tax and regulatory compliance, and employee education required to grant equity to international teams, and offers equity projection and compensation-grid planning plus integrations with cap-table tools such as Carta and Pulley. Easop was acquired by Remote in 2024. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company; Easop is a business SaaS application and publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Eclipse Foods
providers.description: Eclipse Foods is a Berkeley, California plant-based food company making non-dairy ice cream and soft-serve engineered from cassava, corn, rapeseed, and potato to replicate the taste and texture of traditional dairy. Marketed as chef-crafted (co-founder brings 16-Michelin-Star kitchen experience) and sold in gallon tubs and soft-serve mixes to consumers and foodservice operators. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer/CPG brand with a WordPress marketing storefront and no public developer API; the profile captures its web identity, published llms.txt, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ECOVACS Robotics
providers.description: ECOVACS Robotics is a global home service robotics company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, that designs, manufactures, and sells AI-powered autonomous cleaning devices for consumer and commercial use. Its product families include DEEBOT robotic vacuum and mopping robots, WINBOT window-cleaning robots, GOAT robotic lawn mowers, ULTRAMARINE pool-cleaning robots, and the DEEBOT PRO commercial line, all managed through the ECOVACS HOME mobile app. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IDG Capital; as of this enrichment pass ECOVACS publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface — this profile captures its public web, support, and legal properties plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: ElCoach
providers.description: ElCoach (الكوتش) is a Cairo, Egypt based fitness and nutrition technology company serving the Middle East and North Africa. Its bilingual Arabic/English mobile app delivers personalized workout routines and healthy meal plans tailored to each user, combining certified trainers and nutritionists with AI-driven personalization. The product is a consumer subscription app distributed on iOS and Android with in-app payments; it does not publish a public developer API program. ElCoach is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), Endure Capital, Wise Capital, and the Misk 500 MENA and Google accelerators, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Execthread
providers.description: ExecThread is a selective, invitation-based network where successful executives discreetly share confidential, recruiter-led job opportunities with one another that are not posted on public job boards. The membership platform matches vetted senior professionals with unadvertised executive-level roles, offers executive branding services and resume review, and runs a points-based referral economy for members who contribute opportunities. Founded as a private career marketplace, it has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 and by the Financial Times. It is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it exposes no public API or developer surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Exodigo
providers.description: Exodigo is a subsurface intelligence company that maps what is underground and above ground without digging. Founded in 2021 by former Israeli intelligence officers and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, it fuses ground-penetrating radar, electromagnetic (TDEM/FDEM), magnetic gradiometry and electrical sensing with GPS-RTK positioning, then processes the combined signal with AI to produce geolocated 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations and geotechnical conditions. Products span ExoInfo remote data intelligence (AI compilation of public records, engineering documents and imagery), on-site reality capture, AI engineering and digitization, and utility relocation services. Deliverables are handed to customers as GIS and CAD artifacts (Esri ArcGIS, AutoCAD, BIM) and through a client portal rather than a public developer API — as of this profiling pass Exodigo publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK or MCP server. Customers include LA Metro, Caltrans, National Grid, VINCI Construction and state DOTs.

providers.name: ezCater
providers.description: ezCater is a corporate and workplace catering marketplace that connects businesses with a nationwide network of local restaurants and caterers. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Boston, the platform lets organizations order food online for meetings, events, and recurring team meals, and layers workplace-food management on top: meal programs, per-team and per-location spend controls, group ordering, delivery coordination, and centralized invoicing and reporting. ezCater serves companies of every size across the United States and is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. The company does not publish a public developer API; integrations are arranged through its enterprise and partner sales channels. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and trust surface.

providers.name: Fast Retailing
providers.description: Fast Retailing is a global Japanese retail holding company, best known as the parent of Uniqlo, GU, Theory, and other apparel brands. It operates a vast network of clothing stores worldwide, focusing on innovative design, high-quality manufacturing, and efficient supply chain management. The company leverages technology and data-driven strategies to enhance customer experiences and streamline operations across its brands. Fast Retailing continues to expand its international presence while maintaining a commitment to sustainability and corporate responsibility.

providers.name: FlyHomes
providers.description: Flyhomes is a Bellevue, Washington-based real estate and mortgage financial technology company whose Buy Before You Sell platform lets homebuyers purchase a new home before selling their existing one. Its products—Flyhomes Cash Offer, Instant Equity, and Guaranteed Backup Contract—turn financing into competitive cash-like offers, unlock home equity without requiring a prior sale, and reduce a buyer's debt-to-income ratio so they can qualify for larger loans and move only once. Flyhomes reaches homebuyers through a network of in-network loan officers and real estate agents and also operates an AI-powered home search portal. Flyhomes does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, discovery surface (llms.txt), and domain-security posture.

providers.name: FordPass / Ford Pro
providers.description: FordPass is Ford Motor Company's consumer connected-vehicle mobile app and service platform for Ford and Lincoln owners, exposing remote start/stop, remote lock/unlock, vehicle status (fuel/charge, tire pressure, oil life, odometer, location), Vehicle Health alerts, BlueCruise hands-free driving, Wi-Fi hotspot, Phone As A Key, scheduled service, and roadside assistance via the embedded FordPass Connect 4G LTE modem. Ford Pro is Ford's commercial fleet brand spanning Ford Pro Telematics, Ford Pro Intelligence, Ford Pro E-Telematics for EVs, Ford Pro Charging, Ford Pro FinSimple, and dealer/upfit services. The Ford Developer Marketplace (developer.ford.com) hosts Ford's partner-facing API program — FordConnect Query API for consumer-vehicle data and remote command access (with vehicle-owner consent via FordPass account OAuth), plus a Ford Pro REST API surface for fleets including Vehicle Status, Vehicle Historical Status, Vehicle Metadata, Vehicle Efficiency (fuel/energy/idle), Driver Behavior, Trip Reports, and Vehicle Health. Ford Pro Telematics is integrated with Geotab, Fleetio, Samsara, Motive, Verizon Connect, and other fleet platforms, and Smartcar offers a consumer OAuth bridge to Ford vehicles using FordPass Connect credentials. Access to Ford APIs is gated behind a partner application and credentials issued through the Ford Developer Portal; Ford has periodically restricted individual-developer access. No public OpenAPI specification is published outside the partner portal, so this profile documents the Ford developer surface as an index without a generated machine-readable contract.

providers.name: FreshToHome
providers.description: FreshToHome (Freshtohome Foods Private Limited) is a Bangalore-headquartered direct-to-consumer e-commerce company selling fresh, antibiotic-residue-free fish, seafood, poultry, mutton, ready-to-cook and heat-and-eat food. Founded in 2015 by Shan Kadavil, Mathew Joseph and Jayesh Jose, it runs its own farm-and-boat-to-doorstep cold chain, sourcing from thousands of fishermen and farmers and delivering across cities in India and the United Arab Emirates. The company sells through its website and its consumer iOS and Android apps. It publishes an llms.txt at its web root but operates no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Galvanize Therapeutics
providers.description: Galvanize Therapeutics, Inc. is a Redwood City, California medical device company founded in 2015 by Jonathan Waldstreicher, MD and William Krimsky, MD, and created and incubated by Apple Tree Partners (ATP). Galvanize develops pulsed electric field (PEF) therapies that deliver high-voltage, short-duration energy locally to alter the transmembrane potential of targeted cells, inducing non-thermal regulated cell death without denaturing cellular proteins or the extracellular matrix. Its Aliya PEF System is cleared for surgical ablation of soft tissue and is being studied in non-small cell lung cancer, while RheOx addresses chronic bronchitis in the airway. The company received FDA 510(k) clearance for the Aliya EX Generator in May 2026. Galvanize is a privately held, clinically-focused device manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Gameto
providers.description: Gameto is a female-led clinical-stage biotechnology company redefining women's health across the reproductive lifespan. Using proprietary induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) engineering, Gameto develops ovarian cell lines that mimic the biology of the female reproductive system. Its lead product, Fertilo, is an engineered line of ovarian support cells that mature immature eggs outside the body to reduce the hormonal burden of IVF and egg freezing, and is in a Phase 3 clinical trial (FIRST). Additional programs include Deovo, an organoid of the female reproductive system for drug discovery, and Ameno, a cell-based therapeutic targeting menopause and primary ovarian insufficiency. Gameto is backed by Insight Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Gameto publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Gerson Lehrman Group (GLG)
providers.description: Gerson Lehrman Group (GLG) is the world's leading platform for trusted human expertise, connecting organizations with a network of senior-level subject-matter experts to inform strategic decision-making. For more than 25 years GLG has facilitated expert calls and meetings, on-demand expert content and transcripts, quantitative and qualitative research and surveys, in-person and virtual events, and advisory and placement engagements. Its myGLG platform layers AI-powered and agentic research tools over that expert network. GLG was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. GLG operates no public developer API or documented developer program; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: GNC Holdings
providers.description: GNC Holdings, LLC (General Nutrition Centers) is an American specialty retailer of health, wellness, and performance products including vitamins, minerals, herbal supplements, sports nutrition, diet, and energy products. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, GNC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Harbin Pharmaceutical Group following its 2020 acquisition. The company operates owned and franchised retail locations, online stores, and retail partnerships across approximately 50 countries.

providers.name: Go Micro
providers.description: Go Micro is a distributed systems framework for building microservices in Go, providing service discovery, load balancing, message encoding, RPC, and async messaging out of the box.

providers.name: Gradient Health
providers.description: Gradient Health provides AI-powered decision intelligence for insurers, helping them assess risk, manage claims, and improve profitability. Their platform leverages proprietary data and machine learning to deliver real‑world outcomes, offering solutions for health, property, and casualty insurance sectors, with over 300 enterprise deployments and a 95%+ client retention rate.

providers.name: gtmhelix-com
providers.description: Helix GTM Consulting, operating under the gtmhelix.com domain, offers a suite of free go‑to‑market tools and AI‑powered assistants for founders, marketers, and sales teams. Founded in 2022 in Bengaluru, the company leverages 24+ years of B2B experience to provide tools that run in Claude, ChatGPT, or a browser, alongside consulting services. The platform includes 81 tools, 33 skills, and multiple frameworks such as EPIC, IMPACT, and CRAFT, aiming to accelerate growth and improve GTM execution.

providers.name: Harbor Lab
providers.description: Harbor Lab is an AI-powered port cost and disbursement account (DA) management platform for the maritime industry, headquartered in Athens, Greece. Its cloud software helps shipowners, ship managers, charterers, and port agents manage port calls, validate and approve disbursement accounts, benchmark and negotiate port service pricing across a marketplace of thousands of port service providers, and automate payment and settlement — improving operational efficiency, digitizing the process, and delivering cost transparency across port cost management. The company is backed by Speedinvest, VentureFriends, Atomico, and others. As of this profile Harbor Lab exposes a web dashboard product only; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: HD
providers.description: HD is an AI-native healthcare marketplace and patient-navigation platform for emerging Southeast Asia, headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Its consumer surface, HDmall, is a health, dental, aesthetics, and surgery marketplace that lets patients compare transparent pricing and book online across 30,000+ services from 3,000+ clinics and hospitals in Thailand (hdmall.co.th) and Indonesia (hdmall.id). AI-powered navigation turns patient symptoms into personalized, safety-checked care recommendations, and HDcare adds human-led, AI-assisted concierge support for complex surgical cases. The platform has navigated over 500,000 patients. HD is a consumer-facing healthtech operator with no public developer API or portal; the strongest machine-readable surface it publishes today is an llms.txt guiding LLMs to its canonical content. HD is a portfolio company of Partech, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment tracking.

providers.name: HomeLane
providers.description: HomeLane is an Indian end-to-end interior design company that delivers customized home interiors — modular kitchens, wardrobes, storage, bedroom, living room, bathroom, and home-office designs — pairing in-house digital design and 3D visualization tools with material selection and professional installation, backed by a 45-day delivery guarantee on end-to-end modular interiors. Founded in Bangalore and backed by Accel, HomeLane operates across major Indian cities through design studios, a franchise/partner network, and a customer mobile app. HomeLane currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its digital, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Houst
providers.description: Houst is a global short-term rental and Airbnb management company founded in 2015, operating in 17 cities across 8 countries and managing over 11,650 properties. Houst handles the full hosting lifecycle for homeowners and landlords - multi-platform listing creation and optimization, dynamic pricing, professional photography, 24/7 guest communication and vetting, check-in coordination, cleaning, linen and maintenance - powered by a proprietary host dashboard that tracks earnings, occupancy, bookings and performance. The company operates on a commission model and also runs an operating-partner and affiliate programme. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Huawei Cloud
providers.description: Huawei Cloud, the public cloud arm of Huawei Technologies, offers a comprehensive suite of cloud services including compute, storage, networking, AI, and big data solutions. It serves enterprises worldwide with flexible pricing, high performance, and strong security compliance, positioning itself as a major global IaaS and PaaS provider.

providers.name: Hungryroot
providers.description: Hungryroot is a personalized grocery and meal-planning service that blends meal-kit convenience with grocery-store variety. Its AI-driven personalization engine builds each customer's cart from dietary preferences, health goals, and budget, drawing on a catalog of 50,000+ recipes and curated grocery products that support high-protein, gluten-free, vegan, and other dietary needs. Hungryroot is a direct-to-consumer company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a consumer web and mobile app experience rather than a public developer platform. This profile was surfaced through the venture portfolio graph and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which probed the provider's domain and public discovery surfaces (no public API, OpenAPI, SDKs, well-known catalog, security.txt, or llms.txt were found as of this pass).

providers.name: Imbria Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Imbria Pharmaceuticals is a private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in the Boston area that is developing novel cardiovascular therapies targeting cardiac energy metabolism. Its lead candidate, ninerafaxstat, is a first-in-class partial fatty acid oxidation (pFOX) inhibitor designed to shift myocardial substrate utilization toward glucose oxidation, generating more ATP per unit of oxygen consumed and improving cardiac metabolic efficiency without affecting heart rate, rhythm, ejection fraction or blood pressure. Ninerafaxstat is in the global FORTITUDE-HCM Phase 2b trial (NCT07023614) for symptomatic non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM), which has no approved treatments, and holds FDA Orphan Drug Designation for that indication; a Phase 2b in cardiometabolic HFpEF is planned. The company is backed by RA Capital, SV Health Investors, Deep Track Capital, Catalio Capital Management, AN Ventures and Cytokinetics. Imbria is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Infomaniak
providers.description: Infomaniak is a Swiss cloud services provider offering web hosting, email, video streaming, and domain registration. Founded in 1994, it serves businesses and individuals with data centers in Switzerland, emphasizing privacy, security, and sustainability. The company provides a range of APIs for managing hosting services, email accounts, and multimedia content, supporting developers to integrate and automate their workflows.

providers.name: Intus Care
providers.description: IntusCare (Intus Care, Inc.) is a Providence, Rhode Island health technology company building an end-to-end software and services ecosystem for PACE — Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. Founded in 2019 by Brown University students Robbie Felton, Evan Jackson and Alex Rothberg, it launched population health analytics at PACE of Rhode Island in 2020 and now serves 70+ PACE organizations. Its products are CareHub, a PACE-native ONC-certified EMR and care-management platform; IRIS, a risk-adjustment and coding system for PACE and value-based care organizations; and a Population Health & Utilization Management suite delivered with fractionally-staffed Integrated Care Services clinicians. IntusCare markets interoperability and out-of-the-box third-party administrator (TPA) integrations, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract — customer-facing surfaces are the authenticated CareHub and analytics applications.

providers.name: iQIYI
providers.description: iQIYI is one of China's largest online video streaming and entertainment platforms, delivering movies, TV dramas, variety shows, animation, documentaries, and original content across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and OTT/smart-TV devices. Beyond its consumer service, iQIYI runs a SaaS / OTT developer platform that lets partners launch their own branded streaming service with a RESTful API covering Video, Channel, Album, Search, and Player resources, plus AVOD/SVOD/TVOD monetization, analytics, audience management, and DRM. iQIYI also operates the QIYU XR developer platform for VR/AR device applications and maintains an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Hongshan and has been enriched from iQIYI's public developer surface.

providers.name: Kerys
providers.description: Kerys Software is a European (Palaiseau, France) cybersecurity company behind YS::Desktop, a Type 1 hypervisor that runs multiple fully isolated environments on a single workstation. By preallocating dedicated CPU cores to the hypervisor versus VM workloads and adding hypervisor-level encryption, YS::Desktop closes VM escape and cross-VM attack vectors while sustaining roughly 92% native performance. It replaces dedicated admin machines, air-gapped OT laptops, and traditional VDI for regulated organizations in aerospace and defense, energy, finance, construction, and the public sector, with a mandatory Security Domain model (no unmanaged VMs) administered through the YAC console. The company positions around NIS2, IEC 62443, and ANSSI multi-environment workstation guidance and sells 100% through resellers. Kerys does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or pricing; it was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched here from its public site.

providers.name: Kouper Health
providers.description: Kouper Health (Kouper) is a healthcare technology company building an AI-agent orchestration layer for care navigation, deployed on top of a provider organization's existing EHR. The platform spans the full patient journey through three named agents: PRIMUS for patient access and inbound coordination (appointment scheduling, intake, insurance verification, missed-call recovery), ARCHIE for inpatient and post-acute navigation (discharge planning, home health attachment, LUPA risk), and CURA for ongoing care coordination and management (proactive outreach, reminders, check-ins, escalation). Kouper sells to health systems, independent and specialty provider groups, clinically integrated networks, risk-bearing entities, and payers, with multilingual patient engagement, human escalation, and HIPAA-compliant workflows. The company emerged from stealth in May 2025 with a $10M seed round led by General Catalyst with 25Madison and CVS Health Ventures, and operates out of New York, San Francisco, and Nashville. As of this profile Kouper publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts — the product is delivered as a managed EHR-integrated service rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Kymera Therapeutics
providers.description: Kymera Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at 500 North Beacon Street in Watertown, Massachusetts, pioneering targeted protein degradation as a way to build oral small-molecule medicines against targets that conventional inhibitors cannot reach. Rather than blocking a protein's activity, Kymera's degraders recruit the body's own protein-disposal machinery so that a binding event alone is sufficient to eliminate the disease-driving protein, an approach the company describes as a disease-agnostic modality. Its wholly-owned pipeline is led by KT-621, a once-daily oral STAT6 degrader in Phase 2 for Type 2 inflammatory diseases including atopic dermatitis, asthma, COPD and chronic spontaneous urticaria, and KT-579, a first-in-class oral IRF5 degrader in Phase 1 for lupus, Sjogren's syndrome and rheumatoid arthritis. Partnered programs include the oral IRAK4 degrader KT-485/SAR447971 with Sanofi and the CDK2 molecular glue degrader KT-200 with Gilead Sciences. Kymera publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, investor, patient and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Landmark Global
providers.description: Landmark Global provides cross‑border e‑commerce logistics, offering parcel delivery, customs clearance, fulfillment, and returns solutions across Europe, Asia, the US and Canada. Their platform integrates with merchants via APIs and a technology suite called Mercury, helping businesses expand globally with streamlined shipping and tracking services.

providers.name: Lapse
providers.description: Lapse is a London-founded consumer photo company (Lapse Ltd) whose iOS app turns an iPhone into a disposable camera - a one-tap Lock Screen shutter, a film "developing" delay, and a friends-only photo journal built on a "Friends not followers" thesis of no ads, no data sales, and no public follower counts. The app is invite and friends-gated Early Access, free to use, iOS only, and screens uploads with AI moderation; contacts are hashed and encrypted on device. Lapse is backed by Greylock, GV and Speedinvest. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or documentation as of the July 2026 enrichment pass, so this profile captures company identity, the published policy and support surface, and probed security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: LevitasBio
providers.description: LevitasBio is a Menlo Park, California life-science instrumentation company, founded in 2017, that commercializes magnetic levitation technology developed at Stanford and Harvard for label-free separation and characterization of living cells. Its LeviCell family of benchtop instruments (LeviCell 1.0, LeviCell Access 1.0, LeviCell EOS and the high-throughput LeviCell 96) suspends cells in three-dimensional space and separates viable cells from dead cells and debris without antibodies, beads or other labels. The platform is surrounded by LeviPrep tissue dissociation and nuclei extraction kits, the Nuvo automated tissue prep system, LeviSelect untouched depletion kits (tissue RBC, immune cell, mouse myelin, cell debris) and LeviMetrics, an AI-based analysis software layer that reads bright-field and fluorescence imagery captured during a run to characterize the sample. Customers use the platform for viable cell enrichment, single-cell genomics, cancer profiling and 3D culture/organoid workflows. LevitasBio sells instruments and consumables through a direct and distributor channel and, as of this profiling pass, publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Lil Snack
providers.description: Lil Snack is a Manhattan Beach, California games company, founded in 2024, that builds "snackable" daily games and party games — short pop-culture puzzle, word, and trivia titles that refresh every day. It runs its own consumer destination at lilsnack.com (Clue Daily, Scattergories Daily, Swap, DownWords, Pickle, Lite Brite Daily, Wheel of Fortune TODAY, Quiz Climb, Venn, Chain, and more) and also powers games embedded inside partner consumer platforms, citing BuzzFeed, FOX, Hasbro, the Los Angeles Times, Netflix, Peacock, Prime Gaming, Reddit, and Sony. The company reports 40M+ games played and 10M+ players all-time, and monetizes through platform partnerships, sponsorships, and brand licensing. As of this profile Lil Snack publishes NO public developer surface — no API, no documentation portal, no SDKs, no public GitHub organization, and no /.well-known documents; its partner game integrations are arranged through business development rather than self-serve APIs. This API Evangelist profile therefore captures verified company identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Loft Orbital
providers.description: Loft Orbital is a space infrastructure company operating under the banner "Space Made Simple" that integrates, launches, and operates low-Earth-orbit satellites so customers can fly physical payloads or deploy software "virtual missions" without building or operating their own spacecraft. Its Cockpit mission-control platform lets operators task payloads, monitor telemetry, and downlink data in real time through a secure web UI or an authenticated API, and a customer SDK provides frameworks, documentation, and satellite APIs (including Azure Orbital space-edge deploys) for onboard sensors and compute. The Cockpit API and developer docs are gated behind login at api.cockpit.loftorbital.com, so no public specification is available. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: MapmyIndia Mappls (C.E. Info Systems Ltd.)
providers.description: MapmyIndia Mappls (C.E. Info Systems Ltd.) provides comprehensive mapping, location intelligence, and IoT solutions across India. Their platform offers APIs for maps, geocoding, routing, traffic, and advanced services like 4D maps, drone services, and AI-driven analytics. Serving enterprises, developers, and government agencies, MapmyIndia enables integration of real‑world spatial data into applications, supporting navigation, asset tracking, and location‑based services.

providers.name: MayMaan Research
providers.description: MayMaan Research is a clean-energy engineering company that redesigns the internal combustion engine around its patented AquaStroke platform, a piston engine that runs on a blend of roughly 70% water and 30% bio-alcohol (ethanol or methanol) instead of gasoline or diesel. The company builds modular generator sets and powertrains that scale from a 35 kW unit (A35) through the AV2 to multi-megawatt installations, and it positions them as drop-in replacements for diesel gensets in power generation, EV charging infrastructure, data centers, telecommunications, marine, construction, agriculture, defense and off-grid deployments, with near-zero NOx, SOx, CO2 and particulate output. MayMaan is headquartered in Hollywood, Florida with a European office in Paris, holds engine and fuel-system patents internationally, and raised a $30 million Series A led by WAVE Equity Partners. It is a hardware manufacturer: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Microbilt
providers.description: Microbilt provides businesses with powerful alternative credit data and risk management solutions, offering APIs for identity verification, employment credit reports, skip tracing, and more. Their platform helps companies assess risk, reduce defaults, and increase profitability through reliable, frequently refreshed data delivered via robust APIs.

providers.name: Mission Lane
providers.description: Mission Lane is a consumer fintech founded in 2018 that offers the Mission Lane Visa credit card (issued by WebBank) to help millions of Americans with limited or rebuilding credit gain access to transparent, fair credit. Operating as a remote-first company backed by QED Investors, it combines modern data science and machine-learning underwriting with the discipline of an established financial institution, and partners with Plaid for open-finance connectivity. Mission Lane provides a mobile app and a web account dashboard for cardholders but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or partner API program; its engineering surface (BentoML model services, MLOps tooling) is internal.

providers.name: MKS Instruments
providers.description: MKS Instruments is a global provider of foundational technology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, electronics and packaging, and specialty industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans vacuum and gas delivery systems, photonics, lasers, optics, motion control, and process control. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically handled through product-level documentation, sales engineering, and partner channels.

providers.name: NanoLumens
providers.description: NanoLumens is an American designer and manufacturer of direct-view LED (dvLED) displays and video walls, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and founded in 2006 by Rick Cope. It builds fixed and flexible indoor and outdoor displays in custom sizes, shapes and curvatures across the Engage Pro, Engage, NXT, Nixel, NanoPanel 55, Captivate, Performance, CLRVision, CLRVU and NanoBanner product lines, together with Aurora video processing and the NanoSuite display-management software. Its displays are deployed in retail, casinos, higher education, sports and arenas, control rooms, hospitality, themed entertainment, government, corporate and transportation environments. The software side of the business — the AWARE platform and NanoSuite, powered by the ISAAC ecosystem — markets a JSON REST API and webhook-based alerting for remote diagnostics, content scheduling and display-fleet monitoring, but that API is delivered to display owners through an authenticated tenant and has no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Natural Resources Canada
providers.description: Natural Resources Canada (NRCan) is the federal department responsible for the sustainable development, management and use of Canada’s natural resources, including energy, minerals, forests, and water. It provides data, research, tools, and services to support industry, government, and the public in making informed decisions about resource stewardship, environmental protection, and economic growth. NRCan’s digital platforms offer APIs for accessing geospatial data, energy statistics, forest resources, and more, enabling developers to integrate authoritative Canadian resource information into applications and analyses.

providers.name: Neuros Medical
providers.description: Neuros Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Arden Hills, Minnesota, and the maker of the Altius Direct Electrical Nerve Stimulation System — an implantable, patient-controlled high-frequency nerve block indicated as an aid in the management of chronic intractable phantom and residual lower limb post-amputation pain in adult amputees. The system pairs a nerve cuff electrode placed around a peripheral nerve with an implantable pulse generator and a handheld patient controller, and received FDA approval in 2024 after FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and the QUEST pivotal trial. The company sells an implantable therapy to health systems, pain physicians and amputees; it operates a marketing and patient-education website and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Nuvaira
providers.description: Nuvaira, Inc. is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, founded in 2008 to treat overactive airway nerves in people living with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Its dNerva Lung Denervation System is a catheter-based, radiofrequency device used in a bronchoscopic procedure called Targeted Lung Denervation (TLD), which the FDA has designated a Breakthrough Device. The company holds more than 70 issued and pending patents worldwide, has treated over 500 patients across its AIRFLOW clinical program, and is currently running the pivotal AIRFLOW-3 trial. Nuvaira sells a regulated physical therapeutic device to hospitals and interventional pulmonologists; it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Ohmium
providers.description: Ohmium International designs, manufactures and deploys modular, vertically-stackable proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzer systems for cost-competitive green hydrogen production. Its Lotus PEM electrolyzer platform integrates power electronics, water treatment and controls into skid-mounted modules for industrial, energy and mobility customers, and is paired with EPC and remote monitoring and maintenance (RM&M) services. Ohmium is a hardware and clean-energy engineering company: it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its customer-facing monitoring and service portals are third-party SaaS products hosted on Ohmium subdomains behind login.

providers.name: Onafriq
providers.description: Onafriq (formerly MFS Africa) is a pan-African digital payments network headquartered in London with operating entities across Mauritius, Ghana, Nigeria, Tanzania, Rwanda, Uganda, the DRC, and the UK. Founded by CEO Dare Okoudjou, Onafriq operates what it calls "Africa's largest digital payments gateway" — a network of networks connecting roughly one billion mobile money wallets and 500 million bank accounts across 40+ African countries through 2,000+ cross-border corridors. The platform exposes a REST API surface for partners including Money Transfer Organizations (MTOs), Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), banks, NGOs, governments, and enterprises. Core developer products include Async Payouts (the recommended path for MTOs and bulk disbursement partners, with webhook-based status updates), Sync Payouts (custom-built for MNOs requiring synchronous responses), Sync Bank Transfers, Collections APIs (Payins) for receiving funds from cards, cash agents, and mobile wallets, a Contacts API for managing payer/payee records, a Get Rates API for daily foreign exchange rates, and Async Webhooks for Instant Payment Notifications. Two distinct portal endpoints serve domestic (api.mfsafrica.com/api) and cross-border (mfsafrica.beyonicpartners.com/api) workloads. Beyond cross-border remittance and disbursement, Onafriq operates Baxi — a Nigerian agent banking network of 460,000+ agents across all 36 states with its own Virtual Account, Fingerprint, and Account Debit APIs — plus card issuance and processing for physical/virtual prepaid programs and multi-currency treasury services. Onafriq has raised $200M+ in Series C funding from Vitruvian Partners, AXA Investment Managers, and Goodwell, and holds 16 payment licenses including FSC (Mauritius) and FCA (UK) authorization. The legacy MFS Africa developer hub (developer.mfsafrica.com) remains the canonical reference documentation, with a newer developers.onafriq.com portal reflecting the post-rebrand identity.

providers.name: Onco.com
providers.description: Onco.com is a comprehensive cancer care platform operated by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd that connects cancer patients across India with oncologists and treatment services. The platform offers priority expert oncology consultations, pan-India cancer medicine delivery at discounted rates, diagnostic testing and imaging, curated treatment packages with negotiated hospital rates, and the CanWin peer support group for survivors and caregivers. Onco.com reports a network of 400+ oncologists and 23+ treatment centers, having served more than 100,000 patients. It also publishes extensive patient-education content covering many cancer types (breast, lung, blood, prostate, colon, and others) through its About Cancer library and blog. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company; the platform is consumer/patient facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Openbridge
providers.description: Openbridge, operating under the brand Airpim, provides intelligent software solutions that transform data into a competitive advantage. Their platform offers modular, scalable components for data integration, automation, and analytics, serving various industries such as sales, production, logistics, and supervision. The company emphasizes rapid deployment, flexibility, and user-friendly interfaces to help businesses maintain clean, structured data and adapt to evolving needs.

providers.name: Opna Bio
providers.description: Opna Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on oncology, developing novel small-molecule and targeted-degrader therapeutics against key regulators of cancer, including the Hallmarks of Cancer. Its pipeline features OPN-6602 (an EP300/CBP inhibitor in Phase 1 for multiple myeloma, granted FDA Fast Track designation), zavabresib (OPN-2853, a BET inhibitor with Orphan Drug designation for myelofibrosis), multi-functional protein degraders, and additional programs targeting hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. The company operates from South San Francisco and San Diego, California, and Lausanne, Switzerland.

providers.name: Output
providers.description: Output is a Los Angeles-based music software company founded in 2013 by composer and CEO Gregg Lehrman that makes creative virtual instruments, audio effects, and a cloud-connected subscription platform for music producers, songwriters, composers, and beatmakers. Its flagship product is Arcade, a cloud-powered playable sampler and instruments plugin whose library of vocal chops, chords, melodies, basslines, loops, samples, and chromatic instruments (organized into product lines such as Hooked, Poolside, and Drip) refreshes daily. Output's catalog also includes Co-Producer, a sample-discovery plugin that finds samples that fit the current project, and the Output FX suite — Portal (granular synthesis engine), Thermal (interactive distortion engine), and Movement (rhythm engine) — alongside legacy Kontakt-based instruments such as Exhale, Analog Brass & Strings, REV, Signal, and Substance. Products are sold as one-time perpetual licenses and bundled in the Output One subscription ($14.99/month or $119.99/year) covering Arcade, Co-Producer, and the three FX plugins with all expansion packs included. Output raised a $45M Series A from Summit Partners in 2020. Products are delivered as VST3, AU, and AAX plugins (Arcade also runs as a standalone desktop app) installed via account.output.com and the Output Hub; there is no public REST API, SDK, or developer program — integration is through the industry-standard DAW plugin formats.

providers.name: Parloa
providers.description: Parloa is an enterprise conversational AI platform for contact centers that automates voice and chat customer interactions across industries including financial services, utilities, eCommerce, healthcare, media, and IT. The Parloa Agent Management Platform (AMP) supports designing, testing, scaling, optimizing, and securing AI agents that integrate with CCaaS, telephony, CRM, and ERP systems. Parloa is a sales-led enterprise product and developer access to its REST APIs and integration tooling is provided through customer and partner accounts rather than a fully public developer portal.

providers.name: Pedestal Health (formerly Target RWE)
providers.description: Pedestal Health, formerly Target RWE (and NoviSci), is a Durham, North Carolina real-world evidence and health-data company serving life sciences organizations and health systems. It generates regulatory-grade real-world evidence from large-scale observational data and longitudinal patient cohorts across hepatology, dermatology, and gastroenterology (including the TARGET-NASH, TARGET-Derm, and TARGET-Gastro registries), supporting clinical development, regulatory strategy, and care delivery. The company operates as a data, research, and services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched from the company's public website (targetrwe.com now redirects to pedestalhealth.com).

providers.name: Peel Therapeutics
providers.description: Peel Therapeutics is an evolutionary-medicine biotechnology company headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, with research teams in the United States and Israel. Co-founded in 2015 by pediatric oncologist Dr. Joshua Schiffman, the company translates molecules that evolution has already validated in nature into therapeutics for patients with cancer and inflammatory disease. Its founding program is built on elephant p53 (EP53) — elephants carry roughly forty copies of the p53 tumor-suppressor gene against the human two — delivered as liposomal protein nanoparticles, alongside PEEL-224, a TOP1 inhibitor in clinical development. Discovery runs on the company's proprietary, internal Darwin.AI platform and the Darwin Biobank, a comparative-oncology sample collection. Peel is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Pindrop Security
providers.description: Pindrop provides real‑time voice and video authentication, deepfake detection, and fraud risk assessment for contact centers and virtual meetings. Its platform combines synthetic‑engine analysis, AI‑driven voice biometrics, and multi‑signal verification to protect enterprises from AI‑generated attacks, spoofed calls, and fraudulent interactions. The company serves financial services, healthcare, insurance, and retail sectors, offering products such as Pulse, BotStopper, Protect, and Passport to secure communications and verify identities at scale.

providers.name: Pluro
providers.description: Pluro is India's fertility and IVF platform, built as a co-creation model with doctors for patients. It delivers personalised, evidence-based reproductive care through a growing network of 15+ clinics across India, combining advanced clinical science, AI-assisted embryology, standardised treatment protocols, and transparent pricing. Founded by Dr. Bhaskar Shah, Dr. Jaydeep Tank, and Dr. Parikshit Tank, Pluro raised a Rs 125 crore Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners in 2025. It offers IVF/ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, and a range of diagnostic and surgical fertility treatments. Pluro publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Polymateria
providers.description: Polymateria Ltd is a British materials-science company, based at the Imperial College I-HUB on the White City Campus in London, that develops Biotransformation — a masterbatch additive blended into polyethylene and polypropylene at roughly 2% by weight so that plastic which escapes a waste stream weathers into a bioavailable wax and fully biodegrades in the open environment without leaving microplastics behind. The company co-authored BSI PAS 9017, the first standard for measuring the biodegradability of polyolefins, is a World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer and a Terra Carta signatory, and sells to converters, brand owners and packaging manufacturers rather than to developers. Its product is a chemical additive, not software: the public website is a WordPress marketing and media site, and the only credentialed surface it operates is a customer portal that serves third-party test datasets as documents. No developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract of any kind was found in this pass.

providers.name: PromptQuick
providers.description: PromptQuick provides simple prompt rules and toolkits to help developers get better AI results. Founded in 2024, it offers a free Prompt Rulebook, a paid full version, and an AI Product Development Toolkit that generates product requirements, user journeys, and starter code for Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel. The platform includes a blog, documentation, and a signup portal, aiming to streamline AI‑assisted product creation for developers and teams.

providers.name: Q2 Software
providers.description: Q2 provides a single‑platform digital banking solution for financial institutions, including banks and credit unions. The platform offers consumer, small‑business, and commercial banking capabilities, along with fraud intelligence, risk management, and money‑movement services. Q2 also supports embedded finance products and AI‑driven tools for institutions seeking digital transformation.

providers.name: Qomplx
providers.description: QOMPLX, Inc. is a Reston, Virginia research and technology company building risk-analytics and cybersecurity products — Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) for Active Directory and cloud credentials, Managed Detection and Response (MDR), attack-surface monitoring, Active Directory security assessment, offensive security services and vCISO engagements — sold into finance, legal and insurance. Its underlying data platform, QOMPLX:OS (Q:OS), includes TimeEngine, a multi-dimensional time-series database and analytics engine that QOMPLX exposes over an HTTP and WebSocket interface. QOMPLX publishes first-party TimeEngine client libraries for Python, Java and Erlang on GitHub, but ships no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL or Postman collection, and operates no public developer portal, API reference or pricing page. As of this pass its own website has been reduced to a single-page Ghost install and every content page listed in its sitemap returns a 301 self-redirect loop.

providers.name: Qualys
providers.description: Qualys is a cloud-based security and compliance platform offering Vulnerability Management Detection and Response (VMDR), Policy Compliance, Web Application Scanning, Container Security, EDR, and Cloud Security Posture Management. The Qualys API framework exposes XML and JSON REST endpoints across platform pods (qualysapi.qualys.com, qualysapi.qg2.apps.qualys.com, etc.) for managing scans, assets, vulnerabilities, reports, and findings. Authentication supports HTTP Basic auth and JWT bearer tokens via the Qualys Authentication API.

providers.name: Roby
providers.description: Roby (Imageous, Inc.) is a Seattle-based building-management software company whose HVAC automation product connects room and space calendars with a building's BMS (building management system) to automatically switch HVAC to an unoccupied/energy-saving mode when spaces are not in use, delivering measured energy savings and extended equipment lifetime for K-12, higher-education, and office facilities without added staff effort. Roby is deployed through building system integrators (ATS, Climatec, Syserco, ABM Systems, Oprizon, NSF-E) and also offers Receptionist and Helpdesk workplace applications. The product uses Auth0-managed authentication with token-based, SSL-only API access, but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Roche
providers.description: F. Hoffmann-La Roche is a Swiss multinational healthcare company with two divisions: Roche Pharma and Roche Diagnostics. Roche does not publish a general public developer API but exposes interoperability through the navify diagnostics platform, the cobas infinity laboratory software, and an open-source GitHub presence focused on data-science tooling such as pyreadstat, foxops, and OligoGym.

providers.name: Rogo
providers.description: Rogo is a New York-based artificial intelligence company building an AI platform purpose-built for the world's leading financial institutions. Founded by Gabriel Stengel, John Willett, and Tumas Rackaitis, Rogo serves 300+ institutions and 35,000+ bankers and investors with AI agents that execute end-to-end financial workflows — producing institutional-grade Excel models, investment memos, diligence materials, and slide decks. Its platform (including the Felix assistant) integrates with firm systems (SharePoint, CRM) and financial data providers (LSEG, FactSet, Capital IQ, PitchBook, Preqin, Dow Jones, SEC filings) and is custom-deployed with enterprise-grade, single-tenant security. Customers include Truist Securities, Nomura, and Baird. Rogo raised a $160M Series D led by Kleiner Perkins. Rogo publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: Rosebud AI
providers.description: Rosebud AI is an AI-powered game creation platform that lets anyone build and deploy playable 3D games and interactive worlds from natural-language prompts, a workflow the company calls "Vibe Coding" — you describe scenes, rules, and behaviors and an AI assistant named "Rosie" writes and applies the underlying JavaScript. The platform runs on a custom engine designed for AI-era game development, featuring deterministic WASM-based physics, native real-time multiplayer, instant link-based sharing, and a built-in "Juice API" for camera effects, particle systems, and spatial audio. Founded in 2019 in San Francisco by CEO Lisha Li (Ph.D. in machine learning, UC Berkeley), Rosebud AI is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company ships a hosted consumer product and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK packages, MCP server, or developer portal.

providers.name: RS Legacy
providers.description: RS Legacy Corporation is the post-bankruptcy successor entity of RadioShack Corporation, the iconic American consumer electronics retailer founded in 1921. RadioShack filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2015, with RS Legacy Corp assuming the remaining obligations. The RadioShack brand was subsequently acquired by Unicomer Group (El Salvador-based) in 2023, which now operates the brand globally in approximately 70 countries including the United States, Canada, Europe, and Latin America. RadioShack continues to sell consumer electronics, components, batteries, cables, and accessories online at radioshack.com and through franchise locations. No public developer API is currently documented.

providers.name: Ruma Care
providers.description: Ruma Care is a healthcare software company that streamlines the prior authorization process for biologic and infusion medications in infusion clinics. Its AI-powered platform pulls patient and insurance data from electronic health records (EHRs) to identify payer requirements, auto-populates payer-specific prior authorization forms with clinical data, flags missing documentation, and then manages insurer communication and follow-up until an authorization is approved. Built by former infusion clinic staff, Ruma Care consolidates the manual portal, fax, and paper workflows behind buy-and-bill and infusion services into a single platform to reduce denials and accelerate patient access to biologics. Ruma Care is a Y Combinator-backed company. As of this profile the company exposes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Salasa
providers.description: Salasa is an end-to-end eCommerce logistics provider based in Saudi Arabia, offering 3PL fulfillment (warehouse storage, automated pick/pack/ship), hyperlocal dark stores with 2-hour delivery in Riyadh, domestic on-demand and scheduled shipping, cross-border shipping with customs clearance, and reverse logistics / return management. Its Operations Management System (OMS) provides real-time tracking, inventory management, and analytics, and it connects to major eCommerce platforms (Salla, Zid, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Amazon, Trendyol) and offers custom API integrations for merchants automating fulfillment and order synchronization.

providers.name: Saphlux
providers.description: Saphlux is a quantum dot Micro-LED (QD-MLED) display technology company founded in 2014 out of Yale University and headquartered in San Diego, California, with additional operations in China and Japan. It commercialized semi-polar (20-21) GaN-on-sapphire epitaxial wafers to address efficiency droop and the green gap in nitride emitters, and now mass-produces NPQD quantum-dot Micro-LED devices. Its product lineup spans QD-COB and QD-COB Pro Series panels for large-format commercial and home-theater displays and the T-Series monolithic full-color micro-displays for all-day wearable AR eyewear and AI smart glasses. Saphlux is a semiconductor materials and display-module manufacturer that sells hardware to OEMs and display integrators; it publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: Scape
providers.description: Scape (Scape Wellness) is an on-demand wellness technology platform in Latin America that lets customers book professional spa experiences delivered to their home, apartment, hotel, Airbnb, office, or corporate event. Certified, identity-verified therapists arrive with all required equipment — professional massage table, towels, oils, and materials. The catalog spans relaxing, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, lymphatic drainage, reflexology, and couples massages; facials; body treatments; and combined facial-plus-massage experiences, alongside personal and corporate gift cards and workplace wellness programs. Scape operates in Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and the Dominican Republic via iOS and Android apps, with payments through MercadoPago and PayPal. It is a consumer booking platform and does not publish a public developer API or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Scimplify
providers.description: Scimplify is a Bengaluru-based advanced specialty chemicals company that combines deep chemical expertise, software, and global manufacturing capacity to make complex chemical supply predictable at scale. Founded in 2023, it operates as a contract research (CRO) and contract manufacturing (CMO) organization across the specialty-chemicals lifecycle, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flavors & fragrances, industrial, beauty & personal care, food & nutrition, dyes & pigments, oleochemicals, flame retardants, and critical-metals industries. Its integrated Scinode platform, IONS R&D and ATOMS manufacturing ecosystems, and Scira AI agentic layer coordinate discovery, sourcing, and production. Scimplify publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web, content, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sensorum Health
providers.description: Sensorum Health is a healthcare technology company that provides home-based, fully passive sensor technology and integrated clinical services to identify and triage the earliest signs of health decline in older adults living with chronic conditions. The platform monitors patients 24/7 in their own homes without requiring wearables, smartphones, or WiFi, then coordinates clinical interventions when concerning health patterns emerge — with the goal of preventing avoidable hospital admissions. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). Added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; no public API, specification, or developer program has been published as of this profile.

providers.name: Seso
providers.description: Seso is an all-in-one employee management platform built for U.S. agricultural operations, serving customers across all 50 states including 35 of the top 100 agricultural employers. Its software combines a modern farm HR system, compliant digital onboarding (I-9/W-4 with direct E-Verify integration), H-2A visa filing and compliance backed by legal resources, self-serve and managed payroll, and digital paycards for paycheck delivery. Seso also provides H-2A worker services such as consulate scheduling, recruiting, and logistics coordinated from its Monterrey, Mexico office. Backed by Bond Capital and Index Ventures. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Signal Sciences
providers.description: Signal Sciences is a web application and API protection (WAAP) company whose Next-Gen Web Application Firewall (WAF) and Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) defend web apps, APIs, and microservices against the OWASP Top 10, account takeover, and malicious bots without the tuning burden of legacy WAFs. Founded in 2014 by Andrew Peterson, Nick Galbreath, and Zane Lackey and backed by CRV, Index Ventures, and others, Signal Sciences was acquired by Fastly in October 2020 for approximately $775M and is now sold as the Fastly Next-Gen WAF. The product retains its own control plane and REST API at dashboard.signalsciences.net/api/v0, which remains live for existing customers and lets developers programmatically manage corps, sites, requests, events, custom signals, rules, redactions, lists, rate-limited sources, thresholds, virtual patches, and workspace alerts. Product documentation now lives on the Fastly developer documentation site.

providers.name: Silent Eight
providers.description: Silent Eight is an AI-driven financial crime compliance (FCC) technology company founded in Singapore in 2015 and operating globally. Its flagship platform, Iris 7, delivers policy-bound agentic AI that replicates the investigative judgement of experienced compliance analysts, executing explainable, auditable decisions across sanctions screening, anti-money laundering, transaction monitoring, fraud, trade surveillance and complex customer due diligence. Iris 7 is composed of AI Agents by capability (Customer Screening, Payment Screening, Transaction Monitoring, Risk Data Manager, Adverse Media, Case Manager) plus pre-built and custom agents, and is deployed as a governed decision layer on top of existing screening and monitoring systems via managed service, customer cloud, hybrid or on-premise infrastructure. In production with Tier 1 institutions since 2018, including HSBC, Standard Chartered, Emirates NBD and First Abu Dhabi Bank. Silent Eight publishes no public developer program: the platform is delivered under enterprise contract and integrated into each institution's tenant, so no machine-readable API contract is published to the open web.

providers.name: Simbel
providers.description: Simbel is a Paris-based HR technology company (founded 2021, backed by Speedinvest) offering a smart, unified training management suite that combines a Training Management System (TMS) and a Learning Management System (LMS) in one platform. It helps HR and L&D teams automate the full training lifecycle, from need assessment and request approvals through session organization, e-learning delivery, real-time reporting, and legal compliance (BPF, Qualiopi, BDES). Simbel connects to major HRIS and learning tools such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Lucca, Payfit, BambooHR, 360Learning, and Docebo through pre-built integrations. As of this enrichment pass Simbel publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connectors rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: SLB (Schlumberger)
providers.description: SLB (Schlumberger) is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The SLB (Schlumberger) API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Spark Car Wash
providers.description: Spark Car Wash is an express-tunnel car wash operator running a network of high-throughput drive-thru locations across New Jersey, Pennsylvania and New York. The company pairs a conveyorized tunnel — neoglide washers, custom non-acidic cleaning formulas, high-intensity dryers, and a closed-loop water reclamation and filtration system — with self-service "Spark Park" terminals offering multi-nozzle vacuums, anti-scratch towels and automated mat cleaners. Revenue is driven by unlimited-wash memberships sold in Standard, Select and Signature tiers, with additional-vehicle discounts, alongside single-wash purchases. Membership signup and account management run on a third-party hosted portal rather than a Spark-operated application. Spark Car Wash is a physical services operator: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Spinny
providers.description: Spinny (Valuedrive Technologies Ltd.) is an India-based online marketplace for buying and selling used cars. Every Spinny Assured car undergoes a 200-point quality check and comes with a 1-year warranty, a 5-day money-back guarantee, and hassle-free RC ownership transfer. The platform also offers instant online car valuation, doorstep evaluation, used-car finance and EMI, car insurance, RC transfer, scrap-car service, e-Challan and RTO lookups, servicing, the Spinny Max luxury tier, and a Partners auction platform for dealers. Backed by Accel and General Catalyst. Spinny publishes a consumer web experience and an llms.txt for AI agents but does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Squid
providers.description: Squid provides a model repository for power‑system planning, enabling engineers and agents to validate, analyse and publish interconnected models, scenarios and decisions. Backed by Y Combinator and partners, Squid connects tools like PowerFactory, PSS®E, IPSI, CYME and ETAP into a governed source, improving grid planning efficiency and transparency.

providers.name: Swing Therapeutics
providers.description: Swing Therapeutics is a San Francisco digital therapeutics company founded in 2019 that develops evidence-based, smartphone-delivered treatments for chronic illness. Its lead product, Stanza, is a 12-week prescription digital therapeutic delivering Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) for the management of fibromyalgia symptoms in adults, and in 2023 it became the first digital therapeutic to receive FDA De Novo marketing authorization for that indication. Stanza is prescribed by clinicians and dispensed to patients as a native iOS/Android application; the company also operates Swing Care, a virtual fibromyalgia clinic offering physician visits, medication management and coaching. Swing Therapeutics and Swing Care were acquired by XRHealth in July 2026. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification — its software is delivered exclusively as a regulated end-user therapy, and it is an API consumer (its clinical operations run on the Healthie EHR API) rather than an API provider.

providers.name: SylloTips
providers.description: SylloTips is an enterprise AI platform, founded in Italy and backed by Techstars, that adds a continuous-improvement and reliability layer on top of RAG chatbots and planning agents. It captures a company's undocumented, expert knowledge through human-in-the-loop validation, turns validated expert answers into governed, reusable memory, and monitors AI agents for silent failures — confidently wrong answers, outdated citations, and unadmitted knowledge gaps — routing issues to the right experts. The platform is optimized for Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise identity, ships native connectors to existing tools and data systems, and integrates with 200+ apps via Zapier, AWS, and Pabbly Connect. SylloTips publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration is delivered through those connectors and its Microsoft 365 / Teams application rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Synapsor
providers.description: Synapsor (legal entity Ottai Technology (Wuxi) Co. Ltd.) is a Chinese medical-device company based in Wuxi, Jiangsu that develops AI-powered, medical-grade smart wearable devices. Its flagship product is the Ottai continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system - a waterproof, calibration-free wearable sensor paired with a mobile app and AI assistant for 24/7 glucose tracking and diabetes management, sold in China and internationally via ottai.com. Investors include Qiming Venture Partners, Huatai Zijin Investment, Wuxi Industry Development Group, YuanBio Venture Capital, and Shunwei Capital. Synapsor publishes no public developer API, portal, or machine-readable API specifications as of July 2026.

providers.name: Synyi
providers.description: Synyi (森亿智能 / Shanghai Synyi Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Shanghai-based medical artificial-intelligence company founded in April 2016 that builds AI and big-data systems for hospitals. Its platform uses medical natural-language processing, large-scale medical knowledge graphs and multi-agent LLM applications to normalize and mine the unstructured clinical records held in Chinese hospital information systems, and sells that capability as deployed hospital software spanning clinical decision support, medical-record quality control, hospital operations management, an AI-driven clinic model and clinical research tooling. IDC's "China Healthcare Big Data Solution Market Share, 2023" ranked Synyi first in its market. Synyi publishes no public API, no developer portal and no machine-readable contract; its products are enterprise systems deployed inside customer hospitals and reached through a direct sales motion.

providers.name: Tembo Health
providers.description: Tembo Health is a telemedicine practice (founded 2018) that partners with skilled nursing facilities and senior living communities to deliver 24/7 virtual specialty and urgent care to elderly residents. Its board-certified clinicians provide treat-in-place emergency medicine, psychiatry, cardiology, and dementia care, reducing avoidable ER transfers by roughly 75 percent, and the company works with senior-care operators and EHR platforms such as PointClickCare. Tembo Health is a healthcare services provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Terremoto Biosciences
providers.description: Terremoto Biosciences is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, building a covalent drug discovery and development engine around lysine-based covalency. Founded in 2022 by veterans of Principia Biopharma and backed by OrbiMed and Third Rock Ventures across Series A ($75M), Series B ($175M) and Series C ($108M) financings, the company designs highly selective small-molecule medicines aimed both at improving on known drug targets and at reaching targets previously considered undruggable.
